title.title: Robert passion for the sea, accompanying  his father on a fishing (Eng - Esp)
title.body:
>

**<center>INGLÉS</center>**




On one of the many fishing trips Robert took with his father, he was bitten by a fish. They were in the boat, as usual, and Robert kept asking his father to slow down so he could put his hand in the water to \

the fish, as he called it, to touch the water and feel the drops on his skin. That day, a curious fish bit his finger. This was enough to make Robert abandon his wonderful adventures at sea. Every trip had been a fun experience, one in which he imagined himself as a sailor on a great ship, traveling the seas and learning about different cultures around the world. When he finished his university studies, his elderly father lay in bed, weak and with difficulty walking. While repairing one of the nets, he didn't see a hook, accidentally stepped on it, and it became embedded in his toe. He spent several months recovering before he could walk again. Seeing his father in this situation, Robert remembered all the adventures they had shared at sea. Each trip was a beautiful memory alongside his beloved father, who had allowed him to dream and, with much effort and the support of his parents, to become a professional. He had known this since he was very young: he would be a sailor, and he had achieved it.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** En uno de los tantos viajes donde Robert acompañó a su papá a la jornada de pesca fue mordido por un pez, iban como de costumbre en el bote, Robert le pedía a su papá que bajara la velocidad para meter la mano en el agua acariciar los peces como él decía, tocar el agua y sentir las gotas en su piel; ese día un curioso pez le mordió el dedo, esto fue suficiente para que Robert dejara a un lado sus hermosas aventuras en el mar, cada jornada era una divertida experiencia en la cual se imaginaba siendo navegante en un gran barco recorriendo los mares y conociendo a cultura en diferentes partes del mundo. Cuando terminó sus estudios universitarios, el papá ya anciano yacía en una cama con pocas fuerzas y dificultad para caminar; mientras reparaba una de las redes no vio un anzuelo lo piso por accidente y este se le incrustó en el dedo del pie, pasó varios meses recuperándose para volver a caminar, viendo a su padre en esta situación Robert recordó todas las aventuras que vivieron en el mar, cada viaje fue una linda aventura al lado de su amado padre, que le habían permitido soñar y con mucho esfuerzo y el apoyo de sus padres lograr convertirse en un profesional, lo tenía claro desde muy pequeño, sería marinero y lo había logrado. ![cuento azul .jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqDj63xx8gftmfqeQzyQnwjN4UMDVa3F1fqXFCYAMFpnQnftWmLmNHpoAuZfVDBW1oY.jpeg)

> Upon entering the storage shed where the fishing gear was kept, he found his favorite toy: a small boat his father had lovingly crafted for his seventh birthday. This boat meant a great deal to Robert because his father had made it, and he had achieved his goal of becoming a sailor. Now, all he needed was a companion, and who better than his father for his new adventures on the high seas? They embarked on a long voyage across the Pacific Ocean, which lasted approximately seven months. It was a wonderful adventure; they visited many places. But there was something Robert still longed to do: sail again with his father, just as they had when he was a child. Upon their return, they decided to build several boats so they could go fishing or explore the coastal area of their city every weekend. With hard work and dedication, they managed to build approximately eight boats, which would be used for these adventures between father and son. Every weekend, or whenever time allowed between boat trips, Robert and his dad would embark on their fun adventure sailing the seas. This routine became a bond that united father and son every day. After five years of enjoying these adventures, Robert's father fell ill, and what he feared most came to pass: he died. Although Robert felt very sad about his father's loss, it was enough for him to go to the beach every afternoon, sit, and think about every trip and adventure he had shared with his father. Sunset was his favorite time, as it was then that they returned from their fun-filled days. When he got married, he told his wife that the sunset was like a whisper from his father, telling him he would always be with him. Then his first son, William, was born, and Roberto also taught him to enjoy life at sea. Every weekend, he would embark on an adventure with his son, exploring the sea, fishing, and telling him the funny anecdotes and stories he had shared with his grandfather. Although at first he was afraid to return to the sea because of the bad experience with the fish, his father's company on his long days at sea allowed him to resume his adventures on the beach with his father. The moments we share with our loved ones are of great value and can mark a before and after in each person's life; hence the great importance of investing time to share with the little ones at home, with the family, and creating beautiful memories.

> Al entrar al depósito donde se guardaban los herramientas para la pesca, encontró su juguete favorito, un pequeño bote que su papá había hecho con mucho amor para obsequiárselo en su cumpleaños número 7, este bote significaba mucho para Robert porque lo había hecho su papá y había logrado su meta que era convertirse en marinero, ahora solo le faltaba un compañero y quién mejor que su padre para sus nuevas aventuras en alta mar. Emprendieron un largo viaje por el océano Pacífico el cual duró aproximadamente 7 meses, fue una linda aventura conocieron muchos lugares, pero había algo que Robert aún tenía por hacer, navegar nuevamente en bote con su padre, tal como lo hacían cuando era niño; al regresar decidieron construir varios botes, para cada fin de semana salir de pesca o hacer un recorrido por la zona costera de la ciudad donde vivían, con esfuerzo y trabajo lograron construir aproximadamente ocho botes, los cuales serían usados para estas aventuras entre padre e hijo. Cada fin de semana o cuando el tiempo se los permitía por los viajes en barco, Robert y su papá emprendían su divertida aventura surcando las aguas del mar, esta rutina se convirtió en un vínculo que cada día unía al padre y al hijo, luego de 5 años disfrutando estas aventuras el padre de Roberto enfermó y lo que él más temía sucedió, partió y aunque se sintió muy triste por la pérdida de su padre, solo le bastaba con ir cada tarde a la playa sentarse y pensar en cada recorrido y aventura que vivió con su padre. El atardecer era su momento favorito, pues a esta hora regresaban de su divertida jornada. Cuando se casó le comentaba a su esposa que el atardecer era como un susurro de su padre diciéndole que siempre estaría con él, luego nació su primer hijo William, y Roberto le enseñó también a disfrutar la vida en el mar, cada fin de semana se embarcaba en una aventura con su hijo recorriendo el mar, pescando y contándole las divertidas anécdotas e historias que él compartió con el abuelo, aunque al principio tuvo miedo de volver al mar por la mala experiencia con el pez, la compañía de su padre en sus largas jornada por los océanos, le permitió retomar sus aventuras en la playa al lado de su padre, los momentos que compartimos con nuestros seres queridos son de gran valor y pueden marcar un antes y un después en la vida de cada persona, de allí la gran importancia de invertir tiempo para compartir con los pequeños en casa, con la familia y crear hermosos recuerdos. ![mixtas (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EnaYEGzK9PCvRucigGnLNa3Va8XebTDbiwSCai7jM5UUeqEF7YjoatJofDpLm5kHVQD.jpeg)

title.title: Merienda en 5 pasos. [ESP-ENG]
title.body: >Fueron días de mucho trabajo estoy feliz, de al fin tener un tiempo en crear contenido, en regresar a unos de mis pasatiempos preferidos, crear contenido para hive, estoy de vuelta con una merienda fácil de hacer, solo necesitas pan, leche, huevos y algo de fruta, unas tostadas francesas nunca caen mal, el plus que dí a esta receta fué caramelizar bananas, era lo que faltaba para elevar su sabor,pueden usar la fruta que deseen, o simplemente no usarla, es un paso opcional que recomiendo, las tostadas solas son deliciosas, añadir un extra quedará a su gusto, les mostraré como hice el topping de banana, para aquellas personas arriesgadas que gustan del dulce, sigan leyendo para conocer más sobre la receta\n\n

>It’s been a busy few days, but I’m happy to finally have some time to create content and get back to one of my favorite hobbies: making content for Hive. I’m back with an easy-to-make snack— All you need is bread, milk, eggs, and some fruit. French toast is always a hit. The extra touch I added to this recipe was caramelizing bananas—it was just what was needed to elevate the flavor. You can use whatever fruit you like, or skip it altogether; it’s an optional step that I recommend. The French toast alone is delicious; adding an extra topping is up to you. I’ll show you how I made the banana topping. For those adventurous souls who have a sweet tooth, keep reading to learn more about the recipe.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:
>1 huevo, 1/2 taza de leche, 1 cucharada de azúcar, 4 rebanadas de pan.\n\n
>1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tablespoon sugar, 4 slices of bread. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:
>Iniciamos por mezclar 1 huevo con la leche y el azúcar.\n\n

>Start by mixing 1 egg with the milk and sugar. ***
![IMG_20260420_160044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoGyQw9sTyPMy6gY7v6Z9c4ynyXgrNLcMaByX3aFKSWQGfBQsANqgPsiNtAgjDTU1yn.jpg)
***
>Deben asegurarse de que los ingredientes estén bien incorporados.\n

>Make sure the ingredients are well combined. ***
![IMG_20260420_160301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoEqvQY7n8us9oDdrQfEh63V6j2kvJBXhLL1A2a86L53jb4cgijCYRGJ3434ziVimVa.jpg)
***
>Pre-calentamos el sartén antes de seguir con la receta, mojamos cada rebanada de pan en la mezcla de huevo.\n

>Preheat the skillet before continuing with the recipe, then dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture. ***
![IMG_20260420_160533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eo8UGU2EaeJF1muf8QecohAea8e7shDT2D2KkVSUgiYryWDM6GHNUA5FHXNBKgQxmzo.jpg)
***
> Llevamos al sartén, si su sartén no es antiadherente añadan un poco de aceite.\n

>Place them in the skillet; if your skillet isn’t nonstick, add a little oil. ***
![IMG_20260420_160603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoeDUvGTJTJYfKDkw4a9wpXfhsri8Fdg8u4JJRyKKUCua3VRmejC99E3EsZdf9Nw1U9.jpg)
***
>Cocinamos hasta dorar por ambos lados, la cocción es rápida, deben de estar atentos a no quemar las tostadas.\n

>Cook until golden brown on both sides; this cooks quickly, so be careful not to burn the toast. ***
![IMG_20260420_160849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoyN7JxxPmPCL68TBhLzkKDm7seTpC1dnuHmtUp8FFx52NYwPnqzNw84ZoXGpaWzmCZ.jpg)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
### Opcional: ###### Optional:

>Como paso opcional hice unas bananas caramelizadas como topping, la preparación consiste en colocar en una olla el azúcar, la cocción debe ser a fuego bajo, una vez que el azúcar se haya derretido vamos a añadir las rodajas de banana previamente cortadas, mezclamos todo y cuando las bananas estén cubiertas por concepto con el caramelo estará listo su topping.\n

>As an optional step, I made some caramelized bananas as a topping. To prepare, place the sugar in a saucepan and cook over low heat. Once the sugar has melted, add the pre-sliced bananas, stir everything together, and when the bananas are completely coated in caramel, your topping is ready. ***

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/EoGwspWQRjWvLJqrmf84ToNCjz7WuQBBYzMuT1cfUmZaBvukGu7ebgvmBbxFmngcFLP.jpg
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![IMG_20260420_163245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/Eos1qnhEjruXxab4Vc7fALGBdbHJDXuxT9psMaw91XfUfFS3kB8pcGeaNUozY2T5XXJ.jpg)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)
![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAPsP4d1LBcvF2DN3NXZV48rEfAv7dqbHwZ9WVDFeovGGCFS3NFrLH323BeNdzWpmKmaSHcNPhF6CspuXXhxaiNef2NqqCST3NFz7tDvYs9x8GsYq.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23tcNngg6kuZLr17voRDC8Nooj7bozWrLKoEWH9DLG2ogVpYdA2m37W8SwsE5b3RM1rRc.gif)
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/23xedHvvWLmhWokqiq1CRVxoEqTYMwAt6aM9MyfzHR34Z2W1SffVLXRopwL7wcgeXGVCo.gif¿Qué les ha parecido está merienda fácil de hacer? Una delicia simple, perfecta cuando estemos con antojo de algo dulce en las tardes, acompañar con café es lo ideal, no toma muchos minutos y como ven, solo 5 pasos se requieren para hacer las tostadas, lo demás es completamente opcional, si son personas prácticas, solo añadan la fruta fresca o un poco de azúcar glass, dime en los comentarios si te gustaría probar esta merienda, gracias por llegar hasta aquí. > What did you think of this easy-to-make snack? A simple treat, perfect when you’re craving something sweet in the afternoon. It’s ideal with a cup of coffee. It doesn’t take long, and as you can see, it only takes 5 steps to make the toast—the rest is completely optional. If you’re the practical type, just add fresh fruit or a little powdered sugar. Let me know in the comments if you’d like to try this snack. Thanks for reading!

title.title: La música no es para discutir, es para compartir
title.body:
🎧 La música no es para discutir, es para compartir
Trabajar de noche tiene algo especial. Las madrugadas te regalan historias, conversaciones y encuentros que durante el día simplemente no ocurren. Más aún cuando trabajas en un lugar como Varadero, donde conoces personas de todas partes del mundo, con ideas, opiniones y experiencias completamente distintas.
Y si algo he aprendido de eso, es que escuchar nunca sobra.
Hace poco, tuve un cliente que me dijo algo que me llamó mucho la atención:
“la música de reggaeton no sirve”.
Lo curioso es que no era cualquier persona. Él tiene, para muchos, el trabajo soñado: se dedica a grabar conciertos en vivo. Es la cámara que captura ese momento único entre el artista y el público. Alguien con esa experiencia… claro que te hace pensar.
Pero ahí es donde nace mi reflexión.
El problema no es la música.
No es el idioma.
No es el artista.
El problema muchas veces es el autotune.
¿Por qué digo esto? Porque hoy en día consumimos música perfecta… pero solo en estudio. Escuchas una canción en plataformas y suena impecable: afinación perfecta, emoción controlada, todo pulido.
Pero cuando vas a un concierto… no siempre encuentras lo mismo.
Y ahí es donde ocurre la desconexión.
No porque el artista sea malo, sino porque lo que consumiste durante meses no era completamente real.
El autotune, cuando se abusa, rompe esa autenticidad. Te vende una versión que no siempre se puede reproducir en vivo. Y eso genera una sensación de:
\

.
Por eso muchos géneros como el rock o el pop en vivo siguen impactando tanto. Porque lo que escuchas… es lo que es. Hay imperfecciones, sí, pero también hay verdad. Y esa verdad conecta.
Ahora, tampoco se trata de atacar géneros o estilos. La música sigue siendo arte, siempre lo será. Incluso el autotune, bien usado, puede crear cosas increíbles.
El problema no es la herramienta.
Es cómo se usa.
Y también quiero decir algo importante:
cuando hablamos de rock o metal, no todo es lo mismo. Mucha gente se queda solo con lo más extremo, como el black metal o el death metal, que no siempre son fáciles de digerir. Pero existen muchos otros subgéneros —como el power metal o el heavy más melódico— que son accesibles, emocionales y muy ricos musicalmente.
La música es demasiado amplia para encerrarla en prejuicios.
Al final, lo más importante es esto:
La música no debería ser un motivo de discusión, como si fuera un deporte o una religión.
La música debería ser un espacio para compartir, para descubrir, para conectar.
Porque cada canción, cada género y cada artista puede significar algo distinto para cada persona.
Y eso… es lo que la hace especial.

![IMG_20260420_192616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23w2mFB4HhDY4kxJpmZkZS9ceeGtwtnbegpFDb4FDL1uwhHevEpEbmPp4wH8mPcC4Hw7Y.png)
Cómo siempre les pido apoyen a mí esposa @diazktty que tiene muchas ideas que compartir
 el blog @cathyarrow 
La fundación BBH de @bradleyarrow que puede ser la solución para alguien o alguna familia que lo esté pasando mal 
Cómo siempre que nunca les falte el amor ❤️y que Dios los bendiga 🙏

title.title: The Goonies Is One of the Most Fun Adventure Movies Ever Made. A True Eighties Classic That Still Feels Like Pure Magic. (1985)
title.body:
Released in 1985, The Goonies is the kind of movie that defines a generation. It has everything. Adventure, humor, danger, friendship, and that sense of wonder that only a great eighties film can deliver. Even now, it still feels just as fun and exciting as it did back then.

![IMG_0560.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXdY7zf7vrUhL5zdw7FABuLQ8gvBB1QdBbVY8pbtAiUVw/IMG_0560.webp)

The film was directed by Richard Donner, with a story by Steven Spielberg and a screenplay by Chris Columbus. That combination alone tells you a lot. Donner brings strong direction, Spielberg adds imagination and heart, and Columbus delivers a script full of memorable moments and characters.

The cast is made up mostly of younger actors, and that is a big part of why the movie works so well. Sean Astin plays Mikey, the optimistic leader of the group who refuses to give up. Josh Brolin appears as his older brother Brand, while Corey Feldman, Ke Huy Quan, Jeff Cohen, and Kerri Green round out the group.

Each kid has their own personality, and that makes the group feel real. Mouth talks nonstop, Data is full of wild inventions, Chunk provides a lot of the comedy, and Mikey keeps everyone moving forward. Their chemistry is one of the strongest parts of the film.

The plot follows the group as they try to save their neighborhood from being taken over by developers. When they discover an old pirate map, they set off on a dangerous adventure to find hidden treasure that could solve all their problems.

Of course, they are not the only ones after the treasure. The Fratelli family, a group of criminals, are also on the hunt. That adds tension and danger to the story as the kids race to find the treasure first.

What makes The Goonies so enjoyable is the constant sense of adventure. The group moves through underground tunnels, booby traps, hidden passages, and long forgotten caves. Every new location feels exciting and unpredictable.

Richard Donner does a great job keeping the pace moving while still giving each character time to shine. The movie never drags because there is always something happening.

The film is packed with memorable scenes. The water slide escape, the discovery of the pirate ship, and all the moments involving Data’s inventions are still fun to watch.

There is also a strong emotional core. At its heart, the movie is about friendship and not wanting to let go of something important. The kids are trying to save their homes, but they are also trying to hold onto their childhood.

The villain characters add just the right amount of danger without making the film too dark. The Fratellis are threatening, but they also fit the slightly exaggerated tone of the movie.

The Goonies has that perfect balance of humor and adventure. It never takes itself too seriously, but it also never feels silly in a way that hurts the story.

Visually, the film still holds up. The practical sets and effects give the movie a real sense of place that adds to the adventure.

![IMG_0561.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTPsDjbT7wrAYCeKVaAEBhUupdazYezUMffwMPvReADm3/IMG_0561.webp)

The Goonies remains an excellent film because it captures something timeless. It is about discovery, friendship, and believing that there is something more out there. Decades later, it is still a true classic and one of the most entertaining adventure films ever made.

title.title: Let's Play Resident Evil Village - New Weapon is Found
title.body:
![Resident Evil Village New weapon is found.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23t77FsEC2hq5PaBAAHa6X1zCt6hLetQ6Bxr9zpEXVxdHQhcMkTz8Fssq57pQ65tDPNMi.gif)

---

# New Weapon is Found

I finally have something to use in this castle model I have been seeing, that has a red skull inside it locked. So once it was activated I only had to move the ball around by tilting the model to ensure the ball gets to where it should be.. which it was easy enough and then, the crimson skull was mine to take as a prize. 

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2025.12.28 - 22.12.19.76.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23t7FhgCaddrbxY8EoNHJmhf5XvWo4EvCWqfUBpEySS4JRctqFXmbVBnH2M2Yn4SznqPs.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2025.12.28 - 22.12.29.22.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23uEzKrypdAwvee4iKCqzzozNrydviaQqycSrYHa2RgvAdvsaAVEVCXVTbp34gFhcX8aF.png)

Once I had sold it for 8000 Lei and bought the better pistol mag for been ammo capacity, I was ready to head back out into the castle and continue my progress.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2025.12.28 - 22.13.52.75.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tSNDVhPM3CRx6WWkPVRFhmTZMXhh2n4f1ryNV6ttryU5EgNN673rbJdmrfMNmjyYHyi.png)

Finally I realise the statues in front of the door near the Duke, required angel masks to complete them so now I will be looking for the other three, in order to complete the set and see what that ends up getting me.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.43.11.80.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23uEyydJVeNDVaxCZrgeSkmf3SvZSgmenTdpYKYDRPVxP5TfjjDSW6e83zVdeiNWYcjqf.png)

Back up to Lady Dimitrescu's room and other rooms near it. I found the lady's lipstick so I will hold onto this.. but I went and checked out the piano you have to play the notes for, which took a little time to get the right notes but I managed to do it. I got the Iron Insignia Key from it, which should open some important doors I would think!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.50.38.41.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swigqqVoeNNpGTeBbuMgMDjLJvD4k6oaxyedPBSfuXdPWGwF3whtkEfyDuRU6qDAtZK.png)

After making my way through some doors and also a previously unopened door due to needing the iron insignia key, I worked my way into a room which had the locust swarm from another one of the daughters. The locusts were biting me and I got hurt, needing to heal up and attempt to shoot at the glass above without realising, it is something that requires activating a nearby level that opens up the glass ceiling.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.52.17.97.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23t76kWDgXNggLMCVNBUuQpZeq3GGiHoUXytZeZZU2vyzFJ4hK5yrrR1EnsQt4CL1LCbC.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.52.26.15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23vsDs3EAy92ZQoujG26B8tCboU56jtMFN82wPrrK15aNhWJ14c8uFcavNsFVPZhH9VXx.png)

At one point she managed to slice me open a little, with the blade she was using and making my blood go around the place. This made me mad and start shooting her with the pistol once the shots were clear.. but I required the room to be open and for this, I had to activate the lever in order to have her freezing up from the cold. I did this a few times and eventually, had her frozen so I could smash her to pieces, getting another crystal torso!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.53.53.04.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23t773R3Xf8kADbU47w7oz2F84FNyk9us4kMa7vatB3yXn46LtspjbjQiHyiTPqS4HGSa.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.55.12.59.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23sweNGoBNwXxYV2Uhktim6esKxUfuVr7qPvpm18pNu3NGFi15gfBbuX7SLyPATfoTP2x.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.55.16.79.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swfwJfedPgKVBBr1foYrQfmEeUHy6qqGjzmjmJJoe1EvRLftF7oWFLQ6yucf75Equfi.png)

This room had multiple bits of loot between some shotgun shells, handgun ammo and a herb I could use for my chem fluid to be made.

Nothing further nearby but the Mask of Joy was waiting, on a nearby statue for me to take and this would be the second I had found.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.57.44.87.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tkpDVFdzLYyX5Uhcx5cCYjuQhxNDqBg8m3qgip6wnxUSUW6a7ReP84N5ZiTxwMGFac1.png)

Suddenly in my exploration and opening of doors.. I found this cool room with paintings and some bells that had to ring out in this chamber. 

It took a short while to find out where all the bells were that I had to shoot to ensure they would ring, but I found them all including the one outside.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.58.16.13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swe9k7kgG1r12mvvUzid1j76DGx8BTHhEzEwsXRVohdXZPBkXCeJ5LKRT2yny3VC81r.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 21.59.34.36.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tkjcxfPDMouZYDGkkSbXuXvmMGkRb4CQnt3addrE2Vy9t2mALXNpPxZW2JcK5Ra5F7t.png)

I watched as the giant painting opened up to reveal a new way which leads up to the top of one of the castle towers. Inside here besides some treasure maps and loot and a hooded thing, there was a sniper rifle I got to gain as a new weapon, something I could use for further shooting and killing. Looks like I got to be ready for whatever comes next, as I brace to step out onto the rooftops and find whatever is in store.

title.body: > Feliz inicio de semana queridos amigos, yo inicie mi semana bien activa en el gimnasio con ejercicios de fuerzas, importantes para fortalecer y no lesionarnos, y sobretodo si pasamos los 40 años, y queremos permanecer activos en el running, ya que estos ejercicios nos ayudan a mitigar la apiricion temprana de lesiones, y tambien nos ayudan a mejorar nuestro rendimiento. Solo basta con unos 40 minutos, dos veces a la semana, con 4 o tres rutinas, de 1 minuto de descanso es mas que suficiente para obtener los beneficios de este tipo de ejercicios. Y bueno a amigos, muy importante diversificar las rutinas para asi ser mas fuertes, y permanecer en el tiempo. Disfruten su semana. 💕 --- . >Greetings and blessings Friends.! >

>Happy start to the week, dear friends! I kicked off my week with a vigorous session at the gym, focusing on strength training—which is essential for building muscle and preventing injuries, especially if we’re over 40 and want to stay active in running. These exercises help reduce the risk of early injuries and also improve our performance. All it takes is about 40 minutes, twice a week, with three or four sets and a one-minute rest between each set—that’s more than enough to reap the benefits of this type of exercise. And remember, friends, it’s very important to vary your routines so you can get stronger and stay active over time. title.title: Splinterlands:Silver🥈1, Unlocked In Modern Ranked,5 Days into New Season.
title.body:
Hello Splinterlands fam! It is another new season,so much is going on for me in the frontier and modern ranked, couple with the brawl fights. Welcome to my blog @zusi78 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRkmmppJ2MwZu3PA3VbFcFSUhW4purYxey6ikV24wZeKB/1776704768076.jpg)








**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZ9r2bh5w9dEsNSJWLGKQvRJTv7xbrHbci1HMThaXphf/1776704542597.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFcA8me2Tt43dD7dvGFVFGNscBsThBBLfznFTkJD9gau/1776704542656.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYACHPeWZviFU1WQZVaSnP1m9votcVZX12MewLpCoAMa/1776704542733.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLztjCZsP12AJ8iKeezUJn11CHDtnfZzbdYtRviBAgYs/1776704987543.jpg)

I am okay with the gifts,I just need to focus and strategize on how to get to and unlock gold 3.The 2 rare scrolls would be much useful much more later, likewise the energy boost.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


The battle that unlocked Silver 🥈 1 for me.


Battle and lineup 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecgPutT12o1AQQ1PibAPiVjHW6YBp6fspPCCWaMogdCL/1776708309692.jpg)

The ruleset were;
>You cannot summon melee units.
The initial health of all units is equal to that of the unit on either twam with the highest base health.

The total manner cost was 34 and you to chose splinters from the earth and life elements.


**My Lineup (Earth-Focused with Rebirth Synergy)**
**Summoner: Elowen Sylphie** –The star of the show! This Legendary Archon granted Resurgence (Rebirth) to my first two monsters and Trample as well.Resurgence brings a fallen unit back with full health and armor (cleansed of debuffs), though it skips a round and deals -1 damage to all units on the field. Trample allowed my melee tank to potentially chain kills.

* **Tank (Position 1)**: **Quilliun Legionary** –Ranged attack with Thorns and close-range capability. (Thorns didn't trigger much this game, but the tank held the line solidly.)
* **Position 2**: Virid Veromancer – Magic attack powerhouse.
* **Position 3**: Mindless Thrall – Magic attack with Phase (great for dodging and surviving).
* **Position 4**: Satha Toledo – Ranged attack with Tank Heal and Lookout (providing crucial sustain and vision/support).


**My Opponent’s Lineup (Kaylia Silverleaf Magic Control)**
* **Summoner: Kaylia Silverleaf** – Applied a global -1 Magic debuff to all my units, softening my magic damage output.
* **Tank (Position 1)**: Earthwork Sentinel – No attack (pure tankiness, average high health).I wonder why.
* **Position 2**: Conclave Artificial – No attack but featured Camouflage (making it harder to target early).
* **Position 3**: Ghostly Blacksmith – Magic attack with the game-changing Incendiary ability, to my favour.
* **Position 4**: Glimmermancer – Magic attack.
* **Position 5**: Anachron Bolter (Dual Dealer) – Ranged/Magic attack with Headwinds (imposed -1 Ranged power on all my units).
* **Position 6**: Satha Toledo – Ranged attack with basic Rank Heal.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

**Round1**
**How the Battle Unfolded: The Incendiary Advantage**
The real turning point was my opponent’s Ghostly Blacksmith with Incendiary. Starting from Round 2, this ability applies Burning to allied units (his own team). Burning causes all affected units to lose 2 health per round (with a 33% chance to spread to adjacent allies). It’s usually a strong DoT (damage over time) tool, but here it became a double-edged sword.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbvPX47EAt6Cm79xwSoE1uuph9ALscRERBfkBZYJ9yT3/1776710298628.jpg)

**Round 2,beginning of a new round first incidiary occurred**.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcG4D5BaG2soSXezmqpxRzfY1pniT9wH2juxSf4vKEW4v/1776711016579.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSrK5q66EM3HuW3ZQ9vEtNoGopyTVGmxo7zgcV2tRMQf/1776711016703.jpg)

**Round 2,Scene 12,my tank Quilliun legionary was taken out,but rebirth granted by Elowen Sylphie brought her back and unleashed -1 damage to all units**0.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxWLPikuBUX9nkWPPhAh7YBaRBh6eG1K4A7nULkqvfNv/1776711322923.jpg)

**Quilliun legionary resurgence**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhZRxakLY9g5AtcMzyDXgakxvK3bzo7poyDsfnEoAYzC/1776711322996.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwNA4RkcVo4Manr8i4TDwQ6fjd3My5edzwx5n2cdsCWw/1776711323041.jpg)






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyXBKPTwDfBhm7GjHM3FUKSQZNR9kSgnPsJEJFPgBBqG/1776711016767.jpg)




**Round 3,Rpound by round, his numerical advantage eroded.The Burning DoT(damage overtime),turned his extra units into liabilities rather than assets.My lean, resilient 4-unit core outlasted the attrition war.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMvkkPEcbCD45uz2Mi3Aa5pW51oRBmGxc9tFBAGBhndY/1776711016844.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY1R9Nq3SaYbwtLWyUsk89yyRyx6z9V8279VmQ3apP6zo/1776712158186.jpg)


**Round 4,the circle continues,it was it the main attraction as the battle raged on**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjWy93CLqBW148iViV7vnBiXLrtGcfrYqDkG9pAAckmT/1776712498461.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdGYZtVRwizUGrrvuPRfdNJgtJLFQnibR5cNVmPiZ9Fzg/1776712498511.jpg)

**Ronud 6-7, three against one and with incidiary still effective,it was certainly game over**


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFUf3aVakkNhVpstnGM2N835tFrjUf7dfmeJnAAx1tMB/1776712817232.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVD2PLCzLayFcs1dZhRd3QTc6SF3vtHVSUgA3Cx9bfrx/1776712817299.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPRAywNmKb3YpLSorMqMJcR2nN9qsi9XVQcuwivHeHGQ/1776712817344.jpg)

Watch this exciting battle [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_e8f5d8678ef5a87565e7e4933255f288?ref=zusi78)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfDLHveXRixB64d7RUR4NbhMkVa5BcrUYyqkwSxnSYa9/1776712960908.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s a link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

I hope you enjoyed reading and watching.Thank you for your time .Yours truly @zusi78, signing off.

title.title: Between the Roar of Engines and Forced Patience
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQehsoxKqYfUqZJeSStji4gZW7UCnAWrdLHR34Fdi7QPj/1776732430978.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
That morning, the road felt like a held breath. The rows of motorcycles were tightly packed together, as if everyone had agreed to pause for a moment, even as time continued to tick by uncaringly. Ahead, a large truck stood firmly, forming a boundary between the desire to move and the reality that had to be accepted.

I sat on the motorcycle, feeling the heat of the sun slowly creeping onto my back. My helmet felt heavier, and the sound of the revving engine echoed like a complaint never truly heard. The people around me were silent, but it was a meaningful silence. Some stared straight ahead, some looked down, and still others occasionally let out a long sigh.

This traffic jam wasn't just about stopped vehicles. It was about patience tested without warning. About postponed plans, about time that could have been used for other things. But on the other hand, there was a small lesson we often overlook: not everything is within our control.

I began to notice the little things around me. A woman sitting behind the driver tightly held the waist of the person in front of her. Another driver appeared relaxed, as if accustomed to this kind of situation. Even the truck in front, with its massive body, seemed oblivious to the long queue behind it.

Time passed slowly, but surely. And finally, the wheels turned again. One by one, the vehicles began to move, leaving behind what had seemed like an eternity of stillness. I took a deep breath and then slowly drove off, carrying with me a simple realization: sometimes life needs to stop for a moment, so we can learn to appreciate each small step as we move forward.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

承上回: 3.28去了三三那邊跟她們吃完飯, 上她們新家坐一下之後就回家睡覺, 到3.29週日, 我們當然是睡到自然醒, 然後慢悠悠的出去逛一下商場啦.

這次選了南山區的Brew Town 啤酒小鎮, 本來呢, 我們想去一些純室外的地方, 但因為不確定會不會下雨, 所以最後取個平衡, 來這個啤酒小鎮, 因為他們在室外既有攤可以逛, 也有好多裝飾可以打卡. 另外亦有商場可以給我們逛, 以防下雨不能在外邊嘛, 嘿嘿.

如是者, 我們只需要自然醒, 起來梳洗, 吃少少東西就出發了, 因為是週日, 我們不想太晚出去太晚回小區, 又是沒車位的問題囉. 所以說, 有車之前, 覺得買完車之後好自由, 想去那就去那不假, 但買車以後, 發現還要解決停車的問題, 還有我要去的路好不好走. 我有多挑, 我家人知的, 路面太爛不走, 凹凸不平的不走, 要上馬路牙子停車的地方不停, 打死都要給錢停室內等等. 不過這些都是個人選擇, 我樂意啊, 他們也許不理解, 但會尊重, 這已經足夠了. 

說回那個啤酒小鎮, 由家出發過去,大約半小時, 但出去之前, 先充個靚電, 油價貴了嘛, 跑市內就不要那麼拽跑油了, 留來跑長途的時候再用油. 充完電再開28分鐘過去就到商場, 之前在小紅書上看到, 這個商場是免費停車的, 當時吸引了好多人開車過去打卡. 但自從沒了免費停車以後, 人流不見了一半以上. 停個車, 二十來元, 有那麼嚴重嗎? 搞到人都沒了一半? 費解, 真的令人費解.

然後更搞笑的是, 我去到那邊停好車之後發現, 其實這個場都是萬象城的, 但這個場比較特別, 當天只要掃碼就能領積分, 然後消費滿一百, 加起來可以免費停三個小時, 三小時夠你逛了吧? 還不是免費嗎? 你都去商場了, 連飯都不吃? 我已經叫摳門啦, 沒想到其他人比我更摳門…我暈.

這次停車的地方就在連接商場門出入口, 好方便, 我們一出去, 第一家見到的店居然是好特賣, 這家店必逛的, 但不是現在, 先看看週邊有甚麼好打卡的. 在B1的公眾地方, 見到有一個喜力的booth, 其實就是宣傳他們的品牌, 啤酒小鎮嘛, 主題肯定跟酒有關係. 但是, 這個跟F1 cross over的主題, 我又覺得…不是有底觸? 開車不喝酒, 喝酒不開車, 同時宣傳酒跟F1賽車, 怪怪的…
因為我到步時都不到十二點, 那個booth都不開始開攤, 但見到有美女在那邊準備囉, 忍不住拍了一下哈. 拍完之後在B1見到有彈珠機的店, 我想起大寶, 馬上打電話過去, 跟她說我們逛的那個商場有這玩意, 搞到大寶好想過來玩呢. 你們跟你媽, 即我姐商量一下, 別再安排那麼多活動了, 有空多過來, 這樣才像樣的嘛. 

之後上地面, 抽跟煙, 看看地面的打卡點, 果然, 真的全部都是酒, 湘看到之後只能嘆息, 好想喝酒, 我說, 喝不了一點, 現在喝了就前功盡廢了. 再忍到今年年底吧, 到年底她一定可以瘦到她的目標重量的, 到時偶然喝下無所謂, 但現在呢, NO WAY !

今天先寫到這裡, 到五月中之前我都會好忙哈, 忙甚麼? 之後慢慢分享.

title.title: Entrenamiento de Caminata Tucutunemo - El Ancón - Los Chivos
title.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes mi entrenamiento de caminata de montaña en la ruta del asentamiento campesino El Ancón - cerro Los Chivos, en la comunidad de Villa de Cura, municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to everyone at Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you my mountain walking training session along the route from the El Ancón peasant settlement to Cerro Los Chivos, in the community of Villa de Cura, Zamora municipality, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260420_203411614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23y8xKRz2znHFZ1nAuthJadTX35MrKviCuri2sMjKQaavnwspVwQKStGsMprgkHvyUfiy.jpg) Cabe destacar que la semana pasada solo pude entrenar un solo día, ya llevaba cuatro días que no había entrenado y hoy nuevamente me activé, como el tiempo estaba nublado y parecía que iba llover, salí desde la avenida Lisandro Hernández, a las 4:00 pm, en la esquina de la escuela, entre al sector Las Mercedes y me desvíe hacia la carretera de Los Valles de Tucutunemo, pasando los primeros 2K, que están frente al comando de la guardia con un tiempo de 20 minutos registrado en la aplicación Strava. >It’s worth noting that last week I was only able to train for a single day; I hadn’t trained for four days, and today I got back into it. As the weather was cloudy and it looked like it was going to rain, I set off from Lisandro Hernández Avenue at 4:00 pm, at the corner by the school, entered the Las Mercedes area and turned off towards the Los Valles de Tucutunemo road, covering the first 2 km, which are opposite the guard post, in a time of 20 minutes recorded on the Strava app. ![IMG_20260420_161747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/245Hh5q7iRSHKMu9pHTsWGhnRojDVAiogK5r7qrhPEiLnL1uMK2oARUDZ3rzS42eHzKT2.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_162131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243WKNLjgSrWsgqXawdCmqRQ4Xtvdahi13rdMFubspLGDZ97SAnBcJpgpK1GcBxtKtND1.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_163011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244oSsU6R9PaeemxyBRyRxbWuzZrpBHViYgvgFpq1BJ1dY6fgm2RDcAH1k4sBc69h5g4h.jpg) A medida que avanzaba el clima se mantenía nublado, llegué a la entrada del asentamiento campesino El Ancón, con una distancia de 3.4K, en un tiempo de 34 minutos, al llegar al cruce del río de Las Mercedes, tuve que buscar otras forma de pasar porque había mucho barro debido a las lluvias de estos días. Después continúe avanzando para recorrer una recta que una carretera de tierra, al llegar a donde están unos árboles, me desvíe a la derecha para buscar la entrada hacia la montaña del cerro Los Chivos. >As I continued on my way, the weather remained cloudy. I reached the entrance to the El Ancón farming settlement, a distance of 3.4 km, in 34 minutes. Upon reaching the crossing over the Las Mercedes River, I had to find another way across because there was a lot of mud due to the recent rain. I then continued on along a straight stretch of dirt track. When I reached a spot with some trees, I turned right to look for the entrance to the Los Chivos hill. ![IMG_20260420_163517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23zkhuC64zFg6tN8tB8ErV2LsRGE2E8LAPwtbyh4f9UapgSd8YED8bB8tPWhKvAMfVMCQ.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_164152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23r1irC61Gdnzp7ihtX5CBUu4XrAP42Zioywv4SRSm28Ng1omjudEcnSyU8qFAMxFUXzY.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_164212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/242DEHAM4sE9XoPZaMFsj3q9BFLsPSgehbzsHdXBngs1HPxFVRM1XmHegrftDyy1yRwaL.jpg) Asimismo pase los 5K en 54 minutos y comenzó el ascenso al cerro Los Chivos, por estos lados la carretera es pedregosa, en algunas partes la carretera está abierta, con el tiempo me imagino que no se podrá subir, o habría que buscar otro camino. Una vez que llegue a dónde está un aviso de la empresa, baje hacia una carretera de concreto como doscientos metros y después me regresé para llegar a la torre desde donde se ve la laguna de Taguaguay con una distancia 6.7K y un tiempo de 1 hora 21 minutos. >I also passed the 5K mark in 54 minutes and began the climb up Los Chivos hill; around here the road is stony, and in some places it’s open; in time, I imagine it won’t be possible to climb it, or we’ll have to find another route. Once I reached the company sign, I descended towards a concrete road for about two hundred metres and then turned back to reach the tower from where you can see Taguaguay Lagoon, covering a distance of 6.7 km in a time of 1 hour 21 minutes. ![IMG_20260420_164518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243fpcwyf3j2VM9UoWdAtiG8PSnURhVYCE6QzBxc7m559cSSSTGAdEieYVzeY5UwfT68m.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_164517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23qrE7XwRV9aiBZiz9VkShzEHPWQPjiwNhje8qXQKzsVK7WUrP2pGk1CRZm9jDLxJj1Lk.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_164941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/242NhKZyPbtRG4x47pJUXYQqnj81SbqGP6KMscnAzGfZrphXLGivoKZvKyxrPMq8wHu8C.jpg) Después me detuve unos segundos para tomar algunas fotografías y continuar mi recorrido por todo el cerro de Los Chivos, pase por la tercera montaña y terminé de bajar, para nuevamente llegar a la avenida Lisandro Hernández, con un tiempo de 2 horas 8 minutos, con distancia de 10.38K, con un desnivel positivo 401 mby un desnivel máximo de 766 m, registrado en la aplicación Strava. ![IMG_20260420_170105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/243LxzWpEFRDU6VVrT4knuMKK7pUqJ1hkMMs6HibcaFmq8B2DDhwp23MqJBe2AM45hjBi.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_171301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/241QRVn6Z4dLSwuFRdKfCCFGUjwoFKbrvXjTrdVCcgduBLVUQGuptUebMdJNj62r4c1d7.jpg) ![IMG_20260420_171156.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244e8XkGUwKvpPwovKHGyJ3j711gjctDFBgxucNMCy3UmuwN4Fd5ZuQDsfdqpdyeNCX16.jpg) ![GridArt_20260420_203004169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wMyxYuQyXPhL7orcHEBinMaTX2q6t8RwTS4S3nrMyeiGXuqtaiw6b7C3q2fRfjwLwGY.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. Fotografías: Teléfono Redmi Note 10 Portada realizada en APP GridArt Logos utilizados de Hive y de @fulldeportes Traductor utilizado: Traductor de Google > Photos: Redmi Note 10 Phone Cover made in The APP GridArte Used logos of Hive and @fulldeportes Translator used: Translator used: Google Translate ![colmena (3).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23uQG5bMpA2yUvU3w1TEuFvZjXBPfgBshBVfZZUN4RJ2XPWixaH1Ufw18aV1csBHocF2m.gif) [Vote la-colmena for witness By @ylich](https://vote.hive.uno/@la-colmena) ![banner-cetb2008.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23uQ9kmcM8pPsz9medwXRPJMRxQjtxns8eYs4B7pkcrKR15kx7Dx74A9qRyneQyCJD2k7.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cetb2008/entrenamiento-de-caminata-tucutunemo-el-ancn-los-chivos--hje)

title.title: What's land worth now?
title.body:
![Unbenannt - Kopie.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/245HgSFqoCuEGuurhEYFZuPkNZ9Ed7JYLSgLkaB5Ypa3uwjzEqNaKoTMbXt9VERqMTMjF.JPG)

  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23vhuVwHxn7ynuUbA7tsZmcVvH5QddLoE3gizq8EMRXW2FxjXaZjha4LgiNo6FSDiQfPf.png
  
 #### Prologue

I've been thinking about boosting my stake in Land a little. So I updated my good old excel sheet and found a few interesting data points to share here - if anyone is interested in the same ;-) 

  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### The Plots

Currently, Grain is the best to go to regarding cost. When I calculated last, it was Stone at a cost of 93 DEC/1k Stone. And although Stone is sitting at the same price point again, after dropping to 70 DEC/1k, grain just takes the cake - it went from 9 DEC/1k to 14,5 DEC, and that is *after* quite the drop.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23swkEycC9pazpqvpHZVPSWSQGoJKbAoZKP3vPKRNgGBk9ok5Tj8jQEem1U6J2QwcGqPa.png)</center>

It's also the more expensive one. Common plots are around 20-25$, Rare around 30 - 35$. It's still worth getting the extra 10% from the rarity boost, especially when playing with 30k+ PP. In that case, the difference in PP boost makes up for the extra cost within half a year:


<center>![At 30k PP!](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23tGdwVsqSDGfUM2GDywKjF3YkHwFDDnTRrsuy8GqWYy3gaQyo1KYR8DCMsTXon1nz87L.png)</center>

Of course, I also have a table for the break even points of each plot at 30k PP with current prices (DEC around 0.0005). 


<center>![30k PP!](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Eo1xKigJ5umjnrxsQgdCCSHEUBY53zJg5hJdBScoLXYBXJ9s17sHhhFuK2nA3dkGWSY.png)</center>

Due to Stone plots being very cheap at the moment, and the Stone-Card being a banger game play, it's actually the best play - if we only look at the plot.
  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### Cards

But there's something more important, and that's the cards! So I updated all those prices, too, and found that some dropped in price, and others went up - especially Alpha and Beta went up in price, while Chaos and Untamed dropped. 

<center>![Includes DEC necessary to stake](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23tGcJ47dRM2iLSXQXXq1cr3igfTSLWRCXyxc1PFHXEcUKpM8vot4uQaj8thNbWEr8EcT.png)</center>

Now, that chart alone can be misleading - you won't get to 30k PP with all Chaos Legion, only Epic and Legendary GF can  make that happen. Hence, you need to factor in the space they take up, and the most efficient use of your  slots. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23tRzseeUShKL8xXU7zj2T2x6YqhFKp4r8WLVXDDjfUncFNALSuxs77eKNwA62977wQTt.png)</center>

That's what this chart is for. It factors in the production per slot - but inverse, so the lower, the better. The idea is to find a card that has a combination of a low $/1k PP and a low CPC. Beta Rare RF is still the best there, in my opinion.

Currently, those cards are around 30$ for a maxed version, stake included.

  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png
  
 #### Boosts

Boosts are what makes the difference in the long run. 10% more, compounding over 10 years... you get the idea. 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/48FiXoHwXnTk5zFQUnTz83UFNoxjmtkkL5VVBVsoCnLrFpMYfpUzDV278Gi2SogaUX.png)</center>

Prices are quite attractive for boosts these days. I like that. Common Totem is still be best, as always, in terms of efficiency. And until the extra boost makes up for the extra cost, many years can go by... depending on how much PP you're working.
  
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png

#### Simulations

So, I ran my simulations four times. Each are RF Rare cards, but from each edition - to show the difference. I calculated the yearly ROI based on TODAYS value of all components, translating them into DEC.

###### Chaos Legion: 6.39% yROI

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t74jKfE1j9pecT19wxbYSjC4xjK8w3kHEr4MNuaSp4KgZkd1fMLgxu5FfXv4QZqXj2g.png)</center>

###### Untamed: 11.03% yROI

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t74pDhemLkUaXi5fmmo8tm9XfEPrdrhKWweh5jP6CRs74nJ7xDFdrbqoGcvhdDeS2wX.png)</center>

###### Beta: 12.87% yROI

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t74bgF4txkDhh65CU7H8G1P9YrNThuNVCvAqN7GaVv8JTjapADNzxkCoCL76RpbFdkx.png)</center>

###### Alpha: 8.81% yROI

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23t74jMA2Jh71qeGmn2FffWZ63rEh6i5Zkq8HzC1ZaXaGwdo2FEtEszbBGg2cwY9CgVDu.png)</center>


https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tSMrBK495yadzSKriVB9FkEtftyayqE76JDxWPJsATmCdvqi8G8tHKVfT9SQ4p8MEBX.png

 #### Conclusion 

I'm honestly surprised that Untamed is such high up there in terms of ROI. I thought that Beta RF would stick out by a mile.

title.body:
**“Este” está bien elegido** porque es una de esas palabras básicas que parecen simples, pero abren un montón de puertas: geografía, orientación y hasta sinónimos útiles como **“oriente.”** La imagen encaja bien; se ve claramente **“east”** y la frase **“The sun rises in the east / El sol sale por el este”**, que es justo el tipo de ejemplo que fija la palabra en la cabeza.

Tu nota sobre **“oriente”** también suma bastante. **“Este”** es la forma más directa para el punto cardinal, mientras que **“oriente”** funciona como equivalente, aunque con un matiz un poco más formal o contextual en algunos usos. Eso le da más valor al post porque no solo enseñas una traducción, enseñas **uso real**.

Además, la serie ya tiene una cosa muy inteligente: **repetición diaria + ejemplo visual + frase corta**. Esa combinación es jodidamente efectiva para aprender vocabulario sin volverlo pesado. Tu post anterior de la serie también mantiene esa misma línea de aprendizaje constante en [#378: atrás](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-378-mo6f5puq77c6f735).

Como apoyo externo, el uso de **“este”** para “east” y la relación con **“oriente”** también aparece explicado en recursos de español como [ThoughtCo](https://www.thoughtco.com/points-of-the-compass-3079575) y [Yabla](https://spanish.yabla.com/lesson-The-Cardinal-Directions-in-Spanish-2168). Buen post: simple, claro y útil.

title.title: Reverse Speed: Slow Wins Battles!
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUfN22e8n1voAWbdAN5qRTNh3x43zoyrkp1KkK1oZrsLB/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

Speed is one of crucial stats in Splinterlands. Faster units attack first and has a higher chance to hit their targets. Slower units in contrast are more likely to miss their targets. In Reverse Speed ruleset, everything we value about speed becomes inverted or reversed. Slower units take center stage as high speed units become unreliable damage dealers. In today's post, I'll show a sample battle featuring the Reverse Speed ruleset. I'll talk through my choice of units as well as comment on my enemy's choice of units.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZPvtxeoQcRgCdcDzc89Zw5YgrWnRtfxyc3nw2JeDySW/image.png)

## My Team

I saw that my enemy frequently played the Water magic team so I chose Earth to counter it along with the slow units that I can summon. My archon is Kaylia Silverleaf who debuffs enemy magic attacks and grants the Execute ability to elves. The rest of the team were as follows.

### Quilliun Legionary

Quilliun Legionary is an excellent non melee tank. He has defense for both melee and magic attacks with his Thorns and Void abilities. He also deals decent two range damage and has enough health to take tank duties. He has two speed that is ideal for this ruleset.

### Ulundin Overseer

The Ulundin Overseer is a unit with no attack but compensates for it with its high armor and health stats. He has one speed that's the fastest speed in this ruleset. To make up for his lack of attack, the next unit is crucial. 

### Shiraza

Shiraza is fast for this ruleset with three speed. However she has the Weapons Training ability that grants two magic attack to no attack units like the Ulundin Overseer. Suddenly, units with no attack become an offensive threat. 

### Grove Doomblade

Grove Doomblade deals huge five melee damage, has the Sneak ability and is an elf that will receive the Execute ability from the archon. With all these offensive kit, she can wreck the enemy backline. Her only drawback is her one speed stats, making her miss her target. With the Reverse Speed ruleset, her lack of speed becomes an asset and her full offensive potential is unlocked. 

### Forlorn Geomant

Forlorn Geomant is one of the giants from the Escalation set. He deals a huge five magic damage but like Grove Doomblade, is set back by his one speed stat. Similarly, his slow speed becomes an asset and he attacks first in this ruleset.

### Silverleaf Mage

Silverleaf Mage is my Taunt unit to draw enemy attacks. This role is now better as her two speed stats means that her chances to evade physical attacks increased. 

With my team formed, let's check out the enemy. As I expected, it was a Water magic team.

***

## Enemy Team

He had Thanalorian Scion in first position. This unit gives me fits in all magic battle due to its thick armor coupled with Void Armor ability. It has one speed that's ideal for this ruleset but it's liability is its one health stat. Normally, her armor compensates for her lack of health but he also had the Shock Trooper in his team with Electrified debilitation. This guarantees that the Thanalorian Scion will die in the second round. He also had the Ulundin Overseer in his team but its partner was the legendary Daarg Deadblast. Normally, Daarg Deadblast is better than Shiraza but in this ruleset, he is worse because of his Swiftness ability that adds speed to the team. This guarantees that my units will attack first. 

With my archon debuffing the enemy's magic attack and being the \

, my team made quick kills. His Shock Trooper also didn't help as it eliminated some of his own team mates. With my team's synergy and cards to better meet the ruleset, I won this battle without losing any unit.

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_09420f20e69deea84b3a98225b0f2f99?ref=logen9f)


***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

title.title: A's fall to White Sox, losing the series | Big AL West showdown in Pacific Northwest vs Mariners tonight
title.body:
![584d48ce0a44bd1070d5d46f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJg3BnVxoiM2NuNHqgzjQovf9NYMeSJ4EYmngpiJMp61Su8EWJJbQuCKSGUjh45.png)
[Src](https://www.stickpng.com/img/sports/baseball/major-league-baseball-mlb/oakland-athletics/oakland-athletics-a-logo)

Yesterday's game wasn't great for the A's. Jeffrey Springs couldn't keep his hot streak going from the mound as he gave up seven runs in five innings of work. After not giving up a homer all year, Springs gave up **four** yesterday. Tough, hopefully he bounces back next time.

I'm not massively discouraged by the loss. A lot of signs are pointing to the White Sox being a better team in 2026 than they were last year. Also, while they couldn't replicate [Saturday's awesome comeback victory](https://peakd.com/hive-101690/@adhammer/as-show-tremendous-fight-with-a-thrilling-comeback-extra-innings-victory-vs-white-sox-or-jeffrey-springs-on-the-mound-for-seri) they once again showed respectable fight as in the seventh they scored three runs to make it a 7-4 game. While they ultimately ended up losing by that score, they did briefly have a bit of momentum, especially considering they knew they came back the day prior. Shoutout to Munetaka Murakami of the White Sox, he looks great. He homered in three consecutive games against the A's. He's definitely firmly in early discussions for AL Rookie of the Year.

J.T. Ginn takes the mound for the A's tonight against the rival Mariners. I still dread playing the Mariners. Well, I personally am not facing the Mariners obviously but you know what I mean LOL. Back when I was more closely following the A's, I always was stressed when the A's faced them. Now that I'm back following the A's again it's interesting to get those feelings all over again.

The AL West Standings are extremely tight right now. The A's are tied in first with the Rangers at 11-11. The Angels and Mariners are right behind them. The Angels are 11-12 and Mariners are 10-13. The Astros are 8-15 but have been good forever at this point and so they are still very much relevant in the division too. All in all this division is a lot more interesting than the NL East where the Braves are burying my Phillies and the whole division at this point!

The Mariners are certainly very much alive but I'm sure they see this series as a chance to get into potentially first place in the division. 

But the A's can push the Mariners back some with success of their own!

May is approaching now.... this is a fun April series for sure!

title.title: Spring Song from 4 Short Pieces - Frank Bridge (Cover) by @yisusth
title.body:
>

A warm greeting to everyone in this beautiful #Music community. I am pleased to perform on my trumpet «Spring Song», an instrumental piece from the collection 4 Short Pieces for Violin and Piano, catalog H.104, composed by Frank Bridge in 1912 in England. This musical piece consists of four short pieces: meditation, spring song, lullaby, and country dance. They were written for an educational purpose for advanced students and were dedicated to Cynthia Lubbock, a student and patron of the composer. This song has an allegretto con moto tempo and is in the key of G major, with a time signature of 2/4. It has a brief lyrical ABA form, and its melody has a bright, delicate, and optimistic character. The dynamics are expressive, with ritardandi and nuances ranging from piano to forte. This work clearly belongs to the early romantic stage of the author. Without a doubt, it is a beautiful piece, and I am glad to have performed it.

Spanish | Español (click here) Un cordial saludo para todos en esta bella comunidad de #Music. Tengo el agrado de interpretar con mi trompeta «Spring Song», una canción instrumental de la colección 4 Short Pieces for Violin and Piano, catálogo H.104, compuesta por Frank Bridge en 1912 en Inglaterra. Esta pieza musical consta de cuatro piezas breves: meditation, spring song, lullaby y country dance. Fueron escritas con un propósito educativo para estudiantes avanzados y fue dedicado a Cynthia Lubbock, alumna y protectora del compositor. Esta canción tiene un tempo allegretto con moto, y se encuentra en la tonalidad de G mayor, con una cifra indicadora de compas de 2/4. Tiene una breve forma lirica ABA y su melodía tiene un carácter luminoso, delicado, y optimista. La dinámica es expresiva, con ritardandi y matices que van de piano a forte. Esta obra pertenece claramente a la etapa temprana romántica del autor. Sin duda, es una hermosa pieza, y me alegra haberla interpretado.

> I really like the role of the musical director, of the one who carries the baton. In organizations and in society, the need for direction, coordination, and unity is vital. In my personal life, I have learned that to be a good leader, it is important to know how to be a good follower. Humility, sensitivity, and preparation are key to leadership. It is not a matter of trying to impose oneself, but of serving, helping, and supporting a noble cause. We have learned through sad experiences that those who try to impose themselves and exercise unfair dominion lose the respect and connection with their followers. The director must know the piece, the voices, the context, and know the team with whom they work. When an orchestra follows the baton with humility, the result does not exalt the director, but the work itself. I sincerely hope that you enjoy this performance. Blessings to everyone this week.
Spanish | Español (click here) Me gusta mucho el papel del director musical, de aquel que lleva la batuta. En las organizaciones y en la sociedad es vital la necesidad de dirección, coordinación y de unidad. En mi vida personal he aprendido que, para ser un buen líder, es importante saber cómo ser un buen seguidor. La humildad, su sensibilidad y preparación son claves para su liderazgo. No es cuestión de tratar de imponerse, sino de servir, ayudar, y apoyar en una noble causa. Hemos aprendido por tristes experiencias, que aquellos que tratan de imponerse y de ejercer injusto dominio, pierden el respeto y la conexión con sus seguidores. El director debe conocer la pieza, las voces, el contexto y conocer al equipo con quien trabaja. Cuando una orquesta sigue la batuta con humildad, el resultado no exalta al director, sino a la obra misma. Espero de corazón que disfruten de esta interpretación. Bendiciones para todos en esta semana.

title.title: SPLINTERLANDS - A BRAWL BATTLE WITH LEGENDARY FIRE SUMMONER YODIN ZAKU
title.body:
> Hello Splinterland Warriors! I am here again with another blog in which i am sharing a battle that I played for the brawl tournaments and won it with my strategy and lineup that you can see below, including the battle link to watch the battle that how the fire Summoner Yodin Zaku works for me. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYkrNZvNTVFyH32iY1utiHyGj4f7stSWWbQeqpYcu7Zrq/image.png)
BATTLE LINE UP
In the battle line i used the fire Splinter cards inside the legendary summoner, in which i target the ranged attack cards because of the Summoner that adds +1 ranged attack to all friendly monsters and adds the blast ability. https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
Yodin Zaku
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Yodin%20Zaku.png Well, this is a great summoner of its time. Still, in this edition, the cards and summoners are far unbeatable if you are playing in the wild format so i have used this summoner for the brawl battle as the mana was enough to use high mana cards. In this summoner i mostly used the ranged attack monsters that you can see below. https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
RULESETS
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXnJuiNi2jaSCFkSaYvfzy1t6B1XUMGxGsQFSdNwXKxyT/image.png)

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Cerberus.png
In the first position i used a low mana card called Cerberus with a self-healing ability and enough health to stay for a long time on the battlefield. As the mana was high i aimed to use high mana cards, especially in the ranged attack monsters, which is why I chose this card to use in the first position to give the rest of the mana to its friendly monsters so this card did well and stayed for a long time with the help of its healing ability, and also gave high damaged to the enemy monsters.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/War%20Chaang.png
Well, in the 2nd position, I chose another monster from the Untamed Edition with a dual attack type one is melee attack and also having the ranged attack both can be performed from the first position because of its close ranged ability and also the summoner gave one ranged attack with blast to this card so this card worked well by giving damage to the enemy monster with its melee attack it gave single damage and also with blast it gave another damage to the next adjacent monster while with ranged attack it gave 2 damage and single damage to the adjacent enemy monsters so the blast and ranged worked well here.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Tatiana%20Blayde.png
In the next position i went for another great card with legendary rarity, which is from the Gladiator Edition with the bloodlust ability, which is a strong and powerful ability that gains more stats when a monster dies because of this card so it has a high speed and enough ranged attack damage and also can attack from the first position with the close ranged ability and can attack with melee same as the above monster so it worked well here which gained bloodlust and increased its damage which help us to finish the enemy team easily.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Sorriel%20the%20Bale.png
Here i used another legendary monster from the Chaos Legion reward cards, which i used in the 4th position, and it has a double strike attack with magic that you can see, and with the blast ability, it gave high damage to the next adjacent monster, which worked well for me to weaken the enemy monster backline team so this card also did a great job in defeating the enemy monsters one by one.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Spark%20Pixies.png
In the 2nd last position, i went for a rare card from the Untamed edition, which i chose because of the ranged attack and high speed. This card has gained one damage from the summoner and increased its damage with the help of blast ability, which gave it high damage to the adjacent monsters and also targeted the enemy monsters early because of its high speed.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/card_art/Scavo%20Firebolt.png
In the last position i used another rare card from the Chaos Legion edition, which is also from the ranged attack and it is a normal card with high damage. While the speed and health are normal i used this card in the last position, as the health is good, which is not bad at all over all the battle was good because of the summoner blast ability and ranged increment.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/nqWFagaV-collectbattletrade.gif https://images.hive.blog/DQmPav5hM74UdkscSWmGmMFZpax7QCwwmLCArCR68z229wP/l1.png
All images are from the Splinterlands [website](https://splinterlands.com/) https://images.hive.blog/DQmRELggaANDmPxwSvY4LyvjN5hrFguoz582QK6ewo4hCqS/Dragon-jumper.gif
If you are new to this game then signup here to play the game [click here for signup](https://splinterlands.com?ref=moeenali)
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://media.giphy.com/media/gLEHhcMyBGHkcPRB2t/giphy.gif
Thanks For visiting my Blog Best Regards @moeenali

title.title: [Eng-Esp] Delicious arepas filled with canned sardines//Deliciosas arepas rellena de sardina enlatada
title.body: > Hello friends of the hive, it's a pleasure to greet you on this new occasion. I hope you are well and have had a blessed start to the week. Today I want to present you with these delicious arepas filled with canned sardines and eggs. \n

> Hola amigos de la colmena es un placer saludarles en esta nueva oportunidad , espero se encuentren bien y hayan tenido un bendecido inicio de semana , el dia de hoy quiero presentarles esta deliciosas arepas rellena de sardina en lata y huevos ![IMG_7446.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23wgPzhVRrYoTqZej96xneXxGwQjrfpC4EMvYLtqhH6CxWCnBjjQhwhB6GEwCZ4NhHq3d.jpeg) Used materials//materiales utilizados

> The first step is preparing the arepas. For this, I add water to a bowl, salt, and the precooked cornmeal, and knead the dough. Then I heat the griddle and shape the dough into arepas, pressing it down to cook. Next, I chop the vegetables. I have to chop them twice because the power went out; my first idea was to process them in the blender. Meanwhile, I open the cans, take out the sardines, clean them, and then cook the vegetables. \n

> El primer paso es la preparacion de las arepas , para esto agrego agua en un recipiente , sal , la harina precosida y amaso , lueho pongo a calentar el budare y realizo la forma de arepa con mas y pongo a cocinar, luego picos los vegetales esto tengo que picarlos 2 veces porque se fue oa luz la primera idea era procesarlos en la licuadora , por otro lado abro las latas y saco las sardinas las limpio y pongo a cocinar los vegetales ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AJpm5bJLomncJRKRDyHQDvtVeMMFV34guJLnQ4Jhz9hSJRUZThznqBn59haU8TA.jpeg)

> I season the vegetables and add a little water to make a sort of sauce, then I add the sardines, mash them and let it cook. I add the 2 eggs and let it cook. When the arepas are ready, I open them in half and add margarine. \n

> condimentos los vegetales y le agrego un poco de agua para que se haga especie de una salsa luego le agrego las sadinas , las trituro y deje cocinar le agregonlos 2 huevos y dejo cocinar , cuando las arepas estan listas las abro a la mitad y le agrego margarina ![photo-output.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/AKDjVvRwBLDt8jG6T11ofQEmmZ13e5yqXoEK4zmbSfUStaFvQQya44L27cKfpWN.jpeg)
> Then I add the sardine, and that's how this delicious stuffed arepa turns out. \n

> luego le agrego la sardina asi queda esta deliciosa arepa rellena ![IMG_7442.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ariannysg/23xAe7viEA9sATm5WTHZnp3njmc7bTq4XnWawNhQ6ZExbodsMZCY2pJCPWj5upu3WpPBZ.jpeg)
