title.title: 🌸¿Qué estoy haciendo por mi salud? || Plenitud por fuera y por dentro || es-en🌸
title.body:
>Siempre me gusta pasar por aquí, porque los temas son como hechos para mí 😊.
\n\n

>Me uno a la celebración del Día Mundial de la Salud, propuesto por nuestra bella @damarysvibra y que considero que debería conmemorarse todos los días, ya que al levantarnos deberíamos preguntarnos: \
>Honestamente, soy una persona muy sedentaria; tanto por salud como por prevención, mi peso siempre ha sido un problema que no he podido controlar. A pesar de que luzco \

, mis rodillas están sufriendo un sobrepeso de unos 5 kilos y la falta de actividad física para detener el desgaste óseo que me acompaña son dos realidades que, ya llegando a los 40 años, estoy notando con más preocupación.
\n\n>

>I always like to stop by here, because the topics are like facts for me 😊.\nI join the celebration of World Health Day, proposed by our lovely @damarysvibra, and I believe it should be commemorated every day, since when we wake up we should ask ourselves: \
.\nHonestly, I am a very sedentary person; both for health and for prevention, my weight has always been a problem that I have not been able to control. Although I look \

my knees are suffering from an excess weight of about 5 kilos, and the lack of physical activity to stop the bone wear that accompanies me are two realities that, now approaching 40 years old, I am noticing with more concern.
![Diseño sin título (28).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23w3Ge3piFQ4NsGvgwDXyULjjF1N6hqBHvD9vMxGSJf3B5MfecJPcAyeJwNEH3soV4Mzu.png)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/242ruJL4pkrAn8QGmeH59QgEcvbSJXUP8ScoJLHhJu3MGXmNMqXNhTTVLvJvXm1dVhJ6t.jpeg
¿Qué estaba haciendo?

>Nada, solo quejarme. Tengo muchísimas publicaciones reflejando este problema y otra cantidad de comentarios hacia los usuarios que sí hacen actividad, admirando su temple. Por dentro siento que era un grito de auxilio que estaba pidiendo mi cuerpo, para motivarme a hacer algo hoy.
\n\n

>Aunado a ello, mi preocupación iba más allá de lo externo; soy consciente de que esa inconformidad me causa estrés y tristeza, combinada con frustración por no hacer nada.
\n\n

>Para cambiar esta situación, comencé a nadar. Iba los sábados con una amiga, pero su intermitencia me hizo ir perdiendo poco a poco el hábito hasta abandonarlo a finales del año pasado. A pesar de ser una actividad que me gusta, tenía muchas cosas en contra, como la distancia de la playa y no tener el acompañamiento para ir a compartir mi momento de relajación. Lo positivo fue que me quedó la idea de hacer alguna otra actividad.
\n\n>

>What was I doing? Nothing, just complaining. I have many posts reflecting this problem and a number of comments to users who do engage in activity, admiring their determination. Inside, I feel it was a cry for help that my body was asking for, to motivate me to do something today. In addition, my concern went beyond the external; I am aware that this discontent causes me stress and sadness, combined with frustration for not doing anything. To change this situation, I started swimming. I used to go on Saturdays with a friend, but her inconsistency gradually made me lose the habit until I abandoned it at the end of last year. Although it is an activity I like, there were many obstacles, such as the distance to the beach and not having someone to accompany me to share my moment of relaxation. The positive thing was that I was left with the idea of doing some other activity.
![Diseño sin título (28).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23w3Ge3piFQ4NsGvgwDXyULjjF1N6hqBHvD9vMxGSJf3B5MfecJPcAyeJwNEH3soV4Mzu.png)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23xAXWBVAJJRbqB7AL9cpSv1FrYWYdb2MjCCpyU68921D1p3aihoSAwXTbtjmK3Wrer4p.jpeg
¿Qué estoy haciendo?
¡UFF! Me encanta que les daré la primicia: # Inicié el gym 🎉.

>Aunque para algunos pueda sonar común, para mí es algo EXTRAORDINARIO.
\n\n

>En la esquina de mi casa abrieron un espacio para ejercicios funcionales. La abuela de mi sobrina está inscrita y las fotos o videos que suben de ella, realizando las rutinas, despertaron mi curiosidad.
\n\n

>Hablé con ella y ese mismo día fui a encontrarme con el entrenador. Le expliqué las dolencias que tengo en el cuerpo, más mi sedentarismo e incluso que no tenía ropa para ir a entrenar y él a todo le encontraba una solución, literalmente, a todo.
\n\n

>Sin ninguna excusa para poder postergarlo, me inscribí y ya tengo casi un mes entrenando religiosamente de lunes a viernes, por espacio de una hora. Incluso los días de Semana Santa, abrieron el gym y algunos pudimos ir a ejercitarnos y no perder la inspiración 🌟.
\n\n>

>What am I doing? PHEW! I love that I will give you the scoop: I started going to the gym 🎉. Although it may sound normal to some, for me it is something EXTRAORDINARY. On the corner of my street, they opened a space for functional exercises. My niece's grandmother is enrolled, and the photos or videos they upload of her exercising sparked my curiosity. I talked to her and that same day I went to talk to the trainer. I explained the ailments I have in my body, plus my sedentary lifestyle, and even that I didn’t have clothes to go work out, and I found a solution for everything, literally everything. Without any excuse to delay it, I enrolled and I’ve been training religiously for almost a month now, Monday to Friday, for one hour. Even during Holy Week, they opened the gym, and some of us were able to go work out and not lose the inspiration 🌟.
![Diseño sin título (28).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23w3Ge3piFQ4NsGvgwDXyULjjF1N6hqBHvD9vMxGSJf3B5MfecJPcAyeJwNEH3soV4Mzu.png)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23vsXC3fJPEEnZjdRSfrvMtV8LERpeAHEuFBU44pGrwoi6ibU4rkrxBhyu2SvLwtr1nhG.jpeg
¿Cómo me he sentido?

>Sensacional. Recomiendo a todos empezar HOY que me están leyendo. Tengo los videos del día uno al día de hoy y el cambio es grande. Lo que antes hacía con quejas o con menos repeticiones, hoy hago mis ejercicios de forma correcta y aunque aún me quejo o me atacan pensamientos negativos, respiro y me visualizo siendo más fuerte y resistente, lo que me permite enfocarme en alcanzar los objetivos de la rutina planteada.
\n\n

>En conjunto, he cambiado mi alimentación. Eliminé desde el día 1 la harina, el pan, el arroz y el espagueti; creo que era eso lo que me tenía con dolor de cabeza. Todo lo he sustituido por verduras y vegetales, sintiéndome saciada y sabiendo que estoy bien alimentada. Los cambios alimenticios son prioridad para tener éxito en un estilo de vida saludable. ¡Agarren consejo!
\n\n>

>How have I felt? Sensational. I recommend everyone start TODAY who's reading me. I have the videos from day one up to today and the change is big. What I used to do with complaints or fewer repetitions, today I do my exercises correctly and even though I still complain or have negative thoughts attack me, I breathe and visualize myself being stronger and more resilient, which allows me to focus on achieving the objectives of the planned routine. Overall, I have changed my diet. From day 1 I eliminated flour, bread, rice, and spaghetti; I think that was what was giving me headaches. I have replaced all of it with vegetables and greens, feeling full and knowing that I am well nourished. Dietary changes are a priority to be successful in a healthy lifestyle. Take my advice!
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-19 at 12.26.40 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/Eou9B8sNoeBVPnyew4oX5v3jSv98Hyk43zeBZUXAnRZd92EmFF7JYDXUaR6KT2vfCZw.jpeg)

>Por otra parte, cuando hablé con el entrenador y me di cuenta de mi lenguaje desde el no, inmediatamente tomé parte (como lo dice Damaris) en tomar las riendas de mi salud mental. ¿Qué me dice el no? ¿En qué lugar me tenía el no? Entonces, ya no hablo desde la queja o la carencia, sino que me enfoco en lo que estoy logrando y me visualizo alcanzándolo porque es la única manera de poder lograr mis metas de vida sana.
\n\n

>En este sentido, les comento que las personas que me conocen y tenían así fuese una semana sin verme han notado un cambio en mí; no les diré que tengo 8 kilos menos o una cintura de avispa (#GOALS), sino que se van a la actitud y la disposición que tengo; \

, y eso me hace sentir muy motivada al saber que el ejercicio está cambiando mi vida por dentro y eso se nota por fuera.
\n\n

>No podemos olvidar que la motivación nace de nosotros y la salud depende del cuidado que nosotros hagamos en nuestra vida, pero yo tengo la bendición de contar con el apoyo incondicional de mi J.J. Incluso, cada vez que llego del gym, me pregunta cómo estuvo la rutina y coincide que se ven algunos cambios 😊. Contar con una red de apoyo, personas luminosas o que compartan mis aficiones me hace sentir motivada para poder seguir trabajando en mis metas 💯.
\n\n

>Y podría seguirle hablando de cómo la vida me ha cambiado día a día, cuando hasta por ser tema de conversación, siempre sale a relucir la actividad que estoy haciendo, así que siento que con ello también estoy ayudando a otras personas a sentirse tan motivadas como yo 😊.
\n\n>

>On the other hand, when I spoke with the coach and realized my language from the 'no,' I immediately took part (as Damaris says) in taking control of my mental health. What does the 'no' tell me? In what place did the 'no' have me? So, I no longer speak from complaint or lack, but I focus on what I am achieving and visualize myself reaching it because it is the only way to achieve my healthy life goals. In this sense, I want to share that the people who know me and haven't seen me for even a week have noticed a change in me; I won't tell them that I am 8 kilos lighter or have a wasp waist (#GOALS), but they notice my attitude and willingness; 'they talk about vitality,' and that makes me feel very motivated knowing that exercise is changing my life inside, and that shows on the outside. We cannot forget that motivation comes from within us and health depends on the care we take in our lives, but I am blessed to have the unconditional support of my J.J. In fact, every time I come back from the gym, he asks me how my routine went and notes that some changes are noticeable 😊. Having a support network, bright people, or those who share my hobbies makes me feel motivated to keep working on my goals 💯. And I could continue talking to you about how life has changed for me day by day, when even just as a topic of conversation, the activity I am doing always comes up, so I feel that through this I am also helping other people feel as motivated as I am 😊.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-18 at 4.38.34 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23xVJwGMNHns2ecoRRp9HxKMr95UM8MLMwz1DUdXSZEiLpmhQkDp2ViiPaVZVJHHGSo2n.jpeg) ![Diseño sin título (28).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23w3Ge3piFQ4NsGvgwDXyULjjF1N6hqBHvD9vMxGSJf3B5MfecJPcAyeJwNEH3soV4Mzu.png)
¿Qué me espera?

>No lo sé, yo soy una persona que se cansa mucho o mis hábitos no son consecuentes en el tiempo; sin embargo, me he sentido tan bien con la vitalidad que tengo, el compartir con las personas en el gym, las comidas tan deliciosas que me preparo y la motivación interna que tengo, que espero seguir haciendo esta actividad no solo por moda, sino por hacerlo mi estilo de vida.
Si quieren saber cómo aportar a la iniciativa, pueden visitar este enlace de: [¿Qué estoy haciendo por mi salud?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/que-estoy-haciendo-por-mi-saludoror-what-am-i-doing-to-stay-healthy)
_Las fotografías son de mi propiedad. La portada la hice en Canva, al igual que el separador y el banner. El traductor que usé fue DeepL._
# Hasta una próxima oportunidad 🌸 >

>What awaits me? I don't know, I am a person who gets tired easily or my habits are not consistent over time; however, I have felt so good with the vitality I have, sharing with people at the gym, the delicious meals I prepare for myself, and the internal motivation I have, that I hope to continue doing this activity not just as a trend, but to make it my lifestyle. If you want to know how to contribute to the initiative, you can visit this link: The photographs are my property. I made the cover on Canva, as well as the divider and the banner. title.body:
# AI Frontier Report: AI-Driven Robots Take Center Stage

## Executive Summary

Physical AI, the fusion of artificial intelligence and robotics, is moving fast in 2026. NVIDIA's latest physical AI stack, especially Cosmos world models and Isaac GR00T open models, is pushing robots closer to natural-language control, synthetic training, and real-world deployment.

## What changed

### 1. Robotics is becoming a real AI frontier
NVIDIA's new physical AI releases point to a future where robots can learn in simulation, reason over tasks, and transfer that behavior into factories, warehouses, and service environments.

### 2. World models matter now
Cosmos-style world models are important because they let developers generate synthetic training data and evaluate robot behavior before touching expensive hardware.

### 3. Energy efficiency is part of the story
Recent work on more efficient AI systems is a reminder that scale is no longer just about bigger models, it is about doing more with less power.

## Why it matters

- Manufacturing gets better autonomy and lower labor friction
- Logistics gains flexible multi-step automation
- Healthcare gets smarter assistive systems
- Developers get a broader stack for physical AI experimentation

## Bottom line

AI is not just living in chat windows anymore. The next wave is intelligence that can perceive, plan, and act in the physical world.

Follow @jmjury for more insights into the AI frontier.

title.title: “AI comes to the browser… Google launches ‘Gemini in Chrome’ in Korea”
title.body:
![image.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeQaW69vpwxNCPYCCNRzWAmEasSDiTP9AvLDKwPMzxfyt/image.png)

>Google is adding new artificial intelligence (AI) functions to Chrome, which has the largest share of web browsers. In addition to analyzing text, photos and videos, functions such as information comparison, e-mail writing, and image conversion are also officially supported in Korea.
Google announced on Monday that it will expand the launch of Gemini in Chrome, its latest feature that helps search and utilize information on the web using AI. Gemini in Chrome uses Gemini, Google's AI service, to support webpage summary, tab-to-tab information comparison, support for e-mail writing, and image conversion. The latest update is based on Google's latest AI model, Gemini 3.1.

>With the newly added feature, users can use the Gemini built into the browser side panel to summarize the currently viewed web page or organize the necessary information immediately without changing the tab. As you read the news, you can ask for a quick summary of the key content or explain the situation, cultural context, and background information in the picture on the web page.
It also supports the function of cross-checking information scattered on multiple open tabs and comparing and organizing it on one screen. Through this, the price of the product you want to purchase can be used by comparing the price of the product you want to purchase on several shopping sites.
You can also get help that fits your situation or context, such as making a predictive question for studying the test or asking how to change your cooking recipe to a vegan version. You don't have to keep multiple tabs open because the Gemini remembers the page you visited before.
Interworking with Google services such as Gmail, Maps, Calendar, and YouTube has also been strengthened. You can draft emails and add schedules to your calendar without leaving the current page. You can also check locations on Google Maps and ask questions about YouTube videos in Chrome.

>Google's image creation AI, Nano Banana 2, is also installed on Chrome with this update, allowing you to convert images directly inside the browser without uploading files or moving tabs. It can be used by entering commands on the side panel, such as simulating the furniture layout in advance.

>This update will be available first on iOS, the operating system for desktops and iPhones. Android devices with Gemini integrated into the OS can call Gemini while using various apps including Chrome by pressing and holding the power button.
According to Google, these features were built with security in mind from the initial design stage. The model was trained to identify threats such as prompt injection, and user verification procedures were required before sensitive tasks such as sending emails or adding calendar schedules. The protection system is also being strengthened through automated red team training and automatic updates.
This Chrome update is available for users who log in to Chrome with Google ID, and can also import and utilize the existing Gemini conversation history. Actual use is limited to accounts over the age of 18. Starting with this launch, Google plans to add various functions and expand the supported language and region within this year.
Reporter Lee Myung-hwan, lifehwan@asiae.co.kr

Google is combining Chrome with Gemini.

Convenience may continue to increase, but since Chrome is becoming heavier, it’s not something to welcome unconditionally.

At this rate, you might even need to upgrade your computer just to use Chrome.

title.title: 5 años en la Blockchain [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
![cing.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZivdvrgfNfNBXYkWhu9ysKJKS4LXThEEJ9xVChc6Lsz9/cing.jpg)
Hace poco me llegó una insignia que marco todo lo que he construido y todo el tiempo que llevo en esta blockchain y por eso celebro 5 años formando parte de la blockchain de Hive, siendo algo muy emocionante y que solamente yo sé lo que son cinco años y los que vendrán, siempre y cuando esté en mis manos. Cinco años pueden parecer mucho o poco, sin embargo, para mí representan un camino lleno de aprendizaje, esfuerzo y crecimiento. Desde el primer día que me adentré en esta comunidad, comprendí que Hive no es solo una plataforma: es un espacio donde las ideas, la creatividad y la colaboración encuentran un hogar para así poder dar lo mejor cada día. Cada publicación, cada comentario y cada interacción ha sido una oportunidad de aprender y de dejar mi huella en este mundo que no todo el mundo conoce. >I recently received a badge that symbolizes everything I’ve built and all the time I’ve spent on this blockchain, which is why I’m celebrating five years as part of the Hive blockchain—it’s truly exciting, and only I know what these five years have meant and what the future holds, as long as it’s within my power. # >Five years may seem like a long time or a short time, but for me, they represent a journey filled with learning, effort, and growth. From the very first day I joined this community, I understood that Hive isn’t just a platform: it’s a space where ideas, creativity, and collaboration find a home so we can give our best every day. Every post, every comment, and every interaction has been an opportunity to learn and to leave my mark on this world that not everyone knows.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8Cxi2oUVZSL7utGv6ZrxjG2TYDytn4MS1PnV3hJmKDG/image.png)
Cada año qué pasa lo celebro, lo comparto y me preparo para el siguiente, como también en cada año me llevo momentos memorables y que me sirvieron para ser más fuerte. Un camino donde hubo días de entusiasmo, en los que sentí que todo era posible y que mi trabajo y dedicación rendían frutos. Hubo otros días desafiantes, donde los resultados no eran los esperados, donde enfrenté errores, nada votos y obstáculos que pusieron a prueba mi paciencia y constancia. Pero incluso esos momentos difíciles tuvieron un valor incalculable: me enseñaron resiliencia, disciplina y la importancia de no rendirse, recordándome que el verdadero progreso se construye paso a paso y cínico años después sigo por aquí. >Every year, I celebrate what has happened, share it, and prepare for the next one, just as every year I take with me memorable moments that have helped me become stronger. It’s been a journey filled with days of enthusiasm, when I felt that anything was possible and that my hard work and dedication were paying off. There were other challenging days, when the results weren’t what I’d hoped for, when I faced mistakes, setbacks, and obstacles that tested my patience and perseverance. But even those difficult moments were invaluable: they taught me resilience, discipline, and the importance of not giving up, reminding me that true progress is built step by step—and here I am, years later.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfQqnrQuxMU9AzMQffYmFTuAwqnWnEAXPBNg51iRNYdC2/image.png)
Formar parte de Hive también me ha permitido conectar con personas extraordinarias, compartir conocimientos, formar parte de proyectos y recibir apoyo de una comunidad que, a pesar de la distancia física, siempre está presente. Cada interacción ha sido un recordatorio de que la blockchain no solo se trata de tecnología, sino de personas, valores y confianza compartida. Hoy Hive se cotiza alrededor de $0.062 USD, lo que refleja que los caminos de las criptomonedas y la tecnología descentralizada son dinámicos, impredecibles y muchas veces desafiantes, pero uno es quien decide abandonar o seguir. Pero más allá del precio, lo que verdaderamente importa es el valor de la experiencia, del aprendizaje constante y de la comunidad que construimos juntos. >Being part of Hive has also allowed me to connect with extraordinary people, share knowledge, participate in projects, and receive support from a community that, despite the physical distance, is always there for me. Every interaction has been a reminder that blockchain isn’t just about technology, but about people, values, and shared trust. # >Today, Hive is trading at around $0.062 USD, reflecting that the paths of cryptocurrencies and decentralized technology are dynamic, unpredictable, and often challenging—but it’s up to each of us to decide whether to give up or keep going. But beyond the price, what truly matters is the value of the experience, of constant learning, and of the community we’re building together.

title.title: Preconceived Character Analysis - ZAPFIC MONDAY (4/20/26) | Prompt: assessment (evaluación)
title.body: >\n\nFor this week's ZAPFIC Monday challenge, the prompt \

presented the opportunity to rethink how in the past I've listened to other individuals' views about another person. 

I have to admit that I developed opinions without ever meeting the person in question. I learned over time to adjust my thinking. The reason for my change in attitude was that someone formed an opinion about me without even knowing me personally. It makes you pause and reflect on preconceived prejudices. I share a flash fiction story along those lines.

The ZAPFICMonday challenge was created by @felt.buzz and consists of a story told in 240 characters or less. Quite a feat to accomplish. If you're interested, visit the current challenge post: [It's Monday 20th April 2026! Time for #ZapFicMonday: ZapFic240! The \

ZapFic: Write a story using 240 characters OR less!](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@zapfic.club/its-monday-20th-april-2026-time-for-zapficmonday-zapfic240-the-original-zapfic-write-a-story-using-240-characters-or-less). **My story is below:**
![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)
Edward leaned in as he shook Mark's cold, clammy hand. He'd issue his own assessment, but couldn't ignore rumors. If only he avoided gossip columns. Free fodder for competitors. Nice fella. But his wife's exotic dance career overshadowed all.
![Pixabay-reinhardthrainer-samba-4115070_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23wCG1EfESawV1MJRiDaF4wNEMZPWdyQNTF1uqNE5dPQpdWM1kvX2FRK44KL6NiRKXicZ.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/samba-samba-dancer-brazil-to-dance-4115070/)
![FreeWriteDividerLine-MarianneWest.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23ynsk5hF8WgxEK23S91EqNSGFnZiPhnB2eheU6gzx4jFWSuEVwrjbCKxyLXETkXuDtZg.png)

>

Para el reto ZAPFIC Monday de esta semana, el tema «evaluación» me brindó la oportunidad de replantearme cómo, en el pasado, he prestado atención a las opiniones de otras personas sobre alguien. Debo admitir que me formaba opiniones sin haber conocido nunca a la persona en cuestión. Con el tiempo, aprendí a ajustar mi forma de pensar. El motivo de mi cambio de actitud fue que alguien se formó una opinión sobre mí sin siquiera conocerme personalmente. Eso te hace parar y reflexionar sobre los prejuicios preconcebidos. Comparto un relato breve en esa línea.

El reto ZAPFICMonday fue creado por @felt.buzz y consiste en una historia contada en 240 caracteres o menos. Si te interesa, visita el post del reto actual: [It's Monday 20th April 2026! Time for #ZapFicMonday: ZapFic240! The \

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

**Análisis de personajes preconcebidos**

Edward se inclinó hacia delante mientras estrechaba la mano fría y sudorosa de Mark.

Tenía su propia opinión al respecto, pero no podía ignorar los rumores.

Ojalá hubiera evitado las columnas de cotilleos. Eran carne de cañón para la competencia.

Un tipo agradable. Pero la carrera de su mujer como bailarina exótica lo eclipsaba todo.

body.title: Nowe nominały rycarów
body.body:
Gliniane rycary pojawiły się w Królestwie stosunkowo niedawno, bo jesienią 2025. Początkowo bardziej jako pamiątka z otwartej enklawy niż coś, co ludzie będą wykorzystywać. Okazało się jednak, że część osób faktycznie nosi ze sobą gliniane monety i opłaca nimi wydarzenia. Później doszły do tego różne techniczne problemy na Hive. W efekcie zacząłem poważniej myśleć o fizycznych rycarach jako pewnym zabezpieczeniu naszego systemu. 

Jest z nimi tylko jeden problem - gdyby faktycznie chcieć traktować je jako alternatywę do RCRT, to jest ich zdecydowanie za mało. Gdyby każdy chciał zamienić RCRT na monety to skończylibyśmy z niewypłacalnością jak Zondacrypto. Wszystko dlatego, że nominały są dość niskie: 1, 2, 3 i 5.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfP9B4gvqWQCNXNEZcsu4FUQ7bk8rBhPtK1QSTGHGbS4/dfuns_2026_04_20_234939cad9f2beb794.jpg)

Zacząłem więc myśleć nad większymi rycarami. Trochę posiedziałem z gliną. I tak powstał projekt monety 50-cio rycarowej. Z dziurą w środku.

A skoro 50 ma dziurę, to może 100 będzie miało całość...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNtgJJNNEjVH9ZJZwYAdW9vMSbWn3Sv1uENzYBST1a3he/dfuns_2026_04_20_2349390f600f2a46f4.jpg)

...i lekko zmodyfikowany klucz (często używana wersja z kropkami). Na zdjęciach jest prototyp, więc ma trochę mankamentów.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmepTEsDkyT4vJfqTjfP4QsX7QyQVjnWXArF5V9TWHg1Rd/dfuns_2026_04_20_2349392a4a881c47ea.jpg)

\

obu monet planuję na czerwcową rocznicę otwarcia KBK. Wtedy też pojawią się rycary w nowym kolorze. Dobrze koresponduje to z pomysłem @grigorijj'a, który zaproponował by imprezę rocznicową połączyć z możliwością zakupienia czegoś co byłoby tworzone tylko na tę okazję. \n\nA gdyby tak stworzyć jakąś pulę rycarów o nominałach 5, 50 i 100 łączących kolory obu okresów? Np. jeśli na 11 rok istnienia Królestwa przyjmiemy kolor bordowy, to rycar jubileuszowy będzie miał dwa kolory morski (z 10 roku) i bordowy (z 11). Myślę, że to dość ciekawy pomysł. Ciekaw jestem czy postałby w ten sposób rynek kolekcjonerskich rycarów...

I remember the clash I witnessed, it was a big one. I was so scared it would not become a war. The untold part was that it started small, but it was not contained. Assumptions set in, it rose quickly. Eventually the reason for the clash was ignored, and the focus was their pride being hurt.



Initially, I stood to see the clash when it started. It was an open confrontation and a face-off. Wrong words were said, and it sparked the wrong reaction. This was how it started.



Self control is very important in life.
One should learn how to control himself, it is very important.
Words, action are things you do that you cannot take back. So, it is wise to think things through before making a move.

body.title: [FreePlay] Welcome to America’s Most Dangerous City | Grand Theft Auto: Carcer City (Mod)
body.body:
>**My 3speaking Today**   ¡What's up players! Warm greetings to all of you, and let me wish you a great start to the week. I’m truly glad to have you back here on my 3speak channel, and I’m also happy that you’re taking the time to read this : ) , so thank you. Guys, today I’m super happy and excited to bring this wonderful project to my 3speak channel: ***‘ Grand Theft Auto: Carcer City’***, which is a **‘total conversion’** mod created by a small independent studio of modders from the GTA community, led by the modder known as **DEADPOOLMKD**, whom I’d first like to thank for the magnificent work he and his team have done. What is GTA: Carcer City about? Well, let me ask you this: do you remember Rockstar Games’ iconic action video game, Manhunt? I ask this because **Manhunt** is precisely the main inspiration for this mod, since this game is set in the city of Carcer, which is canonical within the Grand Theft Auto universe, and in GTA lore is known as **‘the most dangerous city in America.’** The story of GTA: Carcer City takes place in 2001 (the same year as GTA 3) and two years before the events of Manhunt, where the city is already completely engulfed in chaos and overrun by a large number of criminal gangs who act as the protagonist’s main enemies.   We begin our story in the shoes of **Liam**, a detective with the CCPD (Carcer City Police Department), and after a magnificent opening cutscene, we learn a bit about his background and his interactions with his fellow CCPD detectives. After the opening cutscene ends—which, by the way, features fantastic music— we’re introduced to the standard tutorial showing us how to use our hideout—the place where we can save our games—which, by the way, is a very humble and gloomy apartment located in Midtown, a rough part of Carcer, where at first glance we can see it’s overrun with local gangs, about whom we don’t know much yet, since one very important thing that hasn’t been mentioned is that this mod is in its early stages—meaning it’s currently just a **DEMO**. So we have to understand that many details of the game aren’t finished yet, but this Carcer City mod actually has a very active community, just like the development team, so I’m very optimistic that it will be completed.   During this first FreePlay session, I tried to focus on freely exploring the city of Carcer, since, as you can see starting at the 5:43 mark in the gameplay, the Carcer map is enormous—it’s truly impressive that we have a new 3D-era GTA of this scale right here in 2026 : O . During this first FreePlay, we managed to collect the first 5 of 100 baseball cards, which serve as the game’s collectibles. They feature a spectacular design and aren’t just for show—baseball cards are used because, as shown in the mod’s intro, baseball is the dominant sport in Carcer. During this first gameplay session, we managed to explore most of the northern area of the first island’s map—that is, the zone known as Carcer Point. And well, players, I have nothing more to say for today, but I won’t sign off without first thanking you for your support on this 3speak channel, for which I am extremely grateful, my friends.   -> Download the Mod for Free: [Carcer City on Moddb](https://www.moddb.com/mods/gta-carcer-city/downloads) <- --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjZUumkMzuDaaTdF8cd3PwrNnq57q7XSij3HdG1NDcWb/barra_3shorts.png # **Some technical details:** **1.** Video game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (CLASSIC EDITION - PC) **2.** OS: (Windows 10 x64) **3.** Video Capture Software: Action V 4.4.0 (Win x64) **4.** Edited and Rendered: Capcut (Professional Edition x64) ---- # **Additional mods for Carcer City:** • Animations mod • Turn on / off engine mod • Give Weapons mod • High Beams mod • Manhunt Weapons Pack • No Dual Wield Pistol mod • Open Trunk & Hood mod • Player Changer mod • Reload Weapon mod • Rikintosh HD Cars • Spare Tire mod • Trunk Store Weapons mod • Weapons Recoil Auto mod • Weapons Mod Manager V2 • Bodycam mod • Taser Gun mod ---- https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjZUumkMzuDaaTdF8cd3PwrNnq57q7XSij3HdG1NDcWb/barra_3shorts.png

body.title: Guaiacum sanctum [Span/Eng]
body.body:
>
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/3246/3246465qtkrsyqrwx.webp
Saludos Comunidad
Expansivo inicio de semana lleno de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

>Guaiacum sanctum es el nombre científico del Guayacán Real, este árbol que encontramos en las aceras de muchas calles como por ejemplo en El Tigre/Anzoátegui país Venezuela la ciudad donde vivo. Cuenta la historia de esta ciudad que los árboles de Guayacán Real lo trajeron los pobladores que se trasladaron desde la Isla de Margarita estado Nueva Esparta cuando hubo aquélla expansión del Oro Negro (petróleo), muchos hombres llegaron a esta zona en la búsqueda de mejores condiciones de vida para ellos y su familia.

\n\n

>Se trata de la especie forestal más célebre, tanto del Bosque Tropical Seco, como de la Cuenca del Mar Caribe, de las cuales es nativa, y donde su población se encuentra actualmente severamente disminuida.

\n\n

>El guayacán real, o lignum-vitae, tal como se le conoce popularmente en el idioma inglés, comenzó a irrumpir en el escenario mundial a partir de finales del siglo XV, luego de la llegada de Cristóbal Colón a las islas del Mar Caribe.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/3246/3246465qtkrsyqrwx.webp

>Para cuando los españoles llegaron a América, el guayacán real se encontraba en abundancia en las islas caribeñas, y el uso rutinario de esta madera, así como de la resina aceitosa que contiene, llamada el guayacol, formaban parte de la cultura indígena encontrada.

\n\n

>Volviendo a la historia de los margariteños, la mayoría de estas personas en la Isla hacían el oficio del zapatero su primera actividad económica para lograr el sustento económico. Pues, El Tigre y la zona donde vivo sus primeros pobladores fueron los migrantes de esta Isla, ellos trajeron su cultura sobre todo musical, culinaria y esta planta; para plantar y dar sombra en el frente de estas casas que fueron construyendo con el paso del tiempo y sus mejoras salariales al entrar en el mundo de las compañías petroleras.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/3246/3246465qtkrsyqrwx.webp

>El árbol Guayacán Real, presenta diversas características emblemáticas y valiosas de las zonas tropicales de América, incluyendo Venezuela. También es conocido como Palo Santo o Lignum Vitae (Árbol de la Vida), debido a la dureza extrema de su madera. Produce unas pequeñas flores de un color azul violáceo intenso, que con el tiempo y el sol se van aclarando hasta volverse casi blancas, en realidad no me he percatado el color blanco en sus flores) por lo general las flores azules sí.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/3246/3246465qtkrsyqrwx.webp

>Sus hojas son redondeadas, brillantes y crecen en forma densa, lo que la convierte en un árbol excelente para la sombra. Por ello, quizás esas personas trajeron estas plantas, aunque su crecimiento es muy lento para poder disfrutar de esta sombra a corto tiempo. La madera es considerada como una de las más pesadas y duras del mundo. La madera del Guayacán se hunde en el agua.

\n\n

>Hace unos meses, en la acera de la casa de una vecina había dos plantadas desde que sus padres llegaron a esta zona, una historia de hace más de 80 años, la primera cayó sin ton ni son y la otra también tiempo después. Estos procesos los considero energéticos porque los padres de ella quienes sembraron estos árboles fallecieron hace unos cuantos años, siento que estas plantas fueron su legado, meses antes de fallecer mi suegra que también es parte de la historia de los pobladores que llegaron de la Isla de Margarita cayó la segunda, quizás nadie le dio ese significado pero yo sí, tres personas pilares y estas plantas cayeron.

\n\n

>Hay calles donde estas plantas son tan adultas y allí siguen ofreciendo sus bellas flores, frutos para reproducirse y sus hojas que proveen de mucha sombra. Como símbolo natural es el árbol emblemático del estado Nueva Esparta en Venezuela, la historia de esto en párrafos anteriores. Es una planta que encaja perfectamente con un estilo de jardín de bajo mantenimiento alta longevidad.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/3246/3246465qtkrsyqrwx.webp

>

Así sigo observando con más interés las plantas que veo todos los días en mis caminatas matutinas, esta la que comparto hoy está a media cuadra de mi casa.
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/3246/3246465qtkrsyqrwx.webp
Contenido escrito propiedad de la autora ©Mercedes Mendoza. Todos los derechos reservados [Divisores](https://www.glitter-graphics.com/dividers?page=94) Fotografías propiedad de la autora de su galería personal, en fecha 11/04/2026 [Pàgina Web Consultada](https://www.guayacanreal.com/) [Pàgina Web Consultada](https://www.elmundoforestal.com/portfolio/guayacan-real/)

>
english version (click here)

Greetings, Community!

Wishing you an expansive start to the week filled with health, energy, wonderful ideas, and magic. May you find yourself connecting with your inner self and be full of enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.

>Guaiacum sanctum is the scientific name for the Royal Guayacán, a tree we find lining the sidewalks of many streets, such as in El Tigre, Anzoátegui, Venezuela, the city where I live. The history of this city tells us that the Royal Guayacán trees were brought by settlers who migrated from Margarita Island, Nueva Esparta state, during the oil boom. Many men arrived in this area seeking better living conditions for themselves and their families.

\n\n

>It is the most celebrated tree species of both the Tropical Dry Forest and the Caribbean Basin, where it is native, and where its population is currently severely diminished.

\n\n

>The royal lignum vitae, as it is popularly known in English, began to emerge on the world stage in the late 15th century, following Christopher Columbus's arrival in the Caribbean islands.

By the time the Spanish arrived in the Americas, the royal lignum vitae was abundant in the Caribbean islands, and the routine use of this wood, as well as its oily resin called guaiacol, was part of the indigenous culture they encountered.

>Returning to the history of the people of Margarita Island, most of them made their living as shoemakers. The first inhabitants of El Tigre and the area where I live were migrants from this island, bringing their culture, especially their music and cuisine, and this tree; they planted it to provide shade in front of the houses they built over time, as their wages improved when they entered the world of oil companies.

\n\n

>The Royal Guayacán tree exhibits several emblematic and valuable characteristics of the tropical regions of the Americas, including Venezuela. It is also known as Palo Santo or Lignum Vitae (Tree of Life) due to the extreme hardness of its wood. It produces small, intensely violet-blue flowers that, with time and sun exposure, fade to almost white (I haven't actually noticed the white color in its flowers; the blue flowers are usually more noticeable).

\n\n

>Its leaves are rounded, glossy, and grow densely, making it an excellent shade tree. Perhaps this is why those people brought these plants, although their growth is too slow to provide shade in a short time. The wood is considered one of the heaviest and hardest in the world. Guayacán wood sinks in water. A few months ago, on the sidewalk in front of a neighbor's house, there were two trees planted since her parents arrived in this area—a story from over 80 years ago. The first one fell for no apparent reason, and the second one followed some time later. I consider these events energetic because her parents, who planted these trees, passed away a few years ago. I feel that these plants were their legacy. Months before my mother-in-law, who is also part of the history of the settlers who came from Margarita Island, passed away, the second tree fell. Perhaps no one else understood its significance, but I did: three pillars of the community, and these trees fell.

\n\n

>There are streets where these trees are so old, and they continue to offer their beautiful flowers, fruit for reproduction, and leaves that provide ample shade. As a natural symbol, it is the emblematic tree of the state of Nueva Esparta in Venezuela; the story of this was told in previous paragraphs. It is a plant that fits perfectly with a low-maintenance, long-lasting garden style.

So I continue to observe with more interest the plants I see every day on my morning walks; this one I'm sharing today is half a block from my house.

In a week we'll be on the highway heading east and north towards South Dakota but for today it was an easy run and hike high up on Mingus Mountain on my agenda. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/42be8013-292a-4990-ad72-93f1dd06f26b.jpg) I hit the trail before 9 am so the day's temperature was well below the upper 80s that the thermometer would reach in the afternoon. Even so it was still warm and I quickly worked up a sweat as I turned onto the road. It was a tedious mile climb before I crossed the Blowout Trail entry and began the more enjoyable downhill trail. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/03319708-ff00-4b1e-8469-eb50a5d74e2e.jpg) Just over 5 km covered at a decent pace-slowly improving and I hope quicker gains in SD. Another early afternoon trip up to the Woodchute Mountain trails with Lulu. The 7000 foot elevation made the conditions over 15 degrees cooler so our 3 mile hike was much nicer. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/826e06f3-abee-47ab-ad35-0da75e3908f6.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/059c7824-4b47-4392-a795-768b9ca70a80.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fd28fe90-600d-40c3-8c91-31cd8eccd293.jpg) Other than birds and beetles there were no other creatures on the trail with us. Lulu trotted we'll out in front pausing every now and then for a sniff and pee but overall the pace was pretty good. Big fluffy clouds were building but unfortunately no rain was forthcoming. Time to relax and more organizing our gear for the trip. I hope all my Actifit friends are happy and see you all tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@ultratrain/actifit-ultratrain-20260421t001446469z)_

body.title: When the silence comes ...
body.body:
>

>No problem is so small as not to discuss it as a couple. This is not an apology for fighting, nor that everything should become a war. But it is a wake-up call, because one of the most dangerous things that can happen is that silence reigns. That the important things are not talked about… Worry not when they tell you something they don't like, worry when they don't like it, when they don't feel like talking… What I give speaks about who I am, about me. While what you give me speaks of who you are... We live getting frustrated because we act in a way with people and they do not correspond to us in the same way. We may even think that our personal value is associated with what we receive from others... and there unfortunately we can lose our essence, and always what happens is for the best, although sometimes we give ourselves strokes! Then you look back, and you say to yourself... ahhh if this hadn't happened it wouldn't have come to this another one. To what you are today. >Everything in this life is beneficial for our personal growth. Of course, interactions with people can show us that there are things we can improve. But many times the problem is not you. Above all, if what you are giving comes from generosity, affection and respect. Suddenly, and even if it hurts, you mean something else to that person who is valuable to you. The other also has a story that you don't know and makes him who he is, that's why, in the end, when you decide to give, think that what you give is a testimony of you... not what you get. The static in life leaves us nothing... Movement in physical life is what teaches us and makes us remember to move forward. If not, why did we come to live this life experience? Let's remember that when we leave, it's not going to be worth what they did to you, gave or didn't give, or told you. What counts is what you did, you gave. you said and felt with what happens to you in life. He's particular... You are the protagonist of your story. Your life is your responsibility. We can't run other people's lives, only our own. And by vibration we attract the situations in experiences we live from any kind of relationship and diseases as well. We are even born in places according to our own vibration... to heal... This does not mean that we are bad people and we deserve everything bad that happens to us in this life. They are things that we must experience and realize that it no longer resonates with us because it hurts and is not right. There is the memory that we will take with us and make it better and different. \
Gracias por su apoyo y reconocimiento

Optar por esos marcadores de pintura acrílica, a pesar de su costo, muestra tu compromiso con la calidad y tu deseo de explorar nuevas técnicas artísticas. 

Además, tu ingenio al elegir la cartulina grande para ahorrar y maximizar tus recursos es un testimonio de la sabiduría práctica que todos deberíamos cultivar. Así que, ¡brindo por tu viaje artístico y por la pasión que te impulsa a seguir creando! Cada trazo en tu lienzo negro será una manifestación de tu dedicación y de la conexión que has forjado con tu entorno. 🎨✨

body.title: Observando Playa el Cardón [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>  ![334081.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xATc63ynm8Sw3GgqEZaTn49rfqDwyJ33Shv5Fr4V2DY2bWF5J4nUCYCW3yxDutkUyxR.png) Holiiiissss, ¿cómo están? Feliz inicio de semana para todos. Espero que tengan una superfeliz semana y que todo lo propuesto se les cumpla esta linda semana. Hoy aprovecho para compartir con ustedes mi paseo de hoy, jajajajaja, porque la verdad es que sí se sintió como un paseo, donde lo único que no fue tan agradable para mi gusto fue el sol, pero yo decidí iniciar la semana con actitud de ganadores. Así me dijo un amigo la otra vez que, así las cosas se tornaran duras, debía mostrar mi mejor cara y mi mejor sonrisa, porque si no lo hago, lo que pasa es que nos trancamos y muchas veces no nos damos cuenta de que la tranca la hacemos nosotros mismos.
Hiiiiii, how are you all? Have a great start to the week, everyone. I hope you have a brilliant week and that everything you’ve set out to do comes to fruition this lovely week. Today I’m taking the opportunity to share my little outing with you, ha ha ha ha, because to be honest it really did feel like a bit of a stroll, where the only thing that wasn’t quite to my liking was the sun, but I decided to start the week with a winning attitude. A friend told me the other day that, even if things get tough, I should put on my best face and my best smile, because if I don’t, what happens is that we get stuck, and often we don’t realise that we’re the ones creating the blockage ourselves.
![20260420_092633.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23zbPtECLLge69Pg3GKN227i8QQAxNd7nBkk4JqAMcLH1xt8FUNxf3UmKoZwvV8dEehbz.jpg) ![20260420_092722.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23qrJF4hemqnhPtmVwPFXaVVYFvUtRJbPh7zvBw5vt58Xpxbi5n1C2CCsze2Fn9GyFjuf.jpg) ![20260420_092641.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EoMEGGSyPJxFEjV6SpSHAiuTzhEzEh2AWuN9Er7DoDKbHJwiWNhRpRGrqJG6Vpq2bjE.jpg) Así que yo dije nada; la cuestión es que actualmente ando trabajando por el parque y estaba por Isla, y los que conocen saben que existe un trecho para caminar justo donde limita playa El Tirano con playa El Cardón, pero en este caso, del lado al que me dirigía, era playa El Cardón, ya que iba hacia el parque. Playa el cardón es una playa que yo que siempre m quejo de que las playas a veces suelen ser muy frías esta no lo es, de hecho las playas de este lado de la Isla no son tan frías eso es un punto a su favor, y si hay algo que diga que no me gusta es que son pocas las maticas que hay para protegerse del sol aunque ya casi finalizando por el puente si hay unas cuantas matitas donde se puede tomar sol, es una playa que siempre tiene su oleaje claramente que no como parguito y playa el agua pero siempre tiene su oleaje.
So I didn’t say anything; the thing is, I’m currently working in the park and I was in Isla, and those who know the area will be aware that there’s a stretch of path right where El Tirano beach meets El Cardón beach, but in this case, on the side I was heading towards, it was El Cardón beach, as I was heading towards the park. El Cardón Beach is a beach that I always complain about because beaches can sometimes be very cold, but this one isn’t; in fact, the beaches on this side of the island aren’t that cold, which is a plus, and if there’s one thing I don’t like, it’s that there aren’t many plants to shelter from the sun, although just before you reach the bridge there are a few small bushes where you can sunbathe. It’s a beach that always has a bit of a swell—clearly not like Parguito or El Agua, but it always has a bit of a swell.
![20260420_092921.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EorzphhcZnmCtFKxNRj12Y3YzfqnuTL7mmX4TVWLpoZpREh8LbEhmazKWuZkprNrudJ.jpg) ![20260420_092730.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xVHPbf6o7DdHGoTGBVofa2tupA8UiG41F3xsEHbMDKjd38ubgerKvHswMLc877tDqRs.jpg) ![20260420_092931.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uaK6zGRL1FB2hFDAVNAPXNKDu6rGRKGuXfuz5LPhc5C2M4pTZ66ejfWZA3DDAiucmR2.jpg) ![20260420_092934.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/2423x5HRuzpJEsbkE6PzD2VabtFRZzY8vkUrZMB665TrqFLAxtpmYB9EJGPgAHGJZMunu.jpg) ![20260420_092744.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EqFrTQawmwVDZ7sRorsmxV94ePQc795J2i5ecs5Q61JJKYpzb48mTQNjV1SwhhH3dyd.jpg) ![20260420_092914.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/Eos3GZqDdPHjM6bzK64nqKaDW279NYoZvAChn1xrjico4hZ34oTRDHWAdwVm43iudtM.jpg) Ademas de eso queda un poco bajo a comparación de las demás playas hay que bajar para poder acceder y se pueden obaservar las piedras, me gusto porque ademas de eso todo es muy limpio al no tener tantas plantas que puedan ensuciarla a exepción de cuanto la propia playa hace su proceso natural de limpieza, asi mismo pasé por este popular campito donde siempre recuerdo jugando a mi papá en sus mejores momentos cuando aún era deportista jajajajjaja y lo que siempre me gusto de ese campo es ver como el guayamurí se mostraba sobre él. Llegué al parque de lo más relajada; siento que de verdad me gusto pasar por la playa asi que no me quejo ¡Saludos!
Apart from that, it’s a bit lower than the other beaches – you have to go down to get there – and you can see the rocks. I liked it because, apart from that, it’s all very clean as there aren’t many plants to make it dirty, apart from when the beach itself goes through its natural cleaning process. I also passed by this popular little field where I always remember watching my dad playing in his prime when he was still an athlete, ha ha ha ha ha, and what I’ve always loved about that field is seeing how the guayamurí tree stood out against it. I arrived at the park feeling completely relaxed; I really enjoyed my time at the beach, so I’m not complaining. Cheers!
![20260420_093207.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EnYRRr1L5sCmTcaqm1tjjWtmz9NizGkWKoLjUDXpMWkMqFa97WQeYfzj1hurzygdMxY.jpg) ![20260420_093627.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/241tZQYMf9TgTtWbP7cX91gzN3qdGgEWpEk5QNufZw4zPcNMuMaKLEtR8E4YZwceBKo7H.jpg)
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPp3w4d7XKqyHe7ehy2vRmWfJDa3A7FvafWG3WpoLJcc5/11.png

>U.S. President Donald Trump claimed on the 20th local time that the nuclear agreement with Iran, which is being pursued by the U.S., was signed under the former Barack Obama administration in 2015 and would be much better than the nuclear agreement he broke up.

>President Trump said on social media Truth Social, \

The JCPOA refers to the nuclear agreement (a Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action) reached during Barack Obama's presidency in 2015.
Under the agreement at the time, up to 11 tons of uranium enriched to 20% held by Iran were transferred to Russia, and Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium was limited to 300kg for 15 years at the level of 3.67%.
However, the agreement was later broken in 2018 when the first Trump administration withdrew from the JCPOA, and indirect negotiations with Iran continued under former Joe Biden, but to no avail.
President Trump criticized the deal as \

he said.

>President Trump's comments on the day are also interpreted as suggesting that the Trump administration is using a new agreement with stronger conditions than the JCPOA as the negotiation standard.
At the same time, there seems to be an aspect of whether or not it is intended to not agree unless it is an \

such as the permanent and complete abandonment of Iran's nuclear material and uranium enrichment rights, and Iran's dismantlement of ballistic missile power.
In this regard, the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) quoted officials familiar with the U.S.-Iran deal the day before and reported that there is a certain degree of flexibility in discussions over Iran's uranium enrichment issue.
One option currently being considered by mediators is to allow Iran to produce limited amounts of low-enriched uranium for at least 10 years after halting uranium enrichment for 10 years, the WSJ said.
Iran is said to be exploring whether the U.S. is open to allowing some enrichment-related activities after the suspension of its uranium enrichment (10 years).
Reporter Oh Jeongin (jioh@sbs.co.kr )

Trump endlessly summons the past to appeal to his supporters.

He broke off an ongoing agreement on his own, and now that he has returned to it, there is no reflection on the situation.

He only appears to be a patient of “monarch syndrome,” reveling in the feeling of being a king.

Your reflections on life and fortune strike a deep chord. It is often easy to fall into the trap of comparing ourselves to others and losing sight of the blessings we actually possess. Gratitude for what we have—such as security and access to enriching experiences—is a cornerstone of common sense that teaches us to find value in what we sometimes take for granted.

Your journey—not just physical, but emotional and spiritual—is a beautiful reminder that true wealth is not measured in possessions, but in human connections and the experiences that enrich us. Seeing your loved ones and exploring the diversity of your surroundings are moments that transcend the material and touch the heart.

The empathy you have cultivated by acknowledging the realities of others invites us to be more mindful and grateful. This journey was not just an adventure, but an opportunity to celebrate life in all its forms. Ultimately, it is in those moments of connection, learning and wonder that we find the true meaning of happiness. 

So, here’s to your experiences and the lessons that remind us we are luckier than we sometimes realise! 🥂✨

body.title: Amistades que valen oro / Friendships worth their weight in gold
body.body:
La vida sin amigos es algo que para quien los ha tenido, no se concibe, y para los que dejamos todo atrás, resultan vitales para mantenerse un poco cuerdo en medio de la vorágine de los días fuera de la zona de confort.


<center>![IMG_1468.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mamaemigrante/Ep1WyEv3D6nvJ8Qn6ne5CYq8uu62LKMqiYErPbQgBc8eUUDxViALeH3sSF92FQVZMAz.JPG)</center>


Desde hace 8 años que dejé a todos mis amigos en mi país, para salir a buscar una nueva vida sobre todo para mis hijos, y honestamente, aunque yo no he logrado hacer amigos en mi nueva residencia, viviendo en un ostracismo un tanto por decisión propia, agradezco que mis hijos si hayan sido capaces de establecer lazos afectivos con chicos de sus edades.

Al llegar a este país, mi hijo mayor entró en la escuela primaria, donde fue muy bien acogido y luego en la secundaria ha hecho unas relaciones hermosas con su grupo de amigos, que han sido su soporte y apoyo en muchos momentos de estos años, además de convertirlo en uno más de la manada, y justo de eso se trata el concepto.


<center>![_20191112_130902.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mamaemigrante/23vhqV79pRRxTzxVJJG9hm7LTpqHy8kNyMfFpfDwQBJPswDkLFwbBeqyzHNjdnPTYWBFR.JPG)</center>

En días pasados, uno de esos amigos, me escribe para sacar permiso para que mi hijo vaya a su casa, y me dice que si puede llevar el chip de su celular, pues tiene meses con el aparato dañado y yo no he tenido los recursos para comprarle otro o mandarlo a arreglar.

Lo lindo es que lo que le tenían era la sorpresa de regalarle un celular, usado, pero en muy buen estado, para poderse comunicar con él directamente, aunque me aclararon que no les incomodaba escribirme a mi, les parecía que era un excelente regalo para celebrar que llegó a la mayoría de edad, pues él es el menor de todos ellos, y ya pasó de ser la mascota del grupo, a un hombre.

<center>![IMG-20180703-WA0014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mamaemigrante/EoEo7EVouSjw6iocXNKfS6TSa6JeDAoJ4yQTic6g5hDeAKYSWMiS6E5Rk4URcWFzzHN.jpg)</center>

Quizás sea solo un gesto común entre compañeros, pero en este caso, ha venido a ser la mayor prueba de que mi hijo ha logrado tener amistades que valen oro.


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

Life without friends is something that is inconceivable to anyone who has ever had them, and for those of us who have left everything behind, they are vital for keeping a little bit of sanity amidst the whirlwind of days spent outside our comfort zone.

It has been eight years since I left all my friends behind in my home country to seek a new life, above all for my children, and honestly, although I have not managed to make friends in my new home—living in a state of self-imposed isolation—I am grateful that my children have been able to form close bonds with children their own age.

When we arrived in this country, my eldest son started at primary school, where he was made to feel very welcome, and then at secondary school he has formed wonderful relationships with his group of friends, who have been his rock and support at many times over the years, as well as making him one of the gang – and that is precisely what the concept is all about.

<center>![_20191112_130902.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mamaemigrante/23vhqV79pRRxTzxVJJG9hm7LTpqHy8kNyMfFpfDwQBJPswDkLFwbBeqyzHNjdnPTYWBFR.JPG)</center>

A few days ago, one of those friends wrote to me asking permission for my son to go to his house, and asked if he could take his mobile phone SIM card, as his phone has been broken for months and I haven’t had the money to buy him a new one or send it for repair.

The lovely thing is that what they had in store for him was the surprise of giving him a mobile phone – second-hand, but in very good condition – so they could get in touch with him directly. Although they made it clear that they didn’t mind messaging me, they felt it was an excellent gift to celebrate him coming of age, as he is the youngest of them all and has gone from being the group’s ‘mascot’ to a man.

<center>![IMG-20180703-WA0014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mamaemigrante/EoEo7EVouSjw6iocXNKfS6TSa6JeDAoJ4yQTic6g5hDeAKYSWMiS6E5Rk4URcWFzzHN.jpg)</center>

Perhaps it’s just a common gesture among friends, but in this case, it has become the greatest proof that my son has managed to make friends who are worth their weight in gold.

***

*Las fotos son de mi propiedad y no pueden ser reproducidas bajo ningún concepto sin mi consentimiento. 
The photos are my property and may not be reproduced under any circumstances without my consent.*

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   El Matiz Exacto de su Propio Mar.   ||   The precise shade of its own sea.
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
El Matiz Exacto de su Propio Mar
***

>

Matthew no entró al consultorio del especialista; él lo tradujo. Mientras el médico revisaba unos papeles con el ceño fruncido, mi hijo de diez años se detuvo frente a un estante de libros y, con una precisión de cirujano, comentó:

—Ese lomo está mal impreso. La tipografía no guarda simetría con el resto de la colección.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX9XVvX21495rjgRQEpzRFLV66SBGpEk6MScGMpTV2TVb/consultorio.png)
<sup>[Gracias a Qwen IA por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)</sup>
</center>

El doctor levantó la vista, ajustándose las gafas. En su escritorio reposaba un libro grueso, casi intimidante: el DSM-5. Yo sabía que en esas páginas se había decidido, años atrás, que el mundo de Matthew ya no se dividiría en islas llamadas **\

**. Ahora, todo era un solo océano: ***el Trastorno del Espectro Autista***.

—Es un Nivel 1 —sentenció el médico, tachando una casilla—. Su vocabulario es excepcional, pero su hiperactividad y esa tendencia a retar la autoridad... bueno, son marcadores claros. El espectro es amplio ahora, señor.

Salimos de allí con una etiqueta nueva pegada a la espalda, pero Matthew caminaba como si llevara una capa de superhéroe. Yo, en cambio, sentía que caminaba por un muelle que se mecía demasiado.

—Papi —dijo él, mientras esperábamos el autobús—, la maestra dice que soy \

porque le dije que el sistema solar del mural no estaba a escala. Pero no es desafío, es que la verdad no puede ser pequeña solo para que ella esté cómoda.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZAwaFHsuNyT4RBnYPXucQpdKQwdkdgUkfJ4sL3JmNGB/2escuela.png)
<sup>[Gracias a Qwen IA por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)</sup>
</center>

Me quedé en silencio, observándolo. De pronto, un recuerdo me golpeó con la fuerza de una ola. Me vi a mí mismo, a su misma edad, parado frente a una monja en el colegio San José, discutiendo por qué el azul del cielo no podía ser el mismo azul del mar. \
, repetían. En aquel entonces, hace cincuenta años, nadie hablaba de espectros. Simplemente éramos \
, los que no encajábamos en el molde. Veinte años después, pasamos a ser \
.\n\n¿Será que los especialistas no saben clasificar nuestra individualidad?, pensé. ¿O será que este \

del que todos hablan es en realidad el lugar donde siempre hemos vivido los que vemos más allá de lo evidente?

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdX5fQKAu6pXcSbnjD9G5jSnW6c5WVVpCKJmrcMZ4wvSV/5sumar_capitan.png)
<sup>[Gracias a Qwen IA por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)</sup>
</center>

Esa tarde, Matthew se sentó en el suelo de la sala con sus enciclopedias. El sol de la tarde teñía todo de un dorado suave típico del verano de entonces; pero en mi mente, todo era azul. Un azul profundo, lleno de matices que la ciencia apenas empezaba a nombrar. Me senté a su lado.

—Matthew, ¿sabes qué es un espectro? —le pregunté.

—Es una gama de colores, como el arcoíris —respondió sin apartar la vista de sus dibujos—. Pero a veces la gente solo ve el color que más le asusta.

Me dolió la lucidez de sus palabras. Entendí que el DSM-5 podía agrupar condiciones, eliminar etiquetas como el Asperger o el Trastorno Desintegrativo para meterlo todo bajo un gran paraguas, pero ninguna edición de ningún manual podría capturar la chispa de su rebelión intelectual.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgYcnXzVckvUQ7zHh6aN3L8aRycSphAeoHvF5xUn77AQ/3espejo_recuerdo.png)
<sup>[Gracias a Qwen IA por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)</sup>
</center>

Me di cuenta de que etiquetar a mi hijo por su vocabulario avanzado o por su energía inagotable era como intentar embotellar el océano. Los especialistas buscaban \
en la comunicación social, pero yo veía una honestidad que el mundo moderno había olvidado. Ellos veían \

, yo veía una pasión que no conocía el cansancio.

—Mañana iré a hablar con tu maestra —le dije, acariciando su cabello.

—¿Para decirle que tengo un \

? —preguntó con una media sonrisa.

—No hijo... Para decirle que eres el capitán de tu propio mar. Y que, si tiene suerte, quizás tú le enseñes a navegar en él.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRiPB7TsRBb3hgCNxM89fGXEgnfaXCEq4UDhcq1EgcAg9/mar.png)
<sup>[Gracias a Qwen IA por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)</sup>
</center>

Al final del día, comprendí que el autismo hoy no es una categoría cerrada, sino que la normalidad es un invento estadístico. Matthew no era un diagnóstico caminando; era el reflejo de mi propio niño incomprendido, ahora validada por una ciencia que, aunque a veces parece querer \

, al menos nos ha dado un nombre para no sentirnos tan solos en medio del océano. *El mar de Matthew es azul, sí. Pero es un azul lleno de luz, de verdad y de una esperanza que ningún manual podrá jamás clasificar.*
*** ***

> **Estoy seguro que la amiga @chironga67 y el amigo @silher tendrán una interesante propuesta para esta iniciativa. Espero leer sus entradas.** Gracias a mi querida amiga @issymarie2 por extenderme la invitación en su entrada: [Catalina “Cascos Grandes”](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@issymarie2/catalina-cascos-grandes-un-cuento-azul-segunda-iniciativa-esp-eng).
# **
[Un Cuento Azul](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@mundo.autismo/un-cuento-azul-1er-concurso)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/Ep1WQUJt2FtQ2egAUJe8sfTvYqEy1FhrZYPrT4ERTHFc2wydBp957dTrq7n73WuwJiz.gif [Portada de la iniciativa...](https://peakd.com/hive-161447/@hiveargentina/493af481)
*** ***
🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆

*** *** ##
Dedicado a todos aquellos que, día a día, hacen del mundo un lugar mejor.
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnceTgTBLgAUkErZfdoePC7twytC1CTcqQYDKkU4Lrrd/1024espa_ol8.gif) ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif) ***

*** *** ***

>
# ***
The precise shade of its own sea
***

> Matthew didn’t go into the specialist’s consulting room; he interpreted for him. Whilst the doctor was frowning as he looked through some papers, my ten-year-old son stopped in front of a bookshelf and, with a surgeon’s precision, remarked: ‘That spine is misprinted. The typeface isn’t symmetrical with the rest of the collection.’
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVMREgtvuLVbgqdomQm69svzEedYYnoEb9QNpKVhhvft/1consultorio.png) [Thanks to Qwen IA for illustrating my post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
The doctor looked up, adjusting his glasses. On his desk lay a thick, almost intimidating book: the DSM-5. I knew that within those pages it had been decided, years ago, that Matthew’s world would no longer be divided into islands called ‘Asperger’s’ or ‘Pervasive Developmental Disorder—Unspecified’. Now, it was all a single ocean: Autism Spectrum Disorder. “It’s a Level 1,” the doctor declared, ticking a box. “His vocabulary is exceptional, but his hyperactivity and that tendency to challenge authority… well, they’re clear indicators. The spectrum is broad now, sir.” We left there with a new label stuck to our backs, but Matthew walked as if he were wearing a superhero’s cape. I, on the other hand, felt as though I were walking along a pier that was rocking far too much. ‘Dad,’ he said, as we waited for the bus, ‘the teacher says I’m “defiant” because I told her the solar system on the mural wasn’t to scale.’ “But it’s not defiance; it’s just that the truth can’t be made small just so she feels comfortable.”
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZAwaFHsuNyT4RBnYPXucQpdKQwdkdgUkfJ4sL3JmNGB/2escuela.png) [Thanks to Qwen IA for illustrating my post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
I fell silent, watching him. Suddenly, a memory hit me with the force of a wave. I saw myself, at his age, standing in front of a nun at St Joseph’s School, arguing why the blue of the sky couldn’t be the same blue as the sea. “You’re a difficult child,” they’d tell me. “You’re stubborn,” they’d repeat. Back then, fifty years ago, nobody spoke of spectrums. We were simply “the odd ones out or nerds”, the ones who didn’t fit the mould. Twenty years later, we became “divergents”. ‘Could it be that the experts don’t know how to categorise our individuality?’ I wondered. ‘Or could it be that this “blue sea” everyone talks about is actually the place where those of us who see beyond the obvious have always lived?’
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdX5fQKAu6pXcSbnjD9G5jSnW6c5WVVpCKJmrcMZ4wvSV/5sumar_capitan.png) [Thanks to Qwen IA for illustrating my post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
That afternoon, Matthew sat on the living room floor with his encyclopaedias. The afternoon sun bathed everything in a soft golden glow typical of summers back then; but in my mind, everything was blue. A deep blue, full of shades that science was only just beginning to name. I sat down beside him. “Matthew, do you know what a spectrum is?” I asked him. “It’s a range of colours, like a rainbow,” he replied without looking up from his drawings. “But sometimes people only see the colour that frightens them the most.” The stark clarity of his words hurt me. I realised that the DSM-5 might group conditions together, doing away with labels like Asperger’s or Disintegrative Disorder to lump everything under one broad umbrella, but no edition of any manual could ever capture the spark of his intellectual rebellion.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgYcnXzVckvUQ7zHh6aN3L8aRycSphAeoHvF5xUn77AQ/3espejo_recuerdo.png) [Thanks to Qwen IA for illustrating my post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
I realised that labelling my son for his advanced vocabulary or his boundless energy was like trying to bottle the ocean. The specialists were looking for ‘deficits’ in social communication, but I saw an honesty that the modern world had forgotten. They saw ‘repetitive patterns’; I saw a passion that knew no fatigue. “I’ll go and speak to your teacher tomorrow,” I said, stroking his hair. “To tell him I have a ‘disorder’?” he asked with a half-smile. “No, son… To tell him that you are the captain of your own sea. And that, if he’s lucky, perhaps you’ll teach him how to navigate it.”
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc562tqTNq9z7iy4K6dgChuAFQt82zoWsABKgSAtkaWEQ/4mar.png) [Thanks to Qwen IA for illustrating my post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
At the end of the day, I realised that autism today is not a fixed category, but rather that ‘normality’ is a statistical construct. Matthew wasn’t a walking diagnosis; he was the reflection of my own misunderstood child, now validated by a science which, although it sometimes seems to want to ‘hide the sun with a finger’, has at least given us a name so we don’t feel so alone in the middle of the ocean. *Matthew’s sea is blue, yes. But it is a blue full of light, truth and a hope that no manual could ever classify.*
*** ***

> **I’m sure my friends @sacra97 and @castri-ja will have some interesting ideas for this initiative. I look forward to reading their posts.** Thanks to my dear friend @issymarie2 for extending the invitation in her post: [Catalina “Large Helmets”](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@issymarie2/catalina-cascos-grandes-un-cuento-azul-segunda-iniciativa-esp-eng).

[A Blue Tale](https://peakd.com/hive-125730/@mundo.autismo/un-cuento-azul-1er-concurso)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mundo.autismo/Ep1WQUJt2FtQ2egAUJe8sfTvYqEy1FhrZYPrT4ERTHFc2wydBp957dTrq7n73WuwJiz.gif [Cover of the initiative...](https://peakd.com/hive-161447/@hiveargentina/493af481)
