body.title: 20 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3079: the big clash
body.body:
/>

“So you think you are going to take over the county – you're the big man running things now, huh?”

Mayor Donald Lee Garner Jr. had not turned his back on the president of the country board of supervisors since the mayor had to remind him to get the meeting started on time – the president's face had stayed red to different degrees through the meeting as the real reports had come out about the extensive damage Hurricane Mneme's glancing blow had done with its 14 inches of rain, 50-mile-an-hour sustained winds, and five embedded tornadoes, and as the real need for Big Loft to help out from its city budget became painfully clear while Virginia and the federal government worked on their packages of aid.

In other words, the board president's fate was in the mayor's hands, because all the mayor had to do was say no owing to Big Loft's own post-hurricane needs.

But Mayor Garner knew that would lead to the big clash the president wanted to hide his own incompetence behind – it would make big news and the president would play the drama better than he could because Mayor Garner had no patience for the game.

The mayor also knew that the board president was furious that he had been proven wrong; the “glorified bean counter” label had certainly not stuck no matter how many times he had assured his constituents that the appointed mayor could be controlled. The president was going to have to go back to his constituents and explain himself, and it was not going to be pretty.

But, the kicker – the mayor just opted, through doing good, to heap coals of fire on the president's already glowing head.

“Well, the city budget can't give you everything you want, but owing to being prepared, we do have sufficient reserve funds that we can loan to the county to handle the most pressing needs – on a zero interest basis, even.”

Seven of the eleven supervisors slumped from relief; two others smiled, knowing the mayor was going to come through for the people of Lofton County no matter how he felt about certain politicians. One supervisor, however, was looking over in horror at the expression on the face of the board president, whose influence over his own board had just vanished.

Mayor Garner saw that look too, but looked back calmly, and watched that face get even redder … and in the back of his mind, his cousin, Col. H.F. Lee, came to mind. “The Angel of Death” was polite and professional almost to a 19th-century Lee type of level to his colleagues, and don't let there be a woman or child anywhere around, because he could take that to a whole different angelic level. Mrs. Maggie Lee, when seen in town, was always just glowing and happy, and that was the general outcome for women and children. He also was a tremendous leader of men, and you could almost tell what his “unit” was by just watching, both in the military and on the police force in which he was a precinct captain. The Blue Ridge Precinct was a sleepy, sloppy working vacation for the members of the Big Loft Police Department before October 2019. By March 2020, they were winning every physical and professional award the department had to hand out – the Lee takeover was just that intense.

But also, the laziest man had died from just the look of disapproval on the new captain's face – hello and goodbye, just that quick, and Officer Tom White had not been the first – perhaps the fastest, but by no means the first -- for whom the terror of Henry Fitzhugh Lee had taken their soul out of their body.

Mayor Garner thought about what his cousin had said about the phenomenon: “If you recall our early lessons, the Angel of Death in Scripture arrived and ended the playing of God by powerful men and regimes, namely the Pharoah of Exodus, David, and Sennacherib of Assyria. All three of those men defied God's will from a position in which they felt no human being could challenge them, and they were right about the reality that no human being could challenge them.”

Col. Lee had paused, and sighed.

“When I show up, some men realize they are not even able to overcome another man, much less contend with God and angels. Some people live on their delusions, and without them, die.”

In the back of his mind, the mayor suddenly knew that the board president had just been stripped of his delusions, and was dying – blood pressure way too high for too long. So, he took the board president's attempt to confront him as the act of a man in a medical emergency – and gave the man's ego some oxygen.

“I couldn't even do your job, sir. The city is almost too big for me.”

Surprise … confusion … surprise … and the redness at last dialing down in the supervisor's face.

“I'm not your enemy,” the mayor said. “You came at me disrespectfully from the beginning, but there was never any need for you to have to learn from me today why you can't do that. I'm not your enemy. I'm the mayor of the city that is the county seat, and you're the board president for the county. Big Loft and Lofton County as whole need us both to get it together and work together. I'm willing to work with you, in spite of the bad start – we can do better.”

The mayor extended his hand … and saved a life. After a few moments, the board president reached back, and shook, and breathed, and remembered … .

“Oh my … I forgot to take my blood pressure medicine this morning.”

Mayor Garner pulled a bottle of water out of his suitcase and pulled a chair over.

“Listen, I just said Lofton County and Big Loft need both of us!”

So he sat the board president down, made sure he took his pills, and called for help … and thus the board president narrowly avoided a stroke and would return to his duties in two days a changed man – still humiliated, still unhappy, but with the recognition that Mayor Garner would make a better friend than an enemy.

“You are a kinder man than I am, cousin,” Col. Lee said about it to the mayor later on, “but that comes from you being a civilian, and more like our great-grandfather Horatio Lee and even my grandfather, your great uncle Horace, than I am. You took the knife out of the hand of one who would have gladly stabbed you in the back, by faith that he will not pick up another knife because you trust God to overcome evil with good. I admire you for that level of faith.”

“Yeah, I know I could have just told him off and been done with him, for good,” Mayor Garner said, “but I couldn't handle what you can handle in terms of laying folks down, Henry. You're gifted for that. I'm not. I'm a bean counter. I just want to do my job and go home.”

“Which is why God made both bean counters and bodyguards for them,” the colonel said. “You keep on with the beans, and I have your back in the city on everything else.”

“Henry, that's one of the reasons I don't have to worry about such things. Thank you for being one of God's bodyguards while I count these beans He has allotted me.”

“Thank you for being an honest glorified bean counter, Donald, for I have destroyed enough in this city and would like to go home in peace, too. I enjoy living half the week in Tinyville now, where Cousin Ironwood keeps things in order in his gentle but firm way.”

“Yeah, that's the other Army officer turned police officer that nobody in Lofton County is going to be messing with – how he took down all those rogue police officers with just you and your deputy's help is still a mystery to most, Henry.”

“As it should be. Ironwood's kill list was long enough before that, too, but there's a lot to be said for mystery. He projects the mystery, and people, not knowing what can happen to them, leave well enough alone. Like you, he inherits from the gentler Lee side in addition to the I-Line Hamiltons being humanitarian in outlook.”

“Isn't he right out of Robert E., unlike us being out of the general's brother?”

“He is, and thus is one of the most reluctantly but thoroughly belligerent individuals ever – heavy on the reluctance, and will tie you in knots with your bones notwithstanding in order not to kill you if he can.”

“Yikes – I mean, that's terrifying in its own way!”

“Ironwood doesn't do politics, but he understands very well.”

“Well, he should – his father as a county supervisor single-handedly dragged Lofton County into the civil rights era and lived 16 years more to tell about it!”

“Might be someone you can talk to for gentler but equally effective strategies than those I might share with you.”

“Henry, I will definitely call the heir of Isaiah Hamilton for tips! Wow – how many people know Ironwood is quietly operating at that level?”

“Remember, Donald, mystery.”

“Right, right.”

body.title: The kid who fought to be expelled
body.body: Greetings everyone, welcome to my blog.\n\nYesterday started well. I was supposed to have a two-hour lesson with two children — a primary school boy and an early-teen girl. Before I could start the conversation, I asked them to write their name and age on a sheet of paper. I wasn’t checking attendance. I was checking anxiety. I needed to see if his hands would shake, if he could focus long enough to write two words. It was my quiet way of asking, _“Are you safe enough with me to begin?”_![ \

They’re busy providing for us.” At home he can play video games and watch TV. But he told me: _“We’re comfortable, but we feel emotionally isolated from the family.”_\n\n_**The Words That Stayed With Me**_ He looked at me and said:  \

My parents take us to nice hotels and big malls. We pick whatever we want. That’s okay. But I wish they would talk to me gently and listen without harsh criticism or raising their voice. I’m always scared around adults. I feel so little and lost. I’m going back to the hostel soon and I’m afraid of what could go wrong. The students bully me. Sometimes I can’t sleep. I cry myself to sleep._

_I even fought hoping I could be expelled. But I was only disciplined.”_

He kept talking about his football dreams but the confined space and rigid timetable have frustrated that dream.

**What Boarding School Cannot Fix :**
1. Money does not equal presence_: These kids have everything paid for, but they’re starving for attention. He still wants to be hugged and tucked into bed.
2. Burying bullying with Silence: A school that treats wounds but hides the cause isn’t protecting children. It’s protecting itself — the business.
3. _Discipline is not Listening_: He was disciplined. He’s being sent back. No one asked “why.” He wasn’t heard.
4. _Fear weakens Learning_: A child planning his own expulsion cannot focus on math. His brain is busy surviving and planning escape from the prison — the hostel — not studying.

I’m not against boarding schools. I saw myself in that kid because I was in a boarding system for only a term as a kid 
![IMG-20260420-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXrwa7uSsrrfNYveJ6jRzC7iUTBKD9GhzLBGUtSjgWXXN/IMG-20260420-WA0001.jpg)
and my parents withdrew me. He had spent two terms and still not used to the system. Some children thrive there but when a child is begging, crying, showing you scars, and fighting to be expelled, “performance” is the wrong conversation. _Safety_ is the conversation.

I will speak to their parents. Not to blame — to translate. Sometimes parents working hard to provide can’t hear their child’s heart cry. The parents complained that they are not close to them. They need someone else to turn up the volume.

**To parents** : Your child’s grades live in their heart. If the heart is terrified, the brain shuts down. Fifteen minutes of listening without your phone can matter more than tuition. Going out with each child separately — even for a walk — can be bonding.

_**To schools**_: A child fighting to be expelled is a call for intervention and rescue. Calling parents isn’t optional. It’s a duty of care.

_To the kid I met_: You’re not “bad” for wanting to go to school from home. You’re not “weak” for being scared. You’re just a child asking to feel safe and loved. And that is your right.

_Have you been to boarding school? Was it heaven or hell for you? Parents; if your child begged not to go back, would you pull them out? Let’s talk 👇_

_Would you like to hear to hear the early -teen-girl's boarding story next.._

_Details changed to protect privacy. The image is AI generated. Story shared to raise awareness about effect of bullying and start conversations that save kids._

body.title: Discovering the Glint Shop in Splinterlands and Reaching 20,000 Fans in Rising Star Game
body.body:
## Splinterlands

In Frontier Format I don't earn Glint in my ranked battles; I'll only be able to earn Glint when I start my journey in Modern Format or Wild Format.

I haven't yet chosen which format I'll play, but I'll probably choose Wild Format because I think it's more fun to be able to use all the cards in the game. While I'm not playing Wild Format, I'm looking at the Glint Shop; it has several interesting options for spending Glint, and my focus will be on Loot Chests because, in my opinion, it's more fun and I have a chance to win a Jackpot.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPFixGgGspPywpXuLEDzkEvbC9bazLmXB1KktL377JyFg/d.png</center>

To find the Glint Shop in Splinterlands, you need to log into your account and go to the Rewards option in SHOP.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQF1Ww7iiqWCa3wKcDhg3q5iHh7CYNgn543dkX9iybk3v/dd.png</center>

**There are 3 main options in the Glint Shop, and they are:**

- Rarity Draws.

- Loot Chests.

- Resources.

If your focus is on getting Reward Cards, then I recommend choosing the Rarity Draws option because you'll have a 100% chance of receiving Reward Cards. This is a great option, but I like to test my luck, and for that reason, Loot Chests will be my choice.

**In Loot Chests, you'll have the chance to receive the following rewards:**

- Reward Cards.

- Potions.

- Scrolls.

- Entries.

- Mertis.

- Energy.

- Jackpot.

There are 3 types of Loot Chests: Minor Chest, Major Chest, and Ultimate Chest.

Another reason I want to open Loot Chests is because I can earn Energy, which means more battles in the season.

When I bought my Spellbook, I also received 1000 Glint, but I'm not going to spend the Glint yet because I want to accumulate more before opening the Loot Chests.

**In the future I'll change my strategy and maybe open Rarity Draws to get more cards for my collection.**

## Rising Star Game

body.title: Phillies get swept by Braves, and have lost FIVE straight... | Phils set to face Cubs AGAIN tonight
body.body:
![mlb-Philadelphia-Phillies-Logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/adhammer/AJhXiRGysGbqrUVr31VqR8j9iJthXQeNsJRnjA5UgF2TrkK4JXLPjHUG9MUr24D.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Welp, it may feel like déjà vu or like some glitch in the matrix but indeed it is not. The Phillies are genuinely repeating themselves consistently. 

They lose again and can seemingly do nothing right at the moment. Can't pitch, can't hit. It's looking silly no doubt about it.  Andrew Painter lasted just four innings on the mound yesterday, allowing three runs in that time. The bullpen may have been the only aspect of the game that looked decent yesterday. Offensively it really seems like the supporting cast is letting the team down in a big way. The stars like Bryce Harper and Kyle Schwarber are actually producing fairly well. Kyle Schwarber hit his seventh homer yesterday. Meanwhile Bryson Stott and Alec Bohm have been looking pretty bad at the plate lately. 

Just about 13% of the season is complete and the Phillies are now five games under .500. Tick tock man! I hope they figure something out and fast. [This article](https://www.mlb.com/news/phillies-swept-by-braves-after-fifth-straight-loss) does an excellent job at highlighting just how bad things look for the Phillies at the moment. Their recent struggles haven't been seen by the Phillies in many years. Over a decade easily. 

The Phillies now head into Chicago to face the team that began this losing streak for the Phillies in the first place in the Cubs. Ain't that something? Maybe they can start a winning streak against the very team that started this recent misery.

Aaron Nola is on the mound, let's hope he can be vintage Nola and have a quality start and just pray the offense decides to do something.

Come on boys wake up!

![photo_5131944319509007371_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23zGnsET2HFUZS6Uk2biZh4KFgRnnwZPm7vieSwNmn5YhT7fAmYecKMprRpn5gM6fNuyU.jpg)

It's mango season, and we should take advantage of it because they're sweeter, more delicious, and more affordable.

My favorite mangoes for recipes are the ones we call \

here in my country (Venezuela). This type of mango is usually large and quite juicy when ripe. I like to eat it raw, and I also often use it in salads, but today we're going to make a gelatin dessert. It's like a dessert, but very refreshing, perfect for hot days.

To give this gelatin its firmness, we'll use agar-agar, a natural gelling agent derived from seaweed. I've used it a few times, and it's truly excellent for making this type of dessert and for use as a thickener. 👌

+ Estamos en temporada de mango y hay que aprovechar porque son más dulces y deliciosos, además de económicos.

+ Mis mangos preferidos para hacer receta son los que aquí en mi país (Venezuela) le llamamos, Manga, este mango suele ser grande y bastante  jugoso cuando está maduro, me gusta comerlo al natural y también suelo usarlo para las ensaladas, pero hoy vamos a preparar una gelatina, es como un postre pero bien refrescante, ideal para los días calurosos.

+ Para dar firmeza a esta gelatina usaremos agar  agar, es un gelificante natural que proviene de las algas, yo le he usado en algunas ocasiones y realmente es estupendo para hacer este tipo de postres y para usar como espesante 👌

**Credits for this recipe: YouTube channel, CocinaVeganfácil 💚**

+ **Créditos de esta receta: canal de YouTube, CocinaVeganfácil 💚**

***If you're interested in the recipe, I invite you to join me! 😉***

+ ***¡Si te interesa la receta, te invito a que me acompañes! 😉***

# Ingredients:
-1 cup diced mango pulp.
-1/2 cup water.
-1 1/4 teaspoons agar agar.
-1 1/4 cups water.
-1/4 cup sugar.
-Two 11 cm diameter molds (you can use any mold you like, of your preferred size).

+ # Ingredientes:
+ -1 taza de pulpa de mango picado en cubos.
+ -1/2 taza de agua.
+ -1 1/4 cucharadita de agar agar.
+ -1 1/4 taza de agua.
+ -1/4 taza de azúcar.
+ -Dos moldes de 11 cms de diámetro, puedes usar el molde que más te guste, del tamaño que prefieras.

![photo_5131944319509007342_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoyPaBRgUBNVrK5mXxSQgJn3aqHgeaQp9SoH5xVHobEEyApy8CeqrYVnQWLQEJtqNYp.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

Begin by placing the cup of mango in the blender and adding half a cup of water. Blend until the mango is completely smooth. Set aside.

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ Empezamos echando la taza de mango en el vaso de la licuadora y añadimos la media taza de agua, licuamos, el mango debe quedar bien triturado, reservamos.

![photo_5131944319509007346_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoK7JXnvBjocMqTLtdGZmvW3A8zSb2eTjCgJdAb8ZjoJAMcTMuK18vjf26hPzLQdyEu.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007347_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23w2sRBptdoKx7xbBMLmWFnJaWPGozit3cD4a4YneS3eqsvc9Pyw1BLfv6ojWgmMnpwWJ.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007348_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23uQtacPXgQ1ACYzpAoqmohk7LGupJHFAAgpwVGBsEE9VMy4smhZpskBBe2LGH8bzgQdm.jpg)

--
![photo_5131944319509007349_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wMcohRJA7mWCGJzvfdheYeT3vNGTGLpC8GmRnsspWiu9kTiWFAJhUrE2DRkttqKuMq3.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007351_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiXEtHgiUJgvbTHPDrSnh6SficYVpsjtp7CaW4RJXwCv5UhijUjaeeYuyc7dcvMvjW.jpg)

Now in a pot we're going to add the cup and a quarter of water and the agar agar, mix very well so that the agar agar dissolves and cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spatula. When it starts to boil, continue stirring for a minute and add the sugar.

+ Ahora en una olla vamos a echar la taza y cuarto de agua y el agar agar, mezclamos muy bien que se disuelva el agar agar y cocinamos a fuego medio bajo, movemos constantemente con una paleta de madera, cuando empieza a hervir seguimos moviendo por un minuto y agregamos el azúcar.

![photo_5131944319509007353_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Ep3eikvJaa2wFCsHBPcYRr7cZSG6RQ65Eag9eZ9ZGhd7phbpaUApD3hYfFsp76fuJd9.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007354_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23vhyN49qAN3y3DvXGWDRPFEaeK2eoYh1eR55Arn4P9KemEJjzdYHxuFWag7jXSEzhZMo.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007355_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoAbE8WzTJe8Sh818KQUXZxRDcbcD1BvT6WAHoJuVztqCLmgC76LRhg2GQaLbGL54Rn.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007356_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EptaUEBRLPbAJ5F8Erdb9ttYHza5yNSnJKiSq3FdfMRuhvtohkwFtduqRB541GxFaZ3.jpg)

The moment we add the sugar, the boiling stops. We stir with the paddle, dissolving the sugar, and wait for it to boil again. Once it comes back to a boil, we continue stirring for a minute and then add the reserved mango puree.

+ En el momento en que añadimos el azúcar se para el hervor, movemos con la paleta disolviendo el azúcar y esperamos a que vuelva a hervir, a soltar el hervor seguimos moviendo por un minuto y le incorporamos el puré de mango que teníamos reservado.

![photo_5131944319509007357_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eo8TKzu5h2Wgf6GgWYRX2TKQuFLg2wLAdgF44xnynZhfoRtHQSeBBo1ARWj7vKraySZ.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007358_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EowHWrcoZsRSAdmwFLcXoha5fUYmdiVAAUyEMWYELx8RYEopzHsaHCQ19pRxTy22dgU.jpg)

We continue stirring with our spatula, and when the mixture starts to boil, we continue stirring for two more minutes, at that point we remove it from the heat.

+ Seguimos moviendo con nuestra paleta, cuando la preparación empiece a hervir, seguimos moviendo por dos minutos más, en ese momento bajamos del fuego.

![photo_5131944319509007359_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpJZ5fpqG4mWCGY6kXDfuobZU3u1QWZ7tfKN77ZGKKCktydQDbK3J2ULnBLtsv1GNqQ.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007360_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpA3yAujSxWLtN4eZVyh3A3crRFee9PcL4YNAcY9izhfBdwfmEywuJouJEUudjH6fzS.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007361_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpCAvpXuc6QYVvBgyGUABhyBnpBj8FtmdnHb64D1yA7fwyLXUPwtMdurLJPxsYEV9pD.jpg)

Now we pour our mixture into the molds we have chosen. I have used two round glass molds and greased them with a little coconut oil. This is done so that it is not difficult to unmold the gelatin.

+ Ahora vertemos nuestra preparación en los moldes que hayamos elegido, yo he usado dos moldes redondos de vidrio y los he untado con un poco de aceite de coco, eso se hace para que a la hora de desmoldar la gelatina no se nos dificulte.

![photo_5131944319509007362_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoiWDFhZZbdTeKZVmoTuUJB629tfD4SwpYppbaERhSSLnbV7Hbma2PakfkxNE4L6QjD.jpg)

Let it cool to room temperature and refrigerate until set, about 4 to 5 hours minimum for the gelatin to become firm, better if you leave it overnight.

+ Dejamos enfriar a temperatura ambiente y llevamos a refrigerar hasta que cuaje, unas 4 a 5 horas mínimas para que la gelatina quede firme, mejor si la dejamos de un día para el otro.

![photo_5131944319509007363_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpvjNEwKcmuBrbR7o3f9dtQ9R7DEKnxPPzLyvDv22Dothi1GEux1iNZaEk8mjgaTfpt.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007364_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wqkRSxDTjxz5soWYRRLWvUEyZPfNJjcX8bPUT8jG2omKZjUCeRDXr3qiKJkMTLzhwnz.jpg)

***Our gelatin is ready! Let's unmold it and enjoy! This is so sweetly refreshing 😍***

+ ***¡Nuestra gelatina ya está lista, desmoldamos y disfrutamos! esto esta dulcemente refrescante 😍***

![photo_5131944319509007365_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xenKn2LsBQRjq4zzQnVUQt5d4vTkAVTAj5z98f5Wgwr2J9mBW5UTLDp4NTaCchBLxtP.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007368_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAby8hv3fMTqozdPCEo8z2YV14BZxSrzMkAPaw2gSWLCZYqP8UHXeU2abJVcqvEVthk.jpg)

---
![photo_5131944319509007369_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpLh2sW2RupRgtUAzRncrCMJ5ijwwrDcPzt1k9ap3ApgV4ZisM3PW9J6zhjQKRirWJH.jpg)

---
---
**Serves:** two or three portions.

+ **Rinde:** para dos o tres porciones.

**I hope you'll be encouraged to try this recipe; you've seen how easy it is to make, and you'll only need a few ingredients. It's the perfect dessert for summer! 👌**

+ **Espero y te animes a preparar esta receta, has visto que es muy sencilla de hacer, además usarás pocos ingredientes, es un postre ideal para el verano 👌**

# <center>Thank you for your kind company and support, may the Creator bless you generously 🙏</center>

Durante mucho tiempo dudé… tenía miedo de fallar, de que nadie lo viera, de perder el tiempo.

Pero hoy decidí empezar igual.

Durante mucho tiempo quise dedicarme a algo que en verdad me apasionará,tuve la oportunidad y no quisé dejarla pasar de nuevo. Sé que no será un camino fácil, pero lo que vale la pena requiere esfuerzo 💪.

Hopefully I'll be able to get my goals-and-progress update written and published by tonight, or more likely tomorrow morning or evening. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151059541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWtjBdiqjtpjwiyMmRTxo3zUqZoWMG3xVjxiPyaxK48hJqDhYtb4LCTn3EqF5vstmSa.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151226492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFPUBRqfhtAbZVCZbQGYQGXiy6h8Saoo5M8J2fPcbXb2f9Nvy7JnEaatur8aKyCNs79.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Something significant that I forgot to mention in my last post is that I smashed 18,000 Hive Power the day before yesterday, so I'll easily surpass 18,100 HP before the end of this new week, and with my sizeable chunk of HIVE to power up on the May HPUD, it will bring me quite close to 20,000 Hive Power. My 2026 year-end goal of 25,000 Hive Power is looking very doable indeed! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151414115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsHr2mj5KwDyfZ9WR9WzF1EHYXZnztztRRiqKNyLyTH16GhoMd1ANbXTmzBbJEBviwU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151512633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC5coSVbs77WzxfJcBsbTTsAhmTA5r7PE7HCyyMD6H9R7D8JE2WcxYXKabhZUEVtXBd.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Between keeping up on all my daily and weekly Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, on those in this jungle community, and now my increasingly-deep dives down technological rabbit holes, I'm finding balancing my time in relation to it all quite challenging. This has had the effect of me going to bed multiple times this week past 1-1:30AM, which I've very much been feeling. I need sleep, but I also have lots of things to do and to learn! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151829686.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC9itBRvUzz4HkVDouZFUh5URwAzWPX35Gxn6RVntQ3hpwtpLSxHvcWKJpXw8M6aq9X.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_151938520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wgQ7z96yT2eYm54rppCv4TeRrFNSK5ymLiHPEzJbzigRwST97pvkDRU3jcjGeNkiDjC.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) On the hive-investment front, things just seem to keep getting more and more challenging, with ever more income streams drying up. I mentioned the loss of the daily SWAP.HIVE from my liquidity in the SWAP.HIVE:PWR pool hit me quite hard, because it was my, and the We Are Alive Tribe's, primary source of income, and now it's gone, just like BeeSwap, another essential Hive component disappearing into the void. I ran some numbers today, and after the loss of the SWAP.HIVE:PWR pool, it would now take me delegations totaling around 10,000 HP to @centtoken to return to my previous daily SWAP.HIVE income. All I've got to say is ouch! ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_152107255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhwrv7hAfaXpfi9rTF6RTeGRVP7p8hvQTA7cqfNE7TEWVuLJnseaxau7ipA5LmCodqa.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_152242100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsN21hFwFoYqJMKmu3rgxRyhnDxhXUaUNSYyUsmSGy989MG2NgqDpzsManBUCq1xqCW.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) HP leases sadly aren't even an option for the We Are Alive Tribe, since all the HP is needed for curation. I still don't know exactly what I'm going to do about that. At least the refund for the We Are Alive Tribe's stake of PWR in the pool gave us an extra 250 HIVE, which has regenerated a few more months of daily ALIVE payouts, so very helpful. I would have preferred that the PWR refund were sent as SWAP.HIVE, however, rather than as HIVE, because that was a big chunk of our layer-2 investment liquidity which is now in layer 1, and I'm not into losing some in the conversion process to get it back on layer 2. And, because it's so useful in giving our daily ALIVE dividends a bit of a buffer boost, so that they can continue for longer, part of our community investment liquidity that Ben and I have contributed/donated is now allocated to daily ALIVE-dividend payouts. Now to rebuild our daily and weekly SWAP.HIVE income, somehow. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_152354529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wCJ1w51kjUN3BojhLJ8PizQsYno41qKBWB13eFDuU7ECGbHGB6X4dLREdz1412UjCB3.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_152426283_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsNPcE3RTpLEBFPE35cXjFj31sXEcWmWikuyM3eXVAEfBKNSXpYtR4n11Ewj6PtuUro.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Sunday, I left the Flow House, after finishing my numerous Sunday Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by around 3:30PM, giving my attention first to a few small jungle-community tasks, and then to some photography for my posts. After turning on the generator, and going to make myself some food in Wabisabi, I returned to the Flow House, to do a little more techie research, then to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got everything done quite late, by a little after 10:30PM, and after some asset management for myself and the We Are Alive Tribe, I went to bed, way too late again, by just after 1AM. I woke up a bit after 7AM, still feeling that I needed more sleep, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to prepare my three posts to write (*and collecting token data for my goals-and-progress update*), powering up my BBHO, writing and publishing a post about it, and finally beginning on this post. It's now just after 1:45PM, so it's a marvelous time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on some jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's incarnation of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260418_153220353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wX12wV3634CYMMGkesPgYJcxGGLbnTLmTXFoyETAhc1QTGPp4Zd3iFu1dxYW2Fbv1L4.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260419_160521203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQnJF8yRh15wnb61LQ4eYZPgktRaeveiMSx9YAAyhjVXVUTDFuSHNoM1imFZtrrhWGA.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! body.title: PUBG Mobile: Gun Game
body.body:
by @samye2 on Simpson Plays 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/simpsonplays1 [![PUBG Mobile: Gun Game](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/7618e13d-4fca-4ca1-98e0-5aefd8cde2e1.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/aihiXPvzGhjq9NqJqiHZ2i) 
 
 *****
https://youtu.be/bCJ9qRUW4V0?si=_S3_-KggmIWZt0Mh
*****
Since I downloaded PUBG I've not tried out their Multiplayer mode so today I'm giving it a try. I juts saw this mode called Gun Game, it caught my eyes and that's what I'd be trying out first. Gun Game is also just like Arm Race in Blood Strike and funny how Arm Race was my post for yesterday (coincidence), the name of the map we played on us Hanger basically where airplanes are parked, I checked out the mode and it was really great there are alot of skilled players in PUBG but I managed to play well. I don't know how their guns are graded in this mode but all I knkw was get a kill to upgrade to a higher gun (Blood Strike demands for two kills before upgrading to the next gun and in Blood Strike Arm Race there are no teammates). I did not get the chance to reach the final stage (my teammate reached), I stopped at a sniper which took me a long time to get a kill with but I had to cut that part because I died alot for not being good at PUBG snipers.
All in all I believe Multiplayer in PUBG is more interesting than Battle Royale  Because PUBG Battle Royale map is so big it take a long time to spot an enemy but if you're a fan of exploration try Battle Royale and if a fan of fast aggressive game try Multiplayer.  Thanks for visiting. 
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/aihiXPvzGhjq9NqJqiHZ2i)

body.title: Life Goals: Good and Family Contest #285 (En/ Es)
body.body:
* It immediately clicked for me because these are questions where, depending on the season we’re going through, our answers can vary; but for me right now, the answers sound very different from what I would have said a while back. But let’s take it one step at a time. If I answer the first question, *“What do you think is your main reason for living?”* My answer right now is my family; they are my main reason for living, among others. But if you ask me, “How would you describe your purpose right now, and what keeps you moving forward every day?”* My answer would undoubtedly vary, but at the same time, it would revolve around the answer to the first question. I would tell you that my main purpose in life is to continue getting to know Jesus Christ and to continue grounding myself in His word and example, because without a doubt this world needs more of His guidance, of love, of brotherhood, of honesty, of humility, of respect for others, because I am certain that if we all looked at one another with empathy, understanding, tolerance, and love, the world would be a much better place, and I want to do my part, through Him, to make that happen. And without a doubt, what keeps me moving forward every day is knowing that I am walking hand in hand with Him (Jesus Christ), that, regardless of whether I am gaining anything, there is also the love for my own and for others; there is no other answer. That is why I said that all my answers somehow come together into one. I hope everyone finds peace and tranquility, and that God’s love reaches you all! Greetings!

Es

Cuando leí este enunciado: *\

* De una vez me hizo clic porque son unas preguntas que, dependiendo de la temporada que estemos viviendo, pueden variar nuestras respuestas; pero justamente para mí en este tiempo, las respuestas suenan muy diferentes a lo que respondería hace un buen tiempo.\n\n Pero vamos por partes. Si respondo a la primera pregunta  *, ¿cuál crees que es tu principal razón para vivir?* Mi respuesta ahora mismo es mi familia; ellos son mi principal razón de vida, entre otras, pero si me preguntas: \

* Mi respuesta sin dudas variaría, pero a la vez giraría en torno a la respuesta de la primera pregunta. Te diría que mi principal propósito de vida es seguir conociendo a Cristo Jesús y seguir afirmándome en su palabra y ejemplo, porque sin dudas este mundo necesita más de su guía, del amor, de la hermandad, de la honestidad, de la humildad, del respeto por el otro, porque tengo la seguridad de que si todos nos miráramos con empatía, comprensión, tolerancia, con amor, el mundo sería mucho mejor y quiero poner mi granito de arena, por medio de Él, para que así sea. Y sin dudas, lo que me mantiene avanzando cada día, es saber que voy de su mano (de Cristo Jesús), que, sin importar que voy en ganancia, aparte también es el amor por los míos y por los demás; no hay otra respuesta. Por eso decía que todas mis respuestas de alguna forma se unen en una sola. ¡Espero todos se encuentren en paz, tranquilidad y que el amor de Dios les alcance! ¡Saludos!

body.title: Balance on Port avenue (en/es)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSHxvWfJXEz8pcqPJWq4fU5474SKJHNYxhcqsgcbVKBWV/1776726865111.jpg)

✍️✍️ENGLISH VERSIÓN ✍️✍️

¡Greetings!

How good to find ourselves today on the street to discover and enjoy the good art that the artists are leaving scattered throughout the city and its arteries.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc9JFjCRknTSiqX3F9xBbkG2NXCa6PjyDF2LU5Kd6EnoM/1776727059034.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfhREYyTjoD5t3Z5xGCYkrMgZ5o52KkXMkP1u1tMy15F/1776727059617.jpg)


Today, while I was taking a morning tour along Puerto Avenue, taking, as they say here, a little time to carry out administrative management, in addition to enjoying the impressive view of the Morro Cabaña complex expanding in front of me, a little towards the Christ with his hand raised, with the esoteric gesture of blessing the city with the index and middle fingers raised, and on the other side of the bay, a little towards the freedom of the living waters beyond the entrance to the bay, I was impressed with the vision of a sculptural intervention on the sidewalk of the avenue.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYsZ8XrRMduNntX3aDx4HebKWSo89VG6FGJXVAcNNGk6/1776727060177.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYsZ8XrRMduNntX3aDx4HebKWSo89VG6FGJXVAcNNGk6/1776727231797.jpg)

Really, it is not that I have suddenly discovered the impressive sculpture of the so-called postmodernism, since I had already observed it from a distance or at the speed of a hurried passerby.

Actually, it is a set sculptural, as it is made up of different assembled pieces and is titled \

, the result of the four-handed collaboration between the Cuban artist Osmany Betancourt and the American colleague David Griensmeyer.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTTXKGyb4TszuvpGrv6pqkuggz6Dd3tsko1hkWWxsyPdr/1776727232357.jpg)

The piece has a spatial character, and the essence of the title is revealed in the dynamics of a semi-inclined line that continuously ascends from a bar of a ladder resting on a single point to the tip of an umbrella up there, supported by a girl who, with her clothes flapping, in the air, it also tries to maintain its balance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQ9rJLeQhZZQDprQZYXnQXvXDkcDdJDAVqf7KCtEpACT/1776727232897.jpg)

For Tomorrow is an excellent piece with a well-marked surrealist character and, when observing it from a distance, it gives me the impression that I am looking at a painting painted together by artists such as René Magritte, Chagall and de Chirico. Although there is room for others like Bretón.

The first thing that catches your attention about the set is a head that I assume was cast in some type of resin, which shines in its whiteness, with the base of the neck at the height of the middle of the inclined staircase, and which reaches almost to the top of it. It gives the impression that the metal scale is leaning against the immense head, while it, of course, is visually in empty space.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjaR8MF5FiU91eZJNTsSArsksHqXos2WwqUosXFbPVKk/1776727312623.jpg)

Everything in this piece, which was placed in the environment during one of the recent Havana Biennials, is a challenge to balance, because there is everything there, except balance, since this psychic state is accentuated by the instability produced by the traffic of vehicles at different speeds very close to its location.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdedUBPXQX4GfJ4wzYzZ1Th3ipHa9KXaHvoXWUwTfzEgB/1776727313175.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbY9rc48h18UiR8oCwV5U45SvfV1iB6iCHrbMKEoAovZR/1776727313725.jpg)

I quite liked the capacity and license that surrealism has, the aesthetics of the absurd, only possible in the world of dreams, to play and violate the law of proportions, in this case establishing a counterpoint between the girl, the ladder and the big head in
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaSni4bxJbxXqRSW7XUpNPiu1AZJCxmwpcsvjHPQT5MBR/1776727431966.jpg)

I invite you, if you pass by Puerto Habanero Avenue, do not miss the opportunity to see and enjoy this and other sculptural pieces.  
Thank you for the company.  

All rights reserved © @fdavidsantafe.  

Original text and my authorship.

✍️✍️VERSION EN ESPAÑOL ✍️✍️

>Saludos!

>Qué bueno encontrarnos hoy en la calle para descubrir y disfrutar del buen arte que los artistas van dejando diseminado por toda la ciudad y sus arterias.

>Hoy, mientras hacía un recorrido mañanero por la avenida del Puerto, haciendo, como se dice por acá, un poco de tiempo para realizar una gestión administrativa, además de disfrutar de la impresionante vista del complejo Morro Cabaña expandiéndose delante de mí, un poco hacia el Cristo con la mano alzada, con el gesto esotérico de bendecir a la ciudad con los dedos índice y el del medio alzados, y al otro lado de la bahía, otro poco hacia la libertad de las aguas vivas más allá de la entrada a la bahía, quedé impresionado con la visión de una intervención escultórica en plena acera de la avenida.

>Realmente, no es que haya descubierto de pronto la impresionante escultura del llamado posmodernismo, pues ya la había observado a distancia o a la velocidad de un transeúnte apurado.

>En realidad, es un conjunto escultórico, pues está formado por diferentes piezas ensambladas y se titula \

, resultado de la colaboración a cuatro manos entre el artista cubano Osmany Betancourt y el colega estadounidense David Griensmeyer.

>La pieza tiene un carácter espacial, y la esencia del título se devela en la dinámica de una línea semiinclinada que asciende continuamente desde una barra de una escalera apoyada en un solo punto hasta la punta de una sombrilla allá arriba, sostenida por una muchacha que, con el ropaje batiendo al aire, trata también de mantenerse en equilibrio.

>Para mañana es una excelente pieza de un carácter surrealista bien marcado y que, al observarla a una distancia, me da la impresión de que estoy ante un cuadro pintado en conjunto por artistas como René Magritte, Chagall y de Chirico. Aunque caben otros como Bretón.

>Lo primero que llama la atención del conjunto es una cabeza que supongo fue fundida en algún tipo de resina, que resplandece en su blancura, con la base del cuello a la altura de la mitad de la inclinada escalera, y que llega casi hasta la cima de la misma. Da la impresión de que la escala de metal está recostada a la inmensa cabeza, mientras esta, por supuesto, está visualmente en el espacio vacío.

>Todo en esta pieza, que fue ubicada en el entorno durante una de las recientes Bienales de La Habana, es un reto al equilibrio, porque allí hay de todo, menos equilibrio, pues este estado psíquico se acentúa por la inestabilidad que produce el tránsito de vehículos a diferentes velocidades muy cerca de su emplazamiento.

>Me gustó bastante la capacidad y licencia que tiene el surrealismo, la estética de lo absurdo, solo posible en el mundo de los sueños, para jugar y violar la ley de las proporciones, en este caso estableciendo un contrapunteo entre la niña, la escalera y la gran cabeza en


>Los invito a que, si pasan por la avenida del Puerto Habanero, no pierdan la oportunidad de ver y disfrutar de esta y otras piezas escultóricas.  
Gracias por la compañía.

body.title: The Costume of the Hollow Star
body.body:
Every day is a curtain call for a play I never signed up to perform. I paint on a smile with the precision of a professional, layering the colors to hide the pallor of a heart that is slowly breaking. We are taught that the world is a stage, but no one tells you how exhausting it is when the costume is too heavy and the lines feel like lies. To live as an actress in one's own life is to be the star of a tragedy that everyone else thinks is a comedy, always waiting for the lights to dim so I can finally let the mask slip. ***

The Costume of the Hollow Star

The curtain rises on a staged and steady grace,
I paint a bright composure on a weary face.
Each word is measured and each gesture finely tuned,
To hide the evidence of every secret wound.

I am the master of the laugh that rings so hollow,
With practiced steps that all the happy people follow.
But in the wings, where shadows claim the silent air,
I am a ghost of someone who was never there.

I feel the failure in the tremor of my hand,
A clumsy player in a role I didn't plan.
The lines are slipping and the makeup starts to run,
Beneath the glaring heat of a relentless sun.

Is there a prize for being someone I am not?
For staying trapped within this suffocating plot?
The audience applauds the ghost, the fake, the shell,
While I am drowning in this gilded, scripted hell.

I am a failing actress, tired of the play,
Longing for the strength to throw the mask away.
To stand before the world, unpolished and unseen,
And kill the perfect girl who lives upon the screen.

body.title: Data & Decoupling: The New Era of Crypto Custody
body.body:
https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/pichat/e8de0cc9c8be88e17d7f39f87e75258afad9181c.png

The digital asset ecosystem is currently undergoing a structural transformation, moving away from fragmented retail solutions toward high-security, institutional-grade infrastructure. Recent market data indicates a significant surge in the demand for regulated custody services, driven by the entry of traditional financial giants and the tightening of global regulatory frameworks. This shift is not merely a trend but a fundamental recalibration of how value is stored and managed within the decentralized economy.

From a Systems Thinking perspective, the custody layer serves as the \

of market stability. Without robust, evidence-based security protocols, the entire DeFi and CeFi stack remains vulnerable to systemic shocks. We are observing a transition from simple multi-signature wallets to sophisticated Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and Hardware Security Modules (HSM) that integrate seamlessly with existing banking rails. The Decision Support Data suggests that institutions prioritize \

and real-time auditing over speculative yield, signaling a maturation of the investor profile.\n\nThe current anomaly in the market lies in the gap between technological capability and regulatory clarity. While the technology for self-sovereign custody exists, the operational risks associated with key management often deter large-scale capital entry. Therefore, the emergence of hybrid custody models—combining the transparency of the blockchain with the legal safeguards of traditional finance—represents the new \

of success.

Instead of repeating the same security failures of the past decade, the industry is now adopting a Minimalist approach to risk: reducing the attack surface by minimizing human intervention through automation. The numbers tell the story—custody providers who have integrated automated compliance and AI-driven anomaly detection have seen a marked decrease in security breaches. As we look toward the future, the integration of digital assets into national financial systems will depend entirely on the reliability of these custody frameworks. By focusing on data-backed security and clean, efficient infrastructure, the industry is finally building the trust required for the next trillion dollars of capital inflow.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Día del Geógrafo en Cuba.
body.body:
Cada 20 de abril en Cuba celebra el Día del Geógrafo, una fecha que invita a reconocer a unos profesionales silenciosos pero imprescindibles. En un mundo cada vez más fragmentado y urgido por soluciones territoriales, los geógrafos actuamos como intérpretes del paisaje, analizando la compleja red de relaciones entre sociedad y medio ambiente.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdh4aJ2Yy7MSEvRAaS3LoJAnkHJry4Mz2Tu8KZvH9tXjL/1776727225396.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/GranmaDps/status/1914007319328804881?t=Y55zjiwj5yEbMOze9VvBWg&s=19)



En la docencia, nuestra labor va más allá de enseñar mapas o capitales. Los geógrafos formamos ciudadanos críticos capaces de leer el espacio: comprendemos mejor que muchos por qué una ciudad crece desordenadamente, cómo las actividades económicas transforman el territorio o qué patrones climáticos afectan la agricultura local. Mediante herramientas como los Sistemas de Información Geográfica (SIG) y el trabajo de campo, educanmo a jóvenes en el pensamiento espacial, una competencia clave para resolver problemas desde la movilidad urbana hasta la localización de vertederos. Sin esta base, difícilmente podríamos exigir una planificación territorial consciente.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7bhHMogjLLp1nZLNPUESyigJpeDrVUCsdxtG34iep5s/1776727415822.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/citmacuba/status/1914012596581314623?t=kdXozQubjX_YXDwKP_dbmg&s=19)



En la protección ambiental, nuestro papel es aún más estratégico. Frente a la crisis climática y la pérdida de biodiversidad, los geógrafos elaboramos diagnósticos precisos: identificamos zonas vulnerables a inundaciones, desertificación o incendios; diseñamos corredores ecológicos; y evaluamos el impacto de infraestructuras sobre ecosistemas frágiles. 

Nuestra visión integradora conecta datos físicos (suelos, agua, vegetación) con variables sociales (usos del suelo, tenencia, conflictos ambientales), proponiendo ordenamientos territoriales que equilibran conservación y desarrollo. Por ejemplo, en la gestión de áreas protegidas o en la transición energética, evitamos que un parque eólico dañe humedales críticos.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9BNRzuRSdgQ8JcdY4degdcqdR3YK93qhvt3vnMuDmZ6/1776727608174.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/GeografiaUh/status/1516747965817405441?t=O9D0iUivfMKBadpfAUAvYw&s=19)


Sin embargo, nuestra contribución sigue siendo infravalorada. Con frecuencia, las políticas ambientales se diseñan desde enfoques sectoriales (solo biológicos o solo económicos), olvidando que el territorio es un sistema. Reivindicar el Día del Geógrafo en Cuba es reivindicar una mirada holística: la que entiende que cada acción humana deja una huella en el espacio, y que solo desde el conocimiento profundo del lugar podremos habitar el planeta de forma justa y sostenible. Porque, al fin y al cabo, geógrafos somos todos cuando aprendemos a mirar nuestro entorno con ojos críticos… pero los somos los guías profesionales que nos enseñan el camino.

Nota: He utilizado el traductor DeepL Translate.


ENGLISH 


Every April 20 in Cuba celebrates Geographer's Day, a date that invites us to recognize silent but essential professionals. In a world that is increasingly fragmented and in need of territorial solutions, geographers act as interpreters of the landscape, analysing the complex network of relationships between society and the environment.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdh4aJ2Yy7MSEvRAaS3LoJAnkHJry4Mz2Tu8KZvH9tXjL/1776727225396.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/GranmaDps/status/1914007319328804881?t=Y55zjiwj5yEbMOze9VvBWg&s=19)


In teaching, our work goes beyond teaching maps or capitals. Geographers form critical citizens capable of reading space: we understand better than many why a city grows disorderly, how economic activities transform the territory or what weather patterns affect local agriculture. Through tools such as Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and fieldwork, I educate young people in spatial thinking, a key competence to solve problems from urban mobility to the location of landfills. Without this basis, we could hardly demand conscious territorial planning.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7bhHMogjLLp1nZLNPUESyigJpeDrVUCsdxtG34iep5s/1776727415822.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/citmacuba/status/1914012596581314623?t=kdXozQubjX_YXDwKP_dbmg&s=19)


In environmental protection, our role is even more strategic. In the face of the climate crisis and the loss of biodiversity, geographers make accurate diagnoses: we identify areas vulnerable to floods, desertification or fires; we designed ecological corridors; and we assess the impact of infrastructure on fragile ecosystems. 

Our integrative vision connects physical data (soils, water, vegetation) with social variables (land use, tenure, environmental conflicts), proposing territorial planning that balances conservation and development. For example, in the management of protected areas or in the energy transition, we prevent a wind farm from damaging critical wetlands.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9BNRzuRSdgQ8JcdY4degdcqdR3YK93qhvt3vnMuDmZ6/1776727608174.jpg)[fuente](https://twitter.com/GeografiaUh/status/1516747965817405441?t=O9D0iUivfMKBadpfAUAvYw&s=19)



However, our contribution remains undervalued. Environmental policies are often designed from sectoral approaches (only biological or only economic), forgetting that the territory is a system. To claim Geographer's Day in Cuba is to claim a holistic view: one that understands that every human action leaves a mark in space, and that only from a deep knowledge of the place can we inhabit the planet in a fair and sustainable way. Because, after all, we are all geographers when we learn to look at our environment with critical eyes... but we are the professional guides who show us the way.

Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator.

body.title: 30後就快要出生了
body.body:
大家好鴨！我是拉叔，一名70後的大叔。我感覺自己渾渾噩噩的，好像不知怎麼就活下來到了今天。回頭看看幾十年，原來“時間會加速“，是真的。就好像太空船離開地球引力後，推進器就會將太空船在沒有阻力的環境下加速到超音速20倍。

今天看到老同學在微信傳來一則轉發視頻，是七八十年代的孩子記錄生活，把拉叔也帶回了那個無憂無慮的年代。我家除了拉姐是60後，我和拉哥也是70後寶寶，雖然我不懂得珍惜拉哥，不過印象中的拉哥是真的很遷就當時那個小拉仔。打遊戲也會讓著打，有時我都懷疑自己的實力了。到底是我真的把老哥打垮了，還是我拳頭還沒到他已經準備好飛身往後仰了。

老拉叔的朋友因為搞移民，把一架比賽規格的腳踏車送了給我們。拉哥本來就有一架老拉叔送給他的越野腳踏車，別人送的要給我，我也騎不上去，輪子都比我高鴨，怎麼騎？於是，老拉叔吩咐拉哥把他心愛的越野腳踏車交給我，把那個二手單車給了他。還別說，我當時是氣了好幾個禮拜。我雖然沒有承認過，但是現在想起來，根本就是我自己的妒忌心作祟。我只是不甘願接受老哥的二手單車。

很快的，時間過去了，我們也“長大”了。老拉哥那架二手腳踏車也沒騎過幾次，就愣在一旁養蜘蛛去了。說著的九十年代就是這樣迷迷糊糊的過去了。我們也從少年時代踏入了社會，進入了青年的年華。有那個20歲的小伙子不是不可一世的。那個年代我們都是國家的棟樑，我們都是不再理會腳踏車鎖在哪裡了，畢竟開什麼車去大學，有幾個女孩看過來才是王道。看著老哥駕著老爸的車去約會，我也……還沒來得及考車牌。

眨眼間，大家都是有家庭的人了。原來，我才意識到我根本就是在跟時間賽跑。因為，我家第一個00後出生了。我這個70後就已經不再是在酒吧被喊“哥”的人了。當我再看看身邊的人，原來80後的那些傢伙已經撐起了國旗，正是加入“國家棟樑”的行列了。而我們這班70後的，有成就的就繼續棟在哪裡吧，沒有成就的就滾一邊去了。

也不知怎麼熬過了千禧年，我們家第二個娃娃落地，迎接了10後。這個年代的娃娃，你和他說中文，他要不回答你，要不跟你說英文🫪我都不明白我究竟是吃了什麼把好好的漢族基因弄成了個香蕉🍌出來（外表黃種人，內裡白種人）。20後我相信大家都沒什麼知覺了，畢竟我們大家的20年代前半部都活在疫情當中。

現在的我們往前面一看，剩下四年就是30了。你，已經趕末班車搞個20後嗎？原來，我們大家都不知不覺中，從一個年代升級到另一個，完全代入了我們上一代的生活去了。再看看老姐的女兒，原來那個小冬瓜都已經奔3的大姐姐了🫪

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPajqS1iwGbp6XSkjzGFcjRkrPEBSNxvBAGaZZyAkPq4Y/ai_generated.webp)
圖是花150分弄回來的，試試看#ecency自帶AI附圖功能。以下是證據哈。

A FLOATING ISLAND IN THE SKY
Hello #scifimultiverse, happy new week. In life, I believe that everything is possible. And the possibility of such things begins with our mindset and perception. If I can see it, then I can have it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7GCQGx1TPFA21f1zX4dpuy4n6rRCeFMv45Ua4JBtxbz/image.png) [Ylanite_NietjuhArt](https://pixabay.com/images/download/ylanite_nietjuhart-planet-9934703_1920.jpg) This week’s prompt hints at a floating island in the sky. The first thing that comes to mind with such news is the experience. Like we have Bonny Island in the southern part of my country. A small island surrounded by water. Before now, there was no road to Bonny Island. Once an individual visits the Island and forgets something in the city, they must take a boat again. For someone like me, Bonny Island was a no-go area then. But today, there is a flyover to Bonny Island, and I am ready to visit there anytime duty demands. Therefore, going to a floating Iceland will be a great adventure for me. The news will spark curiosity and anxiety. This will push me to research to get more facts about it. Is it habitable or risky? The outcome of the research will determine my next move. If the findings confirm it is good, then my interest and plan to visit there can start, at least to get away from this noisy environment and polluted world. However, if it is too expensive, I would wait for the promotion window to visit there on a low budget. That adventure would be a great one for me, because I would like to take my family along, since they said two is better than one. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdoSs6KkYbC3YhTeYhZC2eXVQQ3RNSo3hW7EEnYtRiuJs/image.png) [Alexandros Giannakakis](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1721633617260-c01f5a3e0bbb?q=80&w=1974&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) However, I might not want to invest there because it will be risky. I will make enquiries and wait for some time. Though some people may say that first to visit the stream takes clean water, it involves investing my hard-earned money. I may not want to buy or build a house there. A hanging Iceland may melt or give way to a natural disaster one day, since it is hanging. Building there, too, may be very difficult and very expensive since it is hanging and floating. So it may not be wise to invest there. I prefer to visit there, have fun, and come back to my base. No experience is wasted. Feel Free to join [here](https://ecency.com/hive-111030/@scifimultiverse/sci-fi-multiverse-prompt-week-64-edition-1-or-a-floating-iceland-on-sky-or) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT66pGVYf4ZESvQddY2iD13s38hzQrtvM9JussceRXdAC/image.png)

body.title: Rolled pie with cheese, apples & walnuts – quick, simple & delicious
body.body: > Hello to all lovers of good food and healthy treats! This pie was the first recipe my late mother taught me, mainly because it’s so simple to prepare—especially if you use ready-made phyllo sheets instead of making your own dough. Kids absolutely love the rolled apple version with walnuts and cinnamon, while I like to add brown cane sugar for a richer, fuller sweetness. And honestly, adults always ask for an extra piece too.

> 📝 Ingredients: 500g thin phyllo pastry sheets 1kg apples (Golden Delicious recommended) 200g chopped walnuts Cinnamon (to taste) 1/2 cup olive oil mixed with water (50:50) 500g low-fat cheese (0% fat) 1 egg 2 tbsp sour cream (or 1/2 cup yogurt, optional) 👨‍🍳 Preparation: Cheese filling: Mix the cheese with one egg and add sour cream (or yogurt). Stir until smooth.
> Apple & walnut filling: Grate the apples and finely chop the walnuts. Mix them together. Lightly squeeze excess juice from apples to avoid soggy dough.
> 🥧 Assembly: Take 3 sheets of phyllo and lightly brush them with the olive oil + water mix. Spread a thin layer of cheese filling and roll into a long shape.
> For the apple version: Evenly spread the apple-walnut mix, then sprinkle with cinnamon and brown sugar. Roll tightly.
> Brush each roll with the oil mixture and place in a baking tray.
> 🔥 Baking: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (392°F) for 15–20 minutes, until golden brown.

> 🍽️ Serving: Let it cool slightly, cut into pieces, and dust with powdered sugar. The aroma of baked apples, cinnamon, and walnuts quickly fills the home and gathers everyone around the table. The slices disappear fast—especially with kids!

>

This is a healthy and simple dessert I warmly recommend to all parents.

Enjoy and let me know your results!

body.body:
by @bardsilver on Brave-Smoke's Corner 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/bravesmoke [![䷂ - 屯 (Difficulty In The Beginning)](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/7f47f048-9ac8-49ae-a558-d2cd7cd8c4ab.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/tZtj6JiqqnJ3gxiK1d5jpc) 
 
 https://theqiflow.com/pages/i-ching-hexagram-3

From [Zhu Xi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhu_Xi)'s \

:

屯/Zhun (Difficult Beginning)

Kan/Water above
Zhen/Thunder below
 
Zhen has a single yang line moving in beneath two yin lines, so it's virtue is activity and it's image is thunder.

Kan has a single yang trapped between two yin lines, so it's virtue is being trapped, or danger; it's image is clouds, rain or water.

Zhun is the name of this hexagram. It means the point when something is beginning to arise but has not yet fully come through. In terms of the character it represents a sprout beginning to break out of the earth but not yet through.

The hexagram is Zhen encounter Kan, hence the name of the hexagram. Zhen is active below and Kan is danger above; this is the ability to act in the midst of danger. Although the ability to act can be successful, when in danger it is better to hold onto correctness (aka correct principles; observe the times before making a move) and not to advance suddenly. Therefore when a divination yields this hexagram, the prognostication is greatly successful, appropriate and correct, but one can not suddenly have somewhere to go.

Also 9 at the beginning (first line), the yang residing below the yin and all other lines, is the ruler of this entire hexagram. This is the image of the worthy subordinate who wins the support of the people to become a ruler/leader.

body.title: Devil May Cry (2025):  Is Dante still  the master of action?【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
body.body:
> 

  Saludos estimados Otakus de #TheAnimeRealm. Hace poco me recomendaron ver una serie de animé que me cautivó por quien cantaba una de sus canciones, se trata de  [Devil May Cry](https://www.filmaffinity.com/ve/film199256.html) y pues, como el tema musical pertenecía a mi grupo de rock favorito Evanescence, sí o sí tenía que darle una oportunidad y aún mejor, prioridad.

>  Greetings, fellow Otakus of #TheAnimeRealm. I was recently recommended to watch an anime series that captivated me because of who sang one of its songs, it's [Devil May Cry](https://www.filmaffinity.com/ve/film199256.html), and well, since the theme song belonged to my favorite rock group, Evanescence, I absolutely had to give it a chance, and even better, a priority.


<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>


<center>![devil_may_cry-847323382-large.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/AK2CgBeQbNNS1ZM68Lz2bzRjuN8PERhcWo7bb1tGEQoEZPRu6CDnKZRZeJtQhck.jpg)</center>


<div class=\

> De entrada te digo que es una obra maestra, al menos esta versión del año 2025. Lamentablemente no he visto las temporadas anteriores, pero luego de ver esta, definitivamente me pondré al día con las demás esperando su segunda temporada, con esta especie de conejo salido del País de las Maravillas.

> I'll tell you right off the bat that it's a masterpiece, at least this 2025 version. Unfortunately, I haven't seen the previous seasons, but after watching this one, I'll definitely catch up on the others, eagerly awaiting the second season, with this sort of rabbit straight out of Wonderland.

> El personaje de Dante al inicio me pareció algo extravagante y me hubiera gustado que lo hubieran hecho un poco más serio, pero conforme pasaban los capítulos, pues me cautivó el protagonista a tal punto de robarme el corazón.

> At first, I found Dante's character somewhat eccentric, and I would have liked them to make him a little more serious, but as the chapters went by, the protagonist captivated me to the point of stealing my heart.
> Al parecer me enamoro fácilmente de personajes ficticios y Dante no escapó de ello. Su extravagancia y querer vivir su vida siempre al límite cazando demonios hicieron que lo amara cada vez más.
> I seem to fall in love with fictional characters easily, and Dante was no exception. His eccentricity and desire to live life on the edge, hunting demons, made me love him more and more.

> Esto porque se preocupaba por el bienestar de los demás a tal punto de poner su vida en riesgo hasta que sucedió algo increíble con él y quedé con la boca abierta en pleno episodio. Esto me atrapó aún más en la trama y me hizo querer terminarla de ver el mismo día.

> This is because he cared so much for the well-being of others that he risked his own life, until something incredible happened to him that left me speechless during the episode. This drew me even further into the story and made me want to finish watching it that same day.

> El toque extra entre la relación que desarrollaron por muy poco con Dante y con Mary estuvo espectacular, fue una de las cosas que más me gustó. Se nota que tienen química y no sólo por odio puro, sino que se vislumbra algo más entre ellos.

> The extra touch in the relationship they barely developed with Dante and with Mary was spectacular; it was one of the things I liked most. You can tell they have chemistry, and not just out of pure hatred, but you can see something more between them.
> También me agradó el hecho de que ambos personajes tuvieran infancias difíciles. Bueno, no sólo los protagonistas sino también el villano de esta increíble serie.
> I also appreciated that both characters had difficult childhoods. Well, not just the protagonists, but also the villain of this amazing series.
> Ver cómo capítulo tras capítulo trae sorpresas conforme avanza la serie, es uno de los aspectos más fuertes, a mi parecer, que gustaron al público, o mejor dicho, a sus fans.
> Seeing how each chapter brings surprises as the series progresses is one of the strongest aspects, in my opinion, that appealed to the public, or rather, to its fans.

> La banda sonora elegida en cada escena de cada capítulo no puede dejarse de nombrar ya que resaltó por sí sola como si fuera un personaje principal. Uff, esto también le dio un toque único y con clase porque cada canción me trasladó a mi adolescencia.

> The soundtrack chosen for each scene of each episode deserves special mention; it stood out almost as if it were a main character. Wow, it also gave it a unique and classy touch because every song transported me back to my teenage years.

> Además que cada canción iba acorde a los movimientos de cada personaje y no sólo eso, iba acorde a la escena que se desarrollaba, es decir, la letra de la canción describía como anillo al dedo la situación en sí. Era fascinante de ver y escuchar.

> Furthermore, each song perfectly matched the movements of each character, and not only that, but it also perfectly complemented the scene unfolding; in other words, the lyrics of the song described the situation like a glove. It was fascinating to watch and listen to.

> En conclusión, Devil May Cry del año 2025 tiene tanto potencial que me invita a verla de nuevo y más aún a querer buscar sus primeras versiones para ser parte de la gran cantidad de fans que tiene esta serie a nivel mundial. De mi parte le otorgo sus 5 estrellas completas.

> In conclusion, the 2025 Devil May Cry has so much potential that it makes me want to watch it again, and even more so, seek out the earlier versions to join the huge number of fans this series has worldwide. I give it a full 5 stars.

>

body.title: Retomando el camino, Salud y bienestar como prioridad|Back on Track: Health and Well-being as a Priority
body.body:
![U2O8IHmCw9lk6C0J_IMG_20260420_094142.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/U2O8IHmCw9lk6C0J_IMG_20260420_094142/U2O8IHmCw9lk6C0J_IMG_20260420_094142.webp) ![pZCvi7PbC92Es4hF_IMG_20260420_093703.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/pZCvi7PbC92Es4hF_IMG_20260420_093703/pZCvi7PbC92Es4hF_IMG_20260420_093703.webp) ![czOGyI4BaIYDvMTL_IMG_20260420_093631.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/czOGyI4BaIYDvMTL_IMG_20260420_093631/czOGyI4BaIYDvMTL_IMG_20260420_093631.webp) ![LHJ0Vl02QDF1bIai_IMG_20260420_093502.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/LHJ0Vl02QDF1bIai_IMG_20260420_093502/LHJ0Vl02QDF1bIai_IMG_20260420_093502.webp)
​¡Hola, amigos! ¿Qué tal? Feliz lunes para todos. Espero que hayan tenido un gran inicio de semana. Por aquí ando yo con la mejor energía y la mejor vibra; gracias a Dios, retomando el gimnasio desde la semana pasada.
Hi, everyone! How are you? Happy Monday to all of you. I hope you’ve had a great start to the week. I’m feeling great and in high spirits here; thank God, I’ve been back at the gym since last week.
​Estoy dándole muy suave a todos los ejercicios, empezando con muy poco peso, pero con mucha energía y optimismo. Escucho mi cuerpo, sobre todo después de haber estado dos meses bastante enferma con bronquitis e hiperactividad bronquial. Ya este mes pude incorporarme nuevamente; aunque he aumentado de peso, trato de no ponerle tanta mente a eso, porque bajar de peso para mí no es solo querer verme con un cuerpo espectacular, sino que bajar de peso para mí es salud, y es lo que más valoro de cada vez que voy al gimnasio. Ese es mi pensamiento principal.
I’m taking it very easy with all the exercises, starting with very light weights, but with lots of energy and optimism. I’m listening to my body, especially after being quite sick for two months with bronchitis and bronchial hyperactivity. I was able to get back into it this month; even though I’ve gained some weight, I try not to dwell on it too much, because for me, losing weight isn’t just about wanting to look amazing—it’s about health, and that’s what I value most every time I go to the gym. That’s my main mindset.
​Estoy bastante contenta de volver, de encontrarme con todas esas personas que ya conocía. Muchos se extrañaron de mi ausencia y pude comentarles todo lo que ha pasado, que estaba empezando bastante suave para retomar todo y volver al nivel en el que me gustaba estar, para mantenerme y sentirme bien. Así que, nada, estoy muy feliz.
I’m really happy to be back and to see all those people I already knew. A lot of them were surprised I’d been gone, and I was able to tell them everything that’s happened—that I was taking it pretty easy at first to get back into the swing of things and return to the level I liked to be at, to stay in shape and feel good. So, anyway, I’m really happy.
​Aparte de eso, empecé a comer sano de nuevo, un poco más enfocada. Si ustedes no han empezado, no hay un día, un momento o un mes exclusivo para comenzar; siempre que se tome la decisión, se puede comenzar y se puede retomar. Como siempre digo: escuchando a nuestro cuerpo, viendo las señales, cómo nos sentimos, alimentándonos bien y durmiendo bien, que es parte fundamental de la recuperación al ir a un gimnasio.
Apart from that, I started eating healthy again, with a bit more focus. If you haven’t started yet, there’s no specific day, moment, or month to begin; as long as you make the decision, you can start and you can get back on track. As I always say: listen to your body, pay attention to the signs, how you feel, eat well, and sleep well—which is a fundamental part of recovery when you go to the gym.
A lo largo del tiempo que he estado allí, me he dado cuenta de que comer y dormir bien son fundamentales para el avance, para sentirnos bien y, sobre todo, para condicionar nuestro cuerpo.
During my time there, I've realized that eating and sleeping well are essential for making progress, for feeling good, and, above all, for getting our bodies in shape.
​Les dejo un abrazo enorme, la mejor de las vibras a todos y nos vemos luego. ¡Besitos!
Sending you all a big hug and lots of positive vibes. See you later! Big kisses!

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![RMAGDwYrZhBpnlht_fj5.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/RMAGDwYrZhBpnlht_fj5/RMAGDwYrZhBpnlht_fj5.webp)

周天中午我带孩子从楼下回家吃饭，刚进家就听到孩子妈在打电话，听了一会原来是在向网店投诉问题。孩子妈还问我前一天也就是周六有没有外卖员上门送货，周六我在家待了一整天，只有一个快递员上门取件退货并没有送货。于是孩子妈又继续在电话里投诉，口气可谓十分不客气。不管客服如何解释，就是一顿输出加教育，简直就跟机关枪一样，如果我是客服都想直接挂断电话了。

过了一会投诉完了，孩子妈说周五在盒马鲜生买的冷冻馄饨，中午收到后发现不是买的东西，当时联系店家换货后就去上班了，回来后在家里没有找到，周天中午想吃发现还是没有送到就生气的投诉了。我一听连忙说，周五已经送到了啊。周五中午我回家办公，刚到家不到一分钟就有外卖员敲门说送错货了，我检查电话号码无误后看到收到的货是冷冻馄饨就放冰箱冷藏室了。孩子妈周五下班回到家已经快到晚上12点了，来不及说而且我以为外卖员已经电话沟通过了。

我把放到冰箱的馄饨拿出来后，孩子妈意识到刚才投诉错了，于是拿起电话给客服打过去取消投诉。完了之后又把我数落一顿，怪我没有说清楚。可我也很无辜，明明就在冰箱里放着，孩子妈找了一遍没找到以为没有送到才投诉的。不管怎么说投诉是取消了，不用难为客服了。以后收到快递和外卖就给孩子妈说一声，避免出现信息差。

body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWCKb2vvWARVcEy1aH7vipCLVCzgfeXWhfrFsLeL9KYgJ/1776725755650.jpg)\n\nBuenas tardes a todos los amigos de esta comunidad. Hoy estuve haciendo esta receta que mi abuela me hacía de pequeña, y decidí preparársela a mi pequeño, pues él es un niño al que no le gusta comer muchas cosas, y nosotras las mamis tenemos que estar improvisando para que nuestros niños coman. Es muy fácil \

.\n‎\nGood afternoon to all the friends of this community. Today I was making this recipe that my grandmother made for me when I was little, and I decided to prepare it for my little one, since he is a child who doesn't like to eat many things, and we moms have to improvise so that our children eat. It is very easy \

.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXLbcruUncjYzJeFAPW4awsVWFVQLubCTTqcqxPhYFSGZ/1776726094463.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPedEY2zXgP48yTwdf9tUoSPxuGNHmYm1bGhU8xN4V3eH/1776726094501.jpg)

Ingredientes: 
2 huevos 
1 plátano 
Una pizca de sal y aceite 

Ingredients: 
2 eggs 
1 banana 
A pinch of salt and oil

Preparación:
Pelamos y freímos los plátanos. Batimos los huevos y le añadimos una pizca de sal; luego echamos un poquito de aceite en la sartén y agregamos los huevos cuando vemos que va cocinando, ponemos los plátanos encima y volteamos, esperamos que cocine unos segundos más y ya está. Muy simple de preparar y estoy segura de que a sus pequeños también les gustará. 

Preparation:
We peel and fry the bananas. We beat the eggs and add a pinch of salt; Then we pour a little oil in the pan and add the eggs when we see that it is cooking, we put the bananas on top and turn, we wait for it to cook a few more seconds and that's it. Very simple to prepare and I'm sure your little ones will like it too.
