body.title: The Hidden Inequity of Tariff Refunds
body.body:
![Screenshot 2026-04-20 at 7.06.47 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/48SMAT2PTXDVyuyQNqb7KQ8VzmAgwCLCxqmPnfw8N9JXfJmNQrXEsF4GUx9VXhemmt.png)


In a striking reversal of recent U.S. trade policy, companies are now lining up to reclaim billions of dollars in tariffs that were previously imposed and already passed on to consumers. The result is shaping up to be one of the clearest examples of how corporate structures can absorb public costs and privatize the benefits!

Earlier this year, the Supreme Court ruled that a large portion of tariffs imposed under emergency powers were illegal, triggering a massive refund process. The U.S. government is now preparing to return roughly $160–$166 billion to importers which are primarily large corporations that paid these tariffs at the border.

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 at 7.03.58 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23xVH5mkYeKVQpnny1zcCxJdVDGivr7gixRdBDknLoDHUUi31VgUyP7CsZmiQYsSSCEam.png)


Through a newly launched digital portal, tens of thousands of companies have already filed claims, expecting repayment within 60 to 90 days. Here’s the catch, the refunds are going back to the companies not the people who ultimately paid.

Tariffs function like a hidden tax. While companies technically pay them upfront, they almost always pass those costs along through higher prices. Over the past year, American consumers absorbed those increases in everything from household goods to electronics. Now that the tariffs have been ruled unlawful, you might expect those same consumers to be reimbursed. Instead, the system is structured so that only the “importer of record” qualifies for refunds.


![Screenshot 2026-04-20 at 7.07.28 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/EpXKvA7cbp2hmVpF5PcQ1F651dUJaYM3CJuBNMiCayNyuNjgU7J32qib4R3WGTd86Db.png)


That creates a troubling dynamic where consumers paid higher prices due to tariffs and companies collected that extra revenue through pricing and now refunding the tariffs to the companies again. In effect, businesses can be paid twice for the same policy shock.

Perhaps the most controversial aspect is that companies are under no legal obligation to pass these refunds on to customers. Some firms, like shipping providers, have suggested they may return a portion of the money. However for most industries, there is no enforcement mechanism, no mandate, and little transparency. Even major retailers have only hinted at possible price reductions.

This highlights a deeper issue in modern economic policy when mistakes happen at scale, corporations are often first in line for relief, while individuals are left behind just look at 2008...I'm mad because at a time when inflation and cost of living pressures remain high, layoffs are hitting every sector the optics are hard to ignore. Americans who spent more on everyday goods due to tariffs will likely see no direct benefit. Meanwhile, companies are receiving billions in repayments money that, in many cases, was already recouped through higher prices. 

As a shareholder I'm hoping to get some benefit, but I'm lucky since I know not everyone is able to be in the market. I really do feel like we are at a socioeconomic tipping point.

body.title: Bullying Is Bullying—No Matter the Form
body.body: When it comes to physical and online bullying, there is no point measuring the pain because any kind of pain leaves a scar in our heart and should be equally addressed. I read a post on Facebook where a lady was practically begging online visitors to stop dragging and bullying her left and right. She mentioned that she is slowly dying inside of her and hasn't done anything to deserve the bullying she is getting from different people. She further said that reading people's comments about her made her feel bitter and shattered emotionally. Yet, people still dropped terrible comments under the same post; she was appealing for kind words to mend her shattered life. ![Cream Purple Simple Stop Bullying Poster_20260420_235717_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23wXLkPHtvJsNSmFch7yfoCGAPJJqFbiU2S6MFVsD3hC4DXiznRapoCEniV1eXfheHUEg.png) ***** Already she has been broken from the inside out; the bullying carried a lot of weight because it was quite persistent, silent, and dangerous to her. This is about the lady that spoke out, but what about numerous others who are silently going down emotionally due to the same harassment that destroys their mental health? I am aware that many people experienced physical bullying while growing up. Is it the intimidation? Or the mocking or the push?, it was harsh and put some in fear. For the bullying that happened in school, probably teachers stepped in to rescue the victim from his oppressors, and the victim could get relief for the time being and maybe forget it for a little while at home...but now things have changed drastically. ***** With social media nowadays, bullying has become the order of the day; people ridicule others carelessly without thinking of how they will feel. A little mistake online will land you in insults from others and mockery, and sometimes you will be used to create trending memes. It's that bad. Let's leave online bullying aside because it's so rampant. Just when I picked up my phone to complete this post (because I started it in the morning but left it for another offline assignment ), I saw another Facebook notification about a 12-year-old boy who died from bullying. It was a very interesting story to read, so I can learn, as I am already planning for my boys to live in a boarding school. ***** According to the story, the 12-year-old boy lives in a boarding school, and his senior asked him to give him provisions, but the boy refused, and the senior hit him on his neck, and the boy went into a coma. Like play like a joke, the little boy couldn't make it, simply because , he refused to give a senior provision and got bullied by the senior. Can you just imagine? That's wickedness!!. Bullying is dangerous both physical or online. In my opinion, Parents should be more intentional with our parenting journey. Teach these children to be contented with what they have so they don't go out there to bully others when it comes to something to eat and in everything as well. ***** Overall, both kinds of bullying attack the mind and body, our identity, our confidence, etc. Sometimes, it can lead to nursing suicides, depression, lower self-esteem, and lead to death, just like the story I shared above. It's important to create a safe space where everyone can be heard and protected because no adults and children deserve the pain of bullying. The impact of bullying is dangerous and should be equally treated. ---

  <center>

#### 👛Welcome to my blog//Bienvenidos a mi blog👛</center>

		
---

<div class=\

> ***Hello #NeedleworkMonday***. It’s a pleasure to be here this Monday, and I hope you’re having a great start to the week. I’d like to share a project I worked on this weekend—I found it both practical and easy to make. It’s perfect as a gift for moms this coming month. Here’s a step-by-step guide to the process.
ESPAÑOL

***Hola #Needleworkmonday***. Es un placer estar por aca este lunes, deseandoles un buen inicio de semana. Les comparto un proyecto que este fin de semana realicé, me parecio muy necesario y sencillo. Ideal para obsequiar a las madres este proximo mes. Paso a detallar su proceso.

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Unbleached and pink cotton yarn. - Variegated and white worsted yarn. - Crochet hooks sizes 2 and 3.
ESPAÑOL

- Hilo de algodón crudo y rosado. - Hilo estambre matizado y blanco. - Aguja crochet Nº 2 y 3.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-20 at 5.50.48 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/48RNtnW5R6d3yAEJ5jL3xkEN753omhSNUNiYrjRDPK3v8ijhT2NCfkQrQMQkBvZ1og.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> - R1: Slip knot, 3 ch, 2 dc, 2 ch, repeat sequence 3 times, sl st. - R2: 3 sc, corner 3 dc, 3 ch, 3 dc, repeat 3 times, sl st. - R3: Repeat R2, add one more stitch to each row, sl st. - R4-R6: Repeat rows as needed until the piece measures 16 cm. Once the required rows are complete, sew two corners together to form a square. Crochet a pink single crochet (sc) border around the top of the coin purse. Make a button using a magic ring, 6 sc, sl st. Close. Then work 10 sc on top of this, gather it, and sew the back together to form a small ball, like a button. Sew it to the coin purse.
ESPAÑOL

- v1: Anillo mágico, 3 chs, 2 pa, 2 chs, repetir secuencia x 3, pr. - v2: 3 pr, esquina 3 pa, 3 chs, 3 pa, repetir 3 veces, pr. - v3: Repetir v2, agregar un bucle mas en cada vuelta, pr. - v4-v6: Repetir las vueltas necesarias hasta tener 16 cms. Al terminar las vueltas necesarias se cose dos esquinas formando un cuadrado. Se hace un tejido de mp en rosado en la tapa el monedero. Hacemos un botón de hilo con anillo magico, 6 mp, pr. Cerrar. Luego hacemos sobre este 10 mp, se frunce y se cose atras formando una bolita, como un botón. Y se cose al monedero.

body.title: Which Is Real Estate.
body.body:
So we're trying to cut that and allow everybody to meet the GDPR compliance with opt-in and creating a fruitful marketplace for everyone to connect. And we're playing that matchmaker role, as I said, and this way it becomes a clear and concise way to connect with people. So right now we've established a wait list, so we encourage you to join our wait list as we build out this platform to build this kind of pathways of business.

And I'll put that, feel free to ask any questions that you may have, and I'll put something in the purple pill there for you to connect with. Absolutely. And you know, one of the things, Katie, I love about what we've built is that I remember being in real estate and looking for clients, and I would spend so much time, I would buy into a customer relationship management portal.

And what happens is when leads come in and they generate, I have about two to five minutes top to capture that lead, grab that lead, and then I'm able to move forward as a real estate agent with that person. So I have, that's my window of making a contact. So I grab the lead, say yes, I respond.

But in addition to, I'm now making contact with that lead. Unbeknownst to me, I thought it was just, okay, I was unique, and I was the only person receiving that lead. Wrong.

And so when I, by the time I get to them, which is in that two to five-minute window, I found that there were several agents that had already sent a text message, an email, and a phone call. And when I get to them, they're like, what is happening here? You're the sixth real estate agent that I've spoken to in the last hour. So what's happening here? I'm not interested.

Or I find myself just, the phone would ring, or the messages, you're blocked at this point, whatever the case may be. So it was, I'm competing for customers in this large pool, and then you have to go through the whole touch points as well. So there's how many touches to actually convert somebody over from, depending upon where they are in the pipeline and depending upon the product, which is real estate.

body.title: YOUR LIFE DOESN'T MAKE SENSE? FIND OUT WHY
body.body:
This might be your answer!

Friend, there is something I want you to understand, and I need you to pay attention to it very carefully. Because if you miss this, you will keep misjudging your walk with God.

How do you know you are walking in faith when your life does not make sense? When what you are seeing does not match what God said? When the outcomes of your life are not aligning with the promises you 

![IMG-20260419-WA0044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/243M7W8sHSpHrNUQstRoJt5JyyA2YQQrEKExKgXnuh5fQUH5GtLh3EafYwNNs93i9tKqr.jpg)
believe?

Because many people have tied their faith to outcomes. They look at comfort, results, progress, and they conclude, \

And if those things are not present, they begin to question themselves.

But faith has never been defined by outcomes.

If that were the case, then you would have to explain Hebrews 11, where the Bible speaks of people who walked in faith, yet did not receive what was promised in their lifetime. 

The Scripture does not say they lacked faith. It says in Hebrews 11:13, \

So that means faith can be present even when the outcome is not visible.

Look at Joseph. God showed him a picture of his future in Genesis 37, but the process looked nothing like the promise. Betrayal, slavery, prison. If you were to judge his faith by his circumstances, you would say everything was going wrong.

 But Joseph never let go of what God showed him. And in Genesis 50:20, he was able to say, \

Look at David. Anointed as king in 1 Samuel 16, yet he spent years running, hiding, surviving. The oil was on his head, but the throne was nowhere in sight. Would you say he was not in faith during those years?


![IMG-20260301-WA0011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/EoyRTUZLUMaeKbsZoLFq1s9dxMnRKZiL89ZkFXvMnoJLMeshJyAa1zXwQqx6pBBmTRT.jpg)

Faith is not validated by how comfortable your life looks. It is revealed in what you continue to hold on to when your life does not look like what God said.

And this is where many people get confused. They think that if they are still afraid, if they are still struggling, if they are still trying to figure things out, then they are not in faith.

But faith is not the absence of pressure. Faith is not the absence of questions. Faith is not even the absence of emotion.

Faith is this—God has spoken, and I choose to trust what He said, and I align my life with it, even when I do not see it yet.

That is why Hebrews 11:1 says, \
Not seen.\n\nSo if you need to see it before you believe it, that is not faith. 2 Corinthians 5:7 says, \

But if you can hold on to what God has said, and continue to walk in alignment with it, even when your life is not reflecting it yet, that is faith.

And you must not let culture, pressure, or even religious voices redefine this for you. Because some will make it look like faith must always produce immediate visible results. That if you are truly in faith, your life must look a certain way.

But God does not always start where He intends to finish. Isaiah 55:8-9 says, \

He can show you a picture of your future, and still allow you to walk through a process that looks like the opposite of it.

And in that space, your faith is not proven by what is happening around you. It is proven by what you refuse to let go of within you.

So don't measure your faith by your outcomes. Measure it by your response.

Are you still trusting God? Proverbs 3:5-6 says, \

Are you still aligning with what He said?
Are you still moving, even when it does not make sense?
Then you are walking in faith.

And if you hold on to that faith, not perfectly, not flawlessly, but consistently, you will eventually see what God has spoken. Galatians 6:9 says, \

Because faith is not built on what you see.

Faith is built on who God is. Numbers 23:19 says, \
. You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/your-life-doesnt-make-sense-find-out-why-4iq)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 19 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e217ad70-5907-4210-ad54-e9a28b00f6df.jpg) Hey Actifitters, After several missed activities the day before, yesterday was also supposed to be quite busy. One of the time consuming things to do was to pick up Kaia's food. As always, it was an opportunity for a few short stops along the way, especially at the lake. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/149401c7-e0ab-450c-bb90-57fe954bde58.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6295f19a-3411-412f-9d9c-7475d51c320b.jpg) This guy, although apparently lonely, seemed to have a good time, just chilling on the water. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c52d3c2a-8491-4702-b31f-3fdb7a34787f.jpg) I didn't see any boats on the water yet, but people were working on the docks or pontoons. I guess boat season is upon us. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/615da7f3-fa39-4bd2-b244-290cd2a1257b.jpg) Back home, we found Le Chat outside, always hard at work. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ab7d15f5-787c-4dcb-a650-462d93fe3d38.jpg) I felt like being lazy like her, and skip our daily walk, but Kaia wouldn't have it. So we started a short walk behind the front yard where we see more green. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9d89035e-ab46-403b-aaf7-c7331e4eb516.jpg) Good times for Kaia! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9889fb47-f8b4-497d-bd78-b4744d86995e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/30b1f77e-13df-44c1-9d4f-fb2849a40c03.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/51f31e76-4bea-4834-99da-6ba9bed4a7e2.jpg) Le Chat didn't want to join in the small forest, but she did wait for us at the edge. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/83c86938-e456-4489-9855-65c2669ee5c6.jpg) And they could hang out with Kaia for a bit. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/432abcf0-d19d-42ef-aa9e-b8ea94dad413.jpg) We quickly walked in the neighborhood as well. The weather was very strange with snow flakes (remember when we reached in the 80s F or close to 30C a few days ago...), dark clouds and blue patches in the sky, all at the same time! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/55bcb764-e539-4d67-b931-e23f45613ce9.jpg) The main event of the day was the first playoffs game at Little Caesar Arena for the Detroit Pistons this season. Been about 3 years since I went to see a match, so it was nice. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/09147479-5a72-4458-b5d3-c5c6d75a3cfe.jpg) Unfortunately the Pistons didn't play great and lost. It's okay, it's the best of 7 games to reach the next round, they can do it! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9f96006b-852b-4367-bf7c-86cfe702bb5c.jpg) Not easy to get a photo of a moving mascot, in the dark and from pretty far. But mascots in general are the best! Especially Hooper of course. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ef2af4d6-816c-4afc-9968-0d1d4729737b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a59dcf3f-8661-4e3d-8bed-8a10aca3b437.jpg) And that was it for the day. Like I said, a pretty busy day to finish the week and it was lucky I was feeling better than the previous day. Now onto to new week! As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260420t225823378z)_

body.title: Crear aventuras en pueblo vaquero| Tell adventures in a cowboy town
body.body:
>
![IMG_20260404_091922.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmem6pAFiHWRUCBAddy8ReoPFfPs4k4LGvhbR6apb67RXg/IMG_20260404_091922.jpg)
Hola queridos usuarios, siempre he pensado que salir debe generar un estado de bienestar que dure aunque sea una semana al recordar esos gratos momentos. En este lugar siempre me voy al lejano oeste, pero sin la angustia que te salgan unos cuatreros, esas bandas que salen de la nada en las películas de vaqueros. >Hello dear users, I've always believed that going out should create a feeling of well-being that lasts at least a week, as you reminisce about those pleasant moments. In this place, I always imagine myself in the Wild West, but without the anxiety of encountering cattle rustlers, those gangs that appear out of nowhere in cowboy movies.
![IMG-20260404-WA0054.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcPzyHfAiCf8akYSSEaN7AqJSd3dJS9f5jpgW7HYhGKMq/IMG-20260404-WA0054.jpeg)
Con dos piscinas con una estructura muy diferente a muchas piscina que he conocido, de verdad que el entretenimiento comienza cuando intentas entrar a las piscinas no tiene de donde agarrase es algo bien original, creo que es para que los caballos entren sin ningún problema ja,ja,ja. >With two pools with a structure very different from many pools I've seen, the fun really starts when you try to get into the pools, there's nothing to hold on to, it's quite original, I think it's so that horses can get in without any problem ha, ha, ha.
![IMG-20260404-WA0030.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRhvsX6t6kC8aYr1R7m7fM1gpKqwbAVvyN8PdPKrB61Di/IMG-20260404-WA0030.jpg)
Hay muchos espacios donde puedes hacer muchas imágenes, recrearte en ese pueblo tan maravilloso, desde que pisas el color de su tierra te lleva de inmediato a volar la imaginación. Sus habitaciones con una cama matrimonial y tres literas, son habitaciones familiares, con un baño incorporado y aire acondicionado. Puedes quedarte por 25$ el día, pero si van 10 personas sale a 10$ por persona cada habitación. >There are plenty of spots to take pictures and immerse yourself in this wonderful town. From the moment you arrive, the vibrant colors of the earth immediately spark your imagination. The rooms, each with a double bed and three bunk beds, are family rooms with en-suite bathrooms and air conditioning. You can stay for $25 a day, but if 10 people are traveling together, it works out to $10 per person per room.

body.title: The Vulture that flew to the horizon | A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words
body.body:
<center>
![23vi1f9zid6XjBRiFHPWMURAGY8gpMa3RXonsYk49wf9VbX2q4jfnpfrMT7sW3VtXozQB.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23vhz6wkULAAryyVbaKwnixovYgku77kNu16zGVyRvfs3giwc4hGVziSwj4CdFwS6eJey.png)
 [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/black-vulture-vulture-cowl-vulture-2750170/)</center>

<hr>

From the moment he hatched, Toly was a small vulture who opened his eyes to see the vast blue sky with an incomprehensible longing.

While his siblings fought over food in the nest, he preferred to peek over the edge to marvel at the great height of the tree, only imagining the wind brushing his beak. He learned to fly in due time, and since he spread his wings for the first time, it was rare that his rough feet touched the ground again.

Time passed relentlessly and swiftly. When he grew and his dark feathers changed color, Toly had a thought that took hold of his mind. He set out to fly far beyond the forest that saw him born to discover, on his own, just how vast the sky truly was.

With his heart pounding a thousand miles an hour, he left to never return home.

Toly let himself go, flying only by following the wind currents, crossing snowy mountains, green valleys, and golden deserts. That wonderfully long journey finally led him to the legendary realm of the hawks, a place where the clouds seemed within reach.

There, among the peaks of the highest mountain, he met the majestic king of the skies, a veteran hawk who held the title of having flown around the entire world.

The old monarch carefully observed the young vulture, recognizing in his eyes that same unbreakable passion for freedom and the air currents. With a rough voice and slowly extending one of his wings weathered by a thousand storms, he offered invaluable advice for his long journey.

The words of the ancient hawk were: ***\

body.title: Falling in love with a city I’ve never seen [EN/PT]\n
body.body: /> Imagining is free. And lately I’ve been taking full advantage of that privilege, because there’s a city here in Brazil that has taken over my thoughts without any ceremony. Its name is Jaraguá do Sul; it’s in the south of the country, and I’ve never been there. I don’t even know anyone who lives in that area. The story began in a rather mundane way: me browsing YouTube, the way we do when boredom strikes or when our minds crave a distraction. It was during one of those aimless browsing sessions that it popped up. Someone had visited the city, recorded everything, and posted it there. All I know is that, before I knew it, I had already fallen in love. Since then, I’ve become an informal researcher of Jaraguá do Sul. I watch videos of people who’ve visited, read accounts, and look for more content on every channel I find. There’s something about the city’s architecture, the way the streets are laid out, the colors of the buildings—it’s an ornamental, detailed beauty that I wasn’t used to seeing. A city that seems to have been designed with care and affection. One detail that really got me excited was finding out that the weather there is cold. It sounds simple, but for someone who lives where I do—in a city near the equator—it’s almost like an exotic dream. Here, the heat never lets up. Cities in this region are destined for this: strong sun, high temperatures year-round, and little chance of seeing your breath escape your mouth on a winter morning. So imagining a place where it’s actually cold, where you might need a coat and have a good reason to drink hot chocolate—that has a very special charm. Every video I watch about Jaraguá do Sul gives me that strange feeling of longing for a place I’ve never been. As if I had already walked those streets in some dream I forgot upon waking. The residents seem proud of the city, and I understand why. There’s a visible dignity in the way it was built and maintained. I don’t know when I’ll be able to go. It’s not in my immediate plans yet, it hasn’t made it into the budget yet, and it’s still just a wish tucked away in the drawer of my dreams. But I’m in no hurry, because part of the magic lies precisely in that: in the anticipation and the pleasure of imagining every detail before experiencing it. And until that day comes, I’ll keep admiring Jaraguá do Sul from afar. Watching more videos before bed, dreaming of cool streets and beautiful architecture, waiting for the day when I’ll be able to say: I’ve finally arrived. And you, is there a city that you dream about, a place you haven’t visited yet but already want to see? Let me know in the comments! 👇 * * *

>Namorando uma cidade que nunca vi

Imaginar é de graça. E ultimamente tenho aproveitado muito desse privilégio, porque existe uma cidade aqui no Brasil que tomou conta dos meus pensamentos sem nenhuma cerimônia. O nome dela é Jaraguá do Sul, fica no sul do país, e eu nunca fui até lá. Nem conheço ninguém que mora por esses lados. A historia começou de um jeito bastante banal: eu fuçando no youtube, do jeito que a gente faz quando o tédio bate ou quando a cabeça pede distração. Foi numa dessas navegações sem destino que ela apareceu. Alguém tinha ido visitar a cidade, gravado tudo, e postado por lá. Só sei que, quando percebi, já tinha me apaixonado. Desde então, virei uma pesquisadora informal de Jaraguá do Sul. Assisto vídeos de pessoas que foram visitar, leio relatos, e busco mais conteúdos em cada canal que encontro. Tem algo na arquitetura da cidade, na forma como as ruas se organizam, nas cores das construções, é uma beleza ornamental, detalhada, que eu não estava acostumada a ver. Uma cidade que parece ter sido desenhada com cuidado e carinho. Um detalhe que me deixou especialmente animada foi descobrir que o clima por lá é frio. Parece simples, mas pra quem mora onde eu moro, numa cidade próxima à linha do equador, isso é quase um sonho exótico. Aqui o calor não dar trégua. Cidades nessa faixa têm esse destino: sol forte, temperatura alta o ano todo e poucas chances de ver o hálito escapar pela boca numa manhã de inverno. Então imaginar um lugar onde o frio existe de verdade, onde se pode precisar de um casaco e tomar um chocolate quente com razão, isso tem um charme todo especial. Cada vídeo que assisto sobre Jaraguá do Sul me dá aquela sensação estranha de saudade de um lugar onde nunca estive. Como se eu já tivesse andado por aquelas ruas em algum sonho que esqueci ao acordar. Os moradores parecem orgulhosos da cidade e eu entendo o porquê. Tem uma dignidade visível no modo como ela foi construída e mantida. Não sei quando vou conseguir ir. Ainda não está nos planos imediatos, ainda não entrou no orçamento e ainda é só um desejo guardado na gaveta dos sonhos. Mas eu não tenho pressa, porque parte da magia está exatamente nisso: na antecipação e no prazer de imaginar cada detalhe antes de viver. E enquanto esse dia não chega, eu continuo namorando Jaraguá do Sul de longe. Assistindo mais video antes de dormir, sonhando com ruas frias e arquitetura bonita, esperando pelo dia em que vou poder dizer: finalmente cheguei. E você, tem alguma cidade que vive nos seus sonhos, um lugar que ainda não conhece mas já sente vontade de conhecer? Me conta nos comentários! 👇

body.title: Progress in the Foundations set: These are my warriors and archons that are at the maximum level.(En/Es).
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbi9SubsAGrUohhS9YBA9y9rQVk1THz4iaahSiqC8CHTm/progress_foundations.png)</center>   
      
<center><sub>Imagen elaborada en Canva / Image created in Canva </sub></center>   
    
 ----   
      
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)   
</center>   

<div class=\

> Hello, good morning or afternoon, my dear fellow Praetorians. An update to my Foundations battle deck, a post to tell you about the archons and warriors I already own at the max level of this set. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Foundations

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> A few weeks ago I shared with you about my first Archon Foundations with level 4; the fire djinn Barthalamas has been a great help to me in both the frontier and modern formats. Thanks to Barthalamas I have won many battles in Modern and I have used some powerful warriors again in the battles of the Silver League. A few days later, the land archon, Aurelia, also reached the maximum level and, at the beginning of this season, the water archon, Marlai Singariel. These two archons have expanded my battle options, especially the water archon.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhTCe75pNvr1hEWftJNiRPJ2sq3DPYhpZwAeKUQpSJbg/image.png)
I'm only missing two archons to bring to the maximum level, the Incessant Sage life archon and the Thalgrimore death archon; the latter just needs a more regular or golden copy. --- --- Moving on to the warriors, I will be naming them by the element and focusing mainly on the regular copies. ---- Fire warriors: In this element only three warriors have reached their maximum level: Ember Roast Sow, Echelon and Agniavan Salamander. I still have several copies left for the other warriors to reach. Note: I do not take into account Sturdy Axe Warden for being a black copy that I win in the giveaway.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQdW3CRC7MqcFeh1eX7CannM36rdoPgkZAF4sjS9gULKK/image.png)
---- Water warriors: The element that I usually use the most, but at the moment I only have two warriors at the maximum: Port Guardian and Mystic Scaleweaver, well, there is also the Spitting Camel in its black copy. But in general the other warriors are on a good level.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVc2tAbxe9NxUxNU8h45NpNDqn88P4sZZecWv4wqhb67J/image.png)
---- Earth warriors: In this element I have several golden cards and it is one where I also have more regular warriors at their maximum: Dread Tafarian, Wilhelmdale Deputy, Dire Bear and Vicious Quilliun. The lion, the porcupine and the bailiff are my most used warriors of this element and I love having them at full power.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3RmmxP5anD74seneio19fqH5GPFcKVePDSpPffGYBGc/image.png)
---- Warriors life: The Element of Life also counts four warriors to the maximum: Twice Yester Knight, Codex Sage, Hungry Ulund and Celestial Guardian. I don't usually use this item much, which is why I haven't used some of these warriors at their current level yet and the limitation given by the archon's level.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYLQdx9nMRD8hUYYeXVsh6C7dwUjaxnAEyprqfQ1Jghw/image.png)
---- Warriors death: The Death element only has three warriors at maximum: Nim Guard Captain, Black Widow and Little Sister. Two of these warriors I can't use with all their power because I'm limited by the level of the archon.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4DixWPEfhkqtiXEs8vu5UFjcWT3fSMCiofH7SDqCptz/image.png)
---- Warriors neutral: The element that complements the others; at the moment I only have two warriors at their highest level: Kanaaq Miner and A'lan Musketeer. What surprises me is that A'lan was the legendary one that I had the hardest time finding and ironically I uploaded it the easiest.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjSErgNY9goVJGRKcAdvTxjTEtfLEBXpYxUqupcCCVzf/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Thoughts

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> This post is mainly to tell you about my progress regarding the foundations set, which I have been building only based on the chests and packs that I have won in my battles every day in the frontier format. What I'm looking for the most is to have the archons at their top level and that they are useful to me to maintain a good position in the Modern format in the Silver League, that while building the Arcana Conclave set at an acceptable level for that league. I don't usually combine all the cards, to have more options to use in the survival format. I hope to be able to share with you soon a post about the archons that I need to level up and a good battle using them. -----

> Thank you very much to those who read my posts, and thank you very much for your votes and comments. In the following link, you can join the game and get to know this fantastic world: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99 ). I hope to see you soon in a Challenge, telling your battles and experiences. Note: This post is not investment advice; do your own research. --- ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJ8tCPyJpnK58wnnzYgWFSMR4vYHQgFpq8FWFULfjD3d/image.png)

> Hola, buen día o tarde, mis queridos compañeros pretorianos. Una actualización de mi mazo de batalla Foundations, una publicación para contarles sobre los arcontes y guerreros que ya poseo en el nivel máximo de este set. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Foundations

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Hace unas semanas les compartí sobre mi primer Arconte Foundations con el nivel 4; el djinn de fuego Barthalamas me ha sido de gran ayuda tanto en el formato frontier como en modern. Gracias a Barthalamas he ganado muchas batallas en Modern y he vuelto a usar algunos poderosos guerreros en las batallas de la liga Plata. A los pocos días, el arconte de tierra, Aurelia, llegó también al nivel máximo y, al iniciar esta temporada, el arconte de agua, Marlai Singariel. Estos dos arcontes han expandido mis opciones de batalla, especialmente el arconte de agua.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhTCe75pNvr1hEWftJNiRPJ2sq3DPYhpZwAeKUQpSJbg/image.png)
Solo me faltan dos arcontes para llevar al máximo nivel, el arconte de vida Incessant Sage y el arconte de muerte Thalgrimore; este último solo necesita una copia más regular o dorada. --- --- Pasando a los guerreros, los iré nombrando por el elemento y enfocado principalmente en las copias regulares. ---- Guerreros fuego: En este elemento solo tres guerreros han llegado a su máximo nivel: Ember Roast Sow, Echelon y Agniavan Salamander. Aún me faltan varias copias para que los demás guerreros los alcancen. Nota: No tomo en cuenta a Sturdy Axe Warden por ser una copia black que gane en el sorteo.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQdW3CRC7MqcFeh1eX7CannM36rdoPgkZAF4sjS9gULKK/image.png)
---- Guerreros agua: El elemento que más suelo usar, pero por el momento solo cuento con dos guerreros al máximo: Port Guardian y Mystic Scaleweaver, bueno, también está el Spitting Camel en su copia black. Pero en general los demás guerreros están en un buen nivel.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVc2tAbxe9NxUxNU8h45NpNDqn88P4sZZecWv4wqhb67J/image.png)
---- Guerreros tierra: En este elemento tengo varias cartas doradas y es uno donde también tengo más guerreros regulares en su máximo: Dread Tafarian, Wilhelmdale Deputy, Dire Bear y Vicious Quilliun. El león, el puercoespín y la alguacil son mis guerreros de este elemento más usados y tenerlos a full poder me encanta.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3RmmxP5anD74seneio19fqH5GPFcKVePDSpPffGYBGc/image.png)
---- Guerreros vida: El elemento vida también cuenta cuatro guerreros al máximo: Twice Yester Knight, Codex Sage, Hungry Ulund y Celestial Guardian. No suelo usar mucho este elemento, por lo cual aún no he usado algunos de estos guerreros en su nivel actual y la limitación dada por el nivel del arconte.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYLQdx9nMRD8hUYYeXVsh6C7dwUjaxnAEyprqfQ1Jghw/image.png)
---- Guerreros muerte: El elemento muerte solo cuenta con tres guerreros al máximo: Nim Guard Captain, Black Widow y Little Sister. Dos de estos guerreros no puedo usarlos con todo su poder porque estoy limitado por el nivel del arconte.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4DixWPEfhkqtiXEs8vu5UFjcWT3fSMCiofH7SDqCptz/image.png)
---- Guerreros neutral: El elemento que complementa a los demás; por el momento solo cuento con dos guerreros a su máximo nivel: Kanaaq Miner y A'lan Musketeer. Lo que me sorprende es que A'lan fue la legendaria que más me costó encontrar e irónicamente la subí más fácilmente.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjSErgNY9goVJGRKcAdvTxjTEtfLEBXpYxUqupcCCVzf/image.png)
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)

Pensamientos

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freed99/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xna28ssEauDe.png)
--- ---

> Esta publicación es principalmente para contarles mi progreso en cuanto al set foundations, el cual he estado construyendo solo a base de los cofres y packs que he ganado en mis batallas cada día en el formato frontier. Lo que más busco es tener los arcontes a su tope de nivel y que me sean útiles para mantener una buena posición en el formato Modern en la liga Plata, eso mientras construyo el set Conclave Arcana en un nivel aceptable para esa liga. No suelo combinar todas las cartas, para tener más opciones a usar en el formato survival. Espero poder compartirles pronto una publicación sobre los arcontes que me falta por subir de nivel y una buena batalla usándolos. -----

> Muchas gracias a los que leen mis publicaciones y muchas gracias por sus votos o comentarios. En el siguiente enlace podrás unirte al juego y conocer este fantástico mundo: [freed99](https://splinterlands.com?ref=freed99). Espero verlos pronto en un Challenge contando sus batallas y experiencias. Nota: Esta publicación no es un consejo de inversión; realicen sus propias investigaciones. ___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxXswzbWQTYK9VKwK2Wy5BQfQUwDKD8c2TK4EK89eWbb/image.png)
![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uFMJtwBYqobHGRfKciFJvEUovh86N3Qbweq2XJqMVxibXhLkqGtxyReVgTmL1Kqs5mU.gif)

body.title: Frosty….
body.body: Afternoon everyone …. Today I woke up to a thick layer of frost on my lawn and my truck. Well we went from high nineties last week, to frost and a temperature of just thirty five degrees when I woke up. Who doesn’t like ships on coins, rounds or bars…… If you are a pirate at heart then you will agree that ship on them are beautiful. This is one of the classiest bars I’ve ever seen, and I’m very glad that I have one in my possession. So today I am going to share with you a not so small bar with a ship on it. This bar is 250 grams, so just shy of a ten ounce bar. You know those Brits like there metric scale. The bar is from the East India Company. They have been producing coins and bars for centuries now. **_Here’s a little bit about them…_** The East India Company is one of the world’s oldest international brands. Originally formed in 1601 with a Royal Charter from England’s Queen Elizabeth I, the East India Company not only dealt in global trade between the Far East and the United Kingdom, but also produced coinage over its 400-plus year history. In 2010, the company was reformed and even began issuing coins again in 2012. **_I know, I know, show the dam bar already…._**

/>\n\nThey also make silver rounds and many other bars as well. If you’ve never seen this bar before in person, I’d say it should be on your list of bars to obtain. It’s really done extremely well. The detail is exquisitely and it’s done with class.

body.title: A DAILY WORD IN FRENCH (#32)
body.body:
https://media.tenor.com/i8qP30g-IuIAAAAC/home-alone.gif 

Good day everyone! I am soooo sorry, it’s almost late but I don’t wanna fail the consistency I promised us and myself I almost forgot I didn’t write and I had pee planned a wonderful topic. 
Tell me the truth guys, aren’t you all tired of verbs? Lol
I know action word is good but we are not wrestlers lol

 https://media.tenor.com/5DTPdKrbtOYAAAAC/glep-smiling-friends.gif 

So quickly with that being said i am teaching us something very important and I think this should be classified as a noun instead which is a naming word. 
So today’s French word is CHEZ.
Not CHEZ for pronunciation please 🙏 remember we don’t speak out the last word. If you do you change the meaning and it’s no longer French so pronounce it yourself, you are right! 

 https://media.tenor.com/0YyJuTbfzHEAAAAC/yunarukami.gif 

Now let’s get a bit serious, so like I said this is not a verb and not even a typical word you can translate directly. 
Chez means something like “at someone’s place” or “in someone’s home or environment”. It is more than just a word but a very handy expression that could upgrade and make our French language or spoken French ELITE. 
If a French man hears you using this so well in your speech he will be so happy and he will be proud of you especially when he knows youre not native. 


 https://media.tenor.com/vC5L-FX9lFUAAAAC/soutien-help.gif 

Pronunciation is very simple and it goes like shay. “Shay” “shey” pronounced very easily to mean home or house but Thats on the surface, professionally or natively it’s an expression with a quite longer and detailed meaning. 
You will hear it a lot in French because it is very practical.

Observe this examples carefully to see what I mean:

Je suis chez moi — I am at home

Here chez means at home because of the possessive pronoun moi, which means ME en anglais. (En anglais simply means im English)

Je vais chez Marie — I am going to Marie’s place

Here chez means place or residence or apartment because it’s not a personal or direct possessive pronoun but for someone else so you are like a visitor or a guest. 

French is really romantic and we need to take not of the rules so we have a good and fluent experience and what makes this word interesting in particular is that it reflects how French expresses location in a more personal way, It is not just about a place, it is about being in someone’s space or environment.
It somehow shows respect and acknowledgment and you see all of us #education lovers on #hive? We are in our own beautiful CHEZ.  in French we would say CHEZ NOUS. you all already know the meaning of nous. 

Thanks for taking your precious time to read. 
SAINT HEROD 🦸‍♂️ 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@herod/a-daily-word-in-french-32-73c)

body.title: How I Used Real Client Job Posts to Completely Rewrite My Upwork Profile
body.body:
I have come to see Upwork as something that I need to put every effort in daily. Optimizing my Upwork account has become a must. As usual, I did not just guess what to write or rely on an old description.

Instead, I went straight to where the real data is, the job posts that clients are actually publishing every single day. I gathered between 10 and 50 job posts in my niche and began studying them carefully, line by line. The goal is simple, understand what clients are truly asking for, not what I assume they want.

I look at the language they use, the skill they repeated, the responsibilities they emphasize, even the kind of result they expected from a good freelancer. Certain phrases kept showing up and certain tools were mentioned again and again, and specific outcomes were clearly important to them. All of this became my raw material in writing my profile description.

From there, I used those insights to rewrite my profile description. Instead of using generic words like, I'm a freelancer, who does this and that, blah, blah, blah. I focused on mirroring the exact words clients are using, already used to describe their ideal hire.

I aligned my summary with their needs, highlighted the skills they care most about, and made sure that my value proposition answered the question, why you and not someone else? I also updated my skills and tags to match the recurring keywords I find in these job posts. This helped my profile become more searchable and more relevant when clients are looking for someone within my expertise. What I did today may look simple, but it took me a lot of time.

I mean, more than 4 hours and I'm still there. But it is a powerful habit that I'm sure that if I do it every day, it's going to bring me results. I'm training myself to listen to the market instead of just talking about myself.

By letting real job posts guide how I present my service, I increase my chances of being discovered, shortlisted, and hired. It is not magic, it is just intentional optimization. And I keep doing this consistently.

I know that my Upwork account is going to rank and it's going to start getting the invite that it is due. And my Upwork profile won't just be a page about me, it will be a direct response to what clients already say they want.

body.title: Paw print charm, the perfect accent for your bag🐾
body.body: > Greetings and blessings, my dear crafting friends. I hope you’re all doing well and staying healthy, and that this week brings you plenty of productivity and creative projects. For this Monday with needles, I’ll tell you that this past weekend I had a very special commission: a crocheted charm shaped like a puppy paw print to decorate a bag. As soon as I was asked to make it, I knew I was going to enjoy it immensely, because these kinds of small pieces have something very special about them: they’re quick and cute. I chose my favorite 50% viscose and 50% acrylic yarns, which have a soft finish and a very subtle sheen. For the colors, I went with a warm combination: a deep brown for the paw pads and a dark beige for the base. I love how these tones complement each other and give it that cozy, natural feel.

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridas amigas de las agujas. Espero que estén muy bien con salud y bienestar y que sea una semana de provecho y muchas creaciones. Para este lunes de aguja, les cuento que para este fin de semana pasado tuve un encargo muy especial: un charm tejido en forma de huellita de perrito para decorar un bolso. Apenas me lo pidieron, supe que lo iba a disfrutar muchísimo, porque este tipo de piezas pequeñas tienen algo muy especial: son rápidas y lindas. Elegí mis hilos favoritos de 50% viscosa y 50% acrílico que tienen un acabado suave y un brillo muy sutil. Para los colores, me fui por una combinación cálida: un marrón profundo para las almohadillas de la huella y un beige oscuro para la base. Me encanta cómo estos tonos se complementan y le dan ese aire acogedor y natural. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png ![1000659625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xVTMZndXTmG3Zx4mNU7L3gi2nNaRWhH762JAEqaaAep15oJnye7HBmYJbYwukX9FZpH.jpg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

> The little paw print is very easy to crochet, using single, half, and double crochet stitches, so it’s the perfect project to enjoy without any hassle. Plus, it comes together really fast, and that always gives you that satisfying sense of accomplishment. To add that finishing touch, I attached a gold-plated steel carabiner—it’s practical and gives it an elegant, pretty finish for hanging on a bag. And since I love spoiling my customers, I decided to give her a little crocheted heart to go with the little paw print. It was that extra touch that made everything even more special. When I handed it to her, her reaction said it all: she was happy. And I, with a happy heart, confirmed once again that crocheting also creates moments full of joy. 🧶✨

> La huellita se teje muy fácil, usando puntos bajos, medios y altos, así que es un proyecto perfecto para disfrutar sin complicaciones. Además, avanza rapidísimo, y eso siempre da una satisfacción inmediata que complace. Para darle ese toque final, le añadí un mosquetón de acero dorado que es práctico y le da un acabado elegante y bonito para colgar en el bolso. Y como me encanta consentir a mis clientas, decidí regalarle un pequeño corazón tejido para que acompañara la huellita. Fue ese detalle extra que hizo todo aún más especial. Cuando se lo entregué, su reacción lo dijo todo: quedó feliz. Y yo, con el corazón contento, confirmando una vez más que tejer también crea momentos llenos de alegría. 🧶✨ https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xpCrfizuXKD21qN8YNqLF23SGh15ThciNL3J9UAQzP12g6eAuGd6nPAnQXgCMVxe5GC.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23tc3KnWc7ZmRQ4j2NRDt3WhKkHuZfcd5T8BwnVANWDDRwhyWGk5KTd9SUfnKZ2ztRznp.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xAe4axypEKNXQUUxD1Bf7uRAiWo6L4pNR5Z6jhgGdxnupEpzQpKdQAdHB3buCT6VHwC.jpg| |--|--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

body.title: Dreadful Mondays
body.body:
We all know the meme culture that Mondays are the worst days of the week. Normally, I join that culture but I can confidently say that today's Monday has ascertained and cemented the fact.

We first start with my single bad decision of the day.
> Lemme stay at home, no debit, no stress.

What that decision cost me was my mental health.
Three arguments with my mom, a talking down from my dad, my charger cord getting spoiled and somehow, the plate of soup I wanted to eat had turned sour.

This same Monday, I realized just the grey essence of tiredness. A task that I know with all my heart needed full urgency..
I. Just. Couldn't.

It's 11:17 now and mentally, I've logged off for the day, been listening to music since 7pm, got hit on the head by a metal door by 10pm (thankfully just a slight bump) while trying to release my dogs without the two males being free in the same space together (would write about that another time).

![1003436253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23vsUyNu91YCDbvPtnDCpP4oyAaATgYKt1xrmGt8bkamWTTajGs1RbZUCD99xjyxNiSHj.jpg)


If I were to say the only minor win of the day is that I managed to drag myself off my bed and did my workout.


![1003436252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/23vhs8dc1EZptqTWo97k689GbaUKVwS5fyBr3PTMX5J38QRe4puSB2msv9yN33yZG787n.jpg)

I stopped last year and since I'm actually slim fit—despite drastic tries to gain weight— I can't say I have an exact gym goal.
At this point I'm just trying to work off the huge amount of sugar I take in on a weekly basis.

Regardless, that's the summary of my day.
Argument, sour food, laziness, tiredness, mentally drained, head hurting with a bump, listened to 6 hours worth of music and gym session done.

May another Monday like this never happen.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/NZHXnTwS5pEAAAAC/please7tv-please.gif)

body.title: WHAT IF SUCCESS ISN'T ’t WHAT WE THINK IT  IS? LOH 285
body.body: There are Some books you read and leave behind. and there are those that stick with you long after you have closed the last page.\n\nPersonally, one of such books is \

by Robin Sharma.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUTFaSJp2dju5qZxXQccQ5hSaAqM2s6iAZbhojJQHSCDn/images.jpeg)



[Image credit](https://www.google.com/search?client=tablet-android-samsung-nf-rev1&hs=9bP&sca_esv=23368486d762886d&sxsrf=ANbL-n6xOU6cMgaH98JWfCSMYrtL-FfDng:1776723128753&udm=2&fbs=ADc_l-aN0CWEZBOHjofHoaMMDiKpaEWjvZ2Py1XXV8d8KvlI3vWUtYx0DZdicpfE1faGYenqWn-q4MFiFFtvJjTKeAVxBf9XF8ByrMpEedseJb6C23ClWZiq90s5pDauQyCKzJA6ZE-sRNo78txl2cKXF60Ubq16rmFbN7_q6g8AW19RmRlH6swyoEWi4xOresFOOiEMMQp3DXdveV6_QUFW-MEWr1OMXw&q=The+monk+who+sold+his+Ferrari&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwielNC3uf2TAxUvhf0HHZgzL2YQtKgLegQIDhAB&biw=800&bih=1280&dpr=1.5#sv=CAMSWRoyKhBlLUdUWnlwRERYQllaZndNMg5HVFp5cEREWEJZWmZ3TToOZ252V0VYbzlKM2NJSU0gBCoXCgFzEhBlLUdUWnlwRERYQllaZndNGAEwATgASgQIARACGAcgy5W-hgNKCBACGAEgAigB)

I did not read it when I was experiencing a fall-out of things in my life or some out of the ordinary happenings. It was as though I was at that stage that many of us are at, attempting to develop, attempting to improve, attempting to unravel the mystery but still feeling that something was somehow amiss.

The book narrates about a successful lawyer who had what most people seek which is, money, status, success but was still empty. He later leaves that life to find something more, something with a deeper meaning.

Initially, it was radical.

Selling everything? Quitting that type of life?

However, as I continued to read the book I realized the book was not about giving up on success. It was a matter of redefining.

That part hit me.

most of us are raised pursuing a form of success that we never even defined for ourselves. We simply bequeath it, money, recognition, status, without really questioning whether or not they are things that are going to leave us fulfilled.

Among the most significant lessons that I was able to obtain in the book one stood out, and that is the significance of living with a purpose.

Not to merely wake up, respond to life, and go through the routines, but to make a decision on how you would like to live. Choosing what matters. Deciding on what you focus your time and energy on.

It is so easy to say but in reality, many people do not do it.

The other aspect that the book has highlighted is mind discipline.

We are so preoccupied with outward development, skills, money, opportunities but we do not pay much attention to what is going on inside. What we think, what we pay attention to, what we do. The book helped me to understand that when you are not focused or in a negative state of mind, no success you gain outwardly will be complete.

I kept that thought in mind.

It also discusses much about small, consistent habits. Not huge dramatic steps but mere day-to-day steps that build up. The stuff such as guarding your focus, taking time to contemplate, and forming discipline slowly.
Just Pure consistency.

And I believe that’s what made the book stand out.

What would I suggest?

In a world that has been in a frenzy of pursuing something, be it money, growth, recognition, etc, this book makes you take a step back and question yourself, What am I actually pursuing, and why?

It does not command you not to be ambitious.

It only asks of you that you ensure that your ambition is in line with your peace, your purpose and your long term satisfaction.

In my case, I found that change of thought worthwhile.

Not life-changing in a day, but gradual. it alters your attitude to things.

How you work.
How you think.
How you gauge improvement.

And sometimes that is just what you need, not a noisy change of course, but a noiseless change of attitude..

Thanks for Reading..

body.title: Sinners  (Review) [ESP-ENG] by edwardstobia
body.body:
> Normalmente los domingos son días para ver películas con Luna pero este no fue de esos particulares domingos ya que ella pasó el día con sus abuelos paternos y no está mal, para nosotros, los padres, son como unas mini vacaciones ja ja ja nunca pensé que ser padre fuera tan demandante ja ja ja... Teníamos una deuda con los Oscar y ver algunas de de la películas que fueron galardonadas y que nosotros no habíamos visto. >_Sundays are usually movie days with Luna, but this wasn’t one of those Sundays she spent the day with her paternal grandparents. And that’s not a bad thing; for us parents, it’s like a mini-vacation, ha ha ha. I never thought being a parent would be so demanding, ha ha ha… We owed it to the Oscars to watch some of the award-winning films we hadn’t seen yet._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/2432KYLoNG94fX72mn5LcBBFWHLsjRx2XbRKQvdQ4NaGk6n2LyButG6BgpmYstwhDhobD.png En este caso hablo de Sinners así que desde mi punto de vista la película es bastante estructural y divaga mucho en la primera mitad de hecho, no me pareció desde el principio nada atractiva la película pero quise seguir adelante pues en ocasiones luego de la mitad de la película suele haber un giro que me sorprende. La trama nos deja un solo escenario de un solo día lo que empezando desde allí, la película realmente limita su ambición pero ojo, esta es solo mi opinión recuerden que no soy experto en la materia cinematográfica soy solo un amante más al cine [Image source](https://es-us.noticias.yahoo.com/sinners-pel%C3%ADcula-protagonizada-michael-b-160000372.html) >_In this case, I’m talking about *Sinners*, so from my perspective, the film is quite disjointed and rambles a lot in the first half. In fact, I didn’t find the film appealing at all from the start, but I wanted to keep watching because sometimes, after the halfway point, there’s a twist that surprises me. The plot confines us to a single setting over the course of a single day, which, starting from there, really limits the film’s ambition but keep in mind, this is just my opinion; remember that I’m no expert on cinema I’m just another movie lover._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23vsEDupRf69YKjU2J1HZmFFD3cC22i2qtNZzqmC4JNgQJjfhBAvskmaN3veQeFmq8PMj.png)](https://www.filmreviewdaily.com/new-reviews/sinners)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23xKrG71pDvdY8U1TVMH1B7egQYnNaZcnTdrSrZ3vHoPZKZVdXaGkSKCSPbWKwn7LAcMg.png La película indaga entre ideas profundas, la identidad negra, la liberación espiritual y el vampirismo cultural pero ninguna de ellas termina de cuajar para mí. Y bueno, esto último fue lo que me arrebató la opinión de que me gustara pues soy anti película de vampiros la verdad es que no me agradan y acá, no hay una diferencia a lo que ya conocemos de ellos. La estaca en el corazón o el famoso collar de ajos aun así, críticos y fans parecen estar excusando estos problemas para quedar bien en el momento. Si, algo muy similar a lo que pasó con Black Panther. Y no me malinterpreten, entiendo el impacto cultural y por qué está pasando. Lo impresionante es saber desde que vi el premio Óscar que está película tuvo un éxito de taquilla lo cual fue mucho más de lo que imaginaban todo el equipo de producción aún a pesar de contar con grandes actores y en su mayoría actores de color. Ojo, repito, no me malinterpreten no tengo nada en contra de eso y respeto mucho el ímpetu de Coogler, sobre todo después de asegurar los derechos de la película para el futuro. [Image source](https://masdecibelios.es/sinners-bso-canciones/) > _The film explores profound ideas Black identity, spiritual liberation, and cultural vampirism but none of them quite click for me. And well, that last point is what ultimately made me change my mind about liking it, since I’m not a fan of vampire movies; the truth is, I don’t care for them, and here, there’s nothing new compared to what we already know about them. The stake through the heart or the famous garlic necklace even so, critics and fans seem to be overlooking these issues just to look good right now. Yes, it’s very similar to what happened with Black Panther. And don’t get me wrong, I understand the cultural impact and why this is happening. What’s impressive is knowing, ever since I saw the Oscar, that this movie was a box office hit which was far more than the entire production team imagined, even despite having great actors, most of whom are actors of color. Mind you, I repeat, don’t get me wrong I have nothing against that, and I greatly respect Coogler’s drive, especially after securing the film’s rights for the future._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23u5tdGj74mWdsYa8S9LkbyxiST4pydbAxUnffF7Uy2STCo9wM2syYNPXXrw1paHxBVjo.png)](https://www.conlosojosabiertos.com/sinners/)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tRxnzSqyT6WBQVPmCJU1DGGM4yExMUwDSTX5hywDJPxmWUrHTrBeEF3HKBn9UgbczeK.png)](https://www.gq.com.mx/articulo/sinners-vale-la-pena-verla-de-que-trata)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23wMU9U3FfiKKLLPg6RvGXYQGxGWRUwpcX7X9UvXXD3mbc2kfaUaKGm8bnnb6S19wQy4k.png En fin, el actor Michael B. Jordan fue quien levantó el Óscar como mejor actor principal y sabiendo eso, fue que teníamos que ver Sinners pero aquí va mi decisión final sobre la película y la actuación del ganador del Óscar. La película está sobrevalorada no me parece algo que nos deje esa sensación de extraordinario y segundo y no menos importante, no me parece una gran actuación del actor aun cuando el mismo interpreta dos personas creo que he visto mejores actuaciones del actor. Así que bueno, pueden aceptar mi opinión y puedo entender la tuya. Si ya la viste, me gustaría saber qué opinas. Yo, me quedo más con Una batalla tras otra (One Battle After Another) de Leonardo DiCaprio [Image source](https://www.quever.news/cine/sinners-la-nueva-pelicula-ryan-coogler-debuta-puntaje-perfecto-antes-su-llegada-los-cines-n64403) > _Anyway, actor Michael B. body.title: A Hidden Gem in Barquisimeto: Garlic Shrimp at Canarias Port Bar [En-Es]
body.body:
![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/Ep7u2KvyexAPRuJeb88uDSCjd1j3aCXkRhNKqd2z41MKpZtRaiFuKEh8fqHZA8hqcat.jpg)
This week, I had the opportunity to eat at the Canarias Port Bar restaurant inside the Club Canario Larense in the city of Barquisimeto. This restaurant is located on La Salle Avenue. Although I had been to the club for events and parties before, I never had the chance to try the restaurant on those occasions. # Recently, my mom has been in Venezuela. My brother and I decided it was the perfect time to take her out to eat and enjoy some delicious Canary Islands cuisine with her. The food also looked amazing in the reviews we found online. Going out to eat and spending time together has been a bit difficult due to our work schedules. There is also a complex situation in Venezuela—hyperinflation is out of control, which makes it harder to go out frequently. However, it is necessary for emotional well-being. #
![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xKvA93FYHo2rb49xrHiGCwL3zRmp5erGCYiwFVXqVEoWPkLmgqrDJ63zSkKAeHbTyMF.jpg)

> # The bar and restaurant were empty that day. We arrived a little after 2:00 p.m. At first, the manager and the waiter were somewhat rough, but the owner knows one of my uncles. She called and emphasized that they should treat us well, according to what the manager told us during our conversation. I was surprised by her comment. My uncle told me he can’t do anything secretly—haha, they keep an eye on him. Anyway, we didn’t know what to order. # We didn’t want anything heavy—just something light. When I say light, I mean food that wouldn’t feel too heavy. We usually go for grilled dishes, but we decided to avoid that option due to previous bad experiences. #
![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EokdaN1j5SDYpLkhsDpNqNSyseC9GwjkUuTDEGbkqSGrRQGRSEfnSnQKrpbyhjq1C2q.jpg)

> # We chose dishes we had seen in the restaurant’s social media reviews. One was breaded shrimp, and the other was garlic shrimp. We were a bit indecisive, but that’s what we felt like eating. We also wanted to order paella, but we declined because we thought it would be too much food. In total, we ordered four dishes, all served with garlic bread and Zulia beer—except for my mom, who doesn’t drink alcohol; she ordered a lemonade. # The food took about 20 minutes. While we waited, we talked about different topics—countries, my mom’s adjustment during her vacation, and how empty the restaurant was that day. During the conversation, we highlighted how good the beers were because they were very cold. In Venezuela, beer is typically served chilled, not warm like in some other countries in Latin America and around the world. # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xyUobNmRaVvqAKFEHjJeaJPBKW9EvCEj54t4GwNftjmTcc5gdBKTzH2K2sHWgVUYfbE.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23xyXQsJzuaqewk18CjzxW6773Bz1gqXMRXvWhnNGT4uyFXGDWbtVcRwJAdq4ywmjAhfb.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23z7FvHWm7KEAbjyyH6pgVBTERuM6nscVYWx61WXcfGZYMFJLhZrE7vApFDZpyqUJ239w.jpg|

> # The waiter was inexperienced. He had just been hired and had only been working there for four days, and the manager was somewhat harsh with him. We tried not to make things difficult for him; despite being new and inexperienced, he was kind. After about 20 minutes, the food arrived, and the first dishes served were the garlic shrimp—one for my brother and one for me. #
![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/EoK6Gtb8iYmFbDQsKAV9u2641r2jDkHoeXBGuE3BbUTzShHEbHa5bfk1QW7r7sDYrRw.jpg)

> # I loved the ceramic dish shaped like a pot in blue and yellow tones. The shrimp were sautéed with chistorra, pieces of potato, and another ingredient I couldn’t identify (I didn’t ask what it was). # | | | | |---|---|---| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23uFTYxVrRZobU51WZYEUhWT7JcTbMokuZc7cCx1T8VG5yBRQz7DGPMjqniPTJjL6BRvQ.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23x17DqZVDEFqvcaUTNAciWzAChsadxdapSshKA8YWAkBYE24KGfAh5CS3TBZi2Kj58cC.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23tmFqcRXbVQozm9cGwm7EjvR6q4jWhC1imizd6bWvMiASYgLRvqtRrwfs19vNR3u9e4H.jpg|

> # My uncle and my mom ordered the breaded shrimp, which were served on a black ceramic plate. I liked the presentation and the cuts of squid. According to my mom and my uncle, it was delicious. #
![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neruel/23wWtxbQnGXqCT5Qb1vw4dunmYPdfbArbSkhoZmyhJhjuq2abY8mnQMpDpAMe4Hr6ZX4G.jpg)

> # In my opinion, the food was excellent—I especially highlight the presentation and the flavor. I’ve had some unpleasant experiences lately, but the food at this restaurant was impressive. If you want to try something different, with touches of Canary Islands cuisine, this is the perfect place to visit. # With love, Neruel. # Original content by @neruel. All rights reserved ©, 2026. Images: Samsung Galaxy A54. English translation and grammar correction: ChatGPT – DeepL – LanguageTool.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

> Una joya escondida en Barquisimeto: Gambas al ajillo en Canarias Port Bar > > # > > Esta semana tuve la oportunidad de comer en el restaurante Canarias Port Bar dentro del Club Canario Larense en la ciudad de Barquisimeto. Este restaurante está ubicado en la avenida La Salle. Aunque había ido al club por eventos y fiestas, no tuve la oportunidad de comer en el restaurante en esas ocasiones. > > # > > Recientemente, mi mamá está en Venezuela. Mi hermano y yo decidimos que era adecuado llevarla a comer. Disfrutar de una rica comida canaria con ella. Además, la comida se veía deliciosa en las reseñas que encontramos en internet. Salir a comer y compartir ha sido un poco difícil debido a nuestros trabajos. También hay una situación compleja en Venezuela: la hiperinflación está desbordada. Esto hace que sea difícil poder salir con mayor frecuencia. Sin embargo, es necesario por temas de salud emocional. > > # > > El bar y restaurante estaban solos ese día. Llegamos poco después de las dos de la tarde. La encargada y el mesero al principio fueron un poco toscos, pero la dueña conoce a uno de mis tíos. Llamó y le recalcó que debían tratarnos bien. Esto según la afirmación de la encargada cuando conversaba con nosotros. Estaba sorprendido por su comentario. Mi tío me dijo que no puede hacer nada a escondidas, jajajaja. Lo tienen vigilado. En fin, no sabíamos qué plato ordenar. > > # > > No queríamos comer algo pesado, solo comida liviana. Cuando me refiero a comida liviana, era a algo que no fuese pesado. Optamos siempre por comer parrilla, pero decidimos descartar este plato debido a malas experiencias previas. > > # > > Optamos por ordenar platos que vimos en las reseñas en redes sociales del restaurante. Uno era camarones rebozados y el otro era camarones al ajillo. Estábamos indecisos, pero esto fue lo que nos provocó comer. También queríamos pedir paella, pero declinamos esta opción porque pensamos que era mucha comida. Ordenamos cuatro platos, todos acompañados con pan al ajillo y cerveza Zulia Excepto mi mamá, ya que no toma alcohol, ella pidió una limonada. > > # > > La comida tardó unos 20 minutos. Mientras esperábamos, conversábamos sobre temas, países, la adaptación de mi mamá en su periodo de vacaciones y sobre lo solo que estaba el restaurante ese día. En la conversación resaltó el hecho de que las cervezas estaban deliciosas, debido a que estaban muy frías. En Venezuela se toma la cerveza refrigerada y no caliente como en otros países de Latinoamérica y el mundo. > > # > > El mesero del restaurante era inexperto. Estaba recién contratado, solo tenía 4 días laborando y la encargada era algo dura con él. Tratamos de no causarle inconformidad; a pesar de que era nuevo y no tenía experiencia, fue amable. La comida llegó luego de los 20 minutos y los primeros platos que colocaron fueron el camarón al ajillo. Uno para mi hermano y el otro para mí. > > # > > Me encantó la vajilla de cerámica con forma de olla de color azul y amarillo. Los camarones estaban salteados con chistorra, trozos de papa y otro ingrediente que no pude identificar (no pregunté cuál era). > > # > > Mi tío y mi mamá ordenaron los camarones rebosados; este plato lo sirvieron en una vajilla de cerámica de color negro. Me gustó la presentación y los cortes de calamar. Según lo que me comentó mi mamá y mi tío, estaba delicioso. > > # > > A mi parecer, la comida estaba riquísima; destaco en la presentación y lo deliciosa que estaba. He tenido últimamente experiencias desagradables. No obstante, la comida de este restaurante fue impresionante. Si deseas comer algo distinto, con toques de gastronomía canaria, este es el lugar perfecto que debes visitar. Con cariño, Neruel. > > # > > Contenido original de @neruel. body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 19 2026
body.body:
Greetings my friends and all lovers of physical activities all over the world. Welcome to my Actifit Report for sunday the 19/4/2026. Happy Sunday to us all. We just have own more Sunday to go in the month of April. How time flies. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8d26dba9-3399-4af1-875c-48b615c2ab3b.jpg) I attended church service and when I came back I watched a few EPL matches. A pulsating game was played at Villa Park where third placed Villa hosted high flying Sunderland. The thrilling encounter was almost destined for a (3-3) but Tammy Abraham had other ideas as he slotted the winning goal in the 93rd minute to see Villa win by (4-3). Elsewhere, Virgil van Dijk scored a dramatic 100th-minute winner as Liverpool won the first Premier League Merseyside derby at Hill Dickinson Stadium. Everton had remained resolute to see out the game but Van Dijk scored to separate the two neighbours as the game ended (2-1) in favour of Liverpool. In the same vein, Nottingham Forest crushed Burnley (4-0) to boost their survival hopes while condeming Burnley to the murkey relegation waters. But the biggest game of the week was played at the Etihad stadium between 2nd placed Manchester City vs first placed Arsenal. In a game many had taunted as the title decider City had started the game 6pts behind leaders Arsenal. They knew that a win will narrow that gap to 3pts with a game in hand. So they gave all and got through needed 3pts as the game ended (2-1) in favour of the Cityzens. That's it for now. Thanks for reading up to this point. Until next time, I say, keep exercising. All images used here are original and mine too.

body.title: Es tu risa. It's your laugh. (ESP-ENG)
body.body:
Es tu risa una cumbre donde el sol se detiene,
donde el blanco y el fuego se funden al fin;
no hay joya en la tierra que tal gracia encadene,
ni música extraña en ningún otro jardín.

Es perfecta en su ritmo, en su luz, en su entrega,
una marea de vida que a la orilla nos llega,
dejando en el aire, como un rastro de miel,
el calor de tu risa tatuado en la piel.

No es solo un sonido lo que nace en tu rostro,
es una coreografía de luz, un estallido exacto,
un puente que se tiende entre el alma y el aire
con la fuerza rotunda de un sagrado pacto.

Pero tras esa nieve de blancura infinita,
en la sombra encendida de tu boca habitada,
se mueve esa lengua cálida, suave y bendita,
que humedece el incendio de tu voz desatada.

Es la cuna del verbo, es el pulso del fuego,
el músculo tibio que le da forma al juego,
aportando el calor que a la risa da vida,
esa pizca de amor, deseo y alegría.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4dN1ccPvyGkyj7SqVWsMkuWftCSU7kivo3vKr5WD3yg/1776723831677.png)

Poema de mi autoría.
Texto traducido por Traductor en linea de Google.
Imagen tomada de Géminis IA.

✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨✨

English.
Your laughter is a summit where the sun stops,
where white and fire finally merge;
There is no jewel on earth that such grace chains,
nor strange music in any other garden.

It is perfect in its rhythm, in its light, in its delivery,
a tide of life that reaches us to the shore,
leaving in the air, like a trail of honey,
the heat of your laughter tattooed on the skin.

It's not just a sound that is born on your face,
It is a choreography of light, an exact explosion,
a bridge that is built between the soul and the air
with the resounding force of a sacred pact.

But after that snow of infinite whiteness,
in the burning shadow of your inhabited mouth,
that warm, soft and blessed tongue moves,
that moistens the fire of your unleashed voice.

It is the cradle of the word, it is the pulse of the fire,
the warm muscle that shapes the game,
providing the warmth that gives life to laughter,
that bit of love, desire and joy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4dN1ccPvyGkyj7SqVWsMkuWftCSU7kivo3vKr5WD3yg/1776723831677.png)
