description.title: Mohana.Un mar de aventuras 🌊Review. [Spanish-English]
description.body:
Versión del contenido en idioma español 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1N9YydmYmkfxSNgfWmpjJgu8tT9WuxAS4PFGmSPTksk/1776722569350.jpg)

[es.wallpapers.com](https://es.wallpapers.com/imagenes-de-moana)

Hace varios días llevo disfrutando del proyecto animado Mohana. Un mar de aventuras 🌊. Producción de 2016 que mostró uno de los lados más sensibles y tiernos de **Dwayne Johnson** (**La Roca**) y de **Auliʻi Cravalho**.  
_______
**Sinopsis:**
_______

La historia de Mohana se resume en la valentía de la hija del gran jefe quién asume la responsabilidad de cruzar y pelear contra el océano para devolver el corazón de Tfiti la diosa de la fertilidad y la abundancia. Dicho corazón ❤️ fue robado por el semidiós Mawi quien incluso al principio se negó a devolver el corazón, pero a la insistencia y valentía de Mohana cedió y cumplió con su promesa. Mohana fue reconocida por su pueblo quien volvió a retomar sus actividades anteriores de pesca y descubrimiento de islas 🏝️ gracias a Mawie y aquí termina la historia.
____

Hay varios elementos a destacar del filme que lo hacen especialmente hecho para niños y porque no también adultos. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEFG3C27Gytw9t4wdM4DGJQsxmLTGHkxYG7zB5tB6aox/1776723259219.jpg)

[elcomercio.pe](https://elcomercio.pe/mag/fama/que-ver/moana-2-actores-de-voz-y-personajes-quien-es-quien-en-la-pelicula-cast-guide-nnda-nnlt-noticia/)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQek4Tt5xkAxE29E965m2ueaFtqqm4BEokeTe9KqXMQGn/1776723565764.jpg)

[www.marca.com](https://www.marca.com/mx/trending/cine/2023/04/05/642ca2df22601dce608b45e2.html)

 ✅ Uno de los más increíbles fue su reparto de actores donde como mencionaba al principio a Dwayne Johnson en el personaje de (Mawi) el semidiós y Auliʻi Cravalho como (Mohana). Hay personajes secundarios que hacen que la peli tenga más brillo del que ya tiene. 

🎧📼🎙️También están las constantes canciones que son un elemento bastante bueno para desentrañar algunos pasajes de la historia y sus personajes tanto como el cangrejo y los ancestros de Mohana y porque no también la presencia de Mawi quien era este y cuál era su verdadera misión. 
________

Los efectos especiales y la animación hacen que los personajes resalten y sean más originales lo que demuestra el empeño de la producción y sus escritores de llevar algo único al mundo infantil. 

________

He leído de varias fuentes que hay posibilidad de la existencia de una secuela para dicha producción de mano de Disney ahora lo que habrá que ver si llegan a ser tan buena como la primera aunque eso es poco común de que suceda porque la mayoría de las veces lo que hacen es deformar y no continuar el trabajo original.

________

En mi opinión personal Mohana es uno de esos animados que marcan un antes y un después. Porque a pesar de verlos al principio como niños y llamar nuestra atención de primera aún de adultos seguimos disfrutando y encontrando cosas nuevas que no nos habíamos percatado.

________

Para finalizar me gustaría darle una evaluación de 10 puesto que está a la altura de todos los proyectos animados de Disney incluso si lo comparamos con alguno de los clásicos más archiconocidos como La Bella y la Bestia o quizás hasta Cenicienta. 

Pienso que no debería tener una secuela por todo lo que explique anteriormente y esperemos que si está idea se concreta logré almenos no suplantar a la original. 

Entonces amigos este fue mi contenido de inicio de semana espero que les haya gustado y que se anime n a ver está entrega animada tan maravillosa y única de su tiempo.  
________

________

Content Version: English 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1N9YydmYmkfxSNgfWmpjJgu8tT9WuxAS4PFGmSPTksk/1776722569350.jpg)

[es.wallpapers.com](https://es.wallpapers.com/imagenes-de-moana)

For the past few days, I have been enjoying the animated film *Moana: A Sea of Adventures* 🌊. This 2016 production showcased one of the most sensitive and tender sides of **Dwayne Johnson** (**The Rock**) and **Auliʻi Cravalho**.
_______
**Synopsis:**
_______

The story of *Moana* centers on the bravery of the Great Chief's daughter, who takes on the responsibility of venturing across—and battling—the ocean to return the Heart of Te Fiti, the goddess of fertility and abundance. This Heart ❤️ was stolen by the demigod Maui; initially, he refused to return it, but thanks to Moana's persistence and courage, he eventually relented and fulfilled his promise. Moana was celebrated by her people, who—thanks to Maui—were able to resume their traditional activities of fishing and island discovery 🏝️ once again. And that is where the story ends.
____

There are several elements of the film worth highlighting that make it feel tailor-made for children—and, indeed, for adults as well.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEFG3C27Gytw9t4wdM4DGJQsxmLTGHkxYG7zB5tB6aox/1776723061531.jpg)

[elcomercio.pe](https://elcomercio.pe/mag/fama/que-ver/moana-2-actores-de-voz-y-personajes-quien-es-quien-en-la-pelicula-cast-guide-nnda-nnlt-noticia/)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQek4Tt5xkAxE29E965m2ueaFtqqm4BEokeTe9KqXMQGn/1776723565764.jpg)

[www.marca.com](https://www.marca.com/mx/trending/cine/2023/04/05/642ca2df22601dce608b45e2.html)

✅ One of the most incredible aspects was its cast, featuring—as I mentioned at the beginning—Dwayne Johnson in the role of Maui (the demigod) and Auliʻi Cravalho. There are also supporting characters that add even more sparkle to a film that already shines so brightly.

🎧📼🎙️ Then there are the recurring songs, which serve as an excellent device for unraveling certain narrative threads and shedding light on the characters—from the crab and Moana's ancestors to Maui himself: who he truly was and what his real mission entailed.
________

The special effects and animation make the characters truly stand out and feel unique, demonstrating the dedication of the production team and writers to bringing something truly original to the world of children's entertainment.

________

I have read from various sources that there is a possibility of a sequel to this Disney production. Now, the question remains whether it will manage to be as good as the original—though that is a rare occurrence, as sequels often tend to distort the original work rather than build upon it effectively. ________

In my personal opinion, *Moana* is one of those animated films that marks a true turning point. For even though we first watched them as children—and they immediately captured our attention back then—we continue to enjoy them as adults, still discovering new details we hadn't noticed before.

________

To conclude, I would like to give it a rating of 10, as it stands on par with all of Disney's animated projects—even when compared to some of their most iconic classics, such as *Beauty and the Beast* or perhaps even *Cinderella*.

I do not believe it should have a sequel, for all the reasons I explained earlier; let us hope that, should such a project come to fruition, it at least manages not to overshadow the original.

So, friends, that wraps up my content for the start of the week. I hope you enjoyed it and that you feel inspired to watch this truly wonderful and unique animated feature of our time.
________

description.body:
>


# Comenzar

​
#

Cuando una chica está en esa etapa de iniciar su independencia llena de muchas ilusiones y siente tantas emociones en las cuales puede estar nerviosa, con mucho miedo y es una sensación extraña porque al mismo tiempo está feliz y segura de ese paso que está a punto de comenzar. Dejará el nido y eso significa irse de casa donde vivió desde que nació con papá y mamá, es decir con su familia donde creció viviendo un sin fin de momentos que definitivamente son parte de ella y de lo que es hoy; es esa edad donde empezara la universidad, es joven y como afirmar si es adulta o no lo dirá el tiempo y cada una de sus propias experiencias de vida.

Entre muchas cosas que planificar y por hacer está algo muy importante y es la búsqueda de un lugar seguro que será su nueva casa donde vivirá, puede ser que tenga en mente vivir sola o con compañera para compartir los gastos y los lugares tendrán variación de tamaño y precio dependiendo de la zona y los metros cuadrados. Entonces toca amoldarse a su presupuesto de joven estudiante, aunque lo cierto es que tampoco necesita un espacio grande si apenas va a comenzando a vivir sola por primera vez y **un pequeño espacio** está bien para ese inicio y luego en adelante tendrá otros cambios si así lo desea.

La familia, los padres apoyan muchos a sus hijos en esta decisión y aunque ellos también tienen sentimientos encontrados por esa separación la aceptan porque en el fondo entienden que eso es parte de la vida y los hijos no siempre serán bebés, pues, un día crecen y van por su independencia.
​

​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>

​

# Get started

​

#
When a girl is at that stage of starting her journey toward independence, full of hope and experiencing a whirlwind of emotions—she may feel nervous and very scared, yet it’s a strange sensation because at the same time she’s happy and confident about the new chapter she’s about to begin. She’ll be leaving the nest, and that means leaving the home where she’s lived since birth with Mom and Dad—that is, with the family where she grew up, experiencing countless moments that are definitely part of who she is and what she is today. It’s that age when she’ll start college; she’s young, and only time and each of her own life experiences will tell whether she’s an adult or not.

Among the many things to plan and do, one very important task is finding a safe place that will be your new home. You might be thinking of living alone or with a roommate to split the costs, and places will vary in size and price depending on the neighborhood and square footage. So you’ll need to work within your budget as a young student, though the truth is that you don’t need a large space if you’re just starting to live on your own for the first time—a small space is fine for that beginning, and later on you can make other changes if you wish.
​
Families and parents are very supportive of their children in this decision, and although they too have mixed feelings about the separation, they accept it because deep down they understand that this is part of life and that their children won’t always be babies—one day they’ll grow up and set out on their own.
​

#

description.title: Tiempo en familia // Family time
description.body:
>

Cualquier sacrificio que podamos hacer para compartir con nuestros seres queridos bien vale la pena, porque son momentos que afirman nuestro presente y van dejando recuerdos que atesoramos a través del tiempo. Aún siendo algo tan especial, de manera inconsciente podemos menospreciar esas actividades y experiencias que tanto necesitamos para nutrir nuestra vida. El estrés y las ocupaciones de hoy en día pueden ser una especie de corriente que nos puede llevar a un ritmo que, entre muchas cosas, nos puede llegar a privar de lo que realmente es importante para disfrutar de la vida. >Any sacrifice we make to spend time with our loved ones is well worth it, because these are moments that enrich our present and leave us with memories we treasure for years to come. Even though they are so special, we may unconsciously underestimate these activities and experiences that we so desperately need to enrich our lives. The stress and demands of modern life can be like a current that carries us along at a pace which, amongst other things, can end up depriving us of what is truly important for enjoying life. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQPDLyRuQaZxq6rPsHYf1h9bqPFDaYERNCrcuH6dishHs/IMG_20260404_101934_344.jpg A veces podemos dudar o perder el tiempo esperando un escenario perfecto, dejando a un lado la espontaneidad y la intención para que las mismas acciones te sorprendan. Imagino cuántas veces he dejado de hacer algo con mis familiares y mis amigos por creer que no es el mejor momento, y eso arroja un saldo que en lo general me deja claro lo mucho que he perdido. En otras ocasiones pensamos que luego habrá tiempo para lo que piensas y para muchas cosas más, y olvidamos lo cambiante que puede ser nuestra vida y como de la noche a la mañana nuestras circunstancias pueden tomar un giro total y bastante alejado a nuestras expectativas. Más allá de la reflexión, está el poder darnos la oportunidad de poder compartir y encontrar en cada día una razón para cualquier acción que conlleve a nuestra expresión de cariño. Eso es algo que he tratado de cultivar con más regularidad y hasta ahora mi sensación es de felicidad plena. Hace poco hice un viaje con un buen amigo, una travesía que hasta el último minuto era toda una incertidumbre. Aún así decidimos seguir adelante con el plan inicial, y como resultado todo se convirtió en una semana muy especial. Conocimos muchos amigos, exploramos lugares interesantes y nuevos aires que parecían darnos un respiro en medio de tantas tormentas. En mi caso, hasta me dió la oportunidad de compartir más con mi amigo Anderson, lo cual nos ayudó a fortalecer aún más nuestro vínculo de amistad, tal como si se tratara de un familiar de toda la vida. >Sometimes we may hesitate or waste time waiting for the perfect moment, setting aside spontaneity and intention so that our own actions can take us by surprise. I wonder how many times I’ve put off doing something with my family and friends because I thought it wasn’t the right time, and that usually makes it clear to me just how much I’ve missed out on. At other times, we think there’ll be time later for what we have in mind and for many other things, and we forget how changeable life can be and how, overnight, our circumstances can take a complete turn, one that’s quite far removed from our expectations. >Beyond mere reflection, there is the power of giving ourselves the chance to share and find, in every day, a reason for any action that leads to our expression of affection. That is something I have tried to cultivate more regularly, and so far I feel a sense of complete happiness. I recently went on a trip with a good friend, a journey that was shrouded in uncertainty right up until the last minute. Even so, we decided to go ahead with the original plan, and as a result, it turned into a very special week. We met up with many friends, explored interesting places and breathed in fresh air that seemed to give us a respite amidst so many storms. In my case, it even gave me the chance to spend more time with my friend Anderson, which helped us to strengthen our bond of friendship even further, just as if he were a lifelong family member. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVsYGhjjeh6ozKtyVQNHz9xDxT7fDUxN3DqCwbkG8csxe/IMG_20260330_141915_631.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUdRtKsHquX4bawRX4z17gYUEN4LVpNK7f1o45QQEFMiY/IMG_20260330_193440_197.jpg Al regresar a casa, me encontré con una invitación especial por parte de mis sobrinos, quienes están emocionados porque empezaron a practicar fútbol. Ricardo está en la categoría sub 9 y Fernando en la sub 7, aunque a Fernando le gusta más el tenis y creo que más adelante empezará a practicar ese deporte. Ambos están en esa etapa interesante de crecimiento y conocimiento de ciertas actividades que les atraen de forma natural, y me anima mucho ver como ellos desean compartir sus actividades con su abuela, su papá y conmigo. De todos los sobrinos que tengo ellos son los que están más cerca de mí, y espero poder pasar más tiempo con ellos ya que eso también los motiva a seguir aprendiendo. No puedo negar que antes del viaje me sentía muy mal en sentido anímico y emocional, pero ahora aprecio mucho el no haber dejado pasar esa oportunidad de poder conocer a otras personas que ya se ganan un lugar especial dentro de mi círculo familiar. A veces la misma distancia nos permite reajustar nuestra atención y nuestro tiempo hacia las personas que están muy cerca, y eso es algo que deseo aplicar con mayor interés hacia mis sobrinos y al resto de la familia. Lo único que podemos dar por sentado es nuestro presente, así que trataré de siempre buscar una razón o un motivo para mantenerme con la mejor actitud y disposición para dar vida a muchas más experiencias que entre amigos y familia son regalos de incalculable valor. >When I got home, I found a special invitation from my nephews, who are excited because they’ve started playing football. Ricardo is in the under-9s and Fernando in the under-7s, although Fernando prefers tennis and I think he’ll start playing that sport later on. They are both at that fascinating stage of growing up and discovering the activities that naturally appeal to them, and it really cheers me up to see how keen they are to share their activities with their grandmother, their dad and me. Of all my nephews and nieces, they are the ones closest to me, and I hope to be able to spend more time with them, as that also motivates them to keep learning. >I can’t deny that before the trip I was feeling really low in terms of my mood and emotions, but now I’m so glad I didn’t let that opportunity slip by to meet other people who have already earned a special place within my family circle. Sometimes distance itself allows us to refocus our attention and time on the people who are closest to us, and that’s something I’m keen to apply more fully to my nephews and the rest of the family. The only thing we can take for granted is the present, so I’ll always try to find a reason or a motive to maintain the best possible attitude and disposition to bring to life many more experiences with friends and family, which are gifts of incalculable value. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTVaxLKRDyYCmiQXUQMvsxgnmXfgBuHnK4Xo2km4W6rkt/IMG_20260412_184401_138.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQnnU72t7hS8z2tHKUZkxAwZrCVLRYzZizaPyWKB4yEXt/IMG-20260405-WA0016.jpg --- ***Gracias por darle valor a esta publicación con tu tiempo y atención.*** ***Hasta pronto.*** --- >***Thank you for taking the time to read this post.*** >***See you soon.***

description.body:
>

Uncle Acid and The Deadbeats es una banda de rock británico formada en el año 2009 en la ciudad de Cambridge, por Kevin Starrs. Tras sucesivos cambios, la alineación actual del grupo está compuesta por Vaughn Stokes, Jon Rice, Justin Smith y George Hudson. La banda toca géneros de rock psicodélico y el doom metal, inspirándose en el rock de las décadas de 1960 y 1970, un detalle que define su peculiar sonido, evocando la atmósfera sonora de esos años. Como curiosidad, el grupo recurre a instrumentos, equipos y técnicas de grabación desfasados para producir su trabajo musical, así como a tomar elementos de la cultura POP, el cine de terror y la estética psicodélica del siglo pasado.

Tal combinación de elementos hace que el trabajo de Uncle Acid and The Deadbeats, tenga un sonido sombrío, oscuro, con aires nostálgicos y atmósfera apocalíptica. Su discografía se compone hasta el momento de seis álbumes: Uncle Acid & the Deadbeats, Vol. 1 (2010), Blood Lust (2011), Mind Control (2013), The Night Creeper (2015), Wasteland (2018) y Nell' Ora Blu (2024)

description.title: Online Bullying  vs Physical Bullying: Which Is Worse?
description.body:
> *Bullying is very rampant in the world, and bullies know exactly what they are doing. They often intimidate people they see as weaker just to feel good about themselves.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQkWuqevwAY7zRdwoXc6Kuz6ZmuJHtgzXVnNpm9N5uCsb/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-boy-depressed-sitting-9056541/) *I have been a victim of bullying twice. The first experience was disheartening, while the second one ended very differently. Let me share both*. *The first happened during my secondary school days. I was in SS1 at the time, I used to be one of those students who were both brilliant and playful.* *On that fateful day, immediately the bell rang for break time, my friends and I rushed out of the class to start our usual run-and-catch game. It was during the play that the unexpected happened. While running, I mistakenly stepped on a boy’s leg. Before I could even apologize, he gave me a dirty slap.* *I didn’t realize when hot tears started rolling down my face*. *I looked at him and noticed he was in the same class as me but from a different department. He was taller and bigger, so there was nothing I could do. One of my classmates got very angry and confronted him, asking why he would slap his mate over something that was clearly not intentional.* *The boy was known as one of the “neat freaks” in school, he hated stains on his white shirt or socks and avoided rough play.* *But still, he slapped me… and nothing was done about it*. *I carried that grudge all through secondary school, and even after we graduated, I still remembered him*. *Two years later after we graduated, I visited home and saw him on the road. He still looked the same, but I had changed. I had grown taller and more muscular from the factory work I did after school*. *I was in a moving vehicle, so there was no chance for revenge even if I wanted to.* *But something unexpected happened that day…* *When I saw him, I didn’t feel anger anymore.* *I felt pity.* *He looked so skinny and fragile, and at that moment, I realized something, sometimes life handles things better than revenge ever could.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3dPYjLogDkhSZVs15zcLcjQGHAgChYuh9KkY5v9W7T6/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/bully-bullying-boys-624747/) *Now to the second bullying experience…* *It is always the tall boys!* *This time, it didn’t happen in school, it happened at home, on the football field.* *On that day, we were just playing a normal friendly match. ##### Hi everyone :)

To photograph or exemplar that you present here, I was percebendo details that easily went unnoticed in the dark. The white and pink areas contrast with the darker areas, presenting a very detailed surface and a very complex texture. There are small fissures, differences in size and subtle shine that make the entire scene visually quite interesting. The rock appears rich in quartz and shows clear signs of mineral alteration. The most curious thing in this session, like practically all the previous sessions, is precisely to see how an apparently simple sample gains another presence when observed from a macro perspective.

##### Session Purpose
The goal of these macro photography sessions is to capture images with as much detail as possible within the capabilities of the technique used, always focusing on the meticulous observation and documentation of all visual characteristics and details. Furthermore, I aim to create attractive visual compositions for publication on this blog, seeking to share the beauty and complexity of this work.

---

<center><sub>F-stop: F/5 | Exposure time: 1/600 sec. | ISO speed: ISO3000</sub></center>

---

Among the numerous techniques available for macro photography, this method is arguably the most cost-effective and efficient for individuals possessing a camera with a removable lens. By simply detaching the lens and reversing its direction, and employing an inversion ring, the process becomes more manageable and streamlined.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://img.esteem.ws/qpm6pm12ej.gif

---

##### Used equipments
Camera: Canon EOS 600D Digital SLR with CMOS sensor
Lens: EFS 18-55mm with f/5 maximum aperture, allowing shallow depth of field and capturing fine details.
Used inverter ring
Tripod: not used
Lighting: Adjustable LED lights to provide soft, even lighting, avoiding harsh shadows and highlighting the details of structures.

##### Camera Settings
Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: Variable aperture between f/4 and f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (3000) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

Hope you like it :)

description.title: 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 21.04.2026
description.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQGVAuoc6VFR8igq65BELHYDpDuncewqnqG7TPuxdmB6y1FtBiGsnQ6S7def5eJ9PJ5.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 21.04.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tkpGs3u56XgKUvcX8mUApMqNDgoNXPKJVgr7Mwd4MhTmhLPH96gaZXhtVBVE2ikZpoV.jpg)

---

## 1. NEWS

---

### ***Nowelizacja KSC wchodzi w życie — nowe przepisy mogą objąć 38 tysięcy podmiotów w Polsce***

CRN informuje, że nowelizacja ustawy o Krajowym Systemie Cyberbezpieczeństwa (KSC), która weszła w życie 3 kwietnia 2026, może objąć nawet 38 tysięcy podmiotów — z czego ok. 27 tys. to jednostki publiczne. Podmioty „kluczowe\

mają rok na dostosowanie się do nowych wymogów technicznych i organizacyjnych. Firmy, które samodzielnie nie zostały wpisane do Wykazu KSC przez ministra cyfryzacji, będą mogły złożyć wniosek o wpis od 7 maja 2026. Za naruszenie przepisów grożą kary do 10 mln euro dla podmiotów kluczowych i 7 mln euro dla ważnych — z osobistą odpowiedzialnością menedżerów zarządu. To największe rozszerzenie regulacji cyberbezpieczeństwa w historii Polski.

*Źródło: [CRN](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/nowe-przepisy-o-ksc-moga-objac-38-tys-podmiotow/) [PL]*

---

### ***CISA wydaje alert o ataku supply chain na pakiet npm axios powiązanym z Koreą Północną***

CISA opublikowała oficjalny alert dotyczący kompromitacji pakietu npm axios — szeroko stosowanej biblioteki JavaScript do obsługi żądań HTTP — przez grupę powiązaną z Koreą Północną. Złośliwy kod wstrzyknięty do npm axios mógł dotrzeć do niezliczonych projektów i środowisk CI/CD, które automatycznie pobierają zależności. Atak jest powiązany z wcześniejszą kompromitacją certyfikatów macOS w OpenAI. CISA zaleca natychmiastową weryfikację wersji axios używanych w projektach i skanowanie środowisk CI/CD pod kątem wskaźników kompromitacji opublikowanych w alercie.

*Źródło: [CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/04/20/supply-chain-compromise-impacts-axios-node-package-manager) [EN]*

---

### ***Hacker z grupy Scattered Spider przyznaje się do winy w USA — siedemnastolatek odpowie za kradzież kryptowalut***

SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, The Register i Security Affairs potwierdzają, że Tyler Buchanan — jeden z kluczowych członków grupy Scattered Spider, obywatel brytyjski — przyznał się do winy przed sądem w USA w sprawie kradzieży kryptowalut przez SIM swapping i socjotechnikę. Scattered Spider zasłynęła atakami na MGM Resorts, Caesars Entertainment i dziesiątki innych dużych firm. Buchanan był jednym z czołowych operacyjnych grupy i miał koordynować ataki obejmujące przejęcia kont, wymuszenia i kradzieże o wartości dziesiątek milionów dolarów. Sprawa jest kolejnym sukcesem FBI i DOJ w rozbijaniu zachodnich cyberprzestępczych grup, które do tej pory czuły się bezkarnie.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23t72pyvy58WHhM6XhwVrqx8EnVkz7YofyfvUT3GagxmdbPLxPaqQ1PKvgGLxQpFMRv9X.png)

*Źródło: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/british-scattered-spider-hacker-pleads-guilty-in-the-us/) [EN] | [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/british-scattered-spider-hacker-pleads-guilty-to-crypto-theft-charges/) [EN] | [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/2026/04/20/scattered_spider_linked_scot_plead_guilty/) [EN] | [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/191052/cyber-crime/scattered-spider-member-tyler-buchanan-pleads-guilty-to-major-crypto-theft.html) [EN]*

---

### ***Platforma ATHR umożliwia jednej osobie prowadzenie w pełni zautomatyzowanego vishingowego call center z AI***

HelpNetSecurity opisuje nową platformę phishingową ATHR, dostępną na cyberprzestępczych forach za 4000 dolarów plus 10% zysku. ATHR wysyła do ofiar e-maile podszywające się pod Google, Microsoft lub giełdy kryptowalutowe, zawierające tylko numer telefonu do „bezpieczeństwa\

— ale Niebezpiecznik zwraca uwagę, że poprzednie dwa włamania (marzec i sierpień 2025) pozostały bez publicznej odpowiedzi i prawdopodobnie bez realnych działań naprawczych. PESEL w połączeniu z adresem zamieszkania to komplet wystarczający do zaciągnięcia pożyczki.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23x1Hz5YAP1ofX9CVLSGHbwpwnrnri1tHk8cKxtrbkJxu8sapgAE432FBmN13hAyVfkQ4.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/wycieki-danych/partia-mentzena-zhackowana-trzeci-raz-wyciekly-dane) [PL] | [Niebezpiecznik](https://niebezpiecznik.pl/post/mentzen-zhackowany-nowa-nadzieja-wlamanie/) [PL]*

---

### ***Seiko USA: strona producenta zegarków zniszczona przez hakerów, którzy twierdzą, że ukradli dane klientów***

BleepingComputer opisuje incydent w Seiko USA — hakerzy zdewastowali oficjalną stronę producenta zegarków, umieszczając na niej przekaz o rzekomej kradzieży danych klientów. Grupy hakerskie używają defacement stron www zarówno jako demonstracji zdolności, jak i narzędzia nacisku wobec firm przed opublikowaniem lub sprzedażą skradzionych danych. Seiko wcześniej padało ofiarą ataków — w 2023 roku grupa BlackCat/ALPHV opublikowała dane z japońskiego oddziału firmy. Wciąż trwa weryfikacja, czy twierdzenia o kradzieży danych są prawdziwe.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vhRZH63itYHYEehG4GfD3noLJD7KZFCAajG4rxgH6ZA1ECR9mv45Yy9srHNFnkvh3dP.png)

*Źródło: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/seiko-usa-website-defaced-as-hacker-claims-customer-data-theft/) [EN]*

---

### ***Polski uniwersytet omyłkowo opublikował dane wykładowców — kolejny incydent danych osobowych w akademii***

CyberDefence24 informuje o kolejnym incydencie w polskim środowisku akademickim: jeden z polskich uniwersytetów przypadkowo opublikował w swojej witrynie internetowej dane osobowe wykładowców. Choć rodzaj i zakres danych są wyjaśniany, incydent nastąpił w cieniu trwającego od tygodni kryzysu po ataku ransomware na Wydział Zarządzania Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego. Przypadkowe ujawnienia danych (przez błędną konfigurację dostępu do pliku lub systemu CMS) są statystycznie równie częste co włamania hakerskie — ale rzadziej trafiają do nagłówków. Uczelnie jako instytucje publiczne przetwarzają szczególnie dużo wrażliwych danych osobowych i podlegają RODO z pełnymi konsekwencjami za naruszenia.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tbMLHd8Z534jMNYVaPaEeNeqsx5gHrLjjai6YXwfwxAEp5jtyK527Dp9ygsBJBRnP6a.png)

*Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/wycieki-danych/polski-uniwersytet-omylkowo-opublikowal-dane-wykladowcow) [PL]*

---

## 3. CIEKAWOSTKI

---

### ***CERT Orange: jak ChatGPT zaproponował komendę do odzyskania pliku, która zniszczyła cały system***

CERT Orange Polska i Telepolis opisują dokumentowany przypadek, w którym użytkownik poprosił ChatGPT o pomoc przy odzyskaniu niedostępnego pliku w systemie Linux. Model zaproponował sekwencję komend, które — wykonane bez głębszego zrozumienia — doprowadziły do usunięcia kluczowych plików systemowych i konieczności reinstalacji systemu operacyjnego. To ważna lekcja: modele AI są świetne w generowaniu plausybilnie brzmiących komend, ale nie rozumieją kontekstu konkretnej instalacji systemu. Nigdy nie kopiuj i nie wykonuj komend systemowych zaproponowanych przez AI bez wcześniejszego sprawdzenia, co każda z nich robi — szczególnie gdy zawierają `rm`, `chmod`, `dd` lub modyfikacje `/etc/`.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/48PwLukJPYPm8bGmjUpLdBwxdZYs7hxz9sX3kZt3f1Mt9ajiHoJ74woMgSEwWcsqiA.png)

*Źródło: [CERT Orange Polska](https://cert.orange.pl/aktualnosci/poprosil-chatgpt-o-pomoc-w-odzyskaniu-pliku-skonczylo-sie-reinstalacja-systemu/) [PL] | [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/tech/bezpieczenstwo/ai-proponuje-wirusy-chatgpt-pomoc-w-odzyskaniu-pliku) [PL]*

---

### ***CERT Polska ostrzega przed fałszywymi powiadomieniami o KSeF podszywającymi się pod Ministerstwo Finansów***

Dobreprogramy opisują nową kampanię phishingową, przed którą ostrzega CERT Polska: fałszywe powiadomienia podszywające się pod Krajowy System e-Faktur (KSeF) i wysyłane rzekomo z Ministerstwa Finansów. Wiadomości informują o rzekomych problemach z fakturami lub konieczności pilnej rejestracji — z linkiem do złośliwej strony zbierającej dane logowania lub instalującej malware. KSeF stał się obowiązkowy dla dużych firm i jest wdrażany etapami dla kolejnych grup — co sprawia, że duża część przedsiębiorców jest na niego podatna, bo tematy KSeF-owe brzmią wiarygodnie i pilnie. Wszelkie komunikaty dotyczące KSeF należy weryfikować wyłącznie przez oficjalny portal podatki.gov.pl.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wMcP7ndQTdx2f6pxd5DfkTDHgQicruixXQiVVG1KsbY1CRcbDnZ54rWJYCJuwAw1VbL.png)

*Źródło: [Dobreprogramy](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/cert-polska-ostrzega-przed-falszywymi-powiadomieniami-ksef,7277304372611424a) [PL]*

---

## 4. OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

---

### ***CERT Polska: aktywna kampania SMS podszywająca się pod firmę kurierską DPD — wyłudzanie danych kart***

CERT Polska (moje.cert.pl) ostrzega przed aktywną kampanią SMS-ową, w której atakujący podszywają się pod firmę kurierską DPD i informują o „nieudanej próbie dostarczenia paczki\

. Schemat jest wyjątkowo skuteczny, bo atakuje w momencie, gdy ofiara realnie może oczekiwać paczki z zagranicy lub polskiego sklepu. Podejrzane SMS-y należy przekazywać na numer 8080 — CERT Polska analizuje je i blokuje złośliwe domeny.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/243WeD8ngontbqbcNojo7KQ1f7rytTbpBMQJUpMX37PiFc12f5rgxZ4Ydn8g4UuhtxZig.png)

*Źródło: [CERT Polska (moje.cert.pl)](https://moje.cert.pl/komunikaty/2026/49/uwaga-na-falszywe-sms-y-podszywajace-sie-pod-firme-kurierska/) [PL]*

---

### ***Microsoft Teams coraz częściej używany do ataków socjotechnicznych podszywających się pod helpdesk IT***

BleepingComputer opisuje rosnącą skalę ataków na firmy, w których przestępcy podszywają się pod wewnętrzny helpdesk IT przez Microsoft Teams i nakłaniają pracowników do instalacji „narzędzi do zdalnego wsparcia\

, która formalnie nadała służbom granicznym prawo do żądania dostępu do urządzeń elektronicznych podróżnych. Odmowa odblokowania telefonu lub laptopa grozi grzywną lub 15 dniami aresztu. Telepolis wskazuje, że polskie media opisywały wcześniej doniesienia o rzekomym norweskim ataku GPS — który okazał się nieprawdziwy, podkreślając jak łatwo fałszywe narracje techniczne rozprzestrzeniają się w mediach. Nowe rosyjskie przepisy o inwigilacji granicznej wpisują się w systematyczne domykanie systemu nadzoru, który obejmuje już SORM (podsłuch telekomunikacyjny), blokowanie VPN i teraz rewizje urządzeń elektronicznych. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vsEFEoZPe9eULFP2WAgMBsVBnAFpc4xTUrto7HcHZACqLvmv5KEwL3Eti5SU8hZGLr6.png) *Źródło: [Infosecurity24](https://infosecurity24.pl/za-granica/sluzby-rosyjskie-zyskaly-nowe-narzedzie-inwigilacji) [PL] | [Telepolis](https://www.telepolis.pl/wiadomosci/norwegia-atak-gps) [PL]* --- ### ***AI ukraińskich wojsk demaskuje rosyjskich żołnierzy na froncie — ujawniona skala narzędzi rozpoznawczych*** CyberDefence24 opisuje ujawnione przez Ukrainę szczegóły dotyczące skali zastosowania systemów AI do rozpoznawania i identyfikacji rosyjskich sił na froncie. Ukraińskie narzędzia AI analizują m.in. publiczne profile w mediach społecznościowych, zdjęcia satelitarne, nagrania dronów i przechwycone komunikaty, by identyfikować jednostki wojskowe, sprzęt i lokalizacje. Skala tego zastosowania AI w wywiadzie wojskowym jest bezprecedensowa i zmienia charakter współczesnego konfliktu zbrojnego. Ujawnienie tych zdolności ma też wymiar psychologiczny wobec rosyjskich żołnierzy — informując ich, że każde zdjęcie wrzucone na VK czy Telegram może zostać wykorzystane do ich identyfikacji. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23wWw38jGhtPLWDWtS6QF7kvqRK7JUsy75qkVi6i9k8RWNRc7L4iCfexBNnwZzX5RMf4E.png) *Źródło: [CyberDefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/armia-i-sluzby/wojna-w-ukrainie/ai-demaskuje-rosyjskie-sily-na-froncie-ukraina-ujawnila-skale-jej-uzycia) [PL]* ----- *📅 Zestawienie obejmuje artykuły opublikowane ogólnodostępnych serwisach w dniu 20 kwietnia 2026 r. ⚠️ Materiał ma charakter informacyjny i edukacyjny.*

description.title: Nuestra experiencia en FuramaXclusive Sathorn Hotel [ESP/ENG]
description.body:
> ## Español Hola a todos! cuando llegamos a Bangkok en Tailandia, nos hospedamos en [FuramaXclusive Sathorn Hotel]([//]:# (!worldmappin 13.72385 lat 100.53103 long d3scr)) y aunque probablemente no es el hotel más moderno para nosotros, debo decir que disfrutamos nuestra estadía allí, y es que la atención fue espectacular y la ubicación también ya que nos quedaba cerca del parque Lumphini caminando y este era un sitio que visitabamos casi todos los días ya que Olivia se divertía mucho allí. Ahora bien, la reserva también incluía desayuno, y aunque intentamos comer el primer día allí, debo decir que la comida no nos gustó, poca variedad, huevos poco cocidos y los waffles estaban duros, así que terminamos desayunando los proximos días algo del 7-Eleven. La habitación era bastante cómoda y con suficiente espacio para los 3, además como pueden ver en las fotos teníamos una vista genial, también teníamos nevera, tetera y cosas necesarias de aseo personal como cepillos de dientes, toallas, entre otros. El hotel también tiene piscina y gimnasio pero no pudé hacerle fotos a la piscina ya que es pequeña y siempre había alguien allí al que no quería incomodar, el baño era grande también y el servicio de limpieza no faltaba a diario, además todos los días nos dejaban botellas de agua mineral la cual era necesaria para el gran calor de Bangkok, pero si me preguntan siento que el hotel puede mejorar muchas cosas, así que ni lo recomiendo ni lo desaconsejo a pesar de que el precio estaba bastante bien. Y es que como les dije antes, nosotros estabamos cómodos ahí porque teníamos suficiente espacio, las personas que trabajan allí eran muy amables, y teníamos todo lo necesario para la estadia pero falta modernizar las habitaciones y por supuesto mejorar el desayuno, además añadiría limpiar mejor el mueble y la pared detrás de este. ## English Hello, everyone! When we arrived in Bangkok, Thailand, we stayed at the [FuramaXclusive Sathorn Hotel]([//]:# (!worldmappin 13.72385 lat 100.53103 long d3scr)), and although it probably isn't the most modern hotel for us, I have to say we enjoyed our stay there, The service was spectacular, and so was the location, since it was within walking distance of Lumphini Park—a place we visited almost every day because Olivia had so much fun there. Now, the reservation also included breakfast, and although we tried eating there on the first day, I have to say we didn’t like the food—there wasn’t much variety, the eggs were undercooked, and the waffles were hard, so we ended up grabbing breakfast from 7-Eleven for the next few days. The room was quite comfortable and had enough space for the three of us. Plus, as you can see in the photos, we had a great view. We also had a fridge, a kettle, and necessary toiletries like toothbrushes and towels, among other things. The hotel also has a pool and a gym, but I couldn’t take any photos of the pool since it’s small and there was always someone there whom I didn’t want to disturb. The bathroom was spacious as well, and housekeeping came every day. Plus, they left us bottles of mineral water every day, which was essential given the intense heat in Bangkok. But if you ask me, I feel the hotel could improve in many ways, so I neither recommend it nor advise against it, even though the price was pretty good. As I told you before, we were comfortable there because we had enough space, the staff were very friendly, and we had everything we needed for our stay. However, the rooms need to be modernized, and of course, the breakfast needs to be improved. I’d also suggest cleaning the cabinet and the wall behind it more thoroughly.

description.title: Ostriv - mal wieder im Osten
description.body:
Hallo Freunde,

ich hatte endlich mal wieder ein paar Stunden frei und dachte mir, wenn ich jetzt schon einmal die Zeit habe, dann sollte ich sie auch gut nutzen und habe mich hingesetzt wieder ein paar Minuten in der virtuellen Welt zu verbringen. Um genauer zu sein in Ostriv in Osteuropa, auf einer neuen Karte. Auf den bisherigen Karten hatte ich alle Rohstoffe in unendlicher Menge zur Hand. Hier ist es nun anders. Ich habe kein Eisen auf der Karte und nur begrenzte Mengen an Kalkstein und Stein.

___

![20260407011110_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/satren/23tbryeKjAn4Be31rcvT4fBri7hALyNFccz5dndNymWVGABYGgSvypmKtVyU9CioW7XMt.jpg)

___

Die bisherige Karte bestand aus einem Fluss in der Mitte und einem See auf der Seite des Spawns. Hier haben wir jetzt eine Flusskreuzung, durch die am Ende vier größere und eine kleine Insel entstehen, während es auch nur begrenzte Mengen an Rohstoffen gibt. Auf der südlichen Insel ist der Spawn, auf der nördlichen Insel findet man Stein und Kalkstein. Dazu ist der Süden der Karte stark von Wald geprägt und die Weideflächen sind auf einer Insel im Norden, was dazu führt, dass man dort erstmal eine Brücke rüber bauen muss. 

___

![20260407011145_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/satren/23yJ9sP5m5vDZKyRXSGwc57yP2J5mhH5ymQMKxHXspcDmSG6FJ9b7rQyXkcSBEarsRYxc.jpg)

___

Es beginnt wie immer mit einer Zeltstadt, in der unsere Siedler ankommen und bereit sind die ersten Häuser zu bauen. Ich habe eigentlich immer als Start eine klassiche Rundsiedlung mit Gärten außenrum, die eine Versorgung mit Gemüse garantieren. In der Mitte sind Wohnhäuser, Brunnen und Marktplätze. Auf dieser Map muss man sich dann relativ schnell drauf einstellen, dass man Handeln muss, um an Stein, Eisen und Kalkstein zu kommen. Und so habe ich wieder begonnen Holzkohle für den Verkauf herzustellen und weitere Gärten anzulegen, um genug Essen zu erzeugen. 

___

![20260413113422_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/satren/23vhudczg28eiNAYUEHBYcewJWp18aFMah7pvonHpBqpY7uJmQq4tAb3qyWwXWUh3yoot.jpg)

___

Dabei habe ich dann aber auch festgestellt, dass ich Schweinefett ganz gut verkaufen kann und siese Schweine ohne Probleme mit Äpfeln und Gemüse ernähren kann. Also quasi ein Jackpot, ich kann Fleisch als Hochwertige Nahrung produzieren und gleichzeitig Fett für den Export. Dafür brauche ich nur Salz und das kostet mich pro Kilo 0,1 Taler. Wenn ich das Fett dann verkaufen will, bekomme ich pro Fett 0,1 Taler. Zum produzieren von 100 Kilo Fett, brauche ich 10 Kilo Salz. Also kann ich so mein Investment verzehnfachen. Der Vorteil daran ist, dass ich aus einer Ressource, die in großen Mengen produziert wird, einen Rohstoff erzeugen kann, der stark nachgefragt ist. Und gleichzeitig meine Bevölkerung mit hochwertigen Essen versorgen kann, was Gold wert ist um die Moral hoch zu halten. 

Wisst ihr wie schön es war einfach mal wieder ein paar Stunden abzuschalten und diese Welt da draußen zu vergessen? Ich meine mehr oder weniger bestanden die letzten Tage nur daraus durchzuarbeiten und keinerlei andere Freizeit zu haben. Ich kann das ganze nicht weiter empfehlen. Gut das Arbeiten, das Zeit verschwenden, kann ich empfehlen, es tut gut mal was anderes zu machen, als nur ernsthaft Sachen abzuarbeiten. 

Also in dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl. Und nutzt auch mal die Zeit etwas zu machen, was nicht sinnvoll ist, sondern euch Erholung bietet. Nur Arbeiten bringt einen viel zu schnell ins Grab. Anders kann man es nicht sagen.

description.title: Frames From The Hillside - PhotoFeed Contest Landscape Photography 166
description.body:
I spent the early part of Friday attending a funeral at Umuahia, precisely Umuezike Ofeme, Umuah North LGA. It was for a colleague’s mother-in-law, and we were there - colleagues, friends, and well -wishers, to stand with the bereaved, to say final goodbyes to their departed one. 

It was a smooth ride, and we got there just before the funeral service began. However, nothing prepared me for the sight before me: the venue was on a hillside! A hill? Gosh! Honestly. I didn’t even know some parts of Umuahia were built like this — up, not just flat. Nature is incredible! 

A look at the hill, and I was taken aback, wondering how I was going to make it up there. When it comes to hills, please count me out. I can't deal. Lol. Unfortunately, I had no choice but to get myself up there, by all means. Lol. 

So I braved up and began the climb. Little by little, one step at a time, I managed to climb the hill, panting, and when I finally got there, I let out a long sigh of relief. Mission accomplished. Next is the descent! 

***

After the funeral service, and her remains was taken to where she'll be committed to mother earth, I did what I always do when I visit a place - I looked. And when the view opened up over the horizon, asking to be kept, I had to bid its request. 


So, I pulled out my phone and captured it. And it wasn't just the view, but the feeling. The surprise of finding a hill. The way beauty shows up in the middle of hard days, and more.

description.body:
The Wisest of the Sorcerers. That’s the title I gave to this drawing I finished yesterday, but didn't have the chance to share until today.

Aetheriius is the bearer of the most ancient staff on Earth, granting him superior control over the elements. His wisdom grows daily as he channels the knowledge of the Astral Library directly into his mind. Although he currently has a limit on how much of this knowledge he can access, he is destined to ascend as the guardian of that cosmic realm. His fate is to guide, by the moonlight, all other sorcerers seeking power in the magical arts.

No one will ever be as powerful as him, even in his current earthly form. By seeking his ascension through the passive absorption of all magical and anti-magical arts, he will eventually transform into a near-ethereal being. His mere existence in the world forces the dark magic powers to unite just to balance the scales. When his ascension finally occurs—for it is not a matter of if, but when—the imbalance will be so great that the universe will likely create another being just like him.

---

ESPAÑOL

El más sabio de los hechiceros. Así titulé este dibujo que terminé ayer, pero que no tuve oportunidad de mostrarles hasta hoy.

Aetheriius es el poseedor del báculo más antiguo de la Tierra, lo que le otorga un control superior sobre los elementos. Su sabiduría crece día tras día al canalizar los conocimientos de la Biblioteca Astral directamente en su mente. Aunque actualmente tiene un límite para acceder a este saber, su destino es ascender como el guardián de ese espacio cósmico. Su misión será guiar, bajo la luz de la luna, a todos los hechiceros que buscan el poder en la magia.

Nadie podrá igualar su poder, ni siquiera en su forma terrenal actual. Al buscar su ascenso a través de la absorción constante de las artes mágicas y antimágicas, terminará transformándose en un ser casi etéreo. Su sola existencia en el mundo obliga a las fuerzas de la magia oscura a unirse para intentar equilibrar la balanza. Cuando su ascenso ocurra, porque no es cuestión de si pasará, sino de cuándo, el desequilibrio será tal que el universo probablemente se verá obligado a crear a otro ser como él.

In order to actively not forget everything he was taught in the training, he started setting aside some money from his monthly salary that he would use to invest. After he was able to gather the amount, he felt that it was enough; he was now left with the decision of what to invest in. He knew that when it comes to investment, apart from selecting what to invest in, he also needed to decide if he wanted a short-term or a long-term investment, and this was the big clash for him. This was his first time investing, and he wants to get it right, so he decided to reach out to his teacher for guidance. His teacher explained the advantages and the disadvantages of both and even suggested that he should try both. Mr Adams concluded that he would divide his money into two and try both terms, and that was how he started his investment journey. Whenever Mr Adams had a chance to speak to young adults, he would often encourage them to invest and start early. He would often start by sharing all the challenges he had faced and even provide steps and tips he had used to overcome these challenges. ** ** ** ** You can participate by clicking [here.](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/20-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3079-the-big-clash) [Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/chess-metaphor-board-business-316657/) ** ** ** **

description.title: Splinterlands: Adding Portia Nyr to my Bloodline Tribute Team!
description.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT8fAfN7Sq2pN1dCUHt7XFV6SguTXrTuLpC66VX3sTL5g/Screenshot%204950.png 

My **Splinterlands** journey started way back in September of 2021, back when Hive was shooting up the charts and monsters were becoming very, very valuable. If you wanted a **Kitty** or **Llama** archon you were really going to pay for it, they weren't cheap. But they were true gamechangers and those who held them had a serious advantage over the have nots. I was a have not for a very long time! I did eventually pick one of each up, but since have sold them when prices took a downturn. 

Now with **Conclave** and **Escalation** there are some more true gamechangers that are becoming a must have to be competitive. Over the last month or so I have really been enjoying the use of **Bloodline Tribute** in my water teams. This past week I decided to add a special extra something to enhance that ability by renting **Portia Nyr**. She has **Shapeshift** which gives makes her essentially all bloodline when it come to tribute.  She is a promo card and a little bit expensive, which is why I am renting right now, but after playing with the card it's one going down on the soon to be purchased list.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYsfegP6mpZ4uoiPNirEWm7cyrLs529gHFBi7aLmV6Hkq/Screenshot%204945.png 

First off, she is a neutral card and can be used in all splinters.  She is a legendary promo card with only some 1,300 in circulation.  She does have some great abilities starting with **Shapeshift**  and **Pain Forge** at level one.  She then adds **Apex Strike** at level two, level three grants you **Immunity**, and at level four **Relentless Strike** so she takes much less damage from all attacks.  Not to mention here attack climbs to four magic!

This is a really nice card that I will definitely be buying soon. Since I do love using **Bloodline Tribute** she fits my playing style perfectly. Right now she is running about six dollars a copy, so it's going to take some saving to be able to buy one, in the meantime, I can always rent like I am right now!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVRphAPaqqVMFHuyDQz61XScZJ2Qn3ERPRQf9zpLKurHG/image.png 

Let's good a look at her in action!

You can see the entire battle at this  [link.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_1cbe121b37f34b1c7e8d91e74734381e) 



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcEDfGhca1pvpv1KgDo5BVX4v8QfDXJ2NbxJGMtF8yo7q/Screenshot%204937.png 

First off, this is a high mana battle of 69 in **Modern Mode.** The ruleset is the standard one and the screenshot above is after all the buffs have been applied. I chose **Marlai Singariel** as my archon as she increases the magic attack of my monsters by one. First up I place **Wailsworn Specter** for the bloodline tribute ability to undead monsters. That gives monsters of the same bloodline (or **Shapeshift**) monster increased speed, health, and attack power. Next up I place my tank of **Doomshield Warden** followed by **Blue Wyrm Travesty** as he is an undead bloodline. Then I chose the **Mindless Thrall** as it is also undead followed by **Portia Nyr** since she has **Shapeshift** and will be boosted when the **Wailsworn Specter** is defeated. I rounded off the team with **Captain Fellblade** for it speed and dual attack.

My opponent also chose **Marlai Singariel** but went with **Coralforged** as a tank followed by **Commander Slade**.  Next they chose **Torrent Sniper** and **Saltwater Mage**. Then to round out the team they placed the **Mindless Thrall** and **Mystic Scaleweaver**. All pretty good cards and a solid looking team!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWxUzWMxdCmyP1cEaFm45SwVJmFyr8SAQg2jfQtshwXcu/Screenshot%204938.png 


It didn't take long for the **Wailsworn Specter** to go down giving bloodline tribute the my remaining middle tree monsters making them serious high on attack!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUkTzu891dkvR3r4kCgKyxaQbhPT1YMPaoep5X4aFb4xf/Screenshot%204939.png 

Starting round two my opponent lost it's tank **Coralforged**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaLGyZyFyReNrWArQEBFPeXLvNeYxEWqtHKCG4AKr5Wng/Screenshot%204940.png 

**Mystic Scaleweaver** was taken out not far into the second round leaving my opponent's team looking a little weak.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTMAD23Xn9umzCdJD5ovgAL6pruKXLT1HiupQcDYM8H2v/Screenshot%204941.png 

By round three things are looking pretty bleak for my opponent as **Commander Slade** is down for the count.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUiemVvoCRoY4eeYbMz2owe8emGHHjGRffcAuNifz29gw/Screenshot%204942.png 

Here you can see **Portia Nyr** taking out the **Torrent Sniper** with a massive five magic hit!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTZ2wiv5yhkAEL3QK61h3AwkjH6z5ghkL9obJteGxPyce/Screenshot%204943.png 


At the final deathblow is delivered by the **Mindless Thrall** with it's massive five magic attack thanks to the bloodline tribute.

Good game to my opponent, nicely selected team! However, it is hard to overcome bloodline tribute when there are three monsters boosted by it. This is why I really am enjoying **Portia Nyr**, and will likely pick one up once I manage to sell enough cards to cover the cost!










 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQS5v7Hs2KzpgwCE3o9C1faEfZN29Em2mHEkqw16KPYYN/image.png 

## **Opening Fourteen Foundations Packs**

I always like to do some **Foundations** Pack openings.  You never know what you will get, and sometimes you get a very nice surprise. Today I got one of those thank goodness!  No gold legendary cards, but a valuable gold epic card is always welcome!




 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma7wBpMbbKrLqDedqHQhuqDFP67MgUdQCDtXmbXvJ9tzo/Screenshot%204946.png 

First bunch I got some decent pulls with a **Marlai Singariel** and a couple gold cards. I also pulled a death legendary **Little Sister**. Although not horribly valuable it's always fun to get a legendary!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaKSLuMdibEqu3CF9hogc79yMzqHkb9PoVDWnH24aaYqz/Screenshot%204947.png 

Here's where things got interesting with the pull of an epic gold foil **Lunaki Howler** . The run more than $2.50 right now! Not too bad! Plus a earth archon too boot!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ6szVToCcSf9AqFf4HkZqNu97zjFy2s5vfoAGsADCtnV/Screenshot%204948.png 

Not too bad here, a death archon **Thalgrimore** in this batch.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTcY7hHDUXAFDMsp3Bot6rt6UBBe7UBd8E1kxkLyr2Spx/Screenshot%204949.png 

And a fire archon in the last few, so really not too bad overall! The one epic gold foil card alone made it very much worth opening up these 14 packs. It's always a gamble when you open these up, sometimes you get very lucky, and other times you luck out. Today was lucky thank goodness!


If you don't yet play Splinterlands it is a fun game and free to play in Frontier Mode. So give a try, if you haven't joined in on the fun of playing Splinterlands you can join here: https://splinterlands.com?ref=thebighigg


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVRphAPaqqVMFHuyDQz61XScZJ2Qn3ERPRQf9zpLKurHG/image.png 

That will wrap up my **Splinterlands** post for this week. I do hope you enjoyed it. Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below. And as always, thanks you for all of your support, it really is deeply appreciated. Have a great week everyone!




![GIF_20250818_160944_821.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thebighigg/23tRxfsSYAsdjhiguQKAsHWYXiuWTpEqzAgEPCSn3k9FDCsmviaF4RPWwunT73gFqjEL8.gif)

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTGZHB7zyBh9PChGdb8Ys3FsQM8ydk5FbJEs7gLtoRq6c/image.png

I am not a financial planner and this isn't financial advice. Please always do your own research before investing your money. You worked hard enough to earn it!

description.title: Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest - Round #422 Plant silhouettes [Eng/Esp]
description.body:
> Happy Monday, [Shadow Hunters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-179017)! I just got back from university, and the entire day, from morning until late afternoon, was under a relentless sun! The rainy season announcements only lasted a few days last week, which prevented me from finding good shade to share with you, but this week started off scorching hot. I finished my university business, preparing the schedule of activities, taking inventory of the necessary lab materials, and adjusting the times for our practical sessions—all under the blazing sun. I was so overwhelmed that I forgot to hunt for any shade and ended up returning home hot and ravenous. At home, I was preparing lunch and bitterly remembered that I hadn't hunted for a single bit of shade the entire time I was at university. However, fate, or perhaps providence, granted me one last creative opportunity to get a shadow for this week's SMAH contest in its [round#422](https://ecency.com/hive-179017/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-1ec0ef40dce64). It turns out that while I was eating, I watched as the sun continued its relentless onslaught, seemingly in one last display of solar radiation before sunset and the eventual cessation of its fury. But just then, I glanced toward my balcony, saw the curtains, and the stark contrast created by the shadows of my plants against them, silhouetted against the incandescent fury of the afternoon sun.
![photo_2_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xVEbcqfY6APV5DguetTkEuMp9yY3gFqTJEaFZAV2Y8WUzqwL9F9YQKSspTqhLxTB6vo.jpg)|![photo_1_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23ynPw9m5Lkb2r76szeXbLUmM9mcNvpL3KnjsQ85EUMr1G9qfudFb92wSCEHBTYmCxAwh.jpg) --|-- --- ![photo_5_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uQmzVho3cq1rNevHjQ8gAc4cpT9cKNDkX8Qqs8W5YXqnNmui3mvtYeCNVMYN8PmWQ41.jpg)

>\n\nYou might think I don't take care of my plants, but I take great care of them all, especially during these dry season days when I knew we'd have these long, sunny days. That's why I water them frequently every day, and I have an awning to lessen the radiation, which is particularly strong in the late morning and throughout the afternoon. Since it was already late afternoon, the 4 pm sun was already positioned for sunset, but before that, it managed to take advantage of the clear sky and unleash all the light it could. So I decided to seize the moment. I drew the curtains as high as I could to see the shadows of my plants on them, and it looked incredible! The hanging pots are plants called \

here in Venezuela. Below are some of my lilies, ferns, and aloe plants; their combined shadows give the impression of a lush nursery.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tRvWxqnFqswK34rLXwwDzLFHimD2xstYf7ZmmjmX39TA7DFGfV3AbTDuBxHmK6AMydA.png)

> And well, friends, that's how I was able to make the most of this Monday before nightfall. I love my plants, and whenever I can, I post about the care I give them. Being able to show you the lushness of my plants through their shade is an interesting perspective I wanted to share. See you in the next SMASH contest. Best regards!
--- # Versión Español ---
![photo_3_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/EogMpci3FsGtPwMYc4xq77jnz2pFFmShxWkSdKv88N94DcxqMcSgyRLv8NFfToDp28e.jpg)

> Feliz lunes comunidad de [Shadow Hunters](https://ecency.com/created/hive-179017)! Recien volvi de la universidad y todo el día desde la mañana hasta bien entrada la tarde estuvo bajo un sol implacable! Los anuncios de temporada de lluvia solo duro unos pocos días de la semana pasada, lo que me impidió conseguir buenas sombras para compartirles, pero esta semana la empezamos al rojo vivo. Terminé mis asuntos en la universidad, preparar el cronograma de actividades, hacer el inventario del material necesario para el laboratorio y ajustar los horarios que veríamos las prácticas y todo eso bajo un sol implacable. Estaba tan agobiado que olvidé cazar alguna sonbra en los alrededores y terminé regresando a casa acalorado y con mucha hambre. En casa fui preparando el almuerzo y amargamente recordé que no había cazado ninguna sombra en todo el tiempo que estuve en la Universidad. Sin embargo el destino o quizás la providencia me regalo una última y creativa oportunidad de conseguir una sombra para el concurso SMAH de esta semana en su [round#422](https://ecency.com/hive-179017/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-1ec0ef40dce64). Resulta que mientras estaba comiendo veía como el sol seguía con su asedio incesante, parecía como que estaba en un último despliegue de radiación solar antes de la caída del ocaso y finalmente se aplacara su furia. Pero justo en ese momento vi hacia mi balcón, vi las cortinas y el fuerte contraste que generaba las sombras de mis plantas en las cortinas, quedando silueteadas ante la furia incandescente del sol de la tarde.
![photo_2_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23xVEbcqfY6APV5DguetTkEuMp9yY3gFqTJEaFZAV2Y8WUzqwL9F9YQKSspTqhLxTB6vo.jpg)|![photo_1_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23ynPw9m5Lkb2r76szeXbLUmM9mcNvpL3KnjsQ85EUMr1G9qfudFb92wSCEHBTYmCxAwh.jpg) --|-- --- ![photo_5_2026-04-20_00-45-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23uQmzVho3cq1rNevHjQ8gAc4cpT9cKNDkX8Qqs8W5YXqnNmui3mvtYeCNVMYN8PmWQ41.jpg)

Pero como ya era de tarde el sol de las 4 pm estaba ya en posición para el ocaso pero antes se las arregló aprovechando el cielo despejado descargó toda la radiación lumínica que pudo. description.title: Understanding Cyber Security: Protecting Your Digital Assets
description.body: In today’s fast-paced digital world, securing your personal and business information is no longer optional, it’s essential. Cyber threats are becoming more complex and frequent, making cyber security a top priority for everyone. From identity theft to data breaches, the consequences of a cyber-attack can be devastating. In this article, we’ll explore what cyber security is, why it’s critical, and how you can protect your digital assets from the growing array of cyber threats.\n\n<h2 style=\

>What Is Cyber Security? Cyber security refers to the set of practices, technologies, and processes designed to protect systems, networks, and data from cyber threats such as hacking, malware, ransomware, and phishing. These threats can have catastrophic consequences, including financial loss, unauthorized access to sensitive information, and damage to a company's reputation. At its core, cyber security involves defending digital systems from various types of attacks. This includes everything from ensuring your personal devices are secure to protecting large-scale enterprise networks. For businesses, cyber security is crucial not just for protecting data, but also for ensuring continuity of operations and maintaining customer trust.

>Why Cyber Security Matters in Today's World The digital transformation has led to an explosion in data creation, storage, and sharing. As a result, the potential attack surface for cybercriminals has expanded significantly. Whether you're using cloud storage, smartphones, or social media platforms, there's always a potential risk of unauthorized access to your data. For businesses, the stakes are even higher. Cyber-attacks can result in: *

>Financial loss: Direct costs, such as ransom payments or recovery expenses, and indirect costs, like loss of revenue during downtime.

\n*

>Reputational damage: Trust is hard to rebuild once a breach has occurred. Customers and clients are likely to reconsider their relationship with businesses that fail to protect their data.

\n*

>Legal consequences: Many industries have strict regulations, such as GDPR or HIPAA, that mandate the protection of sensitive information. A failure to comply can lead to hefty fines and legal actions.

In short, understanding and implementing cyber security is vital for maintaining the integrity and confidentiality of your data.

>Common Cyber Threats That Threaten Your Digital Assets With the increasing frequency and sophistication of cyber-attacks, it’s important to understand the most common threats that businesses and individuals face: *

>Phishing: A form of fraud where attackers impersonate legitimate entities to steal personal information, such as login credentials or financial details.

\n*

>Malware: Malicious software designed to damage or disable systems. This includes viruses, worms, and trojans that can steal information, corrupt files, or lock systems.

\n*

>Ransomware: A type of malware that locks a victim's files or system and demands a ransom for their release.

\n*

>Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) Attacks: In these attacks, cybercriminals intercept communication between two parties, often to steal sensitive data such as credit card details or login credentials.

\n*

>Data Breaches: When unauthorized users gain access to confidential data. These breaches often involve sensitive personal, financial, or intellectual property data, leading to privacy violations and financial damage.

By understanding these threats, you can take proactive steps to protect your [cyber security](https://bugstrix.com).

>How to Protect Your Digital Assets Securing your digital assets requires a combination of the right tools, practices, and strategies. Here are some actionable steps to enhance your cyber security: 1. **Implement Strong Passwords and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)** Passwords are the most basic form of protection, but they can easily be cracked. Use complex passwords that include a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Moreover, never use the same password for multiple accounts. To further secure your accounts, enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) wherever possible. MFA requires a second form of verification, making it harder for attackers to gain unauthorized access. 2.

>Regularly Update Software and Systems

Cybercriminals often exploit known vulnerabilities in outdated software. Regularly updating your software, operating systems, and applications ensures that you’re protected from the latest threats. This includes security patches, which address known vulnerabilities and make it harder for attackers to gain access. 3. **Install Anti-Virus and Anti-Malware Software** Install reputable anti-virus and anti-malware software on all devices to detect and block malicious activity. These programs help prevent infections from viruses, worms, ransomware, and other forms of malware. It’s essential to keep these programs updated so they can protect you against the newest threats. 4. **Use Encryption for Sensitive Data** Encryption is a powerful tool in protecting your data. It converts your information into a code that can only be deciphered with the correct decryption key. Whether you're storing files on your devices or sending them online, encryption ensures that even if your data is intercepted, it remains unreadable. 5. **Secure Your Wi-Fi Network** Your Wi-Fi network is a potential entry point for hackers. Secure it with a strong password, and use WPA2 or WPA3 encryption. Avoid using default router settings and disable features like remote management unless absolutely necessary. If you’re operating a business, consider setting up separate Wi-Fi networks for employees and guests to prevent unauthorized access to your internal systems. 6. **Conduct Regular Security Audits** A cyber security audit helps identify vulnerabilities within your systems, allowing you to address them before they become a problem. Regular audits should include reviewing network traffic, system configurations, and access controls. These audits ensure your security measures are working and that there are no overlooked threats. 7. **Educate Employees and Promote Security Awareness** Employees are often the first line of defense in cyber security. Regular training sessions should be held to educate employees on recognizing phishing attempts, managing sensitive data securely, and following best practices for password management. A security-conscious workforce can significantly reduce the risk of breaches caused by human error.

>Conclusion\n\nCyber security is essential in protecting your digital assets, whether you're an individual or a business. By implementing strong passwords, enabling multi-factor authentication, updating software, encrypting sensitive data, and educating your team, you can defend against a wide range of cyber threats. Protecting your digital life isn’t a one-time task but an ongoing process that requires vigilance and proactive measures. Stay informed, stay secure, and ensure that your cyber security practices evolve with the ever-changing threat landscape.

description.title: The Life of an Introvert
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNj1wi6X6LBDUhEiF3wT2t2zKhtEi2LCDo3jZ7sD839F/1776721745252.jpg)
 
The Life of an introvert can be so interesting. It's a life that comes with a mix of negativity and positivity at the same time. The introvert person is so withdrawn, quite, and often alone even in a crowded house. They find nothing exciting about social interactions and prefer to spend their time in solitude. 

However, this solitude is where the danger and also the positive aspects of their lives also form. If you don't understand them you might mistake their quietness for rudeness or hatred for others, but in reality they are more lovely and kind when you draw close to them. 

My daughter is an introvert whose life taught me the struggle and beauty of being an introvert. In the beginning I thought she was being foolish and timorous by always withdrawing herself from other children. At home, while everyone watching TV together at the living room, she would retreat to their room and read or draw by herself all alone. 

As she grew older, I thought she would change, but she remain the same. She goes to school from primary to secondary school without any close friends, not a single person she could call a best friend. But there was something positive about her. While others were busy socializing and playing around, she was always writing and reading books which helps her develop a strong story writing skill. By the time she finished secondary school she has written over a dozen of short stories and novels all from her original imagination and creativity.

Another aspect of her life that surprised me was her singing dancing skills. I never expected her to be good at dancing when she hardly socializes with other people, yet she invented her unique dancing style that impressed everyone who saw her perform at school and event. The day I knew about her dancing was a surprise to me. I didn't believe it when I was told that she joined a dancing competition at an event and won the prize. 

If my daughter is singing today you would think she had trained for years under a professional instructor. But the truth is that she learned everything all by herself in her quite room away from others.

Introvert people can be very kind and generous with what they have. They might not show it in their actions but when you take the initiative and ask them for help they do more than you you expected without anyone else knowing about it. 

If you are living with an introvert person, you might judge them wrong and even get annoyed with their behavior if they are your children, but when you draw closer to them you discover the depth of their unique character and strength. 

Watching her today, I realized that being an introvert was not a weakness, but rather a gift that allowed her to develop her talents and passions in way that many extroverts might never been able to do. Her life has taught me that being an introvert is not something to be ashamed of but rather it's a unique kind of lifestyle with its own strength and beauty.

# San Augustin: UFO Crash Recovery Sample Analysis - Alternative Propulsion Engineering Conference

**Source:** https://www.altpropulsion.com/san-augustin-ufo-crash-recovery-sample-analysis/

          
									
Steven Colbern provides extensive SEM, microscopy, and isotopic analysis of material from the purported 1947 San Augustin UFO crash. Six metal samples were provided to Colbern by Mr. Chuck Wade, who stated that he and a digging crew excavated the samples from the desert floor on the plains of San Augustin, New Mexico. This area was reportedly the site of the July 2, 1947 crash of a small, extraterrestrial craft.
This presentation details the analysis of six metallic samples (W1-W6) purportedly recovered from a pre-Roswell extraterrestrial craft crash near Horse Springs, New Mexico. Analysis using light microscopy, SEM, EDX mapping, and ICP-MS revealed an aluminum alloy matrix with unusual elemental compositions and coatings, including high concentrations of silicon, titanium, and nickel.
Many samples exhibited microstructures, pits, and layered structures, possibly indicating nanotechnology. The presence of carbon nanotubes, particularly in sample W1 and a similar implant sample, was confirmed via Raman spectroscopy. Isotopic analysis strongly suggests a non-terrestrial origin, possibly from a region of high neutron flux. Unusual electrical properties and energy emission (indicated by pendulum deflection) were also observed.
Colbern suggests further testing, including acid dissolution to isolate carbon nanotubes, to fully characterize these potentially advanced alien materials. The analysis draws parallels to other purported alien materials, including implants and Roswell debris, further supporting the extraterrestrial hypothesis.
A Pre-Roswell Discovery: The Horse Springs Incident
The story begins with Art Campbell’s discovery of a crashed extraterrestrial craft near Horse Springs, New Mexico – a site predating the infamous Roswell incident. Chuck Wade, a key figure in this investigation, recovered crucial materials overlooked by the military. These samples, the subject of this analysis, offer a glimpse into a technology far beyond our current comprehension.
Eyewitness Testimony and Initial Observations
Eyewitness Gerald Anderson described a horseshoe-shaped craft, approximately 40 feet in length, with a breached hull. Inside, he reported finding two deceased and one living alien being. The craft’s interior revealed a fiber-optic-like material, hinting at advanced technology.
Wade obtained six initial samples, later supplemented by an expedition that yielded a honeycomb-like material (details to be covered in a future post). The samples, primarily silvery sheet metal composed mainly of aluminum, exhibited a crumpled and ridged appearance, except for samples W2 and W6, which displayed a thicker, layered structure. Samples W1 and W5 appeared nearly identical based on initial analysis.
Advanced Analytical Techniques Reveal Unprecedented Findings
A rigorous analysis was conducted using a range of techniques, including light microscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Energy-Dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) mapping, and Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS). These analyses revealed unexpected complexities:

![Image 1](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/JlqAD2yyIBo/hqdefault.jpg)

•Unusual Coatings and Microstructures: Many samples showed evidence of coatings and unusual microstructures, suggesting a sophisticated manufacturing process.
•Unexpected Weakness: Surprisingly, these materials proved less strong than other extraterrestrial materials previously analyzed by the researcher.
•Nanotechnology Hints: The SEM analysis revealed microstructures, but high magnification was hampered by interference, including charging and energy emission – a phenomenon also observed in alien implants studied by Dr. Roger Lear. This suggests the materials might incorporate nanotechnological devices that function even after significant damage.
•Deliberate Surface Modifications: Some samples exhibited pits and ceramic-like crystals, possibly deliberately introduced. These features mirrored similar structures found in implants from patients who claimed alien contact.
•Carbon Nanotubes: Raman spectroscopy revealed the presence of carbon nanotubes, particularly concentrated in sample W1 and a sample from a patient (Patient 16) with similar pits. This patient’s implant was exceptionally strong, requiring a high-energy laser for cutting. The researcher attributes this strength to the highly dispersed carbon nanotubes.

Isotopic Analysis Points to an Extraterrestrial Origin
Isotopic analysis of sample W1 revealed skewed abundances of antimony, copper, and nickel, with heavier isotopes overrepresented. This isotopic signature is inconsistent with terrestrial or even solar system origins, suggesting a source from the galactic center or a region exposed to high neutron flux.
Electrical Properties and Energy Emission
All samples conducted electricity but were not ferromagnetic. A pendulum test performed at the 2010 UFO Congress in Laughlin, Nevada, indicated possible energy emission from the samples, warranting further investigation.
The Researcher’s Personal Encounter
The researcher shared a personal anecdote involving a nanotechnological device embedded in his toe, which emitted radio signals and mysteriously transferred lettering from an envelope onto an X-ray film. This adds a compelling personal dimension to the already extraordinary findings.
Conclusion: A Glimpse into the Future (or the Past?)
The analysis of these materials strongly suggests an extraterrestrial origin, showcasing a level of nanotechnology far surpassing our current capabilities. The presence of carbon nanotubes, unusual coatings, and unique isotopic ratios points to a technology potentially millions, if not billions, of years ahead of our own. Further research is crucial to unlock the secrets held within these enigmatic samples, potentially revolutionizing our understanding of materials science and the vastness of the cosmos. The ongoing investigation promises to reveal even more astonishing discoveries.
