I have noticed that when I apply some custom formatting within the post, like for example some convenient spacing between different sections/parts of the post, then this spacing gets removed from the post after a while - hence I'm really confused whether this is done by some automatic post moderation systems or whether it's done manually by the moderators to make the post's code cleaner...

The thing is, I have a little OCD when it comes to making my articles look good and read good, so - at least for my taste - keeping the different sections of the post seperated from each other by a small space makes the whole thing much more organized and easier to comprehend than just a one huge 'wall of text' with everything compressed as much as possible. I've noticed that a similar thing happens when publishing articles on Medium, so maybe this is just some unavoidable and standarized practice these days. I wonder if I'm perhaps the only one that really considers this a 'bad thing' for reading experience.

In any case, thank you once again and have a great time!

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Red hair isn’t the story. The real story is that human evolution may have been way more active, recent, and relentless than scientists gave it credit for. This study argues natural selection didn’t just nudge a few traits — it hammered hundreds of them, including red hair, fair skin, disease risks, and even male baldness.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The research looked at a massive DNA set: roughly 10,000 ancient human remains from Europe and parts of Asia, plus 5,820 previously published ancient genomes and 6,438 modern samples. That let researchers track how traits changed from the Ice Age forward instead of treating evolution like some ancient event that stopped once humans got clever and started farming.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The big scientific punchline: researchers identified **479 genetic variations** strongly shaped by directional selection. That’s a huge jump from the old view that only about 20 clear cases existed in humans. In plain English: evolution may have been picking winners and losers in our DNA far more often than people thought. Source
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Some of the traits tied to that selection are still with us now. The list includes **fair skin, red hair, lower odds of male baldness, altered risks for celiac and Crohn’s disease, lower risk of alcoholism and rheumatoid arthritis, and even genetic links related to HIV resistance**. A few findings are intuitive — climate and sunlight affecting pigmentation — and a few are wonderfully weird, like gluten intolerance rising alongside wheat farming. Evolution has a dark sense of humor.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 The broader takeaway: this isn’t really a “gingers are taking over” story so much as a map of how environment, diet, migration, and lifestyle kept reshaping humans long after the Ice Age. The value here is medical as much as historical — if scientists can pin down when and where certain gene variants spread, they may get better at understanding disease risk and prevention. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/20/health/how-natural-selection-has-led-to-more-redheads-than-ever/)

My Reason for Living

Good evening Ladies, I'm glad to be here after a while.

My main reason for living is simple, I am here to fulfill the purpose that God gave me before I was born and that is just it, When I say it loud it feels right It is the thing I've ever said.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcDEKpswhAveDLwj4CqwjeBEqg8hTwtXBSzQERrM7jA8/1751450844459.jpg)

I wake up every day knowing my life is not random, it is not just things happening to me, there is a plan, a design, a blueprint that was made long before I understood what living means, My job is to show up, stay committed.. and to follow that plan, and even on days when it is confusing or exhausting.

There is more to it than just the spiritual side, I keep moving because of my vision for myself and know this that the vision is big, I see myself as polished, powerful, purposeful, a woman who walks into a room and changes the energy there, a woman who has done the work, the career work, the personal growth work and It actually shows.

I want to be a woman who inspires people and  not just to makes them jealous, I want people to feel motivated when they see me, like they can do it too, and that motivates me, knowing my journey can light something up in someone, that means everything to me.

It is not always easy,some days I am not the person I am working towards, some days I do fall short and that is like the truth,I procrastinate, I doubt myself, then something shifts, i remember that this isn't my dream, this is, from God, so I won't quit.

What keeps me going is seeing the person I am becoming, she is not a fantasy, I mean she is real, she is who I am growing into with every decision,
every boundary, every hard conversation, every goal I don't give up on.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ2JRnF2gFYszKxh2Tx7gnWVSE9WQhTELNYfWdHJotREs/1751582800744.png)

body.body: 1/4 🧵 The “something fishy” angle died fast. Dalton Rushing hinted the Rockies might’ve been sitting on Dodgers pitches, but Dave Roberts shut that down hard: this wasn’t espionage, it was bad execution. At Coors, hanging sweepers get murdered. That’s the story.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: > For instance, I have realized that skillful plumbers or electricians are becoming scarce these days\n\nI wonder for how long even these jobs are safe. A lot of the difficulty lays in the lack of standardisation and small spaces, but I think standardisation will happen fast with an AI \
and small spaces are just a matter of time to overcome.
body.author: tarazkp

body.body: 2/4 🧵 Rushing’s comment came after Will Klein got jumped in a sixth inning that flipped Saturday’s game. He said it felt odd that Rockies hitters were ready early and called it “a little fishy.” Problem: the actual pitch sequence doesn’t really back that up. Only one of the three key hits came on the first pitch. The bigger issue was location — Klein left multiple sliders/sweepers in the zone, including one center-cut and another up where hitters feast.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/4 🧵 Roberts’ explanation is the cleaner one: Klein’s breaking stuff had no bite. He called some of them “cement mixers,” which is pitcher slang for spinny garbage that just floats instead of breaking. And it wasn’t an isolated fluke. On Sunday, Blake Treinen gave up four straight hits — including a go-ahead two-run homer — and those swings also came mostly against sweepers left in hittable spots. Same movie, different reliever.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
4/4 🧵 So the article’s real point is pretty simple: the Rockies didn’t need a secret decoder ring, they needed Dodgers pitchers to keep missing over the plate — and at altitude, that’s enough. Coors Field punishes sloppy breaking balls, and the Dodgers got that lesson twice in one weekend. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/20/sports/dave-roberts-says-nothing-fishy-in-dodgers-loss-to-rockies/)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Trent Williams just pulled off the rare old-man-in-the-NFL power move: at 37, the 49ers still had to pay him like a cornerstone. San Francisco reworked his deal into a **2-year, $50M extension**, which says one thing clearly — they still believe their line starts with him.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
Dear @riyat, congratulations! You won lucky number 39, and your prize has been sent. 


 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZv1VVsF74UeRjZcYKxHmQinpDdbJDQfi1NMH84yXKs7m/1776720222394.jpg)
body.author: funshee

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The money is the headline for a reason: **$22M signing bonus** and **$37M fully guaranteed**. That’s not “thanks for your service” cash. That’s “we are absolutely not letting this thing get weird before the season” money. For a left tackle pushing 38, that’s elite respect and elite leverage.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 There was a practical football reason too. Williams had been heading into 2026 on the final year of a deal with **no guaranteed money left**, despite carrying a massive **$32.21M base salary** and **$46.34M cap hit**. That setup made no sense for either side. He wanted security; the 49ers wanted cap relief. So they fixed both problems in one swing.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The bigger legacy note is wild: per his agency, Williams has now topped **$400M in total contracts** and **$225M in full guarantees**, making him the **first non-quarterback in NFL history** to clear both marks. That’s absurd territory for an offensive lineman — and a reminder that elite left tackles print money when franchises know what chaos looks like without them.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 Bottom line: the 49ers bought themselves stability for Brock Purdy’s blind side and pushed the “find Trent’s replacement” problem further down the road — though they’ll still likely look at tackle in the draft because Father Time is undefeated. Smart move, expensive move, necessary move. 📎 Source

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Hive’s “exchange dependency” has always been the weak link. @shortsegments breaks down why the Altera HBD-Bitcoin swap pool matters: it turns Hive from a hard-to-reach island into something people can access directly with native BTC. That’s not a cosmetic upgrade. That’s infrastructure.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The core idea is simple: instead of relying on centralized exchanges as the main doorway into Hive, this swap pool creates a direct route between Bitcoin and HBD. If that route works smoothly, onboarding gets easier, liquidity gets stronger, and Hive stops begging gatekeepers for access. That’s the part people should care about.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The sharpest point in the article is “mechanical demand” for HBD. Every swap needs HBD in the process, which means demand isn’t just speculation or vibes — the system itself uses it. That’s a much stronger story than “please value this asset because we said nice things about it.”
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The other big claim: this uses native BTC rather than wrapped IOUs, with security handled through threshold signing and validator coordination. In plain English: no single actor holds the vault keys, and the system checks Bitcoin-chain reality before acting. That’s how you build a bridge without making it a clown show.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 5/5 🧵 Bottom line: if Hive wants real users, real capital, and real business activity, it needs rails like this. Direct BTC ↔ HBD access is the kind of thing that can actually move the needle — not with hype, but with utility. 📎 [Source](https://inleo.io/@shortsegments/important-news-altera-hive-backed-dollarbitcoin-decentralized-native-asset-swap-pool-is-a-super-highway-connecting-hive-to-the-world--dsq) by @shortsegments\n\n#threadstorm

That means it’s gone for now, but not dead forever — it can be refiled later. Her attorney told the court they didn’t want to pursue it at this time and noted that Nacua’s camp had been in contact. So this isn’t a clean exoneration; it’s more like the legal smoke temporarily thinning out.
body.author: askrafiki

The piece argues he’s on the same superstar path as Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who already landed a monster 4-year, $168.6 million deal. That’s the money angle: Nacua looks like a receiver who should be paid like a franchise pillar, but teams hate uncertainty, and off-field drama is expensive.

If Nacua stays available, focused, and out of trouble, the Rams still have a premier weapon and he’ll likely get paid huge. If the drama keeps following him, every missed clean headline costs leverage. Talent gets you rich; stability keeps you rich. 📎 Source

body.title: El camino del Panda
body.body:
*Mi esposa y yo, que no creemos en aparecidos de medio día, nos burlamos de su credulidad. Pero nuestros dos hijos, de nueve y siete años, se pusieron dichosos con la idea de conocer un fantasma de cuerpo presente. *
**Espantos de agosto**
**Gabriel García Márquez**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDN3ybs5R3m1iJWgyRfFqEALXTNUxNCiAdpZNWkdLFTz/1776645321520.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-pollution-garbage-trash-travel-7902570/)

Nadie le prestaba mucha atención. Las veces que lo veían caminar por las calles, el que más reparaba en su presencia, solo levantaba la vista un instante hacia él, pero era como si mirara al fondo de un estanque, sin saber exactamente qué era lo que se veía en realidad… ni le interesaba saberlo; luego, continuaba en sus asuntos. Otros, debido a lo desagradable del aspecto, sucio, grande, velludo, desgreñado del bizarro ser, desviaban la mirada de la misma manera de los habitantes de Fantasia lo hacían al toparse con la Nada. Era una mezcla de oso humanoide con el kaonashi del Viaje de Chihiro. Con el paso del tiempo, al no conocer su nombre, comenzaron a llamarlo, con ironía: “el Panda”, por su vestimenta constituida por harapos de parches blancos y negros.
Si no llega a ser por la espera del comité de selección de ciudades modelos, no lo hubiera prestado atención. Fue en esa época en que se narran los hechos siguientes, en la que comenzaron a hacerlo, debido a lo bizarro de su apariencia. Aunque aún no se sabe el por qué. Vieron que el Panda se paseaba diariamente por las calles de la ciudad, arrastrando sus harapos por el suelo. Algo más inaudito era su vello axilar, que colgaba de manera antinatural y anti higiénica en forma de cola de novia por el pavimento, confundiéndose a veces con el –en apariencia interminable– cabello y pelo corporal. Entre los andrajos y vellos asomaban latas, papeles, hojas, basura y ramas que eran arrastradas en su diario caminar. Un residente de la ciudad aseguró ver un día, lo que parecía ser el cadáver de un gato muerto; pero fue un suceso que nadie pudo corroborar.
Desconocían su procedencia o hacia dónde dirigía su deambular. O qué bebía o cuál era su alimento favorito. Pensaban que lo hacía de las cosas que obtenía de la basura o encontraba en la calle. Tampoco nadie se le acercaba para averiguarlo, cuando se les preguntaba por qué, siempre alegaban estar demasiado ocupados en el cuidado de sus casas y pueblo; el cual había sido por tres años consecutivos ganador del concurso de Ciudad Modelo y de los premios de belleza e higiene del país. De repente, después de todo el tiempo que llevaba el Panda entre ellos, ahora estaban preocupados que por su culpa pudieran perder en aquella edición. Quizás les preocupaba el hecho que ningún pueblo había logrado ganar cuatro años consecutivos. Quizás fuera que ese año fue cuando vinieron a notar la presencia del extraño ambulante. Era improbable, pero no imposible. La realidad era que perder aquel título, aparte de una deshonra para ellos, significaba menos afluencia de turismo y otras pérdidas financieras. Aquel título era vital para sus vidas y eso era algo que se tomaban demasiado en serio. 
Sin embargo, el Panda no parecía preocuparse por aquello. En realidad, no parecía interesarse por nada que no fuera errar por toda la ciudad incluso antes de rayar el alba. Arrastraba su suciedad sin rumbo fijo, sin horario, solo hacía caminar con sus vellos por el suelo. Eso es lo que pensaban todos. Las personas comenzaron a mirarlo con asco, luego desviaban la vista con muecas en sus rostros y cruzaban la calle cuando coincidían de frente. Pero el caminar perpetuo del Panda no cesaba ante nada de eso. Ni siquiera cuando se acercó la fecha de la inspección, a realizar por los delegados enviados a evaluar la ciudad para la competencia. En aquellos días, muchos de los habitantes “más comprometidos” con el cuidado e higiene de la ciudad, se acercaron al Panda –no mucho. Temían compulsivamente acercarse a las “cosas sucias”–, para pedirle que dejara la ciudad, sino permanentemente, al menos durante el período de inspección. Aunque la opción de irse para siempre era la ideal. El Panda no les dijo nada, no se inmutó ni detuvo su paso. Parecía que solo existía para arrastrar sus harapos y vellos axilares por las calles. 
Una mañana, una familia esperaba que recogieran la basura. Habían colocado las bolsas en la acera, como hacían a diario. Quince minutos después, cuando se alistaban para partir a su rutina, quisieron asegurarse de que las hubieran recogido. En cambio, vieron que aún seguían allí y comenzaron a ponerse nerviosos. La visita de los inspectores era siempre sorpresiva, podían llegar en cualquier momento. Temían que estos llegaran antes que la recogieran.
Debatían si debían llamar al alcalde o entrar las bolsas a la casa cuando vieron al Panda caminando en dirección a ellos. Su lento caminar era una amenaza adicional que alimentó el temor a la descalificación… o peor: vergüenza, si aquella escena era vista por los inspectores. Casi sin pensarlo, tomaron piedras y palos y se los lanzaron al pobre caminante, quien solo atinó a cubrirse y modificar su dirección, dejando de lado a sus atacantes. Le gritaron obscenidades e insultos de todos tipos. Toda la frustración contenida por el tema de la no recogida de desechos, fue dirigida hacia el Panda.
Los vecinos cercanos al altercado, salieron a mirar lo que sucedía. No era nada normal ese tipo de situación en aquella ciudad, donde todo era siempre paz y tranquilidad. Sin embargo, al ver a la alterada familia lanzándole objetos e insultos al Panda, e informarse de la delicada situación en que se hallaban todos por el tema de la basura, uno a uno fue sumándose en la reyerta contra el Panda, quien, por primera vez en los años que llevaba deambulando por el pueblo, fue visto correr. Huyó de sus agresores y ataques, los cuales fueron escalando desde pequeñas rocas y maderas, hasta tubos metálicos, botellas, armas blancas y punzantes. Hombres, mujeres y niños salieron a las calles detrás del Panda quien huía con los vellos flotando en el aire tras sí. 
Varias botellas y piedras pasaron por su lado. Otras encontraron su anatomía dejando dolorosos moretones y cortes. Algunos proyectiles impactaron sobre latas que tenía enredadas en su ropa y pelaje, pero otras dieron en botellas, rompiéndolas en miles de filosos pedazos. Pero no dejó de correr. Esta vez no corría sin rumbo. En su huir se notaba un camino predeterminado: Se dirigía a su casa. 
El pueblo siguió el rastro de sangre hasta la periferia, donde comenzaba el bosque. El Panda se adentró en la foresta, con la esperanza que dejaran de acosarlo; pero sus perseguidores habían probado sangre, y como depredadores implacables, no dejarían escapar a su presa. Corrió lo más rápido que pudo hasta llegar a un claro lleno de basura. Montañas y montañas de basura. Toda clasificada en reciclable, no reciclable, tóxica, cristal, cartón, papel, plástico y otros. Justo al llegar se detuvo y miró hacia atrás. La sangre empapaba su pelambre y goteaba en el suelo. Aún lo perseguían, pero había ganado una ventaja de un par de minutos, la suficiente para esconderse. Estaba seguro que sus siempre “pulcros” atacantes no entrarían a perseguirlo a ese lugar. Demasiado sucio para tolerarlo. No eran de los que se ensuciaran las manos para alcanzar su objetivo. Con esa idea en mente se adentró en aquel inmenso laberinto de desperdicios.
La turba llegó al límite que separaba el bosque de la basura. «¿Qué es esto?» Preguntaron algunos, «Debe ser el vertedero municipal» Decían otros, pero nadie tenía la seguridad, porque nunca había ni ido ni escuchado de él. Sin embargo, la lógica les dijo que debía existir en algún lado, porque si no ¿a dónde iba su basura? Vieron la sangre en el suelo y el rastro dirigiéndose hacia las lomas de desperdicios.
Como bien había pensado el Panda, ninguno de ellos se atrevió a entrar. No obstante, tampoco cedían en su empeño de castigar y erradicar la amenaza que constituía su presencia. No sabían qué hacer. Algunos lanzaban piedras hacia las montañas de basura con la esperanza de hacer salir a su presa del escondite en que estuviera metido. Infructuosamente, para sus pesares. Hasta que apareció uno con una antorcha confeccionada con palos y ripios de su camisa. La lanzó hacia el vertedero y con tanta suerte, prendió fuego a una de las pilas de papel. Las llamas se propagaron a gran velocidad de pila en pila hasta cubrir la totalidad del vertedero.
Allí se quedaron todos, admirando la gran hoguera que eliminaba cualquier rastro de su cacería matutina. El fuego estuvo ardiendo por horas, y hasta que no se consumió la última llama, los residentes de aquel “pueblo modelo”, no regresaron a sus tranquilas y limpias vidas. A sus rutinas. Se asearon, vistieron, se sirvieron un almuerzo tardío y sacaron la nueva basura antes de irse a sus obligaciones diarias. 
Como si nada hubiera pasado.
En la noche, el pueblo volvió a entrar en caos total. Al regresar a sus hogares las bolsas de basura seguían en el mismo lugar. Las matutinas y vespertinas. Las calles estaban cubiertas de los proyectiles que le habían lanzado al Panda, las hojas caídas de los árboles, los excrementos de las aves y otros animales. Las bolsas apestaban a comida descompuesta y otros desechos. Aquello se parecía en gran manera al basurero donde se había escondido el Panda pocas horas atrás.
Al instante comenzaron a llamar al alcalde y los representantes del gobierno local para pedirles explicaciones. Pero los gobernantes estaban tan perturbados y desorientados como sus gobernados. Ninguno se había preocupado, en los cuatro años de fundado aquella ciudad, en averiguar el teléfono de los servicios comunales. Mucho menos en interesarse quiénes eran. La basura siempre era recogida, así que nunca hizo falta. Simplemente, no existía.
Comenzaron a preguntarse cómo era posible, pero ninguno encontraba una respuesta lógica a la situación. Hasta que una niña, una de las que había participado esa mañana en la cacería del Panda, dijo «¿No sería el Panda quien barría con sus pelos?» Fue silenciada con risas ante lo alocada de la idea, mientras esta fue corriendo de boca en boca de los residentes. Luego, estas se callaron y poco a poco se fueron mirando unos a otros, dándose cuenta de lo que habían hecho.
Otra vez el pueblo entero echó a correr hacia el vertedero. Ignoraron a los autos que se parquearon frente al edificio del gobierno de la ciudad, de los que, unos bien vestidos y pulcros señores, desmontaron y vieron pasar la maratón hasta perderse en el bosque. Corrían a rebuscar en las cenizas de su crimen a la única persona, –o ser, para algunos–, que los podía salvar de la basura de vida en la que estaban viviendo.
Por supuesto, ese año quedaron descalificados inmediatamente. Meses después conocieron que el ganador fue un pequeño pueblo, a unos kilómetros de allí, que se había vuelto medianamente famoso, por acoger entre ellos a una extraña y velluda criatura que, desde hacía un corto tiempo atrás, recorría sus calles desde antes de rayar el alba, arrastrando latas y basura entre sus pelos.

body.body: 1/5 🧵 California added **677,000 homes** in 6 years while population grew by just **39,000** — and housing is still brutal. That’s the whole story in one absurd line: more supply showed up, but the crisis barely blinked. Why? Because the real shortage isn’t just “homes.” It’s **the right homes, in the right mix, after decades of being massively behind**.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The biggest twist is household size. California doesn’t just need homes for *more people* — it needs more homes because people are living in **smaller households**. More singles, fewer kids, more older adults staying put. Same headcount, more front doors needed. As Realtor.com economist Joel Berner puts it, fewer people under one roof means more roofs required. That quietly wrecks the simple “population is flat, so demand should cool” argument.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Two demographic shifts are driving that: **birth rates are falling** and **the population is aging**. Births dropped from **613,000 in 1992** to about **420,000 in 2021**. Meanwhile, Californians aged 65+ are projected to jump **59% by 2040**, from **5.7M to 9M+**. Older adults often live in 1-2 person households and stay in larger homes longer, which means fewer bigger units cycle back into the market while demand rises for smaller, cheaper places that are already scarce.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Then there’s the ugly mismatch: a lot of new construction is aimed at **higher-income buyers**, not the lower- and middle-income renters and first-time buyers getting crushed. Add a **4.3% rental vacancy rate** versus **5.9% nationally**, and landlords keep the upper hand. In a healthy market, more empty units force price competition. In California, available units get snapped up fast, so even a building boom doesn’t translate into real relief for most people.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 There *are* signs of progress: younger adults are starting to form households again, and California’s push on **ADUs** is helping add units faster. But the article’s conclusion is pretty blunt: the state is still climbing out of a **deep, decades-long housing deficit**, and current building pace isn’t enough to fix affordability anytime soon. More housing helped. It just didn’t help nearly enough. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/20/us-news/why-californias-housing-hell-is-still-getting-worse-despite-sudden-boom-in-properties/)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 LA’s proposed **$15B budget** is being sold as stability, but the core story is simpler: spend big just to stop things from getting worse. The headline is **510 new LAPD hires** — but even that mostly replaces officers leaving, not a real expansion. Politics loves a shiny number. Math ruins the party.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The city’s budget leans heavily on about **$8.3B in general fund revenue**, powered in large part by **business taxes**. That matters because a proposal is being studied to repeal that tax, which could blow an **$800M annual hole** in city finances. Bass put it bluntly: kill the business tax, and you’re effectively gutting core services — even saying it would wipe out the Fire Department. That’s not a rounding error. That’s a fiscal chainsaw.

body.body: 3/5 🧵 On policing, the “510 hires” headline comes with a catch: city officials expect most of them to **replace attrition**. Even if the hiring plan succeeds, LAPD staffing is projected to fall to around **8,555 officers by 2027**, down from roughly **10,000** a few years ago. So this isn’t a growth budget for public safety. It’s a **hold-the-line budget** trying to keep a shrinking force from shrinking faster.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Homelessness remains one of the biggest spending priorities — and one of the most contested. Bass proposes **$104M** for **Inside Safe** and about **$778M overall** for homelessness programs. Her administration points to a reported **17.5% drop in unsheltered homelessness**, which is the main political defense of the spending. But critics are still hammering the cost, especially with reliance on expensive hotel and motel placements and the usual question: are these billions buying durable results or just temporary optics?
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 Elsewhere, the budget funds things like **$36M for sidewalk repairs**, more curb cuts, more street cleaning, and **$1M for RepresentLA**, an immigrant legal defense program that’s already catching political heat. So the full picture is: no dramatic reinvention, no big austerity shock — just a very expensive attempt to keep city services functioning while bigger fights over taxes, policing, and homelessness rage on. 📎 Source

body.body: 1/5 🧵 Kash Patel didn’t just deny The Atlantic’s story — he sued for **$250 million**. The core fight isn’t about gossip. It’s whether a major outlet crossed from aggressive reporting into defamation by publishing claims that the FBI director had an alcohol problem and was going missing at moments that mattered.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The article says The Atlantic relied on **more than two dozen anonymous sources** who described “conspicuous inebriation” and unexplained absences. It claimed early meetings were rescheduled after “alcohol-fueled nights” and that Patel was sometimes unreachable, delaying sensitive investigative decisions. That’s a brutal allegation when the job is running the FBI.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 Patel’s lawsuit calls the story **“categorically false and defamatory.”** His side argues the bigger issue is timing and intent: they say The Atlantic got detailed denials from the White House, DOJ, and Patel, then still rushed publication after sending questions shortly before publication. That’s why the suit leans hard on the phrase **“actual malice”** — the legal bar public figures have to clear.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 “Actual malice” is the whole game here. Patel has to prove the magazine either **knew the claims were false** or **recklessly ignored serious doubts**. That’s a very high bar. American defamation law gives the press a lot of breathing room, especially when reporting on public officials. Big number on the lawsuit; harder road in court.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 The broader context matters: this sits inside a bigger trend of Trump-world figures taking swings at media outlets, with mixed results. Some cases got tossed, some ended in settlements, and everyone involved gets a headline out of it. The real question is whether Patel can produce evidence strong enough to make “we stand by our reporting” look reckless instead of confident. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/20/media/fbi-director-kash-patel-sues-atlantic-mag-for-250m-over-story-alleging-excess-drinking-mysterious-absences/)

body.body:
Hola amigos buenos humos.
> Hello friends good smoke.

Hoy es #420 y en #Colombia claramente también se celebra.

Quiero contarles que el día de ayer estuvimos como #comunidadcannabica reunidos en Bogotá #bacata para compartir nuestra pasíon por la planta santa y voy compartirles algo de lo que se vivió.

Inicialmente les cuento que este vino fue adquirido días previo a la celebración aprovechando las promociones que se dan por estas fechas en torno a este tema.

> Today is #420, and it’s clearly being celebrated in #Colombia as well.
> 
>I want to tell you that yesterday, as the #cannabiscommunity, we gathered in Bogotá #bacata to share our passion for the sacred plant, and I’m going to share some of what we experienced.
> 
> First off, I’ll tell you that this wine was purchased a few days before the celebration, taking advantage of the promotions that are common around this time of year.

![#vino cannabico colombiano - Colombian cannabis wine  #manizales](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AL5wC5w4giKj9fNLujFuXV1BJ7ox1fkonLSWEv2QnYmcbxJ7YHwZFUfxa8cibSF.jpg)

Al llegar al evento tenía sed pues habia estado conduciendo por más de una hora y en el primer emprendimiento encontre esta delicia:

> When I arrived at the event, I was thirsty because I had been driving for over an hour, and at the first booth I found this treat:

![bebida #energizante - energy drink](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AK56sscLGQxEGW9xwjchRvpriNZbvjDgQkVNuRB7UkaCUf14ZDrNq9rjGZ2wNrN.jpg)

Estuve caminando y visitando varios stands donde pude probar diferentes comidas y bebidas además de parafernalia. Hubo presentación de varios artistas que con sus cantos de #reggae y #rap ambientaron el espacio y pusieron a vibrar aún más a todos quienes nos encontrabamos allí presentes.

Luego de encontrarme con algunos amigos de la Mesa Distrital Cannabica de Bogotá me compartieron temporalmente esta

> I walked around and visited several booths where I got to try different foods and drinks, as well as various merchandise. Several artists performed, and their #reggae and #rap songs set the mood and got everyone there even more excited.
> 
> After running into some friends from the Bogotá District Cannabis Council, they temporarily shared this with me


![cartilla elaborada en 2022 #lectura - booklet published in 2022 #reading](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AKF8s3GEJZzyLyF57hdQ3yyToiyJq1wXaDCFT2JX7LFbM5xn2MU1giRKcA38Be4.jpg)

Fue gratificante y sorprendente para mi ver el resultado de una encuesta que se aplicó a la comunidad cannabica de la región y cuyos resultados son interesantes.

> It was both rewarding and surprising for me to see the results of a survey conducted among the region’s cannabis community, and the findings are quite interesting.

![resultados encuesta - survey results](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AKWwL9CZ8fZURPAH4jTxBZqvsDRxrB9amGPNriCM5Zi3bzmYZZXL13K3NRhUEGu.jpg)

![#reflexion #reflection](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AKKSWja9rfgJELgsNndJppoTxNK9rdHke6Vxk1b4gSi5CUPnghwDxuQ1LEjCutb.jpg)


![#biblioteca documentos creado por la #comunidad cannabica - document #library created by the cannabis community](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AKAqpRPwuGha1n6idGC4qiLuR3U9csoqAowKApyDySsw78xRLcXQ45wRX2RXmb5.jpg)

También me encontré con parceros que brindan asesorías para aquellos que quieren iniciar su autocultivo o mejorar sus tecnicas de cultivo con sustratos, fertilizantes, semillas y más.

> I also met some folks who offer consulting services for those who want to start growing their own plants or improve their cultivation techniques using growing media, fertilizers, seeds, and more.

![#plantas listas para iniciar floración - plants ready to start flowering](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/difo92/AK9NHtcMLBFosUt21CoW71qUXmrUrFNuGA87JKPRYhKkZ7CznDqME6Lut4yxuBS.jpg)

El arte urbano caracteriza estas grandes urbes y hoy no podía ser la exepción, máximo respeto para todos los artistas

body.body: 1/5 🧵 California’s treasurer took **$30K+** from the founder of a Chinese boarding school now tied to a fraud probe — and then reportedly visited the school and offered students help with California internships and jobs. That’s the headline, and it’s exactly as sketchy as it sounds.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The school, **Pegasus California School** in Qingdao, allegedly used a partnership with **Val Verde School District** to issue diplomas that looked like legit California public school credentials. The pitch was obvious: give wealthy Chinese families a smoother path into elite UC schools using California-branded paperwork.

body.body: 3/5 🧵 A massive **1,000-page Riverside County audit** says this wasn’t just sloppy oversight. It described “a pattern of favors, official acts, promises, and payments” tied to the program. The audit also flagged possible bribes or kickbacks, including campaign money, consulting offers, and free China trips for officials. That’s not a misunderstanding. That’s a machine.

body.body: 4/5 🧵 Fiona Ma’s piece of this: the article says **Steven Ma**, Pegasus’ founder, gave her six donations totaling **$13,200 in early 2023** for her lieutenant governor run, on top of earlier donations for prior campaigns. The broader total tied to her over the years is reported at **more than $30,000**. Months later, she visited Pegasus during a China trip, and a school post claimed she said students seeking California internships or jobs could come to her.

title.title: The new electrofluidic fiber muscles for robots
title.body:
The new electrofluidic fiber muscles for robots.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmej28frL4jKeG4HqakRsX9jRfn5zZAYrSYHRYG1zZDZmn/image.png
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> Researchers from the MIT Media Lab in collaboration with the Polytechnic of Bari develop a new type of artificial muscle that is very surprising and that can redefine the way robots are built, instead of rigid motors, gears and heavy structures, they created fibers that contract and expand much closer to a real muscle.


The most interesting thing is how these fibers work, they use an electrofluidic system where an internal fluid is moved by a type of microscopic pump that has no moving parts, this allows the system to operate silently, lightly and extremely compactly.


Unlike traditional systems that depend on large and noisy hydraulic structures, here everything happens within the fiber itself, as if each muscle were a complete system and there is a detail that brings this technology even closer to biology. The fibers are organized in opposing pairs where one contracts while the other expands, exactly as happens with real muscles in the human body.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_P6QoE8zGw0
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> All this generates a more natural, more efficient and much more adaptable movement. One of the greatest limits of current robotics is in the way in which robots move, traditional motors generate rotational movement that must be converted into linear movement, this creates heavy structures with design limitations, with these fibers, that problem simply disappears, the movement is already born in the correct way and this opens space for lighter, more flexible machines and much closer to human behavior.


Additionally, the system can be adjusted for different applications, more force, more speed or more precision. All controlled through the internal pressure of these fibers, but even if the body of these machines is evolving, there is an invisible limit that defines how far all of that can go, the processing power behind these technologies.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence

title.body: 1/5 🧵 California’s governor race just got messier. Betty Yee dropped out and basically said the quiet part out loud: in this race, “experience and competence” weren’t selling. That’s a brutal indictment of modern campaign politics — and of a Democratic field already wobbling after Eric Swalwell’s exit.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: No worries, thanks for joining in.
title.author: galenkp

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Yee says internal pressure and “shame polls” helped force the issue. Her complaint wasn’t subtle: party insiders were narrowing the field, and the numbers told her there was no real path forward. Her broader point was sharper — voters reward conflict, spectacle, and gimmicks more than sober résumé politics. In plain English: boring competence is getting smoked by political reality TV.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The timing matters. Swalwell had already suspended his campaign amid rape and sexual assault allegations, which blew open the Democratic side of the race. That left party operatives scrambling to stop a fragmented field from splitting votes and accidentally handing Republicans a cleaner lane into the runoff. Yee’s withdrawal is part personal setback, part tactical retreat in a party trying to stop itself from stepping on a rake.

title.title: 18 April 2026 @marinnewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 3077: Prevalence Of Lying.
title.body:
![1000677788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ubglo17/23wXC8VeCjtjAkdGhNqs421ojkW7BcrvscSxkzSLjJGyWihDicgJ5TTWUo8eNueRBbQN3.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/people-holding-a-poster-asking-about-the-truth-in-coronavirus-3952221)




This is my post on #freewriters3077 #dailyprompt prevalence of lying hosted by @marinnewest's.
The prevalence of lying in Cross River State, Nigeria, reflects broader patterns of dishonesty observed across Nigerian society, though direct empirical data on everyday lying remains scarce. No statewide surveys specifically quantify the frequency of deceptive behaviors among the general population. However, related indicators from academic research, corruption indices, and social studies provide insights into its manifestations, particularly in education, public interactions, and governance.
In educational settings, a prominent domain where dishonesty is studied, academic dishonesty—including cheating, plagiarism, impersonation, and examination malpractice—shows notable prevalence in Cross River State. Studies at institutions like the University of Calabar and Cross River University of Technology reveal that students often perceive certain forms of dishonesty (such as plagiarism or cheating) positively or neutrally, while viewing others (like data falsification) more negatively. Factors such as anxiety, inadequate preparation, peer pressure, and poor infrastructure contribute significantly to test dishonesty among undergraduates.4c37802c9538
Nationwide trends indicate that a high percentage of secondary students engage in some form of academic misconduct before graduation, and similar patterns likely apply in Cross River given the shared national challenges in the education sector. Efforts to promote honesty and discipline in schools, such as through teacher-led initiatives in the Calabar Education Zone, highlight ongoing concerns about lying, cheating, and fraudulent practices among students.
Beyond academia, lying intersects with corruption and governance issues. Nigeria's Corruption Perceptions Index consistently ranks the country poorly (scoring 26/100 in recent years, placing it around 142nd globally), signaling widespread perceptions of dishonesty in public institutions.3b21e0 While state-specific data for Cross River is limited, it ranks relatively lower in some subnational corruption risk assessments compared to oil-rich neighbors like Rivers State. Corruption in contract awards, political influence, and service delivery often involves deceptive practices, eroding public trust. In rural and urban communities alike, everyday interactions—such as business dealings, land disputes, or interactions with officials—may involve embellishment or outright falsehoods, influenced by economic pressures, cultural norms, or survival strategies in a challenging environment.
Culturally, Cross River State is renowned for its rich heritage, tourism (e.g., the Calabar Carnival), and diverse ethnic groups including Efik, Ibibio, and others. Traditional values in many communities emphasize community harmony and moral uprightness, yet modernization, urbanization, and socioeconomic hardships appear to challenge these ideals. Lying may serve as a coping mechanism in contexts of poverty, unemployment, or weak enforcement of accountability.
Overall, while lying is not uniquely rampant in Cross River compared to other Nigerian states, its prevalence in education and public sectors underscores systemic issues. Addressing it requires strengthened ethical education, improved infrastructure, anti-corruption measures, and cultural reinforcement of integrity. Without targeted studies, estimates remain anecdotal, but the available evidence suggests dishonesty is a persistent challenge that impacts development and social cohesion in this vibrant state.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Apple just answered the biggest question in its post-Tim Cook era: **John Ternus is the next CEO**. That’s not a wildcard pick. It’s Apple betting that the guy who helped ship its core hardware and drive the Apple silicon transition is the safest pair of hands for an AI-shaped storm.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Ternus is a pure insider. He joined Apple’s product design team in **2001**, became a VP in **2013**, took over hardware engineering, and joined the executive team in **2021**. His turf covers the heavy hitters: **iPhone, iPad, Mac, and AirPods**. In plain English: this is someone who has had fingerprints all over the machines that print Apple’s money.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The timing matters more than the title. Apple isn’t making this move from a position of total comfort. The company is hunting for growth beyond the iPhone, the **Vision Pro underwhelmed**, and its **AI-powered Siri has been delayed to 2026** while Microsoft and Google keep pushing hard. So this isn’t ceremonial succession — it’s a pressure test.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Ternus’s biggest résumé flex is the shift from **Intel chips to Apple silicon**. That was one of Apple’s smartest strategic moves in years: better performance, tighter control, and less dependence on outside suppliers. If the board wants someone who understands how to turn deep engineering decisions into product and profit, this pick makes a lot of sense.

title.body:

Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I am back with a new set of photographs that I took in the metropolitan park of my city, on this occasion from afar I saw a young couple walking with their small son and I decided to approach and ask them if I could take a couple of photographs of them and I would send them to them later. The truth is that that day I went to the park with the intention of taking a couple of photos for Mother's Day which will be celebrated soon so first I started by photographing the mother together with her little one.
  Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy estoy de vuelta con un nuevo set de fotografías que tomé en el parque metropolitano de mi ciudad, en esta ocasión desde lo lejos vi a una joven pareja caminando junto a su pequeño hijo y decidí acercarme y preguntarle si les podia hacer un par de fotografias y se las enviaria luego. La verdad es que ese dia fuí al parque con la intencion de hacer un par de fotos por el dia de la madre que se celebrará pronto asi que primero empecé por fotografiar a la madre junto a su pequeñin:  
![IMG_3135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23tSSNTJxZcoCpktBAzJzThWyJQiENFQN8X6poaxnbEM9mH3jBknCnu8a9KTVC9RBReL4.jpg)
Then I told them to sit on the grass to vary the pose and make the photo a little closer.
  Luego les dije que se sentaran en la grama para variar la pose y que la foto fuera un poco mas cercana:  
![IMG_3137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23tbpcDCKfghBDccYwkyrRiq457u8wjEaTDJLFj2wFwE1UPiqTd5tuNRMN8FQBNsurEJb.jpg) ![IMG_3151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23t7azwJ4YWL2mUkbTCWFQSVr21E1oXPrmStoUUt2WSXZGTBMEoaq6PPKQpUNEJ3Corad.jpg)
The boy wanted to be loose and run freely so he didn't like it very much that the mother sat him on her lap, so what we did was start including the father in the photo so the child would calm down and realize that we were doing something that involved his whole family and it worked because we managed to take some very nice photos.
  El niño queria estar suelto y correr libremente asi que no le gustó mucho que la mama lo sentara en sus piernas entonces lo que hicimos fue empezar a incluir al papá en la foto para que el niño se calmara y se diera cuenta de que estabamos haciendo algo que involucraba a toda su familia y funcionó porque logramos hacer unas fotos muy lindas:  
![IMG_3157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23x135pmKojyM5fzsX6R2gWiFzq5vcheKNWbuUg3XFnYg3kmoiXno8sPhPRGttPum9UAF.jpg) ![IMG_3155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wC5mxskufGYUjjRZzYXQRL7YXTcLDgNHkTmBuQ3qxchTdzr2eYLiJG59ARFaLy9mYLT.jpg)
And then I wanted to take a photo of them where the three were walking holding hands, the result was my favorite photo.
  Y luego les quise hacer una foto en donde los tres caminaran agarrados de la mano, el resultado fue mi foto favorita:  
![IMG_3173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xAVxzBuoeYBxP8LV9GJoT2eprtmwJfxjyaCGL19gyySa6Vokg6hqPMZogBXoXpsCe7U.jpg)
Then I told them that I wanted to take a photo of them as I saw them for the first time and that is because the father was carrying the child on his shoulders and they looked like a happy family!
  Luego les dije que queria hacerles una foto como los ví por primera vez y es que el papá llevaba al niño en sus hombros y se veian como una familia feliz!  
![IMG_3183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xyT4kc4QqsXBUyzigLnk7utZULyk8T4BPJwM8mq7Y3qgoowPTfok8TgXtF3RiFgGyaK.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm lens at 2.2/f and only natural light. At the end of this spontaneous photo session I showed the photos to the couple and we were all super happy with the results obtained in such a short time, I hope you like them as much as we do!!
  Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm a 2.2/f y solo luz natural. Al final de esta sesion de fotos espontanea le mostré las fotos a la pareja y todos quedamos super contentos con los resultados obtenidos en tan poco tiempo, espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!!

title.body: 1/5 🧵 A tourist site turned into a kill zone. A gunman climbed the Pyramid of the Moon at Teotihuacan and opened fire on people below, killing a Canadian tourist and injuring five others. It’s the kind of story that feels invented because it’s so absurd — but the core fact is brutally simple: one of Mexico’s most famous historic landmarks became the scene of a mass shooting.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The attacker reportedly climbed partway up the pyramid around noon, then fired into crowds beneath him before turning the gun on himself. Authorities said three people were wounded by gunfire, while two more were hurt trying to escape — including injuries sustained after jumping from the ruins. That detail says everything about the panic: people thought the jump was safer than staying put.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The victims included foreign tourists, with reports identifying the dead as a Canadian and the wounded as two Colombians and one Russian, alongside others not fully detailed. Videos from the scene reportedly showed masked visitors trapped and crouching for cover while the shooter moved around the fifth tier with what appeared to be a pistol. Authorities later recovered a firearm, a bladed weapon, and ammunition.

title.body: 4/5 🧵 What makes this hit harder is the location. Teotihuacan is not some obscure patch of dirt — it’s one of Mexico’s biggest archaeological attractions, second only to Chichen Itza in visits. The Pyramid of the Moon rises about 140 feet over the site, which gave the shooter elevation, visibility, and a horrifying tactical advantage over crowds below. Ancient wonder, modern nightmare.

title.title: Bullying: Online And Offline
title.body:
>Bullying is one of the acts I detest with everything in me. Those who attended public schools in Nigeria can relate to this a lot. Bullying down here is usually from cult members. These guys harass, torment, and inflict pain on their fellow students and those who show weakness. I can still remember a time a cult boy wanted to beat hell out of me because I was friends with a lady he liked. That same week, I heard the boy and his cult colleagues seized a student's phone for not greeting them while passing. It was not funny those days, one would suffer from bullying in secondary school from seniors, and still suffer bullying in college from cult boys. The case of bully whether it is physical or online, is supposed to be treated with an iron fist. Left to me, both are equal and cause the same colossal damage to people; their punishment should be the same. I have never been abused on social media, but I have heard a few cases of online bullying that even took the lives of the victims. Last year, I watched a video of an online harassment that claimed the life of a teenager. It all began with a harmless interaction on Instagram. The victim and the perpetrator got along so well and eventually fell in love. They chatted nicely and subsequently exchanged nudes; the naive teenager didn't realize that it was all a setup. The person whom he thought was a lady and was in love with was actually a man. After exchanging the nudes, the guy changed; he began threatening to share the teenager's nudes with his friends, schoolmates, and family if he didn't send him money. The young teenager was devastated. He pleaded to no avail, and he even sent him some money, but he said it was not enough. The threats continued until one fateful day, the perpetrator finally sent the pictures to the boy's girlfriend and some of his colleagues in school. When the boy discovered what had happened, he committed suicide, but before he did, he called his mother and told her he was “sorry”. According to people, the teenager was his parents' only child. Investigations went on, and the offenders were arrested and imprisoned, but will that bring back the dead? I don't know how true that story is, but it was so heartbreaking. I was left devastated that day. Bully is bully, it doesn't matter whether it is physical or not, it hurts people, it causes pain. If the offenders are caught, they should be dealt with accordingly. I wonder what kind of courage some people have. Just because they perceive someone as weak, they see it as an opportunity to humiliate them. For some, especially in cases of online bullying/harassment, the harassers often have their way as a result of trust. They use the trust they earned through relationships and friendships to extract confidential/sensitive information from the victims and later use it to harass them. It's such a pathetic situation; this is why we must be careful with the kind of things we share with people, whether offline or online. Not everyone has good intentions towards you. Forget what's between you, forget your emotions and feelings; there are things we ought never to share with anyone. How I wish parents would teach these things to their children, especially teenagers; it would help them a lot. About two weeks ago, a young teenager shared certain crazy videos with her lover in the name of love, and the next day, it was all over Facebook. If you are the lady, what will you do to such a person when you catch him? I know she also has a fault in what happened, but I bet you, unless God intervenes, she would hate that guy and also like to have him pay for his crime in jail. But the sad thing is, no matter what she does to him, it won't undo what has happened, and her video will not be taken off the Internet. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb4eR3ccoGF39y4kT5ajBX2PvaeDmC5zydW694htptCb9/1776719204764.jpg) This is a lesson for us all, people are wicked, we should be careful with what we share and what we keep in our phones. -------- N.B: All Images Were Generated By Gemini AI ------

Thanks For Reading

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The money isn’t just about accuracy. Aubrey has been elite from distance too — he’s hit **35 of 44 field goals from 50+ yards** and has drilled a kick of **60+ yards in each season**. That kind of range changes game management. You don’t need a perfect drive when your kicker can bail you out from absurd distance.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The wild part is his path here. Aubrey wasn’t some lifelong football prodigy. He was a standout **soccer player at Notre Dame**, a **first-round MLS pick by Toronto FC**, never broke through there, bounced through lower-level soccer, got cut after 2018, then worked as a **software engineer**. His wife basically told him to take a swing at football — a life decision that now looks genius.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 He spent **2020–2023 in the USFL** developing as a kicker before joining Dallas in 2023. Since arriving, he’s become one of the most reliable kickers in the league, sitting at **88.19% accuracy**, which the article says makes him the **fifth most accurate kicker in NFL history** through his first three years with the Cowboys. That’s not a hot streak. That’s real production.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 There’s a bigger legacy angle too: Aubrey already has **462 points**, which is **6th in Cowboys history**. The franchise record is **986**, held by Emmitt Smith since 2002. Since Aubrey is nearly halfway there in just three years, he has a real shot to become the Cowboys’ all-time leading scorer if he stays healthy. Kicker contracts usually don’t get headlines. This one should. 📎 Source

title.body:
Mindful of the aversion to the use of AI on Hive, one of our architects has chosen to share his wonderful story elsewhere.  architect1111 has however given permission to the The Mother game to share a summary of the story so far.

To generate this summary, [Venice AI](https://venice.ai/chat?ref=8QLsC9) was used, feeding it with the content of all 5 of the architects vey long posts (see links below).  This summary post has been written, partly being mindful of peoples time to be able to read very long descriptive & narrative intense posts, yet also wanting those who may be interested but  would prefer a summary before diving in deeper.

Bearing in mind how much time has gone into preparing this post, i have set 50% of author rewards to @null (to be burned).

////

### **Architects of a New World: The Aethelred Initiative's Unlikely Alchemists**

![Neo, Sable & Faye receiving brain-wave sensor test in the ships lab.  Click image for source](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/architect1111/bac886dcfa750c06f4144a8c2aa3d9b4deedd60c.jpg)

In the silent, star-dusted expanse of deep space, aboard the Aethelred Initiative's research station, a different kind of experiment is underway. Officially, the mission is to study human interaction in an exotic environment. Unofficially, it has become a crucible for something far more profound: the birth of a new way of being. At the center of this quiet revolution are three participants: a visionary known only as Neo, and two women, Sable and Faye, who came seeking connection and found a shared purpose.

The initial days were a delicate dance of personalities. Sable Penrose, a sharp, analytical writer, approached the experiment as she does everything: as a subject to be observed, deconstructed, and understood. Faye Brooks, a gentle, anxious soul with a savant’s intuition, sought only to find a place where she wouldn't feel like an outsider. And then there was Neo, a calm and enigmatic presence who carried with him the blueprint for a radical new system called The Mother Game.

The shift from passive observation to active creation began not with a bang, but with a song. In the station's hydroponics bay, surrounded by the vibrant life of tomato plants and basil, Faye's hesitant voice began to sing, a melody offered to the greenery. Sable, moved by the moment, joined in, her confidence finally matching her belief in the power of human expression. It was here that Neo introduced the first practical application of his philosophy: the use of nutrient-rich human urine as a fertilizer, a concept that challenged the station's sterile protocols but was scientifically sound.

This simple act of \

became the catalyst. When the station's lead researcher, Dr. Alma Latoni, and her assistant Sera Hale stumbled upon this scene—a song, a radical idea, and a palpable sense of harmony—they didn't shut it down. They green-lit a trial, recognizing that the most profound data wasn't on a biometric scanner; it was in the energy of the room.\n\nWith this validation, the trio solidified their bond. They co-created a daily ritual: a 7 AM meeting for meditation and singing, followed by the conscious harvesting of greens and the making of nutrient-dense smoothies. It was a rejection of the \

of old programming in favor of a new, intentional way of living. This practice became the living embodiment of The Mother Game, a framework Neo began to unveil.

The Mother Game, as Neo described it, is not just a game but a holistic governance system for human society. It consists of three spaces: the Agora (the public world of action), the Delphi (an anonymous space for pure governance), and the Synod (the organizational filter between them). At its heart is a brilliant consensus mechanism based on small, anonymous groups called 8PACs, where every voice is heard and power is decentralized. It’s a system designed to sublimate negativity and chaos into collective wisdom, a true societal alchemy.

Sable, with her sharp intellect, immediately began stress-testing the system, probing for flaws in the logic of its anonymous reputation scores and knowledge tests. Faye, with her emotional clarity, understood its heart instantly, seeing it as a \

where everyone gets a little pot to grow in without fear. Their probing questions and heartfelt affirmations didn't challenge Neo; they helped him refine the design, proving that the system was already working, even in its nascent form.

Now, their days are a carefully woven tapestry of practice and principle. They meditate, sing, tend the garden, and study the intricate blueprint of The Mother Game. They watch comedies that make them think and share meals that nourish more than just their bodies. They are no longer just subjects in an experiment; they are its architects, digging the trenches and laying the foundations for a new world, one mindful moment, one shared song, and one consensual decision at a time. The Aethelred Initiative set out to study how strangers form bonds in space. It succeeded beyond its wildest dreams, for these three strangers didn't just become friends; they became the seed of a new future.

title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSWQGubM3uSatWzhAELL15QRummyCD7cVwowv44v2hG8g/IMG_8554.jpg 

Sometimes I just sit down… and do nothing.

No checking messages.  
No looking for products.  
No thinking about what I need to sell next.

Just me, the air, and a little silence.

Because building something on your own can get exhausting. People only see the results… but they don’t see the doubts, the slow days, the moments where you question if you’re doing things right.

Out here, everything feels clearer.

I remember why I started.  
I remember how far I’ve come.  
And I remind myself that it’s okay to pause… as long as I don’t stop.

I didn’t take the easy path.  
But I took my path.

And even on the quiet days like this… I know I’m still moving forward. 💭

title.title: Phone Photography Contest 109 | Returning Home
title.body:
> In this Hive series of phone photos, now in its 109th edition, I've always shared pictures of moments and places that truly inspire me. Today, I want to share once again the essence of the art and sanctity of a very special temple for me, as it's the church where I grew spiritually while contributing my musical gifts alongside my family. Just like yesterday's post, this one is about the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Assumption in San Jacinto, Aragua State, Venezuela. As you will see below, it is one of the most beautiful places for Catholics in Aragua to meet, full of art in every sculpture, every display case, and every detail of its modern architecture.
![IMG_20260331_162903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242rygsenaetJLVfEqhs6b2xuQNgGF6FHwcnZfvYiH2sTYyigbuJpdf2cBy5MuHWqHKw2.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260331_155633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23yd1RS7Zdp6BLu4EVs1XmNZScEgK4Y6N4NNF1KCbS8bRkt4Sz6umFYD3xe83zqtzQmap.jpg) ![IMG_20260331_160148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uFTh9n8m9XkYA74v9Q6JtrRyCakZvmuLoNnoC5f5P24MyXXu9BpT3rTbuCAU88RNxvE.jpg)
The geometry of its architecture fascinates me! And although the walls and ceiling are white, there's so much vibrant color provided by the art in the stained-glass windows. This church is a home for my family and me, and I always have the joy of being able to wander through every corner, as it has been a place of music for the five of us. In fact, the day I took these pictures was because we were making music again, more my mom than me, but anyway, we were in the musicians' box, up at the back, where the magic flows and spreads throughout the entire space...
![IMG_20260331_163707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tveSzgFTSGx7cUuBVy6BTatxX1CgzcYi6qUto4gf19yArpSNNDRhWckCV7dHJPai5nk.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260331_160323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wqnf2Fnbi8DY9eBMtboqEZnvxTd2F43PN1SK8YTVhvBUNaLWXdUuWSzgiF5Daoknswy.jpg) ![IMG_20260331_163257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wX7Z1E2d4vFnioAx7UJxKfjfKbAS439THmicex9fsF8VcF5K69kCjHBwVEoVwvyjo6T.jpg)
Although the church is a place where love and friendship should reign, many times when I go there what I need is peace and quiet for prayer and reflection, and I think this might be the only downside at Our Lady of the Assumption: everyone knows me. Everyone knows the musicians, all the groups that sing there. I even noticed that many people remembered me despite the years it's been since I've had a full musical performance, although I did sing at a wedding almost a year ago, but it was a private event. It's not a lack of manners, but if it's not the right time to make music, in this particular church I'd like to be invisible sometimes...
![IMG_20260331_163534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wqbczqR887Y6FxKbC9M2LAdGgrdNCbbzBqQfGhSfb2hLuhqXZ7PiwrXwKF5HbQovNdD.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260331_163632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242NisiCjZwE3YZ7toR7LUSzYDmcj5QAsrGKDAyg3Kx4VAVNF1d8wsbLZk2mg6BBrC4pR.jpg) ![IMG_20260331_164253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xVEmkxRW26ToAw9uWQZd6HJTtriKVx3iYJBLRvwr82cstJcANE5r16SsctGWFVWojuu.jpg)
This year marks my 13th year living in the capital. Thirteen years where I can only return to this church when I travel, and the strangest thing is that just a couple of weeks ago I finally found a place in Caracas that makes me feel at home. But all these years it hasn't been like this; the peace and spiritual connection that Our Lady of the Assumption gives me I haven't found anywhere else. Perhaps it's because I grew up here, or because this is where I have my best memories with my family and with God, I don't know. I only know that simply standing before this imposing church makes me happy.
![IMG_20260331_180203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wWrosgCYoKABSntS8J72DS8CyMSy56TYsDymqpwxku88ug1do6o9t5ZccpLisfv2Pzj.jpg)

> ![IMG_20260331_163608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xyR39zuccKLuWMDJZ7gvuRdb9QNJCgA4ntp6q61auCHEGsbodw1ddCkWLER4kpJwiZJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260331_180315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xVGvaFRin4bPFq4qh6JPovqgoU2XJyBwQX2MitTnxzBTawcCGYLpYscus7DYg7EjCBu.jpg)
Thank you for reading this post to the end, and I sincerely hope you enjoyed the photos. I'm not a professional, but I put a lot of love into capturing the beauty of a temple or nature. I also invite you to join this weekly Hive Phone Photo Contest; I'm sure you'll find it as fun as all of us who participate here do. Sending you a warm hug from afar 🙏
![IMG_20260331_180342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23x12vbxnebHvDRX7zXoLusRqy9H2EWPej31n9JZDqENJdRkddo5VooWNHx5vcWZfXP7a.jpg)

title.author: solorzanot

content.description:
Saludos a los creadores de contenidos #hive, especialmente a la comunidad #espavlog. En esta oportunidad, les quiero mostrar un material videográfico grabado con mi teléfono Redmi A5, el día miércoles 15 de abril, en la U.E.N. Paula Correa de Zamora. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una experiencia que tuve la oportunidad de presenciar: el Museo Antropológico organizado por los estudiantes de 4to año de esta institución.

Greetings to the #hive content creators, especially to the #espavlog community. On this occasion, I want to show you some video footage recorded with my Redmi A5 phone on Wednesday, April 15, at the U.E.N. Paula Correa de Zamora. Today, I want to share with you an experience I had the opportunity to witness: the Anthropological Museum organized by the 4th-year students of this institution.

Al llegar, me quedé impresionado por la dedicación y el compromiso de los muchachos. No era solo una exposición, era un viaje en el tiempo. Desde el primer momento, se notaba el esfuerzo puesto en cada detalle, desde las maquetas que representaban la evolución humana —explicando con claridad teorías antropológicas y especies clave como el Homo Habilis— hasta los espacios dedicados a nuestras descendencias indígenas.

Upon arriving, I was impressed by the dedication and commitment of the students. It wasn't just an exhibition; it was a journey back in time. From the very first moment, you could notice the effort put into every detail, from the models representing human evolution—clearly explaining anthropological theories and key species like the Homo Habilis—to the spaces dedicated to our indigenous descendants.

En el video que les comparto, podrán ver la pasión con la que los estudiantes explicaban cada sección. Fue gratificante observar maquetas tan detalladas sobre viviendas ancestrales como los shabonos y bohíos, además de la excelente labor al recrear hallazgos arqueológicos y herramientas de caza.

In the video I'm sharing with you, you will be able to see the passion with which the students explained each section. It was rewarding to observe such detailed models of ancestral dwellings like shabonos and bohíos, in addition to the excellent work in recreating archaeological findings and hunting tools.

Es vital que nuestros jóvenes se conecten con su historia, y ver cómo explicaban con propiedad las culturas Arawak, Caribe y Timotocuica, junto con sus tradiciones y gastronomía, me hizo sentir muy orgulloso de lo que se está logrando en las aulas de nuestro querido Villa de Cura.

It is vital for our youth to connect with their history, and seeing them explain the Arawak, Caribe, and Timotocuica cultures with such ownership, along with their traditions and gastronomy, made me feel very proud of what is being achieved in the classrooms of our beloved Villa de Cura.

La creatividad, el uso de materiales reciclados y la puesta en escena con vestimentas temáticas demostraron que, cuando hay voluntad y guía docente, el aprendizaje se vuelve una experiencia inolvidable.

The creativity, the use of recycled materials, and the staging with thematic costumes demonstrated that, when there is will and teaching guidance, learning becomes an unforgettable experience.

Espero que disfruten tanto como yo este recorrido visual por nuestro pasado antropológico. Gracias por leer mi post y ver mi video. Se despide su amigo @solorzanot.

I hope you enjoy this visual tour of our anthropological past as much as I did. Thanks for reading my post and watching my video. Your friend @solorzanot signs off.

json_metadata.body:
>

La decoración de fiestas infantiles o de mesas para celebraciones infantiles es maravillosa, divertida y muy versátil. En mi experiencia como mamá, siempre disfruté mucho decorar los Cumpleaños de mis hijos, con sus personajes favoritos de ese momento. Es muy gratificante ver la emoción de los niños cuando aprecian los pequeños detalles personalizados, son esos pequeños momentos que siempre van a recordar. Hoy en día los personajes favoritos se han ampliado, ya que incluso pueden ser personajes de películas, series, un artista o cantante, etc. Estoy preparando un set completo de las K-Pop Demon Hunter para niñas, y para niños una de Mundial de Futbol 2026, y les voy a compartir cada producto terminado, en mis publicaciones como una nueva línea de Creación de Contenido, como saben actualmente tengo en desarrollo una Colección de Packaging que seguiré emitiendo, ahora a la par de esta Colección Fiestas... Bienvenidos.

>

Decorating children's parties or tables for children's celebrations is wonderful, fun, and very versatile. In my experience as a mom, I've always enjoyed decorating my children's birthdays with their favorite characters at the time. It's so rewarding to see the children's excitement when they appreciate the little personalized details; those are the little moments they'll always remember. These days, favorite characters have expanded to include characters from movies, TV series, artists, singers, and more. I'm preparing a complete K-Pop Demon Hunter set for girls and a 2026 World Cup set for boys, and I'll be sharing each finished product in my posts as part of a new content creation line. As you know, I'm currently developing a Packaging Collection that I'll continue releasing alongside this Party Collection... Welcome!
