>

Para todos los productos que haré en la \

estaré utilizando mis recursos de las clases de Papelería Creativa que actualmente estoy haciendo, porque realmente quiero aprender y desarrollar esta línea, y es importante prepararse y hacer las inversiones que debamos hacer, para poder crecer y profesionalizarse en un área. \n \nPero... por supuesto que hay que darle nuestro \

y es por ello que cada plantilla que utilizo la modifico o personalizo, para hacerla diferente y especial. Siempre les daré algún tip personal, y todo se puede modificar, yo lo hago utilizando Canva Pro o Power Point.

>

For all the products I'll be making in the \

I'll be using resources from the Creative Stationery classes I'm currently taking. I really want to learn and develop this line of work, and it's important to prepare and make the necessary investments to grow and become a professional in this area.\n\nBut... of course, we have to add our \

to each project, which is why I modify or personalize each template I use to make it different and special. I'll always give you a personal tip, and everything can be modified. I do it using Canva Pro or PowerPoint.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xpRTwSAM8ZHBtQ6fBP9Uj15FgjAzt4zBGcmirFoieffvmfr4CijucUWDeNeZ3k5ptYz.png)

> * Plantilla Digital * Impresora * Papel fotográfico brillante de 180 gr * Tijera y cúter * Silicón líquido * Cartón * Acetato transparente * Cartulina Holográfica plateada * Cartulina blanca * Apps utilizadas en este producto: Canva Pro versión escritorio, y GEMINI AI para generar los fondos y presentar el producto.

> * Digital Template * Printer * 180gsm Glossy Photo Paper * Scissors and Craft Knife * Liquid Silicone * Cardboard * Clear Acetate * Silver Holographic Cardstock * White Cardstock * Apps used in this product: Canva Pro desktop version, and GEMINI AI to generate backgrounds and present the product.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wMz6AKy6eUxnHAfKCE2NP96e7FMsRR354RhGY38XDT7ABv61tmXf7caFam5PtBGuDCc.png)

>

El diseño de esta Caja para Golosina de las K-Pop Demon Hunter, consta de piezas distribuidas en 3 hojas. Yo las imprimí en mi impresora de \
y este dato es muy importante de configurar en la impresora para lograr que los colores, la nitidez y la apariencia destaquen.

>

This K-Pop Demon Hunter Candy Box design consists of pieces distributed across 3 sheets. I printed them on my inkjet printer in \

This setting is very important to configure in the printer to ensure the colors, sharpness, and overall appearance stand out.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EpLfbRHdBsURQZibnXzBjwHqZoeEdBG8sVmnZ7Bb9VH4hw1zoGdqp7yULsCiXSP38mX.png)

>

Recorté todos los elementos con tijera. Las piezas de la caja o carrito los recorté por sus marcas, y las figuras las recorté dejando un borde blanca tipo sticker.

>

I cut out all the elements with scissors. I cut out the pieces of the box or cart along their markings, and I cut out the figures leaving a white sticker-like border.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EoeFM3Mqmifx2jRJD94ArzdjTYY4Yay8jBaXgRvkGhxihdWjK5GuSYwiTJJqUJsZaYA.png)

>

Las piezas de la caja o carrito de golosinas se marcan con un punzón y regla, para doblar todas las solapas que funcionan para armar el diseño, y también las partes que van a doblar por el tema de estructura.

>

The pieces of the candy box or cart are marked with an awl and ruler, to fold all the flaps that work to assemble the design, and also the parts that will be folded for structural reasons.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23u67PAwR879pQhRThHgYVJWbb5ibCRKo4zakW9sVYNirjshY1xz7tHyz5GCmxAJKLEkp.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xehwpRNRQC8B6HRopo2fpYXzcd8UJ56wAPbJfEFsU6BStpAKcvyAGfb5FxUFTTuNzki.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wCBeE6v4in1gX79MAtRCu6PX1tr3X5NUSaZF4gPWXBwn2cCAWYupW9WBYZkaMiEiutk.png)| |-|-|-|

>

Una vez marcadas se procede a doblarlas. Es importante ir interpretando el diseño muy bien en caso de que sea la primera vez que se utiliza una plantilla.

>

Once marked, proceed to fold them. It's important to carefully interpret the design if it's your first time using a template.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgTrPfkQXtEa6iTjLB8j68c9xjAryQDfYLLN15Pzve6UUvZFULyyWTYbCNSLdaXrBr9.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xyV44yzDkYRjRcfFd3SCmQBEVhZeuc4cLdFPW88G5sdUL2Goe99HCTgrU4tYrHiXKxs.png)| |-|-|

>

En el diseño de esta caja o carrito para golosinas, las piezas llevan unas ventanas que deben cortarse para que funcionen como visor, en este caso es más fácil cortar con cúter y regla.

>

In the design of this candy box or cart, the pieces have windows that must be cut to function as a viewfinder; in this case, it is easier to cut with a cutter and ruler.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xAZu7Ksr6DrnvQeBpZrkzArzSiwXzzpxZ8ikDVVo6D9MGzHNoL3vsZUheyVq9P36koR.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tbyW4NTo2sWYBJXNseizkXGrDh2V1sySgCs2ig6HrFwyGiQWAXjtpbr4oTRnZFWq5Kn.png)| |-|-|

>

Ya tengo listas las piezas debidamente cortadas, marcadas y dobladas, para proceder al armado.

>

I already have the pieces properly cut, marked and folded, ready to proceed with assembly.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EoAbiJGDxPyXsUrhnfP2KviWypWVPZjSjosPoizqzGWzSgFMqBpqRMCdRvmKzhbNJ2Y.png)

>

Primero la estructura del carrito, que con una base con las 4 paredes con los espacios para los visores. En la parte interna se debe colocar un trozo de acetato un poco más grande que el visor, y pegar todo con silicón líquido.

>

First, the cart's structure, which consists of a base with four walls and spaces for the visors. Inside, a piece of acetate slightly larger than the visor should be placed, and everything should be glued in place with liquid silicone.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23u67LDwrx2R1aw9idmE45em58eSoZfGyPNgmB6S9JUKXbUpLYv7d9baPKkMaUMw8wS4M.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wqnMmeh6UVU15uZzZmYvhGeGMu4rY8kxKcsDJMWR3G4n3Qs48KQZzzj1N8VLLLxKRMV.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tmKbuhcYc66jJj2NXLUdUNJH9rjqg6hqfXSmn2KAe54ynT9oBAS4BnZmhBT1BUQRScs.png)| |-|-|-|

>

Toque Personal: Las ruedas de este carrito de golosinas son hermosas, y para darle más estructura le coloco cartón por la parte de atrás de las 4 ruedas. Luego, le coloqué cartulina blanca para tapar el cartón que puede verse muy feo en el diseño.

>

Personal Touch: The wheels on this candy cart are beautiful, and to give it more structure, I added cardboard to the back of all four wheels. Then, I covered the cardboard with white cardstock, which can look unsightly in the design.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vsSMfDJVfr2WdydfbJ6EsEcvqH87ZzLwDoBuZrPQmS2CW2aCr3ugzSmNuoVbQGCCrqS.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vi3hDvaPrLEqCfwsV45MQPSm6hgADfsunMGYymbXiHT9S5cf7LGqeMxuaZ8mcEgvxq3.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xVLyJb5vmC7YMpvLA8yyLjg1hGjkvP95BoD3Q2yg1LAP7sZzpJxP1dL8EoR6nKZA1EB.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23w2oQVSTveAXrtDZK8wRgAnxrmzUJ3XnGVNJBvoWLpqMigKBrgwg4goyGi5qUu7pso56.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Como toque personal: Los personajes o ilustraciones los corté con un borde blanco que simula el efecto sticker, y adicionalmente los pego sobre cartulina holográfica plateada dejando un borde nuevamente. Este detalle le aporta más interés al diseño, ya que cuando le da la luz se aprecian los diferentes colores y esto le da más dimensión y se ve más divertido todo.

>

As a personal touch: I cut out the characters or illustrations with a white border to create a sticker effect, and then glued them onto silver holographic cardstock, again leaving a border. This detail adds interest to the design, because when the light hits it, the different colors are visible, giving it more dimension and making it look more fun.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wMVy2DgrSTVmQuTjHeP6TFgGoMkPz7DBjJqQdPX97pLMH1QuTSqtg9iTNgZcdxVxVcc.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgPqapwnWSHaFYM4PKZgpVCxLpqoMNMDb14wb3sJcnJ9LH66jXyPX7AfkopY6KXkPRK.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uQrDMiaXUhtkE9WhTWot7Q1XsXoEtYQxKAgouq6M3niQdJBZ88tZRsLuaTryvZBnYgT.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tSUEUthtqQpnTFNSKUN4QV89o3s8fTdKrDG5QibXgGAse6NgXZj5ZhME3fCSWeWuVeM.png)| |-|-|-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23ydNv3XwaefvmAhS3eu8unA7CLLXTqKV8fbX8yL65rFLuFwE8haLnDQFnAR3F5P2sy9N.png)

>

Ahora se pegan las ruedas y todas las figuras al rededor del carrito de golosinas, en la disposición que mas nos guste. Y también se puede agregar cualquier otro aplique que deseemos, por ejemplo en este diseño incorporé estas estrellas que venían en otro proyecto, así que la decoración es totalmente personal.

>

Now glue the wheels and all the figures around the candy cart, in whatever arrangement you like. You can also add any other embellishments you want; for example, in this design I incorporated these stars that came with another project, so the decoration is entirely up to you.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tvibYUnd3WEdf4siYfAHy6yEKbCZrWf2uoqxhHZ8qwjhRg74GdYoXfJq17Cejm872KY.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23u67B3juk5V9TwJrcLD9G8XR3dyfxxZZqzv8HDb1T1cDNHZ5ahyfVtb3SrKaC5XUv8cG.png)| |-|-| ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xf5BRMLqMyoDEYzKKD9CNY8jhwsjWde5XuTExeZvHKHdRrRForqHedygJKL21HrVeY9.png)

>

Para visualizar cómo se vería una mesa de Cumpleaños con la temática de K-Pop Demon Hunter, utilicé GEMINI AI, para generar un fondo, especificando en mi PROMPT el mantel, los bocadillos, el pastel, globos, fondo y todo lo que consideré necesario para presentarle mi producto, la Caja Carrito para Golosinas, que acompaña muy bien todo el concepto.

>

To visualize what a K-Pop Demon Hunter themed birthday table would look like, I used GEMINI AI to generate a background, specifying in my prompt the tablecloth, snacks, cake, balloons, backdrop, and everything I considered necessary to present my product, the Candy Cart Box, which perfectly complements the entire concept.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vi878CYnGtzfuEdFr21Y3nudoPrM7UBriydG84R9vGWJCFXJ4iLjUuKKUwmZtDo1vft.png)

>

Otra forma de utilizar este producto es como Caja de Obsequio para los Invitados de la Fiesta, en este sentido se deben hacer tantos como necesitamos, llenarlos de golosinas, y aprovechar para decorar la mesa también, ya que se ve precioso. La siguiente imagen también la generé con GEMINI AI, para presentarles mi producto y el concepto de la fiesta.

>

Another way to use this product is as a party favor box for your guests. Make as many as you need, fill them with treats, and use them to decorate the table as well, since they look lovely. The following image was also created with Gemini AI to showcase my product and the party concept.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tmSJxLmcsTSATKU8JdiowYRPhE9QKFntbznY4eG6HshESq6xvnaUCDv1gJvCy8nffrX.png)

con la temática de K-Pop Demon Hunter, toda la paleta de colores es muy llamativa y tierna, y tiene muchos personajes. Incluso para incluir a los niños en esta temática se puede aprovechar los personajes masculinos de la película, o los divertidos animalitos que forman parte de la historia. Deseo que les guste esta Creación de Contenido sobre Fiestas, yo estoy muy emocionada de ver crecer cada temática y de compartirlo con Uds. Nos leemos en la siguiente publicación.

>

I absolutely loved this first product in the \

with the K-Pop Demon Hunter theme. The whole color palette is so vibrant and cute, and it features so many characters. You can even include boys in this theme by using the male characters from the movie or the fun little animals that are part of the story. I hope you enjoy this Party Content Creation. I'm so excited to see each theme grow and to share it with you. See you in the next post!

json_metadata.title: A simple day, a delicious breakfast, some walking and relaxation!/ ¡Un día sencillo, un desayuno delicioso, un paseo y relax!
json_metadata.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaympbDej7fwAJnSN5LCKMEiJ9ReBeZu8ZL7jcrS7smko/1776711394419.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? How was your Monday? Mine was a bit busy with various errands, but I also had some joys. This morning I woke up and was able to enjoy some delicacies that my sister gave us yesterday. They come from one of my favorite local bakeries, Pasticceria Elisir, which makes excellent desserts, cakes, and biscuits. Obviously, this morning I only ate one pastry and my husband two, saving some for this evening. They were obviously delicious, a good way to start Monday. Then we had to go out to do various things: laundry, grocery shopping, various purchases, the pharmacy, and a whole series of things that had piled up to do. Luckily, the weather was nice in the morning, and I enjoyed a bit of sunshine; I needed some nice weather.

> Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? ¿Qué tal su lunes? El mío fue un poco ajetreado con varios recados, pero también tuve algunos momentos agradables. Esta mañana me desperté y pude disfrutar de unas delicias que mi hermana nos trajo ayer. Son de una de mis pastelerías locales favoritas, Pasticceria Elisir, que hace postres, pasteles y galletas excelentes. Obviamente, esta mañana solo comí un pastelito y mi esposo dos, guardando algunos para esta noche. Obviamente estaban deliciosos, una buena manera de empezar el lunes. Luego tuvimos que salir a hacer varias cosas: lavar la ropa, hacer la compra, varias compras, ir a la farmacia y un montón de cosas que se habían acumulado. Por suerte, el tiempo estuvo agradable por la mañana y disfruté un poco del sol; necesitaba un poco de buen tiempo.

Afterwards, we took a stroll through the countryside. It was a simple stroll because the weather was getting darker (the weather here is always crazier, hot and then cold), but at least we enjoyed the view of the Pistoia countryside, which is always beautiful. And of course, to end the day, we relaxed: a delicious dinner that I'll definitely share on the blog tomorrow, and then some TV and the sofa. In the evening, this is our routine now; we're no longer young enough to go out often! Or, let's just say, both my husband and I are a bit of a couch potato. See you soon, blog friends! And goodnight!

> Después, dimos un paseo por el campo. Fue un paseo tranquilo porque el tiempo empezaba a oscurecer (aquí el clima siempre es muy variable, de calor a frío), pero al menos disfrutamos de las vistas de la campiña de Pistoia, que siempre es preciosa. Y, por supuesto, para terminar el día, nos relajamos: una cena deliciosa que sin duda compartiré mañana en el blog, y luego un poco de tele y el sofá. Por las noches, esta es nuestra rutina ahora; ¡ya no somos tan jóvenes como para salir a menudo! O, digamos que tanto mi marido como yo somos un poco adictos al sofá. ¡Hasta pronto, amigos del blog! ¡Y buenas noches!

json_metadata.body:
The picture below is a stool from my mum. Even though the emphasis is on the shadow, the stool holds a story.

The stool is more than 18 years old, older than our youngest brother who was born around 2009. What is striking about it isn't the age but how strong it still looks, and this draws my attention to the quality of wood that was used in making it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW6vfJFkd6fiSp6ZyKqzx4eMAxaBDZaArZTGp999UZUgJ/1776717248692.jpg)

There are many chairs that were bought before it, made with wood, but most of them are broken and beyond repair, and some have been used as firewood. But here the giant of ancient times stands strong with no sign of spoil.

Below is the security of the house, taking a nap when he should be roaming the house looking for intruders. Haha! The dog was gifted to us early this year and is growing fast and already comfortable with everyone in the house.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyuz1M6JxxTdvURQfQ3hDp4n4FMg8BCCUczNNvSVpguT/1776717248756.jpg)

Even though it's sleeping, its senses are still active. It wakes immediately when someone crosses its path.

The picture was taken at night. The electric bulb was the source of illumination that cast shadows in the two images. An Android phone (Redmi Note 13) was used to capture the images.

**The stool is the main image for the contest**

json_metadata.title: Taking advantage of every opportunity to photograph the different plants he observed while going to work
json_metadata.body: > Last Saturday, my uncle and I went out to do some refrigeration work. In this case, it involved replacing the burnt-out compressor with a new one, refilling the refrigerant, and changing the filter. But that wasn't the most striking thing I saw on the property, especially at the house. We were literally at the foot of the hill, or even a little higher up, as you can see in the main photo of my post. There are practically no basic services there, just electricity and no running water. When I went out to the yard, I found some very beautiful plants. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCpLmSaNu1DhUrNxPmTNBXqDMaJTurTkbMb3DHGmE9i4/1776718130098.jpg) To give you an idea of ​​what I'm talking about, here are some photos of this lemon tree. It's clear that despite the limited water available, they're making the most of it to grow like this. Of course, it's still growing, and I didn't get too close to see it better, but I didn't see any fruit yet, although I'm sure it will soon. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeE8SBYX5HGrZwEUehDwLqRYDr8rtM1yKRwwMCs6zee15/1776718158687.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZneTJeZCw5r2tJ251ytC5KPKWj5MDa1d1T3geijd9unk/1776718159028.jpg) Just below it, arranged in a circle, were tomato and papaya plants. These were undoubtedly planted there to maximize water absorption, and when the lemon tree is watered, the others also benefit. However, once the papaya plants grow larger, they will need to be moved to another location, as they will eventually compete with the other plants, which won't be beneficial to any of them, and they will grow larger than the lemon trees. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSw3rwWZ8aoopHFoXofDLhSheEadjXshxqkzicKr7oB3s/1776718195954.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbWuc9VgvRSEPYKrAmEmxwo5ZCaS3NuhFNnhzpkrs2rKb/1776718196489.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX9TbRs5moZ9psJ7Etsz7o19Vh8uCQinYQjh4BmTo3mUd/1776718196840.jpg) In one corner of the house, almost hidden perhaps to protect it from the sun's rays, was a spinach plant that is growing very well. Its proximity to the wall that divides this property from the neighbor's will also aid its development. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNWX6R9CStobRBGLXFTrXNgDcQ1i8fPATnHDYGVYcdBsV/1776718233712.jpg) This concludes my small contribution to the #hivegarden community, where I try to share photos of my work. Since we have the opportunity to visit different homes, I can observe how each person takes advantage of and maximizes the potential of their land, and also how they manage irrigation when they don't have enough water.

json_metadata.title: New Fear Unlocked and New Respect Too
json_metadata.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_4982.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23w2mQLb3zhQdYqZwyFah7FHTjCLr8gVeRpd8xr8F4eyXsEj6GtQspHKK1NrnDGF1w6Wn.jpeg)

I honestly don’t know what I clicked or what I searched, or which wrong turn I took on the internet but somehow, my entire feed is now flooded with birth videos. On every social app, almost every scroll, and I am not okay.

I mean, I understand it. I do. Birth is a beautiful thing. It’s natural, it’s powerful. It’s basically life entering the world in its rawest form. But the process? Oh my goodness. It has traumatized me.

I don’t anyone really prepares you for it, certainly not like this or in full detail. Not with the sounds, the strain, and the intensity written all over the women’s face I have seen, as she pushes life into existence.

I have watched, rather unintentionally, as women scream, breathe through pain, hold onto something for dear life, their bodies doing something so powerful and yet so overwhelming.

Then there’s me, who just sits there, staring at my screen and asking myself is this really what we all signed up for? ‘cause it makes my heart race. It makes me uncomfortable and scared.

And I know, I know it’s not all pain. There’s joy at the end of it, there’s relief and also that beautiful moment when the baby arrives and everything shifts. I’ve seen that part too. But right now? My mind has refused to move on from the process which brings me to my new level of respect, noreverence, for women especially mothers. Because that? That is not a small thing and it certainly is not just something women do. It is strength in its most physical, emotional, and terrifying form.

And it also made me think about women who choose to be surrogates. Because wow. To willingly go through that, not just for yourself, but for someone else is a kind of selflessness that deserves its own kind of applause.

![IMG_4981.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23yU4gVE1VaWuqu1N4jnaphuvHBqMxDF9BsWVEknP4zrk3pWfTajmzKdd2hAaxoh1ofjm.jpeg)

They are out here making the world softer for women like me, women who, at least right now, are absolutely not ready for that journey.

Maybe one day, I’ll feel differently. Maybe when I’m ready, when it’s my time, when I’ve built the courage to face it. But for now, with the images still fresh in my mind? I want no parts. 

I’ll just sit here, quietly appreciating every mother, every woman who has gone through that process and came out on the other side for truly that is not an easy thing to do. Not even close.

And if nothing else, this accidental deep dive into that side(air quote) of the internet has taught me that women are unbelievably strong. And I will never, ever take that lightly again. 

<sup>[img](https://pixabay.com/photos/beach-motherhood-love-mother-son-4182974/)</sup>

<sup>[thumbnail](https://pixabay.com/photos/mother-family-love-son-child-boy-7457962/)</sup>

json_metadata.title: I Move Regardless. LOH #285
json_metadata.body:
I can't really pinpoint why, but at a point in my journey of life I actually stopped asking or worrying s out what exactly my purpose was/is. Maybe it felt too bih, hard to too tricky for me. And I say that because it feels like there's a particular thing that is needs to be done by me, or likes there's a particular place I'm supposed to be at point in time... I hope I'm making sense..like something that will just make everything suddenly fall into place.



![1000216857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2oQTooJXcTZZRQYUw9TfjZJApLSdpQFneG8gUCwf4UzMtnWQ69b11L5kDg5aDD2CUG.jpg)




And like I said earlier, I don't really know. Because I haven't seen any of that yet. But I know of those days that I only do little could not because didn't want to do more, but because life itself has already done enough. And I will just stay there as the time passes wishing I could push harder.



Some few years ago, I was just getting back on my feet then. I remember my dad came to my room that day to encourage me and advise me about certain things, while using some of his own experience to buttress his points, and I'm still grateful of that till today. But he ended that conversation that day with a question.


*\

* He asked.

That was the exact question he asked me. And in all honesty, I wasn't expecting it, I didn't even have an answer for it. But just so to not drag the topic further, I remembered I told him something which I can't vene recall anymore now. But that question stayed with me longer than anything I can remember.



Even though I'm doing some stuff at the moment, like tending to the needs of others I'm every little way I could, while also planning towards a business of mine and various things... Things too much to mention, things to get are big and deep, things that even I wonder how it will be.




![1000201542.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xKxw1NDz9B9yKTpWFuPqoRSAzNX2ZphdBBBCB5e92qVRBED1chjEW3MJ1VguejJHT7X.jpg)




But even with how weighty and big it all seems, I don't wake up each day thinking much about it, but what I've been doing is to not go a day without doing something. I make sure not to waste a single day. Even if it's just one thing I'm able to do, so far it's not too stressful. Even if it's just a little opportunity to make money that shows up, I grab it ASAP so far it won't break me. And if it's to be of help too, I do so while putting myself in check too. So, as far as I'm making a little bit of progress, it's enough for me.



It doesn't sound big or serious right, well that's just it for me. Just a simple kind of life, but one aimed at progressing and never going backwards.... that's it for me, and it's enough to keep me going.

So, I move regardless...even if it's just a little movement forward....I move.





🌹

--- Happy start to the week! Another month is almost over—it’s crazy to think that just a short while ago we were welcoming April, and now we’re already saying goodbye to it. Well, that’s life—it flies by like a swift arrow, passing so quickly that we don’t even see it coming. Last week I set myself a challenge. To be honest, I didn’t think I’d be able to pull it off with everything else going on, but I’m glad I did. Sharing and trying out new recipes has been a truly rewarding experience—full of flavor, special ingredients, improving old recipes, and finding the balance between texture and smoothness. Cooking is definitely an art form, one that requires a lot of time, dedication, and creativity, but above all, a good sense of seasoning. My mother is the epitome of that seasoning—I undoubtedly inherited it from her.

json_metadata.title: (ENG/ESP) 🎨📚✍️ Creating bookmarks with inspirational quotes / Elaborando marca libros con frases inspiradoras 🎨📚✍️
json_metadata.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to everyone in this community, craft lovers, especially those who love recycling! I was thinking about making thank-you cards for my customers at the bazaars, and after thinking about it for a bit, it occurred to me that the best thing to do was make bookmarks. I had previously made some for my sister with Kraft paper, and I was quite pleased with how they turned out. However, unlike those projects where I used drawings, this time I decided to use collage, since I had some magazines lying around and I'm feeling creative in that area (not to mention it would have taken me longer if I'd tried drawing, haha).
![1000401990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xpKSTFovLmS1qjiUiSbL8tAY8m7St6DWERYn7cTP8Z4FRqriSumzPHyPnhGuaKCRe1K.jpg)

The first thing I did was cut out the words and phrases that caught my eye from the magazines. Then, I started going through them to see if I could put them into sentences. It was a fun process, because I felt like I was putting together a puzzle, haha. To make sure I didn't forget them, I wrote them down. I didn't need to have the whole sentence cut out; just one or two words were enough, and then I filled in the rest with a marker. For the \

of the bookmark, I used construction paper, cutting out rectangles that were 6cm x 20cm.
![1000398184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1JtLZruZNrbUD2qETJvVYd1eJXoCaPzerPG69c2LyduzZU4vrPXBQcG8JhvpzXVp.jpg)
Since I already had the phrases written on paper, the process was much easier. Basically, I glued the cut-out words on with white glue first, and then I wrote the rest in pencil to complete the sentences, just to avoid mistakes, haha. I think it was a good decision not to use cut-out words for everything, since the workspace was very small and it would have ended up looking cluttered. In addition, I also glued on some figures or images that complemented the message, as decoration.
|![1000398185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tve5sMdyd4znnRWWLJMGEFWYkDPPbjWgSmCadmVVYECMC6SstikwhWoYR2fXaNPR4FY.jpg)|![1000398230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23u65CNyFFkYbTzficyCTVwBtAGFdENxcXxUjQ4Y4j4xRhA7cHh1uN6YLXUo8jWqfiZNR.jpg)| |-|-|
Once that was done, I used the markers. I outlined the words I had previously written in pencil with black ink, and then used the colored markers to add some more decoration.
|![1000398241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tvebDvYBTgZDE7KhEQdi2gTRyZvwNZEfdaWpnb8RMSZqhXSQZ54FMDiKsYeimNQDddE.jpg)|![1000401954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoAajH1LPfFayDBymMrBNLFCZw2REbojKNKiRbmogQ3hWtqa8DLCDZrrwRvNkyg1744.jpg)| |-|-|
I could have left them as they were, but they seemed too plain. So, I decided to glue small pieces of fabric to the edges, and for that, I used liquid silicone, which is a stronger adhesive for this type of material. I let the fabric dry and then applied a coat of water-based gloss to protect the paper a bit. Although, they would also look great using contact paper or even laminating them! They would look fantastic laminated! Maybe I'll make them that way in the future.
|![1000398247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoeEsrbfRVyxTMAo8k1XvMBqw7Ds8vABSqxFB24YK3oAJu9m4YxtNsJv4fVLUb7pYHq.jpg)|![1000399267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EonkZDWmg21nzJhcBwRyYWfNzLhvwuSG8WMddxSpmjm5H1jSmJPVDoR5nq7m9Zde7nX.jpg)| |-|-|
Finally, I decided to add a strip to the top of each bookmark so they could be found more easily. I had thought about using yarn (I have several colors in my workshop), but since I didn't have any where I was, well... I had to improvise. So, I ended up using strips of fabric, which I braided. Very carefully, I made a small opening in the cardstock and threaded the braids through it. Finally, I glued a small piece of cardstock to the back of the bookmarks to secure the braids and give them some firmness. As you can imagine, I used craft glue for this step.
|![1000399289.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoErSz5w72feJxnYbMu5bENo1X3sqDNGX7dDeq5T2zbcWh7uBaH6YU8QcCr2nfXv4AL.jpg)|![1000399291.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EowH7UBXEZ8gdkhhgYwLp7LdKa8qGVh3pFDfdjBJABi7QTPYQ84NyXhfXeKgeBUnExr.jpg)|![1000399300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpC9zfBN1ooU2Rm6GqsdhvGQKt29Dgv2GUsmyEUVYDncoYBjywh71mLPMbq4VhTzR5L.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000399301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EopsVDZC5ZuSotQF4QpnHVB4bAsnYPVc59tMgPQtRMaxHSJHk6NNxLJ7RoHvPWtM1Xg.jpg)|![1000399302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eokd4TjC7FTt7u4ma7eYPnYu587d2HZmEtnJfX9NtjnUY5tgZ6Zc77veLZKiVgoawT1.jpg)|![1000399303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EogMqiXBzKySQ76pp1LtxVX5rkWFxfnQffssYFRR9jDY2GhUDYirFQiPCTn9zakiQXs.jpg)|![1000401955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2m8Jmm6dGPxWRD532ojpMug5CF8jjCsYTEwKAVxJNhmcTHiZqqSrDMwGtpnJPKc733.jpg)| |-|-|-|-|
And just like that, the bookmarks were ready! 📚✨ I was only going to make a few, but I got so inspired that I ended up making a dozen. The best part is that I even had some words left over to use on future bookmarks or for any collage I want to make.
![1000400057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVKF3orNxesYko8yVDUpFQ1SLy1VYFWFQ6kheXLdTn7nAh4trPLBSbwMRHmcfukN2SZ.jpg)
As you can see, it's an easy, quick, and cute project that makes a great gift for a book lover. We can even personalize them by adding the person's name or things that remind us of them. At the bazaar, a customer told me, \

#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad, amantes de las manualidades, sobre todo del reciclaje! Estaba pensando en realizar unas tarjetas de agradecimiento para mis compradores durante mi asistencia a bazares y luego de pensar un poco, se me ocurrió que lo mejor, era hacer unos marca libros. Anteriormente, había realizado unos para mi hermana con papel Kraft y el resultado me gustó bastante. Sólo que a diferencia de en esos casos, que hice dibujos, en esta ocasión pensé en utilizar la técnica de collage, ya que tenía algunas revistas y ando creativa en ese aspecto (sin mencionar que me iba a tardar más si me ponía a hacer dibujos jaja).
![1000401990.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xpKSTFovLmS1qjiUiSbL8tAY8m7St6DWERYn7cTP8Z4FRqriSumzPHyPnhGuaKCRe1K.jpg)

Lo primero que hice, fue recortar las palabras y frases que más me llamasen la atención de las revistas. Luego, comencé a revisar las mismas y ver si podía armar oraciones. Fue un proceso divertido, pues me sentía como armando un rompecabezas jaja Para que no se me olvidaran, las iba anotando. No era necesario tener toda la frase en recortes, bastaba con una que otra palabra y luego, completar el resto a marcador. En el caso de la \

del marca libros, utilicé cartulina escolar, recortando unos rectángulos de 6cmx20cm.
![1000398184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1JtLZruZNrbUD2qETJvVYd1eJXoCaPzerPG69c2LyduzZU4vrPXBQcG8JhvpzXVp.jpg)
Como ya tenía las frases escritas en papel, se me hizo más sencillo el proceso. Básicamente pegué con pegamento blanco primero las palabras que tenía recortadas y las que hacían falta para completar la oración, las escribía primero con lápiz, para no equivocarme jaja. Creo que fue una buena decisión no hacerlo todo con palabras recortadas, ya que el espacio de trabajo era muy pequeño y acabaría viéndose \

. Adicional a ello, también pegué algunas figuras o imágenes que fueran a la par con el mensaje, a modo de decoración.
|![1000398185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tve5sMdyd4znnRWWLJMGEFWYkDPPbjWgSmCadmVVYECMC6SstikwhWoYR2fXaNPR4FY.jpg)|![1000398230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23u65CNyFFkYbTzficyCTVwBtAGFdENxcXxUjQ4Y4j4xRhA7cHh1uN6YLXUo8jWqfiZNR.jpg)| |-|-|
Una vez hecho esto, utilicé los marcadores. Delineé con color negro, las palabras que anteriormente había escrito con lápiz y con los marcadores de colores, me encargué de decorar un poco más.
|![1000398241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tvebDvYBTgZDE7KhEQdi2gTRyZvwNZEfdaWpnb8RMSZqhXSQZ54FMDiKsYeimNQDddE.jpg)|![1000401954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoAajH1LPfFayDBymMrBNLFCZw2REbojKNKiRbmogQ3hWtqa8DLCDZrrwRvNkyg1744.jpg)| |-|-|
Pude haberlos dejado así, pero se me hacían simples. Por lo que, se me ocurrió pegarle trocitos de telas en los bordes y para ello, utilicé silicón líquido, el cual es un pegamento de mayor fijación para éste tipo de material. Dejé que secara la tela y seguido, les coloqué una capa de brillo a base de agua, con la finalidad de proteger un poco el papel. Aunque, también quedaría genial usar papel Contac o de plano, plastificarlo ¡Se verían fenomenal plastificados! Tal vez en un futuro, pueda hacerlos.
|![1000398247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoeEsrbfRVyxTMAo8k1XvMBqw7Ds8vABSqxFB24YK3oAJu9m4YxtNsJv4fVLUb7pYHq.jpg)|![1000399267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EonkZDWmg21nzJhcBwRyYWfNzLhvwuSG8WMddxSpmjm5H1jSmJPVDoR5nq7m9Zde7nX.jpg)| |-|-|
Para terminar, se me ocurrió colocarles alguna tira en la parte superior, con la finalidad de que pudiesen ser localizados más rápido. Había pensado en usar estambre para ello (en mi taller tengo varios de colores), pero como no tenía nada de eso en dónde me encuentro, pues.. tocaba improvisar. De ese modo, acabé utilizando tiras de tela con las cuales, hice unas trenzas. Con mucho cuidado, hice una pequeña abertura en la cartulina y por allí, introduje las trenzas. Finalmente, les pegué un trocito de cartulina en la parte trasera de los marca libros, para fijar las trenzas y darle firmeza. Como es de imaginarse, usé el silicón frío para éste paso.
|![1000399289.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoErSz5w72feJxnYbMu5bENo1X3sqDNGX7dDeq5T2zbcWh7uBaH6YU8QcCr2nfXv4AL.jpg)|![1000399291.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EowH7UBXEZ8gdkhhgYwLp7LdKa8qGVh3pFDfdjBJABi7QTPYQ84NyXhfXeKgeBUnExr.jpg)|![1000399300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpC9zfBN1ooU2Rm6GqsdhvGQKt29Dgv2GUsmyEUVYDncoYBjywh71mLPMbq4VhTzR5L.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![1000399301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EopsVDZC5ZuSotQF4QpnHVB4bAsnYPVc59tMgPQtRMaxHSJHk6NNxLJ7RoHvPWtM1Xg.jpg)|![1000399302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eokd4TjC7FTt7u4ma7eYPnYu587d2HZmEtnJfX9NtjnUY5tgZ6Zc77veLZKiVgoawT1.jpg)|![1000399303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EogMqiXBzKySQ76pp1LtxVX5rkWFxfnQffssYFRR9jDY2GhUDYirFQiPCTn9zakiQXs.jpg)|![1000401955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2m8Jmm6dGPxWRD532ojpMug5CF8jjCsYTEwKAVxJNhmcTHiZqqSrDMwGtpnJPKc733.jpg)| |-|-|-|-|
Y de esta forma, los marca libros, estuvieron listos 📚✨ Iba a hacer unos pocos y me inspiré tanto, que acabé realizando la docena. Lo mejor de todo, es que me quedaron algunas palabras para usarlas en próximos marca libros o para cualquier collage que desee realizar.
![1000400057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVKF3orNxesYko8yVDUpFQ1SLy1VYFWFQ6kheXLdTn7nAh4trPLBSbwMRHmcfukN2SZ.jpg)
Como pueden ver, se trata de un proyecto fácil, rápido y lindo que puede servir como un detalle para un amante de la lectura. Inclusive podemos hacerlos más personalizados y colocar el nombre de la persona o las cosas que nos recuerden a la misma. El día del bazar una clienta me dijo: \

... y eso me verificó que quedaron bien jaja En fin, ahora, procedo a mostrarles cómo se ven cada uno, junto a la frase, que podrán leer en el pie de cada fotografía 😉
|![1000400069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23uR163T1YchhTW2j8yi9U8G4cUcTdM5rsG8Y5czveZkZDjhp5X2YqN6cozGdAcBpCW67.jpg)|![1000400061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wMgkgzVgnhERDiws8zpPvB8kccn94RdjaQtatzByRXPqxiqtGUhHuUH5vMTWcJ55nPc.jpg)|![1000400066.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xAeRHxqwJKpn4pnf8nEZS97M3DE24xVqTvWh4beWhySGadyfycC3kbpCWADqRT2vdGh.jpg)| |-|-|-| |✨📚 *¿Por qué dudas de ti? ¡Si eres genial!* 📚✨|✨📚 *Haz de tus deseos un compromiso contigo mismo* 📚✨|✨📚 *Llena este año de los momentos realmente importantes para ti* 📚✨| |![1000400060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23uFc9rUsezMZBoA74RSPoiL3o1ANNHDCpgpCrFdjUqLCGk7rQyZYEKFKK2hmFMg5NpHK.jpg)|![1000400070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2wS6hY7Vs5aAvnwkCsnAZYqvmYrg3PLPsuEyJZjG2dHcfdC2Rh483ZmWhAJeB57M1x.jpg)|![1000400063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xepQS13dXrXgDsMBWLv3oAPvk6ADvdTeuiqSqtxVWrskoZaJgTDopvDPsfeQTZ37GTZ.jpg)| |-|-|-| |✨📚 *Vale la pena luchar por tus sueños* 📚✨|✨📚 *Nunca subestimes el poder de una sonrisa radiante* 📚✨|✨📚 *Ábrele las puertas a un nuevo comienzo* 📚✨| |![1000400064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgUJNfDBjZpbtmZFH6jchnLiMuzyGS557dpiRexLoAUePa7vviNnQWnu2BWepL6SzuL.jpg)|![1000400071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23x1HNQduFjd5a2f4f2davc5bDGnrGy2DihfaLm3r3fLwbYZWTFB7LXqejVeJT4i69EjS.jpg)|![1000400062.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wCJN8odWB6pdhkkuFGdDYp3v3nZneVpdmSBttYuYX4cWezQTe4PwhexAczH77kP1Gs9.jpg)| |-|-|-| |✨📚 *Respira. Todo saldrá bien* 📚✨|✨📚 *Ponte al día con tus sueños* 📚✨|✨📚 *El futuro está en tus manos ¡Créalo!* 📚✨| |![1000400068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xAeHUjCdATovPJsnbHUrLyzx7HNFDPbY4Rh7J5RFgzanLMagZEkYVfq5WjaRuDgf8ne.jpg)|![1000400065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23x1Hcmirb3Soky3ENqPEnVpUjmgT3SxEsRc3yuA7rRNWqj7MVavG3RhiYoWV9JhRwuD1.jpg)|![1000400067.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23y92B517L4KJ5ohsRf7G7kj2p9wRn8HWLRRZkXA7hZNGBaP1dSUm8aVfTCZVLnotiR56.jpg)| |-|-|-| |✨📚 *Sigue en búsqueda de tu bienestar y ten fé* 📚✨|✨📚 *Compartir tiempo contigo es mi actividad favorita* 📚✨|✨📚 *Un futuro más brillante llegará cuando pongas todo tu corazón* 📚✨|

json_metadata.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme26D4eGJuJJowmTLmeWvpzyfj5EbKeGCMY7gJFf6K5NC/image.png)

Today is also not about creativity and art. A little about work.
This is an alpha version of the document generator. You know, documents like official letters from an organization or something like that.
Yes, I understand that all of this can be done using Google Docs, Microsoft Office, or Libre Office.
But my task was to create a very primitive tool in which it was simply impossible to do anything wrong. So that it was impossible to mess up the formatting, move pictures, logos, and generally throw some garbage into the document.
A tool that doesn't require you to install anything, register anywhere, or pay for anything.
And it turns out that it is possible!

json_metadata.title: Create Your Own Free Music - 1 song in seconds!!!
json_metadata.body:
>


If you follow me or even if you don't but you have seen some of my articles then you probably know that I like to utilize Locally hosted AI as much as possible. There are numerous reasons for that but I won't bore you with all of that.

Because of my incessent desire to run all AI locally (well all that I can run locally on my current hardware anyways) I subscribe to a lot of differnet news/articles/media to stay up to date on all things Local AI. 1 of those is the ComfyUI Blog. And I get e-mail notifications everytime something new pops up in the ComfyUI world. You can also just view the blog here https://blog.comfy.org or add it to a daily AI roundup agent if you are so inclined.

---

The specific post we are going to talk about is this one titled: 

<center>
<strong>\
https://blog.comfy.org/p/ace-step-15-xl-commercial-grade-music#media-36b3b62a-a82d-4dd6-86c6-adaa7a5200e7 If you want to skip to me actually making a song, Head to the \

Header in this article towards the bottom. --- # Getting Everything Ready There are 3 different 'models' to pick from. I had to test all of them OBVIOUSLY 😉 - XL-Base — Most versatile, highest diversity. For maximum creative range. - XL-SFT — Peak audio quality, some loss in diversity. For clean final outputs. - XL-Turbo— 8 steps, ~6x faster, no CFG. For fast iteration. I have used all 3, and after my inital testing I like to stick to XL-SFT specifically. But your mileage may very. ## Key Highlights - Commercial-Grade Quality — Evaluation metrics place output between Suno v4.5 and v5, with 4B parameters delivering richer audio than the 2B predecessors - Ultra-Fast Generation — Under 2 seconds per full song on an A100, under 10 seconds on an RTX 3090. xl-turbo cuts inference to just 8 steps (~6x faster than base/sft) - Flexible Duration — Generate anything from 10-second loops to full 10-minute compositions - 1000+ Instruments and Styles — Fine-grained timbre description across a massive range of musical genres - 50+ Language Lyrics — Prompt with lyrics for structure and style control in over 50 languages - Commercially Licensed — MIT license, trained on licensed music, royalty-free/public domain, and synthetic MIDI-to-Audio data It states that it can generate a full song under 10 seconds on a RTX 3090. I have a RTX 5070TI so it should generate a song in 6-8 seconds, on paper at least. 
Assuming you already have ComfyUI installed and working...
Start your ComfyUI, if not already, and go to the 'Templates' section on the left hand menu. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23swi5kH2YTrLy3DxMkvENUpcpWGNtr141qTVC3g1Nv5sL9VVJo24i6CBiGv6jLMzCkaf.png Then search for \

dropdown menu defaulted to only show Locally Hosted options becuase I am not paying for tokens... 😉 https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tRveiNMa94CWrGiDSkUmx35mHQS3MrTHdAqiLT46J7RK3sgsNzVd6URuEEyFBhFNabt.png There are currently 4 Templates that we care about and they are all on the top row. Here they are: https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tkjvftcgTrtSwMjbvhd1TRQULtDCU18fM4xJ2Y8T7u6GjBnb6ddyZtNiNN25wtRKSED.png --- Here is what each one will look like when you first open them up. ## ACE Step v1 M2M Editing Edit exsisting songs to change style and lyrics using ACE Step v1 M2M. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/Eo1vWZdNsmkadizykYcgG9EvTF1aUfmZQVKUkkDwPri3byQcq1UuYqhEvnizgsjnSLy.png --- ## ACE-Step v1 Text to Instrumentals Generate Instrumental music from text prompts using ACE Step v1. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23swfuMSToXgtDiecEVkxzEva7Ls3hdqpn7oCUfowSnt1k87dBrxgzTD7aMZqrm7LEyTg.png --- ## ACE Step v1 Text to Song Generate songs with vocals from text prompts using ACE Step v1 https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/Eo1vVZ66Eyves6GTGH4cysaWSBgaARowTqJiFvHgQi3PNRfV8kHEx83L2rSQYkN7zHs.png --- ## Text to Song (New) Generate songs from text prompts using ACE Step v1. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23vhTvjKHhVWTarRo6AKCQq8WGnxSGhk2nDZSPim6zuyp1141DscTT2EuFVK66ihorz5s.png --- ## Manual Method Once you are familiar with ComfyUI you can just download the json files and get more indepth with your Local AI. But it is not for the faint of heart. https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/audio_ace_step1_5_xl_sft.json You could also just use it as another way to see which Models are used in workflows and download them directly from Hugging Face, if you like it that way! Models: Directory: \

,

But I won't get into that here. If you know how, then there is no point in me explaining it. And if you don't know.... go ask your AI how to do it.

Be just be careful downloading models willy nilly...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoATY75ZAyVA9APCE5rCZJwfPfpXmZ7F6BGZgyBKV2CCRXUh1LQs6qwnVrS73un2iRy.png

Because if you are not careful, it can quickly get out of hand haha

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tHZ9t61i9xRcXuF8qZMd2i598imJFQoYbi39kYm7QZoBrnWnthCJCfaonJhHUHRWVCn.png


























---

# Let's Create A Song!


For this walkthrough I am going to use the \

Template. ## Step 1: Generate the Lyrics You can do this a million ways. For this example I am asking my local 'gpt-oss:20b' model on Ollama to generate the lyrics for me. I just typed up a short (crappy) list of what the lyrics should be about. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tGZw7BeumBJiGPXeayKHA8RcnKEGdCBUo8BTNdsucwVbEZcngjAeu4cwXXhdxsYRVer.png After thinking for 18.8 seconds this is what it created for me. 
Title: “Hive High”

(Intro – short, upbeat synth riff)

Verse 1
Wake up, the sunrise is in the code,
I tap my phone, and the world is all my own.
From Steem’s spark to Hive’s blazing light,

We spin the stories, and we light the night.

Chorus

Verse 3
From the ashes of old, a new era was born,

So post your thoughts, engage with friends so wide,
HIVE flows like music, on a joyous ride.

Chorus
Hive’s on the rise, we’re reaching for the moon,

(Outro – a fade‑out of synths, a bright hook)

Hook (repeated) –
Hive, Hive, the future’s bright,
Hive, Hive, join the flight!
And now we put that into ComfyUI:

> I also changed the Conditioning to: 
anime opening, shonen anime, 90s rock, 90s pop rock, electric guitar, live drums, male vocals, powerful vocals, raw vocals, anthem, heroic, natural voice, no autotune
The best I could do was upload to Google Drive and then embedd the song here but you may have to click on the 'Listen on Google Drive' to listen to this song. And I will preface it with, it needs a LOT of work haha.

Listen to the track:
> Your browser does not support the audio element.

>Listen on Google Drive

But this post is just to show you how easy it is to create your own song locally with AI. Now granted it did take ~20 seconds to generate the song but still that is crazy that I can generate an entire song in under 30 seconds. I generated a quick video I put on repeat so you can see the video and song all in one.

json_metadata.title: Learning Through Mistakes in Bread Baking
json_metadata.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfKjzQRexTQug83Sxy4N3MndVtT914Ysxa82rS7Ce9wyd/d4b81de7_eb6d_4bfa_b636_358e396922e9.jpg)


I didn't intend to make a post, but this happened, so excuse me if there are not many photos... 

Some of the best things I discover and learn come from making mistakes. It has helped me become less afraid of errors, and because of that, I never hesitate to try new things or explore different methods. There is always something to learn in the process.

One example happened today while baking bread. When I first started learning, I followed recipes very closely but rarely got the results I wanted. I was aiming for soft, fluffy bread similar to shop-bought loaves that stay fresh longer. Over time after my experimentations and trial and error, I eventually achieved that result. I thought I had finally perfected it until I only realised one thing today that will make my bread-making even better.


I used my regular strong bread flour but I nearly forgot to add the yeast. I only realised after I had already kneaded the dough by hand for at least 20 minutes. I felt disappointed and thought I had wasted the flour.

To save it, I decided to dissolve the yeast in a small amount of water and worked it into the dough. I stretched and folded the dough many times. It was difficult at first, and I doubted it would spread evenly. I expected the batch to fail and had already started accepting that outcome.

However, after the first rise, the dough had more than doubled in just a short time. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcDoV5sfMQVohDQJRDHuje6WAwJMmD7ov16d6aKaFGBKh/8d3647b8_e78c_4a97_9553_f23520e22fb7.jpg)


When I began shaping it, it became so active that the surface started to puff up like a balloon within minutes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqBPfDB5dV7ZLegd3UYPKgt7P2Z9jaoXG6DEbKAQtS3x/bf6e46c0_e121_4a41_b662_2ea3c9938fd0.jpg)

Look at that! I’ve never seen a dough balloon so smooth!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRavzgybbhRrnKovjQhz31tG3yPzoXJCrgfZs1Pf9DnJ/fbd95a46_dc89_482b_ba87_aee2de6705e9.jpg)

I could see it popping as I shaped the dough balls.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUD5vMYReCKqR2zmU3vKa714AxxxLy6UwRABejUBXLfqA/e4a690f5_8d12_413d_8660_25e91f9d7697.jpg)

They were fun to watch as they got bigger and bigger but wouldn't pop!

I unknowingly used a stretch-and-fold technique to fully incorporate the yeast and make the gluten stronger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTgFmktWhP6rhBjcfc8qfCZftd5ZoTRC74EPGV5Ns1Q7T/7afb2f34_99d8_47ed_bcbe_4680da3cdead.jpg)

The surface of this dough springs back when you press on it.

Not only did it distribute the yeast properly, but it also strengthened the gluten structure. I usually only use stretch and fold for sourdough, but now I realise it also works very well for regular bread dough rather than just kneading. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMg1rUW5wSAFR3VFbb38QxShQY1GRZecYj96p9zqYbjT/4ed7011d_0a97_4f52_a299_d7f1152f4d00.jpg)

In the end, the result was soft, fluffy, and beautifully risen buns.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP59BADD9W8fU3PrAgoVfUM7VBkaxUNNPSdZfme2rMmbs/7f021b0a_c298_48ad_8780_a945be79532c.jpg)


I am really pleased with what I discovered today. If you are a baker, do you use stretch and fold in baking your regular bread or just for sourdough?

Have a lovely day.
Mariah👩‍🍳

json_metadata.title: Love Yourself Without Waiting For Validation From Anyone
json_metadata.body:
There comes a point in life when you begin to realize that the most important relationship you will ever have is the one you have with yourself. If you can truly understand who you are, your strengths, your limits, your emotions, and your needs, you unlock something powerful and that is the ability to love yourself without waiting for validation from anyone else.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSbUmYzXaDyB5FhPtwMS5YunoLWuRY4MD9rFZzvcbcXFb/1000205443.png 


[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/fashion-woman-retro-glamour-10232262/)

Too often, we place our worth in the hands of others. We wait for people to notice us, to appreciate us, to affirm us. We stretch ourselves thin trying to meet expectations that were never designed for us in the first place. But the truth is, no matter how hard you try, you can never fully satisfy everyone. And even if you come close, it will never feel like enough. There will always be another demand, another opinion, another silent judgment.

That kind of cycle is exhausting. You are human, You are not built to carry everything, fix everything, or please everyone. Sometimes, the exhaustion you feel doesn’t even come from physical work, rather it comes from overthinking, from emotional stress, from trying to be “enough” in the eyes of people who may never truly see you. Your mind can get tired. Your heart can get heavy. And pretending otherwise only makes it worse.

This is why self-understanding matters so much. When you understand yourself, you stop over-explaining your worth. You stop chasing approval. You begin to accept that your value is not measured by how much you do for others, but by who you are at your core.

Loving yourself is not about arrogance or selfishness, it’s about acceptance. It’s about knowing when to rest without guilt, when to say no without fear, and when to walk away from situations that drain you. It’s about believing in yourself even when no one else does, and standing firm in your truth regardless of outside noise
.
People will always have something to say. That will never change. But what can change is how much power you give to those voices. When you shift your focus inward, toward your growth, your peace, and your well-being that is when you begin to live differently. You begin to move with purpose, not pressure.

At the end of the day, you owe yourself understanding. You owe yourself patience. And most importantly, you owe yourself love. Because when you truly have that, you no longer need to chase it anywhere else.


**Thank for checking on my post and have a wonderful day**

json_metadata.title: Rebuilding a life - The Tale of Greasy - ENG- SPA
json_metadata.body: > Doing what you love is priceless, but making a living from it is even better, almost a privilege in life for those who can experience it. Greasy was one of those who enjoyed doing what he loved; he was a violinist and loved the instrument. He grew up playing it, and later, thanks to it, he was able to experience his best moments and memories. With the violin, he escaped poverty, played for great artists, and gained much merit and prestige himself. He also met his beloved wife, Irma, through music. Everything was going wonderfully, and there was nothing more he could ask for; he was completely satisfied. But the violin he loved so much, the one that had given him everything he had, now, after so much time, threatened to take it all away. He had managed to become part of a very prestigious orchestra; being part of it granted him a title of honor within the music world. But sometimes great things come with hidden downsides. On the one hand, he had the advantage of doing what he loved, gaining more prestige, and no longer having to continue playing in small orchestras. He would enter, so to speak, the big leagues of music. The downside was the enormous amount of time this job would demand. He would have to spend long periods away from home for last-minute projects. The orchestra wasn't just about traditional music; when a big-name singer came to the country, they hired them, and when a company wanted to create a major soundtrack, they looked to this orchestra. So, because they were so good, they had a very heavy workload. They constantly traveled from country to country, from contract to contract. Everything they did was perfect, so they gained more and more notoriety. Despite knowing what this job would take away from him, Greasy accepted it at the time and had to live with the consequences of that decision.

> Hacer lo que te gusta no tiene precio, pero vivir de eso que te gusta es aún mejor, casi considerado un privilegio en la vida del que lo puede experimentar. Greasy es uno de los que disfrutaba haciendo lo que le gustaba, era un violinista y amaba el instrumento. Creció tocándolo y luego gracias a el pudo vivir sus mejores momentos y recuerdos. Con el violín salió de la pobreza, pudo tocar para grandes artistas y el mismo ganó mucho merito y gran prestigio. También conoció en la música a su amada esposa Irma. Todo iba a las mil maravillas y no había nada más que pudiera pedir, estaba completamente satisfecho. Pero el violín que tanto le gustaba, el que le había dado todo lo que tenía ahora luego de tanto tiempo amenazaba con arrebatárselo todo. Y es que el logró hacerse parte de una orquesta muy prestigiosa, ser parte de ella le otorgaba un titulo de honor dentro de la música. Pero a veces las cosas muy buenas vienen con cosas malas escondidas. Por un lado tenía el plus de que haría lo que le gustaba, tendría más prestigió y ya no tendría que continuar en orquestas pequeñas. Entraría por así decirlo a las grandes ligas de la música. Lo malo aquí era la gran cantidad de tiempo que este trabajo le demandaría. Tendría que pasar largar temporadas fuera de la casa para proyectos de ultimo minuto. La orquesta no era solamente de música tradicional, cuando un gran cantante venía al país los contrataba, cuando una empresa quería crear una banda sonora muy importante a quien veían era a esa orquesta. Así que como eran tan buenos tenían una carga de trabajo muy alta. Constantemente viajaban de país en país, y de contrato en contrato. Todo lo que hacían quedaba perfecto así que cada vez más ganaban más notoriedad. A pesar de saber las cosas que le quitaría este trabajo Greasy lo aceptó en su momento y tuvo que pasar por las consecuencias de esta decisión.
![joel-timothy-tkL2_ZpOECc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23xARECdBWdJMipBiuZG6JpMcJxpypK4FfHn81LV2Pe6jdapyofAGZvxoXbMUGBGjBKTv.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> At first, he only saw the positive side. He was still doing what he loved, but on a higher level than he ever had before. He was earning a lot of money and started buying properties and luxury cars. But it was all pure irony. He hardly ever had time to be at those properties, much less drive one of those cars. Everything was almost banal, and material possessions were worthless. In a way, what he loved was taking away other parts of his life that he used to enjoy more. But that wasn't the worst part of his life. His marriage to Irma suffered greatly, as he barely had time for her. He had met her years before as a violin partner at a concert, and now the very instrument that had brought them together was tearing them apart. He also had two children, Tania and Prat, aged 5 and 9, respectively. They were growing up without their father. But for a long time, he let what he loved consume him and didn't try to do anything about it. So the consequences came in various forms. His wealth was being diluted by the properties he bought. He had to pay for maintenance and all kinds of insurance. The worst part was that he didn't even live there. The same thing happened with the cars. But the saddest thing of all was that Irma left home with her two children. They didn't want to be with him because he was never around, so they went to live with their mother. He tried to get her back through legal means, but it was impossible. Even the authorities agreed that even though he had the prestige and money to take good care of them, he wouldn't be present for his children, so they believed their mother would take better care of them. This was a huge defeat for him, and above all, a bucket of cold water thrown in his face that finally made him realize what was happening.

> En un principio solo vio la parte buena. Hacía lo que le gustaba todavía, pero en un nivel aún más alto que lo que nunca hizo. Ganaba mucho dinero y comenzó a comprar propiedades y autos de lujo. Pero todo era pura ironía. Casi nunca tenía tiempo para estar en esas propiedades y menos tiempo para conducir uno de esos autos. Todo era casi banal y lo material de nada servía. De cierta forma lo que le gustaba le estaba quitando otras partes de su vida que antes disfrutaba más. Pero eso no fue lo peor que se afectó. Su matrimonió con Irma se afectó mucho, pues casi no tenía tiempo para estar con ella. El la había conocido como compañera de violín hacia años en un concierto y ahora el mismo instrumento que los hizo unirse los estaba separando. El también tenía dos hijos, Tania y Prat, ambos tenían 5 y 9 años. Y se estaban criando sin su padre. Pero por mucho tiempo el dejó que lo que le gustaba hacer lo consumiera y no intentó hacer nada por remediarlo. Así que las consecuencias llegaron de distintas formas. Su riqueza se diluía entre las propiedades que compró. Porque tenía que pagar mantenimientos y seguros de todo tipo. Lo peor es que ni siquiera vivía ahí. Con los autos pasaba lo mismo. Pero lo más triste de todo es que Irma se fue de casa con sus dos hijos. Ellos no querían estar con el porque nunca estaba presente, así que se fueron con su madre. El intentó recuperarlo por la vía legal pero no le fue posible. Y es que hasta las autoridades coincidieron en que el aunque tuviera prestigio y dinero para cuidarlos bien no estaría presente con sus hijos por lo que consideraron que la madre los atendería mejor. Esto fue una gran derrota para él y sobre todo un cubo de agua fría en la cara que lo hizo despertar por fin de lo que estaba pasando.
![zac-gudakov-ntYj9o5rxO0-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23uQk8vLGpxb3NmuiLXRG6QxD5dfxaGMwGQBZf27drAgs1JNth6jfXTU4tMjz8PAkpPoz.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> He acknowledged that the violin that had given him everything had now taken it all away. But it wasn't the fault of the music, nor the violin; it was entirely his own. He simply hadn't known how to balance what he loved with his responsibilities. But he still had the violin; he just had to change course, and perhaps everything would change. So, in time, he changed and left the orchestra to return to his former life. He would earn less and have less prestige, but he would have more of the most valuable resource: time. He went to Irma's house and showed her how he had changed and begged her to rebuild what they once had, for them, for the children, for the violin that had brought them together. And she agreed, because she saw that he had changed. The violin gave, the violin took away, the violin fixed everything.

> El reconoció que el violín que se lo había dado todo ahora se lo había quitado todo. Pero no fue la culpa de la música, ni del violín, fue toda suya. Es que no supo equilibrar lo que le gustaba con sus responsabilidades. Pero aún tenía el violín, solo tenía que cambiar de rumbo y quizás todo cambie. Así que a tiempo cambió y dejó la orquesta para seguir como estaba antes. Ganaría menos y tendría menos prestigio pero tendría más del recurso más valioso, el tiempo. Fue a casa de Irma y le mostró que había cambiado y le rogo en reconstruir lo que tuvieron una vez, por ellos, por los niños, por el violín que los hizo conocerse. Y ella aceptó, porque vio que ahora él había cambiado. El violín dio, el violín quitó, el violín lo arregló.
![vitaly-gariev-b-7yKCvivnA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23uQp2awUyBeE6obzKXXh6aniBwAXH1kBB3eia1idbDTpQEzK2Yz69GgoQJihobpzUXVk.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

json_metadata.title: A Trip to Strawberry.
json_metadata.body:
>

I chose to help Abigail where John  shared his feelings of exhaustion with their current life. After Abigail asked him to pick up a dress parcel along with the mails of Geddes, I took Jack on a wagon ride to Strawberry. While at the post office, John was forced to reveal his real name, drawing the attention of a mysterious stranger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdBSMrSYgNX4ML4FnA8byPpcoyTcjTJukJUbuTweB7uN/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPG9j5nPfwtWPJk2g4a32vtMLWDiW6fhYPf4ybuV31LZq/screenshot_2_.png)

I had two missions available and I chose the one where I had to go for Abigail first. This was the first time John was really telling Abigail how he was feeling with his new life.

He talked about how he was getting exhausted and bored with the repetitive nature of the ranch work and the lack of excitement in their daily routine.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNNA2fjww6hg3qzTt9t8LAYMbFuR1CTSdsfVaPfDuFLL/screenshot_3_.png)

Then Abigail said there was an old ranch down by Blackwater that she was hoping to buy after saving some money and getting a bank loan. She seemed very hopeful about their future as independent landowners, but her plan did not convince John at all.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVs1SSArXfcm4EW3vJXiVtUyXXPJWFdzCoL7AFj8pdFyj/screenshot_4_.png)

Suddenly, Mr. Dickens came over to tell John that Geddes wanted him to fetch some mail at the post office of Strawberry. It was a simple task, but it gave John a reason to leave the ranch for a while. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRrR3e5Zy5QLv948Tz1E1owZaeYs54thvjjMDvkZ48eG/screenshot_5_.png)

Before John was going out, taking Jack along for the ride, Abigail asked him to grab a special parcel. She mentioned it was a dress that should be under John's name at the post office.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP31TVWgidVegRAN5WkH3gTvzMGwHLURZXpKdtJsXYiYr/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvfsDvLAPVuUsdMiT8KxwaVCvA29XP6J3X27nr7eDkKE/screenshot_7_.png)

So I started riding the wagon having Jack beside me on the front seat. It was a rare moment of connection for them as the wagon rolled through the beautiful countryside.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNtRWiYbMzckAi5vQrwh3veyAZdph9sesTdz9gdnKXcRr/screenshot_8_.png)

After a while, John gave the reins of the wagon to Jack as he wished to teach his son how to drive a wagon. Jack was nervous but excited to be in control of the heavy vehicle.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjB1WWv6MycZyhsSYrNzdXFAAmdrG9mwQMWpv356tgEu/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxKhfJvHoF2TqNTtdCY6YJuDcJ9YQ6Mvyu1Yb8yaPzLV/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTG3qScaJZDDibw2JJb9vRZzhxam3Zk5CSUfJ5ay8GSP/screenshot_11_.png)

As Jack was the one controlling the wagon, he was going very slow to stay safe. The rest of the path was finished in a cinematic view, where Jack drove the wagon carefully until they finally reached Strawberry. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKhGoZMYN2qa9kQVJWyiXw1qjfY6iwPoTiXvCow5h2he/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmReRgjWEMwDZqAku3Ntr3oKsepaK8JDj4UTzEdwaCGhHh/screenshot_13_.png)

After reaching Strawberry, John took back the reins and I had full control over the wagon once again. I was driving inside the town smoothly, towards the post office.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMW3JU1BokTSVGwozkp6UpT47VgQ8divy416w1ANjiib/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRET1oNwgrW8S2CsuyRezsYot3P1QCYqTKV2CgmV5xJiK/screenshot_15_.png)

Then John asked Jack to wait for him there by the wagon while I stepped into the post office. I walked up to the counter to speak with the postmaster.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhExr4VQvQJmtCAknGJPGLTqbj13DQeUPFbtscZWmobA/screenshot_16_.png)

I noticed this man in a hunter's outfit who was looking at something across the room. I somehow realized he could be a problem for me later.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdjiuhJrbKS7vpmY9XG11sGfsUkU49bXQU7JiFnC1mQgf/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSrLMwt3MsyXu9AoGWmfs73U7VYVQzq46FyYF9N98rsJ/screenshot_18_.png)

John mentioned the parcel Abigail had talked about first. The postmaster looked through his ledgers but did not find anything under John's disguised name.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4BZ2EP5fCf94p2haQRdMdjEefgnZKsigwe5gnNuZcLm/screenshot_19_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxSvGMegZu1x9B2xbZ1NRdQzU4qtX5ZDgmcdH4mwvcy2/screenshot_20_.png)

So John had to tell his real name to the postmaster, which did not have any results as well. He finally told Abigail's name, and suddenly that man over there stared at John in a mysterious way and left the post office in a hurry.

info.title: A Trip to Strawberry.
info.author: izuki.midoriya

content.description: <div class=\

>

I chose to help Abigail where John  shared his feelings of exhaustion with their current life. After Abigail asked him to pick up a dress parcel along with the mails of Geddes, I took Jack on a wagon ride to Strawberry. While at the post office, John was forced to reveal his real name, drawing the attention of a mysterious stranger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdBSMrSYgNX4ML4FnA8byPpcoyTcjTJukJUbuTweB7uN/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPG9j5nPfwtWPJk2g4a32vtMLWDiW6fhYPf4ybuV31LZq/screenshot_2_.png)

I had two missions available and I chose the one where I had to go for Abigail first. This was the first time John was really telling Abigail how he was feeling with his new life.

He talked about how he was getting exhausted and bored with the repetitive nature of the ranch work and the lack of excitement in their daily routine.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNNA2fjww6hg3qzTt9t8LAYMbFuR1CTSdsfVaPfDuFLL/screenshot_3_.png)

Then Abigail said there was an old ranch down by Blackwater that she was hoping to buy after saving some money and getting a bank loan. She seemed very hopeful about their future as independent landowners, but her plan did not convince John at all.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVs1SSArXfcm4EW3vJXiVtUyXXPJWFdzCoL7AFj8pdFyj/screenshot_4_.png)

Suddenly, Mr. Dickens came over to tell John that Geddes wanted him to fetch some mail at the post office of Strawberry. It was a simple task, but it gave John a reason to leave the ranch for a while. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeRrR3e5Zy5QLv948Tz1E1owZaeYs54thvjjMDvkZ48eG/screenshot_5_.png)

Before John was going out, taking Jack along for the ride, Abigail asked him to grab a special parcel. She mentioned it was a dress that should be under John's name at the post office.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP31TVWgidVegRAN5WkH3gTvzMGwHLURZXpKdtJsXYiYr/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvfsDvLAPVuUsdMiT8KxwaVCvA29XP6J3X27nr7eDkKE/screenshot_7_.png)

So I started riding the wagon having Jack beside me on the front seat. It was a rare moment of connection for them as the wagon rolled through the beautiful countryside.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNtRWiYbMzckAi5vQrwh3veyAZdph9sesTdz9gdnKXcRr/screenshot_8_.png)

After a while, John gave the reins of the wagon to Jack as he wished to teach his son how to drive a wagon. Jack was nervous but excited to be in control of the heavy vehicle.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjB1WWv6MycZyhsSYrNzdXFAAmdrG9mwQMWpv356tgEu/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxKhfJvHoF2TqNTtdCY6YJuDcJ9YQ6Mvyu1Yb8yaPzLV/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTG3qScaJZDDibw2JJb9vRZzhxam3Zk5CSUfJ5ay8GSP/screenshot_11_.png)

As Jack was the one controlling the wagon, he was going very slow to stay safe. The rest of the path was finished in a cinematic view, where Jack drove the wagon carefully until they finally reached Strawberry. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKhGoZMYN2qa9kQVJWyiXw1qjfY6iwPoTiXvCow5h2he/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmReRgjWEMwDZqAku3Ntr3oKsepaK8JDj4UTzEdwaCGhHh/screenshot_13_.png)

After reaching Strawberry, John took back the reins and I had full control over the wagon once again. I was driving inside the town smoothly, towards the post office.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMW3JU1BokTSVGwozkp6UpT47VgQ8divy416w1ANjiib/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRET1oNwgrW8S2CsuyRezsYot3P1QCYqTKV2CgmV5xJiK/screenshot_15_.png)

Then John asked Jack to wait for him there by the wagon while I stepped into the post office. I walked up to the counter to speak with the postmaster.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhExr4VQvQJmtCAknGJPGLTqbj13DQeUPFbtscZWmobA/screenshot_16_.png)

I noticed this man in a hunter's outfit who was looking at something across the room. I somehow realized he could be a problem for me later.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdjiuhJrbKS7vpmY9XG11sGfsUkU49bXQU7JiFnC1mQgf/screenshot_17_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSrLMwt3MsyXu9AoGWmfs73U7VYVQzq46FyYF9N98rsJ/screenshot_18_.png)

John mentioned the parcel Abigail had talked about first. The postmaster looked through his ledgers but did not find anything under John's disguised name.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP4BZ2EP5fCf94p2haQRdMdjEefgnZKsigwe5gnNuZcLm/screenshot_19_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxSvGMegZu1x9B2xbZ1NRdQzU4qtX5ZDgmcdH4mwvcy2/screenshot_20_.png)

So John had to tell his real name to the postmaster, which did not have any results as well. He finally told Abigail's name, and suddenly that man over there stared at John in a mysterious way and left the post office in a hurry.

That look told me something bad was coming soon, as if he recognized the name or the man standing before him.

json_metadata.body:
![ben-white-7SRymDKKDus-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWbjPACJWLn4E9gUF5zr9TuJ3hNz9U6qjkPGKLQBv1aB/ben-white-7SRymDKKDus-unsplash.jpg)
[source ](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-on-thinking-pose-7SRymDKKDus)
In the heart of Osogbo, noise was the norm. Generators hummed, arguments among commercial bus drivers and Nigeria Union Road Transport Workers staff, traders called out princes, and music slipped through every open window. For Mr. Johnson, a man who had just been discharged from the hospital, the town was beautiful but there were noises everywhere. It was a disaster for Mr. Johnson. The doctor's instructions were to rest when you get home to enable him to recover on time. 

His house was located beside the iron bender. Every minute the grinding machine was working to cut the iron. He could not sleep during the day or night due to the noise of his neighbor. His blood pressure is high beyond normal. This made him think unnecessarily.

He called the attention of the caretaker to it, and he said there was nothing he could do about it. It is due to the environment you find yourself in. Your house is situated on the side of a public place like that. What do you expect? You can expect nothing less than this, unless you move to Government Reserve. Area (GRA). 

Soliloquy.
How am I going to cope with this noise now? The doctor said my blood pressure is not normal. Ah! I won't allow them to harm me. Said Mr. Johnson. 

The following day, early in the morning. I just took a walk to Palm Grove where government reserve for tourist purposes. The only things you can see are some monkeys that used to play. If you have candy or bananas in your hand, they are ready to collect it and eat in your present, big trees, and the ancient art and design work around the forest area. When he got there, he saw a long concrete seat and sleep more than two hours before waking up. He left the place in the evening, and he felt solace. It was a perfectly quiet place to take some relief in conditions like this.

However, the next day, he picked up something he could use to spread on the floor to sleep. Ah! So there was something like this before. Thank God.

When he went to the hospital for a medical check-up, the doctor said you are ok, and continue to rest very well. You are better than the last time you came here. 

That was how he was able to get over the high blood pressure and his family was happy with the new development. 

                   The End

La maîtrise de ses émotions est essentielle à la stabilité des résultats. Faire des pauses, analyser ses paris précédents et ajuster sa stratégie permet de garder l'équilibre et d'éviter de céder à ses impulsions.

I also utilized Enkidu to scout the mansion from above before continuing my silent infiltration. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREpHeYsA6KE8oFbbPmmcVbYm6NqxsMT14fTVcwzqZwkz/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2WEx9nNrpceZQnkMAHGDuf2M9goL8EM6yQLFXkdreAU/screenshot_2_.png) At the restart, I approached the spot with a lot of caution where the soldiers killed me last time. Even after I tried to ignore the conflict, they noticed me and came for me anyway. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJ5Bb7W6w3fzE5sEwpGKQee8iigbNPETHuk68fE2Lc5e/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCnTuc7ArNX1X7fMyy6mgkrxBdHEJm5bWCHCCPukgEVD/screenshot_4_.png) This time I did not give them the same chance to overpower me like they did before. I stayed focused and took all of them down one by one with so much pleasure. It felt good to get my revenge on the guards who had stopped my progress earlier. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPS4Ztq7GCdf13qAWT1rPWJGbwASfN6nGJNNMJ9gnhKb/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPFDLCAsbCRN4YfnUEmyVmGr9kgdE2oNdyKj8uUzViCdF/screenshot_6_.png) Then I reached the area close to the mansion, but before infiltrating the main building, I noticed the surroundings to look for a stealthy way to get inside. json_metadata.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776716248819-bdc960bcb2779b21.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=titodiaz03/ec110cb2)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=titodiaz03/ec110cb2)


---

Esta canción la escribí hace poco tiempo, es de esas canciones que salen cuando tienes algo que decir y no se puede evitar. Resulta que hay momentos en los que nos proponemos lograr algo o hacer algo, y quizás ese algo puede cambiar nuestra vida o sea que es una decisión importante, y después de haberlo pensado mucho decidimos ponernos en marcha. Pero en este caso algo sucedió que evitó que tomara mi decisión, y desgraciadamente no está en mis manos arreglarlo para así seguir mi camino. Por eso es que es Náufrago el nombre de esta canción, por esos momentos en los que te sientes naufragado en tu realidad, y no ves ningún pedazo de tierra firme que signifique salvación.
También hago alusión a esos momentos en los que piensas que estás tomando una buena decisión pero no te das cuenta de que estás equivocado, porque eso también suele pasar. Pero? ¿Quien le dice al necio que está mal? Si cuando se quiere no se teme a naufragar.
No me puede faltar mencionar a la figura de Ernesto Parra, persona que menciono en mi canción. Ernesto Parra es un actor,director y guinista de teatro cubano de la provincia de Las Tunas al oriente de Cuba, el cual por problemas económicos y sociales en dicha provincia decidió mudarse a La Habana, y para eso le dijo a sus actores que el que decidiera seguir su camino era bienvenido, y el que no se atreviera a dicha azaña no tendría ningún reproche hacia la persona. Y así lo hizo, se mudó a empezar de cero en otro lugar donde era un completo desconocido, empezó de cero, y con mucho esfuerzo y paciencia ha logrado y está logrando muchas cosas. Fué una decisión muy valiente, lo admiro por eso, y así sentí la necesidad de mencionar lo en mi canción.
De esto trata \

Autor: TitoDíaz
