body.title: Weekly StreetArt #214 (🎁 : 1 HBD to share)
body.body:
As every Monday, it's time for [**Weekly StreetArt**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784), your weekly dose of **#StreetArt**. This morning, upon waking, I was surprised to see a light dusting of snow on the street. Winter hasn't given up yet. But by midday, with the sun shining despite the cold temperatures, it had all disappeared. I hope spring arrives for good soon so I can explore the streets of Montreal and show you some new murals.

> *Comme chaque lundi, voici venir le temps du [**Weekly StreetArt**](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784), votre dose de **#StreetArt** hebdomadaire. Ce matin, au réveil, quelle fut ma surprise de voir un léger tapis blanc dans la rue. L'hiver n'a pas dit son dernier mot. Mais ce midi, avec le soleil malgré les températures froides, tout a disparu. J'espère que le printemps s'installe pour de bon bientôt pour que je puisse parcourir les rues de Montréal pour vous faire découvrir de nouvelles murales.*

![P1140743.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/EpC9skTidiDCWMa2MammGZXaHK9TtPTdLs2RbatBi3MaEJ8AGrjWdW3oAKqU5ERC9nC.JPG)

To illustrate this **Weekly Street Art**, I'm sharing a mural by [**DFEK**](https://www.instagram.com/__dfek__/) and [**Jonathan Bergeron**](https://www.instagram.com/johnnycrap/) that I posted a while back, see [CCC's Street Art Contest #199](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-199-dfek-and-zen-montreal). But this time, I understand the gorilla's purple color better; you get cold quickly when your body is buried under snow 😀. Plus, it's enhanced with a collage **Girls Just Wanna Have Fun** from a Montreal feminist collective whose name I've forgotten.

> *Pour illustrer ce **Weekly StreetArt**, je vous propose une murale de [**DFEK**](https://www.instagram.com/__dfek__/) et [**Jonathan Bergeron**](https://www.instagram.com/johnnycrap/) que j'ai postée il y a quelques temps, voir [CCC's Street Art Contest #199](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/cccs-street-art-contest-199-dfek-and-zen-montreal). Mais cette fois, je comprends mieux la couleur violette du gorille, on attrape vite froid quand notre corps est enseveli sous la neige* 😀. *En plus, c'est agrémenté avec un collage **Girls Just Wanna Have Fun** d'un collectif montréalais féministe dont j'ai oublié le nom.*

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

Here are the three posts that caught my eye this week. As always, this choice is subjective - our community is brimming with quality posts!

For each publication highlighted in the Weekly StreetArt :

## @harveyword - Melbourne (Australia)

![01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23y8orggxUjVJGayg8F3vNjkkLRyN4PsFQzw9mvhsUWkm1EguyeXE3Xf4Fn8vL4e6SUyZ.jpg)

***

> *Puis comme à son habitude, **@frankblack** nous fait découvrir une superbe murale de Bogotà. C'est l'oeuvre de **Sapop3rra** et **Fefa Cox** avec un message fort, Nadie Es Ilegal, Personne est illégal. C'est une belle réussite bien mise en valeur par les photos, surtout avec l'architecture de cet immeuble en arrière plan.*

**📰** [**Streetart. No one si illegal**](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@frankblack/streetart-no-one-si-illegal-bogotacolombia-esen)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## @fonestreet - H.U.R.T.O aka OYE - Punta de Mata (Venezuela)

![03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23vsNJpBmsBzjw8PoHCa3Tng5467A8G98w6YFTpFw3peUjdw1243cVikHmPEsSyKgY1Ez.jpg)

And we'll finish with the return of **@fonestreet** who's sharing his latest work. It's always cool when an artist posts their work directly on Hive. He poses the question: **Vandalism or Art? I'd love to know your opinion by leaving a comment**. I'm curious...

***

> *Et on termine avec le retour de **@fonestreet** qui nous partage sa dernière oeuvre, toujours cool quand un artiste poste directement son travail sur Hive. Il pose la question Vandalisme ou Art. J'aimerais bien connaitre votre opinion en laissant un petit commentaire. Je suis curieux...*

**📰** [**We are Back!!**](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@fonestreet/we-are-back)

![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)
	
**Have a great week full of StreetArt**.
***Très bonne semaine à tous remplie de StreetArt***

body.title: A birthday whisky triple
body.body:
When it comes to birthdays people are always asking what to get me. I really do not want more general stuff, but I will always happily accept good chocolate or whisky. The chocolate may not last long, but it takes me a while to get through a bottle of whilsky.

![Just a wee one](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/EogMR2a1LGRKADfsNiKkQxF82uLtSfwdpUm28txtcJK19RhSAfuX6aZQsWirDiDs2wi.png)

For my last birthday I did well in the whisky department. Someone I know is a member of [The Scotch Malt Whisky Society](https://smws.com/) who do special edition bottles from barrels they acquire. They got me a full bottle and that miniature. That little bottle has quite a kick that could be tamed with a drop of water.

![The big guys](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/EoChfjME72Lzyd1z6b6wVBCcXmAM3DpudTyhJCP7Ynh6hhjS7bnb2Lshn9B8nQfkdAG.png)

I think the bigger bottle may have been chosen for the name given my interest in music. They give you tasting notes, but I can just say there is a lot of flavour going on. It goes down quite smoothly if gently sipped. You do not swig a drink like this.

![Let The Good Times Roll](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/Ep1V4crK27oNMMTCoHv3sLrJUf3GWBAJfvDnH6hAnop1jYfqa1oeTuYxaBjyoDTKjgv.png)

The [Glenmorangie](https://www.glenmorangie.com/products/the-nectar-16-years-old) was inspired by a French pastry shop and it is pretty sweet, but not sickly. It has matured in bourbon and wine casks.

![A drop of nectar](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/EpLg2DNfsUBCqMBYWLhAhKxEhyw1XhhB5y1rJxzi4hMx9rfh7tcXPDG4YWuKZAJQzqv.png)

It is nice to get gifts you can enjoy for a while and these will last me a few months. Well, apart from the little one that only provided a couple of decent shots.

![Toppers](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23wg8mCc7Pmqyf2ZhHJu1RRwnjbVQUHeGTKk37irePNyJUuuCRgRkYJUX6QsRxfmeBfGM.png)

I do not keep all the bottles, but I keep some of the stoppers if they are interesting to remind me what I have has. Of course I am also logging that here on Hive.

I always say that I am no expert on whisky, but I can still enjoy it.

Cheers!

This weekend brought some great basketball. There were favorites that dominated and a couple of upsets that left more than a few people stunned.

Saturday, April 18: The Home Teams Rule (Almost All)

Cleveland Cavaliers 126 - 113 Toronto Raptors: Cleveland (4th) came out swinging. The Raptors (5th) fought back, but the Cavs defended their home court with authority. (CLE leads 1-0).

New York Knicks 113 - 102 Atlanta Hawks: Madison Square Garden was a cauldron. The Knicks (3rd) shut down Atlanta (6th) in a physical, high-intensity game. (NYK leads 1-0).



![gettyimages-2271494706-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/Eptdy1a4vpZLnd7YuWQyLUKYdVf6auGdBtivapNpCSZCu8yizmZEo9Edcomy71y7d6L.png)



Denver Nuggets 116 - 105 Minnesota Timberwolves: The defending champions (3rd) showed no mercy. Denver controlled the pace and frustrated the Wolves (6th) in the final minutes. (DEN leads 1-0).


![gettyimages-2271993862-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tmBKmtHQC6J1jisPzKzBCZHn8VDjckbAgCrYauAaiJWUvSdMB3yPhq5zZHkHsaXsuYC.png)


LA Lakers 107 - 98 Houston Rockets: LeBron and Kennard showed their veteran experience. Although the Rockets (5th) came out with a lot of energy, the Lakers (4th) shut the door in time at Crypto.com Arena. (LAL leads 1-0).

 

![gettyimages-2271991468-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23uQnLGRPbR7ynKKSPoJQC2i9yYcJdHE1r9YkK4ik9c2gNGLLMpmKzWrP4rsmhG7Qepg9.png)




Sunday, April 19: Upset in Detroit and Dominance by the Favorites!

Boston Celtics 123 - 91 Philadelphia 76ers: A rout at the Garden! Boston (2nd) showed no mercy to a Sixers (7th) team that was tired from the Play-In. The Celtics looked unstoppable. (BOS leads 1-0).

Oklahoma City Thunder 119 - 84 Phoenix Suns: The Thunder (1st in the West) put on a basketball clinic. Phoenix (8th) was completely outclassed by OKC’s speed and accuracy. (OKC leads 1-0).

![gettyimages-2272125535-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23vhnpucbiNvnXTH2dNDJTw74mngqJuFvMSNqXsYX99gSYzcafXVMHRzHqBYnJkCBWtSK.png)

Detroit Pistons 101 - 112 Orlando Magic: The upset of the weekend! The Magic (8th) surprised the Pistons (1st) in their own arena. Paolo Banchero (23 pts) led an Orlando team that wasn’t intimidated by the best record in the East. (ORL leads 1-0).

San Antonio Spurs 111 - 98 Portland Trail Blazers: Wembanyama’s Spurs (2nd) got the job done. Portland (7th) fought hard, but San Antonio’s execution ultimately proved superior. (SAS leads 1-0).

![gettyimages-2271633464-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/EoH1pH33oZB75Aczqoj6ajnr4PrgxLoBEfWcE3o3eJPkhKmLEYtYJTmSzvnaPKc7eae.png)

Without a doubt, almost all the predictions came true, with the exception of the surprise the Magic gave the Pistons. This is just the beginning, and there may be more surprises to come. In this recap, I’ve covered two days of the playoffs, but I’ll try to do it daily so I don’t get too many games piling up. Sports bring us so much joy, and when the playoffs arrive, the real basketball begins.

Este fin de semana se jugó baloncesto del bueno. Hubo favoritos que aplastaron y un par de campanadas que dejaron a más de uno frío.

 Sábado 18 de Abril: Los Locales mandan (Casi todos)

Cleveland Cavaliers 126 - 113 Toronto Raptors: Cleveland (4°) salió a morder. Los Raptors (5°) pelearon, pero los Cavs defendieron su patio con autoridad. (CLE lidera 1-0).

New York Knicks 113 - 102 Atlanta Hawks: El Madison Square Garden fue una caldera. Los Knicks (3°) frenaron a Atlanta (6°) en un juego físico y de mucha intensidad. (NYK lidera 1-0).

Denver Nuggets 116 - 105 Minnesota Timberwolves: El campeón defensor (3°) no dio tregua. Denver controló el ritmo y frustró a los Wolves (6°) en los minutos finales. (DEN lidera 1-0).

 Domingo 19 de Abril: ¡Campanada en Detroit y Dominio de los Favoritos!

Boston Celtics 123 - 91 Philadelphia 76ers: ¡Paliza en el Garden! Boston (2°) no tuvo piedad de unos Sixers (7°) que venían cansados del Play-In. Los Celtics lucieron imparables. (BOS lidera 1-0).

Oklahoma City Thunder 119 - 84 Phoenix Suns: El Thunder (1° del Oeste) dio una clínica de baloncesto. Phoenix (8°) se vio totalmente superado por la velocidad y puntería de OKC. (OKC lidera 1-0).

Sin duda alguna casi todo los pronósticos se dieron a excepción de la sorpresa que les dieron los Magic a los Pistons, este solo es el inicio y pueden venir mas sorpresa de ahora en adelante, en este resumen coloque 2 días de playoffs pero tratare de hacerlo a diario para que no se me acumulen tantos juegos, de igual forma el deporte nos hace disfrutar mucho y cuando llegan los playoffs empieza el verdadero baloncesto.

body.title: The Hot Dog Trail in San Cristóbal | La Ruta del Perro Caliente en San Cristóbal
body.body:
>
 
# English

Welcome back to my blog, dear readers. A couple of weeks ago, my city hosted for the first time an event that had already been held in other parts of the country for years: the Hot Dog Trail.

This event involves several businesses in the industry preparing a special hot dog for the competition, and all the businesses have to sell it at the same price, with the goal of finding the winning hot dog. After tasting the product, customers have to vote in various categories to choose the winner.

Since some friends of mine have a business that was participating, the first hot dog I tried was theirs. Honestly, it was a 10/10—and not just because I know them, but because they have great products. The hot dog they offered had caramelized onions in a bacon sauce that was incredible. 

Later, I had the chance to try another hot dog from a different business that was also competing. People were talking about this place and how their product was exquisite, so we went there another day. Their hot dog was made with spicy shredded beef and was also delicious, but my winner was still the first one. 

A few days after the event, we found out the results: the winner was El Catire Hot Dog, a business that’s been in San Cristóbal for several years. However, I didn’t get to try the hot dog they had at this year’s event.

I really love these kinds of events because they encourage people to try something different and also to support the talent of our entrepreneurs.

I hope to be able to try all the hot dogs at the next event. 

We'll read you in the comments! 💛

---

# Español 

Bienvenidos un día más a mi blog queridos lectores. Hace un par de semanas en mi ciudad se llevo a cabo por primera vez un evento que ya se hacía años anteriores en el país y se trata de la Ruta del Perro Caliente.

Esta consiste en que varios negocios de este rubro, preparan un perro caliente especial para la competencia, y todos los negocios tienen que venderlo al mismo precio, con la finalidad de encontrar al perro caliente ganador. Sus clientes, luego de probar el producto, tienen que votar en varias categorias para escoger al ganador.

Como unos amigos tienen un negocio que iba a participar, el primer perro caliente que probe fue el de ellos. La verdad estaba 10/10 y es solo porque los conozco sino porque tienen buenos productos. El perro caliente que ellos ofrecieron tenia cebollas caramelizadas en una salsa de tocineta que estaba increíble. 

Luego tuve la oportunidad de probar otro perro en otro negocio que también estaba compitiendo. Las personas hablaban de este lugar y de que su producto era exquisito así que otro día fuimos para alla. El perro de ellos era de carne mechada picante y también estaba delicioso, sin embargo mi ganador era el primero. 

Luego de varios días del evento. Conocimos los resultados, el ganador fue El Catire Hot Dog, un negocio que tienen varios años en San Cristóbal. Sin embargo, no llegue a probar el perro que tenían en esta edición.

La verdad me encantan este tipo de eventos, porque motivan a las personas a hacer algo diferente y también a apoyar el talento de nuestros emprendedores.

Espero poder probar todos los perros de la siguiente edición. 

¡Nos leemos en los comentarios! 💛

Hoy salí del hospital con una sensación distinta… como si el día me estuviera dando una pequeña tregua. Miré a Yessica y sin pensarlo mucho le dije que no quería ir directo a casa, que necesitaba hacer algo diferente, aunque fuera algo simple.

El calor estaba insoportable, de esos que te agotan solo con caminar, pero aun así nos fuimos a dar vueltas, a ver tiendas, a entretener la mente un rato. El hambre no tardó en aparecer, así que empezamos la misión de encontrar dónde comer. Entramos a varios lugares, preguntamos… y nada, el mismo problema: no aceptaban pagos por transferencia. Yo insistía en que quería probar algo nuevo, pero el día, al parecer, tenía otros planes.

Y así fue como terminamos en el café Trovando.

A veces uno vuelve a los mismos sitios sin mucha expectativa… y de pronto pasan cosas bonitas. Cuando entramos al patio interior, me sorprendieron los cuadros nuevos en las paredes. Eran de Undercraft, un artista local que me encanta, así que ya desde ese momento sentí que había valido la pena llegar hasta allí.

Pedimos sin complicarnos mucho. Un capuchino para Yessica y, para mí, un café a la crema de vie, queriendo cambiar un poco. Probé el de ella… y sí, me arrepentí al instante: estaba delicioso. El mío no estaba mal, tenía su gracia con el expreso, el licor de crema y el whiskey, pero no fue amor.

Después vinieron las pizzas napolitanas, y ahí sí tengo que decir que me sorprendí de verdad. Nunca me había atrevido a pedir pizza allí, pero estaban increíbles: masa fina, crujiente, con una salsa perfectamente equilibrada y bastante queso. De esas que disfrutas sin pensar mucho.

Las acompañamos con frappuccinos bien fríos. Yessica nunca había probado uno, y verla disfrutarlo tanto me hizo sonreír. Esos pequeños momentos compartidos son los que más se sienten.

Y claro, no podíamos irnos sin algo dulce. Pedimos helado de guanábana con chispas de chocolate y galletas. Cremoso, con un sabor riquísimo… de esos postres que cierran todo de la mejor manera.

Entre risas, historias y la música de trova sonando de fondo, el tiempo se fue sin darnos cuenta. Por un rato, todo lo demás dejó de pesar.

Hoy no descubrí un lugar nuevo, pero sí confirmé algo que a veces olvido: no es el sitio, es la compañía… y esos pequeños momentos que, sin hacer ruido, te alegran el día.



# English Version 




Today I left the hospital with a different feeling… like the day was giving me a small break. I looked at Yessica and, without overthinking it, told her I didn’t want to go straight home, I needed to do something different, even if it was something simple.

The heat was unbearable, the kind that drains you just by walking, but we still went out, wandered through a few shops, just to distract ourselves for a while. Hunger didn’t take long to show up, so we started the mission of finding somewhere to eat. We walked into several places, asked around… and nothing, the same issue everywhere: no transfer payments accepted. I kept insisting I wanted to try somewhere new, but the day, apparently, had other plans.

And that’s how we ended up at Café Trovando.

Sometimes you return to familiar places without expecting much… and then something nice happens. When we stepped into the inner patio, I was surprised by the new paintings on the walls. They were by Undercraft, a local artist I really like, so from that moment on, it already felt worth it.

We ordered without overthinking it. A cappuccino for Yessica, and for me, a coffee with crema de vie, wanting to switch things up a bit. I tried hers… and yes, instant regret, it was delicious. Mine wasn’t bad at all, with its mix of espresso, cream liqueur, and whiskey, but it wasn’t love.

Then came the Neapolitan pizzas, and I have to admit, they truly surprised me. I had never dared to order pizza there before, but they were amazing: thin, crispy crust, a perfectly balanced slightly sweet-and-tangy sauce, and plenty of cheese. The kind you just enjoy without overthinking it.

We paired them with two cold frappuccinos. Yessica had never tried one before, and seeing how much she enjoyed it made me smile. Those small shared moments are the ones that really stay with you.

And of course, we couldn’t leave without dessert. We ordered soursop ice cream with chocolate chips and sweet cookies. Creamy, rich, and absolutely delicious… the perfect ending.

Between laughter, stories, and the soft sound of trova music in the background, time slipped by without us noticing. For a while, everything else stopped feeling heavy.

Today I didn’t discover a new place, but I did remember something I sometimes forget: it’s not about the place, it’s about the company… and those small moments that quietly make your day better.

body.title: When Words Become Weapons
body.body: > Back in high school, I remember being in class with these twins who used to bully my friends and I. You’d be surprised to hear that I was victim of bullying because I hardly speak about it. A little back story- I started schooling with these twins but they were older than me and so they were a year ahead of me. There were a couple others who also started with us which was right from crèche. We were all kicking it until I got to primary 3 when they headmistress told my parents she wanted to promote me two classes ahead but my dad refused. Fast forward to primary 5, I was taken straight to junior high one which was the class where these twins were in. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFo5ZV3fnm1jrg5RjRUruY3opBdk8UaATC5nSMvFGiHv/img_0872.jpg) That was when my misery started. I’d honestly like to believe they bullied myself and everyone in the class, including teachers just because they couldn’t sit with the fact that I was in the same class with them or they were just crazy people who needed help. Now that I think about it, it was actually bad but they got expelled from the school later which made things a lot better. As someone who has been bullied before, I can tell you bullying is not the way to go at all with regard to anything. I’ve never understood why people just wake up and decide to bully others because what do you derive from making someone life hell. Thanks to technology, the rate of bullying in our world today has increased drastically. And what makes it worse is that fact that most people now get bullied by people they don’t even know and Vice versa. Imagine someone sitting on his old of mat somewhere in his single room trying to bully you on the internet over something worth more than all their belongings and you feel bad about it. That’s some different level of crazy because what do you mean someone somewhere will just pick up a phone and decide to bully anyone on the internet. It’s a fact that people are bitter but hey, there’s not need using your family issues as a yardstick to come online and make someone feel less of themselves. If anything, you should leave kind words for the. Bullying, whether offline or online is not something I stand for but from my point of view, online bullying had to be the worst. Because with in person bullying, at least I know you and I will be able to call you out one day but with only, you don’t even know the person yet this person has managed to ruin your life in all the ways you can imagine. This is actually why I advise people to not take everything online seriously. If their lives were good, they wouldn’t be online trolling others. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpBWbuDdj3W3AkkrqRqm8F2rbbjssookGGApdaW3bpri/img_0870.jpg) One thing I love about this generation is the fact that they call people out . Recently, there’s been this trend where people take to the internet to call out their bullies and told them how much their lives were affected by them. I know how the internet work which means those bullies will actually find these videos and if they are really good people, they will change but if they are still bullies, they’d have to learn their lessons the hard way. Bullying has very negative effects on individuals- people have low self esteem because of bullying and some go as far and committing suicide. You wouldn’t want someone’s blood on your hands to learn to be kind and train your kids and everyone around you to walk with love and kindness in their hearts. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

body.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: MUJERCITAS (1999).
body.body:
***Buenas amigos espero que tods esten super bien, un gran abrazo para todos, hoy con una nueva ediciòn sobre los dramaticos de Venezuela, en esta ocasiòn la historia es una dramatico de epoca, con dos de los protagonistas jovenes de la epoca.***

---

![193..jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23vsb96tB33Pe6hFMMkqYDcid1vH29sjZ95d55iW34zBzyHzix6AjbrGkvbM2PuzmmXfX.jpg)

<center>***Portada Realizada por mi.***</center>

---

<center>***INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***​Mujercitas es una adaptación televisiva venezolana de la famosa novela clásica de la escritora estadounidense Louisa May Alcott. Producida en 1999, la historia fue trasladada a un contexto histórico venezolano, específicamente a mediados del siglo XIX (alrededor de 1859), durante la Guerra Federal. Esta versión logró combinar el romanticismo de la literatura clásica con los paisajes y la historia de Venezuela.***

---

<center>![httpsstatic.wikia.nocookie.nettelenovelasimages77eMujercitas_1999.jpgrevisionlatestcb=20251104135349&path-prefix=es.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/48WhCQxW6DNNWeUJgvmdjzSv1S6nBwcLgYEbELCkXPHmmRepcqF9RGR3Rziyn4o225.jpg)</center>

---

<center>[Tipografia de la novela](httpsstatic.wikia.nocookie.nettelenovelasimages77eMujercitas_1999.jpgrevisionlatestcb=20251104135349&path-prefix=es)<center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***​-Titulo Original: Mujercitas.
-Productora: Venevisión / Laura Visconti Producciones.
​-Año: 1999.
​-Guion: César Sierra (Adaptación de la obra de Louisa May Alcott).
​-Dirección: José Alcalde.
​-Protagonistas: Daniela Alvarado, Adrián Delgado, Erika Schwarzgruber, Lourdes Martínez y Zhandra de Abreu.
-​Elenco Estelar: Eduardo Serrano, Esther Orjuela, Javier Valcárcel y Juan Carlos García.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por el elenco.***

---

<center>![httpsscontent.fccs9-1.fna.fbcdn.netvt39.30808-6511198303_10232949738980555_8099174253355953508_n.jpgstp=dst-jpg_p180x540_tt6&_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e06c5d&_nc_ohc=aFW8M9NTd9oQ7kNvwGYWC9d&_nc_oc=AdpZuVmdXfVhbQQelpFdGaow5jAyzVM.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/EoiYYntWLriqF6b4vpeMcoQS8JdLF9ZaPkoawdB1xaYF3cd1zBT4BXsX2KgexNqc4YR.jpg)</center>

<center>[Actrices protagonistas de la novela](httpsscontent.fccs9-1.fna.fbcdn.netvt39.30808-6511198303_10232949738980555_8099174253355953508_n.jpgstp=dst-jpg_p180x540_tt6&_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e06c5d&_nc_ohc=aFW8M9NTd9oQ7kNvwGYWC9d&_nc_oc=AdpZuVmdXfVhbQQelpFdGaow5jAyzVM)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***​La historia se centra en la vida de las cuatro hermanas Bracho, quienes viven con su madre en una Venezuela convulsionada por la guerra, mientras su padre lucha en el frente.***

***​Josefina (Jo): Interpretada por Daniela Alvarado, es la hermana rebelde, audaz y con sueños de ser escritora. Representa el espíritu libre que choca con las normas sociales de la época.***

***​Manuela (Meg): Interpretada por Lourdes Martínez, es la mayor, la más romántica y responsable.***

***​Valentina (Beth): Interpretada por Erika Schwarzgruber, es la hermana sensible y musical, cuya fragilidad de salud marca uno de los puntos más emotivos de la trama.***

***​Luz Marina (Amy): Interpretada por Zhandra de Abreu, es la menor, algo consentida y con talento para la pintura.***

***​El conflicto central gira en torno al crecimiento de estas jóvenes, sus primeros amores —destacando la relación entre Jo y su vecino Juan Marcos (Adrián Delgado)— y los sacrificios que deben hacer para mantener la dignidad de su hogar en tiempos de crisis.***

---

<center>![httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BYmI4NjUzOGItOGFjMS00YTY4LTk3NzctMjZjMmEyYWQyZWQ5XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23x1SW8rqa6RvWZLb8M3QTxmmJ7qiAuDdn4GBsvt3h3hUmGSfinWWM53c29LDP3Nw32DA.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BYmI4NjUzOGItOGFjMS00YTY4LTk3NzctMjZjMmEyYWQyZWQ5XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA.***</center>
-

***Esta producción es muy recordada por haber reunido nuevamente a la pareja de moda del momento: Daniela Alvarado y Adrián Delgado, quienes venían del éxito masivo de A todo corazón. La crítica elogió la capacidad de César Sierra para adaptar los diálogos originales de Alcott a un español antiguo pero fluido, respetando la esencia de los personajes.
​Visualmente, la novela destacó por su dirección de arte y vestuario, que recreó fielmente la Venezuela rural del siglo XIX. Fue una apuesta diferente para el horario juvenil, ya que en lugar de uniformes escolares o entornos urbanos modernos, presentaba una historia de época con valores tradicionales y un tono mucho más literario.***

---

<center>![httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BODI5NWNmNWEtYTY3MC00ZGVjLWIzYzgtNTRlNDJkNjdmZTUyXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/23x1FU4baPJeHKNDXJGcetvXMZzMPxytBfxe3kNfGkod1WMibHwLFv3kJUHp1c6y5vSVL.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas principales de la novela](httpsm.media-amazon.comimagesMMV5BODI5NWNmNWEtYTY3MC00ZGVjLWIzYzgtNTRlNDJkNjdmZTUyXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Mujercitas es considerada una de las mejores adaptaciones juveniles de época hechas en Venezuela. Logró que una nueva generación se interesara por un clásico de la literatura universal, gracias a las actuaciones naturales de su elenco joven y a una producción cuidada en sus detalles históricos. Su legado reside en haber demostrado que las historias clásicas son atemporales y pueden resonar con la misma fuerza en cualquier contexto.***

---

<center>![httpsi.ytimg.comvi0ZOTZsSUUlYhqdefault.jpgsqp=-oaymwEmCOADEOgC8quKqQMa8AEB-AH-BIAC4AOKAgwIABABGGUgXihUMA8=&rs=AOn4CLDSJTQuk3iiPUw_RxwsdAUItwuzlA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spliddash/EowGX5odp4tzXERGnrirMpPVTx2p64o9FgSj4YxMboMRPmzxtjweyABRnsiLcH9tGBa.jpg)</center>

<center>[Actor protagonista de la novela](httpsi.ytimg.comvi0ZOTZsSUUlYhqdefault.jpgsqp=-oaymwEmCOADEOgC8quKqQMa8AEB-AH-BIAC4AOKAgwIABABGGUgXihUMA8=&rs=AOn4CLDSJTQuk3iiPUw_RxwsdAUItwuzlA)</center>

---

body.title: |Reflexión ( ESP-ENG)
body.body:
> ✳️ Saludos cordiales, amigos de @holos-lotus. Deseando a todos salud, prosperidad y crecimiento personal, aqui estoy como cada semana, vía #ecency, para reflexionar juntos en un nuevo tema!!! ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhZm94GChD1UmUmReUQKruvxATD1JtXDswhyW42sEfji/1776648917224.jpg)
***

>


He empezado a caminar cada dos o tres días. Cuatro, cinco kilómetros. Por ahí. Termino destrozado. Pero te confieso que me siento mejor.

Eso estoy haciendo por mi salud, estimada @damarysvibra

Gracias por provocarme estas confesiones.

Cuando me veo al espejo, hay un tipo de unos cincuenta años, con sobrepeso, un escritor, que pasó un tiempo justificándose. La espalda, las rodillas, el trabajo, el frío, el calor, el \

. Colección de mentiras tan bien ensayadas.

Pero está bueno ya. Empecé a caminar.

El sobrepeso no es un castigo del destino, es, si acaso , el resultado de mis propias decisiones repetidas durante años. Duele decirlo, pero decirlo, libera. Porque si yo lo hice, yo puedo deshacerlo. Nadie va a venir a rescatarme. No hay app mágica ni dieta milagrosa. Hay piernas. Mis piernas. Y acera. La misma para todos. Y el terraplén.

El dolor no es mi entrenador gritándome que llevaba décadas dormido. ¿Cómo no van a doler las rodillas si las traté como un mueble durante muchos años? El dolor es información pura. No me dice \

. Aprendí a diferenciar entre el dolor de la lesión y el dolor que avisa de que estoy haciendo algo que nunca hice. El segundo es bienvenido. El segundo es cambio. Sentirme mejor no es estar bien. Ojo con esta trampa. Puedo sentirme mejor y seguir pesando lo mismo. Puedo sentirme mejor y seguir a muchos kilos de donde debería estar. Sentirse bien es un estado emocional. Estar bien es un estado real. No los confundo. No me conformo con el primero si no alcanzo el segundo. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEUw15VnBYFVuWBETbueu1zgrYgd6o6J7Z5wcCWv9xKA/1776648917557.jpg)
***

>

La vergüenza me acompaña cada vez que salgo a caminar. La misma que sentí cuando subí una cuesta y tuve que parar a los dos minutos. Esa que me hizo bajar la mirada cuando un corredor me adelantó sin respirar. Pero ya la vergüenza deja de ser mi enemiga. Ahora es mi fiscal. Me recuerda que puedo más. Que he vivido por debajo de lo que soy capaz.

Y soy capaz de muchas cosas.

Yo creo que la vergüenza, bien usada, es mejor que la autocompasión.

La esperanza incómoda me agarra en el kilómetro cuatro, cuando el cuerpo ya no puede más pero la cabeza empieza a pensar: \
. Esa esperanza sin fotos bonitas. Sin promesas de cambio radical. Solo con una frase pequeña: \

. Esa esperanza es feroz. Me caes bien. Tampoco es que haya encontrado la motivación. A veces pienso que la motivación es una mentira que venden los que no se levantan con las piernas temblando. Tengo es un acuerdo conmigo. Un pacto, sin florituras. Me pongo las zapatillas o y a salir andando. Mi única excusa válida es rendirme. Y rendirme es una decisión, no una condición. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXEMqFUdKQ819ZJKuQfHrCFmqCuS1qyhcd6EZeAG2XHa/1776648917820.jpg)
***

>

No tengo veinte años. No tengo el cuerpo de un atleta. No tengo tiempo infinito. Pero tengo piernas. Tengo aire. Tengo la capacidad de elegir entre quedarme en el sofá con un argumento perfecto sobre por qué no puedo, o salir  y demostrarme que sí puedo. Aunque sea mal. Aunque sea lento. Aunque sea a trompicones.

Escribo para vivir. Camino para no morir antes de tiempo. Las dos cosas me hacen mejor.

Siento que caminar no me está cambiando el cuerpo. Todavía no. Lo que está cambiando es el diálogo interno. Antes decía \

. No es poético. Es real. Si dentro de un año mi cuerpo está exactamente igual que hoy… ¿qué excusa voy a contarme que no me haya contado ya? ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWERZ5xCmHaTdkRpFxqKUfQptSgAypXtgbP8wAiC8zsmi/1776650226562.jpg)
***
>\n\nLlevo tres semanas. Es un comienzo. Puede que la semana que viene abandone. Pero también puede que no. Y esa pequeña posibilidad, esa diminuta certeza de \

, es más grande que todas las excusas que acumulé durante años. **© Marabuzal, 2026. Contenido original. Todos los derechos reservados.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg) Holos Lotus 👣 \

> ✳️ Warm greetings, friends of @holos-lotus. Wishing you all health, prosperity, and personal growth, here I am, as every week, via #ecency, to reflect together on a new topic!!! ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhZm94GChD1UmUmReUQKruvxATD1JtXDswhyW42sEfji/1776648917224.jpg)
***

>

I've started walking every two or three days. Four or five kilometers. Around that. I end up exhausted. But I confess that I feel better.

 That's what I'm doing for my health, dear @damarysvibra

 Thank you for prompting these confessions.

When I look in the mirror, there's a man in his fifties, overweight, a writer, who spent a long time making excuses. His back, his knees, his job, the cold, the heat, the \

A collection of such well-rehearsed lies.

But enough is enough. I've started walking.

Being overweight isn't a punishment from fate; it's, if anything, the result of my own decisions repeated over the years. It hurts to say it, but saying it is liberating. Because if I did it, I can undo it. No one is coming to rescue me. There's no magic app or miracle diet. There are legs. My legs. And the sidewalk. The same one for everyone. And the embankment.

The pain isn't my trainer yelling at me that I've been asleep for decades. How could my knees not hurt if I treated them like a piece of furniture for so many years? Pain is pure information.  It doesn't tell me to \

I've learned to differentiate between the pain of an injury and the pain that warns me I'm doing something I've never done before. The second is welcome. The second is change. Feeling better isn't the same as being well. Beware of this trap. I can feel better and still weigh the same. I can feel better and still be many kilos away from where I should be. Feeling good is an emotional state. Being well is a real state. I don't confuse them. I won't settle for the first if I don't achieve the second. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcEUw15VnBYFVuWBETbueu1zgrYgd6o6J7Z5wcCWv9xKA/1776648917557.jpg)
***

>

Shame accompanies me every time I go for a walk. The same shame I felt when I climbed a hill and had to stop after two minutes. The shame that made me lower my gaze when a runner passed me without taking a breath. But shame is no longer my enemy. Now it's my judge. It reminds me that I can do more. That I've lived below my potential.

And I am capable of many things.

I believe that shame, used well, is better than self-pity.

 Uncomfortable hope grips me at kilometer four, when my body can't go on but my mind starts thinking, \
That hope without pretty pictures. Without promises of radical change. Just with a simple phrase: \

That hope is fierce. I like you. It's not that I've found motivation, either. Sometimes I think motivation is a lie peddled by those who don't wake up with trembling legs. I have an agreement with myself. A pact, no frills. I put on my running shoes and start walking. My only valid excuse is to give up. And giving up is a decision, not a condition. ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXEMqFUdKQ819ZJKuQfHrCFmqCuS1qyhcd6EZeAG2XHa/1776648917820.jpg)
***

>

I'm not twenty years old. I don't have an athlete's body. I don't have infinite time. But I have legs. I have breath. I have the ability to choose between staying on the couch with a perfect argument about why I can't, or going out and proving to myself that I can. Even if it's bad. Even if it's slow. Even if it's stumbling.

I write to live. I walk so I don't die before my time. Both things make me better.

I feel that walking isn't changing my body. Not yet. What's changing is my inner dialogue. Before, I used to say \

It's not poetic. It's real. If in a year my body is exactly the same as it is today… what excuse am I going to tell myself that I haven't already? ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWERZ5xCmHaTdkRpFxqKUfQptSgAypXtgbP8wAiC8zsmi/1776650226562.jpg)
***
>\n\nI've been at it for three weeks. It's a start. Maybe I'll quit next week. But maybe I won't. And that small possibility, that tiny certainty of \
is bigger than all the excuses I've accumulated over the years. **© Marabuzal, 2026. Original content. All rights reserved.**

body.title: (EN-PL) Book review of “How to worry less about money”, by John Armstrong-Recenzja książki „Jak mniej martwić się o pieniądze” autorstwa John Armstrong
body.body:
(English version)

This book will help you realize that there are other things in life to worry about, apart from money

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2hMKJpwLSsE&pp=ygUWd29ycnkgbGVzcyBhYm91dCBtb25leQ%3D%3D

I came across the book “How to worry less about money”, by John Armstrong, when I visited my local library, which I hadn’t visited for some time due to the corona-virus.

The book is part of “The School of Life” series, which includes life-changing books on topics such as self-knowledge, relationships, sociability, work, and leisure.

Therefore, it becomes obvious that the book written by John Armstrong on how to worry less about money is expected to adopt a perspective that follows the general theme of “The School of Life” series.

This means that the book is written in a social and philosophical context that is aimed at boosting self-knowledge, rather than showing ways, through which, someone can solve their money problems, for example, by getting rich.

In fact, the author is adamant on this right from the beginning of the book, and keeps stressing this point throughout the book.

**What is the main idea of the book?**

As far as I have understood from reading the book, the main idea is that money is important in life, because people see it like that.

This applies to other things in life, as well, to which, people attach more importance than they should.

Although money is believed to be essential in the modern world, it is only a means of transaction; nothing more and nothing less than that.

If people understand this fundamental function of money, they will be able to get rid of a big part of their money-related worries.

Of course, this is different from having access to more, or living with less, money, and has nothing to do with solving someone’s financial problems.

Actually, the author clearly points out that, if a person acknowledges that there are other things in life apart from money, this acknowledgment will not help that person to pay an outstanding bill.

**Why do people believe that money is so important?**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qpf1pNpxgn8&pp=ygUZd2h5IGlzIG1vbmV5IHNvIGltcG9ydGFudA%3D%3D

According to the author, people believe that money is so important, as they try to mask their real worries, fears, and concerns that are caused by other things and in other areas in life that are not related to money.

This is the main reason why money won’t, and can’t, solve all problems in life, and, as the author puts it, it is also the reason why rich people still have problems after they get rich, and in spite of many of them having access to ridiculous amounts of money.

Of course, poor people face totally different problems than rich people.

**My own question: Can you ignore the fight for survival?**

There are millions of poor people in the world who live below the poverty line and even live in hunger, and I don’t think that these people have an option to see money in a different light and stop worrying about it, and this is because they simply struggle to survive another day.

Even cents can make a real difference in the life of those people.

Although the author may seem to have missed this point, since the whole discussion in the book is about the objective, rather than subjective, value of money, very poor people can only have a subjective view of money, because more money means, for example, more food to them, which is extremely vital for their livelihood.

However, even this case proves the author’s argument to an extent.

At the end of the day, when you see people living in absolute destitute and hunger, then you realize the real value of money; you also realize that the “sentimental” value that people attach to money is actually fake.

I think that the author would agree with me on that, and based on the fact that he is a philosopher, his perspective and approach are fully justified.

After all, the purpose of the book is not to discuss social inequality and poverty, but rather whether the money-related worries of people are real, or not.

Of course, this takes a certain living standard for granted.

On the other hand, if the author was an economist, this discussion would be very different.

**My verdict**

Armstrong’s book made me think, and I believe that, in this way, the author achieved his goal.

The vivid examples presented in the book helped me draw mental pictures, which is something that I desperately needed, i.e. mental stimulation.

On top of that, I came to realize that the behavior and attitude of people around me have ulterior motives that I couldn’t see before.

The book also helped me to understand that my own behavior and attitude towards money is determined by seemingly irrelevant factors, and this understanding allowed me to adopt a fresh perspective, which, as the author argues, will hopefully make me worry less about money and care more about more valuable things in life.

(Wersja Polska)

Ta książka pomoże Ci uświadomić sobie, że w życiu są inne rzeczy, o które warto się martwić, oprócz pieniędzy

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2hMKJpwLSsE&pp=ygUWd29ycnkgbGVzcyBhYm91dCBtb25leQ%3D%3D

Na książkę Johna Armstronga „Jak mniej martwić się o pieniądze” trafiłem podczas wizyty w mojej lokalnej bibliotece, której nie odwiedzałem od jakiegoś czasu z powodu koronawirusa.

Książka jest częścią serii „Szkoła Życia”, która zawiera książki zmieniające życie, poruszające takie tematy jak samoświadomość, relacje, towarzyskość, praca i wypoczynek.

W związku z tym oczywiste jest, że książka Johna Armstronga o tym, jak mniej martwić się o pieniądze, ma przyjąć perspektywę zgodną z ogólną tematyką serii „Szkoła Życia”.

Oznacza to, że książka została napisana w kontekście społecznym i filozoficznym, którego celem jest pogłębienie samoświadomości, a nie wskazanie sposobów, dzięki którym można rozwiązać problemy finansowe, na przykład poprzez wzbogacenie się.

Autor jest w tej kwestii stanowczy od samego początku książki i stale podkreśla ten punkt.

**Jaka jest główna myśl książki?**

O ile zrozumiałem z lektury książki, jej główną ideą jest to, że pieniądze są ważne w życiu, ponieważ ludzie tak je postrzegają.

Dotyczy to również innych rzeczy w życiu, którym ludzie przypisują większą wagę niż powinni.

Chociaż uważa się, że pieniądze są niezbędne we współczesnym świecie, są one jedynie środkiem transakcyjnym; niczym więcej i niczym mniej.

Jeśli ludzie zrozumieją tę fundamentalną funkcję pieniędzy, będą mogli pozbyć się dużej części swoich zmartwień związanych z pieniędzmi.

Oczywiście różni się to od dostępu do większej ilości pieniędzy lub życia z mniejszą ich ilością i nie ma nic wspólnego z rozwiązaniem czyichś problemów finansowych.

Autor wyraźnie wskazuje, że jeśli ktoś uzna, że ​​w życiu istnieją inne rzeczy poza pieniędzmi, to takie uznanie nie pomoże mu w uregulowaniu zaległego rachunku.

**Dlaczego ludzie uważają, że pieniądze są tak ważne?**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qpf1pNpxgn8&pp=ygUZd2h5IGlzIG1vbmV5IHNvIGltcG9ydGFudA%3D%3D

Według autora, ludzie wierzą, że pieniądze są tak ważne, ponieważ próbują ukryć swoje prawdziwe zmartwienia, lęki i obawy, które wynikają z innych rzeczy i obszarów życia niezwiązanych z pieniędzmi.

To główny powód, dla którego pieniądze nie rozwiążą i nie mogą rozwiązać wszystkich problemów życiowych, a także, jak to ujmuje autor, powód, dla którego bogaci ludzie nadal mają problemy po osiągnięciu bogactwa, mimo że wielu z nich ma dostęp do absurdalnie dużych sum pieniędzy.

Oczywiście, biedni ludzie borykają się z zupełnie innymi problemami niż bogaci.

**Moje własne pytanie: Czy można zignorować walkę o przetrwanie?**

Na świecie są miliony biednych ludzi, którzy żyją poniżej granicy ubóstwa, a nawet głodują. Nie sądzę, aby ci ludzie mieli możliwość spojrzenia na pieniądze z innej perspektywy i zaprzestania martwienia się o nie, ponieważ po prostu z trudem przetrwają kolejny dzień.

Nawet centy mogą realnie odmienić życie tych ludzi.

Chociaż autor może się wydawać, że nie dostrzegł tego, ponieważ cała dyskusja w książce dotyczy obiektywnej, a nie subiektywnej wartości pieniądza, bardzo biedni ludzie mogą mieć jedynie subiektywny pogląd na pieniądze, ponieważ więcej pieniędzy oznacza dla nich na przykład więcej jedzenia, co jest niezwykle istotne dla ich utrzymania.

Jednak nawet ten przypadek do pewnego stopnia potwierdza argumentację autora.

W końcu, gdy widzisz ludzi żyjących w absolutnej nędzy i głodzie, uświadamiasz sobie prawdziwą wartość pieniędzy; uświadamiasz sobie również, że „sentymentalna” wartość, jaką ludzie przypisują pieniądzom, jest w rzeczywistości fałszywa.

Myślę, że autor zgodziłby się ze mną w tej kwestii, a biorąc pod uwagę fakt, że jest filozofem, jego perspektywa i podejście są w pełni uzasadnione.

W końcu celem książki nie jest dyskusja o nierównościach społecznych i ubóstwie, ale raczej o tym, czy ludzkie troski związane z pieniędzmi są realne, czy nie.

Oczywiście, zakłada to pewien standard życia.

Z drugiej strony, gdyby autor był ekonomistą, ta dyskusja wyglądałaby zupełnie inaczej.

**Mój werdykt**

Książka Armstronga skłoniła mnie do refleksji i wierzę, że w ten sposób autor osiągnął swój cel.

Wyraziste przykłady przedstawione w książce pomogły mi stworzyć obrazy mentalne, czego rozpaczliwie potrzebowałem, czyli stymulacji umysłowej.

Co więcej, uświadomiłem sobie, że zachowania i postawy ludzi wokół mnie mają ukryte motywy, których wcześniej nie dostrzegałem.

Książka pomogła mi również zrozumieć, że moje własne zachowanie i stosunek do pieniędzy są uwarunkowane pozornie nieistotnymi czynnikami, a to zrozumienie pozwoliło mi spojrzeć na sprawę z nowej perspektywy, która, jak twierdzi autor, mam nadzieję sprawi, że mniej będę się martwił o pieniądze, a bardziej o rzeczy wartościowe w życiu.

_Sources and further reading:_

[How to Worry Less about Money by John Armstrong-Goodreads](https://www.goodreads.com/en/book/show/14478541)

[Subjective Theory of Value: Definition, History, Examples](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/subjective-theory-of-value.asp)

[How to Worry Less About Money: 5 Lessons from the Book](https://stephanjoppich.com/how-to-worry-less-about-money/)

* * *

_Originally published by me on_ [_vocal.media_](https://vocal.media/motivation/book-review-of-how-to-worry-less-about-money-by-john-armstrong)

body.title: Modern Big Mana Battles are Lots of Fun!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPy727nADj4QhV87YN2FoQyiK1bDcopytvorMLrSpQ9yy/3rtd4iuwd6nuejen5avrjuoyatfqbqfccji1n7uixr4g2kpkn7w8npzl7qrj4etegdj5c8fscmkko5est4uct57zv951wwrhkbvkneuejb2g6ahsgdws79nitzjx5zqfjdfycqi3ayzjgtnyk2uy8mohyvcuyxbkkicpe2os89xwle.png) ## Introduction I used a classic Splinterlands Share Your Battle challenge image for this post, because I think it is kind of fun and nostalgic. Also, I am sharing a battle here so it kind of fits. But I am not going to be using Legionnaire Alvar in this battle, as I am sharing a modern battle and he is long out of Modern League. Instead I am going to share a high mana battle with some of my favorite modern monsters. ## The Ruleset One of the most important things to consider in your Splinterlands battles is obviously the ruleset. In this case we have a relatively high mana battle where you can use sixty points to build your team. In the olden days this would be a really high mana battle as you would not be able to go higher than sixty, but these days the real unlimited mana battle is where 99 points are available as a lot of really high mana monsters were introduced after Chaos Legion set.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWFJQUCVQX5z4wGfzHkH6FH9Mt8UxoxjfvUSqxaTTTYVz/image.png)
In this battle we have Up to Eleven, Lost Magic and Noxious Fumes rulesets in effect. When I see Noxious Fumes rulesets, I like playing monsters with Immunity ability such as Mad Ogre Anarchist as I am playing here as well as the monsters that have an Ambush ability as you get to hit one more time before the battle even starts and before the poison starts eating at you monster's health. My Rush Townsend is not even maxed out for the Modern Diamond level and it is still one of my favorite cards to play in this ruleset and in general. Another key card here is Oridum Graybrow. This legendary card has Spite ability where it has a 100% chance to counter attack when defeated. It also has Resurgence ability where it self-resurrects with 100% armor and health which would bring it back with no poison.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUv5aqzwT3777sLrqgmaniDsyAnbFJedgsMf5nxrfwV2u/image.png)
Oridum Graybrow is a very strong card and I like playing it when the fire splinter or dragon splinter are available.

## The Strategy
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyc1iWNbMCNVRjFDKPZZv3bMpLFrdL6mgLXtSLhjXjNJ/image.png)
Since we have Noxious Fumes in effect I decided to go for the offensive high damage strategy that utilizes Nidhoggr as my summoner. This summoner reduces opponent's health by one point as well as remove their armor and it gives three of my monsters Blast ability. That sounds like a perfect recipe for the current ruleset.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcmJoA5vxrL67wHGmTNjw5YiBgvsygQs3XJP67JBHDDTz/image.png)
Additionally my strategy here is to split a potentially focused fire from my opponent by using a high health taunt monster. Here I am using Syrenth legendary reward card that comes with a base health of ten and one shield as well as four ranged damage as well as Taunt, Dodge, Return Fire and Stun abilities. I figure since magic is not available my opponent is likely going to be using at least some ranged attackers and return fire would reduce their shield or even tap into their health. And finally what offensive blast strategy is complete without Venka the Vile?! Yes this is a relatively low mana monster with no immunity, but her seven melee damage combined with Charge and Trample abilities makes playing her here definitely worth it.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRk2YmysDfqjjCHPUFfcsXrWNqwBAdSL3KUWfLFcr3FKL/image.png)
## The Battle [Link to the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_8b4f58069259b220604938d91508e908?ref=seattlea) As we see here my opponent chose to go with a Commander Slade upfront, that is actually a dangerous move for my high damage strategy that is focused on the front monster as there are likely to be many misses and that is a potential way to loose this battle. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPRb2hY61H7Fi2mzxWEdgfsJhNMasCi97E1qi1taomipy/image.png) The miss scenario did play out as expected, my Rush Townsend missed both of his attacks despite being the fastest monster on my team. A few other monsters also missed and got backfire damage. At least Venka didn't miss, but at the start of the second round we are in a precarious position with poison set to take out my tank and my taunt monster as soon as round two starts: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT47z8pNnaG4jUAJzLRTGgSp98gMeEmGxSwduUgZR6B9t/image.png) Round two started with both monsters dead and Venka really proving her worth as she took out their tank and a second monster behind it. Oridum Graybrow also did well by taking out their Venka and self-resurrecting with full health and no poison affliction. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFXkCNsPZxSL6yQe6QvRq52oeqoRU7wCG9p2jM97FXpN/image.png) Round three starts with a clear advantage for our team. And Venka with just one point in remaining health proves its worth once again by taking out both of the remaining enemy monsters! And it is a sweet victory in a fun and exciting battle with almost seventeen SPS as my reward: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFMeqU9vD7sJwAns4uw6pzncEL3cdzFekDUB1z34vUnG/image.png)

He estado muy full con muchas actividades y hoy precisamente no fue la excepción, debido a que han habido otros cambios en mi ambiente de trabajo, además de que he tenido que poner mucho de mi tiempo en el ámbito laboral. También han pasado muchas cosas en mi vida que me han tenido ocupada tanto física como mentalmente, la verdad es que estoy intentando despejar mi mente para poder crear contenido más seguido para Hive. Usualmente publico mi contenido a un horario muy específico, pero debido a varias circunstancias a veces estoy tan ocupada que no puedo publicar a la hora prevista, aún así, esta quiero traerles un nuevo post. No obstante, a pesar de los imprevistos he podido enfocarme en hacer las cosas bien y estoy mentalizada en pasar este semestre de la mejor manera posible, así que dejé a un lado lo negativo y simplemente me puse manos a la obra con mis responsabilidades. Una de las cosas que más me gusta al comenzar clases es que puedo vestirme como más me gusta, ya que en el trabajo usualmente me tengo que vestir de manera deportiva o con el uniforme cómo cosa que aunque me gusta mi trabajo, realmente me gusta sentirme libre a la hora de vestirme. Hoy les muestro algunos outfits que me he puesto para ir a la universidad que me han gustado bastante, algunos días no he podido tomarme fotos, pero las veces que recuerdo de tomarme alguna foto me la tomo, la verdad es que me siento muy bien conmigo misma. Hi again! Today I’m come to you with a pretty cool new post, this time featuring a new set of photos I’ve taken of my outfits over the past few days. I’ve been super busy with lots of activities, and today was no exception, since there have been some changes in my work environment, plus I’ve had to devote a lot of my time to work. A lot has also been going on in my life that’s kept me busy both physically and mentally. The truth is, I’m trying to clear my mind so I can create content for Hive more often. I usually post my content at a very specific time, but due to various circumstances, sometimes I’m so busy that I can’t post at the scheduled time. Even so, I wanted to bring you a new post today. I started classes at college last week, and even though I was really excited to get started, things haven’t gone as I expected, since a few things have happened that have changed the plans I had in mind. However, despite the unexpected events, I’ve been able to focus on doing things right, and I’m determined to make the most of this semester, so I’ve put the negativity aside and simply gotten down to business with my responsibilities. One of the things I like most about starting classes is that I can dress however I like, since at work I usually have to dress casually or in a uniform, so even though I love my job, I really love feeling free when it comes to what I wear. Today I’m showing you some outfits I’ve worn to college that I’ve really liked. Some days I haven’t been able to take photos of myself, but whenever I remember to snap a picture, I do, and honestly, I feel really good about myself. One of the things that makes me feel best, besides my cats, is being able to dress however I like, and these are some photos I wanted to share with you. I hope you like them!

> ![divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ochitoalreves/23uQmsFb7wdVU1MPTuPG9wXiRHKhacnLVDHQDNv1rh7RM6VpWYTj8pYgh39uucrStmwnk.png) _Fotos de mi autoría | Photos of my authorship_ _[Fuente](https://www.pngall.com/es/camera-png/download/41706) del divisor | [Source](https://www.pngall.com/es/camera-png/download/41706) of the divisor_ --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@ochitoalreves/sintiendome-y-viendome-bien-feeling-and-looking-good)

This is first time in this year, Bitcoin price got 3 Successive Weekly green candles. Today is the first day of the week and Bitcoin price went up. Bitcoin price is in 4th successive weekly green candle. It is first time to see this green candles series since May 2025. We have seen mini bullish trend in May 2025.

Here you can see weekly chart of Bitcoin price. Bitcoin price is still in an ascending channel coming from 60K. Bitcoin price should close this week with green candle to reverse up. We have seen this green candles series as bullish seasons.



![e1.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swiWiwQZs7aSv9WiEuxW5ibfa8a8uTuKf4LHfGWifjSnRxgKk5jL5ANab7fxmMMxpDB.PNG)

Here you can see the indicatos on weekly chart of Bitcoin price. MACD Indicator was all time low level and It reversed up. Even it reversed up, It is so close to all time low level. We need a few weeks to see going up.

Fisher Indicator was on the bottom and reversed up with this green candles series. These green candles series is not enought to break up ascending channel. We may see Bitcoin price in this ascending channel during this year.

![e2.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swkNkYSaDxizvk5fHoe6cWR4yhExJDoWiPSJaGEn8bab5ebX4Xwj1wuTqMXTqgZS6UU.PNG)

When we see weekly red candle, reversing up scenario will end. Bitcoin price is still close to bottom line of this ascending channel. I can not imagine when Bitcoin price breaks down this ascending channel. We will see..

body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 5 Foundation packs, Winning 2 Gold Foil and Epic Card, Battle with Deflection Field and Cripple modifiers
body.body:
Hello everyone,
How are you all? I hope everyone is fine and doing great in their life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYybu2SH75PRNe7YNWmq7fK1xDSF6Z1D3BNQE7qgv6Hsd/image.png)



Today was a nice day for me in Splinterlands. As usual, I went to the mana well, as you can see in the screenshot below. At the mana well, I had six Foundation chests, and I decided to open five of them and save one for later.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd9aMg3MPTQYCTxhVPnsYazoR2ixF8Q4pvBWPS2VcHjBi/image.png)

I was excited to see what I would get because today my gut feeling was telling me that I might win at least one gold foil card. Let’s see if that actually happened or if I was going to be disappointed again.

In the screenshot below, you can see that I opened five Foundation chests, and thankfully, I did not win just one but two gold foil cards. The very first card I got was an epic card, so I was already happy with the opening. I also won a summoner, which made it even better.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3ndySeFJ4zbNhrZBRhytBUiBSztANeJajL8Bn4Rxmqh/image.png)

The gold foil card I won was Dread tafarian, and both gold cards were the same. I am sharing that card below. It is a well-known card, but for those who do not know about it, you can check it out. It comes with a healing ability, which is why it is often used in battles, especially in Frontier mode.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNh9WSHDETNfoq9XFBPYV6GtUysj7KoKwTjryTyn5wMq/image.png)

In the screenshot below, you can see that I combined three of this card to upgrade it to the next level. Now I need two more copies to max it out, so I hope I can get them in future openings.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3nfP75UR55p8fuzF6e5YW2RoRbMWAL2tpCMWYVxfXPG/image.png)

Now let me share one of the battles I played today. It was against Aurelia, and I used Thalgrimore in my team. You can see the battle lineup in the screenshot below.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2PhMzvco3pjMcDiNvX54TbLUqhqkHm3S9EFaxr38i5V/image.png)

In the next screenshot, you can see round two, where it was down to 3 vs 2. Even though the opponent had Mystic Scale Weaver at max level, I was still confident that I would win the battle.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR6xvFx1wk2kMuTMvihvXB4dEfDvFbgKT4JXyvjTfFR72/image.png)

Finally, in the last screenshot, you can see the final round where it was 1 vs 1. My legendary card Little Sifter delivered the final blow, and I won the battle.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqnYavfbN9BkUWLDRJ8V5oo6cfgnEwW7KYmspTCaU4wT/image.png)

That is all I did in Splinterlands today, and it was a good day. I won two gold foil cards, an epic card, and a summoner. Even though I did not get a legendary card, I am still very happy with the results.

Now coming to my Terracore base. In the screenshot below, you can see that I used five attacks today, and they gave me a total of 1,195 scrap tokens, which is a good result.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHUFn2aNKNxzUBBh7t6xSoAFNpGLDRpKN3cK6iBrmS9B/image.png)

I also plan to start playing Golem Overlord again because it has been a long time since I played it. That games need more attention and time and that is the reason why I have been unable to play that one but let's try and get back to that soon.


That is all I did in both the games I play on Hive blockchain.

body.title: Monday… one of those tougher ones./Poniedziałki mają swoją własną kategorię trudności. /My Actifit Report Card: April 20 2026
body.body:
Monday… one of those tougher ones.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/62b8d426-2b64-4a54-9cc2-a1f6e0716843.jpg)
The kids came back after the weekend like little hurricanes 🌪️
The morning was still in the “we’ve got this” mode, but the afternoon… that was full alert. 300% attention, instant reactions, and a million situations to handle at once. One of those days when you feel like you’re doing the job of three people and still trying to smile through it.

I spent most of the day at work, and since the weather wasn’t great, I drove both ways. And honestly… when I got home, I sat in the car for a good 10 minutes. Silence. No stimuli. Just me and a moment to breathe. A little therapy before stepping into my second shift – home life.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/26d8d4b9-a1a0-4b63-84c8-7cf6a93b9761.jpg)
And then HE steps in – the hero of the day 💙
My oldest son.

He picked up his younger brothers from preschool and school, made lunch – cooked pasta, reheated soup. When I walked in, a plate was waiting for me, along with a story about his day. Seriously… moments like this are pure gold. You’re exhausted, but your heart just grows.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/044c9eff-885f-43ab-a1b8-d1cc9b194c82.jpg)
A short rest… and then that thought in the back of my head:
“Okay, but 3,000–4,000 steps is kind of embarrassing…” 😅

I didn’t feel like it.
At all.
But you know what? I got on that treadmill.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b449dfb9-a4f3-434c-b98d-93262aa4dfa2.jpg)
And it was one of those decisions you don’t make because you want to – but because you know you should.

🏃‍♀️ Today’s workout:

✔️ 5.07 km on the treadmill
✔️ 51 minutes of movement
✔️ 8,944 steps
✔️ average pace 10'14\

/km ✔️ spokojny, tlenowy trening – bardziej dla głowy niż dla wyniku Do tego krótka seria siłowa: 💪 TRX 💪 przysiady z hantlami 💪 wyciskanie nad głowę Bez spiny. Bez rekordów. Ale zrobione. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a95a33a0-7563-4fdb-ac9d-381ed13fa8f9.jpg) Patrząc na tętno i wykresy – to był trening w strefie spalania tłuszczu i lekkiej aerobowej. Czyli dokładnie to, czego dziś potrzebowałam – wyciszenia, a nie zajechania się. I właśnie za to lubię ruch najbardziej. Nie zawsze chodzi o formę. Czasem chodzi o to, żeby poukładać sobie głowę po ciężkim dniu. Dziś nie był idealny dzień. Był męczący, intensywny i momentami trudny. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/525caa53-cd74-4f32-a431-2b67d7034417.jpg) Ale był też: ✔️ z pomocą ✔️ z wdzięcznością ✔️ z ruchem na koniec A to już całkiem sporo 💛 Teraz szybki prysznic i sen, bo jutro pobudka o 5:00. Nowy dzień, nowe wyzwania… i pewnie znowu kawa ratująca życie ☕😄 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/003ab8be-4438-48eb-94a3-8ba2ef2d10a6.jpg) Dobranoc! 🌙
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@patif2025/actifit-patif2025-20260420t184958774z)_

body.title: A Moment Before the Rain: Watercolor Art
body.body:
Hi! Today I am sharing a picture of cloudy sky before rain. I thought for a long time for drawing it. Now in my country the weather is warm. At noon the weather is very hot but nights are cloudy. There is also probability of storms. Sometimes in the afternoon the weather seems to be stormy. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZbA3hCkDs3REGUW7WDTSSEka7YkbJvo6u2jPeqjL3u4a/1776710645553.jpg)

One week ago a storm 'Kaal Boishakhi' occurred.  Every year in Boishakh this storm happens in Bangladesh. First two months of Bengali calendar are rainy and stormy and second two months are full rainy season. So I took by brush and colors to draw a cloudy sky that seems it might rain now. That means the moment before rain. I used water color and acrylic colour both. The white color I used is acrylic. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPkkV8TM1EZH9uKmVD7mMNyaev41cMfPtuZBt2bLceSK/1776710680216.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNs9nPK8X5mcA3xwjFkGDuskoiZdNsgzMK7HYCu8yqAvf/1776710693326.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYakYvw3S1TgippMEeB9CFvrh56jt8HYFPRn8bx84dhTP/1776710704421.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPitgqhruhSoBQFpc5zhRxDvu4g5wVrM48qeJTBnYi9Sq/1776710714769.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZECEpyZF3J269xdoiqe7StSYcA8cYXGUm79iDMVWWcz8/1776710726016.jpg)

First I cut an art paper from the drawing book. I margined the border by pencil. Then draw a very light sketch. first I draw the black clouds with water color. Nearest clouds are black and the cloud of a long distance I used white color.  I draw a green shade where the sky met with land together. Then a small house and some trees on the right side of the field. I draw a river. In the field nearest to the river I used light green and in the middle of the field I used a little more dark green.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcg7ER14KEPYmQVY8xvRcyRvASforvokgFGqhQVC8Hemw/1776710741443.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbjk4ofoevdEnsBCBLHttkd3nVWum9MyCvK2cXvkNQFbE/1776710759228.jpg)

There I draw a little part of the river which spread into the field. As the brush was not very thin I felt some problems to draw the boats. I finished to draw the boats and I took a long time and also reworked to gain a minimum perfect shape and view. I am trying to draw without any reference from last few months. I take idea from some images but try to draw from my imagination. I think it will help me to be a good artist. I want to draw more and also share with you.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZbA3hCkDs3REGUW7WDTSSEka7YkbJvo6u2jPeqjL3u4a/1776710792778.jpg)

I am waiting for your comments about my painting. Hope it will help me to enrich the power of my imagination.

## Hi to all you zapficers and freewriters!

I hope that you have been having a great week, I have so far, but then again it is only Monday morning!😁

This post is my entry for the **ZapFicMonday**! To check out the rules and how to participate ✍️ then please read [It's Monday 20th April 2026! Time for #ZapFicMonday: ZapFic240! The \

ZapFic: Write a story using 240 characters OR less!](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@zapfic.club/its-monday-20th-april-2026-time-for-zapficmonday-zapfic240-the-original-zapfic-write-a-story-using-240-characters-or-less) from @zapfic.club

**The gist is that we need to write a story using 240 characters or less!**

The easiest way to check this is by putting your text into a wordcounter, and then you must take a screenshot and add it to the post as proof that your text is no more than 240  characters for your story!





![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengogaming/23tbREov743rX1e2zrSKj3rAPLUDZJi1nKQrkJ8uf1T4Axz9Pkg1nWMmuFu74BnchGAKP.png)

body.title: Pain Is Pain: Why Bullying Should Never Be Ranked
body.body: Bullying is never a good thing; it's an act of intimidation and abuse that should never be encouraged, and no one deserves to go through bullying, and that's why I believe many are encouraged to desist from doing it, and when you're a victim, speak up. Bullying can lead to all kinds of things, such as emotional damage like depression and anxiety, then suicidal thoughts, long-time trauma, physical harm, amongst many other negative effects. Regardless of where bullying takes place, I believe it's bad, although some have the belief that one is greater or more severe than the other when you compare online bullying with physical bullying. Is that true? What is my opinion on this? Find out more about that below. ![1000312829.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23wWuAh7QXhrKY2hhN8jw9AyaWUSzDzw96TL3c6s7DycKMp9QDdxgMfoZHWPivLepEkpj.png) I believe I explained the meaning of bullying to the best of my knowledge above; it's more or less when you oppress someone, maybe with our words or actions, words that can be diminishing and lead to emotional distress or physical actions that can lead to injuries that could be serious. Although many might argue that online bullying doesn't lead to physical injuries, it actually can; it's just that the victim might be the one to inflict such injuries on themselves due to mental health instability. Personally, I don't think one bullying or harassment is greater than another. Be it physical or online, both are bad, and we can't begin to weigh which bad is greater than the other. Online people will say different things to you that'll make you depressed and wish you never came online; it'll lead to a point where you want to isolate yourself. This isn't just done to an individual; even businesses go through the same. And when it comes to physical bullying too, it's the same, from physical injuries to emotional distress, withdrawal that leads to isolation, and lack of confidence of the victims. So in light of that, I believe both acts of bullying and harassment should be treated and seen equally because they often leave the same kind of devastating feelings behind. And this is why we need to educate people more about the dangers of bullying and the needs to refrain from engaging in it. Because it can be really devastating, we all as individuals need unity to come together, which brings about bonds, progress, and peace in society at large. We should let love lead and abstain from harassing people because it's not good; you can simply put yourself in their shoes to know how you'll feel if you're the one going through the same. ![1000312671.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/Eopszhs8AvExEJsSVFqrNNVCDTviLq5Mc2ZwetqXTB7rJvrLBZXECbFUbVaWBTymGZv.png) In a nutshell, bullying is bullying regardless of where it takes place, be it physical or online. Victims in both platforms face emotional trauma that leads to isolation, lack of confidence, depression, and anxiety. Which isn't what anyone deserves, so in light of that, let us treat people with love and respect, correcting in love rather than making them a laughing stock or bullying them to make ourselves feel good. Stay away from bullying, it's not good. *** All photos are taken and edited on canva. ***

# LIMA STREET DIARIES: THE HUMID SAUNA / DIARIOS DE CALLE: EL SAUNA HÚMEDO [ENG-ESP] ### Daily Life in the Concrete Jungle / El día a día en la selva de cemento
(https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eo45m11QFh7wnCs4p8pC6afUqc1NcBQCFChxAhzT8RzjQ7Xz8t7Z5Q1pTeCH1FHkdHA.jpg *“The city turns into a sauna, but the camera never stops.”* / *“La ciudad se vuelve un sauna, pero la cámara nunca se detiene.”*
*** #### English Hello friends, another day of black and white photography posts. As I told you, summer is just beginning here. It supposedly starts in late December, but March is when the sun turns hellish. For those who don't know Lima or haven't read my posts, we have 99% humidity; that, combined with the heat, turns the city into a sauna. Houses here are made of brick and cement, it's rare to have air conditioning, and my fan sounds like a broken car engine. The opportunities I have to take photos, outside of the project I'm putting together, are on the buses and in my community. Still, there are endless things I keep photographing. I really like street portraits; capturing such natural moments, plus the raw black and white, lets the image tell its story on its own. Sometimes I wish I had a portable printer to give photos away, although I always post more expressive photos here that people might not like to see. #### Español Hola amigos, un día más de publicaciones fotográficas en blanco y negro. Como les comenté, el verano recién empieza por acá; supuestamente empieza a fines de diciembre, pero en marzo es cuando se enciende el sol de una manera infernal. Los que no conocen Lima o no han leído mis posts, tenemos un 99% de humedad; eso sumado al calor convierte la ciudad en un sauna. Acá las casas son de ladrillo y cemento, es extraño tener aire acondicionado y mi ventilador suena como motor de auto malogrado. Las oportunidades que tengo de tomar fotografía, fuera del proyecto que estoy armando, son en los buses y por mi comunidad. Igual hay un sinfín de cosas que voy fotografiando. Los retratos callejeros me gustan mucho; capturas momentos tan naturales que, sumados al crudo del blanco y negro, dejan que la imagen cuente su historia sola. A veces me gustaría tener una impresora portátil y regalar fotos, aunque siempre por acá subo fotos más expresivas que tal vez a las personas no les gustaría ver. > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* *** #### 🖼️ THE GALLERY / LA GALERÍA

body.title: Living Daily to Fulfil God’s Will [LOH 285]
body.body:
by Rick Warren. It’s my second time reading this beautiful book, as it says a great deal about God and humanity. The book is about understanding our purpose and reason for living in this life, which is for the pleasure of God. Literally, everyone is created for God’s purpose, and that’s one way we could live a meaningful life. I am a Christian who believes in God and wants to make sure I don’t derail from the purpose of my living, which is to do the will of God. If I were to answer the question posed by @merit.ahama, it’s nothing other than this: the reason for my living is to do the will of God. Purpose, to me, isn’t something I am trying to chase but rather one in which I am aligning with daily. Life without a purpose or reason can be meaningless, and if one is living without walking in the right direction, then it means such a person is just occupying space here on earth. Apart from the family and friends I have around me, they are also part of my reason for living because I am meant to love them, care for them, and ensure the light of God is pointed at them. So, literally, I am living to ensure I glorify God in whatever I am doing. This gives a deeper meaning to even the smallest parts of my day. What keeps me moving is nothing but one thing: God still wants me living, and every day I wake up to another day, I know it’s another chance for me to fulfil the will of God for that day. So, every time I wake up, I ask in my prayer: Lord, what do you want me to do today? Because I don’t want to walk in my own way. I was doing my devotion earlier this morning, and the verse was from Matthew 16:24, where Jesus was saying to His disciples and to us in our contemporary times that if anyone wants to come after Him, such a person must give up their own way, take up their cross, and follow Him. Emphasis on “must,” which means once an individual has decided to follow Christ, it’s not about them anymore but about Christ. You see, that word “must” means to surrender and not something done in your own convenience. It’s a sacrifice! What keeps me moving forward each day? It is the fact that I have another opportunity to do the right thing, which I must not fail to do, else it’s a sin according to James 4:17. So, it’s not a routine for me every day to keep moving but a responsibility and an opportunity to live for God.

ENG:
I visited the Fragua Martiana, a site built on the only remaining ruins of the San Lázaro quarries, where **José Martí** endured political imprisonment with forced labor when he was barely a young man.

The bronze statue represents Martí, based on the only existing photo of him from that period, behind which he wrote the famous words to his mother: \

The bronze plaques on the wall are dedicated to his parents, who did everything possible to free him from such a severe punishment and managed to have his sentence commuted to exile—something that most likely saved his life and changed the history of my homeland.

On the stone walls, covered with many ferns (Martí adored greenery and nature), there are other marble and bronze plaques with words he wrote throughout his life about that prison and what it had meant to him. Others bear names: the fellow prisoners he mentioned in his work Political Imprisonment in Cuba. Children younger than him, 12 years old; elderly people over 70; some.of them innocent people who were there with no idea why.

Martí was in political prison between the ages of 16 and 17. He came out with health problems that never left him throughout his short life. From the chain of his shackle, he took a link, with which he made a ring that he never took off. So as never to forget.

San Lázaro gave us the Martí we came to know... but what a price.
***

body.title: Ostatnio czytałem #225 - \
