body.body:
----
Seulawah RG nature tourism, a small paradise with pristine natural views and the best place to relieve fatigue and enjoy a very peaceful atmosphere.
----

![IMG-20260421-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYQcdomGCnoZmdrwmg5HHrG8Kth5r6bUvqHm7DhnTsEFb/IMG-20260421-WA0001.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Good evening, my friends, wherever you are. I hope you are all healthy and happy so you can go about your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a pleasant day.

In this blog, I want to share some images with you all related to one of the tourist destinations I've also shared in my previous blog, *Seulawah RG Nature Tourism*. However, in this blog, we will focus on exploring and seeing the facilities at that destination.

So, keep following my blog to see the Seulawah Agam RG tourist destination, along with short articles from me.

![IMG-20260420-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdxovqGMbXf7Na9BPyQvQxFVNgT6J1XVWqCFGR4aPZrWk/IMG-20260420-WA0008.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPK6nvDf4w7vAzKsD5PKPHoq7NJvTSa6xv1r4KRRtTfRe/IMG-20260420-WA0007.jpg)

Located in Makmur Village, Blang Bintang District, Aceh Besar Regency, Seulawah RG Nature Tourism Destination is a relatively new tourist destination known for its pristine natural scenery and is a great place to unwind and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere with friends or family.

![IMG-20260420-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUYLtefchxuedgAU26A7B4XPUsyB9YtHDh1ZQumMiyBzX/IMG-20260420-WA0006.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUJnpHEp9YqwzgEY9XkD7ZeYZMXdhvUdQ2U1vbHCX1ya5/IMG-20260420-WA0000.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdP7HjQp5u9Wf9oD6yb4oBGFwJQQbTbEs1f44kEHSZkfc/IMG-20260420-WA0018.jpg)

The first thing that caught my attention as I explored this tourist destination was the strikingly colored, love-shaped building perched atop a hill.

My friend...
After I researched the area and arrived, I discovered that this striking building was one of the VIP villas located within the area.
However, on sunny days, this area is often used by visitors as a photo spot, with its stunning views, especially since the building is situated at the highest point of the area, surrounded by synthetic grass.

![IMG-20260420-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSiVAWzgMrA3ozAz5mPEwBS6B8h2tcvCi2aNZ5w9FTwsq/IMG-20260420-WA0001.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNgWbVJimKNhCbrSYnKec42E1pecupc7encB22GS6oTdA/IMG-20260420-WA0003.jpg)

At a glance when I was in this area, I could see the vastness of the Seulawah RG Natural Tourism destination area.

![IMG-20260420-WA0010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaFuYBTDF5fqDJC1CvfGBf2WDKk5pVvfgKnbPCATwCtpb/IMG-20260420-WA0010.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3mcNDY8qU2tBoYZmH4jRNzSVtSGz6YXUyaCZBq48RQk/IMG-20260420-WA0017.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTqTWYnDkFr3H82GJysqJbX87iWBV8K7q6G56BV2VqTkZ/IMG-20260420-WA0016.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTe2zmsccjvHfGFYjxajbV1NjW5Ufres69fwHXC1mdP31/IMG-20260420-WA0015.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyqn5bNdWVHbKQgSzrKfQPCzrfHbetDLaULy42Q5NzM9/IMG-20260420-WA0013.jpg)

Then I continued to explore the tourist destination area which is not far from the striking building which is one of the VIP Villas, we can also immediately see the swimming pool.

![IMG-20260420-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQD83CdzzjoyW5soRZhfr7Ezt2Dbum8ruGqGXtVxcsFJZ/IMG-20260420-WA0002.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQZ8nYtLhxPeq8BoCK9FSvVSAnpREgVos6x8vE3zvMuaY/IMG-20260420-WA0005.jpg)

Now, for those of us who enjoy fishing, you can rest assured that this place also offers a fishing platform with a super-abundance of fish.

In the image I've shared, you can see this simple pond, which is part of the area provided by this place and is also one of the interesting facilities to try. Therefore, I highly recommend those of you who enjoy fishing, if you visit here, try to catch some really, really big fish, if you're lucky.

![IMG-20260420-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPUiYw1dXBKJ5ReSU2AQC2nPq4TMJjjmQGvkaxLfVfbAf/IMG-20260420-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVw5mxQuphAoGRhGEYzC4JLbZ3Yg3RAHzK9UgrijC6vHm/IMG-20260420-WA0004.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRLyMTeGqsnzYTHE2xVCTiJqP8ARtwPZakAAo2BKtFxq3/IMG-20260420-WA0014.jpg)

While fishing, you can also order food, as there's a food service station next to the pond. I think the light snacks available in the area are a perfect way to enjoy the fishing atmosphere while fishing.

Furthermore, the area is very spacious, with more than one food service station.

![IMG-20260420-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSj73zB38y2uor9XRvkeFp9pqrr322jqhQpmktufTXQMJ/IMG-20260420-WA0012.jpg)

![IMG-20260420-WA0011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTw4KbtNPAYzxYartsZnZ5aiJ3HnMqBo3nx5ih8UAX9c6/IMG-20260420-WA0011.jpg)

Another facility I encountered while exploring this tourist destination was a playground.

My friends...
So, for those of you visiting with your beloved children, don't worry, because this place also provides children's play facilities and a wide selection of games.

![IMG-20260420-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTkAjzq9AVyUxArKe75VzsZu1CDS2k8VzgeaVGW3aLcox/IMG-20260420-WA0019.jpg)

![IMG-20260324-WA0142.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKzANbSFT3o7rKG9nXgRWdeLjxvWmyELX2C4tPQj7FMM/IMG-20260324-WA0142.jpg)

![IMG-20260324-WA0140.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP7qAjbvmiriKb2kT4f6s8Wgmmz8qfyMwb1eGVcxVWide/IMG-20260324-WA0140.jpg)

Okay, my friends, those are some pictures of the facilities at the Seulawah RG nature tourism site.

From that, I can say that not all places can provide a sense of calm with adequate facilities, but this place is different. Here, the atmosphere, views, and feelings blend perfectly.
For me, this isn't just a hangout spot; it's more like a place to reset.
Therefore, I highly recommend that you all consider visiting the Seulawah RG nature tourism site if you're ever in Aceh.

And thank you very much to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.
Leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me, so I can make this blog even better in the future.

That's all for now.
Greetings everyone.
See you in my next blog.

---

Hoy 20 de abril del 2026 doy inicio a este evento personal al que he decidido llamar SESIÓN MUSICA EN APAGÓN. Este espacio tiene la peculiaridad de que las canciones que estaré interpretando son de la autoría de otros artistas con arreglos melódicos míos, basados en el género de la trova cubana y en mi estilo propio en interpretación. También dentro de este espacio haré un estilo de videos blogs dando mis opiniones y mis visiones sobre todo lo que abarca el tema de la música en la actualidad y en tiempos pasados. Daré y reaccionaré a canciones en estreno y géneros musicales. Para esto propongo la participación de ustedes como público y consumidor de mi contenido. Cómo público me comentarán en cada publicación la temática a tratar o canción a interpretar en el siguiente video. Deseo conformar una relación de Creador y público dónde interactuemos y desarrollemos un debate sobre lo que tanto apasiona que es la música en todo su esplendor.
Cuento con su apoyo y espero que les guste esta idea 🙏 


Canción interpretada:
El tiempo lo dirá _ Pedro Capo
Canción original:
[link text](https://youtu.be/rs77bWculoA?si=VHlJxq-aZVLL6q7K
)
ENG:
Today, April 20, 2026, I'm launching this personal event I've decided to call MUSIC IN BLACKOUT SESSION. This space is unique in that the songs I'll be performing are by other artists, with my own melodic arrangements based on the Cuban trova genre and my own unique style of interpretation. I'll also be creating a video blog format, sharing my opinions and perspectives on all aspects of music, both contemporary and from the past. I'll be performing and reacting to new releases and musical genres. I invite you, as the audience and consumers of my content, to participate. As the audience, you can comment on each post with the topic or song I'd like to see in the next video. I hope to build a relationship between creator and audience where we can interact and develop a discussion about what we're both so passionate about: music in all its splendor. I'm counting on your support and I hope you like this idea 🙏
Song performed:
El tiempo lo dirá - Pedro Capó 
Original song:

body.title: 🍗🔥 SHREDDED CHICKEN “ROPA VIEJA” STYLE 🇨🇺✨ 🔥🍗/🍗🔥 POLLO RIPEADO EN SALSA ESTILO ROPA VIEJA 🇨🇺✨ 🔥🍗
body.body: > Hello Foodies Bee Hive community! 🙌 Today I’m sharing this delicious Cuban-inspired recipe, but with a special twist… I made it using an **Olla Reina** 👑🔥 This dish was inspired by those family moments where **ropa vieja** filled the house with irresistible aromas 🍽️🇨🇺. But this time, I adapted it with chicken and cooked it in a practical, faster way thanks to the Olla Reina 💡✨ 📸 The result? Tender, juicy shredded chicken soaked in a rich, flavorful sauce 🤤💥
> * Oil 🛢️ * Garlic 🧄 * Cumin 🌿 * Tomato puree 🍅 * 2 Goya seasoning packets 💛
> 👨‍🍳 **PREPARATION:** 1. Place the chicken thighs in the Olla Reina with water and cook until tender 🍲⚡
> 2. Remove the chicken, shred it (ripearlo) with a fork 🍴
> 3. Save one cup of the chicken broth 💧
> 4. In the same pot, add oil and sauté garlic, cumin, and spices 🔥

> 5. Add the shredded chicken, vinegar, salt, garlic, cumin, and Goya seasoning 💥 6. Pour in the tomato puree and a bit of the reserved broth 🍅💧 7. Let it cook until the sauce thickens and everything is well combined 😍

> 💡 **TIP:** Cooking it in the Olla Reina enhances the flavor and makes the chicken extra soft and juicy 🤤🔥 🍽️ I served it with moro rice, fresh tomato salad 🍅🥗, and a refreshing guava juice 🍹… a true Cuban-style meal! 🇨🇺✨ This recipe reminded me that tradition can evolve while keeping its essence alive 💖
> Let me know what you think 👇 and don’t forget to save it! 💾🔥 * * *

> ¡Hola comunidad de Foodies Bee Hive! 🙌 Hoy les traigo esta receta cubana con un toque especial… ¡hecha en **Olla Reina**! 👑🔥 Esta receta nace de esos recuerdos donde la **ropa vieja** llenaba la casa de aromas increíbles 🍽️🇨🇺, pero esta vez la reinventé con pollo y usando la Olla Reina para hacerla más práctica y rápida 💡✨ 📸 El resultado: un pollo suave, jugoso y lleno de sabor en una salsa deliciosa 🤤💥
> * Aceite 🛢️ * Ajo 🧄 * Comino 🌿 * Puré de tomate 🍅 * 2 sobres de Goya 💛
> 👨‍🍳 **PREPARACIÓN:** 1. Coloca los muslos de pollo en la Olla Reina con agua y cocínalos hasta que estén blandos 🍲⚡
> 2. Retira el pollo y desmenúzalo 🍴
> 3. Guarda un vasito del caldo 💧
> 4. En la misma olla, añade aceite y sofríe el ajo, comino y especias 🔥

> 5. Incorpora el pollo ripeado junto con vinagre, sal, ajo, comino y los sobres de Goya 💥 6. Agrega el puré de tomate y un poco del caldo reservado 🍅💧 7. Cocina hasta que la salsa espese y todo esté bien integrado 😍
> 💡 **TIP:** La Olla Reina ayuda a que el pollo quede más tierno y absorba mejor los sabores 🤤🔥 🍽️ Lo acompañé con arroz moro, ensalada de tomate 🍅🥗 y jugo de guayaba 🍹 ¡Una combinación perfecta! 🇨🇺✨
></center>\n\nCuéntame qué te parece 👇 y guarda esta receta 💾🔥

body.body:
**Outfits say something, but not nearly as much as people pretend.** They can signal mood, context, taste, social awareness, or whether someone wants attention or ease, but they do **not** reveal character with any real reliability. That gap matters: first impressions are fast, but fast is not the same as accurate. Research on person perception backs that up—clothing shapes judgment, yet those judgments are often shallow and incomplete [PMC](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10559650/) [SAGE](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/10888683231157961).

Your point is the right one: **simple clothes do not mean a simple mind**. A person can dress plainly and still be deep, sharp, chaotic, kind, arrogant, brilliant, or all of the above. Clothes are better at telling us **how someone chose to present themselves in that moment** than who they truly are.

The image fits your argument well. It shows a plainly dressed man in a quiet street, but around him there’s this burst of books, color, and imagination—basically a visual middle finger to shallow judgment. **That’s the whole point:** the outer layer looks calm; the inner world is on fire.

On the “story” side, I’d put it like this: **an outfit alone rarely tells a full story, but it can carry traces of one**. A clean shirt says almost nothing. A soldier’s uniform covered in mud, sweat, and blood says **something happened**—but even then, it still doesn’t tell the full truth without context. Clothes can be clues. They are not a verdict.

A related community take showed up in [this post](https://inleo.io/@peckypeace/both-are-dangerous--) touching on how appearance and visible situations can shape quick reactions, but your post goes deeper because it separates **surface signal** from **actual identity**. That distinction is smart. People judge by covers because it’s easy; understanding someone takes actual effort, and apparently that is too much work for half the planet.

body.title: MLB: Los Rojos ¿Por fin?  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
body.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Una de las cosas que le he venido pidiendo a nuestro gran amigo @hosgug desde hace tiempo, ha sido paciencia para ver a sus Rojos de Cincinnati explotar finalmente, luego de años de reconstrucción. Jamás puedo afirmar con contundencia que ha llegado esperanzadoramente ese día, dado que los Rojos han sufrido una cantidad de imponderables en lo que va de zafra, sobretodo con su pitcheo abridor. Pero he aquí que un error de fildeo del tercera base de los Mellizos, ante batazo de Eugenio \

Suárez en el décimo episodio, abrió la remontada final para barrer la serie ante el equipo de las ciudades gemelas. El marcador final: 7-4 y la seguridad de asaltar el primer lugar de una peleada división central de la Liga Nacional, alejando en el tercero de la misma división pero de la liga Americana a los Twins. Tampoco le podemos atribuir todo lo bueno que está sucediendo en Cincinnati a Suárez dado que es un juego de conjunto, pero él junto con el novato Sal Stewart además del bullpen rojo y un renovado Ely De La Cruz, han hecho soñar al público del American Great Ball Park de Ohio. Punto. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     One of the things I’ve been preaching to our good buddy @hosgug for a while now is to stay patient with his Cincinnati Reds, waiting for them to finally pop after years of that rebuild. I can’t say for sure if that day has officially arrived, especially since the Reds have dealt with so many tough breaks this season—mostly with their rotation. But check it out: a booted ball by the Twins' hot corner on a hard-hit ball from Eugenio 'Geno' Suarez in the 10th sparked the comeback to complete the broom job against Minnesota. Final score: 7-4. Now they’re sitting pretty at the top of a gritty NL Central, while pushing the Twins further back in the AL Central race. You can’t pin all the success on Geno since it’s a team game, but him, the rookie Sal Stewart, that shutdown pen, and a locked-in Elly De La Cruz have the fans at Great American Ball Park dreaming big. Period.

# ---

![Roccio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wWyFpnx66LtUHsFvN5cVEoFmE2hcAz4vqrZn1caMLTsFBMUqrogVZBN1pUn5K9hSh3x.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/orioles-vs-guardians/2026/04/19/824452/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Sí, el toletero dominicano José Ramírez largó dos vuelacercas para la causa indígena en el Progressive Field, pero fue el campo corto venezolano Brayan Roccio quien se llevó los reflectores de la prensa por segundo día consecutivo en Cleveland. La razón de esto fue las 3 carreras impulsadas en sus turnos al bate, cuando la pizarra ya tenía dos outs y eso episodios estaban a punto de culminar en cero carreras. El caraqueño apenas batea para AVE .254 en su acumulado, pero lleva AVE .375 en sus últimos 7 juegos, incluyendo una racha de 6 bateando de hit. Ayer se fue de 4-3 y llevó la cadena a 9 imparables en 20 turnos con dos cuadrangulares y 8 impulsadas. Se ha convertido en una pieza clave de la ofensiva de su equipo y los ha ayudado a preservar el liderazgo de la división central de la liga Americana ¿La víctima? Los Orioles de Baltimore quienes cayeron por pizarra de 8 carreras a 4 y se hunden en la división este de la misma liga. No sabemos si es la inercia provocada por el título de Venezuela en el Clásico Mundial de Baseball hace ya un mes, pero tiene que estar influyendo en esos bates criollos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Sure, the Dominican slugger José Ramírez crushed two bombs for the Tribe at Progressive Field, but it was the Venezuelan shortstop Brayan Roccio who stole the headlines in Cleveland for the second straight day. He was the man because of those 3 RBIs he cashed in with two outs on the board, keeping innings alive that were about to be tossed in the trash. The Caracas native is only hitting .254 on the season, but he’s been on fire lately, batting .375 over his last 7 games with a 6-game hitting streak. Yesterday he went 3-for-4, stretching that run to 9 hits in his last 20 ABs, including two jacks and 8 ribbies. He’s turned into a clutch piece for that lineup, helping them hold onto the lead in the AL Central. The victim? The Baltimore Orioles, who took an 8-4 L and are sliding down the AL East. We don’t know if it’s the momentum from Venezuela’s WBC title a month ago, but it’s definitely putting some extra mustard on those Venezuelan bats.

# ---

![Ruiz.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23x1FKpiTzWvqeYZuGEE9qbQ6nAX9hoqiVuXbBEg2Ud2K8yiWQy1XqZrGF9USr8aqKiHd.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/giants-vs-nationals/2026/04/19/822750/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Con los Bravos de Atlanta escapados en la azotea de la división este de la liga Nacional (no quiero imaginar cuando el bate de Ronald Acuña Jr. despierte), la discusión recae sobre cual equipo de esa tabla sería el comodín (en caso de que la central de la misma liga deje cupos para los demás). Lo decimos porque los Nacionales de Washington parecen estar jugando a un mejor nivel de lo que se esperaba y están empatados con los ¡Marlins! en el segundo lugar. El receptor criollo colaboró en la estrecha victoria de 3 carreras a 0, sobre los Gigantes de San Francisco de visita en la capital, largando un doble impulsor para abrir el marcador en la parte baja del quinto episodio. El batazo parecía en poder del jardinero Heliot Ramos, quien se tiró de cabeza y no pudo atrapar, perfeccionando la carrera del anclado en segunda cuando el tiro no pudo ser retenido por el catcher de San Francisco. De lo contrario habría sido out el corredor. Dos carreras más impulsadas por el siguiente bateador Curtis Mead con cuadrangular, terminó el racimo de 3 que necesitaron los capitalinos para seguir en la pelea. Veremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     With the Atlanta Braves currently cruising at the top of the NL East (and I don't even want to imagine what happens once Ronald Acuña Jr.'s bat wakes up), the real talk is about who’s going to grab those Wild Card spots—assuming the NL Central doesn’t hog them all. We say that because the Washington Nationals are playing way above their pay grade right now, sitting in a dead heat with the Marlins for second place. The Venezuelan backstop, Keibert Ruiz, played a huge part in yesterday’s tight 3-0 shutout win over the Giants at Nationals Park, lining an RBI double to start the scoring in the bottom of the 5th. It looked like Heliot Ramos might make a web gem on it, but he came up empty on the diving effort, allowing the runner from second to coast home when the Giants' catcher couldn't handle the relay. Otherwise, he would've been dead to rights. The very next hitter, Curtis Mead, followed up with a two-run blast to cap off the 3-run rally the Nats needed to stay in the hunt. We’ll see how it shakes out.

---

![Sanoja.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23w2qGy1cDRRnuC6gifvGShKeGM6fThiJxyvmKjnkyXnuaKYkaBB9FE7qA1Q5iBEpESfi.jpg) Screenshot from [Source](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/brewers-vs-marlins/2026/04/19/823881/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     El criollo Ildemaro Vargas continuó su cadena de juegos seguido bateando de hit, en el partido donde Arizona cayó ante los Azulejos por 10-4. El hombre colecciona 18 partidos repartiendo leña. Hacemos seguimiento. El utility venezolano Javier Sanoja de los Marlins, ha estado sentado aún cuando batea para AVE .320, algo que no se entiende. Sin embargo, cuando le llaman de la banca, el se encarga de recordar a los peces que es mal negocio mantenerlo en la reserva. Dicho y hecho, utilizado como emergente, el hombre dió un sencillo de recursos con las bases llenas para impulsar dos carreras de las 5 que anotó el equipo en la victori 5 a 3 sobre los Cerveceros de Milwaukee. Enfrascados en una lucha a cuchillo por el segundo lugar de la división este de la liga Nacional contra los Nacionales, el equipo de la ciudad latina por excelencia debiera considerar mantener al chico en la alineación todos los días. Es una chispa que no se apaga fácil y podría aportar al equipo, tanto como lo hizo Altuve con los Astros al principio de su carrera. Abogamos por ello. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The Venezuelan Ildemaro Vargas kept his hitting streak alive even though Arizona took a 10-4 beating from the Blue Jays. The man has been raking for 18 straight games now. We’re keeping a close eye on that. Meanwhile, the Marlins’ utility man Javier Sanoja has been riding the pine despite hitting a solid .320, which makes zero sense. But every time they call his name off the bench, he reminds the Fish that keeping him in the dugout is bad business. Case in point: coming in as a pinch-hitter, he poked a clutch bases-loaded single to drive in two of the five runs in their 5-3 win over the Brewers. Locked in a dogfight with the Nats for second place in the NL East, the team from the 305 really needs to think about putting the kid in the lineup every day. He’s a spark plug that doesn't quit and could give them that Altuve-style impact from early in his career. We’re definitely pulling for him. That’s a wrap.

body.title: Outfit can't represent whole story
body.body:
>

It says not to judge a book by its cover, and I also think it is ideal not to judge anyone by their looks. Unfortunately, most of the people around us judge people by their appearance. I think that it is not good to judge people by appearance, but I also can’t deny the fact that first impression matters a lot, and in first impressions, aside from behavior, we focus on people’s outfits, as outfits represent people’s personalities. So, how much does an outfit represent a person’s personality, or is an outfit capable enough to tell the whole story of any incident? ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmayfUfyNT2VQt7bFnQaTEBSb8aji964N77TE3ZFoYT6hJ/ai-image-1776706985405.jpeg) When it comes to personality, I don’t think it is capable of representing personality. Our outfits can represent our clothing preferences mostly. At most, they can represent whether we love simplicity or want to be highlighted, but still, that is not accurate. My own personality is enough to make me understand it. If anyone sees me, it is not so easy for them to judge me. My outfits are always simple, but my thoughts are not so simple, and I don’t want people to judge me easily. Again, there are a few times (rare cases) when I intentionally wear a gorgeous outfit. I just do it because I want to show people not to judge my thoughts as well as my preferences. So, outfits can’t judge a person’s personality. Now let’s discuss whether they can represent a whole story or incidents. To be honest, it is something that can’t be answered directly. Suppose I am wearing a normal outfit; what can it represent? I don’t think there is anything it can represent. It is just an outfit that tells no story. Let’s think about a different example. Suppose we can see a soldier’s outfit, and there is mud, sweat, and blood on the same outfit. Can it represent anything? I guess it has something to tell. Let me imagine the story behind it. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmULURyBXmgXptduTcXSjENX7MBfGXWdWqWD7GfHn46pqu/ai-image-1776707328913.jpeg) The outfit may represent the responsibility of a soldier. The sweat and the mud represent the hard work and the effort a soldier makes for us, and the blood on the outfit as well as the uniform may represent the determination to protect the country and being ready to sacrifice for the country, even if it costs blood as well as the life of the person. So, in that case, an outfit can represent a story, but just by seeing the outfit, I can only try to imagine the situation. There is no way to understand the whole story just by the outfit. If we have a good power of understanding, we may predict the story a little bit, but there is no way to understand the whole story.

body.title: The Time Is Ripe To Draft Deadbeat Teenage Fathers Into The Military
body.body: ![Merlinsinlove is the author of this picture/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/02/26/21/24/afghanistan-2101434_1280.jpg) If you live in the United States of America as I do, you're probably well aware that President Donald J. Trump has enacted a new law that would automatically register every man between the ages of 18 and 26 years old for selective service. That is, if our Federal government needs to draft young men into the military, the information for them on where to find eligible young men for that same purpose would be readily available. The problem is that President Trump has been receiving a large amount of backlash for his decision regarding the draft. Below is a video that describes that same backlash. President Donald J. Trump's Decision To Reinstate Selective Service Has Been Met With Backlash https://youtu.be/Wo-dhBrWpyg?si=FIZ9c_xJBtZa9Byb Now, I don't think what President Trump is doing is a bad idea. The main problem here is the way he is going about it. He could make his decision to impose automatic selective service registration a popular one if he also enacted a provision in that same law that would automatically draft deadbeat teenage fathers. If you read my **[previous article](https://peakd.com/crime/@epicenterdefacto/teenaged-adult-men-should-fear-american-statutory-rape-laws)**, you'll remember that a group of police officers arrested an 18-year-old young man for having sexual intercourse with a 14-year-old girl after they found them both in the backseat of a car. Many of the people in the comments section to the same video of that incident called the 18-year-old man a creep and a sexual predator. However, I question how these same people would have reacted in the comments section if the police had caught a 14- or 15-year-old boy doing the same thing instead. Now, let's take this \

story a few steps further and say that the 14- or 15-year-old boy had gotten the 14-year-old girl pregnant and then bailed on her.  It would not have surprised me if the very same people in the comments section to that same video who verbally trashed the 18-year-old man who actually had sex with the 14-year-old girl would have made every excuse for a 14-, 15-, or even 16-year-old boy doing the same thing and behaving like a turd after getting the young girl pregnant.\n\nThose same people would be saying, \

They would also stop seeing the 14-year-old girl as a victim but rather as a bad girl who is trying to trap the underage boy with a baby.

I know that some of you are going to say that the example I provide herein is a poor one, because most 14-year- and 15-year-old boys are too young to get their driver's license and would not have a car at that young of an age.  Well, there are state jurisdictions in our nation where it is legal for boys that young to drive, so I must stand by my example.

Underage girls in high school and even middle school confront so much pressure from their male classmates to have sex with them that it is unbelievable.  It could explain why girls as young as 12 and 13 years old seek out older boyfriends instead of boyfriends their own age.

Teenage boys that are still minors share the raunchiest conversations in boys' locker rooms throughout our nation about the 13- or 14-year-old virgin's whose cherry they popped, and they think nothing about the consequences for that same girl in the event that she becomes pregnant.  Many of these boys find inventive ways to get out of having to pay child support if these girls decide to keep the babies.  Often they will bully and harass these young girls once their pregnancy starts showing.

When an 18-, 19-, or 20-year-old man gets a 14- or 15-year-old girl pregnant unintentionally, at least he will usually have the decency to provide child support for her and will even go as far as marrying her once she becomes legally old enough to be wedded.  Yet society and the law here in our grandiose nation will treat such a young man like a criminal, but they will do nothing to punish underage boys who engage in deplorable conduct against these young girls.

I'm not claiming that all 12-, 13-, 14-, and 15-year-old girls are goody-two shoes.  However, what I find happening way too often is that underage boys are getting these girls pregnant and then literally ruining their lives afterwards.  The outrage of it all is that these punks get to go on with their lives as though nothing has happened, while the underage girls they impregnate get stuck with very tough decisions that no girl should be making when she is still too young to vote.

My solution to this problem is that each and every deadbeat teenage father here in the United States should be drafted into the military on their eighteenth birthday.  If President Trump were to include that codicil in his new law regarding automatic selective service registration, the rate of teenage pregnancies would likely plummet here in the so-called land of milk and honey.

All President Trump would have to do is arrange to set up a desk at the Selective Service System that would receive complaints from disgruntled parents of underage daughters, providing the names and information of teenage boys that impregnated their daughters and abandoned them.  Once those boys turn 18, a bus would come and take them off to serve in the military.

If President Trump were to add such a provision in this new law of his regarding automatic registration for selective service, mothers across our nation would go into helicopter-mom mode and do everything to stop their teenage sons from getting any underage girl pregnant.  Also, if these punks were treated as priority to be drafted, men between 18 and 26 years old that are either in college or married, with children, or both would fall into the bottom of selective service pool to be drafted.

Some of you may be old enough to remember what happened to **[Kevin Gillson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kevin_Gillson)** back in 1997.  Yes, he was 18 years old.  Yes, his 15-year-old girlfriend was pregnant with his baby.  He wanted to step up to the plate as the father of his girlfriend's baby.  He was in love with her, but the police and the court system ruined everything for him and his girlfriend.

In light of all the crap that these young adult men like Mr. Gillson go through, it somehow doesn't seem right to me that any boy 17 years old or younger should get a free pass to behave any way he wishes with an underage girl he got pregnant merely because he's lucky enough to be on the same side of the legal age line as that girl.  Drafting these punks into the military would shed a new light on how shameful it should be for someone to be a deadbeat teenage father.

Now, I realize that somebody is going to come back at me after reading my article and argue with me that once a boy turns 18, he should find a girlfriend that is either the same age as him or older.  My response back to that so-called argument is that the heart does what it wants rather than what society and the law expect it to do.

If a 15-year-old boy gets 13- or 14-year-old girl pregnant and then he turns into an absolute piece of crap toward her afterwards, drafting him into the military is the ideal poetic justice that will set him on the straight and narrow.  Moreover, if he is drafted into the military on his eighteenth birthday and he gets a commanding officer whose 13-year-old daughter's boyfriend knocked her up and then went sour on her, you know that commanding officer is going to make that young man's life miserable 24 hours a day as deserved.

This problem with deadbeat teenage fathers has been going on for decades, and it's time to make these punks face the music for their actions.  Parents of sexually promiscuous and sexually abusive teenage boys that are younger than 18 years old seldom ever care what happens to the underage girls their son gets pregnant.  Our laws are stepping in the right direction by forcing them to pay child support to the baby their son fathered until he comes of age, but we have a long way to go before things are right.

If 17-, 16-, 15-, 14-, 13-, and even 12-year-old boys know that they may be getting drafted into the military on their eighteenth birthday if they get an underage girl pregnant and then bail on her and go as far as bullying and abusing her, these boys may think twice about whether they should have unprotected sex with any girl.  Their parents will certainly be concerned about them in that regard all the time.

No deadbeat teenage father will be bringing his new girlfriend with him to the maternity ward right after his baby mama has given birth in that same event.  The smug, cocky attitude of these deadbeat teenage fathers will go away quickly once they realize that they may become property of the U.S. Armed Forces on their eighteenth birthday.

If you read some of my older articles here on this writing platform about Maddie Lambert and all the nonsense she had to go through with her baby daddy, Isaac Frausto, after she became pregnant at the age of 13, you'll realize how deadbeat teenage fathers that are still minors have it way too easy in our society.  While our society and our laws wrongfully treat teenaged adult men as sexual predators for even as so much having a non-Platonic interest in adolescent girls, underage boys are getting away with ruining these girls' lives.

![Military_Material is the author of this picture/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/08/25/07/17/soldiers-2679303_1280.jpg)

It's time that our nation starts drafting these deadbeat teenage fathers on their eighteenth birthday.  Their wages in the military could easily be garnished for child support for the babies they father.  They could also be obligated to put the names of the underage girls they got pregnant and the babies they fathered on their life insurance policies after they are drafted into the military.  It only takes one stroke of President Donald J. Trump's pen to make this notion a reality.

body.title: Online vs Physical Bullying..  Which One Cuts Deeper?
body.body: > It is one of the questions that seem easy to answer until it happens to you. the real fact is, bullying is bullying. It dosent matter whether done in person or online because the consequences of it can be Devastating.. But, to tell the truth, personally I do not believe that they feel the same. and I do not believe that they influence people in exactly the same manner either. As we grew up, the majority of us knew bullying as being something direct or physical. He slanders you to your face, flaunts you about, humiliates you in front of people. It’s visible. People can see it. And there are instances where one can intervene. Physical bullying is hurtful in such a direct manner. It strikes your confidence in a hurry. It may cause you to feel insignificant to others. And there are times when you are afraid of it happening again, and the fear of it is even longer than the event. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkiPzhzFmo88oCY9ZuCLKf38bw6rmKSFpJKvLosLZw4V/1776707606501.jpg) However, there is a different with online bullying. It’s quieter, but at the same time louder. Through the internet, individuals utter statements that they would not make in real life. It’s that audacity that exists when someone is behind a screen. No eye contact. No immediate consequences. Words thrown around without consideration of what they mean. And the worst part? It doesn’t stop. At least there is some distance with physical bullying. You come home, and you have a rest. But online bullying is with you at all times. The negativity is brought to your phone. You dream up and view it. You make attempts to forget, and it remains. Alerts, remarks, feedbacks, it is all redundant. I have observed that a few words on the internet can remain in the heads of the person long enough. Not that they are true, but that they are constant. The repetition of anything negative makes it begin to seem real, even where it is not. That is what makes online bullying a threat in another manner. It is not necessarily loud but it is constant. Does that imply that physical bullying is not so serious? Not at all. Physical bullying may be traumatizing. It is capable of instilling fear, anxiety and even permanent emotional harm. It may influence the way one perceives him or herself and the feeling of insecurity in his or her own home. However, when it comes to a fair comparison between the two, I believe that online bullying is overvalued at times. It is treated by people as mere words and yet words may determine what one thinks about oneself. Language has the power to separate a person. The words may drive one to silence. And when the people speaking are numerous at once it can be overwhelming. Should both of them be equal then? Myself, I believe yes, although with the realization that they work in different ways. Physical bullying must be dealt with promptly due to the physical damage it inflicts. However, online bullying should also be given serious consideration due to the psychological impacts that it may have in the long run. The actual issue begins when one disregards it due to the fact that it does not appear as serious on the surface. The most significant lesson, in my case, is the following, the environment might change, and the effect is still present. In either a face to face or online occurrence, bullying can influence how an individual views him/herself, how she/he relates to others and how she/he navigates the world. And that is but sufficient to treat them both with that gravity with which they ought to be treated.. [Image source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-in-a-garment-lJfgwQ1nNQo) ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

**Title: Five Years Back.**

Life, huh? Life can be so humbling at times. And in all honesty, if we think about it, we will realize that a lot of things have changed. Even though 5 years ago may look small, still, we can't deny that a lot of things have changed and we've made different decisions during that small space of 5 years.



So, we've made different decisions, delved into various things, said *\

But now, imagine life did; imagine you could go back into your own life five years ago, and you're going back with everything you know now; what will you do? What will you change?



Are you fixing a mistake? Will you re-enroll in another school? Will you choose another course? Will you say yes to that man/woman? Will you take that opportunity? Will you distance yourself from someone or hold on to them more?

Mind you, this isn't about regret; it is more of a reflection on those moments of the past, those moments that are given, but if there's a chance to go back in time, you will redo them...

body.title: [ENG-SPN] Castile: Where History Dared to Dream / Castilla: donde la Historia se atrevió a soñar
body.body:
![P1210248.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoH2EduQLcwCUyqNZvGCZTZAdbEDiagHLYCptqJeQ6fFR1W6pXpFvvHmBaV5kM5bfmP.JPG)

We temporarily leave behind the captivating lands of Guadalajara and, following the whims of our golden compass, begin a new logbook through the boundless heart of Castile. This is undoubtedly the land that gave birth to heroes and villains; that stood steadfastly by the great deeds of the first counts who, with barely a handful of men, dared to relentlessly harass and attack the powerful armies of Almanzor; places that also saw the first judges carry out their duties with unwavering resolve; a land that witnessed the construction and consecration of magnificent monasteries, in whose shadow villages flourished that would later become thriving cities; and in whose rugged landscape, beneath churches and hermitages, the greatest narratives emerged, elevating medieval storytelling to the level of Art, expressed in architectural styles such as Romanesque and Gothic.

![P1210284.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xp2ZT7yS57UVPxkoxRJNxPLaK66q7rJBcrKjuWhbxXzYhPeH2z2uK4PyEvkvdFB9Mht.JPG)

From the splendid beauty of that genuine time capsule that is its cathedral, a masterpiece nourished by the wisdom of the centuries and accumulating artistic treasures worthy of admiration, to the desolate fields that witnessed the vanished dream of oil, not far from where witches once wielded their terrifying power, as in Cernégula, we will also pass through some of the most enigmatic and little-known sanctuaries and delve into the diverse, mysterious, and turbulent paths of the Saint James Way.

![P1190833.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/242YE4Ttj4xgmMgqt7MyCXDsrjV3beVLce8oxnvFYdyxuc2UHXBxpy3PU9bFJJhrap69f.JPG)

Dejamos temporalmente atrás las apasionantes tierras de Guadalajara y siguiendo los caprichos de nuestra brújula dorada, iniciamos un nuevo cuaderno de bitácora por ese infinito corazón de Castilla, que es, sin duda alguna, esa tierra que vio nacer a héroes y villanos; que asistió, imperturbable, a las grandes gestas de los primeros condes que apenas con un puñado de hombres se atrevieron a hostigar y atacar sin descanso a los poderosos ejércitos de Almanzor; lugares que vieron también a los primeros jueces ejercer su labor con determinante disposición; una tierra que asistió a la construcción y consagración de soberbios monasterios, a cuya sombra florecieron pueblos que más adelante se convertirían en populares ciudades y en cuya sarmentosa geografía florecieron, a la sombra de iglesias y ermitas, los más grandes storytelling que elevaron el relato medieval a la categoría de Arte, desplegados en estilos arquitectónicos como el románico y el gótico.

![P1200003.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xAbtkLuMf7JXyEeMvBpU7phRvWUe3DToAU5vTzUzJhgWffVhZFPyrnSVQkD8xgVMstV.JPG)

Desde la espléndida belleza de esa genuina cápsula del tiempo que es su catedral, obra maestra que se fue nutriendo de la sabiduría de los siglos y acumulando unos tesoros artísticos dignos de admirar, hasta los desolados campos que asistieron al sueño desvanecido del petróleo, no lejos de donde las brujas ejercían su terrorífico magisterio, como en Cernégula, pasaremos también por algunos de los santuarios más enigmáticos y poco conocidos y nos adentraremos en los diferentes, mistéricos y turbulentos senderos de los caminos a Santiago.

![P1200091.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EonnWFh96H3GYx9dtYYBAD97xBitSNs9AbYybfgsvQ5PCRn3r8AWP2aT1dHM2J3YX6p.JPG)

body.title: Doubting  Thomas
body.body:
? Did you know it's actually from the Bible? 

A doubting Thomas is someone who is a skeptic or refuses to believe without direct personal experience. I would wager that all of us have been a doubting Thomas at one point in our life. I certainly know that I have.

You can read a lot about Thomas in the book of John. 

It's in John 20 where the term doubting Thomas comes from. 

---

*One of the twelve disciples, Thomas (nicknamed the Twin), was not with the others when Jesus came. They told him, “We have seen the Lord!”*

*But he replied, “I won’t believe it unless I see the nail wounds in his hands, put my fingers into them, and place my hand into the wound in his side.”*

*Eight days later the disciples were together again, and this time Thomas was with them. The doors were locked; but suddenly, as before, Jesus was standing among them. “Peace be with you,” he said. Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here, and look at my hands. Put your hand into the wound in my side. Don’t be faithless any longer. Believe!”*

*“My Lord and my God!” Thomas exclaimed.*

*Then Jesus told him, “You believe because you have seen me. Blessed are those who believe without seeing me.\
Thank you, okay, please try it my friend.

body.title: Hive Music Festival - Week N° 184 - Round 1 (April 20 to 25) [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
> The Hive Music Festival continues to be the stage for great artists who make music in this big, beautiful hive. It is these stars who have motivated us to make some changes that we are sure will be even more favorable for those stars who offer us their brilliance in every performance. Everyone has done a great job, and we are honored to have you as part of this great musical celebration. We want to start by continuing to thank you, the artists, audience, and sponsors, who with love have kept the Hive Music Festival stage shining as brightly as ever.
>

>El Hive Music Festival sigue siendo el escenario de grandes artistas que hacen música en esta gran y hermosa colmena. Son esas estrellas quienes nos han motivado hacer algunos cambios que estamos seguro, serán aún más favorables para esas estrellas que nos ofrecen su brillo en cada presentación. Todos han realizado un gran trabajo y nos honran en que sean parte de esta gran fiesta musical. Queremos comenzar por seguir agradeciéndole a ustedes, los artistas, público y patrocinadores, quienes con amor han hecho que la tarima del Hive Music Festival siga brillado como lo ha venido haciendo. \n\n

>The Hive Music Festival continues to restart its evaluation rounds to select the winners. Last week, we wrapped up Week #183, bringing one cycle to a close and ushering in another. Today, we kick off Round 1 of Week #184. We know that in these new weeks, you’ll shine as always, and that many artists will continue to share their talent and bring music to every corner of Hive.
\n\n>

>El Hive Music Festival continúa reiniciando las rondas de evaluación para elegir a los ganadores. La semana pasada cerramos con la semana #183 cerrando un un cliclo y dando paso a otro. Hoy damos inicio a la ronda 1 en la semana #184. Sabemos que en estas nuevas semanas brillaran como siempre y que muchos artistas seguirán compartiendo su talento y llevando la música a cada rincón de Hive.

>The Hive Music Festival continues to promote music by adding to the good initiatives that exist at the musical level on the platform and of course that motivates us to continue working for our artists inside and outside of Hive. We continue working to offer the best opportunities to our artists, so that we can help them to grow inside and outside of this great hive, offering them the best opportunities.
\n\n>

>El Hive Music Festival continúa impulsando la música sumándose a las buenas iniciativas que existen a nivel musical en la plataforma y por supuesto que eso nos motiva a seguir trabajando por nuestros artistas dentro y fuera de Hive. Seguimos trabajando para ofrecerles las mejores oportunidades a nuestros artistas, de tal manera que podamos ayudarles a su crecimiento dentro y fuera de esta gran colmena brindarles las mejores oportunidades. ![HMF_Cintillo_C62.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musiczone/23w31zfaGDJBk27JZPHPWr36DcYxxSuaVouzLse53vw1vdhGEWPKXG5n15MnNX1RoN1vC.png)

> Since the 12th cycle we have been awarding a small weekly incentive, which is given to the artists selected by the judges so that the public has the option to choose the artist of the week and thus we give part of the protagonism to the public who, of course, are of utmost importance in the whole event. The Hive Music Artist is an honorable mention to the outstanding artists of the week of the Hive Music Festival. A way to thank them for being part of the musical party that we have in this community week after week.
>

>Desde el ciclo 12° hemos estado otorgando un pequeño incentivo semanalmente, el mismo se les otorga a los artistas seleccionados por los jueces para que el público tenga la opción de elegir el artista de la semana y así le otorgamos parte del protagonismo al público quienes por su puesto, son de suma importancia en todo el evento. Una manera de darles las gracias por ser parte de la fiesta musical que en esta comunidad llevamos semana a semana. \n\n

The artist of the week will be selected by the judges based on artistic criteria such as intonation, creativity, body expression, mastery of the piece, diction and pronunciation.

body.title: A Movie That Taught Me More Than I Expected. LOH285.
body.body:
Hello ladies, for this prompt for the ladies of hive , I will go with the first topic, so it's like this for me, one movie that really made me sit back and think deeply about life is The Godfather, i did not just watch it as entertainment thing, I watched it and saw some serious life lessons hidden inside it, I mean the kind that you do even realize you’re learning until later.

At first, it just looks like a regular crime movie, family business, power, all of that. But if you really pay attention, it goes way beyond that. One major thing it taught me is how important control is control over your emotions, your decisions, and even how you respond to people, Don Vito wasn’t the loudest man in the room, but he was always the most respected, that alone says a lot, Sometimes, it’s not about who talks the most, but who thinks the most.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPCNrRyJUELac6iDnfz7F3Ktz3DVchgtSus3aj1V4rERh/1776706982913.jpg)


I learned something from this movie about power, power is not about being strong ,it is about the people you know and the relationships you have, Power is also about the time you do things, I saw that in the movie when people did favors for each other it meant a lot, this made me think that in my life , the people I know and how I treat them can help me in ways that just working hard cannot,  I do not mean that I will try to trick people, no,  I will try to be smart about how I treat them.

Then there is Michael Corleone, The way he changed is really interesting to me. Michael Corleone started out as a person who did not want to be part of his family's business, you see he just wanted to live his life without any problems.. 

Over time , things happened and he became a different person, this part of the movie made me think about how the people around me and the choices I make,  can change who I am, Sometimes I do not even notice that I am changing until I look back and realize that I am not the person I used to be before, this Michael Corleone and his story really made me think about this seriously.

Another thing I picked up is the idea of consequences, every decision in that movie had weight, nothing was just small,  one wrong move, one emotional reaction, and everything could fall apart, It made me start thinking more carefully about my own decisions, like not everything needs a quick reaction, sometimes, you need to pause, think, and move smart.

Also, family played a big role in the story, no matter how messy things got, everything still came back to family. It made me appreciate how important it is to have people you stand for and people who stand for you, even though their world was extreme, the core idea still applies in real life.

I really think you should watch The Godfather.... It is not for fun but it also teaches you some valuable things about life 

It shows you the importance of being patient and thinking ahead.

 It teaches you to control your emotions and consider the consequences of your actions.

The Godfather is one of those movies that stays with you long after you have finished watching it, For me The Godfather was more than a movie, It was like a lesson on how life really works all wrapped up in a story.

body.title: Bitcoin Bounce for Android Review
body.body:
I realized I have a lot of games on my phone that are based around earning crypto of some sort (most popular obviously being Satoshis for Bitcoin). I figured why not start covering the ones I enjoy and reviewing most of them that are worth the time so others can make better decisions on what to spend their time on. Obviously with any earning game, there are going to be ads. This is a spot I can honestly give Bitcoin Bounce by Thndr some props – you can give the game a go many times (around five to eight) before an ad is forced on you. That is about where the positives end for Bitcoin Bounce.

Graphics and Sound

Bitcoin Bounce is a little bare bone, but what is here is clean and clear. I did not notice any background music on by default, just the sound effects as you play. That is a nice touch, let the player get in the zone and enter Zen mode as Bitcoin Bounce is going to quickly infuriate most of us. Graphics are smooth, powerups scattered around the level each have a nicely detailed effect on them. There is no slow down or anything like that that I saw on my Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra. There is just not that much going on to slow down a more modern phone. https://youtu.be/SX1oRfflXkg

Challenges and Maddening Moves

You are going to get into Zen mode and catch yourself tapping to drop the ball at the wrong time because a platform you came off speeds you up. It is a bit of a mind glitch to see in action and will cause you to have to restart or watch a video to continue. Bitcoin Bounce has a few things like this that will mess with your sense of distance. It will make you mad and likely rage quit so remember, that device you are playing on costs A LOT more than a pillow or something soft nearby you could throw. I do want to address the earning potential of Bitcoin Bounce. It is really non-existent. I played for over 15 minutes total and earned two Satoshis. That is horrible earnings for time invested. I think the earning is linked to your distance beaten but I am not sure. The game is not clear on how to earn either. If you want a jumping auto runner then Bitcoin Bounce may be worth your time. If you are looking to earn some Satoshis, do not bother. There are far better earning games out there to try out. Grab [Bitcoin Bounce on Google Play]( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thndrgames.bitcoinbounce&hl=en-US). It is free.

body.title: Rich pasta with cabbage and beans/ Pasta rica con repollo y frijoles.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXcnbsiGXWeCUP6zUZKajmpS3PiGXDZwsm7hKPTwY4H5a/1776668734237.png)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? Here I am again in the kitchen. Today I found cabbage on sale. I love cabbage in any way, but today I was also craving pasta, so I decided to make cabbage and bean pasta, perfect for cleansing the stomach. 

For this recipe, you'll need: 

* 300 grams of cabbage
 * 100 grams of canned cannellini beans 
* 1 shallot
 * 6 tablespoons of oil 
* 120 grams of pasta 
* 3 tablespoons of fine salt

 First, peel the shallot and slice it thinly. Add it to a pan with three tablespoons of oil and sauté for two minutes. Next, prepare the cabbage, chop it into small pieces and add it to the pan with the shallot. Cook for fifteen minutes. In another pan, add another three tablespoons of oil. Drain the cannellini beans and add them to the pan. Cook for about five minutes.

☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️

Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿cómo están? Aquí estoy de nuevo en la cocina. Hoy encontré repollo en oferta. Me encanta el repollo en todas sus formas, pero hoy también tenía antojo de pasta, así que decidí preparar pasta con repollo y alubias, perfecta para limpiar el estómago. 

Para esta receta necesitarás:

 * 300 gramos de repollo
 * 100 gramos de alubias blancas en conserva 
* 1 chalota
 * 6 cucharadas de aceite 
* 120 gramos de pasta 
* 3 cucharadas de sal fina

 Primero, pela la chalota y córtala en rodajas finas. Añádela a una sartén con tres cucharadas de aceite y sofríela durante dos minutos. Luego, prepara el repollo, córtalo en trozos pequeños y añádelo a la sartén con la chalota. Cocina durante quince minutos. En otra sartén, añade otras tres cucharadas de aceite. Escurre las alubias blancas y añádelas a la sartén. Cocina durante unos cinco minutos.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvgEC9LDXkWGC8vkDXdX845yEnNqTwCWKr1Gq7mZCakA/1776668776754.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQRxSqHwmdfLd1B7zDBhLymbjFVedzNQNeT8exMj6Z1i/1776668777008.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMLrfk6epUFrm3rK2v8Qf8nqCMrhHR2Nv3e2Jq6HK9oK/1776668777329.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbiLQrLXdizgV8kAVNiTfJ6s5gegdJDkj88noA7FuG3Vs/1776668777624.jpg)

Then add the beans to the pan with the cabbage and shallot, mix well, and cook everything together over low heat for another three minutes, until everything is nice and crispy.

 Meanwhile, prepare a pot of salted water. When it boils, throw in the pasta and cook it for the time indicated on the package. Penne usually takes about ten minutes. When it's ready, drain it and add it to the cabbage and beans in the pan. Serve your pasta hot, which is tastier. This simple, inexpensive, and very nutritious pasta is a great option!

☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️☘️

Luego, agrega las judías verdes a la sartén con la col y la chalota, mezcla bien y cocina todo junto a fuego lento durante tres minutos más, hasta que esté crujiente. Mientras tanto, prepara una olla con agua salada. Cuando hierva, añade la pasta y cocínala según las instrucciones del paquete. Los penne suelen tardar unos diez minutos. 

Cuando esté lista, escúrrela y añádela a la col y las judías verdes en la sartén. Sirve la pasta caliente, que está más rica. ¡Esta pasta sencilla, económica y muy nutritiva es una excelente opción!

body.title: Green Song in a White World
body.body:
<center>![](https://johnmichaelkeating.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/GreenSong-3-scaled.jpeg)</center>

<center>GreenSong 3 – Pencil, ink, and water media – 8.5  x 11 in.</center>

As the days of March grew warmer in the foothills, we began to forget Winter. Winter, however, did not forget us. “Spring,” we laughed when we awakened to the songs of birds we had not heard since October. “False Spring,” we sighed as our days and nights turned white and cold again.

This flower, a gift from a friend, ignored the winds and white drifts piling up against the windows. On the coldest days it seemed to grew taller. Green fingers sprouted, searching for light. Every day I contemplated it, listened to it, drew it.

Years ago when I used to offer classes at the college, I would suggest to my students that drawing is not only the act of seeing, of observing with our eyes whatever the subject might be: flowers, clouds, skin, whatever. But drawing is also an extension of our fingers, as if we were touching the subject, embracing it. What I have lately been learning from the flower is that drawing can also be an extension of our ears. During these weeks of companionship, the flower and I seem to  mirror each other; I oberve it, it observes me. It listens to me, I listen to it. To my surprise, the flower sounds like it is singing.

Do you remember when as a child you first held a  conch shell to your ear and were amazed to hear the sounds of the sea? The flower makes a sound like that, like a sound light would make if we could hear light. No, no, I thought, I must be mistaken, flowers don’t sing. The amazing sounds are only feathery whispers of snow piling up against the windows.

Then again, perhaps they aren’t.

<center>⁂</center>

For more thoughts and images:

My book ☛  [Double Vision, Waking Dreams](https://johnmichaelkeating.com/2023/12/08/double-vision-waking-dreams/)
My website ☛  [JohnMichaelKeating.com](https://johnmichaelkeating.com/)

body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz inicio de semana para todos mis amigos amantes de las bebidas increíbles, deseo que esta venga cargada de bendiciones para cada uno de ustedes, siempre de la mano de Dios Todopoderoso; bienvenidos al blog! Hoy le comparto la #receta de un batido de guayaba y durazno que preparé el día de ayer; siempre uso la guayaba cruda, pero en esta ocasión decidí sancochar ambas frutas y licuarla en la misma agua de la cocción, el resultado fue un batido muy delicioso y lleno de vitaminas y minerales además de un extraordinario sabor donde se podían percibir ambas frutas; les muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** Happy start to the week to all my friends who love amazing drinks! I hope this week is filled with blessings for each and every one of you, always guided by Almighty God. Welcome to the blog! Today I’m sharing the #recipe for a guava and peach smoothie I made yesterday. I usually use raw guava, but this time I decided to parboil both fruits and blend them in the same cooking water. The result was a delicious smoothie packed with vitamins and minerals, plus an extraordinary flavor where you could taste both fruits. Here’s how I made it ![IMG_20260329_142510_613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xefJXkmChQsW1CM1rbxchvXieHfwpZh6t2teuGPyCvb7gMhhUC4Gr1iRndBr34oXJdx.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** para aproximadamente 10 vasos de jugo utilicé: 6 guayaba y dos duraznos grandes, azúcar al gusto, agua c/n

> **
INGREDIENTS
** For about 10 glasses of juice, I used: 6 guavas and 2 large peaches, sugar to taste, and water as needed ![IMG_20260329_131506_962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23x171nMpPQLQzkWLrHb4SjkMPbQFvkRzay5iQjN1yqY9DymQaMo9boNFrz2Cr3hpoNhF.jpg) ![IMG_20260329_131514_011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqpj62MvH1YKTFPPwQZERnGbj8zmr41rnKnTDkcEYAthWBoBuWrYZprdEf4JADSdMTE.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Después de lavar muy bien las frutas las corté en trozos y la llevé a sancochar, una vez que estuvieron cocidas dejé reposar, luego llevé a la licuadora con la misma agua de la cocción, agregué azúcar al gusto y licue fuertemente hasta que todo estuvo homogéneo; pasé por una coladora para retirar las semillas de la guayaba

> **
PROCEDURE
** After washing the fruit thoroughly, I cut it into pieces and parboiled it. Once it was cooked, I let it cool, then put it in the blender along with the cooking liquid, added sugar to taste, and blended it on high until smooth; I strained it through a sieve to remove the guava seeds. ![IMG_20260329_132526_412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMgp6LNL3Jw4TcaG4dwiGUJGLQBRTPVVkkVuZczyo1uXbCLo4SzcTBTFeqT7Tz2Fk8r.jpg) ![IMG_20260329_132229_336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqkHo7TkRo4VM536eodySNoyb7f4kc7maiWaJLCpKJjdLtsnCbLJx93s6ETYZwWfGAE.jpg) ![IMG_20260329_132628_199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23y8mhw4wUvt5oKmJWBeJgkJFArN9uJURS18dwSSNuKxbK3sp5hzMHNNiLbEKdn6JmbFX.jpg) ![IMG_20260329_135814_056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/2423qnw4BZHRctqTVQi3BCZ4eBq7mJesDAFbvKZSjSfrSjxoUpww8aqND3w3zajcutrQ1.jpg) ![IMG_20260329_140141_522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xAVktiSSod9bcPG7zwRZoiKFBe4pN22wAmh2Ujprvarr9tjs1vcYhg2tJnwfe1daXeY.jpg)

body.title: If Claude Built Your Startup, Are You Still a Founder?
body.body:
<center> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXEgHtXNNZb4frN7ESi5c4E5CTnvbdsVwk4ShArTPFERG/image.png 
[Source](https://sora.chatgpt.com/g/gen_01k05cy160e21sn82cjd8hvzfx)</center>

There is something I've actually been thinking about for a long time, and this is a funny question. Since the start of AI and the likes of **ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and even Grok**, there are so many things I've been thinking, and the intrinsic question is, can you really call yourself a founder if your entire product is built by an AI, for example, Claude? 


I've seen the output of what Claude is actually bringing into the market and the design experience is so top-notch so I can't deny that but can you call yourself a developer or a founder using AI to develop, does that justify things? On the surface it sounds like a joke or a funny question that I want to ask others but underneath is a serious conversation about what building means in the age of AI.


There is a lot that goes into building a particular business, be it a SaaS or B2B. In the traditional sense, **a founder is someone who takes an idea and turns it into a product or service and bring it into the world for everybody to use**. They don't always write code, it's not all the time.


Many founders, they hire developers, designers, agencies and all sorts of skills to make sure that their business and organization fly and make profits at the end of the day, yet nobody is asking questions about their title as a founder because their value lies in the vision, the direction, risk, decision and the ownership of that exact business that we're talking about. 

Now if you replace developer with Claude, if you wrote the prompt, refined the ideas and structured the features and decide what to build, test and output and keep iterating until the product makes sense, are you any less of a founder? 

You might not have typed every line of code, but you still were able to define the problem, shape the solution, choose the strategy and take the risk. You also hone the result, whatever Claude is bringing out, you hone it.


So AI has become a tool, just like **Figma, Framer, Webflow** and the likes. And it has become a no-code platform, but it's far above it in terms of output. It can do better.


Where the question now becomes uncomfortable is when someone does almost nothing and want the full credit. If all you did was type Claude, build a startup for me, copy paste everything out and blindly you have no idea what your product does, how it works and who it serves, then you cannot call yourself a founder, sorry to say, because that is a shallow experience. At that point, you are more of a passive user than an active creator.


Being a founder goes far beyond being called a title. It's less about who wrote the code and more about who carried the responsibility. Do you think, decide, refine and execute? Did you hone the process and the outcome? If yes, then using Claude as your team member does not qualify you.


It just means your co-founder is an AI that works 24-7. So maybe the better question is not, did Claude build it? What we should be asking is, did you lead it in the right direction? If you did, you are still a developer, just a founder of the AI era. 




Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@timscreative/if-claude-built-your-startup-are-you-still-a-founder-ddy)

body.title: Comfort Food Starts Again
body.body:
Hello Asean Hive Community

I was happy a couple days ago because I felt like I had recovered almost 100%. I had some digestion issue, from food poisoning then evolved to mild GERD. As the result I had a very tight control on my diets. Let say this in more common way, I had to eat bitter tasteless and disgusting food lol.

So when I felt I had recovered, it brought a very joyful feeling because I knew I could start eating food that were delicious. Food which were branded as dangerous or too much for my digestion, now I could eat them again lol. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EokddDYP36gRbCNa3UVmackGKGdXeioYjqoPymaf5cf361Yq359TLYjBNcXVhp4rBHb.jpg

So I went to several places ordering ~~junk food~~ comfort food... and in this post it is about Martabak. I would not talk in detail about martabak, I have posted it before here, but I am too lazy to find my post about it.

As you can see on my picture above, there is a price list there. Biasa means common, then special which you already know what it means, Istimewa means special too, and the last one is super. Then you can see 2 - 3 - 4 5 telor, which telor stands for egg.

So the price list is based on how many eggs you want in your Martabak. They used duck eggs, as you can see those eggs aren't chicken's. Savory Martabak should use duck eggs, they give more groovy fatty taste than chicken. However there are people who prefer chicken eggs due to health issue. I see nothing wrong with that, but this is a wrong place to order martabak if they have that issue.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23xVMJdmENCXCwVHgq4TYqyceuVrMht8FAGXAwte8BEkovDoU5dcPHpjbSyU5nYwMfnkY.jpg

There, they started to fry my Martabak. Savory Martabak is fried, not baked. Basically it is a pancake with many egg and butters. However savory Martabak is healthier than the sweet one. The savory Martabak is actuall from Yaman or Arab, it is Mutabbaq or Murtabak. The sweet Martabak is from Chinese pancake called as Lok Ho Pan.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EogPDXvLPPMLSP9Evv5zFQGPopWvyDk2FPNpoRWJxUsZoFbmHffXkxmbqduHpXuT2VT.jpg

So I do not understand how in the past the history ran, from Hok Lo Pan and Murtabak, ended up as Martabak that most people know from Indonesia. Both are adopted foreign cuisine, with some adaptation and modification they become widely accepted in Indonesia.

Anyway I ordered the special 3 eggs one, it cost me 45.000 rupiah or around USD $2.7. It was considered cheap for a Martabak. As I have said that, Martabak is not meant for poor people, they are comfort food that only middle class and above could eat that. Lower class usually order Martabak only in some special occasion, such as birthday or getting some promotion in their job.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EprUU4avXsqX26fyTfaxdWjrqJqsLzPfZSNbBmyL6adtkb8ztLC7jQyajHuPSz7Nrfi.jpg

So this was my Martabak. Each Martabak even they have the same name and use duck eggs too, the taste differ from each stall or each brand. They have their own mix for the meat, egg, and seasoning. So buying Martabak from various outlets from time to time is worth to try, because it will give you different experience.

Ok that's my food story today. See you next time and take care yourself!


---

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/48XetgSWyfBM2qUaM6DgxMupc8697f6fQQvnbVnxgvAwbF2DtDg8rzGXSFQs9M5YAX.png

Thank you for coming and reading my post. I live in Jakarta, Ex-Capital City of Indonesia.  I used to live by making money online, that's why I like being here, on HIVE, and in #PIMP - (Paper In My Pocket) community. Feel Free to leave any comment below

title.body: > Una de las actitudes que deberíamos tener bien afianzadas, es nuestra buena disposición al aprendizaje, incluso aún más que el aprendizaje en sí; porque a menudo, encontraremos algo que nos puede ayudar a ser mejores y poder ver esa oportunidad nos beneficia, aunque esté disfrazada de desafío. En la vida no siempre se trata de ganar o perder, es bueno poder medirnos en el camino y darnos cuenta si estamos listos para el próximo desafío. ¿Qué podemos mejorar?¿Cuáles son nuestras debilidades?¿Estoy tan bien preparado como creo? Son preguntas que todos deberíamos formularnos eventualmente.

> One of the attitudes we should cultivate is a willingness to learn—perhaps even more so than the act of learning itself—because we will often come across something that can help us improve, and recognizing that opportunity benefits us, even if it’s disguised as a challenge. Life isn’t always about winning or losing; it’s good to assess ourselves along the way and see if we’re ready for the next challenge. What can we improve? What are our weaknesses? Am I as well-prepared as I think I am? These are questions we should all ask ourselves at some point. ***
