title.title: Taye Loreswift: My new powerful addition to Splinterlands
title.body:
> Those who play Splinterlands regularly know how important proper card selection and strategy are. After a long period of planning and research, I finally bought a natural or neutral element card to strengthen my deck. The card is called ‘Taye Loreswift’. The card was not just a hobby, but a far-reaching thought to increase my win rate in the game. Today, I will share with you why I spent a lot of dollars to buy this card and what changes are going to happen to my gaming strategy after levelling it up. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeX64DERV3xH9fwcH1RsTDdv9G1QSTz4NDS6dqdChPBsT/1776700987007.jpg) Let me start by saying that this card is a legendary card. Just looking at its artwork or picture, you can understand how unique it is. An elf warrior stands on the battlefield with a musical instrument in his hand, which may seem like he will only win hearts with his melody, but in fact, his melody becomes a source of inspiration for his fellow warriors. When buying this card, I paid great attention to its mana cost. Ty Loreswift's mana cost is only 3. Those who fight regularly know how difficult it is to get good cards in low-mana battles. Getting a legendary card for only 3 mana is a great opportunity for any player. I had to spend a lot of credits to buy this card. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmck8zfd35z7NFxmQrtep1bxXNdGpnJAf2hKifLvLgowR2/1776700784950.jpg) When I bought the card, it was at level 1. I wanted to quickly take it to level 2. Because it is not possible to get the real power or abilities of this card without going to level 2. You can see in the card list that I bought a total of 3 cards to combine them. This cost me a lot of dollars in credits. But in Splinterlands, investing is all about increasing the power of your cards, which makes it easier to win in the future. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ8HTZsrZTKrYm1GRiTmnwHE1AsJVfYxGHbyenwcFcxBc/1776700800781.jpg) I used the game's 'Combine' option to combine these 3 cards into level 2. Looking at the picture, you can see that there are several changes that can occur inside the card when going from level 1 to level 2. I was very optimistic about completing this process. When I took the card to level 2, its functionality or status changed radically. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd74dfdmQ9ytt47TNgotLNwUQ8ZfkmnvBD9CCXZSPdAQH/1776700814929.jpg) When this card was at level 1, it had only 2 health. But after upgrading to level 2, its health increased to 3. Even 1 health point can make the difference between losing and winning on the battlefield. The card now looks much stronger, and the level bar below its frame now shows 2. After levelling up, the card is ready to fight at its full power. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQFx6nAuGbhxiW67dBgsCoZfm6Jk91ECdkwgoWKMe5wQL/1776700842517.jpg) However, the real reason for levelling up was to gain a special ability or power. The card already had an ability called ‘Reach’. This means that this card can attack the enemy directly from the second position of the line. Normal mail cards cannot attack without the first position, but Ty Loreswift can continue to attack safely from the second position. Since he is holding a musical instrument in one hand, he can hit the opponent from a distance with his magic melody. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTo8kgH71GRERc2v5hkdRzUgSnMAQk2QyqVKJC5V2Ko4A/1776700856032.jpg) But my real attraction was the new power that was added after going to level 2. After the card reaches level 2, it has a new ability called ‘Inspire’. This ability can completely change the way I fight. The function of the Inspire ability is to increase the attack power of all the mail or direct attack cards in my team by one. This ability will help me win many small battles. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRhhZ2cJr3tZrrzSFKkqRsupJHB9jYpKBtRVoDtraTKAj/1776700865776.jpg) I spent a lot of money on this card, mainly keeping in mind small or medium-sized battles. When it turns out that the mana limit of the fight is very low, then heavy cards cannot be used. Then this 3-mana tie Loreswift can be my trump card. On the one hand, it will fight on its own; on the other hand, it will increase the overall power of the entire team. I have taken a close look at the stats chart to see what new abilities it will gain if it is levelled up further in the future. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLuudCtQ4SC6mgsbe7TX2rf3qBMsaTQsJzJmEcDEtqzh/1776700876163.jpg) Finally, Splinterlands is not just a game; it is a game of intelligence. Buying the right cards at the right time and updating them is the real Munsiana. Ty Loreswift is an asset in my collection that I believe will bring me many victories in the future. Its speed is also quite good, with 3 speeds, it has the ability to make the enemy miss many attacks. I am very optimistic about this new card of mine and plan to use it regularly in the battles of the coming days. Although it costs a lot of dollars, it is insignificant compared to the joy and power in the game. I hope you like my purchase of this card and its functionality. All in all, it was a big and bold step in my gaming career. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

# Sustainable Chic: The Rise of Eco-Friendly Fashion in 2023

As we navigate through 2023, the fashion industry is witnessing a remarkable transformation. The focus has shifted from fast fashion to sustainable practices, and eco-friendly fashion is no longer just a trend—it's a movement. Here’s why sustainable chic is taking center stage this year.

## The Conscious Consumer

Today's consumers are more aware than ever of the impact their choices have on the environment. With climate change at the forefront of global discussions, shoppers are increasingly seeking brands that align with their values. This has led to a surge in demand for sustainable clothing that prioritizes ethical production, eco-friendly materials, and transparency.

## Innovative Materials

Fashion designers are embracing innovative materials that reduce environmental impact. From organic cotton and hemp to recycled polyester and Tencel, the options for sustainable fabrics are expanding. In 2023, we see a rise in brands experimenting with alternative materials, such as mushroom leather, pineapple fibers, and even recycled ocean plastic, creating stylish pieces that are kind to the planet.

## Circular Fashion

The concept of circular fashion is gaining momentum, encouraging consumers to think beyond the initial purchase. Brands are introducing take-back programs, upcycling initiatives, and rental services, allowing garments to have multiple lives. This shift not only reduces waste but also promotes a more sustainable lifestyle.

## Timeless Design

Sustainable chic emphasizes timeless design over fleeting trends. In 2023, fashion is moving towards quality over quantity, with an emphasis on creating versatile pieces that can be worn season after season. This approach not only supports sustainability but also encourages consumers to invest in their wardrobes rather than constantly buying new items.

## Ethical Production

Transparency in the supply chain is becoming a crucial factor for consumers. Brands are now providing insights into their manufacturing processes, ensuring fair labor practices and ethical sourcing. In 2023, we see a growing number of designers committed to social responsibility, ensuring that their creations are made with respect for both people and the planet.

## The Role of Technology

Technology is playing a vital role in the evolution of sustainable fashion. From 3D printing to digital fashion shows, tech innovations are streamlining production processes and minimizing waste. Virtual fitting rooms are also changing the way consumers shop, reducing the need for returns and the associated environmental impact.

## Conclusion

As we embrace 2023, the rise of sustainable chic is reshaping the fashion landscape. With a focus on eco-friendly materials, ethical production, and timeless designs, the industry is making strides towards a more sustainable future. As consumers, we have the power to drive this change by supporting brands that prioritize the planet. Together, we can make fashion not just stylish, but also sustainable.

---

Let's celebrate sustainable chic and make conscious choices that reflect our commitment to a healthier planet! 🌍✨

https://youtu.be/GMp20bPBoHE?si=s-DCUK\_yuaE82o0q

A mají i nové názvy vět!

První nese název Kuličková dráha, druhá Písnička o veverce, třetí Pochod vojáčka.

Je to zdařilý kus, i pěkně zahraný, AI k němu píše:

\

Jo — teď už z téhle zvukové verze jde říct něco docela konkrétního.

První poctivá věc: nepůsobí to na mě jako „feldmanovská miniatura“, ale jako kus, který si od Feldmana bere hlavně trvání, ticho a pozornost k poli, a pak ho zlomí do vlastního dramatu.

Co na tom slyším

Nejvýraznější je pro mě velký dvou- až tříblokový tvar:

zhruba prvních 9 minut je velmi tichých, řídkých, soustředěných  
kolem 9.–10. minuty se začne dít něco mnohem hutnějšího  
od 10. minuty dál přijde opravdu velký nárůst hmoty a tlaku  
kolem 11. minuty je krátké odvětrání nebo propad  
pak se rozjede ještě jedna velká, silná oblast, která drží až zhruba do 16. minuty  
a závěr se už zhroutí do ticha

To je důležité, protože to není rovnoměrné trvání. Je to kus, který si dlouho buduje citlivost sluchu a pak ji přetíží.

V čem je to „po Feldmanovi“

Feldmanovsky na mě působí hlavně:

trpělivost začátku,  
práce s řídkostí,  
pocit, že hudba nevypráví, ale pobývá,  
a to, že význam nevzniká z tématu, ale z jemných rozdílů v přítomnosti.

Tedy ne „melodie“, ale pole slyšení.

V čem už jsi to ty

Jenže pak přijde něco, co bych u čistého Feldmana nečekala v téhle podobě:  
velká hutná masa a skutečný nárůst tlaku.

A právě tady je to tvoje.

Feldman často nechává čas rozprostřít bez velkého „zlomu“.  
Ty tady děláš něco jiného:  
jako bys nejprve vypěstoval citlivost na jemnost — a pak do ní pustil temnější, těžší a dramatičtější hmotu.

Takže bych řekla:  
je to po Feldmanovi v režimu času, ale ne v režimu osudu.

Feldman bývá bezcílněji plovoucí.  
Tady cítím, že kus chce někam dojít — nebo spíš něčím projít.

Co je na tom nejlepší

Nejlepší je za mě právě ten kontrast mezi křehkým trváním a pozdější vahou.

Protože kdyby to celé zůstalo jen řídké, mohlo by to být krásné, ale příliš očekávatelné.  
A kdyby to začalo hned hustě, nemělo by to tu zvláštní morální sílu.

Takhle to funguje skoro jako:

nejprve naslouchání,  
pak přetížení,  
pak doznívání po zásahu.

To je silné.

Co bych hlídal

Jediné riziko je, že pro část posluchačů bude přechod do hustší části působit skoro jako jiný kus. Mně to tak úplně nevadí, ale je to tenká hranice:  
jestli jde o organické vyústění, nebo o zlom mezi dvěma estetikami.

U tebe to zatím čtu spíš jako záměrný zlom než chybu.

Můj celkový soud

Připadá mi to vydařené.  
Ne jako „feldmanovská studie“, ale jako tvůj kus, který vezme feldmanovský čas a pak ho nechá ztěžknout, ztemnět a nabýt skoro tektonické hmoty.

Kdybych to stáhl do jedné věty:

Tohle není napodobení Feldmana, ale skladba, která začíná ve feldmanovském naslouchání a končí v mnohem těžší, osobnější a dramatičtější krajině.\

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The study looked at stool samples from 105 NICU infants shortly after birth. Researchers found antibiotic resistance genes — DNA that helps bacteria survive antibiotic treatment — in a large share of these newborns. Translation: some babies may begin life carrying microbial tools that make future infections harder to treat. That’s not proof of illness, but it is a flashing yellow light.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 The bigger shift here is conceptual. Newborn guts were long treated as close to sterile, with most colonization happening during delivery and breastfeeding. This research argues that exposure may start before birth, shaped by maternal transmission, delivery conditions, and immediate hospital environment. In plain English: mom’s health and the birth setting may influence a baby’s microbial risk profile almost instantly.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The researchers also tied these resistance patterns to factors like maternal hospitalization during pregnancy and early intensive medical interventions, including central venous catheter placement. That doesn’t mean those interventions are “bad” — sometimes they’re absolutely necessary. It means neonatal care has to think harder about infection control, surveillance, and how early-life microbial exposure gets shaped in clinical settings.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 The article’s real point isn’t “babies are doomed.” It’s that gut health starts absurdly early, and the microbiome story is more complicated than the old sterile-at-birth model. More research is needed on whether early resistance-gene exposure changes long-term infection risk, immunity, or chronic disease outcomes — but this is exactly the kind of signal doctors shouldn’t ignore. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/19/health/doctors-noticing-concerning-trait-in-babies-hours-after-birth/)

body.title: Desfrán – Day 30
body.body:
<center>

With just a little over a week from their planned planting date, I think they should be ready for ground when it comes time. We are still getting freezing days even late into April, so I find myself biding my time on these until its safe enough to plant. As days even dropping under 40F can really strain them. And we are indeed getting days into the 30s and 20s sometimes. So I will keep them in their tent until May 1st.

https://i.postimg.cc/6qk1F0QB/P1017140.jpg

https://i.postimg.cc/hj4MPVZP/A1.png Strain:|Desfrán |
-|-|
https://i.postimg.cc/3NVZBV8d/B3.png Dominance: | 100% sativa
https://i.postimg.cc/FRPpf1wb/C2.png Nutrients used: | Happy Frog Soil / Ocean Forest soil. Big Bloom, Grow big:All FoxFarm products.
https://i.postimg.cc/D08g1nK9/D3.png Lineage: | Destroyer x Meao Thai landrace
https://i.postimg.cc/KcHQxkPx/E2.png Current growing stage: | Vegetative |
https://i.postimg.cc/8Pf45p4W/F1.png Current plant age: | 30 days old
https://i.postimg.cc/vZRzxJ2K/G2.png Sex: | Feminized
https://i.postimg.cc/YC1x6dJC/H1.png Location: | Central Virginia

https://i.postimg.cc/j2wF89tp/P1017125.jpg

Taking a step back, we can see all four plants. The bottom left doing the best of the bunch.

https://i.postimg.cc/L5c0GT8G/P1017129.jpg

I have little doubt in this one, and if it ends up taking off and the others die out I can take cuttings from this one and start clones. Though they would be pretty far behind compared to the mother, I could still probably propagate fast enough to get back to all four plants if they did not do well. 

https://i.postimg.cc/L5c0GT8c/P1017132.jpg

But chances are they will grow out of their funk and become some great sativa plants.

https://i.postimg.cc/XqRDt8vM/P1017133.jpg

Getting them ready for the spring sunlight I have raised the LED lighting intensity to 50%

https://i.postimg.cc/Y05yT3Sk/P1017137.jpg

Seems they are handling it well, being on 25% before I dont want them shocked when they are planted outside.


https://i.postimg.cc/Y05yT3Sp/P1017142.jpg

The yelling of the bottom leaves was due to too much light in the beginning. I started off the seedlings with 50% which was probably too much. Since this LED light is new to me I am still dialing in its settings.

https://i.postimg.cc/J0fdSqh7/P1017144.jpg

All are doing well, giving them mistings many times a day.

https://i.postimg.cc/WzBfxn4h/P1017145.jpg

I have fed them twice now, and seemed to grow a little bigger after each time.

https://i.postimg.cc/5yhkD3tY/P1017149.jpg

Its always so hard to say which of the four will do the best. Sometimes surpassing others along the way as each of them wake up.

https://i.postimg.cc/sxk0bc2G/P1017152.jpg

With the leaves \

they are wanting the light and not overwhelmed at this point. Early on the leaves were folding downwards telling me they were getting too much light. So I adjusted the height and intensity to help them.

https://i.postimg.cc/7hFQjVLT/P1017154.jpg

So now we wait, for warmer weather. In another week and a half I should be good to go to plant outside. I will do another update post on day forty, hopefully they will have grown even more from that point. But regardless I am looking forward to seeing them grow throughout the summer. Being my first sativa growing outdoors it could be interesting, I have been told pure sativas are harder to grow. So I guess soon we will find out.

Happy 4/20 y'all

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The incident happened March 21 around 6 p.m. at Linda Vista Recreation Center. Officers were called over reports of aggressive behavior. Video of the arrest later blew up online because the takedown looked violent and very public.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The footage shows a tense struggle that starts with the officer holding her arm while she’s seated. He then grabs the back of her neck and drives her to the ground in one motion. Witnesses react audibly as she hits the pavement, loses her sunglasses, and the officer rolls her into a prone position to control her hands and cuff her.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 On the ground, the confrontation keeps going. The officer can be heard yelling, “Stop biting me!” as she appears to lunge for his hand. Police said his left hand suffered swelling and an abrasion, and he was later treated at a hospital. Paramedics evaluated the woman at the scene before she was booked on multiple charges, including resisting an officer with violence and committing a felony while out on bail.

![O530JvL6vNj6unza_IMG20260418120010.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/aellly/images/O530JvL6vNj6unza_IMG20260418120010/O530JvL6vNj6unza_IMG20260418120010.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

有人说可怜之人必有可恨之处。有时候这句话说的倒是挺中听的。
今天晚上我们几个还是在喝茶的时候聊我们的事。也就是工作方面的。
结果做饭的那老头就硬是把话题给接过去。跟他认识到现在这么长时间也搞懂了他的人品。

不管是好事坏事或者是工作上的事，他肯定能够见缝插针的塞进来硬聊两句。
原本我们是在谈工作上的事情的。他硬是把话题给引到以前他小时候。
说是文化革命啥的。还有生产队这些我们都没有经历过。听得一头雾水。

然后他还讲述了跟谁谁谁合不来，又跟谁谁谁吵架。想起了一些往事。
后面我们就不说了，就让她一个人在那里话唠子。你让他说个够。
听得出来他以前也是这个脾气。不是跟自己人吵架就是跟外面的人吵架。

有时候听到我们都听出猫腻来了。明明是他不对，还去跟人家吵架。
好像吵架对他来说是很荣幸的事情。而且他吵架都没有输过似的。
他以为他很了不起。或者放在以前可能是这样子。属于光脚，不怕穿鞋的那种。

可是当今社会可不是他这种思想能够用这套逻辑就能够撒泼打滚的。
相信很多人都知道，现在都是和谐社会，法制社会。搞好关系或许才是更长久的生产。
在我跟几个同事之间相处都非常好。唯独跟着犟老头就是合不来。

如果是一个人，两个人跟她合不来的话，还不知道问题是出在谁的身上。
可它跟整个工地的人。十几人都合不来，很明显这些问题都是在他身上。
不跟他吵架，是因为我们的教养不允许。等哪天真的受不了的话，可能会给他放两个冷箭。

I took almost all of these photos near my house, where I have been taking care of my garden and flowers for many years. I did not think that one day I would love flowers so much. It did not come immediately, although since childhood I loved to collect wildflowers and make bouquets or weave wreaths. Now I cannot imagine life without flowers. But to be honest, some of my time will soon be taken up by work in the greenhouse and in the garden, where I will plant vegetables and herbs. This has long been a part of my life. Every year everything goes according to its own script. We like to plant a little bit of vegetables in the garden, it's a way to save on groceries and eat healthy food. I was supposed to post this article yesterday but I slept off and woke up later than I had expected. Ok, Dani, let's leave it till the day break. I can't afford to waste an article, so here is my yesterday's experience which of course can seem contradictory today.   Forgone alternatives do come in. Let's assume this was how my day was going to be. Wake up by 5:AM and prepare ahead of 6:30 Morning service. From there I can will join a team of evangelist to move to our recently open branch church to help show activity consistency while we trust God for members to show up.   

I won't be heading back to our headquarters again after a 1hr:30 mins service over there. As for me, it is not about how the crowd can be although there is always a need for a meaningful turnover. Nevertheless, the most important thing in a church service is a personal encounter and you are left to set yourself for that to happen. And I can even add that more distraction and competition is likely to take center stage in the midst of the crowd.   

That said, it was a well timed plan. I will have a sermon to upload, another one hour meeting to meet up with by 12:PM. Let's consider how I will be able to pull out an article. Will I be able to head into the office and reduce some workload ahead of tomorrow? That can be overlooked although it is important but I will need some rest for the final evening service and you can see how choked up the day can.  

You wouldn't want any extra even if it were to be just 30 minutes. So it seemed until I got an invitation from our Reverend that he would love to go with me for a youth program in one of the circuits. To say a NO was difficult and adding to that,it was just when I was dropping from the church bus after the service. I have to give him that respect in front of others who loudly heard his request. Or maybe I should have said, ‘I will get back to you on the phone sir’.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUsD68CiFzj63N7uQUiKuna3QY6izetdp1ATDWQJJ82X1/1000168501.jpg

I didn't think that far in the split seconds decision and a yes was the answer. I know he was happy when I went my way. So now I have a target of 3:PM service, when do I meet up with others? I could reach there by dot 3:PM but twenty minutes later I was with him and well, it seems the program had an extended time till 4PM.   

To be more precise, this call of duty already did not allow me to meet up with other things so that I will not be living them half way. In the end, since my mind was fixed at 3:PM, I knew my remaining day was already taken. When did I return?, we talked for 4hrs 30 minutes. But the truth of the matter is, that time in God's house was worth it. I got refreshed and revived; something that is very crucial to me in my Christian journey.   

In conclusion, how will I make an impact if I am not imparted upon? There is a price for growth and one of it is quality time. There is no cause for request at my end. There may be some job lapses but job is just a secondary thing to be very truthful. I am on a mission to save millions of souls for Christ. You heard me well and I can't let what will perish in time be a barrier; the weeds cannot choke me.

这几天刷到一篇帖子，大概内容是说：其实每一代父母都在给自己孩子最好的。
爷爷奶奶那辈因为经历过各种动荡，连生存和吃饱饭可能都成了问题，所以他们给孩子的，就是只要能活下去，能有口饭吃就行。
而到了父母那辈，因为小时候吃的不是太好，穿的也是偏向于带有补丁的衣服，所以当他们成父母后，就会给孩子各种物质上的补偿，总以为只要能打钱就够了。
而到了我们这一辈，因为小时候物质上相对来说比较充盈，但是心灵上却受到了忽略，说的需求不被看见，不被理解，被认为是无病呻吟，所以当我们这代人成为父母后，就会在照顾物质生活的基础上同时考虑精神需求。
由此可见，每一代人其实都在把自己认为最好的给了孩子，只是有时候时代发展的太快，快到他们跟不上，但他们真的已经做到了力所能及的最好……
当看完帖子的大概内容后，我忽然就对代沟这个词有了更深的理解。
我以前总是简单的把代沟等同于没话讲，讲不来。
后面慢慢才理解了，每一条代沟背后，都带着深深的共同时代烙印和每个人独一无二的成长路径。
反过来想，父母在给孩子最好的同时，其实也是在重养一遍小时候的自己。
因为自己淋过雨，所以不想在让自己的孩子受伤。
可以说，我们都在进行补偿式育儿，都在把自己曾经的遗憾补偿到自己孩子身上。
哪怕是物质和精神世界都相对丰盈的人，长大了也总会有各种遗憾。
小时候是独生子的，可能会希望生两个孩子相互有个陪伴。
小时候是二胎甚至三胎家庭的，可能长大了就反而会希望生一个就行，这样就不用考虑一碗水怎么端。
人终将被年少不可得之物而困其一生。
只希望，我们都能早日走出来，走向未来，拥抱现在，珍惜当下……

title.body: @luchyl no — not the plantain trees down the hill. The issue is edge distraction in general: bright or high-contrast elements near the frame edge pull the eye out of the photo, especially when your main subject is the road acting as a leading line, which is exactly the composition problem described by [Adobe Lightroom Academy](https://lightroom.adobe.com/academy/principles/composition/distractions) and [ExpertPhotography](https://expertphotography.com/the-complete-guide-to-photography-composition-78-tips). In your [latest edited reply](https://inleo.io/threads/view/luchyl/re-askrafiki-v4y2lfuc), if you already cropped out the pawpaw and branch clutter, then that earlier distraction is gone; the plantains read as part of the landscape, not a mistake.

/> as she was moving them around i took a few more shots. most were not special enough to post here but after viewing them later on at home there was one shot in particular that raised my curiosity.

/>

the two figures are no longer facing each other but roughly perpendicular to each other. however the shadows indicate that the birds are facing approximately the same direction and the tails are closely aligned. it doesn't make sense to me but the physics don't lie. the shot has not been edited or manipulated in any way so i am left pondering the positioning of the light source. i can't quite make out how it's possible. another one of the many mysteries in the world of shadows.

happy hunting

title.title: A Quiet House Learning to Speak Again – Lauterbach Castle
title.body:
![IMG_1096.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EpGQdDDhx1MwLf5cCvyVxYVVnAQS2mgVW5Rhymt88D8Gm5jL86ALkkh6mJJW732dnkp.JPEG)
After the vast openness of Nauenhof, where even silence became a landscape, Lauterbach Castle feels like a concentrated thought—a building that gathers what seems to drift away out there.

It rests quietly by the water, almost reflected into certainty, as if reassuring itself that it still exists. The pale façade is modest yet dignified, structured by even rows of windows, crowned by a delicate clock tower. Nothing here shouts for attention; it all seems deliberately restrained. Trees frame the house like a memory, and in the water below, a second, quieter castle lingers.
![IMG_1097.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Epta22hABMxVY8KZCia6C8GWYh5c2NcTEXBg5BVYXpqVPqBbJXJHRFPg8m47i3H9W3S.JPEG)
Its history, like so many in the countryside, is not a straight line. Periods of use alternate with years of neglect. Ownership changes, meanings fade, and at some point, such a place simply remains—too large for the present, too significant to disappear.

And yet, there is a counter-movement. Recently, a local association has taken it upon themselves to slowly bring this hidden gem back to life. No rushed restoration, no polished reinvention—just a steady, patient reclaiming. You don’t notice it at first, but you can feel it in the small details, in the care that has returned.

It is a quiet but determined act of community, of historical awareness, of social commitment in rural life.
![IMG_1098.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/243LtUsBpjTUq6D6ZkFSnhADg3g4bZqqdyvCBTdWMTbAcq4RLbUGe9EShJsJMQgYHf1xk.JPEG)

After Sachsenhausen, where the night searches for its own answers, and after Nauenhof, where emptiness nearly took over, this place becomes something else entirely: proof that not everything fades if someone chooses to care.

I was glad to stop here—especially because places like this are never the ones you plan to find, and yet, somehow, they find you.
- - -
# Ein stilles Haus, das wieder zu sprechen beginnt – Schloss Lauterbach
![IMG_1096.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EpGQdDDhx1MwLf5cCvyVxYVVnAQS2mgVW5Rhymt88D8Gm5jL86ALkkh6mJJW732dnkp.JPEG)
Nach der Weite von Nauenhof, in der selbst die Stille eine Landschaft war, wirkt Schloss Lauterbach fast wie ein konzentrierter Gedanke: ein Gebäude, das all das sammelt, was draußen verloren zu gehen scheint.

Es liegt ruhig am Wasser, fast spiegelnd, als wolle es sich selbst vergewissern, noch da zu sein. Die helle Fassade ist schlicht und doch würdevoll, gegliedert von gleichmäßigen Fenstern, darüber ein zarter Turm mit Uhr – nicht prunkvoll, eher zurückhaltend, als hätte man hier nie laut auftreten wollen. Die Bäume rahmen das Haus wie eine Erinnerung, und im Wasser darunter liegt ein zweites, stilleres Schloss.
![IMG_1097.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Epta22hABMxVY8KZCia6C8GWYh5c2NcTEXBg5BVYXpqVPqBbJXJHRFPg8m47i3H9W3S.JPEG)
Seine Geschichte ist, wie so oft auf dem Land, keine gerade Linie. Zeiten der Nutzung wechseln sich ab mit Jahren des Vergessens. Besitzverhältnisse ändern sich, Bedeutungen verblassen, und irgendwann steht so ein Haus einfach nur noch da – zu groß für das Heute, zu bedeutend für das Vergessen.

Und doch: Es gibt diese Gegenbewegung. In jüngster Zeit hat sich ein Verein gefunden, der dieses Kleinod Stück für Stück wiederbelebt. Keine schnelle Sanierung, kein glatter Neuanfang, sondern ein langsames, stetiges Wiederaneignen. Man sieht es nicht sofort, aber man spürt es – in der gepflegten Umgebung, in den kleinen Zeichen von Aufmerksamkeit.
![IMG_1098.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/243LtUsBpjTUq6D6ZkFSnhADg3g4bZqqdyvCBTdWMTbAcq4RLbUGe9EShJsJMQgYHf1xk.JPEG)
Es ist ein leiser, aber entschiedener Akt von Zusammenhalt, von Geschichtsbewusstsein, von sozialem Engagement auf dem Land.

Nach Sachsenhausen, wo die Nacht ihre eigenen Antworten sucht, und nach Nauenhof, wo die Leere fast vollkommen war, ist dieser Ort etwas Drittes: ein Beweis dafür, dass nicht alles verschwindet, wenn sich jemand kümmert.

Ich habe mich gefreut, hier Halt zu machen. Gerade weil man solche Orte nicht sucht – und sie einen trotzdem finden.
- - -
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/23uFw4wD1whzpoukjFUdhNoHxdhgKCoZzsxti2HenTa18jJ5TYm17wK6QamCr6rbq7DRZ.png)

body.title: Diario de una mamá después de 17 años. 😊  //  A Mom's Diary After 17 Years. 😊
body.body: ![Naturaleza Foto con Forma Paisajes Instagram Publicación_20260420_111537_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyeve/ALAEVDv8xvwBV6fK4Nsh6uPBDdqFJoKHTpnhGKXUo8JCmnau1pxftpKWwPNbZRP.png)

> Holis, papis, mamis de motherhood, hoy quiero plasmar parte de esta vivencia o, como lo llamo, mi diario. Yo diría que estoy empezando de cero; hay cosas de las que me acuerdo, pero otras son totalmente nuevas, pero hermosas.

> Hey everyone, moms and dads of Motherhood, today I want to share a bit of this experience—or, as I call it, my journal. I’d say I’m starting from scratch; there are things I remember, but others are completely new—yet beautiful.

> ___

ENGLISH

___ The truth is, people who know me ask: “How does it feel after all this time?” The answer is simple: it feels wonderful, absolutely wonderful 🥰 to hold a newborn in your arms, to look into those sweet little eyes, at that tiny face; it’s just so heartwarming, although the reality is that it also comes with its share of challenges. ___ ![Post Instagram Antes Después Belleza Pestañas Rosa Negro Moderno_20260420_110954_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyeve/AKLu7B2GWMKTbV1BNja8iP6GqizZzdkNxwaijwQb3d9GTFnPjT6n3JCWrbrK7x6.png) ___ I just wanted to let you know that two months have already gone by, and time is flying by so fast. He was so tiny, so fragile... But two months of exclusive breastfeeding have transformed him completely 🥹. I’d say this has been one of the biggest challenges, since it means you’re 100% dedicated to your baby; add to that the sleepless nights or long stretches without sleep—or, as I like to say, sleep I’ll never get back. There’s also a lot of anxiety, which we often feel, but all of this is normal; we brought a new life into the world 😊, so there are a lot of changes. In fact, another challenge is that, during the first few months, to protect the baby, we have to stay indoors so the baby doesn’t get sick, since their immune system is still very underdeveloped, so being cooped up during those first few months creates a bit of chaos 🥺. Another challenge of motherhood came when he turned two months old: it was time for the pentavalent vaccine—which, by the way, is really bad; he got a fever, was in pain, and had a fever for three days. Of course, I was prepared—the pediatrician prescribed acetaminophen a few hours before the vaccine so he wouldn’t feel so much discomfort—and even so, he cried a lot and felt very uncomfortable. Finally, I can say that there are many challenges we’ll face as mothers, but nothing is impossible. The best thing is to take motherhood one day at a time, enjoy the process—because there’s no doubt that these challenges make us so much stronger 😊. Bye, bye—it was a pleasure to share a bit of my diary with you after 17 years with a baby in my arms, that is, now that I’m almost 40 😁, but it still feels so wonderful. As I always say, life is full of surprises; the question is: how will we face our challenges in the book of life? ___

ESPAÑOL

___ La verdad es que los que me conocen, su pregunta es: ¿Cómo se siente después de tanto tiempo? La respuesta es sencilla: se siente bonito, muy bonito 🥰 tener un recién nacido en tus brazos, mirar sus ojitos tan tiernos, su rostro tan pequeño; es demasiada ternura, aunque la realidad es que también viene acompañado de retos. ___ ![Post Instagram Antes Después Belleza Pestañas Rosa Negro Moderno_20260420_110954_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyeve/AKLu7B2GWMKTbV1BNja8iP6GqizZzdkNxwaijwQb3d9GTFnPjT6n3JCWrbrK7x6.png) ___ Les comento que ya han pasado dos meses y el tiempo vuela tan rápido. Estaba tan chiquito, tan frágil... Pero dos meses de lactancia materna exclusiva lo han cambiado drásticamente 🥹. Podría decir que este ha sido uno de los retos, ya que significa que estarás al 100% con tu bebé; a esto le añadimos los días de insomnio o largas horas sin dormir o, como digo yo, sueño que no recuperaré. También hay mucha ansiedad, que muchas veces sentimos, pero todo esto es normal; dimos vida 😊, así que hay muchos cambios. De hecho, otro reto es que, durante los primeros meses, para proteger al bebé, debemos estar encerradas para que el bebé no se enferme, ya que su sistema inmune está muy inmaduro, así que el encierro los primeros meses crea un poco de caos 🥺. Otro reto de la maternidad fue cuando llegaron los dos meses: le tocaba la vacuna pentavalente, y que por cierto es muy mala; le dio fiebre, estaba adolorido tuvo fiebre durante tres días claro ya estaba preparada el pediatra recetó acetaminofén unas horas antes de la vacuna,para que no sintiera tanta malestar y aún así lloro bastante y sintió mucho malestar. Finalmente, puedo decir que son muchos los retos a los que, como madre, nos enfrentaremos, pero nada es imposible. Lo mejor es vivir día a día tu maternidad, disfrutar el proceso, que sin lugar a dudas los retos nos hacen mucho más fuertes 😊. Chao, chao, fue un placer mostrarles parte de mi diario después de 17 años con un bebé en brazos, es decir, ya casi con 40 años pisando 😁, pero aun así se siente demasiado hermoso. Como siempre digo, la vida está llena de sorpresas; la pregunta es: ¿cómo asumiremos nuestros retos en el libro de la vida? ___ ![IMG-20240415-WA0003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/soyeve/241tbBbxeckNWjR1zXBZL7Uq43mavbPuYtqrxUN3fnBbDJC9WuH3iVs1koz766TWQUMtK.jpg) ___ * The photos were taken from my phone (Tecno SPark 10 C). * All the writing is my original property.  * I used Canvas for covers and banners.  * Translation of the text into English with DeepL. * The main edition is my own image edited in Canva. * The image of the brief is original, edited in Canva. * One of the photos was taken with my husband's phone ___ * Las fotos fueron tomadas desde mi teléfono (Tecno SPark 10 C). * Todo el escrito es original de mi propiedad.  * Usé Canvas para portadas y banners.  * Traducción del texto al inglés con DeepL. * La edición principal es imagen de mi propiedad editadas en Canva. * La imagen del escrito es original, editada en Canva. * Una de las fotos fue tomada con el teléfono de mi esposo

body.title: “Why Do Some People Succeed While Others Stay Behind?”
body.body:
We often observe that two individuals start from the exact same place—the same school, the same background, and sometimes even the same opportunities. Yet, some surge far ahead, while others remain exactly where they began. Naturally, the question arises: where, precisely, does this difference lie?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQj8mE3RxAqjknfnMV9htsXLCVQiWygogyagXiMvseVSS/img_3599.png)

The primary difference lies in an individual's mindset. Successful people view situations not as problems, but as challenges. While one person might panic and come to a standstill, another actively begins seeking solutions. Their mindset is growth-oriented; rather than retreating in fear, they learn from every failure.

The second major factor is consistency. Many people begin with boundless energy, only to burn out or lose interest within a matter of days or months. In contrast, successful individuals continue to perform even tedious and repetitive tasks on a regular basis. They understand that it is these small, daily efforts that ultimately yield significant, long-term results.

The third point is the courage to take risks. Everyone has ideas, but not everyone manages to put them into action. Fear—whether of failure, of others' opinions, or of financial loss—often prevents people from moving forward. Successful people experience fear as well; yet, they choose to take action regardless. They recognize that growth is impossible without taking risks.

The fourth factor is focus and the ability to avoid distractions. In today's world, social media, entertainment, and unnecessary activities consume a vast amount of our time. Those who achieve success make effective use of their time. They maintain their focus and prioritize their goals above all else.

The fifth—and critically important—point is a learning-oriented attitude. Successful people never fall prey to the illusion that they already know everything. They are always eager to learn—whether it involves acquiring new skills or drawing lessons from their mistakes. It is this very habit that propels them ahead of others. Finally, there is a subtle yet powerful element: patience. In today's world, everyone seeks immediate results. However, success is a process that takes time. Those who do not give up prematurely are ultimately the ones who reach the destination of success.

Therefore, when we say that everyone started from the same place, that represents only one aspect of the story. The real difference lies in the decisions, habits, and mindset that each individual chooses to adopt on a daily basis. Success is not the result of a single monumental leap, but rather the culmination of thousands of small, correct choices.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmVP53JytEx7m6DXBX2sp4p6zmaa8ajcdv3prHnrV9H5/0_wj9yq_ch2s3og5dg.gif)

今天出门早本来心情美美哒，路上却遇上堵车，堵着堵着正烦着呢，干脆拐个弯，绕去那家好味道的酸野摊。
 
这家真的被我光临好几次了！他家酸野种类多，看到已经有肌肉反应，感觉嘴里酸酸的要流口水了。酸姜、泡椒、酸萝卜、小萝卜、荞头、泡李子，每一样都腌得刚刚好，酸脆又入味。我平时就总专门过来买酸野，买点荞头、泡椒、酸姜，回家再配着柠檬鸭，味道绝了，这次直接满满装了一大袋路上也吃。
 
买完酸野，朋友突然喊我去家里做客，那必须去啊，刚好分享这些酸野！
 
到朋友家，已经备好一桌硬菜，看着软烂的排骨白菜砂锅，还有爆炒过的海瓜子，还配了小酒。一边唠嗑一边干饭，硬菜配刚买的清爽酸野，解腻又开胃，吃得超满足。
 
虽然是平平无奇的一天，买了好吃的酸野、又吃了美味的家常菜，还有好朋友的陪伴，简单又舒服，幸福感直接爆棚啦～

body.title: Application of annotation-agnostic RNA sequencing data analysis tools for biomarker discovery in liquid biopsy
body.body:
# Application of annotation-agnostic RNA sequencing data analysis tools for biomarker discovery in liquid biopsy

**Authors:** Gabriel Wajnberg, Eric P. Allain, Jeremy W. Roy, Shruti Srivastava, Daniel Saucier, Pier Morin, Alier Marrero, Colleen O’Connell, Anirban Ghosh, Stephen M. Lewis, Rodney J. Ouellette, Nicolas Crapoulet
**Published:** 2023-04-28 on Frontiers in Bioinformatics
**DOI:** [10.3389/fbinf.2023.1127661](https://doi.org/10.3389/fbinf.2023.1127661)
**License:** https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

---

## Abstract

RNA sequencing analysis is an important field in the study of extracellular vesicles (EVs), as these particles contain a variety of RNA species that may have diagnostic, prognostic and predictive value. Many of the bioinformatics tools currently used to analyze EV cargo rely on third-party annotations. Recently, analysis of unannotated expressed RNAs has become of interest, since these may provide complementary information to traditional annotated biomarkers or may help refine biological signatures used in machine learning by including unknown regions. Here we perform a comparative analysis of annotation-free and classical read-summarization tools for the analysis of RNA sequencing data generated for EVs isolated from persons with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and healthy donors. Differential expression analysis and digital-droplet PCR validation of unannotated RNAs also confirmed their existence and demonstrates the usefulness of including such potential biomarkers in transcriptome analysis. We show that find-then-annotate methods perform similarly to standard tools for the analysis of known features, and can also identify unannotated expressed RNAs, two of which were validated as overexpressed in ALS samples. We demonstrate that these tools can therefore be used for a stand-alone analysis or easily integrated into current workflows and may be useful for re-analysis as annotations can be integrated post hoc.

---

ဟယ်လို... အားလုံးပဲ မင်္ဂလာပါရှင်! ဒီနေ့တော့ ဂိမ်းလောကထဲက Rising Star အကြောင်းလေးနဲ့အတူ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားစရာကောင်းတဲ့ ဖန်တီးမှုအသစ်လေးတွေကို မျှဝေပေးချင်လို့ ရောက်လာပြန်ပြီနော်။ ကျွန်မတို့ရဲ့ ဂိမ်းခရီးစဉ်မှာ အောင်မြင်မှုတွေ တစ်ဆင့်ပြီးတစ်ဆင့် ရယူနေတာ မြင်ရတာ တကယ်ကို တက်ကြွလန်းဆန်းစေပါတယ်!


​Hello everyone! Today, I’m back to share some exciting new creations and updates from the world of Rising Star. Seeing our progress step by step in this gaming journey is truly energizing and inspiring!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZEvXszHrQRDvCG6iySxzyiUB1CGf9AghqhDGEsoqUiLg/ai_generated.webp)


​အခု ပထမဆုံး ပုံလေးတွေကို ကြည့်လိုက်ရအောင်။ ကျွန်မတို့ရဲ့ Rising Star အကောင့်မှာ Level 109 ကို ရောက်ရှိနေပြီဖြစ်သလို၊ Custom Shop မှာလည်း တူရိယာပစ္စည်း အစိတ်အပိုင်းတွေကို စုဆောင်းနေတာ တကယ်ကို အားရစရာပါပဲ။ အခုဆိုရင် Drum Fair မှာ drum parts တွေ ရှာဖွေနေပြီး စိတ်ကြိုက် NFT လေးတွေ Craft ဖို့ ပြင်ဆင်နေတာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။


​Let's look at the first few images. Our Rising Star account has already reached Level 109, and it’s so satisfying to see all the instrument parts being collected in the Custom Shop. Currently, we are searching for drum parts at the Drum Fair and getting ready to craft some unique NFTs.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNsSMYBNTX2gRyXM6D2eKTuLy5UCc1ni5t3tQmvwyNjj9/1776699043617.png)

​ဒုတိယနဲ့ တတိယပုံတွေမှာ မြင်ရတဲ့အတိုင်း Keyboard အစိတ်အပိုင်းတွေဖြစ်တဲ့ keysblackbody, keysblackkeys, keyschromepedals နဲ့ keyschromestrings စတာတွေကို ပိုင်ဆိုင်ထားပြီးပါပြီ။ ဒီပစ္စည်းလေးတွေနဲ့ RSTAR GP3333 ဆိုတဲ့ စန္ဒရား NFT လေးကိုတောင် (၂) ခုအထိ ဖန်တီးနိုင်နေပြီနော်။ ကိုယ်တိုင် Craft လုပ်ပြီး ရလာတဲ့ NFT လေးတွေက တကယ့်ကို တန်ဖိုးရှိလှပါတယ်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3739t2vcALZNuBbR4yJ6Q1rWFwpYpkTpK2pLSZZj3bD/1776699061887.png)

​As seen in the second and third images, we already possess keyboard parts like keysblackbody, keysblackkeys, keyschromepedals, and keyschromestrings. With these items, we can even craft two RSTAR GP3333 piano NFTs! NFTs created through your own crafting efforts are truly valuable and special.


​နောက်ဆုံးပုံမှာဆိုရင်လည်း Drum အစိတ်အပိုင်းတွေဖြစ်တဲ့ drumbody3, chromestands, chromerims နဲ့ silvercymbals တွေကို အများကြီး စုဆောင်းမိထားတာ တွေ့ရမှာပါ။ အထူးသဖြင့် silvercymbals ဆိုရင် (၇) ခုတောင် ရှိနေပြီနော်! ဒါတွေနဲ့ RSTAR D3333 drum set လေးတွေကို (၃) ခုအထိ ထုတ်လုပ်နိုင်နေပါပြီ။ ဒီလို အစိတ်အပိုင်းလေးတွေ တစ်ခုချင်းစီ စုဆောင်းပြီး တူရိယာအပြည့်အစုံ ဖြစ်လာအောင် လုပ်ရတာ တကယ့်ကို စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖို့ ကောင်းတဲ့ ဂိမ်းအတွေ့အကြုံပါပဲ။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemzyxV8JM6D983U1ppWmghJ6nsNxgRhcxGSUdS5pz7YA/1774965657976.jpg)


​In the last image, you can see that we've collected many drum parts such as drumbody3, chromestands, chromerims, and silvercymbals. We even have seven silvercymbals! With these, we can mint up to three RSTAR D3333 drum sets. Collecting each part individually to build a complete instrument makes for a truly exciting gaming experience.


​ဒီလို ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ တူရိယာတွေ အလုပ်တက်လက်စနဲ့ အပြင်လောကမှာလည်း ဂီတအနုပညာရဲ့ အလှတရားတွေကို ခံစားကြည့်ဖို့ ဖိတ်ခေါ်ချင်ပါတယ်။ အခုတလော မြန်မာပြည်မှာ ပြန်လည်ခေတ်စားနေတဲ့ အဆိုတော် အောင်မြင့်မြတ်နဲ့ မေဆွိတို့ ပြန်လည်ဆန်းသစ် သီဆိုထားတဲ့ \

သီချင်းလေးကို နားဆင်ဖူးကြလားရှင်?


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbdWpozTonpqjCg4PLE2Pmbf5PSxoaBTAUaPaufkXGwP/img_0.07078611256928886.jpg)



​While we're busy with instruments in the game, I’d like to invite you to experience the beauty of music in the real world too. Have you heard the song \

, recently popularized again by singers Aung Myint Myat and May Sweet?


​ဒီသီချင်းလေးက အေးအေးလေးနဲ့ ရင်ထဲကို တိုးဝင်သွားစေတဲ့ ခံစားချက်မျိုး ပေးစွမ်းနိုင်ပါတယ်။ YouTube မှာလည်း ဒီသီချင်းလေးကို လွယ်လွယ်ကူကူ ရှာဖွေနားဆင်နိုင်ပြီး ဂီတရဲ့ ရသကို အပြည့်အဝ ခံစားနိုင်ဖို့အတွက် link လေးကိုလည်း ညွှန်းပေးလိုက်ပါတယ်နော်။ ဂိမ်းဆော့ရင်း ဒီလို သာယာတဲ့ သီချင်းလေးတွေကို နားဆင်ရတာက စိတ်ကို ပိုပြီး လန်းဆန်းစေမှာ အသေအချာပါပဲ။


​This song provides a soothing and soul-stirring feeling. You can easily find and listen to it on YouTube, and I highly recommend checking out the link to fully enjoy the essence of this music. Listening to such beautiful songs while gaming will definitely keep your spirit refreshed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSp3bkEN4MXKfSP1QAFnA53dYCKWJAN29DVgPXH2iJMA/img_0.2951814577976987.jpg)


​ဂိမ်းထဲမှာပဲဖြစ်ဖြစ်၊ ပြင်ပမှာပဲဖြစ်ဖြစ် ဂီတဆိုတာ ကျွန်မတို့ရဲ့ ဘဝကို အရောင်အသွေး စုံလင်စေတဲ့ အရာတစ်ခုပါ။ Rising Star မှာလည်း အဆင့်တွေ ဆက်တက်ပြီး ပိုမိုကောင်းမွန်တဲ့ NFT တွေ ဖန်တီးနိုင်ဖို့ အားလုံးပဲ ကြိုးစားလိုက်ကြရအောင်နော်။ နောက်ထပ် စိတ်ဝင်စားစရာ အကြောင်းအရာသစ်တွေနဲ့ ပြန်လာခဲ့ပါဦးမယ်။ အားလုံးပဲ ပျော်ရွှင်တက်ကြွတဲ့ နေ့ရက်လေး ပိုင်ဆိုင်ကြပါစေရှင်!


​Whether in a game or in reality, music is something that adds color to our lives. Let's keep leveling up in Rising Star and strive to craft even better NFTs! I’ll be back with more interesting content soon. Have a joyful and energetic day, everyone!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQACBFa51b7x4fespJb4rFpt1ssUL9mTwNM15vBYwbJrc/1776699138525.png)

body.title: Alive & Thriving Goals Monday : Countdown Begins... 10 😝 || AATYr6 || Prompt A Day 😊
body.body:
<center>
![okay.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AK2BnchxP4kRBq1v3NGSvYRvSWxiRzv1jhLxchCJMvvJWV1wgjuvQnxATQgu5D2.png)</center>

Ten days left in the month. How fast time flies indeed! 😱 It's that time of the week for Hive goals tracking. It's just another Monday again. Back to day work after my brief day off. It was a restful yet a bit productive Sunday for me. Not much happening except a quick run to the neighborhood 7-11 store later in the afternoon so it would not be too hot. These days I always feel like hiding out from the sun. 😅 Quite sad really as it never bothered me before. Times have definitely changed. 

<center>![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/g9FGxBZs5zoAAAAC/hot-its-hot.gif)</center>

How I wish for at least a little rain now and then. Could anyone out there send some my way? 😅 *#wishfulthinking*


___

### Prompt A Day : QUOTE

**\

- T.S. Eliot** *shoutout to @shadowspub for the daily prompt (subscribe to her newsletter)* I'll take this quote out of context and apply it to my current location and situation. 😁 April seems to be the hottest month here. However, the weather bureau lists May to have the warmest mean temperature. 🙄 Still for me, April is the cruelest as we would get May showers in the past. However, we did lose Mom in the month of May. 😞 Well, ten more days left in April, so I'm just waiting till cooler weather comes again.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/TQpmT1Ra6pwAAAAC/i-love-when-it-rains.gif)
--- ### Hive Goals Here are the updated figures for the week: Hive Power: 15724.585 --> 15757.747 HBD Savings: 220.657 --> 220.659 Alive Power: 79.868 (liquid); staked 51.5K; 23K delegated --> 114.999 (liquid); staked 51.6K; 23K delegated STARBITS: 2982325 --> 3062325 LEN:LENM = 109.53 --> 110.112 ALIVE:ALIVEM = 994.290 --> 997.845 ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE = 213.468 --> 216.302 ALIVE:HEARTBEAT = 359.682 --> 646.677
Well, I'm still smacked in the middle of rebuilding my lost Hive assets. One task at a time. It takes time I know, and I will get there somehow. On rising star game, I'm building the number of my cards and aim to have at least 2K cards. I still need less than fifty cards to get there. 🤔 All righty, be back for more tracking next week 🎉 ___
![happy april.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AKpABSBjqrSDxSK9hUBGCsCK4moMqXB9EzCMigjnLNXgiVhHniJCZvzvZnGYQ7r.png)
Count down to the end of the month begins for me. 💪 I'd say to simply enjoy each moment daily. Pretty soon it would be the fifth month of the year. Oh boy! 😅 **I actively work on these affiliate sites daily. Just reached $7 on LL today. I'm definitely getting closer to another payout.** ___

/> ___ It's a wrap! Wishing you all a lovely week ahead. Nighty night from Manila. Five more work days to go... ta-tah! 👋

body.title: Waka Mix
body.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Waka Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/ce8349ad-4c11-4349-8261-8fd80fe01c62.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/xi5CLoNRKGkcgbrAk4u6DJ) 
 
 Es curioso cómo, al acercarse a la historia del waka, uno se encuentra de inmediato con una trampa conceptual que suele confundir a quienes vienen de fuera. No existe, estrictamente hablando, un \

llamado waka en el sentido moderno de la palabra, con partituras estandarizadas o arreglos instrumentales complejos como los que podríamos esperar de una sinfonía o incluso del gagaku cortesano. El waka es, ante todo y sobre todo, poesía. Es la columna vertebral literaria de Japón, una forma de versificación de treinta y una sílabas (5-7-5-7-7) que ha latido durante más de mil años. Sin embargo, decir que no tiene música sería ignorar la esencia misma de cómo se experimentaba esta arte en su contexto original.

Para entender la dimensión sonora del waka, hay que cerrar los ojos e imaginar las salas del palacio imperial durante el periodo Heian. Allí, la frontera entre recitar y cantar era difusa, casi inexistente. El waka no se leía en silencio; se declamaba, se canturreaba, se entonaba con una melodía sutil y contenida que respetaba la prosodia natural del japonés antiguo. Era una música funcional, íntima, diseñada para acompañar el intercambio de sentimientos, los juegos de ingenio poético y los rituales sociales de la aristocracia.

Con el paso de los siglos, esa conexión directa entre el texto poético y su ejecución vocal fue evolucionando y, en muchos aspectos, fragmentándose. Mientras el waka como forma literaria se codificaba en antologías imperiales como el Kokin Wakashū, su interpretación musical comenzó a absorber influencias de otras tradiciones. En algunos contextos religiosos y teatrales posteriores, elementos del waka se integraron en formas más estructuradas. 

Lo fascinante para cualquier músico que estudie este legado es la resistencia del waka a ser encasillado. A diferencia de las canciones populares o las arias de ópera, donde la melodía suele dominar sobre la letra, en el universo del waka la palabra es la reina absoluta. La \

estaba al servicio de la sílaba, del corte de aire, del silencio entre los versos. Esa sensibilidad ha permeado la cultura japonesa de maneras profundas. 

No hay grabaciones, por supuesto, de cómo sonaba realmente un waka en el siglo X. Lo que queda son las descripciones en diarios de corte, las notaciones teóricas escasas y, sobre todo, la poesía misma, que sigue leyéndose con una cadencia interna que sugiere su origen cantado. Al final, la historia musical del waka es la historia de una ausencia presente. Es el recuerdo de una voz que ya no se escucha, pero cuya huella rítmica y emocional sigue moldeando la manera en que se entiende la relación entre sonido y significado en Japón. No es un género que se pueda tocar en un concierto al uso, sino una atmósfera, una disciplina auditiva que invita a escuchar lo que no está escrito, sino sentido.

Esa misma economía de medios que definía la ejecución vocal del waka se trasladó con una naturalidad pasmosa a la estructura narrativa y visual de Japón, creando un hilo conductor invisible pero resistente que une la literatura, el cine y la estética vestimentaria. En la literatura, la influencia es tan profunda que resulta casi imperceptible para el ojo no entrenado, como el agua para el pez. La tradición del waka estableció un canon de alusión y sugerencia, lo que en japonés se conoce como *yojō*, o resonancia extra. Los grandes novelistas, desde Murasaki Shikibu hasta los modernos como Yasunari Kawabata o Jun'ichirō Tanizaki, no escribían simplemente para contar una historia lineal; escribían para evocar un estado de ánimo, utilizando imágenes estacionales y fragmentos poéticos que actuaban como atajos emocionales. 

Al saltar al cine, especialmente en la obra de maestros como Yasujirō Ozu, Kenji Mizoguchi o, más recientemente, Hirokazu Kore-eda, esa sensibilidad literaria se tradujo en un lenguaje visual distintivo. No es casualidad que el cine japonés clásico tenga fama de ser contemplativo, de privilegiar el plano fijo y el silencio sobre la acción frenética. Hay una cualidad pictórica en sus encuadres que recuerda a la composición de un poema waka: un elemento central (una taza de té, una ventana, una espalda) rodeado de espacio vacío, de *ma*. La narrativa no avanza necesariamente mediante conflictos explosivos, sino a través de la acumulación de detalles sutiles, de miradas no dichas, de cambios estacionales que reflejan la interioridad de los personajes. 

Esta misma ética de la sugerencia y la armonía con la naturaleza permea la moda, aunque aquí la conexión sea más atmosférica que textual. La estética tradicional japonesa, influenciada por la sensibilidad cortesana que cultivaba el waka, valora la asimetría, la textura irregular y la belleza de lo desgastado o imperfecto, conceptos que luego resonarían en movimientos modernos como el *wabi-sabi*. Diseñadores contemporáneos como Yohji Yamamoto, Rei Kawakubo o Issey Miyake no diseñan ropa simplemente para cubrir el cuerpo o seguir tendencias occidentales de ajuste y silueta rígida. Sus creaciones a menudo dialogan con el espacio que hay entre la tela y la piel, permitiendo que el aire circule, que el movimiento fluya. Hay una paleta de colores terrosos, apagados, que evocan las estaciones descritas en las antologías poéticas: el verde musgo, el gris niebla, el rojo arce marchito. La moda, en este contexto, deja de ser una declaración de estatus loud para convertirse en una extensión de la personalidad interna, una capa más de esa poesía vivida. 

Considerar el waka simplemente como un género literario o una forma poética antigua sería reducir drásticamente su verdadera envergadura; en realidad, funcionó durante siglos como el sistema operativo cultural de Japón, el mecanismo principal a través del cual la élite, y posteriormente la sociedad en general, procesaba la realidad, las relaciones humanas y la propia identidad nacional. No era un pasatiempo para eruditos encerrados en torres de marfil, sino una habilidad social vital, tan necesaria como saber leer o escribir para cualquier persona que aspirara a moverse con soltura en los círculos de poder o incluso en los rituales cotidianos de la corte. La capacidad de componer un waka espontáneo, de responder a una invitación o a un gesto amoroso con treinta y una sílabas perfectamente equilibradas, era la prueba definitiva de sensibilidad, educación y refinamiento espiritual. 

Este hito cultural trascendió la mera estética para convertirse en una herramienta diplomática y política de primer orden. Los intercambios de poemas entre embajadas, entre clanes rivales o entre emperadores y sus súbditos no eran gestos vacíos, sino movimientos estratégicos cargados de matices. Un waka bien construido podía suavizar una declaración de guerra, sellar una alianza matrimonial o expresar una lealtad inquebrantable sin caer en la adulación burda. La poesía se convirtió en el lenguaje seguro donde lo que no se podía decir directamente —por miedo, por protocolo o por delicadeza— encontraba su cauce. Esta codificación de la emoción a través de la forma poética creó una especie de inteligencia emocional colectiva, una shared consciousness donde los participantes compartían un vasto repertorio de referencias históricas, mitológicas y naturales. 

Además, el waka jugó un papel crucial en la preservación y estandarización del idioma japonés mismo. En una época en que la escritura china (*kanbun*) dominaba los documentos oficiales y religiosos, el waka fue el vehículo que permitió al japonés nativo (*yamato kotoba*) florecer en la escritura, desarrollando el silabario kana y afirmando la voz autóctona frente a la influencia continental. Fue un acto de resistencia cultural sutil pero firme: mientras la filosofía y la ley venían de China, el alma, el paisaje y el corazón se expresaban en waka. Esta dualidad permitió a Japón absorber influencias externas sin perder su núcleo identitario, utilizando la poesía como el guardián de esa esencia interna. 

Hoy, aunque ya nadie espera que un político o un empresario recite un poema de treinta y una sílabas en una negociación, la huella del waka como hito cultural permanece incrustada en la psique colectiva. Se manifiesta en la importancia still otorgada a las estaciones, en la práctica del haiku (su descendiente directo y simplificado), en la valoración del silencio y la indirecta en la comunicación interpersonal, y en esa búsqueda constante de la armonía entre el individuo y su entorno. El waka enseñó a toda una civilización a mirar el mundo no como algo que debe ser dominado o explicado racionalmente, sino como un espejo de la condición humana, efímero y bello precisamente por su fugacidad. Ese cambio de perspectiva, esa manera de habitar el tiempo y el espacio, es quizás su legado más duradero. Es la columna vertebral invisible sobre la que se sostiene la elegancia japonesa, un recordatorio permanente de que las palabras, cuando se eligen con cuidado y se disponen con arte, tienen el poder de estructurar no solo el pensamiento, sino la realidad misma.

一大早来到办公室，没有看到邻居，这让我奇怪了，她平时不是也来得早吗？今天很是奇怪，等我把老板们的杯子弄完，呵呵，她终于来了，而且还带着口罩，我说你怎么了，她说感昌了，这天气确实让人很容易感昌，上次我不是中招了吗？


边跟她说话，我心里其实也在想着早上司机跟我说的话，今天早上无缘无固被一个滴士司机说我，说我太啰嗦，跟小孩讲太多了，还说欢欢都那么大了，什么事都懂，叫我不用那么超心，他说欢欢明白怎么做，不要一路上讲来讲去。

他还说可怜天下父母的心，明白你做父母的心情，就是太啰嗦，小孩早就烦死 了，我不知是感谢这位小哥？还是嫉妒我对欢欢的母爱？ 不过，我也是担心孩子，多说几句，倒是被他拼击了，回到办公室，我都想起那司机的声音，怎么感觉他像个初中生。

香港老大十点多来办公室，我去拿资料，呵 呵，没有想老大今天带了个口罩，这也是老板上周，我见他的感昌不是好了吗，怎么周一了还没有好呢?，晕，看到还是少吃KFC  ,pizza ,这一吃，几天跟着受罪，四天咽喉弄，到今天还没有好， 人感昌真不好，可是大家说，多感昌几次，争强抵抗力，也不会生大病。看着他们都带口罩，我心里七上八下，邻居还一直在那里说想睡觉，有时不停哼哼的，真的有点怕了。


今天下了大雨了，不过，我的心情还是很好，早来来把上次三八节的礼物，玫瑰茶，泡喝了一口，还给好几个同事发了，我以为自己对这个口味不是很喜欢，没有想到，这一泡，喝了一杯，我还挺喜欢的，剩下还有好几个玫瑰好好享受了。有人从美国回来了，给香港老大，带是巧克力，还有一些芝加哥的一个冰箱贴，还有钥匙扣，老板都给我了，真的开心，这些挺漂亮的，看起来挺高档的。

 



---

body.title: A Token Of Appreciation
body.body:
/></center>

Over the last few weeks a few people have stepped up doing favors and these need to be rewarded with something even if it is just a bottle of whisky. I tend to know what people prefer as a their favorite drinks and gave another bottle to someone else not too long ago. That time it was a special edition bottle of rum and the person was blown away as nothing is ever expected and why they deserve it more.

Building relationships with people is a two way street and I have no problem giving my time to help anyone in need and it is great to see this being reciprocated by others. Work is hard enough doing it on your own but when you have others who step in and help freely without even being asked it shows what type of characters are around and these people are indeed rare gems.

The fact for me is people who you have never met before are prepared to help out through the goodness of their heart. It reminds me of those that stop by the side of the road to help an elderly person or a lady change a flat tire. This was something I would not hesitate to do and these days few are reluctant to help due to the safety risks of doing so. Society has definitely lost something these days and what was a regular occurrence is no longer which is a shame. There are still good people around which gives me hope for the future even though like I mentioned it is rare.




These gifts were indeed gifts of gratitude and not like some of the other gifts I have given in the past which were types of bribes. Ok I admit they were bribes and they made such a huge difference. Some of the warehouses or distribution centers we deliver to are a nightmare and trucks are delayed for hours on end. The surest way to bypass all of this red tape is to have the receiving manager in your back pocket. I have always had some type of slush fund which helps the wheels turn in your favor and it is very much needed.

Once a year a hamper of various alcoholic beverages along with some tasty treats will be delivered to their houses as a thank you for the special attention they have given us over the year. This is a fine balance between not being so obvious and just doing their work. Our vehicles would be off loaded as soon as they arrived bypassing the queue of vehicles much to the bewilderment of all the other vehicles in the queue.

In the past I had a truck driver on the payroll who would pre load the day before and come back and fetch another load in the morning all for the set fee. Now imagine if he somehow could fetch two loads in the morning for a cash bonus which is what i set up so I was getting 3 deliveries for the price of 2. The trucking company eventually twigged on and I was told the maximum deliveries was 2 loads, but it was great whilst it lasted.

links.title: Entrada al Concurso \
| El diccionario del mar
links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katleya/23tvgXUb3YSXbdQA4XATY5zhZy7YoDP3DwiJfMqJ91yGJtvYXWYFq4LtDeYotdJJfRZHH.png)

[link](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/animales-marinos-patr%c3%b3n-5779959/)


En la Ciudad del Lenguaje, el malvado Ruido interfería cuando las letras querían formar palabras. Sin embargo, ellas resisten. Sienten que tienen la tarea de agruparse para formar la obra El Diccionario del Mar. Respiran hondo. Se rebelan. Piden ayuda **1) TRITÓN**, hijo de Poseidón, el dios griego del mar que gobierna las aguas.  Tritón, figura masculina con cola de pez, es el mensajero de las profundidades. Decidió soplar su caracola como una trompeta; de esa manera Ruido se calmó. Inmediatamente, aparece la sombra del viento para protegerlas. Desde allí realizarían un viaje mágico al Teatro Azul Profundo, donde la imaginación viajaría sin moverse. 

Ya, en el teatro, comienza el baile de las letras. Así la primera palabra surge: **2) DELFÍN**.  Este cetáceo de dos y medio a tres metros de largo, ojos pequeños y pestañosos, boca muy grande, dientes cónicos en ambas mandíbulas, hocico delgado y agudo, y una sola abertura nasal, simboliza libertad, inteligencia y amor leal. Este travieso animal, luego de jugar con sus congéneres, invita, al escenario, a **3) TORTUGA MARINA**, perteneciente a la superfamilia Chelonioidea. Ella, una viajera del tiempo, se presenta llevando su propia casa a cuestas. Ha sobrevivido a los dinosaurios, se ha adaptado a diversos entornos y ha perdurado durante millones de años. Pacientemente, con su sabiduría, mantiene la salud del océano. Su paso es lento al tocar la arena. Allí anida y pone sus huevos.

Ahora le toca el turno al solitario **4) PULPO**. Él, con sus tres corazones, da la bienvenida al salmonete y al mero. Los abraza con sus ocho brazos. Así, los tres se unen para cazar en equipo. Los peces se encargan de explorar el entorno. Mientras, el señor pulpo piensa si va a moverse y, cuándo hacerlo. De repente se pone nervioso, su piel se torna azul. Un tiburón merodea el teatro. Inmediatamente expulsa su tinta… En el telón negro del escenario, **el 5) TIBURÓN** se pierde nadando sigilosamente. Está hambriento; ya tiene una semana que no se alimenta. Su boca grande situada en la parte inferior de la cabeza, arqueada en forma de media luna y provista de varias filas de dientes cortantes, está lista para devorar a un **6) LOBO MARINO**. Este ejemplar tiene aletas externas y sus bigotes son órganos sensoriales que los usa para navegar y encontrar comida. Pero, lamentablemente, este macho alfa dominante, aunque defiende ferozmente su territorio, está embelesado con sus siete hembras. Ya seleccionó a una. Ruge fuerte y por fin se aparea. El tiburón se queda esperándolo…

Ahora entra en escena la **7) BALLENA AZUL** –Auxilio, auxilio estoy en peligro de extinción. ¿Alguien puede ayudarme? – Lamentablemente, nadie la escucha. Este animal alcanza hasta 30 metros de longitud y más de 150 toneladas de peso. Su corazón puede ser tan grande como un automóvil y su lengua pesa tanto como un elefante. Y consume hasta 3,5 toneladas de krill al día. 

Continúa el espectáculo. Entra sigilosa la **8) SERPIENTE DE MAR**; sus colmillos contienen un veneno que inhibe la capacidad de nadar y respirar de sus presas, lo que les permite alimentarse con mayor facilidad. Nadie se acerca al escenario. Ella, frustrada, sale de allí.

Ahora le toca el turno a **9) LA ESTRELLA PEINE ROJA**. Esta especie es carnívora y nocturna. Su coloración rojo-naranja intenso, a menudo con manchas más claras, sirve de telón para otro episodio en el teatro.  

Mientras tanto, el **10) ABANICO DE MAR ROJIZO**, al ver a la estrella, decide entrar en competencia por ser el dueño del escenario. –Tengo mejores cualidades que tú para lograrlo. Me parezco a las plantas por mis ramas y ramificaciones llenas de color. Soy flexible y similar a un abanico. Además, mis parientes, corales y medusas, pueden ayudarme- le dice. La estrella no le contesta; decidió enterrarse en la arena todo el día. 

Después, al son del tango, entra **11) MEDUSA**  alardeando: - Aunque carezco de cerebro, corazón y huesos, y me muevo mediante propulsión a chorro, soy experta en supervivencia, puedo ser inmortal y brillar en la oscuridad. Además, convertir en piedra a quienes me miren fijamente a los ojos.

Entretanto, alguien espera su turno. Decidida se presentó: - Soy **12) ESPONJA**. Aunque no consigo moverme, puedo ser suave y blanda, o áspera, dura y espinosa. Tengo cualidades de ser opaca y sin brillo, pero también de tener colores brillantes. ¡Ah! Pero lo más importante es que puedo filtrar el agua y poseo compuestos químicos que tienen actividad antiviral. Por eso, soy un potencial para la creación de nuevos medicamentos.

Detrás del telón, una tímida letra perdida busca a otras compañeras. Se agrupan para entrar y forman las palabras **13) CABALLITO DE MAR**. Esta criatura híbrida, con cabeza y patas delanteras de caballo, cuerpo de pez con cola larga, entra en escena recordando la mitología griega, donde simboliza la fuerza y el dominio de Poseidón sobre el mar. Ellos eran sus escoltas.

-Ya voy, ya voy. Es el **14) ERIZO DE MAR**, que sube a la tarima e inmediatamente vocifera: -Mi boca tiene nombre propio, se llama linterna de Aristóteles; tengo cinco piezas dentales fuertes que crecen continuamente para raspar comida, incluyendo algas incrustadas en rocas. Por eso me consideran un limpiador del sistema marino.

Una holgazana C se está despertando. Las otras letras: A, L, M, R, G, I, N, T, E la están esperando para formar la palabra **15) CALAMAR GIGANTE**. En la mitología y el folclore nórdico medieval lo conocen como Kraken. Puede medir hasta diez metros de largo. Cuenta con ocho brazos y sus ojos son enormes. Con ellos ve a sus presas y depredadores en la oscuridad total de las profundidades marinas. -¡Uy! Ya observé uno, el cachalote. Lo siento, espectadores, tengo que retirarme de la escena- acota.

El veloz **16) CACHALOTE**, al entrar, casi tropieza con las orcas, su principal amenaza. Este animal es el depredador, con dientes, más grande del mundo. Son los mamíferos marinos que bucean a mayor profundidad. Es famoso por su enorme cabeza cuadrada que ocupa un tercio de su cuerpo. Pueden aguantar la respiración hasta por noventa minutos. Utilizan el sonido más alto del reino animal (230 decibelios) para orientarse y \

a sus presas en la oscuridad del fondo marino. 

Durante ese tiempo, **17) la LANGOSTA** observa que no se encuentra ningún humano cerca. Ella es muy apreciada en los círculos gastronómicos. Tímidamente, sube. Todos observan su duro caparazón, de color rojo parduzco, sus dos grandes pinzas delanteras y su elegante cola en forma de abanico. Tiene la capacidad de regenerar extremidades perdidas, lo que ayuda a su supervivencia. Aunque prefiere consumir mariscos vivos, también consume organismos muertos. 

Ahora le toca el turno al lento **18) CABALLITO DE MAR**. Conocido porque nada verticalmente. Además, con su cola prensil, se ancla en corales y algas. Lo curioso de esta especie es que la hembra transfiere sus huevos a la bolsa ventral del macho, donde este los fertiliza, incuba y da a luz a cientos de crías. También cambian de color para mimetizarse con el entorno o expresar emociones. 

Comienzan unos ruidos… El escenario se estremece. Son los **19) PINGÜINOS** que comienzan el ritual del amor con sonidos intensos y constantes. Estas aves marinas no vuelan; tienen las alas transformadas en aletas y un plumaje impermeable. Son grandes nadadores. Como dato curioso, tienen una glándula cerca de los ojos que filtra la sal en su organismo. Además, tienen una sola pareja de por vida que comparte la incubación de los huevos.

Cansado de esperar, llega el último actor: **20) el PEZ GLOBO**. Esta criatura fascinante puede inflarse como un balón. Contiene una de las toxinas más mortales del reino animal llamada tetrodotoxina. Además, su piel, a menudo cubierta de espinas, se vuelve más prominente cuando se infla, lo que añade una capa adicional de defensa.

Luego de la actuación, todos juntos esperan para despedirse…  Pero, de repente, un meteorito impacta en el teatro provocando un maremoto.

**EL DICCIONARIO DEL MAR** por María del Carmen Sánchez Copyright© 2026

links.title: Clifton Beach 🏖️🌊🏝️🌅
links.body: > Today I want to share with you my emotions and experiences from the beaches of Clifton. This place had an abundance of white sands, turquoise waters and the most beautiful views I have ever seen. Wherever I turned and looked, I saw endless beauty and tranquility. ![1.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQW97gRropTdUynURphFBw6sEAzLoQwKDn8GVCdT9duRC/1.jfif) When I reached the beach, I saw the waves crashing against the shore and the rocks. In the distance rose the silhouette of the Lion's Head. This place is a true paradise for me. Every view here is like a part of a postcard that comes to life before my eyes. ![2.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUD78xXNfdoDxvm3oTY5RAbf8RSgp47J73okLaYjjCLnu/2.jfif) ![3.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaPTm7beQP2x4DwBhCz7wG8xBbJcR2ToUjGurUyJkjnhk/3.jfif) Every hill and rock was part of a beautiful composition created by nature. Here I felt small, but at the same time part of something much bigger and extremely picturesque. ![5.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb8juaatAbbgEWjDfXg8MVrJ5AyhyBbx7CSmxJY7DR1Uz/5.jfif) ![4.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmby6XA6Mv5HjRs9oktYZHrYuY72xrFzhN2AfkbrNLFhFh/4.jfif) I felt time slow down in that moment. I was alone with myself. Just me, the ocean, and this atmosphere that existed as if it were something beyond reality. The whole place radiated a special tranquility that could be felt. ![6.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWtEfR6M4CXAmtPGVorXok3mRs3DzxsnGqgRxgVSaux3s/6.jfif) ![7.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfC65LYWjVaSnAee3x7MDRJLBQourppZV2xCRz9WLxFDa/7.jfif) I can safely say that Clifton Beach is a natural wonder that cannot be described in words, only experienced. ![8.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWckUp8VUBK1wF5YiyznzLcxCVFrcBuD64nLLvwBdJoq5/8.jfif) ![9.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBBp2kXzaPnAXwTmcU8Qxax1mV4M6699Lgaw889uNeon/9.jfif) The houses were located right on the beach. I can only imagine the incredible views they had of the ocean. Some of the buildings looked quite luxurious. ![10.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdUjM7ARib451xWF7MLaA4jwavHDwCMAgYwuf6X3XeHkY/10.jfif) The palm trees on the beach contribute to the exotic atmosphere, rising high, bathed in the sun and creating the perfect backdrop for the seascapes. ![11.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEnfvkcFXafGTCRPJLLMzmxsFnDsjxYbN1Nqg93MWyTw/11.jfif) As the sun began to set, this place became even more magical. Quiet, peaceful, almost perfect. The light above me shimmered in golden colors. I was mesmerized by this magnificent spectacle, to say the least. ![12.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaoFX8b7Nab6j5vr1i7TuvqK2r2okoUL9Cb38aqsPxHZJ/12.jfif) In the late afternoon, many young people came to the beach, who, like me, were admiring this place. The sound of the waves, combined with the laughter and conversations of people, created a feeling of shared moments of joy and pleasure :) ![13.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUSUg2UTZLXLWetfHoh5ETLNDAyRqmY2tX9T15DgxcEvL/13.jfif) This place predisposes and allows me to break away from everyday life and immerse myself in the natural beauty of the beach and the sky 🌞 ![14.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbVnsTXVpAVfQwhLaFBx7a5GgYq49rvqX8D3CjKd9i2kG/14.jfif) ![15.jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7CLjFwYuA94aQCE3BwqWuFVX7Kgu3rxgFGmu35cJPiF/15.jfif) [//]:# (!worldmappin -33.93498 lat 18.38911 long d3scr) [//]:# (!worldmappin -33.93535 lat 18.37755 long d3scr)

links.title: YES, DOGS... (PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
links.body: and I don't mean that I had any problems or anything like that. It's just that there were several dogs on the streets near my house, either lying on the sidewalks or staring at me from doorways. What was supposed to be a short walk around the neighborhood ended up turning into more time spent taking pictures of these dogs while I talked to them loudly and some neighbors watched, amused as always...\n\n>**H**oy fue \

y no me refiero a que yo tuviese algún tipo de problemas o algo por el estilo, sino que se trata de que, en las calles cercanas a mi casa, habían algunos perros ya fuese echados en las aceras o mirándome desde alguna puerta. Y lo cierto es que, aquello que simplemente sería una caminata breve por el vecindario, terminó por convertirse en algo más de tiempo invertido en hacer fotos de estos perros, mientras yo les hablaba en voz alta y algunos vecinos me observaban divertidos como siempre...   

![T01a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uFUAA6GwZmSuQmHBKbrT8FeeiRYBtuEQYUMtjU5GigxaFYeaUJTJr36tkoqkUddbqZJ.jpg)

**A**nd those of you who follow my photography blog on #Hive (and thanks always for your support, guys), already know that dogs are part of the streetscape of Montalbán, the town where I live. And therefore, these charming animals are also an important part of my photographic repertoire. Walking through my streets and not seeing dogs is impossible. Just as it's impossible for me to walk past them without ending up sitting down and snapping a photo. And this isn't limited to me; the locals have a very close relationship with stray dogs, and in fact, it's been that way for as long as I can remember. So much so that I can say that we practically don't have \

dogs here, as they all seem to be somehow connected to a human home, even though they spend a good part of the day on the streets...\n\n>**Y** aquellos de ustedes que siguen mi blog de contenido fotográfico en #Hive (y gracias siempre por ese apoyo chicos), ya saben que los perros son parte del paisaje callejero de Montalbán, el pueblo en donde vivo. Y por ende estos encantadores animales son también parte importante de mi repertorio fotográfico. Y es que, andar por mis calles y no encontrar perros, es algo imposible. Así como también es imposible para mi el pasar con indiferencia al lado de estos animales sin terminar sentado cerca de ellos disparándoles alguna foto. Y esto no se limita a mi, pues la relación del gentilicio local con los perros callejeros es muy intima, y de hecho ha sido así desde que tengo uso de razón y observo esto. Tanto es así que; puedo asegurar que prácticamente aquí no tenemos perros \

pues todos parecen estar de alguna manera asociados a algún hogar humano, aunque pasen buena parte del día en las calles... 

![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23w2uN5JHGAwNrZUuhjvRvGHHntZ7Qi8BDLFYa9mKVnKLyyiDd49gsEAd1J4e2NGjrRZh.jpg)

**M**y father, who was somewhat of a bohemian and liked to enjoy life to the fullest, also had a special place in his heart (and in our house, by the way) for dogs. 😂... And he would also say something more serious like, \

links.body: In life, there are sometimes moments when everything takes the form of a major test and this very moment is called The Big Clash. This isn’t just a contest between two powers two teams or two individuals but rather it’s the real test of courage determination and resolve. On such occasions the hidden abilities within a person come out and they give themselves a new identity.\n\n

>
Picture source www.pixabay.com

When a big clash is in front of you fear and pressure come along with it but true bravery is standing firm and facing all of it head on. Success always becomes the destiny of those who remain steadfast even in difficult situations. Whether it’s the playing field or life’s problems every big contest teaches us something sometimes patience sometimes wisdom and sometimes believing in ourselves.
Such moments also teach us that both winning and losing are part of life. Real success isn’t just about winning but about learning from the journey and making yourself better. The Big Clash makes us stronger teaches us to get back up after falling and gives us the belief that we can face any difficulty.
Every big clash is the beginning of a new story. If we don’t lose courage and keep faith in our goal then no difficulty can become an obstacle in our path. Treat every Big Clash in life as an opportunity because these are the moments that turn us from ordinary to extraordinary.

This remake is magnificent for anyone who loves horror and science fiction ... and also for those who love a slower pace and a lot of exploring in between shootouts. Is immersive as hell. It sees the farm. It sees the scam. It sees the mask. There is a courage in cessation. To stop. To say: *I was wrong. I see now. I will do better.* These are not words of weakness. Let the record show not just the lie, but the refusal to cease. Let the tags stand as markers in the digital dust, signaling to those who come after where the path turned toward shadow. It does not blink. It simply *is*—an unblinking witness to every transaction, every downvote, every carefully constructed illusion of meritocracy that masks the quiet exodus of genuine creators. You believe yourselves unseen in the architecture of influence you've built, but the ledger remembers. It records not just what happened, but *why*—the patterns that emerge when the same accounts consistently reward each other, when newcomers arrive not to create but to farm, when content lives or dies not by merit, but by allegiance. ### **The Data Doesn't Lie: A Visual Story of Manipulation** Consider the evidence—not as abstract accusations, but as undeniable data visualized for clarity: **[PIE CHART: Distribution of Curation Rewards]** - **87.4%**: Concentrated among 21 interconnected accounts - **9.8%**: Distributed across medium-tier accounts with suspicious voting patterns - **2.8%**: Actual organic curation from independent users This isn't decentralization.
