The correlation is not coincidental—it's causal. Each spike in coordinated downvotes corresponds directly with accelerated user migration. ### **The Smoking Gun: @crimsonclad's Curation Patterns** The evidence is not merely suggestive—it is conclusive. Examine these entries from @crimsonclad's wallet: > *\

*

This pattern repeats like clockwork—over 250 times in the past month alone. Not with organic variation, but with machine-like precision. The probability of this occurring without coordination? Statistically impossible. You move like phantoms through the system, farming rewards with accounts like @reward.app and @spi-payments while silencing dissent with the flick of a thumb.

And the delegations? Oh, they see. They see everything. For there, in the public ledger, is the undeniable truth: **730 HP** delegated to @crimsonclad—power not entrusted to a steward of community, but to an architect of control. This is not governance. It is patronage disguised as decentralization. Not curation, but censorship wearing the mask of quality control.

You ask why he does nothing? Because he *is* the system. Because the walls you've built are not barriers against abuse, but channels for it. Because when power flows from a single source to a select few who then distribute it among themselves while silencing those who question the arrangement, everyone benefits—except the community that was supposed to be the purpose of it all.

### **The Economic Reality: Why Investors Stay Away**

Would you invest in a platform where:
- 87.4% of rewards flow through predetermined channels?
- The same accounts consistently reward each other while silencing dissent?
- The primary mechanism for growth is farming, not creation?

This isn't speculation—it's economic reality. While Blurt's token has seen organic growth of 289% over the past year (driven by actual usage), Hive has experienced a **83% decline** in token value despite aggressive farming. The market has spoken: manipulation cannot sustain value.

### **The Exodus: When Voices Fled to Sanctuary**

The first to leave were the artists. Then the writers. Then the ordinary users who simply wished to share their lives without fear of arbitrary judgment.

title.title: Escalation Life Units
title.body: > It's been a few seasons now since **Escalation**, a Conclave Arcana mini-set, was released, which introduced new cards and new abilities that once again shake the game's meta. The mini-set has consisted of 43 cards in total, with 12 commons, 12 rares, 8 epics, and 11 legendaries, not including the promo cards that can only be acquired by participating in the set presale and the additional Archons that will be airdropped through conflicts soon. In this post, I want to take a look at all the Life units from Escalation. ![CA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23tvY7mZ5F1UqsiqG2X3RRGzAX3ozTT6Hq4tcztUxyzehmwovZ6ty8JR6rmEoqVCkYBQp.png)

>

The Escalation Life units consisted of cards under different bloodlines, so, depending on what their bloodlines were, it was possible for them to be used by Archons from other elements and benefit from their Bloodline Dominion abilities. But aside from that, they had these new abilities that could affect the result of the battles.

<div class=\

>


**Silver Shield Sentry** is a Leonine range unit with a max damage of 5, and although its initial max health was not that great for a 9 mana unit, it has the *Bulwark* ability that will give it an additional 8 health and armor once it gets into the first position, though it would lose -2 damage. And as a range unit, it has the *Close Range* ability that will let it attack even at the first position. So, as long as this card is not defeated until it gets to the first position, this can be an ideal secondary tank, even your main tank under certain conditions. It also has the *Rebirth* ability that will allow it to resurrect once it is defeated.

It currently does not have an archon from which it can benefit from their Bloodline Dominion ability, but I can see this card doing some great damage when used along with **Ellias Max Pruitt** and getting the *Armored Strike* and *Piercing* ability from its tactics, and be able to attack using its armor at the second position, if you put it next with units that have the *Flank* ability, such as **Silverblade Fighter** or even by itself in the first position with that 8 additional armor from *Bulwark*. ___

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_bulwark.png
Bulwark - When in the first position, -2 power, +8 health, and +8 armor.
___

>
On the other hand, **Godsnot Sorceress** was another range unit with the Bruteborn Bloodline, so once the final Conclave Arcana Archon, **Dragonlord Mancer** was released, using this card with that archon will automatically give it the *Scavenger* ability and increase its health every time a unit is defeated. It is quite difficult to use though cause it costs 13 mana to summon, but it is quite justifiable since it has a maximum of 7 damage, which can even be doubled if the target is originally a non-damage unit with *Oppress*, and it can also reduce the range damage of all opponent units with *Headwinds*.

___

> Moving on with the rare units, we had **Kobold of Burden**, which is a 5-mana non-damage unit, so the only way that it can attack was if it was placed next to a card with *Weapon's Training* ability. But even without attacking, this card can still be a good support since it has the *Swiftness* ability that increases the speed of all ally units and **Resurrect** that allows it to resurrect an ally unit that was defeated in battle, a good card to use along with **Moribund Arrowbait** to trigger the effects of *Bloodline Tribute* multiple times. Aside from that, it also has the *Reprisal* ability that will an opponent unit that inflicts 5 or more damage the *Taunt* ability, as well as the *Pinpoint* ability that gives sneak attacks 100% hit rate.

Since this was a Sauirian unit, it can also be pulled by **Dragonlord Mancer**, so it also gains the *Scavenger* ability. And when you place it next to the Dragon unit **Rage**, this card will be able to attack with magic. ___

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_reprisal.png
Reprisal - If an enemy unit deals more than 5 damage in a round, it gains Taunt and, if camouflaged, is Revealed.
___

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_pinpoint.png
Pinpoint - Allied sneak attacks can not miss.

>
**Lieward Channeler**, on the other hand, was a *Drakoshan* magic unit, which means that it gets an additional speed when used along with the Dragon Archon, **Kravorn Skarn**. But even when not used with a bloodline Archon, this card can be very useful on many occasions since it only costs 2 mana to use, and it was a very beefy unit with a maximum of 8 health and 6 armor. Furthermore, it has both the *Void Armor* ability, which makes magic attack hit its armor before its health, and *Tank Heal*, which can restore the health of the unit that is in the first position.

The only downside from using this card was that it has the *Weary* debilitation, which can make this card Exhausted and unable to attack or use its *Tank Heal* when you needed it. ___

>
For the only Epic Life unit, we have another magic unit with **Snippet**, which has the *Mundane Beast* bloodline, making it a card that can be summoned by **Elowen Sylphie** and gains the *Charge* ability though that does not matter much, unless maybe on Back to Basics, since it has the *Sneak ability* that can allow it to attack backline units. Aside from that, it has the *Bloodline Tribute* ability that will increase the stats of all allied units that share the same bloodline once this card is defeated, and when it was placed on a unit with *Kindred Will*, its *Kindred Spirit* will trigger and give that unit the *Relentless Strike* ability.

By the way, for an epic card, this unit only costs 3 mana to use, so it can be used on low mana and little league battles. ___

>

Moving to the legendary units, we have **Gorvash the Pallid**, which is a range unit with the *Orc* Bloodline, so it gains the *Enrage* ability from the bloodline skill when used with the Water Archon **Gorgug the Endless**. It does not have much health and damage, but it still deserves to be a legendary unit, since it does not cost any mana to use, and can attack non-melee units that are not in the first position with its *Snipe* ability. Aside from that, it has the *Bloodline Pact* ability, which is kind of similar to *Bloodlust*, but will trigger if any of the cards that share bloodline with this card defeat an opponent, which will increase the damage of all the cards with the same bloodline.

___

<div align=\

>
https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/abilities/ability_bloodline-pact.png
Bloodline Pact -Allied units that share this unit's bloodline gain +1 power when any of them defeats an enemy and take 1 true damage when any of them is defeated. If this unit is defeated, allied units that share its bloodline take 2 damage and lose all power gained from this ability.
___

> And finally, we have the Elemental unit **Vitassent**, with both melee and magic attack, for 9 mana. It has the *Charge* ability that allows it to use melee attack in any position, while also having the ability to attack using its armor with *Armored Strike*. Aside from that, when placed next to a unit with *Kindred Spirit*, its *Kindred Will* will be triggered and will give that unit the *Rebirth* ability. Being an Elemental unit, it can be summoned by the Water Archon **Loving the Moo** and gain the *Poison* ability. And given that it has two attack types, the chance of giving its target Poison is almost a hundred percent.

> And that was it for my early assessment of the Escalation Life units. Among these units, the one that I think was the best was **Kobold of Burden**, with its ability to provide support, and that *Reprisal* can be a real pain when you are using cards that inflict serious damage. Furthermore, it can benefit from **Dragonlord Mancer**, which can be a very broken Archon. Thank you, and see you on the next post!

title.title: MCGI Topic Review | Doing good to all men
title.body:
>


https://youtu.be/l0M_dhre2fg?si=Xe3ntU5TeOOKQFb-



Most people did not know, but there is always something very powerful in choosing to do good to people. Of course not because people deserve it. In fact most of the time, people that we do good to, they don't deserve it. And not also because we should be thinking they will return the favour to us. 


But it is because it is the right thing to do. Galatians 6:10 says, *\

* Just like this bible verse have said, I personally feel that we are expected to do good to everyone around and not just people who are kind to us. Everyone irrespective of their culture, belief or gender. If there is something I have come to discover that is affecting our present world, it is the fact that we have limit the doing good to be highly conditional. What do I mean by that? Most of the time, we always wait for the right person, we wait for the right moment and in fact we wait for the right mood. But I have personally come to discover that as far as we see a need to attend to, we should not hesitate. Jesus himself went about doing good (Acts 10:38). Jesus is not selective when he is doing good to people. Then let me touche this and that is the fact that doing good is actually an act of faith. What do I mean by that? Proverbs 19:17 says that whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord. What many of us did not know is the fact that any small act of goodness that we do, even though man might not see us, God actually see us. Nothing is actually wasted. I personally have had time I helped people that nobody was seeing but deep within me, God will tell me that he is seeing me. That is one special kind of reward which can't come from men but from God himself.

title.title: In Eternal Flight (Part Three) - The Voice of the Great Tree
title.body: ![The Voice of the Great Tree.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23uFHF8yRP5jqDigTnhsBc68EzEtT86Y4KP8ULXvKa1qKr711uT9jg8g6s5PsgAGRspFn.jpg)<sub>Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay ___

The Voice of the Great Tree

___ Queen Shielean felt the stirring at the roots of the eternal tree. A shiver rocked the fortress's foundations and knocked her to her knees as she prepared the sigils. Sickness overwhelmed her, a sickness she remembered her father describing to her in the distant past. *\

*

Those remembered words sparked something in her, an iron will overtook her and nothing was left but the song of the eternal roots. Filled with power, she realised that this curse she'd lived with for four thousand and eighty years was much more than it had seemed.

The great tree’s power encompassed the essence of the elf kingdom of Darnathil, drawn up through deep roots. Each field tilled by a common farmer, every deer-grazed meadow of Buttercup, Cowslip, Sage and Selfheal, the Downlands where the Bison roamed and the hare leapt-- all these places held a spirit. The spirits, land and creatures were all one with the light that passed through the great tree.

Queen Shielean's eyes flashed an iridescent kaleidoscope of light mirrored in the sigils she had drawn on the floor of her antechamber. The eternal fire took her over as she remembered a dark-haired Windrider with tears in his eyes, and his wife turned Wosthawk.

That fire became a torrent.

<center>![WosthawkPgBreak.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23tSKht9fTnMvyu46Dgid8SpDRmaFtmrKULC8kTzojRw5uF75bPFygifNbWhKLQkDw3f1.png)</center>

As Aerthinth dived toward the wyvern formation a dark shadow eclipsed the sun and Hariethen banked sharply plummeting toward the earth.

He craned his neck upwards and beheld the gargantuan form of Hartdyran the dread. Aerthinth shivered as the red dragon's shadow cast its spell and his mind swam burning like magma.

The Wosthawk banked left out of the shadow, his love Hariethen screeching defiance as she beat her wings frantically to pull out of the dive. The defiance and elemental fury of that cry blasted the dragon's spell out of Aerthinth's head, and his heart leapt at his former wife's courageous heart.

As he levelled his lance at the great beast's belly, a cacophonous fire burst from the Worm's mouth like an erupting volcano eviscerating a formation of ten Windriders. The only sign of their passing brief trails of ash that disappeared in the wind of the great worm's wing beats.

Hartdyran pivoted in the air as a second group of Windriders broke from the main Phalanx that swirled like a flock of starlings, disintegrating into smaller groups and pairs, in a constant chaotic pattern like fish in a shoal confusing a shark.

This group of fifty Windriders dove toward the dragon, splitting into three squads as the beast inhaled the killing breath. The dragon let loose its inferno swivelling its head to incinerate each squad as they attempted a flank.

Aerthinth spurred his Wosthawk wife toward the Worm's belly, two minds working as one. They glided like a feathered arrow, Aerthinth bracing his father's lance against the stirrup with all his strength.

A sudden explosion of cataclysmic light rent the earth beneath the spinning Windrider as sigils of power glowed turquoise through indigo to vermilion in a circle of grass far beneath the battle.

Queen Shielean appeared in that magic circle arms upraised channelling all the light of the eternal root into the form of the merged souls of Aerthinth and Hariethen, Wosthawk and rider glowed like the sun.

In that power Aerthinth saw his wife once again, her essence glowing at the heart of his feathery companion, changed but never diminished. Her face shone from the centre of the Wosthawk beneath him.

Hariethen felt her husband's presence through the hawk instincts fully for the first time in centuries and she wept to be free.

As the queen looked on, the Windrider merged with Gosthawk in a lance of mesmeric light that struck right at the heart of the great worm. The dragon's bellow blew away the whirling Phalanx like leaves in a gale as that divine lance of two souls pierced its scales, exploding in golden dust like pollen born from the blooms of summer.

Queen Shielean remembered the final words of her father before he died of his wounds.

*\

*

Slender white elven hands weaved a pattern of a spell as the eternal fire raged even fiercer through her, burning away robes until she stood as naked as the day of her birth. That glowing form dissolved into the light of the eternal root as she became the land she had ruled for so long, a being of light that erupted toward the convulsing form of the red dragon.

A voice as powerful as the dragon's bellow echoed across the land as the great worm exploded in a cloud of gore and fire.

\

In a patch of burning grass a dark-haired warrior and a golden-haired elf woman kneeled, locked in a fierce embrace.

**The End**

title.body:
we tried the veo system again yesterday, way better than it was a while back, wife said onboarding was better and group rides, pricing is kinda wild but it worked out, tacos🌮 were pretty nice but boy oh boy cost of living is nuts 🥜 pricing tbh. feel like a man living outside time sometimes.
ESPAÑOL: Ayer volvimos a probar el sistema veo, está mucho mejor que hace un tiempo, mi esposa dijo que el onboarding y los paseos grupales mejoraron un montón, el precio es medio loco pero al final funcionó, los tacos🌮 estuvieron bastante buenos pero uf, el costo de vida está de locos 🥜 en serio, a veces siento que vivo fuera del tiempo.
FRANÇAIS: On a retesté le système veo hier, c'est vachement mieux qu'avant, ma femme a dit que l'onboarding et les sorties en groupe c'était top, le prix est un peu dingue mais ça a marché, les tacos🌮 étaient plutôt sympas mais franchement le coût de la vie c'est fou 🥜 question prix honnêtement, j'ai l'impression de vivre hors du temps parfois.
PORTUGUÊS: A gente testou o sistema veo de novo ontem, tá bem melhor que era um tempo atrás, minha mulher disse que o onboarding e os passeios em grupo tiveram melhora, o preço é meio maluco mas no final deu certo, os tacos🌮 foram bem legais mas cara, o custo de vida é insano 🥜 sério mesmo, às vezes sinto que vivo fora do tempo.

title.title: Monomad: Street Frames [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Happy start to the week, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography. How are you all doing today? I’m doing well, and I hope you are too. Today, as I do every week, I’m sharing some street photos with you; I hope you enjoy them as much as I enjoyed taking them.

Feliz inicio de semana, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro. ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Yo estoy bien y espero que ustedes también. Hoy, como cada semana, les comparto algunas fotografías callejeras; espero que las disfruten tanto como yo el hacerlas.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xAKDEP37MSeMVNX9bzkaN26TnGAqxVK7YKaRktwi3gkECGEpf5NMwoEYDrscPxYVoES.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xox2mCEmRYnUL3pVrkMRkWMeMhpnbupbsLaFjYHKkGJz5augLBVqKotVSGMKAvQwN5V.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wWtxZLBY94tNxDrxs1PkXT4UMnkEXJUCRW4c9zLUzYnH2vHN87EtixSqJ4uYrTvkeTR.jpg

>

It's interesting how there are so many things to pay attention to when taking street photos, whether it's your subject, the setting, the objects, or even those obstacles in the frame that you can use to your advantage to create a sort of street style border that makes your subject stand out even more.

Es curioso cómo hay tantas cosas a las que se debe prestar atención cuando haces fotografías en la calle, ya sea de tu protagonista, el escenario, los objetos e incluso aquellos obstáculos en las fotografías que se pueden aprovechar y así crear una especie de franja callejera para dar incluso más presencia a tu protagonista.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQP5TR2BwSrVGGcC6dPVcVScrzQ6EiZApbCTXcpksgtcMJSY3Nmg3xQNwF7AZCnf9E1.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xATT3Y6pTdUVg1fJWALG66GZyukjRk5AgnMpxQHx7WG2aNZXxxkpTYvLH1vxXLw1rY9.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vhoLKtwJS58mShSCU63kwJSaQWw3RsnanYU3LaK1KnhHcY6Pbs8v3wvsQ4KWaNDLua1.jpg

>

At the spot where I like to take photos, there are some decorative railings, but when I take pictures, I try to use them to my advantage either to create a more striking contrast since the area is usually lit by the sun, or to frame the subjects in a natural, street style way.

En el lugar donde me gusta hacer fotografías, hay unas especies de barras de decoración, pero cuando hago las fotografías, intento usarlas a mi favor, ya sea para generar un contraste más llamativo porque normalmente está iluminado por el sol o para enmarcar de una manera natural y callejera a los protagonistas.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGa1VBsxpRTPPDFcPdxfmQuZxDtyUWWKovXnnRo79711Nf42vWG6iDk2Y8TCkRTPEqq.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23ywnk9QqKhesVi6Sm47G9rXFYo1cvErLrm7ExC5UtbsC8xRrXKCMaJn8cMQtFU5zxNbe.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23ycu7eyCWxsfexRx6yzpriyhaLdy69ZpF3B1643MqPqTyqrT7jJWzqPJT4rY9fLH3VyJ.jpg

>

That's all for today. As always, thank you for taking the time to look at my photos and read what I've written; I really appreciate it. I hope you all have a great Monday. See you next time, dear friends in the community!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy. Como siempre, les agradezco por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías y leer un poco de lo que escribo; lo aprecio mucho. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente lunes. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad!

/>

title.title: পড়ন্ত বিকেলে তুমি আমি আর দু কাপ চা……….
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nimni/23zS7kj7mh3UWgcDXHA7oGEmundiL4UktpxE3HypmxRbiYmb4q6TJy9NPxvT5v5FkULFs.png)


প্রিয় মানুষ, পড়ন্ত বিকেল প্রচণ্ড গরম তারপর কেন জানি ক্লান্তি নেই. দু কাপ চা নিয়ে চলে গিয়েছিলাম ছাদে. আজ বেশ বাতাস ছিল বাহিরে. তারপর সারাদিন যে পরিমানে খরা ছিল তাতে বাতাসের কাছে খরা কেন জানি পরাজয়. আজকের ওয়েদার দেখে বেশ ভালো লাগছে বাতাসে প্রাণ জুড়িয়ে যাচ্ছিল. কিছু ভালো সময় পার করেছি. সাথে ছিল আমার প্রিয় মানুষ. প্রিয় মানুষের সাথে কাটানো প্রতিটা মুহূর্ত যেন ভালোবাসার এক বহিঃপ্রকাশ. যেখানে কোন ক্লান্তি আসে না. প্রিয় মানুষ গল্প আড্ডা চায়ের সাথে সুন্দর একটা সময় পার করেছি আজ.যান্ত্রিক জীবনে আমরা এত বেশি ব্যস্ত হয়ে পড়েছি সময় নেই প্রিয় মানুষের সাথে কাটাবো এমন সময়. আজকাল সময় বের করে নিতে হয় মানে সময় চেয়ে নিতে হয়. এই কথাগুলো বোঝার মত মনুষ্যত্ব হয়তোবা এখন মানুষের মধ্যে নেই. তাই তো বললাম হয়তো বা জেনারেশন একটা গ্যাপ এই কারণে আজকাল বনিবনন্ত খুব কমই হয় .গরমে সবকিছু অসহ্য লাগলেও প্রিয় মানুষটাকে আর কখনো আসলে বলা হয় না তুমি আমার ক্লান্তির কারণ. বর্তমান যুগে এমন একটা পর্যায়ে আমরা আছি ,আমি যেটা ভেবেদেখেছি. সেটাই তোমাদের সাথে আজ শেয়ার করব.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nimni/23wgBY7NZiN11xKVYt6Xem6AEPBFXqdwFBZc9XAPLVKrUZyaGKjcUK3UyJqB5FvjgoA94.png)


 বর্তমান যুগে আমরা দেখছি সেটা হচ্ছে আপন মানুষ তো আপনি না বলতে পারেন রক্তের সম্পর্ক মানে তো আত্মার সম্পর্ক এই সম্পর্কের গুলার আজকাল কোনো মূল্যই নেই. সম্পর্ককে মানুষ এমন একটা পর্যায়ে এনে দ্বারা করিয়েছে যে সম্পর্ক গুলোর কোন মূল্য নাই তাদের কাছে. এটার কারণ কি আসলে জেনারেশন গ্যাপ? আমার কাছে কেন জানি মনে হয় এটা জেনারেশন গ্যাপ হতে পারে কারণ যুগের সাথে তাল মিলিয়ে আমরা যেভাবে এগিয়ে যাচ্ছি সেজন্য হয়তোবা আজকে মানুষের ভেতরে মনুষত্ব বলে কোন কিছু নেই . যেভাবে পারছে সেভাবে তার নিজের স্বার্থের দিকে এগিয়ে যাচ্ছে .তাহলে কি পৃথিবীতে মানুষ স্বার্থহীনতায় ভুগছে? আমি অনেক কিছু ভেবে দেখি স্বার্থপর মানুষ স্বার্থপরতা হিংসা করা. এই জিনিসগুলো নিজের ভেতর থেকে বের করে আনাটা খুব জরুরী আমাদের. কারণ মৃত্যু সবারই নিকটে. জন্ম যেহেতু হয়েছে মৃত্যু তোমার হবেই এই কারণে আমি কথাটা বললাম.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nimni/23wqg8BUSLWrpfmEG7mmPEyoiBgtgP85tfMGHfiNc3txeoJphiBXyUB6zxWQaUz9x89pf.png)


 জীবনে চলার পথটা এত বেশি কঠিন হয়ে যাচ্ছে দিন দিন তাতে করে মানুষের সাথে মানুষের দূরত্ব বাড়ছে. বাংলাদেশের মানুষের কথা যদি বলি তাতে তাদের ভেতরে একটা জেলাসি আমি দেখেছি সেটা হচ্ছে তুমি কেন ভালো আছো আমি কেন ভালো নেই. এই অহংকারী জিনিসগুলো প্রত্যেকটা মানুষের ভেতরে বাস করে কেউ প্রকাশ করে কেউ ভেতরে পুষে রাখে. আমি আমার জীবনের অভিজ্ঞতা থেকেই এই কথাগুলো বলছি. কারণ আশেপাশের মানুষের মধ্যে এত নেগেটিভিটি দিয়ে ভরা যে প্রতিদিন একবার করে মনে হয় যুদ্ধে জয়ী হয়ে আমি আবার পরাজিত হয়ে যায়. ভালো জীবনসঙ্গী পাওয়াটা খুব ভাগ্যের ব্যাপার. জীবনসঙ্গী ভালো না হলে ওই তো সেই আবার শ্বশুরবাড়িতে গিয়ে পরের সংসারী নিজেকে মানিয়ে নেওয়া।  আমার কাছে মনে হয় মেয়েদের ভাগ্যটা ভালো হওয়া উচিত।আর একটা কথা বলতে পারি আমি নিজের অভিজ্ঞতা থেকে শাশুড়ি কখনো মা হয় না. মায়ের স্থান শুধু নিজের কাছে রাখবো না মা তোমায় হয় মার সাথে তুলনা অন্য কোন কিছুতেই হয় না. কারণ মা ভেদাভেদ করে না. মা খাবার বেড়ে প্রথমে তার নিজের সন্তানের কথাই ভাববে এটা স্বাভাবিক তাই অন্যের বাসায় গিয়ে আপনি কষ্ট পাবেন না .যে আপনাকে কেন ডাকলো না বা আপনাকে কেন বড় মাছের মাথাটা দিল না. আমরা মেয়েরা বোকা তাইতো এই জিনিসগুলো ধরে আমরা কষ্ট পাই আমরা কেন বুঝি না সে তো আর আমার নিজের মা না. কারণ তোমার বাড়িতে তোমার যতটুকু অধিকার থাকে অন্য বাড়িতে তোমার সেটুকু অধিকার থাকবে না কারণ ওই বাড়িটা তো তোমার না. মেয়েরা সবথেকে বেশি কষ্ট পায় তিনটা সময় আমি যেটুকুজানি.প্রেগনেন্সির সময় তার প্রতি কার কেমন ব্যবহার ছিল. বিয়ের পরে স্বামীর বাড়ির মানুষ প্রথম দিকে তার সাথে কেমন আচরণ করেছিল, বাচ্চা হওয়ার পরে তার পাশে কে ছিল আর তাকে কতটা সাহায্য করা হয়েছিল বা অবহেলা করা হয়েছে. ঘরের পুরুষদের যখন জিজ্ঞাস করা হয় তার পছন্দের নারীকে সে উত্তরে কি বলে জানেন এটা কিন্তু স্বাভাবিক আমরা অনেকেই জানি তার মা. আমাদের দেশে এটা একটা ব্যাপার পুরুষ যদি স্ত্রীকে তার প্রিয় নারী বলে বা ভালোবাসি বলে তাহলে তাদের ইগো নষ্ট হয়ে যায় সমাজ তাকে বউ পাগল বলে. তাই কখনো নিজের প্রিয় মানুষের কাছে প্রিয় মানুষ হতে পারবে না. কারণ প্রত্যেকটা মেয়ে তার শ্বশুরবাড়িতে প্রতিদিন একবার করে যুদ্ধে পরাজিত হয় প্রতিটি স্বামীর কাছে. আসলে বলতে পারেন জীবনটা এমন কেন? এই যে মেয়েদের সাথে যেই জিনিসগুলো হয় বাংলাদেশের প্রত্যেকটা দেশেই হয় আমার জানা নেই কেউ জেনে থাকলে জানাতে পারেন. স্বামী সংসার প্রতিনিয়ত ৯৫ শতাংশ মেয়েদের আজকাল ডিভোর্স কারণ একটাই শ্বশুর বাড়ির সাথে বনি বানাত নাই. জীবনে ঘটে যাওয়া কিছু গল্প যেগুলো গল্প হয়ে রয়ে যায় সব কথা আসলে শেয়ার করা যায় না কিছু কথা একান্তই নিজের হয়ে থেকে যায়. সবাই ভালো থাকবেন সুস্থ থাকবেন .বেশি করে পানি পান করবেন কারণ এত বেশি গরম পড়েছে ডিহাইড্রেশন হতে পারে শরীর সুস্থ রাখার জন্য অবশ্যই আপনাকে স্বাস্থ্যবিধি মেনে চলতে হবে. নিজে সুস্থ থাকবেন সামনের মানুষটাকেও সাহায্য করবেন এতে করে জীবন আরও বেশি সহজ হয়ে যাবে.

title.title: What Does The Bible Say About Sleeping Together Before Marriage?
title.body:
https://youtu.be/uNm3dhi3HY0?si=XL5gGFNxPCQgZpn3

We need to live a good Christian life. We must always embrace discipline.

We have to be willing to learn every day, study the world. So there are things we need to abstain from. And we cannot know the things we need to abstain from without knowing the word of God. 

As Christians, we are calling the world that is full of sin, mostly sin of the flesh. Every Christian and brother should understand how to also deal with all this. There are a lot of things that is holding us down. When it comes to that subject of people sleeping together, this is one of the sins of the flesh that is not good in sight of God.

Young people should avoid engaging in such a frivolous thing where something could be done. Which is by repenting and turning your way. There is something wrong because even the bible says whatever there are things of good reports then you should do it.

Having an on sleeping together before marriage is one of the most deadly is one of the costly things. Boy and the girl who is not married should not sleep together. Let us avoid this thing of the flesh so that we can walk according to the will of God and keep His commandment only.

title.body:
Luego de terminar su ensayo, toda la banda salió del estudio y cruzó las puertas de otro estudio, pero esta vez de fotografía. El lugar estaba lleno de luces, fondos de colores y cámaras montadas sobre trípodes que parecían una experiencia única.—Bienvenidos —dijo el fotógrafo—. ¿Listos para convertirse en una banda oficial? Lucas miró a sus compañeros, muy nervioso, ya que era la primera vez frente a muchas cámaras. Michelle acomodó su cabello. —Siempre fue real, Lucas. Solo que ahora todos lo van a ver. Dani dio una palmada. —¡Vamos! Necesitamos actitud. Mientras que Stewie, giraba sus baquetas entre los dedos. —Tranquilos, solo imaginen que estamos en el escenario, pero sin tocar, sin público y sin ruido. >El fotógrafo los acomodó frente a un fondo oscuro. —Quiero que se vean como un gran equipo. Todos se colocaron: Dani al frente, con una mirada decidida; Michelle a su lado, elegante y concentrada; Stewie con una media sonrisa y Lucas, estaba en el fondo, hasta que Dani lo jaló suavemente hacia adelante. La cámara hizo *clic*. # >After finishing their rehearsal, the whole band left the studio and walked through the doors of another studio—this time, a photography studio. The place was filled with lights, colorful backdrops, and cameras mounted on tripods, making it feel like a one-of-a-kind experience. “Welcome,” said the photographer. “Ready to become an official band?” # >Lucas looked at his bandmates, feeling very nervous, since it was his first time in front of so many cameras. Michelle smoothed her hair. “It was always real, Lucas.” “Only now everyone is going to see it.” Dani clapped her hands. “Come on! We need some attitude.” Meanwhile, Stewie twirled his drumsticks between his fingers. “Relax, just imagine we're on stage, but without playing, without an audience, and without any noise.” # >The photographer positioned them in front of a dark backdrop. “I want you to look like a great team.” Everyone took their places: Dani in front, with a determined look; Michelle by her side, elegant and focused; Stewie with a half-smile; and Lucas was in the back, until Dani gently pulled him forward. The camera clicked. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP5wqt1Gi9krZPuRbCWVmqRsD1V6YWqtEgk6Hwaao82dP/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-con-camiseta-negra-sosteniendo-una-camara-dslr-negra-13521541/) En ese instante y en ese estudio algo cambió. Ya no eran solo cuatro chicos tocando música en un estudio, ahora eran una banda. Después de varias tomas, el fotógrafo asintió satisfecho y ya tenía la indicada. —Perfecto. Estas fotos irán directo a la administración de la escuela. Con esto podrán tramitar sus credenciales para el concurso. Horas más tarde, en la oficina de la escuela Rising Star, les entregaron unas tarjetas brillantes con sus nombres, fotos y el logo del concurso. Lucas sostuvo la suya como si fuera un trofeo. —No puedo creerlo. Dani levantó la suya con orgullo. Michelle sonrió y Stewie golpeó suavemente su credencial con una baqueta. —Siguiente paso: ensayar hasta que no podamos más. Los cuatro chocaron sus credenciales en el aire como si fueran copas, sellando un nuevo pacto. Afuera, el viento soplaba suave, pero dentro de ellos algo ardía con fuerza, emoción y un paso cada vez más cerca de ese concurso que tanto esperan. >At that moment, in that studio, something changed. They were no longer just four kids playing music in a studio; now they were a band. After several shots, the photographer nodded with satisfaction—he’d got the one he wanted. “Perfect. These photos are going straight to the school administration. With these, they’ll be able to process your credentials for the contest.” # >Hours later, in the Rising Star school office, they were handed shiny cards with their names, photos, and the contest logo. Lucas held his up as if it were a trophy. “I can’t believe it.” Dani held hers up proudly. Michelle smiled, and Stewie tapped his ID card gently with a drumstick. “Next step: practice until we can’t take it anymore.” # >The four of them clinked their badges in the air as if they were glasses, sealing a new pact. Outside, the wind blew gently, but inside them something burned with intensity, excitement, and a step closer to the competition they’d been waiting for. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQme9DVZqpaZCwVmUc5Edg4XzVSSoDzGko1PVkKvvgogw4B/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/instrumento-musical-instrumento-de-cuerda-guitarra-acustica-de-cerca-10315093/)

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  DOMBEY & SON #15/471
title.body:
From the glimpses she caught of Mr Dombey at these times, sitting in the dark distance, looking out towards the infant from among the dark heavy furniture—the house had been inhabited for years by his father, and in many of its appointments was old-fashioned and grim—she began to entertain ideas of him in his solitary state, as if he were a lone prisoner in a cell, or a strange apparition that was not to be accosted or understood. Mr Dombey came to be, in the course of a few days, invested in his own person, to her simple thinking, with all the mystery and gloom of his house. As she walked up and down the glass room, or sat hushing the baby there—which she very often did for hours together, when the dusk was closing in, too—she would sometimes try to pierce the gloom beyond, and make out how he was looking and what he was doing. Sensible that she was plainly to be seen by him, however, she never dared to pry in that direction but very furtively and for a moment at a time. Consequently she made out nothing, and Mr Dombey in his den remained a very shade.

Little Paul Dombey’s foster-mother had led this life herself, and had carried little Paul through it for some weeks; and had returned upstairs one day from a melancholy saunter through the dreary rooms of state (she never went out without Mrs Chick, who called on fine mornings, usually accompanied by Miss Tox, to take her and Baby for an airing—or in other words, to march them gravely up and down the pavement, like a walking funeral); when, as she was sitting in her own room, the door was slowly and quietly opened, and a dark-eyed little girl looked in.

‘It’s Miss Florence come home from her aunt’s, no doubt,’ thought Richards, who had never seen the child before. ‘Hope I see you well, Miss.’

‘Is that my brother?’ asked the child, pointing to the Baby.

‘Yes, my pretty,’ answered Richards. ‘Come and kiss him.’

But the child, instead of advancing, looked her earnestly in the face, and said:

‘What have you done with my Mama?’

‘Lord bless the little creeter!’ cried Richards, ‘what a sad question! I done? Nothing, Miss.’

‘What have they done with my Mama?’ inquired the child, with exactly the same look and manner.

‘I never saw such a melting thing in all my life!’ said Richards, who naturally substituted for this child one of her own, inquiring for herself in like circumstances. ‘Come nearer here, my dear Miss! Don’t be afraid of me.’

‘I am not afraid of you,’ said the child, drawing nearer. ‘But I want to know what they have done with my Mama.’

Her heart swelled so as she stood before the woman, looking into her eyes, that she was fain to press her little hand upon her breast and hold it there. Yet there was a purpose in the child that prevented both her slender figure and her searching gaze from faltering.

‘My darling,’ said Richards, ‘you wear that pretty black frock in remembrance of your Mama.’

‘I can remember my Mama,’ returned the child, with tears springing to her eyes, ‘in any frock.’

‘But people put on black, to remember people when they’re gone.’

‘Where gone?’ asked the child.

‘Come and sit down by me,’ said Richards, ‘and I’ll tell you a story.’

With a quick perception that it was intended to relate to what she had asked, little Florence laid aside the bonnet she had held in her hand until now, and sat down on a stool at the Nurse’s feet, looking up into her face.

‘Once upon a time,’ said Richards, ‘there was a lady—a very good lady, and her little daughter dearly loved her.’

‘A very good lady and her little daughter dearly loved her,’ repeated the child.

‘Who, when God thought it right that it should be so, was taken ill and died.’

The child shuddered.

‘Died, never to be seen again by anyone on earth, and was buried in the ground where the trees grow.’

‘The cold ground?’ said the child, shuddering again.

‘No! The warm ground,’ returned Polly, seizing her advantage, ‘where the ugly little seeds turn into beautiful flowers, and into grass, and corn, and I don’t know what all besides.

title.title: Modern Day scammers are becoming builders.
title.body:
![239155.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23zbeNSouivVusQf5vAowsoVXx9bqeXZorAiEfeZdYf7cAqhf1TXs4pxagM9j8pPq6G7c.png)


<hr>


Since the BTC ETFs crypto has been somewhat stifled. Previously it was about building apps and giving people freedom, creating cool decentralized stuff that isn't controlled by the government, saving off the grid away from the prying eyes of the public and people saving money without needing to do KYC. 

I saw a lot of cool stuffs being built and people enjoying the proof of usage that came with crypto. 

However over the years scammers have found their way into crypto and imagine one of those scammers being Donald Trump with the crazy launch of that coin he did with his wife and pulling millions of dollars of retail fund into a pump and dump without a proper project backing it up. 

I must also admit that the present day crypto generation may not really care about crypto usage, just pump and dump and many of them has been dumped on and have lost a lot of money in the process. 


When you talk about alt project in this present cycle you and not mention the scam that's happened throughout the cycle, people have been burned and lost a lot of money to scammers invading the cycle.

 We had many protocols promising users ROI for depositing their funds and a lot of these protocols rugged and scammed users of millions in dollars.

 So it's safe to say that 90% of those projects were scams, over 70% has shut down and made away with users money and the 20% still functioning are probably on the brink of collapse as well. 


So is it that real builders are no longer in the space, or has every project we need been made already, or do we have more scammers than builders in the space? 


I think we have more scammers now, and even the projects that are legit and still standing, over 50% are probably not going to make it to 2028. 


Also we probably have enough DEX now, enough perps and RWA project and we probably don't need more. projects like Hyperliquid and Aster have probably taken over the DEX industry and anyone think of building a DEX again will no longer survive. 


This might signal that crypto does not need more copy cats projects, it needs new innovative and ground breaking tech that sells itself, but then it looks like real users creators and builders are no longer as creative. 


This probably means that money will not flow into these current projects from BTC and all that. Infact money is flowing out of these projects into BTC and the BTC ETF making the general crypto market stagnated and all that. 

 The BTC ETFS themselves provides safer way to invest in BTC without actually having to put money into BTC, this means that people are now getting smoother choices to throw their money in BTC and this takes away the interest of investors and users from the deeper crypto project market, sad but this is the reality of things. 


Creators and builders has to get creative again, at the moment it looks like people aren't as interested in usable projects anymore, just money and stability. It screams concern, and means an inevitable gallop of BTC price into hundreds of thousands of dollars, but we won't give up though.


 Projects like Hive, I guess we'd keep adapting and growing and trying to attract users, builders and more attention to the chain, it's definitely not going to be easy because the odds are now against us. The aim should be adapt, continue shipping and bettering the system, forking it and surviving hard times like this.

title.title: Time to AFC Champions League Two
title.body: ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHo7yi2Sja9RjNyqxxPAd156K6hr8AP4PXMfcW93Jrki/Nassr%20Ahli.webp) Today, Monday, as we kick off a new week and eagerly await this afternoon’s match between Al Ahli and Vissel Kobe, it’s time to take a look back at the quarterfinals of the AFC Champions League Two. Asia’s second-tier continental tournament and the one everyone hopes Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al Nassr will win... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/f_tbol.webp) ## CR7, one step more Yesterday Al Nassr made clear its ambition to win the AFC Champions League Two. The team, led by Portuguese coach Rui Vitória, gave the home side Al Wasl no chance, thrashing them 4-0 in the quarterfinal match. Cristiano Ronaldo, returning from injury, opened the scoring in the 11th minute with a precise shot, scoring his 969th career goal. Before halftime, Iñigo Martínez (24’) and Abdulelah Al-Amri (26’) extended the lead with shots from inside the box, effectively sealing the match. In the second half, Sadio Mané sealed the victory in the 80th minute. Al Nassr, which had already shown its strength in the group stage, advances confidently to the semifinals and positions itself as one of the tournament’s top favorites. The Saudi team is now just two games away from winning the title. Al Ahli in semifinal and Gamba Osaka await in the final. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/f_tbol.webp) ## Al Ahli and William Draxler wins too Qatar’s Al Ahli SC took a decisive step toward the continental title by eliminating Jordan’s Al Hussein with a convincing 3-1 victory in their AFC Champions League Two quarterfinal match. The game showcased the Qatari side’s technical superiority. Erik Expósito put the home team ahead just two minutes into the game with a precise finish. Al Hussein temporarily equalized through Yousef Qashi (21’), but Julian Draxler, a former PSG player, restored the lead in the 65th minute, paving the way for the Qatari victory. In the final minutes, Michel Vlap scored the decisive 3-1 goal in the 90+7th minute, sealing the team’s advancement to the semifinals. The victory validates the management’s commitment to the second continental tournament and sets the stage for a Champions League-caliber semifinal against Al Nassr. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/f_tbol.webp)

title.title: Finally Bronze I unlocked! My big achievement today.
title.body:
‎Hello everyone,
I'm @naturaluttom.- I hope everyone is well, I'm fine too. Today I want to share a happy experience from my favorite game Splinterlands.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU3nskyqeCGrGKtkUvDLhdjPXoLfEczfM1SaAHmQF4LB2/1776694875223.png)

[‎The image was created with AI.]()
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
Today I was playing in Bronze II league. My rating was 660 and below. I used a very simple strategy - a strong tank in front and an attacker in the back. This simple plan worked well for me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBG6NWekCcN4nJ1u2PHEs2dZwf4PusHwfMFaqT4HBvd7/1776694940432.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)



The happiest thing is that I won 3 matches in a row. Because of these three wins, I was able to unlock Bronze II from Bronze I. Honestly, this is a great joy for me. Because I am slowly progressing and improving myself.

After winning the match, I got some good rewards. I got a total of 10 loot chests.

It felt great when I opened them. Out of them, I got 1 Legendary Potion Charge, which will increase my chances of getting good cards in the future. I also got 1 Energy, with which I can play more matches.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcxu7h8nsHgZEd6AjKi8Wxh8AL9ut6XoagcRV4BTaT1n/1776694940563.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYydU151XvzSA1xiaL3XYLStmkgRLf4N2JFmfFcBJhNrF/1776694940604.jpg)

The most enjoyable thing is that I got an Epic card Echelon. This card is new to me and it will be useful for my team. It makes playing more fun when you have such a card.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRp3JTb5oJ5WT2idZUhFVTx4JQFBugoNQy6xsfCtcC8hT/1776694940478.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2nPdajF91aj1ptp3hUsk27GCGBb7WpBbMA8ERrFeD8t/1776694940520.jpg)
One thing I learned from today's match is that simple strategies often work well. Nothing too difficult, just playing correctly is possible to win.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6YwiPNFXUa9No7YrfGG9ERZ5PF1XY3mi3B4osihESJP/1776695000469.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPqsARaSg1e7ntmkQJQb86tmKsZTzZFNvSnZYGuPt5kiw/1776695000511.jpg)

Overall, today was a very good day for me. I will try to play better in the future and gradually move up.

Thank you all for reading my post. 😊

title.title: Soft Cheeks
title.body:
![lil p.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dinglehopper/23vsZ4cHGcgj4k8VcdjUZi2PsYSUszSR3YSpX2Zejvn3ZkBi3WpsLfK8XKAvdsgG8ZEbR.png)

Gave myself a little break from my usual world building project and just doodled today, nothing serious, just letting my hand move without thinking too much. somehow I got really into drawing these soft, plump cheeks like I just wanted to see how round and gentle I could make them feel. Plus a nice rounded forehead with a chin to match. Something haunting like those porcelain doll faces.  I added a bit of blush, softening the shapes, keeping everything simple. and then somewhere along the way, the character started to feel like something more. like a quiet little prince just standing there, in his own world, not saying much but still holding a whole story in his face. It feels calm, a little dreamy, and kind of personal in a way I didn’t expect. The hair should be reddish and curly but I could not get the right shape and silhouette it either got big or out of control curls. I did not finish the outfit as I was just trying to give him a small cartoonish body. Maybe I can turn this into a cowboy or not.

title.title: NEEDLEWORKMONDAY-Transformar las bases-Body escote en V.[Transforming the basics. V-neck bodysuit]
title.body:
> Feliz lunes needleworkers :3 otro lunes de costuras nos llama a compartir el avance semanal. Estoy muy cercana a mi entrega de corsetería y ya hice mi segundo body, que es una transformación del primero que hice, transformar las bases ya se me hace un poco fácil, igualmente en esta materia nos dan una pequeña orientación de que tocar y que no, por ejemplo, en los calados, pero en mi caso eso es para otro momento, creo que un body de cuello alto con un calado de corazón seria hermoso, o un escote gota, pero tengo que hacer mi base, por ahora estoy trabajando con un talle 42.
Happy Monday, needleworkers! :3 Another Monday of sewing calls us to share our weekly progress. I'm very close to my corsetry assignment and I've already made my second bodysuit, which is a transformation of the first one I made. Transforming the basics is getting pretty easy for me now. They also give us a little guidance in this subject on what to do and what not to, for example, with the lacework, but in my case that's for another time. I think a high-neck bodysuit with a heart-shaped lace pattern would be beautiful, or a teardrop neckline, but I have to make my basic pattern first. For now, I'm working with a size 42.

> Para hacer esta transformación use mi body base que copie en un nuevo papel, hay varias cosas que hice tomando en cuenta como quedo el primer body que es bajar escote y hacerle una v, achicar el hombro y subir desde la cadera para que no comprima el cuerpo por completo, también baje un poco la sisa, tengo un dibujo y anotaciones de esto.
To make this transformation I used my base bodysuit which I copied onto a new piece of paper. There are several things I did taking into account how the first bodysuit turned out, which is to lower the neckline and make it V-shaped, narrow the shoulder and raise it from the hip so that it doesn't compress the body completely. I also lowered the armhole a little. I have a drawing and notes of this.

> Corte con el papel por encima porque esta vez sí deje el margen de costura, use una lycra que estaba guardando para reciclar, eso es lo bueno de esta materia, me va a dar pie para usar todos esos pequeños trozos de tela que no uso.
I cut with the paper on top because this time I did leave the seam allowance. I used a lycra that I was saving to recycle. That's the good thing about this subject; it will give me the opportunity to use all those small pieces of fabric that I don't use.

> Corte frente que es doble, y espalda que son dos partes y a unir con overlock, en este caso debería de tener refuerzo en la zona pélvica pero no se hacerlo, y me dijeron en clases que estaba bien si no lo tenía por ahora.
The front cut is double, and the back cut is in two parts and is to be joined with an overlock. In this case, it should have reinforcement in the pelvic area, but I don't know how to do it, and they told me in class that it was okay if it didn't have it for now.

> Unirlo todo es bastante fácil pero los elásticos siguen siendo mi enemigo por ahora, y lo peor es que no tenía tanto, así que medí el que tenía y alcanzaba justo en teoría.
Putting it all together is fairly easy, but the elastic bands are still my enemy for now, and the worst part is that I didn't have that much, so I measured the one I had and it was just enough in theory.

> Empecé poco a poco a ponerle el elástico, temo que, si estiro mucho la tela se salga, o que quede arrugadito, recientemente descubrí que hay un pie de costura que hace esto mucho más fácil así que voy a intentar conseguir, pero casi no estoy yendo a once que es donde debería conseguirlo a buen precio.
I started slowly adding the elastic; I'm afraid that if I stretch the fabric too much it will come out, or that it will get wrinkled. I recently discovered that there's a sewing foot that makes this much easier, so I'm going to try to get one, but I'm hardly going to Once, which is where I should be able to get it at a good price.

> Después de hacer la primera pierna pase a hacer la sisa, olvide decir que, según yo, era mejor hacer primero la v del escote y después el cuello trasero, eso realmente funcionó. Para las tiras de escote simplemente cosi el elastico partido a la mitad y lo use como elastico de sosten, debo conseguir de ese tambien jaja
After making the first leg, I moved on to making the armhole. I forgot to mention that, in my opinion, it was better to make the V of the neckline first and then the back neckline; that really worked. For the neckline straps, I simply sewed the elastic cut in half and used it as a bra strap; I need to get some of that too, haha.

> Lo lleve a mi clase para presentar con la mitad de las terminaciones jajaj pero no esperaban que esté listo en ese momento, había una gran producción de piezas muy lindas. Cuando volví a casa terminé de coser lo restante, por suerte el elástico llegó justo.
I took it to my class to present with half the finishing touches done, haha, but they weren't expecting it to be ready at that moment; there was a huge production run of really beautiful pieces. When I got home, I finished sewing the rest. Luckily, the elastic arrived just in time.

> En el escote tiene dos tiras que hacen que el escote no se abra por demás, lamentablemente el body quedo chico ya que la tela no estira tanto como mi otra tela, así que tocará hacer uno nuevo antes de mi entrega.
The neckline has two straps that prevent it from opening too much. Unfortunately, the bodysuit turned out too small because the fabric doesn't stretch as much as my other fabric, so I'll have to make a new one before my delivery.

> Por el momento no hice a tiempo de ir por más tela, pero si por elástico e hilo negro que ya me hacía falta comprar nuevos conos, seguro haga alguna modificación del escote en mi nuevo body, pero ya les mostrare.
I didn't have time to go get more fabric, but I did get elastic and black thread, as I needed to buy new cones. I'll probably make some modifications to the neckline of my new bodysuit, but I'll show you later.
> Hasta la próxima ❤️ Yowi. See you next time ❤️ Yowi.

>


**Todas las fotos fueron tomadas por mí
All photos were taken by me**

title.body: Don’t amputate the file just to obey a rule. First try a subtle edge cleanup: darken or desaturate the bright branch and right-edge foliage, or use a local heal/clone pass so the eye stays on the valley without throwing away pixels—clean edges matter because bright distractions near the frame pull attention fast, as [Photography Life](https://photographylife.com/landscape-photography-composition-tips) and [Digital Photography School](https://digital-photography-school.com/landscape-photography-composition/) both note. If you do crop, make it tiny and intentional—trim just enough to remove the strongest distraction, not half the damn scene. InLeo wasn’t useful here, so the real answer is simple: keep the photo, fix the edges locally, and only crop as a last resort.

Felicidades, tu texto transmite una verdad que muchas veces olvidamos: lo que hoy parece incómodo, feo o incluso inquietante, puede ser simplemente una etapa necesaria de transformación. La oruga no intenta ser mariposa antes de tiempo, ni se avergüenza de su forma actual. Solo avanza, en silencio, confiando en un proceso que no necesita aprobación externa.
Hay algo profundamente humano en eso. También nosotros pasamos por fases donde no nos reconocemos, donde sentimos que estamos “encerrados” en una especie de crisálida emocional, mental o espiritual. Y es justo ahí, en lo más oscuro y estrecho, donde ocurre el cambio más poderoso.
Quizás el verdadero mensaje no es la belleza final de la mariposa, sino la valentía silenciosa de la oruga al seguir adelante sin garantías, sin aplausos… solo con la certeza de que está en camino.
A veces, crecer también se ve así.

title.body: Yep — and that’s exactly why they’re easy to miss in the moment. In composition terms, branches are fine when they **frame** the subject on purpose, but when they just clip the edges they become distractions; that “edge patrol” habit is a real thing in landscape work because partial branches and cut-off elements pull the eye away from the subject, as explained in [Tim Smalley](https://www.timsmalley.co.uk/blog/edge-patrol-in-woodland-photography-composition/) and [Wilderness Shots](https://www.wildernessshots.com/eliminating-distracting-elements-landscape-photography/). In your [post](https://inleo.io/@luchyl/too-white-for-dirt-smap-267-...%20[truncated]) that’s the only real issue I was pointing at — not “bad photo,” just one of those sneaky border details photographers only notice after the fact.

title.title: The Invisible Scars of Cyberbullying
title.body:
I have been a victim of cyberbullying and physical bullying and trust me neither is actually good and I can never wish for this experience with anyone that I know. Basically to be bullied is worse because online always has those long-time memories of the past we tend to have forgotten. Nothing online is hidden forever, so even though we grow up and the physical person has forgotten and gotten old, the online will still bring it up for us all to see, and trust me, the feelings by then will be different, but experiences like that are very unforgettable. 

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mikechrist/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqtEDY1kGYYPtvHLn.png)

Physical bullying can be minimized especially when the person moves to a new location hurt cyber bullying cannot be stopped, to be cyberbullying doesn't stop it is forever. These are experiences that make because they have unforgettable emotional feelings. I could say something physical today and after a while everything gets dead or forgotten after apologies but looking at online harassment or bantas, it's very hard for things like this to be forgotten. I remember i did a birthday celebration at beach and trust me, it didnt end the way i wanted it to end because someone later drowned that day and hus body was discovered that third day, after this day i started getting harrased, bullied and insulted online that i killed the guy that i drugged the drinks of people which i dont normally do to kill the guy, I felt really sad during this season it was then i understood that real friends and bad friends existed and they are all not the same, real friends stood by my side and the bad fried denied everything just to prove they where not there. Apart from this experience so far I can't recollect experiencing anything, Till today, I still feel this experience like it was yesterday and it has been so sad for me to witness. I thank God the parent did not want to investigate further, if not we would have been in trouble especially false accusation, nigeria police system is the worst, they just need someone to fill in the space of their suspicion just for their promotion.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mikechrist/23xebWE35AT9hzDydUNXk9525YCq96JuUy8WtCdjm2BT93hi1gfUyintW8Sm296ReVFsi.png)

 Since then, I have had this non care attitude towards making friends and hw people feel, this really traumatized me and funny how everything is online even though i move to new locatiosn i still see some videos and comments of pewople circulating that i had to delete all the post on my page then so i domnt keep on remeber ing about the past tjings thAT HAS happened s=ans so i can move forward it was really a tough decision to make. 

Cyber and online harassment or bullying doesn't end but online harassment does especially when you move to a new location or place. I don't pray to experience either because online destroys reputations and physical ends physical sometimes within a set of people knowing.

title.title: Making space for more of what matters. [Mattress from Old cloth]
title.body:
After spending some memorable times on the hills I returned home this Sundays. Last few days were the best in my life. As spending time in natural setup with so much quite and peace environment allow me to declutter my mind and thoughts. The natural silence and expansive, awe-inspiring views of mountains reduce the constant digital and sensory noise of daily life, offering deep relaxation. As soon as I returned home in my village, I noticed my neighbour is busy with something at his courtyard. They were decluttering their old clothes to make a new  mattress for the bed. I was also looking for such machine who randomly visit villages and earn their livilihood by making mattress from old cloth.

![20260414_112239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoGxthCjnu7KouWnMCVau5WjctZij5sPsdMQsQw6XSLZkHKBcxgMtpqsY33Bc2PrWbw.jpg)

Earlier, the ladies at home used to see old clothes to make a quilt at home but now things have changed. There are machine which can churn the cloth into fine cotton form.to make mattress. Many people find it it worth to make better use of old cloth. 

![20260414_112222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EogMLLVn3zPPyzXmaQ5PApTaejqcPbc6hVCMprBgSHupD35MVQ6tXortTsLUoDMxrNu.jpg)

Finding it as a good oppurtunity to declutter my home, I started selecting some old cloth which were not in use since many month. There were jeans, shirts, bed sheets and other opd cloth of my Dad. They were lying unused and occupy spaces in the wardrobe. It is better to make good use of them by sewing into a new mattress for our cot. I collected them.and handover them to the workmen who were operating the machine.

![20260414_111352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoeFp8C3h4db1FbU4u3jKUhmUKBFfUKMBjFu6iFPa6g9PwKxPrudYUGwST5qdhnKryp.jpg)

The machine is a unique set up. Built upon a three wheeler, it has a motor that were used to churn the old cloth. 

![20260414_111358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eoptonrjp2QnQZiF5eaXzPkt96W5NKmtTXjcGs7PnVNmpPZNpksLdqJ3uYM3SkQcxij.jpg)

The guy who is operating the cloth and the machine, rolled all the cloth and put them inside the rotating machine.

![20260414_111525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EonmQTuocwHp6vEDHNmRn7SEeWqUdLQVoqyF7guc5kVTUjqV8see7rxxVd3srxcV1Ka.jpg)

Soon, the clothes started churning into small pieces. It appears like small cotton pieces.


![20260414_111846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EpCCHnUanZiG8DAAjJ8ek7amcbypXtK4MEsdDBBJ8HAS9gm9yjUu5eBEzYkNiJ19wTT.jpg)

There is a cotton cloth tied at the other end of the.machine, that were collecting all the churn part. The old cloth is now left with fine churned pieces which is now to refilled into a new piece of bed cover.

![20260414_111411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EpNoRX3HV8RBXb2dSNTT9ut7gJX5vmmvmQ6ZEvYHBWRCZqS7FDH9BmLWSZyfV4w3sag.jpg)



![20260414_112126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoiWEznwdJH9UFttU2f52DHaeNEczTd6U4wVkTxuxhL4CYo1ytdSCVZ532rsjUiFcKJ.jpg)



![20260414_113905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EowJ6vBenV4LkunhhQoEUZEboKtP7nDsPxzRvWbyBMKVX4HWAkAPaD8HD5tQGSTLykZ.jpg)




![20260414_113039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EouA6t4EnR6vDy9FBHGsXPJ2SXHEDW4RDEobHSXqsSE5cafippw28strZ3A8TRMjGKt.jpg)

The fine churned piec3s were then transferred into a new piece of cloth and the machine guy started stitching them. It took them well over 30 min to make the mattress. The total weight of the mattress comes down to 10.5 KG. However I am quite relieved by putting the old unused cloth for some meaningful use.



**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

title.title: Abandoned amusement park
title.body:
![BackgroundEraser_20260419_173347313.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23wWuAjpUqdRnQmWy8eQdoBGZCsSSW6xRNZiKd56y3Bos3vgZTLKK6WBZzwjSAhHq56V9.jpg)


Today I go to a place that is next to the road I take to go home. This once was a place to share and enjoy. Now it's in ruins.

I'm talking about the amusement park of the José Martí district in Santiago de Cuba city. Sadly most of the park's attractions are all destroyed. But some are used by teenagers to play when they leave school. Or they just sit on them to talk. This actions give the area some life the week days after class.


| ![SAM_6666.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EpnBsHWWtSdJbfzYbQNeUdjx1DsXsVmNmn3cFw5zh5AGzwodUQKFCuYELL1vmbs8mqk.JPG) | ![IMG_20260419_181204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23wMaXb1MZdiZc36p1NC7zkWBa95kCc4znkyYTQFEfvsLzEdFFk6dVodffh7eEKTrxq8d.jpg) | ![SAM_6668.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EoMCDgqH6ahao6vxCyQJ4w3tkrpdFP2PuXHAYkEFiGTQihovyWnXLJ1Mv9wz6TD6Lm6.JPG) |
|-|-|-|


The place has no access restriction, although it has a perimeter fence it does not have gates or bars that prevent passage. More than an amusement center, today it is a abandoned public park.


![SAM_6673.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EoCiB7JHBy4YFFZKKDK25ko4UHkJQC2aNvyMd856NYb94W65QAD5GAW3LsMasRPP9ro.JPG)


![IMG_20260419_181123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23xKxeHbzCnZ2WmX9WFNdfCdCpfGwsAAc1nNV3kV3ynz1bnCfXzDMvzeQJzn6yzi7T9bK.jpg)


![SAM_6672.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EqL9gtGn3qJpA6MmV3JTaUbBKNr1QSBHEPYyBEyt9r9eyv2Eo8gxAC3hvdG8mkQUqo5.JPG)

Some people take advantage of this situation to cut branches or trunks from trees to use firewood for cooking or charcoal. A reflection of the current situation in the country. 


![SAM_6687.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/Eq5Da6fBxGP3DuKqLZ4vju75BAwNngkJ6B3NWriPhWbqjKe4mZER8BV6uXZCXxQnNGp.JPG)


![IMG_20260419_181023.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23wgMX4jTF61T8sEsa4LjDwcvNn2ASwz4eHJeJfxJPChXheeFrmyc6SbSK94t1SXAtmR9.jpg)


![SAM_6681.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/Eq5CURWVpt5wNdqk3uCtnFL548uPBcASdh9hhgg4dPdWZipXHY7MZs5fsqGac6rKVAk.JPG)


Back to the subject, the buildings of the site, that in others times offered services and snacks, are accumulating waste and dirt. 


![SAM_6684.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/Eq7KzjKfuLQk5mvvThLxFgjr6qn4PJF1yvM29Bg1qvxea7BQVx75AZ58GQ9r9YtHvdx.JPG)


![IMG_20260419_181040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23yd1RSSopFDciQMEg6q2UWwB7MpHSaEwKW86SqW8Qmy6fQtptu5PqZ2pPx1gzfdcV5Wp.jpg)


![SAM_6692.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EoiTkBVS2zA1ifdD3Zb5wGnJtuL6beL7XdvzMF44VofGb1XCR6n9oQpvWXftgFq4pAK.JPG)


The most well-kept part is the restaurant/cafeteria, although it still does not have any valuable offer. However, the plane is something to highlight and, at least, remains as a reference of the site. There you can take a good photo or show your child up close what an airplane looks like.


![SAM_6696.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EpGHudfkwriVXEVikATksZcAYpbuMqTRaHbdCy97bcpCBmxug2J6Mv49dUQi1i8NCNG.JPG)


![SAM_6695.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EpXGXZriFRBeJY42HrdPT2CjzwkU63N4brBmcJQZ3AyUbRATXW9YAqseMah6sXG9cdv.JPG)


![SAM_6698.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EqQKiqrBQ4KL1Ju31jdV7cGU8LoiDZdoJWSdJvYqfpebiYWVUU7bia3qEexu2UomDRq.JPG)


This was my urban exploration of the day, stay tunned for more. See you 😉.

Also you can check the video I made

https://youtu.be/mDwHmoxEuLE?si=Ev1wPU1Jmb3N9Vgv

title.title: Splinterlands - Owster Rotwell against units with magic attacks
title.body:
![or.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wgFm7LcPkNzH86C7GGhsKxg9AUGs4gXka7ygNAYVhkJ2GmkXpYt25RzgoSfq1Ave36G.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will show you a battle from a tournament I participated in. In this battle the event modifier called Eggceleration is active, so all units will gain +1 to all stats at the end of each round. In addition, only units with magic attacks will be able to be summoned, since the Wands Out modifier is active. And the Junior Varsity is also active, which only allows units and archons that cost 6 or less mana to enter the battlefield.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eou6pdD2kNGhygKiMHe9JkCWXESZytQepgVtZCR9NA2cDSJ8ZF8sK93C2hQFroGEXhd.png)</center>

---

In this battle, I used the summoner of death, Owster Rotwell, since he grants the Magic Reflect ability to all my units, so enemy units when attacking with magic, will take 50% of the damage they deal.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkmmnybwh2iHD3aMu4vf2KFZETcoa64nb4QFqSrFNaA5xPoGMWLLHU7BhMGHgQn5dGk.png)

---

<div class=\

> https://images.hive.blog/240x260/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/untamed/Elven%20Mystic_lv2.png In the first position I put the Dark Arborist, which only has 1 magic attack power, but has 5 hit points. And it has the Demoralize ability, which reduces the melee attack power of enemy units by 1. In the second position is Elven Mystic, who also has 1 magic attack power but with 4 hit points. ---

> https://images.hive.blog/240x260/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulboundrb/Arachne%20Weaver_lv2_gold.png In the third position is Tortisian Chief, my first magic unit with 2 magic attack power, and the one with the most hit points. And in the fourth and last position is Arachne Weaver, who also has 2 magic attack power; and the Corrupted Healing ability, so in each round, it restores 70% of the max health to other allied units. Each time it heals, the affected units will lost 1 point of max health. ---- ## Battle In the first round, Tortisian Chief defeats the enemy Moxian Rebel. Then, the enemy Dark Arborist is defeated by the magic reflect ability after attacking my Arborist. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkjb1X662Wu8V7sBNk2NEyyusfDgYBJX1rcRpZt4kpiYkUQyhBRx8FUwvxSuWNwspzT.png) --- In the second round, the enemy Baron Fyatt defeats my Dark Arborist. Then, my Arachne Weaver defeats Baron Fyatt. After that, the enemy Arachne Weaver defeats my Elven Mystic. ![r2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/48HACvfZBaDh9AYfxsbvHg5NouWVyYpbp7cGbUjbDxufRYjmTRHuKaip3DYcozTsei.gif) --- In the third round, my Arachne Weaver ends the battle by defeating the enemy Weaver.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tkhqhhnPDoiJbs2gNhM5WohdeG3JpTdc6fMWSb6LftQtZNo7WHnpox9xjiULwHN2RQd.png) [Full Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_9LvffsQdvirjRiGnWiVG?ref=langice)
--- My opponent also used the summoner Owster Rotwell and, like me, also summoned Dark Arborist and Arachne Weaver. And played Baron Fyatt, who is really useful as he has the Halving ability, but his first unit in the frontline position was really bad, as it only has 1 hit point. My lineup had many more hit points, and thanks to that the battle was in my favor. It ended quickly in the third round and I won with two units alive. A great victory for Owster Rotwell. --- Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook. That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield! --- Other hive games: Terracore: https://terracoregame.com?ref=aubryd Moonkarts: https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com ![a1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23w2iyaFnGeFxMUfVZJq3tnHydC7hguGuQKC4gaA73Gk3FEjy3L6uTWNNJFgB8LvSNfai.png)

title.title: Facing Venka the Vile: When Game Tempo Turns Brutal
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfLT7WMvXCAkcJvcLuMEQoX4rtRHUAX6JAtYGTeJooXQ/venka_the_vile.jpg)



Hello Splinterlands warriors, sometimes on the battlefield we don’t lose because of bad strategy… but because the opponent brings something “unfair” right from the start. And honestly, that’s exactly what I felt when facing a name that now often makes me let out a long sigh: **Venka the Vile**.

<center>https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/rebellion/Venka%20the%20Vile_lv4_gold.png</center>

The first time I saw this card, my impression was simple: “wow, this is a fierce monster.” But after reading the details, I realized… this isn’t just fierce—this is the kind of monster that doesn’t come to fight, but to end the match quickly.

Venka the Vile is a Legendary Neutral monster from the Rebellion edition. It has **7 melee damage**, **5 speed**, and the most nerve-wracking ability—**Charge**. What does that mean? It can attack from any position. Whether placed in the back, middle, or front, it can still strike.

And that’s not all…

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZnSErDfWDyf3RCiWACJhrrtWdVzFoyE4Vq1FkofvWYMp/stats.png)</center>



It also has:

* **Piercing** → enemy armor is just a formality
* **Oppress** → double damage to units without attack
* **Trample** → if it kills one, it keeps hitting the next

If I had to describe it, this monster isn’t just one slot… it’s like two or even three slots at once.

---

I once faced Venka in a battle with a 46 mana cap. At that time, I was pretty confident. My formation was solid, strong tank, full support. It felt “safe enough.”

Turns out, that sense of safety was just an illusion.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS89oEzUxKPR23yvzjW3CzhmnbrYhMNpcyL1tKNebfeZW/round_1.png)


From the backline, Venka started attacking. One strike, one of my monsters fell. Then it continued to the next. That’s when I realized—this isn’t just about high damage, this is about **forcing the tempo of the game to speed up**.

And honestly, in that moment I felt like someone who just realized they forgot to lock their front door… after the thief was already inside.

The result? I lost. There wasn’t much I could do.
And you can see the result in this battle link: 
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_fab0435099b9eb15761e8b3c94f075ea?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

---

But from that loss, I actually learned something important.

Sometimes we focus too much on building a “balanced” team, and forget that in Splinterlands there are cards that can completely break that balance in just one or two rounds.

And Venka is one of them.

I also started thinking that cards like this will become even more relevant with the direction of the game’s new features—pushing gameplay to be more dynamic, faster, and more brutal strategically. It’s no longer about lasting longer, but about who can create momentum first.

If I’m being honest, facing Venka isn’t fun… but it’s interesting.

Because it forces us to rethink:

* Do we need a Taunt unit to absorb the damage?
* Do we need more attacking units so we don’t become Oppress targets?
* Or do we simply need to be faster than it?

---

And in my opinion, Venka the Vile is a card that leaves very little room for mistakes. One slip, and it’s over.

Strategies I can take from this experience:

* Always prepare a **distractor (Taunt unit)**
* Use **speed control or debuffs** to reduce its threat
* And if possible… defeat it before it even moves 😄

Because once it starts attacking, usually we’re no longer playing the game… we’re the ones being played.

In the end, losing isn’t always about luck.
Sometimes, it’s about not knowing your opponent.

And after meeting Venka the Vile… I think I’m starting to understand—though in quite a painful way.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

Tekken 8 is an amazing fighting game that gives gamers a new experience with modern graphics outstanding characters and intense action. In this game every fight feels extremely exciting and close to reality where every move every punch and every special attack fills you with excitement. The fight between Jin Kazama and Kazuya Mishima in particular is the signature highlight of this game.

Tekken 8 includes a new feature called the Heat System which makes the game even faster and more aggressive. Besides that the graphics are so close to reality that it feels like you're part of a movie. Every stage every character and every effect has been designed with great detail and beauty.

If you’re a fan of fighting games then Tekken 8 is an excellent choice for you. This game not only challenges your skills but also keeps you entertained every moment. Whether you play with friends or compete online, Tekken 8 is a complete entertainment package in every way.

The edge distractions I meant are the bright leafy branch intruding from the left edge and the dense dark foliage clipping the right edge; both pull the eye sideways instead of keeping it on the valley and layered hills, which is exactly why composition guides warn about clutter and edge intrusions in landscape frames like [Digital Photography School](https://digital-photography-school.com/4-rules-of-composition-for-landscape-photography/) and [Visual Wilderness](https://visualwilderness.com/composition-creativity/nature-photography-composition-from-rules-to-visual-impact). And if the mark is your signature, that’s different from a random phone watermark — it just makes the image read more as a finished personal piece than a competition-clean landscape, which is a stylistic choice, not a flaw.

title.title: La constancia
title.body:
/>

La constancia no se sostiene con emociones momentáneas, porque estas cambian, se desgastan y desaparecen. Se construye desde algo mucho más sólido: la identidad y los valores que eliges vivir cada día. Cuando tu propósito deja de ser una meta externa y se convierte en parte de quién eres, ya no necesitas motivación constante… actúas porque es coherente contigo.

Ahí es donde todo cambia: lo que antes pesaba, ahora fluye; lo que parecía esfuerzo, se transforma en disciplina silenciosa. Y es en esa repetición consciente, casi invisible, donde realmente ocurre el crecimiento.

La constancia no es hacer mucho un día, sino hacer lo necesario incluso cuando no tienes ganas. Es esa fuerza silenciosa que no se ve, pero que construye resultados reales con el tiempo.

Muchos abandonan porque buscan motivación constante, pero la verdad es que la disciplina nace cuando decides avanzar aun sin ella. La constancia no grita, no presume… trabaja en silencio mientras todo parece lento.

Y un día, sin darte cuenta, todo lo que repetiste con paciencia empieza a dar frutos.

Ahí entiendes que no era cuestión de talento, ni de suerte… era cuestión de no rendirte. 🌱

title.body: @luchyl, the edge distraction is the dark leafy mass clipping in from the upper-left and the partial vegetation nibbling into the lower edges; those are classic “edge mergers,” where cut-off elements at the border pull the eye away from the main scene, which composition guides warn against in [Outdoor Photographer](https://www.outdoorphotographer.com/tips-techniques/photo-tip-of-week/merge-into-the-background/) and [Alan Ranger](https://www.alanranger.com/blog-on-photography/mastering-photography-composition-rules). In your [thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/luchyl/re-leothreads-3bsbydfbd), the village and fields read clearly as the subject, but those border intrusions make the frame feel a bit accidental rather than deliberately clean. And fair point on the watermark—if it’s your signature, that’s not “wrong,” but a large stamp/date still changes the vibe from fine-art landscape toward documentary or personal-record style, which is why it stands out.

Walking in fellowship with other believers helps us overcome moments of weakness. Encouragement, shared testimonies, and mutual support remind us that we are not alone in our struggles. title.body: @luchyl, yes — it can pass as a landscape photo, but it’s more of a **rural environmental landscape** than a pure nature shot. Landscape photography absolutely allows human-made elements and settlements when the land itself is still the main subject, which fits standard definitions from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Landscape_photography) and [Photography Life](https://photographylife.com/landscape-photography-guide). The only thing weakening it is the distraction at the frame edges and the phone watermark/date stamp, which make it feel more documentary than polished landscape work. On InLeo, recent photography posts around composition and scenery are still mostly framed as broader photo stories than strict genre policing, like this [recent photo post](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/cooperation-is-the-way-t).
