---

# <center> Té de Limón Frío </center>

---

La corta existencia de mi vida
se reduce a la rapidez con la que soy consumido.

Rápido, el día que la sed sea implacable.
Entre bocados de comida,
cuando soy un mero acompañante.

Casi abandonado
entre conversaciones tranquilas de risas
y demasiadas pausas
para leer capturas de pantalla.

La condensación cae por las paredes
de esta transparente y fría prisión,
un lento recordatorio
de que pronto dejaré de existir.

No sé si serviré para nutrir
o simplemente como parte
de una cantidad de líquido
que hay que tomar a diario.

Pero hoy,
ahora,
en este vaso,
en esta mesa,

soy solo té de limón frío.

---

__________

Lastly a birds eye view of Drakes Steps - as named after Sir Francis Drake by Queen Elizabeth I - after he returned from his three year, round the world 'voyage of discovery'. The mission was in fact a covert operation whereby five ships set sail to essentially plunder various Spanish and Portuguese ports in Europe and South America, ultimately leading to the Spanish retaliating with their armada. 

Multiple battles were fought on land and sea as part of a war that lasted from 1585 to 1604 and only ended after a treaty was signed that favoured both nations. A cease fire was put in place and trade resumed. James I of England was recognised by the Spanish as King.

James eventually became King Of England after the passing of Queen Elizabeth I with no heir to the throne.
![Screenshot 2025-09-03 at 15.10.28.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/23tbpcBRXFzvYi7SapqBgFT5zm8RYxBm1ddU23FxZQT8m7dzwxxnDmyvxZempzKt8mo3S.jpg)

Birds eye view of an old slipway from a bygone era. The docks were once used to receive newspaper from Finland and owned by News International which publishes The Times and The Sun. It is currently owned by a Hong Kong based investment company.
![Screenshot 2025-09-03 at 15.09.50.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bombaycrypto/23tGyGbbPVbfqqpyUvZS1cBG836bjn7sCbEGNky27wiQ5Aixu3BPxuCbPAigBBnmxfrwd.jpg)

title.title: Rolka po tygodniu
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBAGS2haqaHJBzaqx61kWMXBs1nr33RrwyahqyBh39SS/image.png)

Minął tydzień od publikacji [rolki o trzech powodach, dla których warto odwiedzić KBK](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXEayXIDI_Q/). Była to czwarta rolka po publikacji [tej viralowe](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DMuzwHNo77I/) o niepodległości. No i po raz pierwszy zebrałem na jej temat całkiem sporo danych. Codziennie spisywałem statystyki, żeby mieć porównanie w przyszłości. Choć z tym porównywaniem to może być różnie...

Przede wszystkim dlatego, że 28K wyświetleń i 541 polubień to dane dotyczące zarówno Instagrama, jak i Facebooka. 

|Rolka...|po 12h|po 36h|po 60h|po 84h|po 108h|po 132h|7d  
-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|  
Wyświetlenia|7026|16593|21878|24214|25617|26788|28017  
Polubienia|193|322|413|470|494|511|541  
Komentarze|9|11|13|20|21|22|23  
Udostępnienia|74|139|219|246|257|275|286  
Zapisania|85|164|244|281|303|322|335  
Obserwatorzy / Nieobserwatorzy|16,5% / 83,5%|12,2% / 87,8%|10,1% / 89,9%| 9,7% / 90,3%|9,4% / 90,6%|9,3% / 90,7%|9,2% / 90,8%  
Relacje|3,4%|2,9%|2,1%|2,2%|2,2%|2,1%|2,0%  
Karta Rolki|68,7%|69,1%|58,2%|54,4%|52,5%|51,3%|49,9%  
Karta Ekspoloruj|8,7%|9,8%|8,3%|7,9%|7,6%|7,5%|7,2%  
Obserwujący|46|125|193|230|239|250|265

A na koniec dwa wnioski.

- Po pierwsze, rolka miała ponadprzeciętne wyświetlenia, ale trudno nazwać ją viralową. 28K w 7 dni to satysfakcjonujący wynik, który przełożył się na realne efekty. Dzięki niej w KBK pojawiło się kilka nowych osób. Przybyło też wielu obserwujących. Szacuję, że w ciągu następnych dni rolka osiągnie 30K. Może też mieć jakieś drugie życie.
- Po drugie, w przeciwieństwie do rolki viralowej poszła ona szeroko zarówno na Instagramie, jak i Facebooku. Na IG miała 16515 wyświetleń, na FB - 11502. Są to dość zbliżone liczby. Dla porównania, viralowa rolka na Facebooku miała tylko 3234 wyświetlenia, znacząco mniej niż na Instagramie. Wniosek z tego taki, że nie ma jakiegoś jednego, uniwersalnego przepisu na viral. Wciąż wiele w tym wszystkim przypadku. Coś może mieć większy lub mniejszy potencjał, ale nigdy nie może być gwarancji.

title.title: AAVE TVL Down Close to 10B in Two Days!
title.body:
If you are not awere curently there is ongoing situation regarding a hack of close to 300M that happened on a bridge of the LayerZero protocol, managed by KelpDAO. 

More than 100k Ethereum was stolen in the hack, in a form of a staked ETH with the ticker rsETH, and the hacker used protocols like AAVE, Compound and others to cash out of the rsETH token to ETH and get liqudity. This left AAVE with a bad debt, or a loss, and the AAVE protocol froze all the WETH pools. This partial freeze cased a panic, and other users who are in other pools started exiting the protocol, and that value is now close to 10B in just two days. The TVL droped from 26B to 17B now. This is quite the bank ran.

There has been very little comunication in all this from the AAAVE team, and obviously users are nervous. AAVE has been a highly regarded DeFi protocol with the highest TVL in the industry. Will see how will they come up from this.

title.title: DEATH OF LITTLE CHILDREN WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY ABOUT IT
title.body:
The Bible does not give a single systematic explanation for the death of little children, but it offers themes that believers have drawn on for understanding and comfort. It teaches that death entered the world through humanity’s fall, and as a result all creation, including the youngest lives, is affected by its brokenness. 

At the same time, Scripture consistently portrays God as just, compassionate, and especially attentive to the vulnerable. Narratives and teachings throughout the Bible have often been understood to suggest God’s special care for children and the hope that they are received into His presence.

At the same time, the Bible does not minimize grief or provide simple answers. Loss is met with deep lament, and sorrow is acknowledged as a real and painful human experience. https://youtu.be/RkwrGwWSDqE?si=w02l_RDXhQSwXmYt

title.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 43 Favourite Childhood Story
title.body:
![SBC 43.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23vi3j4WMCM24NH49sTXwZVGv7bnaCyBE45CR6pf83cenpAaQx2d4CzH9gAKVUibB1eBS.png)


***
# The SB-Chronicle Prompt #43
With #sb-chronicles... we are posting a question on Mondays, prompting anyone who wants to join in to write their own \
Chronicle for future generations to read! *If you feel like suggesting a next prompt yourself... please feel welcome to contact one of the \

!*

###  What was your absolute favourite story when you were a child?
> I'm not talking about what you read to your grandkids now, but the one that captivated you when you were a wee child. Was it a classic adventure that made you want to roam the countryside, a comic that you hid inside a schoolbook, or perhaps a tale your parents spun out of thin air at bedtime?
###### Tell us the title, the memory of where you were when you heard it, and why that specific story was the one that stayed with you all these years.

***

# The How-2 join the Silverbloggers Chronicles

- Just take the prompt question and answer it in your own Hive post. 
- **Post in our Silver Bloggers Community**.
- Be sure to **use [#sb-chronicles](https://peakd.com/created/sb-chronicles) as your first tag**, to get them all listed at the same place. 
- Write 100% original content of **around 300 words in English**.
- **Put the link to your post into the comment section of your chosen prompt.**
- Have fun.
- 

And soon enough, we’ll have a \

for future generations. **There is no time limit for all this...** Write whenever you like and whatever prompt suits you. Just make sure you use the proper tag and put a link to your post in the comment section of the chosen prompt, so we can curate your story.

[You can check here on all our prompts - always updated with what's to come!](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-writers-block-terminator)
***
![SB_Chronicles_Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/Eo8UoVbkMbQLQ4Mv34M33H1DPziCRD6Kc9fanV7reiyH3hHt5kXjpLpTNKR54CnoZnL.png)
***

# The Idea of the Chronicles
...kinda started when our community advisor [SilverScribe](https://peakd.com/@ericvancewalton) came up with the Memoir Mondays. A new topic/question every Monday for a whole year, and we all loved it so much that we've fallen into a kind of writer's block since the \

of it.  <sup><sup> *Not really, but still...* </sup></sup>

So what could be more obvious than to continue somehow? Something has to be done to tackle writer's block, or even the ‘all-time low’ at Hive...
***
The Silverators started brainstorming the hows and the whens to get an idea of what we could all share for the best of our community. To have a sort of \

that never gets old.

In the synonyms for the word memoir, we can find - chronicle. Now, that was it.... our own chronicles!  **The Silverbloggers Chronicles**! The place where we all keep our memories to share with the future. The library of a silly, wild bunch of Silvers. **The Silvery Book of the Wise**! Hehehe


***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***
### On Winning the Prize ?!
We are all winners in this by supporting each other in the community, be it with an upvote, a tip, and/or a kind comment... 

> Since we \
know that many are just chasing big votes, with not doing much at all, running behind the whales to get them to pay attention, craving for a vote of lots of dollar$. Or the ones being \

and trying to benefit from the Vitamin R<sup>elation</sup> until there's a Lambo in sight...!

We feel this is the wrong way. A community should be there for each other, even if many humans are conditioned differently. It's more about putting the ego-selfish-ego aside, because life is not about money, it's about joy/happiness. That everyone gets support for their best they give to the community. 

> You may say it's good to have dreams? Yes, we live these dreams to achieve the best for everyone. Remember - joy/happiness?!

Why are we even writing about this while promoting the Chronicles for our community? It's to make us all realise that many members don't get high-profile support, but we can \

ourselves. Also, to understand that the idea of a memoir library for future generations is probably not the way to get rich, to finally get that Lambo. It's about sharing viewpoints, knowledge, and the occasional good laugh. It's about individuals, nature, and happiness. And be sure, we continue to curate the pearls in our midst!
***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***

## Last words...
***
We would love to get more eyes on this post *and* all community posts from - [@hive-106316](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316) - our Silver Bloggers Mother Account.  This is why we make a point of reblogging your posts.  Please do the same?!  

<center>

### Come and join our [Silver Bloggers community![Silver Bloggers footer banner 600 x 300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/48WD1eopcAX4rSS8vpYrV1FgBxPT9MQgSPaM2ToKczuqCr1Z41rVsFP8GHaoMoe4MT.jpg)](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316)

### And a big THANK YOU for your support
</center>
***
[![SB_NoAI.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/Eo6MQJHtPDETiEe2BCnwng3GefzS4S4q8jQBKEUpMgCrLp97LstcvcZJNS8rwT7D567.png)](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-menu-a-silver-bloggers-guide-to-the-hive-iverse)

body.title: Doing good to all men | The Oldpath
body.body:
(James 1: 27, Isaiah 58: 10-12). 

Caring for people is not a suggestion, it is a biblical command. It is a character trait every one that calls him or herself a believer should possess. We shouldn't live our lives on a daily basis ignorant of this.

If we claim to be truly Christians one of the things that we should be found doing is doing good to people. Not just our family but also to our brethren in the household of faith. They also should be regarded and treated as family.

Even down to our neighbours, strangers, even our enemies. When mandated us to do good to men he did not specify it to only a certain category. It was general. We were should live our lives in obedience to this command.

body.title: Arsenal, Ngapaen sih?
body.body:
> Nah, kan beneran kejadian!!! ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeT3QjbEReGeC7iVZtH8ZSB5XJ55f7sEtuZT5PDoC85Zn/image.png) Bener-bener nih Arsenal kayaknya cuma bisa gacor di awal musim aja, terus di akhir musim malah melempem kayak ayam sayur. Apa emang mesiunya udah habis kali ya, jadi meriamnya ga bisa nembak lagi. Malah kalah 2-1 dengan rival terdekat, yaitu Manchester City, di Etihad Stadium. Kan jadinya poinnya udah hampir sama jika dilihat dari klasemen sementara di bawah ini. body.title: Brno Public Transport/Brněnská MHD [Eng/Cz-translate by AI]
body.body:
**Riding the “šalina” like a boss**
If you’ve ever been around Brno, you know one thing — without trams, trolleybuses, and buses, you’re basically screwed. Brno’s public transport runs on a level many cities could envy. And it’s not just about getting from A to B.

**A bit of history so we don’t sound clueless**
Brno kicked off public transport way back in 1869 — yeah, seriously. Back then, trams were pulled by horses (no Tesla vibes yet 😄). It was the third city in the whole Austro-Hungarian Empire after Vienna and Budapest.
Then it paused, came back, switched from steam to electricity… basically a full upgrade from ancient tech to something solid.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqLVQ5Qkz3QSLsBYsfBo7VDDvWdRU3jchZSgSQdWiYqU/1776694248524.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZv1DJEfhvYnQgJPXLhDxoBYQfRNk4SStkWcBD5D46cG/1776694254262.jpg)


**So how big is it today?**
Nowadays, Brno has dozens of lines — trams, trolleybuses, and buses all nicely connected like a good playlist. Whether you’re in Líšeň, Bystrc, or Královo Pole, you’ll get where you need.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzLbsvYTz97PpYc8RsyBYB2MEn4Zityws3USJC99rcgS/1776694268165.jpg)


**Any records? Hell yeah**
Brno’s public transport is no amateur. In 2024, it carried over 384 million passengers — which is insane.
That basically means every local (and half the country 😄) is riding daily.

**Night connections = Brno special**
This is next-level stuff. At night, all buses meet at the main station and then spread out across the city like a GTA mission.
On weekdays, they carry around 10k people, and on weekends up to 25k.
Coming back from a party? No need for expensive rides — just catch a night connection and you’re good.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTPVx8d9qj4tjUjtZFcpSWoUk7KbvQc1JjtnKrtN24w7m/1776694290412.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQKCoqQHBGF32LeQpxLVBvc9z8EigA89d8cfVcs27wReu/1776694290433.jpg)


**Why Brno’s public transport rocks**
– goes almost everywhere
– affordable (travel pass = lifehack)
– runs at night
– and yeah… it’s a whole vibe
Honestly, Brno without public transport would be chaos. This way, you hop on a tram, chill, look out the window, and think about life.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGFcdJ8DQyUTy2G1gxWtQqM1cqiPQUDRCZXFeKiNq6PW/1776694310196.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeANARtcnRt8XQc8JmnsTLBpG9voBUn6KqeNzwFHKzQeK/1776694310211.jpg)

**The bottom line**
If you really want to experience Brno, don’t just stick to the city center. Jump on a tram and explore.
Because here, we don’t say “tram”… we ride the šalina, bro 😎

[CZ]

**šalinou jak boss, aneb jak se vozí štatl**
Jestli jsi někdy jel po Brně, tak víš, že bez šalin, trolejbusů a busů jsi prostě v háji. Brno jede MHD stylem, který by leckterý město mohlo závidět – a není to jen o tom, že ti to doveze prdel z bodu A do bodu B.

**Trocha historie, ať nejsme za lopaty**
Brno rozjelo MHD už v roce 1869 – jo, fakt. Tehdy ještě koně tahali tramvaje (žádný Tesla vibe 😄). Byli jsme třetí v celý monarchii po Vídni a Budapešti.
Pak se to chvíli rozpadlo, zase obnovilo, přišla pára, pak elektrika… klasickej upgrade jak z Windows XP na něco použitelnýho.

**Kolik toho vlastně jezdí?**
Dneska má Brno desítky linek – šaliny, trolejbusy i autobusy, všechno propojený jak dobrej playlist. Ať jedeš z Líšně, Bystrce nebo z Krpole, vždycky se nějak dostaneš.

**Rekordy? Jasně že jo**
MHD v Brně není žádnej amatér. V roce 2024 se svezlo přes 384 milionů lidí – což je totální masakr číslo.
To znamená, že každej Brňák (a půlka republiky k tomu 😄) sedí v šalině prakticky furt.

**Noční rozjezdy = brněnský unikát**
Tohle je level, kterej jinde moc neuvidíš. V noci se všechny busy sjíždí na hlavák a pak se rozjedou do všech koutů města jak GTA mise.
Ve všední dny odvezou kolem 10k lidí, o víkendech klidně 25k.
Jdeš z kalby? Neřešíš Uber za kilo, prostě počkáš na rozjezd a jedeš.

**Proč je MHD v Brně top?**
– jede skoro všude
– relativně levná (šalinkarta = lifehack)
– funguje i v noci
– a hlavně… je to vibe

Upřímně – Brno bez MHD by byl chaos. Takhle si dáš šalinu, chillneš, čumíš z okna a řešíš život.

**Závěr?**
Jestli chceš poznat Brno fakt autenticky, nelez jen po centrech. Sedni na šalinu, projeď si město a nasaj ten vibe. Protože tady se neříká „tramvaj“… tady jedeš šalinou, kámo 😎

body.body:
![1000517779.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ambar1825/23uaMgW5VHVZHKurpRtJoa6LSRbNdWBJLG9WUh2d929Fb6dtWkH62xhNr953HbfBGYH89.jpg)

Ya son 36 años de vida!
>I’m already 36 years old!

A un día de mi cumpleaños número 36 y estoy pasando por un bajón tan fuerte como muchos otros pasados en estos últimos 7 años. Mi mente que vive en un movimiento constante, sobre pensando sin descanso, estuve despierta hasta casi las 2:00 am buscando un motivo por el cual debería estar más feliz un día como mañana y a simple vista no lo encontré porque la bulla en mi cabeza es tan grande que no deja salir las posibles cosas bonitas por las cuáles debo agradecer. Si me dejase llevar por mis pensamientos intrusivos definitivamente desearía pasar el día echada en mi cama, dentro de mi fortaleza que es mi habitación pero luego la otra parte de mi que me mantiene cuerda y es la que me exige salga de ese sitio oscuro al que me arrastra mi mente, me recuerda que tengo a una pequeña que depende de mí y es allí donde vuelvo a mi. Mi hija es mi salvavidas

>With just one day left until my 36th birthday, I’m going through a slump as bad as many others I’ve experienced over the past seven years. My mind is in constant motion, overthinking nonstop. I was awake until almost 2:00 a.m. trying to find a reason why I should be happier on a day like tomorrow, and at first glance, I couldn’t find one because the noise in my head is so loud that it doesn’t let the possible beautiful things I should be grateful for come to the surface. If I let myself be carried away by my intrusive thoughts, I’d definitely want to spend the day lying in bed, inside the fortress that is my room. But then the other part of me—the part that keeps me sane and demands that I leave that dark place my mind drags me into—reminds me that I have a little girl who depends on me, and that’s where I come back to myself. My daughter is my lifeline.

Estoy sola en casa en una lucha interna sin poder hablar con nadie más de mis sentimientos porque simplemente no quiero juicios y mucho menos consejos vacíos de personas que no saben lo difícil de vivir con problemas de depresión y ansiedad. 

>I’m home alone in an internal struggle, unable to talk to anyone else about my feelings because I simply don’t want judgment—let alone empty advice—from people who don’t know how hard it is to live with depression and anxiety. 


Un post más, una confesión más, una herramienta que me da seguridad de poder expresar solo una parte de mi sentir sin miedo al rechazo y eso lo valoró. Se que al igual que las demás va a pasar desapercibido pero eso también es bueno. 






>One more post, one more confession, a tool that gives me the confidence to express just a part of how I feel without fear of rejection, and I value that. I know that, like the others, it will go unnoticed, but that’s okay too. 


![1000065520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ambar1825/242DZMLXnzfWAGqHY9R4UZGokj5vQnohDeJskhtjc8o7BdHr6kZtQNCQKC3whzFrfVoRS.jpg)

Dire Warnings from Heaven 
End-Times, Inc.: Seven Apocalyptic Scares That Made Believers Do Crazy Things (and the People Who Profited).  

From Orson Welles' Martians to Harold Camping's Rapture, a century of dire warnings from heaven has led to mass panic, mass suicide, and a whole lot of merchandise. 

It was Halloween Eve, 1938, when millions of Americans reached for their radios and heard the end of the world. The broadcast—a dramatization of H.G. Wells' War of the Worlds—was so convincing that listeners jammed police switchboards, grabbed their guns, and prepared to fight off Martians with heat rays. But the panic wasn't real—at least, not as real as the newspapers claimed. And that tension between genuine fear and manufactured hysteria has defined every major apocalypse scare since. 

Here are seven events since 1900—plus one critical precursor—that scared believers into doing crazy things, complete with the money trail and legal fallout left behind. 



 The Precursor: The Great Disappointment (1844).  

The Prediction: Jesus Christ would return on October 22, 1844. 

William Miller, a Baptist preacher, convinced thousands of followers—the Millerites—to sell their possessions, don white robes, and ascend to heaven. When Jesus failed to appear, the day became known as the \

The Crazy: Followers sat on rooftops in their robes, waiting for the rapture that never came. Some wept through the night. 

The Ramification: Instead of abandoning their faith, many Millerites invented the \
theology—claiming Christ had entered a heavenly temple rather than Earth—which birthed the Seventh-day Adventist Church. This psychological template of \

failed prophecy would repeat for generations. 

Money? Mostly lost. Followers had given away their possessions. But the Adventist movement would grow into a wealthy denomination with hospitals, schools, and publishing houses. 



 1. The War of the Worlds (1938). 

The Prediction: Martians were invading Grover's Mill, New Jersey, with deadly heat rays and poison gas. 

Orson Welles and the Mercury Theatre on the Air produced a radio adaptation that used fake news bulletins to interrupt what seemed like a regular dance music program. For listeners who tuned in late—missing the disclaimer that it was fiction—the realism was terrifying. 

The Crazy: In Concrete, Washington, a power failure plunged the town into darkness right as the Martians were supposedly attacking. Believing this was the end, men grabbed their guns to shoot the aliens. A New York City woman ran into a church screaming that the end had come. Police in Newark received nearly a thousand calls. The New Jersey Bell telephone company reported 75,000 to 100,000 extra calls during the 8:00 hour alone. 

The Ramification: The FCC launched an immediate investigation. Trenton's City Manager wrote a furious letter complaining that the broadcast had \

. Congress demanded laws to prevent such broadcasts.  \n\nUltimately, the FCC closed its investigation in December 1938 after CBS promised to avoid making fiction sound like breaking news. No fines were issued. However, the FCC later adopted a formal \

(Section 73.1217) that today would likely result in massive fines for such a broadcast. \nAccountability: Orson Welles apologized publicly, claiming he didn't know the broadcast would cause panic—though internal evidence suggests otherwise. H.G. Wells, author of the original novel, told the New York Times that CBS had \
.  \nMoney? Welles became a household name, launching his film career. CBS saw its audience skyrocket. The Mercury Theatre gained national attention. While no direct profiteering occurred, the \

narrative sold a lot of newspapers—the New York Times front page story is now considered a significant overstatement of the actual hysteria. 



 2. The Cold War \

(1950s-60s). 

The Prediction: Nuclear annihilation at the hands of the Soviet Union, interpreted by evangelicals as the biblical Armageddon preceding Christ's return. 

The Crazy: School children practiced \

drills—huddling under wooden desks that would have done nothing against an atomic blast. Families built fallout shelters stocked with canned goods and firearms. Some evangelical preachers identified Soviet leaders as the Antichrist. 

The Ramification: The nuclear threat never materialized as predicted, but the Cold War ended only after decades of near-misses (Cuban Missile Crisis, Able Archer 83). The existential fear reshaped American civil defense policy and popular culture. 

Money? A booming industry of survival gear, shelter construction, and canned food suppliers. Civil defense contractors made fortunes. The evangelical prophecy industry—books, conferences, films—grew substantially.  



 3. Heaven's Gate (1997).   

The Prediction: The Comet Hale-Bopp was hiding a UFO that would take their souls to \
\n\nLed by Marshall Applewhite, the Heaven's Gate cult believed their bodies were mere \

that needed to be shed to board the spacecraft behind the comet. \n\nThe Crazy: On March 26, 1997, police entered a rented mansion in Rancho Santa Fe, California, and found 39 bodies—all dead by suicide. They were dressed in matching black Nike sneakers and armband patches reading \

Each had consumed a fatal mixture of phenobarbital and vodka. 

The Ramification: The largest mass suicide on U.S. soil. Applewhite had convinced followers to sever all ties with family, sell their possessions, and dedicate their lives (and deaths) to the cause. The cult funded itself through a web design business called Higher Source. 

Accountability: Applewhite died with his followers. No one was prosecuted. The event sparked national debate about cults, religious freedom, and warning signs. 

Money? The cult had assets, including a $7,000-per-month mansion lease. Their web design business generated revenue. After the suicides, the remaining estate was tied up in legal battles. Nike famously tried to distance itself from the brand association. 



 4. The Y2K Bug (1999-2000).   

The Prediction: On January 1, 2000, computers would crash because of a two-digit date coding error. Planes would fall from the sky, power grids would fail, and society would collapse. 

The Crazy: Survivalists moved to remote compounds. Families stockpiled water, generators, ammunition, and dehydrated food. Some dug wells and drilled for natural gas. The recommendation to stockpile toilet paper as a barter item became a running joke. 

Southern Baptists and Pat Robertson's Christian Broadcasting Network openly viewed Y2K as a recruiting tool. \

.  

The Ramification: Nothing happened. The new year arrived with barely a flicker. Millions of food buckets sat untouched in garages for years. 

Accountability: The experts who predicted catastrophe largely disappeared from public view. Some admitted they got it wrong. Most simply moved on to the next scare. 

Money? This was the big one. Y2K became a $600 billion global industry. Consultants billed fortune. Lawyers prepared for lawsuits. Survival gear companies saw massive spikes. Walton Feed's dehydrated food business doubled. Emergency Essentials saw sales rise 40%. Books flooded the market—including Everyone's Guide to Making a Million Dollars on the Year 2000 Crash for $44.95. One observer called Y2K \

. 



 5. Harold Camping's 2011 Rapture.   

The Prediction: The Rapture would occur on May 21, 2011, followed by the end of the world on October 21. 

Using complex biblical numerology, the 89-year-old Christian broadcaster spent millions on billboards worldwide declaring \

\n\nThe Crazy: Followers sold their homes, quit their jobs, and drained their retirement accounts to spread the message. Some spent their life savings on advertising. When May 21 passed without incident, Camping claimed it was a \
(invisible) judgment. When October 21 also passed quietly, he admitted he \

The Ramification: Family Radio, Camping's organization, had spent approximately $100 million on the campaign. Most of this came from selling a television station and an FM station, but significant donations also came from followers who sacrificed everything. 

Accountability: The Freedom from Religion Foundation asked the California Attorney General to investigate fraud. Legal scholars said lawsuits were almost certainly doomed under First Amendment protections. The Supreme Court's 1944 United States v. Ballard decision ruled that courts cannot declare religious beliefs true or false. \

. He noted that Family Radio never advised followers on financial matters. 

Money? Family Radio retained most of its assets. Charity Navigator had rated it a 4-star charity. The $100 million was spent exactly as promised—on advertising the end. Legally, that made it difficult to claim fraud. But for followers who lost their life savings, the distinction was cold comfort. 



 6. The 2012 Mayan Apocalypse.   

The Prediction: The Mayan Long Count calendar ends on December 21, 2012, bringing catastrophic Earth changes or total destruction. 

The Crazy: People flocked to \

like Bugarach mountain in France (believed to be a Noah's Ark-style refuge) and Sirince, Turkey. Survival gear sales skyrocketed. One survival company reported a 400% increase in pandemic kit sales. 

The Ramification: The sun rose on December 22. The world continued. Most Mayan scholars had said all along that the calendar's end simply marked the beginning of a new cycle. 

Money? Global box office for the movie 2012—starring John Cusack and massive CGI destruction—was $770 million. The Stevens Point Brewery sold a \
with Mayan calendar labels. CafePress sold tens of thousands of doomsday items: thong underwear reading \
and T-shirts with the planet Earth saying \
. Tour companies charged $5,000 per person for trips to Mayan ruins on the fateful date. Hotels offered \
packages. \n\nA religion professor noted the cycle: \

. 



 The Pattern: Profit, Panic, and No Accountability.  

Seven events, seven cycles of fear, and one consistent outcome: someone always makes money. 

The profiteers fall into three categories.  

The Legitimate Opportunists: Y2K consultants, survival gear sellers, movie studios, and breweries selling apocalypse-themed products. They didn't create the fear, but they happily capitalized on it.  

The True Believers: Harold Camping, Marshall Applewhite, and the Millerites genuinely believed their predictions. Their followers' financial losses were collateral damage to sincere (if delusional) faith. 

The Legal Escape Hatch: The First Amendment's protection of religious belief makes fraud claims nearly impossible. As long as the predictor genuinely believes—or can convincingly claim to believe—their prediction, they cannot be sued for being wrong. The Supreme Court has ruled that juries cannot determine the \

of religious claims. 

The pattern endures because the human need for meaning—and the human capacity for self-deception—remains unchanged. Whether it's Martians, nuclear war, computer bugs, or comets, the apocalypse is always just around the corner. And someone is always selling tickets.

body.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  A Child's History of England #17/210
body.body: >CHAPTER V—ENGLAND UNDER CANUTE THE DANE

>

Canute reigned eighteen years. He was a merciless King at first. After he had clasped the hands of the Saxon chiefs, in token of the sincerity with which he swore to be just and good to them in return for their acknowledging him, he denounced and slew many of them, as well as many relations of the late King. ‘He who brings me the head of one of my enemies,’ he used to say, ‘shall be dearer to me than a brother.’ And he was so severe in hunting down his enemies, that he must have got together a pretty large family of these dear brothers. He was strongly inclined to kill

>Edward, two children, sons of poor Ironside; but, being afraid to do so in England, he sent them over to the King of Sweden, with a request that the King would be so good as ‘dispose of them.’ If the King of Sweden had been like many, many other men of that day, he would have had their innocent throats cut; but he was a kind man, and brought them up tenderly.

Normandy ran much in Canute’s mind. In Normandy were the two children of the late king—

>Alfredby name; and their uncle the Duke might one day claim the crown for them. But the Duke showed so little inclination to do so now, that he proposed to Canute to marry his sister, the widow of The Unready; who, being but a showy flower, and caring for nothing so much as becoming a queen again, left her children and was wedded to him.

Successful and triumphant, assisted by the valour of the English in his foreign wars, and with little strife to trouble him at home, Canute had a prosperous reign, and made many improvements. He was a poet and a musician. He grew sorry, as he grew older, for the blood he had shed at first; and went to Rome in a Pilgrim’s dress, by way of washing it out. He gave a great deal of money to foreigners on his journey; but he took it from the English before he started. On the whole, however, he certainly became a far better man when he had no opposition to contend with, and was as great a King as England had known for some time.

The old writers of history relate how that Canute was one day disgusted with his courtiers for their flattery, and how he caused his chair to be set on the sea-shore, and feigned to command the tide as it came up not to wet the edge of his robe, for the land was his; how the tide came up, of course, without regarding him; and how he then turned to his flatterers, and rebuked them, saying, what was the might of any earthly king, to the might of the Creator, who could say unto the sea, ‘Thus far shalt thou go, and no farther!’ We may learn from this, I think, that a little sense will go a long way in a king; and that courtiers are not easily cured of flattery, nor kings of a liking for it. If the courtiers of Canute had not known, long before, that the King was fond of flattery, they would have known better than to offer it in such large doses. And if they had not known that he was vain of this speech (anything but a wonderful speech it seems to me, if a good child had made it), they would not have been at such great pains to repeat it. I fancy I see them all on the sea-shore together; the King’s chair sinking in the sand; the King in a mighty good humour with his own wisdom; and the courtiers pretending to be quite stunned by it!

It is not the sea alone that is bidden to go ‘thus far, and no farther.’ The great command goes forth to all the kings upon the earth, and went to Canute in the year one thousand and thirty-five, and stretched him dead upon his bed. Beside it, stood his Norman wife. Perhaps, as the King looked his last upon her, he, who had so often thought distrustfully of Normandy, long ago, thought once more of the two exiled Princes in their uncle’s court, and of the little favour they could feel for either Danes or Saxons, and of a rising cloud in Normandy that slowly moved towards England.
>CHAPTER VI—ENGLAND UNDER HAROLD HAREFOOT, HARDICANUTE, AND EDWARD THE CONFESSOR

>

Canute left three sons, by name
>Hardicanute; but his Queen, Emma, once the Flower of Normandy, was the mother of only Hardicanute.

For many bettors, sports betting becomes part of their daily routine. Morning line analysis, checking the news, and evening matches all create a certain rhythm. However, it's important to remember that excessive involvement can lead to burnout and poor decisions.

When a bettor begins to build a system, they inevitably consider the most convenient way to trade the markets. Reliability, speed, and variety of events come to the forefront. Therefore, while searching for the optimal option, some consider https://afg.1xbet.com/en/mobile as a platform that allows them to focus on analysis rather than technical details.

Proper risk management remains key. Even with a good understanding of sports, it's impossible to predict everything. Splitting your bankroll and avoiding overly risky bets helps mitigate the influence of random factors and maintain stability over time.

Over time, bettors come to the conclusion that sports betting is not a way to prove something to others, but a personal process. The calmer and more rational the approach, the higher the likelihood of maintaining interest and avoiding unnecessary losses. This is a game of reason, not emotion.

body.body:
Hi,

I'm struggling into life atm, facing injuries, unemployment without any income and depression.

Photography has always been the beacon in the dark so I began doing lightpainting again starting from last week. I'll try to do it as often as possible during the following weeks as I'm convinced it will help me to recover and smile again.

For my 2nd session, I met a friend of mine. I visited a very nice park the day before and I had tons of ideas including camera rotation and backlighting. We headed to this location and we spent about 3 hours here, enjoying the calm of nature. Here are some of our results of the night :

![_MG_1301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dawnoner/23tGa9AmK61mrXyp9iGGxqhAKzcfH4eFaXMio8zGGgdFUhk8GPze27yWacbp9ZnRxzodj.jpg)

<center>**WHAT IS LIGHTPAINTING?**</center>
Lightpainting is a photographic technique in which exposures are made by moving a hand-held light source while taking a long exposure photograph, either to illuminate a subject or to shine a point of light directly at the camera, or by moving the camera itself during exposure. Nothing is added or removed in post processing.

body.title: “Some places don’t just show you beauty — they let you feel peace, and Gashat Valley is one of them.” 🌿💚
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsYufQxUJ5S4QfhVWqupQTTi5cJYFrE4SfaJFqG7NJJo/1776693814880.jpg)

I recently visited Gashat Valley, and honestly, it felt like stepping into a dream 🌿✨


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQL4rfrQ4VsWmhcdTGuXtVm6G9FX9AW7NMeNr1nZNFmt/1776693801261.jpg)


The beauty of this place is beyond words. Everywhere I looked, there was fresh green grass covering the land like a soft carpet. The peaceful river flowing through the valley added such a calming vibe — I could sit there for hours just listening to the sound of water 💚
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPRawUQZt7xbQ4UUixcXgLan8Fg4gKbd9SU2RfRskZxZ/1776693622353.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQWxtZDi3PaLG75fP21pqiC9EE2MDs3TouoGhmfAFk2xu/1776693833163.jpg)


The weather was perfect, the air was fresh, and the entire environment was so relaxing. It’s one of those places where you forget all your worries and just enjoy the moment.

I truly enjoyed every second of my journey. Gashat Valley is not just a place, it’s a feeling — pure peace, beauty, and happiness 🌄

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTfABoy52wsWFhqyLu5FTt239Z4g5KqKRvC6cvfhUKQbz/1776693541861.jpg)


Gashat Valley, one of Pakistan’s lesser-known natural treasures, is a breathtaking destination that truly reflects the country’s unmatched beauty. Surrounded by towering mountains, this valley offers a peaceful escape from the noise of city life. The landscape is covered in lush green grass that stretches as far as the eye can see, creating a soothing and refreshing environment for visitors.🌿🌱


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEzWcqq4Qzck1oM7LLUFoKWUBgiy6YRjB6Lo3J12HxXE/1776693652864.jpg)

One of the most captivating features of Gashat Valley is its crystal-clear river that flows gently through the valley. The sound of the flowing water, combined with the cool breeze and chirping birds, creates a magical atmosphere that feels almost unreal. The valley is especially beautiful during spring and summer, when the greenery is at its peak and the weather is pleasant.🌿☘️🌾

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQL4rfrQ4VsWmhcdTGuXtVm6G9FX9AW7NMeNr1nZNFmt/1776693693264.jpg)

Nature lovers, photographers, and adventure seekers can all find something special here. Whether it's hiking through scenic trails, relaxing by the riverside, or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings, Gashat Valley offers a unique experience. Its untouched beauty and calm environment make it a perfect place for those who want to reconnect with nature.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQWxtZDi3PaLG75fP21pqiC9EE2MDs3TouoGhmfAFk2xu/1776693715208.jpg)

body.body:
Hi, yes. I’ll follow your advice — it sounds really good to me. 

The thing with those rides is that they don’t plan them on the same day, but throughout the week. The idea was to meet in that park on H and 21 in Vedado on Saturday before 3 p.m., because at exactly 3 they leave for the planned destination. They don’t take the wind into account, haha… I think the wind is the real coach.
In fact, to get from my house to that park I took an avenue, Boyeros, which is a fast road. There are no climbs until a bit before arriving, but the whole time there was a strong headwind. I had no way to measure it — I wish I had. And to top it off, I was racing against the clock, because they don’t wait. They have English punctuality. They leave at 3 on the dot, without waiting for anyone who hasn’t reached the meeting point.

From that park onwards, heading to Cojímar, it was another battle against the wind and along streets that weren’t in great condition. We even went through another municipality called Regla. And there were some climbs as well. 😶

Does your Garmin tell you when to rest and for how long? I have no way of knowing, so I just follow my intuition and the signs of my body. I rested yesterday and today, so tomorrow I’ll be ready to go out on the bike again.

body.title: The Secret Behind the Lens: Pedals and Landscapes in Punta Brava
body.body:
What’s the best part about cycling with your phone in your pocket? It’s not just the workout. It’s that your bike forces you to stop where a car wouldn’t even notice a shot. 

A few days ago, I took my iPhone 11 Pro Max out to El Campestre on the way to Punta Brava, and the shots I captured got me thinking about the true meaning of landscape photography.

Forget the stiff rules. Here’s what works for me when I’m out there, trying to make my iPhone's sensors capture what my heart feels.

- Geometry is Key: Look for lines—like train tracks or old gates—that lead the viewer into your journey.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT25SaFVjYpEx4d2Gg93L1mo8286AwXeUK6R6iYdVBXRd/img_1863.jpg)


- Texture over Perfection: I love how my iPhone handles the grit of old stone and cold metal. Realism is in the wear and tear.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZWi7CWVj5ntBMrwzcapRnC9yMhiqCxxuq3mhcYmezDBk/img_1966.jpg)

- The Human Element: Capturing the serious dignity of daily life in the countryside adds a narrative weight that nature alone can't match.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYo61enwqrSQ3KvDZEzDPPgCPbyn3yRi5t7veozCVSgpK/img_1839.jpg)

- The Best Camera is the One You Have: Using my iPhone allows me to be fast and capture the soul of the moment without the bulk


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQBd4MX4CrMLnnHiPSzxS25UNVcLoZ5AxR2rPeAE45iu/img_1841.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRBbEL7QgucR89d8gJXhCMP9t8Fc9F98P8aWFQW8ADXd/img_1882.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYviypbgexBkGBENu7vkXPHzqZPRzCo6Yb1QxWo1VMZ1Z/img_1833.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWebUBojbRt3Du7hY5bNdVjbN2G9GaT15VmAEemorrGWw/img_1838.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbKCiMMMCVyYDRHf6Nazf4DhukAqwA4LJNqyuhkr22Ut/img_1877.jpg)


In the end, Yoyo's Photograph isn't about the gear; it's about being there, feeling the dust on the road, and using your lens to bridge the gap between landscape and memory.
See you on the trail!


🚲📷🚲📷🚲📷🚲📷🚲📷🚲📷🚲📷🚲


El secreto detrás del visor: Entre pedales y paisajes en Punta Brava
¿Sabes qué es lo mejor de salir en bicicleta con el teléfono en el bolsillo? No es solo el ejercicio. Es que la bici te obliga a detenerte donde un auto ni se entera que hay una foto. 

Hace unos días me perdí por El Campestre, rumbo a Punta Brava, y me traje unas tomas con mi iPhone 11 Pro Max que me dejaron pensando en lo que realmente significa la fotografía de paisajes.
Olvídate de las reglas aburridas de los manuales. Te voy a contar lo que me funciona a mí cuando estoy ahí afuera, tratando de que los lentes de mi iPhone capturen lo que mis ojos sienten.

- La geometría no es solo para matemáticos
A veces nos obsesionamos con el horizonte y nos olvidamos de las líneas que tenemos a los pies. En una de las fotos que saqué, las vías del tren cortan el paisaje de una forma casi agresiva, pero armoniosa. Ese es el truco: buscar estructuras que guíen la mirada. Ya sea un portal de hierro viejo o el camino de tierra, usa esas líneas para que quien vea tu foto sienta que está recorriendo el trayecto contigo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT25SaFVjYpEx4d2Gg93L1mo8286AwXeUK6R6iYdVBXRd/img_1863.jpg)

- Olvida la perfección, busca la textura
A veces una pared descascarada de un arco antiguo cuenta más que un atardecer de postal. Con el procesamiento del iPhone, me gusta resaltar la rugosidad de la piedra y el frío del metal. Si la foto se siente \

, para mí pierde el alma. El realismo, ese que se nota en el desgaste de las cosas, es lo que hace que una imagen sea honesta.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZWi7CWVj5ntBMrwzcapRnC9yMhiqCxxuq3mhcYmezDBk/img_1966.jpg)

- El factor humano (aunque no sonrían)
Hicimos un ejercicio interesante hace poco analizando rostros. En el campo, la gente no siempre está posando. Capturar esa dignidad seria, ese esfuerzo de quien carga agua o trabaja la tierra, le da un peso narrativo a tu serie de paisajes que ninguna montaña puede dar por sí sola. Es el contraste entre la inmensidad del cielo y la escala humana.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYo61enwqrSQ3KvDZEzDPPgCPbyn3yRi5t7veozCVSgpK/img_1839.jpg)

- Tu mejor herramienta es la que llevas encima
No necesitas un equipo pesado para hacer arte. El iPhone 11 Pro Max me permite ser rápido, discreto y capturar el rango dinámico de estas nubes en Punta Brava de una forma increíble. A veces el blanco y negro ayuda a desnudar la imagen y dejar solo lo esencial: formas, luces y sombras.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQBd4MX4CrMLnnHiPSzxS25UNVcLoZ5AxR2rPeAE45iu/img_1841.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRBbEL7QgucR89d8gJXhCMP9t8Fc9F98P8aWFQW8ADXd/img_1882.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYviypbgexBkGBENu7vkXPHzqZPRzCo6Yb1QxWo1VMZ1Z/img_1833.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWebUBojbRt3Du7hY5bNdVjbN2G9GaT15VmAEemorrGWw/img_1838.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbKCiMMMCVyYDRHf6Nazf4DhukAqwA4LJNqyuhkr22Ut/img_1877.jpg)


Un consejo de amigo...
Si vas a ir a El Campestre, prepárate para lo inesperado. El mejor paisaje no es el que planeas, sino el que te encuentras cuando decides frenar la bici porque algo en una puerta vieja o en un árbol solitario te \

que ahí había una historia.
Al final, Yoyo's Photograph no se trata del equipo que uses, sino de estar ahí, sentir el polvo del camino y entender que tu teléfono es solo el puente entre el paisaje y la memoria.
¡Nos vemos en el próximo sendero!


**Photography by: Yoyo's Photograph.
• Device: iPhone 11 Pro Max.
• Editing: IPhone Photos app.
• Location: El Campestre, Punta Brava.**

Hola a todos. Luego de haber trotado a ritmos muy rápidos los días sábado y domingo, hoy tocó ritmo suave. Les cuento cómo me fue.


Inicié tarde, aunque fue apenas a las 7:15, pero el sol ya estaba pegando fuerte. Esa fue otra razón por la que decidí salir a correr a un ritmo suave, tratando de trabajar principalmente en mi respiración. A ese ritmo debería poder manejar sin problema la respiración, y así fue, afortunadamente. 



Las calles estaban bastante transitadas por lo que debía estar muy atento tanto a los carros como a las personas. Lo bueno fue que no tuve ningún problema con relación a ese punto. 


Hoy estrené un pantalón corto verde, y esa es la razón por la que me tomé la foto de portada de una forma diferente, así se ve el short. Se portó bien hoy, sin problemas también por ese lado.


Me siento muy bien físicamente y por eso tuve que controlarme para no acelerar en ningún momento del entrenamiento. Leí ayer a una de las compañeras de #hiverun decir que correr en zona 2 requiere mucho autocontrol, y hoy confirmé la realidad de esas palabras. Lo bueno es que pude completar este entrenamiento, el número 18 de este mes. Hasta mañana, queridos amigos.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdsMVdSHnho1Uqw8Nu3UaGUv9CzAttesTt5cZrRGEx5sL/separadores_55.png  
 
English

Hi, everyone. After running at a very fast pace on Saturday and Sunday, today I decided to take it easy. Here’s how it went.


I started late—though it was only 7:15 a.m.—but the sun was already beating down hard. That was another reason I decided to go for a run at a gentle pace, focusing mainly on my breathing. At that pace, I should be able to manage my breathing without any trouble, and fortunately, that’s exactly how it went. 



The streets were pretty busy, so I had to be very careful of both cars and people. The good news is that I didn’t have any problems in that regard. 


Today I wore a pair of green shorts for the first time, and that’s why I took the cover photo a little differently—so you can see the shorts. They performed well today, with no issues there either.


I feel great physically, so I had to hold myself back from speeding up at any point during the workout. Yesterday I read one of my #hiverun teammates say that running in Zone 2 requires a lot of self-control, and today I confirmed the truth of those words. The good news is that I was able to complete this workout, the 18th one this month. See you tomorrow,
dear friends.

body.title: Headed to an Adventure? Nah! (HBD Papa!!!)
body.body: My father celebrated his birthday last week, and as usual, I accompanied him to the Divine Mercy shrine to light some candles and offer prayers. It's a family tradition. To make use of our time more efficiently, we're also dropping by the wholesaler store nearby to get some stuff for our store, and also for our house. My mom cooked some special dishes for him.

> Does it seem that we're headed to an adventure? *Hahaha* Actually, we bring backpacks when buying something from the wholesaler. The store is around 10-15 minutes away on foot if we take the shortcut, so bringing the stuff we bought by hand would be very difficult and heavy. However, if we place them inside our backpacks, it wouldn't be as heavy, and we won't be using any plastic anymore. It's like an ecobag, but a backpack version. *haha* We dropped by the wholesaler first and gave our list, then we headed to the shrine. We'd just go back to the wholesaler afterwards.

> It was almost 9 AM when we went there. The sun was up, and was quite strong... so I was running out of breath going up the hill. Normally, I wouldn't since we usually go there early when it's not hot. Anyway, we survived. XD

> My cousin Nicole and my aunt came over to bring his cake, and some lumpia in the afternoon. They went home soon because they had things to do... I celebrated Papa's birthday with Mama and our furbabies. It was simple, yet we enjoyed some delicious food, which I failed to take photos of. My mom made spaghetti and hamonada. The next day, my cousins and my aunts came over again. We celebrated my father's birthday together with Arashi's. Their birthdays are one day apart. We enjoyed a lot of good food, and we bonded over karaoke, too! I also went to the shrine with them, but that is for another post. Thanks for reading, and see you around! *EPPO investigation still underway

body.title: Kpop Group \
And Getting A Legendary Card From The Pack
body.body:
.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbru2sPph7AQcg6tHczvD4TRu7z6bxhMSnuLGcr89bDAs/1776693637255.jpg)

[Image Source](https://share.google/1pglVGiqVUy4t3rH2)


Last few days ago, I told about rain. After talking about him, I suddenly remembered another second generation kpop group, mblaq. The reason I remembering mblaq is because this group is one of the first group produced and mentored by rain and his entertainment agency, J.Tune Camp. 



Mblaq has five members, Seungho, G. O, Mir, Lee Joon and Thunder. They had trained by singer Rain in two years before debut. Their first debut stage was also from Rain seoul concert. 

They debuted in 2009 and achieved success with their first album \

. They released many albums throughout their career and achieved mid-tier success in second generation. Although MBLAQ has achieved some success, they didn't achieve longevity like some kpop groups. 


https://youtu.be/SenkemTrZMQ?si=JtaR5_WP896AG-7F

The members Lee June and Thunder left the group in 2014.Although the last three members tried to stay active as the group and released their last album in 2015.From that time, there is no new music album from their group and kpop industry considered them as retired group. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaXtgBBeGCyphUjtABaJ8h1wXzJtP2y7zBCnNw8nyoyAc/1776693694188.jpg)


[Image Source](https://www.risingstar.com)



Today, I bought two packs in rising star game. I don't know whether I am getting lucky (or) the game puts more good cards in the pack. Today, I am getting good cards than before. I even got one legendary card from the pack. This is the first time I got legendary card from the pack and I am happy to receive it. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQb9yewsZGPXxZnP2C5RYRF9BGqYvj1n7Afsub74y1F1/1776693711364.jpg)


[Image Source](https://www.risingstar.com)


From the first pack, I got two rare people cards and one common instrument card. They are 673 608 Love Mobile, R618 Conch Shell Horn and i311 Cajon Brushes. 673 608 Love Mobile gives 360 fans, 0 skill, 4 luck, 3 im.  R618 Conch Shell Horn gives 50 luck and i311 Cajon Brushes gives 1 luck. 


The second pack is my lucky pack and I got legendary card, L124 Super Yacht Sophia from it. From L124 Super Yacht Sophia, I got 7200 ans, 0 skill, 600 luck and 100 im. 

The other two cards I got from the second pack are R669 Lemon Import Kit and i291 Moot Horn. They are instrument cards, and I got 50 luck from R669 Lemon Import Kit and 1 luck from i291 Moot Horn.

body.title: ZZZ's fourth electric attacker: what makes Cissia stand out from her rivals? / Zenless Zone Zero (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776606291419-6ae2dcbe4d284d15.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=alexbit/cfaca790) ▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=alexbit/cfaca790) ---

ZZZ's fourth electric attacker: what makes Cissia stand out from her rivals? / Zenless Zone Zero (Eng/Esp)

> Hello my beautiful people from hive gaming, here AlexBit in a New post for the community! This time, we're focusing on Zenless Zone Zero, specifically the second part of version 2.7, along with a new character.

> In the ever-competitive world of Zenless Zone Zero, the arrival of a new character always generates a buzz. This time, the spotlight is on Cissia, an S-rank agent who promises to shake up the meta. With the Electric attribute and the Attacker specialty, Cissia becomes the fourth electric attacker in the game. However, unlike her predecessors, she doesn't seek to be the center of attention, but rather to enhance her team as a sub-DPS and an indispensable battery for Sporo.

>

Cissia's gameplay revolves around accumulating Poison charges. With her basic attack, Lick, she deals electrical damage and accumulates these charges, gaining 2 additional charges upon landing the fourth hit (3 if the enemy is stunned). Upon reaching maximum, Cissia consumes these charges to execute Serpent's Kiss, a powerful dive attack that not only deals significant area damage but also inflicts Bone Corrosion on the enemy.

<div class=\

> Cissia's true magic lies in her passive abilities. While possessing Poison, the entire team ignores a percentage of the enemy's defense when dealing electrical damage. This percentage scales directly with her Energy Recovery, potentially ignoring up to 25% of the enemy's defense. Furthermore, if the team includes a Stun character or one with the same attribute, Cissia grants an additional 30% Critical Damage to all members (50% to herself), making her an exceptional buffer.

> To maximize her potential as an offensive support, Cissia needs to build Energy Recovery. Her best set of Discs is Dawn's Bloom (4 pieces) along with Swinging Jazz (2 pieces). The former boosts her base damage, and the latter gives her the energy she needs to rotate her abilities. Main Stat Recommended Value Disc IV Critical Damage / Critical Chance Disc V Electric Damage / ATK Disc VI Energy Recovery Sub-stats Critical Chance > Critical Damage > ATK% Her signature weapon, Serpentine Seeker, is ideal, although the A Drill - Red Shaft engine is an excellent free option that synergizes well with her rotation.

Is it worth it?

 Cissia is an exceptional character when paired with Sporo, forming one of the most lethal electric duos in the game. Her ability to reduce enemy defense and increase the team's critical damage makes her unique. However, if you don't have Sporo or don't plan to get her, Cissia loses much of her spark. Personally, and staying true to my playstyle, I'm not going to go for her, as I'm saving my resources for the game's highly anticipated anniversary. But if you're a Sporo main or looking to maximize your Electric team's potential, Cissia is practically a must-have investment.

>
  • All content was taken from my Zenless Zone Zero playthrough.
  • Editing program: CapCut.
  • The GIF was made with

>

✨Español✨

Cuarta atacante eléctrica de ZZZ: ¿en qué destaca Cissia frente a sus rivales? / Zenless Zone Zero (Eng/Esp)

> Muy buenas mi gente bella de hive gaming, aquí AlexBit en una nueva publicación para la comunidad, en esta ocasión estamos solamente con el Zenless Zone Zero en la segunda parte de su versión 2.7 junto con un nuevo personaje.

> En el siempre competitivo mundo de Zenless Zone Zero, la llegada de un nuevo personaje siempre genera revuelo. Esta vez, la atención se centra en Cissia, una agente de rango S que promete sacudir la meta. Con atributo Eléctrico y especialidad Atacante, Cissia se convierte en la cuarta atacante eléctrica del juego. Sin embargo, a diferencia de sus predecesoras, ella no busca ser el centro de atención, sino potenciar a su equipo como una SUB-DPS y una batería indispensable para Sporo.

>

El gameplay de Cissia gira en torno a la acumulación de cargas de Veneno. Con su ataque básico, Lengüetazo, inflige daño eléctrico y acumula estas cargas, obteniendo 2 adicionales al conectar el cuarto golpe (3 si el enemigo está aturdido) . Al llegar al máximo, Cissia consume estas cargas para ejecutar Beso de Serpiente, un poderoso ataque de caída que no solo causa un gran daño en área, sino que también activa el estado de Corrosión Ósea en el enemigo.


<div class=\

> La verdadera magia de Cissia reside en sus habilidades pasivas. Mientras posee Veneno, el equipo entero ignora un porcentaje de la defensa del enemigo al hacer daño eléctrico. Este porcentaje escala directamente con su Recuperación de Energía, pudiendo llegar a ignorar hasta un 25% de la defensa enemiga . Además, si en el equipo hay un personaje Aturdidor o del mismo atributo, Cissia otorga un 30% de Daño Crítico extra a todos los miembros (50% para ella misma), convirtiéndola en una potenciadora excepcional

> Para maximizar su potencial como apoyo ofensivo, Cissia necesita construir Recuperación de Energía. Su mejor set de Discos es Florecimiento del Alba (4 piezas) junto con Jazz Oscilante (2 piezas). El primero potencia su daño básico y el segundo le da la energía que necesita para rotar sus habilidades . Estadística Principal Valor recomendado Disco IV Daño Crítico / Prob. Crítica Disco V Daño Eléctrico / ATK Disco VI Recuperación de Energía Sub-estadísticas Prob. Crítica > Daño Crítico > ATK% Su arma característica, Buscadora Serpentina, es ideal, aunque el motor A Taladro - Eje Rojo es una excelente opción gratuita que sinergiza bien con su rotación .

¿Vale la pena?

 Cissia es un personaje excepcional si se combina con Sporo, formando una de las parejas eléctricas más letales del juego. Su capacidad para reducir la defensa enemiga y aumentar el daño crítico del equipo la hacen única . Sin embargo, si no se tiene a Sporo o no se planea conseguirla, Cissia pierde gran parte de su chispa. En lo personal, y siendo fiel a mi estilo de juego, no voy a tirar por ella, ya que estoy ahorrando mis recursos para el esperado aniversario del juego. Pero si eres main Sporo o buscas potenciar tu equipo eléctrico al máximo, Cissia es una inversión casi obligatoria.

>

body.title: The Weight of Both Bullying When Measured
body.body:
Some days ago, a friend of mine and I were having a conversation that has to do with the environment we grew up in as a child, what those environments contributed to our childhood experiences and how or what it could have shaped us to be if our parents had not relocated to a better place.

![1000639245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23t7DhvGUm66fQJxFrs3Z9KMjR9wiwd7L1Cd4pAgYtPgBZo5F7we4H2k96xEYu1WYBUyR.jpg)

We had a lengthy conversation on this as it led to a discussion on this prompt of bullying and he shared with me how his environment was filled with cases of bullying left, right and center. Someone of your age could bully you and someone older or younger than you can actually bully you if you're not smart enough to have the first courage in putting up a fight when the bully is initiated. 

I explained these so that we can all get to see that these things doesn't just seem to appear in the society all of a sudden but because they have been nursed right from a tender level to a matured sized bully.
It was condoned from the local communities so there is absolutely no way it won't be globally initiated and sometimes I wonder why this whole bullying comes to place.
Is it to show seniority, hatred towards the person or power intoxication?

I remember back then in secondary school, when I was still in junior school and there was this group of 3 girls from the senior school sitting and gisting. They called me with the thought that they wanted to send me on errand to get something for them since it's break time and truly that was it but the only difference was that I was not given money to get the things they sent me but I was threatened to buy them and until I told them that my break time allowance was only 10naira before they reduced what they had sent me that day to the amount I had with me.

Physical bullying goes a long way in victims lives as they get hunted by these memories or even get shaped with these incidents if it was a chronic bullying that was not curbedmmm on time.
However, no matter how serious or bad physical bullying is, it is of no difference with online bullying.
Have you ever seen someone been bullied online? Especially when it is someone who doesn't have this fighting spirit, you end up seeing them cry and getting shattered.

![1000608200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AJpeztEQhsudhR8CYqKYDt2WnSpvuDJ7fw88toxv2cfMxShS4CeTz465r4wX4jJ.jpg)

All these trolls here and there, who would devise every means possible just to ensure the victim doesn't have peace unless they quit that account and go faceless on social media..... It's just so alarming that these things have become so rampant that even when this bullying act is noticed, we have minimal rate of people to attack it.

Just that the only difference I see between physical bullying and online bullying is that, as a victim of online bullying, you can easily look away from such person or account or probably block them off if you really think you don't wanna get moved by their dramatic displays but how do you wanna avoid physical bullying except if you leave the space or community for such person or people especially when it has eaten deep in such person that it's now hard to fight back or seek for help.

In all, none is greater or lesser than the other in weight of crimes as their victims are always traumatized by their acts so both physical and online bullying should receive SAME JUDGEMENT AND TREATMENT. Culprits should be served same meal of punishment when apprehended.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Hive Learners community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗 

All images are generated using Meta AI

body.title: [ENG/ESP] Eight years since you left us: Sad and grateful
body.body:
A necessary introduction

Eight years ago, life dealt me one of the most terrible blows it could ever deliver, when it took my mother from this earthly plane.

Beyond the pain that always stays with me, life has rewarded me with her personal example, and her legacy has been something that has helped me face life's hardest hits.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGiBVsZcnwG3ies1i9TN5qs9J38PtWJDtxXeUobdEx1k/1776693765755.jpg)


Today, I leave this reflection in honor of her memory.

Your departure

There are absences that cannot be explained: they are felt. They do not live in memory, but in that secret place where the soul keeps what truly matters. Today, eight years after my mother Estela's departure, her presence remains a light that never goes out, a gesture that accompanies, a voice that still guides.

My mother was a woman made of human qualities that cannot be improvised: the joy that lifted the spirit of our home, the responsibility that supported everyone without asking anything in return, the tenderness that knew when to speak and when to simply be there. In her six children, she found her greatest treasure—not because there were many of us, but because each one of us was, for her, a story to nurture, a future to protect, a love to multiply.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVE7SMKP1LzMavZ4FdGjeN9UcaZ8F9BKURGSP7cgbY6sa/1776693821062.jpg)




Her life was an act of silent devotion, the kind that seeks no applause but leaves deep marks. Those who knew her know that her laughter had a unique way of putting the world in order, that her gaze could read exhaustion and hope, that her embrace was a place where everything made sense again. And even as time moves forward, some presences do not fade—they become roots.

Eight years later, what remains is not the sadness of her departure, but gratitude for her having passed this way. Because my mother did not leave: she transformed into the strength that accompanies me, the serenity that sustains me, the voice that reminds me that life, even in its trials, is worth living. She lives in every gesture of her children, in every act of kindness we inherited from her, in every decision made with love.

To remember her today is an act of justice and tenderness. It is to tell the world that there was an extraordinary woman, who gave more than she received, who loved without reserve, and who left in her family a legacy that cannot be erased: to live with joy, responsibility, and an open heart.

To conclude, dear mother, I leave you with two décimas—something you always enjoyed me dedicating to you on every anniversary or celebration we shared.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSNm9kF9DFETtwLZe4GFRno4MPjbM69rsbvMeN7MkJxQ/1776693844358.jpg)


Décimas for my mother



Eight years have passed, and here you are,
mother of radiant laughter,
your footprint lives on in the life
you left within your six children.
Your devotion never leaves,
your love remains a lesson,
your voice still brings us comfort
when the day becomes a wound.
You are shared strength,
you are a light that always flies.



You were joy and duty,
you were an embrace that sustains,
you were the soul that keeps
the home steady in its being.
Today we see you again
in every gesture that dwells within,
in the kindness that guides us,
in the tenderness that protects.
Mother Estela, never too costly
is the memory that gives life.



Note: I used DeepL Translate.
The image is my own.




Una introducción necesaria 

Hace ocho años la vida me asestó uno de los golpes más terribles que me pueden suceder al llevarse a mi madre de este plano terrenal. 

Más allá del dolor que siempre me acompaña la vida me ha premiado con su ejemplo personal y su legado ha sido algo que me ha servido para afrontar los golpes de la vida.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGiBVsZcnwG3ies1i9TN5qs9J38PtWJDtxXeUobdEx1k/1776693765755.jpg)


Hoy, dejo esta reflexión en honor a su memoria.

Tu partida

Hay ausencias que no se explican: se sienten. No viven en la memoria, sino en ese espacio secreto donde el alma guarda lo que verdaderamente importa. Hoy, ocho años después de la partida de mi mamá Estela, su presencia sigue siendo una luz que no se apaga, un gesto que acompaña, una voz que todavía orienta.

Mi madre fue una mujer hecha de cualidades humanas que no se improvisan: la alegría que levantaba el ánimo de la casa, la responsabilidad que sostenía a todos sin pedir nada a cambio, la ternura que sabía cuándo hablar y cuándo simplemente estar. En sus seis hijos encontró su mayor tesoro, no porque fueran muchos, sino porque cada uno era para ella una historia que cuidar, un futuro que proteger, un amor que multiplicar.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVE7SMKP1LzMavZ4FdGjeN9UcaZ8F9BKURGSP7cgbY6sa/1776693821062.jpg)

Su vida fue un acto de entrega silenciosa, de esas que no buscan aplausos, pero dejan huellas profundas. Quien la conoció sabe que su risa tenía un modo particular de ordenar el mundo, que su mirada sabía leer cansancios y esperanzas, que su abrazo era un lugar donde todo volvía a tener sentido. Y aunque el tiempo avance, hay presencias que no se diluyen: se vuelven raíz.

Ocho años después, lo que queda no es la tristeza de su partida, sino la gratitud por su paso. Porque mi mamá no se fue: se transformó en la fuerza que me acompaña, en la serenidad que me sostiene, en la voz que me recuerda que la vida, incluso en sus pruebas, vale la pena. Vive en cada gesto de sus hijos, en cada acto de bondad que heredamos de ella, en cada decisión tomada con amor.





Recordarla hoy es un acto de justicia y de ternura. Es decirle al mundo que existió una mujer extraordinaria, que dio más de lo que recibió, que amó sin reservas y que dejó en su familia un legado que no se borra: el de vivir con alegría, responsabilidad y corazón abierto.


Para concluir aquí te dejo, madre mía, dos décimas, algo que disfrutabas que te dedicara en cada aniversario o fiesta que tuviéramos 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSNm9kF9DFETtwLZe4GFRno4MPjbM69rsbvMeN7MkJxQ/1776693844358.jpg)


Décimas para mí madre


Ocho años y aquí estás,  
madre de risa encendida,  
tu huella sigue en la vida  
que en tus seis hijos dejás.  
Tu entrega nunca se va,  
tu amor sigue siendo escuela,  
tu voz aún nos consuela  
cuando el día se hace herida.  
Eres fuerza compartida,  
eres luz que siempre vuela.


Fuiste alegría y deber,  
fuiste abrazo que sostiene,  
fuiste el alma que mantiene  
la casa firme en su ser.  
Hoy te volvemos a ver  
en cada gesto que anida,  
en la bondad que nos guía,  
en la ternura que ampara.  
Madre Estela, nunca es cara  
la memoria que da vida.


Nota: Utilicé traductor el DeepL Translate.
La imagen es de mi propiedad.

body.title: Same spot
body.body:
![IMG_8278.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/243ftwB8w8hekkwYP6qwcL6Dke9MoFx5zUQDmG4AtsJWeDAKoDkzqoqDBgzjg6vJ8dTvR.jpg)

-------

I looked at the Palamidi fortress from my window and without thinking too much about it, I decided to go. It had been a while since my last visit. In my previous post, more than a month ago, I started climbing the stairs leading to it but I stopped halfway.Today, though, it felt like it was calling me, or at least that’s what I told myself at the time.


![IMG_8284.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23zS7koayXWkj7cay3hMeYNcaRnsKWC28rwED7ihfhXCTGjQXV677Sd7aTijLpB7kViWL.jpg)

------

<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23vhyirq5FH3SFoqemAFAHsi1KahL4EYfVG1PwZMNNpSk6jpDgi1Mptsndq8Q3ZpMu9ed.jpg</center>

----

![IMG_8293.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23ynWTYRfnoxpNzXLEYFZozwX2vsSp6AHh5TPx7DJp8iwwnzkFNstJ8SNFM6aES8MrGmT.jpg)

--------


Of course, an old Venetian castle has no reason to call anyone. It just sits there, as it always has. Anyway, I went. I don't really need a particular reason to visit it other than feeling like it. It's only five minutes away after all. I have been there many times and I knew what to expect. And yet, every time feels slightly different. If not for any other reason, just because I am a bit different myself.


![IMG_8303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/242NmBCZGxaDPDyWK7cahwrDZBetNx6B8WXj3JMUPXFmztdVgEWuRTAqgCdSfH22Aq35M.jpg)

![IMG_8304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23u65ByFcE5nLjoBYH7ahSAzCCLvy5pDaRZgW1DaoTkr3xkcC1iVLq1yKWV5rVyFYcKte.jpg)

-----

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23wWrtgi6RqxLr79M9jEBt5m5ALV7LZTz1emMpq3Uf3Z2G5Pqkvv8LvvxToUNmSJwgRVa.jpg --------
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23tH9wfzRbj7vqPwURUPNw4e5Z3bGdVH6FLrxAVqzZzLSeea9QJL12kb2mNTZZQMvHsTv.jpg
------- It was the last day of March. Spring was already all around in the Mediterranean air and the weather was perfect for a walk. Not too hot, not too cold, not too windy. Just enough to make walking feel easy and unforced. From up there, everything looks peaceful and quiet. The fortress out in the sea looked so small and delicate next to the cruise ship that was slowly unloading visitors a few hundred meters away. A different mindset, a different scale. And at the same time, on an even smaller scale, the weeds growing through the stones, doing what they do best, completely indifferent to any human affairs.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23zkpEymYtcWkLT6YZsgnTtdgP6GCJy2osSiANCA3BVwTpsADC85EXk2xjr1DLqjPQNaC.jpg
![IMG_8327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/243BiCgHffS1hUMjK4SQohUhnoPKsEE1ScBR33aBByYzL2YUiLLULpXnSaLgrSw1Znq87.jpg) ![IMG_8331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/242DETh9u3aZ3pTqNoUm3Kyqh7FCvG1LXmRVsrKobpfoiRX9FrctzGBy7trRfiAjkYnFr.jpg) ![IMG_8334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/242hYf3Q6xzuhkXWsM28ogAtysBLbNzpyPbvW75K9PsttbY9HrQeTNWmNorSUu3CorKtv.jpg) ![IMG_8348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23x19TT2adV8VGABKXxVXGwbDbZqXibyBCY3WwwLsBaFrfHBfSYWmstXhR8bmJZBH7kVY.jpg) ![IMG_8353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23uFYMWwewzLrY4aR8FkmccixQFE75HFLTVEc2pEcvRVETkBq5oejebncWUNE2MWLTdhv.jpg) ------- I’ve always liked it up there. I find it very relaxing to be among strong stone walls, gazing at the sea. And without many visitors in the castle, it is even more relaxing. At some point, I found myself thinking about the times when people stood in the same place for very different reasons. Not for pleasure but for protection. Not to wander, but to prepare. I tried to imagine what they were seeing from up there when enemy ships were approaching to conquer and loot. ![IMG_8358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23vsSgM6d7Ss29g4fxoF4o5HXh9fGXR6sqVbG5fyYQmPcJsyDRdq9QYu4gxBXNFVATh7Q.jpg) ![IMG_8361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23vsL1kQAewCqgfeVpYWFnAqeJa4W3BSibFW3Cog6LNLeC9oYphuRUuq3q5wFWnas2RAa.jpg) --------

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23x17PzrMaDr9dzp79iWr4vh89M1BaxtwvfvRAvpt5gm19V1afkLXSUHpZQH53tKKwW7w.jpg ------- ![IMG_8371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23zRyL2vuxZXM5gnLKqHy33QQ4Pwnd91xAgh8e24365gAAcuNGhZVB1qZQgDRmowucPYY.jpg) -------- Certainly not the kind of beauty we notice now. Not the colors, not the light, not the view as something scenic and enjoyable. It must have been a totally different experience even though they were standing on the exact same spot as myself. But time passes, things change, even the war itself is different now and still, the place remains. Holding all of that, whether we think about it or not.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23vi1zwnP26ofJKeuVCBUVJ2EqLoF1dbDoQaXw25yS4pQ786q9WSzFvdEzE1MjX7FCJXn.jpg
--------------
The camera that I used is a Canon EOS 6D mark II. I edited the photographs in Adobe Photoshop Lightroom Classic. --------------- **All the pictures and the words are mine.** *Thank you for reading and if you want to know more about me you can check out my [introduction post.](https://peakd.com/hive-174578/@fotostef/my-introduction-to-the-hive-community)* **Commenting, upvoting and rebloging are highly appreciated!**
