body.title: A Look at the Number One DEX Uniswap | Data on TVL, Volume, Users, Top Pairs and More | Apr 2026
body.body:
A Look at the Number One DEX Uniswap | Data on TVL, Volume, Users, Top Pairs and More | Apr 2026

From all the defi apps we have seen in the crypto market, Uniswap has kept its dominance and continued to develop and grow. It was the first defi app to bring in users thanks to its simplicity and incentives. Following the FTX collapse and the multiple other collapses centralized entities in 2022, its importance grew even more. In the last period Uniswap seems to be growing and spreading on other ETH L2 chains like Arbitrum, Base etc. It also facing a strong competition from other projects on Solana.

Let’s take a look how is the protocol performing under the current market conditions. 

 




![01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23vsBZe8G6fFR8TZMm7D4ZKwQu23FeymsQJaajeEt7EMKeNVmCEMU1PoC9NxPvQzYof1D.png)






Here we will be looking at:
-	Total value locked
-	Trading volume
-	Top exchanges
-	Number of users
-	Top Pairs
-	Price

**The period that we will be looking at is 2020 - 2026.**


## Total Value Locked
Here is the chart for the TVL on Uniswap starting from September 2020 according to DeFiLama.

 







![image001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tRv7N1VCyzZA3xspHR2jsjb1JWkpo7Sffov3zvKVHgZWi1bU8DaMvDBsDzBX1zR1ajX.png)








Uniswap launched its token back in September 2020, and the liquidity grew fast then. A record high of 10B was reached in April 2021, and again in November 2021. Since then, it has been a downtrend and dropped to 3.5B at the end of 2023. 
In 2024 the TVL grew at first reaching 6B in April, and since then it has been sideways in the range of 4B to 6B, up to recently when it dropped to around **3B** where we are now. 

## Trading Volume

Trading volume is extremely important. That is where the fees come from and the APR for liquidity providers. No trading volume means no fees and no capital in the protocol. 
The chart for the trading volume looks like this.


 




![image003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uEyz1tc7L8Emhea1DGryyZP8LK4kBvAYLGzK15YaB2NA7LA2xTPctNtc1dVv8b77gJD.png)






This is a chart for the daily trading volume. It’s quite volatile. 

The daily trading volume has been more constant in the last year, similar to the TVL, with occasional spikes whenever there is some volatility in the market. At times there was more than 5B in daily volume, all legit and recorded on chain with fees paid. 

We can notice the drop in the last months with the training volume hovering around 2B. Still it’s a big number. 

Note that the data for the volume above is a summary of all the different chains where Uniswap operates. Uniswap is now multichain with BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Unichain etc. integrated. 

### The monthly trading volume looks like this:


 




![image005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tvVgyEeAAMKcuiL6ukxxStu1ynErWdwFHtS42pWB4Fu26gMa6hFmo6yMVixTB3j685e.png)







A clearer picture here than the daily volume. 
An increase in the trading volume in 2021, a drop in 2022, and a growth since then up to recently in October 2025 when it reached more than 100B in trading volume in one month. 
A drop since then and in the last few months the trading volume is around **60B** per month. 

When we break down the trading volume per chain we get this:

 






![image007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tRvSesZrci4mV8QGmdX4rdJg9dRPCi8JvLdEsq2MYL8gwcLAWJ3UwR4WgdYREqzm7HC.png)







We can notice the fragmentation since 2024. More and more chains came online ad they sort of took over a share from Ethereum. In the last period, chains with high volume except Ethereum have been BSC, Arbitrum and Base. 



## DEX VS CEX Volume
If we take a look at the data for the trading volume on the other exchanges provided by some of the aggregators like Coingecko the numbers looks like this. 


 



![image009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/Eo6CgyVcygjpxd5dZVQE2sLs6j6U37o7EKu6XHKJELix7FK1oPHHxwttgUgqCEQWewS.png)








Uniswap ranks in the top 10, or on the fourth spot now, that is quite good ranking. At times it has been even on the second spot just after Binance. 


## Monthly Active Users
How many users does Uniswap have? Here is the chart.



 



![image011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tRv7NLrboHXSZtE4Ryjcw2KGXwXz2weDWkaF15hBNtJbEQxHLHQdXbAG5TDvPW11To2.png)








This is a chart on a monthly basis.
We can see a massive growth in 2024 monthly due to the expansion on other chains. The record high numbers of MAUs was reached in June 2025 with 22M users. Quite the number. Since then a sharp drop in the MAUs to around **3M** in the last months. 



## Top Trading Pairs on Uniswap

Here is the chart for the top trading pairs **ranked by liquidity.**

 





![image013.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uFGsSyZaRG122dhh1TUnmWGPa9LhUnNhn18VbUBppChFSbSYHCTMrRri1BmgqpbtkrS.png)








The WISE/ETH pool is on the top spot with 130M on the V2 on Ethereum. 

The ETH-USDC pair is on the second spot with close to 130M. In the past the stablecoin to stablecoin pairs were on the top in liquidity like USDC-USDT but obviously these have now moved elsewhere.  WBTC in the top as well with two pairs against USDT and ETH. Note that the liquidity of the pairs is combined from different chain and pools. 


## Price
The chart for the UNI price looks like this.



 




![image015.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23t79QDAQtSVTYLFuK35Cx75oCiHVZeKFc4DuhdVLvCxKGsLmCTPXk2F9F3hmBAva8KKN.png)







The UNI token has been on a wild ride, reaching $40 at some point in 2021. Since then, it has dropped and has been hovering around the $5 mark for a long time. 
In the last few months it has even dropped lower than that and it is now around 


first half of 2024 it has increased again to 15 USD at one point and dropped to back to 5$. In the last months it has increased again and now it is close to **10 USD**.




All the best
@dalz

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uQfVZinc9ctDkGyjgKCjb8JCvtCKeto4Y7xcg6CsdFar1d6UJkEWjXPNyCbUyXc1jXD.jpg)


[Fuente.](https://www.espn.co.uk/football/report/_/gameId/401862890)

<div class=\
>El fútbol a veces puede ser muy poético y es que nos puede dar sin querer partidos con un gran significado dependiendo de la realidad de los clubes en cuestión (Semifinal de la Champions League). \

es un dicho que se puede emplear muy bien en el presente de par de clubes de los cuales ya he hablado bastante por acá pero que por eso no deja de ser fascinante su historia, sobretodo la de su entrenadores. Siempre se ha dicho que tanto Simeone como Arteta no son técnicos ganadores y la verdad es que el argentino ha ganado 8 titulos con el Atlético y el español 3 con el Arsenal por lo que la queja no viene por ahí; es porque a veces están tan cerca de la gloria que es incomprensible que no la alcancen.

> Football can sometimes be quite poetic, unintentionally delivering matches with profound significance depending on the circumstances of the clubs involved (Champions League Semifinal). \

is a saying that perfectly describes the current situation of a couple of clubs I've discussed at length here, but their stories, especially those of their managers, remain fascinating. It's often said that neither Simeone nor Arteta are winning coaches, but the truth is, the Argentinian has won eight titles with Atlético Madrid and the Spaniard three with Arsenal, so the criticism isn't based on that; it's because they sometimes come so close to glory that it's incomprehensible they don't quite reach it.

>Comencemos con el Atlético de Madrid quienes este sábado jugaron la final de la Copa del Rey contra la Real Sociedad después de haber dejado por fuera al Barcelona en una eliminatoria que será recordada. Los del Cholo tenían la oportunidad de volver a ganar dicha competencia después de 13 años cuando en el 2013 la consiguieron precisamente con un Simeone recién llegado prácticamente. Pero la realidad ha sido dura con los colchoneros y es que otra vez se quedaron a un paso del título al no poder lograr la máxima efectividad en la tanda de penaltis. Hay que decir que el partido fue muy bueno y muy parejo, ambos tiempos se los dividieron cada uno en intensidad y juego y contra toda narrativa a los rojiblancos les tocó remontar en par de ocasiones.

> Let's start with Atlético de Madrid, who played Real Sociedad in the Copa del Rey final this Saturday after knocking out Barcelona in a tie that will be remembered for years to come. Simeone's men had the opportunity to win the competition again after 13 years, having last won it in 2013 with Simeone practically a newcomer. But reality has been harsh for the Colchoneros, as they once again fell just short of the title, failing to convert their penalties. It must be said that the match was excellent and very evenly contested, with each team displaying a high level of intensity and skill, and against all odds, Atlético had to come from behind on a couple of occasions. ![2.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tvCazrAcjt3dpaWGUozgkjCwTYtvqJoPJTkf82ZMXyZRP7MPBG32psBAuu2G4hL4XA8.webp) [Fuente. ](https://www.intothecalderon.com/atletico-madrid-player-ratings/20293/real-sociedad-atletico-madrid-la-liga-player-ratings-sorloth-alvarez-griezmann-simeone-conor-gallagher)

>Comenzar perdiendo a los 15 segundos es un golpe moral importante pero con un Lookman entonado y Julian Alvarez haciendo grandes goles lograron meterse en la prórroga y eventualmente en los penales. ¿Pero por qué el Atlético siempre pierde a pesar de ser un equipo con garra? - en esta oportunidad fue porque no supieron definir y porque para mi Sørloth no debió ser el primer pateador pero al final son misterios del futbol. La cosa es que de nuevo se van en blanco pero aún hay una luz al final del túnel y es que la semana que viene se enfrentan al otro club protagonista de esta reseña, otro que también tiene fama de ser igual o hasta más \

con eso de ganar títulos. Y si, hablamos del Arsenal que últimamente vienen un poco en desgracia por la baja súbita del rendimiento que mostraron en los primeros 6 meses de la temporada.

> Conceding a goal after just 15 seconds is a significant blow, but with a sharp Lookman and Julian Alvarez scoring some great goals, they managed to force extra time and eventually penalties. But why does Atlético always lose despite being such a tenacious team? This time it was because they lacked finishing ability, and in my opinion, Sørloth shouldn't have been the first penalty taker, but ultimately, these are the mysteries of football. The fact is, they've come away empty-handed again, but there's still a glimmer of hope: next week they face the other club featured in this review, another team with a reputation for being just as, or even more, unlucky when it comes to winning titles. And yes, we're talking about Arsenal, who have recently been on a downward spiral due to the sudden drop in performance they showed in the first six months of the season.

>Esta caída de los Gunners viene un poco desde que perdieron la final de la Carabao contra el City, desde ese momento han ganado solo 1 partido de los últimos 6, algo inimaginable el año pasado o a principios de este 2026. El tema principal es que ayer, en casa del City de Guardiola, se enfrentaron nuevamente por liga, en un partido de suma importancia de cara a la definición de la Premier. El Arsenal sigue líder pero después de la derrota de ayer quedaron a 3 puntos del Manchester y estos con 1 juego menos. Es decir, si los ciudadanos ganan ese partido empatarían el liderato y solo habría que ver la diferencia de goles que al día de hoy el Arsenal la supera con +1. En el camino creo que alguno va a perder o dejar algun punto por allí pero la realidad es que ganar la Premier ahora depende expresamente de cada uno.

> This slump for the Gunners began somewhat after their Carabao Cup final loss to City. Since then, they've won only one of their last six matches, something unimaginable last year or at the beginning of 2026. The main issue is that yesterday, at Guardiola's City's home ground, they faced each other again in the league, in a crucial match for the Premier League title race. Arsenal remains top, but after yesterday's defeat, they are now three points behind Manchester City, who have a game in hand. This means that if City wins that match, they would draw level on the top spot, and the only tiebreaker would be goal difference, which Arsenal currently holds with a +1 advantage. Along the way, I think one of them will lose or drop points, but the reality is that winning the Premier League now depends entirely on each team. ![3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/EogNMdk5RbKDY6HyUwmWJGfamXTYywfuoN3pJGPUYPKBRv2kY4wjgzjetbunfwFWMw5.webp) [Fuente. ](https://www.outlookindia.com/sports/football/manchester-city-vs-arsenal-english-premier-league-2025-26-gunners-hit-woodwork-twice-near-misses)
>Creo que si el Arsenal quería terminar un poco más tranquilo la temporada debió haber ganado ayer pero otra vez perdieron cuando más necesitaban ganar, otra vez esa fama de equipo \

se hizo presente y dejaron 3 puntos vitales de cara al campeonato. El City fue mejor que el Arsenal ayer, eso hay que recalcarlo porque en ningún momento vi a los dirigidos por Arteta querer buscar con ansías el partido, quizás en los minutos finales pero solo por la urgencia de estar en los últimos minutos. ¿El drama? - el drama lo viviremos exactamente el 29 de este mes cuando estos dos clubes se vean las caras para ver quien puede ser el equipo menos \

de europa. Los rojiblancos buscarán resarcirse de tantos fracasos en Champions y los ingleses querrán llegar a apenas su segunda final en su historia.

> I think if Arsenal wanted to finish the season a bit more comfortably, they should have won yesterday, but once again they lost when they needed it most. Once again, their reputation as a \

team was on full display, and they dropped three vital points in the championship race. City were better than Arsenal yesterday; that needs to be emphasized because at no point did I see Arteta's men desperately trying to win the game, perhaps in the final minutes, but only out of sheer urgency. The drama? We'll witness the real drama on the 29th of this month when these two clubs face off to see who can be the least \

team in Europe. The Reds will be looking to make amends for so many Champions League failures, and the English side will be aiming for only their second final in history.

***<center>Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado.
¡Un abrazo a todos, nos leemos en la próxima!</center>***

> Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it.
¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.title: Cooking Blog: GInisang Malunggay Pods For Our Lunch
body.body:
![Copy of Copy of Copy of Copy of Copy of I Decided to Invest Working Chair (No More Back Pains) (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCj1u9CXDvYBix1YkSbdukuoEqswer18DSjmPCWSxapoJw1Hd29secuzsvqbniLLwb.gif) ----
Hello, how are you? Whenever we ran out of food, we eat our Malunggay Tree always provided us with delicious malunggay pods, which we are so thankful for, because in a week now my father is going to harvest its pods again. Sometimes peeling the skin off is time-consuming at the same time, so my father always peels it for me LOL. So I am going to cook Ginisang Malunggay Pods for our lunch today. ----
Ingredients I Used:

>
  • 1 tbsp. Cooking Oil
  • Meat
  • 4 Cloves Garlic
  • Red Onion
  • Thumb Ginger
  • 4 Tomatoes
  • 2 tbsp. Bagoong Paste

>
  • 3 cups Water
  • 1 Chicken Cube
  • Winged Beans
  • Kamote
  • Lima Beans
  • 1 kg Malunggay Pods
  • Left over Longganisa
-----
Let's Cook!

> ![IMG_1663.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2fpwYjcKroZT55G4aZA5bYRGup2HR9Q56Pi5B9aq19F1Se6zodNrcJQiUBAAmAYB.JPG) In a hot pan, I added a tablespoon of cooking oil, and then I am going to add the meat I am going to use. -----
> ![IMG_1665.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonmYnFUtdWFM2Nv3VGtJzs1cwdwbBNg3AFxHQmEhXtuPQD3sKKyBa8WwuVFxaVLj6J.JPG) Cook it until it turns brown and crispy. -----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoptvrkmQiKPchSqq2cQw8UsnxrGXhb1uEtHmyr6NC9QcGj9G8JLyVcf9vsPnR1KRHb.JPG) And then I am going to add the garlic, red onion, and ginger, sautee them until the fragrance of the aromatics comes out. -----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowHWiv64gdzrc26FntJA4p78WeEvA8SmeCtuveM7dfzCBdWZR8UxYHDVn2B1svXCsL.JPG) When the aromatics are sauteed, I am going to add the tomatoes. ----

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3fkVy4P11JHKZ942Ad6cyGcjA8A47P2sueKTXnheG8uowiy3TXF7cjK4sX8ARrzp7.JPG) Mix everything until the texture of the tomatoes turns into a mush. -----

> ![14.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5oDWmvkbRmFbiD98LRzKJFAxQ19YdqvBVFKMCuczmF3WnU35cP8ZxtM5k1vB6Ysy2.JPG) I add two tablespoons of Bagoong Paste and let that seep into the tomatoes. If you don't have bagoong, you can use fish sauce. ----
> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpCBNGu1CVwe3Tuh7FV6bqRngRjrP6Fs12qcbowTxC2ZoR3z4MrdAzhBqBnj6SY8Eja.JPG) Then I added about 3 cups of water. -----

> ![18.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopuuSd8J9Y1nj4NKmgu6FgnjG4Kgo23V1DWzqAfDH8B2s1JVdXGa3igExGFbEVPg4y.JPG) Then I added a cube of chicken broth for extra flavor. ------

> ![20.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5nhayzxAA88RddyDHVz951FPvUAWENiGb51vpRrFW5HqvYj3Zcn8meiYqCVzwSeRe.JPG) When the broth starts boiling, I add Himbabao, Lima beans, and the beans of Lima. -----

> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoke6rLj9p3bdbccLgSQQg2YBAL2kvacF6s6FE1Chz57b3EF9hUi2YfnH7ittQP9ZZv.JPG) Because I cook a lot, I mix everything every 5 minutes while it's cooking, so that all the malunggay pods will be cooked evenly. I mixed everything about 4- 5 times. You know when the malunggay pods are cooked when they change color from green to yellowish green. Then I forgot to film myself adding the leftover longganisa to the pan. -----

> ![30.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEsVEhLPxFLRp4HdDBofwWyTW58n3U49rDHL2DjMJQmKEaRQbAGpZKH61FGkr8gfja.JPG) Serve hot and plated! Here's a close-up look at the food. ----- ![28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokfZFed4Zbyh36kakLzj7jmq7VC3VumfgyQtC4cMzHaTpTv9tCPThnzAsfTNWhpPuS.JPG) ![29.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonnMdPcKC6V6HUx5gvrcTgDbL31pQbvkRoAgMx7hPLisvcJRXD4TGJxd5NPAtHgoM1.JPG) Happy eating! :D ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
----

body.title: Yordan bien, Houston mal
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUTMnwVCLjD2MrDqrVgQkLhNwTzGEzR8J5DhuUJZ2JWAa/20260420_094201.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/MLB/status/2045963272319365264?s=19)</sub></center>

---
Los Astros de Houston están on fire. Esa sería una excelente frase para describir su trayectoria de los últimos años. Pero en el inicio de esta campaña las cosas no han ido como me imagino habían planeado, a pesar de tener a una de sus estrellas en su punto caramelo.

Ayer volvieron a perder, esta vez frente a los siempre competitivos Cardenales de San Luis. Perdían 4-1 en la octava baja, cuando un jonrón solitario de “Air” Yordan encendió la chispa en esa entrada. Luego sus compañeros se combinarían para lograr anotar 2 más y empatar el juego. Sin embargo en el noveno no pasó nada y en el décimo, pues, los Cardenales hicieron daño en serio para anotar 3, que resultaron suficientes y alargar la recuperación de los Siderales.

Con el batazo, Yordan Álvarez llegó a su décimo jonrón, con lo cual es líder solitario en este departamento, por encima de otros monstruos como Aaron Judge. También encabeza la lista de impulsores en toda la Gran Carpa. Por tanto, no concibo como los Astros no han aprovechado este momento del tunero, pero como bien se dice por ahí, este es un deporte de todos, no de uno solo.

Otros cubanos vieron acción en Las Mayores, pero en sentido general fue un domingo gris para mis paisanos. Del letargo solo se salvó Miguel Vargas, quien desde el segundo bate de las Medias Blancas de Chicago, bateó de 3-2 con 2 anotadas, 2 impulsadas y jonrón incluido. Su compañero de equipo Edgar Quero también hizo su contribución, al impulsar la primera del partido con fly de sacrificio.

Ambos contribuyeron a la victoria de los White Sox, alcanzando la octava de la campaña, y la que permitió salir un rato de la última posición de su división. Hoy lunes continúa la campaña, esperemos ver nuevas hazañas.

body.title: From 15% HBD APR to 12% and Buying GIFU
body.body:
Even though i am not that active these months i always check the price of HIVE, GIFU and based on my time, some news around Hive. Honestly speaking, besides GIFU i only have a constant frustration. First of all as the title indicates, the witnesses decided to decrease the APR to 12%. As a matter of fact, most of them are voting for 10% but thanks to some who set it as 15-14-12, the price is set at 12. Note that it used to be 20! 

These past few years and even now there are constant conversations both here and on Discord about the future of Hive, about why the price is that low, how we will increase it and so forth. I have also shared my views about it but there are people who not only expressed their point of view, but had valid arguments, did the math and provided ways and solutions. 

The results are that some people who hold the power here in terms of HP, they basically continue to do whatever they want, they don't listen to anyone but themselves or their close friends and that's why we keep going from worse to worst. So either these people are extremely stubborn and don't want to admit wrong or they are basically taking advantage of Hive and the community for their own wallet. Sometimes it can be both. 

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/ILwnVIQ1BGUAAAAC/facts-lebron.gif)

Hive not only needs more everyday people who post, upvote and communicate with each other but above everything needs investors and Dapp creators who will create interesting things and bring way more people. 

The marketing initiatives so far are worthless, no matter what you tell yourself. I would urge you to break down the amount of money the DHF invested in these marketing initiatives throughout these years and the end result. We are spending thousands of dollars to attend crypto-science events to get new members. How many will join and how many will stay? I for once have never decided to invest in a crypto or join a community from a said event and literally nobody that i know of. 

Simply promote the shit out of Hive through social media, where way more people will get to see and way more people can easily join and sometimes it can be free, if you use TikTok, for example. Why that denial of traditional social media, while everyone is there? Events are extremely outdated for this goal. 

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/NYPwiRoi5IgAAAAC/old-fart-fart-love.gif)

Also, i have read countless posts again throughout the years saying that decreasing the APR pretty much solves nothing. I hold both staked HP and HBD and have not powered down anything so far. I kept witnessing people talking badly about the APR, while in reality, it solves nothing. We have the same talks when it was 20%, it moved to 15% and basically the price keeps getting dumped. 


The reason is obvious. It's not the APR. People are getting tired of Hive, they don't earn, not solely because the content is bad, but because the price is dumped and a lot of people are basically upvoting their friends. Also, the DHF is one of the main reasons we are where we are. Millions of dollars spent on dead projects, on overpriced projects, on people who don't deserve that money, on failed proposals and lack of accountability. Simply have a friend with tons of HP and you are okay to get funding. 

In the funding world, there are certain criteria one needs to have in order to get funding. Proper business and marketing plan, monthly, quarterly, and yearly numbers and projections, detailed numbers on everything and accountability if something goes wrong. Here we have people who don't have any of that, make a generic post that chatgpt can do, and ask for salaries, high amounts of money that nobody would actually give them in real life.

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/Bi2n1GZ3WdUAAAAC/fired-you%27re-fired.gif)

Cut the funding on most of the projects, create a new way for proposals to be made and voted on, where other factors besides how much HP you hold would be taken into account and let's wait and see. Use social media to attract people and have 1vs1 talks with investors and dapp creators. 

Alternatively, let's continue this path, cut the APR to 10% then 8% then 5%, keep taking advantage of the community and people and see Hive reaching 1 cent, while at the same time more money will be made for everyone, including those who are taking advantage of it now, if the prices go up x10.

body.title: Midnight Shift Feels
body.body:
>

**Hello there, lovely hoomans!**

I just got time to post a blog here again. My shift has changed from opening to mid-shift this time. I haven't experienced this before since I started at the opening since my first company. This new body clock is surelt unfamiliar and I just explored it last night. 

<div class=\

> ![IMG_20260419_231153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/23yJQupuazunXyB8G9BLyqsn1Y78zYLcYBqkHhMu5s7M6nUJiMj5jzrbaZzmRdaiVQd9Z.jpg) Back then, if we could only choose our preferred shift, I wouldn't really go for midnight or morning shifts. Aside from there's no public transportation at that hour, I'm also confused how the daily shifts work. Let's say for example, at midnight shift for Sunday and you have a rest day on Saturday. Instead of having a rest fay completely, you still have to prepare for work late at night just to start your next shift on midnight which already counted as Sunday. I don't know if I just have a lot on my mind lately, so it's hard for me to process or I only resist it that much. I'm so used to have that 8pm or 9pm shifts. This new system is quite hard to digest. But anyway, I'm a slave for money, so I still went and work. LOL. ![IMG_20260420_044524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EouA9bjzVDpjBsvfY4XoXdwGJuVpq9HqvRSi5msYTd9PuAvcU88dp4nbkpajZLVvVnp.jpg) My lunches previously would be exactly at midnight, so it kinda feels like I'm turning the day into night, literally. Now, I'm not sure what dimension I'm placed anymore. I couldn't eat with my friends since they have a different schedule and reshuffled to different teams. ![IMG_20260420_044548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EoCjbeQayvvcZ9Jpo1UELPsd3ZUq9GBR9vQSA43Uq6ismGcVPMHgSYYqagh5cBvRWAt.jpg) Even the pantry is empty at this hour, since most of the employees are going home at 5 am already. I just realized it completely why I strongly opposed this shift *—I'm alone*. Workloads are heavy but friends made it lighter when they're around. I'm often proud to be introvert but maybe I'm just so used to their lively presence that not being with them making me miss them that much. We've been together for months, it's quite hard to just go on without nothing happened. Even the only friend left with me in this new account have been separated with me and placed on a different team. We still see rach other and communicates via Teams but it hits different when we're together. Now, I'm literally a slave for money. I can only work, eat, and sleep, repeat on this state. There's still a chance that the schedule would change later on. (1) If there's a new batch of trainees coming in the production, and (2) if management reshuffles again to meet business demands. I wouldn't have high hopes with this, though. This happens after a few months depending on KPI scores of Monthly reports. ![IMG_20260420_090730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EpxrHG1AP6Si1ADoCybxhqrsS4KXjVm8XBgoaHJS8dnSXtH8UzmZ1vaDWsKYRcsqnNc.jpg) Another reason why I don't like this shift is the sun! It's already scorching hot after end of shift. It's summer now, you know. High heat index is waving everyday and my sickly fragile body can't handle too much heat or a simple cold. Well, good luck to me from hereon. I think I'll be having many rants about this moving forward. Anyway, thanks for stopping by to read this more like a rant than a blog. Have a great day, people! ✨🌻
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLH61jJ6Ftm6Eqe3fDXzw3Cx5N2Y2qCuSRLCzQHgLXE5XFvRm54Sn248CRT5itY3DJbLgqa3FYJJJ6pbvdgq4gGwB3ZLqN9azwC2vhXjpFcUuu2hSzGer.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/23wCbb1sRLHKU724Ko6dWVbuN2QdYWiG1izWZycWmXWRntfdPJkQQ6qSnZAK14dGPHeAu.png)

body.body: 1/5 🧵 NYC may be about to make medical emergencies even more expensive. The FDNY is proposing a **29% jump for 911 ambulance rides** and a **42% spike for on-site treatment**. That’s not a rounding error — that’s the kind of increase that makes people think twice before calling for help, which is a terrible incentive in an actual emergency.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵 The core numbers are ugly. A basic life support ambulance ride would rise from **$1,385 to $1,793**. “Treatment in place” — when medics treat you without transporting you — would jump from **$630 to $896**. Advanced life support would also climb hard: **Level 1 from $1,680 to $2,196**, and **Level 2 from $1,692 to $2,012**. The per-mile hospital transport fee stays at **$20**, and oxygen remains **$66**.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵 FDNY’s argument is straightforward: costs are up, labor costs are likely rising, and the city wants patients/insurers to absorb more of the bill instead of taxpayers carrying as much of it. This would be the **first rate hike since May 2023**, and the department is already pricing in expected raises tied to the labor patterns set in other city union contracts — even though EMS workers still don’t have a settled contract.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵 The bigger story is the system underneath the price hike. EMS unions say the real crisis isn’t just billing — it’s **chronic underpayment and staffing collapse**. EMTs and paramedics are paid less than firefighters and other uniformed first responders, and union leaders argue that’s driving people out of the job. Their warning is brutal: **1,500 medical first responders, or 37% of the workforce, could leave in 2026**, pushing response times even higher.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/5 🧵 So this isn’t just a “fees are going up” story. It’s a pressure point where **city budgets, labor inequity, public health, and emergency response quality** all collide. Charging more might help offset costs on paper, but if staffing keeps bleeding out, New York could end up billing more for a weaker system. Public hearing is set for **May 15**. 📎 Source

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/04/20/us-news/fdny-plans-to-hike-cost-of-ambulance-rides-by-29-increase-on-site-emergency-treatment-by-42/)

body.title: The natural charm of the mountains || which farmers love for growing corn.
body.body:
Good evening to all my friends who always share posts about independent plantations in this beloved community.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmds5nSmPSRXLroqkjK2gBmE2XA5rbXTnqQJub9u7d6nrE/incollage_20260420_201412548.jpg)

------
------

Hi everyone, it's been a while since we last saw each other. Tonight, I'm back to my usual routine and sharing the beauty of the mountains with you here.

Yesterday, my little brother and I climbed a beautiful mountain. We climbed a fairly high hill, revealing many plantations below.

I happened to be really bored at home, and of course, I wanted to get some fresh air and relax for a while. So, I thought about climbing a mountain in my hometown.

To reach the summit, my little brother and I spent about two hours on our motorcycles.

After reaching a point that offered a sweeping view, I stopped and took some photos of the road.

# This is the road we took to the top of the mountain.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW3yvWYdkFrLxg8CxHifi7hnDafxnzBCi4auY5ukYnSZY/img_20260420_wa0014.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJHZcE2CLjowxe88ZJLoTT6Hjk5wiHHm8z2KBNJjKxuh/img_20260420_wa0013.jpg)



Afterwards, I immediately felt the energy of nature and a very cool atmosphere because the weather was quite cloudy yesterday. I enjoyed the view on the road I showed above, which is the last section of the beautiful hill.

# This is the mountain view I saw.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAS4WXKVq8AiEu2nXGNeUKMohCK8LqUdgdu1XMsFic24/img_20260420_wa0016.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaZjEYgM2LSVngRFEMwm4J5XYqny1W8bqYyamRmJBE1eA/img_20260420_wa0009.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz5QgfdQcYfekRDL8JuasZq29N7Rq5KWFALsAZN4cGrd/img_20260420_wa0011.jpg)



There, we can see a river with clear water in the middle of a cornfield. Of course, farmers love this area, especially for growing corn. The mountains are a great place, with fertile soil for gardening, corn, and banana trees.

# This is what some highland crops look like.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecB7nNo5GpXQydrwgHa7v6vbzdfo9X6Pe3LgiZwxfMzc/img_20260420_wa0010.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWLhWMsHXUdcCCUniE2gnKeoXGvy9A7YiJznjAkcJiZk/img_20260420_wa0015.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQARaALSVrXfNXT3G7TiQkVh2X9MPTSohrxENHamUGbWA/img_20260420_wa0017.jpg)



In my area, it's common for villagers to farm, each with their own plot of land in the mountains, around 2 to 5 hectares for corn cultivation. This is a good opportunity for hard work and a decent harvest.

Well, friends, that's all I can show you tonight about the plantations I saw while climbing the mountains. I hope you enjoy the photos I've shown above, along with the fairly extensive corn cultivation in my area.

# All the photos I've shown here were taken using my realme 7I camera.

# All the stories I share here are purely my own; I've not plagiarized anything from anyone else.

# Friends, see you in my next post!

Espero estén muy bien, aquí quiero mostrarles una actividad que me pidieron hacer y no me esperaba y llevaba años sin hacer, armar legos. Fue una actividad bien random pues a una amiga le habían regalado ese lego en forma de maceta de pinguino y quería hacerlo pero como estaba presente me dijo para hacerlo con ella. De verdad que fue lo más relajante y divertido que he hecho en mucho tiempo sin planear, si hay momentos un pelo frustrastes o llenos de miedo poruqe quieres que salga bien o que no se te pierde ninguna pieza, pues hay piezas más pequeñas que otras, y que ves las instrucciones y no estas 100% seguro que entendiste todo, pero allí vas armando y vas viendo como si de verdad estás en el buen camino. Cuando lo terminamos fue demasiado tierno y emocionante pues daban ganas de hacer otro y simplemente ver donde poníamos nuestra obra de arte. De verdad que recordó como actualmente existen mil legos de todo tipo, tamaño y temáticas y lo bonitos que se ven que de verdad pueden ser un adorno para la casa, no son juguetes para entretener solamente, entonces por su puesto como el que hice es una maceta con una flor quería más con diferentes flores, espero les gusten las fotos salieron tiernas. ¡Nos vemos! ![Separadores-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dimeshana/EoeFPt1Ax6fShMKv12hjCSgCr3opFjaiFhpcG9MMKeJPbnfSqXWfnRyuxq1rZdGHE5B.png)
english version (click here)

Hey everyone! I hope you're all doing great. I wanted to show you an activity that someone asked me to do—something I hadn't expected and hadn't done in years: building with Legos. It was a pretty random activity because a friend had received that penguin-shaped flowerpot Lego set as a gift and wanted to build it, but since I was there, she asked me to help her. It was honestly the most relaxing and fun thing I’ve done in a long time without planning it. Sure, there are moments that are a little frustrating or nerve-wracking because you want it to turn out right or not lose any pieces—since some pieces are smaller than others—and you look at the instructions and aren’t 100% sure you understood everything, but as you keep building, you realize you’re actually on the right track. When we finished it, it was so cute and exciting—it made us want to build another one and just see where we’d put our work of art. It really reminded me of how there are now thousands of LEGO sets of all kinds, sizes, and themes, and how beautiful they look—they can truly be a decoration for the home; they’re not just toys for entertainment. So, of course, since the one I made is a flower pot with a flower, I wanted more with different flowers. I hope you like the photos—they turned out cute. See you later!

Hello everyone, I hope you all are fine, I am also doing well. Today I am going to give you a very important update, this is not just an update, it is a decision that I have taken up for myself. I have embarked on a journey of regaining my fitness, regaining my lost physic, my mental health. I am embarking on a journey in which I will be a very strong person mentally and physically, emotionally as well.

So, for a few years now, I lost my physic, I lost the body shape that I ideally had, I gained a lot of weight. Because of stress and anxiety and because of a sedentary lifestyle. But now, I am embarking on a journey where I will regain my strength both mentally and physically.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNggw4N35Jc9GFH6BZQDe2QVnzuD4tKg4MbAa8HpxPfFq/img_1481.jpg)

body.title: Toparlar Waterfall / Toparlar Şelalesi ( EN-TR)
body.body:
Hello, Fellow Travelers

We often don’t know where waterfalls come from; like a secret pool hidden by the mountains and hills, they are ready to meet the earth when the time comes.  That clear water, breaking free from the heights, flows onward, touching the grass, stones, and moss along the way. Then, reaching a high cliff, it plunges downward. It is at that moment that we witness the most beautiful part of the scenery. Just like the view I saw at the natural wonder of Toparlar Waterfall, located between Köyceğiz and Akyaka...


>Merhaba Gezginci Dostlarım

>Şelalelerin nereden geldiğini çoğu zaman bilmeyiz; sanki dağların ve tepelerin sakladığı gizli bir havuz gibi, zamanı geldiğinde yeryüzüyle buluşmaya hazırdır.  Yükseklerden kopup gelen o berrak su, yol boyunca otlara, taşlara ve yosunlara dokunarak ilerliyor. Sonra yüksek bir kayalığa gelerek kendini aşağıya bırakıyor. İşte o an manzaranın en güzel anına tanıklık ediyoruz.  Tıpkı Köyceğiz ve Akyaka arasında kalan doğa harikası Toparlar Şelalesinde gördüğüm manzara gibi...

[//]:# (!worldmappin 36.99741 lat 28.63294 long  d3scr)

![IMG20260325141806.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcfPp965TcEj74PFgcfmvyBANcBwR8paGbhUJ5SSkExg4/IMG20260325141806.jpg)

While I was on vacation in the Aegean region, I really wanted to see the waterfall located in the Toparlar neighborhood, which is part of the Köyceğiz district in Muğla province. To see the waterfall, which is about 5 km from the Köyceğiz district, I set out from the hotel where I was staying in Ölüdeniz.  To get to the waterfall, I drove from Ölüdeniz along the Fethiye-Muğla road, turned off at the sign for Toparlar Waterfall, and drove about 5 km on a dirt road until I reached a certain point. After that, we reached Toparlar Waterfall following a 10- to 15-minute walk. 

>Ege'de tatil yaptığım sıralarda Muğla ilimizin Köyceğiz ilçesine bağlı olan ve Toparlar Mahallesinde bulunan şelaleyi yakından görmeyi çok istemiştim. Köyceğiz ilçesine yaklaşık 5 km uzaklıkta olan şelaleyi görmek için  Ölüdeniz'de kaldığım otelden yola çıktım.  Şelaleye gitmek için Ölüdeniz'den Fethiye Muğla yolundan ilerleyerek Toparlar Şelalesi yazan tabeledan saparak yaklaşık 5 km topraklı yoldan aracımla belirli bir noktaya kadar geldim. Sonrasında 10 15 dakikalık bir yürüyüşten sonra Toparlar Şelalesine ulaştık. 


![IMG20260325140958.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyJKoAcm6i8fgTBs7WqP6KYzKb1hW3zuyy2RjyYe9hHU/IMG20260325140958.jpg)

![IMG20260325140954.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVYL7Q4f97zAaJdZWhi8vaV3eMdiSQ1YBFoMZNyMjQCu/IMG20260325140954.jpg)

![IMG20260325164400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW8XTT9L3gFH1pNWrEfkGDn614NGdJZo5HswSBs3Ja8zU/IMG20260325164400.jpg)

![IMG20260325140329.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfXD1BNNnjvixPt99PdrGmJmarxKg7dW4fRQdx3tjDbNz/IMG20260325140329.jpg)

![IMG20260325140353.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVYgAtWAgUBbtzRbYyGMjufJube3avKz7dAJ8fR7zqCcw/IMG20260325140353.jpg)

![IMG20260325140933.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNb1rqGhsYvSm31q9LmX1UY5t1z5KmQczxsc2CEELWm7/IMG20260325140933.jpg)

The waterfall flows along a stream through a wide forest, winding its way between large and small rocks that have taken on a black hue. We walked along a narrow dirt path at the edge of the stream, and at times along rocky paths where the stream flows, heading straight toward the waterfall.  As we walked along the path, small waterfalls had formed in some sections of the stream. In fact, the water had created depths so great we couldn’t see the bottom. People probably swim here in the summer.  The waterfall flows at its strongest during March, April, and May. During these months, the rushing water has carved out the rocks, forming small pools.  We specifically added this spot to our travel itineraries during these months. Because most waterfalls and streams flow very rapidly during these months due to the combination of melting snow and rainwater. This phenomenon can be observed both along the Mediterranean coast and the Aegean coast. 

>Şelale, geniş bir ormanın içinde siyah rengine bürünmüş irili ufaklı taşların arasından bir dere boyunca akıyor.  Derenin kenarından dar topraklı yoldan ve zaman zaman da akan derenin bulunduğu taşlı yollardan geçerek şelalenin tam aktığı yöne doğru yürüdük.  Yolda yürürken derenin bazı bölümlerinde küçük küçük şelaleler oluşmuş. Hatta suyun dibini göremediğimiz derinlikler oluşturmuş. Muhtemelen yazın buralarda suya giriyorlar.  Mart Nisan ve Mayıs aylarında şelale en güçlü haliyle akıyor. Bu aylarda şiddetli akan sular kayaları da oyarak küçük küçük havuzlar oluşturmuş.  Biz özellikle bu aylarda burayı gezi rotalarımıza ekledik. Çünkü çoğu şelale ve dereler karların erimesiyle   ve  yağmur sularının birleşimiyle bu aylarda çok hızlı akarkar. Bu durum hem Akdeniz kıyılarında hem de Ege kıyılarında görülebiliyor. 

![IMG20260325143005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmabHvKu9ce5g8PUTRxqPdRWHH4NNdW7UJYyFdMaZjdAkY/IMG20260325143005.jpg)


![IMG20260325140744.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPAxJBziaydCsZHYfBCf6TbysHM1yiQpKcbW7MRZXtaXx/IMG20260325140744.jpg)

![IMG20260325140740.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSh8bNPTR5XBryvTECA7SxaDZVXuRQNHxFV8YuxVq7bkN/IMG20260325140740.jpg)

![IMG20260325140718.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQHpbwN2bkH135W4k8NF5gq9NHogq6yrfLSBTK8NhSv2K/IMG20260325140718.jpg)

We walked along the water’s edge—and sometimes even in the water—toward the point where the waterfall originated. The water looked quite clear and shallow. The fact that the stones were clearly visible and looked so vibrant also showed just how clean the water was. The current wasn’t very strong, but in some sections, the water falling from a height increased its speed.  Amid the sounds of birds and insects, we continued on our way, feeling both the coolness of the water and its soothing calm. Occasionally, we sat on a rock along the edge and focused solely on the sound of the water. Most of the rocks around us had been shaped by the water.  They had all taken on different forms and were scattered about. 

>Suyun kenarından ve bazen de içinde yürüyerek şelalenin geldiği noktaya doğru yürüdük. Su oldukça berrak ve sığ görünüyordu. Taşların net bir şekilde seçilebilmesi ve canlı duruşu suyun ne kadar temiz olduğunu da gösteriyordu.  Akış hızı çok güçlü değil ama, bazı bölümlerde yüksekten düşen sular hızını da artırıyordu.  Kuş seslerinin ve böcek seslerinin içinde  suyun hem serinliğini hem de huzur veren sakinliği hissederek yolumuza devam ettik. Arada kenarda bir taşın üzerinde oturarak sadece suyun sesine odaklandık. Etrafımızdaki çoğu taşlar sudan nasibini almışlar.  Hepsi farklı şekillere bürünerek etrafa yayılmışlar. 

![IMG20260325141054.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQsXjHv453Cu61zC9TAxZwShrtS1giGv5GxhFhgSamfgG/IMG20260325141054.jpg)

![IMG20260325140841.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ6KdFaXVdC4UaciGFidZzVYkrD6P1LyCgQEFuvjtFov9/IMG20260325140841.jpg)

![IMG20260325140848.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhu3xaUsFrtpSBZX9G9Htf9doMvrrUFwRfssAW1y2PGA/IMG20260325140848.jpg)

![IMG20260325140421.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewg5HqjMvQ3m1ohQQdfZxDTNh9Ly8DGnoLZ3QnSc4n96/IMG20260325140421.jpg)

![IMG20260325140531.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVMV6LNWPpuFmPTipLTqxLgKua3oEppgziDnVmkkmVnLk/IMG20260325140531.jpg)


![IMG20260325140946.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaeEyChQtYEFJC25itAYLyTjzKmHyLgVQ5rpHvTrz5mC8/IMG20260325140946.jpg)


![IMG20260325141049.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZcQm7L298CxBqRiW2398JazmdkhQpX7QPwpEXmKyrZt2/IMG20260325141049.jpg)

The grasses, plants, and trees growing along the water’s edge on both sides look so colorful and vibrant that they highlight the water’s clarity and purity. As we walk through the narrow path of uneven ground and rocks along the edge, we sometimes find it difficult. Some of the stones are wet and slippery, so we need to be careful. The yellow and green grasses along the water’s edge are spread out widely. Dense stands of pine trees can be seen on the hills and mountains near the water. In the open areas left behind by the water, there are also broad-leaved trees that provide more shade. This demonstrates just how dense the vegetation around the water is. 

>Suyun kenarında sağında ve solunda yetişen otlar, bitkiler ve ağaçlar o kadar renkli ve canlı görünüyor ki; suyun tüm berraklığını ve temizliğini gözler önüne seriyor. Kenardan inişli çıkışlı oluşan dar toprağın ve taşlarının arasından yürürken zaman zaman da zorlanıyoruz. Bazı taşların yüzü ıslak ve kaygan dikkatli olmak gerekiyor. Suyun kenarındaki sarı ve yeşil otlar etraflıca dağılmışlar. Suyun yakınındaki tepelerde ve dağlarda yoğun çam ağaçları görülüyor. Suyun geride bıraktığı boş alanlarda geniş yapraklı daha gölge veren ağaçlarda var. Bu da suyun etrafındaki bitki örtüsünün ne kadar yoğun olduğunu gösteriyor. 


![IMG20260325141718.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbhev6fL3Ac8cdAjNqxrk7CnrZwD1zYtcqvxi4ddDkGfo/IMG20260325141718.jpg)


![IMG20260325141102.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQnbSnJyJ1v1JKAxmbQ2FAz7df9C5trsoZcGFozPncQbE/IMG20260325141102.jpg)


![IMG20260325140746.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbpctRj2hhg6QK1AB4LnbsEBTrVEmTHfuakV5KPLfQPk4/IMG20260325140746.jpg)

![IMG20260325142650.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaKjqgpDcmeJ2S8t3Rrj8q2DDCJchVwEXXD6SyKrvobJi/IMG20260325142650.jpg)

![IMG20260325141623.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3eL9KExcfLzA2xapQz9c1KyKif3nuJAch9za1LB93pL/IMG20260325141623.jpg)

![IMG20260325141537.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeuY6mTMEqdh1Zy646NAZCPeBKXS2CkWcxGbfca6oQoMQ/IMG20260325141537.jpg)

I especially want to highlight the spots where the water flows with great force. In these areas, the shape and size of the rocks, along with the spaces they create, form a natural, unadorned beauty. We can see the clarity and purity of the water both on its surface and in the sparkle it leaves on the rocks and plants it strikes. Just watching the frothy spectacle created as the water flows is a great pleasure. The color of the stones varies depending on how the water strikes them. The tones and shapes of the stones, which resemble brown and black hues, also change depending on their location. 

>Suyun coşarak aktığı noktaları özellikle göstermek istiyorum. Bu alanlarda taşların şekli, büyüklüğü ve oluşturduğu boşluklar doğal sade bir güzellik oluşturmuş. Suyun berraklığını ve temizliğini hem suyun yüzünden hemde çarptıkları taşlara ve otlara bıraklığı parlaklıktan anlayabiliyoruz. Aktıkça oluşan köpüklü şölenleri izlemek bile insana büyük bir keyif veriyor. Taşların rengi suyun çarpmasına göre farklılık gösteriyor. Kahverengi ve siyah renklere benzeyen taşların tonları ve şekilleri de bulundukları yere göre değişiyor. 

![IMG20260325141712.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWccXbHXfxz5Qc2r7wz5ZFcQofUu7g2v2FRhKyHKWgXuK/IMG20260325141712.jpg)

![IMG20260325141629.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUhX9VUeozVJgFnXxhds41rtczE1Efq2cgjsoEqjFeUga/IMG20260325141629.jpg)

![IMG20260325141125.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmazR22QPTc8qWoPSbvB4Sr2wudJW9wcHQWUvDX857GbgC/IMG20260325141125.jpg)


![IMG20260325141129.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRZ94JC6EYBehuvJUdhyeDgHtMX17x6jhkuARneaQyTMo/IMG20260325141129.jpg)


![IMG20260325141100.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbw3HyWPBqjYZW9kRG28ZLrehdg4QQEovJGM4DRK7CT9C/IMG20260325141100.jpg)

We had arrived at that wide area where the waterfall flowed abundantly. Around the water, which flowed in a manner reminiscent of a long, overhanging bridge, there were mosses, aquatic plants, and rocks covered in moss. As the water flowed under the sun’s shining face, taking on a clear and clean appearance, the surrounding rocks and plants looked vibrant and colorful.  In this area, the waterfall cascades down a powerful ledge into its pools. The water arriving here flows over a natural rock formation, cascading like a fine veil to form small pools. The water, striking the rocks, flows onward in a mist of foam. It seems that natural beauties have emerged as a result of the water eroding the rock. 

>Şelalenin bol bol aktığı o geniş alana gelmiştik. Uzun taşan bir köprüyü anımsatan bir şekilde akan suyun etrafında yosun ve sucul bitkilerle beslenen otlar ve taşlar yosunlar bulunuyordu.  Güneşin parlayan yüzünde akan su berrak ve temiz bir şekle bürünürken  etrafındaki taşlar ve otlar canlı ve renkli görünüyordu.  Bu alanda şelale güçlü bir set üzerinden dökülerek havuzlarına ulaşıyor. Buraya gelen su doğal bir kayalık üzerine gelerek ince bir tül perde şeklinde akarak küçük küçük havuzlar oluşturuyor.  Kayalara çarpan sular köpükler halinde süzülerek ilerliyor. Suyun kayayı aşındırmasıyla ortaya doğal güzellikler çıkmış görünüyor. 


![IMG20260325142034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaN3q5kPZ3qwVp7WymtvuBTm1ExV9u9mKPCGUjoBUbBtZ/IMG20260325142034.jpg)


![IMG20260325141910.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZuvPau4F9JytUdEeBVQw1yCxsQTGNqyktV2protJiAZd/IMG20260325141910.jpg)

![IMG20260325141619.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS2hnedTnsHjViVKY4VpJSmkSDkJHvRHs5e1kbtmApRHr/IMG20260325141619.jpg)

![IMG20260325141802.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbDh9FoyHtKMbqeuX1eoRzjwgzHCHFPnQokRsbCpdqFRS/IMG20260325141802.jpg)

![IMG20260325141431.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmQ56Ki4CtjKaZyrLkfn8UKueGrhGQAaRe9CY54H5CLe/IMG20260325141431.jpg)

After cleansing our souls with the sound of flowing water at the end of the day, we turned back to leave the waterfall.  You know how we always say that some places can only be truly understood by experiencing them firsthand? Well, Toparlar Waterfall had become just such a place for us—a place we experienced and where our souls were cleansed. 

>Günün sonunda akan suyun sesiyle ruhumuzu temizledikten sonra, şelaleden ayrılmak için geri döndük.  Hani hepimiz söyleriz ya, bazı yerler yaşanarak anlatılır. İşte toparlar şelalesi de bizim için yaşayıp, ruhumuzu temizlediğimiz bir yer olmuştu. 

![Passenger777.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJC4twuaVWbv36cmAFG8Gc1LTcYxXa4qaoW3kqzgJRx8/Passenger777.gif)

body.title: Get ready to plant vegetables to welcome summer. 🌿🌱🪴
body.body:
![IMG_2477.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/23vsZ51uDQowDkoG26ynwm8jUCTCjDoqsMqhXS8s6qdKZ79QB7MrGUujRtELoXSwPN65Z.jpeg)

***
Hello everyone, it's me again to give you an update on my gardening this year. Last time I prepared the soil for planting, I made sure to let it dry to kill any weeds, because if I planted then, those weeds would grow.
***

![IMG_2472.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/23tbwME5S8j4dsJSY9qmpFshyCpVprBQes3KEeaUHqgw7fpAhx1VFHMfCwomCNgu8Si6w.jpeg)

![IMG_2470.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/23t7mN5ut88uJvneD5u3Dfa5W58MgfjKqNtTCzf4KrcDQjSPrAutYNvABqot5um1PRyUL.jpeg)

![IMG_2467.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/Eo8Tqu5aRiRqiMsyyDdfDveZLvPhRmLjuHMnD4sQB945dhwYuf8wbhtHcXUfivqBrsG.jpeg)
***
I prepared the soil for almost a week, and I was hesitant about whether to continue because the weather was getting cold and I was getting lazy. But since I'd already started, I wanted to continue. Today, I planted seeds for two plots of water spinach and one plot of kale. These are Thai vegetables. A few days ago, I tilled the soil to make it more compact before planting the seeds, but I'm not sure if they'll sprout.
***

![IMG_2469.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/Eoc8Su6qv2G7uLAW2fFp6L95vzXC1m85Twn3RqEWoXEY1uMM6yJMG4SgVidejaJL2xY.jpeg)

![IMG_2462.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/EoAZoMeKqxZrMsH5y9FMqy94RxVcECBb5W5i4jVX7NzP6cjWjGNXqgAwQch97GQvFbb.jpeg)

After this, I'll be away for about a month, so I've asked my dad to look after the vegetable plots for me, watering them every other day. Besides the two vegetable plots, I also planted seeds of chili peppers, coriander, and Thai basil on the sides. I'm hoping they'll sprout. This time, I planted them rather spontaneously, but since I got the seeds, I wanted to plant them all. If they sprout, I'll be happy; if not, it'll be okay.
***

![IMG_2473.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/23tmHzrjohQUomWqFufMRgJZJbS11CuunJsXnZfwzYXt3GapYKwNA1Ko97uVikLipFFQ3.jpeg)
***
The Italian summer is very long, so if the vegetables don't sprout in time, or if they do sprout, it will be a problem. The weather was too cold. However, I'm counting on this and hoping the seeds I planted will sprout. After planting, I lightly covered the soil and then watered the vegetables.
***

![IMG_2475.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/miingjazz/23wqkWmowTD8sbmtSvZnnRXf8J8kEAsWjBxNSHUhhSApZBoRDVdz2EL6oYsymVfPtd3PH.jpeg)

According to the instructions, these vegetables should yield produce in about a month, but I'm not sure if these will. We'll have to wait and see. Anyway, please cheer me on! I hope everyone enjoys my post. Thank you for following and have a great day!

body.title: Pain, N40, Saw Mod, Sparrow Chicks, Tree Limbing, Owl Hork - Sunday
body.body:
Another night of shit sleep thanks to another dream, only my second in many many years, and it was a continuation of the first from the prior night. My shoulder was torched and I got up at 5am to abuse it with the Theracane. Eventually only Flexeril managed to calm it down by mid morning. I headed to North 40 after 9am and it was not nearly as slammed as on Friday. Picked up hammocks and spray fluids for the shop. Once back I spent time getting the trigger safety removed from the chainsaw. It made it so I could only use the saw with one hand due to having to depress the safety. So off it came and the saw works SOOO much easier now. ![IMG_20260419_110852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmDZSkQ7pVigitMjnP6YwgdK2E5SBzZHZwpRok3tAHhEtvGqqeabjEL5ZyFd6hYUSeM.jpg) Clanked a pipe against the outside of the tool shed and saw a bird dart off. After a moment of searching I found the little sparrow had a nest and a clutch of chicks that all fought for what they hoped was food coming at them. ![IMG_20260419_125013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhsGhN7sCy3g9Q3uZafRePTy5XcTr8kEd2qbgYtxczG7gdq7cu5wqxHZZL7s3R5dfsm.jpg) J had his first flag football match which @stryeyz took him to while R stayed home with me. I grabbed the saw and hiked up the hill and limbed one of the downed trees. The saw cuts like a champ but I ran the battery too low to buck much of the top. The trigger was way easier to engage without the safety and the saw being lighter was easier to hike with. ![IMG_20260419_151647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23z7BpkesNqYU9yGzWjPmsRRjHYbqZ7BndYQy4RLcoK2GCLoLmKLA1AhYg1HqxbRp7F3S.jpg) I had dropped my glasses when a branch thwacked my head as it fell over which I did not notice till back at the house. So back up the hill I went to get them then roamed the trees on top finding oodles of owl hork on the ground beneath certain trees. It barely all fit in my hand. ![IMG_20260419_163203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xyVDEcredP5W6cs5gYb39BXATV9gRPa6d2Djr2AzTgmL7ywWh41CugKVD7LdAo9WGmQ.jpg) The one in my hand is HUGE and could only be from a great horned owl as it would have taken a big throat to get that out. Some of the others are for sure from smaller owls and they all looked to be a bit weathered to varying degrees. ![IMG_20260419_163739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wqik5ghTuCsgVWkMBQyThVYwAQvWGSKPuFaqmfF6rsfgyecxfnheHosonQ6yCX9cMmf.jpg) Better sleep last night with no dreams but my shoulder is still jacked, though the Flexeril that helped me sleep. This morning I get the boys to school, then I have a job to do in town working on a fence. I got my Varia last night and will try it out on a ride early afternoon. At some point I will get the garden planted, I'm not to enthused to do so this year so we will have a very limited amount growing. Better than tossing it to the birds when it goes bad at least and since I am the only one working in the gardens it will give me time back in life. ---

body.title: Moving the pieces on the board.
body.body:
<center>[Futurism](https://futurism.com/tesla-crumbling-elon-musk-bail-out-xai)</center>
It's been a while since I made any changes to my cryptocurrency portfolio, and starting another week, I think it's time to do so. Considering the behavior of the market itself (which isn't the best), I've decided to bet on moving the pieces on the board in favor of my own interests. I'll never be able to know, with detailed precision, if my choices are entirely correct... But I can standardize some behaviors.
This decision always comes with a good dose of insecurity, especially when the market doesn't give us good future prospects. On the other hand, remaining inert in the moment doesn't bring me good feelings. Despite the caution in making these exchange moves, I always think I could be doing something better. Anyway, only the future will tell if this will bring me good results. My balance has been positive, even with a low percentage.
If the gains are in the green, of course I'm happy. That doesn't mean I don't care about how I do the cryptocurrency trading table. These pieces always make me reflect on my effort within a segment that until a few years ago I didn't care as much as I do now, because I finally understood that this economy is part of the \

that is already among us. Acquiring more and more knowledge has never been as important as it is now.\nI always like to remember that it's not the market that needs to adapt to my expectations, but rather those who are depending on it (in this case, me... and so many other millions of investors around the world). It's a \

where we can't define the rules; we just walk along the paths given to us throughout the journey in search of the much-desired financial freedom we are seeking, in a very incessant adventure. ---
**Moviendo las piezas en el tablero.**
Hace tiempo que no hago cambios en mi cartera de criptomonedas, y al empezar otra semana, creo que es hora de hacerlo. Teniendo en cuenta el comportamiento del mercado (que no es el mejor), he decidido apostar por mover las piezas del tablero a favor de mis propios intereses. Nunca podré saber con total precisión si mis decisiones son del todo correctas... Pero puedo estandarizar algunos comportamientos. Esta decisión siempre viene acompañada de una buena dosis de inseguridad, sobre todo cuando el mercado no ofrece buenas perspectivas de futuro. Por otro lado, permanecer inactivo en el momento no me produce ninguna satisfacción. A pesar de la cautela al realizar estos movimientos en el mercado de divisas, siempre pienso que podría estar haciendo algo mejor. En cualquier caso, solo el futuro dirá si esto me dará buenos resultados. Mi saldo ha sido positivo, aunque con un porcentaje bajo. Si las ganancias son positivas, por supuesto que estoy contento. Eso no significa que no me importe cómo me va en el trading de criptomonedas. Estas operaciones siempre me hacen reflexionar sobre mi esfuerzo en un sector que hasta hace unos años no me importaba tanto como ahora, porque finalmente comprendí que esta economía forma parte del “futuro” que ya está entre nosotros. Adquirir cada vez más conocimientos nunca ha sido tan importante como ahora. Siempre me gusta recordar que no es el mercado el que debe adaptarse a mis expectativas, sino quienes dependen de él (en este caso, yo... y tantos otros millones de inversores en todo el mundo). Es un “juego” donde no podemos definir las reglas; simplemente recorremos los caminos que se nos presentan a lo largo del camino en busca de la tan anhelada libertad financiera que buscamos, en una aventura constante. ---
**Movendo as peças do tabuleiro.**
Já faz um tempo que eu não faço mudanças no meu portfólio de criptomoedas, e começando mais uma semana, acho que chegou a hora de fazer isso. Considerando o comportamento do próprio mercado (que não é dos melhores), ainda decidi apostar em mover as peças do tabuleiro a favor dos meus próprios interesses. Nunca terei como saber, com uma precisão detalhada, se as minhas escolhas estão totalmente corretas... Mas posso padronizar alguns comportamentos. Essa decisão sempre vem acompanhada de uma boa dose de insegurança, principalmente quando o mercado não nos dá boas provisões de futuro. Por outro lado, me manter na inércia do momento não me traz bons sentimentos. Apesar da cautela em fazer esses movimentos de troca, sempre acho que poderia estar fazendo algo melhor. De todo jeito, se isso vai me trazer bons resultados, só o futuro irá dizer. O meu saldo tem sido positivo, mesmo com porcentagem baixa. Se os ganhos estão verdes, é claro que eu estou feliz. Isso não quer dizer que eu não me preocupo em como eu faço a tabela de trocas nas criptomoedas. Essas peças sempre me fazem refletir sobre o meu esforço dentro de um segmento que até poucos anos atrás eu não me importava tanto quanto agora, porque eu finalmente entendi que essa economia é parte do “futuro” que já está entre nós. Adquirir cada vez mais conhecimento nunca foi tão importante quanto agora. Eu sempre gosto de lembrar que não é o mercado que precisa se adequar as minhas expectativas, mas sim, quem está dependendo dele (neste caso, eu... e tantos outros milhões de investidores ao redor do mundo). Se trata de um “jogo” onde nós não temos como definir regras; apenas vamos caminhando pelas trilhas que nos são dadas ao longo de todo o percurso em busca da tão sonhada liberdade financeira que nós estamos buscando, numa aventura muito incessante. body.title: The Plum Tree That Grew With My Son
body.body:
Hi!

I created this account with the idea of writing about games, because at that time gaming was my main form of entertainment and I was wasting quite a lot of time on it. But well, times have changed. I've grown up, I have a wife and two children. I still play sometimes, but rarely and there's really nothing worth writing about. Instead, my wife and I have a small garden and I feel like showing something from it occasionally :) And maybe also getting some advice or asking for tips.

To begin with, I'd like to show you my plum tree. There's a tradition in Poland (and elsewhere as i know) that a father plants a fruit tree when a child is born. Although people usually plant an apple or pear tree, we decided on a plum. And so it has been growing for the fourth year together with our son, reaching quite large sizes very quickly.

Last year it flowered for the first time, but unfortunately the frost effectively destroyed the blossom. This year it's even bigger and more heavily covered with flowers, which fills us with hope that maybe even some fruit will appear. The only problem is that there aren't many bees or other pollinators visible... and this is what the plum blossom looks like:

![21983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarmagames/23tvZrRnzkuwBMm8YZv2TCbxsFLtooMuF18cbyTBLBNzAZi1p98RD4sXuCQNVwPMPdcZE.jpg)

I'll send a full photo of the whole tree once it has fully leafed out after winter :)
---
## Śliwa dla uczczenia narodzin syna.

Stworzyłem to konto z myślą o pisaniu o grach, ponieważ wówczas była to moja główna rozrywka i całkiem sporo czasu na niej... trwoniłem. Ale cóż, czasy się zmieniłem, dorosłem, mam żonę i dwójkę dzieci. Czasem jeszcze gram, ale rzadko i nie ma o czym pisać. Mamy za to z żoną niewielki ogród i mam taką ochotę, żeby czasem coś z niego pokazać :) A może też dostać jakąś podpowiedź czy poradzić się. 

Na początku chciałbym pokazać moją Śliwe. Jest taka tradycja w Polsce (i nie tylko), że ojciec sadzi drzewko owocowe przy narodzinach dziecka. I chociaż zwykle sadzi się Jabłoń lub Grusze, my zdecydowaliśmy o śliwce. I tak rośnie już czwarty rok z naszym synem osiągają bardzo szybko spore rozmiary.
W zeszłym roku pierwszy raz zakwitła, ale przymrozki niestety skutecznie zniszczyły kwiatostan. W tym roku jeszcze większa i mocniej obsypana kwieciem napełnia nas nadzieją, że może pojawi się jakiś owoc. Tylko coś pszczół i innych zapylaczy nie bardzo widać..., a tak się prezentuje kwiat śliwy:


![21983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sarmagames/23tvZrRnzkuwBMm8YZv2TCbxsFLtooMuF18cbyTBLBNzAZi1p98RD4sXuCQNVwPMPdcZE.jpg)



Ja tylko drzewko w pełni się rozwinie po zimie prześlę jego zdjęcie w całej okazałości:)

body.body:
# Learn Ethical Hacking (#5) - Active Scanning - Mapping the Attack Surface

![leh-banner.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2LpoeHUPesc4Dy8haRKLJgfuDY6UBKdc3sED8Dz3JH9/leh-banner.jpg)

### What will I learn

- **Nmap** mastery: SYN scans, version detection, OS fingerprinting, NSE scripts;
- **Service enumeration**: identifying exactly what's running and which version;
- **Banner grabbing**: extracting service identity information;
- **Vulnerability scanning** with Nessus/OpenVAS: what they find and what they miss;
- Writing your own **port scanner in Python**;
- The noise problem: how active scanning gets you caught.

### Requirements

- A working modern computer running macOS, Windows or Ubuntu;
- Your hacking lab from Episode 2;
- Python 3 with socket module (standard library);
- The ambition to learn ethical hacking and security research.

### Difficulty

- Beginner

### Curriculum (of the `Learn Ethical Hacking` series):

- [Learn Ethical Hacking (#1) - Why Hackers Win](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-ethical-hacking-1-why-hackers-win)
- [Learn Ethical Hacking (#2) - Your Hacking Lab](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-ethical-hacking-2-your-hacking-lab)
- [Learn Ethical Hacking (#3) - How the Internet Actually Works - For Attackers](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-ethical-hacking-3-how-the-internet-works-for-attackers)
- [Learn Ethical Hacking (#4) - Reconnaissance - The Art of Not Being Noticed](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-ethical-hacking-4-reconnaissance)
- [Learn Ethical Hacking (#5) - Active Scanning - Mapping the Attack Surface](https://hive.blog/hive-196387/@scipio/learn-ethical-hacking-5-active-scanning) (this post)

### Solutions to Episode 4 Exercises

**Exercise 1 -- OSINT collector comparison:**

```
Results vary, but typical patterns:
- github.com: ~500+ subdomains from CT logs (massive infrastructure),
  TXT records show Google verification, SPF includes many IP ranges
- cnn.com: ~200+ subdomains, heavy CDN usage visible in A records
  (Akamai/Fastly), multiple MX records (enterprise email)
- nasa.gov: WHOIS heavily restricted (.gov registration), relatively
  few CT subdomains visible, strict DMARC policy (p=reject)
```

The key insight: organization size correlates with subdomain count (attack surface), government domains tend to have stricter security posture, and CT logs reveal infrastructure that organizations might consider \

**Exercise 2 -- Google dorking a university:**

```
Example dorks and findings (fictional university):
1. site:university.edu filetype:pdf \

-> Found: budget documents, meeting minutes marked confidential
2. site:university.edu inurl:admin
   -> Found: /admin/login.php, /wp-admin, /phpmyadmin
3. site:university.edu intitle:\

-> Found: open directory listings with student project files
4. site:university.edu ext:sql
   -> Found: database export files (hopefully test data)
5. site:university.edu \

filetype:log
   -> Found: application log files with authentication attempts
```

The key insight: universities are treasure troves because they have huge, decentralized web presence managed by different departments, students, and researchers -- many with minimal security awareness.

```python

    result = subprocess.run(

# Test:
# github.com: SPF + DMARC p=reject (strong)

```

The key insight: `p=none` in DMARC means the organization monitors but doesn't block spoofed email. An attacker can send emails appearing to come from anyone@that-domain and they'll land in inboxes. Shockingly common.

---

# Learn Ethical Hacking (#5) - Active Scanning - Mapping the Attack Surface

Passive recon told us _what_ exists. Now we poke it to find out _what's running_ and _what's vulnerable_. This is where things get loud -- the target can see us coming. But we know enough from our recon (episode 4) to be targeted rather than random. We're not spraying packets at the entire internet hoping something sticks -- we have a shortlist of IPs, subdomains, and services that our OSINT work identified. Now we verify.

Active scanning is the dividing line between observation and action. Everything after this point requires authorization in a real engagement. No exceptions. Remember episode 1 -- the CFAA does not care about your intentions, only whether you had permission.

In our lab? We authorized ourselves by building the targets. _Laten we beginnen._

### Nmap: The Swiss Army Knife

**Nmap** (Network Mapper) is the most important tool in a pentester's arsenal. Full stop. If you learn only one security tool this year, make it Nmap. I've been using it since my early sysadmin days and it has never once failed to be relevant -- from quick sanity checks on a client's server to full-scale pentest engagements. Everything starts with Nmap.

At its core, Nmap sends packets to target ports and analyzes the responses to determine which ports are open, what services are running, and what versions they're at. But it goes _much_ further than that -- scripting engine, OS detection, firewall evasion, output formatting, timing controls... it's an entire ecosystem packed into one command-line tool.

Here we go -- let's start with the basics against our Metasploitable2 target:

```bash
# Basic TCP connect scan (-sT: full TCP handshake)
nmap -sT 192.168.56.101

# SYN scan (-sS: half-open, stealthier, requires root)
sudo nmap -sS 192.168.56.101

# Version detection (-sV: probe open ports for service/version info)
sudo nmap -sV 192.168.56.101

# OS fingerprinting (-O: analyze TCP/IP stack behavior)
sudo nmap -O 192.168.56.101

# The \

scan
sudo nmap -sS -sV -O -A --script=default 192.168.56.101

# Specific port range (all 65535 ports -- takes a while)
sudo nmap -sS -p 1-65535 192.168.56.101
```

Let me break down what each scan type actually does at the packet level, because understanding the _mechanism_ is what separates a professional from someone copy-pasting commands:

**TCP Connect Scan (`-sT`)**: Your machine completes a full TCP three-way handshake (SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK) with each port. If the handshake completes, the port is open. This is the most reliable scan but also the loudest -- every connection gets logged by the target. If you remember the TCP handshake from episode 3, this is exactly that -- just repeated across thousands of ports.

**SYN Scan (`-sS`)**: Also called a \

scan. You send a SYN packet. If you get SYN-ACK back, the port is open -- but instead of completing the handshake with ACK, you send RST (reset). The connection never fully opens, so many older logging systems don't record it. This is the default Nmap scan type and the pentester's bread and butter. It requires root/sudo because crafting raw SYN packets needs elevated privileges.\n\n**UDP Scan (`-sU`)**: UDP is connectionless -- there's no handshake. Nmap sends a UDP packet and waits. No response = port might be open (or filtered). ICMP \

= closed. UDP scanning is _slow_ because you're waiting for timeouts on every port, but it finds services that TCP scanning completley misses (DNS on 53/UDP, SNMP on 161/UDP, DHCP on 67-68/UDP). Never skip UDP scanning in a real engagement -- some of the juiciest vulnerabilities live on UDP services.\n\n**OS Fingerprinting (`-O`)**: This is clever. Nmap sends a series of crafted TCP/IP packets and analyzes the responses -- things like TCP window size, initial TTL, IP ID sequence patterns, and how the target responds to malformed packets. Different operating systems implement the TCP/IP stack slightly differently, and Nmap has a database of thousands of OS fingerprints. It'll tell you not just \

with a confidence percentage.

### Version Detection Deep Dive

The `-sV` flag doesn't just check if a port is open -- it actively probes the service to determine _exactly_ what's running:

```bash
sudo nmap -sV --version-intensity 9 192.168.56.101 -p 21,22,80,3306
```

Output:

```
PORT     STATE SERVICE VERSION
21/tcp   open  ftp     vsftpd 2.3.4
22/tcp   open  ssh     OpenSSH 4.7p1 Debian 8ubuntu1 (protocol 2.0)
80/tcp   open  http    Apache httpd 2.2.8 ((Ubuntu) DAV/2)
3306/tcp open  mysql   MySQL 5.0.51a-3ubuntu5
```

That version string -- `vsftpd 2.3.4` -- is _incredibly_ specific. And incredibly dangerous (for the target). A quick search reveals CVE-2011-2523: a backdoor was deliberately inserted into the vsftpd 2.3.4 source code distribution. If you connect to the FTP service and send a username containing a smiley face (`:)`), a root shell opens on port 6200.

Let that sink in for a moment. Someone compromised the _source code_ of a widely used FTP server and added a backdoor triggered by a smiley face. This is a real supply chain attack from 2011 -- years before SolarWinds made supply chain attacks front-page news.

_That's_ what version detection gives you: not just \

The difference between _interesting_ and _game over_. We found this same version in episode 2's exercises when we first scanned Metasploitable2 -- now you understand _why_ that scan result matters.

### Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE)

Nmap includes a scripting engine with hundreds of pre-built Lua scripts for vulnerability detection, brute forcing, service discovery, and more. The NSE is what transforms Nmap from a port scanner into a full vulnerability assessment tool:

```bash
# Run default scripts (safe, informational)
sudo nmap --script=default 192.168.56.101

# Check for specific vulnerabilities
sudo nmap --script=vuln 192.168.56.101

# HTTP enumeration (directories, methods, server info)
sudo nmap --script=http-enum 192.168.56.101 -p 80

# SMB vulnerability check (EternalBlue, etc.)
sudo nmap --script=smb-vuln* 192.168.56.101 -p 445

# FTP anonymous login check
sudo nmap --script=ftp-anon 192.168.56.101 -p 21

# How many scripts are available?
ls /usr/share/nmap/scripts/ | wc -l
# > 600+ scripts!
```

The `--script=vuln` category is particularly powerful -- it actively checks for known vulnerabilities and outputs CVE numbers with descriptions:

```bash
sudo nmap --script=vuln 192.168.56.101
```

On Metasploitable2, this will flag things like: \

Each finding is a potential entry point.

You can also write your own NSE scripts (they're Lua, pretty straightforward if you've done the Learn Python Series and understand the concepts -- Lua syntax is actually simpler than Python in many ways). But for now, the 600+ built-in scripts will keep us busy for a _long_ time.

Having said that, don't treat NSE output as gospel. Scripts have false positives, especially the `vuln` category. A script might flag \

based on a version string match without actually confirming the vulnerability is exploitable. Always verify findings manually before including them in a report. The tool gives you leads; _you_ do the confirmation.

### Banner Grabbing the Manual Way

Before Nmap, pentesters grabbed banners by hand -- connecting to a port with `netcat` or `telnet` and reading what the service sent back. We did a simplified version of this in episode 3. It's still useful because sometimes you want to interact with a service directly rather than through Nmap's abstraction layer:

```bash
# FTP banner
nc 192.168.56.101 21

# SSH banner
nc 192.168.56.101 22

# SMTP banner
nc 192.168.56.101 25

# HTTP banner (need to send a request)
echo -e \

| nc 192.168.56.101 80
```

Each of these will spit back a banner identifying the service and (usually) the version. FTP servers are especially chatty -- they'll tell you the software name, version, and sometimes the operating system, all before you even authenticate.

The important thing to internalize is _why_ services do this. It's a relic from a friendlier era of computing, when knowing what software you were connecting to was considered helpful. The FTP RFC says servers SHOULD send a greeting. SSH sends its version string as part of the protocol handshake. SMTP announces itself to comply with email delivery standards. These aren't bugs -- they're features. Features that happen to be _incredibly_ useful to attackers.

Modern security hardening includes stripping version information from banners. An Apache server can be configured to only say `Server: Apache` instead of `Server: Apache/2.4.52 (Ubuntu)`. SSH can be configured to send a generic version string. But the default configuration for almost every service in existence is to tell you everything. And defaults are what most people run.

### Writing Your Own Port Scanner

As with everything in this series: understanding the tool by building it yourself. Here's a concurrent port scanner in Python that brings together concepts from the Learn Python Series (sockets, threading, queues):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
\

import sys
import threading
from queue import Queue
from datetime import datetime

def scan_port(target, port, results):

    thread_list = []
    queue = Queue()

    for port in range(port_range[0], port_range[1] + 1):
        queue.put(port)

    def worker():
        while not queue.empty():
            port = queue.get()
            scan_port(target, port, results)
            queue.task_done()

    for _ in range(min(threads, port_range[1] - port_range[0] + 1)):
        t = threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True)
        t.start()
        thread_list.append(t)

    queue.join()

    results.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    print(f\
)\n    for port, banner in results:\n        banner_str = f\
