title.title: Yellow toy - Entry contest #422 [ENG-ESP]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVVfTdzyREqmsv8cS3fwYQWfaL9WcV5K45BTrW2riRrz/image.png) At first glance, the yellow toy seems simple: small, rigid, motionless, and, above all, almost stationary on the floor. However, once you start playing with it, you’ll discover the many movements it can make; moreover, its geometric shapes, color, and mechanical design make it something far more incredible and unique. But it isn’t the toy itself that really catches your attention—it’s the small shadow surrounding it. Behind the toy, projected onto the floor, appears a larger, deeper, more realistic silhouette of the toy itself—and it is not a simple dark shadow; it is another version of the same object. One that has no color, no details, and only appears when there is light. While the toy remains still, the shadow seems to spread out, as if it wanted to escape beyond the limits and at the same time convey something it cannot. Furthermore, at that moment the light defines the object, but it is the shadow that interprets it, and what we see is not always what matters most. >El juguete amarillo parece simple a primera vista, pequeño, rígido, sin movimientos y sobre todo casi inmóvil sobre el suelo. Sin embargo, una vez que comienzas a jugar con él tendrás cuentas de muchos movimientos que puede hacer, además sus formas geométricas, su color, su diseño mecánico, permite que sea algo mucho más increíble y único. Pero no es él juegue lo que realmente llama la atención, sino la pequeña sombra que lo rodea. # >Detrás de del juguete, proyectada sobre el suelo aparece una silueta más grande, más profunda, más real de dicho juguete y no es una simple sombra oscura, es otra versión del mismo objeto. Una que no tiene color, no tiene detalles y solo aparece cuando hay luz. # >Mientras el juguete permanece firme, la sombra parece extenderse, como si quisiera escapar más allá de los límites y a la vez poder contar algo no puede. Además, en ese punto la luz define al objeto, pero es la sombra la que lo interpreta y lo que vemos no siempre es lo que más importa. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBe4B8DLqEkT1AjB7j7y9FcWbVjAUtCG2XhQZwJqvDVa/image.png) The entire scene can change without the object moving, since the silhouette on the ground is not constant. It lengthens, shortens, and distorts—all depending on the light—and at times it seems larger than the object itself, while at other times it almost disappears. But it is always there, accompanying us, reminding us that everything that exists also has a version that cannot be touched. The shadow remains intact, and in that silent relationship—almost invisible unless observed closely—there is a simple yet powerful idea: not everything that defines something lies in what is directly visible; your eyes can see beyond. Sometimes, the most interesting thing is right next to it, in that dark space that few pause to look at. >Toda esa escena puede cambiar sin que el objeto se mueva, ya que la silueta en el suelo no es constante. Se alarga, se acorta, se distorsiona todo dependerá de la luz y en varias veces parece más grande que el propio objeto, otras veces casi desaparece. Pero siempre está ahí, acompañando, recordando que todo lo que existe también tiene una versión que no se puede tocar. # >La sombra se mantiene completa y en esa relación silenciosa, casi invisible si no se observa con atención, hay una idea sencilla, pero poderosa: no todo lo que define algo está en lo que se ve directamente, tus ojos pueden ver más allá. A veces, lo más interesante está justo al lado, en ese espacio oscuro que pocos se detienen a mirar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3eLHkqHdt5wtNp1orBsLFBsujepqwNkYoP1Aa8ZDuYh/image.png)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1YQAsu4GB81sVj4eS7YynfmSoXYhjpF5CvEkReLPj1r/image.png)

title.title: СРБИЈА: Врисак у празнину
title.body:
![Corac-2026-04-20_131055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/23yJ5a6m78Pbz6Bn9DpsgEfNbdRGhPXYcZdkjJgkVekb4yyMcNTCFHqD9NcZmhFey5SgY.jpg)
Source / Извор: [Снимак екрана](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cOnOhXve81c)

#
[Automatic translation into English]()

### Знам да вриштање не помаже, али да парафразирам једног ‘пробуђеног’ западног новинара, иначе добитника Пулицерове награде: „Могуће је да нам ово што говоримо личи на врисак у празнину, али кад ништа друго не преостаје, вриштати се мора…“
У историјском нестанку народа коме наметнуше идентитет ‘Срба’, угаони камен биће предаја Косова и Метохије без зрна барута. Без страшног стида због предаје великог дела популације терористичкој групи под заштитом западних сила. Без савести, која би свакако – да је има – против овако одвратне и очигледне велеиздаје подигла побуну. Тај кукавичлук увек се плаћао најскупљом монетом – крвљу. Пред Васкрс, на Велики четвртак гост је код Вука Росандића био др Александар Ћорац, редовни професор на Медицинском факултету у Приштини са седиштем у Косовској Митровици. Он је један од тих мученика са Косова и Метохије који су, захваљујући велеиздајничкој политици колонијалне управе, преко ноћи постао странац на сопственом огњишту! #### Професор Александар Ћорац. Трајање: 1:24:14 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cOnOhXve81c 00:00:00 Интро 00:01:38 Имејл као сведочанство велеиздаје и губљење емпатије према суграђанима 00:13:00 Братина: Полиција има право да убија студенте! 00:18:00 Растурање Србије неће стати на отцепљењу Косова и Метохије 00:22:30 Не сме се дозволити прихватање велеиздаје као чињеничног стања 00:32:00 „Договорено ја да ви будете подручје за рударење!“ Предаја ресурса 00:36:40 Рио Тинто добио прикључак на ЕПС 00:46:22 Распад патриотске опозиције и величање велеиздаје 00:55:00 Подела у Српском националном форуму на Косову и Метохији 00:57:00 Технологија застрашивања патриота и заблуда о победи 01:02:00 Закон о води за пиће – приватизација као увод у уништење народа 01:13:20

>Приватизација Националног института за контролу воде „Јарослав Черни“ 01:15:30 Профит изнад здравља и живота 01:17:10 Нико се неће спасти говорећи: „Ми нисмо знали!“ #
* * *
Његова је прича трагично сведочанство нашег колективног саучествовања у велеиздаји и самоуништењу. Јер савременим средствима много је лакше уништити читав један народ него коришћењем примитивних, садистичких средстава због којих је направљена усташка ‘независна држава’ 1941. И која се данас повампирила с благословом јерархије СПЦ и велеиздајничке колонијалне управе. Обе ‘институције’ без икаквог стида тргују јасеновачким мученицима, Косовом и Метохијом, Старом Србијом, долином Јадра… сасвим лепо показујући колико им је стало до вас народе, и до ваше будућности. Данас ће Рио Тинто почети бушење и тровање воде. Онда ће нагло порасти број терминалних обољења. Људи ће давати сву имовину у нади да постоји оздрављење. Само ће пребацити све своје богатство фармакомафији, док рударска мафија буде пљачкала ресурсе. И нико неће бити оптужен нити осуђен за тај геноцид, јер – све је урађено по закону! Ваши су представници све прихватили и потписали! Сутра ће на ред доћи ‘Прешевска долина’, Топлички крај… Тамо се већ некажњено отвара ватра према полицајцима. Нико не одговара. Па ће онда на ред доћи Рашка област. Па Војводина… И никад неће стати док то демонско ћутање и чекање на још једне ‘изборе’ са извесним резултатом, и даље траје. Године 1950, након страшног страдања у Другом Светском рату, један лутерански пастор по имену Мартин Нимелер, оставио је следећу поему:
![Poem_by_Martin_Niemoeller_at_the_the_Holocaust_memorial_in_Boston_MA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lighteye/Eoc6YvRhWKuYeqwqSTDrRQWC6pzzsnHCUpZZwCCGbBr3yaQLKjw32bJKcYKDmy8HHTW.jpg)
Source / Извор: [wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_They_Came#/media/File:Poem_by_Martin_Niemoeller_at_the_the_Holocaust_memorial_in_Boston_MA.jpg)
[Прво су дошли](https://sr.wikipedia.org/sr-ec/Prvo_su_do%C5%A1li...) Прво су дошли по комунисте    А ја сам ћутао јер нисам био комуниста Онда су дошли по социјалисте    А ја сам ћутао јер нисам био социјалиста Онда су дошли по синдикалце    А ја сам ћутао јер нисам био синдикалац Онда су дошли по Јевреје    А ја сам ћутао јер нисам био Јеврејин Кад су дошли по мене    није било никога да се због мене побуни #
* * *

Сви који су одбили да подрже студентски отпор током бројних прошлогодишњих позива на генерални штрајк, ухваћени су у претпоследњем стиху.
#
Зато се вриштати мора.
Макар да се разбије самртна тишина.
Макар као последњи чин пре нестанка у празнину…

title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

I never thought I’d say this, but here we are. The Jobbers are taking over WOO! And honestly? I’m completely on board. What started as a small addition has turned into something much bigger. It’s changed how I look at the game, how I approach collecting, and even how I think about future events.

>*Don't miss out on yet another limited time event from WOO, \

, taking place from 6th April 2026 till 30th April 2026! Go to [THIS LINK](https://play.wrestlingorganizationonline.com/event) to join and get another chance to win even more WOO Jobber packs now!*

---

## **Some quite thoughts from me (as usual)**

* **The rise of Jobbers has added a new layer of excitement to WOO.**
  
What used to feel like background content now feels essential. That shift has made the game more engaging overall.

* **The ongoing events keep the momentum alive.**
  
Instead of one-off experiences, WOO is creating a continuous flow of content that keeps players invested.

* **The collection aspect has become more meaningful over time.**
  
Every card now feels like part of a larger journey rather than just an isolated asset.

* **The community engagement around these events has been noticeable.**
  
Players are talking, sharing, and reacting more. That energy is what keeps a game alive.

* **The future of WOO feels more exciting than ever.**
  
If this is the direction things are heading, I can’t wait to see what comes next.

## **And so to round up everything I've just said...**

The Jobbers are here. Not just as extras, but as a driving force. And if this is what a takeover looks like in WOO… Then I’m all in.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: A MOVIE THAT CHANGED MY LOVE LIFE
title.body:
Hello , everyone your welcome to my blog today.

Love in every word is a romantic love movie that comes with a lot of intense emotions and love surrounded by a lot of struggles but at the end love always wins.The main actor's in this movie are bambam Bamike oluwami and uzor arukwe. Obiora who played the role of the rich business man popularly known as odogwu para,and bambam as chioma the hardworking young lady who is running her own perfume brand.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmS5KcNVqSyPkCyptfxtppo9vQ6TCDqt9X7CP9NSC18yrP/147473.jpg 




 Apart from the two main characters let's not forget about the major role played by Thelma chukwunwen as chioma s mother yes she was a very supportive mother and she was always by her daughter. Even as a woman who was abandoned by her husband she stood by her daughter and set a good example for her.And then down to her two best friends ify and ivie everyone deserves to have someone like those two in their lifes , their support towards her in the course of the movie was one I appreciate so much. The way they all prayed for her to be loved right, for her business to flourish that shows true friendship.

The fact that we ladies see the good man right in front of us and we are willing to let him go because of something as small as his local accent, so chioma was not impressed was not impressed with the traditional Igbo man she got herself.But then there is one thing about love that is pure it always strives and it did for this two. The role of odogwus mother Lolo which was played out by patience ozokwo . When she got the information that chioma father wasn't present in her life and wanted her out of her son's life .

But uzor odogwu paranra played a fast one on them and set them up to meet at the resort without them knowing each other before and they happened to cross part in the most beautiful way ever and she reconnected with odogwu para .Let's not forget ify who literally wore black and black to mourn chioma and odogwu s break up , it was the highlight for me. And the grand wedding at the end showcases the pride in African and Igbo culture.

Talking about how this movie impacted my life, I would day I have been unfortunate when it comes to love and this movies renews my hope that  lobe can come from the strangest places and from people we don't expect and still stand the test of time.

There was a point where she's almost lost the man because of some family issues but their love stood the test of time.

Thank you for stopping by my blog today.

title.title: Is there protection for sinners || Mcgi topic review
title.body: The bible teaches us that God is merciful in everything he does and he treats everyone equally no matter if you're a sinner. Sin separated us from God but still God loves us he wants us to come back to him. Throughout Scripture, God offers refuge to those who turn to Him with humility and repentance, showing that His protection is closely tied to His mercy and grace rather than human perfection.\nhttps://youtu.be/1vsr_G6DxJE?si=j2ar0ljxv2CDlDVi\nAnd we must know that, not because God protects us doesn't mean we should continue to wallow in sin. God’s protection is often connected to a changed heart and a willingness to turn away from sin. Those who persist in rebellion place themselves outside of His covering, not because God refuses to protect, but because they reject His ways. True security is found when a sinner acknowledges their need for God and seeks His forgiveness.

Quanti documenti servono realmente per ottenere la residenza permanente a Panama? Molti meno di quanto immagini. La lista è essenziale: un passaporto con almeno sei mesi di validità, un secondo documento d’identità come patente o carta d’identità e cinque fototessere. L’elemento più importante è il casellario giudiziale apostillato, che attesta l’assenza di precedenti penali. Se ti trasferisci con la famiglia, serviranno anche il certificato di matrimonio o l'estratto di nascita dei figli, entrambi apostillati. Molti di questi documenti sono richiedibili comodamente online e l'intera pratica può essere istruita in poche settimane. Se desideri una guida passo passo per non commettere errori nella raccolta dei documenti, visita il nostro Beacons in bio. title.title: Ні, Ірландія не “висилає” українців: розбираємо, що відбувається насправді
title.body: **“Ірландія повертає 16 тисяч українців додому**” — ви бачили цю новину? Вчора вона була всюди… звучить страшно. Але це не правда В інформаційному просторі вибухові речення зараз розходяться дуже швидко. І викликають паніку. Одними лише заголовками.

/>

[джерело](https://www.facebook.com/photo?fbid=1402530231904369&set=a.629249029232497)

**Розбираємо що з цього правда, що «хайп»**

Факти:

▪️Ніхто не прийняв рішення “повернути українців до кінця року”.

▪️Йдеться про інше:  
держава планує поступово припиняти надання житла приблизно для 16 000 людей.

Це неприємно. Але це не депортація.

▪️Людей не “відправляють додому”.  
Їм доведеться самостійно шукати житло в Ірландії. Про повернення готелів туристичному бізнесу говорять вже не перший рік! То це вже не новина навіть…

▪️Про виплати:  
€2 500 на людину або до €10 000 на сім’ю — це не нова “програма для українців”.

Це стандартна схема добровільного повернення, яка існує давно і працює для різних категорій.

▪️Так, Ірландія змінює політику:  
менше підтримки, більше самостійності.

І це тенденція, яку вже видно по всій Європі. І до цього потрібно бути готовими.  
Джерело ([https://www.thetimes.com/world/ireland-world/article/ukraine-refugees-immigration-package-ireland-qk5ns56wj?](https://www.thetimes.com/world/ireland-world/article/ukraine-refugees-immigration-package-ireland-qk5ns56wj?))

title.title: El lenguaje del amor cuando los pasos se cansan: Los 84 de Santa / The Language of Love When Steps Grow Tired: Santa’s 84th
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyUXha7gd4UV4jHq1efzt1w2sq3yRDgxLAwXEGt6wPoG/1776685812070.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNR4u44ptFYz9a4Ze21qsSDHJVzymhVEU9GrhdC6xNwo/1776685890572.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWR7BhrSQFp1yTmd1mGRo9MkbR6GLy3QpVKAf1UrhoNS/1776686230300.jpg)


​🌸｡･::･ﾟ🦋｡･::･ﾟ🦋｡･:*:･ﾟ🌸

ESPAÑOL 

Las abuelas tienen un idioma propio que no necesita de palabras; se traduce en el tiempo que nos regalan, en la paciencia infinita de sus manos y en ese amor que parece no agotarse nunca. Ser abuela es convertirse en un puente entre el pasado y el futuro, entregando en cada abrazo un sinfín de historias, consejos y una ternura que nos moldea el alma. Ellas no solo nos dan su tiempo; nos entregan su vida entera, tejida con hilos de sacrificio y dulzura, recordándonos que el amor más puro es aquel que se da sin esperar nada a cambio.

Hay una belleza particular en las reuniones familiares, en el olor a pasto y en las risas que llenan los espacios. Hace unos días, nos reunimos para celebrar la vida de una mujer que es raíz y calma para nosotros: Santa.

Cumplir 84 años es un hito, pero celebrarlos cuando el cuerpo ya no responde como antes tiene un significado más profundo. Santa ya no camina, y verla allí, sentada bajo la sombra de los árboles, nos dio una lección silenciosa: el amor no necesita que corramos hacia él; el amor es saber quedarse al lado de quien ahora necesita que nosotros seamos sus pasos.

Fue una tarde de esas que se sienten \

. Sin pretensiones, solo nosotros, el sol filtrándose entre las ramas y ese sombrero de paja que ya es parte de su esencia. El pastel fue un homenaje a su dulzura: blanco, puro y adornado con flores pequeñitas, recordándonos que la sabiduría no siempre viene en grandes discursos; a veces, es simplemente estar y dejarse querer.

No hubo grandes lujos, pero sí un ambiente inolvidable. Porque la vejez puede ser dura, pero cuando se acompaña de manos que te sostienen, se convierte en un descanso merecido. Gracias, Santa, por enseñarnos que para ser el centro del mundo de alguien, no hace falta dar un solo paso, solo hace falta haber amado tanto como tú.

Muchas gracias por acompañarme y leer mi post. Espero que lo hayas disfrutado.

🌸｡･::･ﾟ🦋｡･::･ﾟ🦋｡･:*:･ﾟ🌸


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyUXha7gd4UV4jHq1efzt1w2sq3yRDgxLAwXEGt6wPoG/1776686782123.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNR4u44ptFYz9a4Ze21qsSDHJVzymhVEU9GrhdC6xNwo/1776686807474.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPL3CpWA5EwpfeE5pb9HiBZJw2Xp6MdqttY3g3cFn7eNw/1776686851924.jpg)


ENGLISH 

Grandmothers have a language of their own that needs no words; it is translated into the time they gift us, the infinite patience of their hands, and a love that seems to never run dry. Being a grandmother means becoming a bridge between the past and the future, delivering through every hug an endless array of stories, advice, and a tenderness that shapes our souls. They don’t just give us their time; they give us their entire lives, woven with threads of sacrifice and sweetness, reminding us that the purest love is that which is given without expecting anything in return.

There is a particular beauty in family gatherings, in the scent of grass, and in the laughter that fills the air. A few days ago, we gathered to celebrate the life of a woman who is both our root and our calm: Santa.

Turning 84 is a milestone, but celebrating them when the body no longer responds as it once did carries a deeper meaning. Santa can no longer walk, and seeing her there, sitting under the shade of the trees, gave us a silent lesson: love doesn't need us to run toward it; love is knowing how to stay by the side of the one who now needs us to be their steps.

It was one of those afternoons that felt \

Unpretentious, just us, the sun filtering through the branches, and that straw hat that is now part of her essence. The cake was a tribute to her sweetness: white, pure, and adorned with tiny flowers, reminding us that wisdom doesn't always come in grand speeches; sometimes, it’s simply about being there and letting yourself be loved. There were no great luxuries, but there was an unforgettable atmosphere. Because old age can be tough, but when accompanied by hands that hold you, it becomes a well-deserved rest. Thank you, Santa, for teaching us that to be the center of someone’s world, you don't need to take a single step; you only need to have loved as much as you have. Thank you very much for joining me and reading my post. I hope you enjoyed it.

title.title: Celebrating 6 years on the Hive blockchain and even more
title.body:
Just these days I got a new personal badge for 6 years on the Hive blockchain and that showed me how fast time passes when you you have a good time. And that is just the amount since the Hive forked as I am present on this blockchain since 2017, but together with the fork I have moved all my funds to a new account. Summed up that would be around 9 years, which I cannot believe how much I have been around the Hive blockchain and the ecosystems built here.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23wgFkA5nFQgXh8f1djjQScmvKdaWcqUguXYT5evq8eLf2GhoatWVQ2ffNfRrPBspEnmt.png)

This was a journey with ups and downs, with hype and despair and considering how many crypto projects fail each year, I believe that the Hive blockchain stood the test of time. We had and still have big expectations from this ecosystem, even now when the price is under $0.10. But the user base and communities from here are the ones that are keeping the flame burning and help it survive in the hardest times.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23w2gwysk1qYwt33UP9NSvrANtLEgFQy3Z1W9gNPjCgm31e85iin55PNzV9RNoBw7BYH5.png)

Another year has passed and I am still here and believe in HIVE above everything that's around in this ecosystem. The power and responsibility that it holds we all can feel it and through being here, holding and even investing we can participate in shaping its future. It is not easy, many of us gave up, but I still see the light at the end of the tunnel and I believe that with some innovative ideas and smart moves, we might transform this space into something much greater.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23t7FUE1BUnSUt5ygXjj2MgytbrZHDvZ8mYysDsTYdhHPn4KFpbWX4SUxpupKnr6sdVSm.png

What the future will bring us is hard to predict, but what I believe is that we need to improve the tokenomics by spending more carefully and focus on projects and futures that capture value from the outside word and bring it within. With all the clouds that are upon the crypto market in general and Hive blockchain ecosystem in special, I think that there are still some sun lights that keep us going. I am one of the \
from around here and I hope this ecosystem will keep on going and growing.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@behiver/celebrating-6-years-on-the-hive-blockchain-and-even-more-jfg)

title.title: New Cards I Bought to Upgrade
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2ZgvnKpm3yE7ja33KwKgmd6LrVFCip9gXqjMu6aPubn/image.png)

Greetings to all Splinterlands players and hive gaming community! I bought new cards to upgrade the ones I already have. Most of the cards were gifted to me by our guild officer. I upgraded some of them while also upgrading my Foundation set. With the new cards, I briefly reached Gold level last season before dropping back to Silver. I already got my advancement reward chest this season and received a Splintervibes: Mantaroth. I don't have the Mantaroth card so I offered the music for sale. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***New Cards I Bought to Upgrade***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNjWGuLaQunL1sfP5Tomdpv2oNiBkdTzKLK1s9qsT2vvD/image.png)

I bought a lot of cards to upgrade the ones I have. I bought Conclave Arcana cards and Foundation cards. I play in fray one that uses Foundation cards so I have to upgrade them to contribute better in our brawls.

**Portly Cannoneer**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7MwLef64paciKjXhHnekRpLR13Nd6mPdZHe1SwtpRF6/image.png)

I bought four cards to make my card to level two. It increased its attack by one. I use this card to support melee units. Having increased its attack is a nice upgrade to contribute on offense.

**Mindless Thrall**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvj8iUdKLuV6QtYD4Lr8efjPDxvASjDbtab98UR2Tiax/image.png)

This card shows up in 90% of my games. This is a reward card that can be obtained for free in chests. I couldn't wait so I decided to buy two cards and upgraded it to level three. It powered up its magic attack to three. Now I have two cards with three magic attack when I use the water element.

**Vicious Giraffe**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyRTGqL4A4uktMpPDWoMswWUYxhFhYWHnNZLNNkkWYoN/image.png)

My guildmate gifted me a level two Giraffe together with Cavewise Wayfinder. The pair works best if the giraffe is at level three with Painforge skill. I bought the cards I needed and upgraded it to three. I'm also planning to upgrade Wayfinder to three to get an extra attack.

**Silverleaf Warlock**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPxbEP1sZQfCksHa2HSMaX6ppHiBQ6r3dnpCpnbtHApJt/image.png)

I had this card at level one for so long. Upgrading it to two gave it Swiftness skill. It benefits the whole team by giving them extra speed. 

**Foundation Set Cards**

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7sWMRpBBXfPFNCwUJeUGBYGocghPrKfrM6XJ8Lyiy1s/image.png)</center>

I bought Foundation set cards to bring them to maximum level. It will give me an advantage as I noticed many of the opponents I face in brawls have lower level cards. Having maximum level cards will help me contribute better in our guild brawls. There are more cards that need to be maxed, mostly the epic and legendary cards. As for core and escalation sets, there's still many cards that need upgrade.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)



***My Referrals***

If this post interests you and you are not playing Splinterlands yet, please consider joining this wonderful game using my referral.

https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=iamchessguy

Be active. Walk or run and earn afit tokens! Join me at actifit.io

title.title: Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children (2016) [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>Today I want to share a story that, unfortunately, wasn't continued. I felt it had a lot of potential; however, from what I read back then, and even now with summaries of the first three books I found online, while visually it did the books justice, narratively it left much to be desired. Many felt the story was better suited to a series than a two-hour film. Anyway, since I didn't read the books (only summaries and reviews), this time I'll give my opinion of the film itself. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074155_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tkozsRtUnj2QQU6DafHF6wP8WnKbkiG8vMZwMKRHSkwki5q3e1ydHc8878rzMTkfjgM.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm4176156928/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_1) ---
> # Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children…. ---

>Released in 2016 and directed by Tim Burton, this fantasy story is based on Ransom Riggs's Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children books. It stars Eva Green, Asa Butterfield, Ella Purnell, Terence Stamp, Samuel L. Jackson, and many more. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074258_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EnyoyAK44MhuGAxnd3i62uLAB4cGcQqkyecWmnU8T1ktNCEfS9R5aE4ZaM1vpMm2eZP.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm2454589953/?ref_=ttmi_mi_9_1) ---

>The story follows Jacob Portman, a teenager who, after the tragic and mysterious death of his grandfather and several events in his life, decides to embark on a journey to a remote island in Wales to investigate the stories he heard as a child from his grandfather about an orphanage for children with peculiar abilities and its headmistress, Miss Peregrine. What sounded like fantasy, our protagonist soon discovers were not mere children's tales from his grandfather. ---

>Although this orphanage was destroyed in its time, he will come to understand that this place is actually trapped in a loop that repeats the same day in 1943, leading him to meet all these children with fantastic abilities in person. As he delves deeper into this new universe, he discovers that his arrival is no coincidence and that these children live in hiding because they are stalked by dark forces and terrifying creatures. Jacob must decide whether to return to his ordinary life or accept his own destiny to help his new friends survive a threat that only he can detect. What will our protagonist decide? Will they all manage to escape the danger that awaits them? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074355_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EnyoS39CyrZzF4jAoLxC2v3VxSs4DSDqB9Cc7zpqx5hBjnmYpHcoLex2dyUJtc821Vh.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm3337296128/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_2) ---

>Ultimately, the entire film has that Tim Burton feel; you know for sure that he had a hand in this story, which, from the beginning, very effectively builds Jacob's sense of isolation in Florida, contrasting it with the gray and foggy atmosphere of Wales. It draws you into that curiosity, mystery, and what the protagonist is going through. The story's structure feels solid because it presents the rules of the world and the characters organically. However, when it reaches the climax, well, it falters dramatically. Here you understand why fans of the books said a series was better, as the pace accelerates abruptly, and you try to understand what's happening. Furthermore, what began as a gothic fairy tale becomes a conventional action battle that somewhat breaks with the elegance of the initial mystery. ---

>As ​​for the set design, there's no complaint. Burton uses a desaturated color palette for the real world and a vibrant, almost Technicolor, saturation for the 1943 time loop. This psychologically reinforces the idea that the quirky world is \
than reality. The house design (filmed at Torenhof Castle in Belgium) is a character in itself. The interior decoration, filled with antiques and curiosities, creates a \
atmosphere that is pure Burton. ---

>Now then, regarding the performances, Eva Green as Miss Peregrine was definitely a very good choice; she knows how to portray those mysterious characters very well. However, I feel that the protagonist lacked something; he seemed a bit flat, not very memorable. And Samuel L. Jackson, although I love his acting, also felt that his performance was somewhat comical, given the mysterious and gothic atmosphere the story was building. I don't know if the character he plays in the book is like that—an entertaining villain, but not very threatening. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074431_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoCataftrBxB63aQaHruDvMefaLS7vH4o3WoH4CrbfrDTXDdXVjcA4TsrW7s8AVn1hk.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm3454736640/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1) ---

aesthetic: The blend of the macabre with the beautiful is perfect; every corner of the orphanage feels like a Gothic painting, undoubtedly its strongest point.\n- Eva Green as Miss Peregrine: She is, by far, the best thing about the film. Her performance is captivating and captures that \

energy with nervous tics and a sharp elegance. - The concept of Time Loops: The idea of ​​reliving a perfect day in 1943 to escape death is fascinating and very well executed visually, especially in the scene where time resets under the bombing. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074457_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wgBFnr2CFUXig3oECzH7ESFjy1UuurGAGL11SdaEzoEaJJfqNA34NReBGGzFHT9PeHp.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm3471513856/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2) ---

> - The cartoonish villain: Samuel L. Jackson is a great actor, but his portrayal of Mr. Barron falls into excessive comedy. - Changes to details of the original story. - The protagonist lacked something; he felt flat. - Fast pace, especially in the ending. - Chemistry between the protagonists: The relationship between Jacob (Asa Butterfield) and Emma feels somewhat forced and flat. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074548_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo45KT4Kfn6vtCBqaR5rCHJ4egYSXVc1w6VSVxdbsrBNtxFXYMDHYhsQ6vqLncxhmuS.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm1629263873/?ref_=ttmi_mi_25_2) ---
>6.5/10 Story │ 7.5/10 Acting │ 8/10 Sound │ 9.5/10 Stage Design │ 7.5/10 Overall ---

>It's a technically brilliant and visually hypnotic film. Its greatest strength is capturing the feeling of being out of the ordinary, something Burton does better than anyone. Its biggest flaw is the script, which towards the end loses faith in its own strangeness in an attempt to please an audience looking for fast-paced action. And, as many say, if it had remained somewhat faithful to the book—perhaps not completely, but by changing the abilities of its main characters—the film would have been better received. I'm very sorry they didn't continue producing his trilogy; I hope someone is inspired to make it into a series, like the Percy Jackson one. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

# ESPAÑOL
---

>Hoy quiero traerles una historia que lamentablemente no continuaron, sintiendo que tenia mucho potencial, sin embargo, en lo que pude leer en ese entonces, incluso ahorita con resúmenes de los 3 primeros libros que encontré en internet, pues como visualmente si le hizo justica, más narrativamente dejo mucho que desear, queriendo que muchos se sintiesen que la historia dama más para una serie, que para un filme de solo dos horas. En fin, como no leí los libros (solo resúmenes y opiniones) esta vez daré mi opinión del filme como tal. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074155_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tkozsRtUnj2QQU6DafHF6wP8WnKbkiG8vMZwMKRHSkwki5q3e1ydHc8878rzMTkfjgM.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm4176156928/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_1) ---
> # Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children…. ---

>Estrenada para el año 2016, bajo la dirección de Tim Burton, una historia de fantasía basada en los libros de Ransom Riggs El hogar de Miss Peregrine para niños peculiares. Fue protagonizada por Eva Green, Asa Butterfield, Ella Purnell, Terence Stamp, Samuel L. Jackson y muchos más. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074258_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EnyoyAK44MhuGAxnd3i62uLAB4cGcQqkyecWmnU8T1ktNCEfS9R5aE4ZaM1vpMm2eZP.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm2454589953/?ref_=ttmi_mi_9_1) ---

>La historia sigue a Jacob Portman, un adolescente que, tras la trágica y misteriosamente muerte de su abuelo y varios sucesos en su entorno, decide emprender un viaje hacia una remota isla en Gales para investigar las historias que escuchaba de niño, por parte de su abuelo, de un orfanato de niños con habilidades peculiares y de la directora del mismo, Miss Peregrine. Lo que sonaba como fantasía, pronto nuestro protagonista reafirmara que no eran puros cuentos infantiles de su abuelo. ---

>Pues, aunque en su tiempo, este orfanato estaba destruido, comprenderá que realmente ese lugar esta dentro de un bucle que repite el mismo día de 1943, llevándolos a conocer personalmente a todos esos niños con habilidades fantásticas. A medida que se adentra en este nuevo universo, descubre que su llegada no es una coincidencia y que estos niños viven escondidos porque son acechados por fuerzas oscuras y criaturas terroríficas. Jacob deberá decidir si regresar a su vida ordinaria o aceptar su propio destino para ayudar a sus nuevos amigos a sobrevivir a una amenaza que solo él puede detectar ¿Qué decidirá nuestro protagonista? ¿lograrán salvarse todos del peligro que les asecha. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074355_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EnyoS39CyrZzF4jAoLxC2v3VxSs4DSDqB9Cc7zpqx5hBjnmYpHcoLex2dyUJtc821Vh.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm3337296128/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_2) ---

>En definitiva, todo el filme tiene ese aire de Tim Burton, sabes con certeza de que el puso manos en esta historia, la cual, al inicio, construye muy bien el sentimiento de aislamiento de Jacob en Florida, contrastándolo con la atmósfera gris y neblinosa de Gales; te adentra a esa curiosidad, misterio y lo que se encuentra atravesando el protagonista en sí. La estructura de la historia se siente sólida porque nos presenta las reglas del mundo y a los personajes de forma orgánica, sin embargo, cuando ya llega el punto del climax, mmm, falla dramáticamente, aquí logras comprender por qué los fans de los libros manifestaron que era mejor una serie, ya que el ritmo se acelera abruptamente, y tratas de entender lo que esta ocurriendo, agregando que, lo que empezó como un cuento de hadas gótico se convierte en una batalla de acción convencional que rompe un poco con la elegancia del misterio inicial. ---

>En cuanto, a la escenografía, no hay queja, Burton usa una paleta de colores desaturada para el mundo real y una saturación vibrante, casi technicolor, para el bucle de 1943, esto hace que, psicológicamente, se refuerce visualmente la idea de que el mundo peculiar es \

que la realidad. El diseño de la casa (rodada en el castillo de Torenhof en Bélgica) es un personaje en sí mismo. La decoración interna, llena de objetos antiguos y curiosidades, crea una atmósfera de \
que es pura esencia Burton. ---

>Ahora bien, con las actuaciones, en definitiva, Eva green como Miss Peregrine fue una elección muy acertada, sabe manifestar muy bien esos personajes misteriosos, sin embargo, siento que le falto algo más al protagonista, lo sentía algo plano, no destaca mucho y Samuel L Jackson, aunque me encanta como actúa, también lo sentí con una interpretación cómica para todo el aura misterioso y gótico que se venía cargando la historia, no sé si en el libro, el personaje que el interpreta es así, el ser un villano entretenido, pero poco amenazante. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074431_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EoCataftrBxB63aQaHruDvMefaLS7vH4o3WoH4CrbfrDTXDdXVjcA4TsrW7s8AVn1hk.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm3454736640/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1) ---

: La mezcla de lo macabro con lo hermoso es perfecta; cada rincón del orfanato se siente como un cuadro gótico, sin duda alguna, es su punto fuerte. \n- Eva Green como Miss Peregrine: Es, por mucho, lo mejor de la cinta. Su actuación es atrayente y captura esa energía de \

con tics nerviosos y una elegancia cortante. - Concepto de los Bucles Temporales: La idea de vivir en un día perfecto de 1943 para escapar de la muerte es fascinante y está muy bien ejecutada visualmente, especialmente en la escena donde el tiempo se reinicia bajo el bombardeo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074457_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wgBFnr2CFUXig3oECzH7ESFjy1UuurGAGL11SdaEzoEaJJfqNA34NReBGGzFHT9PeHp.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm3471513856/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2) ---

> - El villano caricaturesco: Samuel L. Jackson es un gran actor, pero su interpretación de Mr. Barron cae en el exceso de comedia. - Cambios en detalles de la historia original. - Al protagonista le falto algo, se sintió plano. - Ritmo acelerado, sobre todo en el desenlace. - Química entre los protagonistas: La relación entre Jacob (Asa Butterfield) y Emma se siente un poco forzada y plana. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-04-20_074548_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eo45KT4Kfn6vtCBqaR5rCHJ4egYSXVc1w6VSVxdbsrBNtxFXYMDHYhsQ6vqLncxhmuS.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt1935859/mediaviewer/rm1629263873/?ref_=ttmi_mi_25_2) ---
>6.5/10 Historia │ 7.5/10 Actuaciones │ 8/10 Sonido │ 9.5/10 Escenario │ 7.5/10 General ---

>Es una película técnicamente brillante y visualmente hipnótica. Su mayor acierto es capturar la sensación de ser un fuera de lo común, algo que Burton sabe hacer mejor que nadie. Su mayor fallo es el guion, que hacia el final pierde la confianza en su propia extrañeza para intentar complacer al público que busca acción rápida, y como dicen mucho, si se hubiese mantenido algo fiel al libro, quizás no completo, pero cambiar de habilidades en sus personajes principales, la película tendría mejor recepción, aunque lamento mucho no siguieron produciendo su trilogía, espero alguien se anime hacerla serie, así como la de Percy Jackson. --- ![SEPARADORFINAL.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23t7DhyLsnCvap7nZh5KQhSei8HfFKRCDACSsevDY6FtCrxZEtkcEjJFcgM5dmXK527Py.png) ---

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  The Mystery of Edwin Drood #17/166
title.body: >ASPER, ONhis way home through the Close, is brought to a standstill by the spectacle of Stony Durdles, dinner-bundle and all, leaning his back against the iron railing of the burial-ground enclosing it from the old cloister-arches; and a hideous small boy in rags flinging stones at him as a well-defined mark in the moonlight. Sometimes the stones hit him, and sometimes they miss him, but Durdles seems indifferent to either fortune. The hideous small boy, on the contrary, whenever he hits Durdles, blows a whistle of triumph through a jagged gap convenient for the purpose, in the front of his mouth, where half his teeth are wanting; and whenever he misses him, yelps out “Mulled agin!” and tries to atone for the failure by taking a more correct and vicious aim.
>“What are you doing to the man?” demands Jasper, stepping out into the moonlight from the shade.
>“Making a cock-shy of him,” replies the hideous small boy.
>“Give me those stones in your hand.”
>“Yes, I’ll give ’em you down your throat, if you come a-ketching hold of me,” says the small boy, shaking himself loose, and backing. “I’ll smash your eye, if you don’t look out!”
>“Baby-Devil that you are, what has the man done to you?”

>“He gives me a ’apenny to pelt him home if I ketches him out too late,” says the boy. And then chants, like a little savage, half stumbling and half dancing among the rags and laces of his dilapidated boots:

>“Widdy widdy wen!
I—ket—ches—Im—out—ar—ter—ten,
Widdy widdy wy!
Then—E—don’t—go—then—I—shy—
Widdy Widdy Wake-cock warning!”
>—with a comprehensive sweep on the last word, and one more delivery at Durdles.
>This would seem to be a poetical note of preparation, agreed upon, as a caution to Durdles to stand clear if he can, or to betake himself homeward.

>John Jasper invites the boy with a beck of his head to follow him (feeling it hopeless to drag him, or coax him) and crosses to the iron railing where the Stony (and stoned) One is profoundly meditating.
>“Do you know this thing, this child?” asks Jasper, at a loss for a word that will define this thing.
>“Deputy,” says Durdles, with a nod.

>“I’m man-servant up at the Travellers’ Twopenny in Gas Works Garding,” this thing explains. “All us man-servants at Travellers Lodgings is named Deputy. Wen we’re chock full and the Travellers is all a-bed I come out for my ’elth.” Then withdrawing into the road, and taking aim, he resumes:
>“Hold your hand,” cries Jasper, “and don’t throw while I stand so near him, or I’ll kill you! Come, Durdles; let me walk home with you to-night. Shall I carry your bundle?”

>“Not on any account,” replies Durdles, adjusting it. “Durdles was making his reflections here when you come up, sir, surrounded by his works, like a poplar Author.—Your own brother-in-law;” introducing a sarcophagus within the railing, white and cold in the moonlight.

>“Mrs. Sapsea;” introducing the monument of that devoted wife. “Late Incumbent;” introducing the Reverend Gentleman’s broken column. “Departed Assessed Taxes;” introducing a vase and towel, standing on what might represent the cake of soap. “Former pastrycook and muffin-maker, much respected;” introducing gravestone. “All safe and sound here, sir, and all Durdles’s work! Of the common folk that is merely bundled up in turf and brambles, the less said, the better. A poor lot, soon forgot.”
>“This creature, Deputy, is behind us,” says Jasper, looking back. “Is he to follow us?”

>The relations between Durdles and Deputy are of a capricious kind; for, on Durdles’s turning himself about with the slow gravity of beery soddenness, Deputy makes a pretty wide circuit into the road and stands on the defensive.
>“You never cried Widdy Warning before you begun to-night,” says Durdles, unexpectedly reminded of, or imagining, an injury.
>“Yer lie, I did,” says Deputy, in his only form of polite contradiction.

>“Own brother, sir,” observes Durdles, turning himself about again, and as unexpectedly forgetting his offence as he had recalled or conceived it; “own brother to Peter the Wild Boy! But I gave him an object in life.”
>“At which he takes aim?” Mr. Jasper suggests.

>“That’s it, sir,” returns Durdles, quite satisfied; “at which he takes aim. I took him in hand and gave him an object. What was he before? A destroyer. What work did he do? Nothing but destruction. What did he earn by it? Short terms in Cloisterham Jail.

title.title: Grab the Broom
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsiFQzFT4kC9vo23jg942koyvF7ikxiGZqzor7NSc48N/20260327_131836.webp)

---------------------------

It was another sweep for the Radford Highlanders Softball team this past weekend.  A much needed one as they close in on the end of the regular season.  With just a few more series left in the year, the ladies from Radford have their eyes on the conference tournament and then hopefully the national tournament.  Only the top five teams in the Big South Conference get to play in the conference tournament, so they need to finish strong after a shaky start to the season.

I haven't looked at the Big South standings in a while, but from the way it sounds, things have gotten pretty tight and heading into this weekend it wasn't as much of a sure thing as it was last year that they were going to make it to the tournament.  Adding to that, they went up against a Gardner-Webb team that as of Friday morning had the best offense in the conference.  

Thankfully, the Radford pitching was able to shut that offense down in a big way!

Things kicked off on Friday evening with a 4 PM game against the Bulldogs of Gardner-Webb University.  As has been the case for most series, Radford started their ace pitcher Redmon in the first game.  She pitched a complete game shut out and Radford was able to win the game 3 to 0.  It was a pretty awesome showing and it is important to remember that this team has the best offense in the conference, so not allowing them to score any runs is a big deal.

Saturday the action started at noon with the first game of a double header against Gardner-Webb.  This one went a little differently with Cooper taking the mound as pitcher.  The Bulldogs took an early 2 run lead in the second inning that they carried into the seventh and final inning.  Unfortunately, it wouldn't hold, and The Highlanders were able to make a very late game rally to walk off the game 3 to 2.  

It was a pretty amazing complete game by Cooper on the mound.  Radford has been on the losing end of a few walk offs this year, so it was really nice to see them finally get one of their own.  At just the right time I might add.

Riding that wave, the second game was another pitching masterpiece by Sabo  who also threw a complete game shutout with the Highlanders winning 3 to 0 once again.  Our niece didn't get to bat at all, but she did get to pinch run and she was one of the scoring runs in that early game on Saturday.  

Tomorrow the Highlanders have a one off out of conference game against a Tennessee team that is 9th in the nation right now.  Then they finish up their regular season with two series against Winthrop University this weekend,  and Queens University down in Charlotte North Carolina in the middle of next week.

I really hope the Highlanders can carry this momentum with them into the post season!

title.body: У Європі можуть скасовувати рейси через дефіцит палива Експерти попереджають, що влітку можливі скасування рейсів через нестачу авіапалива, а пасажири можуть залишитися без компенсацій.

/>

[джерело](https://www.businessinsider.com/airlines-cancel-flights-rising-jet-fuel-prices-shortage-iran-2026-4)

🇩🇪 У Німеччині цього літа можуть скасовувати авіарейси через брак палива. Влада змушена буде визначати, які рейси отримають пріоритет.

Аеропорти та авіакомпанії вже звернулися до уряду з вимогою термінових дій, щоб уникнути хаосу в сезон відпусток.

🇳🇱 Водночас нідерландська авіакомпанія KLM скасує 160 рейсів протягом наступного місяця.

Пасажири, яких торкнулися ці зміни, будуть переброньовані на наступний доступний рейс.

Авіакомпанія зазначила, що не має проблем із постачанням авіапального, але прийняла це рішення як захід економії у зв’язку зі зростанням цін на паливо.

**🇮🇪 Ірландія та Ryanair: що відбувається**

Ірландський лоукостер Ryanair заявив, що наразі має гарантовані поставки авіапального лише приблизно до середини травня.

Компанія попереджає:  
• якщо ситуація з постачанням не стабілізується, влітку можливі перебої з пальним в окремих аеропортах Європи  
• у разі загострення кризи не виключаються скорочення рейсів або їх скасування з червня–серпня

**Водночас:**  
• наразі масових скасувань в Ірландії не прогнозують  
• але ціни на квитки майже гарантовано зростуть через дорожче паливо

Ryanair також зазначає, що частину витрат уже закладає в тарифи, тому пасажирам варто очікувати дорожчі перельоти цього літа.

Підвищення цін

Авіакомпанії Air France і KLM заявили про підвищення вартості квитків через подорожчання пального.

Також британська Virgin Atlantic ввела додаткову паливну надбавку. EasyJet раніше попереджала, що війна вплинула на бронювання і призведе до підвищення цін на квитки до кінця літа.

За оцінками ринку, **ціни на авіапальне вже майже подвоїлися, що змушує авіакомпанії:**  
• скорочувати маршрути  
• зменшувати кількість рейсів  
• піднімати тарифи

Що це означає для пасажирів

Експерти попереджають:  
• можливі локальні скасування рейсів у Європі  
• менше дешевих квитків  
• вищі ціни на перельоти  
• і в окремих випадках — відсутність компенсацій, якщо причиною є форс-мажор (паливна криза)  
Джерело ([https://www.businessinsider.com/airlines-cancel-flights-rising-jet-fuel-prices-shortage-iran-2026-4](https://www.businessinsider.com/airlines-cancel-flights-rising-jet-fuel-prices-shortage-iran-2026-4))

title.title: [EN/PT] EOS: Uploading my Rewards Cards
title.body:
> # [EN] ![capa.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wWtjcJRwTaARMhtTBJJ5dyWfsP1cBsxrszRH4AhTMwBmrJFzv8iHqpJBZkgyKeGQnbv.gif) # Hello Splinterland Fans Splinterlands is part of my daily routine—it’s a daily hobby. My goal of making my collection even stronger keeps me playing almost every day, aside from the fun, of course. Splinterlands has countless cards, but I’m focused on leveling up my Rewards cards. With so many cards, it’s currently difficult to choose which ones to max out, since every player’s financial resources and even their time are limited. Playing with max-level cards means more chances to win battles and improve rewards. Currently, my goal in Splinterlands is to max out all my **Conclave** Reward cards. My current focus has been on rare cards; I’ve been buying Rare Draws and sometimes chests to balance my Glints token earnings. To boost my Glints token earnings, I’ve been burning SPS intermittently, so I don’t miss out on earning SPS and more Glints tokens. This way, I keep my earnings balanced because I also want to increase the amount of SPS staked; my goal is to reach 50K SPS.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Enynb6QzMjNJLmwMJTh3uJWzFcjYAANmS1fmiBmAdVebw8EHK26dF8cs2hZxKLXVBy1.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tRtaiD79SLg4iSCeundUKzjv2LjBG2iV85nkMY8X3aHKjp2rwrU4dmPWsgLyoBuvrA1.png)
In this latest End-of-Season (EOS), I managed to max out some common cards (from level 4 to level 5) and rare cards (from level 3 to level 4). I opened several Rare Draws, in addition to, of course, opening several Minor and Ultimate Chests. Every time I level up my cards, it gets easier to achieve better results in battles. And that excites me, because I don’t have to spend a lot buying or renting cards. That’s why Splinterlands is one of my favorite games—you can build your collection just by playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xKotfyqSgXHgUstWRcTF4g1eYQFLVFj4zVV5ZADN4u59Rbo4p26cXZTSBCyZw2RsShp.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23ycyG6KBxd93hjvdAgGKgXmfsH98w5YMrs1871BMKkyS7Z1Bfj3Rg7ign9jWnqviiaE4.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23yJA13Mg4T17EXfc8JBEaXSe6MQ9GGt795LyE81CKF4fHdTnfbeivUJBq7oc9LswnARN.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xeX8im9T3bKLNsyKD9JCgsLT52UhZDrjrbXwAkwxJoChSEuDQacEK5eUymGZfX2nLAb.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23y8mdX6fqkfUgY9bFnC4objeWB9CigGdXv5UG6nndCNXd2HDUqEWd8ayViUjX1EApZtU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vsDwRaGXArPxSJ6MJPZPT3a7iy3UxruPfhQTtkfWfPFe9VRhRyXR3swvC2rkLJuBVpU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23zGaCAE2aDEujWE6Y8uzS4aBy95B95oMsmEtBmB2rDzuXZpf1DSmiYrUNtaikX5huo83.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xKjbS4z1NieLXJ5hvSw92uh6CKroQpm7FeX32dPugBgL7ePHt27XqfhjchjwidEKE9m.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EoCbtmxYeePUhSJg4tAdB2BbWkpDskPbvVp2dNvsdeuheGbMtZ9BwFGp3dcYCH1UodS.png)

> In this latest End-of-Season (EOS), I received about 100K Glint + 25K Glint from battle ranking rewards. This amount of Glint has really helped me level up my collection. In the past, I used to get more, since Splinterlands has been getting increasingly difficult and the prices of reward items have gone up. Most cards saw improvements in stats related to Speed, Armor, or Health. Only one monster gained an additional ability. In today’s battle, we’ll use some of these cards to enhance our strategy. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Eos2oFCFQuCPre9KPBfq4hLUc63pxzvbfRdYgxgC5LPJf9NQFn7zaamEcYwRNx2b82p.png) Now that we have these Reward cards at new levels, it’s time to test them out in battle. This battle featured the following rulesets: **Odd Ones Out**, **Noxious Fumes**, and **Explosive Weaponry**. In addition, there was 42 mana available and only Fire and Earth Splinters. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tGy7VLTgg6iGwi9uJnrbHDev1wC1VNyEsKSqTSuYGfGsesz4U4xsppEsA887i65BSRG.png) In this situation, with a reasonable amount of mana available, I chose the Archon **Risqruel Drath**, which allows me to select monsters from these two Splinters. In addition, all ranged monsters gain +1 ranged damage, the Flying ability, and, of course, tactical abilities. In this battle, I chose the ability that never misses its target. A good way to mitigate the impact of the **Explosive Weaponry** Rulesets was to place a monster in the second position with the **Deflect** ability, so the other units wouldn’t take damage. My opponent had everything needed to execute a similar strategy, but chose a different one instead. # [Click Here to Watch the Full Battle!](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_578b19fc297e68c455d6d08b41e372da) In the first round, you can see both players' lineups. On my side, I fielded a Reward Soulbond monster, **Magmaforged**, because it has low mana cost. My opponent placed a (-2) magic damage debuff on two of my monsters on the field. My opponent lost two of his monsters in this round, including his main tank, which had a lot of health. ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tm9TpenKW7ddMpF9WyHH9ac8Am5hVbkcYMcMVRsMLwzA2BT2XAmn49YWV6uzqMDKpcV.png) That battle ended quickly; despite the reduction in magic damage, we managed to defeat several enemy units. And practically all of our monsters remained on the field. Among the Reward monsters, **Magmaforged** was chosen because of its low mana cost. ![f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vhpwL2cijwngVWxaTaCyRSbyFHKNtBpih2HK6Z2CtCs8oyubLr6jzYTJMSGyajuGmud.png) Therefore, it’s essential to keep leveling up in Splinterlands to achieve better results. And there’s nothing better than leveling up your collection without spending a single penny. So, my advice is for players to focus on a specific card rarity and start buying Draws of that rarity to max out those cards. I hope you enjoyed this! ___ **If you’ve made it this far, thank you so much for your time, and if this content was helpful in any way, please leave an upvote and reblog!** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tGvyDT7ASwcw8K6yCRtkHFf7wLshNrkTrgKytk1atFUboxso73BsMUSQBtk5qozjXAM.png) # [PT] ![capa.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23wWtjcJRwTaARMhtTBJJ5dyWfsP1cBsxrszRH4AhTMwBmrJFzv8iHqpJBZkgyKeGQnbv.gif) # Olá Splinter Fanáticos Splinterlands faz parte do meu dia a dia, sendo um hobby diário. O objetivo de tornar minha coleção ainda mais forte faz com que eu jogue quase que diariamente, além da diversão, é claro. Splinterlands possuem cartas a perder de vista, mas eu estou focado em aumentar o nível da minhas cartas Rewards. Com tantas cartas, atualmente é difícil escolher quais colocar em nível máximo, pois os recursos financeiros e até mesmo o tempo de cada jogador é limitado. Jogar com cartas de nível máximo significa mais chances de ganhar batalhas e melhorar as recompensas. Atualmente, meu objetivo em Splinterlands é colocar todas as minhas cartas Reward **Conclave** em nível máximo. Meu foco atual tem sido as cartas raras tenho comprando Rare Draw e as vezes baús para balancear os meus ganhos de tokens Glints. Para dar um boost em meus ganhos de tokens Glints eu tenho queimado SPS de forma alternada, para não deixar de ganha SPS e mais tokens Glints. Dessa forma, deixo equilibrado meus ganhos pois também quero aumentar a quantidade de SPS staked, minha meta é chegar ao 50K SPS.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Enynb6QzMjNJLmwMJTh3uJWzFcjYAANmS1fmiBmAdVebw8EHK26dF8cs2hZxKLXVBy1.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tRtaiD79SLg4iSCeundUKzjv2LjBG2iV85nkMY8X3aHKjp2rwrU4dmPWsgLyoBuvrA1.png)
Nesse último final de temporada (EOS) eu conseguir maximizar algumas cartas comuns (do nível 4 para nível 5) e raras (do nível 3 para 4). Abrindo vários Rare Draws, além é claro de abrir vários Minor and Ultimate Chests. Cada vez que elevo o nível de minhas cartas mais fácil vai se tornando, para ter melhores resultados nas batalhas. E isso me anima, pois eu não preciso gastar muito comprando ou alugando cartas. Por isso, Splinterlands é um dos meus jogos favoritos, pois você pode construir sua coleção apenas jogando.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xKotfyqSgXHgUstWRcTF4g1eYQFLVFj4zVV5ZADN4u59Rbo4p26cXZTSBCyZw2RsShp.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23ycyG6KBxd93hjvdAgGKgXmfsH98w5YMrs1871BMKkyS7Z1Bfj3Rg7ign9jWnqviiaE4.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23yJA13Mg4T17EXfc8JBEaXSe6MQ9GGt795LyE81CKF4fHdTnfbeivUJBq7oc9LswnARN.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xeX8im9T3bKLNsyKD9JCgsLT52UhZDrjrbXwAkwxJoChSEuDQacEK5eUymGZfX2nLAb.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23y8mdX6fqkfUgY9bFnC4objeWB9CigGdXv5UG6nndCNXd2HDUqEWd8ayViUjX1EApZtU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vsDwRaGXArPxSJ6MJPZPT3a7iy3UxruPfhQTtkfWfPFe9VRhRyXR3swvC2rkLJuBVpU.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23zGaCAE2aDEujWE6Y8uzS4aBy95B95oMsmEtBmB2rDzuXZpf1DSmiYrUNtaikX5huo83.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23xKjbS4z1NieLXJ5hvSw92uh6CKroQpm7FeX32dPugBgL7ePHt27XqfhjchjwidEKE9m.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EoCbtmxYeePUhSJg4tAdB2BbWkpDskPbvVp2dNvsdeuheGbMtZ9BwFGp3dcYCH1UodS.png)

> Nesse último final de temporada (EOS) eu recebi cerca de 100K Glint + 25K Glint de recompensas por ranqueamento de batalha. Essa quantidade de Glint tem me ajudado bastante na evolução da minha coleção. No passado eu conseguia uma quantidade maior, pois Splinterlands vem se tornando cada vez mais difícil e também os valores dos itens Rewards estão mais caros. A maioria das cartas tiveram melhoras com relação a estatísticas referente a Velocidade, Armadura ou Vida. Apenas um monstros ganhou uma habilidade adicional. Na batalha de hoje vamos utilizar alguma dessas cartas para incrementar a nossa estratégia. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/Eos2oFCFQuCPre9KPBfq4hLUc63pxzvbfRdYgxgC5LPJf9NQFn7zaamEcYwRNx2b82p.png) Em posse dessas cartas Reward em novos níveis chegou a hora de testá-las em uma batalha. Essa batalha contou com os Rulesets: **Odd Ones Out**, **Noxious Fumes** e **Explosive Weaponry**. Além disso, havia 42 de mana disponível e apenas os Splinters fogo e terra. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tGy7VLTgg6iGwi9uJnrbHDev1wC1VNyEsKSqTSuYGfGsesz4U4xsppEsA887i65BSRG.png) Nessa situação e com uma quantidade razoável de mana disponível, eu escolhi o Archon **Risqruel Drath**, que permite escolhe monstros desses dois Splinters. Além disso, todos os monstros ranged ganham mais (+1) de dano ranged e habilidade Flying e é claro as habilidades táticas. Nessa batalha eu escolhi a habilidade que não erra o alvo. uma boa forma de mitigar os impactos dos Rulesets **Explosive Weaponry** foi escalar um monstro na segunda posição com a habilidade **Deflect**, assim as demais unidades não sofrem danos. Meu oponente tinha tudo para fazer uma estratégia semelhante, mas preferiu outra estratégia. # [Clique Aqui para Assistir a Batalha Completa!](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_578b19fc297e68c455d6d08b41e372da) Na primeira rodada, é possível ver a escalação de ambos jogadores. Do meu lado, eu escalei um monstro Reward Soulbond, **Magmaforged**, por possui baixa mana. Meu oponente colocou um debuf de (-2) de dano mágico em dois dos meus monstros em campo. Meu oponente nesta rodada, perdeu dois de seus monstros, inclusive seu tanque principal que possui bastante saúde. ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tm9TpenKW7ddMpF9WyHH9ac8Am5hVbkcYMcMVRsMLwzA2BT2XAmn49YWV6uzqMDKpcV.png) Essa batalha terminou rápido, apesar da redução de dano mágico conseguimos derrotar várias unidades inimigas. E praticamente quase todos os nossos monstros ficaram em campo. Dentre os monstros Rewards, **Magmaforged**,foi escolhido devido sua baixa mana. ![f.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23vhpwL2cijwngVWxaTaCyRSbyFHKNtBpih2HK6Z2CtCs8oyubLr6jzYTJMSGyajuGmud.png) Portanto, se faz necessário sempre evoluir em Splinterlands para ter melhores resultados. E nada melhor do que evoluir a sua coleção sem gastar nenhum centavo por isso. Então, meu conselho é o jogador focar em uma raridade de cartas e começar a comprar Draws dessa raridade, para levar essas cartas para o nível máximo. Espero que tenham gostado! ___ **Se chegou até aqui muito obrigado pelo seu tempo e se de alguma forma este conteudo foi útil, deixe seu upvote e reblog!** Imagens: @splinterlands [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23tw426MWpq8fAr4TjRAatv8RwXWtzcP357eShoipfuxkE1BHsWcWEbp8254ifYYmqBjS.png)](https://discord.gg/zYcJfq7tdQ) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@elderdark/enpt-eos-uploading-my-rewards-cards-fjd)

title.title: 20 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3079: the big clash
title.body:
In this globalized and digitized world, we face a major clash between human ingenuity and artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence is taking over everything, and we allow ourselves to be defeated. Every day, we delegate our functions to something extreme. Artificial intelligence has the capacity to do things for us faster and more efficiently, but where does that leave our human ingenuity, our creativity, imagination, and skills? We are atrophying, becoming more useless, allowing ourselves to be replaced in everything, even our feelings. We grant it the right to act for us, to manage our unpleasant emotions, and to help us with quick techniques and theories to find balance in our emotional well-being. By seeking comfort, ease, or quick solutions, we miss out on developing lasting, profound, meaningful, and personal skills that would allow us to manage and overcome emotions ourselves. It used to work that way. The great clash occurs between human ingenuity and artificial intelligence, where if we are careless we are left in a very bad position without will or initiative; rather, we should combine AI with the human being to be our ally, combining speed with an endless number of options in seconds without leaving aside our human capacity to think, create, act and lead. >En este mundo tan globalizado y digitalizado estamos enfrentados a un gran choque entre el ingenio humano y la inteligencia artificial, es que la inteligencia artificial está tomando el control en todo nos dejamos vencer y cada día estamos delegando nuestras funciones a algo extremo, la inteligencia artificial tiene la capacidad de hacer cosas por nosotros de forma más rápida y en mayor cantidad, pero donde queda nuestro ingenio humano, nuestra creatividad, imaginación, habilidades nos estamos atrofiando, nos hacemos más inútiles, nos dejamos remplazar en todo incluso en los sentimientos ya le damos ese derecho de actuar por nosotros, de gestionar nuestras emociones desagradables que nos ayude con técnicas y teorías rápidas para encontrar el equilibrio en nuestro bienestar emocional, por buscar comodidad, facilidad o soluciones rápidas nos perdemos de desarrollar habilidades duraderas, profundas, significativas y propias que nos lleven a gestionar, superar una emoción por nosotros mismos, anteriormente funcionaba de esa manera. >Entre el ingenio humano y la inteligencia artificial se da el gran choque, donde si nos descuidamos quedamos muy mal parados sin voluntad ni iniciativa, más bien deberíamos combinar IA con lo humano ser nuestro aliado, combinar rapidez con un sin fin de opciones en segundos sin dejar de un lado nuestra capacidad humana de pensar, crear, actuar y liderar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMpxyzPMKrnfT2GSBXMqC9r7F4KkNVhnV7JQSPgVnhTU/1776686032894.jpg) This piece is my entry for the daily writing challenge from the Freewriters community, a project by @mariannewest. title.title: Tuesday is the new Thursday. 🧡
title.body:
Tuesday is the new Thursday. 🧡
And tomorrow… we’re back!

- Brasserie Millewee
- Tuesday, 21st of April
- From 19:00

You remember Millewee? The latest spot to join the Innopay journey.
And now… it’s closer than ever to be live! 

That means you will be able to:
- Scan the QR code
- Order directly from the menu
- Pay however you want (yes, even card)
- Ask for cashback

And of course, enjoy your amazing meal!
Simple. Smooth. Already working in Luxembourg.
No theory. No slides. Just real usage, in a real place.

And around that? The usual Letz OffChain chaos 🧡

One minute you are in the strait of Hormuz talking geopolitics, next you are talking Bitcoin doing its thing again, then about AI moving way too fast (Opus 4.7, Kimi 2.6…) but somehow… it always ends with stories, laughs, and new connections!  

You never really know what we’ll talk about. And that’s the point.
If you’ve been meaning to come… this is a good one.

Come meet the family, come see what we’re building!
Tomorrow. 19:00. Millewee.
See you there. 🧡

title.title: Distributed Dumpsters
title.body:
>

I was walking close to home with the dog, but in an area I hadn't been before. Prior to having a dog, there was little reason to walk into unfamiliar areas, because there isn't that much around. With a dog though, I end up taking some different paths and depending on the weather, walking a bit further. This place was like a dumping ground for the council, with skips, old signage and a heap of granite curb stones, which is what is used in much of Finland instead of cement curbs. Fancy. But I was thinking that all this stuff is just sitting here, and I reckon I could use some of those stones in my garden to build a brilliant stone fence. 

> Now I have to work out how to steal them, and lift them, as each probably weighs a metric tonne.

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/241ZfoHCmY3q4FXgn6eFGeuXeqPjoNMg4RH8TmucvihumDnepv25mS2dRpJYQx2cUSo3J.png)


---

I am sure that at some point this area will be developed and turned into apartments and houses, to go along with the ten thousand or so other unsold and empty new dwellings in the country. Eventually, there will be pressure to fill them and with the birth rate at 1.2, well below the required replacement rate of 2.1 just to keep it steady, it can really only come through immigration. And this of course creates a lot of uncomfortable problems for governments and citizens, because they don't want immigrants to \

the country, but at the same time, they want to have valuable properties and business opportunities, which aren't possible in a declining population. 

A declining population isn't all bad, because it takes pressure off the environment, but anyone who thinks that society becomes better, is likely fooling themselves. Because it doesn't change human nature to compete and want to maximise resources, so there will still be wars, and there will still be starvation and atrocities performed in the name of profit, and communities will continue to degrade and fall apart, with a furthering of disconnection and much of the issues we already face. 

I reckon there are a lot of people who believe that technology is going to somehow save us, because it is going to replace nearly everything that we as humans can do. This way, even in a declining population we won't need people to plough a field or clean a toilet, work a register or drive a taxi - and apparently with all the free time we have (unpaid) we will have the space to be our most creative and live our best lives. I just don't see it though, as the meaning of life itself starts to rapidly slip away once we don't have *anything meaningful* to do.

Sure, the jobs mentioned are not necessarily meaningful in and of themselves, but they are part of the fabric of the economy in which we live, which means that even though (as I see it) the majority of what we do is meaningless busywork, most people get satisfaction of some kind from being a value-adding member of society. Those who would be considered disenfranchised and disillusioned members of society, are also those who tend to cause social disorder, crime and take a nihilistic view to all they do, which ends up being a wholly self-serving position, where me comes before *all else,* and by a long way. 

Life is made up of many layers and a good life requires a fair amount of alignment between them, especially if part of the more complex world in which we live now. Yes, a simple life is possible, but it doesn't scale for the majority of people and in order to really live it well enough, you have to be highly self-sufficient, which most people are not and will never be, because to do so requires a huge amount of learning and compromise. So as I see it, most of us would need to find ways to make a good life out of the complex situation we have, but that isn't to say that what we have now is the only situation we can have.

Technology has always changed things and the current trajectory is going to see the largest change in the history of humanity, because it is going to lead us into a situation that for the first time, human expertise will be inferior to that of the technology. It has already started where for most people on earth, an AI can consume better, think better, and produce better. But it is going to keep on going, and going, until nearly everything we can do as a human, is made obsolete. And while it is still possible to \

in reality, very, very few people will be able to maintain that, let alone get paid for it. And that pay is incredibly important to consider, because without people getting paid, nothing gets consumed in the financial economy. While all the robots and AI can work out some kind of pay and tax system, ultimately the only reason for their existence, is to produce for us. And if we are unable to buy what they produce, what happens? This means that not only are we meaningless and irrelevant, but the technology we created to replace us, is also. We are going to *be forced* to rethink what value is and how our economy works, because it is impossible to sustain in current if there are only middlemen, with no one producing, no one earning, and no one consuming. Therefore, we are going to have to work out what humans can do that is valuable and worth paying for, that doesn't include having to do any kind of traditional production or service work. > Non-traditional products and services. As I have mentioned before, the world would be a wholly different kind of place if rather than profit at any cost, business success was aligned to human wellbeing. That way, goods and services would have to add wellbeing value to humanity in order to turn a profit in the economy. But even if all the machines were aligned to this purpose, we would still have a problem of how humans are going to organise themselves in society. So perhaps the non-traditional goods and services that people could use as a differentiator comes from service to the community itself. But even with this, there just can't be enough positions available to feed everyone, so some form of handout like a UBI would be required - unless there was no money whatsoever and we lived in a society where resources were distributed by an artificial intelligence based on what it thought was best for humanity. > Technology to the rescue? It all seems to get pretty dystopic pretty quickly by my estimations. Having said that though, if the current course is not corrected, it is going to get dystopic very fast anyway, so perhaps it is better to try the dystopia directed toward wellbeing, rather than the one doubling-down on profits. We have created a slow-burning dumpster fire of a society and instead of dousing the flames, we keep on adding more fuel. None of this might matter in a few decades, because at the rate we are undermining ourselves, we might not last that long anyway. Great for the environment. title.title: Більше подорожей — менше засудження
title.body: Раніше я багато о подорожувала. Навіть мала авторську рубрику в журналі \

/>\n\nА також власний тревел-бізнес та програму на телебаченні. Нашу машину впізнавали в різних куточках України бо її часто бачили по тєлєку. А поїздки островами Греції в карантинні обмеження показували в прямому ефірі на \

І от що я помітила.  
Люди, які багато подорожували, рідше засуджують інших.

І справа не в тому, що вони раптом стали добрішими чи «кращими». Просто в них більше не залишилось ілюзії, що існує одна-єдина правильна версія життя.

Вони бачили надто багато «норм».

У одній країні — нормально їсти руками, і це не про бідність, а про традицію і контакт із їжею.  
В іншій — за столом мовчать, і тиша там означає повагу, а не холодність.  
Десь обіймають незнайомих, ніби давніх друзів.  
А десь навіть прямий погляд у очі може здатися викликом, а не відкритістю. Десь пригощають і сідають разом за стіл як родина, а десь - ти гість на відстані.

І щоразу ця «норма» працює. Вона не виглядає дивною для тих, хто в ній живе. Вона логічна, цілісна і достатня.

Коли ти бачиш п’ять таких світів — ти дивуєшся.  
Коли десять — починаєш сумніватися.  
Коли тридцять — перестаєш вірити, що твоя версія є єдиною правильною.

І тоді з’являється щось важливіше за доброту — внутрішнє прийняття перед чужим досвідом.  
Ти більше не поспішаєш давати оцінку. А тем більше - поради \

. Не тому, що не маєш думки, а тому, що знаєш: вони не універсальні.

Подорожі розмивають жорсткі межі «правильно» і «неправильно».  
Вони вчать бачити контекст — історію, клімат, релігію, бідність, достаток, страхи і звички, які формують поведінку людей. Що їх привело як націю до того стану, який вони мають зараз.

І з часом ти починаєш розуміти: більшість речей, які ми називаємо «дивними», — це просто інша відповідь на ті самі людські потреби.

Ті ж самі питання — як жити, як їсти, як любити, як поважати одне одного — але інші рішення.

І тоді терпимість перестає бути моральною чеснотою.  
Вона стає наслідком досвіду.

Подорожі не вчать географії.  
Вони вчать сумніватися у власній очевидності.  
І саме з цього сумніву народжується справжня широта погляду.

До речі, це моя третя весна в Ірландії. І тільки зараз я помітила, як яскраво квітнуть нарциси вздовж дороги. Скільки рожевих дерев у подвірʼї людей. Як вкриваються, наче жовтим килимом, галявини з кульбаб. Яка соковита світло-зелена ірландія в квітні.

Наче хтось протер мої окуляри серветкою. І я почала все це бачити. Знов, як колись вміла.

Щасливої весни вам, мої рідні люди🫶

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 20 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gd1941b51eb1996b6bf388ce4cc2db6e7e7ad94cbe30c1d60b6cbe937e1f51b7c615961aab23eb58fe895a3d7e31f15d36f77cedcbb5310499099e871c2c680b6_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente emocionante. Empecé en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el canto de los pájaros me dieron la energía que necesitaba. Allí conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas; me contó que lleva haciendo eso todos los días desde hace más de 20 años. Su sonrisa y su conexión con esos pequeños seres era contagiosa. Continuando mi ruta, pasé por una feria de arte local. Había una exposición de pinturas vibrantes y artesanías únicas. Hablé con un joven artista que estaba exhibiendo sus obras. Me explicó que se inspira en la vida urbana y en la diversidad de las personas que encuentra en sus paseos. Me hizo reflexionar sobre cómo cada rincón de la ciudad está lleno de historias esperando ser contadas. El clima era perfecto, y al final, llegué a una pequeña cafetería donde disfruté de un delicioso café y un pastelito. Fue un día lleno de encuentros y descubrimientos que me recordaron lo vibrante que es la vida en la ciudad. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)).
