body.title: Lo que me agradan de los demás/ Échame el cuento/ Cosas que me gustan de las personas [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @mundohispano, un gusto pasar por acá, vengo en esta ocasión a participar en la [Iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-117341/@brujita18/echame-el-cuento-cosas-que-me-gustan-de-las-personas-esen) de @anafenix y @brujita18 e invito a @yaslenysofia a participar. --- ![REVIEW (19).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vi4LKEUjCpQjR4hpJore5vzbBzG3rXfrVqdMsnYWhS1X4HW5hFR1jWyuHuQyCavqdku.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Hablando de cosas que me gustan de las personas, me parece interesante el tema, y por ello debo comenzar diciendo que una de las cosas que me agradan que tenga las personas es la sinceridad, una persona que no tiene pelos en la lengua, que aunque a veces la verdad pueda ser algo cruel o que uno se niegue a escucharla que a la final necesitas hacerlo, es algo que me gusta mucho, me parece que es el tipo de persona que sabes que no te va a mentir ni engañar porque no es capaz de ocultar nada y eso a la final resulta bien y tranquilo, porque es preferible saber la verdad que vivir en mentiras. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>Otra cosa sería las personas que no les importa admitir sus errores, aceptar que te equivocas o que hiciste algo mal y de por ello pides disculpas aceptando tu error no es algo sencillo, sea por el orgullo o porque no quieres creer que te equivocaste ps el llegar hacerlo habla muy bien de ti, y eso es una cualidad que no todos son capaces de tener o les cuesta, por eso el que alguien lo haga y no le importe hacerlo sino dejar claro su error es algo que agrada porque es una persona que puede ver más allá y mejorar al respecto, confiando en si misma que no volverá a cometer ese error y al mismo tiempo aprender de ello, de verdad ver personas así son buenas para uno mismo aprender que hay que hacer las cosas como son aceptar lo que hemos hecho y crecer a partir de ello. --- ![sweetlouise-positive-thinking-4933330_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/244xwHs8pjXqmw3niBD8Jysnd4iYb4buAddDeufDxeder3JS8yJTDPUibMHaeDS1v8z48.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-4933330_1920.jpg) ---

>Una persona educada, alguien que es capaz de saludar, pedir disculpas, pedir permiso, habla muy bien de ello, y una persona así es agradable conocer y tener cerca, es ese tipo de persona que te agrada para aprender y poder tener una grata conversación, así mismo como una persona positiva, son ese tipo de personas que por más mal que les esté pasando son capaces de sonreír y apoyarte a ti aunque sus circunstancias no sean del todo buena, esas personas son muy agradables de compartir y conocer porque de igual manera te llenan de su energía, te motivan y son capaces de ayudarte a ver las cosas desde otro punto de vista lo cual resulta agradable, ciertamente cada cosa que uno puede encontrar en los demás puede resultar agradable aunque a veces no, pero a la final cada uno es capaz de aportar algo que hace que los demás quieran mantener a tu lado, aprender de ello y sentir una grata compañía. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello, dear friends at @mundohispano, it’s a pleasure to stop by. I’m here today to take part in the [Initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-117341/@brujita18/echame-el-cuento-cosas-que-me-gustan-de-las-personas-esen) from @anafenix and @brujita18, and I invite @yaslenysofia to join in. --- ![REVIEW (22).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vi4LKEUjCpQjR4hpJore5vzbBzG3rXfrVqdS4yENgQLWbHhzT2cZp2SigY12KAyQWVF.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>Speaking of things I like about people, I find this topic interesting, and so I have to start by saying that one of the qualities I appreciate most in people is sincerity—someone who doesn’t mince words. Even though the truth can sometimes be a bit harsh, or even if you refuse to hear it at first, in the end you have to face it, and that’s something I really like. I think that’s the kind of person you know won’t lie to you or deceive you because they’re incapable of hiding anything, and in the end, that works out well and brings peace of mind, because it’s better to know the truth than to live a lie. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>It’s a different story with people who aren’t afraid to admit their mistakes. Accepting that you’re wrong or that you did something wrong—and apologizing for it by owning up to your mistake—isn’t easy, whether because of pride or because you don’t want to believe you were wrong. But when you do manage to do it, it speaks volumes about you, and that’s a quality not everyone possesses or finds easy to demonstrate. That’s why when someone does it—and doesn’t mind doing so, but instead makes their mistake clear—it’s something that’s pleasing, because they’re a person who can see beyond it and improve in that regard, trusting in themselves that they won’t make that mistake again while also learning from it. Truly, seeing people like that is good for you—learning that you have to take things as they are, accept what you’ve done, and grow from it. --- ![sweetlouise-positive-thinking-4933330_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/244xwHs8pjXqmw3niBD8Jysnd4iYb4buAddDeufDxeder3JS8yJTDPUibMHaeDS1v8z48.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-4933330_1920.jpg) ---

>A polite person—someone who knows how to say hello, apologize, and ask for permission—makes a very good impression, and it’s a pleasure to meet and spend time with someone like that. They’re the kind of person you enjoy learning from and having a pleasant conversation with. Likewise, positive people are those who, no matter how difficult things may be for them, are able to smile and support you even when their circumstances aren’t ideal. These people are very pleasant to spend time with and get to know because they fill you with their energy, motivate you, and help you see things from a different perspective—which is refreshing. Certainly, everything you find in others can be pleasant, though sometimes it isn’t; but in the end, everyone has something to offer that makes others want to stay by your side, learn from you, and enjoy your company. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

> **Thank you very much for reading. I hope you enjoy it. I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have, and if you’d like to know more about me, here are my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
**Translated Using Deepl** ![separadoryasma2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23t7FGdvDtjjEnDiEmhiBDnp6mbsh7xtMBUvkUFiwLtYYSHA9MCnR3VGBuvWJeHNVDBGh.png)

Snoopy Artemis I ($SNOOPY), a new ERC-20 token, has launched on Ethereum, aiming to transcend the typical meme coin narrative by anchoring its identity in a half-century of space exploration history. The project celebrates Snoopy’s real-life role as a NASA icon, from the Apollo 10 mission to his flight as the zero-gravity indicator on Artemis I.

Unlike projects built on fleeting hype, $SNOOPY leverages a verifiable legacy. Its vision is to create a community-driven cultural token that honors human achievement and the spirit of exploration. Early traction has been significant, with a rapidly growing global Telegram community and strong initial trading volume on Uniswap, signaling market confidence in its unique, story-driven value proposition.

### How to Participate:

Set Up Wallet: Secure a crypto wallet like MetaMask or Trust Wallet.
Acquire ETH: Purchase Ethereum (ETH) from a major exchange.
Trade on Uniswap: Visit the Uniswap app and swap ETH for $SNOOPY using the official contract address to ensure security: 0x4442e318FF5748b7e2924AaC0D8925daD9B12f5b.

### Project Roadmap:

Phase 1: Launch & Community Foundation: Fair launch, liquidity lock, and initial community growth.

Phase 2: Listings & Exposure: Secure listings on CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, and major centralized exchanges (CEXs).
Phase 3: Ecosystem & Partnerships: Develop partnerships with creators and STEM-focused organizations.

Phase 4: Real-World Integration: Launch merchandise and explore charity initiatives supporting space education.

Community engagement is central, with planned \

NFT airdrops for holders, creative competitions, and giveaways celebrating milestones in space history.

### Risks & Reminders:
$SNOOPY is a decentralized community project. The cryptocurrency market is volatile. Please conduct your own research (DYOR). The project is not affiliated with NASA or Peanuts.

How Snoopy Artemis I Stands Out:While most tokens are either pure memes or complex utility platforms, $SNOOPY carves a new niche as a cultural token. It doesn't promise to reinvent finance; it promises to carry a powerful, real-world story on-chain, offering a blend of cultural relevance and community spirit backed by a 50-year legacy.

### About Snoopy Artemis I:
Snoopy Artemis I is an independent, community-driven project built on the Ethereum blockchain. Its mission is to celebrate the historic collaboration between Snoopy and NASA, creating a lasting digital tribute to the spirit of exploration and achievement. The project operates with a community-first ethos, prioritizing transparency and organic growth.

body.title: Шпинат і перець
body.body: /> Усім привіт! Шпинат мій за сім тижнів, за які має давати врожай, доріс до такого результату. Зараз він показав квіткові бруньки на всіх кущиках, тож листя більше не буде, а тільки може ще трохи доростить це листя. Хоча там досить гарне коріння пущено у пляшках. Однією з причин, я думаю, є те, що в квартирі у нас досить холодно, ми провітрюємо, і додатково я його не підсвічувала весь час, тільки виставила на балкон (на якому іноді настільки холодно, що ми закриваємо туди двері. Ну але експеримент з пророщуванням зрозумілий. Я тепер знаю, як робити гарну схожість і наступного разу підготую достатньо пляшок/стаканів, щоб була грядка і... омлет з шпинатом та випічка з шпинатом, які я обожнюю. З магазину, в якому я замовила жовтий чемерник та ялинку, мені так ніхто і не зателефонував (там не було можливості оплатити зразу). Але у них написано, що обробка замовлень в сезон до 5 робочих днів, що теоретично сьогодні. Якщо так нічого і не отримаю, то вже поїдемо в садовий центр обирати. Планів на купівлю багато, а гроші я поки не готова викласти за все, тож буду спочатку виокремлювати бюджет, і думати, що купити оптимально. Також чоловік у мене пробував кілька разів садити перець, і у нього він досі не зійшов. Тільки ми підозрюємо один чи два сходи. Що також може бути пов'язано з зовсім не тепличними умовами нашої домівки. Але тим часом я прочесала інтернет і знайшла цікавий спосіб пророщування насіння перцю. Я підрізала кінчик, а потім загорнула у ватний диск і п'ять разів по черзі потримала по 3с у гарячій воді, і 5с у холодній воді. Обіцяли, що насіння проросте протягом десяти годин. Сьогодні вже минуло виходить годин 30 і практично всі ці насіннячка реально проклюнулись. І я їх пересадила у мінвату та просочила теплим розчином води буквально з 1г добрив. Ось так тепер виглядає.

/> Там, якщо наблизити, то можна побачити, що усі насінинки в місці зрізу показали корінчик. Дуже прикольно. Це насіння, яке мені мама прислала з Італії. Має бути гострий перчик (якщо виживе у нас, та за тиждень-два кінець кінцем має вже бути нормальна погода і тепло). При чому на пакетику написано, що стартувати його потрібно у лютому-березні, щоб врожай був влітку, ну але ж у нас тут не Італія :)

body.title: Family Time in Nature: Walking Through Tunnels and Forests And Our Easter Sunday Hiking Adventure in Cuha Valley, Hungary.
body.body:
![6311.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23vsG1tWzw9QuQt2aqVgFC8JxMYmPNgnJB3jYNGfVbAEqGXgTSucEojcR5J8Ho85BMsKT.png)


Easter Sunday is usually a time for family. We have egg hunting, games, and music  celebration in our town. But this time, our family wants it differently.





After several days of strong winds and  we made the most of the beautiful weather. Taking advantage of the beautiful clear skies and  we decided to go for an outdoor adventure. We packed our bags with food and water and put on our hiking shoes. 

![5183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpnCKo5wncTJYSbSyNaRzmeDSCXNp2ak7aXqyGwFLT5YwuSDT71fgWei4ZqanU2o9nt.jpg)

And we went to the cuha-völgy in Hungary for another hiking nature adventure.


![5411.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23xp1yHHZzWuJEDwp3HqPKtMrx4p9YrkaX6xTDRAhgD73REAG2DQrQJY3E2VMvMrqknJn.png)

The weather that morning was perfect for any outdoor activities. We started our journey at 10 in the morning. We're on the  
Monostor bridge, driving to Hungary. 



![5304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpVACRZ68RAh51mvoUBBHVshcBiwKyDtdujYcj6RJD6HKPbyCKsow63NF9ojxgb3ns1.jpg)


The weather was perfect, the deep blue sky wide with just a few clouds.  When we got there, the parking area was busy- lots of hikers were getting ready too.




The small village gather for Easter Celebration. Ferris wheel and carousel in the big lots. Families gather together for an Easter Egg Hunting. Aside from that, ice cream shops and buffets are open for the celebration.


![6309.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23xyTCYmE1y1YznVs8vvgBiZJ6uiY9BFQVZJHJxcXTauuxshWDPb1B6Q4MbevLuBg4yWU.png)

Our bags were ready and started our hiking adventure. The fresh forest air immediately welcomed us. It was refreshing and calm- exactly what we needed after days of crazy winds. It was a place where we could relax and enjoy simple moments together.


![5193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpC9V2kbvCtszTdEMXqj45kqaAdtKqv7BJkct6aD1UYeYpYp1HtpiBETkLDKJnTSUC7.jpg)

![5192.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wqiSGnG9XKGpVQXS1XShKwaW8wab71FpE5Yay6Pv1K8uieymZeQp32o5NmT5SzHFVrU.jpg)


![5212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoAaHdvrB5RaAV6S7zJFnkKbruHAkJptSKcx57AjaiGSd6m7fyfrFAS2TCo2sfpHqwD.jpg)

![5213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5mgxPoDteqeJWynPPgNFCFLkxnshu8WAtFEM6VBxw8jRu8wiN5ti1Cm6seaPZAqoY.jpg)

![5215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23xyR3h8hEyKV1yHhfqbRmx74AhfK5gC9msFHfpmGoUCJyfakAvjWoNeFTuzpY9PTz3QW.jpg)


![5190.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5mJZAdYXxCw2TFvJMZH5MEQDcssex3zB5qkQCFE6JG9TJvgRVK8xVBGKKyqojToFa.jpg)

We reached a small stream and the water sparkled under the sunlight . It was the first small stream and more to come as our trail will be more challenging.


![5337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Eou9CG8tXCrNVG6bvKiE8qWV8tEXyKJb4TnCj9iiYEncuqGYN8YvdJkWWFDJSutL2NR.jpg)

![5336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23tSYH5dEAfLwgMv6CsjtEHqfm6yxRBeofGhXLkQKBKNkWmLahcdcJw9sd8zhrpYigDo1.jpg)

![5211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EorzmCPKVce3tPwFkE7QTvWL2YSSe9SrC3vGvNr8q3zgsZ1s2p3c7jMH5hsuY9wF1XP.jpg)

We continued our walk, and the kids and I chose to cross the stream on a big fallen tree. And my husband just carefully stepped on stones to cross the water.


As we walked through the valley, the water was so crystal clear and we fully appreciate the beauty of nature. Tall trees surrounded us that made the area feel calm and relaxing.


![5265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpXJa4rCgxYbZLThoVHYgYCFZpgkXx2ZKGNLoRR1brFZoU3hCEMZQBV4WjC5iQNNj6a.jpg)



What I loved most about Cuha Valley was its stunning natural surroundings. And the towering rock formations added a breathtaking view to the landscape. Some visitors were not just to hike but also to climb. We saw kids challenge themselves by climbing the steep rock walk. It was really an adventure.


Our experience was even more relaxing and the air felt cool and refreshing.



![5235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Ep5nG1winFEMqJjg1i2Xq1EM8Kp7S1ZgVPnCf6XyM18yw5ia6tsxj1aB8zuM3kpYrEt.jpg)

![5263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Eokd5DEP4wG7YYTFKeDPx9vPMYrSBmtJynWyyvKMLuvLKL8eaSwhw3wh5q6yNhczN53.jpg)

![5244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpNnNUEMjAsFQhTUixRGBJTDpXuQ2V2N4YLBgnJcnnVnWWDt5nGm63muw3XmUXXwFGv.jpg)

![5269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EpvhP8Td8zYbRFS7Ryw2xcZCfik4J6CAMLdF1Q8u9mYsQEMUCZ9wCfSSsD49kd47Y35.jpg)

![5270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wCEDgyyrHsxaM5vtxRp8wohJFUUMy3grckpzc7rKpkPo6W79q5tAJp6Das4eCdPmT3W.jpg)



The place was made even more unique because of the railway and its tunnel. To reach the railway, we need to climb the stairs. After seeing the tunnel, we went down stairs and we were lucky to see the train pass over the tunnels above and added a special charm in the place 

The old stone bridge arched and human engineering felt nature blended on it together.



It was easy to follow the trail, with the wooden paths, marked routes and the water stream guiding us along the way.



![5298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23zGa4Ri56cUdFFNE2qMJGMYirR8W5a5ecKjYnjyQsYmEXET6oBtz3dJ7BEN4XjTMrnG2.jpg)

![5297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/Epviu4UL5Y62iJ5zWWKns6DosV9UrEmvDMkwSw16fsbAPXGgJUiR1h3sJyrW46WRLMN.jpg)

![5294.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23w2iu8sD9Qg4mPC2b5d4Z3tpLiPfQW1meNAF1Lh5Rfx1FTRdUtrKvnhvECuniUQ3DFGz.jpg)


Along the way, we discovered small caves that added to the adventure. And one of the highlights was the Kőpince Cave. Its natural rock openings added a unique charm to the hike. Every adventure we have becomes a chance to discover new places as a family. Hiking gives us a quality time that brings us closer- we talk, laugh and enjoy each other's company. Another memories added to our lists this year.





![5229.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23ynNRq3eg6CNkLXttMpnPqUXdhEee9jY6BR8AVtr9swCDkbnjAoorQXuQ5orxNmTV7Kz.jpg)

![5231.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23wCDijTtdNWLiktFRQaSLsYYCvgFjFeeq5yYkmyWXZgnkj6S1JgUHT6ZG8qC2vKvF33h.jpg)




What I love most  about the places like Cuha Valley is the sound of water, tall trees and the cool fresh wind.

The quiet place that makes you slow down and just breathe. The most important thing is to feel grateful that my kids discover the rocks, streams and tunnels.

Holidays don't need to be grand. And sometimes the simplest days become the most meaningful ones. We skipped the egg hunt and our Easter hike turned into a family memories we'll keep FOREVER.
 

![5334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/EoptKbd4fiiGaT2P5Yq87Em6D3Uu8v2QSjsnooz9xN7BxUzVm4pVCz4kxThyfZrrq6Y.jpg)


We went on our own adventure and discovered the beautiful nature. And Cuha Valley is definitely worth exploring. 
![1749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiekate86/23tw1RGcyG27D9fJmVnFfCmG49kya1HDGeGX6bkVtCrjLYB42YuYbAaPF7YTHHQ77mo1j.jpg)

body.title: There Are So Many Opportunities
body.body:
In real estate, I found that it took me 33 days. And I mean that's phone calls, that's DMs, that's emails, and sometimes it can lag on for years depending upon the price range and what's your niche. So if you're in that luxury market, it might take you a couple years for that person to call you back, and that's consistent campaigns that's being ran in order to say, hey, I'm still here.

How you doing? I noticed you were looking at a house like this. Let me send you a house like this. Hey, I know you're looking for this apartment, two-bedroom, three-bath apartment, and you want a balcony.

Here's four of them that came on the market. If we're early, we can go ahead and schedule. Can I schedule this meeting and appointment for you? Hey, by the way, I noticed that you're not looking for a boat or industrial or commercial.

Listen, I was swimming in a whole bunch of different lanes. So by knowing that I am dealing, one, with credible people, right, so they went through the KYC process. I'm dealing with a real person.

I'm not dealing with a bot. Do you know how much time that saves me? But then, two, knowing the business, going through that KYB, understanding that this is a viable business. This business is generating revenue.

They have the needs, and so being that matchmaker can save so much time, especially in that small- to medium-sized business area. Absolutely, absolutely. So, yeah, and those were some of the pain points that I looked at is who doesn't want more customers? Who doesn't want to work with credible businesses? I think that's something that we all need to consider.

Where are you getting your business from? What talents are you sharing with others that you have? If you're skilled staffed, even, put it out there. Hey, I can work with you. There are so many opportunities to really support sustainable revenue, and you share that from a requester standpoint.

body.title: Sentul Trekking part 2
body.body:
>Do you still remember the day when you went trekking in Sentul and visited the waterfall? This is a follow-up post about the second waterfall I visited. I forgot its name, but somehow I ended up taking a selfie in front of the Barong Waterfall sign, Leuwi Hejo. 

To get to this waterfall, the path wasn't too muddy, but there were still dense plants on both sides. For some reason, not many people visit this waterfall, even though I think it's beautiful and its location is quite secluded. I was happy because it was quieter on the way to this waterfall. 

----


![IMG20250706105502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23ynf8JPa3njpfUQ6cTYQJbsKAqP2dYy2hSqepXaBRNtjPgh8Za365jd2NsuDqwzxEYw1.jpg)

![IMG20250706124823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23wWru5ebLgLi7stBSWe54HMZ73LwJxZ9K6YqnPajjpVXWaYmBd3zb3Cr9eVNJrMZP6u7.jpg)

![IMG20250706105448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/Eoc7WXKSTuFzYtzqgtPZ9zR9gwRm7PQNLe62UrZv38wY9qv1SwS1QFHuGRaMBMZZxjd.jpg)

____

Although there were some fairly steep sections of the path and we had to be careful, it was still safe, and at some points I could even run a little because some of the paths were still flat. 

---

![IMG20250706123224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23uQmv2FNc22zauPorvZRd2UKUSAgRuRszZuiqarcGheVeRLk8pvubekVysEVxsna3fQc.jpg)

![IMG20250706124404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23w2nzJ5K6a5khyVYNMNbe5t12xZL82rjz1shHNgHB2PEN1MhW1Ph4hr8VoLRXwkCw8Wh.jpg)


---

Of the four waterfalls I visited, I think this last one was the most memorable. Although it is short, the roar of the water and the spray are very strong and refreshing. The air here was also fresher. Perhaps because there were only a few people here, only about five from our group. 



----


![IMG_20260328_09034023.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23w2eJb5kTH4JdToy78sUm9hHZmuGLkU8UTdVFydrtLkxHA61RTrg5hUVgYUnAokrprgr.jpeg)

---

I took a short video and some photos, then stood around the waterfall to enjoy the atmosphere. Since this was the last waterfall and the end of today's trip, I decided to enjoy it very leisurely. 

Don't imagine that tomorrow I'll be back to my usual routine and the hustle and bustle of Jakarta. Today, at this moment, my soul and mind are still attached to Sentul and all the waterfalls in this area. Maybe I should visit here another time to enjoy the other waterfalls. Everything was enjoyable for me.

Maybe if you're in the same city as me, we can come back here together(?) for Hive Trekking? LOL. 

And so today's journey ends, and I must say goodbye. Wait for my next adventure. There are still two mountain climbs I haven't told you about yet. See you in my next travel journal. Thank you for reading my writing. See you.   

 
---

body.title: Weekends Derailed
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23yJGFWVqvKumP1RCmMojGU9LVgqvDBCvkydQ6sN5cE2jF6oA4GokvtvuJM6ctU8ZLkMx.png)</center>

-----------------------

I had some big plans for the past couple of weekends.  Okay, maybe not big plans, but I had some stuff I wanted to get done now that the weather is starting to be a bit more cooperative.  In fact, a week ago this past Saturday was just about one of the most perfect days we have had in 2026 so far.  Unfortunately life, or more specifically @mrsbozz had other plans for me.

Her parents recently bought a new house, and so the past couple of weekends have been spent helping them get packed up and moved over to then new address.  I'm a bit sad to say they still have a long way to go, but we are making progress.  It's actually kind of funny, despite the fact that I did not grow up in their old house like my wife did, I still feel a bit of sadness about them leaving it behind.

Just the other day I mentioned to her that I didn't get to spend my last Christmas there.  You might recall I was sick this past year for Christmas, so I spent the majority of my time at my own house staring at the ceiling or the toilet bowl.  I didn't get to participate in any of the fun traditions we have built over the past several decades.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/242NfAmRhzcF9RRuPLSasoZAEz22rF4jgCvDKtLMs2AAirZFroJwY7819tthy4yVn9rdW.png)</center>

--------------------------

Despite that, this is still a good move for them and I am excited for them. The old house was great when they were younger and had three kids running around, but now that is just the two of them, they really don't need all that space.  Likewise, as they get older, it's good to be part of a community where the yardwork and all of that is taken care of by someone else.  

It will be a shift for them, but I think they will settle in just fine.  They just might need to find some new hobbies.  Especially my father in law.  He used to love to putter around the yard, so it will be hard for him to let that go I think.  

Speaking of puttering, I have some rocks I have been meaning to move from one flower bed to another for several years now.  That was on my list to get started last weekend.  The lawn is ready to have its first cut of the year, so I need to get to that sometime too. 

The problem is, the next two or three weekends in a row my wife and I have plans that I made for us a long time ago.  Meanwhile, I need to get our travel trailer home from storage at my parents house.  Get it cleaned, washed, de-winterized, repack the wheel bearings, check the gas lines for leaks, and get it all packed up for our first camping trip of the season at the end of May.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wWy7DVjnpNWj7e3ffaHUZrT4M6vK4LRejXu31qsRE5LrRx4JXAKo2eNZSJUjbEiAP7i.png)</center>

----------------------------

No big deal right?  Meanwhile, we also need to get the power washer from my brother in law so we can get the deck ready to go for the summer.  Put away all the winter stuff and pull out all the summer stuff from the shed.  @mrsbozz wants the windows on the house professionally washed, and I need to get the garage cleaned up at some point.

No rush...

I don't want to say I am annoyed that my last two weekends have been blown up.  I don't think that is quite the right word.  It's been for the greater good, and I fully acknowledge that.  I just hope the weather cooperates so I can get the rest of this stuff done.  The good news is, it looks like the rain is going to hold off for a bit, but we really need the temps to stay above freezing for a while now.

body.title: Bees, butterflies and dragonflies in this garden.
body.body:
It looked like an ordinary garden flower bed, but I decided to wait for nature's visitors.
![040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wCFwR5yw3ce9dnsFSFbgrYpQuncqEobiJhbqwf9py5tcUWyfEx8jV1epftxRi4EHP9B.jpg)

So many times, one just has to sit still and to wait for the action. This was such a time.

We were on our way out for a meeting when all of a sudden the water icon lit up red on the car's instrument screen, then a beep noise started as a warning. So, halfway we had to stop at a service station so that I could see why the car was crying for water. I cannot blame the car as the water level was dangerously low, and so I topped it up to the correct level. However, it would have been dicey to continue on the trip as it was a warm day, and I didn't know if the water would start acting up again. Years ago, the car that I had at the time overheated, and it cooked the engine. I had pulled over but the damage was already done. That is why I decided this time to turn back. So, we rescheduled the meeting on my wife's phone and we headed back. On the way the car was behaving, and we pulled in at a local farm for a coffee to steady my nerves :) 

Just as well that we did as there is a coffee shop on the farm and while we waited for the coffee some movement caught my eye in a flowerbed close by. So, I kept my eye on the flowerbed and that's when I first saw the Acraea butterfly that landed on a flower. Some bees were also active in the flowerbed and with great luck a dragonfly came to sit close to us in the morning sun. All the photos that you will see in here were taken by me in that flowerbed.
Come and see.

The butterfly, also in the first picture, is a Garden Acraea (Acraea horta). 
It is a member of the Subfamily Helioconiinae. There are six Acraea species in the country, and this Acraea is the only specie to be found in the Western Cape. 
![111.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wC7xFazPd8HyLUqLAvZfVXpDum3enxtyQtxBXKtQ5dCnZV4f3fU86d8CkG8e7iBVq4c.JPG)

Did I tell you that the bees were also active in the flowerbed. 
![011.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wMTpa6VvYQWzpGNzTyYjufo5fRFKayvj3uVQSyTXjC9P2pgZmePs59K9N1mDcFmecZo.JPG)

They were honeybees collecting pollen. 
![010.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uFRQYTspgM7sJ143T1CwHyS7jArR3tMcxvPgowRRTUvx3TGhKeDXh5y22oyW6XmBokt.JPG)

Just another one in a shady spot.
![125.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23vhqH7gx5j1mR67LuZuD63RwTXoDxyFk9GGxNJCBJjEWdckW12wZYGgmCN868M9CXmQZ.JPG)

Here below I will show you three photos of the flowerbed.
![015.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoAZpYEUcJGSbMYWc2diqc2LraNEddNXfct3E1oDogYu7Sq46QpRvj6Up6UwjxfAVjQ.JPG)

![017.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EonkbWsohu45AD9Mt8Em7gJgQxov8jwX4B1YujZFMGnmTTPYNhLCEToqEiirTYoYKok.JPG)

![021.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xp6gdKAaTKKZkTLEY6qf37MVGuDVgBDogyMkBPHKJzTnxAHM6pWSqCSwbqSkQiWDYrn.JPG)

That's the dragonfly that came to sit close by, and it looked like a Two-striped Skimmer (Orthetrum caffrum).  
![009.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23zm5ky2dfdmYDXAYPmbHMWxumBDasKdneKe7zHXPACC9y4Km4Lv7tZayZj9TnWqU9RU3.JPG)

For some reason, he was skimming up and down and I will show you the reason why in another post. 
![026.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wr7hyo3KnfuCZWeTTgCMMSW9NiUHPhw4yYJMj1Y2bWDcvKbF2zs8uwda7XazJknPkdb.JPG)

Nature's song will continue long after humans are gone, as it was like such before and it will be the same after. Billions of people have enjoyed nature's bounty through all of the generations, and nature's resilience is legendary. Let me tell you that we were so happy to see this flowerbed, as it always shows us how simple life can be. I am reminded here, of a story about a wildfire scorching the earth, and afterwards to everyone's amazement a lovely crystal white flower started growing in the blackened wasteland of the fire. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

I don't keep a space open for the sake of keeping a space open. I believe we all have something to say, and I value your time. So I'm excited to hear what's going on.

So you all, let's start with us. Katie, you want to talk to them a little bit about what we've created? Sure, absolutely. Good morning, everyone.

Incentory is based on intent signals. We wanted to build something that allowed people to opt in and meet compliance. What we found is that a lot of people who have small, medium-sized businesses, businesses of different sizes, when they're trying to grow their businesses and get lead data, the ROI for their spend is really poor.

They're getting a lot of dead-end data and reaching out in ways that don't meet compliance, so they're putting themselves at risk. So what we wanted to do was build a platform that allows people to opt in. So it's an opt-in platform.

So we have requesters who are looking for services, and then we have service providers who can also join the platform and be able to make that match. With making that match, the requester of the service also gets a payout for taking part in the service provider campaign. So there's incentives there to take part, and not only do you get the payout, but you actually get to connect and control who you speak with in the service providers that are going to be contacting you through the campaigns.

- Early holders preparing to exit

Hoy decidí explorar una parte de la ciudad que no conocía bien. Comencé mi caminata en un parque local donde vi a un grupo de personas haciendo tai chi; su energía tranquila me inspiró a respirar profundamente y disfrutar del momento. Hablé brevemente con una mujer mayor que me contó que lleva practicando tai chi durante más de una década. Ella mencionó que le ayuda a mantener el equilibrio, tanto físico como emocional. Continué mi camino y pasé por un mercado callejero lleno de colores y aromas. Allí conocí a un joven que vendía artesanías hechas a mano. Me mostró un llavero que había fabricado con materiales reciclados y me habló de su deseo de promover el consumo sostenible. Fue genial escuchar su pasión y ver cómo su creatividad se reflejaba en su trabajo. A medida que avanzaba, me encontré con un mural impresionante que representaba la diversidad de la comunidad. La mezcla de colores y estilos artísticos me hizo detenerme a contemplar y reflexionar sobre la belleza de la diversidad. En general, fue una caminata enriquecedora, llena de encuentros interesantes y momentos que me recordaron lo vibrante que es la vida en la ciudad. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). The situation in Britain regarding attacks on synagogues is getting worse and worse.  Recently it appears that we are getting one firebombing of a synagogue or of Jewish organisations per week.

The latest attack was in Kenton in North West London when an incendiary device was thrown through the window of the synagogue.

The London Evening Standard reported:

\

The initial fire was apparently spotted by routine police ‘reassurance patrols’ in an area that has within it a lot of Jews.  If these Metropolitan Police officers had not spotted the fire at an early stage then this could have had far greater impact.

As before there is speculation that this as with other Jew hatred related attacks in London is the work of the Iranian Islamic regime and this cannot be ruled out.  It’s quite possible that the Iranian government is paying criminals in Britain to attack British Jews something which is quite the escalation from what we’ve seen in previous years.

Of course the Prime Minister has decried this attack but it’s unlikely that his government will do anything to stop this problem getting even more  out of hand.  This is because  the ruling Labour Party has significant problems with both Jew hatred among its own members and supporters and because the Labour Party cannot robustly protect Britain’s Jews without upsetting the millions of Jew hating Muslims that comprise Labour’s new ‘core vote’.

I’d like to think that things will get better for Britain’s Jews but I’m cynical enough and knowledgable enough about history to not be all that optimistic.

body.title: The Blue Hair
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theithei/2424EczxiDvX6EDgqcS6c6QTbRFXyhwodkUZKbbKn8EAvf1KR6FXDoCr25x8ANMm2MAfb.png)

 
Back again for another exciting round of the Doodle Magic challenge this time, I started with a really dynamic, swirling blue shape that had some fantastic curves and sharp points at the top. Usually, I have to rotate these shapes a few times to find the spark, but the moment I saw this one, the inspiration was instant.

Looking at that main swoop, I didn't see a random object or a splash of water I immediately saw the back of a neck and hair going upwards and the top is an abrupt baldness. The points at the top felt so much like a stylized, spiky hairstyle that I knew I had to build a character with a lot of focus and personality around it.

Decided to keep that original blue shape exactly as it was. I used those top flickers to define the hair and let the lower curve naturally guide where the ear and neckline should sit. From there, I completed the profile by giving the character a bold, prominent nose and a single, huge eye that really captures a sense of curiosity and unease. I really love how that vibrant blue pops against the neutral, flat skin tone that I usually choose for this kind of challenge; it makes the original challenge shape pop even more.

Stuck closely to my favorite clean and flat aesthetic for this one. I find that keeping things simple with bold lines and solid color blocks really helps the narrative of the transformation stand out without getting cluttered by too much detail. It was fun to take an organic, wavelike blob and find the human character hiding inside it. Building a whole mood just from a few sharp angles and a specific shade of blue is exactly why I love this challenge.

When you look at abstract shapes like this, do you immediately start seeing people and personalities, or do you find yourself imagining objects or landscapes? Why not give it a go and show us what you got

Here is the reference shape should you want to try this challenge

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theithei/242sEDzSovrXqX6RKdUAiCxWahaimpXjjYsZtAgMBDRuEUQf8z4xp4J2rbYxeyrNC5Fef.png)

body.title: 3 Venezuelan Horror Movies
body.body:
![Black Horror Vlog Youtube Thumbnail (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uFRypsMJiEaBx4LUTKLoJTutR5kHd9Ba4CtimBCAVRYGELyqAg4fPN7XJ9j6hRNHRGY.jpg)
[Fuente](https://comerciocorporativo.blogspot.com/2018/11/el-silbon-origenes-proximamente-en-las.html)
[Fuente](https://radiomundial.com.ve/tag/el-infierno-de-gaspar/)

Often, when we think of horror movies, we immediately think of big American productions like The Exorcist or The Conjuring, but we often overlook the fact that our country (Venezuela) also produces high-quality films in this genre. I'm not usually a big fan of horror, but I've seen some films that make me think they deserve more support, not just because they're Venezuelan, but because they truly have many noteworthy elements that elevate their quality. >A menudo cuando pensamos en películas de terror siempre se nos vienen a la mente las grandes producciones estadounidenses como El Exorcista o El Conjuro, pero ignoramos que en nuestro país (Venezuela) a menudo también hay mucha calidad en los films de este género. Usualmente no soy un gran consumidor de este genero, pero he visto algunas películas que me han hecho pensar que merecen más apoyo, no solo por ser venezolanas, sino porque de verdad tienen muchos elementos que son dignos de resaltar y elevan la calidad.

La Casa del Fin de los Tiempos

The House at the End of Time

This film is the debut feature of Venezuelan director Alejandro Hidalgo. It tells the story of a woman unjustly accused of murdering her husband and causing the disappearance of her children. Thirty years later, she returns to her home, only to find it shrouded in mystery and terrifying events. The film transcends mere horror; the director employs numerous symbols, particularly Masonic ones like the square and the all-seeing eye, as well as religious and witchcraft symbols. However, what truly captivates me is the inclusion of numerous subgenres within the plot, which makes it both more engaging and dynamic. >Esta película es la opera prima del director venezolano Alejandro Hidalgo, trata sobre una mujer que fue injustamente acusada de haber asesinado a su esposo y de la desaparición de sus hijos, treinta años después ella regresa a su casa pero allí se viven misterios y situaciones terribles. La película en si va mucho más allá del terror, el director recurre al uso de muchos simbolismos, en especial masónicos como la escuadra o el ojo que todo lo ve, pero también símbolos religiosos y de hechicería, no obstante lo que llama mi atención es que hay muchos subgéneros en la trama que hacen que se vuelva más interesante y dinámica.

https://youtu.be/JZ8eMI5ThG8

El Infierno de Gaspar Mendoza

Gaspar Mendoza's Hell

I truly enjoyed this film because it felt different. It's a blend of gothic horror and epic drama, set during the Venezuelan Federal War. The protagonist, Gaspar Mendoza, carries a terrible, dark past, and to escape the crimes he committed during the war, he retreats with his family to a country house. However, certain presences and manifestations begin to torment him. The film is quite unlike anything I've seen before, featuring interesting cinematography that prioritizes a dark and opaque atmosphere to maintain an oppressive feel. The performances rose to the challenge, especially the lead actor's. >De verdad que disfruté mucho de esta película porque la noté diferente y es que es una mezcla de horror gótico con drama épicos ya que está ambientada en la guerra federal venezolana. El protagonista, Gaspar Mendoza, carga a cuestas un terrible pasado oscuro, así que para intentar huir de todos los crímenes cometidos durante la guerra se retira junto a su familia a una casa de campo, pero ciertas presencias y manifestaciones comienzan a atormentarlo. La película es a todas luces muy diferente a lo que yo había visto antes, maneja una fotografía interesante en la cuál se prioriza una ambientación opaca y oscura para mantener una atmósfera opresiva. Las actuaciones estuvieron a la altura del reto, en especial la del protagonista.

https://youtu.be/p8RwabpaO2Y

El Silbón

The Whistler

This film aims to highlight and explain the origins of one of the most popular specters in Venezuelan folklore, El Silbón, who, as his name suggests, whistles in the darkness of night. It's a distinctive and chilling whistle (if you hear it close, it's because he's actually far away, and if you hear it far away, it's because he's right behind you). Legend says that his soul was cursed the moment he murdered his father to eat his entrails, and since then he has been condemned to carry a bundle of his father's bones. The film, therefore, seeks to explain the origins of this character and his motivations, as the father in question was a violent and abusive man. It has an interesting narrative that tells the story in two timelines, the performances are very convincing, and it's clear that the budget was well managed. The production is a Venezuelan, American, and Mexican collaboration, indicating a significant investment. >Esta película pretende resaltar y explicar los orígenes de uno de los espectros más populares del folclore venezolano, El Silbón, el cuál como su nombre lo indica, suele silbar en la oscuridad de la noche, es un silbido característico y escalofriante (si lo oyes cerca es porque en realidad está lejos, y si lo oyes lejos es porque está justo detrás de ti) Dice la leyenda que su alma quedó maldita en el momento en que él asesinó a su padre para comer sus vísceras, y desde entonces está condenado a cargar un fardo con los huesos de su padre. La película entonces pretende explicar los orígenes de este personaje y también sus razones, ya que el padre en cuestión era un hombre violento y abusivo. Tiene una narrativa interesante que cuenta la historia en dos tiempos, las actuaciones son muy convincentes y se nota que hubo una buena administración del presupuesto. La producción es venezolana, estadounidense y mexicana, así que hubo una buena inversión.

https://youtu.be/-OVN5-hJeBw

Thank you for allowing me to share with you this selection I made of what I consider to be the three best Venezuelan horror films. I open the dialogue so that you can share your opinions and contributions about more films with me. >Gracias por haberme permitido compartir con ustedes esta selección que hice de lo que considero las tres mejores películas de terror venezolanas, abro el diálogo para que compartan conmigo su opinión y aportes sobre más películas.

![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)

body.title: Cada libro es un nuevo mundo [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Purple Beige Retro Illustration Vintage Music Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23viGi458YTxG4kh4ocoqhEv2w7ASVaj4crxtYgVabXJTPA1oSEWN1JXuAz21HS76pYUP.jpg)

Hola, gente de internet ¿Cómo están? hoy quiero compartir con ustedes mi experiencia con los libros, esos que yo llamo \

sí, porque para mí eso es lo que son, los libros son compañeros de viajes y de tardes de lluviosas, son portales a nuevos mundos que te muestran otros estilos de vida. Algunos solo te entretienen, otros te hacen reír o llorar, algunos llegan hasta el punto de darte verdaderas lecciones de vida.\n\n>Hello, internet people! How are you? Today I want to share with you my experience with books, those I call \

Yes, because for me that's what they are. Books are travel companions and companions on rainy afternoons; they are portals to new worlds that show you other ways of life. Some simply entertain you, others make you laugh or cry, and some even go so far as to give you true life lessons.

![b7f2d2b714e0f0a8aaca853beb639cc41aa905d8r1-320-181_00.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23vrtjWAMmaagjdHYXdWBCo9VLg7mV1486sy7GP9qxZYUMVrCU82denbWwxWwCr9REEYF.gif)

Con respecto a ese libro especial que haya cambiado mi vida... no podría decir que tengo solo uno, amo leer pero no soy fiel a un solo libro o autor, sin embargo si me pidieran mencionar solo uno yo diría Memorias de una Geisha, porque amo la cultura japonesa y de cierta manera este libro me permitió entender acerca de la vida de las Geishas y Maikos, y digo \

porque luego apareció un libro de una verdadera Geisha desmintiendo algunos mitos (lo cual me pareció fascinante también) además, aunque Memorias de una Geisha no sirva como un fiel referente cultural o histórico de Japón, de todos modos amo la determinación de Sayuri (la protagonista) me parece que es admirable y también opino que la narrativa del autor es exquisita.

\n\n>Regarding that special book that changed my life... I couldn't say I have just one. I love to read, but I'm not loyal to a single book or author. However, if I had to name just one, I would say Memoirs of a Geisha, because I love Japanese culture, and in a way, this book allowed me to understand the lives of Geishas and Maikos. I say \

because later a book by a real Geisha came out debunking some myths (which I also found fascinating). Besides, even though Memoirs of a Geisha isn't a reliable cultural or historical reference for Japan, I still love Sayuri's (the protagonist's) determination. I find it admirable, and I also think the author's writing is exquisite.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xetLHQaKUnzQBaTzJCsLnJ1RucwHaiUGjkM79w275oteSgetk6qin35UBWnEnVbUsk4.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/4597893830417541248/)

No puedo dejar de mencionar El retrato de Dorian gray: es una historia espeluznante pero con mucha profundidad y enseñanzas, nos enseña que el valor no está en la apariencia física sino en lo que cultivas dentro de ti. Oscar Wilde es uno de los íconos de la era victoriana y su narrativa tiene ese toque de misterio y oscuridad que lo hace fascinante. >I cannot fail to mention The Picture of Dorian Gray: It's a chilling story, but one with great depth and valuable lessons. It teaches us that true worth lies not in physical appearance, but in what you cultivate within yourself. Oscar Wilde is one of the icons of the Victorian era, and his narrative possesses that touch of mystery and darkness that makes it so captivating.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tbkNv4Uic2hpSnC2avSaZz8ywWFx3ru7F3D7xGWAGYSnSj85rWtPNt7ePFehGfcKGkB.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/706009679115681629/)

¡Ah! pero no puedo dejar de lado Harry Potter: porque me ha acompañado por muchos años (desde mi infancia) Sus personajes son muy bien desarrollados, en especial Tom Riddle/Voldemort, y la creatividad y extensión del mundo mágico me encanta, es simplemente soberbia.

>Ah! But I can't leave out Harry Potter: because it has been with me for many years (since my childhood). Its characters are very well developed, especially Tom Riddle/Voldemort, and I love the creativity and extent of the magical world; it's simply superb.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tbPF1ApTmf89FjyAUSYbDxyXiixV6VB9pH81msRktvnooyFtHtQqQTsreTZReERN541.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/321514860873243236/)

En cuanto a mi genero literario favorito tampoco tengo uno en especifico, amo el Terror, el suspense, y el thriller psicológico. Les recomiendo La asistenta, este libro me mantuvo en vilo todo el tiempo 🤗

body.title: The Never Ending Story [Summary and Analysis] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Presentación Diapositivas Proyecto de Historia Vintage Scrapbook Marrón.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wMY9najDyLQ2FjSU3PaNaJpxdgwtnFeNEoU5scKh3oSFGsBjPT2t2mC93H5NGxNvMBP.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Ever since I saw the movie a while ago, I wanted to read the book, the original story it's based on, because I seriously love fantasy stories, which is why I also love Harry Potter and Narnia, but the truth is that The Neverending Story pleasantly surprised me by finding so much depth in both its plot and each of the characters. >Desde que vi la película hace tiempo quise leer el libro, la historia original en la que está basada, ya que en serio amo con locura las historias de fantasía, por eso amo también Harry Potter y Narnia, pero la verdad es que La Historia sin fin me sorprendió gratamente al encontrar tantísima profundidad tanto en su trama como en cada uno de los personajes.

Overview/Resumen

Bastian Balthazar Bux is a lonely boy with a very bad relationship with his father. He is overweight and is constantly bullied by his classmates at school. Because of this, he finds refuge in books. In fact, one day he goes to a bookstore and steals a book that isn't for sale. It's called... guess what?... yes, exactly, The Neverending Story. As Bastian begins to read, he is fascinated by what he finds. It's about a kingdom called Fantasia that is slowly disintegrating due to the lack of dreams and hope among its people. This creates a void that everyone calls \

The Empress is desperate and sends the warrior Atreyu to find help to prevent the total destruction of Fantasia. But as Bastian continues reading, his heart begins to beat faster, as he discovers that the \

Atreyu is looking for is none other than Bastian himself. He has an important mission: to give the Empress a new name.

\n\n>Bastián Baltasar Bux es un niño solitario y tiene una muy mala relación con su padre, tiene sobrepeso y por causa de esto es molestado constantemente por sus compañeros de clases en la escuela, debido a esto él encuentra refugio en los libros, de hecho en una ocasión el va a una librería y roba un libro que no está a la venta, se llama ¿Adivinen cómo?... sí, exactamente, La Historia Sin Fin. Al comenzar a leer Bastian está fascinado con lo que encuentra, se trata de un reino llamado Fantasía que poco a poco se desintegra por causa de la falta de sueños y esperanzas de los humanos en su mundo, esto crea un vacío que todos llaman \

La Emperatriz está desesperada y por eso envía al guerrero Atreyu en busca de ayuda para evitar la destrucción total de Fantasía, pero a medida que Bastian avanza en la lectura, su corazón comienza a latir con más prisa, ya que descubre que ese \

que Atreyu está buscando es el propio Bastian, él tendría una misión importante, darle un nuevo nombre a la Emperatriz.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqq6NWwfLafqY3fLsoYPe5RYRYd2bbwG3nYBcA8PYBwvmvAYS527CbaVHFxYWjAvc2z.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/369647081917177490/)

In the second part of the book, Bastian arrives in Fantasia and, with the help of the AURYN (a medallion), rebuilds the nation with his wishes. However, each wish causes him to lose one of his memories in his own world, and this unfortunately makes him cold and arrogant, as he begins to lose his essence and identity. Atreyu helps him overcome his fears, so he discovers that his only desire is to love, and he is ready to return to his world and restore his strained relationship with his father, just as he rebuilt Fantasia.

>En la segunda parte del libro Bastian llega a fantasía y con ayuda del AURYN (un medallón) reconstruye la nación con sus deseos, pero cada deseo le hace perder uno de sus recuerdos en su propio mundo y esto lamentablemente lo vuelve frío y arrogante, ya que comienza a perder su esencia e identidad. Atreyu lo ayuda a superar sus propios miedos, de modo que descubre que su único deseo es amar, y está listo para regresar a su mundo y restablecer la deteriorada relación con su padre, de la misma manera que reconstruyó Fantasía.

My Opinion/Mi Opinión

After reading this story, as is my custom, I began to delve deeper into it... What does nothingness mean? What does it represent? Why is it fueled by people's lack of desire? And then I understood that it's about human apathy. The disappointments and prejudices that every human being experiences in their life sour their character, gradually undermining any dreams and hopes they may have, leaving them empty. Do you understand? That's what nothingness is. Nothingness is a force that sweeps away and destroys everything in its path. This can make you apathetic, bitter, and even insensitive. And what do people whose dreams and illusions have been shattered often do (though not always)? They destroy the dreams and illusions of others (sometimes out of envy, and other times in an attempt to protect them from the pain of failure). And in this way, the situation becomes a loop that leads to an endless story.

>Tras leer esta historia, como ya es costumbre en mi, comencé a profundizar en ella... ¿Qué significa la nada? ¿Qué representa? ¿Por qué la alimenta la falta de deseos de las personas? Y entonces comprendí que se trata de la apatía humana, las decepciones y los prejuicios que todo ser humano experimenta en su vida van agriando su carácter, poco a poco van socavando los sueños y esperanzas que pueda tener, dejándolo vacío ¿Comprenden? Eso es la nada, la nada es una fuerza que arrasa y destruye todo a su paso, esto puede volverte apático, agrio e incluso insensible, ¿Y qué hacen a menudo (no en todos los casos) las personas cuyos sueños e ilusiones han sido rotos? Destruir los de los demás (a veces por envidia y en otras circunstancias ene un intento por protegerlos del dolor del fracaso) y de esta manera esta situación se vuelve un bucle que deriva exactamente en una historia interminable.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xySdJder7ayHP6pKoBS5HUGvFqUGN39o4GFGVNoWCbR2hZ47NW43WQmorEYnY6LCAtR.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/3025924727746729/)

Another important point to highlight in this wonderful work by Michael Ende is that fantasy is not an escape from reality, but a means through which you can better understand it. For example, when you read Narnia and find the parallels with Christianity, it helps you better understand this faith. Sometimes we recognize in certain characters behaviors that we probably adopt without realizing it, and this third-person perspective can help us understand ourselves better. Elves, fairies, and magic in general are representations of longings and dreams that exist in real life, perhaps in a hidden corner of our hearts, sometimes concealed and intimidated by \

or sinking like Atreyu's horse.

\n\n>Otra cosa importante a resaltar en esta maravillosa obra de Michael Ende es que la fantasía no es una evasión de la realidad, sino un medio a través del cuál puedes entenderla mejor, por ejemplo cuando lees Narnia y encuentras esos paralelismo que hay con respecto al cristianismo, te ayuda a comprender mejor esta fe, A veces reconocemos en ciertos en personajes conductas que probablemente adoptamos sin darnos cuenta, y esta mirada en tercera persona puede ayudar a que nos comprendamos mejor. Los duendes, hadas y la magia en general son representaciones de anhelos y sueños que existen en la vida real, quizá en un recóndito rincón de nuestros corazones, a veces escondidos y amedrentados por \

o hundiéndose como el caballo de Atreyu.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uFXuxQR1YUaBAjXERiceyzhPGtJ89RM2KTE3msvWRsKRkKXc2P4ZmQ6sCouuSvPCz4z.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/6473993210989940/)

Bastian is in a learning process in which he better understands himself, finally accepts himself, leaves behind his insecurities and that constant need for attention and external recognition. Why? Because he recognizes that everything starts with himself.

>Bastian se encuentra en un proceso de aprendizaje en el cuál él se comprende mejor a sí mismo, finalmente se acepta a si mismo, deja los complejos atrás y esa constante necesidad de atención y reconocimiento externo ¿Por qué? porque reconoce que todo empieza por el mismo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23x131PmvbnMNaQphr8a69Use8FVYaTvenQX9hpTiQ2CSuAfD7DM1ii6Pqdt9CjYyJZYk.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/59813501295928416/)

I hope you enjoyed my analysis and that you read this book if you have the opportunity to do so because it is truly worthwhile.

>Espero que hayan disfrutado de mi análisis y que lean este libro si tienen la oportunidad, porque realmente vale la pena.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)
>Imagen diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva.

body.title: Girl From Nowhere: The Reset (2026) Review
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamboring/23yJGU4PcNuc74FsZHxersjDf3KpdyPSJJfhgAHkUoQzg8LmMhEv3SSFCQ9CSZD11h7Ei.png)

As an avid fan of *Girl From Nowhere*, I always anticipate what would happen in the reset version. *Girl From Nowhere: The Reset* is like a reboot of the franchise where they reimagined Nanno in another universe. I just finished it and I have mixed reaction from it. Becky portrays Nanno as the main lead, and you can't deny that she performed well. She's beautiful and more like evil-type of face. Each episode has a different storyline, so I'm going to rate it based on my personal taste. It might contain spoilers, so I warn you.

# Episode 1 - \

- 7/10

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fCiu2krQ00Q

For me, the topic of this episode is cliché but relevant. It talks about bullying, where Jom's circle was bullying Sky. The main lesson in this story is clear, as it represents how we pass our trauma to someone. This leads to a cycle of events where we just hurt each other. Yet, Jom's karma is bad and very unrealistic. It seems like revenge, in my opinion, and I like how Sky reacted to his nemesis' karma. They might have just wanted to add light romance to this series. I think they had a point in adding it since it would be super boring if they didn’t add a twist.

# Episode 2 - \

- 9/10

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FdKUkLfrO4I

Out of all the episodes, this is my favorite. It talks about invasion of privacy and the issue of victim blaming. I can't tell the whole story, but this is well-written. I love the karma compared to the first episode, which looks like revenge. Until now, I'm still shocked at how it ended with Peck's arousal. The karma is just a chef’s kiss. In my opinion, the ending seemed forced, and adding *Girl From Nowhere* to Nanno's panty ruined the experience. Regardless, I still like how the two boys, along with the principal, got their karma so badly. If I were in their position, it would definitely haunt me forever.

# Episode 3 - \

- 6/10

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aBD8CJbgXeo

This is the worst-written episode in the series. I think Nanno's judgment of her victim's hatred toward his co-content creator seems rushed. Instead of triggering his karma that quickly, she should have elevated it further. She should have also looked at Jaimie's side (the one who got hate) further since he also lied. Anyway, I like how they represent the RPW war happening on social media. It is the only thing that makes it watchable.

# Episode 4 - \

- 8/10

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WdItaoDNalE

I like it, but it's super quick. Like in the previous episode, it doesn’t get elaborated further. First, I like how Nanno questioned Blossom's idea about \

I just don't get satisfied on how cliffhanging the ending is. Maybe the writer just wants to let the viewers decide what her choice would be if she continues or not. No karma happened to Blossom, so I find it quite weak. Yet, I love the twists in the story, and it is the most memorable for me out of the episodes.\n\n# Episode 5 - \

- 8/10

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91P8uXyREMI

In our country where crocodiles are leading the government, I like how its story relatable. The role of Nanno here is more like two-faced. I also love how the group exposed their corruption and remained standing despite challenges. I just don't like its predictable ending, but I don’t mind it. Moreover, I'm also surprised that they inserted BL elements in this story since it's so popular in Thailand. I don't mind it as well, though.

# Episode 6 - \

- 9/10

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mbizOsw4hY0&t=3s

I just watched it yesterday, and I like it as well. But for me, Episode 2 is still a bit better than this. This is the last episode, and I love how Nanno questioned the principal. You know, we can't deny that we always make the same mistakes. It's also inevitable that we often judge those who are at fault, but we also do it. In short, we are all hypocrites. Until now, I don't know what happened to Sky and his role in following her. Maybe it will be answered in the second season (if there will be.)

Thank you for reading. In conclusion, I just prefer the old season better than this version. Personally, I like Chicha more as the lead since she looks more innocent and creepy than Becky. I'm not saying that Becky is a bad actress since she nailed the role here. Unfortunately, the directors also didn’t show much of the iconic laugh, and the writing is weak. While watching it and waiting for another episode, I rewatched the two original seasons. It's better watching it a second time after seeing it five years ago, haha. Looking forward to Japanese adaptation, though.

Original Link of the [Thumbnail](https://www.google.com/search?q=girl+from+nowhere+the+reset&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSaxoyKhBlLVpZVWZoY2ZwU2diMjdNMg5aWVVmaGNmcFNnYjI3TToOWXVTLXR5aHdwU1pRQk0gBCoxChtfVDhqbGFaQ3BFNDdsMnJvUDE5dkFtQWdfNTkSEGUtWllVZmhjZnBTZ2IyN00YADABGAcg3f-d8ghKCBACGAEgAigB)

body.title: Hive Open Mic week 315 || YOU REIGN FOREVER || covered by @sampraise77
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776682479405-dd89608ba1c24dab.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/af2f362f)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=sampraise77/af2f362f)


---

Hive Open Mic week 315, @sampraise77 is my name and for this week I will do a rendition of a song titled YOU REIGN FOREVER by Theophilus Sunday. 
The main thing this song says is that God is in charge and He never changes. It paints a picture of Him as someone whose power isn't just for a short time or affected by time passing. No, His power is complete and lasts forever. This really sets up a feeling of deep respect, helping us remember that God isn't just powerful. He's also always consistent in how He runs things and who He is, forever. When you look at things this way, it makes you trust Him, because it tells you there's nothing uncertain or shaky about God.

Another big idea the song talks about is that God was here even before time started or anything was created. This brings up the idea that God's wisdom has always been around, not something He had to learn or build up over time. It's like everything that exists comes from His really thought-out and perfect understanding. What I mean is, creation wasn't some accident; it was all on purpose, coming straight from God's own intelligence. This helps someone listening see life not just as random stuff happening, but as part of a carefully designed plan.

The song also mentions how we humans are part of that whole divine plan. It really stresses that our lives aren't separate from God. Instead, we came from Him, and He's the one who keeps us going. This shows a biblical way of looking at the world, where people aren't just independent beings trying to get by on their own. Nope, they're really deeply connected to the one who made them. Things like our life, how we move, and who we are, are all shown as depending on God being around.

One really deep thing this suggests is the idea of being really close to God, even united with Him. The message goes further than just admitting how great God is; it actually asks the person listening to see themselves as living inside Him. This talks about a relationship that's really close, always there, and keeps you going strong. It suggests that real fulfillment and purpose only come when you stay connected to God.

So, all in all, the song really gets across some big ideas: God rules forever, His wisdom was there before anything else, He created everything on purpose, and believers really depend on Him. It's like it invites the listener to a place of humility, to give themselves over, and to really know God's purpose. Instead of just seeing life as something we run on our own, it nudges us to think that everything flows from God and eventually goes back to Him, putting Him right at the center of everything that exists.

Source
https://youtu.be/abZ2BJlnPv0?si=fIMZ7K5aMD81uc-5

---
