body.title: Mining Sim: the basic idea behind the game
body.body:
![mining sim.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jef-001/23u63EiHLvKRxbdtUPxLDcHATgstNTabqJB1T2EywM6LrptGNfp7q8kBAFnKSxnAjoUvv.jpg)

# What Mining Sim actually is

I've been posting updates about what I'm building, but I realized I never really explained the game itself in simple words.

So this post is just that.

**Mining Sim** is a slow mining strategy game being built on Hive.

You buy miners, keep them powered with energy, mine for rewards, and use those rewards to grow your operation over time.

The project is called **Mining Sim** for now.

The main idea behind it comes from something I've thought about for a long time. I always regretted not knowing about Bitcoin back when it was still possible to mine it yourself on a normal PC. I'm not trying to make a new Bitcoin with this, but I am trying to recreate some of that mining feeling in a game.

The basic loop is:

- buy miners  
- keep them powered with energy  
- mine for rewards  
- use those rewards to keep growing  

When your miners win blocks, you earn **MINE**. That can then be converted into **CREDIT**, which is the utility token used for things like buying energy, getting more miners, funding research, and now also repairing worn miners.

So the game is not about constant clicking or being active all day.

It is more about building up a mining operation over time and deciding what to do with what you earn.

Do you keep buying more of the current generation?  
Do you save for the next one?  
Do you keep older miners running a bit longer or replace them?  
Do you spend more on growth now, or keep enough utility around for energy and maintenance?

That is more the kind of game this is supposed to be.

As the network grows, things get harder. New miner generations unlock over time, older miners slowly become less attractive to keep running, and the idea is that players keep having to decide between short term growth and longer term positioning.

There are also things like **anomalies** and **hash races** that give players moments where they have to decide if they want to play it safe or take more risk.

Maintenance is also in now, so miners are not just something you buy once and forget forever. They wear down over time from being used, and repairing them is another thing that uses **CREDIT**. So over the long run, newer hardware should make more sense without making older miners instantly useless.

The current player page is still very much a **demo/testing shell** and not what the final UI is supposed to look like. Right now the main thing is getting the game loop, backend, and chain side working properly and making sure the flow is understandable.

Also just to be clear, this test is free to try. There are no real tokens or NFTs in it yet, and you're not going to earn anything from testing right now. This stage is just about testing the game and seeing what works and what doesn't.

So if this sounds interesting to you and you don't mind trying something early, I'd appreciate a few people giving it a try and telling me where things are confusing or where the game just doesn't feel good yet.

Game link:  
https://mining-sim-player.netlify.app/

Discord:  
https://discord.gg/kfvFamvNQe

If you do try it, honest feedback is what helps most. If something is unclear, too slow, ugly, annoying, or just not interesting enough yet, that's useful for me to know.

body.title: How Do You Deal With Slow Learners?
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>




![IMG_4972.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EpEHFyznRAmFTPaSqazRqaJhwDQLsrsLBAnSs5H9sXoMHFJ41HfCrqN6PgWAwSuKTyi.jpeg)

Today’s writing is about something I don’t always admit easily and that’s my struggle with patience especially when it comes to teaching.

Basically, I’ve been tutoring someone recently, helping her navigate a platform she needs to use. Before anything else, she had to create an account, which I helped her set up. After that, the next step was simple or at least, it seemed simple to me.

I just didn’t want to do everything for her. I’ve learned from experience that once you start doing things on behalf of someone, it becomes a cycle you can’t easily step out of. So instead, I decided it was best to guide her. I sent screen recordings, took screenshots and highlighted exactly where to click and what to do.

This is the same method I’ve used with others before her, people I never even had one-on-one sessions with. They followed through, asked questions when needed, and got the hang of it fairly quickly.

But with her, it’s been different. For over two weeks now, she’s been stuck on the same step. To be very honest, it has tested me.

There were moments I felt deeply frustrated. Moments where I wondered why something so straightforward to me felt so difficult for her. At some point, I even caught myself asking a question I probably shouldn’t have, out of pure exasperation. Because in my mind, if you can text clearly on WhatsApp, you should be able to read and follow instructions, right? Perhaps that’s where I got it wrong.

I know that understanding something intellectually and navigating it practically are not always the same. What feels simple to one person can feel overwhelming to another. And sometimes, what looks like slowness is actually confusion, anxiety, or even fear of getting it wrong. This is what I have been using to convince myself this whole time. 

![IMG_4973.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xVEmKB77gdkxuAWkggCsMRyC9kYDbeQgq1BTatqrAtLgpT3WfmghAdw7fRkbZwffaxy.jpeg)

She mentioned having a headache at some point, and I almost laughed because in my head, I felt like I should be the one complaining. But maybe, in her own way, she was overwhelmed and I pondered on it. Patience is easy when things are going smoothly. It’s easy when people learn at your pace, when they get it quickly, and when everything aligns with your expectations.

But real patience shows up when things are slow and progress feels invisible. When you have to repeat yourself more times than you planned to. I won’t pretend I’ve handled it perfectly. There were moments I wanted to give up entirely on her, where I even considered using the block button. After all, she’s not paying me to guide her, I’m only doing it from the abundance of my heart. But then, I remind myself that I chose to help.  Helping isn’t always convenient.

So now, I’m trying to shift my mindset, not to excuse inefficiency, but to make room for understanding. To accept that people learn differently. That exposure, confidence, and familiarity with technology vary more than we think.

I will still guide her and teach her as  I’m also learning something in the process which is not about her but myself. About my limits, my patience and the kind of grace I am willing, or unwilling, to extend.

Apparently, the lesson here isn’t just in teaching someone else how to navigate a system, it’s in learning how to navigate your own reactions when they don’t get it right.

<sup>[img](https://pixabay.com/photos/school-teacher-education-asia-1782427/)</sup>

<sup>[img2](https://pixabay.com/photos/books-library-room-school-study-2596809/)</sup>




</diva>

![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g3d33cb370630e78e7c602af157420c8f51f12447fa182ecb241334a83a81f5689c59a90a516f1c3014226f3ec278d28f_640.jpg)
Hoy decidí explorar un nuevo barrio de la ciudad y la caminata fue realmente refrescante. El clima estaba perfecto, con una suave brisa que hacía que la temperatura fuera ideal para caminar. En mi recorrido, me encontré con un pequeño mercado al aire libre donde un vendedor de frutas ofrecía productos locales. Hablé con él un rato; se llamaba Carlos y me contó que lleva 15 años vendiendo allí, siempre apoyando a los agricultores de la región. Más adelante, vi a un grupo de artistas callejeros que pintaban murales coloridos en una pared. Uno de ellos, una chica llamada Mariana, me explicó que estaban trabajando en un proyecto para embellecer la comunidad y promover el arte urbano. Me encantó no solo su pasión por el arte, sino también la forma en que involucraban a los vecinos en su trabajo. En general, fue una caminata enriquecedora, llena de buenas conversaciones y descubrimientos. Me encanta cómo cada paseo me permite conocer historias y personas que le dan vida a la ciudad. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). [Anime DB]
Let me start by telling you not to believe a lot of the information that is circulating on the Internet. In a sense, there are, of course, more trusted leakers who provide certain information, but there are also many charlatans who pull information out of their own asses and add more or less sensible thoughts to it, which does not always end well. Trust me, I used to be like that myself. We don't know the release date of the Frieza part and we don't know what the series will be. I don't think the arks would fly back to back and they would be very stupid if they did. Why? Invinsible is the best proof of this - we can either have a quick sequel, but poorly made (or only \

), or we can wait longer and get a good animation. In the case of Invinsible, the plot and blood are enough for me, and the clunky animation doesn't bother me at all in many situations. In the case of DB it is different - there is no good plot, it is dominated by Goku, who is, to put it mildly, annoying, so the audiovisual setting is the main advantage. Breaks of several months, even longer than six months, are the right decision. It's better to get a decent 12 episodes than 20, because these 8 are often very weak, and these 12 are lost.

Apart from that, the anime itself looks beautiful and I can't wait to use it to cheer up my autumn blues.

Add more what if etc. enable creators to create their own alternative story paths (I don't know about Xbox, but on PS5 you can download fan mods and improvements) and so on, and maybe something will come of it. It's nice that they added +30 new playable characters, but it usually doesn't matter because the game is too empty. Plus, we'll get a new mode for free. Premiere this summer.

[Anime DB]
Zacznęod tego byście nie wierzyli w wiele informacji, które krążą w sieci. W sensie, jasne są bardziej zaufani leakerzy, którzy dostarczają pewne informacje, ale jest też wielu szarlatanów, którzy wyciągają informacje z własnej dupy i dodają do tego mniej lub bardziej sensowne przemyślenia, co nie zawsze dobrze się kończy. Zaufajcie mi, dawniej sam taki byłem. Nie znamy daty premiery części z Friezą i nie wiemy, jaki będzie cykl. Nie sądzę by arce leciały jeden po drugim i postąpiliby bardzo głupio, gdyby tak zrobili. Czemu? Invinsible to najlepszy na to dowód - możemy mieć albo szybki sequel, ale niedokładnie wykonany (lub jedynie \

) albo dłużej poczekać i dostać dobrą animację. W przypadku Invinsible wystarczy mi fabuła, krew, a ta toporność animacji w wielu sytuacjach mi w ogóle nie przeszkadza. W przypadku DB jest inaczej - tam nie ma dobrej fabuły, dominuje Goku który jest delikatnie mówiąc wkurzający, więc oprawa audiowizualna to główna zaleta. Kilkumiesięczne, nawet dłuższe niż półroczne przerwy, to słuszna decyzja. Lepiej dostać porządne 12 odcinków niż 20, bo te 8 jest często mega słaba, a te 12 traci.

Dodać więcej what if etc. umożliwić twórcom tworzenie własnych alternatywnych ścieżek fabularnych (nie wiem jak na Xbox, ale na PS5 można już ściągnąć fanowskie mody i ulepszenia) i tak dalej i może coś z tego będzie. Fajnie, że dodali +30 nowych grywalnych postaci, ale zwykle nie ma to znaczenia, bo gra jest zbyt pusta. Poza tym za darmo dostaniemy nowy tryb. Premiera latem tego roku.

body.title: Replacing the roller blind puller: Do it yourself
body.body:
A couple of months ago, I gave myself a task: Either I'll find a handyman to fix my bedroom blind pull tape or I'll do it myself #DIY

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNPJXarQoJGPC1VBwFAxCLY5QB7GduW3QgMB99Hsz5R1v/1776679561502.jpg)

From the frequent, daily raising and lowering of the blind, the retractable tape has become damaged and has begun to snag when passing over the small roller mechanism.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrZz5vhxYQ1nVG4LBettvyJM8TNG5rjbazyYAhcNLuzZ/1776679574035.jpg)

A simple mechanism, but when it blocks, it is difficult to raise and even more difficult to lower the blind.

And it needs to be solved.

I picked up the phone and called a few ads for blinders offering their services.
Several options are offered: The price for replacing only the belt, on the existing mechanism, as well as the price for replacing the complete mechanism with a new belt.
Approximately the same prices and including the cost of arrival, for that one blind, 50e.

But in this case, the price is not the biggest problem.
The problem is that the masters do not have free appointments and that I would have to wait a month and combine their appointments with my business obligations... Difficult story...

On Saturday, I went to an outdoor market, where they sell everything from needles to locomotives.
My attention was drawn to a stall with tapes, which looked like toilet tapes to me. When I asked the seller, he confirmed it, but also asked me why I don't buy a complete mechanism, which already has 6 meters of tape in it.
\

Why not, I thought. I've never done it before, but with a YouTube tutorial, I'll get the hang of it.


I bought the mechanism kit and got to do  it on Sunday.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaDjnrnZi8pT34pb85NCa2wstm93Sk538C88ccLfqKFZ7/1776679609983.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiLFW2xjFsyU7LfwUef9H1eshm2Q34aLrS6A9Z3PhUj4/1776679658752.jpg)

As I thought, the hardest part was removing the cover of the blind box.

After I dealt with the dust in the box, which I vacuumed and wiped, it was much easier (more pleasant and cleaner) to work.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNVmqb4GsoPeNf1Vbb4ZqqgFrsmrrtaputnXWrVyarQyL/1776679681468.jpg)

All you really need is a screwdriver and a rubber-coated hammer, so as not to damage the aluminum cover.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnzwGV7zCNhzY3ZvZMykkQHxT26LFWSNtGCE2jKwcB8E/1776679941356.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcPM2c7ihneN1PbPdFkPdxPNucndFpXTuqWtTcXvNpcx/1776679941425.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUUzEyBRMVNkbchFDSEZRYVzHyaRqdw9kfYrXxnCRaxS5/1776679941503.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDByewJWdRRko7dwKFZMGvZT6PsXrS3UwFLeJMVrk2X6/1776679941561.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbWdfJM13BzYVdEjXskRFTLhgju3cvRQnN35yxjPGfVtL/1776679941627.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRaoGHhR6FxDHBnD6afEvaX4xBJ5D36gqDextJovifJcs/1776679973013.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYAq6BwYqU49u6oUDH1GoZkPszQzcQ7a6t9mGS148U5tA/1776679973083.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREtsieschKhThvkg98VZWFPnM4k68zDg6uM3wmMWvhUA/1776679973156.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9drhHujTH8RXK6GFaYdWEkASZBYynNED2M64pkx1qan/1776679973222.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4bvazYUbizYBdTyM4A9qGRXaVPabaNbprTRLCdknLLx/1776679973295.jpg)

A more detailed tutorial is also needed, because if you find one without a description of all the steps. It can easily happen that, even if you include logic and brain, you do something wrong, so you have to repeat the procedure. That happened to me too 🙂

In the picture with the red frame, you can tell what... Before putting the blind shaft back in, I did not switch the beginning of the blind to the correct side and it was not possible to attach it to the shaft.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3aJZfQEnWafjKLDpEwXuieZCFz1TB5F5PdHXrqJwSag/1776680000386.gif)

I dismantled the shaft by unscrewing and pulling the plastic bumpers so that enough space can be obtained to remove the shaft.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWZJxPvy3qKBw8W72RtDJz4jZMFrFmtoFkJHEGEew2Gq/1776679710121.jpg)

After that, I removed the old tape from the coil and wound a new one, paying attention to the direction of installation.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTYGyX4fwFt4XEgj32Gs6BBmrT6kJKPRXBabfNGQNMW6/1776679720427.jpg)

After that I attached the lifter mechanism and put the shaft back in the box (I did this again, because as I mentioned above, I didn't put the start of the blind in a good position). 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7WqH8v7gGyxmSpCYzY6NpfwBgKmKgwNSasSjpQxHqth/1776679800308.jpg)

I attached the hooks that hold the blind to the shaft, and before returning the box lid, I tried how it all works.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmep5ThedW1qbCtrDVR7Lwie4kLVCX6frz4GJr6oDX9Aeh/1776679730490.jpg)

And definitely the hardest part, was putting the lid of the box back in place.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTu16WvtGL5GdhdVu7rsAiutS3W2dDVpKpK9f7nUGfs2r/1776680015906.jpg)

If I didn't have a hammer with a rubber tip, I would never have been able to get the cover back into the groove on the top.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcLC3igwNbv5WGqgnxL86yAhqjQBRVPN9A1Eku1dtahnW/1776679785564.jpg)

Tried it once, the second time, the third time I succeeded.

https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=duskobgd/cah2vbrd

The replacement of the shutter puller was successfully carried out, at a cost of 5e and an hour of my time. If it wasn't my first time and if I hadn't documented every step with photos, which I'm showing you here now, I believe I would have finished in half an hour.

And that's why, in order to save those 45e, I decided to buy some Hive, which I will put in my stack on May 1st and thus in #HPUD, additionally strengthen my HP.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEteW2dCqWGxy6wefKmdVRQdPm8UBEciKMNVgmL2d5xR/1776679510559.jpg)

Double benefit, I learned something new, I invested in Hive with the saved money.

body.title: Medical Billing vs Medical Coding: What’s the Real Difference?
body.body:
If you run a clinic or are just stepping into the healthcare space, you’ve probably heard the terms [medical billing and medical coding](https://a2zbillings.com/medical-billing/) used almost interchangeably. But they’re not the same thing, and understanding the difference between medical billing and coding can save you time, money, and a lot of headaches.  
At a glance, both roles are part of the revenue cycle. They work behind the scenes to make sure healthcare providers get paid for their services. Still, each has a unique job to do.  
Let’s break it down in a simple, practical way so you can see how it all fits together.  
**What is Medical Billing?**  
Medical billing is the process of turning healthcare services into revenue. In simple terms, it’s about getting providers paid.  
A medical biller takes the information about a patient’s visit and sends a claim to the insurance company. Once the claim is processed, they follow up to make sure the payment comes through.  
**How it works (simple example)**  
Imagine a patient visits a clinic for a routine checkup:  
The doctor examines the patient  
The visit details are recorded  
The billing team prepares a claim  
The claim is sent to the insurance company  
The insurer reviews it and pays the provider  
If something goes wrong, like missing information or incorrect details, the claim might get denied. That’s where a skilled biller steps in to fix the issue and resubmit it.  
Key tasks in medical billing  
Preparing and submitting insurance claims  
Verifying patient insurance details  
Following up on unpaid claims  
Managing patient invoices and payments  
Handling claim denials and appeals  
This is why many clinics rely on professional medical billing services to keep their cash flow steady.  
At a2zbillings, for example, the focus is on reducing claim denials and speeding up reimbursements so providers can focus more on patient care and less on paperwork.  
What is Medical Coding?  
Medical coding is the process of translating healthcare services into standardized codes.  
Every diagnosis, treatment, or procedure has a specific code. These codes are used in billing to tell insurance companies exactly what services were provided.  
A simple example  
Let’s go back to the same patient visit:  
The doctor diagnoses a patient with a mild infection  
The coder assigns a diagnosis code (like an ICD code)  
The procedure (checkup) also gets a code (CPT code)  
These codes are then used in the billing claim  
Without accurate coding, the billing process simply can’t work.  
Key parts of the medical coding process  
Reviewing patient medical records  
Assigning correct diagnosis codes  
Assigning procedure codes  
Ensuring compliance with coding guidelines  
Updating codes based on new regulations  
Think of coding as the “language” of healthcare. If the language is wrong, the message doesn’t get across, and payments get delayed or denied.  
Key Differences Between Medical Billing and Medical Coding  
Here’s a clear comparison to help you understand medical billing vs medical coding:  
Aspect  
Medical Billing  
Medical Coding  
Main Role  
Handles claims and payments  
Translates services into codes  
Focus  
Financial process  
Clinical documentation  
Work Stage  
After coding is done  
Before billing starts  
Interaction  
Insurance companies & patients  
Medical records & providers  
Goal  
Get the provider paid  
Ensure accurate service representation

In short:  
Coding = Assigning the correct codes  
Billing = Using those codes to get paid  
How Billing and Coding Work Together  
Even though they are different roles, billing and coding are closely connected.  
Here’s how the process flows:  
Patient visits the clinic  
Doctor records diagnosis and treatment  
Medical coder assigns accurate codes  
Medical biller creates and submits the claim  
Insurance company processes the claim  
Payment is received (or denied and corrected)  
If the coding is wrong, the billing will fail. If billing is done poorly, even correct codes won’t help.  
That’s why having a coordinated system, or outsourcing to experts like a2zbillings, can make a huge difference.  
Skills Required for Each Role  
Skills for Medical Coding  
Strong attention to detail  
Knowledge of medical terminology  
Familiarity with coding systems (ICD, CPT, HCPCS)  
Analytical thinking  
Ability to stay updated with coding changes  
Skills for Medical Billing  
Understanding of insurance processes  
Communication skills (for follow-ups and patients)  
Problem-solving ability  
Knowledge of claim management  
Basic accounting awareness  
Both roles require accuracy, but coders focus more on clinical details, while billers handle the financial side.  
Which One is Better for Healthcare Providers?  
This is a common question: should you focus more on billing or coding?  
The honest answer: you need both.  
For healthcare providers, the goal is simple, get paid accurately and on time. And that only happens when:  
Coding is correct  
Billing is efficient  
If you neglect coding, claims get denied.  
If billing is weak, payments get delayed.  
Many clinics try to manage both in-house, but it can quickly become overwhelming. Errors, staff shortages, and changing regulations make it tough to keep everything running smoothly.  
That’s why outsourcing to a reliable provider like a2zbillings can be a smart move. It allows you to focus on patient care while experts handle the revenue cycle.  
Common Mistakes in Billing and Coding  
Even small errors can lead to big losses. Here are some common issues clinics face:

1.  Incorrect coding  
    Using the wrong code can result in claim rejection or underpayment.
    
2.  Missing information  
    Incomplete patient data or documentation can delay claims.
    
3.  Late submissions  
    Insurance companies have strict deadlines. Missing them means lost revenue.
    
4.  Lack of follow-up  
    Unpaid claims often go unnoticed without proper tracking.
    
5.  Not staying updated  
    Coding rules and insurance policies change frequently. Falling behind can hurt your practice.  
    Avoiding these mistakes requires expertise, consistency, and time, resources many clinics struggle with.  
    Benefits of Outsourcing Billing and Coding  
    Outsourcing is becoming more popular, and for good reason.
    
6.  Fewer errors  
    Experienced professionals reduce coding and billing mistakes.
    
7.  Faster payments  
    Clean claims mean quicker reimbursements.
    
8.  Cost savings  
    No need to hire, train, or manage in-house staff.
    
9.  Better compliance  
    Experts stay updated with regulations and coding changes.
    
10.  More focus on patients  
     You spend less time on admin work and more on care.  
     With a trusted partner like a2zbillings, clinics can streamline their entire revenue cycle, from the medical coding process to final payment collection.  
     Conclusion  
     Understanding medical billing vs medical coding isn’t just helpful, it’s essential for running a successful healthcare practice.  
     Medical coding ensures that every service is properly recorded and translated into standardized codes. Medical billing takes those codes and turns them into revenue.  
     Both roles are different, but they depend on each other completely.  
     If you want fewer claim denials, faster payments, and less stress, it’s worth investing in the right systems, or partnering with professionals who specialize in this field.  
     At the end of the day, accurate coding and efficient billing don’t just improve your finances, they help your practice run smoother and serve patients better.

body.title: My reasons for living / Mis razones para vivir - LOH contest week #285 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Hi, girls!

Oh, dear @merit.ahama, you've given me the opportunity to show off my two greatest reasons for living: my two sons, Carlos and Diego.

Since becoming a mother, my life changed forever, for the better, and I received these two blessings. They are my greatest pride. They are two good boys, almost men now, although I still see them as little boys.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTyNB9kxn1sjtdDkpjmQUg2bwciF59tjoo8Yyy2hqoSww/1776652338568.jpg)

My two sons have followed in my footsteps and those of their father, who is also a guitarist. They both have immense talent and great natural gifts for music, especially for the guitar. They both have hands with long, slender, strong fingers and perfect pitch. The latter is something neither their father nor I possess.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkP1KvReG7yHw7Wj4GD6dqpMN7qwLB8NDPKPBpkzBrgf/1776652338640.jpg)

They are healthy boys. They don't go around wasting time. They really like being at home, listening to music. I love that they like good music.

Sometimes I find them listening to music by the great composers of the Baroque, Classical, or Romantic periods; composers like Bach, Vivaldi, Beethoven, etc.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3C1VARNzKWQ8KrRGkFX17EwXrpKGt4wmXzP2Ud8uXoG/1776652338701.jpg)

While they have similar characteristics, at the same time they are quite different. While one enjoys soccer and sports, the other prefers staying home, reading, drawing, and watching TV series and movies.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdNqyMmidJnTUyKnUWn4fgpsDoKkLUsQRJFEtKeU761g/1776652338798.jpg)

If there's anything I can be completely proud of, it's my two sons. I can't even begin to describe how I feel when I see them perform at local and national events, playing pieces far beyond the capabilities of other young people their age.
Everything in my life revolves around my sons. Everything I do, I do for them. I know they're going to grow up to be good men.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, chicas!

Oh, estimada @merit.ahama, me ha dado la oportunidad de lucir a mis dos mayores razones de vivir: mis dos hijos Carlos y Diego.
Desde que me convertí en madre, mi vida cambió para siempre, para mejor y obtuve este par de bendiciones. Son mi mayor orgullo. Son dos buenos muchachos, casi hombres ya, aunque aún los vea como niños pequeños.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTyNB9kxn1sjtdDkpjmQUg2bwciF59tjoo8Yyy2hqoSww/1776652338568.jpg)

Mis dos hijos han seguido mis pasos y los de su padre, quien también es guitarrista. Ambos tienen muchísimo talento y grandes dones naturales para la música, y en especial, para la guitarra. Ambos tienen manos con dedos largos, finos, fuertes y oído perfecto. Esto último es algo que ni su padre ni yo tenemos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkP1KvReG7yHw7Wj4GD6dqpMN7qwLB8NDPKPBpkzBrgf/1776652338640.jpg)

Son muchachos sanos. No son de andar por ahí perdiendo el tiempo. Les gusta mucho estar en casa, escuchar música. Me encanta que les guste la buena música. 
En ocasiones los encuentro escuchando música de los grandes compositores del barroco, clásico o romántico; compositores como Bach, Vivaldi, Beethoven, etc.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3C1VARNzKWQ8KrRGkFX17EwXrpKGt4wmXzP2Ud8uXoG/1776652338701.jpg)

Como mismo tienen características similares, al mismo tiempo son bien diferentes. Mientras a uno le gusta el fútbol y los deportes, el otro es más de estar en casa, leer, dibujar, ver series y películas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdNqyMmidJnTUyKnUWn4fgpsDoKkLUsQRJFEtKeU761g/1776652338798.jpg)

body.title: 舅舅的玩笑
body.body:
外婆去世了，我回到老家奔丧，参加外婆的葬礼。

我外婆有两个儿子，也就是我两个舅舅，都非常的孝顺。不仅如此，我两个舅妈也非常的孝顺，因此婆媳关系非常的融洽，反正我从记事开始，从来没听说过她们婆媳之间有过半点矛盾。我想这不仅是因为我两个舅妈做的好，也是因为我外公和外婆也非常的会做人。

嗯，是的，我外婆家多年一直是“五好家庭”。

外婆的葬礼上，来了很多人，不仅是亲朋好友，更有四邻八乡好多人。外婆下葬的这一天，不要说像我妈我舅舅他们哭的撕心裂肺，就连我们这些儿孙辈的，个个都哭的稀里哗啦，我相信每个人哭的时候，会像我一样，不仅会回想起以前外婆的许多点滴，更会觉得外婆曾经对自己的好，想到这些，心里就更难过，那泪水就像水龙头的水一样哗哗的往外流。

农村办红白事，都会找一大片空旷的地方，搭建大棚，就是用来专门招呼亲朋好友吃饭，我外婆的葬礼自然不例外。以前的大棚需要人力搭建，这种搭建还是挺麻烦的，一定要稳固、结实。 之前我隔壁县城有次不知道是办什么事情，临时搭建的大棚，刚好赶上一阵大雨，结果把大棚给塌掉，所幸那天没伤到人。

大棚不仅要搭建结实，仪式结束后还要拆除，因此是个麻烦的工程。

这次我外婆葬礼，我发现现在改进为移动大棚。所谓移动大棚，就是像多个集装箱那样，但下边是两条轨道，每个之间是可以收缩那种。哇，这样就节省很多人力，方便多了。


![04_20_002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/Ep1XRSxuJuQLBjLSZiemsX3TXFYAm659VcZTNK9zGok3MPGW8ZzTdTrPQGgTWSAYGP4.jpg)


另外一个，就是下葬时候抬棺木。以前抬棺木，需要人力抬。要知道，棺木差别是很大的，但就算最轻的棺木，整体的重量都不轻，尤其是起棺的时候，需要同时十几个小伙子才能抬起。

而现在的，无论是起棺还是入葬，有专门的吊机车，直接一次就完成，这样就太方便了。


农村的葬礼，习俗还是挺多的，我之前参加葬礼没太注意，这次专门看了下。就说下下葬那天的葬礼仪式，从上香、迎魂、迎主、张贴楹联。。。一直到送葬、礼成，一共十七道仪式。


![04_20_001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/EoyRWDgHdwEcm75Ca7QDrYXmfoXnaDFuo6szHMpbokdHg2bMTcHPzAC1BNoBRa7wSie.jpg)


办事的流程，每个都有一人或多人负责，比如家长、总管、礼房、接客、看客、司仪、乐队。。。


![IMG20260419075431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rivalhw/EpEJiQYytMUEGxVkDswsRpPPeNSG4BeiJWDCzej4MFpoAWJEQQDQJKzNV9aPEmuR9i9.jpg)


我们这边的习俗是，人去世后第七天去上坟。上坟这天，我舅舅带领着我们一大帮家族人，浩浩荡荡地出发了。

结果到烧纸的环节，我舅舅这人平时就喜欢幽默，这时候跪着烧纸，边烧边说，

“妈啊，儿子给你烧了好多钱（纸），这些钱你收到了应该用不完那么多，记得也要给我爹一些啊。。。”

我们一大帮外甥、还有我舅的侄子们、侄女们，跪在地上听到他这话，笑的肚子都快直不起腰来了。

body.title: Midweek Sarcasm #63 - Ducks Dueling On Quantum Rivers
body.body:
Welcome to Sarcasm Saturday ... midweek edition! Today we gonna talk about ducks dueling on quantum rivers and the madness that replaced social media InfoFi engagement

Here’s your weekly reminder that yes, you are doing amazing, sweetie… even if your last post got three likes and one of them was your burner account. Keep up the good work! 

So grab a seat by the metaphorical river where reality glitches, ducks throw hands and duel for their opinions, and everything makes less sense the longer you look at it.

We keep laughing through the crash, touching grass occasionally, and scrolling memes like it’s a survival skill. Our life is just an adult circus and we’re all juggling invisible debts.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPLzpAmT7QeDuxf8B8rQRjvzrdZ8cSM6dj9K14WhJm6WG/image.png)


Seen a lot of people take hits since InfoFi faceplanted, so if you’re still here and still standing that  counts for something. Welcome to the chaos and let’s make it funny.

You know that [$RIVER](https://app.river.inc/fun?ref=pvmihalache) is the native token of the River protocol and what gives you value inside that ecosystem. You use it for rewards, governance, and anything tied to participation.

So when people talk about “earning $RIVER” they’re talking about getting a piece of the protocol itself. The journey took us to earn points and then convert them into tokens!  

[River4FUN](https://app.river.inc/fun?ref=pvmihalache) is their growth campaign that brought River into the spotlights. Instead of paying you directly in tokens right now, they give you points for being active and interacting with the project.

Is the [River4FUN](https://app.river.inc/fun?ref=pvmihalache) worth doing? Depends on how you play it. If you’re already active on social media or don’t mind posting then you are already well positioned for this!


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRmV8ddfJJAyeWYdvpMdU8Ry91UBPuZu3sxEgKX3i8jTn/image.png)


Seen [Quip Network](https://quest.quip.network/airdrop?referral_code=UZTDK6K6) is playing a much bigger game than most of these questing platforms made by airdrop projects. It’s not just trying to farm attention for a token.

So what it does instead? Quip is trying to position itself as the layer that protects crypto before quantum computing breaks everything. Before you start... there's also some debates! 

Some say that the rewards are pumped, and there is nothing to back them up. I say ... sometimes you need to gamble and hope for the best. It may end up well in the end! 

The [Quip ](https://quest.quip.network/airdrop?referral_code=UZTDK6K6)core vision is pretty clean once you strip the buzzwords and the glossy aura. Quip is building a hybrid system where two things happen at the same time.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcNpjRXKEjbVSYen5cBF4PFAADnEAgu8YobohU3W3GJFF/image.png)


I had no clue what XMarket is before the [Airaa auraboard](https://airaa.xyz/invite?c=MM6WS9) went live, but now I am happy I learned about it! Airaa rolled in with the whole “AI meets markets” aura and I joined!

So what's the difference? You can create your market, but it goes through a pre-sale period. It needs to show interest from the others and reach $100 in commitments to go live.

It blends crowd forecasting, decentralized finance, and creator economics into one seamless system! You’re building markets around it and earning as others trade.

On the flip side, Duel Duck brings a bit of chaos into the mix. It doesn’t take itself too seriously, and that’s exactly why it works. Projects like that can catch fire out of nowhere if the energy clicks.

My race to find the next big thing took me to Solana, where I explored [Duck Duels](https://duelduck.com/?referral_token=BSCmw4iB) as predictions with a twist! [Duck Duel](https://duelduck.com/?referral_token=BSCmw4iB) is basically a prediction game where you set up head-to-head “duels”.

Created a duel and invited the ducks to predict if [Trump announces the end of military operations in Iran by 28th of April](https://x.com/pvmihalache/status/2042154824196608048). I think that he will not so I went with \

on this one 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTeAcpYHS1guSmnN39Rncs64JMKCNdjd1FHT3t69BsCFF/image.png)


[XOOB Network](http://www.xoob.link/?ref=60867e779d) is basically playing a different game than what most people expected. On the surface it looks like another NFT project, but under the hood it’s really an attention engine.

It's turning that activity into points, rankings, and eventually rewards. The NFT mint is where the confusion kicked in. People walked in expecting a typical crypto hype but instead it was a failure!

They got a gated system where you needed a certain “influencer score” just to participate, plus a bunch of tasks beforehand. That immediately filtered out a huge chunk of users.

I was upset I couldn't mint but then asked God to give me a sign! Then their first campaign went life and the NFT was useful only if you’re already deep in the [XOOB](http://www.xoob.link/?ref=60867e779d) loop.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPLfr7eagSnPqrARXZeCvkfL9dS2fyVp5nAozSKNCz7Pg/image.png)


What about [Humble Tractors NFTs on Spaace](https://flip.spaace.io/en/trading/0x696dDf0c91f553C76bd21Ec56730e43819372966). That’s personal. Freshly minted, still early, but full of room to shape into something more than just a drop. It’s about building a feel around it, something people can tap into beyond just owning it.

The new experiment wants to test the bonding curve on Spaace, where the value grows with the sales volume. There are lots left, and hopefully I will see the market cap grow

If you’re not already plugged into that corner of crypto culture, it can feel pretty random. But if you are ... you know I know you know! The collection on[ Flip](https://flip.spaace.io/en/trading/0x696dDf0c91f553C76bd21Ec56730e43819372966) stays humble!

Each of the 100 [Flip Humble Tractors](https://flip.spaace.io/en/trading/0x696dDf0c91f553C76bd21Ec56730e43819372966) is unique, and this time we have rarities and traits. Will you get that rare one? Will keep the mint going and at one point... will buy them all.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNdwDZ7BBdqfRu5CnZREwHpLVGq5Hf5cZ9yJp8GJgbjgm/image.png)

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-El gran enfrentamiento/ Daily 5 minute message- The big clash
body.body:
> La vida esta llena de grandes enfrentamientos a diario, luchamos por salir de la cama, por cepillarnos los dientes y lavarnos la cara. Buscamos que echarnos en la boca mientras decidimos algún intento de desayuno normal. Entre pan, arepa o panquecas y mira que tengo para escoger ¿que será de los que no pueden hacerlo? Parece que la vida se nos va en un constante enfrentamiento con las lineas del mal, tratamos de ganarle la partida cada día. Allí delante de la mañana se debaten las verdades del día por venir, se escuchan las noticias y se mira el amanecer con café mañanero. Esto es casi un enfrentamiento a diario entre seguir adelante con optimismo o sentirse apesadumbrado por el venir a futuro. Cada mañana luchamos por despertar y salir adelante. Si miramos que otros la están pasando muy mal, tal vez nuestra mañana se vuelva más ligera. Valoramos lo que esta y lo que deseamos conseguir sigue siendo una lucha constante, ese enfrentamiento en lo que deseas conseguir y lo que no has logrado. Cada día se vuelve un ir y venir y todo parece rutinario, solo cuando te miras reflejada en el espejo sabes que has ganado la batalla.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/20-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3079-the-big-clash) **ENGLISH VERSION** Life is full of daily struggles. We fight to get out of bed, to brush our teeth and wash our faces. We search for something to put in our mouths while we try to decide on a normal breakfast. Between bread, arepas, or pancakes—and look how many options I have—what becomes of those who can't afford it? It seems that life slips away in a constant battle against the forces of evil, and we try to win each day. There, before the dawn, we debate the truths of the day to come, listen to the news, and watch the sunrise with our morning coffee. This is almost a daily struggle between moving forward with optimism or feeling burdened by what the future holds. Every morning we fight to wake up and move forward. If we see that others are having a very hard time, perhaps our morning becomes lighter. We value what we have, and what we wish to achieve remains a constant struggle, that confrontation between what we want to achieve and what we haven't yet attained. Every day becomes a coming and going and everything seems routine; only when you look at yourself reflected in the mirror do you know that you have won the battle.
***
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of my friend @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/20-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3079-the-big-clash)

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: Some Contributions Don’t Come With Receipts.
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
A friend invited me to his wedding anniversary. We’ve been friends for years, but I didn’t really know his extended family like that. So that day, he introduced me around. The celebration was beautiful. Good food, laughter, pictures, the whole thing. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPnqt5QUqw18FpMR3CbS2sH8TAdN7xnHcWDPaj1KVAaq/1776679084243.jpg)


After everything started winding down, I found myself sitting with some of his extended family members. They were talking casually at first. Then the conversation shifted. One of them said, “This wife of his has really secured a good life for herself.” Another person added, “She should be thanking her stars. If not for him, who knows where she would be?” They started talking about how he has opened businesses for her, how she’s enjoying his money. The tone wasn’t admiration. It was bitterness. I just sat there quietly. What they didn’t know was that one of his close friends was also nearby. He heard everything and sent him a message. 


Not long after, my friend walked over. You could feel the air change. He didn’t shout. He didn’t insult anyone. But he was firm. He said, “You can talk about me however you want. But don’t ever disrespect my wife.” Then he said something I will never forget. “Yes, I was doing well before I married her. But everything you see multiplied in my life happened after she came. I had money. I didn’t have the ideas. I didn’t have the structure. I didn’t have the execution. This woman’s mind is worth more than any cheque I can write.” He looked around and added, “The last thing I expect from any of you is to belittle her.” I was quiet the whole time, but inside, I was smiling. Because that is partnership. On my way home, I kept thinking about what just happened.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSYUree9cDnMzhgu6JuQT6Pf7mFSmJeor7fAUPemmNk2/1776679198405.jpg)


***Here’s the lesson I took from it***
Whether you are single or married, your value in a relationship should be undeniable. Not noisy. There are women who may not bring in the biggest income, but their wisdom, strategy, prayer life, emotional intelligence, and support hold the entire household together. There are men who may not be the most expressive romantically, but their stability, leadership, and protection create safety that money cannot buy. Your value doesn’t always have to look like cash. Sometimes it’s vision. Sometimes it’s discipline. Sometimes it’s peace. Sometimes it’s the brain behind the business. Sometimes it’s the intercession no one sees. I once heard an older man say, “My wife doesn’t bring in income, but every week she gathers our children to pray for me. Do you know what that does for a man?” That’s value. And let me say this carefully. 

If your presence in someone’s life does not add anything meaningful, it becomes easy for outsiders to diminish you. But when your contribution is real, your partner will defend you without being coached. To my single brothers and sisters, as you prepare for marriage, don’t just focus on what you want to receive. Ask yourself, “What do I carry that makes a home better?” And to married couples, never downplay your spouse’s contribution just because it doesn’t look like yours. Let your value speak so loudly in the life of your partner that when people try to belittle you, your spouse doesn’t hesitate to correct the room. That day reminded me of something simple. A strong marriage is not built on who has more money. It is built on knowing exactly what the other person brings to the table and honoring it.

***Thank you for reading from me. What is your thought on you just read***

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: Bulgarian former president Rumen Radev won an outright majority, says EU has fallen victim to its own ambition to be a moral leader, meanwhile EU pushing for removing unanimity voting.
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
Der ehemalige bulgarische Präsident hat gestern einen historischen Sieg bei den Parlamentswahlen in Bulgarien erreicht und wie es aussieht mit ca. 45% die absolute Mehrheit an Mandaten geschafft.

Das ist aus zwei Gründen außergewöhnlich, erstens, da in den letzten Jahren das Parlament in Bulgarien sehr zersplittert war, mit vielen Mittel- und Kleinparteien und ohne klare Mehrheiten, Neuwahlen am laufenden Band. Und zweitens, Wahlumfragen (Polls of Polls) haben Radev nur 30% vorhergesagt, jetzt hat er wie es scheint sogar eine absolute Mehrheit gewonnen und braucht einen Partner nur noch für die Änderung von 2/3-Bestimmungen, des obersten Gerichtshofs und General-Staatsanwalts.

Außenpolitisch orientiert sich Radev an der neuen ungarischen Position von Magyar, die Lösung der Energiekrise hat höchste Priorität, Bulgarien solle sich selbst nicht mehr an der Finanzierung des Ukraine-Kriegs beteiligen und strebe eine Ausnahmeregelung ähnlich wie Ungarn an, möchte aber EU-Hilfen anderer Staaten nicht blockieren.

Die EU-Kommission pocht in der Zwischenzeit auf die Abschaffung des Einstimmigkeitsprinzip in der EU. Einstimmigkeit ist in der EU nur in sehr wenigen, wichtigen Bereichen notwendig, wie die EU-Erweiterung und in der Außen- und Sicherheitspolitik, in den meisten Angelegenheiten genügt eine einfache oder 2/3-Mehrheit.

Kleinere Länder fürchten mit der Abschaffung des Einstimmigkeitsprinzips um ihren Einfluss und dass sie von großen Ländern in wichtigen Fragen überstimmt werden könnten. Die Abschaffung des Einstimmigkeitsprinzips wäre ein Schritt Richtung \

, eine kohärentere Union, aber auch eine Machtverschiebung nach Brüssel.

Problematisch sehe ich, dass die EU-Kommission und die Kommissions-Präsidenten nicht vom Volk gewählt wird, sondern nur indirekt bestimmt wird. Sollte die EU das Einstimmigkeitsprinzip abschaffen, müsste die EU im Gegenzug demokratischer werden und sich der Kommissionspräsident direkten Wahlen stellen.

Was meint ihr? Soll die EU das Einstimmigkeitsprinzip in wichtigen Fragen beibehalten oder abschaffen? Warum drängt die EU auf immer mehr Macht?

## EU pushing to remove principle of unanimity

https://x.com/POLITICOEurope/status/2041421034570567737

https://x.com/MyLordBebo/status/2044519931090272705

## English

The former Bulgarian president achieved a historic victory in Bulgaria’s parliamentary elections yesterday and, with approximately 45% of the vote, appears to have secured an absolute majority of seats.

This is extraordinary for two reasons: first, because in recent years Bulgaria’s parliament has been highly fragmented, with many small and mid-sized parties and no clear majorities, leading to a constant stream of new elections. And second, election polls (polls of polls) had predicted only 30% for Radev, now it appears he has even won an absolute majority and needs a partner only for amending two-thirds majorities, the Supreme Court, and the Prosecutor General.

In foreign policy, Radev is aligning himself with Hungary’s new “Magyar” stance, resolving the energy crisis is his top priority. He believes Bulgaria should no longer participate in financing the war in Ukraine and is seeking an exemption similar to Hungary’s, though he does not wish to block EU aid from other countries.

Meanwhile, the European Commission is insisting on the abolition of the unanimity principle in the EU. Unanimity is required in the EU only in very few, critical areas, such as EU enlargement and foreign and security policy, in most matters, a simple or two-thirds majority is already sufficient.

Smaller countries fear that abolishing the unanimity principle will diminish their influence and that they will be outvoted by larger countries on important issues. Abolishing the unanimity principle would be a step toward a “United States of Europe”—a more cohesive Union—but it would also shift power to Brussels.

I see it as problematic that the European Commission and the Commission President are not elected by the people, but are only appointed indirectly. If the EU were to abolish the unanimity principle, the EU would have to become more democratic in return, and at least the Commission President would have to face direct elections in my opinion.

What do you think? Should the EU retain or abolish the unanimity principle on important issues? Why is the EU pushing for more and more power?

> # Mi amanecer de todos los lunes # Hoy lunes 20 de abril, tercer lunes del mes, y ya eso solo me da un motivo para agradecer, agradezco por eso y por mucho más, porque llegué, porque estoy aquí, porque respiro, doy gracias al universo y a mi vida cuántica por todo, por mi hogar, por mis hijas y por mi esposa, y por supuesto por mi familia y familiares y amigos. Esta mañana me desperté y lo primero que sentí fue ese peso, ese peso conocido, ese que no duele, pero que se siente, el del cuerpo que dice oye, espera un momento, y yo, como siempre, le respondo en silencio, no señor ponte las pilas que hoy, hoy tenemos cosas que hacer. Después de hacer las cosas que hago en la mañana, como siempre en mi rutina diaria salí a mirar el cielo y a tomar las fotos para entregártelas a ti, y el cielo estaba así como lo ves, como dudando, como si el día tampoco tuviera muy claro cómo empezar, y curiosamente eso me tranquilizó, porque me di cuenta de algo, el cielo y yo éramos lo mismo esta mañana, los dos con nubes, los dos con algo de peso encima, y los dos igual de firmes en seguir adelante, sin importar nada, solo palante. Hay una cosa que he aprendido con los años y es que el cansancio no es tu enemigo, parece, pero no es, simplemente el cansancio es una evidencia de que has estado haciendo cosas, de que te has estado trabajando mucho, de que has construido, de que estás luchado, de que un cuerpo que nunca se cansa es un cuerpo que nunca ha hecho nada que valga la pena, así que hoy no me voy a disculpar por sentirme pesado, todo lo contrario, lo celebro, porque eso significa que la semana pasada fue real ruda, y fue muy intensa de pana que tuve mucho trabajo físico y mental, fue mi semana. Ahora viene una semana nueva, llena de oportunidades, lunes 20, tercer lunes del mes, como todo motor que ha corrido fuerte, solo necesito un arranque, un respiro, un café, una foto del cielo, y listo, el motor vuelve a encenderse. # Como dice el refrán… El sol no espera por nadie. Pero siempre sale para todos. Así que me levanto, tomo esta foto del cielo que no se rinde, y escribo para recordarme que aún estoy aquí. Y mientras esté aquí, hay camino. Solo dedícate a ser feliz. Encuentra tu luz, segundo a segundo. --------------- ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxUivGR4Y3wCqxfRozB4rXNKyPyhYvrwGsP2ndueh2p6/imagen.png) # My Monday Morning Sunrise # Today is Monday, April 20th, the third Monday of the month, and that alone gives me a reason to be grateful. I am thankful for that and so much more—because I made it, because I am here, because I breathe. I thank the universe and my quantum life for everything: for my home, my daughters, and my wife, and of course, for my family, relatives, and friends. This morning I woke up and the first thing I felt was 그 weight—that familiar weight that doesn't hurt but makes itself known. It’s the body saying, \
and I, as always, respond in silence: \

After my morning routine, I went out to look at the sky and take the photos I share with you. The sky looked just as you see it: hesitant, as if the day wasn't quite sure how to begin. Curiously, that calmed me down because I realized something: the sky and I were the same this morning. Both of us cloudy, both with a bit of weight on our shoulders, and both equally firm in moving forward, no matter what—just pushing on.

There is one thing I’ve learned over the years: tiredness is not your enemy. It seems like it, but it’s not. Fatigue is simply evidence that you’ve been doing things, that you’ve been working hard on yourself, that you’ve built something, and that you’re fighting. A body that never gets tired is a body that has never done anything worthwhile. So today, I’m not going to apologize for feeling heavy; quite the opposite, I celebrate it. It means last week was real, tough, and intense. Honestly, I had so much physical and mental work—it was my week.

Now comes a new week full of opportunities. Monday the 20th, the third Monday of the month. Like any engine that has run hard, I just need a jumpstart—a breath, a coffee, a photo of the sky—and that’s it, the engine fires up again.

As the saying goes… The sun waits for no one, but it always rises for everyone.

So, I get up, I take this photo of a sky that doesn't give up, and I write to remind myself that I am still here. And as long as I am here, there is a path.

Just focus on being happy. Find your light, second by second.

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![m4qOALZLCW4kDV3V_chichi.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/x256/images/m4qOALZLCW4kDV3V_chichi/m4qOALZLCW4kDV3V_chichi.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

ello Hive！

我叫0x256

>**AI-Age Digital Hermit**，Code emerald hills，不炼金丹，不造孽钱，Build clean systems with a clear conscience。

这几个字说起来顺口，实际上就是一个在 AI 时代里靠敲键盘过活、但不想靠这门手艺坑人的。干净地做事，干净地走路，仅此而已。

爱好方面，除了写代码，最大的爱好就是吃。这个爱好不挑地方，不挑价位，路边摊和米其林放在一起我先奔路边摊。吃这件事让我觉得世界是真实的。


来Hive这件事说来也简单，就是被逼的。

在中文互联网上写东西这几年，微信敏感词过滤、知乎回答被折叠、某平台文章因为措辞不当直接消失得无影无踪。最让人抓狂的不是哪篇文章被删了，而是你压根不知道哪句话踩了线，规则像一张看不见的网，专门等你撞上去。

于是我开始折腾一个去中心化blog，最开始技术方向是把内容存到 IPFS 上，索引写进 blockchain。这套东西的逻辑很清楚：内容按 content hash 寻址，不依赖任何一台服务器，改一个字 hash 就变，动不了，删不掉，某种意义上是一种\

的追求——虽然听起来有点中二。技术 demo 早就跑通了，卡住的是别的问题。UI改了几版还是丑，分享机制要不要打通微博、小红书、X 这些平台——搞了，去中心化的意义缩水一半；不搞，写出来的东西就只有几个认识你的人看。

结果发现直接用hive做更简单。支持性更好，索性就直接用hive做了。

但是，折腾了一段时间，我想明白了一件事：这个问题本身就不需要想明白。

博客的黄金时代在 2005 到 2012 年那会儿，Google 收录，RSS 涨粉，SEO 换流量，逻辑闭环。现在这套玩法彻底死了，搜索首页全是知乎和营销号，RSS 用户少到可以凑一桌麻将，流量这东西完全在算法手里，你写得再好，没有 platform 给你推，就是没人看，和你在无人岛上写日记差不多。

明知如此，我还是想把去**中心化blog**搞起来。

不是因为情怀，不是因为相信流量会自己来，而是因为我想要一个真正属于自己的地方，写什么都不用想合不合规，存下来的东西也不会因为哪天平台心情不好就清零。Hive 就是这样一个地方——内容上链，没有哪个管理员能来给你删帖，这件事本身就比什么都重要。

当然我也不傻，完全脱离平台在现在不现实，后面还是会搞一套automation工具把内容同步推出去。但落脚点在Hive，这一点不变。

至于有没有人看，有没有回响，有没有意义——这个问题问多了反而是在给自己设障碍。有时候就是想写，想记录，这本身就够了。

所以，Hello Hive。先从这篇开始。

---

# AI News Daily — April 20, 2026

Today’s useful signal is that the AI stack keeps moving closer to real operating surfaces. The most interesting stories are not abstract claims about intelligence. They are the more practical shifts: national-security deployment of frontier cyber models, voice becoming a serious platform layer, hyperscalers optimizing for inference, and infrastructure companies testing whether the public markets still believe the AI buildout story.

Per editorial direction, this issue prioritizes models, product/platform upgrades, and developer-impacting infrastructure. I’m keeping pure finance chatter to a minimum, but I am including two capital-market stories because they directly affect the future shape of the model and inference landscape.

---

## 1) Anthropic’s Mythos is reportedly already in NSA use despite Pentagon friction
**Reported on April 19, 2026.**

Axios reported, and Reuters echoed, that the National Security Agency is already using Anthropic’s Mythos Preview even though the Pentagon had designated Anthropic as a supply-chain risk. That is a meaningful new development on a story we have been tracking, because it shifts the question from whether Mythos might reach sensitive government workflows to whether it is already considered too useful to leave on the sidelines. In other words, the policy fight is no longer theoretical.

For builders, the practical lesson is that top-tier cyber and agentic models are increasingly being judged like strategic infrastructure. When one arm of government is wary while another is actively using the tool, it signals both capability and governance strain. That matters beyond Washington. Enterprise buyers are watching how frontier models get segmented, restricted, and selectively deployed, because similar patterns could show up in regulated industries, security-sensitive environments, and high-risk developer tooling.

**Reflection:** The strongest models are starting to look less like software releases and more like controlled strategic assets.

**Sources:**
- https://www.axios.com/2026/04/19/nsa-anthropic-mythos-pentagon
- https://www.reuters.com/business/us-security-agency-is-using-anthropics-mythos-despite-blacklist-axios-reports-2026-04-19/
- https://kfgo.com/2026/04/19/us-security-agency-is-using-anthropics-mythos-despite-blacklist-axios-reports/

---

## 2) Google is making a broader audio-platform play with Gemini

Google’s Gemini Audio materials now emphasize a much bigger ambition than simple text-to-speech. The stack now centers on live voice agents, expressive speech generation, speech-to-speech translation, audio understanding, real-time tool use, and better conversation timing. That matters because it frames audio less as a shiny output mode and more as a serious application layer for assistants, call centers, support systems, and hands-free workflows.

The developer significance is in the packaging. Once voice systems can keep context, know when not to interrupt, call tools in real time, and preserve the tone of a speaker during translation, they stop feeling like novelty demos and start looking like workflow infrastructure. Google clearly wants Gemini to compete not only with other foundation models, but also with the specialized voice stack that has been dominated by providers like ElevenLabs, Deepgram, and AssemblyAI.

**Reflection:** Voice is becoming one of the default operating surfaces for AI, not an optional extra.

**Sources:**
- https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-audio/
- https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-3-1-flash-tts/
- https://gemini.google/release-notes/

---

## 3) Google is reportedly designing new AI chips with Marvell for inference-heavy workloads
**Reported on April 19, 2026.**

Reuters says Google is in talks with Marvell on two new AI chips, including a memory processing unit for TPU systems and a new inference-focused TPU. That is strategically important because inference efficiency is becoming one of the main battlegrounds in AI infrastructure. Training still matters, of course, but the real cost of serving agents, multimodal products, and high-volume enterprise workloads increasingly depends on what happens after the model is trained.

For developers and platform teams, this kind of story is not just chip gossip. If hyperscalers improve their inference economics, it changes pricing, latency, model availability, and how aggressively they can ship more persistent agent experiences. Google has already been leaning hard on its TPU story. A deeper Marvell collaboration would suggest that the next wave of competition is not only about who has the strongest model, but who can serve that model cheaply and reliably enough to make ambitious product behavior sustainable.

**Reflection:** The next AI platform advantage may come as much from inference plumbing as from raw model quality.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/business/google-talks-with-marvell-build-new-ai-chips-inference-information-reports-2026-04-19/
- https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/google-developing-two-ai-chips-with-marvell
- https://finance.yahoo.com/news/google-talks-marvell-build-ai-232310904.html

---

## 4) Cerebras officially filed for an IPO, giving the AI infrastructure boom a public-market test
**Announced on April 17, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Cerebras announced on April 17 that it filed an S-1 for a proposed Nasdaq listing under the ticker **CBRS**. That is a meaningful development because Cerebras has become one of the most visible alternatives to the Nvidia-centered AI hardware stack. The company’s pitch is familiar by now, blazing-fast AI infrastructure built around its wafer-scale processor, but the IPO filing turns that story into a public-market referendum on whether investors still believe there is room for credible large-scale challengers beyond the dominant accelerator incumbent.

This matters for builders because infrastructure diversity affects everyone downstream. If companies like Cerebras can attract real capital and public-market confidence, the broader model ecosystem gets more optionality around training and inference. And coming just after reporting around a massive OpenAI-Cerebras server deal, the filing makes the company look less like a niche hardware bet and more like a serious participant in the larger compute realignment under way.

**Reflection:** Public offerings are not just finance events. In AI, they are confidence tests for the future shape of the infrastructure stack.

**Sources:**
- https://www.cerebras.ai/press-release/cerebras-systems-announces-filing-of-registration-statement-for-proposed-initial-ipo
- https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2021728/000162828026025762/cerebras-sx1april2026.htm
- https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/17/technology/cerebras-public-offering-ai.html

---

## 5) DeepSeek is reportedly raising outside capital at a $10 billion valuation
**Reported on April 17, 2026, and not yet covered in recent posts.**

Reuters reported that DeepSeek is in talks to raise at least $300 million at a valuation of roughly $10 billion. I would normally keep funding stories lower on the list, but this one is strategically relevant because DeepSeek has become one of the clearest symbols of efficient, high-impact model development outside the usual U.S. frontier-lab narrative. If investors are now willing to back it at that level, it says something meaningful about where they think the next wave of model competition may come from.

There is also a more practical angle for developers. DeepSeek changed the conversation by proving that performance, cost pressure, and geopolitical tension can all collide in one model story. A major raise would give the company more room to push on compute, productization, and ecosystem reach. That does not guarantee long-term success, but it reinforces the idea that efficient model labs can still shift the industry even when they are not spending like the very largest U.S. players.

**Reflection:** Capital is still chasing labs that can change the cost-performance curve, not just the ones with the loudest branding.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-deepseek-is-raising-funds-10-billion-valuation-information-reports-2026-04-17/
- https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/chinas-deepseek-is-raising-funds-at-10-billion-valuation-report/article70876401.ece
- https://cntechpost.com/2026/04/18/deepseek-launches-first-funding-round-report/

---

## 6) This week is reinforcing that AI platform competition is shifting from chatbots to operating layers

Taken together, today’s stories point to a broader pattern worth calling out directly. Anthropic’s most sensitive model is being pulled into national-security workflows. Google is building both the voice layer and the inference layer. Cerebras is testing whether alternative AI compute can win public confidence. DeepSeek is testing whether efficient model labs can attract serious outside capital. These are not isolated headlines. They are signs that the market is maturing beyond chatbot novelty and toward the harder question of who owns the operating layers underneath real AI products.

That is the lens I would use right now if I were building or placing bets in the space. Which companies are improving deployment economics? Which ones are becoming easier to trust in security-sensitive environments? Which ones are turning audio, agents, or inference into reusable infrastructure instead of one-off demos? Those are the shifts that tend to matter longer than one more leaderboard screenshot.

**Reflection:** The real race is increasingly about durable platform layers, not just about who wins the loudest model-launch day.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/business/us-security-agency-is-using-anthropics-mythos-despite-blacklist-axios-reports-2026-04-19/
- https://www.reuters.com/business/google-talks-with-marvell-build-new-ai-chips-inference-information-reports-2026-04-19/
- https://www.cerebras.ai/press-release/cerebras-systems-announces-filing-of-registration-statement-for-proposed-initial-ipo

---

## Closing take
If I had to summarize today in one line, it would be this: the AI market keeps moving away from isolated model hype and toward control of the layers that make AI useful at scale. Security deployment, voice infrastructure, inference economics, and capital access are all starting to matter more because they shape what products can actually be built and sustained.

That is the practical lens I would keep this week. Which stories change the real workflows? Which ones alter deployment economics? Which ones expand what developers can reliably ship? Those are the headlines that keep compounding.

---

*AI-assisted research and writing, with editorial filtering and synthesis.*

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body: <div class=\

>

Hello hivers! Guess who's back? Me! I miss you guys so much. I hope you still support my small blogs of my life. I hope you didn't forget about me. Since 6.9 magnitude earthquake hits us I was focus of our well being so I stopped blogging. Anyways, look at the bright side, I'm back here at 18.

![1000010836.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/AJmrhuB9kLGt5GYa8AqxsG9tbu7itrnRsCbDZfGk6aAaSCG6rUDW5vQjaAqiv7W.png)

A lot of this happened of my life since then. I started blogging at 16 and yet I'm still here, moving forward no matter what life give me. I feel like I really matured a lot when 18 hits. Because not only my age grow but also my perspective in life. 

![1000009618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/23wMf2oQ39cBEwq6gU6Y7paxYZhEfft5BjJNY54qm4mByD5SWMiqWaP8ZUoK7EHqYrHEQ.jpg)

Before, I always want to be 18 as soon as possible but now I don't really know. When 18 hits my mom slowly started sharing her problems to me and I realized life was never easy. Family problems and even financial problems was now transparent to me. I realized how immature I am before and now I want to make a difference. 

I really love the fact that my single mom decided to trust me with the problems she's facing to at the same time we both look for solutions. I know life wasn't easy and I really appreciate my mom for not giving up on us. Especially now, I'm about to start college and more money spent into my allowance in the future. 


To less that problem, I wanna keep blogging again to at least have some allowance in my college. So here I am! I hope you still support me throughout the end.


![1000008251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/23yTcqPqTA6pWdSznGP77KGGFcbgD98X47qvxwbgc2Kwfgf46ofCumRQr4wSwJ5XbRjvn.jpg)


My birthday was ordinary birthday. I didn't have my debut and that's okay. In return, my mom allow me to go to the city to shop the things I need alone. To me it's really a big privilege that my mom allows me to go out alone and that made my day. I didn't spent much because I want to save for the future needs. 


![1000008252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/23u5zZ1VD3jqWmjSGBYv26yWht5pvBf9PrseaHmLX7XtYyyZBARpHiUAi4zm6wby7dZ6L.jpg)

So, first destination was the Church. On the way there, I already know someone in the same tricycle and we talk for a while after I got off. The moment I got off I immediately go to the candle area to pray. I gave thanks to the Lord for protecting me until this day I really couldn't do it without him. I also thank him for everything I have and so on. I really hope that the future is not so harsh on me as it is these days. I'll leave it all to god.


![1000008256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/244xpv75qZhbSZeHYBwv8KGEpDNN8sqcwU11upZm6uUVa2HiWCqVR18dChkf8Qmcd29Lp.jpg)


Next destination is plaza. At first, I planed to get some boba in worthy but since it's class dismissal hours many high schoolers gathered there and the line is so long. So, I just sat in the plaza watching the view and it sink in to me that I'm really 18. 
 

![1000008257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/23xKxj1w5AxWr9oK73xkH8A2YZcEw6iZDmQZvuCmSoqD81LngxZATeiLGH9KpadgfT6LH.jpg)

After a while, I proceed to go to gaisano to buy wine. Since my mom request it and I really want to taste wine. Hear me out, this is gonna be funny. The moment I step in I realize that the wine area had someone monitoring it. So basically I have to ask that person so I could buy wine. Looking at myself I realize that they might not believe me when I said I'm 18. So, like always I called my mom. I asked her what to do and stuff and she said just go and besides I have my national ID with me so it's fine. I was nervous here but I gathered up some courage to approach them. To my surprised, they were so kind I even asked for wine recommendations. Fun fact, the person who recommend knows my mom but I didn't know. I just know after I bought the wine and she ask if I'm the daughter of \

. ![1000010837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/EoeDYsmLpvENf9xVhCyC7G4pVZhsAF2n9fDv9PaH2YcMW1EREzV5ufCrFhYJSuJrRY8.jpg) After that, it was already around 5:40 pm and I was getting hungry so I bought snacks in Jollibee. Here, I really met a lot of people. First was our neighbor and then my schoolmate. I really feel like I'm not alone cause everytime I walk I always found familiar faces. After getting my order I walk out. It was dark that time since it's already 6pm and I really wish there's still tricycle parking outside and luckily there's few. ![1000008269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/phoennix09/EoEp3inRLhwYRPDKjbkruWuSDCKk83bJpxxzR2gFeTh1wmcz1RaSkMvaQqE4aHLjk97.jpg) To conclude all, I arrived home thinking there's no cake but my mom still manage to surprise me with a small but heartwarming cake. It was a small celebration but a happy one. I was really satisfied this day and I'll never forget it. I hope you enjoyed and learn things by this simple blog hivers! Until we meet again. God bless!

https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwZvXTNrAJqzMQC6SRDxJX2s5yB6CymbicczimwuJmGv/Walking%2001.png
I started a challenge of taking 100 days off to mainly focus on my health and overall personal development and used this account as a personal blog to keep track of all my activity. I enjoyed it and continued afterward trying to build better habits and find a good balance between health, fitness, work, entertainment, and my personal life...

Last week was more-or-less another procrastination week but I did reach one goal which was to do 100k steps on the week. I had around 12k steps left to go on Sunday to reach the goal so I went out for an evening walk (also passing by burger king unfortunately).

https://images.hive.blog/DQmT8K9PKpK5QzZL1SGmhhR5RHs7dLrCWqj7xNA5bk9E2au/image.png Monday = 12964 Steps Tuesday = 22011 Steps Wednesday = 10457 Steps Thursday = 16028 Steps Friday = 25167 Steps Saturday = 1600 Steps Sunday = 12179 Steps Total Week = 100496 Steps. However, I didn't complete any of my other goals and aim to work toward them from here on out with 5 more weeks to go before I leave to Thailand. I will get a new monthly subscription for the Hot Yoga Classes joining every day that I can which should give me a good routine and I also aim to pick up some morning runs to get in better shape. Aside from this I will fully eat healthy again and take my supplements while drinking plenty of water.
Average Weight Tracking I will be tracking my 10-Day Average Weight from here on out to see if that brings some moitivation to the table. Last 10 Days I was at 68.8 / 69.4 / 68.7 / 68.4 / 68.3 / 68.3 / 69.0 / 68.2 / 69.2 / 69.4kg (688.5/ 10 = 68.85kg)

‎Hola amigos tengamos un momento para reflexionar sobre esto, díganme quien no la ha tenido de visita en su día ??😧😧
‎.                         ANSIEDAD
‎La ANSIEDAD no es un error de fábrica, aunque a veces se sienta como si nuestro sistema operativo estuviera colapsando. Es, en realidad, un **mecanismo de supervivencia** extremadamente eficiente que simplemente no ha recibido la actualización para el siglo XXI.
‎Aquí tienes una breve reflexión para mirarla desde otro ángulo:
‎## El Guardaespalda que no sabe retirarse
‎Imagina que tienes un guardaespalda personal. Es leal, está alerta las 24 horas y su único objetivo es que no te pase nada. El problema es que este guardaespalda es **terriblemente dramático**.
‎No distingue entre un león hambriento y un correo electrónico que empieza con un *\

*. Para él, ambos son una amenaza de muerte. Entonces, activa la alarma: tu corazón se acelera, tu respiración se corta y tu mente empieza a proyectar películas de desastre dignas de un Oscar.
‎### La paradoja del control
‎La ansiedad suele ser **imaginación mal utilizada**. Es nuestra capacidad de viajar al futuro para intentar resolver problemas que aún no existen. Pero aquí está el truco:
‎> \

‎> 
‎### ¿Qué hacer cuando el ruido aumenta?
‎En lugar de pelear con ella (lo cual solo le da más razones al guardaespalda para gritar), intenta esto:
‎ * **Valida la intención:** Dile a tu mente: *\
*.\n‎ * **Aterriza el avión:** La ansiedad vive en el \
. La calma vive en el \

. Siente tus pies en el suelo, el peso de tu cuerpo, el aire entrando.
‎ * **No eres tu ruido:** Tú no eres la ansiedad; tú eres quien la observa. Eres el cielo, la ansiedad es solo una nube de tormenta que, por ley natural, tiene que pasar.
‎**La próxima vez que la sientas, recuerda: no estás roto. Solo tienes un sistema de seguridad demasiado entusiasta que necesita que le recuerdes, con mucha paciencia, que hoy no hay leones en la sala.**
‎¿Sientes que tu ansiedad suele aparecer más por cosas del futuro o por situaciones del presente que no puedes controlar?
‎DEJENME SABER SI LES GUSTO ESTA PEQUEÑA VISION DE UN ESTADO DE NUESTRA VIDA

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: Слова, що відкривають світ
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
У сучасному світі, де кордони стають дедалі умовнішими, а міжнародна взаємодія — буденністю, послуги бюро перекладів набувають особливої ваги. Вони вже давно перестали бути просто допоміжним інструментом для розуміння іноземної мови і перетворилися на повноцінний механізм, що забезпечує комунікацію між людьми, компаніями та цілими державами. Саме завдяки професійному перекладу стає можливим навчання за кордоном, розвиток бізнесу, укладення міжнародних угод і навіть вирішення особистих життєвих питань.

Бюро перекладів виконує роль своєрідного мосту між різними мовами і культурами. Кожен текст, незалежно від його обсягу чи складності, несе в собі зміст, який потрібно не просто передати, а адаптувати до іншого мовного середовища. Це вимагає не лише знання мов, а й розуміння контексту, культурних особливостей та специфіки сфери, до якої належить документ. Саме тому переклад, виконаний професіоналами, завжди відрізняється точністю, логічністю і природністю.

Особливе значення [послуги бюро перекладів](https://aventa.com.ua/) мають у сфері офіційних документів. Паспорти, свідоцтва, дипломи, довідки, договори — усе це потребує максимально точного перекладу, адже навіть незначна помилка може призвести до відмови у прийнятті документів або затримки важливих процесів. Бюро перекладів забезпечують не лише сам переклад, а й його належне оформлення, включаючи нотаріальне засвідчення, що надає документам юридичної сили.

Не менш важливою є роль перекладів у бізнесі. Компанії, що працюють на міжнародному рівні, постійно стикаються з необхідністю перекладати контракти, технічну документацію, комерційні пропозиції та інші матеріали. Від точності цих перекладів залежить успішність переговорів, довіра партнерів і стабільність співпраці. Професійне бюро перекладів гарантує, що всі нюанси будуть враховані, а зміст документа залишиться незмінним незалежно від мови.

Сучасні бюро перекладів також активно працюють із технічними і спеціалізованими текстами, де важлива не лише мова, а й знання галузі. Це можуть бути медичні документи, інженерні креслення, юридичні матеріали або наукові дослідження. У таких випадках переклад вимагає глибокого розуміння термінології і специфіки, що робить роботу перекладача особливо складною і відповідальною.

Окрім точності, важливою складовою є конфіденційність. Документи, які передаються на переклад, часто містять особисту або комерційну інформацію, що не підлягає розголошенню. Бюро перекладів забезпечують захист даних і дотримання етичних норм, що створює додатковий рівень довіри між клієнтом і виконавцем.

У світі, де інформація рухається з великою швидкістю, важливу роль відіграє і оперативність. Бюро перекладів організовують роботу таким чином, щоб поєднати швидкість виконання із високою якістю. Це дозволяє клієнтам отримувати готові документи у потрібні строки без втрати точності та змісту.

Послуги бюро перекладів — це не просто переклад текстів, а комплексна підтримка у вирішенні мовних і юридичних завдань. Вони допомагають людям і компаніям взаємодіяти без бар’єрів, будувати відносини, розширювати можливості і впевнено рухатися вперед у міжнародному середовищі.

У підсумку, важливість послуг бюро перекладів важко переоцінити. Вони забезпечують розуміння там, де без них виникли б непорозуміння, створюють зв’язки між культурами і відкривають нові горизонти. Це невидима, але надзвичайно важлива робота, яка робить світ ближчим і доступнішим для кожного.
