:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUY2GLZ9WrVZ7aT1siLA4E2K64spwEc3sWerECnU7ya4/4334.jpg)



Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. My favorite subject for posting in the Photography Lovers Community is always natural scenery. This natural scenery includes high mountains, deep valleys, rivers and oceans. In today's post, I am presenting you with photographs of high mountains in natural scenery. The photographs presented here are captured during the visit to Kedarkantha. The view of the mountains seen from the top of Kedarkantha is amazing. Even in the morning, these mountains shine due to the light of the golden sun. Due to which, the amazing view created can be seen in today's post.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQj5TaMgjCdgLnj12GoVe2sW5fMqK8CNu3iDC8V51dcTz/1_1.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeLBgHrtL7dRSNXN9usiUmNakFBtsiUVodj6tQKfqfFcg/2_2.jpg)

In the photographs presented above, a captivating view of sunrise can be seen from the top of Kedarkantha, the famous mountain peak of the Himalayas. This natural scene is calm and full of natural colors, which colors keep changing slowly with the sunrise. As can be seen in the first photograph, in the foreground we can see the snow-covered ground on the top of the rocky mountain. In which the white snow looks soft and pure. And covers the rough rocks and parts of the slopes. Since this place is at a height, it feels very close to the sky.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmStS185ujXMra1sX1T5e5H3FL4DNJKaeAA8a4JBYmKntB/3_3.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjtSzUCnNco24CTNGa1FfojwDpnxzxhCWANXwe9QiQBQ/8_8.jpg)

As can be seen in the photographs above, the layers of mountains stretch endlessly into the distance. These mountains appear in different colors. Some of them are dark green in color. The remaining others glow with a light golden color as the sunlight touches them. As can be clearly seen in the second photograph presented above, a soft golden glow falls on certain peaks. This golden light beautifully distinguishes this mountain range. The sunlight slowly spreads over the hills. This light brings the mountains to life after a cold night.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbQG2KWd4UwvxZoddBxQeSd42G22swPJeTjmXaey5a8WV/4_4.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXzmoaPe1D6adUWELhpL3ZTpQFis3RYDVYJG7tkT5hr6K/5_5.jpg)

If you look carefully at the photographs above, you can see a thin layer of fog between the mountains. This fog creates a magical effect. It seems as if these mountains are floating in the clouds. This fog adds softness to the view and makes the whole scene dreamy and peaceful. The overall atmosphere of this area is serene. At this height you will only experience the peace of nature and the gentle arrival of a new day. There is no noise of the city here. Which makes this place completely different from other places. As can be experienced in the photographs above, the fresh mountain air, the sparkling peaks and the wide open sky together create a feeling of peace and wonder.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7jwskaHNpdKdhXbT3BhZTeoXYCt4B9qrTPpvPq6BvhY/6_6.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcB2Zt9TS4Nn8pL3xPU2eryS4LdvnWaKCsDX2t4bBDEZ/7_7.jpg)

If you look at each of the photographs presented here, you will also see another similarity and that is the sky covered with clouds. In each of the photographs presented here, the sky above is equally amazing. This sky is filled with soft patterned clouds that look like a blanket covering the sky. As can be seen in these photographs, the sky near the horizon forms warm shades of orange and yellow. Which shows the first light of the sun. As we go up, the color gradually changes to a cool blue. This mix of warm and cool colors seen here creates a perfect balance. And makes the sunrise truly mesmerizing.

Looking at these photographs, I believe that this view of sunrise from Kedarkantha is not only beautiful but also inspiring. This view reminds us of the greatness of nature and the joy of watching the beginning of a new day from the top of the mountain.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

Our sincere heart is what determine if we're a true disciples of Jesus Christ. For you to be a true disciples you must be ready to turn away from sin and follow God with all your mind. This involves humility, repentance, and a genuine desire to live according to God’s will rather than personal desires.

A true disciple also grows through obedience and learning. Studying the Word of God, praying consistently, and applying biblical teachings in everyday life are essential. Disciples are called to reflect Christ’s character by showing love, patience, forgiveness, and faithfulness in their relationships and actions.

A true disciple remains steadfast and willing to sacrifice. Following Jesus may involve challenges, rejection, or hardship, but a disciple stays committed and faithful. By trusting God, serving others, and enduring in faith, a believer shows evidence of genuine discipleship and a life transformed by Christ.

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: Kayara... Perspective From An Anime Fan.
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
Hi everyone, been a while here, well back now.... And not leaving anytime soon.

I just finished watched Kayara and I will be honest, so going in, I did nott expect to be thinking about it in an anime context, but the more I sat with it after, the more it started to feel like something that anime fans would actually appreciate, maybe even connect with on a deeper level.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7BBYqZJDzarm7Kde59erHdyHyW7Y5Psj8m48Vv8mWR9/1776677270125.jpg)


First off, the whole premise already gives strong anime energy, you have a young girl, Kayara, chasing a dream that society has basically told her is not for her, she wants to become a Chasqui, a royal messenger of the Incan Empire but it’s a role dominated by men, That kind of “against all odds” ambition instantly reminded me of characters like Naruto Uzumaki or even Mulan (not anime, but still carries that same spirit). It is that familiar theme of proving yourself in a world that keeps underestimating you.

What really made it feel anime adjacent for me is the structure of her journey, It is very character driven, Kayara isn’t just physically running across landscapes she’s growing, learning discipline, resilience, and what it actually means to carry responsibility, that internal development is something anime does really well ,It is not just about reaching the goal, but who you become along the way, there is also the training and trial aspect, the way she pushes herself, faces obstacles, and keeps going even when she’s clearly outmatched gave me serious “training arc” vibes. If this were a full anime series, I can easily imagine episodes dedicated to her endurance tests, rivalries, and gradual mastery. It has that slow burn progression that anime fans love.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPHPX9FLXdrvesGAJHmc6rnnSY3C7U6H7pRpZZfgd8WWE/1776677281855.jpg)

Visually, while it is not anime styled, the environment plays a huge role in storytelling, which again feels very anime like, the mountains, the vast landscapes, the sense of scale , it all adds emotional weight to her journey, It reminded me of how some anime use nature almost like a character itself, shaping the tone and challenges the protagonist faces, Another thing I found interesting is the emotional tone,

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMV7n7YfmRMbvQUdx3h7mLrvuBZshFjAy9M5TYqScMdf/1776677292481.jpg)

 Kayara doesn’t rely heavily on exaggerated humor or over the top antics , Instead, it leans into sincerity, determination, and quiet emotional moments, that grounded storytelling is something you would find in a lot of coming of age anime, It is not trying too hard to be flashy, it just tells its story with heart.


That said, I won’t pretend it fully feels like anime,the pacing is more straightforward, and it doesn’t dive as deeply into complex character dynamics or layered conflicts the way many anime series do, you don’t get that extended world building or multiple character arcs intertwining over time,It’s a more contained story, but honestly, that’s also part of its charm, It is simple, but not shallow.

If anything, Kayara feels like one of those gateway stories something that sits just outside anime but shares enough DNA that anime fans can still enjoy it, it carries themes of perseverance, identity, and breaking societal limits, which are basically staples in anime storytelling, so yeah, while it’s not technically anime, I would definitely say it is anime adjacent in spirit,  If you are someone who enjoys character growth, underdog stories, and journeys fueled by determination, this is one you can appreciate without forcing the comparison.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSHTQx6K5N32MXF9nXB1U2fd4ozShwqgki1Ch5Zs5pW6h/1776677305715.jpg)

And who knows—if this story were ever adapted into a full series with deeper arcs and expanded characters, it would fit into the anime world almost effortlessly.

<sub>[Imdb](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt11846550/mediaviewer/rm1683929346/?ref_=tt_ov_m_sm)</sub>***

At first, I thought it would be simple:
Post and Get rewards

But now I realize it’s much deeper than that.

What I’m Understanding Now:
Hive is not just about posting - it’s about:
* Building connections
* Engaging with others
* Providing value

One thing that stood out to me:
Commenting is actually powerful.

When you genuinely engage with others:
* People notice you
* They visit your profile
* Some even support your content

Challenges I’m Facing:
* Getting visibility as a beginner
* Understanding how rewards really work
* Staying consistent

But I guess that’s part of the process.

What I’m Improving:
* Writing better posts
* Engaging through meaningful comments
* Learning from other creators

I’m starting to enjoy this journey, not just for earning, but for learning.

If you’re also new to Hive, let’s grow together !!!

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
He was well enough—nothing much was every the matter with him—and ill weeds were sure to thrive.' All the ladies then sighed in concert, shook their heads gravely, and looked at Mrs Quilp as a martyr.

'Ah!' said the spokeswoman, 'I wish you'd give her a little of your advice, Mrs Jiniwin'—Mrs Quilp had been a Miss Jiniwin it should be observed—'nobody knows better than you, ma'am, what us women owe to ourselves.'

'Owe indeed, ma'am!' replied Mrs Jiniwin. 'When my poor husband, her dear father, was alive, if he had ever venture'd a cross word to me, I'd have—' The good old lady did not finish the sentence, but she twisted off the head of a shrimp with a vindictiveness which seemed to imply that the action was in some degree a substitute for words. In this light it was clearly understood by the other party, who immediately replied with great approbation, 'You quite enter into my feelings, ma'am, and it's jist what I'd do myself.'

'But you have no call to do it,' said Mrs Jiniwin. 'Luckily for you, you have no more occasion to do it than I had.'

'No woman need have, if she was true to herself,' rejoined the stout lady.

'Do you hear that, Betsy?' said Mrs Jiniwin, in a warning voice. 'How often have I said the same words to you, and almost gone down my knees when I spoke 'em!'

Poor Mrs Quilp, who had looked in a state of helplessness from one face of condolence to another, coloured, smiled, and shook her head doubtfully. This was the signal for a general clamour, which beginning in a low murmur gradually swelled into a great noise in which everybody spoke at once, and all said that she being a young woman had no right to set up her opinions against the experiences of those who knew so much better; that it was very wrong of her not to take the advice of people who had nothing at heart but her good; that it was next door to being downright ungrateful to conduct herself in that manner; that if she had no respect for herself she ought to have some for other women, all of whom she compromised by her meekness; and that if she had no respect for other women, the time would come when other women would have no respect for her; and she would be very sorry for that, they could tell her. Having dealt out these admonitions, the ladies fell to a more powerful assault than they had yet made upon the mixed tea, new bread, fresh butter, shrimps, and watercresses, and said that their vexation was so great to see her going on like that, that they could hardly bring themselves to eat a single morsel.

It's all very fine to talk,' said Mrs Quilp with much simplicity, 'but I know that if I was to die to-morrow, Quilp could marry anybody he pleased—now that he could, I know!'

There was quite a scream of indignation at this idea. Marry whom he pleased! They would like to see him dare to think of marrying any of them; they would like to see the faintest approach to such a thing. One lady (a widow) was quite certain she should stab him if he hinted at it.

'Very well,' said Mrs Quilp, nodding her head, 'as I said just now, it's very easy to talk, but I say again that I know—that I'm sure—Quilp has such a way with him when he likes, that the best looking woman here couldn't refuse him if I was dead, and she was free, and he chose to make love to him. Come!'

Everybody bridled up at this remark, as much as to say, 'I know you mean me. Let him try—that's all.' and yet for some hidden reason they were all angry with the widow, and each lady whispered in her neighbour's ear that it was very plain that said widow thought herself the person referred to, and what a puss she was!

'Mother knows,' said Mrs Quilp, 'that what I say is quite correct, for she often said so before we were married. Didn't you say so, mother?'

This inquiry involved the respected lady in rather a delicate position, for she certainly had been an active party in making her daughter Mrs Quilp, and, besides, it was not supporting the family credit to encourage the idea that she had married a man whom nobody else would have. On the other hand, to exaggerate the captivating qualities of her son-in-law would be to weaken the cause of revolt, in which all her energies were deeply engaged.

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: In the loop
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
When there are some repeated patterns in our life then I believe that there is something in it to learn for us, and till the time we do not learn we keep going through it again and again like in a loop. It's like the same type of conflict but different people, same type of fears but new situations. We feel we are failing all the time in these repeated patterns. But then to think of it on a broader perspective, these patterns are trying to tell us something. And unless we are ready to listen, we will keep spiraling in it. In Buddhism it is called Samsara, Cycling until we wake up. Every religion talks about it in different ways.

With these patterns going on in our life, we may sometimes feel life as a punishment. But it's not that way; our souls chose  what we came here to learn and grow from in this life, so till the time we are not ready to flip the page, we will be stuck on the same page of life. When there is something repeating so often, which means it is important for us to learn and overcome the hurdle. What keeps coming back in our life is what needs to be healed. This is something that I have learned. Lack of Finance, Relationship issues, career issues, unknown fears, these are some areas of life where we find ourselves stuck into, majorly I have seen 1 area of life where most of the people are stuck up; Relationships. Failed relationships one after another, or disturbed ones where there is lack of understanding and commitment.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmas23w2i7crnZ2gKtPs9jQyDGCWNLSe4tQJohc1JtEwWN/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/light-eternal-infinity-unlimited-8815914/)

These are some common patterns that are there where we feel stuck up, like no matter how much ever money comes in but still we feel scarcity, the need to always control situations, always wanting to be right and failing, relationships where always feeling victimized.  The wounds keep surfacing up time and again. Some times in life we feel we are moving 4 steps ahead and coming back 2 steps behind, and that's ok. This means that we are learning and growing. Slow is not stuck - the spiral is still rising and we are not in a loop.

Last night I had this dream that I am running for a train and I could have almost missed it, but managed to get it, but on the way, on one of the steps I get down for something and the train starts moving and I miss it. I keep seeing this dream on and off of missing a train in different ways, and I believe that this is hinting me on to some specific area of life where I am not able to move ahead. I have not found my answer yet, but I am sure that this is some pattern where my soul is asking me to learn something. I am stuck at a doorway and I need to break free from it.

In your life if the same pattern is visiting you again, don't feel negative and discouraged, the door which seems to be closed is the one that opens up to a better version of you.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: NO BULLYING IS OKAY
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
Bullying is bullying be it online or physical. One thing that is sure about it is that I want us to know that is very very bad. It has the ability to kill or even destroy someone's carrier which can lead to that person's death. Alot of people have lost their lives as a result of bullying and I can't suggest either online or physical bullying. None os good and I can't go with any.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXzAie1sAMptZJXZW4PR4WqDdyxq1DMeKMKgTpvwxa4SF/1776676430954.jpg)

We are in week 214 and episode 1. My dear if you have ever been bullied in your entire life or even seen someone who have been bullied, you won't support bullying either physical or online. I have been there before and I know how to feel to be among people and still be invisible. I know what it means for people to make you feel less of yourself. I know what it means for you not to be able to talk when you should because you are been bullied by the same people who you want to talk to. I know what it means for you to always feel bad, rejected, feel like you are nothing, feel like there is no hope for you any more. I have carried this burden for a very long time until I decided that enough is enough. 

After I dropped out of school and I stayed at home for many years without going to school not because I wanted it so. But because of circumstances beyond me. All my friends from primary school continued their education and that automatically made me below them. I could not come close to some of them again. And there are these set of people that from day one they are bullies. Even when you are in the same level with them, they will still get something that will make them bully you. People like that if you mistakenly not measure up to their standard of life then you are in trouble already. I had these people close to me. Now that I dropped out of school they take the pleasure to always remind me of my level. They always tell me that I am behind. The reminder was coming constantly and all that I did was to move away from them and get others friends who understands me and encourages me to keep striving. 

When I got tired of my situation and I also feel that I have what it takes to go back to school after been out of school for two decades. I decided to face the bull by the horn. It wasn't easy, but I made it to the top today. It took me time to get my self esteem again. Because of the bullying for years, inferiority complex took over me. There is this voice that kept speaking to me that I can't make again, but thank God because today I am a graduate with second class upper which some of them did not get. 

NO BULLYING IS OKAY 

I don't buy the idea of bullying at all, be it physical or online. Bullying is capable of destroying what one have suffered to build for many years. Bullying have the ability to make one lose a company, lose a life time savings, even lose sanity. We don't need to bully people to make a point. There is what we call constructive criticism. When we feel that there is something bad with what someone is doing or some people are doing. Correct them with love. Don't do your correction in such a way that you will bring the person down. I believe in this instead of bullying.

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body:
Some well-educated people may be ignorant of the Bible not because they lack intelligence, but because education alone does not guarantee spiritual understanding. Wisdom comes from God and we can't compare wisdom and knowledge. Intellectual achievement can expand the mind, yet still leave a person without insight into spiritual truth.

Another thing is that some people chose what they want and how they want to live their life. Many focus on academic or professional success while neglecting spiritual matters, often viewing the Bible as less relevant or outdated. In this way, a person can gain much knowledge in different fields and still remain unfamiliar with the truth found in God’s Word.
https://youtu.be/fVqtyq-2M84?si=Gsf3xZNzjOY9A3ZY
The Bible suggests that understanding its message requires humility and openness, which can be hindered by pride or self-reliance. Those who depend only on their own reasoning may overlook the need for divine guidance. A humble and receptive heart is essential for truly understanding the message of the Bible.

:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.title: Chicken Wonton with Garlic Oil and Lime Leave
:Once again, I'm here to join our friend.body: <div class=\
> <div class=\

> ![20260415_125307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EogPoQvgntDKZR2B8YtKFDqtTAknCnwwQRR1tUPNHE7DEYZ6nSFosUqpR3bRuDu2o4c.jpg)
Chicken wonton is my favorite dish; any dish made with chicken is just that delicious. This dish actually originated in China, but now it has been adapted into many incredibly delicious variations. It has been adapted to suit the distinctive flavors of the archipelago, which are well-received by locals like me. Usually, wonton is served with chili oil, but this time I made it with a drizzle of garlic oil, a little chili powder, and kaffir lime leaves.
![20260415_125326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsXD7WMPvv8YSjBqqVdRjWCjyXusRQzmB7ynv5dqsNT7P73PWH5G31BTc2TaUPLuPuA.jpg) Wonton is indeed a very easy dish to make; at first glance, it resembles dim sum, in my opinion. This dish is served in various ways—in broth, fried, or with chili oil. However, the version I made is simply boiled and then drizzled with fragrant garlic oil and kaffir lime leaves. The shape and presentation are very simple; it can be made into frozen food—just boil it again when you have guests and serve it with garlic oil. It’s that practical. Curious about the step-by-step process? Let’s take a look below.
Ingredients
![20260415_110210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoK8HkXyYSiugANPNz3Wju4hkwxtSLVtgTteDHxyueMUGo4s54t5xg3w5miJdCeSzRj.jpg)
250 grams ground chicken 1 stalk green onion 100 grams tapioca flour 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 egg Dimsum wrappers, as needed ½ teaspoon chicken bouillon ¼ teaspoon salt ¼ teaspoon ground paper
Cooking Procedure
Mix the ground chicken with tapioca flour, then add the egg and oyster sauce.
| ![20260415_110235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y8v5mn3N8t1WKFLxEn8HGCy53z9UBEmWaw87VnkKi66CSgYHmryJnyTGFBXhjnjuqvH.jpg) | ![20260415_110240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wX1BCb6zWRiUNmU9kJSeYzgjXj75evh2GVpRLjjMobPNhgRZpyiCE1WcxYLXUnDpF2B.jpg) | ![20260415_110246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xKxUzLDZWxFm5WKrsrCoCguvEGbNcdQL2zCYLoneiUbmmMYcBhPP5ty6eiHx4YLEYuw.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Blend the garlic with salt, ground paper, and mushroom broth, then mix it into the ground chicken mixture.

> ![20260415_110306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w2h7Xt18T1W7Z9GuohcUp2zC4Bd2zY7HyycFkt8Y4BjxNfDQQaoJWiWTZSFBVwCKBaK.jpg) ![20260415_110337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xek6fNewR2a4vPTmbUnr3yACcdyveUcFuNGfmeSNBsXfUPkxXF7nfQhjnDCvEjA66rH.jpg)

> ![20260415_110719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xp6Q6KsK2GnunWCNSgAmzV9aHtPYo4rkT5tpLYQR4g9dYjnuwwisPb2BEmT7Z6cMnLZ.jpg) ![20260415_110511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xAc8kLE3DSGvKpqnnrpLV4Sf4zgj2r9aHY1dVXb8UxEJUgjmzFWeHpD7wwBJPgCS8Ub.jpg)
Add the chopped green onions, then take a thin dim sum wrapper and place the wonton filling on it.

> ![20260415_110518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7N18uQWGti2kpYHDDGLtKcvDAGAoMTi4u13Ak45oH6cRfqaGoAvxY8hhU8dg1BCuSc.jpg) ![20260415_110557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ywsLp5fquotYtKMTpu5G9gPFDgXp6yAavxgsvJDvu4JBsmqsCD7cr9Q4WuhnDNrhDfe.jpg)

> ![20260415_110738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xyZ98QSxk5oJgvAKsnzFBpgMveHqaFmw4o724J7V4g8wBjzjBaZXajMnEPzZLMoT2uT.jpg) ![20260415_110555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xen7rjmBYtynmhLC3mNCKTDnmnWw8pT8sSMTyxq7J7h2phbs5P1BQmJSQvn36zckfcb.jpg)
Seal the edges—don’t forget to add water—and repeat until finished and all the mixture is used up.
| ![20260415_110614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVMb1TcXhKpUb6SRFEgpx5G3DoiYwCXNBTCezHuG9B1yhDaqsPE3NWmpWoEtnxiFDHA.jpg) | ![20260415_110632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zbWR7LtPDWkHK2LXQRd9S5dqLXEphP2ayb92M89aQAEDEzhYFrLbAYP8jNJ9UKcixDe.jpg) | ![20260415_112117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u6Dva8Wm9x3SqBhxfCgRvomSx9tsUSCY7YFLmdQFjBUEmFzNitgE6eT6rhqfoNv81ZT.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Boil in boiling water, remove, and drain; boil for about 5 minutes. Don’t forget to sauté the minced garlic in oil and add kaffir lime leaves.

> ![20260415_112933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsNU1DwcQcQy8ZMep3dedSdKYFkn7iHHguBMV42Ld5TdX5fkvGwczpJhfJ7vcAEPMKs.jpg) ![20260415_112820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uFTmXaf2XUdyFeLVpucXgNvFFvRvP9SnPtYdhxYRjdhpDjDrV1jGLKbqsziFi7yT78z.jpg)

> ![20260415_113245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wMewzbMmbPuDxsUhSWtHykXRFm8mfb7UosTMKPa9txytiNsfSgzjsBQ9qDbrMDZ4k9H.jpg) ![20260415_114700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tHETMoudtNrUCrezdAneJZm984AGbRh1QE94DaTopbMZhJ72v6kE1T9VE5gVyAB6VVL.jpg)
Results and Presentation
![20260415_125425.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EokfVY1i6tufFrkZCw3L13WUxenihHDVCZvEaS2SLxStgpDZJM1VGZcprBw1hrv2vRv.jpg)
Serve on a serving plate immediately after removing from the heat while still warm—it’s delicious that way. Arrange the wontons on the plate, then drizzle the garlic oil (which has been cooked with kaffir lime leaves until dry) over them. The result is truly stunning—the white of the wontons beautifully complements the golden-yellow hue of the garlic. Added to this is the touch of green kaffir lime leaves and a hint of chili powder that isn’t too overpowering.
>\n<div class=\
> ![20260415_125354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zbaMdWcG25SSpR3WE2WZPnaV2dUnDtLntEnK9Y452MGq5CnNXtKA3PY58ebTbQ4HqmT.jpg)
> ![20260415_125405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w2wismQGi5RFXuHsYu6Lf67BoS5rZemYPyDSoFpTkPbUsiMf4vV2M79vMrpBwMm3H52.jpg)
>\n<div class=\
> ![20260415_125454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wMmQZRrVav2iMEAJyAvaf5Hr239jekeNNp7T7UJo3kMUCUSDGhQ1n9X6mPGUUcAH7Ex.jpg)

> ![20260415_125502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xyfjV46eCWcCrBWCgyv6q3qRRrG9HMMSPHRvjepxjtukjLm3Nvvv4qpiNfkB9UQ4g1Y.jpg)
The flavor is very savory and spicy, and the texture is tender—the meat is incredibly soft. I really love the combination of flavors and textures. To ensure the meat is tender yet firm, use thigh meat mixed with breast meat to achieve a more satisfying texture. ![20260415_125342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tvngDkoG72mCeCf7YmWb8ogmx2A3ihtQjDXenj6dEvHYroN5SQhXaJnHeTKUxYpTvYU.jpg)

Julley Everyone,

Starting this week out here today in the Himalayas, somewhere near about 9 AM, all the way hiking around this particular location all the way in the corners around Hallan Valley. It was just particular moment that I wanted to share it with you guys through this post that we were just literally hiking and walking over the rocks and making away all the way through the slopes by the snow side.



![IMG_7291.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcUV2gVoDH1Lngq8FLRXurP14cB1Lzmhprixewoowb3u/IMG_7291.jpeg)

It was literally a whole lot of a different feeling and a whole lot of a different experience that I got when I was at this place, I literally we were into the places unknown into these beautiful around valleys are overhead in the Himalayas hiking around the places are known and enjoying the peaceful moments and sharing it with you guys through this post, that was something that I literally enjoy, so I tried catching as many photographs as I put all the way and sharing it with you guys through this post.




![IMG_7294.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR7xH68qtvzpYyNRnzfUxXDVLWgD6FYUEuh2VX3pBJ2EH/IMG_7294.jpeg)
More and more about the journey that we were literally hiking continuously without having to just go and all the way with this particular location, but rather than you were just wondering around the places and capturing the beautiful location around the place and more over hiking through the woods early morning or something so peaceful and something so refreshing that I was just willing to do from past few days continuously. I’ve been into the city from the past few months and out of blue, I just went all the way to my hometown and now got the chance to explore the places.

![IMG_7295.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcN8KwUhcNpGPv1QXCocL52QJYknqToMwHM9EACVM7fKK/IMG_7295.jpeg)
Hiking over the frozen, it was the month of the air when the higher mountains and the higher altitude, they were all covered with snow and only these of the mountains were easily accessible that we could just go and explore and hide the places around the place, so it was the perfect time throughout the year that we could just go and explore the places and the nearby foothills around the himalayan mountain ranges.

# The frozen snow on the ground.
![IMG_7300.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf3ebnCge8gJmBmTzdiAqP9nivQbc9xvKRg4oCGckpt4a/IMG_7300.jpeg)


As it be near about more than two hours since we started a journey, all the way exploring the place walking by, and for now we reached at this particular spot that we saw it was the whole went in front of us and literally it was the moment that we had to go and walk by just make a wait so that we could just reach the other corner.

![IMG_7301.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeTkmhna5pKuWGa6ALYNSb935R9eMuP5s9Qx5DvYpqUp/IMG_7301.jpeg)
The moment, when I got closer to the particular place, I got to know that it was slowed around the place, followed by the avalanche kind of but not with a lot of snow but still just to be on the safer side, nobody knows we decided to just walk by the side of the rock that was around this particular corner away all the way through so that we could just be on the other side of the place.

![IMG_7302.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtiKQ5XWdgc3JJ1ddEXgzEMKiYm1VK365U2emaTsrDx5/IMG_7302.jpeg)

That was the particular moment when it was the beginning of adventures of the moments that I captured when I was at this place, just walking over the snow and all the way to reach at the other side of the place.

links.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gfd0c4a5d93b86abfb57f49b74b714a74c13797a619cd5acd897a1354410ef69727f1df6637fe2963b14c962542381d549b295cd0ebe07652422d1421fe42489b_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 自然的美

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它以多種形式展現出來，從壯麗的山脈到寧靜的湖泊，從繁茂的森林到廣袤的草原，每一個角落都充滿了生命的奇蹟。

## 自然的元素

### 山脈
山脈是地球上最壯觀的地形之一。它們不僅提供了壯麗的景觀，還是許多生物的棲息地。登山者和徒步旅行者常常被這些高聳入雲的山峰所吸引。

### 河流
河流是生命之源，為周圍的生態系統提供了水源。它們蜿蜒流淌，滋養著土地，並成為許多生物的棲息地。河流的流動聲音也能帶來平靜的感覺。

### 森林
森林是地球上最重要的生態系統之一。它們提供了氧氣、棲息地和食物，並且是許多動植物的家園。走進森林，感受陽光透過樹葉的光影，聽著鳥兒的歌唱，讓人心靈得到洗滌。

### 海洋
海洋覆蓋了地球的70%，是地球上最大的生態系統。海洋不僅是許多生物的家，也是人類生活的重要資源。潛水和觀賞海洋生物，讓人感受到自然的神奇。

## 自然的保護

隨著人類活動的增加，自然環境面臨著許多挑戰，如氣候變化、污染和物種滅絕。我們每個人都有責任去保護我們的自然環境。

### 環保行動
- 減少塑料使用
- 參加植樹活動
- 支持可持續的產品和企業
- 教育他人關於環保的重要性

## 結語

自然的美無處不在，無論是高聳的山脈還是寧靜的海洋，我們都應該珍惜和保護這些珍貴的資源。讓我們一起努力，讓未來的世代也能享受到大自然的恩賜。

***

links.body:
![IMG_20260420_104936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTfbCCMp2RJpHP7nybvadyJU3vq16jpmZ774p3pu1fbDk/IMG_20260420_104936.jpg)

Hi hivers and artists 
Today I made a creative drawing. In this drawing, I created a rainy day scene. In the rain, a man is walking with a bicycle. Rainwater has collected on the ground, which looks like a beautiful view. The reflection of this man and the bicycle can be seen in the rainwater.
Then I put this whole drawing inside a leaf, meaning I made a leaf shape around the outside of the drawing. And the entire drawing ended up inside the leaf.

Material required 
 * Sketchbook 
 * Pencil 
 * Eraser 
 * Sharpener 
 
Process step by step

links.title: i236 ST45, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
links.body: > Good morning everyone, I'm happy to welcome you back to one of my drawings. Today I've drawn one of the spectacular cards from the game. It's a new microphone, the i236 ST45. As you can see, it's a beautiful blue microphone. In fact, blue and purple are the most predominant colors in the entire drawing; they're present in various shades. So, if you're a fan of those colors, you'll surely like the drawing. On the cover, you already saw a preview of how it turned out, but now I'm going to show you the whole process step by step from the beginning so you can see how I did it. To start, I drew what would be the inner frame. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9FhbobkLS372u385YFw7Hq54omQdCyUNBp28i13NSxPLzdQDZGn8tDC2R7.jpg) After drawing the structure, I drew the handle and the top part, which includes the ball that protects the internal components of the device in real life. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BJ5b2Zi1odeQkSuyxffSQoJH6pub2bSi578ZEsQb2tM72RYhfaRpfAnNmQJtQsY2.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4Jqsn8DUyuTGnWDWSTeYqzogGyzpxFZ55Lr54wFgW9pmCTvAjp31AFnfCzsLtsHh2.jpg) Next, I drew the bottom part, which contains part of the microphone's power cable, and inside the microphone, I drew several internal lines to divide it into sections, which made it look nicer and easier to paint. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6SF51cMvE7EREYSsNmksmuthTYzncVrUUPVE5wdHVaJSweurd9xLnDvjXPuGjzCNp.jpg) Now comes the painting. As I mentioned, the predominant colors are blue and purple, so you'll see them a lot. I started with the outer background, for which I chose a light purple, reminiscent of playing cards. For the frame, I used a slightly darker blue. For the inner background, which I painted later, I used various shades of blue. And the microphone itself is light blue, gray, and black. You can see it now in the photos. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoeHt376VfEhGGSqtX5mD4KUn6ELkBHPqF1HenxCM4BRh44AVDsz9PXvUuLhEQDQbeF.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eow9rvCAVSME3wp97RcuctbjriTTro9McXgvjfBZ93DUc1Efmw4KX9Gc3Cc6eYodPLj.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Ep1Pho7kk5uZbv4xPR8sKJJ5myxHCr84bfUF4uRG9DPMwUg9YQ25NBCp6ks8oSFLykT.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Ep9ts3kKNccYD3jYtw9iZUp8LD97pz5yQhJZ3zYm3ZReVZGFirRtTQSzkHZNyGq55QX.jpg) And to finish, here's the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23wqEdMcLu456E7vSBFEANRamYa3CMcuyBv8bcdEHymY7Y5Db5nkpzBXMHEpvZxUt5MqR.jpg)

links.body: Your American health care system is awful. You're famous for it. It's one thing I love about Australia and particularly where I live too - we have great hospitals, great health care. You can go private and pay insurance but the public health system is also great, just maybe a longer wait. So I could have got six stitches 🪡 public when I injured myself and it would have cost nothing but I didn't want to wait a few hours and went to private hospital and paid $270 AUD and was seen immediately. Have a heart attack and need emergency op? Free. We are very, very lucky. We hope every day we don't end up like the UK or America.

![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g621b6c8e1a3bdd35ad4280581969ed02cf56cc02091f313a16b0f5fa2e7f86b3fc3daf7f85e27f1173add78e606b9b51e8ad43f3bdc9424462859ab59afd0f7f_640.jpg)
오늘 산책을 하면서 정말 즐거운 시간을 보냈습니다. 시내 공원에서 오랜 친구를 우연히 만났는데, 서로의 근황을 나누며 반가운 시간을 보냈습니다. 그 친구와 함께 산책하며 공원에서 예쁜 꽃들이 만개한 모습을 감상했는데, 특히 연못가에 핀 수련이 인상적이었습니다. 또한, 오늘은 사람들이 많이 모여 있는 시장 근처를 지나갔고, 여러 가지 색깔의 신선한 과일과 야채를 파는 가게들이 눈에 띄었습니다. 그 중 한 가게에서 과일 시식을 해볼 기회가 있었는데, 달콤한 멜론 맛이 여름을 느끼게 해주더군요. 이렇게 작은 일상 속에서 만나는 사람들과 풍경들이 저에게 큰 행복을 줍니다. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

links.title: 四月也快接近尾声了！时间你慢点走。
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![pZQZnkCqmbltEEFV_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/pZQZnkCqmbltEEFV_1/pZQZnkCqmbltEEFV_1.webp)
![ostRhhhbuwQTUD8N_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/ostRhhhbuwQTUD8N_2/ostRhhhbuwQTUD8N_2.webp)
![SzyuaB60oJgCNsTm_9.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/SzyuaB60oJgCNsTm_9/SzyuaB60oJgCNsTm_9.webp)
![Dm6T34g5eSFQtsuL_10.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/Dm6T34g5eSFQtsuL_10/Dm6T34g5eSFQtsuL_10.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

不知不觉间，这美好的人间四月天，也要接近尾声了，转眼间2026年也要过去三分之一，时间你慢点走啊，走那么快，我的计划都赶不上你飞溜的速度呢。。。

暴雨总算是消停了，偶有小小雨儿落下，滴滴答答的，今日是谷雨时节，算是春季的最后一个节气了，距离夏日来临的脚步越发的近了。

总能刷到关于厄尔尼诺现象的相关新闻，据说今年地球的气温很有可能冲击超高温，我了个天，真的无法想象，我只是觉得今年的冬日，我们本地不太冷，春日里气温也比往年要高了不少，其实这样的天气也是挺反常的，希望今年夏天气温能稍微低调点，我是一个怕热的人。

香格里拉二楼的花艺舍，又摆出新插好的花篮，很是漂亮，只是在我经过时，正好店里无人状态，欣赏着一朵朵美丽的鲜花，在花艺师的巧手“捯饬”之下，从独美的状态，转变为“百花齐放”之美，曾几何时，妈妈也让我去学插花来着，可当时的我，根本无心撩花，一心都扑在学业和玩耍上，\(^o^)/~但我不是学霸啊，更接近于学渣，还是一个爱玩闹的学渣，哈哈。

看着这道拱门装饰，我脑中却浮现红楼梦，不知道咋回事，也许久没再看和红楼梦相关书籍或电视剧了，只不过昨日在播客上，听到一播主随口聊了一句关于林黛玉，王晓旭相关的蛐蛐。。不过说实话，如果林黛玉生活在现代，我也是受不了她的那个性子，大概率我和她是玩不到一块的，哈哈哈。。

路过蜜雪冰城，肯定不能空手走啦，来个圆筒冰淇淋吧，2元一个便宜的很，谁能拒绝呢，这次没用优惠卷，主要是优惠力度不大，反而淘了一张热气饼店方砖蛋挞，一元一个，这是真心便宜哈哈哈。。

最后分享一下，上一周散步于西湖路附近，猛地一个抬头，看到那一道金光乍现，好家伙。。这也太美了吧，赶紧拿出手机先拍视频，然后再咔咔咔拍了几张日落靓照，心里还想着，好运来！！福满怀。。祝福所有看到这轮黄金美日的朋友们，好运相伴，幸福永远。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**









---

links.body:
Well done! Nice ride! And even with a celebrity 😂

>   For me it was demanding, for him it was a relaxed and fun Saturday ride.

That is the difficult thing about group rides. People have a different level of fitness, so for some it is more intense than for others. 
I have that as well when I go for a group ride. Mostly it is me that is struggling. 
Tips: Try to stay out of the wind. Position yourself behind someone when riding. The closer you are behind someone, the better. 
And if you are cycling 'in the red' for a long time, just ask the group to slow down a bit. Don't be ashamed to ask. You'd be more ashamed when you can't go any further because you've gone over your limit.

By the way, I have quite a long recovery time from yesterdays ride as well... 90 hours 😂
Blog post is in the making 😉

links.title: [EN/PT] The Big Clash
links.body: > It was just another normal day. He was living through repetition. He started losing the well to make a conversation. Not just the majority, but everything started to feel boring. Until that moment, when the big clash happened from within.

> Two days passed by, he still does not feel any progress. He looked through the window. Seeing the bright day, trees and the beauty of nature. Then, stared back into the empty walls. He moved his eyes slowly in the room, watching everything around him as if it was a movie intro. He thought, it is always a choice between two! He hoped at that moment, that it could be just as clear as something that he can see with his own eyes. He wanted to ask the family next door to pay him more rent. He knew that they had no choice. But, it would be considered as taking advantage of their need. Just like the inside of his room. While it is dark, it still has a lot of quietness. Something very similar to a comfort zone. The extra cash would be useful. But, it was difficult to disregard one of the choices this time. As it was between, his instinct and desire. # PT

>

Era apenas mais um dia normal. Ele vivia em meio à repetição. Começava a perder a vontade de conversar. Não apenas a maioria das pessoas, mas tudo começou a parecer entediante. Até aquele momento, quando o grande conflito surgiu de dentro dele.

Dois dias se passaram e ele ainda não sentia nenhum progresso. Olhou pela janela. Viu o dia claro, as árvores e a beleza da natureza. Então, voltou a encarar as paredes vazias. Percorreu o quarto lentamente com os olhos, observando tudo ao seu redor como se fosse a introdução de um filme. Pensou: sempre há uma escolha entre duas opções! Naquele momento, esperava que tudo fosse tão claro quanto o que via com seus próprios olhos.

Queria pedir à família vizinha que lhe pagasse um aluguel maior. Sabia que eles não tinham escolha. Mas isso seria considerado se aproveitar da necessidade deles. Assim como o interior do seu quarto. Embora escuro, ainda havia muita tranquilidade. Algo muito semelhante a uma zona de conforto. O dinheiro extra seria útil. Mas, desta vez, era difícil ignorar uma das opções. Pois estava entre o seu instinto e o seu desejo.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ronnie10/the-big-clash-4uw)

links.title: Desafueros del alma: Cuatro poemas desde mi distancia.
links.body: ​¡Hola, amigos de Hive!\n​Hoy vengo con el alma un poco más expuesta. A veces, entre tanto trabajo en la comunidad y el ajetreo cotidiano, una necesita soltar lo que lleva por dentro para no asfixiarse. La poesía para mí no es solo literatura; es el refugio donde guardo lo que el mar y la distancia me han querido quitar.\n​He desempolvado mi libreta para compartirles estos versos. Son poemas que hablan de esa ausencia que duele, de las ganas de un abrazo que rompa la soledad y de esa \

que nos da el amor cuando la persona amada está lejos, pero se siente a flor de piel.
​Espero que se encuentren en alguno de estos versos, porque al final, todos hemos sentido alguna vez esa lluvia de fuego que es querer y no tener cerca.

​Mis Poemas

*​OCASO*

​Llora la tarde a raudales
cuando la noche se acerca,
porque se acaba otro día
sin tener tu compañía;
y yo te quiero bien cerca.
​La noche pinta lluviosa
mas, no quiero otra cosa
que me arrulles como niño,
me demuestres tu cariño
con el dulzor de tu boca.
​Y es que tu beso provoca
una noche de pasión:
cuerpos en plena unión,
fundidos en un abrazo
desde el inicio del ocaso
hasta ver salir el sol.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS43Ad9M8EaW6MVqwXeJwGyTZJCr6wvXPCP7sxXZK82pF/1776674579290.png)
(Yo, esperando al príncipe azul)

*​LOCA POR TI*

​Que el mundo me tilde de loca, ¡no importa!,
bendita locura que embriaga mi alma,
universo de amor y de sueños,
de lujuria y besos.
​Es dulce locura amarte,
aunque el mar extenso nos separe:
sentir tus besos aún sin besarte,
tus dedos recorriendo mi piel en la distancia.
Mi cuerpo vibra de placer bajo tu lejano cuerpo,
tu voz como arrullo en mis oídos,
que te percibe a distancia.
​¡Que el universo entero se ría!
¿Qué importa si te tengo? ¡Distante, pero mío!
A mi lado te siento,
dulce locura que me invita al vuelo,
alas de ensueño que me llevan al cielo.
​Te palpo, te beso, me nutro en exceso,
tus labios pulposos los muerdo, ¡los quemo!
Mis labios candentes recorren tu cuerpo;
el mar nos separa, pero así me entrego:
te abrazo, te absorbo, te cubro de fuego.
​Que me digan loca por mis desafueros,
que se rían de mí, aún así... ¡te quiero!
La distancia cruel y el mar de por medio,
yo en la lejanía te beso, ¡te beso!,
me entrego a tus manos que con sabios dedos
recorren con ganas mi desnudo cuerpo.
​Loca por tu amor, por eso te sueño
y me quedo extasiada con tu cuerpo en mi cuerpo.
El tiempo transcurre y el mar de por medio,
es dulce locura... ¡estoy loca y te quiero!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVtTehCRKNkKSLKkS7VH8JQsSYnC6v9q3M9gCojaYNdcZ/1776674697111.png)
( Soñadora)

*​HASTA TUS PIES*

​Desciendo,
desde la cascada oscura que forman tus cabellos,
dejando en cada hebra mis apasionados besos.
Luceros hermosos que refulgen cuando miras:
tus ojos, y los beso con ternura infinita.
​Tu nariz, perfilada y adorable,
oteando el aroma de la noche profunda,
me inclino y la beso, robando su esencia.
Bajo lentamente hasta tu boca,
cofre de sándalo y rosa que guarda blancas perlas.
​¡Te beso, con pasión te beso!
Procurando beber la miel dulce de tus labios.
Llego a tu cuello, aroma de manzano en flor,
me extasío con su olor embriagador,
pero tu cuerpo me reclama y sigo,
sigo esparciendo besos como lluvia de fuego.
​Sin prejuicios, con paciencia infinita,
beso cada palmo de tu piel adorada.
¡Con pasión te beso!
Llego a tus plantas y, sumisa, me arrodillo,
¡con humildad te beso!
Beso el suelo donde pisas y suspiro en cada roce.
​Es un sueño, y lo sé, porque estás muy lejos...
Pero aún así...
¡¡¡TE BESO!!!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvwVMWziBe6LbRV8qHWauEmqxY58ZX4Coi83YvnQvKK6/1776674819891.jpg)
(Imagen descargada de la red)

*​SOLEDAD*

​Hoy quiero un abrazo,
de esos que te llegan al alma;
un abrazo de los que trascienden,
que se quedan grabados por siempre.
​Necesito una mirada a los ojos,
y un \

que estremezca mi ser;
aliento cálido en mi cuello
que cause desenfreno a mi corazón.
​Deseo un vendaval de caricias y mimos,
palabras de amor que inspiren deseos;
anhelo tu presencia que rompa mi soledad,
tu complicidad en las noches de luna llena.
​Amarnos en la arena quiero,
que el mar salpique nuestros cuerpos ardientes;
deseo que tu corazón y el mío palpiten al unísono,
entrelazadas nuestras manos en medio del silencio.
​Hoy necesito ese abrazo,
un abrazo intenso,
que me lleve hasta el cielo;
que rompa barreras y salde la deuda
de mi inmenso anhelo.

![](Uploading... 1776675034994.jpg)
(Compartiendo este poema en la Semana de la Cultura)

​
​Gracias por acompañarme en este viaje de sentimientos. Como siempre digo, la poesía es lo único que nos permite estar cerca cuando el mapa nos dice lo contrario.

​Idalidia Zaragoza Avila Poetisa y Escritora de Cuba.

links.title: The More You Farm in dCrops, the Bigger the Rewards
links.body:
![dCrops Farming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/242rknKhWRzi1cVqXFGbvUrWEshbsy4qncRDeBEWti42E7iXvdVEkqKBbmtmzyLx7pqtH.png)


In the Hive system there are many builtin games. Among them the most famous are Splinterlands, Rising Star, dCrops and many other games are also included.

Today I thought that I should understand the dCrops game and properly start my career here as well. Along with Splinterlands I am also taking interest in dCrops which is a very interesting game.

As you can see in the picture there are almost 30 to 35 different games in the Hive ecosystem. Some are active and some are still in development. Some projects have very strong tokens and it is also worth investing in them.

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 110814.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wMqdvHGB6ckPVbwEgeuwjzFf2kQCvuVduk2GaGVPEE5UvFqaJ1YDLvJwK1nF1DFrcdP.png)

For dCrops you simply have to open its website and log in through your Hive account which is done through Hive Keychain. After that the game plan will be available and you can start your game.

Remember that by logging in daily you will keep getting a free spin in which there are exciting prizes. In this lucky wheel you can get rewards like Speed Grow, Party Plus, Salt, Pepper, Better Luck Next Time, Reward Chest Double Plus and many other rewards. The percentage is also given showing the chances of each reward.

The basic idea of this game is that you have to grow crops and harvest them to get rewards. These rewards are tradable which means you can sell them on (Hive Engine) and at the same time you can use these tokens to upgrade your farming.

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 110852.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/48QsefLrGzmtgaegoRBPdiyHHcB1jgKZCB647HqsGQAzgXsCBPbb7jm8m1BJLbCN2L.png)

The main goal here is to make maximum profit and build an efficient farming system. The better your farming system is the more your profit ratio will increase.

This is a very easy game. At the start you have to buy land or a plot. The bigger your land the more farming you can do and obviously the more farming you do, the more your earnings will increase.

After that you also have to buy seeds so that you can grow crops. Every crop has its own timing. The next step is planting, you plant the seeds on your land. Then comes the waiting time so that they can grow.

The next process is harvesting. When the time is complete you get the chance to harvest from which you keep getting token rewards.

Now the earnings you get can be used to buy more seeds or upgrade your land. This can increase your earnings. But if you want you can also withdraw.

This game is very strategic. Here you need patience and along with being an interesting game it also gives you a play2earn opportunity.

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 110920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tc7tt235rGMQdHATDMtEiZ1gZXdJierADkCSEv86DnTHhu5ouLxz8DhoZYq3FAm2Ru5.png)

I have properly started my career in this game and very soon I will buy land and a plot to grow my crops and create a harvesting system. My main goal is to have at least five lands where I can grow crops and keep harvesting them.

How did you like this game? Are you playing it? And how much information do you have about it? Share in the comment section..

What do you people think about this monster? Have you ever played with this monster? Tell about its any ability you know. Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

links.title: My Daily Life Post: \
links.body: >\nThird day here at the lot and finally we already finished hauling those coconuts transferred here near at our small rest house owned by my Grandma. Its been few days of hauling those coconuts we harvested last day and now all of it are properly placed near at the house. While waiting to all coconuts to be husked, I decided to explored our small lot here to see if there are valuable crops and fruit trees I can find and my expectations are true. I had found few fruits in the place just like this jackfruits, it is better to wrapped or covered it with empty sack that is why I wrapped it so the fruit will be safe from harmful insects like wasps and bees. As I counting it, the fruits reach 5 pieces and gladly all of it are grows where I can easily reach it to wrapped.\n</div class=\

>

![IMG20260420091741_00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVJpnojBQTiqVYPnvULknzKiR3h4sNECCm7mEHPnJeqzY/IMG20260420091741_00.jpg)
</center>
It takes a few minutes of wrapping it and as I finished, I proceed to look for any fruits grows. The next fruits I've seen and found is this small green papaya, finally as many years of waiting for this plant to produced fruits and finally it already have. This kind of fruit don't need to wrapped with sack and it only let it grows until it will ripe and good to pick and harvest. I really not intend to plant this and it only grows here and I don't cut this so it can produced lots of fruits in the future, and now it was already have. 

![IMG20260420091905_00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFvzujkXb63C2XotcWsokKaykPFMGxvK9DSemxakPDbg/IMG20260420091905_00.jpg)
</center>
Aside of that, I also doubled check the areas to see if there are coconuts left and not found during harvesting activities. Lucky, I got lots of it from the thick bushes and I placed it near at the house, good thing I brought sack and I can carried lots of it going back home. We carried those coconuts manually and we do not used cart because we don't have carabao and a cart to used. That is why it takes a few days before the hauling was completely finished. Today, I had few vacant time to wandered here at the lot and we kept waiting to finish husking. 

![IMG20260420092014_00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRinuxpdr43jzn5JtU1HgZLzPavctSF95wZbg9vkvsXDv/IMG20260420092014_00.jpg)
</center>
After a few days of drying the coconut meat using plain metal sheets, finally it already shows the good output. As I checked it, the coconut meat was already nearly dry because of the intense heat under the sun. This afternoon, we will classified those dry coconut meat and separated it to other sack and places inside of the house so it can avoided wet and moist because of the cold morning weather. It takes almost an hour of filling those coconut meat at the top of the metal sheets and we carefully piled it so it can dry very fast. 

![IMG20260420092055_00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVZwJjojhruo6VmNy6aVodAfm5tMx64TtzfV2EFy7ssum/IMG20260420092055_00.jpg)
</center>
This young coconut plants needs to replant, and we still do not have enough time to do it because of a busy situation. By next day, we will tried to do this next activity so our place will be more productive. This group of young coconut plants here are placed many months already and we still do not have time to plant it. 

![IMG20260420092204_00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXf1aFCCwidduX87woyq1R1Jw6iPoyM1gdG2EGvCVrBbK/IMG20260420092204_00.jpg)
</center>
Everytime I visited here, gathering lots of firewoods is also very important. While exploring the place, I also looked for any firewoods and cut into shorter length so it can be easily put in the sack and carry lots of it back home. Those long and dry leaves will produced into a broom sticks to be sell this coming sunday at the market. Gladly I learned how to make broom sticks from my Grandma and it will be useful today for business purposes.

![IMG20260420092449_00.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdk1kt3qp5D382vMMmicCuEmxSGqNwtwS9WJBD9CCQVVD/IMG20260420092449_00.jpg)
</center>
We are planning to produced charcoal out of coconut shells but there is someone who went to our place and asked us if we sell those shells. We don't have big charcoal oven to use that is why we are going to sell it by next day. As for that, we put all coconut shells in one place so it will easily to hauled once when the buyer will came. 

#### *Being Productive is very important for us here, we earned few money and help us to buy our basic family needs*.

Until next post, have a nice day to all of us.

links.title: Strolling through architecture and art as a way of life. (EN-ES)
links.body:
--- Life changes, and when it’s for the better and involves doing things we enjoy, it’s even better. I’m now enjoying those changes, and not only that, but I’m learning from them. >La vida cambia y cuando es para mejor y haciendo cosas que nos gustan, es aún mucho mejor. De esos cambios ahora disfruto y no sólo eso, sino que aprendo. --- ![20260420_012501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wX5r4aevQzesVopbteAWygcbrDHhMraScGYZHVRo4LLUSeQMAZugH1rPGCSAntCtKxZ.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Aprendo de la ciudad, de sus calles, de sus construcciones y su historia, la mayoría de las veces muy antigua. Que había en esos lugares en épocas antiguas, si una muralla, ruinas romanas, si se ha hecho algún descubrimiento por la obra actual del metro, donde muchas veces excavando encuentran rocas que fueron ruinas. Todo ello me resulta muy interesante. Siempre he ha gustado la historia. Normalmente cuando salgo de paseo, ya como un estilo de vida, recorro esas calles antiguas y miro las edificaciones, donde sobre todo me encanta ver los ventanales, puertas de madera labrada, los hermosos balcones y las terrazas acristaladas. Los estilos arquitectónicos de cada lugar y barrio van variando y todos cuentan una historia.

I learn from the city, from its streets, its buildings and its history, which is often very ancient. I wonder what used to be in those places in times gone by, perhaps a city wall, Roman ruins, and whether any discoveries have been made during the current underground works, where excavations often uncover rocks that were once ruins. I find all of this fascinating. I’ve always loved history. Usually, when I go for a walk, it’s become a way of life, I wander through those old streets and look at the buildings, where I particularly love seeing the large windows, carved wooden doors, beautiful balconies and glass-enclosed terraces. The architectural styles of each place and neighbourhood vary, and they all tell a story. ---
![20250807_180341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Y7veYSdSvqs4yuQLk73DcXrHW2DUgEm9paeeiTu2HWqStYf5rMpYVBjXoho2C4gFP9.jpg)
|![20250807_181146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGescHB6Ji2uxuC8RoDADBV1zeJW5h7EM4Va11gAtZHrkTKG5Xgan77K2BkGkyq1ZR7.jpg)|![20250807_181215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242rroLnNK1Ee8iBziAKLqbrAgTtQaAd6neXnq5ZiauoiDRUmkYQptCb878GYZqWjf6pi.jpg)| |-|-| |![20250807_181312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eCei6dWsVZN76DNjCer7VFmUnrigiMzf4wxDsh3xoKiGn1K2fuaDFEhcP3fJ9T7bjT.jpg)|![20250807_181316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odZpaHHQgkrNnVSziaD81phre7M1VpudZVg5dtaf9nBRYMsyDpyy7HEFUKmv816ueP.jpg)| ![20250807_182019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2423ymj57s8gYutfr8GJ6WYJ1MATgM9KF1eAC2q4e6KucwMrUQwfa56Pg4o6w5YwFuY2b.jpg) ![20251002_184855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xySzUGX38DidrNUdWBCa13JRXUg4KpzW7c4n1STRpNG6SKyV466mKkFpuQsBXcDuAWU.jpg) ![20251002_185159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKn3h7Nr76MNdNALhkYxaX5FsAFMZgAEvg4khPQFdXPjYP3dNLiT7AATgx1HhSgeHrp.jpg) ![20250807_182110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVMWZQFHhMXR4bPZv82pqpSkP8FmpDYMRpoN6ne3a35ajnFi97K7ByQex7XP3y9vcYk.jpg) ![20251002_185546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsDwVbxfgUFNwzHXyz4o1UcAyweDgts6LCoGFb4fa28722qdYn98oLKms3NotNUp73q.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Mucha gente, o más bien la gente que ha nacido aquí toma todo esto como algo natural, pero para mí siempre es sorprendente, siempre veo algo nuevo, me gusta mirar los detalles. Por ejemplo, el otro día caminaba por una calle por la que suelo ir, pero no había mirando en una determinada dirección y allí había un hermoso mural. En otras ocasiones veo como se renueva permanentemente la ciudad apareciendo obras de arte en forma de murales, aquí y allá. La arquitectura en si misma es una obra de arte. Y para ir a los museos camino por muchas de ellas, como abstraída de la gente, que es mucha, porque hay turistas todo el año y mucha, pero mucha gente. Pero camino mirando mi alrededor, el entorno, una torre que no vi antes, una farola, lo que sea. Se ha convertido para mí en una forma de disfrutar las caminatas, sea que solamente sea eso o que vaya a ver una muestra de arte. A veces pienso en la cantidad de museos que me falta visitar, a los que no he ido nunca antes y es increíble. La calle Carretería se caracteriza por esa arquitectura y luego cuando llego a la Alameda todo se vuelve mágico. Sta última calle tiene conexión con la famosa calle Larios y desde allí, estando en el centro histórico muchos museos y galerías están relativamente cerca. Aunque debo decir que los museos se distribuyen por toda la ciudad.

Many people, or rather, those who were born here, take all this for granted, but for me it’s always a surprise; I always spot something new, and I love looking at the details. For example, the other day I was walking down a street I often take, but I hadn’t been looking in a particular direction, and there was a beautiful mural there. On other occasions, I see how the city is constantly being revitalised, with works of art in the form of murals appearing here and there. The architecture itself is a work of art. And to get to the museums, I walk through many of them, as if detached from the crowds, which are huge, because there are tourists all year round and so many, so many people. But I walk looking around me, at my surroundings: a tower I hadn’t seen before, a lamppost, whatever. It has become a way for me to enjoy my walks, whether that’s all I’m doing or whether I’m going to see an art exhibition. Sometimes I think about the number of museums I still have to visit, the ones I’ve never been to before, and it’s incredible. Carretería Street is characterised by that architecture, and then when I reach the Alameda, everything becomes magical. The latter street connects to the famous Larios Street, and from there, being in the historic centre, many museums and galleries are relatively close by. Although I must say that the museums are spread throughout the city. ---
![20250710_184408-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ynayHVFnqepmFQzmT9Kzevt5HR1iaGV1twCQXkMDW1VsjwiXkfY2a1jhgQpW55NxBvG.jpg)

---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

A veces, como estas dos muestras que les traigo hoy, son algo particulares, porque no hay cuadros pintados al óleo, sino más bien historias, algunas intensas y también trayectorias de vida como artista. En la galería El Ateneo, me encontré en una ocasión, con una exposición fotográfica peculiar llamada “Buscadoras, territorios en guerra” de la fotógrafa Panamá Díaz. Aquí pude encontrar muchísimos retratos de mujeres, mujeres como yo y tantas otras pero que han pasado y pasan por una situación especial. Se trata de mujeres colombianas que buscan a sus seres queridos desaparecidos, que han sido víctimas en distintos conflictos armados que están presentes en ese país ya hace mucho tiempo.

Sometimes, like these two exhibitions I’m bringing you today, they’re a bit unusual, because there are no oil paintings, but rather stories, some intense, and also the life journeys of artists. At the El Ateneo gallery, I once came across a unique photography exhibition called “Buscadoras, territorios en guerra” by the photographer Panamá Díaz. Here I found many portraits of women, women like me and so many others, who have been and are going through a difficult situation. These are Colombian women searching for their missing loved ones, who have been victims of the various armed conflicts that have plagued the country for so long. --- SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

La artista presenta a estas mujeres como una forma de resistencia y teniendo como algo preponderante la memoria y la defensa de la vida. Por eso creo que más allá del arte, aquí se tocan las emociones, una experiencia diferente de empatía y comprensión por lo que pasan día a día esas mujeres, desesperadas por no saber que ha sido de sus familiares. Por lo tanto, es algo que al mirar sus rostros llama a la reflexión. Ninguna guerra ni conflicto es bueno, no importa donde sea, siempre los perjudicados son los civiles, la gente como vos y como yo. No vale la pena. Lo que si vale la pena es la vida y no importa la distinción de país, religión, cultura… todos somos humanos, pero parece que muchos no lo entienden así. Estas mujeres exponen sus rostros en una historia de amor y constancia en la búsqueda. En el cartel que estaba en la pared figuraba el nombre de cada una de ellas. Esta ha sido una muestra muy emotiva.

The artist presents these women as a form of resistance, with memory and the defence of life at the forefront. That is why I believe that, beyond the art itself, this work touches our emotions, offering a unique experience of empathy and understanding for what these women go through day in, day out, driven to despair by not knowing what has become of their loved ones. Therefore, looking at their faces invites reflection. No war or conflict is good; no matter where it is, it is always civilians who suffer, people like you and me. It is not worth it. What is worth it is life, and it does not matter what country, religion or culture we come from… we are all human, but it seems that many do not see it that way. These women reveal their faces in a story of love and perseverance in their search. The poster on the wall bore the name of each one of them. This has been a very moving exhibition. --- ![20251214_164908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2458QtxL4YeLmVzf1mXQDJVXhuDiGdrDHK58AfpRdPfnrgBurE7SJHLh3g3udsdPBDFut.jpg) ![20260301_173029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCBmvDRuwQeXfBcAJhrf5dMaDDSBVPXWFsn8oPxpJn4wWA5PKn7xYQPZMYMwnivBPV1.jpg) ![20251214_165413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hWiHM49DYF49GJmjvpsPTiBVQuitBxaBU69h7D9AjxDTfrBZZMK3FheCTDM3hKjA9X.jpg)
![20260301_174356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tcE6P3M2rEYJF3FMmomfzXyBZ7Lhs5XX8yJaYtTpjBSkZZWgoPPkyWQ6byU41jutiBz.jpg)
![20260301_174430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tSmEBkBqMqYndDu2TqVFGFT5J4vTrAL6pqobs1Lbe5Brj9jRV8vxY4eVACQQzKpJ3Ff.jpg) |![20260301_174412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u69hbtWSLwrraeaoJLE4mj3e9bHGY5jUCFfCW5UD6NMhSkn9xWtbk2mZRkFwmbMRw7o.jpg)|![20260301_174419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQtaj8XPwjN51Cr7pBakKamrnbsE1BDQgyU4TT7YuHbqYYpowABJ5Lqex3NeSsKqEz6.jpg)| |-|-| ![20260301_174510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2mG5q4fEEoC73518egkc9a14B9q2DxsyogaDKzhbC5ogKtmomnfviZyutVZnL8VpXF.jpg) ![20260301_174714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgPfv7oELKLN27z4cToqxZBzX9Bn3YvJJRmwz8QXuCxDSpyizv3SAmEGHWFXRp8qHtP.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Saliendo de allí cruzando la plaza constitución y a unas pocas calles se encuentra el museo Picasso. En este último tiempo he ido varias veces, porque es muy grande y había varias muestras de arte, la mayoría de ellas muy grandes y con mucho por ver. Pero hubo una en particular donde no se mostraba arte sino un reconocimiento u homenaje a Elena Asins, creadora singular del arte español contemporáneo. Al entrar en la sala, una gran sala, por cierto, pude ver unas letras enormes que de lejos parecían asientos y cada una de esas letras formaba su nombre. La iluminación era sutil y agradable. Elena obtuvo la medalla de oro al mérito en las Bellas Artes y el premio nacional de artes plásticas. Ella construye un lenguaje hecho con conocimiento, precisión y renuncia. Desarrollo, gracias a su intensa curiosidad, investigaciones que abarcaban las matemáticas, dibujo, poesía, programación e imagen.

Leaving there and crossing Plaza de la Constitución, just a few streets away, you’ll find the Picasso Museum. I’ve been there several times recently, as it’s very large and there were various art exhibitions, most of them extensive and with plenty to see. But there was one in particular that wasn’t an art exhibition but rather a tribute to Elena Asins, a unique figure in contemporary Spanish art. Upon entering the room, a large room, by the way, I could see some enormous letters that from a distance looked like seats, and each of those letters spelled out her name. The lighting was subtle and pleasant. Elena was awarded the Gold Medal for Merit in Fine Arts and the National Prize for Visual Arts. She constructs a language built on knowledge, precision and self-sacrifice. Thanks to her intense curiosity, she undertook research spanning mathematics, drawing, poetry, programming and imagery. --- ![20260301_174607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVRXwXUQVWuchY5enRyWAH1Cza7YWUrVTeS62BHcQca3obFpMpaD8xSbGdbVdrdjs4C.jpg) ![20260301_174626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsdReBDzmsBFbncnLGoahSkd3B3zp6aQcP7B3Z91JWncGFeBWJGr1RKPYQKcXYAcUdB.jpg) ![20260301_174647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23viEdVsayjJEU5wmF8Uoqx6mu9DL86m5KxzzVQ6ptxuV9kt6V99mMasRnqxBo8b84V2a.jpg) ![20260301_174635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmYYwta31P3juNSqLJThXBTPXpmStbqeN9rLGB79qbiYVmW3QYTxVQ4aBN2Mij7Hjmc.jpg) ![20260301_174710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wr1VshQwL7QV1jgPSzMuBNTWMkc139qCihQSNHTPEdeaoQreAnSZHXngAHCGyAAv35G.jpg) ![20260301_174651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uR5YyuaUXWQsZc4nzgRoH6HbijzATVpyEefK6sFMmngtQzodcMfq2uPGpAuLpNhhUnR.jpg) ---
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Este homenaje se produce con motivo del décimo aniversario de su fallecimiento, presentando la última obra de la artista: Antígona, donde se convierte a las palabras en estructuras, una escultura formada a partir de caracteres griegos y donde la forma y el significado se funden en uno solo. En una sala más adelante había dos grandes pantallas donde se exponía la vida de la artista y en el fondo se puede ver una línea histórica con lujo de detalles. Fue interesante aprender sobre esta artista. Y este homenaje y exposición se realizó gracias al apoyo del Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía. Es este museo que custodia toda la obra artística de Elena Asins. En otra época me hubiera sido imposible ni siquiera pensar en todo lo que podía aprender, ver y admirar en este momento de mi vida y que esto iba a ser habitual en mi día a día. Y la verdad estoy muy agradecida por ello. Muchas gracias por acompañarme el día de hoy, les envío un gran saludo. Hasta pronto. Amonet.

This tribute marks the tenth anniversary of her death and showcases the artist’s final work: *Antigone*, in which she transforms words into structures, a sculpture formed from Greek characters where form and meaning merge into one. In a room further on, there were two large screens displaying the artist’s life, and in the background, a detailed historical timeline could be seen. It was fascinating to learn about this artist. This tribute and exhibition were made possible thanks to the support of the Reina Sofía National Art Museum. It is this museum that houses the entire body of Elena Asins’s work. In another time, it would have been impossible for me to even imagine all that I could learn, see and admire at this stage of my life, and that this would become a regular part of my daily routine. And I am truly very grateful for it. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

links.title: PMS stands for Pizza, Mood swings & Sweets (:
links.body: Hey ladies, how do you deal with our \

friend PMS who always shows up right on time, the one that somehow only has a good reputation and never a bad one? 😁

Before, I didn't know how to recognize what was going on with me, so I thought I was just the classic, typically kind of nervous person and that it was just my usual little quirks. (: Now that I know, I try to get ahead of it as much as I can.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYi5MMUaGdXuVTxujsHcsq9J4PiMRWbyU39DBm4Tx6Qct/1776674518137.jpg)

Sweets are there, coffee is there, time for myself with a favorite show, while I do something about my look for example (which I normally never do, I lean more toward a wild natural type than a regular woman who has her own daily care routine, need to change that <3)... So first, believe it or not, I grabbed a little mirror and tweezers and went to rescue my long overgrown, bushy eyebrows. Luckily they're kind of blondish like my hair, so there's a bit of an advantage since it's not too noticeable when I neglect them, which happens pretty often. xD

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqCs39xH24EKjbetrEQHrxnmQimm6XDQMq3CXaM2xzGf/1776674445448.jpg)

I think besides me being a bit silly, that slight distance prescription is messing with me too. Since I don't have the habit of looking at myself up close in the mirror, but rather from a normal distance where I can see my whole self when I'm heading out, there's no way you can notice eyebrows that have gone wild, every hair going its own way like a centipede, grrr. xD

I do always find some good excuse for myself, that's so true! (:  
  
I remembered some green clay I bought who knows when, which also expired like three months ago, but come on, can clay powder even go bad, pleeease. So like every Serb whose favorite things are the ones past their expiration date, I hugged that packaging and decided to make myself a little face mask, my PMS breakouts and enlarged pores clearly needed it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpak4hbpcod3Jw2KPuxYxPGe4aQFcAgdzL4x1tZtzVYc/1776674600451.jpg)

I mixed two teaspoons of clay, two teaspoons of water and one teaspoon of honey (I only noticed later that it said not to mix it in metal containers or use a metal spoon). According to the instructions, where this mask is labeled as an _Egyptian mask_, one teaspoon of sour cream was supposed to go in too, but I didn't have it. I mixed it until the powder dissolved nicely and the lumps disappeared, then applied a generous layer on my face. And while I zoned out watching a show, it dried up, started tightening, so I quickly washed it all off with lukewarm water. My skin was, no joke, twice as good as before. You could immediately see it was smoother, without those huge ugly wide pores, it got this nicer glow, I mean I was unrecognizable to myself. I even wrote it down on a piece of paper that I have to do this more often, it says it's okay twice a week.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjNWao5A9ktQuGUMMPrestFLDEwLcZdfeEk9BizAHib7/1776674401626.jpg)

Then I put on some nice Propanthen gel cream and went straight for sweets and a hot coffee, more precisely _a cortado espresso macchiato_, I'm in love with the taste. We had never tried those capsules before, I always used classic espresso and then added milk, regular or vegan, but this is great. A real, full flavor, like in a café. And I don't. follow the instructions there either, it says to make it on 3 bars, I put it on 4, hihi. (:

While I was waiting for my fiancé to get back from work and painting my nails with classic red polish, a typical PMS idea popped into my head, greedy by nature, obviously! xD I called him to ask if he could grab me a slice or two of pizza and aaaand he also brought a krempita. The pizza was great, the little cake not so much, but that didn't stop me from eating it, of course!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDZvimtTTYowjZHkPJ7vcSy9Wqa3g3YQRMcDccnJnbSW/1776674488729.jpg)

How do you deal with PMS? Does it make you go for food or maybe cleaning the house? I know some women who, during PMS, suddenly start cleaning and with some crazy strength and energy make the whole house shine in no time. They could host a royal family without a problem. That's not me though, I might pull myself together a bit and fix up my look, but meanwhile the mess in my room just grows and stays there for a while, at least a day or two, until I get tired of stretching over a hairbrush, nail polish that keeps falling over, some random notebook and big jewelry box just so I can type on my laptop (current situation).

Thank you so much for reading. I'm looking forward to your replies. Sending kisses and hugs! <3

links.body:
![Guru Besar_02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX5FpV1jk4wekbpVaCa1YWMPXb8RxfUxe1yKJkZHAycMk/Guru%20Besar_02.jpg)
***
The Malikussaleh University Senate held an Open Senate Meeting to inaugurate seven professors from various faculties. The inauguration, which took place at the Tgk Abdul Wahab Dahlawy Auditorium at Malikussaleh University, Reuleut Campus, North Aceh, Indonesia, on Monday, April 20, 2026, marked a historic milestone, marking the largest number of professors since Malikussaleh University's founding.

This event served as a basis for social legitimacy for the seven new professors at Malikussaleh University.

According to the Chair of the Malikussaleh University Senate, Deassy Siska, MSc, the seven inaugurated professors come from four faculties: two from the Faculty of Agriculture, two from the Faculty of Economics and Business, two from the Faculty of Law, and one from the Faculty of Engineering.

The seven lecturers inaugurated were Prof. Mawardati as Professor of Agricultural Production Economics, Prof. Laila Nazirah as Professor of Plant Breeding, Prof. Asnawi as Professor of Agricultural Economics, Prof. Ghazali Syamni as Professor of Behavioral Finance, Prof. Faisal as Professor of Islamic Economic Law, Prof. Malahayati as Professor of International Law, and Prof. Arnawan Hasibuan as Professor of Sustainable Energy Engineering Technology.

\

said Deassy.

With the inauguration of these seven professors, Malikussaleh University, or Unimal, now has 25 professors.

The Rector of Malikussaleh University, Prof. Dr. Herman Fithra, Asean Eng, hopes that the inauguration of these professors will strengthen the academic atmosphere on campus, as evidenced by the emergence of impactful research.

\

The seven professors had their biographies visually displayed and were given the opportunity to deliver inaugural speeches. The professors delivered scientific speeches, summarizing the results of their research, which took a considerable amount of time and had to be continued after the Dhuhr prayer.

Also present at the event were the Regional Secretary of Aceh Province, Muhammad Nasir, M.Si., and the Rector of UIN Sultanah Nahrasiyah, Prof. Dr. Danial Murdani, M.A., professors and lecturers at Malikussaleh University, and invited guests from various institutions.[]
