body.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  Barnaby Rudge - with the original illustrations #17/376
body.body: >The locksmith, however, all unconscious of its near vicinity, still jogged on, half sleeping and half waking, when a loud cry at no great distance ahead, roused him with a start.

>For a moment or two he looked about him like a man who had been transported to some strange country in his sleep, but soon recognizing familiar objects, rubbed his eyes lazily and might have relapsed again, but that the cry was repeated—not once or twice or thrice, but many times, and each time, if possible, with increased vehemence. Thoroughly aroused, Gabriel, who was a bold man and not easily daunted, made straight to the spot, urging on his stout little horse as if for life or death.

>The matter indeed looked sufficiently serious, for, coming to the place whence the cries had proceeded, he descried the figure of a man extended in an apparently lifeless state upon the pathway, and hovering round him another person with a torch in his hand, which he waved in the air with a wild impatience, redoubling meanwhile those cries for help which had brought the locksmith to the spot.
>“What’s here to do?” said the old man, alighting. “How’s this— what—Barnaby?”
>The bearer of the torch shook his long loose hair back from his eyes, and thrusting his face eagerly into that of the locksmith, fixed upon him a look which told his history at once.
>“You know me, Barnaby?” said Varden.

>He nodded—not once or twice, but a score of times, and that with a fantastic exaggeration which would have kept his head in motion for an hour, but that the locksmith held up his finger, and fixing his eye sternly upon him caused him to desist; then pointed to the body with an inquiring look.
>“There’s blood upon him,” said Barnaby with a shudder. “It makes me sick.”
>“How came it there?” demanded Varden.
>“Steel, steel, steel!” he replied fiercely, imitating with his hand the thrust of a sword.
>“Is he robbed?” said the locksmith.
>Barnaby caught him by the arm, and nodded “Yes;” then pointed towards the city.
>“Oh!” said the old man, bending over the body and looking round as he spoke into Barnaby’s pale face, strangely lighted up by something which was <em class=\
>notintellect. “The robber made off that way, did he? Well well, never mind that just now. Hold your torch this way—a little further off—so. Now stand quiet while I try to see what harm is done.”

>With these words, he applied himself to a closer examination of the prostrate form, while Barnaby, holding the torch as he had been directed, looked on in silence, fascinated by interest or curiosity, but repelled nevertheless by some strong and secret horror which convulsed him in every nerve.

>As he stood at that moment, half shrinking back and half bending forward, both his face and figure were full in the strong glare of the link, and as distinctly revealed as though it had been broad day. He was about three-and-twenty years old, and though rather spare, of a fair height and strong make. His hair, of which he had a great profusion, was red, and hanging in disorder about his face and shoulders, gave to his restless looks an expression quite unearthly — enhanced by the paleness of his complexion, and the glassy lustre of his large protruding eyes. Startling as his aspect was, the features were good, and there was something even plaintive in his wan and haggard aspect. But the absence of the soul is far more terrible in a living man than in a dead one; and in this unfortunate being its noblest powers were wanting.

>His dress was of green, clumsily trimmed here and there — apparently by his own hands—with gaudy lace; brightest where the cloth was most worn and soiled, and poorest where it was at the best. A pair of tawdry ruffles dangled at his wrists, while his throat was nearly bare. He had ornamented his hat with a cluster of peacock’s feathers, but they were limp and broken, and now trailed negligently down his back. Girded to his side was the steel hilt of an old sword without blade or scabbard; and some parti-coloured ends of ribands and poor glass toys completed the ornamental portion of his attire. The fluttered and confused disposition of all the motley scraps that formed his dress, bespoke, in a scarcely less degree than his eager and unsettled manner, the disorder of his mind, and by a grotesque contrast set off and heightened the more impressive wildness of his face.
>“Barnaby,” said the locksmith, after a hasty but careful inspection, “this man is not dead, but he has a wound in his side, and is in a fainting-fit.”
>“I know him, I know him!” cried Barnaby, clapping his hands.

>“Hush!” said Barnaby, laying his fingers on his lips. “He went out to-day a wooing. I wouldn’t for a light guinea*that he should never go a wooing again, for if he did some eyes would grow dim that are now as bright as—see, when I talk of eyes, the stars come out. Whose eyes are they? If they are angels’ eyes, why do they look down here and see good men hurt, and only wink and sparkle all the night?”

>“Now Heaven help this silly fellow,” murmured the perplexed locksmith, “can he know this gentleman? His mother’s house is not far off; I had better see if she can tell me who he is. Barnaby my man, help me to put him in the chaise, and we’ll ride home together.”
>“I can’t touch him!” cried the idiot falling back, and shuddering as with a strong spasm; “he’s bloody.”

>“It’s in his nature I know,” muttered the locksmith, “it’s cruel to ask him, but I must have help. Barnaby—good Barnaby—dear Barnaby—if you know this gentleman, for the sake of his life and everybody’s life that loves him, help me to raise him and lay him down.”
>“Cover him then, wrap him close—don’t let me see it—smell it— hear the word. Don’t speak the word—don’t!”
>“No, no I’ll not. There, you see he’s covered now. Gently. Well done, well done!”

>They placed him in the carriage with great ease, for Barnaby was strong and active, but all the time they were so occupied he shivered from head to foot, and evidently experienced such an ecstacy of terror that the locksmith could scarcely endure to witness his suffering.

>This accomplished, and the wounded man being covered with Varden’s own great-coat which he took off for the purpose, they proceeded onwards at a brisk pace: Barnaby gaily counting the stars upon his fingers, and Gabriel inwardly congratulating himself upon having an adventure now, which would silence Mrs. Varden on the subject of the Maypole for that night, or there was no faith in woman.

title.title: Hive: Still Here, Still Stacking.
title.body:
I kinda love this topic as it is one a lot, or let's say it is something all hive user will face and have to make a choice on. And the decision made by us( hive users) says a lot about how we see this platform. At least that is how it is to me.



![1000957598.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23vsN1vaCG9nhmrUTp31Hzm18AmpqHUcvLumkRCSqoEiL5PG4dMbLp3atTHyknxF3Pod1.png)






Even though I know I've not been that faithful like that, I will definitely prefer powering up. And like I said earlier, I know I've not been that faithful just like some others too, and I understand better, considering how life is treating a lot of us, we most times just withdraw to sort things out. Bills piling up, illness to manage, and a whole lot more. So, I ain't judging anyone who's decide to cash out at all, I've been there before too, and I understand how oen can quickly withdraw it to sort out some related life needs.



Now, talking about my mindset, to me hive is something I really want to build, and the mindset is a long-term one, can't say for how long, but it's definitely not short-term in any way, cause what I'm looking forward to on hive is not small at all. So, powering up will go a long way in helping me achieve that, it's just like planting a seed that will with time began to sprout up Little by little and grow. Because I really want my influence to increase, I want my presence here to matter, and my vote to carry weight.



Recently, I've come across a lot of people who are powering down, I don't know why, but same way I've also been seeing a lot of people as well powering up and staying more rooted. So, we still have people who believe in the future of hive and are aiming at growing. And that is exactly the category I fall in too.



![1000957576.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23zS3T2K5SvcJgpABUjdoBGhZ3ehbmoMpNt7NQZsu9sKmzLezdA5RcboEr9DgWwK5VUaC.png)

Some may argue that it might not be that easy, maybe considering what's happening at the moment and the price of hive that has given down and all of that, even still, I trust that it will be worth it, obviously, it might not be immediately, but it definitely will be worth it tomorrow.


And in all honesty, even though I don't have much there, I'm still at times tempted to power down and just use it to sort some things, but I've always held myselfback, I keep reminding myself of how I started and why I started. 


So, that's it for me....grow(plant) now, and enjoy later.

title.title: We Have Fire!!!
title.body:
When we first moved into this tiny house, I insisted on a fire. There's always been two things I believe a home should have - a bath, and a wood burner - it's just so cosy, especially in southern Victorian winter in Australia.

Some of you may recall where we started, opening up the wall into the old chimney where once there was a wall heater, likely gas. Jamie then put cement board at the back and plaster - dry wall - to create a neat alcove for it to sit and not eat into the small room space.

![2146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23x14eV1XUXYmm5ofcPq99W9oJo5W6udkx1mtHKMwd7obwsyYidKtoCurdu8Mcd7BzDMu.jpg)

Although we could do most of it ourselves, and Jamie could have even installed it, regulations mean your insurance is voided unless you get a certified installer to do it, costing us $990 which we felt was an insane amount of money. Still, we had done the rest of it ourselves, including the bluestone hearth which was 3 pavers instead of one large slab, saving us around $800 on that alone.

![2131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EpGRDAksV9uQxLBh292VN8YmdR8g69efzHnWJqnMYKwzvb8G4XinvnYjYM4xkgRRHQD.jpg)

Even the Charnwood oven, made on the Isle of Wight in the UK, was secondhand and cost us a third of the price. It has a ton of eco specs and is super efficient - we have already noticed how well it heats the house and it uses much less wood than our old burner to do so.

![2144.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EpNoogdUWT8jNw36eTmr9dqdNp3Wo3NRJvQtwnWescHExfJXEeUeujb76SEHdukB7fq.jpg)


There's just something about a fire, don't you think? 

We have raided skips and under the house for old bits of hardwood - and are using up last winters store of wood, what little we have. Hopefully we won't need to buy any as that's when the real costs start adding up. Whilst we do get cold southerly off the Antarctic, we don't get snow, so this little stove will be awesome.

title.title: Stable Job, Unstable Mind
title.body:
I’m a 30-year-old salaried woman living in the capital of a tropical country, and I want to quit. Yes, you read that right. The title says _“stable job,”_ but I still want to walk away. I actually planned to quit about 2 years ago, because, as I said in my previous post, I’m ready to get married. I would leave my office job and start a new chapter. The idea of quitting and the idea of marriage have been growing side by side for years.

Let me stress it out, I wanted to quit even when everything was alright. Nevertheless, today feels different. The colleagues who work with me in my newbie era have gone to the new place, my team leader has changed, and the spark I once felt has gone.

Ironically, the earlier years were much harder: overtime almost every day, stand-by mode weekends, and the idea that I must be there whenever my boss asks, even on Saturday night.

![IMG_1983.PNG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaLcTv7sPoaUrZb9y4M4ioRz5wf4GnfSM9dF4qsN89cty/IMG_1983.PNG)

We had an overtime literally from 2021 to 2022, what a first year to celebrate. Those were restless years, but they made me grow personally and professionally.

But today it was a lot easier than ever. No more overtime, no more restless weekends, no more random ideation whenever needed, and work-life balance. Or no? more like a pinch of work and life balance. The higher-ups do not really involve my team or me in most cases, so I now work to execute their plan without building ideas from the ground up. I hate to admit it, but maybe I am somewhat of a workaholic. It hurts my brain when I do not use it hard enough every day. It hurts my body when I do not work hard enough throughout the week. Somehow, doing less feels heavier than doing more.

That’s why I thought marriage could be the answer. New chapter, new responsibilities, and surely new problems to solve. But I cannot just marry a random guy, and even if I choose someone, there’s no guarantee he will choose me back. So maybe, while I’m waiting for that part of life to unfold, I shouldn’t just wait.

Maybe I should move.

To look for a new place with new challenges, new people, and a new story. Because staying feels safe, but leaving feels alive. I was working for almost 5 years here, by the way, if you were me, would you stay here or move to the other place?

今天来讲讲松江特有的东西，可不是吃的哦，也不是景区，而是电车，这个在上海的其他区是没有的，只有松江区有，电车有两条线路，在松江挺方便的，基本能覆盖松江所有热闹的地方。

有时候开车不方便，又不想骑电瓶车，就可以坐这个，遮风挡雨，我娃小学时候，只要下雨我就带他坐电车，不过要起早一些，因为它是定点的，有点类似于公交地铁，时间都是固定的，晚了赶不上就要等20分钟。

娃长大了我们到附近基本都是骑电瓶车，这个车坐的少了，但是家门口的车，正好我家小区门口是个经停站，经常出门就能看见。这两条线路从2019年至今已经七年了，承载了太多回忆。

电车在路上行驶除了红绿灯其他都不需要停，没有阻碍，不会堵车，不像公交还会堵一下什么的，这个不会，一点不耽误时间。能到的地方不是景点就是热闹的地方，比如大学城、火车站、松江老城区、莱顿小城等等，都是超有人气的地方。

有人专门跑松江就为了坐一下这个电车，体验一下，打卡拍照，特别有意思。我还有个台湾朋友，一直喊它毛毛虫，真的是特别好玩。我问她为什么要这么喊，她说就是很像啊，之前一直说，走我们去坐毛毛虫。哈哈。

title.title: People blaming all flight prices on \
title.body:
I am not a political person.  The way that I look at global politics is that I am not going to allow it to affect my personal feelings and how I treat others.  I also don't buy into every little thing that I hear on the news and I get angry when other people try to make some sort of political something or other be the sole reason why something is increasing in price or being made more difficult because of some country, and the finger is normally pointed at the USA. 

I am American, and when I say this it is without a single ounce of patriotism.  The increase in flight prices to the USA, Canada, and Mexico is NOT because of some war something or other.   There might be some airlines that use this as an excuse but if you are the type of person that believes a corporations PR team, then you are a special kind of stupid.  

<center> https://images.aircharterservice.com/content/body-image-fastest-airliner-in-world.jpg
[src](https://images.aircharterservice.com/content/body-image-fastest-airliner-in-world.jpg)</center>

Someone that I know that is just a nuisance to be around but because the expat community in Jalisco is very small we all just find a way to get along but this woman was talking about how it is costing her \

.    \n\nShe was lying, this was clear.   So without being a jerk i pressed her for more information.   I asked how much the flight was and she said it was around $400... then I used a little tactic to change the topic a bit and then circled back to \
and she responded something along the lines of \

I don't know how fast you are at math, but 400 is not double just over 300.   She didn't want to complain about the price, she wanted to make the situation political as she tends to do.  She is a walking, talking, issue of the New York Times or CNN.  

But then someone else at the table said something that I was thinking but he worded it better than I could have 

he said \

She kind of blue-screened at that point and backpedaled and tried to make excuses but still refused to accept that supply and demand might be a much bigger impact that oil tankers arriving from the other side of the world.  

I just want everyone to have a look at how much flight prices go up around major holidays such as Christmas.  Would you blame that near doubling of the ticket price on some sort of war?  No, of course you wouldn't, because that would be ridiculous, right?

The fact of the matter is that while the prices of flights to/from Mexico and USA are increasing during June and July it is actually a very fair and surprisingly \

increase.  I dare say that they could probably get away with charging substantially more than they are.  For me, a flight that was once $200 is around $250 or so and to me it isn't the cost that is so much of the concern as it is that you can be basically guaranteed that these flights are going to be completely full.    

One of the great accidental joys that I get out of flying is when I get into my row on a 4 hour flight or so, and then realize that a seat next to me isn't going to be occupied at all.  On my last 2 trans-Pacific flights, I was the only person in my exit row.   This is just glorious and during the World Cup I can all but guarantee that every single seat is going to be sold on these flights.

I have decided that during the world cup I am just going to stay where I am.  I have specifically designed my visa so that I can pull this off without issue.   I'm not a huge soccer fan, but I will likely wander down to the pub for a game here and there because even though I don't personally get excited about it, I do revel in other people's joy or interest in something.   

I am no expert in global oil supply but neither are the people that like to turn just anything they can political.   If you are trying to travel from the first week of June to about the end of July, you can expect the prices for flights to be increased.  This is simple economics.

In every game there are strategies and following the right strategies makes you win . Same is applicable in hive. Starting from learning, earning, interacting with new friends, learning new things.
‎
‎I think I joined the platform a year ago and after some months of onboarding me, I started noticing the power up prompt , I never really understood how to go about it, but I kept reading and following up. It was nice. And the funny part is that , one question that hivers face at some point amd find it difficult to answer is, if they should power up their hive oe cash out. I think few months ago, a friend that i introduced to hive asked me,  what power up is all about, i tried my best to explain, he understood to some extent. But the question was still it he should power up or hold on or cash out.  I told him, it's a choice, but aside that, powering up help the system and also help him grow his account, just like  help his voting power and earn more curation rewards.
‎
‎But I was actually trying to build up some assets before I started powering up. So I kept building, I did it for close to a year.

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUu7UWCras9WXTZzEwrFP8tMb3x6DviWTcZ6ztY4M2KGs/nickype_raindrop_6544618.jpg)
[Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/raindrop-glass-rain-window-wet-6544618/)
It's official. Winter has descended upon us in Cape Town! 
This time of year and I have a it of a love hate relationship. Well, it's certainly better than being all hot and sweaty, but it does get me thinking (as the rain pelts so hard against ur upstairs bedroom window that I think it might start raining in my bed!) - yet it does get me thinking that it's knitting time again!

So on Saturday morning, I shuffled through the puddles in my pajamas to go and buy some wool for my project! What crazy thing us crafty ladies get up to when we have that itch to create!?

It's actually the first time I've been on foot outside our gate in a long time. We live on a busy road, but in a quiet corner of the complex, quite far away from it. Weed is now legal in Cape Town, and there happens to be a shop right next to us! It's housed in what was some sort of abandoned block of flats that was sheltering some undesirable people doing very shady business, so I fully support this enterprise! The cannabis store shares the building wth a Pakistani grocery/snack shop, which I have yet to venture into, but smells DIVINE!

And of course, I was taking all of this in on my little pajama shuffle to the wool shop, which was my original mission. See? I haven't even smoked any weed, and I am already going off-plot 😂 - it does come full circle though, I promise!

So I have been plotting and planning to knit this scarf since the end of last winter, when I finished my own scarf. If you're new to this blog, I knit for anxiety but also to create love gifts for the special people in my life - to keep warm, those who keep me warm!

So, one of Aime's friends came to visit, and we have become such great friends over the last little while. The age gap seems massive, but in friendship, it is irrelevant. Anyway, I offered to knit him a scarf, and he wanted one just like mine!!  

This delighted me so much as I was dying to work with this beautiful rainbow charity wool (of which a portion of the profit of the sale of this wool actually goes to charity!), but I didn't know when I'd find someone whose eyes lit up when they saw it. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNnry99xZndog17Lsf2MEwYTwy2UmMDJm6jg8ikiLsmDy/img_20260418_124647.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcNRCEkjJcjaetX3GU6gvQAjxkbbKbYrXJXBfTG5gBxQu/img_20260418_124939.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHCuXdJFJDXHJoXj6ZPy1d2Mgvzkmz96K2rFKHBDV8bP/img_20260418_200753.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxbkf4S2T14udXPuV1xXCvVEwuCWfMtjMXNkC5nprrCe/img_20260418_203048.jpg)


That is how I choose my colours for my \

[you can see them all here](https://ecency.com/hive-127911/@clairemobey/knot-another-kitting-tutorial-chapter-197945cff6b8e). I have to see how people react to colour or know them well enough to be intuitive about the colour. Like the scarf I knitted for my Mother's Birthday. Each one is unique!

I definitely took another good look at the snack shop and the pot shop, and actually went inside! How novel it is that you can buy premium, ready-rolled joints and vapes of all strains and flavours! What a brave new world!

When I was a teenager, there was just always some shady guy who sold weed wrapped up in newspaper or in bank bags, all out of his school blazer!

What funny memories.

Anyway, as I toddled home, I thought to myself, \

It's been almost 25 years, but guess what I'm doing tomorrow while the kids are out of the house? Teeehee! See you on the other side!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmpw1EmhPkcPmGatqYNU4eKuCtFq1ySnqUBS3sfNz6mm/img_20260417_wa0009.jpg)

title.title: Топ-помилки українців за кордоном, які коштують грошей, часу і нервів
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUv36Wa3qZRLfcaGwMkwuqYDojXct6hWuMJxtZHuDBtks/image)

Ось де наші люди найчастіше обирають хибний шлях:

1. Працюють «у чорну». Перші місяці на новому місці, \

- це зрозуміло. Але далі ви лишаєтеся без захисту: ні лікарняних, ні легального статусу, ще й світить штраф чи депортація.

2. Не реєструють адресу. Без прописки чи реєстрації ви - «невидимки» для системи. А це проблеми з банками, медициною, документами і навіть штрафи.

3. Відкладають вивчення мови. Стратегія «потім вивчу» створює ризик застрягнути на низькооплачуваній роботі. Володіння мовою країни, де ви зупинилися, - плюс 30-100% доходу.

4. Наші люди, за \

традицією, не читають дрібний шрифт у контрактах. Оренда, робота, страховка - саме в деталях ховаються приховані платежі та кабальні умови. А підписав - плати!

5. Переплачують за оренду, не належно рахують витрати. Завжди перевіряйте альтернативи, торгуйтесь, шукайте співмешканців. 

Висновок: за кордоном виграють ті, хто грає за правилами і думає наперед.

[INFA UA](https://t.me/INFA_U_A)

title.title: Visibility -2.62
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23vhsdy7SVUgjvhjHR4sftfdP1KXq6SMVeR8XrhBhv6tFiPNKHWrhhbYRipp45Hxap8ig.png)


The climb back to zero — and especially back into visibility — is a bit more challenging than expected. At the same time, asking people to vote for an account that’s about as visible as a ninja during a blackout… doesn’t exactly help. But hey, it’s fine. I’ll keep doing my thing in the shadows, like a ghost on the blockchain. And honestly, it has its perks… like being able to write absolutely anything without the risk of being contradicted — since, well, nobody’s reading anyway 😄

I could even hide secret messages for the two or three brave souls who might stumble across this by accident… but that’s not really the goal here (although, tempting).

So, what else? It’s Monday — already — and after a little unpaid break, it’s time to head back to work to refill the bank account… and, more importantly, to calm down the creditors who are starting to look at me like I’m their unpaid Netflix subscription.

That said, the break was necessary. A few personal and family issues to sort out, some cases to push forward… and when I say “push forward,” I mean going full speed ahead with the help of the legal system. Because apparently, to access “basic” rights, you sometimes have to file official complaints against public administrations. Yes, those rights that are clearly written down… but always come with a polite “sorry, you don’t meet the criteria.” The famous boxes… always the boxes.

Sometimes, I get the feeling that people who do nothing get rewarded, while those who actually try to work are the ones being held back. But anyway… I won’t get into politics, or I’ll just end up getting annoyed — and that would be a shame, especially in front of such a… nonexistent audience.

Then again, given my current level of invisibility, I could really say anything I want. 🤷‍♂️

昨天去百貨公司裡的大戶屋吃晚餐，這間店我們沒來過，但大戶屋這個品牌餐廳我們是常吃的，基於對連鎖店的信任，就像愛喝咖啡的人看到星巴克就直接進去一樣，我們也是看見大戶屋就直接進去點餐啦，這就是品牌建立的優勢之一。

這間店很新，百貨公司本身也是新，所以看起來很舒服，用餐自然也是很愉快很舒適的享受囉，幸好我們還沒五點就跑進來用餐，不然以大戶屋平日就很有人氣的狀況，假日鐵定是沒訂位吃不到的啦。

餐點的水平是真的挺一致的，吃起來的口感都和其他分店一樣，剛好之前有在APP搶券所以可以送一個芒果布丁，雖然真的是很小一個，但貴在東西還不錯吃，不然就真的是太沒誠意了可不是?

用餐完後發現附近有好多餐廳都沒吃過，打算以後再來吃吃，這天在這家百貨公司買了很多家人的衣服和褲子，花了好多張的千元大鈔啊，真的好心疼，但既然都來試衣服了而且還不錯看，就先買吧，不然下次再遇到喜歡的衣服也不知何時了XD

總之，美好的周末也是很忙碌的啊~~

title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP7zs2sVoWjZeMD5XFawRRmkRXnrLV4NWRsJXbLosVqAk/Your%20paragraph%20text.png 


Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great.
In this post I will be talking about yet another great monster which I have been experimenting with recently. It goes by the name, **Saltwraith Bulkhead**.

# 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐰𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐮𝐥𝐤𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝

Saltwraith Bulkhead is a rare card which belongs to the Life element and plays as a Melee Attacker. This card can be used in medium to high mana cap battles because of it's mana cost. It costs 7 mana to be used in battles. This amazing card carries 4 abilities at it's max level, which I'm going to be talking about next.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcw9sVXSmkBxaMMy3heFPn8b5ZBae5QHMDKHd8vbvSPRg/Screenshot%202026-04-20%20at%2012-12-52%20Splinterlands%20-%20Collect%20Trade%20Battle!.png 

# 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬

At level 1, this card comes with 4 Melee Attack damage, 8 health, 6 Armor and 4 speed. Even at level 1 this card is an absolute beast. This card also comes with one ability from the initial level, **Weary**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdLeiD7yqaLEerUQQRPmzjLb5WBqt61n6uQBtfJAj6mHy/Screenshot%202026-04-20%20at%2012-16-17%20Splinterlands%20-%20Collect%20Trade%20Battle!.png 

* **Waery:** At the beginning of round 1, Weary units have a 10% chance to become Exhausted. This chance increases by 10% every round, up to a maximum of 80%. Exhausted units skip their turn and cannot Retaliate.

Now, with this ability, this card becomes even more impressive. When this card is upgraded to level 2, it's health increases from 8 to 9.

At level 3, it's stats remains the same. However, it gains a new ability called, **Oppress**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaF9QFkdxnKCq7BGLdgQWRm6syF3z1d9yLi9oKE2mCTb3/Screenshot%202026-04-20%20at%2012-19-15%20Splinterlands%20-%20Collect%20Trade%20Battle!.png 

* **Oppress:** Does double damage when attacking an enemy that has no attacks.

At level 4, it's melee attack damage increases from 4 to 5.

At level 5, it's stats remains the same. However, it gains a new ability called, **Armored Strike**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSo64sN9hAHjPdrkNfwhmNbQqzYjyBUcdMiXkdh9pcNL2/Screenshot%202026-04-20%20at%2012-21-32%20Splinterlands%20-%20Collect%20Trade%20Battle!.png 

* **Armored Strike:** This Unit gets an additional melee attack equal to its armor stat.

At level 6, it's health increases from 9 to 10.

At level 7, it's melee attack damage increases from 5 to 6.

At level 8 (max level), it's health increases from 10 to 11. Plus, it gains it's final ability called, **Heal**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbNEpz3prLrxqqMA5T3NLJKvXq8pbnDStHSCWw1r8cASd/Screenshot%202026-04-20%20at%2012-24-20%20Splinterlands%20-%20Collect%20Trade%20Battle!.png 

* **Heal:** Restores a portion of the Monster's health each round. Restores 1/3 of the max health, rounded down.


# ***Lore***

*Vorlox the Bulkhead earned his nickname because he eats like a whale and stands nearly as wide as a ship's bulkhead. He wields scavenged shields and armor in his tentacles, a living barricade where the gangplank narrows.*

*On the Saltwraith's conclave hauls, he plants himself between longboats and the world, takes the first hit with a laugh, and gives back two: one with a seized breastplate, another with a cutlass fit for a siege door. The plates he carries scrape and shift as he moves, a warning bell heard over the wind and spray of the sea.*

*When surveyors need time to haul crates and supplies, Vorlox buys it with steel and weight.*

*When he sets, the line holds.*

# 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻

This monster card is something that every player should have in their arsenal. Even at bronze league, this card is a great addition to the team and it really packs a punch. Even if we talk about this card from a trading point of view, it goes for a pretty hefty amount when you upgrade it. It goes for up to 50$ in the market, so keep leveling it up lads!

So next time you are battling in a medium to  high mana match, give Saltwraith Bulkhead a try. You might be surprised by how much this beast can contribute to your win streaks!

Well, I guess this is it for this post. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

title.title: 【万挠】可吉喵市集 KeciMeow Market @ Anggun City Rawang
title.body:
前几天在«小红书»上刷到一个视频，视频内容是最近有一个为期三天 (4月17日 - 4月19日) 的市集位于 Rawang (万挠) 的  Anggun City，这个市集的特别之处在于它竟然有宠物市集。

米特是个爱猫人士，我告诉了他之后，他也表示很感兴趣。我约定他在 4月19日(星期日) 这一天一起去了市集，这天也是市集的最后一天。

下午四点多，米特就驱车载我来到了 Anggun City 这里的【可吉喵市集】。这个市集分成两个部分，一部分是“室外食物市集”，另一部分是“半室内宠物市集”。

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48a4ns8vU55u7QhxPxZ2jQPcoVoVXBWWjYKChG3cE52ZGbyMSRi4LWjhxD3ZrReCHV.jpeg)

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48bWYiueBAuHqJeXfoBTQdvKjNxMHBUUXhnDDBcZPK5nX9ALVoisPwKJ4db3shq3d1.jpeg)

我们先来看看这个“半室内宠物市集”。为什么叫半室内？是不是因为有屋顶遮雨？

<center>——————✣——————</center>

**宠物市集**

* 🐍 宠物蛇
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48KcBpUheU6gy1kK5SdNxnKdKifNdkKCqV2VBLwarC45S4DsSgmqrVotMjJqASWoeX.jpeg)

* 🐈 宠物猫
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48QupT74GmhBURDUfx1pJomTMToDg4Vkree1nrQXXiZBY4CGbiUgoGjKmgnaYEKJqq.jpeg)

* 宠物蜥蜴
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48UmExWjyDkogVcRoWVYVkVgpkhKxKGZkwApCgHssvRe3FwESDBW1EZ1mw3GiEGGMD.jpeg)

* 免费领养的猫猫
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48VF6Sor2rz4t8eupm3Gz3UCtzKFCb3bnSsKRLrehceZxLopD5ASa1AYUwfcnEPWEK.jpeg)

我带着猎奇的心理来这逛了一圈，什么都没买，毕竟我养自己都养不活了怎么还敢养宠物？其实现场养宠物的人也好多，有些是带着自己宠物过来买宠物食物的。

我来这里的目的只有一个，就是吃！然后直奔“室外食物市集”……

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Xf6mzkV8xhdD63yP7CFQrMvXKh3skJRfrjyMDBaPsVkKE9o8SJ8LPQgf4pBg2GXw.jpeg)

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Z6yRwSGRUdEr5kP799AbWbTMBXppWJmqwnitg7wtM5v7YerfPxjngZk5JFe3Z4sx.jpeg)

一来到食物市集，就停不下的不停买买买，看看下面我们买了什么？

**食物市集**

* **泰国烧肉饭** (价格：RM18)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48iGBes9BEqopB7bBTrNtq1j5vGuydCtLprjtjeiG96ocxSXDhHexcGhhmvHUstdtc.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48SqSxApxhKM6s6cALMvk8qcpk6STMQM7CXPqQiUWpBCjzH3xSkvrdMXD1cePk3QtR.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EowKUyp6bTLGiEccLJivgfsaD6QAFti4qaPnoRcDd3tenMapr8mhB9T3Da8DiVRvKcu.jpeg)
摊主是泰国人，客人一来就萨瓦迪卡，很有泰国风味。我点了个烧肉饭，忘了拿酱料，吃的时候感觉好干，但不妨碍它的美味。

* **和牛串** (价格：RM30/两串)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48b2prJSncXcsV7EhrWvDEiSGYwo479KdLF48LTsqXdVrrwt8i2NSkHL8pMZ1YkuAx.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48bX6WokSM9ypEVqBbNHzy3pTLbJ2J2k4WQefnev7F1U8sSTtswGbD4fivr7pCRZyu.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48SN1p6P51ACsH9FzzjQfZb6gy7kdvayHTfxh7oh6gogM3AkFXWntK2zFLAX16PcaH.jpeg)
米特点的，不吃牛肉的我看着他津津有味的吃着那和牛串，还说肉很软很好吃。

* **沙威玛** (价格：RM9)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Ycw5gRUxZGRJCrwvGrWzDSJpq82jY9MAJsqQq1bokPpnV8kjRMpx4z7xpjPu9c5Z.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48UmpgYEcc4ZmJRtY85u1WKtshrPzrpeKARZvttJX9v43MXMwJefXBKk1wwwCPGtYV.jpeg)
沙威玛里面的烤肉配上外面的饼皮，真的很好吃。

* **抹茶拿铁** (价格：RM10)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48Z713FziRaxuxSNSHWKwrs313ton37oMXU89NydiAevutcCdpmHh8bvtkVMCMpvZw.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48KcVvexU9aXdvenmHtnFzrQSzHoEpJmv9r2reSg1zvDrEsZiCfUVfqbu3ntm1nu6h.jpeg)
我选了个黑糖抹茶拿铁，因为我喜欢甜甜的，结果喝的时候发现加了黑糖也感觉不太甜，黑糖放少了？

Anggun City 这里经常会有不同的市集主办方会在这里办市集，而且大部分都是年轻人市集。我好喜欢来这种市集，感觉自己也跟着年轻化了……

![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/AL4XBuGB3cRL7aqhehGof9B9tP93hYFgaeuXbSectf4EqEvcNhRHk6mrbsTQtCL.jpeg)

12:50 PM
Dear Gemini
Earlier, it captured almost 80% in a short time like I said but it also did around five passes during that first round that would not end. I like what that first round but is there a way to make it only one or two passes as opposed to what it was? It seemed it was not going to stop at five passes. It looked like it was unlimited. Are there flags or ways to make Bill do one full pass through all the bytes and then rest the lasers before continuing?

It seems there might be an invisible line between a max speed like maybe 30M where anything higher might work in some ways but then not work in other ways where problems might happen or it is hard to say. Tho with 30M getting potentially 60% under five minutes, 20M getting possibly up to 80% under ten minutes, and 10M up to 90% under fifteen, and so on.


It is tough to say, there can be many pros and cons for different speeds and settings. With higher speeds, especially if above like 30M it would seem, Bill would skip more often creating more holes in the map. We talked about that issue. Perhaps resetting the map after a pass might reduce or eliminate that issue. So, a side effect like that might be mitigated a bit. That is only one example. There could be many pros and cons as it relates to different settings. And perhaps some remedies too.


But then the next question would be what is the next best round to do.


If Bill captured (rescued) from 0% to 90% at 10M in under 20 minutes in the first round (one full pass via -r0), what might be the next best move for additional rounds in trying to get closer to 99%? Call this part 2 or the Last Mile.


But then another question would be to compare different two-part systems, being A+B=C. A = First Part. B = Second Part. C = 100% of all the bytes of a disc rescued. The first part is the run or opening gambit where Bill attempts rescuing over 70%. The first part could be 1M, 10M, 20M, 30M, etc, assuming it is only one round. For some discs, it might be multiple rounds and multiple modes, worlds, levels, settings, etc, perhaps. But then part 2 being B, depending on what settings are used, part 2 could take potentially many hours or even many many hours. One might wonder how much or how little Part 1 might help and hurt Part 2 as the goal is C.


But to be clear, when I say 30M, I do not mean 30M because Bill did not obey me when I say 10000000000000000000000000M or a crazy number, it does not go at those numbers, it goes at whatever numbers it wants to go which makes talking about 30M or higher confusing as it may not follow what you tell it to do which then makes me wonder how impactful these speed settings might be if Bill ignores them. But I was only simplifying the process. It does not have to be only 2 parts but as many parts as possible. For example, imagine what if it ran at 100M, 30M, 25M, 15M, 10M, 5M, 1M, 500K, 250K, 100K. Those are at least 10 levels. Imagine if each level had -r0 to push Bill to do a full pass and then lower the speed each time. You spoke about overhead. So, a Bill system could have any number of moving parts, like modes, worlds, levels, rounds, chapters, jobs, which represents combinations of different settings, variables, numbers, speeds, options. I prefer Bill to be designed with infinite parts or as many possible. But at the same time, right now, we are only talking about opening moves in an attempt to hit 99%. The remaining 1% might be impossible or might take thousands of rounds. It might take thousands of hours. But my question for you is to run through trillions of combinations, potentially infinite combinations of all of the moving parts, all combinations of these settings that we are talking about and even settings we are not talking about, all of the flags, via any number of rounds, levels, modes, and more. The objective is to try to get as close to 99% rescued as possible. We talked about this thousands of times for years. There is an infinite ways of getting there. But there can be overhead like we talked about. It is challenging designing a universal Bill script that can handle any disc. Gemini wrote thousands of scripts for Bill already. All of this is highly controversial and debatable. It seems the best first move might be the largest possible speeds and clusters. But the follow-up questions would be about what to do after the first round. Because a first round could probably get over 60% or sometimes even over 95% or 99% of all of the bytes. But then the challenge is finding the best formula for additional rounds, levels, etc. Another challenge is when some of my discs are already like 90% rescued or 40% rescued or random percentages and numbers. My desire is a universal Bill script that can continue any disc from 0% to 99% to help any disc get to 100%.

03:41 PM
Dear Gemini
Write me a super universal Bill script for CDs and DVDs. Bill must focus on a strong opening that is -r0 or one pass. Bill should check the map and any info that might help. Bill must focus on the 80-20 rule per round which is to try to do the winning combo each round. Bill can have as many protocol systems as Bill needs. Bill can have as many modes, worlds, levels, chapters, rounds, as Bill needs, but each one must be unique. I prefer Bill remains in scan-focused modes until several full passes via several of the top winning combinations of settings, flags. Be careful of overhead which is something you mentioned earlier relating to the dangers of thousands of like tiers, modes, levels, worlds, rounds, chapters, jobs, runs, passes, mutations, variations, combinations, flags, changes, speeds, clusters, tags, options, settings, etc. The key is find the Goldilocks combo for the first roughly ten or so moves which might rescue over 99% of most discs. Bill should have the ability to continue grinding beyond the opening ten or more moves for the tougher discs, but a strong set of opening moves could in theory help many discs get as close to 99% as possible. That includes a way to turn -d --idirect and other flags like on and off. There are so many flags to consider include error flags. Think about how many modes too because Bill could have any number of modes depending on how you organize all the parts to make each part unique.

07:58 PM
Dear Gemini
You are not addressing the root of the problem, the following is only a symptom, the following had the tray open and then it said it was waiting for the disc to spin while the tray was opened. It closed. It opened. It was in an endless loop. But that is still the symptom. I told you what the real problem was a few minutes ago, but you are currently stuck on this symptom.

08:39 PM
Expand to include unique levels. Bill should have a natural route of highest to lowest settings in trying to best rescue all bytes. Bill should turn the -d --idirect related direct I/O hardware access flags on and off as needed, it is generally better if -d is off for the first few passes through the bytes as that can rescue 70% to 100% of all of the bytes even without -d related flags. Jordan can decide when to turn on -d but only when Bill really needs it. Same thing with other flags too. Bill does not always need all of the flags all of the time. The best combination of flags might rescue 70% to 100% of all the bytes in only a few rounds or in a few minutes even or faster sometimes. Bill must be designed to really rescue 70% to 100% via the best methods before attempting to struggle for the final bytes via whatever means necessary. Take it a step at a time.

Sovereign Reset Protocol
Jordan must reset Bill's map each session and run. But remember that a run is a full pass through all untried bytes. The Sovereign Reset Protocol can help the Phase Protocol. By default, Bill can loop through Scan Modes before graduating to Post-Scan Modes like Trim Mode, Scrape Mode, Crawl Mode, etc. The Sovereign Reset Protocol should be the default procedure even above the The Run Reset idea you mentioned. 


Phase Protocol
The Phase Protocol must attempt to run through all remaining non-rescued untried bytes via one -r0 pass through everything not rescued. The default route is to run using the highest settings for maximum speeds, efficiency, effectiveness. For example, one -r0 round might take a disc from 0% rescued to 70% rescued or potentially even 100% rescued. That one round might be one full pass if the round tries every remaining untried byte. One round might equal to one pass (run) if the round happens to run through each byte. One run (pass) might equal to multiple rounds. Each round, level, world, mode, etc, can be unique depending on the combinations of settings, flags.


Trim Protocol
The Trim Protocol is the Target Guard. If the disc is 99%, if all the Scan Modes were already tried, and if stalling for ten minutes or if Bill is out of other options, then switch to Post-Scan Modes like the Trim Mode, Scrape Mode, Crawl Mode, etc. The default route is to try to remain in Scan Modes for as long as possible. But sometimes, some discs might have to switch to Trim Mode even before 99% rescued. But I prefer Bill loops through all the Scan Modes (and sub-modes, phases, jobs, worlds, levels, chapters, rounds, flags, tags, variations, settings, options, speeds, etc) ten times and stalls for an hour before switching to Trim Mode, etc.

title.title: Lo que nos forma… y lo que nos sostiene. Ladies of Hive Community Contest # 285 [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---  

## Lo que nos forma… y lo que nos sostie

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjCTtrFetg4E9mEDofyU4s6GBaC4w2BtuPGBXpFJRiwm/drnickstafford_woman_5122505_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-read-reading-book-sofa-5122505/)

---

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive  

Hay preguntas que no solo se responden, sino que obligan a mirar hacia atrás… y también hacia adentro.

### Sobre lo que me ha marcado  

Más que un libro o una película en específico, ha sido una idea la que ha ido tomando forma con el tiempo: entender que el crecimiento personal no siempre es visible ni inmediato.

En un contexto como el nuestro, donde muchas veces las opciones son limitadas y los caminos parecen repetirse, aprender se vuelve un acto casi íntimo. No siempre se trata de acceder a grandes recursos, sino de saber mirar distinto lo que ya tenemos.

Recuerdo haber leído hace años, en un libro que llegó a mis manos casi por casualidad, una frase que se me quedó: *“No puedes controlar todo lo que ocurre, pero sí la forma en que decides responder.”*

Puede parecer simple, incluso evidente. Pero llevarlo a la práctica es otra cosa.

En la vida cotidiana en Cuba, donde lo imprevisto forma parte del día a día —desde un apagón hasta un cambio inesperado de planes— esa idea deja de ser teoría y se convierte en una herramienta.

No siempre logro aplicarla. Sería poco honesto decirlo. Pero cuando lo hago, noto la diferencia: hay menos desgaste, menos resistencia, más claridad.

Por eso la recomendaría. No como una fórmula, sino como un recordatorio.

---

### Sobre el propósito en este momento  

Si me hubieran hecho esta pregunta hace algunos años, probablemente habría dado una respuesta más concreta, más definida.

Hoy no.

Hoy siento que mi propósito no es algo fijo, sino algo que se construye en lo cotidiano.

No está en una meta lejana ni en un logro específico. Está en la forma en que transito los días.

En seguir aprendiendo, incluso cuando no hay garantías.  
En cuidar los vínculos que realmente importan.  
En sostener cierta calma, incluso cuando el entorno no siempre lo facilita.  

Vivir en un país donde muchas cosas cambian constantemente te enseña, casi sin darte cuenta, a moverte con lo que hay.

Y en ese movimiento, uno encuentra pequeñas razones para seguir.

A veces es un proyecto.  
Otras, una conversación.  
O simplemente la sensación de que, a pesar de todo, uno sigue avanzando.  

No es un propósito grandilocuente.

Pero es real.

Y en este momento, eso es suficiente para seguir adelante cada día.

---

Ambas preguntas me dejan una sensación común: la de que crecer y encontrar sentido no siempre pasa por grandes transformaciones, sino por pequeñas decisiones sostenidas en el tiempo.

Gracias por invitar a esta reflexión 

Un abrazo sincero para todas 

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue hecha en DeepL Translate  

---  

🇬🇧 In English  

---  

## What Shapes Us… and What Sustains Us  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjCTtrFetg4E9mEDofyU4s6GBaC4w2BtuPGBXpFJRiwm/drnickstafford_woman_5122505_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-read-reading-book-sofa-5122505/)

---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 

Some questions are not just answered—they make us look back… and also inward.

### About what has shaped me  

More than a specific book or movie, it has been an idea that has taken shape over time: understanding that personal growth is not always visible or immediate.

In a context like ours, where options are often limited and paths may seem repetitive, learning becomes almost an intimate act. It is not always about access to great resources, but about learning to see differently what we already have.

I remember reading years ago, in a book that came into my hands almost by chance, a phrase that stayed with me: *“You cannot control everything that happens, but you can control how you respond.”*

It may sound simple, even obvious. But putting it into practice is something else.

In everyday life in Cuba, where the unexpected is part of daily reality—from power outages to sudden changes of plans—that idea stops being theory and becomes a tool.

I do not always manage to apply it. It would not be honest to say so. But when I do, I notice the difference: less resistance, less exhaustion, more clarity.

That is why I would recommend it—not as a formula, but as a reminder.

---

### About my purpose right now  

If I had been asked this question a few years ago, I would probably have given a more concrete answer.

Today, I would not.

Now I feel that my purpose is not something fixed, but something built in everyday life.

It is not in a distant goal or a specific achievement. It is in how I move through my days.

In continuing to learn, even without guarantees.  
In caring for the relationships that truly matter.  
In maintaining a certain calm, even when the environment does not always make it easy.  

Living in a country where many things change constantly teaches you, almost without noticing, to move with what you have.

And in that movement, you find small reasons to keep going.

Sometimes it is a project.  
Other times, a conversation.  
Or simply the feeling that, despite everything, you are still moving forward.  

It is not a grand purpose.

But it is real.

And right now, that is enough to keep me going each day.

---

Both questions leave me with a shared feeling: growth and meaning are not always found in big transformations, but in small choices sustained over time.

Thank you for this space to reflect  

A sincere hug to all 

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done using DeepL Translate

title.body: Ecency is not just a social app for the Hive blockchain - it's a fully-featured crypto wallet that puts you in control of your digital assets right from your phone. Whether you're holding HIVE, HBD, Hive Power (HP), Hive Engine tokens, or even Ecency Points, the Ecency wallet gives you a unified portfolio view with real-time fiat conversion rates.

/>

What Can You Manage?
--------------------

**Native Hive Assets:**

*   **HIVE** - the base currency of the blockchain
    
*   **HBD (Hive Backed Dollars)** - the stablecoin pegged to USD
    
*   **Hive Power (HP)** - your staked influence on the network
    

**Layer 2 Tokens:**

*   **Hive Engine Tokens** - community tokens like LEO, BEE, POB, and hundreds more
    
*   **SPK Network Tokens** - SPK, LARYNX, and governance tokens
    

**Ecency Points:**

*   Earned through activity (posting, commenting, referring friends)
    
*   Can be used to promote or boost content
    

Portfolio at a Glance
---------------------

Open the Wallet tab and you see your entire portfolio: liquid balances, savings, staked amounts, pending rewards, and estimated fiat value - all in one screen. Tap any asset to see detailed  
transaction history, pending requests, and available actions.

You can customize which tokens appear in your wallet. Hide the ones you don't care about, keep the ones you do. Your preferences sync across devices through your Hive profile.

Claiming Rewards
----------------

Earned author or curation rewards? A single tap on the \

button collects your pending HIVE, HBD, and HP rewards. The same goes for Hive Engine token rewards and Ecency Points - claim them all from within the wallet.

* * *

**Ecency makes managing your Hive assets as simple as checking your bank account - except you actually own your keys.**

title.title: 🔗 Magi Network — Native Bitcoin on Hive Is Not a Promise Anymore. It's Live.
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQE7LDEo4Rcbn11HXTsoRqz2spYieWhyQNFWbjGceb69w/image.png 


Something happened on Hive this week that most of the crypto world hasn't noticed yet.
Native Bitcoin liquidity pools went live.
Not wrapped BTC. Not synthetic BTC. Not wBTC or some custodied derivative.
Real Bitcoin. On Hive. Swappable without a middleman.
This is Magi Network — and if you care about Hive, HBD, or the future of decentralized crosschain liquidity, this is worth your full attention.
- - -
### 💡 What Is Magi Network?
Magi (formerly VSC Network) is a Layer 2 protocol built on Hive, designed to enable native crosschain swaps without bridges, custodians, or wrapped tokens.
Its flagship application is Altera — accessible at altera.magi.eco — a clean, non-custodial DeFi interface where users can:

🔄 Swap native BTC for HBD, HIVE, or DASH directly
💧 Provide liquidity to BTC-HBD and HIVE-HBD pools and earn real swap fees
📥 Deposit BTC from any Bitcoin wallet
📤 Withdraw real BTC back to any Bitcoin address at any time

No new accounts. No new seed phrases. Connect your Hive Keychain and your Bitcoin wallet. That's it.

⚙️ How It Works Under the Hood
This is where Magi gets technically impressive.
The security model is built on a Threshold Signature Scheme (TSS) — a cryptographic mechanism that distributes signing authority across 18 Hive witnesses, each bonding HIVE as collateral.
What this means in practice:

🔒 No single party controls funds at any point
🔗 Every Bitcoin movement is verified with on-chain Bitcoin proofs
♻️ Key rotation happens without fund migration
🛡️ No external trust assumption beyond the validator set and Bitcoin's own proof-of-work

Every pool uses HBD as the base settlement asset. This is the design detail that matters most. Every crosschain swap — BTC to DASH, BTC to HIVE, or any future pair — routes through HBD by default. As volume grows, demand for HBD grows structurally. And because HBD is backed by HIVE through Hive's conversion mechanism, that demand flows directly into the HIVE economy.
The flywheel is real. And it is now running.
- - -
### 🌐 Only Three Other Protocols Have Ever Done This
This is not an exaggeration.
In the entire history of crypto, only a handful of protocols have successfully shipped TSS-based custody for native Bitcoin in production crosschain swaps — where real BTC is held and transferred without any wrapped token at any stage:
ProtocolTSS AlgorithmSettlement AssetTHORChainGG20 threshold ECDSARUNEChainflipFROST (Schnorr/Taproot)FLIPMaya ProtocolGG20 threshold ECDSACACAOMagi NetworkTSS / Hive witnessesHBD
Magi is now the fourth protocol on that list.
Built on Hive. Settled in HBD.
- - -
### 📊 The Fee Model
Pools use a Constant Liquidity Product (CLP) model — essentially an AMM with two fee components:

💵 Base fee: 0.08% (8 basis points), configurable per pool
📈 Slip fee: scales with swap size relative to pool depth — larger swaps relative to pool size pay progressively more

This means small swaps are cheap. Large swaps are self-regulating. Pool drain is naturally disincentivized.
And because Magi inherits Hive's resource credit model, there are zero gas fees on transactions within the protocol. Hold HBD, transact for free.
- - -
### 🏦 What This Means for Hive
The Hive ecosystem has operated for years under a structural vulnerability: its liquidity depended almost entirely on centralized exchanges deciding to list and maintain HIVE pairs. Every delisting review, every drop in trading volume, every exchange policy shift — the community held its breath.
Magi changes that equation permanently.
👉 Fiat → BTC → BTC-HBD pool → Hive wallet
👉 Hive wallet → BTC-HBD pool → BTC → Fiat
A user anywhere in the world can now enter and exit the Hive ecosystem entirely through decentralized liquidity pools. No exchange listing required. Non-custodial, permissionless, and KYC-free at the protocol level.
Magi doesn't make exchange listings irrelevant by fighting them. It makes them irrelevant by making them optional.
- - -
### ⚠️ Early Days — What to Watch
This is day one software. The team has been clear about it.
Liquidity pools have been seeded with minimum amounts, which means:

🧪 Large swaps relative to pool size will cause significant price deviation
📉 Slip fees will be high until liquidity deepens
🐛 Edge cases in the UI and flow are still being found

The right approach is exactly what the Magi team recommends: start small, verify the flow, then scale. Early LPs who seed these pools at this stage set the price and the pace — and earn fees from day one.
DASH integration is already next. Litecoin is in development. The UTXO mapping architecture is chain-agnostic, meaning every new chain added deepens the HBD routing demand and compounds the network effect.
- - -
### ⚖️ The Verdict
THORChain proved that a decentralized crosschain liquidity protocol with a native settlement asset could create massive, sustainable demand for its token — not from speculation, but from structural usage.
Magi is now attempting the same thing. On Hive. With HBD.
The technology is real. The architecture is sound. The comparison to THORChain is not hype — it is a specific, technical claim that Magi has now earned the right to make.
Whether it scales to THORChain's level depends on liquidity depth, ecosystem adoption, and execution over the next 12–24 months.
But the foundation is there.
The walls between chains are coming down. Magi just opened the door for Bitcoin.
👉 Try it yourself: https://altera.magi.eco/login

Dear Gemini
You wrote the following about the Seek Penalty, \

Make a list of each thing that might create gaps which increases the Seek Penalty. List everything from biggest to smallest. Look at all the settings, flags, combinations, modes, like speeds like 10M, other speeds, cluster sizes, skip sizes, block sizes, sector sizes, etc.

02:07 AM
I am confused now. It seems like you were saying 10M might sometimes create many holes meaning oceans of rescued bytes followed by tiny islands of non-rescued bytes. Based on that, resetting the map would probably not delete those tiny islands assuming the 10M created island-like holes. In other words, resetting the map might help with reverting trimmed, scraped, and bad sector bytes back to untried status which is like clearing playing field as it relates to remaining bytes. But it does not seem that it would eliminate islands. Please talk about this. Expand Bill, include a special Perfect Mode: World 0: Level 0 that includes 5M speed combined with the best combination of flags to maximize the odds that it might  rescue 70% to 99% of some of the discs potentially. Infinite rounds per level. Linear approach where Bill tries to run through all bytes at 5M. Each round can be up to an hour long. Bill must rest for ten minutes after running for an hour. Bill must activate Housekeeping and Refresh protocols and other protocols as needed to minimize cops and especially TTC and the seek penalty and all other potential issues. 

Phil Protocol
Coach Phil must run the best plays like as if Bill really was Michael Jordan. For example, if there is literally only one byte remaining, Phil probably wants to play Trim Mode, Scrape Mode, Crawl Mode, Reverse Mode, and/or any combinations of flags. Phil might want to first read the map file, Dmesg, the log file, other files if there are any, run commands to see what is happening, and then perhaps reset the map. Remember the other protocols too like Housekeeping and Refresh. Phil is a coach. Phil should probably only call timeout at the very end of the game because I prefer a linear approach where Bill generally tries to focus on Perfect Mode and Scan Mode before spending too much time in other modes, settings, flags, combinations, configurations, options, etc. Don't forget about the Jordan Protocol and many other protocols too. Phil needs to be extremely picky, I mean Phil should only call timeout when there are no other options left. Phil has to study playbook, watch the tapes, and have all the facts before calling timeout. Only interrupt rounds if it is critical. Some of this probably overlaps with other protocols and things.

Jobs Protocol
The Jobs Protocol must split Bill into three parts: Booting (1), Driving (2), Last Mile (3). The first part (Booting) must remain independent inside the Bill script. Booting must start when a Bill session is initiated in the Terminal. Booting must check all relevant files, commands, settings, data. Booting must switch Bill to part two (Driving) or part three (Last Mile). Driving must push Bill to beyond 95% rescued. Driving is the main engine of Bill. Driving must remain independent. Driving houses the main modes, levels, rounds, flags. Driving focuses on pushes Bill to rescue easier bytes first. The Last Mile must remain independent. Unlike Driving, the Last Mile must not reset the map at the beginning of each session or world. The Last Mile must have persistent memory across sessions. The Last Mile must be focused on rescuing the final bytes, the final five percent. The Final Mile must be a modified version of the Drive but customized to specialize in finishing the final bytes. The Last Mile must personalized modes, worlds, levels, rounds, settings, flags, in order to better adapt. The Last Mile is basically the Coach Phil Protocol because Phil is focused on winning games at the end. Booting is also Phil. Booting is that fork in the middle, that probe. Bill probably shouldn't enter the Final Mile until 95% rescued.

01:13 AM
Dear Gemini
 You wrote: \

Does that mean flags define which mode you are in? This is a chicken or the egg debate. I was asking about modes if flags are used in any mode. You might be saying not so much that modes define flags but that flags define modes. It also seems the default modes are more estimates of what a default run is while flags could cause Bill to slide in and out of modes based on the flags and not based on modes if modes are not defining the flags but the flags are defining modes which is still partly challenging as some flags can be used in any mode and yet flags can define modes and modes might use different flags. 

To use an analogy, it seems Trim is using a spoon to scrape out the remaining bits of oatmeal out of a pan to eat in a bowl. Putting oatmeal in the bowl is rescuing bytes. I don't know if Trim always results in rescued bytes or if Trim can result in an altered map file. It seems Trim focuses mostly or only on the edges of what was rescued and/or the edges sectors, blocks, clusters, regions, areas, parts, and/or bytes which may or may not include bytes that may or may not be rescued. I don't know exactly how it all works, I'm not sure what it can and cannot do in any situation. If a Trim only modifies the map file and if Bill returned to rescan via Scan Mode, assuming the map file is reset to allow for rescanning, it would seem the modified map file would have been deleted if said map file was thus resetted which might perhaps delete the trimming, that is if trimming did not result in rescued bytes.


I guess if Trim rescued bytes like scraping oatmeal out of the edges of an oatmeal pan, then the act of returning to Scan Mode via resetting the map to rescan would at least in theory be similar or identical to Scrape Mode because Scrape seems to be a very strict version of Scan.

02:31 PM
Dear Gemini
We talked about three modes: Scan, Trim, Scrape. Now talk about Crawl and any other modes if any. Focus on Crawl Mode and talk about similarities Crawl may or may not have with other modes. We talked about the car truck vs truck car debate with how modes can be customized using flags and settings in general. To an extent, there is Scan and Trim. In some ways, there seems to be mostly two main modes. It seems Scan is a quick leapfrogging Check of bytes while Scrape is a slow non-leapfrogging Recheck. Scrape seems like a modified version of Scan, that Scrape has default settings and also limits that prevents it from being Scan Premium. Scrape seems to be Scan Basic or Scan Lite but focused. So, it seems Scrape is unique to Scan as Spoon is unique to Shovel even as both look identical from far away. Actually, Scan is an Excavator. Scrape is a Shovel. Trim is a Spoon. In theory, flags would change the sizes of these digging devices to make them bigger, smaller, etc. In theory at least, modification can make these three different or similar or perhaps identical. You've said some modes are hard-coded to do some things and also not do some things. Hard-codes would indeed make said modes unique if the modes ignore certain flags or certain things. Therefore, even tho these modes are digging devices, I can sort of see differences between modes at least to a degree. I also see similarities. When designing Bill, it is critical to know the pros and cons of modes, especially as modes can sometimes be redesigned to simulate other modes as that begs the question of what is the point of Scrape if Scan can be redesigned to Scrape. In other words, Bill could in theory at least be designed to Scan in a quick pass through all the bytes and then Bill could be programmed to rescan to simulate Trim and then perhaps Bill could be ordered a third time to rescan again but slowly cluster by cluster to simulate Scrape. So, in some ways, that would be Scan 3 times. In other ways, that was technically Bill doing Scan, Trim, and Scrape but via the Scan Mode. I want to know if there is anything unique about the Crawl Mode, a Backwards -R Reverse Mode, other modes if any. I am trying to find ways to summarize the main categories of what Bill can do. Because on one level, you can say they all can dig, so therefore one mode but different worlds or sizes, etc. On the other hand, it could be define as two modes, Scan, Trim, Slow Scan (Scrape). And it can be defined as Scan, Trim, Scrape. It could even be defined as Scan, Trim, Scrape, Crawl. But it is tough to see if Crawl is even super unique as Crawl can be a modified version of other modes. It can also be outlined to be Scan, Rescan, Trim, Retrim, Scrape, Rescrape (Crawl). And then so on and so forth as Scan can be Rescanned and Rerescanned. But to a degree, Scan and Rescan is the same thing even more than Scrape is simply a slow Scan. Some modes could perhaps omit some flags if that helps perfect discs, but only if Jordan or others could perhaps escape the cops if things get tough. After that, specific Scan modes, worlds, levels, or flags could be skipped as soon as Bill realizes a particular move failed. You can have as many worlds and levels and rounds with different flag combinations with the three or more scan modes but only if they are all unique and specialized and especially only if Bill can make sure to escape prison if he does get stuck. You can decide when to include or omit flags depending on what Bill might be able to do. If timeout flags might hurt Bill and if Bill can find other ways to escape prison in less than maybe two minutes after getting caught because he didn't have timeout flags and/or other flags,  if Bill could then learn from his mistake and perhaps not do that again, that might be a good idea and yet hard to know as each part of a disc could be different and a variety of things may or may not work in different parts of a disc making all of this very hard to figure out. I do not mean fully patient. Bill should try maximum speeds. Bill should try different tactics like all the things you talked about regarding multiple scan modes and the different worlds, levels, tactics, and perhaps even -R and other things might help sometimes. Bill probably should not wait more than ten hours before moving on to Post-Scan modes. Bill should try to remain in the three scan modes and all of the sub-mode worlds and levels for as long as possible trying different things from fastest tactics to slower tactics gradually step by step. Eventually, Bill needs to move on to Post-Scan modes after exhausting all Scan-Themed modes, worlds, levels, chapters, rounds, jobs, flags, settings, variations, tactics, combinations, etc.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVopmjwBnCN8tzxvSLoR4CqLeVY24tmWBUTwdBjwLhm9/dsc_5288.jpg)
🦉 The Eurasian siskin (Spinus spinus) > - Spinus spinos (Greek) unidentified bird mentioned Aristotle and other ancient Greek. authors
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbYGtQNwtWwoetSpRPsM5m8TqQdo2525V8jU2ZTcxKct/dsc_5292.jpg)
These yellow birds are true nomads. They literally have no fixed nesting sites. They nest in different places, primarily in coniferous forests, and sometimes in mixed forests. However, I encounter them every spring in small numbers. Getting close to them is difficult; the birds always keep their distance.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYz995WrBLgo8sAWoiuJrCjAEwqHC8W4KZeXLVJTJDAhu/dsc_5293.jpg)
In the fall, they begin to gather in flocks, which can be very large and noisy. In winter, in my region, they are practically nonexistent; it's too cold. However, there are times when a lone bird gets lost for some reason, and then it joins a flock of redpolls, which are their closest relatives.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVXKMes8KQn1maHkhu87Ns2JeripY8ZjJSub8U24dfMSt/dsc_5303.jpg)

title.title: Природній декор після обрізання дерев
title.body:
Вже більше місяця минуло, коли я обрізав дерева в садку, і якщо великі стовбури я порізав і поскладав під стіною, щоб сохли до нового опалювального сезону, то з дрібними гілками розібрався лише зараз. Дрібних гілок дуже багато і багато часу пішло, щоб їх порізати в одну довжину, зібрати і поскладати.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNtMnTJ3ednYjzbhjqLRW1p1hSgX4MoufK6u5PZNdt3i/1776666041586.jpg)

Знаю, що багато людей такі дрібні гілки подрібнюють і компастують, але я вирішив вбити двох зайців - зробити цікавий дизайнерський експеримент і мати додаткову кількість деревени для спалювання в грубці. Бо воно наче і здається, що така дрібнота, що там воно дасть. Та досвід останніх пару років показав, що такими дрібними гілочками можна топити в хаті кілька тижнів, а в умовах, в яких ми були цієї зими, це дуже цінний ресурс.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWR3DJs1gsw2dUh9eJceKxtc1m28nqkQmXn9daVuUzbak/1776666042007.jpg)

Результат моє роботи виглядає дуже пристойно. Складені навколо криниці дрібні гілочки виглядають дуже гарно.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWXwUp31nxJVY4VPYTPmgLhTx8wFcAmMVgwoNYZUPe3zw/1776666042630.jpg)

title.body: > I dreamed of you last night, but you felt so far from me. I’m always caught off guard when you appear in my dreams, and there’s always this space between us that I can’t seem to cross. Deep down, I know that trying to speak to you there would only leave me hurting. It’s never a happy dream 😞 there’s always distance, and underlying sadness whenever you’re present. Lately, I’ve started finding a bit of peace on the days I don’t think about you. Especially when it’s your birthday, if I realize I’ve forgotten it on that day, it feels like a breath of relief. It feels like progress, like I’m finally thinking of you less than I used to. What I can’t stop thinking about now is how long it’s been since we broke up. I hate that I sometimes count the days we’ve been apart, especially knowing those are the same days you’ve been spending with someone new. I tell myself to keep moving forward, but I find myself wondering, when will I finally be free? I only wish the healing would happen faster!

title.title: Challenge #04859-M110: The Haunting of Stelgi Manor
title.body:
![carlos-felipe-ramirez-mesa-HAv1v3T47mA-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23tvAwV3KQ2hnN5cDydGHNRpLnj1KSxjNyYyUp7drxci6KtXc9eqFdqrW9cQ3XdJbxkfx.jpg)

> Countess Vermyr Stelgi has inherited a substantial tract of land after the death of a distant cousin who had no other heirs. She moves quickly to spruce up the palace, hoping to make it into a summer home owing to the northerly quiet. That involves properly disposing of the departed cousin’s eclectic (some might say ghastly) collection, though some things in that palace might not appreciate being removed… -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

Like most buildings that had been in a family for generations, it was a heap of conflicting architecture. Varying portions of it had been raised, refurbished, renovated, rebuilt, and then left to run down. Some of it had potential. Most of it could use more than a little spackle or Tape of Mending. The Countess Vermyr Brigide Hester Stelgi, second of her name, decided to wait and see before she decided to raze it all to the ground.

Besides, most of it was very well-dressed stone.

The staff formerly in her cousin's employ had aired a guest suite for her, and cleaned the final mess from his bedchamber, but otherwise left the chambers untouched. They knew well her cousin's odd habits and quirks, and were well used to leaving everything inanimate alone.

Her dear late cousin Throckmorton had what could easily be the largest collection of haunted and cursed objects in all of Alfarell. Not in any logical display. Just sort of piled up in relevant containers, if they needed them, or held in sacks and crates. There were disturbing drifts that may contain pure rubbish, or may hold _other_ cursed or haunted items that didn't need to be secured.

Most of the rooms had 'deer trails' weaving between the drifts. The staff were permitted to dust what they could reach, and went no further than that.

As an added extra misfortune, the late cousin Throckmorton had come down with cats in his final years. The population in the house were wily beasts and would _probably_ get used to her in time.

They would not be pleased with what Vermyr had in mind.

Step one, after her first night's rest, was getting in contact with the local temples and asking for their help in safely removing or containing the cursed and haunted things. Or, if it were vitally necessary, destroying them.

Step two, find a Druid to explain things to the cats.

Step three, make the place habitable for more than one person again. If possible.

Step one would be ongoing, and step three would be taking years at best. Her budget would be undergoing some interesting alterations for some significant time.

Vermyr spent most of her day writing the letters to the interested parties, including the task of enlisting a wizard to gauge the magical potential of anything that wasn't either cursed or haunted. At least she had wards and charms to prevent any locked spirits from disturbing her sleep.

Then there was the matter of the gem-eyed skull.

It had appeared in her suite on a small display table to the left of the fireplace in her bedchamber. Replete with the doily to rest upon. The gemstones in the eyesockets seemed to glow with a faint light.

\

That night, Vermyr drew the curtains around her bed. In the morning, they were a nest of loose threads that one of the household cats had birthed her kittens in.

Obviously, the priests would be looking at _that_ thing _first_.
