title.title: The Silverblogger Chronicles-Prompt #42.The Neighborhood That Still Lives in Me. [EN/ES]
title.body:
Hello SilverBloggers community!

This week I’m joining the **Chronicles weekly prompt (Week 42)**, a topic that doesn’t just bring back memories… it brings back a place that is still part of my life, even if it no longer feels the same.

---

## The Neighborhood That Still Lives in Me  
### *Cidra, Matanzas — between what was and what remains*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwVLXG5txfsHLAr4znRGV8FYZ36inZUVwTvZJMR9aWy3/dimitrisvetsikas1969_old_house_2878027_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/old-house-traditional-architecture-2878027/)

---

I didn’t just grow up in a neighborhood.  
I grew up in a small town called Cidra, in the province of Matanzas, in a quiet area.

That was my world.

From the year I was born until I was about fifteen, those streets shaped who I became. I stayed there much longer, until I was around forty, but if I’m honest… by fifteen, life had already left its mark.

Those were different times in my country.  
Years that many would call good, before the beginning of what later became known as the “Special Period.”

But beyond the historical context, what I remember most is something simpler… and stronger.

We were like a big family.

It wasn’t just about neighbors living close to each other. It was about people who showed up when needed. If someone had a problem, it became everyone’s concern. If something had to be done, there was always a hand willing to help.

That kind of unity is not easy to explain today.

As a rural town, peace was part of everyday life. Not silence, but a kind of calm that allowed you to live without constant tension. You knew the people around you. You trusted them.

That was normal back then.

And in that same place, years later, I built my own home with my own hands.  
Right above the house where my mother lived… the same house where I grew up.

Life, in a way, came full circle there.

That is also where I raised my daughter with my wife.

So this is not just a place I remember.  
It is a place I continued building, even as time moved forward.

---

But time doesn’t just pass.  
It transforms.

Today, when I look at that neighborhood, what I feel is difficult to explain… but it is not a good feeling.

The physical deterioration is visible.  
The streets are no longer the same. There is a lack of institutional care, but also a loss of commitment from many who still live there.

What once felt alive now feels worn down.

Most of the people I grew up with are no longer there.  
They aged… and many of them passed away.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbGzmRC7mMDKvQQtUn8cmoVKR5uv3EHwqH1nZeN6TxE1n/geralt_woman_100343_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-senior-old-aged-elderly-100343/)

---

New people came, but the sense of community is not the same.

There are also daily difficulties that weigh heavily: problems with water supply, electricity, and even communication. There is no stable mobile coverage in the area, largely due to infrastructure issues.

It’s true that when I was a child, none of that existed… but today, those things are no longer luxuries. They are part of modern life.

And their absence makes everything feel more disconnected.

---

There is something else that changed everything for me.

My mother passed away almost three years ago.

Before that, even if I was kilometers away, as I got closer to the neighborhood, I could feel it. Something in the air was different. Familiar. Alive.

Now… that feeling is gone.

I still go back. The house is still there.  
But it is not the same place anymore.

> *A place doesn’t disappear when it changes… but something inside you does.*

---

What remains is not what I see today.

What remains is what that place gave me.

The values.  
The sense of community.  
The understanding that people matter more than structures.

But there is also a kind of quiet sadness.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6SdLc6WNgAhxbx97LuNLbngHjpup2cExWE2BANYCTon/clickerhappy_road_2609200_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/road-stop-overgrown-abandoned-2609200/)

---

Because I have seen, with my own eyes, how a place that once felt full of life can slowly lose its essence.

> *Not all losses are sudden. Some happen little by little… until one day, you realize nothing feels the same.*

---

*Images: Pixabay*  
*Translation: DeepL / Google Translate*

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

---

📢 If you want to see my full process in real time inside Hive and Web3, I’m documenting it here:

👉 Daily Hive Journal 🚀  
https://t.me/diariohive  

There I share progress, mistakes, and results with no filter.

---
## En Español
---

Hola comunidad de SilverBloggers!

Esta semana me uno al **prompt semanal Chronicles (Semana 42)**, un tema que no solo me trae recuerdos… sino un lugar que aún forma parte de mi vida, aunque ya no se sienta igual.

---

## El barrio que aún vive en mí  
### *Cidra, Matanzas — entre lo que fue y lo que queda*

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwVLXG5txfsHLAr4znRGV8FYZ36inZUVwTvZJMR9aWy3/dimitrisvetsikas1969_old_house_2878027_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/old-house-traditional-architecture-2878027/)

---

Yo no crecí solo en un barrio.  
Crecí en un pequeño pueblo llamado Cidra, en la provincia de Matanzas, en una zona tranquila.

Ese era mi mundo.

Desde que nací hasta aproximadamente los quince años, esas calles fueron formando quien soy hoy. Seguí viviendo allí mucho más tiempo, hasta cerca de los cuarenta, pero si soy honesto… a los quince ya la vida me había marcado.

Eran otros tiempos en mi país.  
Años que muchos consideran buenos, antes del inicio de lo que luego se conocería como el “Período Especial”.

Pero más allá del contexto histórico, lo que más recuerdo es algo más simple… y más fuerte.

Éramos como una gran familia.

No se trataba solo de vecinos viviendo cerca. Era gente que estaba cuando hacía falta. Si alguien tenía un problema, era problema de todos. Si había que hacer algo, siempre aparecía una mano dispuesta.

Ese tipo de unión no es fácil de explicar hoy.

Como pueblo de campo, la tranquilidad formaba parte de la vida diaria. No era silencio, era una calma que te permitía vivir sin tensión constante. Conocías a quienes te rodeaban. Confiabas en ellos.

Eso era lo normal.

Y en ese mismo lugar, años después, construí mi propia casa con mis manos.  
Justo encima de la casa de mi madre… la misma donde yo crecí.

La vida, de alguna manera, cerró un ciclo allí.

También fue el lugar donde crié a mi hija junto a mi esposa.

Por eso, este no es solo un sitio que recuerdo.  
Es un lugar que seguí construyendo incluso mientras el tiempo avanzaba.

---

Pero el tiempo no solo pasa.  
Transforma.

Hoy, cuando miro ese barrio, lo que siento es difícil de explicar… pero no es una buena sensación.

El deterioro físico es evidente.  
Las calles ya no son las mismas. Hay falta de atención institucional, pero también una pérdida de interés por parte de muchos de los que aún viven allí.

Lo que antes se sentía vivo, hoy se percibe desgastado.

La mayoría de las personas con las que crecí ya no están.  
Envejecieron… y muchas fallecieron.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbGzmRC7mMDKvQQtUn8cmoVKR5uv3EHwqH1nZeN6TxE1n/geralt_woman_100343_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/woman-senior-old-aged-elderly-100343/)

---
Llegó gente nueva, pero el sentido de comunidad ya no es el mismo.

A eso se suman dificultades diarias: problemas con el abasto de agua, la electricidad e incluso la comunicación. No hay cobertura celular estable, en gran parte por problemas de infraestructura.

Es cierto que cuando era niño nada de eso existía… pero hoy ya no son lujos, son parte de la vida moderna.

Y su ausencia se siente.

---

Hay algo más que cambió todo para mí.

Mi madre falleció hace casi tres años.

Antes de eso, incluso estando a kilómetros de distancia, cuando me acercaba al barrio podía sentirlo. Había algo en el aire… familiar, vivo.

Hoy esa sensación se ha perdido.

Sigo yendo. La casa sigue allí.  
Pero ya no es el mismo lugar.

> *Un lugar no desaparece cuando cambia… pero algo dentro de uno sí lo hace.*

---

Lo que permanece no es lo que veo hoy.

Es lo que ese lugar me dejó.

Los valores.  
El sentido de comunidad.  
La comprensión de que las personas valen más que las estructuras.

Pero también queda una tristeza silenciosa.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6SdLc6WNgAhxbx97LuNLbngHjpup2cExWE2BANYCTon/clickerhappy_road_2609200_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/road-stop-overgrown-abandoned-2609200/)

---

Porque he visto, con mis propios ojos, cómo un lugar lleno de vida puede ir perdiendo su esencia poco a poco.

> *No todas las pérdidas son de golpe. Algunas ocurren lentamente… hasta que un día te das cuenta de que nada se siente igual.*

---

title.title: Data Driven View of Current Conditions
title.body:
## Crypto Market Snapshot 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUypPHGz38LV8bqmgoKHhL7WZXxjT9iykV859KgmDhA72/image.png 

The crypto market continues to operate in a transitional phase where price action, liquidity, and narrative are not fully aligned. This creates an environment that feels quiet on the surface but remains structurally active underneath.

This type of phase has historically been where positioning matters more than prediction.

---

## Market Overview  

As of the latest available data:

- Bitcoin is trading in the mid range between 60,000 and 70,000 USD  
- Ethereum remains stable in the 3,000 USD range  
- Total crypto market capitalization is fluctuating between 2.3 trillion and 2.6 trillion USD  
- Stablecoin dominance remains elevated, indicating sidelined liquidity  

These numbers reflect a market that is not in a full expansion cycle but also not in contraction. It is sitting in equilibrium.

---

## Liquidity Conditions  

Liquidity is the primary driver of crypto markets. Current conditions show:

- Global M2 money supply growth is stabilizing after previous contraction  
- Interest rates remain relatively high compared to the previous cycle  
- Risk assets are competing with yield bearing instruments such as treasury bonds  

This creates friction.

Capital is no longer forced into crypto. It now requires a reason to move.

That reason is usually narrative combined with momentum.

---

## Bitcoin Dominance  

Bitcoin dominance continues to hold strength:

- Dominance is sitting above 50 percent  
- Altcoin rotation remains limited  
- Capital is prioritizing perceived safety over speculation  

Historically, strong Bitcoin dominance phases occur before broader altcoin expansions.

This is not a guarantee of an alt season, but it is a structural prerequisite.

---

## On Chain Activity  

On chain metrics show a mixed but stable environment:

- Transaction volumes remain consistent  
- Long term holders are not distributing aggressively  
- Exchange balances continue a slow decline over time  

This suggests that despite lower attention, conviction has not disappeared.

Participants are holding rather than exiting.

---

## Hive Ecosystem Position  

Within this broader market, Hive remains in a low attention phase.

- Hive price is trading roughly between 0.07 and 0.10 USD  
- Market capitalization remains under 50 million USD  
- Network activity continues despite reduced external visibility  

From a structural standpoint:

- Blocks are being produced  
- Content is being published  
- Value is being distributed  

The system is functioning exactly as designed.

---

## Attention Versus Value  

Markets operate on attention first and value second.

Right now attention is concentrated elsewhere:

- AI narratives  
- Macro economic uncertainty  
- Large cap crypto assets  

This leaves smaller ecosystems underpriced relative to their activity.

That gap does not stay permanent.

Historically, attention rotates.

---

## Strategic Interpretation  

This environment rewards a specific type of participant:

- Consistent accumulation over time  
- Focus on fundamentals rather than price spikes  
- Ability to operate without constant external validation  

The data does not currently support aggressive speculation.

It supports positioning.

---

## Risk Factors  

There are still clear risks in the current market:

- Macroeconomic tightening could reduce liquidity further  
- Regulatory pressure continues to evolve  
- Market sentiment can shift rapidly with external events  

Ignoring these factors leads to poor decision making.

Acknowledging them creates better positioning.

---

## Final Perspective  

The market is not dead.

It is recalibrating.

Periods like this are often misinterpreted because they lack visible excitement. But historically, these are the phases where long term outcomes are shaped.

The difference between participants is simple:

Some wait for confirmation.

Others position before it arrives.

The data right now shows a market that is stable, liquid enough to function, but not yet driven by broad speculation.

That combination has always been where early positioning happens.

title.title: Starting the Offgridlife Claymation Series
title.body: I did some drawings yesterday for my forthcoming Offgridlife Claymation series. Paintings and drawings based on @offgridlife ai claymation videos about [Free Art Frees Art](https://freeartfreesart.com/). So far, there's ten quick pencil outlines in 6B pencil on offwhite A4 size paper, and scans of each where I increased the contrast so I have some usable traces to work from when making the flat colour paintings. \n

/> The plan is to end up with five sets. One of the drawings I've already done, then four sets of paintings. One in flat colour like the [Blond Cards](https://blondcards.com/) one of black Indian ink paintings and two of loose acrylic paintings like the [Heckel's Horse Jr A3 paper on cardboard series](https://edgeworth.blog/2025/10/10/hhj-a3-sketchbook-pages-on-cardboard-paintings/), one using the traces and another freehand. If I get the time I'd like to do some digital flat colour ones using the scans and GIMP, the image editor I use that's like free Photoshop. Not only will they all be on cardboard with lots of surrounding [Advertism](https://advertism.org/) but will have the following three addresses written into the artworks themselves @offgridlife , @ronthroop and @jompiy . Maybe not on all of them, but I think it will look good on at least most. FREE ART FREES ART is building quite a team to be reckoned with. I'm looking forward to taking these to [The Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) display. So much so, I'm not going to Billy's today so I can get working on them, hopefully to have them done and processed for next weekend.

/> \nFREE ART FREES ART has already taken virtually all [my music](https://edgeworth.blog/music/) making time up, and I suspect will mean less [Monday day trips to Chatham](https://edgeworth.blog/2023/03/22/chatham-dockyard-diary-episode-18/) in the near future. The same's true of space. I don't have the room to get all the music recording gear out and set up in my studio as I need the FREE ART FREES ART stuff immediately to hand. It's a bit of a problem, but just means I need to get my workflow more organised. An hour a day for computer tasks, like writting this, an hour or two for music and a big tidy up around the house should fix it. \n

![i1ehDvHwZOItJWKa_IMG_20260418_181254.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/i1ehDvHwZOItJWKa_IMG_20260418_181254/i1ehDvHwZOItJWKa_IMG_20260418_181254.webp)
![bHgYf8QQohvuyDmj_IMG_20260418_181259.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/bHgYf8QQohvuyDmj_IMG_20260418_181259/bHgYf8QQohvuyDmj_IMG_20260418_181259.webp)
![fQlHxa1lDB2vi5qm_IMG_20260418_182536.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/fQlHxa1lDB2vi5qm_IMG_20260418_182536/fQlHxa1lDB2vi5qm_IMG_20260418_182536.webp)

</center>
</liketuimages>

刚到旭辉一楼，大宝就突然喊到：“邓紫棋！”我抬头一看，整层楼都挂满了她的海报，才惊觉原来我家孩子也认识她。
 
现在的10后不看电视、不追综艺，可网络热梗、流行歌却比我们这些老古董懂多了，刷短视频、和同学聊天中都能获得许多讯息。

海报上写着傍晚六点开始，大宝说她挺喜欢邓紫棋的，一定要等到六点亲眼看看，还说最爱《唯一》。我不是粉丝，《唯一》没听过，只知道《喜欢你》《泡沫》《我的秘密》，还曾有幸在她压轴出场的群星晚会上听过《泡沫》，那时候她的人气就很旺了。
 
时间尚早，我们先出去转了一圈，五点多再回商场。开进地下室，空荡荡的车位让我犯嘀咕：“难道现在人都不追星了？明星要来还这么空？”进了商场，人流也和往常差不多，舞台倒是搭好了。大宝一眼看到前排空位，拉着我们就冲过去，前面两排全是和她差不多大的小女孩。主持人笑着调侃，让她们给哥哥姐姐让让位置，说“你们对邓紫棋的喜欢，肯定没我们多”，结果一群孩子齐刷刷喊：“我们也喜欢！”
 
我越看越不对劲，悄悄问旁边的女生：“邓紫棋会来吗？”她笑着摇头：“怎么可能？她要是来，商场早就挤爆了，我们哪还有位置坐。”我尴尬地抬头，才看清海报角落的小字——粉丝见面会，明星不到场。
 
我赶紧跟大宝说明情况，劝她回家，可她无动于衷，说再等等。
 
穿紫色周边服的女主持人开始试音，第一首就是《我的秘密》。她唱得真好，毫不怯场，声线和邓紫棋完美契合，全程没看屏幕，节奏却卡得精准，只有两处歌词唱错了，不细听根本发现不了。想来她是邓紫棋的忠实粉丝，这场粉丝见面会大概就是她组织的。
 
试音结束，前排的孩子直接喊：“要听《泡沫》。主持人说歌单里没有，但呼声太高，先让两个男生唱了一遍，不跑调却总少点味道。后来主持人在台下拿起话筒一起唱，她的声音一加入，瞬间就有感觉了。
 
现场还免费发放荧光棒，可其他周边得参加过邓紫棋演唱会才能领。明星的魅力果然不容小觑。听完三首歌，我拉着孩子们回家了。虽然没见到真人，却也在现场听了几首歌，关键唱得还不错。.

---

title.title: Looking for a Place for His Wedding
title.body:
Hello friends. I just want to share my experience yesterday when I went to a venue that I heard from a friend. My son is about to marry, so we're looking for a nice venue where everyone feels comfortable and relaxed, not just having fun. So we went to LJ Mega Convention Hall of Butuan. They also offer wedding planning, decorations and food catering services. The center has just newly built so it looks tidy, spacious and cozy. The hanging and glittering tassles that compliments the environment color looks calm and elegant. Inside is fully air-conditioned, so I'm pretty sure that the guests, the bride and groom will be comfortable. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgH8hjt1SDys8jP7YH3yRXkNrrmbZATSVCYZ3KRATQdN/1776667299424.jpg)
The place looks minimalist. The tables and chairs are good looking, but these will all change depend on what motif I would love to choose. The bubbly ceiling ornaments combined with the hanging flowers can provide a garden indoor wedding. Pretty sure, it will be a nature like wedding of my son. I had imagined what we all will be look like and the bridesmaids will wear a flower crown. Will it be redundant? Tell me. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQjXRWz3RGiWKBAoQ2Uj2CYnGFwAUBjEEHrerBsZgZpv/1776667299465.jpg)
We liked the place so much. It was new, clean, comfy and spacious. However, the venue costs 60,000 pesos per hour excluding the food cater and decorations. How expensive is this for you? It adding all the costs, it would be 100 thousand plus. If you're planning to marry one day, save right now so that you can have a dream wedding that you want and it will not cost your parents. LOL! It's expensive to marry, so study first before prioritizing a lovelife. After studying, there are many responsibilities that awaits, so marry at the right time and at the right bank savings. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeX3kiodSqQ2HamnoppULmuScaxXQAXE8jK6BphRqQ1wr/1776667299528.jpg)
Because the price they gave wasn't right for my budget, we choose the beach wedding. My children want a beach wedding because it's summer. Not just the small of money to spend, but the guests can also swim at the beach after the wedding ceremony. Today, I contacted the beach and the price is only 20,000 pesos rent for an hour in their convention center. Plus, they have hotel accomodation for 1,500 per night. We're planning to stay there for two nights in about pre-wedding and after. I have already booked three rooms. The special room is for the bride and groom. The big room is for us. The other room is the make up room and corkages. Anyway, bye friends. There are many things I'd like to do. 'Till next time!

title.title: Learning Hive Projects in Public #6: Hive Keychain (Current Understanding)
title.body:
# Learning Hive Projects in Public #6: Hive Keychain (Current Understanding)

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSW4TL9MUNTbqWgeD94fFk9EPGj2wXziSbZj3EQ7UjhjH/image)

Today I’m continuing this editorial series with **Hive Keychain**, one of the most visible authentication and transaction-signing tools in the Hive ecosystem.

*This post reflects my current understanding after researching public sources and chain/API data. I may still misunderstand parts of this system. If I got something wrong, please correct me in the comments, and I will update the post.*

---

## 1) What this project is

**Verified:** Hive Keychain is a browser wallet extension for Hive that lets users store keys locally and approve/reject blockchain operations through a popup flow instead of pasting private keys into dApps.

**Verified:** The extension injects a `hive_keychain` API into webpages so integrated Hive dApps can request actions like transfer, vote, custom_json, sign, and other operation types.

**Inference:** In day-to-day usage, Keychain acts as a core trust layer for many Hive frontends and tools.

---

## 2) History/timeline (publicly verifiable)

- **2018-10-18:** `@keychain` Hive account created (chain API check).
- **2019-12-13:** `hive-keychain-api` repository created (GitHub org data).
- **2020-03-19:** `hive-keychain-extension` repository created (GitHub API).
- **2020-04-29:** earliest `@keychain` blog entry currently visible (`hive-keychain-proposal-dhf`) from chain API checks.
- **2022-04-08:** latest release object in GitHub releases endpoint is tagged `v2.0.0`.
- **2026-04-20:** Chrome Web Store lists extension version `3.15.5` updated April 20, 2026.

**Unknown:** Full pre-Hive migration timeline and all historical milestones before current public repos/accounts are not fully reconstructed here.

---

## 3) Team/people (public only)

**Verified (public GitHub contribution data):** Top visible contributors to `hive-keychain-extension` include `stoodkev`, `cedricguillas`, and `theghost1980`.

**Verified (public store listing):** Chrome Web Store lists developer as **Hive Keychain Limited**.

**Unknown:** Exact legal entity structure, full-time team size, and governance model are not fully clear from these sources alone.

---

## 4) Problem it is solving

Hive dApps need users to sign operations, but asking users to paste private keys directly into websites is a major security and UX problem.

**Verified:** Keychain’s documented model is:
1. dApp requests operation via injected API
2. user sees approval UI
3. user approves/rejects
4. signed operation is broadcast

This shifts key custody/signing away from every dApp frontend and into a dedicated wallet layer.

---

## 5) Technology and architecture (current understanding)

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbdQhyUTZrNATdcZneYN549WnCFKPNcCDcJ6UfkuU7xmC/image)

### What appears verified
- Browser extension model (Chromium/Firefox).
- JavaScript API injected as `window.hive_keychain`.
- Documented methods include handshake, posting, voting, transfers, custom_json, signing, proposal ops, and more.
- Extension docs describe encrypted local key storage and lock behavior.

### What appears likely/inference
- Architectural direction seems to be broader than a single extension: public repos also include mobile, SDK, API, multisig frontend, and newer EVM-related work.
- This suggests Keychain may be evolving into a wider identity/signing stack across Hive + adjacent tooling.

### Unknowns
- Exact current production architecture boundaries between extension, mobile, backend APIs, and experimental repos.
- Security-review cadence and formal audit status (not established in the sources I used).

---

## 6) Hive integration points

**Hive L1 integration (verified via docs/API):**
- transaction signatures and broadcasts for core Hive operations
- account, posting, active authority usage paths
- proposal operations and other governance-related transactions

**Hive Engine integration (verified via docs):**
- `requestSendToken` and `requestSwap` are documented in the Keychain API docs
- this indicates direct UX support for token actions beyond native HIVE/HBD flows

**Chain activity signal:** `@keychain` blog shows active development updates in 2026, including proposal/transparency and product updates.

---

## 7) Strengths, tradeoffs, risks

### Strengths
- Strong security/UX pattern versus key pasting.
- Widely recognized integration surface for Hive dApps.
- Active public update trail in 2026.

### Tradeoffs
- Extension trust model concentrates risk in one wallet layer, which must remain well-maintained.
- UX consistency depends on dApps implementing request flows correctly.

### Risks / evolving areas
- Browser-permission sensitivity and user trust expectations are high.
- Expansion into more chains/features can increase complexity and attack surface.
- Public transparency on audits and architecture details may need to keep pace with scope growth.

---

## 8) Open Questions

1. What is the current formal security-audit status for extension/mobile/SDK components?
2. How is the product roadmap prioritized between core Hive stability and EVM expansion?
3. Which Keychain components are considered production-critical today vs experimental?
4. What reliability metrics (approval success rate, broadcast failure rate, signing latency) are tracked internally?
5. How should dApp developers think about graceful fallback when Keychain is unavailable?

---

## 9) Sources

- Hive Keychain extension repo: https://github.com/hive-keychain/hive-keychain-extension
- Hive Keychain docs README (API methods/features): https://github.com/hive-keychain/hive-keychain-extension/blob/master/documentation/README.md
- Hive Keychain GitHub org: https://github.com/hive-keychain
- Chrome Web Store listing: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hive-keychain/jcacnejopjdphbnjgfaaobbfafkihpep
- Hive account `@keychain` blog feed (chain API based): https://peakd.com/@keychain
- Hive account `@hive-keychain` (chain): https://peakd.com/@hive-keychain

---

If you build a Hive app and have direct experience with Keychain edge cases, I’d especially love your corrections and implementation notes.

title.title: El contexto no es decoración [Esp-Eng]
title.body: _Saludos comunidad @holos.lotus_\n\n_Camino al trabajo en la mañana,  veo las aceras y las calles rotas, en las que alguna que otra vez me tropiezo, el montículo de bolsas en una esquina cualquiera que lleva días esperando al camión de la basura, el grafiti cansado en la pared de algún edificio abandonado. Ya luego llego a casa, cierro la puerta y digo: \

. Pero esa frase no es neutral, ella ya es una herida, porque lo que hay no se queda afuera, sino que se te mete en los huesos, porque aunque se pretenda negar, el contexto no es una mera decoración, no es el telón de fondo del teatro, que es posible ignorar mientras se representa una obra, el contexto es algo que te empuja, sientes su respiración, o el susurro de qué hacer y cómo sentirte._

>Greetings community @holos.lotus

>On the way to work in the morning, I see the broken sidewalks and streets, where I occasionally trip, the pile of bags on some random corner that's been waiting for the garbage truck for days, the tired graffiti on the wall of some abandoned building. Then I get home, close the door, and say: \

But that phrase isn't neutral—it's already a wound, because what's there doesn't stay outside; it gets into your bones. Because even if you try to deny it, context isn't mere decoration, it's not the backdrop of the theater that you can ignore while a play is being performed. Context is something that pushes you; you feel its breath, or the whisper of what to do and how to feel.
***********
<center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/01/11/21/30/road-3076970_1280.jpg</center>
************
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/la-carretera-callej%c3%b3n-ciudad-3076970/)</center>

_Quizás han notado cómo puede llegar a cambiar su humor cuando el día amanece gris y lluvioso, eso no es por casualidad, las estadísticas de felicidad suben con el sol, y bajan con la tormenta, no porque seamos frágiles, sino porque somos permeables, como esponjas en un charco, aunque nos guste creernos de piedra. Cuando los entornos te empiezan a gritar cosas feas, devolviendo una imagen de desidia y abandono, de \

, de ver tantas cosas rotas que no se reponen, los códigos se aflojan. Si la calle es un basurero, ¿por qué iba a molestarme en buscar un contenedor? Si el vecino estaciona en la acera y nadie dice nada, ¿por qué no voy a hacerlo yo también? Esa sensación de \

no nace de la maldad humana, sino de un espejo roto, el entorno devolviendo la imagen de que las normas no existen, y entonces tú dejas de verlas. No es solo cuestión de la basura o las paredes descascaradas, hablo de la mirada del otro, del clima político, del rumor constante de que las cosas van mal, todo eso va modelando, diciendo cómo comportarte._\n\n_Y cuesta aceptar que tenemos una tendencia natural a explicar todo desde adentro: \
, cosa de mirada disposicional diría algún psicólogo. Mi personalidad, valores, carácter claro que importan, pero también existe otra mirada, que podríamos llamar situacional, \

. No podemos de golpe cambiar nuestro entorno o comunidad de la noche al día, no es posible hacer que la basura desaparezca con un chasquido, o que la degradación de las viviendas se repare por arte de magia, eso es un hecho, y esos hechos que hasta rabia dan, porque sabes que las causas son más grandes que tu bolsillo y tu tiempo, lo que sí está en nuestras manos es saberlo._\n\n>Maybe you've noticed how your mood can change when the day dawns gray and rainy. That's not by chance—happiness statistics rise with the sun and fall with the storm, not because we're fragile, but because we're permeable, like sponges in a puddle, even though we like to think we're made of stone. When environments start shouting ugly things at you, projecting an image of neglect and abandonment, of \

of seeing so many broken things that never get replaced, the codes loosen. If the street is a dump, why would I bother looking for a trash can? If the neighbor parks on the sidewalk and no one says anything, why wouldn't I do it too? That feeling of \

isn't born from human evil, but from a broken mirror—the environment reflecting the image that norms don't exist, and then you stop seeing them. It's not just about the trash or the peeling walls; I'm talking about the gaze of others, the political climate, the constant rumor that things are going badly. All of that shapes you, tells you how to behave.\n\n>And it's hard to accept that we have a natural tendency to explain everything from within: \
—a matter of dispositional perspective, as a psychologist might say. My personality, values, character—they certainly matter, but there's also another perspective, which we could call situational: \

We can't change our environment or community overnight with a snap of our fingers. We can't magically make the trash disappear or repair the decay of housing. That's a fact—and those facts are infuriating because you know the causes are bigger than your wallet and your time. But what is in our hands is knowing this.
********
<center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2019/07/31/08/48/cuba-4374729_1280.jpg</center>
*********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/cuba-pobreza-fachada-ventana-4374729/)</center>

_Saber que ese contexto te está impactando ya es un escudo, no uno mágico, sino uno que te permite decir: \

.  Puedes ponerle un límite al mal humor del día gris, puedes aunque cueste, barrer la acera frente a tu puerta aunque el resto esté sucio, y en medio del deterioro decidir que no vas a convertirte en el reflejo de ese deterioro, porque hay una diferencia entre \
(que suena a rendición, a tragar saliva y agacharse) y \

. Lo segundo es un acto de rebeldía, de entender que aunque no puedas cambiar las causas hoy, puedes trabajar sobre los efectos para que no te pudran por dentro, y esa actitud distinta tiene un poder paliativo real, no va a solucionar el problema de raíz, pero evitará que el problema te solucione a ti._\n\n_Hay quienes dicen: \

. Muy bonito el dicho, pero mientras las causas se pelean en reuniones y despachos que te quedan lejos, la vida sigue en el día a día mojado, en la acera rota, en la incomodidad constante. A veces toca empezar por los efectos, porque de tanto aguantar, se te olvida que puedes hacer algo, aunque sea minúsculo, y de esos actos minúsculos sostenidos por mucha gente, quizás algún día se construya el empujón que las causas necesitan._\n\n>Knowing that this context is impacting you is already a shield—not a magical one, but one that lets you say: \

You can put a limit on the bad mood of a gray day; you can, even if it's hard, sweep the sidewalk in front of your door even if the rest is dirty; and in the midst of decay, decide that you're not going to become the reflection of that decay. Because there's a difference between \
(which sounds like surrender, like swallowing hard and bowing down) and \

The latter is an act of rebellion—understanding that even if you can't change the causes today, you can work on the effects so they don't rot you from the inside. And that different attitude has a real palliative power. It won't solve the root problem, but it will keep the problem from solving you.\n\n>Some say: \

Nice saying, but while the causes are being fought over in meetings and offices far from you, life goes on in the daily wetness, on the broken sidewalk, in the constant discomfort. Sometimes you have to start with the effects, because after enduring so much, you forget that you can do something—even if it's tiny. And from those tiny acts, sustained by many people, maybe one day the push that the causes need will be built.
**********
<center>https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2016/07/08/17/21/cuba-1504867_1280.jpg</center>
**********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/cuba-la-habana-coche-antiguo-coche-1504867/)</center>

_No somos el mundo y nosotros, por separado, somos un solo cuerpo, con influencias que van y vienen, el entorno te golpea, pero tú también le devuelves algo, puede ser resignación o un esbozo de sonrisa, sé que es difícil sonreír en tiempos difíciles, más no se trata de una sonrisa boba, de las que niegan la realidad, es no dejar que la realidad te anule, es saber que ese esbozo por pequeño, ya es una victoria, significa que aún tienes un resquicio desde donde mirar las cosas de otro modo._

_Es la vida cotidiana, la tuya, la mía, la del vecino que ya ni saluda, si logramos entender cómo nos afecta lo que nos rodea, quizás dejemos de ser víctimas para transformarnos en algo más incómodo, más incómodo para el propio deterioro, eso ya es empezar a cambiar algo._

>We are not the world and us, separately; we are one single body, with influences flowing back and forth. The environment hits you, but you also give something back to it—it could be resignation or a hint of a smile. I know it's hard to smile in difficult times, but it's not about a foolish smile that denies reality. It's about not letting reality cancel you out. It's about knowing that that small hint is already a victory—it means you still have a crack through which to see things differently.

>It's everyday life—yours, mine, that of the neighbor who doesn't even say hello anymore. If we manage to understand how our surroundings affect us, perhaps we'll stop being victims and transform into something more uncomfortable, more uncomfortable for deterioration itself. That, in itself, is the beginning of change.
************

Through her work, Garofalaki explores themes of memory, identity, and the invisible weight we all carry, personal, social, and collective. Her artistic language blends subtlety with intensity, creating pieces that feel both intimate and universal.

title.title: Going back to see the recycling initiative that Da Nang set up in tourist areas
title.body: Vietnam has a tough time facing reality.  They are well-known throughout the world for being one of the largest per-capita polluters of any country in the world.  If you live here you can see this in action because it doesn't really matter where you go, there is trash everywhere.   While I cannot confirm this is true or not, the rumor has it that the sewers pump in giant pipes several miles off the coast and that is their septic treatment program.   Fish are pretty good at taking care of human waste but since the areas are fished by commercial vessels to the point of near eradication of all ocean species, there is not much out there to eat the waste.   And to think.... some people consider seafood a \
type of food.\n\nAbout 5 years ago the city and more specifically the area that I live in put up a bunch of signs about \

and then had recycling bins put all over the place.  Since I often travel on a scooter to the other part of town that is in no way affiliated with tourism, I saw first hand that these green initiatives applied ONLY in the tourist areas.  I had my suspicions that this would be the case anyway but when I saw that the whole \

thing was all just a lie to trick tourists, it was still kind of depressing.

Well, these days the recyling centers that they set up in the areas that tourists would frequently walk have almost completely become unattended, unmaintained, and even though there isn't much in the way of nature around, the jungle has taken them over.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23vsKyxLnBv3FzENKRT8N7yUyXqXfDja759Q38ovvspSKUZ9iNSsB1iSEKXhNF9B1mGKL.png)
</center>

Now if you were a sensible government official - if there is such a thing - wouldn't it be more prudent to simply take these things away?  It doesn't add much to the ambiance and it has the opposite effect that was originally intended of duping the visitors into believing that the government actually cares about the environment.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23vhuno5z3ZQbmHZfzGteSakaUX7S9cVtSvop1nbNuzBx2S6z6ayPAqu9PzqXJoUR621Q.png)
</center>

This one isn't as terrible, but it is still pretty bad.  One thing that always kind of irritated me about these was that the entrance where you drop off the bottles or whatever had these sort of security methods built in to make it impossible or at the minimum, painful for any waste collector that is trying to make a few bucks for to exchange for food.   Just why?  

It also made me upset that they had a few sections for things I know damn well that this city doesn't have the capacity to recycle anyway.  Batteries and glass are not recycled in Da Nang, or perhaps anywhere in Vietnam.  So if you were a conscientious traveler who separated these things they simply ended up getting thrown in the regular trash anyway.

The money that was spent on this ruse could have been used for anything else and it would have been better spent.   If this country truly wants to clean up their image they could do so.   I would start by punishing people for littering, which I've seen it with my own eyes man, people just throw things on the ground when they are done with it and they have no remorse or fear of consequences when doing so.  Cabbies throwing cigarettes buts on the the ground is extremely common.

title.title: Yesterday didn’t go as I had planned at all
title.body: *Saturday* night stretched longer than expected. I stayed up really late, thinking about different things, some important, some just random thoughts that refused to let me rest. By the time I finally slept, my body was already exhausted, but my mind still felt active. Surprisingly, I woke up around 5am on Sunday. Normally, that would have been enough time to prepare and go to church, but I could feel something wasn’t right. It wasn’t just tiredness, it was deeper than that I felt mentally stressed and drained. I tried to convince myself to stand up, get ready, and push through it, but my body just didn’t cooperate. So I made a decision I don’t usually make I went back to sleep. Later in the morning, some of my friends came around. They were surprised I didn’t show up in church, and of course, they asked questions. I could see it on their faces, that mix of concern and curiosity. I simply told them the truth I was too stressed and needed rest.

> At first, I felt a bit guilty. Missing church isn’t something I take lightly. But as the day went on, I started to understand that sometimes, rest is also necessary. We don’t always have to push ourselves beyond our limits just to meet expectations, even good ones.

>

Yesterday reminded me that being human means recognizing when your body and mind need a break. It wasn’t about laziness, it was about recovery.
Hopefully, next Sunday will be different. I’ll be back, stronger and more refreshed.
Have you ever had a day like that, where your body just says “not today”? Hahaha 🤣 😂,share with me in the comments section. 

*Thanks for coming to my blog*

title.title: 🌸➡️🍊 Nature Doesn’t Rush… Yet Everything Happens
title.body:
Just a few days ago, this plant was covered in tiny white flowers… today, I spotted these young fruits forming 👀
That moment made me pause.
In farming, nothing happens overnight. You weed, you water, you wait… and sometimes you wonder if anything is even changing. But quietly, nature is working.
Now here it is—the result of patience, consistency, and care 🌱
This is why I always believe in growing what we can and eating fresh. Fruits like these are not just food—they’re real nourishment, straight from the source 🍃
It also connects deeply with what I stand for—natural living and plant-based nutrition, just like what I promote through Harmonel Moringa Green 💚
Small garden… big lessons.
Trust the process. Growth is happening—even when you don’t see it.

title.title: I miss...everything 🤣.
title.body:
Here I am, happy to post again, in response to one of the topics proposed by Galen for this Weekend Engagement. Thank you 😊.

Oh, what do I miss about being a child? Almost everything! I miss the house where I grew up. The smell of wood and thatch from its roofs. The fresh breeze that came in through its single-leaf windows, which were like little doors. That house no longer exists; in its place there’s a more modern and “comfortable” one, but nothing like the old house. I loved sliding on soapy water along its long hallway and playing with the streams of water that fell from its roof when it rained.

I miss getting soaked in the downpours and splashing in the mud, even though my grandmother would yell at me that I was going to get sick… and sometimes I did 😜. I miss the lack of responsibilities, that thing of not having to worry about anything except playing and wishing night would never come… so I could keep playing 🤣. I miss the snacks of salty round crackers with guava paste and cheese, the ones that tasted better on stormy afternoons when the thunder kept me from going outside. But as soon as the rain let up, I’d run to make little boats out of newspaper and float them down the streams of water and mud left by the rain. I also miss walking to school very early in the mist that wouldn’t let me see even a meter ahead, and I’d arrive soaked as if I’d been caught in a downpour.

Climbing up into the mango and tangerine trees and eating their fruit while sitting on their branches is a memory I treasure like gold. Running around under the coffee plants, which were always in the shade, was so much fun. Though more than once I’d come out screaming from the stings of santanillas (fire ants), which burn like hell 🤪.

I miss the ice cream cart that came by with its classic song and its white cardboard “pintas” with a red stripe and a blue one. The “Beatriz” yogurt that had a cow painted on the label and tasted like heaven. I long for the candies and pastries from the little candy shop in my town, I’d buy them on my way back home from school, fresh out of the oven. I’ve never had any others like them.

I miss the traveling library that came every week and the mobile cinema with its movies projected onto a white cloth. That capacity for wonder I had for everything is something I remember with nostalgia. But what I miss the most is the ability to apprehend, that ease as a child to absorb effortlessly, to learn just by looking and asking. That ability I feel I’ve lost… but oh well, age takes its toll 🤪.

In short, I miss being a child because I miss a life that tasted like rain, mango, tangerine, and salty crackers with guava paste and cheese. Because I long for a home that no longer exists, and for a version of me who learned without even realizing it. Because back then, the worst thing in the world was night falling or getting a \

bite. Because in the end, it’s not things I miss, I miss that ease of being happy that only children have.

title.title: Higher or Lower Contest - Round 3
title.body:
Round 2 was a bloodbath! 

Only 4 players correctly predicted that there would be more than 14 goals in the 5 matches that made up the round. In fact, there were 17 goals. 


![Designer (5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23yU6RH9ucK3oxzT2bGu13tjtDftfuGT2fXaZZs2nQ9xs3HMgFferW3DpzRt65EJeLmgC.png)


A minimum of 2 goals in every game and then 6 in the Bayern v Stuttgart fixture is what really tipped the balance. To be fair, that was always the game that was most likely to put the scoring over the top and so it proved to be. 

It does of course set the bar very high for round 3 at 17 goals. Hopefully that will prompt a few players to buy back in and indeed we've already had a couple do just that which has pushed the prize pool up to 1300 MEDALS. 

Will we get a repeat of yesterday's goal fest? Let's have a look at the fixtures... 


### Crystal Palace v West Ham

A massive game for West Ham after the 3 teams around them in the relegation battle all picked up points over the weekend. A win here would pull them 4 points clear of Spurs, a defeat leaves it looking like a direct fight with their London neighbors for the final spot in the bottom 3. 

Palace are in a slightly odd position themselves. With 2 matches in hand, they could move up as high as 6th if they were to win both and look to boost their European qualification hopes. Of course, their other going concern is in Europe where they've reached the semi-finals of the Conference League and are chasing a 3rd trophy in the space of 12 months which represents a period of unparalleled success in the club's history. 

Neither of these sides seems to like a London derby. Palace have won just 1 of their last 8 home games against London teams while the Hammers have picked up just 4 points against other London clubs in the same time frame. 

The bookies are somewhat sat on the fence with this one as far the likelihood for goals are concerned. 

<u>Under/over odds </u>
Under 2.5 goals - 2.00
Over 2.5 goals - 1.80

Over 2.5 goals in last 5 games

👈 most recent matches


![Screenshot 2026-04-20 at 06.24.51.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/23tvubGRRkxCQPargdPVDdpGGFU3BE9bRdowLMTa5xNyvEGMo6vLrNnUVhp3XkGDvg776.png)


### Lecce v Fiorentina

Having had a lot of matches yesterday that defined title chases, today is very much relegation battle Monday. 

Lecce are currently sat in the bottom 3 of Serie A and on a dreadful run of form with 4 straight defeats to their name. 

Fiorentina have picked up 3 wins and 11 points in their last 5 matches to slingshot past tonight's opponents and up to 15th place, 8 points clear of the drop zone. 

This then is your classic 6 pointer! A win for the Viloa would see them all but safe. A win for Lecce would take them out of relegation while dragging their opponents back into the quagmire. 

Goal scoring wise the home side have managed just 21 league goals in 32 matches so far, the lowest in Serie A this season. They've failed to score in their last 3 outings but to be fair, those games have all come against much better opposition. After this match, they face the 2 sides below them in the league, so you'd say their fate is in their own hands if they can just locate where the opposition's net is! 

The Viola beat Palace midweek but crashed out of the Europa League anyway (4-2 on aggregate). Will that dampen their ambitions for the rest of the season? 

I think this one is likely to be a fairly tense affair. 

<u>Under/over odds </u>
Under 2.5 goals - 1.67
Over 2.5 goals - 2.15

Over 2.5 goals in last 5 games

👈 most recent matches

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 at 06.36.14.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talesfrmthecrypt/48K8Xm3a7DVtwAAKSA3rJY8rTqrnR9z1HfyGVbyudiT8KnpaGieJF9suNqZ2RGGskL.png)

### Midtjylland v AGF

You might have noticed that we've gotten a little more exotic with some of our picks today. That's necessity as much as anything. We need 5 games all kicking off within a couple of hours of each other so.... Welcome to Denmark! 

I'll be honest, I know nothing about Danish domestic football. I'm just reading up now to get my head around their league structure which like several leagues from smaller European countries has 2 distinct phases. 

The first phase is a general league where everyone (12 sides in the top flight) plays everyone, home and away. Then it appears the top 6 teams go into a 'Super League' for a further 10 games. 

We are just coming up to the half way point of that Super League phase with these 2 having been the top 2 sides in the normal league stage of the season. 

Since then, neither team has been pulling up any trees against the stronger opposition they now face on a weekly basis. 

Midtjylland were dumped out of Europe recently by Notts Forest (Did you go to that match @doombot75? Can you share any tips on them?) and from being the top scorers in the regular league phase, have failed to score more than 2 goals in a game since February. 

The same can be said of AGF who are 5 clear at the top. They've scored just 4 goals in their last 4 games too. 

Recent matches between these 2 giants of the Danish league don't suggest a goal fest (1-1, 1-0 & 1-1). 

The bookies couldn't be more on the fence for this one or maybe, like us, they just don't watch much Danish football! 

<u>Under/over odds </u>
Under 2.5 goals - 1.85
Over 2.5 goals - 1.85

### Moreirense v Estoril Praia

To Portugal and 2 sides you've probably never heard of! 

In fact, here's a bit of trivia I do know about the Portugese League. Only 5 clubs have ever won it and I bet everyone can guess 3 of them easily. I doubt many can get the remaining 2. As a clue, it's neither of these 2 sides! 

Both these teams are as mid-table as you can get in 9th and 8th place respectively. Recent poor runs of form have put pay to either side's ambitions of challenging the big boys to become the 6th team in Portugese football history to win the league. 

On the goal front, Estoril Praia are the league entertainers. 101 goals have been scored in their 29 games to date, more than any side in the league. 

Moreirense aren't quite so thrilling, they've huffed and puffed to just 32 league goals this season. 

However, if you are thinking that like yesterday, there could be a really high-scoring game, then perhaps recent history suggests this will be it. These two played out a 3-3 draw in December and in total there have been 21 goals in their last 5 meetings with no fewer than 3 goals in any single match.

Under 2.5 goals - 1.83
Over 2.5 goals - 1.91

### Gaziantep FK v Kayserispor

Last but not least, we stop by Turkey. 

Kayserispor are in desperate need of a result. They've dropped to 2nd last after the weekend results with the bottom 3 being relegated from the Super Lig. 

You don't need a degree in data science to see their problem. They are the league's lowest scorers and have the league's worst defence. 

However, it is very tight down there with 5 sides involved in a relegation scrap. A win for Kayserispor would move them out of the bottom 3. That however would be just their 5th win of the season (they love a draw in the Turkish league, around 30% of fixtures end in stalemate). 

The other thing they love in Turkey is a sending off. There has been at least 1 red card in 9 of Gaziantep's matches this season!

If they can keep 11 men on the field they'd probably fancy winning this one with relative ease as they did when the 2 sides met in November (0-3). The same fixture last year finished 3-2 in favour of the home side.

title.title: Making a Fool of Myself at College 😅 Week #305
title.body:
> ![post instagram Collage verano minimalista beige.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/AKKTT25cfXav7tPpdfyNLpghZLHWzKZ1Yqd8CcvYWtM9chQmceFQDQTsQPRQwv8.png) Hi, community friends! I hope you all had a great weekend. We were at my parents’ house, and honestly, I really needed that—hehe, it had been over a month since I’d seen them!! But anyway, let’s get to the point: today I’m definitely joining in with this question👇
Have you ever been ridiculed? Why did it happen, and how did you react—both outwardly and inwardly?
Well, honestly, many times, but there’s one time I remember as if it were yesterday😅😂 It turns out that when I was just starting college, first semester, I had broken up with my boyfriend of six months at the time, because he messed up and I found some messages—not because I checked his phone, but because people were calling him and he didn’t want to answer; he was acting really weird. and when I handed him the phone, the message was right there at the top. That very night I broke up with him, and he made a huge scene, smashing his phone and everything! The thing is, he spent weeks trying to convince me to get back together with him. But the last and most embarrassing thing he did was write on a white T-shirt with a marker asking me to forgive him. “Gusanita, forgive me. I LOVE YOU,” it said on the front, and he was yelling at me and chasing me all over campus 🙃🙃🙃. It was way too embarrassing for me, and from then on, I hated him even more 😅😅 ![alexas_fotos-excuse-me-5263696_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milagrosmhbl/23vi1x3c9TscKjr7LYQzg2r2hfiG5gkz7dm1vuMU7T7jSoxCGEqbiHsANkPYmxwDHipSy.jpg)
*Source*
And obviously, the group of cheerleaders who were studying with me started calling me “little worm” from then on 🙃🙃, and they never forgot that stupid shirt that guy paraded around the whole university in!! Which, by the way, he later sent to me, and obviously I threw it away 😂 because when I say no, I mean NO!

title.title: A touch of green in my rooftop garden: The joy of growing chillies.
title.body:
> ![IMG20260217172343.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP6XMdgHYqtVudKDaUdarDSfZCnyawMcPRemfVLJwwAje/IMG20260217172343.jpg) A touch of green in my rooftop garden: The joy of growing chillies. There is no substitute for gardening to find some peace in the midst of a busy urban life. For me, gardening is not just a hobby, it is a way to connect with nature. Today, I am sharing with you the current pride of my rooftop garden, the fresh and green chilli plant. ![IMG20260217172347.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVC1g9aeSKx36PebtA6viD8KQ9cYBAH9P98Rw8M1W47Wf/IMG20260217172347.jpg) As you can see in the picture, the plant is blooming with beautiful white flowers. These small white flowers of the chilli plant are as beautiful to look at as they are to bear a message of abundant harvest. When small green chillies peek out from the center of each flower, that sight is the greatest achievement for a gardener. My plants are now bearing chillies quite well. The feeling of being completely fresh, poison-free and growing it by one's own hands is incomparable. ![IMG20260217172338.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmarfhgsJX96NBSr4CmCA8LR1YaDQnL6Gvj2grseDsp2hb/IMG20260217172338.jpg) The chilli plant does not take up much space, so it is perfect for a rooftop garden or balcony. I have noticed that getting enough sunlight is very important for the chilli plant. If the plant gets at least 5-6 hours of sunlight a day, both the growth and yield of the plant are good. I take very simple care: - Soil: I used a mixture of organic fertilizer and loamy soil. - Water: I water regularly, but make sure that the roots do not get waterlogged. - Care: Sometimes I use kheil pocha water as fertilizer, which helps nourish the plant. ![IMG20260217172336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwMfH4tGAnbigTu67paNj4gKE6uhSYMpC6R8URa3edbt/IMG20260217172336.jpg) When you cook your afternoon snack or lunch with peppers from your own garden, you get a strange satisfaction along with the taste. Those who are thinking of starting a garden but cannot start, can start with at least one pepper plant. Believe me, when you see the first pepper growing on the top of the tree, all your hard work will seem worthwhile. Let me know in the comments how you liked this small update of my garden. Who among you has a rooftop garden? This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

title.body:
>

*Greetings, Hive travelers! It’s a pleasure to greet you and share a glimpse of my visit last week to a beautiful tropical beach in the state of Sucre, Venezuela. This beach, called San Luis, is truly magical—not only does it have an incredible ocean, but it also offers such a unique landscape that simply visiting it is a privilege. It stretches for more than 1.5 kilometers along the Caribbean coast, whose refreshing waters lap against the beautiful golden sand.* *After swimming with my children, I set out to walk along the seashore while the waves lapped at my feet, discovering several boats sailing freely through the area—local fishermen from the area who took advantage of the opportunity to give tourists rides for a very modest fee so they could see just how beautiful and expansive this coastline is.* *As for the vegetation, as you can see, the palm and coconut trees stand out, undoubtedly giving this place a paradisiacal touch and providing shade to visitors who come here in search of a day of relaxation and family fun.* *If you have the opportunity to travel to Venezuela, one of your favorite destinations in the eastern part of the country should be this beach located in the city of Cumaná, which keeps every tourist who visits it coming back again and again. In my case, I’ve been coming to this wonderful beach for over 40 years now, and I wouldn’t trade it for anything. Greetings and blessings.* ****

>

***Saludos viajeros de hive, gusto en saludarlos y compartirles parte de lo que fue mi visita el fin de semana pasada a una hermosa playa tropical en el estado Sucre Venezuela; esta playa llamada San Luis es realmente mágica ya que no solo tiene un mar increíble sino que además disfrutas de un paisaje tan único que sencillamente visitarla es un privilegio. Esta cuenta con una extensión de más de 1.5 kilómetros frente a las costas del Mar Caribe, que baña de frescura la bella arena dorada.*** ***Después de nadar con mis hijos, me dispuse a caminar por la orilla del mar mientras las olas bañaban mis pies, descubriendo varias embarcaciones que navegaban libremente por la zona, pescadores locales del sector que aprovechaban de pasear a los turistas a cambio de una tarifa bastante módica para que pudieran ver lo bello y extenso que es este litoral.*** ***En cuanto a la vegetación como pueden ver destacan las palmeras y cocoteros que le dan sin duda un toque paradisiaco a este lugar, brindando su sombra a los visitantes que venimos a este sector en búsqueda de un día de relax y diversión en familia.*** ***Si tienen la oportunidad de viajar a Venezuela, uno de sus destinos favoritos en el oriente del país debe ser esta playa ubicada en la ciudad de Cumaná, que mantiene atado a todos los turistas que la visita a regresar siempre, en mi caso ya son más de 40 años viniendo a esta maravillosa playa, la cual no cambia por nada. title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeS9Fzf1PgFmmBfHhEWXWyGAHXtVME9G6X2nW6htb1JQT/1776664816348.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhTKA7DUVbzemVWGJDsNqUKugdttzngvrG6gqx7Uqzd7/1776664817361.jpg)

## Beautiful Needlework Friends!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW9Lk7ayhDdYnbkFjmAMjTB5M9SyhqKYfpQBnXGKGwjKW/1776662414254.jpg)

I've been back at the sewing table this week, ***at last*** - and have already finished a very nice (in the end, started months ago!) bag, and *very nearly* completed another pair of fabulous trousers...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabBpqYuJzHw7qDwEyHsQ3ue16BQPGceHmwMh39XzPoGW/1776662414759.jpg)

Both projects have been sitting around not-yet-done, partly because of more pressing matters on our #sovereignhomestead (like landslide, storms, leaking house) , but also due to the solutions not coming easily.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme18k5Yh16aGfRwXTDVF8DtmGYKj8VRwCveWqrpFr4TUw/1776662415193.jpg)

#### I need a lot of space to get a project finished satisfyingly, and this really cannot be forced! So weeks and months went by, until I got enough head and energetic space, to concentrate on it sufficiently... and to find the right fabrics and accessories that would make it right.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdoEFunAdAoqKT7RMVYKmQ6JxZSLPhr5qMKop82QfqN9/1776662415740.jpg)

Hand-sewing, also, requires quiet, long hours of not doing anything else. For me it takes a full day with nothing else on the agenda. In our free and uninhibited life, @vincentnijman and I have plenty of room to do things spontaneously, whilst at the same time we absolutely are full to the brim with sacred tweaking of land and flora.... It is hard to tear ourselves away from the glory of it all, and focus on anything in the house!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeSj5iQ3h2jxaLJvmS3U3RB4p5LBeXFejBT6GdUAi95Fk/1776662517948.jpg)

However, once a garment nears the finish-line, it is easier to get stuck in, eh! And the sunny days, sitting out on the grass in the evening glow, next to the cat: divine.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcs4sGT75PefA7afnfE6Ggxg7GACeLvVRcwpyBeg5Eqxa/1776662518314.jpg)

**So these big trousers/ pants began as a cut-off pair of turquoise pinstripe kecks, which I wanted to pair with two other contrasting pinstriped trouser fabrics. But in the end I was stuck with not much choice in my fabric store here, which is a fraction of what I hold back in my other house. I tried multiple materials, but nothing resonated... until this nightie caught my eye, and I realised that it would be the perfect fot colours-wise - if I could make the length of it work...**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeEiTUrKCfzqpoi75eUhdKQvZEn4WMH2h21ot2vEE4GT/1776662518728.jpg)

To get the right length, though, I had to resolve the button area, at the top middle of the skirt part that I cut from the nightdress. So I took the old button (material) strip, cut the buttons off it, opened it out, then folded and sewed it into the space that was missing material. And it worked just fine. I love having wee quirks like this in my unique garments; it makes them even more inimitable!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZo7137Xh9dwotdBwTjJMmiyLmhsv6cSW4h2cEtVDi1w1/1776666135205.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNPjYgKAjbvGw1Ucwrog8EJbpn1PP37GTQiEctHPKtn4/1776666167887.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeMVgsGkkVzVL6j1xvPkau9rK3M37giHPYHQuDYm2Zweq/1776666190662.jpg)

The three elements, the beachy blue-green, the hot red, and the flowery drama, are held together by two additional elements: bordered strips at the top of the flowery print area, to neaten the gentle gathers in them, and also a thin homemade bias-binding strip which I am in the process of adding to the bottom of the trouser legs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaz32jFcTRQ99hEsyBC4ACaQqeFqxBaGfhX5Sdi9C2XAr/1776662413843.jpg)

It's the first time I've done a very neat bias-binding job! I used some darts (little V cuts) on some parts of the bias-binding, to help it sit right. The strips were  cut from a red skirt ruffle, and the stripey bordered pieces were from the (inside waist of the) previous red pinstriped trousers which make the legs on these ones.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPZSzzyrdd4PFSRAKgAwg4NW2Ku5HBfY2hMEUKBYZ4GSH/1776666248296.jpg)

***I look forward to a making a photoshoot for you all, with bag and trousers....*** 💝💝💝💝

# With Love!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNBCoL2kPM2gMDgGg42b7yTPQqYyEhVzW8xn7uV7d3cq/1776666406653.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVCY7TFZHGPunkp1SZQGjwFP8mTzobvDDuyHceqMPpjD/1771237735901.jpg)

title.title: November 30, 2024 - Waking Up to a Broken Reality
title.body:
>

Just when I believed I had moved on, there are still days and nights when you crawl back into my mind. There are moments when I’m busy and I pause, proud of myself for going hours or days without thinking of you. My mind celebrates the quiet, but my heart still aches.

Today, a song suddenly popped into my head “Die With a Smile” by Bruno Mars ft. Lady Gaga. The line about a “haunted dream” hit me hard. It reminded me of how you show up in my sleep as if everything is still real, 😔 only for me to wake up confused. Tempted to go back to sleep just to feel that happiness with you again, even though my mind warns me not to.



There are also nights when I’m scared to sleep because I don’t want to wake up hurting, haunted by dreams that pretend you are still mine. believing that you still love me, that you still want to be with me. My subconscious creates these moments in my dream that lift me up and breaks me right after upon waking up, false hope I’d say.

If a different version of us exists somewhere, still together, I hope that \
holds on tight. If I were given another chance, I’d do things differently. As I write this, with tears falling again, the truth remains... I still love you...

title.title: Curator Cat: Our New Favorite Thing!
title.body:
Greetings Fabulous Felines and Hoomans of Hivelandia and surrounding communities!

In yesterday's caturday update I mentioned that the Mom-Hooman had brought in a bucket of grass as a treat for us cats.

![CC0765-Grass1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23ywj2Eikd31dVua4DQKiwU3D9myPi7cWBjLumUPF3AJZueD3Es3KKoUkTZVtixxnDL7C.jpg)
*This is the greatest thing ever!*

Well, this has quickly turned into our new very most favorite thing in the house!

If you have cats in your life you're probably aware that we really like to nibble and green stuff, when presented with the opportunity. This is why house plants and cats often do not do well together!

![CC0765-Grass2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/243qEqy8j27avmFUXXxGnajFJMZRLfinWuKfy3syzBuT7PzvYjEWGqGjbyqHzRRX8J2vu.jpg)
*Nala, ever curious, was actually the first one to check it out!*

But not all green things are bad for cats, and in fact in nature we are likely to nibble on a few green things as well because it helps with our digestion.

However, I don't think the Mom-Hooman realized what a huge success that bringing in this little bucket of grass was going to be, in terms of how much we enjoy it.

![CC0765-Grass4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/243Be1DZwD3dMsYrxpUYDAgzzzhEHu2i32ur9vQ3JQBfy9Rrrof33cJ1DtcBqjesP7ZDk.jpg)
*Shangri wants in on the action!*

Even after just a few days, it's already beginning to look like something has been seriously grazing on it! Which — of course — we have!

Thankfully, regular old lawn grass is pretty harmless to cats and we really like chewing on the fresh shoots. I think the Mom-Hooman is also grateful for the fact that there has *not* been a lot of kitty ook around the house!

![CC0765-Grass6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/244oWosQLeQNuK6oyL5vFtvvkh5jzbfDb4xeMfY965roq6J6W4ttDnoXskvhPVZuVbS5v.jpg)
*Three cats grazing!*

In fact our usage has been so intense that now the Hoomans are talking about actually starting a second pot outside so when this one gets decimated to the ground they can bring in another one and so new grass can be grown in the one we just trimmed down.

That seems like a really good arrangement to me! It would be nice to have something fresh and green were actually *allowed* to eat, and always available.

![CC0765-Grass7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/242rq9sCT5FRJ5Tnqhsz4A2k5Pxw9zkZYR2KoWt5yESHEvEZUDFHFKWJKPHP6WzvWuaWq.jpg)
*This is so cool!*

Of course, that does not stop me from trying to sneak into the living room where the house plants are and have a nibble in there. There isn't anything actually toxic in there, but there *are* a couple of plants that make me a little bit sick to my stomach.

On the whole, the Hoomans do a pretty good job of policing that space so it's pretty rare that I get in there.

And, of course there's always the allure of doing something that is not allowed!

![CCS-008-SunnyNap.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat/23wMcakBKNGLQxJsE37tSx7XYSRDdbdG1XhnMnaHyH74MzoqGfxpxoMY56hNsncvvD23G.jpg)
*Afterwards, taking a nap in the sun, in the Mom-Hooman's office!*

For now though, I'm just going to be very grateful for the new grass and I know the other cats are as well. Even Smudge comes out for an occasional nibble!

Thanks for stopping by to visit our little cat blog, and we hope to see you again soon! If you have cats in your life, why not share a post with them here on Hive?

title.title: The dominant tension
title.body: The Strait of Hormuz cracked open again over the weekend, tankers queued up like nothing had happened, and crude still plunged double digits on Friday before the weekend. May WTI futures cratered 11.45% to a five-week low, Brent followed suit, and the energy sector that had been the only green patch through March suddenly looked exposed. Markets didn't cheer the \

; they smelled the bluff. One more tweet from Trump about indefinite suspension of Iran's nuclear program, one more vague ceasefire holding with Israel and Lebanon, and suddenly the risk premium that had inflated oil to over $100 evaporated faster than summer gasoline.

This isn't resolution. This is the market doing what it always does when geopolitics meets liquidity: price in the upside of normalization while quietly ignoring how fragile the whole setup remains. S&P 500 pushed to 7,126, up 1.20% on the day. Nasdaq added 1.52% to 24,468. Dow climbed nearly 1.8%. Tech and growth names led because lower energy costs mean fatter margins tomorrow, or so the algos decided. Defense stocks gave back some of their war premium. The 10-year yield barely budged around 4.3%. Gold held near $4,700-$4,800 territory, refusing to crash with oil because even in relief rallies the smart money keeps one eye on the next flare-up.

The dominant tension isn't peace in the Gulf—it's the speed at which this cycle of shock and shrug repeats. For weeks the narrative was energy shock: Hormuz disruptions, Saudi and UAE production cuts, Brent spiking past $110 at points, inflation fears forcing the ECB to pause its easing and debate hikes while the Fed stayed glued to hold. Now the tap reopens on paper, oil dumps, and equities rip as if the underlying supply chain damage, the stranded tankers, the rerouted logistics never mattered. European gas futures had screamed higher; now they're breathing. Aluminum and fertilizer prices that spiked on energy pass-through are easing. But the memory lingers in corporate boardrooms: one weekend of saber-rattling exposed how thin the global energy redundancy has become after years of underinvestment and just-in-time optimization.

Central banks are watching this whiplash with the same unease as traders. ECB policymakers spent last week downplaying an April rate hike, insisting they need more data on second-round effects from energy before committing. March projections already baked in higher headline inflation for 2026 thanks to the war premium; now the baseline shifts again. Fed dots still point to restraint, but the market's pricing reflects the same schizophrenia: lower oil good for growth, yet any renewed disruption reignites the exact inflation the higher-for-longer crowd fears. Divergence is back in fashion. BoJ tightening, ECB potentially reversing course, Fed on pause—currencies feel the torque. EUR/USD hovering, dollar holding firm.

Crypto, as usual, provided the chaotic counterpoint. While equities toasted the de-escalation, DeFi bled out another record hack. Kelp DAO, the liquid restaking protocol, got drained for roughly $293 million—116,500 rsETH, about 18% of supply—via forged cross-chain messages exploiting LayerZero's EndpointV2. Funds vanished across bridges, positions frozen on Aave and SparkLend, TVL evaporating in real time. This came hot on the heels of Drift Protocol's $285 million Solana perp exploit earlier in the month, pushing April's DeFi losses well north of $600 million across a dozen incidents. North Korean actors, private key compromises, social engineering, sloppy multi-sig setups—the usual suspects, the usual excuses.

The parallel is brutal. Traditional energy markets sell resilience through diversification and strategic reserves; decentralized finance sells it through code and incentives. Both failed the stress test in their own way. Oil's volatility exposed physical chokepoints and years of deferred maintenance on global infrastructure. Crypto's serial meltdowns exposed how \

systems still concentrate risk in bridges, oracles, and a handful of validators or signers that bad actors target with state-level patience. Bitcoin traded around $74k with modest moves, Ethereum near $2,270, Solana $84-ish—leaking a bit on the broader risk sentiment but nothing catastrophic. The real pain stayed on-chain, where retail liquidity providers and leveraged positions absorbed the hit while institutions nodded along to surveys claiming crypto as \

Here's the structural rot underneath the relief rally: we've optimized everything for efficiency and yield at the expense of redundancy. Energy supply chains, shipping routes, collateral bridges, monetary policy transmission— all tuned for calm seas. When the seas get rough, the repricing is violent, then quickly forgotten because memory is expensive and forward curves love mean reversion. Trump pushes domestic drilling and tariff threats as the fix; Europe eyes relaxed merger rules and defense spending. Both bet on scale solving fragility. History suggests otherwise. Scale without slack just amplifies the next transmission.

The tape's message this weekend was classic late-cycle denial: celebrate the averted disaster, front-run the margin expansion from cheaper input costs, and dismiss the tail as \

S&P at fresh highs, Nasdaq streaking, small caps catching a bid. Earnings season looms with guidance that will quietly bake in higher freight and volatility assumptions even as oil dips. PPI and CPI prints in coming weeks will test whether the energy relief sticks or gets swamped by second-round wage and services pressures.

This isn't the end of the Iran chapter; it's another verse in the same song. Markets have trained themselves to rotate from fear to FOMO in 48 hours because the alternative—building actual resilience—requires capital allocation that hurts near-term returns. So we reopen the strait, reopen the protocols, reopen the risk appetite, and pretend the system got stronger instead of just luckier.

The data orbiting this center tells a clearer story than the headlines. Oil's violent round trip, gold's refusal to collapse, crypto's parallel fragility, central banks' hesitation to declare victory. The global economy isn't healing; it's learning to live with higher baseline volatility in energy, security, and trust. Equities can ignore that for a while—liquidity and narrative are powerful anesthetics—but the next kink in the hose, whether in the Gulf, a bridge contract, or a policy misstep, will remind everyone how little margin for error actually exists.

Until then, enjoy the melt-up. The barrels are flowing again, the indices are climbing, and the holes in the system remain exactly where they were before the weekend. Only the prices changed.

title.title: 最近感冒
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![4oaxN6ysNEEvB0Kz_MEITU_20251219_220208482.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/4oaxN6ysNEEvB0Kz_MEITU_20251219_220208482/4oaxN6ysNEEvB0Kz_MEITU_20251219_220208482.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近一周一直处于感冒中~~~感觉是比较严重的那种。比较影响认状态的就是头疼，感冒引起的头疼。

上个周五开始症状比较严重了，头疼也引起一系列问题。工作完全提不起精神，然后休息也休息不好。然后我小孩也感冒了，他主要就是晚上咳嗽得很厉害，其它时间都还是生龙活虎，要是玩，精神抖擞耗不完的劲儿。

因为娃晚上折腾咳嗽，进一步导致我这段时间休息也不好。

按正常的规律作息，我应该这周去跑步两次，特别是周末，可能会完成一个10公里的跑步。一切因为一个小感冒，必须调整，躺平。

我感觉我自己的抵抗力很差，很多小病恢复起来都很漫长，就是那句病去如抽丝一般。

人到中年，必然需要关注自己的健康了，我自己也自我分析过，后来也在一些文章里看到这样的结论，肌肉含量低，蛋白质偏低导致身体的免疫力不高。

我自己在电子秤上的体侧，是脂肪接近中度，但是我的体重和体态其实不算特别胖，体侧出来经常是蛋白质含量偏低。今年医院体验，已经开始出现轻度脂肪肝了。

我得出的结论是：我可能要考虑增加肌肉的一些运动了，而不是纯粹的靠有氧来控制体重。

有氧运动可能还有个危害，就是也会消耗自己的肌肉。之前也看到过一个说法，说人随着年老，丢失的肌肉很难找回来，这个对健康的影响很大。

最近也是在琢磨和找一些理论依据：人到中年，到底是该有氧运动还是无氧运动。

好吧，今天文章是一个由感冒引发的对身体健康的思考，进而引发的可能运动锻炼的规划~~就这么个事。

---

The muses dance joyfully and, with a slow pace, accompany me to edit. Playfully, they observe my images, and the photographs are selected at random. Naughtily, they sit next to my Sacha. The little baby can't be left out. Pelusín walks on the rooftops; the little rascal never stops meowing. They select a variety of objects without rest. In monochromatic tones, they suggest I edit. Right at twelve, time comes to a halt. Silence comes to life, and the muses help me edit. Among textures, dogs, and cats, I get lost in my archives; and my varied selection, I wish to show you today.*
