title.title: I soaked my body with the sound of the pouring rain in this scorching heat of summer.
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776665676739-32b00e0c9fdcde96.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dmann/b7bf6540)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dmann/b7bf6540)


---

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well by the grace of Allah Ta'ala. I am also doing well by your prayers. I am healthy along with my family. I am thanking Allah Ta'ala for this. Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmEJwTXUTMiaBQpbeUg9rbjtsBUaAVdJYu9ANbJBACM5/1776664718258.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXimgvfECNABppzLqpnJNdxcTBsYL4LG8MZ54KjXfmduY/1776664718463.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxMWBZ6D8sg13HodrFGLqTzorENdpopyc1ofNL5HqBqP/1776664718582.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2VZfFGRUPL6LApDCvpuABd2z5WATgedYGRYdA4vLq1g/1776664718677.jpg)

Friends, today I have come with a new video for you. The video is about the sudden rain that came during this summer season, that is, during this intense heat, and made us completely happy. I will try to show you such a video. Today, it was suddenly very hot and in the midst of this heat, but suddenly in the afternoon, the rain came and made us completely refreshed. But seeing this rain, we are very happy because sometimes when it rains, the weather turns in our favor and brings us a little comfort from the heat.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsr2rJYZtdsQJi6E7QuYuDYyFAsmBa1t9zvKHgTmDknR/1776664735478.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyPrHn2gHRnVfzenrjmJEpYynoFbPiueLUzEpYjh3Siw/1776664735607.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbNkNKCbmZVSYDHb2n2THCSVkw1teRQqqGmbgHfwd5mza/1776664735706.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAamswdz3VUj2WRMFSgVxoTMBdVk1j31vYXbpiiJBHnh/1776664735813.jpg)

This rain was very necessary for us because in the midst of the intense heat and sunshine for a long time, it suddenly rained and the wind was blowing and it was very nice to see these scenes because in the midst of this heat, rain is one of our daily necessities. Moreover, when it rains, the trees and plants come alive and look very fresh and nature becomes beautiful and attractive. This rain happened after a long time, but everyone is happy and joyful to see it. In the meantime, I got wet in this rain and washed my body and felt a lot of joy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFVcb9YXyHz71kUsTMiw93VDr61WK9UTeq7qMr3eMDpG/1776664757046.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1gpofUyQmcPbvaE63WuyerbmrvKBkAQRy5HZtLtTjdX/1776664757185.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsmAgRSwtdv3yhqJqfFXimarcVy8WRsiHHFeGBuGKikc/1776664757294.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP84RBAHHKkvv5WGN6f4haxVhRD4yUTFTK5NkvitTEFRi/1776664757395.jpg)

If the roof of the house, especially the tin roof, is filled with raindrops, what a beautiful sound can be heard, but hearing it, the mind is filled with life and nature seems to regain its own form and its own pace. And this rain is very beneficial for us. It is a blessing given by Allah. Thousands of blessings are hidden in this rain. For example, when it rains, many plants grow in our country. Among them, rice is cultivated in our country. This rain, that is, rain, can be said to be a blessing from Allah. Getting wet in this rain is a lot of fun, it feels very good, a lot of joy is felt and the mind is filled with life and the mind wants to get lost in that unknown.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbNkNKCbmZVSYDHb2n2THCSVkw1teRQqqGmbgHfwd5mza/1776664775283.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJnagiQQegV8qiTozkUbNVBbStJpSSidvPe57vmV9LN6/1776664775396.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeC7EGWRum59w22UvyhviEx4LqwiecMHxBrLEvnp3GNkw/1776664775509.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAiqugu31BS2o7pqRnGLXYLfWSETp9NJyN7HuZtkKA53/1776664775596.jpg)

Friends, it is summer in our country now, that is, during the hot summer, the temperature is above 40 degrees Celsius. And if it rains in between, then there is no need to worry. There is a lot of joy, peace, and a very beautiful and cheerful mood. And rain is a thing of enjoyment that we all enjoy today. But everyone in our family got wet in this rain and felt joy. Even though I was very cold, I didn't feel any stinginess in getting wet in the rain. I left, just like I did in my childhood, as you can see in the video. It is raining heavily and the water is rolling down but the train is running.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbN1bk2T6MLobQVyn46TyHaPf9bdcMbgmwMH1KuFXKx3p/1776664795204.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSU4KC8TXn4QR9kJpZcQw1ga3LfAgajSTY5f4e6XVY6uK/1776664795324.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJnagiQQegV8qiTozkUbNVBbStJpSSidvPe57vmV9LN6/1776664795407.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSMkcuUq2v5a7jToDmU3xAqxiYfdX9tuQZZZ8WLsTVXPT/1776664795504.jpg)

So friends, how did you feel today, getting wet in the rain and the scene of the rain, you must definitely tell us through your valuable opinions and don't forget to tell us who likes the rain in the rain. I like the subject. I like getting wet in the rain. Friends, everyone, stay healthy and beautiful. If you are well, I get inspired to make videos. info.author: dmann

content.description:
Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well by the grace of Allah Ta'ala. I am also doing well by your prayers. I am healthy along with my family. I am thanking Allah Ta'ala for this. Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmEJwTXUTMiaBQpbeUg9rbjtsBUaAVdJYu9ANbJBACM5/1776664718258.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXimgvfECNABppzLqpnJNdxcTBsYL4LG8MZ54KjXfmduY/1776664718463.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxMWBZ6D8sg13HodrFGLqTzorENdpopyc1ofNL5HqBqP/1776664718582.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2VZfFGRUPL6LApDCvpuABd2z5WATgedYGRYdA4vLq1g/1776664718677.jpg)

Friends, today I have come with a new video for you. The video is about the sudden rain that came during this summer season, that is, during this intense heat, and made us completely happy. I will try to show you such a video. Today, it was suddenly very hot and in the midst of this heat, but suddenly in the afternoon, the rain came and made us completely refreshed. But seeing this rain, we are very happy because sometimes when it rains, the weather turns in our favor and brings us a little comfort from the heat.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsr2rJYZtdsQJi6E7QuYuDYyFAsmBa1t9zvKHgTmDknR/1776664735478.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyPrHn2gHRnVfzenrjmJEpYynoFbPiueLUzEpYjh3Siw/1776664735607.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbNkNKCbmZVSYDHb2n2THCSVkw1teRQqqGmbgHfwd5mza/1776664735706.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAamswdz3VUj2WRMFSgVxoTMBdVk1j31vYXbpiiJBHnh/1776664735813.jpg)

This rain was very necessary for us because in the midst of the intense heat and sunshine for a long time, it suddenly rained and the wind was blowing and it was very nice to see these scenes because in the midst of this heat, rain is one of our daily necessities. Moreover, when it rains, the trees and plants come alive and look very fresh and nature becomes beautiful and attractive. This rain happened after a long time, but everyone is happy and joyful to see it. In the meantime, I got wet in this rain and washed my body and felt a lot of joy.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFVcb9YXyHz71kUsTMiw93VDr61WK9UTeq7qMr3eMDpG/1776664757046.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU1gpofUyQmcPbvaE63WuyerbmrvKBkAQRy5HZtLtTjdX/1776664757185.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsmAgRSwtdv3yhqJqfFXimarcVy8WRsiHHFeGBuGKikc/1776664757294.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP84RBAHHKkvv5WGN6f4haxVhRD4yUTFTK5NkvitTEFRi/1776664757395.jpg)

If the roof of the house, especially the tin roof, is filled with raindrops, what a beautiful sound can be heard, but hearing it, the mind is filled with life and nature seems to regain its own form and its own pace. And this rain is very beneficial for us. It is a blessing given by Allah. Thousands of blessings are hidden in this rain. For example, when it rains, many plants grow in our country. Among them, rice is cultivated in our country. This rain, that is, rain, can be said to be a blessing from Allah. Getting wet in this rain is a lot of fun, it feels very good, a lot of joy is felt and the mind is filled with life and the mind wants to get lost in that unknown.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbNkNKCbmZVSYDHb2n2THCSVkw1teRQqqGmbgHfwd5mza/1776664775283.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJnagiQQegV8qiTozkUbNVBbStJpSSidvPe57vmV9LN6/1776664775396.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeC7EGWRum59w22UvyhviEx4LqwiecMHxBrLEvnp3GNkw/1776664775509.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAiqugu31BS2o7pqRnGLXYLfWSETp9NJyN7HuZtkKA53/1776664775596.jpg)

Friends, it is summer in our country now, that is, during the hot summer, the temperature is above 40 degrees Celsius. And if it rains in between, then there is no need to worry. There is a lot of joy, peace, and a very beautiful and cheerful mood. And rain is a thing of enjoyment that we all enjoy today. But everyone in our family got wet in this rain and felt joy. Even though I was very cold, I didn't feel any stinginess in getting wet in the rain. I left, just like I did in my childhood, as you can see in the video. It is raining heavily and the water is rolling down but the train is running.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbN1bk2T6MLobQVyn46TyHaPf9bdcMbgmwMH1KuFXKx3p/1776664795204.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSU4KC8TXn4QR9kJpZcQw1ga3LfAgajSTY5f4e6XVY6uK/1776664795324.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJnagiQQegV8qiTozkUbNVBbStJpSSidvPe57vmV9LN6/1776664795407.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSMkcuUq2v5a7jToDmU3xAqxiYfdX9tuQZZZ8WLsTVXPT/1776664795504.jpg)

So friends, how did you feel today, getting wet in the rain and the scene of the rain, you must definitely tell us through your valuable opinions and don't forget to tell us who likes the rain in the rain. I like the subject. I like getting wet in the rain. Friends, everyone, stay healthy and beautiful. If you are well, I get inspired to make videos. And if you encourage me, I will be able to move forward on a new path. I am saying goodbye to everyone today with the hope and expectation that Allah Hafez

title.body:
## **It's Adventure Time, Reflection Hunters!**

Today I'm truly surprised. I thought I'd seen it all, but I was wrong. I went out to continue my search for reflections and I came across something completely new. Want to know what I saw? Well, you'll have to find out in Reflection Hunters Contest N°268.

In every reflection resting on the glass, I see a very special image: the perfect reflection of a deep and infinite love. That mirror where only someone like me exists could be anyone. That, my friends, is the reflection of a love that transcends.

Here, in this beautiful community, the search isn't just about capturing images, but about finding the reason for existing and persisting one more day to see what has yet to be seen.

Keep your eyes wide open so you don't miss out on luck, find that reflection and seize it: be patient, it's out there, waiting to be found by you.

If you'd like to learn more about this place, feel free to join the community.

We cordially invite you to participate in this exciting activity called \

I assure you, you'll want to stay and fall in love with the sport of hunting. Reflex hunting is an endless adventure.

<hr>

<center>
![1000090063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EpJXAiqYpkto4vraP2SXoxVPkFSDi1xWXDZeM82fNoRs4gZj7tBpj6Qa3FWoMrfyPwW.jpg)
</center>

📷 **“The Headless Man”**

They say it's easy to lose your head... but I always thought that was just an expression. As I wandered aimlessly, in my reflection in the mirror, a mysterious man took out his phone to take my picture. The disturbing thing is that he was missing his head. I'm going to assume he was brainless.  

<hr>

<center>![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)</center>

<hr>

<center>
![1000090061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EqQP7Ed7cxcYTYfvujgBooQM9A3wuE1re6XuTmBxNXpkbLSxMQxCQUZgtrtGMdXnSHg.jpg)
</center>

📷 **“The Sign Worn by Time”**

There was a time when that pharmacy had a large advertising sign next to its glass door. On it, a smiling girl promoted a product I've long forgotten... Now the smiling girl is gone, only a black stain that looks very much like rust.

<hr>

<center>![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)</center>

<hr>

<center>
![1000095110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EqdASDXzwqa1QVZQ1FuoJDuxrVf9Z6X2PrzMj6DxvpHt9ynvmr48oj6RZ9q6y6oa6kV.jpg)
</center>

📷 **“A locked window”**

When a door closes, a window opens: But if that window is also locked, then there is no freedom. Only a maximum-security prison from which one must somehow escape.

<hr>

<center>![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)</center>

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 18 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f3a16f1f-13cc-466e-8fdd-f74fb62d9601.jpg)

Some days are just hard to get interesting things to talk about.  Today was a work day so I didn't have that much time. 

Yes I walked the dog in the morning and the evening but that meant I got up early and walked after a day at with when I was tied. 

Welcome to life with a dog 

But the morning? 

Was a really nice walk. Not too hot, not too cold, moist and cool but that made things fresh. 

The cherry trees are just starting to bloom which is really nice.  They aren't really full bloom when they are stunning but they are still pretty enough for me to be happy to see them.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1a5b87e6-f4f6-45e9-b844-873fb93c9fdb.jpg)

Why did I take a picture of the baseball fields?  Well I can't remember ever actually taking a picture of them from this angle. This morning they looked extra green and the sun hit them at a really nice angle so I figured it was time to take a picture. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fbac8782-523a-40d5-81a2-f759cf5c4160.jpg)

Entering the park I think I came at just the right time.  I didn't catch the sunrise which was a little sad but then again the sunlight filtering through the trees made everything bright and cheerful. I can enjoy that to brighten my day, especially when I know I'll be stuck inside at work all day. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ef3aa829-6bea-4006-b1a9-60f23beea139.jpg)

I kept walking and I got to marvel at the really long shadow that I saw from my dog and I . I know that everyone has seen long shadows before but what can I say... This morning it seemed more interesting than usual.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/73db6f03-e384-4e6e-82c4-9570b83d1562.jpg)

And a tree. Yeah I know.. it's just a tree. But still I just sat the trees and the woods behind and I just thought they were beautiful and alive. Possibly because they were dead and leafless just recently. 

I kept thinking that summer will be here soon enough. Things will dry out. Things will be less green and feel \

from the heat and the sun. This morning just felt full of life so I really enjoyed it.. And as a side benefit of spring. The park washrooms have been unlocked again for the season. Thank goodness. It's always nice to know there is a washroom nearby when leaving home on a long walk. Walking the winter? No washrooms and can't run home in case of emergency. It can get uncomfortable for me. Very glad when they decide to open up the public restrooms again. Probably April 15th was the glad day. I'm just glad it's open for a few months to come.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260420t061323523z)_

title.title: My Battery Was About To Explode, So I Fixed It Myself
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcWfHf52dQVZfLHzZ9asmMFX4LkCnryetArAhccQMbbP/1776664509431.png)

This past few months, I noticed my phone battery had become bulky and swollen. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQd26o58aespKnu84JntoGTqUDdXQqFb78ZLWj3u9BRX/1776664616575.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdazM97V3mWCLGZDCkBKVFg974Xep7xH4qbUF6ipksL62/1776664616610.jpg)

I knew this wasn't just a simple issue because it could explode or cause damage to the internal parts.

So, for safety reasons and to get my phone working effectively again.. I decided to replace its battery. 

Instead of buying a new unit or paying for expensive repair services, I decided to do it with my own hands.
 
I ordered a compatible battery online for ₱557/$9.58, and it arrived this Saturday.

The package was great because it also included a complete set of tools needed for the repair. 

And here's my repair process..

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdi2x1AP2VdK4AwURX4QAmXfcanCH3DRXxa5oKGmntNa/1776664655107.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbxkVAa1u8PTpVaaMWu9xu3tQi5nW4ZUuEt9yHZqTUFuq/1776664655152.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcB1STr4sjSLaRLR3esFfMnz43KiHL328zwwEm4kMRGYc/1776664655185.jpg)

I started by carefully disassembling the back cover. I had to do this very slowly and gently because one wrong move could damage the fragile parts and connectors inside.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYkHZ86upQE9wRQC3VwbzNMNujrF7tgXCMXNcMbU6nEKg/1776664691540.jpg)

Once the cover was off, I checked if the new battery matched the old one exactly. And good thing it was a perfect fit.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRHj9y4MBRRSixYXDrBAGWMUKWkfHNwEPKxXA3aSouRXw/1776664715709.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSnZzb5v7kNRKa6HJ15ipmbK8Qp999dpjBGux593zDUo/1776664715773.jpg)

Next, I removed the screws holding the frame in place. These screws are extremely small! So make sure you place them in one safe spot, so you don't lose even a single one. 'Coz losing them is a headache you don't want, trust me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTZy5qC6Tm6vhkYF2pFXJ69Peo7udqRieJA4T3fDHuzT/1776664779914.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdV2fvjpbseEJK1bKbveiUzuZbbD9qAZCM7hDiDfKGZGU/1776664779981.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXrGCr15wKMp3JpHAh5gLszfgybL5FMDZB8Je9zvPcEHz/1776664780029.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX9dqq3EKPrfZXkH3KeYr6TE5aHE7vT3cNUqpYuKZpNjR/1776664780085.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXqURA2JMxDSmYvYhQQze4Z4MgeQwC9NVV6pMsufiBEd/1776664780140.jpg)

After taking off the frame, I then carefully removed the old, swollen battery. Then installed the new one in its place.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTQGdnCxqm3b9LMQECpfUJwUhNW2QhZTTENFmRw35zXo/1776664811365.jpg)

After that, I did a test run. When I pressed the power button, thankfully, the phone turned on immediately! Everything was working smoothly with the new battery. 👍🏻

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpyY2QSSABgve4FAUWfzAq4Fa6VPToUa5vnbGewuc68Y/1776664845764.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6cQAEdVyX3qXZsrVd6EBpyYsDeLwPjJsrJ9VwNDK9pJ/1776664845806.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWe2uaKRF7P7j9FWTWPU1hrmmAyEmLY1Hg3qXzKKKn7Bf/1776664845846.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYY9eXBtwiQaX2bnQgnHBDKanA7HsHqxUDzMb5SGTueJE/1776664845908.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTj8uazqr7SJsAg52hChA16cf5isb7W7posNubGwkm3DE/1776664845965.jpg)

And since the original adhesive was already removed, I used T-7000 glue to put the back panel back. I applied it evenly and pressed the cover down properly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2r3GH9qpcYaSurqWf7VhjyeEctuvYEce7VwZpPjMozC/1776664873015.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoem5TG33qNzcpiTwGPnbyPxV3SqvQ3xQHynbuQVe4tv/1776664873075.jpg)

Also, to make sure it sticks perfectly, I wrapped rubber bands around the phone. Technically, it is recommended to leave it like that for about 8 hours for the glue to dry completely. But I got impatient and removed them in just a few minutes, haha! 🤣 

And that’s it! My phone is as good as new again. It feels much safer to use now, and the performance is back to normal. I really hope this new battery lasts long and won't get bloated again anytime soon.

By the way, big thanks to my lovely wife @mayt for documenting all of this! My phone was in my hand at that time, so I couldn't take or capture the moment... good thing she did it for me! 😉

*Language Assistance: Grammarly*

title.body: Схему весняних обробок абрикос я вивчила років 5 тому, коли рятувала від щорічного \

наше молоде деревце. Як же мені хотілося побачити, що за сорт абрикосів росте на нашій ділянці! Але кожного разу після цвітіння квіточки і листячко чорніли та засихали. Всі навколо з сумом говорили: та от як завжди, тільки абрикос цвіте - одразу й мороз, і нема ягід, бо цвіт обмерзає. От і як тут бути, погодитись чи шукати способи порятунку абрикоса? Я пішла другим шляхом.
І, о чудо! На каналі свого вчителя по догляду за виноградом випадково натрапила на його відповідь про абрикоси! Він на прохання своїх читачів докладно розповів і про морози-абрикоси, і про їх хвороби, через що гинуть плоди. І, звісно, порадив, як і чим обробляти, щоб мати гарний врожай, незважаючи на морози по цвіту.
Абрикоси у нас того року вродили на диво рясно. Вони були безподобно смачними, рум'яними, ароматними. І залишились для людей, які купили наш дім. Бо ми у той рік переїхали в батьківську хату.
Але тепер я щороку обробляю всі наші плодові дерева за цією схемою. Яблука та сливи вже встигли віддячити нам за це щедрим урожаєм.
Так що не завжди треба на мороз покладати всі гріхи. Бо так ніколи нічого особливого й не спробуєш у своєму саду виростити.

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  Martin Chuzzlewit #16/428
title.body: >IN WHICH CERTAIN OTHER PERSONS ARE INTRODUCED; ON THE SAME TERMS AS IN THE LAST CHAPTER

>Mention has been already made more than once, of a certain Dragon who swung and creaked complainingly before the village alehouse door. A faded, and an ancient dragon he was; and many a wintry storm of rain, snow, sleet, and hail, had changed his colour from a gaudy blue to a faint lack-lustre shade of grey. But there he hung; rearing, in a state of monstrous imbecility, on his hind legs; waxing, with every month that passed, so much more dim and shapeless, that as you gazed at him on one side of the sign-board it seemed as if he must be gradually melting through it, and coming out upon the other.

>He was a courteous and considerate dragon, too; or had been in his distincter days; for in the midst of his rampant feebleness, he kept one of his forepaws near his nose, as though he would say, 'Don't mind me--it's only my fun;' while he held out the other in polite and hospitable entreaty. Indeed it must be conceded to the whole brood of dragons of modern times, that they have made a great advance in civilisation and refinement. They no longer demand a beautiful virgin for breakfast every morning, with as much regularity as any tame single gentleman expects his hot roll, but rest content with the society of idle bachelors and roving married men; and they are now remarkable rather for holding aloof from the softer sex and discouraging their visits (especially on Saturday nights), than for rudely insisting on their company without any reference to their inclinations, as they are known to have done in days of yore.

>Nor is this tribute to the reclaimed animals in question so wide a digression into the realms of Natural History as it may, at first sight, appear to be; for the present business of these pages in with the dragon who had his retreat in Mr Pecksniff's neighbourhood, and that courteous animal being already on the carpet, there is nothing in the way of its immediate transaction.

>For many years, then, he had swung and creaked, and flapped himself about, before the two windows of the best bedroom of that house of entertainment to which he lent his name; but never in all his swinging, creaking, and flapping, had there been such a stir within its dingy precincts, as on the evening next after that upon which the incidents, detailed in the last chapter occurred; when there was such a hurrying up and down stairs of feet, such a glancing of lights, such a whispering of voices, such a smoking and sputtering of wood newly lighted in a damp chimney, such an airing of linen, such a scorching smell of hot warming-pans, such a domestic bustle and to-do, in short, as never dragon, griffin, unicorn, or other animal of that species presided over, since they first began to interest themselves in household affairs.

>An old gentleman and a young lady, travelling, unattended, in a rusty old chariot with post-horses; coming nobody knew whence and going nobody knew whither; had turned out of the high road, and driven unexpectedly to the Blue Dragon; and here was the old gentleman, who had taken this step by reason of his sudden illness in the carriage, suffering the most horrible cramps and spasms, yet protesting and vowing in the very midst of his pain, that he wouldn't have a doctor sent for, and wouldn't take any remedies but those which the young lady administered from a small medicine-chest, and wouldn't, in a word, do anything but terrify the landlady out of her five wits, and obstinately refuse compliance with every suggestion that was made to him.

>Of all the five hundred proposals for his relief which the good woman poured out in less than half an hour, he would entertain but one. That was that he should go to bed. And it was in the preparation of his bed and the arrangement of his chamber, that all the stir was made in the room behind the Dragon.

>He was, beyond all question, very ill, and suffered exceedingly; not the less, perhaps, because he was a strong and vigorous old man, with a will of iron, and a voice of brass. But neither the apprehensions which he plainly entertained, at times, for his life, nor the great pain he underwent, influenced his resolution in the least degree. He would have no person sent for. The worse he grew, the more rigid and inflexible he became in his determination.

- Curators and admins now have a new \

menu option in the sidebar.
- Sometimes the system misses posts or comments because Hive servers lag behind — this feature lets curators manually add those missed items.

# Daily Development Update: hCurators Manual Curation Feature and hSnaps Fixes

## hCurators

### Add Missing Item Feature for Curators and Admins

- Curators and admins now have a new \

menu option in the sidebar.
- Sometimes the system misses posts or comments because Hive servers lag behind — this feature lets curators manually add those missed items.
- Curators simply paste the URL of the missed post/comment and hit submit.
- The system checks if the item is valid, fetches its details from Hive, and adds it to the curation queue.
- If an item was previously rejected, submitting it again will restore it back to pending.
- Flagged authors are still blocked — their content cannot be added.
- Everything works the same way as if the system had caught the item automatically.

title.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1137 - by Allmonitors
title.body:
#1137 - The Wright Park Pond Scenes for Monday. 

Happy Monday my amazing Hive family across the globe! I hope this new week greets you with energy and optimism. Let's support one another and make this week our best one yet. Wishing everyone a fantastic Monday ahead😊. 

Now for our daily shots once upon a high noon when my wife and I were strolling through the iconic Wright Park in Baguio City. Despite the middle of the day, the weather was comfortable as the area was covered with majestic pine trees that towered above us. 
![1000014117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tSQ23P2mY2nJMmasPBXMjXXwseAHfL1x3fVZs3KikErEgcvnkQZCxpWjfRc2yZK5Ct8.jpg)

Their thick branches and needles filtered the sunlight, protecting us from the harsh heat. The park is right in front of the Mansion House and the grand view of the white mansion surrounded by pine trees served as a beautiful backdrop.
![1000014138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tbkz2wWVuaA5ZqJDmkbJ2Yd9bfwgdZNQei6AaeJE4N2a1mzRsAvYZqrquPiUQP3kj36.jpg)

The place was filled with life. Since it was a tourist spot, there were plenty of people around walking and exploring the area, just like we were. Families were enjoying the fresh air and kids were running excitedly. 
![1000014103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vsNmqmTwbBQsaLchrC62xWogeQUGm15F3MpXLf2Hyej6MSb1FVeiTQvUH643r3rwwfo.jpg)

![1000014100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23uFM31XrKCuSzMQWR3HsEZNsTAQaHxiHWFTnMVjDcJXKJ8BbQKLta7QxNu4QQUJ7BjCm.jpg)

By the sides of the main walkway, there's some garden that was bursting with color. The area was full of blooming flowers. There were clusters of small yellow flowers that looked like tiny sunshine, also with beautiful pink zinnias. 
![1000014152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23u63AL9BFUKgRYGAEeftuVcDaH8sAb3mYaZkEiQGcXX43XqHSVzGQMGa52r4MatAZqNu.jpg)

![1000014124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tbsLNW8GFU1RbzwsjVvGw8QAzZdaDTorMx16Eo51bPY3H7SM5ANRP4THAwa1hC5Buhg.jpg)

There were honeybees busy at work, flying from one flowers to another. I watched them land on the yellow and pink petals, just doing their important task of collecting nectar and pollen. It was a fascinating sight to see nature in action, it's been a while, right there in the middle of a busy park.p We spent a good amount of time there just watching the bees and enjoying the scenery. It was a peaceful moment in the middle of a sunny day in Baguio.
![1000014142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vsQPJSATVUxPvqwxtMUyvEFJzYVxo7B9EUidSZweCNeqmkjwEjt7ToZwGxJjt8z5WcG.jpg)

![1000014148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23u63KtB3b1WvrG482F5qCZewzf76AUCaAjAGMkoUCjhZjvdiWhPovcdNRJwZ3C3fft4G.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken Baguio City, Philippines.


<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

title.title: Season 3 And 4 Of Jack Ryan (2018 - 2023) || TV Series Review.
title.body:
![1000103966.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23wgBAuSTkeEHmwGJeo9mYtHRe4unbdfBT4G2hDtJ12SjgGT5tmYaaAXqR7yvhsihfUDd.jpg)
After binge-watching Seasons 1 and 2 of Tom Clancy’s *Jack Ryan*. I was sold on this political action thriller and [reviewed](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@esther-emmanuel/thrilling-jack-ryan-2018-2023-season-1-2-oror-tv-series-review) it. There was no stopping me. Seasons 3 and 4 turned out even better and more interesting than the previous seasons. The main characters were further developed, especially Jack Ryan (John Krasinski). Season 3 began in an explosive way. It centered around a dangerous conspiracy in Russia that involved a fight against NATO's agenda, the Czech Republic's president and her father, and the restoration of Soviet-era power through an operation that was used as a cover. ![1000104053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tbkydzF4BLgEFm9iqF8PwqHyUwoGRCA4JzABEWMNThQriatrECU3AY9yUrRy7DYfznW.jpg) ![1000104060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/Eo43oxf2vCA6Nvjvg4Cn65Qx3nuxJSTfHv5MQiR9rWVG66gFYi1XRUcPDevvbNCZXPn.jpg) In this season, we were taken back to Russia 1969 when the USSR still existed. A secret project to develop a nuclear weapon named Sokol began. Unfortunately, it was shut down and deactivated by Luka Gocharov, a Soviet officer. This led to the death of all the scientists on the project. ![1000104062.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23yTWbspxr1UiwrvUq3J2gzSvJmDVa7wwrXz2QkUMFJitXow7FQhVj4uwJdNrwwcb3ePs.jpg) ![1000104055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23vhqCi2mUu9CeU6VYvRnnFpGudmwnFXBTqmJtn8NFFBAtNH1mapWzotZJTiMd4jMDD7C.jpg) In the present, Jack Ryan learned from a Russian asset, Zoya Ivanova, that Sokol had been reactivated. He was able to uncover a bigger plan by the illusive group behind the Sokol reactivation. In his efforts to expose this group, Jack was framed and became a fugitive. How will he redeem himself? ![1000104063.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoEimxRYq7E4pcLUgj828QdeAmwthBNtLFFKHB4mx1jqnmff58ynBaCjPsbzBKLp1Bd.jpg) ![1000103973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tRzan29drwa5pFwm1WCcmhmeZqVYm5G43V6dcBhiXQiTA13PN39iPze1kmT2X9bb88o.jpg) The fourth season concluded the entire series. In this season, Jack was made the deputy director of the CIA. He discovered corruption had eaten deep into the system and he planned to uncover the powers behind it. This involved him weeding out crime syndicates and terrorist groups. ![1000104064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23ywqEtVbMyEuw3JZJrkupKi2XXk2yxRv7Wpdm1CJQzYSZeyXVYeu4oSG7woSXtVNx1vy.jpg) ![1000103979.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tm72Y9yKPWsyXKb1kVgwFqSjW2hsqeXUYmBj9VSsNeVHMu4jwJGvwM9xYHj34Y5H3FG.jpg) To achieve this goal, Jack recalled Mike November (Michael Kelly) to his team, formed a new relationship with Domingo Chavez (Michael Peña), a former Navy SEAL and a senior CIA operative. While on this mission, he resigned from his position as the deputy director of the CIA. Still, the manpower was not enough to take down the villains. Will he succeed? Can he weed out those behind the corruption in the system? #### My favourite Characters. ![1000104051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoyMZDxRSgmSb7E6BrRu4t1TJUnvVKspj5TEdtWkqBjTJX2Pe2pWGoRts5TDfHem9BY.jpg) **James Cosmo as Luka Goncharov:** James was the perfect actor for this role. He embodied it as if he was born for it. As a high-ranking Russian official responsible for deactivating Sokol in 1969 and with deep knowledge of Cold War secrets, he was quite a formidable character. He was complex, unpredictable, calculating and mysterious. At first, he seemed like an antagonist but in the end, he was the manpower Jack needed to succeed in his mission. ![1000103977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/Eo44ka2Av2UojP8yuJn1on2Vj5JVBLkTZbmyuaR6HhvemfRWAxwysxtaGvNLJCfuNPb.jpg) **Michael Peña as Domingo Chavez:** This was my first seeing Michael embody the role of a ruthless, no-nonsense character. His performance was unique and unforgettable. I was impressed. As a ruthless and skilled operative, Michael brought a little bit of dark humour, energy, and mannerism into the series. He was analytic like Jack but also tactical and resourceful. I enjoyed his performance. ![1000103970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tRzVogLSgcGV1RSTgYrgtoyVqG9yx5uXB38vKEB6y7oumxmGJUtg3VwB4xCaeTcSZSZ.jpg) **Okieriete Onaodowan as Adebayo 'Ade' Osoji:** He was unexpectedly revealed as the antagonist in the fourth season. At first, he was just a smart political advisor but he later turned out to be the brains fueling the corruption in the system. More like the wolf under a sheep's clothing. His performance was excellent and convincing. #### My Review And Rating Out of all the seasons, I enjoyed season three the most. The story was told uniquely from two timelines: Russian 1969 and the present times, which made it more interesting. The transitions between the present and flashbacks were seamless and fascinating to watch. The involvement of the Russians in season three made it more thrilling. More covert ops and action sequences kept me on the edge of my seat. I like how the creators put Jack Ryan through the fire and toughened him. Due to the conspiracy that got him framed and a fugitive, the pressures to redeem himself kind of developed his character. He became smarter and more tactical. That was a plus for this character which made this season better. However, Season 4 was a bit of a letdown. The plot was okay but did not seem relatable, in my opinion. Jack Ryan had to resign from his position as deputy director of the CIA so he could tackle corruption in the system. There's no system in the world without some corruption so Ryan's effort to make the system clean was at most temporary. I wished the plot of this season was better. Rating the third and fourth seasons, I'll give them 8.5 stars out of 10. If you enjoy crime and espionage thrillers, this series is worth watching. The plots, acting and action sequences are compelling. https://youtu.be/AK-Mdu1Epy0?si=0-xWWFwVev6HBnEi ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from the movie screenshots* *[Poster image source](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/Jack_Ryan_TV_Series-774070287-large.jpg)* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗

# Writing help

title.title: Starving yourself is NOT a good way to lose weight
title.body:
I am not a fan of fad diets because there is a reason why they are really popular for a while and then kind of fade a way.  I am a purist and the science is behind what I have to say and how could it not be.  Our bodies are complicated machines sure, but at the end of the day your body is like a car that has reserve gasoline tanks.   The parts of your body like fat and muscle are the reserve tanks. and the food you intake is like filling up at the gas station.  

<center> https://www.burnthefatinnercircle.com/members/images/2249.jpg?cb=20251216064727
[src](https://www.burnthefatinnercircle.com/members/images/2249.jpg?cb=20251216064727)</center>

There is so much bullshit on the internet these days because influencers and people with channels have to always be coming up with new things in order to keep you engaged and keep you buying their programs or bullshit supplements that they, the speaker, don't even use themselves.   I hate it when I hear big time people like Joe Rogan talking about how he uses something every day when he is clearly reading a script.   No you don't! 

I believe that the one and only true way to weight / fat loss is by doing something that Piers Morgan upset a bunch of body positivist people with saying

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23zbU3sZKotAzwnn59gVkinaB4PnbZ9QCUZ4sZFuerLYgUsbcuaUyAN7orpmVf2gaYUyn.png)
</center>

Obviously the guests lost their damn minds when he said that but he's correct.  If you put less gas in your tank than it needs to get where you are going in a day, it has no choice but to access the reserves.   This is just pure, simple science.

There's a lot of hacks out there like fasting and what not and you know what, go ahead and believe that if you want to but the end result in the same:  If over time you are consuming fewer calories than you are burning YOU WILL LOSE WEIGHT... period.  

The over-complication of all of this is mostly because people want to make money by saying what appears to be educated things on the internet, but most of the time these guys are all snake-oil salesmen.  I know two people personally that make a living doing videos and getting subs from fitness advice and we talk about it in private and they let me know (provided I promise to never call them out) that they don't actually do half of the stuff they talk about in their videos.   

The other day I was talking to a friend about caloric deficit and how I believe this is the only thing that matters other than making sure you get enough protein as well.   The real battle with caloric deficit is getting enough protein but there are ways to make that happen if you just plan ahead, I will talk about this in greater detail later.

But the other day, because i had like 5 cups of coffee and was on a sort of pain medication that mixes with the caffeine to turn me into a no-food-needing machine, the entire day had gone by and I found myself post-run in a huge calorie deficit and wasn't even hungry. 

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23t76tCnSkW2mmq6FuNnMrgVrQF3XYo6y4EPK7ZTECaxsbsECeJvA1DXpT1HMGwkjQAzW.png)</center>

Now here is the thing folks.  To some, this might seem like a big fucking win because 2500 calories is nearly the equivalent of a pound of body fat.  3500 is the rounded estimate of how many excess calories that comprises a single pound of body fat.  

So for some, they might be celebrating their express route to a loss of a pound in a day but this is a terrible strategy for a lot of reasons.

Look, I don't know how this is determined, but there are a lot of researchers out there that have discovered that since your body is such a complicated and intelligent machine, if you subject it to such massive caloric deficits, it will switch your body over to what many call \

Without your permission, your body is going to slow down a lot of processes including digestion, so that you don't starve to death.   Your body doesn't know that this is just something you did by accident, it sees it as an emergency and takes the steps necessary to protect you.\n\nIf you were to do a calorie deficit like this many days, your body may just decide to set your metabolism very low and keep it there.  So that's maybe why a lot of people from that show \

who are starving themselves for the TV show, end up gaining all or most of the weight back once they show is over and they return to eating normally.\n\nSo what is the sweet spot?  I'm not going to pretend to know the answer to that and neither do many other honest fitness people out there.  But a general rule of thumb is that if you are in the 300-500 calorie deficit per day, that your body doesn't treat this as an alarm and it will slowly but surely use your \

instead of just shutting down.  At this rate you will lose a kg every 2 weeks and honestly, this is a safe, sustainable method of weight loss.

If you are impatient and/or lazy, just get liposuction.  That's lame, but it is a lot safer than fucking around with your metabolism.  

Things get more complicated when you want to both lose weight and gain or maintain muscle, but there are ways to accomplish this as well.   Most of the methods are a lot less difficult than you might be thinking but just like anything in the fitness world, it is going to take some level of devotion on your part to make it happen.   

It doesn't have to be as hard as you might be thinking, but the point of this write-up is that if you find yourself one day with thousands of calories as a deficit, you really should find something to eat.  This is not a good thing and you shouldn't be proud of it... you could actually be stunting your progress. 

I base this not on being a professor, I have no education background to qualify me for this but I can show you this

<center> 
![combo fatty.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/normie.fitness/23xKxw5K7xgcDdfH36fRns4qnLN2EjNdEUgNFRhPXggbsk1sRurYDUb7ZoM9sUkbQaHuK.jpg)</center>

The first one is me in my 20's still reeling from having an unstoppable metabolism by virtue of being young.  The second picture is me at 110 kg.. a fat fuck that couldn't really do anything.... the last picture is me, after I got a plan, dropped the weight, and gained more muscle than I have ever had in my life.   I drank beer through all of them... life is balance, it isn't starving yourself... check it out!

title.title: Stop Overthinking, Start Executing
title.body: >\n\nSomeone can create an idea, have a dream of what to do, then they will think and keep thinking, but at the end, it is not thoughts alone that get the job done, but you have to empower it with the necessary action for it to deliver, starting with taking the first step. No matter the brilliance of your thought, it does not substitute execution. Someone that takes a step even though it may not be perfect and may be flawed, is still better than someone who has a \

thought but without executing it. This is why you have to stop overthinking, and then start executing.

<center>![20260419_142648.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmSxxA8RFagE2Es631uuhXBqqXDDBbaJf3Ej1JHWLmtBzK/20260419_142648.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/human-toy-in-white-background-12585520)</sub></center>

A friend of mine once came to me and told me how he has been nursing a particular idea for almost a year. He wanted to go into poultry business. He watched some online videos, gathered extensive information about the business. Yet he was still waiting for the \

to start. This waiting kept him stuck with just thoughts for almost 1 year. I simply advised him that there is no amount of waiting that will bring him the perfect time. I told him to start with what he has. He then took a step, even though it was flawed, but he learnt from his mistakes. He started growing. At this point, he has sold over 300 of his fowls with some good profits. If he did not act but just kept thinking, he would have missed out of the opportunity to make money from the business. Overthinking is one of the most common obstacles to progress. You will be surprised how lots of people have great ideas, great ambitions, clear goals, yet they remain stuck in the same place, not because they do not have talents or abilities, but because they spend a lot of time thinking, and less time acting. The results you seek will not jump out directly from your thoughts, they will come from the actions you have empowered your thoughts with. It is true that thinking is very important, at least for planning and decision making, but excessive thinking can become a trap if not checked. At some points, you need to stop overthinking, and start to take actions and steps. Some people easily mistake overthinking for preparation. They will waste their time waiting for the perfect moment, gathering extensive information, trying to avoid mistakes, and trying to fine-tune things. But what they fail to understand is that they are already avoiding actions which may be as a result of fear, which can include fear of uncertainty, fear of unknown, fear of failure, fear of criticism, etc. The longer you stay in your head, the more doubts you will begin to create, which can ultimately make it difficult to take the first step. Do not allow too much thoughts to stagnate you from making a move.
![20260419_142807.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbUaDStBU4VDsYpw3f8S4Sn3Rh4QnQgBzF6rLwBuc51s4/20260419_142807.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/silhouette-of-a-man-sitting-by-a-round-window-in-a-boat-11266110)
It is worthy to note that it is execution that will turn your ideas into reality. It does not matter how mind-blowing your ideas are, they will be nothing without actions. Imagine someone who wants to learn how to swim, but keeps watching YouTube videos on swimming, and cramming principles. But without entering the water, he will not learn how to swim. It is when you start executing that you will learn more things that thinking alone cannot teach you. It will make you to discover what works, what does not work, what needs to be improved, and the new processes to follow. You learn more by doing than by just thinking. Starting does not require perfection. In fact, you do not have to figure out everything first before you take your first step. Some people even start without having a complete knowledge of what they want to do, nor the perfect condition, but it did not stop them from achieving greatness. Just start, you will learn along the way, then you will adjust, adapt, evolve, and become better. If you keep waiting until everything is perfect, you may never start at all. But when you take the first step, you will build the confidence for the next step, and before you know it, you will see yourself taking some giant strides. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

title.title: Splinterlands: Celestial Guardian is good in Earthquake battles
title.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I won because I used Celestial Guardian.

## Featured cards

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wzdSoagm3mvdv9uNTBGrFURbRDZZxJjJdiVeoVL5tEhi173ev2XXid1Xtkwekrusn5y.png)
Celestial Guardian is a life splinter that costs 8 mana. This card starts with flying. It doeesn't learn any new abilities when it levels, but it does gain 2 health making it a tankier monster. 

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23wBy2Z8EYcHDtTjtxZKu3nKvdJFJdaJoky6Dp6gSXCwsukeTzZ7LieRUTYVdpdH3h8RN.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Earthquake. This means that all monsters without the flying ability will take 2 physical damage per turn. There is also 24 mana available, and I can use any [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for earth and death.  

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Incessant Sage|6|Summoner|+1 Armor|
|Codex Sage|4|1st|Void Armor|
|Celestial Guardian|8|2nd|Flying|
|Lady Amara|6|3rd||
|Total Mana:|24|||

My summoner is Incessant Sage for the +1 armor. My tank is Codex Sage with void armor. Celestial Guardian is my backup tank, and Lady Amara is my last magic monster.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. I went with a magic lineup because I didn't want to deal with armor. Celestial Guardian is my main damage dealer because it has flying, so it can outlast my opponent. 

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/Eoc8UteXRpeesNNr5Wkf31vZVA822LcpxgsZenbtXi4ShdoQ94Lin6MfjbbdpicsvFw.png)
At first glance, I think that this match is my win. My opponent's monsters don't have much health other than his tank. As I am using magic monsters, that dodge ability doesn't hurt me. The earthquake will slowly wipe out his monsters.

### Round 2

![round 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vi3wiq2PRKuYAPEJvB6cxDPNBD1fQ4tfVYphsw2MAf4wxUN5793HwVKPp9i1co8qYe9.png)
A round later, my opponent has lost his tank, and most of my monsters are still quite healthy. The earthquake will take one monster down, and the other one will be low enough in health. My magic monsters can't miss, so I don't think there is anything my opponent can do.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vsSgpXpFn8ff8p3tF2BtfXjq29D9NtfrZ4rjPnoKnRwM9e1gBXpXhCwWMdPpT2cqHHu.png)
I won that match later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle this time did go exactly as planned. I had my magic monsters deal damage, and Celestial Guardian stayed alive due to its flying ability. My opponent just slowly died off due to the earthquake damage, and that let me win this match without too many issues. 

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_70dd6b1570bb12e93a0a007b663b6195?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

title.title: Bera Dallin || Taunt and Armor Combo || A Powerful Tank Monster
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 20, 2026, 10_43_02 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23w2sQnGZJWs3SBvPtExgtto5aAf3AppAFUKoJWrmfa42i5FAvckzpAhRqRMpjTFNBkA2.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


It is an amazing monster which we also call a tank monster and its best positioning is on the front line. This is such a monster that whatever tank monster comes in front of it, it faces it strongly and it keeps giving continuous protection to its allied units.

Yes its name is Bera Dallin which is a famous and strong monster in Splinterlands. It is considered special in high mana battles because of its mana cost. Remember to always keep such monsters in your deck because sometimes in high mana battles you need a tank monster that can defend your team.

For example if a battle comes with more than 50 mana then you should have two strong tanks which you can place on the front line and after that it is also necessary to have active and supportive monsters. 

Anyway a best team combination is made when you understand the cards well, know their stats and keep adding them to your deck with good selection.

If I talk about Bera Dallin mana cost it is 11 which is more perfect in high mana battles. But players also use it in mid mana battles as well because its defense line is quite strong. That means in mid mana battles if you keep even one such monster then one tank is enough.

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 100024.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wBeJ5VmErg7GyS3hvbZzRXZxKAWHyxVEZz5ZY5ykUPpwb9a5ZpHP6HqPR8CtMh38Bqz.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The biggest reason for its strength is its armor and health. Its armor is 6 which will keep blocking enemy attacks continuously and its health will not get direct hits. That means first its armor has to be finished then its health can be affected.

And further its health is also 12 which is very high. That means even if there are strong hitters it can easily survive for 3 to 4 rounds.

Besides this another special ability is its speed which increases its attack and also increases the speed of allied units. Another good thing is that it is a melee attacker meaning it attacks from close range and its power is 2. 

You can see that this monster is holding a sword on its shoulder and wants to attack the enemy and because of its melee attack it can deal good damage.

Its two special abilities are Armed Strike and Taunt. In Armed Strike if it has armor it gives gain to melee attack so that it can deal damage according to its remaining armor. And in Taunt it draws the attack of enemy units and does not affect reach, scattershot, wing break and enemy units in the first position. These are its two special abilities.

![Screenshot 2026-04-20 100007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo45iv4qEzx7amaoemo4im8MNYKw9rUbv6CJa6ZvujXaFKptgJH6eFgyPjneiSNCPjm.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Now coming to its weakness, what weakness is found in this monster? it does not have the ability of ranged attack meaning it cannot attack monsters from far. And you cannot use it in low mana battles which is its big weakness.

If I talk about its price this card is available in the Splinterlands market and at level one it will cost you about $3.5. And its maximum level and CC affect its price. On my screen I am seeing this card at different prices like $26 and $32 as maximum at this time and $3.5 is its minimum value.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

у пісні Yel ve tütün гурту Shatur-Gudu, яку Джамала органічно доповнює.\nТрек виконується кримськотатарською мовою, як і всі композиції гурту. Перекладається ж назва пісні як \
. А написав ці сильні слова  співзасновник гурту Сулейман Мамутов, перебуваючи в Києві. Тут, під час нічних обстрілів, він майже тиждень не мав змоги спати. І ось звучить композиція у жанрі \

, яка розповідає нам про теперішні виснажливі київські світанки.
Jamala після виходу треку на музичні платформи повідомила, що для неї ця співпраця стала відповіддю на власні творчі пошуки. Так, співачка вперше спробувала себе у рок-звучанні, та ще й рідною кримськотатарською мовою.
Пісня присвячена доньці співзасновника гурту Сулеймана Мамутова — Амєль, а також та всім батькам, які навчилися розрізняти типи ракет за звуком, оберігаючи сон своїх дітей.

title.title: Tinkling leaf-runner
title.body: > At the tip of a gently curved leaf, a tinkling leaf-runner appears like a little secret kept by nature. Its small, slender body is enveloped in contrasting colors. Red, black, and yellow blend beautifully in one frame. See the red, like a small ember glowing amidst the lush green. The black on its abdomen makes it appear serene, like a silent night. Its soft yellow legs resemble the first rays of sunlight rising over the eastern horizon. Nature truly is a master at painting every detail of this insect's body, making it a tiny creature that is not only alive but also radiates an incredibly captivating beauty.

> The wind whispers softly, shaking the leaf it rests on, but the insect doesn't waver at all. It stands there calmly, as if it already knows that life is in constant motion. It stands there calmly, not resisting the swaying in the slightest, simply gripping the leaf tightly, balancing its body in time with the wind's rhythm. What this insect does may seem simple, but it is actually extraordinary and full of meaning. It was all felt by a calm heart and eyes that were willing to stop for a moment to look at it.

title.body:
[Índice de los 324 capítulos.](https://novelasymaspb.wordpress.com/portfolio/gracias-por-no-casarte-conmigo-en-aquel-entonces-transmigracion-rapida/)
=====================================================================================================================================================

* * *

* * *

Cap. 012. El contrataque de un \

></center>

* * *

En cuanto terminó la audición, el director Zheng le pidió al asistente Li que publicara el primer guion. Quería revisarlo para que pudieran discutir si tenían alguna idea.

Hizo incapíe específicamente en Rong Xuan, quien dijo generosamente: “Realmente tengo algunas ideas, pero son bastante subversivas. No sé si el público puede aceptarlas”.

El director Zheng dijo felizmente: “Lo aceptemos o no, lo mejor es que hablemos de ello primero. Tener ideas es algo bueno”.

“Entonces ordenaré mis pensamientos y te molestaré más tarde.” Rong Xuan ya no le quitaba tiempo al director Zheng. Tomó el guion y se hizo a un lado para leerlo con atención, lo que permitió que otros concursantes se presentaran y le pidieran consejo al director Zheng.

Muchos concursantes se sienten atraídos por su acción y siempre compiten en la industria del entretenimiento. Durante las transmisiones en vivo las cámaras se concentraran aún más donde hay mentores. Rong Xuan estaba de muy buen humor y el director Zheng tomó la iniciativa de preguntarle a ella sus ideas, así que era una oportunidad que le daban, incluso si ella ocupara el resto del tiempo del director Zheng, nadie diría nada para quejarse. Pero una vez que ella estuvo dispuesta a ceder espacio de cámara, todos los demás tomaron en serio esta amabilidad y pasaron a preguntarle cosas al director y aprovecharon aparecer ante las cámaras.

Más tarde, un concursante se acercó a Rong Xuan y le dijo que había asumido el papel de villano. Quería preguntarle cómo hacer que el villano fuera agradable y menos odiado. Rong Xuan compartió directamente su opinión de como sería un viaje mental en la cabeza de un villano.

Los villanos también son seres humanos, con sus alegrías, penas, su ira y felicidad. Mientras no sean pervertidos, debe haber una razón para lo que hacen. Si la razón no es buena, la actuación será odiada; si la razón es inteligente, será una actuación agradable ante la cámara. El actor necesita encontrar el motivo del villano, utilizar eso como soporte principal y luego interpretarlo para lograr efectos inesperados.

Algunas personas también le preguntaron a Rong Xuan cómo podía interpretar bien un papel como el de Linglong, haciendo algo mal y quedando adeudando a alguien, pero lo hizo sin querer. Rong Xuan es realmente la única que ha interpretado un papel así de una serie televisiva clásica. Otros papeles similares son algo agradables. Por ejemplo, Ji Xirong es un ejemplo típico de alguien que no interpretó bien ese papel, e interpretó a una pequeña hada que era amada por otros muy mal, hasta convertirla en una ‘loto blanco hipócrita’.

Gu Rongxuan fue la que más tuvo que decir al respecto desde dentro del mar de conciencia. Ese fue el único papel que desempeñó bien en los inicios de su carrera. Cuando lo recuerda, ella lo pensó muchas veces. Rongxuan simplemente le pidió que lo compartiera en el mar del conocimiento, y Rongxuan ayudó a transmitirlo en palabras a los demás actores.

La experiencia de una actuación exitosa es muy valiosa. Los concursantes que no tienen nada que hacer se reúnen alrededor de Rong Xuan y la escuchan compartir su experiencia. Habló con tanta atención y detalle que era evidente que lo explicaba sinceramente y no ocultaba ninguna información clave. La favorabilidad de los concursantes hacia ella se disparó, e incluso la acompañaron hasta el final de la transmisión en vivo, hablando y riéndose de las cosas interesantes que encontraron mientras filmaban.

Gu Rongxuan nunca antes había tenido una experiencia así. Se sentía muy especial, como si hubiera descubierto por primera vez que había tantas cosas hermosas en el mundo. Sin la interferencia de Shen Mingze, todavía tenía muchas oportunidades de ser feliz. Fue sólo que perdió la capacidad de descubrir la belleza en ese momento en que fue traicionada. ¡De repente sintió una iluminación repentina, como si las nubes oscuras que la cubrían se dispersaran!

Rong Xuan pudo percibir su estado de ánimo y compartió otra experiencia con ella. 【Estar inmerso en el odio puede volver loca a la gente. Hacer cosas más felices puede mejorar todo y encontrar una oportunidad de venganza】

Gu Rongxuan preguntó: 【¿Tú también haces esto?】

【Estoy trabajando en ello.】 Una imagen de enojo recorrió la mente de Rong Xuan. Levantó la comisura de la boca y se sintió tranquila. Ella lo está intentando, espera no tardar demasiado, trabajará duro y cuando esté lista volverá.

Rong Xuan siguió discutiendo el contenido del guion con el director Zheng en la mesa. Esta vez, se agregó al asistente Li. Todos tuvieron que comer de todos modos, lo que ahorró más tiempo. Esta vez, el director Zheng tenía experiencia y encargó directamente varios platos exclusivos para que los comiera Rong Xuan.

Rong Xuan tampoco intenta ser modesta. Simplemente saca el guion y dice lo que quiere cambiar.

“Creo que el perdón de la heroína Fang Qing al protagonista masculino Tan Ming es demasiado irrazonable y no se ajusta a los valores de las mujeres contemporáneas. La contradicción y la ruptura son procesos inevitables, pero después de la ruptura, prefiero que Fang Qing viva una vida despreocupada, libre y feliz. No necesita regresar para volver a estar juntos ni necesita otros buenos hombres. Puede estar en el mundo y ser la persona más envidiable por sí sola. En cuanto a Tan Ming, es asunto suyo que sea un ‘hijo pródigo que regresa'. Quizás él mejore su personalidad, así que bendito sea. Pero Fang Qing invirtió en su matrimonio mucha emoción y juventud, pero fue herida sin piedad por él. En el tiempo de separación, era Fang Qing levantándose sola. ¿Y si Fang Qing estaba devastada? ¿Tan Ming alguna vez mirará atrás? ¿Acaso él se sentirá culpable por lastimar a Fang Qing? Siento que nada puede excusarlo, pase lo que pase. Tal vez cuando sobreviven al accidente automovilístico, ella se sienta aliviada y deje de odiar. Pero los espejos rotos definitivamente no se pueden volver a unir.”

El asistente Li dijo: “Entiendo lo que quieres decir. Dramas como este deben tener perdón al final. Incluso si no se reconcilian, aún pueden ser amigos o conocidos. Pero lo que vamos a filmar no es un drama, es solo un clip del programa donde puedes ignorar estas reglas tácitas y simplemente contar bien la historia. Recuerdo que cuando se transmitió el drama por primera vez, algunos espectadores dijeron que terminó mal, debido a que Fang Qing perdonó a Tan Ming. Así que creo que se puede cambiar. El público de nuestro programa está compuesto principalmente por jóvenes. Son gente que se mueve con las tendencias actuales, y es posible que estén más de acuerdo con las ideas de Rong Xuan”.

El director Zheng asintió pensativamente. No entendía muy bien lo que estaba pensando la gente joven ahora, pero pensó que si su esposa tenía una aventura y lo dejaba, y miraba hacia atrás para ver que estaba mejor y volvía a él, probablemente él no lo podría aceptar. ¿Quién quiere reconciliarse con ella?

Si se tratara de su hija, él estaría furioso con el yerno infiel y no habría cómo apagar el fuego de su furia. ¿Qué perro puede separarse si quiere y volver a estar juntos si quiere? En este drama, los familiares y amigos de Fang Qing se sintieron conmovidos por Tan Ming y vinieron a persuadirla a ella para que hiciera las paces. Después de todo, él estaba tratando de reconquistarla. ¿Qué clase de búsqueda es esta para enmendar el daño? ¡Esa tontería no es distinta al acoso y enredo de un idiota!

El director Zheng dio una palmada en la mesa: “¡Cambio! Acabo de sentir que algo andaba mal después de leer el guion. La diferencia entre ellos me parecía insalvable, lo que me hizo sentir incómodo. Cambiaremos eso, iremos en esta dirección de perdón sin nuevo matrimonio y se establece también el apoyo central de otros personajes. En el original era como si cada uno fuera una ‘persona herramienta’, sin ninguna vivacidad.”

El asistente Li tosió suavemente y aconsejó en voz baja: “Cambiémoslo. Aunque el drama anterior seguía siendo popular, así que es mejor que no lo critiquemos sin delicadeza”.

“Bueno, ¿no estamos solo nosotros conversando como equipo cerrado sin nadie más? Ya tenemos esta idea, así que busquemos a los demás actores y veamos qué otras ideas tienen; haremos una lluvia de ideas. El espectáculo terminará pronto, así que quiero intentar dar una respuesta satisfactoria en este último cortometraje.” El director Zheng hizo lo que quiso e inmediatamente notificó a Shen Mingze, Cai Sisi y otros participantes que fueran a la pequeña sala de conferencias a tomar el té y charlar sobre el guion.

Tan pronto como Shen Mingze escuchó la dirección que quería cambiar, tuvo una premonición siniestra y apresuradamente dijo: “Director Zheng, esto podría convertirse en un gran papel de protagonista femenino, y Tan Ming se convertiría por completo en un cabrón despreciado. ¿No parece inapropiado? Es un poco contrario a la obra original.”

Rong Xuan se burló: “¿Lo que haces simplemente está ahí y tienes miedo de que te llamen cabrón?”

Esta afirmación le sonó particularmente dura a Shen Mingze. Sintió que Rong Xuan estaba señalando con el dedo y maldiciendo, pero aún no lo había refutado. Luego escuchó a Rong Xuan decir: “Por supuesto, desde tu perspectiva como protagonista masculino, también puedes explorar la línea de crecimiento del protagonista masculino. ¿No es Tan Ming un hijo pródigo? Ampliar la sinceridad del regreso de este hijo pródigo y resaltar su sinceridad dependerá de tu actuación. Después de proteger a Fang Qing, pero aún sin ser perdonado, el personaje dejará atrás el pasado y se convertirá en un nuevo buen hombre, como si renaciera.”

Shen Mingze dijo: “Esto les dará a los protagonistas masculinos y femeninos una fuerte sensación de separación. Es claramente un drama matrimonial, pero se ha convertido en dos líneas paralelas al final”.

Rong Xuan dijo directamente: “En este programa, la trama se puede cambiar. ¿Por qué seguimos filmando sobre el matrimonio y el amor? ¿No sería más innovador cambiar de dirección? ¿De lo contrario, tienes una idea mejor?”

Los dos estaban peleando entre sí y los otros concursantes relajaron inconscientemente la respiración mientras pensaban: \
.\n\nSin embargo, hoy en día, es la primera vez que ven a Rong Xuan con tanta crueldad. ¿Será realmente porque le echaron la culpa del fracaso de \

a pesar de que ella estaba haciendo un favor? Shen Mingze no tiene mucho talento inicial; de lo contrario, no habría confiado en Gu Rongxuan en primer lugar. Ahora sus habilidades de actuación se han perfeccionado, pero cuando se trata de cambiar el guion y explorar la profundidad psicológica de los personajes, él no es nada bueno en eso. ¿De dónde va a sacar mejores ideas? Después de congelarse por un momento, el director Zheng dijo: “Antes de que haya una mejor dirección, decidiremos tentativamente sobre esta versión. Creo que la opinión de la señorita Gu es muy buena. Tanto los protagonistas masculinos como femeninos han crecido. Aunque su amor se ha ido, ambos se han convertido en mejores versiones de sí mismos y tendrán vidas más emocionantes.” El asistente Li se hizo eco: “Desde la perspectiva de la audiencia, este desarrollo también es muy bueno. El público al que le guste ver el tema de reconciliación al estilo del ‘espejo roto reunido’ se arrepentirá cuando vea esta trama, pero tendrá una mentalidad de bendición y no la odiará. Creo que le gustará a la mayoría de la audiencia, sin mencionar que definitivamente disfrutarán el final. Es como otro camino que pudo haber tenido el programa original y me siento bien por ello.” Todos estuvieron de acuerdo, ¿qué más puede decir Shen Mingze? ¿Oponerse nuevamente no le daría ninguna cara respetuosa al director Zheng? También espera lograr que Ji Xirong aparezca en las obras del director Zheng y aprovechar esta cadena de relaciones para obtener recursos cinematográficos y televisivos para sí mismo. Le resulta imposible no aceptar lo que sea que el director quiera. Sin embargo, su anterior alegría al elegir un drama amoroso de matrimonio desapareció por completo, y la siniestra premonición en su corazón se hizo cada vez más severa. La relación entre los protagonistas masculinos y femeninos es muy similar a la de ellos. ¿Podría Rong Xuan haber querido usar esto deliberadamente para algo? Rong Xuan no tiene pruebas que demuestren que ellos estaban juntos durante muchos años. ¿Qué puede hacer ella entonces? Pero pase lo que pase, su plan anterior de utilizar el complot para estimular las emociones negativas de Rong Xuan fracasó, y fácilmente podría estropear todo si no tenía cuidado. Siempre ha interpretado papeles decentes, solo para conseguir recursos de alta calidad y tener una buena imagen. Si no lo hace bien esta vez, se quedará atrapado en múltiples papeles de canalla. Cai Sisi y otros interpretaron actores a la mejor amiga y a parientes de Fang Qing, pero en lugar de conmoverse con Tan Ming, apoyaron a Fang Qing para que se despidiera del pasado. Todos exploraron sus características desde su perspectiva y convirtieron sus papeles en un nuevo personaje. Una vez finalizada la discusión creativa del guion, se dispersaron para prepararse para el rodaje al día siguiente. Shen Mingze regresó a la habitación, se abrió el cuello de la camisa y pateó el sofá con tanta fuerza en señal de ira que asustó a Ji Xirong. Ji Xirong preguntó apresuradamente qué había sucedido. Shen Mingze estaba de un humor completamente inexpresivo y no creía que Ji Xironglos femeninosayudarlo. Simplemente agitó la mano, fue hacia el dormitorio para hacer una llamada telefónica y le dijo a la empresa que Rong Xuan probablemente estaba planeando algo que afectaría su desarrollo. Ji Xirong es prescindible para la compañía, y la compañía puede esperar y ver, pero Shen Mingze es el nuevo Mejor Actor. La compañía lo ha entrenado durante años y puede ver los resultados de su inversión en él. Por supuesto, no puede permitir que Rong Xuan destruya su inversión. La compañía anunció inmediatamente que enviaría al agente Wu Chengyi para controlar a Rong Xuan, y Shen Mingze se sintió aliviado. Tan pronto como Rong Xuan terminó de bañarse y comenzó a memorizar el guion, su asistente, Xiaolin, llamó a la puerta y dijo que Wu Chengyi estaba aquí. Xiaolin incluso añadió una frase: “Hermana Xuan, él ya saludó al equipo del programa y logró un permiso, lo cual no viola las reglas. Está esperando en el café ahora mismo, ya ves...” Se puede entender que eso fue para evitar la excusa que ella usó la última vez. Rongxuan cerró el guion y dijo: “Está bien, yo también tengo algo que busco conversar con él”. * * * [Índice de capítulos](https://novelasymaspb.wordpress.com/portfolio/gracias-por-no-casarte-conmigo-en-aquel-entonces-transmigracion-rapida/) ============================================================================================================================================ * * * * * * _¿Me apoyas?_ ============= Si te gusta mi aporte, puedes invitarme un café [https://www.buymeacoffee.com/pedrobrito2004](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/pedrobrito2004) o apoyarme con PayPal [https://www.paypal.me/pedrobrito2004](https://www.paypal.me/pedrobrito2004). ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- [

title.title: Adventures In Homesteading (Day 623)
title.body:
Hello Everyone!

**A meandering writing schedule, The resource struggle, A cold wind, More rain & The rainwater bucket shuffle!**

Alright, I am getting started doing the writing later than I like doing so... and I have been struggling with whether I should just go to sleep... or try to see what all that I can spell out here instead. The idea of going back to sleep almost won out, because even after downing some tea... I was/am still feeling tired, groggy and more than a little irritable.

Since I have not been getting much in the way of deep sleep lately, the 'irritability' makes sense... and I am glad that I can at least see it for what it is and try not get too hung up on it. Most of it, is assuredly a combination of dealing with this foot injury (at a really inconvenient time of year), coping with all the financial stress and of course the constant grapple of not having enough food and water more often than not.

On the flip-side of that, constantly running out of supplies in general... has been a truly annoying (and downright problematic) aspect of this particular adventure. That sort of instability (or just inconsistency) has been one of the most common recurring themes over the previous six hundred odd days... and admittedly trying to *constantly* solve it has left me in pretty piss poor shape all around.

Being accustomed to hardship and 'being alright' living on very limited finances (meaning as long as my bases are covered I do not really want anything else) is a far cry different than *continually* grappling with higher priced goods... and whether I have the my ability (or inability) to purchase them when they are needed. The cumulative effect (aside from decreased physical and mental health) has been that my nutrition has suffered... and I often feel fatigued and dehydrated not to mention that *of course* the anxiety/stress has me feeling more than a little neurotic.

If it were not for the kindness of friends, family and some strangers... I would not have made it this far along... yet *that* has also added on a whole other layer of stress... because I am having to ask for mutual aid way more than I either 'want to' or am accustomed to doing. What I jokingly call 'digital panhandling' is no way to 'make a living' and while I dislike asking for folks to help... I also know what *not* asking for help does... and that there are folks that *want* to help... so I do my best not to overthink it all.

After nearly a decade of sharing content, I know that (for me) there is not much to expect when it comes to making anything even remotely close to a living at doing it... but if I *do not* do it... I will not even have the pittance that it amounts to. I really do my utmost to avoid thinking on that topic overly much... because in the end, I always wind up crunching the numbers (of time invested versus monthly return) and yeah making one to three dollars for two to four hours of work a day... is 'discouraging' to say the least.

To be clear here, I am more 'stating the facts' than complaining... and am aiming to point out the reality of the situation in regards to what all I have been grappling with of late. After all, I am the one that made the choices in my life that lead me to where I am... doing what I am doing... and as much as I might piss and moan about it along the way I am 'stuck' being a writer!

Anyways, today I continued trying to wrest my sleeping schedule back into shape... and stayed up for most of the day doing a combination of stuff on the computer and stuff outdoors. I also forced myself to stay up long enough, so that when I did go to sleep... it would hopefully be for an extended period of time which as it turns out did not actually work.

Earlier in the day, I tried to hike around a little bit to help tire myself out... but the wind was rather icy, gusting hard and it was so cold outside that it felt like those 'summer like' days we have been having were nothing but a series of fever dreams. During the night before it had also rained a fair amount (at last) and the lingering dampness mixed with the wind and cold... made being outside less than appealing!

The cold actually got me pretty dang good first thing this morning, when I went outside with the dogs... and I literally 'froze in place' and had to 'get a grip on myself' as shivering took me over. Not really being prepared for that upon going out the door in shorts and a light sweater I 'duck walked' (even on my bum foot) back inside and had to bundle up in a jacket to overcome the shivers.

In other news, that recent rain did not produce a whole lot of actual rainfall... even though it rained on and off for hours on end last night and into the wee hours of the morning. When I went around and checked the buckets after dawn, I noticed that (aside from the one I use for collecting drinking water) all the buckets had a heck of a lot of pollen and road dust in them.

I am unsure if I ever mentioned it but when I get a lot of sediment like that (in the rain water collection device) I let the sediment fully settle to the bottom before using the water in them. Once the sediment has all settled, I then pour the water from the buckets into either other buckets that I keep indoors (out of the sun and with lids on them) or into a capped container that I store in a shaded place.

After I get the water from the bucket(s) I then clean the bottom of them out the best that I can... so that the sediment cannot dry out and become difficult to remove later. Basically, I keep the buckets that collect utility water 'setup and ready' (under the eve) so that in case it ever rains I do not miss collecting it... and (like I noted in a previous entry) I only setup the drinking water buckets once it is raining and rained long enough to wash the roof off.

Well, the hour is now super late so I am going to call this entry 'good enough' and get on with the rest of my evening. I hope that everyone is doing well.Ciao for now.

<center>*Just like that everything is green again with the change of seasons!*</center>

<center>**Thanks for reading!**</center>
