title.title: Revisiting the Guimaras Man-Made Forest: Trees Reaching the Sky
title.body: — John Muir 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 Last year, we found a special place in our province. It is the Man-Made Forest in Guimaras. We wanted to go back and see the trees again. We also wanted to see if the place had changed. 🍃 When we went there before, we stayed in one spot, near the entrance. This time, we chose to explore deeper in the woods. We followed every small path we could find. The ground was covered in brown, crunchy leaves. The forest is full of very tall and slender trees. Most of them are mahogany trees. They grow straight and high into the air. It felt very peaceful to walk among them.

/>

  
  
It was a beautiful, sunny day. The sky was blue and very clear. Because the trees are so tall, the sunlight peeks through the leaves. It creates pretty patterns on the path and through the trees.

<table style=\

>

As we walked deeper, we found a small wooden hut. We think it is a place for the caretaker to rest. It looked very quiet and cozy sitting there in the middle of the woods. They did a great job maintaining the place. No overgrown weeds, no trash anywhere 👍👏

/> The forest is a great place to visit if you like nature. Tall mahogany trees that reach for the sky. Hidden paths that lead to quiet spots. Golden sunlight shining through the branches. We are so glad we came back to explore more of this beautiful forest! 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲 🌿 🌲

title.title: 🌸➡️🍊 Nature Doesn’t Rush… Yet Everything Happens
title.body:
Just a few days ago, this plant was covered in tiny white flowers… today, I spotted these young fruits forming 👀
That moment made me pause.
In farming, nothing happens overnight. You weed, you water, you wait… and sometimes you wonder if anything is even changing. But quietly, nature is working.
Now here it is—the result of patience, consistency, and care 🌱
This is why I always believe in growing what we can and eating fresh. Fruits like these are not just food—they’re real nourishment, straight from the source 🍃
It also connects deeply with what I stand for—natural living and plant-based nutrition, just like what I promote through Harmonel Moringa Green 💚
Small garden… big lessons.
Trust the process. Growth is happening—even when you don’t see it.

title.title: Giving myself everything I want
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUsHRcGqY6tUvNRi8RhgowHDQifTKdggCVpD8YWRyg1PQ/IMG_2870.jpeg 


It’s been a while since I can remember feeling BAD. It’s probably a lot shorter than I realize but this may be th longest i’ve ever gone without some kind of emotional crash, either due to external circumstances or internal dissatisfaction. 

I’m not saying I haven’t been sad or mad but these feelings don’t get in the way of anything and they don’t distract from anything.  Bad news comes and I do what I can to mitigate it.  Good news comes and it becomes fuel. There is no negative ruminating. There is no fixation. There is hardly any worry. I just don’t do it anymore.

I’m finally free. I’ve finally trained myself to keep my eye on the prize.  I can’t ever be sure I’ll even get there, but if I don’t I will be as sure as I can that it nothing to do with a lack of efforts. And I know deep down that I am on the path I’m meant to be on. 

It may not be the path I’d choose if I could go back in time, but it’s always the path I’ll feel best about choosing tomorrow. 

When I think about how I got here, it all feels a bit abstract because I tried for years and years with varying results but then suddenly one day it just clicked. 

I started enjoying the whole process. 

But telling someone to enjoy the process is like telling them to just be happy. If they don’t know how, it feels like telling someone to be 15 cm taller. It feels like something out of your hands. 

I think the biggest change that made this possible was a full commitment towards giving myself everything I wanted, starting with the things I had immediate influrnce over. 

First I let go of all guilt around being happy. That means even if others are suffering, even if people call it selfish, I have to prioritize my own mental state. 

(And interestingly enough you can actually feel sympathy and even deep sadness and full happiness and contentness at the same time if you donmt judge yourself for how you feel.  The emotions come up and if you just let them be, they can co-exist.)

Then I started to face my fears and battled them one by one. I started dressing in ways I was scared to dress before. I said things I was scared to say. I got rid of all the pleasantries that drained me (obligatory participation in events, meeting friends when I felt tired) and kept the ones that feel good (like making someone feel welcome or showing appreciation). 

I stopped hiding myself from my students even though it meant risking my salary, but even if I lost a student or two, the rest became even more appreciative and I’ve built a much better reputation as an artist as a result.  I was invited to play a show by one of my top 10 favorite Japanese bands., teice, and became acquantinces with another. Friends started paying attention to my work again after years of being lukewarm. 

We seem to associate prioritizing our happiness with being selfish and it’s not. Selfishness is when we disregard others out of spite or laziness. It’s when we beleive that we have to sacrifice our own happiness to make other people happy and then try to recoup our losses. 

I can see through most “bad” people. They are almost all people who weren’t good enough to themselves and put someone elses happiness before thenselves until they couldn’t bear to anymore and decided to say “Fuck it!”, OR they are people who believe too religiously in zero sum games.  

Not everything is a zero sum game. Some trees bear enough fruit, and some cups runneth over. 

A nice person is someone who puts others first and betrays themselves. 
A good person is someone who never gives up on practical alternatives to zero sum. 

I do not aim for nice. 
I always aim for good. 

That being said, I will never go out of my way to hurt someone and if I am put in a situation where one of us has to lose, I look for a different kind of framing that all parties might agree to, or at least have fewer problems with. 

One trap I find people falling into is giving too much authority to others over their own life. You are allowed to be who you want to be and do what you want to do.  It’s hard sometimes because self sacrifice is the norm in almost every culture (otherwise how do you get people to pay taxes abd join the army) and sacrficie is not always a bad thing if you truly beleive in what you are doing, but in those situations, it no longer feels loke sacrifice, it feels like honest devotion.  

Sometimes it’s easier to lie to ourselves than to face the face that the people around us overstepped in a way that forced us to betray ourselves. If you found yourself in a job you hated becayse of your parents you know what I am talking about. 

It can be very hard to live true to yourself.  

We may also find outselves full of spite and without a moral compass when we detach from social support networks and faith systems that have allowed us to betray ourselves.  In my experience this is a case of fatigue and disconnection from passion, too many years of silently allowing ourselves to be a victim to the whims of the world. 

When you rediscover your passion and pursue it head on, it’s impossible to remain spiteful and feeling like a victim. 

So if you sense a darkness in you as you pursue your own happiness over others, remember that that isn’t you, it’s your neglected inner child that needs acknowledgement and love and support, and once you give it that you’ll see it become more compassionate again, so believe in goodness and aim for it, even if it feels like a lie sometimes. Being able to afford true deep appreciation and unconditional love requires us to give that to ourselves first so we may need a fair bit of rewiring. 

I try to follow my joy wherever it leads, even into unfamiliar territory, with the exception of when it would impose upon the freedom of others.  Everyone should be allowed to followed their own path and everyone should be able to say no if they don’t want to follow you down yours. 

—-

title.title: Enduring Work Despite the many Troubles
title.body:
Greetings everyone! Another day for another blog.

How was your day? I really had a challenging one at work.

![Cold escape with friends_20260413_100252_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23z79qQCxbv6XHH3oRWnbgeRhBUweVHS4Q2urTP3VFM6nokSswPMj2XEqttsLp27H9nYP.png)

Today there has been a scheduled power interruption for the entire day we lost power starting at 5:00 in the morning. I am usually anxious in this kind of situation because I have an online work and I need power to sustain. It was a perfect timing because the solar power station I ordered online has already arrived and I got to test it finally. Since there is no electricity, my internet is also affected, thus, I have to travel to town to search for a better signal using my mobile data. 
Today’s working venue is at the baywalk which is a 10 minute drive from home. Just grateful that my brother is free and I asked him to take me there using our motorbike. My work starts at noon until 6:00 in the evening.

![received_937707282199759.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/245cMXTZVVb3oywer1pojFnt1WZoDWMY6WwQBH1xAxEp2W14fZ3atBeR96r9H5bct91VF.jpeg)

![received_1469870605168255.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/243ftUcNoKAmTsTtSaBwTamDtbr7AxGgE3GU1PgjqKiX1tAHt5PmntwLQbExnxj8Xu661.jpeg)

![received_3843107835996099.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wC9iSdRmLoxjrH7jH5Jc6Y7LUnmsbDFijvoyzC8secPSZPW5CucZe4st3HQN3nhRskJ.jpeg)

![received_2102200380350873.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xox6BBpBvL1Yynz4XK5cwcRmaZ2cFD3cwT3ht4zRN6ZJrn2YW2pBH92MebzK4yTFH7B.jpeg)

I was happy to find a place which is just cool, peaceful and there are vacant tables where I could place my laptop and other stuff. I was enjoying the scenery like the mountain, the sky and the sea. I also enjoy seeing the kids from a distant enjoying swimming and diving from the sea wall. It was terribly hot but I still could feel the cool breeze coming from the shore.

![received_1277337744585024.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xKr31tZgUJ7W7oRnjeU6NnoCkBPEC17jUqw7Qt3kyTqKgLyu7qQiZNJXtQ8UwdMqbwa.jpeg)

![received_918463431056472.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/242hNGW5WrsHcCyooXtHqTDBq8Hv41CLmfNgCcCZMfqeaVwyWttV2WwQW8NMKvNJWabh9.jpeg)

I thought that the peace and coolness would remain that way not until trucks and motorcycles delivering gravel and sand started coming and parked in front of me. I started becoming anxious because of the noise and I can no longer concentrate with work. Plus, there is dust everywhere as the laborers started unloading construction materials in front of me. During that time, I really felt helpless as I could no longer find any other convenient place to transfer to. So I had no choice but to remain at the place and endure the noise and dust.

In the late afternoon, more people kept coming just to walk and jog around the baywalk. Some came by families just to breath some fresh air and take their kids to walk and play in the wide plaza. I no longer mind the noise and just prayed that I would finish soon with work. 

![received_1371852894986437.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/245mvvf72PRwFYcNGdM7ePSDmf2GFFdwyYxPoxnxgTCNEWPMnvxgYdNQWfA28WHgFNStY.jpeg)

Despite the troubles I experienced at work today, I was somehow happy with my solar power station that has helped me sustain. I was able to charge my phone and laptop and continue with today’s work. I would say, I did not regret buying it.

![received_751424954603650.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/244y489AEttFpeBvjEc6HbTcjatb6EwkaKap3xsp9SZYTK8w5Z3Xn422mWfXJYPmNbYyv.jpeg)

![received_987256377310717.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/EpLgSnWgmaaSCgEDdq8eY1EPYCYiY7AFDSUSzCw9j7jBP4YJq6uV5um8f47CQAegX43.jpeg)

I have an hour left until I finish work. And here comes another struggle because the tables that I’ve been using has to be taken by the owner. So I need to find a new place where I could place my gadgets. Who would have thought that a street lamp would be of help. Yes, it was funny indeed. I placed my laptop on the cemented foundation of a street lamp. I stayed there until  I finished work.

I was just grateful I get to finish work despite all the work struggles I encountered today. I went home so hungry and exhausted.

Photos are mine and edited with Canva.

title.title: Television Review: Nixon vs. Kennedy (Mad Men, S1x12, 2007)
title.body:
![(source:madmen.fandom.com)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/madmen/images/b/b7/Don_train_nixon_vs_kennedy.jpg)


**Nixon vs. Kennedy (S1x12)**

Airdate: 11 October 2007

Written by: Lisa Albert, Albert Jaquemetton & Maria Jacquemetton
Directed by: Alan Taylor

Running Time: 48 minutes


When Matthew Weiner, having cut his teeth on the late, groundbreaking seasons of *The Sopranos*, unveiled *Mad Men* in 2007, critics were quick to recognise the profound influence of HBO’s pioneering drama on his own creation. This extended beyond mere aesthetic or thematic borrowings to a fundamental narrative architecture: the habit of reserving the most consequential plot developments and character revelations for the penultimate episode of a season, rather than the finale. In its very first season, *Mad Men* adhered to this sophisticated structural principle with remarkable confidence. The twelfth episode, *Nixon vs. Kennedy*, is the season’s true dramatic pivot, a masterfully constructed hour that defines its protagonist more sharply than any before it and irrevocably sets the series on its course. It is an episode where history happens in the background, personal betrayals unfold in the foreground, and a man’s entire fabricated existence is laid bare, only to be validated by the most cynical of philosophies.

The “wham” event that gives the episode its title and temporal setting is one that the protagonists observe with a mixture of professional interest and personal bias, but over which they exert no control: the 1960 United States Presidential election. In the nostalgic memories of the Baby Boomer generation and subsequent Hollywood myth-making, this election defined the dawn of a new, optimistic decade and altered the course of world history. Yet in the world of Sterling Cooper, it is merely the backdrop to an office party, a topic for boozy speculation, and a symbol of the entrenched establishment being nervously challenged. The staff, largely staunchly pro-Nixon, gather around the television on the night of 8 November 1960, convinced of the Vice-President’s imminent victory despite the polls’ closeness. The election night coverage becomes an excuse for yet another bacchanal, fuelled by copious alcohol. In this loosened atmosphere, subplots simmer: Ken Cosgrove discovers Paul Kinsey’s pretentious play manuscript, leading to an impromptu, drunken performance with Joan Holloway drafted into a role—a moment that underscores the performative nature of identity that permeates the series. Meanwhile, the alcohol also facilitates a reckless coupling between Harry Crane and Pete’s secretary, Hildy (Julie McNiven). Their fumbled, regret-filled encounter the next morning—Harry wracked with guilt over infidelity, Hildy ashamed of her unprofessionalism—serves as a microcosm of the era’s shifting sexual mores, where liberation is often followed by immediate remorse.

The professional stakes are raised earlier that day with the arrival of Herman “Duck” Phillips (Mark Moses), a former Y&R executive with London experience and British contacts. Don Draper, ever the instinctual talent-spotter, is keen to install him as the new Head of Account Services. This position is the very one Pete Campbell, despite his youth and grating entitlement, desperately covets. Feeling thwarted, Pete unleashes his secret weapon: the parcel from Don’s half-brother, Adam Whitman, which contains artefacts that could unravel Don’s meticulously constructed identity as “Don Draper”. In a tense confrontation, Pete attempts blackmail, demanding the job in exchange for his silence about Don’s true past as Dick Whitman and the mysterious circumstances of the *real* Don Draper’s death in Korea. Don’s response is a masterpiece of controlled panic. Outwardly, he dismisses Pete with icy disdain; inwardly, his entire world teeters on the brink. This insecurity manifests in a desperate, romantic flight of fancy—he visits his lover, Rachel Menken, and proposes they abandon everything and reinvent themselves in California. Rachel’s refusal, grounded in her responsibilities to her department store and family, is a sobering reminder that not everyone is willing or able to shed their skin so completely. It leaves Don isolated, forced to face his past.

That past is revealed in a series of stark, economical flashbacks to Korea in 1950. The sequence is a testament to the show’s ability to achieve profound narrative impact without a lavish budget. The chaos of war is conveyed through bureaucratic farce: Lieutenant Don Draper, expecting twenty men to build a field hospital, is sent only one—the hapless Private Dick Whitman. The ensuing shelling and catastrophic gasoline explosion are depicted with brutal efficiency. The charred, mangled corpse of the officer is the most graphic violence the series has shown to this point, a shocking visual counterpoint to the episode’s other adult content. In this moment of chaos, the wounded Whitman seizes his opportunity, swapping dog tags with the dead officer. He awakes in a hospital, awarded a Purple Heart under a false name, and is tasked with delivering the coffin containing “Dick Whitman’s” remains to the fallen man’s family. His refusal to disembark the train, and the fleeting, haunting glimpse of him caught by his young brother Adam, is a chilling moment of self-annihilation. The subsequent scene on the train, where a sympathetic, attractive woman mistakes his trauma for noble guilt and offers sexual comfort, is pivotal. It teaches the nascent Don Draper a fundamental lesson: the image he now projects—the dashing, wounded officer—is a powerful currency that can elicit desire and compassion, cementing his skills in deception and manipulation.

The following day, a humiliated and furious Pete decides to execute his threat. He marches into Bertram Cooper’s office, with Don in reluctant tow, and unveils the secret. The resulting scene is one of the series’ most brilliantly ironic twists. Pete, expecting shock, outrage, and Don’s immediate ruin, is met instead with Cooper’s bland, dismissive “Who cares?” Bert, an ardent devotee of Ayn Rand’s objectivist philosophy, is not appalled but delighted. He admires the sheer, audacious self-invention Don has accomplished. In Cooper’s worldview, Don is the ultimate Randian hero, a man who created himself *ex nihilo* through will and opportunity. Pete, the scion of old money who plays by the perceived rules of lineage and tradition, is suddenly revealed as the anachronism. Cooper, the elderly patrician, is philosophically more attuned to the emerging, meritocratic (and morally ambiguous) 1960s than the ambitious young climber. He coolly suggests Don could fire Pete, but also notes that such ruthlessness might be an asset to the firm. The crisis is over; Don’s façade is not just intact but validated by the highest authority in his professional life.

This resolution is underscored by the episode’s final irony. Don returns home, his career and identity secure, only to watch Richard Nixon concede defeat to John F. Kennedy on television. The world he and his colleagues assumed would continue—a Nixonian world of quiet, conservative certainty—has been upended. Yet, as Bert Cooper muses earlier, if Kennedy bought the election through fraud (a popular conservative grievance at the time), he will need the services of pragmatic, amoral men like them. The 1960s, with all their upheaval, have truly begun, and Sterling Cooper is ready to profit from them.

*Nixon vs. Kennedy* is a superlative piece of television writing and a defining episode for *Mad Men*. It employs an intensely economical approach to complete the foundational arc of Don Draper’s background, answering the “how” and “why” with devastating clarity. The episode is also notably graphic for the series to that point, juxtaposing the horror of a burnt corpse with the discreetly shot but evident nudity of Hildy—pushing boundaries, albeit less aggressively than its HBO forebears. Its masterstroke is the deployment of dramatic irony on multiple levels: the audience’s historical knowledge of Kennedy’s victory plays against the characters’ Nixonian certainty, and Bert Cooper’s reaction subverts every expectation of how such a secret should be received. The season overall doesn’t have much of a plot, serving instead to introduce setting and character. *Nixon vs. Kennedy* is the glorious exception, the plot-heavy, character-defining crescendo that justifies the slow burn of the preceding eleven episodes. It proves Matthew Weiner learned the most important lesson from *The Sopranos*: that the deepest truths about people are often revealed not when they are making history, but when history, indifferent to them, is happening just outside the window.



RATING: 9/10 (++++)

title.body: hello everyone 🤗 👋🏽👋🏽 how are you doing right now..though it's a bit too late to post this but I want share how happy I am as a mother to witness my daughter reaching this another milestone-- HER GRADUATION DAY \n\n

> --- As a mother,seeing my child reached this milestone felt a little bit overwhelming and exciting..at last the every effort and sacrifices everyday led to this beautiful and wonderful celebration of her graduation day..

> At 9:00oclock all the pupils in pre-school were being lined up and get ready to prepare for the processional march..As the march started I can't helped but felt so much proud as a mom while walking at the center of the aisle escorting my daughter during the processional..

> And when her turned to be on stage I accompanied my daughter and she received her certificate with a smile..I let my mother took pictures on us..This day felt so memorable and special to me and to my daughter..
>\nTo the people who always supported me with my motherhood journey I'm always grateful to them..I'm thankful that I survived also my daughter's milestone..\n
> Seeing her being successful at her age felt always so much joy that at last she's a bit mature and a little responsible now..

>
To her teacher also,I'm very grateful for she had the patience to teach my daughter to be a loving and a responsible kid..

Today I celebrated this graduation day with pride.Seeing my daughter walking on the stage was a happy feeling ever.. Happy too see her receiving her certificate at last...

title.title: How Often Should We Study The Word Of God. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
title.body:
https://youtu.be/lb9pM-VkUKE?si=K3PxqgFEVGSUl-KA
Good morning, brethren. It is a new week; it is Monday, the beginning of the working week. Let us wake up on the right side with God. Let us remember the teaching of the Word of God which teaches us to trust in the Lord with all our heart. We are not to depend on our own understanding. But in everything that we do, we should acknowledge God, then he will guide our path. When God guides a man:s path, that person is sure to meet with success in all that he or she embarks upon. Do you trust in God for your endeavors this week? Maybe you don't. I am inviting you today to trust God with your life. He will direct your path to success.

The Word of God is our guiding light. For without God, we can do nothing. We need to daily meditate on the word of God. We should delight ourselves in reading the Bible both morning and evening. It is the word of God that we have inside us that lighten our path as we keep going on our daily activities. There is no way one will be able to trust God if the Word of God is lacking in that person's heart. Faith comes by hearing; and hearing from the Word of God. It is not everything that we hear that will build our faith in God. Some news kills our faith and generates fear in us. Let us rely on the Word of God and believe everything that we learn from God.

title.title: Una Galleta Averiada / The Broken Cookie
title.body:
<center>

Una galleta sale del paquete,
rodando sola y de manera indiferente,
se estrella y esto la detiene,
contra un plato donde algo duerme
y su sueño se interrumpe abruptamente.

Se asoma una hoja larga,
intenta ver lo que pasa,
con cuidado baja
y con la galleta un rato habla
luego con fuerza lejos la manda. 

>A cookie rolls out of the package,
rolling on its own, indifferent,
it crashes and comes to a stop,
against a plate where something is sleeping
and its sleep is abruptly interrupted.

>A long leaf peeks out,
trying to see what’s happening,
it carefully lowers itself
and chats with the cookie for a while,
then flings it forcefully away.

![31047.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wgWJ8TsXrrKyczreqK75vginp1QS4pQ62awk6DbudMagwzhzk6EE8twFAeCyz1HdXhJ.gif)

La galleta se va rodando
y la hoja sube para seguir su descanso,
pero la galleta regresa tras un rato,
averiada, le falta un pedazo
y se estrella de nuevo contra el plato. 

La hoja de inmediato baja
y siente mucha lástima,
no quería que la galleta lastimaran,
la toma en sus brazos y la abraza,
para luego con ella llevarla. 

>The cookie rolls away,
and the leaf rises to continue its rest,
but the cookie returns after a while,
damaged, missing a piece,
and crashes onto the plate again.

>The leaf immediately comes down
and feels so sorry;
it didn’t want the cookie to get hurt,
so it picks it up in its arms and hugs it,
then carries it away.

![31048.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wqtjxFTBkVvuWihXwCfyLvW7c66uRpHGiZXFoAFv5ub89YigPqmS2qpiVCuPHTGwx4g.gif)

La sube hasta lo más alto
y ahí se pierden por un rato,
dejó este asunto olvidado
y me siento en la mesa con cuidado,
para almorzar un pan largo. 

Tomó mi cuchara con fuerza
y divido el pan sin prudencia,
lo que no esperaba es ver la galleta,
que la hoja protegia con cautela
entre la masa envuelta. 

>He lifts her up to the very top,
and there they lose themselves for a while;
he left this matter behind,
and I sit down at the table carefully,
to have a long loaf of bread for lunch.

>He took my spoon firmly,
and I cut the bread without hesitation;
what I didn’t expect was to see the cookie,
which the blade had carefully protected
inside the wrapped dough.

![31049.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xAiS5qJpviWGeRvHojNoociBfMv38Wy2AcE93RbK7BktsxKmFpk7vfqXfyotim6WAzX.gif)

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  The Life and Adventures of Nicholas Nickleby #16/456
title.body: ‘Ey!’ he said, ‘it was as good as anoother; that was a’ a matther of opinion’; and fell to looking at the fire, staring round the room, and whistling a little. On my reverting to some other topic that we had been discussing, he recovered immediately; but, though I tried him again and again, I never approached the question of the school, even if he were in the middle of a laugh, without observing that his countenance fell, and that he became uncomfortable. At last, when we had passed a couple of hours or so, very agreeably, he suddenly took up his hat, and leaning over the table and looking me full in the face, said, in a low voice: ‘Weel, Misther, we’ve been vary pleasant toogather, and ar’ll spak’ my moind tiv’ee. Dinnot let the weedur send her lattle boy to yan o’ our schoolmeasthers, while there’s a harse to hoold in a’ Lunnun, or a gootther to lie asleep in. Ar wouldn’t mak’ ill words amang my neeburs, and ar speak tiv’ee quiet loike. But I’m dom’d if ar can gang to bed and not tell’ee, for weedur’s sak’, to keep the lattle boy from a’ sike scoondrels while there’s a harse to hoold in a’ Lunnun, or a gootther to lie asleep in!’ Repeating these words with great heartiness, and with a solemnity on his jolly face that made it look twice as large as before, he shook hands and went away. I never saw him afterwards, but I sometimes imagine that I descry a faint reflection of him in John Browdie.
>In reference to these gentry, I may here quote a few words from the original preface to this book.

>‘It has afforded the Author great amusement and satisfaction, during the progress of this work, to learn, from country friends and from a variety of ludicrous statements concerning himself in provincial newspapers, that more than one Yorkshire schoolmaster lays claim to being the original of Mr Squeers. One worthy, he has reason to believe, has actually consulted authorities learned in the law, as to his having good grounds on which to rest an action for libel; another, has meditated a journey to London, for the express purpose of committing an assault and battery on his traducer; a third, perfectly remembers being waited on, last January twelve-month, by two gentlemen, one of whom held him in conversation while the other took his likeness; and, although Mr Squeers has but one eye, and he has two, and the published sketch does not resemble him (whoever he may be) in any other respect, still he and all his friends and neighbours know at once for whom it is meant, because – the character is so like him.

>‘While the Author cannot but feel the full force of the compliment thus conveyed to him, he ventures to suggest that these contentions may arise from the fact, that Mr Squeers is the representative of a class, and not of an individual. Where imposture, ignorance, and brutal cupidity, are the stock in trade of a small body of men, and one is described by these characteristics, all his fellows will recognise something belonging to themselves, and each will have a misgiving that the portrait is his own.

>‘The Author’s object in calling public attention to the system would be very imperfectly fulfilled, if he did not state now, in his own person, emphatically and earnestly, that Mr Squeers and his school are faint and feeble pictures of an existing reality, purposely subdued and kept down lest they should be deemed impossible – that there are, upon record, trials at law in which damages have been sought as a poor recompense for lasting agonies and disfigurements inflicted upon children by the treatment of the master in these places, involving such offensive and foul details of neglect, cruelty, and disease, as no writer of fiction would have the boldness to imagine – and that, since he has been engaged upon these Adventures, he has received, from private quarters far beyond the reach of suspicion or distrust, accounts of atrocities, in the perpetration of which, upon neglected or repudiated children, these schools have been the main instruments, very far exceeding any that appear in these pages.’
>This comprises all I need say on the subject; except that if I had seen occasion, I had resolved to reprint a few of these details of legal proceedings, from certain old newspapers.
>One other quotation from the same Preface, may serve to introduce a fact that my readers may think curious.

title.title: Craving Foods in Mang Inasal: Grilled Chicken with Soup and Unlimited Rice and Drinks , Palabok and Special  Halo-halo .
title.body:
Hello Hivers specially here in HivePh. Have a great day ! 
Just sharing here my cravings of foods in one of the famous fast-food chains today nationwide , MANG INASAL. 

![1000089230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23xetVZ3sJtyfCF6LMQ9c5mLyXbs4p8zijnTRJx8dspi7vfUZJzWsGtt4cZwcB7BukWnv.jpg)
After the 3 weeks vacation of my sister-in -law from Australia ,we went to the nearest Mang Inasal here in Lapu-Lapu City as despedida for here going back to Australia with her family . 

![1000088945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23x1BKQa771xXMjHpS4MYjyZrJdW3N4jjNKpdqxozpPWevj6Vspz5Xeq9cxKDBw57az8P.jpg)
We chose Mang Inasal due to its nice meals that can satisfy our cravings. I like all meals being served in this fast-food. They have the grilled chicken thigh and leg with unlimited rice if you want with selected drinks . This meal alone is enough to satisfy our cravings. . 

![1000088949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoyQ3P7C8UVsZXesvNQUpkF1KUGbjLuztRVkjijhK1vkkHcqsrhRyQ5QEDCrkeDG9xi.jpg)

![1000088947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoiWG6sypWsFEBXPWxWsduDCczbkqpfz3BXWpCD8rQS76F5qZsRSsRTbhnChn1SjfS2.jpg)
  Meal is not complete without this scrumptious palabok . I like the taste of this noodle that you can feel its special ingredients  once it  passes the throat . Its savory and tangy taste is so comforting and satisfying once twisted in the mouth. Palabok with rice is enough to compliment the meal . But, since all the foods serve in here are tempting due to its especial spices, it made us eager to try all of these . 

![1000088948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Eo6MMUwY3PF4AJ2YVWuN81eEZCviHSEcWqHEAPp322B5pXJh6rFpwnYiM2wvpxMLvDm.jpg)

![1000088950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoErwGPVwvBUtWb8TqKXMPwnXy4hKDHuo4effYdm1GdjNuLj6W98HoAApFwQXfDKL24.jpg)
After having the meal , to compliment the cravings , we had to finish it with special halo-halo. 
Not all fast-food chains serving this . But in Mang Inasal they have it. You can choose special or regular , large or small serve . This halo-halo has these multiple  ingredients such as evaporated milk, milk dusting added to its creaminess  mixed with shaved ice , ube ice cream, leche flan , buko pandan, red sago, jackfruit, red mongo beans , yellow beans, nata de coco and sweetened banana. 
After taking all of these , we go home with our stomach very full . 
Some other days , if we have another meal, mang Inasal is still our best choice . They have been serving very affordable delicious meals . 

![1000088951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpGRgUEGNZwc5VELDgX2kbWcku434TnomR1tC166jCUs5aZPZ7csDjueqfqEuCiem6n.jpg

Thank you for reading my blog . Till next time . 

Disclaimer,all  pictures are originally mine and are edited in canva . 

More power to HivePh!

title.body:
Tracking my result for season 180 : (approximately April 1 to April 15, 2026) https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tvcWHTtW5SAv63Z2J86Zuyvn5Jk2BQQ5qBQrGBvv5hRm1DUaVKJN4Z8X9eFfSokovT1.png
It feels like a quiet time in Splinterlands and in crypto in general. Though developments and building are still happening behind the scenes. I am looking forward to guild overhauls coming in a few months. They will introduce a new game mode to replace the old Guild brawls. I tried out SH Bot for a month and now I am back using XBot. The reason being that although SH Bot gave me a slight increase in winrate and leveled my season ranking up a bit, it was not enough to justify paying $2 per month plus 30% of my SPS earnings for it. With XBot I already own the token and only give up 10% of my SPS earnings. One feature that I really did like about SH Bot was that there was an option to where the bot would only play with a certain amount of staked SPS. I have never found this option on XBot. But it was nice because part of my staked SPS is purchased by me weekly. Fairly often I don’t notice that my SPS is low and so I end up wasting energy on battles with less of a multipler than I would like. Here is my soulbound progress from splinterhub. Slow but steady, I have increased by a few percentage points from a month ago.

Land cards did not sell out quickly like the original ones did. Currently, they are selling under the .25 cent price that was originally estimated and only about half of them have been minted. I have only sold a few of them so far.

title.title: How to have early success in *Octopath Traveler 0*
title.body:
I absolutely loved my first exposure to Octopath 2 but when I completed it, and loved basically every minute of it. I thought that I would try other games for a bit rather than jumping straight into another game that is basically exactly the same.

Now, after trying and liking a few of about a dozen games I am back on *Octopath*.   When I first started playing I found that I was really struggling very early on but that is because the game doesn't hold your hand and it isn't very clear what you are supposed to do.  It gives you a path to choose at the very beginning and the impression that you get is that you must pursue that particular path and that path only.   This is not the case and if you do try to go that route, you are going to have a bad time.   

<center> https://static0.thegamerimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/cotc-influence.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5
[src](https://static0.thegamerimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/cotc-influence.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5)</center>

When presented with this decision early on it is asking you with what it is that you want the most.   Looking at the benefits you can get it seems pretty fantastic to go for any of them.   I don't yet know what rubies are for but I suppose that will become evident later on.

Anyhoo, when I chose Fame, I looked at the map for my objectives and the \

ones were what appeared to be my desired destination although since this is kind of trying to pretend to be an open world game, you are capable of going in a bunch of other directions as well.

<center> https://static0.dualshockersimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/20251209171607_1.jpg?q=49&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=2
[src](https://static0.dualshockersimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/20251209171607_1.jpg?q=49&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=2)</center>

I decided to go thorough the Wealth categories one by one and wasn't paying much attention to the other destinations.  This resulted in me eventually getting to a boss that absolutely wiped the floor with me and had me trying a few more times only to realize that \
\n\nIf you look at the map above there are some very important things that say \

and while this was never pointed out to me by the game's design, these are things you need to prioritize, especially in early play.  These are, well 100% of them have been so far, people that will join your crew. 

<center> https://oyster.ignimgs.com/mediawiki/apis.ign.com/octopath-traveler-0/3/3b/Skill_Example_Phenn_Repeat_-_ot0img.jpg?width=1280
[src](https://oyster.ignimgs.com/mediawiki/apis.ign.com/octopath-traveler-0/3/3b/Skill_Example_Phenn_Repeat_-_ot0img.jpg?width=1280)</center>

You start the game out with 1 then 2 then 3 people in your crew, but you are allowed up to 8 active characters at a time.  I was unaware of this and the game doesn't tell you this.  So these battles that I was fighting and getting worked over pretty badly was because I had half as many people in my crew as I was allowed to have simply because I followed the \

that I thought was what you were supposed to do. \n\nI think that in this game, as was often the case in the other *Octopath* game that I played, that if you encounter something that absolutely whips your ass, there is a good chance that it isn't a bad strategy on your part, it is that you are not supposed to be there yet and you need to return to your map and look for \

to add new members to your party, or go and take on a quest that has a lower level associated with it.  

In my case with the first boss that I fought, it was around my current level, but I had half the amount of companions that I could have had with me.   

Having more people = more firepower, this should be obvious but well, I guess Squenix decided to force us to think for ourselves a bit and I don't have a problem with that.  

In this RPG, doing the same thing over and over and losing isn't going to make your experience any better, so when faced with a wall, walk around a bit and most importantly, look at your map and see if there is something else that you could maybe be doing.

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A simple Sunday that said it all
title.body: > **I hope you all have a wonderful start to the week, full of renewed energy and that motivation that makes everything go a little more smoothly. As for me, I can say that this Sunday I recharged my batteries to the max. I really needed it. I slept most of the morning, with no rush, no alarms, and none of that hustle that sometimes follows us even on weekends. I woke up very calmly, enjoying that slow awakening that is so welcome when the body has been accumulating fatigue. We had planned days in advance to go out to lunch with my father. We wanted to get him out of the house for a while, give him a change of scenery, and do something different all together. Although we visit him almost every day during the week, the time we share is usually short because we arrive tired from work. And I know—because life has taught me—that you have to visit older adults with time, with patience, and with a willingness to listen to them. They speak more slowly, walk more slowly, feel more slowly. And you have to learn to match their pace. Our son got up early and decided to rake the leaves in the yard. He bagged them up to throw them away and left everything very tidy. He wanted to do it quickly because he didn’t want to miss his walk with his grandfather. For him, those moments are special too, and I love seeing him so aware of the importance of spending time with his family. By around 10:00 a.m., we were ready to head over to my father’s house. The weather was sunnier than it had been the previous days, with that soft glow that signals a beautiful day. It was perfect for going out, chatting, taking a short walk, and just spending time together.**

> *Espero que tengan un hermoso inicio de semana, lleno de energías renovadas y de esa motivación que hace que todo fluya un poco mejor. Yo, por mi parte, puedo decir que este domingo recargue las mías al máximo. Hacía falta. Dormí gran parte de la mañana, sin apuros, sin alarmas, sin esa prisa que a veces nos acompaña incluso los fines de semana. Me levanté con mucha calma, disfrutando ese despertar lento que tanto se agradece cuando el cuerpo viene acumulando cansancio. Desde días antes habíamos planeado ir a almorzar con mi padre. Queríamos sacarlo un rato de su casa, cambiarle el ambiente y hacer algo diferente todos juntos. Aunque durante la semana lo visitamos casi todos los días, el tiempo que compartimos suele ser corto porque llegamos cansados del trabajo. Y yo sé —porque la vida me lo ha enseñado— que a los adultos mayores hay que visitarlos con tiempo, con paciencia, con disposición para escucharlos. Ellos hablan más despacio, caminan más despacio, sienten más despacio. Y uno tiene que aprender a acompasar el ritmo. Nuestro hijo se levantó temprano y decidió recoger las hojas del patio. Las embolsó para botarlas y dejó todo muy ordenado. Quiso hacerlo rápido porque no quería perderse el recorrido con su abuelo. Para él, esos momentos también son especiales, y me encanta verlo tan consciente de la importancia de compartir con su familia. Cerca de las 10:00 de la mañana ya estábamos listos para ir a casa de mi padre. El clima estaba más soleado que en días anteriores, con ese brillo suave que anuncia un buen día. Era perfecto para salir, conversar, caminar un poco y simplemente estar juntos.*
![photo_2026-04-20_00-29-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23yd623w4YVUTfHSnGdkrMkNAWbjgiXLT6AHP2bfFRQq2WHn7niMnbUJX3jBChg3kJDwX.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EokbairLtgjP6QuGfSs6wijt3L7XXAi68f1vRArRtY7cACKKBT2TwWfZmtyC7Z2y4cA.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-18-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqBbgkJUkGfNBwEX7RC1dwpar6LvrLbpzeeoLgNom44F2BHy2a5anTzxvDR8pJSZdSD.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-18-52.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqBcB2Mx7yKt2ioUKeKmmFjmhY6X4VcbdAzckDjrr9cF64pB54xpDRLBgTasCKuCQXx.jpg)

> **My father asked us to take him to meet a longtime friend of his before we went to lunch—a holistic doctor who has been looking after his health and cares deeply for him. We were happy to oblige. When they saw each other, it was a beautiful moment. He was moved to see her, and she was also delighted to see how much he had recovered since the last time they met. We gave them some space so they could talk, reminisce, and catch up. Sometimes those reunions are more therapeutic than any medicine.**

> *Mi padre nos pidió que antes de ir a almorzar lo lleváramos a encontrarse con una amiga de muchos años, una médico integral que ha estado pendiente de su salud y que lo aprecia muchísimo. Aceptamos encantados. Cuando se vieron, fue un momento hermoso. Él se emocionó al verla, y ella también se alegró al notar lo recuperado que estaba desde la última vez que se encontraron. Les dimos su espacio para que conversaran, recordaran anécdotas y se pusieran al día. A veces esos reencuentros son más terapéuticos que cualquier medicina.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnoJdZD8seA2kT3mUbxDKEC65ZGmPznS2zHYvrnuHYy2MEweDNcinibhM5EkAtjPQ6d.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpQume19uej2ti3PCEjttZ5YxMqocN2r82ki9cRudSzm8Rg1bb2kJUVrjBatPRdrpCx.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpLf7EeUtahqWDVBvkx1f1jQLsrRy9QP3gUXvsFqYsJie2TTLSDndu7zBUyH6hVcaQL.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-18-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpVC3eKYeHhvrdMjFGV2RWhwcgvnUA84QDdpNK6kbxWoidqB566E3TJhZBbBC5E22fy.jpg) ![a (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpNqn8cKojNZBLivRGYG9aDEU511pn2pW9onjrro5CTP3JMGnitrvt4Kmfta3ePkAT5.jpg) ![a (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EprWQeTv7tmwEzhDGcFZBEuYUqqWNLLBF4eQKNvop6Cmmrcq2ULwSHVSuGUtBsCtDfq.jpg)

> **When we were done, we continued on our way until we reached the Río de Playa El Ángel market, which is my father’s favorite. The idea was to have lunch without anyone having to cook, without any obligations, and without rushing. The food at that market is varied and very fresh, so it’s always a good choice.**

> *Cuando terminaron, seguimos nuestro camino hasta llegar al mercado Río de playa El Ángel, que es el que más le gusta a mi padre. La idea era almorzar sin que nadie tuviera que cocinar, sin obligaciones, sin apuros. En ese mercado la comida es variada y muy fresca, así que siempre es una buena opción.*
![z (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Epxqj9g1veR1iRW3ojGpLgePFj3888xV3rRAZmNtYRubCBJyv7TvpZn4e6ZtL44dcoS.jpg) ![z (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq9TuWgFMycf6149wsmYWkpy5xUkvHnWz8AWeewRvJGwmH7gUk2kzuRbKwwNsrQw2CG.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoeFRcvhRS9MTS7Ax9Yx3BX9KdCToM5JcjhcWSucZ9xsamgkTyrmWY9FtvQ3WDtpJti.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoGyoyjwCmTUX1LsFhv24pB6dHh74D2mYWGjSX7T6ccpdCJYkxRyJUDaXW7FaSgNL1Z.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep1Xt6yf68L8QKMmgyzDBYnzUWQBhfVqm1hkn2btHy96utnHkxnUXy7xfsZKNKNVZVo.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpA2XRQeRnS7KurbCPxSRUmaxBn5r9ksfk2pvNY6ukTAEDS9vHodw4FDMs7zENzWAm3.jpg)

> **My father chose the fish wheel, just like me. My son, true to his tastes, ordered chicken. And my husband, as always, went for the pasticho he loves so much from that place. We all enjoyed our meals, but what we enjoyed most was the conversation—the jokes, the laughter, the stories we’ve heard over and over again and still love. That family time together is, in the end, what matters most.**

> *Mi padre eligió la rueda de pescado, igual que yo. Mi hijo, fiel a sus gustos, pidió pollo. Y mi esposo, como siempre, se inclinó por el pasticho que tanto le gusta de ese lugar. Cada uno disfrutó su plato, pero lo que más disfrutamos fue la conversación; los chistes, las risas, las historias que se repiten y aun así nos encantan. Ese compartir en familia que, al final, es lo más importante.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoeExSS7h69ethNsctvdUVuQ16ETNVHLce5wn4dS1Fka89Hdc96eWJa9H2eYm8Thj3R.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK6o9xBbe9a5LJjiJsV6uas1fRSzMrkQ3YSUrPvapsvcgnMnYwyTHyWQoc4gNUTmuV.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoEqzrgLvHzKpzrMEsbifqFW2yhVCpdetfYXf7gaBgjy4Kcv69mPhkyGEMS6kNiphir.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eoc8YpZEwPZCpNkCSQdKavVieKGvFgsRrJGMwoFq2FLizJbN7MUezJw31F25gK891y5.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK7DcJwPavqQVaU9x6k4YcYvzbJAb9QD3Hzb1PmJr97hpqw3amMmjeRndLMCCeibrg.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-19-00.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23vsUqdptdpeU9UW5TzG55HaPrdyLWuWZN4Y8nDNEHNAiLbjJXbmae4wZfEPSDTVVCmyD.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-20_00-18-59.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoTcP472eisoCJQQw5XYTN946MWzwrvT6n3ZXg5FBai2Fh2rzqPdaFiscgAfrDpbgNd.jpg)

> **After lunch and a pleasant time together, we took my father back home. We also needed to rest a little more so we’d be ready and full of energy to tackle the new workweek ahead. So I’ll keep you posted on how this week goes as it gets underway, with all its challenges, surprises, and beautiful moments. See you soon. Bye.**

> *Después de almorzar y pasar un rato agradable, llevamos a mi padre de regreso a su casa. Nosotros también necesitábamos descansar un poco más para estar listos y con buena energía para enfrentar la nueva semana de trabajo que comienza. title.title: POWER UP  |  WITHDRAW EARNINGS
title.body:
It's not everyone that understands that life is extremely difficult for a lot of people and anytime they see money, they grab it immediately to sort out basic needs. Yes, not everyone knows about that. Or do you know about that? No, you don't!


POWER UP & WITHDRAW EARNINGS.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1yt1A4JruUUnBigPg6oZYzpdXuaZVV6v6gmhxnDQ3rr/1002472539.jpg)



Before I continue, I deal with the two sides...to withdraw and power up. Yes, if I had focused on powering up all my earnings, I would have been a whale here already and probably be in debt in real life too.  If I had settled with withdrawing all my earnings here, I wouldn't have up to 1,000HP remaining in my balance. So, I balance up by saving as power up and also withdraw when life actually becomes very tough in real life.


*Some time ago on this platform there was a trend of some whales down voting people that were powering down. Although, the whole idea of powering down is bad because it shows one just wants to hit and run and doesn't want to add to the community, in fact I instruct all my referrals not to power down because it helps in saving money as well especially in the beginning stage. But the truth is, we don't know the problem these people are passing through that made them power down. Some whale accounts which I can't mention their names were so serious about it and it was so annoying because it could be also that these people had saved up as a means of power-up and felt it was time to take a profit.*

For me, the method I'm practicing has been fair to me and if eventually things become better with regards to earnings outside the Hive platform and I don't need to touch my money here, then I'll go with the method of staking all my earnings here to increase my value too. I hope that comes and let it be soon.
Of course I have a friend that doesn't touch her earnings and she has grown so big. But life is very fair to her outside hive too😅. This same thing is applicable to everyone who has been stacking up here...yeah, life is good to you outside the hive platform.

Thanks for reading.

周五那天，是三月三假期第一天，和朋友约了划船，5点开始，帅哥去跑外卖了，我叫他四点就回到，结果磨蹭到四点十几二十才到，然后打车又久，师傅离我们几公里，去到那边要二十几分钟，路上又堵车，我几乎崩溃，气得我不行了。

因为我明明提前告诉他了，但是他还迟到那么多，朋友已经从家里去到了，我们才出门，后面朋友发来了视频和照片，告诉我们要怎么走，给了路线指导，我都做好了赶不上船的准备了。

结果最后三分钟居然赶到了，我们一路狂奔，终于上传了，验券之后就直接登船，没有多余的安检什么的，成功和朋友汇合了。

后面我们就在船上看了风景，给彼此拍照。在船上看风景，视野真的不一样，风景也不一样，第一次坐这种油或者电驱动的船，感觉体验也蛮不错的。

五块钱的船票，居然还有免费拍照的机会，摄影师可以给免费拍一张小照片还能打印出来。要买的话也是30一张，也不贵。

但是我和帅哥都是匆匆出门赶路，没有特别准备，我俩也表情管理失败，最后没有勇气去拍，错失了一次免费拍照的机会。

后面和朋友玩起了自拍什么的，也算是圆满了。

title.body:

![vM5yQjRVVDW5Nva0_IMG_6676.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/vM5yQjRVVDW5Nva0_IMG_6676/vM5yQjRVVDW5Nva0_IMG_6676.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

昨晚班主任在群里发消息说，美术生已经转入小班，我们不用上一对一的课程了。看到消息时我特别开心，终于可以不用那么累了。之前要兼顾两个班，还要带美术生，时间被严重挤压，几乎没有私人空间，整天都在备课。这种状态持续了太久，已经很久没有这么放松的感觉了。

本来上周六我只有早自习和晚上的课，结果因为美术生又加排了一节上午第三节课，导致我周末连瑜伽课都没法去上。只好趁着下午一点点空闲，让点哥带我去健身房撸铁，只能抓住一切机会运动。反而感觉工作量越大，内心对健身的渴望就越强烈。只要哪天没有晚自习，有空我就一定会去活动活动筋骨，整个人心情也会好很多。

我明显感觉到自己的核心力量有所增强，平时练得比较多的是美背和核心，唯独不怎么练臀腿。我实在不喜欢练臀，每次练完都酸得不行。

周日我还去水街那家瑜伽馆上了一节普拉提棍全身课，直接把我累趴下了。课程介绍写的是全身训练，我以为各个部位都会练到，结果大部分时间都在练臀，刚好是我最弱的项目。

练着练着就有点跟不上，汗一直往下滴，但练完以后又觉得特别畅快。看来我算是走上“正道”了，再也不排斥健身，甚至还乐在其中。

中午跟表姐约好一起吃饭，提前给侄女庆生。转眼她来这边快两年了，侄女也16岁了，时间过得真快！去年这时候给她过生日的场景还历历在目。

知道她很喜欢范丞丞，我提前在小红书上找他的联名周边，查到他代言了帕森墨镜和花西子彩妆。

一开始想送墨镜，夏天出门戴正合适，结果周边赠送活动已经结束了。后来看到花西子有送范丞丞周边的套装，加上夏天正需要防晒，就买了一套花西子防晒霜，还搭配送了范丞丞小卡，没想到正合她心意。她说前几天还在闲鱼上纠结要不要买这套小卡呢，这也算是心有灵犀啦～

body.title: A coffee in a special place / Un café en un lugar especial (eng-esp )
body.body:
Hello, coffee lovers!

We've always said that coffee is a great reason to get together with friends. And yesterday was one of those days when this maxim held true.
Yesterday, my wife and I met at a friend's house to enjoy some good coffee and freshly picked ripe cherries.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwnHbTHfh6b3t7mYXqzMrvZsVDo55hu4MgKNoFrsMofB/1776629978066.jpg)

Our hostess invited us to share some delicious sweets before going inside. We love going there to chat, as she has a beautiful patio, shaded by the many fruit trees that grow there.

One of these trees is a cherry tree; the cherries were perfectly ripe and ready to be picked.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZbCW22Xp4mB9XQCkGneoyAszytkeSMpRPcGd23H9HPG/1776630598399.jpg)

Once there, we brewed a good pot of coffee while chatting about literature, film, our families, and various other topics that came up between cups of coffee.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8vvSS4KTEwXUyHihuykzD33jumCCPePBfutB7SCbzJo/1776629978196.jpg)

Of course, we also stopped to pick the cherries 🍒. This was one of the moments I enjoyed the most, I won't lie.
The cherries were so ripe that they fell off the branch at the slightest touch. Sometimes they even lost a bit of their skin, leaving the juice in your hand.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNd6h6pd5WZcCWtLFqHrHDfftSm6TVJyS2ro89Sm3tSr6/1776629978338.jpg)

So, in addition to the delicious coffee we made (with a different coffee maker, of course), we had several pounds of cherries to share and eat.

Believe me, I had never thought about eating cherries while drinking coffee. A cookie, chocolate, candy... that's one thing, but cherries? It had never occurred to me.

However, it works.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpqzGPEPDMcZydevRANgkVuhZjv2HUMnibsHtUSdAW2S/1776629978476.jpg)

And if you don't believe me, ask @elviguitarra, who had a blast.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb578Fp79B4UXa3f5VLPFPd3kTF731s7K65Q3BXZxhQiz/1776629978584.jpg)

At the end of the day, he ended up lying down in the hammock while we prepared the third batch of coffee.

Those were the best three hours of yesterday; filled with coffee, ripe fruit, and the best possible company.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, amigos del café.

Siempre hemos hablado de que el café es un gran motivo para reunirnos con los amigos. Y ayer fue uno de esos días en que esta máxima se cumplió.
Ayer, mi esposa y yo nos reunimos en casa de una amiga para disfrutar de un buen café y de cerezas maduras recién recogidas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdwnHbTHfh6b3t7mYXqzMrvZsVDo55hu4MgKNoFrsMofB/1776629978066.jpg)

Nuestra anfitriona nos invitó a compartir unos deliciosos dulces antes de ir a su casa. A nosotros nos fascina ir hasta allá a conversar, ya que tiene un patio hermoso, sombreado gracias a los múltiples árboles frutales que lo habitan.
Uno de estos árboles es uno de cerezas; las cuales se encontraban bien maduras y listas para recoger.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZbCW22Xp4mB9XQCkGneoyAszytkeSMpRPcGd23H9HPG/1776630598399.jpg)

Una vez allá, preparamos una buena cafetera mientras conversábamos de literatura, de cine, de nuestras familias y de otros varios temas que surgían entre taza y taza de café.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8vvSS4KTEwXUyHihuykzD33jumCCPePBfutB7SCbzJo/1776629978196.jpg)

Por supuesto, también hicimos un alto para cosechar las cerezas 🍒. Este fue uno de los momentos que más disfruté, no les voy a mentir.
Las frutas se encontraban tan maduras que, de solo tocarlas, se caían de la rama. A veces hasta perdían un poco de la piel y dejaban el jugo en la mano.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNd6h6pd5WZcCWtLFqHrHDfftSm6TVJyS2ro89Sm3tSr6/1776629978338.jpg)

De modo que, además del exquisito café que preparamos (otra cafetera, por supuesto), teníamos varias libras de cerezas para compartir y comer.
Créanme que nunca había pensado en comer cerezas mientras tomaba café. Una cosa es una galleta, chocolate, dulces... pero ¿cerezas? Nunca se me había ocurrido. 
Sin embargo, funciona.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpqzGPEPDMcZydevRANgkVuhZjv2HUMnibsHtUSdAW2S/1776629978476.jpg)

Y si no me creen, pregúntenle a @elviguitarra, quien lo vivió a sus anchas.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb578Fp79B4UXa3f5VLPFPd3kTF731s7K65Q3BXZxhQiz/1776629978584.jpg)

A última hora, terminó acostándose en la hamaca, mientras preparábamos la tercera cafetera.
Fueron las mejores tres horas del día de ayer; llenas de café, frutas maduras y de la mejor compañía posible.

body.title: An Unforgettable Morning at Fortín Solano [ENG🇬🇧/SPA🇻🇪]
body.body:
>

Greetings to all the wonderful people of the Hive community. To be honest, today I want to share with you my recent adventure from April 19th, 2026. It was full of physical effort, recreation, and pleasant conversations with people I met along the way. Quite beautiful, to be completely honest. It was an experience I hadn't had in a long time.

#

I woke up very early at 5:00 AM. I got out of bed, went to the bathroom, took a cold shower, and got dressed as quickly as I could. The excitement I felt was something I hadn't experienced since January 2, when I went to the river with my younger brother. But that's a story for another post soon.

#

When the clock struck 6:00 AM, I left my house. With the fresh morning breeze and the sun rising over the horizon, I rode my bicycle towards a place in my city called Rancho Grande. The plan was to meet my adventure partner, leave the bike there, and continue on foot to climb a route known as the way to Fortín Solano.

#

This fort is also known as Mirador de Solano, located on the crest of El Vigía. It was a strategic military fortification used for multiple purposes: facing pirate ships, maritime surveillance, a prison, and other uses. To be honest, they also say that beneath it there are catacombs and an intricate network of tunnels connecting specific points of the city. Only the high military commanders of the time knew about them — back in 1766, when the fortress was built.

#

We started walking from Calle 35 in Rancho Grande and covered approximately 2.5 kilometers climbing to the top of El Vigía. Once we reached the top, the tiredness we carried simply vanished. In front of our eyes was such a marvelous view of the \

I took a couple of photos that, to be completely honest, left me speechless. # Then two people from Caracas approached us. They had arrived just the night before and decided to live the same adventure as us. The only exception was that for them, it was the first time seeing something so wonderful. We ended the conversation, the kind people said goodbye, and then we gathered our things to trace our way back. # Without a doubt, today was an unparalleled experience. Once I arrived at work to open the business, I told everyone about it. I hope it happens again soon, and that I can continue sharing part of my life and my adventures with all of you.

> Mis saludos cordiales a toda la gente de la comunidad Hive. Para ser honesto, en esta oportunidad quiero conversarles sobre mi reciente aventura del día 19 de abril de 2026. Estuvo llena de esfuerzo físico, recreación y conversaciones amenas con personas que conocí durante el trayecto. Fue bastante hermoso, para ser completamente honesto. Una experiencia que tenía tiempo sin vivir. # Desperté muy temprano a las 5 de la mañana. Me levanté de mi cama, fui al baño, tomé una ducha fría y me dediqué a vestirme para salir con la mayor prisa. La emoción que sentí no la experimentaba desde el 2 de enero que fui al río con mi hermano menor. Pero eso ya es historia para una pronta publicación. # Cuando el reloj dio las 6 en punto salí de mi casa. Con la brisa fresca de la mañana y el sol saliendo por el horizonte, conduje mi bicicleta en dirección a una localidad de mi ciudad llamada Rancho Grande. El plan era encontrarme con mi compañero de aventura, dejar la bicicleta e irnos a pie para subir una ruta que se le conoce como la vía al Fortín Solano. # El ya mencionado Fortín también se le conoce como Mirador de Solano, ubicado en la cresta del Vigía. Fue una fortificación militar estratégica con usos múltiples: hacer frente a las amenazas de barcos piratas, vigilancia marítima, prisión, entre otros usos. Para ser honesto, también se cuenta que debajo de esta se encuentran catacumbas y una entramada red de túneles que conectan puntos específicos de la ciudad. Solo los conocían los altos mandos militares de la época de 1766, fecha en la que fue construida esta fortaleza. # Partimos a pie desde la calle 35 de Rancho Grande y recorrimos un aproximado de 2,5 kilómetros subiendo hasta la cima del Vigía. Una vez arriba, el cansancio que llevábamos encima se desvaneció automáticamente. Frente a nuestros ojos se encontraba un paisaje tan maravilloso de la Ciudad Cordial. Capturé un par de fotos que, para ser completamente honesto, me dejaron sin palabras. # Luego se acercaron a mí y a mi compañero dos caraqueños que habían llegado recién la noche anterior. Se dispusieron a vivir la misma aventura que nosotros. Con la excepción de que para ellos era la primera vez que veían algo tan maravilloso. Culminamos la charla, las amables personas se despidieron de nosotros y luego tomamos nuestras cosas para trazar nuestro camino de vuelta. # Sin duda alguna hoy fue una experiencia inigualable. Una vez que llegué al trabajo para abrir el negocio, le hablé de esto a todos. Espero que pronto se vuelva a repetir y que pueda yo seguir compartiendo con ustedes parte de mi vida y de mis aventuras. ------ ---- |

body.title: Exquisite stewed mortadella//Exquisita mortadela guisada
body.body:
> Hello friends at @foodiesbeehive... Happy weekday! Here I share my post for this space, and I hope you like it. Today I’d like to share with you a lunch I made for my family. When it’s time to cook, we ask ourselves, “What can I make today?” We check the fridge and the pantry, and depending on what we have at home, we get to work. With a little creativity and just a few ingredients, you can whip up some delicious dishes—and today I’ll show you how to make braised mortadella.
![InCollage_20260419_201711889.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/AKs23j3pXF6dmnasdYF1jy2dQvkiQp7J6ZjZnSoiFM6b8Vt1kc6Mk6JYyxHbKS3.jpg)
This recipe is easy, using ingredients you can find at the supermarket. It’s perfect for any day of the week, and I’ll show you how to make it today. ***INGREDIENTS*** - 1 500g package of mortadella. - 1 bell pepper. - 1 onion. - 7 sweet peppers. - Several cloves of garlic. - 1 zucchini. - 1 carrot. - Salt to taste. - 1 chicken bouillon cube. - 1 teaspoon of annatto or food coloring.
![InCollage_20260419_191822846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23zbVvFNAVVfCkkVFTeZRRwQ6wmcScHMUk2dhrwvDFFD9q1bnzB3GbqbhkppZw2GAaWpg.jpg)
***UTENSILS*** • Pot. • Cutting board. • Knife. • Plate. • Spoon made of wood. • Container. • Teaspoon.
![InCollage_20260419_191702833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23yTjZTpUGeZVcv4LuH58bxfpcffcj9PfMnbXuo2Kpx3unFGHbjQh3KMrX5zffBGooM36.jpg)
**STEP-BY-STEP** * Wash the utensils.
![InCollage_20260419_201358664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23xyZf6pdzEGm2ZeTiChEC6fdCD3DNy4eGeNFq7JegWfHonS4UJvQ6paKeyACVdYfAnSB.jpg)
* Wash the vegetables (onion, bell peppers, paprika) and root vegetables (carrot, zucchini).
![InCollage_20260419_191450560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23xVRY12kvseRzn8mpwG4tHx5C3y7PisunUY6LRibouXfVR6BooUBS1ujSjv34pJnEXB6.jpg)
* Chop the mortadella into large pieces.
![InCollage_20260419_192357952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23vsUchSoFM1C7Dxx5ygave3JdUc1RsNuFASHWHRUkhq6xunc9y5s6HdUdSyfLh3An4sU.jpg)
* Chop the vegetables into small pieces.
![InCollage_20260419_192227060.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23wX3LYFiAxNNcR9T2BgfY5GrSuVGgyFwUostUgGbfhyf9GxwyW5onQNGxhZFJsTeEcyp.jpg)
* Sauté the onions, bell peppers, paprika, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally.
![InCollage_20260419_203531336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/AJL35xNWtSTHzXUnbv4tJAjvnF2FSjGbJ9V1gsFAjRh33uYdo6FmYSrxidmzW1w.jpg)
* Add the mortadella,the salt and chicken broth, let it cook for a few more minutes, and it’s ready.
![InCollage_20260419_204241197.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/23w2qRzurkykvdf7zakTLbGi5ri5hAKgapQfbsBph11gsex1dEHy3PDN35xEBd7NeUKS9.jpg)
* Serve and enjoy.
![InCollage_20260419_192459341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/AKU4e6yUdUzRUnxNnjFh2fBcp2z56e3G9BDUnKEYp6Pwu4TFCfVCty3BfgEV447.jpg)
I hope you’ll try making it at home, where it can be served for breakfast, lunch, or dinner alongside arepas, rice, spaghetti, bread, cassava flour, crackers, and more.
![InCollage_20260419_201613479.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yohanna78/AKzCVEjMnRSep3u9dqKTJw5v348dhUMPbxN45Wa84E8DzZ78bCCoZGazwCCjp38.jpg)
Per 100 g of mortadella, there are only 60 to 70 mg of cholesterol—the same amount found in white meat. Its salt content is also minimal. Last but not least, its high content of vitamins B1, B2, niacin, iron, zinc, and other minerals makes mortadella an ideal food for those who play sports or engage in physical exercise. Thank you for taking the time to read my post and for your support. I hope to see you here again soon with another delicious meal. The photos are by @yohanna78 with my Tecno Pop 7. Translated with Deelp translator.

Feliz día de semana por aquí le comparto mi publicación por este espacio y espero que les guste. >En esta oportunidad quiero compartir con ustedes la elaboración de un almuerzo que preparé para mi familia. >A la hora de cocinar nos preguntamos ¿qué puedo preparar hoy? y revisamos la nevera, la despensa y de acuerdo a lo que dispongamos en casa nos ponemos manos a la obra, con creatividad con unos pocos ingredientes se cocinan platos muy deliciosos en donde les prepararé mortadela guisada. >Esta receta es fácil, con ingredientes que se encuentra en el supermercado, se puede dar en cualquier día de la semana y te la mostrare hoy. >***INGREDIENTES*** > - 1 Mortadela 500gr. > - 1 Pimentón. > - 1 Cebolla. > - 7 ajíes dulces. > - Varios dientes de Ajo. > - 1 Calabacín. > - 1 zanahoria. > - Sal al gusto. > - 1 tableta de Caldo de pollo. > - 1 cucharadita de onoto o color. >***UTENSILIOS*** > • Olla. > • Tabla de picar. > • Cuchillo. > • Plato. > • Cuchara de madera. > • Envase. > • Cucharita. >**PASO A PASO** > * Lavar los utensilios. > * Lavar las verduras (cebolla, ajíes dulces, pimentón) y vegetales (zanahoria, calabacín). > * Picar la mortadela en pedazos grandes. > * Picar los vegetales y verduras en trozos pequeños. > * Sofreír las cebollas, los ajíes dulces, el pimentón y los ajos. body.title: Kugel with Cottage Cheese and Raisins\\Kugel mit Hüttenkäse und Rosinen
body.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we're cooking a variation of kugel with cottage cheese, raisins, and apples. The kugel is made in a round pan with egg noodles, sugar, cottage cheese, raisins, apples, and beaten eggs. It makes a hearty and delicious casserole. I loved it, so I'll be making other versions of kugel. Let's go, it's going to be delicious!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZX9Kn5qsGyj9trSffQrHctnTUdRBHrqD6cx3tQqDHoad/1.jpg)


Ingredients:
● Egg noodles - 300g
● 5% cottage cheese - 300g
● Apples - 2 pcs
● Raisins - 2/3 cup
● Sugar - 2/3 cup (to taste)
● Eggs - 4 pcs
● Butter - 40g
● Cinnamon - a pinch
● Black pepper, salt, vegetable oil for greasing the pan - to taste

1.Cook the egg noodles in salted water until tender; this takes about 10 minutes, depending on the type of noodles. Drain the noodles, add a knob of butter, and stir. I'll tell you a secret: this dish would work even with vermicelli; you can use any thin pasta that sticks together.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTPgSQRPfoTN86iwrG5usjCLtsMeezrTCktgD4JgEbVeh/2.jpg)


2.Add the cottage cheese, steamed raisins, sugar, and grated peeled apples to the same pan. Stir the mixture and sprinkle with cinnamon, a pinch of salt, and ground black pepper (pepper is essential in this recipe!). Beat the eggs in a bowl with a whisk or fork and add the egg whites to the pan. Stir the kugel mixture until smooth and sticky.



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb41WzSxLNGQwfGYvV8ywrVQ5k1fwSZmD3A2juwH1E7Fu/3.jpg)


3.Grease a round baking pan with vegetable oil and pour the contents of the pan into it. Smooth the kugel with a spatula and place in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit). Cook for 30 minutes.


![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYMvdCYJLYz9jLKbufWzZwHgHxEQvrACRjUpNRpsuSRET/4.jpg)


4.Remove the crispy kugel from the oven and let it cool. It looks quite crispy!



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWoYQP98oam75WqSJ4vFtX1Xh6Zj6foTT9D7Rnata5tTe/5.jpg)


5.Cut the kugel into pieces and serve. A delicious egg noodle casserole for tea! And the black pepper perfectly complements the sweet flavor of the noodles. I need to make more! There are so many variations of kugel!


![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPGqY4Ztaah6zASDx8yduECnG1knfhTjBndaAvWWky8NF/6.jpg)


Shall we cook it?


![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir eine Variante von Kugel mit Hüttenkäse, Rosinen und Äpfeln zu. Der Kugel wird in einer runden Form mit Eiernudeln, Zucker, Hüttenkäse, Rosinen, Äpfeln und verquirlten Eiern zubereitet. Er ergibt einen herzhaften und köstlichen Auflauf. Er hat mir so gut geschmeckt, dass ich noch weitere Kugel-Varianten ausprobieren werde. Los geht's, es wird lecker!

Zutaten:
● Eiernudeln – 300 g
● 5%iger Hüttenkäse – 300 g
● Äpfel – 2 Stück
● Rosinen – 2/3 Tasse
● Zucker – 2/3 Tasse (nach Geschmack)
● Eier – 4 Stück
● Butter – 40 g
● Zimt – eine Prise
● Schwarzer Pfeffer, Salz, Pflanzenöl zum Einfetten der Pfanne – nach Geschmack

1.Die Eiernudeln in Salzwasser bissfest kochen; das dauert je nach Nudelsorte etwa 10 Minuten. Die Nudeln abgießen, ein Stück Butter hinzufügen und umrühren. Kleiner Tipp: Dieses Gericht funktioniert auch mit Fadennudeln; Sie können jede dünne, zusammenklebende Pasta verwenden.

2.Hüttenkäse, gedämpfte Rosinen, Zucker und geriebene, geschälte Äpfel in dieselbe Pfanne geben. Die Mischung umrühren und mit Zimt, einer Prise Salz und gemahlenem schwarzen Pfeffer bestreuen (Pfeffer ist in diesem Rezept unerlässlich!). Die Eier in einer Schüssel mit einem Schneebesen oder einer Gabel verquirlen und das Eiweiß in die Pfanne geben. Die Kugelmasse glatt rühren, bis sie klebrig ist.

3.Eine runde Backform mit Pflanzenöl einfetten und den Inhalt hineingießen. Die Kugelmasse mit einem Spatel glattstreichen und in den vorgeheizten Ofen bei 180 Grad Celsius (350 Grad Fahrenheit) schieben. 30 Minuten backen.

4.Den knusprigen Kugel aus dem Ofen nehmen und abkühlen lassen. Er sieht richtig knusprig aus!

5.Den Kugel in Stücke schneiden und servieren. Ein köstlicher Eiernudelauflauf zum Tee! Und der schwarze Pfeffer harmoniert perfekt mit dem süßen Geschmack der Nudeln. Ich muss unbedingt mehr davon machen! Es gibt so viele Kugel-Varianten!

Wollen wir ihn mal zubereiten?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

body.title: Solo vs. 2-Player Missions | Ghost of Yotei Legends: The Serpent
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



After completing the prologue of the Ghost of Yotei Legends multiplayer mode, I set out to try one of its campaign missions, which offers the possibility of playing solo if you don't have a PlayStation Plus subscription like me.
>#### Ghost of Yotei Legends | Campaña: La Serpiente Misión 1 solo
>Tras completar el prólogo de el modo multijugador de Ghost of Yotei Legends, me dispuse a intentar una de sus misiones en el modo campaña, que ofrece la posibilidad de jugarlo solo, si no tienes la suscripción al Playstation plus como yo.

<center>  
![1000354118.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tGXden1RoFNbsYx9pV3t9ZXYXScU4KK2omeMBrLsvZAvQccrECgnzQKkzL94Q2PadWk.gif)
  </center>


I knew this was going to be a challenge because these missions are designed to be played in pairs. With two players in theory, the number of enemies you face can increase, as well as the difficulty they offer in combat. That's why I decided to make a video of my experience and how I completed it solo, in case anyone looks on YouTube for how to do it alone.
>Sabía que esto iba a ser un desafío porque está misiones están diseñadas para jugarse en duo. Al ser dos jugadores en teoría, el número de enemigos que enfrentas puede aumentar, así como la dificultad que ofrecen al combatirlos. Por eso decidí hacer un vídeo de como fue mi experiencia, como lo complete solo, por si alguna persona que busque en Youtube como hacerlo solo.

<center>  
![1000354121.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tGbncBoZsvN4ia38ZtYd3rPX5a28JXAD43LGSRTXb6opb1cdWruJg2PVgUrz7Lu2zK2.gif)
  </center>


As I mentioned in my previous post, the campaign consists of several missions with different difficulty levels, divided among the six of Yotei. I decided to complete the first mission of The Spider, as it is the first one Atsu faces in story mode. This mission consists of 3 acts; in each one, you advance through terrain where you must eliminate all enemies and a kind of cursed cabinet.
>Cómo conté en mi publicación anterior, la campaña consta de varias misiones con distintos niveles de dificultad, divididas entre los seis de Yotei. Decidí completar la primera misión de La Araña, ya que es el primero que Atsu enfrenta en el modo historia. Está misión consta de 3 actos, en cada una avanzas por terrenos donde debes eliminar a todos los enemigos y una especie de armarios malditos.



<center>  
![1000354123.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tRzwsUsTRKt1WADj1wtKwejUGJWx7XubWBqXRvuPWhdaVjZXu6KLwP3t8S5E4UVfYgv.gif)
  </center>


That sounds easy, but it turns out the enemies are cursed with the kami of the moon, the sun, and the star, if I remember correctly. To defeat each type more easily, you must acquire the power of the moon, the sun, or the stars. The thing is, you can face enemies with each of these curses at the same time, so while you deal a lot of damage to one, you don't to another, which forces you to dodge a lot and switch powers constantly.
>Eso suena fácil, pero resulta que los enemigos están malditos con el kami de la luna, el sol y la estrella si mal no recuerdo. Para derrotar a cada tipo más fácilmente, debes hacerte con el poder de la luna o el sol o las estrellas. El caso es que puedes enfrentar a la vez a enemigos con cada una de estas madilciones a la vez, así que mientras a uno le haces mucho daño, a otro no, lo que te obliga a esquivar mucho y cambiar de poder constantemente.


<center> 
![1000354122.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23tS12ns7ZNBQsUfvEyDSrGPU8pwZEWPQok2DhNX8VNtZRVU5YEr1wGoy9CKFgiEZnmYT.gif)
   </center>


Mastering this takes time, but once you get into the rhythm and get used to it, you start to enjoy it. You have 3 lives in case you are defeated; it's best to save them for the 3rd act, where everything becomes more complicated. By completing it, we gain experience that allows access to better weapons that deal more damage, improve defense, and give us access to new abilities, so we can access missions where a higher level is required. I'll leave the video here; it's a bit long, lasting 28 minutes, but you can fast forward to the third act to at least see how it ends.
>Dominar esto toma tiempo, pero una vez que le tomas el ritmo y te acostumbras, empiezas a disfrutarlo. Tienes 3 vidas por si te derrotan, lo mejor es guardarlas para el 3er acto, dondo todo se complica más. Al completarlo ganamos experiencia que permite acceder a mejores armas que hacen más daño, mejoran la defensa y nos dan acceso a nuevas habilidades, para poder acceder a las misiones donde se requiere un nivel más alto. Por acá les dejo el vídeo, es algo largo, dura 28 minutos, pero puedes adelantar hasta el tercer acto para por lo menos ver cómo termina.
