body.title: Fruit Hunting and Harvest Prioritize eating healthy and beneficial fruits for our health
body.body:
# Hello Hive

Happy new week to us all I pray that the new week works in our favour and may we enjoy the very best of it.

We have had one of the most longest weekend ever and been so tired I stayed away from online for the longest time ever. I was able to make it to church on Sunday which was yesterday before retiring to my bed and resting as much as I can.


![1000194654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xVMbVrhFfbhgHWQLFfEkni8RDj6mEuw6vhnn3rbLX4oqsyM9xq9cVxZdQWbXgswkiwS.jpg)



Last weekend, we were able to complete a major part of our weeding exercise like I have bloggged about earlier. The weeds covered almost all the crops here, from the corn down to the  pepper farms, the vaste fluted pumpkins and even into the recently planted okro.
Now that the rains have begun to fall we trust God some of the crops that were finding it challenging to grow due to I sufficient rain water will begin to do well now. 


![1000194634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242hSR7Nq275o1UaaqoqK9ifGvz4Jn3vh4tKwiXzBvfG5kchmUynfzvDrcE7D6JXXvAB6.jpg)

Part of what we have gone out doing on Saturday was to hunt for some free fruits. Fruits are getting more scarce and expensive as the day passes by. I continue to wonder why not so many people   value eating of fruits. 
Most of the community people here eats a lot of starchy food, they prefer to eat as much of what will fill up their belly rather than harness the vitamins and minerals  present in fruits.


![1000194625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xyhtJvqB4xLg7b5VJgXer4g6LzizvTEYqAcZ8C8YTiyWEvNmKtSv15RLYvi2JoYyn9F.jpg)


Eating healthy and balanced diet is important for our health , often times it's not about quantity but quality and fruits are very beneficial for our health ...

Before now it is possible to see fruit trees almost everywhere around us, anyone can plug different types of fruits for free but due to estate management and construction of houses nos  most fruit trees have been cut down and fruits are no longer readily available 


![1000194634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242hSR7Nq275o1UaaqoqK9ifGvz4Jn3vh4tKwiXzBvfG5kchmUynfzvDrcE7D6JXXvAB6.jpg)



![1000194646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EqhQkL4JSd6fCpbiKmx2gyzovmqLH5SqvW1FAzT8Pqv8in3LBud9htRaGQEGkh1uSrz.jpg)


To eat certain fruits you have to purchase the ones sold at the market which have been brought in from other location.

With Any opportunity we get to the reach our farm farm on our own, we often move further into the bushes where we can get fruits for free.  So far there are a few available ones here that people can still harvest for free.


It is important to plant fruit trees and grow some of these healthy fruits within our environment. In my father's compound, we do have some orange trees which pepper heva been enjoying it's fruits for a long time now,  I hope that more people will come to realize the benefits of eating fruits and prioritize the planting of fruit trees is strategic places in the community

## Korean Hive Village Contest #43  Sharing K-Culture #12 🎁

Hello. Friends

Thank you for your interest, love, and participation.

We would like to run a contest to revitalize the Korean Hive Village community.

We want to grow into a contest where all my HIVE friends can participate. Please comment if you have any good opinions.

We hope you will participate.

✅ Notification

Thank you for your support
@yeouido.park - VOTE support
@melinda010100 - Ecency Points

If you would like to sponsor for the revitalization of the community, please leave a comment.

Thank you ❤️

---

***1.Post on Korean Hive Village***

# Prompt : Sharing K-Culture

Please share any pieces of Korean culture you’ve experienced over the past week. Any field is welcome!

🎨 K-Culture Categories to Talk About
👉K-Food (Dining Culture): Tell us about visiting Korean restaurants, cooking Korean food yourself, or your experience with communal dining.

👉K-Content (Media): Share interesting scenes or memorable backgrounds from K-Dramas, movies, or variety shows you watched.

👉K-Pop (Music): Talk about listening to your favorite artist’s new song, watching music videos, or participating in dance challenges.

👉K-Beauty & Fashion (Style): Share your stories about trying Korean skincare/makeup or styling yourself with Korean fashion brands.

👉K-Language (Language): Introduce new Korean words or grammar you learned, or funny episodes you had while studying Korean.

👉K-Webtoon & Literature (Books): Share the Korean emotions you felt while reading webtoons on your phone or Korean novels.

👉Etc: Feel free to share any other K-Culture experiences that don't fit into the categories above.

✍️ Writing Guide
Select an Experience: Choose a category from the list above that you experienced this week.

Describe in Detail: Tell us specifically about a taste, a scene, or a moment that left the deepest impression on you.

Share Your Thoughts: Write about the feelings you had or what new things you learned about Korean culture through that experience

We will select 3 people who write good quality posts for the community.

1st place 20 HSBI, 300 Ecency Points 🎁
2st place 10 HSBI, 200 Ecency Points 🎁
3st place 5 HSBI, 100 Ecency Points 🎁

How to Participate : Please Post with #kcontest tag and leave your URL in the comments and record the 3 friends you want to sponsor.

If you win, the 3 people who want to sponsor will receive 1 HSBI 🎁.

***2.Reblog***

Among those who do reblogs, 5 people will be drawn and 1 HSBI 🎁 will be given to each.

***3.Subscribe to Korean Hive Village***

We will select 5 new subscribers and give you 1 HSBI 🎁 each.

***4. @hivekr (Korea  Community Delegation Service) Events for delegators***

We will select two person and give you a small prize. 🎁

Period : ~ 2026.4.24

Result Announcement : 2026.4.25

body.title: B&N | El mundo sin color || B&W | The world without color 📸
body.body:
![1000981061.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xAZuZ6a7J9S586cFdaYrax1avzSfiiWTYsDjHnGfob3pfSVZ1WnU95CZNc7KPBvPeS7.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

¡Hola Chicos!

Hace algunos días les conté un poco sobre como fue este día documentando todo al estilo blanco y negro. Ese día tomé muchas fotos, de las cuales les compartí varias pero acá les voy a presentar mis favoritas y el motivo por el que me gustaron tanto. Es muy diferente ver la vida a color que en ausencia de él. Siento que las fotos transmiten mucho más sentimiento que una típica. Además el teléfono que tengo captura mejor los momentos que el anterior y no había tenido esa motivación de querer probar su potencial, más allá de lo que documento por trabajo.

Hi guys!

A few days ago I told you a bit about how I spent this day documenting everything in black and white. That day I took a lot of photos, several of which I shared with you, but here I'm going to show you my favorites and why I liked them so much. It's very different to see life in color than in its absence. I feel that the photos convey much more emotion than a typical one. Also, the phone I have now captures moments better than my previous one, and I hadn't had the motivation to try out its full potential, beyond what I document for work.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000887654.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23zkk7We1aMqSaiju4HJ4a9T5m57FqyARfxnU1hVvRGrE59E3YbfYWNF419KJXUvDPXmc.jpg) De un tiempo para acá he venido perdiendo la costumbre de tomar fotos y me he limitado a tomar solo cualquier situación que me sirva para hacer un post, ya sea de Hive o de mi Instagram. Incluso me he dejado de tomar fotos, es por eso que dentro de estás pruebas decidí tomarme algunas para ver qué tal resultaba.
![1000887646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/242DSz9WhqKCHAJgMTcRpYy4UHoNdU45pUCANPDPvnKixicabtfbBVoEUmVbFAJ8V17Cq.jpg) Lately, I've been losing the habit of taking photos and have limited myself to only capturing situations that might be useful for a post, whether for Hive or my Instagram. I've even stopped taking photos altogether, which is why I decided to take some during these tests to see how it would turn out.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000887649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2iuBMs5gyE3FjgHjD8MBL2NKVsJfvanwz4ifcCqC6TJ5c54SGDCXW1RdBoAfHrzyiN.jpg) ![1000887655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23ywqPtyxJgp6smGNkwLFFC3mUnSQQiR13xxwhDPJ73nzeMTgoz9WzKHe4PQM8tfTrRxR.jpg) Ese día tuvimos un taller en el local y por estar tomando fotos en blanco y negro se me olvidó por completo que debía hacerlo a color para las redes 🤭. La foto de las pinturas me encantó.
![1000887648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23w2mSFSutG1Ve5tr4ue9zidoVE7JnbFyZmfwJAirrkP1CKtqKm63jEv6odyWLPdapYPd.jpg) ![1000887644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23wC9iPaHzjRwN6ig474CTzchEkn5PQoRyMh7xwnwhHwuK6iD2CNwVpD6EFm2PRYXZvx8.jpg) That day we had a workshop at the studio, and because I was taking black and white photos, I completely forgot I was supposed to post them in color on social media 🤭. I loved the photo of the paintings.
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000887650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23viAKpATXNGkjUZv6f3RKZvcEpGWn2T8SYtYQ7c667LYqnxa36CBjhTjdXaWbdu5VFFb.jpg) ![1000887643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23zbKEo7iPgzcpGnWaJJDLeHijEpJVaMmQenDNMqrsijNHFJBg5K9NCc9xHHRrRzYNoLS.jpg) Ese día iba a ir a una farmacia cercana al local para comprar unos esmaltes de uñas y aproveché el atardecer para capturar unos momentos muy especiales. Mi foto favorita es la de las instalaciones eléctricas que me parece que se juega mucho con la perspectiva y los ángulos de la estructura. No soy experta fotografías pero siento que esta tiene mucho potencial.
![1000887652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vi26BHJhS4MR2DcCNqdwdw8wSpfX9GmJS9y11EtPBRrf5muJ1c5Wuy8exyo25qMsiA9.jpg) ![1000887656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/242NefjS3DyVzKQrRkWhzimqziJNrCTXNsbaWgPAZSuuWm2SLqJsopbv1KS7nu4ExkRm3.jpg) That day I was going to a pharmacy near the shop to buy some nail polish, and I took advantage of the sunset to capture some very special moments. My favorite photo is the one of the electrical installations, which I think plays really well with perspective and the angles of the structure. I'm not an expert photographer, but I feel this one has a lot of potential.
![1000887663.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23tvnpxbev6mQjdCVieq5yhXZc7RzArjvEWbAymzbaF94T8XBdtbgrDdtERuiBRJejQBy.jpg) ![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)
![1000887657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23zGijEySoCCwFavoyFH6keMXHjpVnTETBJ3bJnqfDTjWY8MNAwE2LSvVdd3qVdwNwpTu.jpg) ![1000887667.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23vsNPeRGQnMivc8wHXeVfC3S9HWZkexdcotYRBdJDSsHuwyvQ7LgEm5Jofy7mVjDCg5P.jpg) De verdad fue un bonito experimento el documentar mi vida de esta forma. Pienso hacerlo más seguido porque además de lograr resultados increíbles, me divierto mucho en el proceso. La fotografía es uno de mis hobbies y el congelar un instante para poder llevarlo conmigo para siempre es algo mágico. Espero les haya gustado estas fotos tanto como a mí nos leemos en un próximo post.
![1000887645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23uQrHEa58MJxAQUdtemoFYwAYzHeLPPpz8BA73EYR17BRtwtymy5noGhXxKmN5ZyrPLi.jpg) ![1000887660.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/23xebSLDPpzXjThLVEpKiTefQCySDugYfhFTwYGHk17EwyomgWu1y8uJDzkMWyi6JHW6B.jpg) It was truly a wonderful experiment documenting my life this way. I plan to do it more often because, besides achieving incredible results, I have so much fun in the process. Photography is one of my hobbies, and freezing a moment so I can carry it with me forever is magical. I hope you enjoyed these photos as much as I did. See you in the next post!
![colorido (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/estefania3/EqfMmY8yEq5LHeoFpS7iEadNv2dkKxnS7Xx7BVvVGfq7YstqehGVhibw6QoCwjWQtjC.png)

title.title: Tìm hiểu về chế độ lấy gió trong và ngoài xe ô tô (A/C)
title.body:
Hệ thống điều hòa trên ô tô luôn có 2 chế độ quan trọng: lấy gió trong và lấy gió ngoài. Hiểu đúng và dùng đúng sẽ giúp bạn mát nhanh hơn, tiết kiệm nhiên liệu và bảo vệ sức khỏe.

Chi tiết: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/che-do-lay-gio-trong-va-ngoai-xe-o-to/> 

![che-do-lay-gio-trong-va-ngoai-o-to.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/382113b62e2ddc66650d67d9f792d5423b1f5f8b14d72750d99a15e991bb7ffd)



1.  Lấy gió trong là gì?

👉 Là chế độ tuần hoàn không khí bên trong xe, không lấy không khí từ ngoài vào.

🔹 Ký hiệu:

Hình ô tô + mũi tên xoay vòng bên trong

🔹 Đặc điểm:

Làm mát nhanh hơn

Giữ nhiệt độ ổn định

Ít bụi, ít mùi từ bên ngoài

1.  Lấy gió ngoài là gì?

👉 Là chế độ hút không khí từ bên ngoài vào trong xe.

🔹 Ký hiệu:

Hình ô tô + mũi tên đi từ ngoài vào

🔹 Đặc điểm:

Không khí tươi hơn

Giảm bí, ngột ngạt

Nhưng làm mát chậm hơn

1.  So sánh nhanh 2 chế độ

Tiêu chí  Gió trong  Gió ngoài

Làm mát  Nhanh  Chậm

Không khí  Tái sử dụng  Tươi

Tiết kiệm xăng  Tốt hơn  Tốn hơn

Lọc bụi  Tốt hơn  Kém hơn

1.  Khi nào nên dùng gió trong?

👉 Nên bật khi:

🌞 Trời nắng nóng

🚗 Đi trong thành phố đông xe

🏭 Khu vực nhiều bụi, ô nhiễm

🚦 Kẹt xe

➡️ Giúp mát nhanh và tránh khí độc

1.  Khi nào nên dùng gió ngoài?

👉 Nên bật khi:

🌙 Trời mát

🛣 Đi đường dài

🚗 Xe đông người (dễ thiếu oxy)

😵 Cảm thấy ngột ngạt

➡️ Giúp không khí trong xe dễ chịu hơn

1.  Cách sử dụng hiệu quả nhất

👉 Mẹo chuẩn:

✔️ Lúc mới lên xe nóng:

→ Bật gió ngoài + mở cửa vài phút

✔️ Sau đó:

→ Chuyển sang gió trong để làm mát nhanh

✔️ Đi lâu:

→ Thỉnh thoảng chuyển gió ngoài

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

❌ Không bật gió trong liên tục nhiều giờ

→ Dễ thiếu oxy, buồn ngủ

❌ Không dùng gió ngoài khi ô nhiễm nặng

✔️ Vệ sinh lọc gió điều hòa định kỳ

1.  Lỗi thường gặp

❌ Không biết đang bật chế độ nào

❌ Luôn để gió trong → ngột ngạt

❌ Luôn để gió ngoài → điều hòa yếu

1.  Mẹo nhớ nhanh

👉 Gió trong = mát nhanh

👉 Gió ngoài = không khí tươi

Kết luận

👉 Hai chế độ gió đều quan trọng:

Gió trong → làm mát hiệu quả

Gió ngoài → đảm bảo không khí

➡️ Cách dùng tốt nhất:

Kết hợp linh hoạt tùy tình huống

title.body:
Việc công ty bán xe ô tô cho cá nhân không chỉ là giao dịch mua bán thông thường mà còn liên quan đến hóa đơn, thuế và thủ tục sang tên. Dưới đây là hướng dẫn đầy đủ, dễ hiểu từ A–Z: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/thu-tuc-ban-xe-cong-ty-cho-ca-nhan/>

![thu-tuc-ban-xe-cong-ty-cho-ca-nhan.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/ddc8fb382e8f08ac5cf79515a1a35ff5fed81b75811f307246cc9a1b89c2530e)



1.  Công ty bán xe cho cá nhân có hợp pháp không?

👉 CÓ. Doanh nghiệp hoàn toàn được phép bán tài sản là xe ô tô khi:

Xe thuộc sở hữu công ty

Có đầy đủ giấy tờ hợp pháp

Được người đại diện pháp luật phê duyệt

1.  Các loại thuế cần nộp

🔹 Thuế phía công ty (bên bán)

👉 Công ty phải kê khai:

💰 Thuế GTGT (VAT): thường 10%

💰 Thuế TNDN (lợi nhuận từ bán tài sản)

📌 Xuất hóa đơn VAT cho người mua là bắt buộc

🔹 Thuế phía cá nhân (bên mua)

👉 Người mua phải nộp:

💰 Lệ phí trước bạ: 2% giá trị xe

➡️ Áp dụng khi sang tên

1.  Hồ sơ bán xe công ty cho cá nhân

🔹 Phía công ty chuẩn bị

Giấy đăng ký xe (cà vẹt)

Hóa đơn VAT

Quyết định thanh lý tài sản

Biên bản họp (nếu có)

Giấy giới thiệu + CCCD người đại diện

🔹 Phía cá nhân chuẩn bị

CCCD

Tiền mua xe

Hồ sơ sang tên

1.  Quy trình thực hiện

🔹 Bước 1: Công ty ra quyết định bán xe

Lập quyết định thanh lý tài sản

Xác định giá bán

🔹 Bước 2: Ký hợp đồng mua bán

👉 Có thể:

Ký hợp đồng

Hoặc dùng hóa đơn VAT thay thế

🔹 Bước 3: Xuất hóa đơn VAT

👉 Đây là điểm khác biệt lớn so với cá nhân bán xe:

Công ty bắt buộc xuất hóa đơn

Ghi rõ giá trị xe

🔹 Bước 4: Nộp lệ phí trước bạ

👉 Cá nhân thực hiện:

Nộp tại cơ quan thuế

Nhận biên lai

🔹 Bước 5: Sang tên xe

👉 Nộp tại cơ quan công an:

Giấy đăng ký xe

Hóa đơn VAT

CCCD

Biên lai trước bạ

➡️ Bấm biển số mới (nếu khác tỉnh)

1.  Điểm khác biệt so với mua xe cá nhân

Nội dung  Công ty bán  Cá nhân bán

Chứng từ  Hóa đơn VAT  Hợp đồng công chứng

Thuế  Có VAT + TNDN  Không

Minh bạch  Cao hơn  Thấp hơn

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Phải có hóa đơn VAT hợp lệ

✔️ Giá bán không nên quá thấp (dễ bị truy thu thuế)

✔️ Xe không bị thế chấp, tranh chấp

✔️ Kiểm tra phạt nguội trước khi mua

1.  Chi phí tổng thể

👉 Người mua thường phải trả:

Lệ phí trước bạ: 2%

Phí đăng ký, biển số

Giá xe (đã gồm VAT)

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Quy trình:

Công ty quyết định bán

Xuất hóa đơn VAT

Cá nhân nộp trước bạ

Sang tên xe

Kết luận

👉 Mua xe từ công ty:

Thủ tục rõ ràng, minh bạch

Có hóa đơn đầy đủ

👉 Nhưng:

➡️ Phải chú ý phần thuế và hồ sơ hợp lệ

title.title: 做事‘一心二用’之后……
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![8Drjjo6sETYdXavd_MEITU_20260420_122341069.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/neithya/images/8Drjjo6sETYdXavd_MEITU_20260420_122341069/8Drjjo6sETYdXavd_MEITU_20260420_122341069.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

周末在我姐家里蹲——看音综度过的，而我姐和姐夫他们，顶着狂风外出去接我妈了

看着时间觉得她们可能快回来了，我就发信息给我姐，说自己在家先煮个燕麦粥（我姐买的，但一直没怎么吃，疑似快过期了）

煮了一半看着粥太稀了，发现柜子里有葛根粉，豆包上查询了下煮葛根粉的方法后，就直接挖了三勺放进去搅拌（当时一边看电视一边看说明，结果漏看了一行字😂

为了再营养些，又倒了一杯牛奶🥛，还洒了六颗红枣

等晚上开吃的时候，我姐说里面放了桃胶?燕麦粥里有很多看似透明的小疙瘩，我说没有是葛根粉……咬破疙瘩后，里面还是葛根粉😭，就……煮的粥都不能喝了……因为葛根粉成了块状，大部分都没熟

我喝了半碗，晚上还闹肚子了😂，其他全都倒了，好浪费（被训斥一顿自然必不可少😔

做事得专心、仔细……不能一心二用，不过那些左右手可以同时写字的人，是咋恁牛掰啊！

**感谢阅读！祝你生活明媚，身体安康！**

title.title: El ser superior (cuento corto)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYthBnxaHNrxru788gDJBFLi5GWVfqyHFpxfNexmhgnhH/1776651524203.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-dragon-fantasy-9129381/)

1 - Cenizas

Este mundo es inmenso, siempre que lo miro mi vista se pierde en el horizonte. Me siento siempre en el mismo lugar, siempre a la misma hora y siempre junto a mi padre.
— Te he dicho mil veces que salgas, no te quedes solo mirando
— Y siempre te he dicho que no.
— Ya han pasado años, madura.
En verdad han pasado años, años desde que me paré en el borde de la cueva y salté hacia la selva que se encontraba abajo, sobrevolé las copas de los árboles hasta encontrar un claro donde pude bajar. La selva siempre ha sido salvaje, demasiado incluso para mí. Desde mi primer encuentro todo fue terrible, un tigre se me tatuó tres rayas en mi espalda, los monos me lanzaban todo aquello que les cayera en la mano y el resto de los animales me hacían todo tipo de bromas y abusos inimaginables hasta hacer que mi orgullo muriera, el supuesto ser superior tuvo que enterrarlo en un trozo de tierra lleno de animales los cuales han cambiado el cuento de juan y el lobo por John el bobo. Ya de eso han pasado cinco años, hoy me siento mejor.
Hoy voy a bajar.
Casi nada ha cambiado, las mismas bromas, la misma gente, excepto ella. Allí estaba sentada al lado de Alex el puma, bella gloriosa, única en su tipo, mi tipo.
Todavía recuerdo sentado aquí en mi cueva su mirada, la vergüenza al ver lo que me hacían o mejor dicho, lo que me dejaba hacer. Desde arriba los veo temblar ante el padre y reír ante el hijo. No lo pude aguantar más, como una roca me dejé caer, abrí mis alas y volví a sobrevolar los árboles pero esta vez sin intención de bajar, abrí la boca y desaté el infierno. Rugí, grité, escupí fuego hasta que el agua prendió, las llamas besaban el cielo con sus calientes labios, los árboles caían a cientos, desde arriba oía su crujir, pero lo que más placer me daba era escuchar como se convertían las risas en llantos y los llantos en gritos, en verdad todos son iguales, todos se queman iguales. Todo se redujo a cenizas, desde mi cueva todo ha cambiado, ya todo es mejor.
— Escúchenme aquellos que aún respiran, desde hoy miércoles, seré tratado como rey.
O se convierten a mí y tendrán vida.
O en mi encontrarán su fin.

2 - Anima
 
Ha pasado el tiempo y no he dejado de buscarla, no puede haber muerto, los dragones no arden. Es verdad que no he bajado más, me contento con mirar desde mi cueva, desde aquí veo todo mi nuevo reino, ya casi no hay ceniza, a duras penas se ven zonas de ese color entre las copas de los árboles. A cada rato sobrevuelo la selva, solamente mi sombra hace correr a todo ser por debajo de mí, en ocasiones el viento hace parecer que hasta los árboles me temen. Un reino nuevo, un mundo nuevo, creado a mi gusto, soy el que da y otorga vida, soy juez y verdugo, soy incompleto.
Todo lo hice por ella, tan bella, de escamas verde malaquita y ojos del mismo color, la última vez que la vi, no, no era yo, la última vez que John el bobo la vio solo había vergüenza en su mirada, ese día nací. Día tras día la busco, el único que sabía algo de ella era aquel Alex, primero decía que no sabía quién era ella pero bastante habló colgando de una pata mordiendo las nubes, decía que había muerto en el incendio, eso no es cierto, los dragones se quemarán cuando los pumas vuelen, Alex no pudo.
Estoy llegando a mi montaña y veo que en la puerta de mi cueva hay alguien, es ella, no puede ser. Ahí estaba ella, las cicatrices en su pecho y el ancho de su lomo me dicen lo mal que lo ha pasado. No me dice que le ha pasado, no ha querido hablar del tema y sinceramente no me interesa mucho, lo único que importa es que está aquí, conmigo. 


3 - El relato

Pasan los días y ella sigue sin hablar prácticamente, lo necesario para pedir agua o dar las gracias, aún se despierta por las noches, rugiendo, ya he tenido que cambiar las pieles de las paredes por las quemaduras. Llego de hacer una ronda y la encuentro exaltada, pienso al verla que hay o hubo algún peligro, porque la mezcla de olores es bastante fuerte, es raro que alguno se aventure tan arriba a no ser que haya sido convocado por mí. Anima se me acerca con la mirada baja y antes de que pudiera hablar me habla:
— El día después del miércoles de ceniza — comenzó su relato de esa manera — una manada de tigres me acorrala, trato de huir pero los monos no me dejan abrir las alas, no puedo levantar vuelo, no puedo huir y de repente no recuerdo nada más. Lo siguiente que veo es una cascada como única puerta y ventana, una puerta del triple de mi tamaño de mi ancho, una puerta imposible de atravesar, me alimentaba cazando los peces que caían y que podía atrapara esa velocidad, eso claro, durante el verano, durante el invierno se transformaba en el cristal más frío que puedes imaginar, tan frío que se congelaba más rápido que lo que lo podía derretir. Una vez a la semana aproximadamente me despertaba toda amordazada y comenzaba el show. Nunca supe como habían entrado, pero ahí estaban preguntando porqué habíamos hecho eso, que me habías dicho, me preguntaban sobre el tiempo que estábamos juntos y toda clase de locuras que no te puedes imaginar. Cada pregunta iba acompañada de su respectiva violencia, los tigres eran fanáticos de levantarme o cortarme las escamas una a una, a los monos les encantaban las herramientas, las mofetas, erizos, tortugas y cuanto animal existe en esta selva pasó por mi celda en la cascada, así pasaron semanas, meses, años. Hasta este invierno, calculé una fecha en que el hielo debía ser más delgado y escapé. Ya sabes donde he estado, porqué estoy así como me ves y el porqué no me gusta hablar del tema.

La cueva

La sangre me hierve en las venas, salgo corriendo y salto hacia lo más profundo de la selva nueva, invoco a gritos a una reunión en el linde de la selva nueva con la vieja, sobrevuelo como un rayo todo mi reino escupiendo lava de vez en cuando para que todo el mundo sienta mi furia. Todos llegan al sitio acordado pero no veo a ninguno de los clanes que me interesan y nadie sabe o nadie quiere saber, la sangre corre a ríos y solo deja de hacerlo cuando siento que Anima me llama. Me cuenta sobre la ubicación de la cueva, sobre cómo llegar a ella.
 Llevo tres días apostado frente de la cueva escondido para que nadie me vea, alimentando mi ira con tragos de saliva ardiente, la cueva no tiene otra forma visible de entrada que no sea a través de la cascada. Nadie había pasado ni siquiera cerca de aquí hasta ahora, ahí está Megan, esas manchas suyas son inconfundibles, la veo pasar por el pie de la cascada pero no la veo más luego de pasar por detrás de una rama que me corta la vista. Espero y la veo unas horas después, pero esta vez no estaba sola, andaba con otro animal bastante raro y que nunca había visto antes, nunca había visto en dos patas a otros que no sean los simios, este o esta (pienso que sea hembra por las mamas) tiene un pelaje raro, largo y de un color amarillo y solo en la cabeza como los caballos, de piel blanca, ¿Qué será? Pero eso no es lo importante, lo que tengo que hacer es descubrir como entro a la cueva. Me dejo caer al pie de la cascada y observo bien por si hay alguien o huellas de alguien, encuentro el rastro de Megan y termina en una roca bastante grande, pero más grande es mi sorpresa al ver que no pesa nada, fácilmente se movió ante mi fuerza. Entro a un pasillo tallado en la roca bastante ancho para ellos pero no tanto para mí, subo y subo a todo lo largo del pasillo hasta llegar a la sala de la cascada, al parecer el final de la cueva, entro y de repente un golpe en la cabeza, un olor fortísimo y nada más.
Despierto y me encuentro despierto pero totalmente atado, grito exigiendo que me soltaran o que me dieran la cara, siento el ruido de la roca moviéndose tras de mí, la veo. Anima se para enfrente de mí, de espalda a la cascada.
— ¿Recuerdas el miércoles de cenizas? — preguntó.
— Apúrate Ani, y záfame, no llego a las ligaduras, y no se queman, créeme, lo he intentado — le dije pero preguntándome como había llegado a mí.
— ¡Responde! Me gritó
— Claro que lo recuerdo, fue el día que te conocí.
— ¿Porqué lo hiciste?
— Por ti, por mí, por nosotros, por aquellos que se rieron.
— Yo estaba ahí, no me reí.
— Yo lo sé, te vi.
— Y sin embargo convertiste todo en cenizas, estando yo allí y no estaba sola.
— Nunca me preocupaste, tú eres como yo, los dragones no arden.
Siento pasos detrás de mí, el ser extraño que antes andaba con Megan se para al lado de Anima, ella baja la cabeza y se la deja acariciar por este diminuto ser.
— Es verdad que los dragones no arden — habló la criatura —, pero el resto de nosotros sí, ¿nunca has pensado en los demás?
— Seres inferiores, ustedes están solo para servirnos y obedecernos — grito con todo el desprecio que me da y me dirijo entonces a Anima —. Desátame Anima, salgamos de aquí, te lo ordeno.
La criatura coge entonces en la mano una rara herramienta que destella  la luz se acerca a mí y siento frío correr por dentro de mí. Las luces de la cascada comienzan a menguar, Anima, Anima, Anima.

4 - La criatura

— ¿Ves linda? — me dijo luego de limpiar su arma de la sangre de John.
— Sí — respondí asintiendo con la cabeza— maestro.
— No es el tamaño ni la fuerza lo que define al ser superior — me dijo tocándome el rostro con cariño —. Es la inteligencia del que sobreviva al final, ahora vamos y llévame a mi nueva casa en la montaña. 
Salí volando con ella montada sobre mi lomo, recordando sus últimas palabras a John mientras le abría la barriga:
— Es verdad, los dragones no arden, pero sangran.

title.title: Hướng dẫn cách hút xăng ô tô đúng cách để tránh hư hỏng động cơ
title.body:
Hút xăng (rút nhiên liệu khỏi xe) là việc đôi khi cần thiết, ví dụ: đổ nhầm nhiên liệu, xe lâu không dùng, hoặc cần chuyển xăng. Tuy nhiên nếu làm sai cách có thể hỏng bơm xăng, tắc hệ thống hoặc gây nguy hiểm cháy nổ. Dưới đây là hướng dẫn [cách hút xăng ô tô](<https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/cach-hut-xang-o-to/https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/cach-hut-xang-o-to/  >) đúng cách.

![cach-hut-xang-xe-o-to.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/cb7c1ac9d3a9ff2a3c393fb9a54e1c147fcf15fbc8a7e1d6926672c58b054818)



1.  Khi nào cần hút xăng ô tô?

👉 Một số trường hợp phổ biến:

⛽️ Đổ nhầm xăng/dầu

🚗 Xe để lâu không sử dụng

🔧 Bảo dưỡng, sửa chữa hệ thống nhiên liệu

🚫 Xăng bị nhiễm bẩn

1.  Cảnh báo quan trọng trước khi thực hiện

❌ Không hút bằng miệng → cực kỳ nguy hiểm

❌ Không làm gần lửa hoặc nơi kín

✔️ Đeo găng tay, khẩu trang

✔️ Làm ở nơi thoáng khí

1.  Cách hút xăng ô tô đúng cách (an toàn nhất)

🔹 Cách 1: Dùng ống hút + nguyên lý siphon (đơn giản)

👉 Chuẩn bị:

Ống nhựa dài

Can đựng xăng

👉 Thực hiện:

Cắm 1 đầu ống vào bình xăng

Đầu còn lại đặt thấp hơn bình xăng

Dùng bơm tay hoặc tạo lực hút ban đầu

Xăng sẽ tự chảy ra

📌 Lưu ý:

Không hút bằng miệng

Can phải đặt thấp hơn bình xăng

🔹 Cách 2: Dùng bơm hút chuyên dụng (khuyến nghị)

👉 Đây là cách an toàn nhất:

Dùng bơm tay hoặc bơm điện

Cắm ống vào bình xăng

Bơm để hút nhiên liệu ra ngoài

➡️ Ưu điểm:

Nhanh

Không nguy hiểm

Không làm bẩn hệ thống

🔹 Cách 3: Xả xăng từ đường ống nhiên liệu (kỹ thuật)

👉 Áp dụng khi:

Xe hiện đại khó hút từ bình

👉 Thực hiện:

Tháo ống dẫn nhiên liệu

Dùng bơm để xả

⚠️ Cách này nên làm tại gara

1.  Lưu ý với xe đời mới

👉 Nhiều xe hiện đại:

Có van chống trộm xăng

Không thể hút bằng ống thường

➡️ Bắt buộc:

Dùng bơm chuyên dụng

Hoặc tháo hệ thống nhiên liệu

1.  Những sai lầm cần tránh

❌ Hút bằng miệng

❌ Dùng ống kim loại gây tia lửa

❌ Để xăng tràn ra ngoài

❌ Làm khi động cơ còn nóng

1.  Nguy cơ nếu làm sai

⚠️ Cháy nổ

⚠️ Hỏng bơm xăng

⚠️ Tắc kim phun

⚠️ Gây ô nhiễm

1.  Mẹo an toàn

✔️ Dùng can chuyên dụng

✔️ Làm nhanh, gọn

✔️ Lau sạch nếu bị đổ

✔️ Đậy kín nắp bình sau khi xong

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Cách tốt nhất:

➡️ Dùng bơm hút xăng chuyên dụng

👉 Tránh:

Hút bằng miệng

Làm trong không gian kín

Kết luận

👉 Hút xăng ô tô không khó nhưng cần làm đúng:

Ưu tiên an toàn + đúng kỹ thuật

Với xe đời mới → nên dùng thiết bị chuyên dụng

➡️ Nếu không chắc chắn:

👉 Tốt nhất mang ra gara để tránh rủi ro 🚗

description.title: Cooperation is the way to progress.
description.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/3810788/pexels-photo-3810788.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-writing-in-paper-3810788/) Cooperation is a very important word and topic in our lives. Due to the lack of this cooperation, there are many people in the world who fall behind and cannot progress, cannot fulfill their life goals. Again, because of this cooperation, there are many people who become much more successful in life, get the success that is needed to live a beautiful life. In fact, we should be by everyone's side and cooperate with them in various tasks. Many times, it is seen that despite promising cooperation to other people, people do not cooperate properly, that is, they say in their mouths that they want to cooperate but do not cooperate in any way in real work. We should not trust these people in any way. These people are very harmful to us and our path to progress. Because these people will not cooperate with us and will not let us move forward in any work in the hope of cooperation. They will push us backward and backward. Therefore, we need to stay away from these hypocritical people in the name of cooperation. We constantly see a large number of helpless people around us on the way to walking on the streets who have nothing to do. There is no shelter and even food and drink are very difficult. We should try to help these people constantly. If we extend our helping hand to various helpless people, God will definitely help us so that we can live better and help helpless people. In fact, if we continue to do good deeds, the Creator Himself will help us and continue to support us by our side. If we walk alone or try to achieve a goal alone, it will take us a lot of time and more than half of our lives will be spent achieving that success. But if we help each other to move forward on the path of progress, then surely we will quickly reach the goal of life together and achieve success. If we do not have a jealous attitude towards family members or friends, but stand by their side in their efforts to improve their lives and continue to support them constantly, then they will definitely improve in life and as a result of our cooperation, that improvement will be much easier and faster. If we help our friends, relatives and loved ones to bring success in their lives, then the success they achieve in life will also be our success. By working together, we will be able to live a beautiful and successful life and live well, which will gradually make our society more successful. Our next generation will learn from our cooperation and will be able to cooperate with each other, which will help them improve and build our society well. Many times, it is seen that despite having many abilities, many people cannot improve in life due to lack of cooperation, they are very broken because they cannot fulfill their goals and dreams in life and cannot improve in life. Due to this pain of losing in life, they do not get the courage to do anything else in life, as a result, the various skills and abilities of those people are completely wasted. And if these skills and abilities are not used in our society, our society can suffer a lot of progress. In order to move our society forward beautifully and to utilize the skills and abilities of all people, we must cooperate with each other and move forward together. If we cooperate, we can also get help from people in different ways at the wrong time, so people should always be there for us at the wrong time and should cooperate with people fully. So we need to have an attitude of cooperation with each other. There are many people in our society without whose cooperation we cannot function. There are many professional people, we need to give importance to those professions. The attitude of cooperation towards everyone in the society can help us to build a beautiful society. description.body:
Theo quy định mới nhất tại Nghị định 168/2024/NĐ-CP (áp dụng 2025–2026), mức phạt lỗi dừng/đỗ xe ô tô không cố định, mà phụ thuộc vào vị trí và mức độ vi phạm.

Chi tiết: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/loi-do-xe-sai-quy-dinh/> 

![loi-do-xe-sai-quy-dinh.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/cbb81288b22b90bad50f99733153a0eaa64b7222eedb2c9c8457f5ae9d10fae0)

👉 Tổng thể:

➡️ Từ \~400.000 đồng đến 22.000.000 đồng

1.  Mức phạt phổ biến (lỗi nhẹ – thường gặp)

👉 Các lỗi như:

Đỗ xe không đúng nơi quy định

Không sát lề đường

Đỗ ngược chiều

Đỗ trên vỉa hè sai quy định

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 600.000 – 800.000 đồng

🔹 Một số trường hợp cụ thể

Đỗ xe cách lề > 25cm:

➡️ 800.000 – 1.000.000 đồng

Đỗ xe trên cầu, nơi cấm:

➡️ 600.000 – 800.000 đồng

1.  Lỗi gây cản trở giao thông

👉 Ví dụ:

Đỗ xe chắn đường

Gây ùn tắc

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 4.000.000 – 6.000.000 đồng

➡️ Có thể trừ 2 điểm GPLX

1.  Lỗi nghiêm trọng (cao tốc)

👉 Dừng/đỗ sai quy định trên cao tốc:

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 10 – 14 triệu đồng

👉 Ngoài ra:

Trừ điểm bằng lái

Có thể bị xử phạt bổ sung

1.  Lỗi gây tai nạn giao thông (nặng nhất)

👉 Nếu dừng/đỗ sai gây tai nạn:

💰 Mức phạt:

➡️ 20 – 22 triệu đồng

➡️ Trừ tới 10 điểm GPLX

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh mức phạt

Mức độ vi phạm  Mức phạt

Lỗi cơ bản  600k – 800k

Đỗ sai vị trí cụ thể  800k – 1 triệu

Gây ùn tắc  4 – 6 triệu

Trên cao tốc  10 – 14 triệu

Gây tai nạn  20 – 22 triệu

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Có thể bị trừ điểm GPLX

✔️ Có thể bị cẩu xe nếu đỗ sai

✔️ Lỗi nặng có thể bị xử lý bổ sung

Kết luận

👉 Lỗi dừng đỗ xe ô tô sai quy định:

Nhẹ: vài trăm nghìn

Nặng: lên tới 22 triệu đồng

➡️ Quan trọng nhất:

Không đỗ xe ở nơi cấm, cao tốc hoặc gây cản trở giao thông

description.title: Sang tên đổi chủ có phải mua lại bảo hiểm xe không? Chi phí bao nhiêu?
description.body:
Khi mua xe cũ và làm thủ tục sang tên, nhiều người băn khoăn có phải mua lại bảo hiểm hay không. Câu trả lời là không phải lúc nào cũng cần mua lại, tùy từng loại bảo hiểm.

Chi tiết thông tin: <https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/sang-ten-doi-chu-co-phai-mua-lai-bao-hiem/>

![sang-ten-doi-chu-co-phai-mua-lai-bao-hiem-khong.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/39c9bb2df1c9ef30ae966c2ca3d410e2a05bfa0c436d8885da54b5638fdb1b59)



1.  Có phải mua lại bảo hiểm khi sang tên xe không?

👉 Không bắt buộc trong mọi trường hợp, nhưng cần phân biệt 2 loại:

🔹 1. Bảo hiểm trách nhiệm dân sự (bắt buộc)

👉 Đây là loại bắt buộc phải có khi lưu thông.

✔️ Nếu bảo hiểm còn hạn

→ KHÔNG cần mua lại

→ Có thể tiếp tục sử dụng

✔️ Tuy nhiên nên:

→ Làm thủ tục cập nhật tên chủ xe mới với công ty bảo hiểm

📌 Tránh rắc rối khi xảy ra tai nạn

🔹 2. Bảo hiểm vật chất xe (tự nguyện)

👉 Không bắt buộc

✔️ Có thể chuyển quyền hợp đồng sang chủ mới

✔️ Hoặc hủy và mua mới

📌 Phụ thuộc:

Thỏa thuận giữa người bán và người mua

Điều khoản của công ty bảo hiểm

1.  Khi nào nên mua bảo hiểm mới?

👉 Bạn nên mua lại nếu:

Bảo hiểm cũ sắp hết hạn

Không chuyển đổi được tên chủ

Muốn chọn gói bảo hiểm tốt hơn

1.  Chi phí bảo hiểm xe ô tô

🔹 Bảo hiểm bắt buộc (TNDS)

👉 Mức phí theo quy định nhà nước:

🚗 Xe 5 chỗ không kinh doanh: \~480.000 – 530.000đ/năm

🚐 Xe kinh doanh: cao hơn

🔹 Bảo hiểm vật chất xe

👉 Phí thường:

💰 1,2% – 2% giá trị xe/năm

📌 Ví dụ:

Xe 600 triệu → phí \~7 – 12 triệu/năm

1.  Thủ tục chuyển bảo hiểm sang tên

👉 Nếu muốn giữ bảo hiểm cũ:

Liên hệ công ty bảo hiểm

Cung cấp:

Giấy đăng ký xe mới

CCCD

Ký phụ lục hợp đồng

➡️ Hoàn tất trong 1–2 ngày

1.  Lưu ý quan trọng

✔️ Bảo hiểm TNDS phải luôn còn hiệu lực

✔️ Nên cập nhật thông tin chủ xe

✔️ Kiểm tra điều khoản trước khi chuyển

1.  Tóm tắt nhanh

👉 Sang tên xe:

Không bắt buộc mua lại bảo hiểm

Nhưng:

TNDS → nên cập nhật tên

Bảo hiểm thân vỏ → tùy chọn

👉 Chi phí:

TNDS: \~500k/năm

Thân vỏ: \~1–2% giá trị xe

Kết luận

👉 Khi sang tên đổi chủ:

Có thể giữ bảo hiểm cũ nếu còn hạn

Nhưng nên cập nhật thông tin để tránh rủi ro

➡️ Nếu muốn yên tâm:

👉 Mua bảo hiểm mới là phương án an toàn nhất

description.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gfd1f89e3437d3ed61107e148793977d82d65366a6f17dfb2978f2e875803cd669716bc9d7bda9e2a2eba757b050e2614c1fd2288f57574cb11e94308d02c37fd_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 探索城市中的自然

在现代城市生活中，我们常常被高楼大厦、繁忙的交通和喧嚣的生活所包围。然而，城市中也隐藏着许多自然的美丽角落，等待我们去探索和发现。以下是一些建议，帮助你在城市中找到自然的乐趣。

## 1. 城市公园的奇妙

城市公园是城市中自然的绿洲。无论是晨跑、散步还是野餐，公园都提供了一个放松身心的好地方。你可以：

- 在公园的小径上骑自行车
- 参加户外瑜伽课程
- 观察鸟类和其他野生动物

### 推荐公园

- **中央公园**（纽约）
- **海德公园**（伦敦）
- **金门公园**（旧金山）

## 2. 街头绿化的力量

许多城市正在努力增加街头绿化，以改善空气质量和提升居民的生活质量。你可以：

- 关注街道上的花坛和绿植
- 参与社区植树活动
- 支持本地的绿色倡议

## 3. 城市中的水体

许多城市都有河流、湖泊或海岸线，这些水体不仅美丽，还为各种野生动物提供了栖息地。你可以：

- 在河边散步或骑行
- 参加划船或钓鱼活动
- 观察水鸟和其他水生生物

### 推荐水体

- **芝加哥河**（芝加哥）
- **泰晤士河**（伦敦）
- **滨海公园**（新加坡）

## 4. 自然教育与活动

许多城市提供自然教育项目和活动，帮助居民更好地了解周围的生态系统。你可以：

- 参加自然导览
- 参加环保工作坊
- 参观城市农场或植物园

## 5. 结语

在城市中探索自然，不仅可以让我们放松心情，还能增强我们对环境的认识和保护意识。无论是公园、街道绿化还是水体，城市中处处都有自然的身影。让我们走出家门，去发现和享受这些自然的美丽吧！

---

希望这个主题能够激发你对城市自然的探索热情！你还有其他关于城市自然的想法吗？欢迎在评论区分享！

description.title: 😝National Amaretto Day! / ¡Día Nacional del Amaretto! 😎
description.body:
>

This Italian liqueur is typically made with bitter almonds, whose flavor is enhanced by the addition of alcohol, giving it that much-loved touch. For some, its aroma is equally irresistible, but to learn about its origins, we must go back to **1525**. Yes, that means venturing into Renaissance Italy, to Saronno.

> Este licor italiano se elabora típicamente con almendras amargas, cuyo sabor se realza con la adición de alcohol, lo que le confiere ese toque tan apreciado. Para algunos, su aroma es igualmente irresistible, pero para conocer sus orígenes, debemos remontarnos a 1525. Sí, eso significa adentrarnos en la Italia del Renacimiento, en Saronno.

The painter Bernardino Luini gifted the young model for his painting, The Virgin of Miracles, a blend of brandy and almonds. It may have been his own creation, a family recipe kept secret for centuries until the 20th century. The Di Saronno family began producing it for the market. Until 2001, it was sold as Amaretto di Saronno. However, the company changed the name to Disaronno Originale, as we know it today. There are other stories of families who crafted their own secret recipes for this almond liqueur, some of which are still produced today. While we know many details about the history of this day, how it became a day of the year remains a mystery.

> El pintor Bernardino Luini obsequió a la joven modelo para su cuadro La Virgen de los Milagros: una mezcla de brandy con almendras. Es posible que fuera una creación suya, una receta familiar que se mantuvo en secreto durante siglos hasta el siglo XX. Fue la familia Di Saronno  quien comenzó a producirla para el mercado. Hasta 2001, se comercializaba como Amaretto di Saronno. Sin embargo, la empresa cambió el nombre a ***Disaronno Originale, como lo conocemos hoy en día.*** Existen otras historias de familias que elaboraban su propia receta secreta de este licor de almendras, algunas de las cuales aún se producen. Si bien conocemos muchos detalles sobre la historia de este día, se desconoce cómo se convirtió en un día del año. 

The best way to celebrate this day is to enjoy a glass of this famous Italian liqueur. Some prefer it on the rocks, others with a mixer, perhaps a splash of Coca-Cola. Its flavor alone is cause for celebration, so you could add it to a cake recipe to enjoy it. Since the Italian translation is something like \

baking it into something sweet could be fun.

description.title: Drawing Satoru Gojo, the Strongest Shaman from the anime Jujutsu Kaisen(eng-spn)
description.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1776658230543-3a0e20ed5268c696.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dominic1/c6d57669)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dominic1/c6d57669)


---

Hello Hive friends! Today I'm back again to share a drawing I've been practicing a lot. It's of **Satoru Gojo**, who, like the other drawings I've done, is a character from the manga *Jujutsu Kaisen*. Gojo is the homeroom teacher of the first-year class at the Tokyo Magic Academy, and he's also known as **The Strongest Shaman**.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23uFa9hR8XaXGfJQxhAVPcQ2BBamZ2cNqTGBxf5vLwdNm5jvjwsynemYoKjaNiRaMa97t.png)

**Satoru Gojo** is the strongest sorcerer of all, but he faced a very powerful demon who took over all his strength and destroyed him.

Of all his abilities, I like one in particular, because I like it too: eating a lot of sweets. He's a very powerful, strong, and tall character.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/EoeFouvAvPbyhxGoBx9ySym6TqWaugD43aSpzn3f1SLj8bFPZNQZwTnJFnLAT8xeKYJ.png)

I'm practicing this drawing so I can improve and show it to all of you here on Hive.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23tvijCeEBAMv3zu7ARxXtT6Jm7SWvyGoGRVCx54sCfvi5hwSj7bjjJ5kk6x8TX3kVCXz.png)

I hope you enjoy the video; I made it with a lot of love to show my drawings.

___

Hello everybody,

My entry is our Multicab rear glass which have the reflection of the Alateris Tree in front of our property. This Multicab is long time standing there because we are waiting for the mechanic. It can't run maybe because of the engine trouble. 

Actually I snapped this car because I want to shoot the bird who visited here every morning and look at herself in the mirrors car but every time I approached to shoot, it flew right away. The bird is so sensitive. She can sense am nearing here location to shoot.

When I scrolled my gallery I saw what I snapped without the bird. Hmm, the reflection of the tree is so clear thus my entry.

description.body: Hier stoße ich zumindest auf zwei Punkte, die einer Kommentierung bedürfen. Das Einsammeln von Bärlauchblättern ist (zumindest nach meinem heutigen Kenntnisstand) weder dem Tatbestand der Ordnungswidrigkeit noch der Straftat beizuordnen. Darüber hinaus, wird die Pflanze nicht abgegrast, sondern geerntet. Wer also in der Lage ist, ein schmackhaftes Bärlauch-Pesto zuzubereiten, wird sich eine derartige Gelegenheit wohl nicht entgehen lassen. \nNicht unerwähnt sollte auch bleiben, mich überglücklich schätzen zu können, kein Mitglied der österreichischen Behörde zu sein, die für das Auszahlen einer Sozialhilfe zuständig ist. Diese Form der Auszahlung verursacht möglicherweise keine Überweisungsgebühren, aber eine schlechte Mundflora.\nJetzt weißt du, weshalb ich deinem Rat gefolgt bin, und meine winzige Kapitalansammlung auf der Blockchain belasse. :-) Hier mangelt es nicht an Lehrstunden für das reale Leben.

description.body:
[Índice de los 324 capítulos.](https://novelasymaspb.wordpress.com/portfolio/gracias-por-no-casarte-conmigo-en-aquel-entonces-transmigracion-rapida/)
=====================================================================================================================================================

* * *

* * *

Cap. 011. El contrataque de un \

></center>

* * *

Las diversas transmisiones en vivo en las que participó Rong Xuan fueron editadas en tres episodios por el equipo del programa y transmitidas en varias plataformas, para que los espectadores a quienes no les gusta ver transmisiones en vivo o quieren ver el contenido clave puedan verlas cómodamente. Ahora que quedan tres números finales, el último trabajo a ser filmado en el programa de variedades, ha comenzado una nueva ronda de audiciones.

El primer paso es que los cuatro mentores tomen el guion y lo trabajen antes de poder prepararse para la filmación.

Los cuatro clásicos esta vez son películas de espías encubiertos, de esos que queman el cerebro haciendo pensar quién es el verdadero espía, películas de desastres trágicos, dramas románticos de ídolos y dramas de amor urbano.

La primera opción de los cuatro directores fue una película de espías encubiertos porque era difícil de filmar, más representativa de sus habilidades y muy conocida, lo que facilitaba que el público la conectara.

El director Zheng cruzó las manos sobre la mesa, reflexionó un momento y preguntó en voz alta: “Esta es la última película. No nos hagas elegir primero cada vez. ¿Escuchemos también lo que quieren hacer los concursantes?”

La presentadora Sun Ying sonrió y dijo: “Este método también es muy interesante. Entonces, ¿es mejor que simplemente nos alineemos? Déjame escribir cuatro etiquetas con nombres. Si te gusta esa película, simplemente párate detrás de la etiqueta con el nombre correspondiente.”

Esto ahorra la mayor cantidad de tiempo y deja claras las decisiones de todos de un vistazo. Desde dentro del mar de conciencia, Gu Rongxuan y el sistema adivinaron en un susurro qué guion de cine elegiría el director Zheng. Sabían que Rongxuan quería trabajar con el director Zheng, por lo que, por supuesto, tenían que seguirlo a él en esta última oportunidad de cooperación en este programa de actuación en vivo.

Pero Rong Xuan apoyó el drama romántico urbano del matrimonio desdichado sin dudarlo y se convirtió en la primera persona en elegir.

Todos la miraron y dentro de ella Gu Rongxuan estaba tan confundida como el sistema. 【¡El director Zheng definitivamente no elegiría esto!】

Rong Xuan respondió con calma: 【No soy una actriz profesional en absoluto. El efecto fue muy bueno la última vez porque actué con mis verdaderos colores y porque todos tenían bajas expectativas sobre mí. Esta vez las expectativas de todos han aumentado. Si actúo mediocremente, todo lo que he hecho antes será en vano. Este drama matrimonial trata sobre ser engañado y abandonado por un hombre. Es algo en lo que tengo experiencia personal y es el tema con el que me siento más segura entre los cuatro dramas, así que elegí este. Si quieres estar en el papel del director Zheng, debes dejarle ver el potencial, ya sea en su grupo de trabajo o no. No es bueno actuar descuidadamente y es inútil si fallamos en su grupo. Además, quiero hacer algo con esta trama. Si quieres que el Director Zheng me use, no puedo tener tanto material sucio sobre mí.】

Gu Rongxuan aceptó humildemente la instrucción y una vez más se advirtió a sí misma que debía ser tranquila y racional cuando encontrara problemas. Después de estos días, aprendió vagamente algunos de los métodos de Rong Xuan. Sabía que las oportunidades eran raras, por lo que incluso si Shen Mingze y Ji Xirong estuvieran presentes, no les prestaría atención. Solo quería aprender más de Rong Xuan para poder hacerse cargo de su vida en el futuro y estar a la altura de su ayuda.

Este drama matrimonial fue muy popular el año pasado. Cuenta la historia de una pareja que lleva muchos años enamorada y tiene una crisis de relación. El protagonista masculino se siente atraído por la pasante que lleva consigo al trabajo y siente que él y la protagonista femenina ya no tienen pasión ni dulzura. Sin embargo, la pasante le hace volver a experimentar celos y protección, y decide romper con su esposa.

El dolor y el cuestionamiento de la heroína molestaron al protagonista masculino y ella dijo muchas palabras sin misericordia. Después de eso, la heroína se puso de pie nuevamente, tuvo una mejor carrera, se vistió más bellamente y tuvo más pretendientes. El protagonista masculino no puede evitar sentirse atraído por ella nuevamente, y luego descubre que la persona que ama siempre ha sido la protagonista femenina, pero solo vio la sombra de la protagonista femenina en la pasante y tuvo una ilusión.

Se inicia entonces un plan para perseguir y enamorar a su esposa. El protagonista masculino trabajó duro para enmendar sus errores, se disculpó y admitió constantemente sus errores e hizo muchas cosas. Fue un modelo del ‘regreso de un hijo pródigo’ y conmovió a todos en torno a la protagonista femenina. Finalmente, en un accidente automovilístico, el protagonista masculino protegió a la protagonista femenina y casi muere. La heroína finalmente se conmovió y le dijo: “Te perdono.”

Después de su nuevo matrimonio, continuaron enfrentando conflictos en sus carreras, familias y relaciones interpersonales, y todavía había conflictos, pero los dos nunca volvieron a soltarse de las manos y trabajaron juntos para resolver problemas cada vez, lo que fue un final feliz estándar.

Mucha gente odia este final, pero la popularidad de este drama demuestra que todavía hay muchos espectadores a los que les encanta ver la historia del reencuentro y reconciliación. Cuando el programa recrea el clásico, también quiere recrear los conflictos, las rupturas y el perdón del héroe y la heroína. Este tipo de trama debe combinarse con todo el drama para ser bueno. Los clips de una sola toma no solo no pueden ser innovadores, sino que también pueden hacer que la gente no sienta nada mientras los ve, resultando muy inferiores al drama original. Por lo tanto, debido a su dificultad técnica, este drama ocupa el último lugar en la lista de selección de los cuatro directores.

Un director preguntó en broma: “Rong Xuan, ¿estás parada en el lado equivocado? ¿No deberías elegir el trabajo en la película de espías? Creo que puedes interpretar bien al agente encubierto.”

Rong Xuan dijo apresuradamente: “Director, está siendo demasiado elogioso. De hecho, mis habilidades de actuación todavía tienen muchas deficiencias. Siento que no soy lo suficientemente estable. Algunos papeles los domino mejor, pero otros no puedo interpretarlos. Por ejemplo, este papel encubierto es demasiado difícil para mí. Realmente no puedo interpretarlo bien en tan poco tiempo.”

Varios directores se sorprendieron un poco. Cuando se está en el mejor momento de sus carreras, admitir que no se podía desempeñar un papel determinado podría perjudicar su popularidad. Pero era una muestra de autoconocimiento y de humildad que también lo tendrían en cuenta al evaluar al campeón final del programa. Al ver a Rong Xuan aclarar todo sin dudarlo, todavía tenían cierto aprecio en sus corazones.

Un buen actor no debería querer conseguir cualquier buen papel que vea, sino que debería preguntarse si puede actuar bien y vivirlo. Antes no entendían cómo era Rong Xuan, pero su actitud ahora les parece que es la correcta.

Los demás concursantes también seleccionaron las obras en las que querían participar una tras otra. Ji Xirong supuso que el director Zheng definitivamente elegiría la película de espías encubiertos y se paró directamente allí. También lamentó que Shen Mingze tuviera que ir al grupo de Rong Xuan para poder atacarla, y no pudiera actuar con ella; de lo contrario, se asociarían y definitivamente dejarían que el director Zheng la volviera a ver con buenos ojos.

Después de ver las elecciones de todos, la presentadora Sun Ying le preguntó a Shen Mingze. “La última vez, Mingze no se sentía bien y no participó en el rodaje de la obra. ¿Ha decidido en qué obra participar esta vez?”

Shen Mingze parecía estar considerándolo seriamente. Habló de algunas películas en las que había actuado y luego se interesó mucho: “Actuaré simplemente sobre el tema del matrimonio y el amor. Este es el único tema en el que nunca he actuado antes. Quiero experimentarlo”.

Sun Ying inmediatamente pensó en el punto clave: \

body.title: Want to get started with “Splinterlands” but not sure which deck to choose? (Part 2)
body.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

In the previous post, we looked at an introduction to the decks you should choose to get started in the game; however, this depends on many factors, since the investment or available budget may vary from person to person, and this is a key factor when choosing a deck that suits your needs. Today’s post will be more specific, as I want you to have the actual costs of current decks at your fingertips—or at least those from the older sets up to “Rebellion”—since I’ll have to calculate the costs for “Arcane Conclave” manually, as the tools haven’t yet updated the code to include this set.

In any case, today I’ll break down the costs of the decks, and it’s up to each of you to decide which one suits your needs and available budget. I’ll also explain why these costs vary—based on my experience and knowledge of card prices from those sets—and why some decks might be more expensive than others. I’ll organize this by budget so you have a clearer guide to the decks. Also, if for some reason you didn’t see my previous post, by clicking [HERE]( https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@cieliss/want-to-get-started-with-splinterlands-but-not-sure-which-deck-to-choose-read-to-the-end) you can read it and catch up on Part 1.

**So, if you want to find out which deck is best for you as a beginner, keep reading this post—it’ll be really helpful, especially if you’re new to the game:**

---
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png

## <center>Analyzing \

</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

Okay, to start, we need to identify and/or analyze the card decks—specifically, the most cost-effective option among all the decks, which determines both their price and their competitiveness. This is important to know, since there are hundreds of cards, and if we don’t keep all these aspects in mind, we could get off to a bad start in the game. In addition to knowing the format we want to play—which I explained in the previous post—knowing what types of cards are in the “META” and all these details I just mentioned will give you a 99% advantage over new players just starting their journey in the “Splinterlands” ecosystem.

**Now that we’ve clarified that, let’s take a closer look at the prices and some key details to help you make the best decision based on what players are looking for:**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

* **The most economical option:** This is the typical question every player asks themselves when trying to understand the META; however, overall, the cheapest set—including all its sub-sets—is undoubtedly “Chaos Legion.” This is because every card in this set has a “huge” supply, with common cards available for as little as $0.01 and legendary cards for under $1, allowing many players to build a very complete deck on a budget. Although I want to clarify something: just because it’s cheap doesn’t mean it’s bad.

* **The most competitive decks:** This answer is pretty obvious, but newcomers might be wondering about it quite a bit. However, there’s no debate here, since the current META is “Rebellion and Conclave Arcana.” This means that if you want to compete at the highest level with the current mechanics, you need to have these two decks.

* **Why do prices VARY?:** Even though these are NFT cards, the reality is that, like all financial assets, they have a limited supply. Therefore, they adhere to the principle that every asset must have to be valuable—namely, scarcity and, of course, utility. In our case, the utility of the cards is evident on the battlefield, so this is why we can determine their price, in addition to other details, such as the type of “Lamina,” but I suppose you already knew that.


---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png

## <center>\

Recommendations by Budget</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

This is what everyone has been waiting for: finding out how much you need to spend to build a deck that suits you—though, of course, it also depends on the format. But since I already covered all that information in Part 1, you can find the link at the beginning of this post. Now, let’s get into the deck budgets:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Types of decks by \

* **High budgets:** For me, high-end decks are those that are scarce and, of course, have a higher collectible value than the rest. Generally speaking, the first editions of these sets are the ones that meet those criteria, which means that the high-end editions are “Alpha and Beta.” Although they aren’t the only ones, since “Conclave Arcana” with its “Black Foil” card versions is very expensive, for the simple reason that they are very hard to find, making them extremely scarce. * **Medium Budget:** For me, the set that qualifies as mid-range is “Rebellion,” since its cards and mechanics make it a very powerful set. However, since “Arcane Conclave” is the newer set, many of its cards are cheaper than those in Conclave, and furthermore, both sets have a very controlled supply, so their value is quite stable. I could also include “Untamed” here, but that would be for the “Wild” format. * **Low Budget:** There’s definitely only one winner here, and that’s “Chaos Legion.” As I mentioned before, its cards aren’t very expensive—in fact, they’re the cheapest in the entire game—so it’s undoubtedly the best recommendation I can give to someone just starting out. However, since there’s such a large supply of them, their value won’t increase, so, if you choose this deck, your goal should be to play to earn SPS and GLINT and forget about the deck’s value. --- ***Aquí les dejo algunas imágenes de los costos de varios mazos de cartas completos, debajo de la imagen sabrán a que edición/set pertenecen:*** |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23t75758PqaHzYP14fzL6H1vQ87AnasTWmzeT4SVTVmpYf6Ncoqnvvxdn83Z59dm3XJea.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/48Fi7vbo9XbnEkqgPnCAw8g9DGcAMDtRSJLn92WRwoSWRkanXM3ravHRduZQYnyhYH.png| |-|-| |Alpha/Beta - Gold|Alpha/Beta - Silver| --- |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23t752LG4gDjaeV59WyZEDVgEfCT9TveBUzh1oyv3nHg9e3DMVNaoynwFgTcMYh3AmQ8p.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23t75758PpHy2pAdWtWr2riZfJq3rnESSkmphWtRS4Gik85uobMuZUL2q5NXDwuf1Qkye.png| |-|-| |Untamed - Gold|Untamed - Silver| --- |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23t75758PpE8s2z3bAct1GXt665ZuV2P7EhMiQZMpL7oU5NznkhkN82oyn4HgkaX3qjQg.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23t75758PqaHzYP1427tfuhg7beeHm59PaBD6BSfN2v7fcGFTReusWNmcxhHemaR1ra99.png| |-|-| |Chaos Legion - Gold|Chaos Legion - Silver| --- |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23t7574oDeKYxz81BrbQV5T98vRgGyj6EUzJ8jizQv7KtT9qguHhBtH2XixKd7FPWxAKt.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/48Fi7vcnEdy8TtdRWcA3LvwPzyMn7jZ9bWxMuWdSiYUmR4BPDWzb36EnS6r92R6CFH.png| |-|-| |Rebellion - Gold|Rebellion - Silver| https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif There’s certainly plenty to choose from when building a good card deck in Splinterlands. Of course, as I mentioned at the beginning, it depends on many factors, so it’s entirely up to you to decide where to play. The first step would be to choose a format, and then the deck or decks. If you have any questions about this, please feel free to reply to this post—I’d be happy to help.

body.body:
>

Buenas noches mis queridos amigos que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos hayan pasado un excelente fin de semana. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![IMG_88blog. 
86.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvoD5bBN5mnmqBNwepHAXBsq2n1FTGhD6TUcmUCd5YWXnCH6sw9bPfnRG3pjnD8Juqi.jpeg)

![IMG_8862.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFc55CHH6kd4pfYXDbmTWksMMQGQyTG1Z6MdiAcKzNYjEvVRw8vm7t2w1FYYFhauJoy.jpeg)

![IMG_8860.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep5nkCHguqNZMm4M9G2sC7keVE5vKJEWYmhSam7z2EaeigzQ92C5GbqPfDQWGRCwZ6x.jpeg)

![IMG_8866.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tfR2d4mkagAVxG1fuYaVGdAqE2huuUtmoZZHsHrigxcZn96YrPXaQpoVnkHckVdkBJ.jpeg)

![IMG_8883.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMct3FXnugSKaaGtced9EyYRYDaC2R2N9LuAd3izjGQ2Y2UFud77MvUKhevyKkrZCUW.jpeg)

![IMG_8884.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTjYz5R3j36G7Y73SurVQAEdpfyqnAFq1aY8SJkchjTyzAnif5c35rFbxh7oKtLnAsv.jpeg)

![IMG_8877.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xejonX25duAxUmhewMNSew1hGJW2T9CNatVAmWgj6QP5Wr5GJNcHjL8evqDfY6YvASt.jpeg)

![IMG_8868.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd6E1SUxZpE6YMQudcEw9nimvFjbWLgsJGjyR52X3YLHJS4p9sJjFHMVqYckPACyXz6.jpeg)

![IMG_8870.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23y8xE7uzapTj9KbQUL7wKVHfhC8kAAJTnaGQUZcKWRJzw3bcJtdnhTTctRNZ7wHdv5yW.jpeg)

![IMG_8875.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wX3cQus72f797ae5rvmysSFnZmR25ojMYZpCBKJShWf77Ap6GhvAFaoigxHAmNe1gun.jpeg)

Hoy paso por esta gran comunidad con el fin de compartirles la receta para una deliciosa crema de maracuyá. Es súper sencilla de preparar y se hace con pocos ingredientes, pero es una crema que les aseguro que a todos les encantara : niños , jóvenes y adultos. 

Es demasiada rica, y lo mejor, que lleva pocos ingredientes y es rápida de preparar. Se que una vez que la preparen les va a pasar igual que a mi, jamás dejarán de prepararla, y lo bueno es que se puede preparar del sabor que usted desee, lo único es cambiando el sabor, es decir en lugar de maracuyá se puede utilizar cualquier otra fruta. 

Ahora les nombro los ingredientes y el paso a paso que es muy sencillo.

# Ingredientes
* 3 huevos
* 2 parchitas o maracuyá 
* 130 mililitros de concentrado de parchita
* 200 gramos de azúcar
* 3 cucharadas de fécula de maíz disuelta en 2 de agua.
* 1 cucharada de margarina 

# Paso a paso 
Coloco una olla con agua a hervir, luego en otra olla coloco el azúcar, los huevos y el concentrado de maracuyá, bato bien? Lo llevo a fuego hasta que empiece a empezar.

En este momento le agregó la fécula de maíz disuelta en las 2 cucharadas de agua hasta que espese, batiendo constantemente sin dejar que pegue. 
Para finalizar, apago, bajo la estufa y le agrego la margarina, revuelvo y listo. Apago, bajo y en plato, llevo  a la nevera durante 2 horas y sirvo   También se usa para rellenar cakes.
Hasta aquí mi contenido espero sea de su agrado. Nos vemos en un próximo contenido.

> # English Version # Delicious passion fruit cream [Esp/Eng]

> Good evening my dear friends who read me in the @ hivefood community, I hope you all had an excellent weekend. Everyone is welcome to my blog. ![IMG_88blog. 86.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tvoD5bBN5mnmqBNwepHAXBsq2n1FTGhD6TUcmUCd5YWXnCH6sw9bPfnRG3pjnD8Juqi.jpeg) ![IMG_8862.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFc55CHH6kd4pfYXDbmTWksMMQGQyTG1Z6MdiAcKzNYjEvVRw8vm7t2w1FYYFhauJoy.jpeg) ![IMG_8860.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep5nkCHguqNZMm4M9G2sC7keVE5vKJEWYmhSam7z2EaeigzQ92C5GbqPfDQWGRCwZ6x.jpeg) ![IMG_8866.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tfR2d4mkagAVxG1fuYaVGdAqE2huuUtmoZZHsHrigxcZn96YrPXaQpoVnkHckVdkBJ.jpeg) ![IMG_8883.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wMct3FXnugSKaaGtced9EyYRYDaC2R2N9LuAd3izjGQ2Y2UFud77MvUKhevyKkrZCUW.jpeg) ![IMG_8884.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTjYz5R3j36G7Y73SurVQAEdpfyqnAFq1aY8SJkchjTyzAnif5c35rFbxh7oKtLnAsv.jpeg) ![IMG_8877.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xejonX25duAxUmhewMNSew1hGJW2T9CNatVAmWgj6QP5Wr5GJNcHjL8evqDfY6YvASt.jpeg) ![IMG_8868.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd6E1SUxZpE6YMQudcEw9nimvFjbWLgsJGjyR52X3YLHJS4p9sJjFHMVqYckPACyXz6.jpeg) ![IMG_8870.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23y8xE7uzapTj9KbQUL7wKVHfhC8kAAJTnaGQUZcKWRJzw3bcJtdnhTTctRNZ7wHdv5yW.jpeg) ![IMG_8875.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wX3cQus72f797ae5rvmysSFnZmR25ojMYZpCBKJShWf77Ap6GhvAFaoigxHAmNe1gun.jpeg) Today I pass by this great community in order to share the recipe for a delicious passion fruit cream. It is super easy to prepare and is made with few ingredients, but it is a cream that I assure you that everyone will love: children, young people and adults. It is too rich, and the best, that it has few ingredients and is quick to prepare. I know that once they prepare it it will happen to them just like me, they will never stop preparing it, and the good thing is that it can be prepared in the flavor you want, the only thing is changing the flavor, that is, instead of passion fruit you can use any other fruit you want. Now I name the ingredients and the step by step that is very simple. # Ingredients * 3 eggs * 2 parchitas or passion fruit * 130 milliliters of parchita concentrate * 200 grams of sugar * 3 tablespoons of corns * 3 tablespoons of cornstarch dissolved in 2 of water. * 1 tablespoon of margarine # Step by step I put a pot with water to boil, then in another pot I put the sugar, eggs and passion fruit concentrate, do I beat well? I'll set it on fire until it starts to start. At this moment he added the cornstarch dissolved in the 2 tablespoons of water until it thickens, beating constantly without letting it stick. To finish, I turn off, lower the stove and add the margarine, stir and that's it. I turn it off, I lower and on a plate, I take it to the fridge for 2 hours and I serve It is also used to fill cakes. So far my content I hope you like it. See you in a future content.

body.title: Oatmeal cake with apple and coconut (Eng-Esp)
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgPfzjeT9kxrUrDrsxo9WSsq8HAmqxmtdtp5mpnYsdKb76tZAMcChCv42Zro7oLnrbg.png)</center>

* Good evening hivefood friends, I hope you had a fantastic weekend! If you're looking for a healthy, delicious and easy-to-prepare snack, this recipe is for you!
Below, I'll explain how to make an \

... You'll enjoy a very tasty and aromatic flavor!

>* Buenas noches amigos de hivefood, espero que hayan pasado un fantástico fin de semana... Si desean disfrutar de una merienda saludable, deliciosa y fácil de preparar esta receta es para ti!
A continuación, les explicaré como realizar un \

... Disfrutarán de un sabor MUY sabroso y aromático!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpQxk6CLoHGtU3LLWcoBTyhqM8sAtFoxqemQLr666yLXBPZHgqQpC5MZKGiicf2BwYe.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: 1 cup of oat flour, 1 apple, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup of milk, 1 tablespoon of vanilla essence, 3 tablespoons of shredded coconut, 1 teaspoon of baking powder, honey (as needed to sweeten) and 1 teaspoon of ground cinnamon.

>* INGREDIENTES: 1 taza de harina de avena, 1 manzana, 2 huevos, 1/2 taza de leche, 1 cucharada de esencia de vainilla, 3 cucharadas de coco rallado, 1 cucharadita de polvo de hornear, miel (cantidad necesaria para endulzar) y 1 cucharadita de canela en polvo.

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* We add the eggs to a deep container, add the vanilla essence... We mix until well combined.

>* Incorporamos en un envase hondo los huevos, agregamos la esencia de vainilla. Mezclamos hasta integrar bien.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Ep5q5rLgiVmzPsWVG3ysezUMcoSVgR4pgvMSrMWjKJ6UYwknX5bqHwHVo2DZttK2cwb.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242DX8CvD3qT6GzJUpsoSUSv3eZtuaKYVobW5Z3ER8N79PZM2kGoA6HzY3gyR4C6dETDn.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpGT3xeeTBAa6dVaKEewenf78QB1ZbRTamNj7uzkCvjTyZHVreE89CBCAvE1FW8Du5B.png)</center>

* In this step, we'll add our star ingredients, which will give it a slightly rustic texture and a very appetizing and delicate flavor... We add the apple (preferably red), grating it on the coarse side; I suggest NOT peeling it. We add the shredded coconut.

>* En este paso, vamos a colocar nuestros ingredientes estrellas, los que aportarán una textura ligeramente rústica y un sabor MUY apetitoso y delicado... Colocamos la manzana (preferiblemente roja) rallamos por el lado grueso, les sugiero NO extraer la piel. Agregamos el coco rallado.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23y96qVD9xZsVbFq9gmp1GjQaJLR4Z9ZPmDvsSa3ZUPofxGtF5oBn4CQL8NxhiVXGmbM7.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yx25MTP6uaa9ySxcvPdonCYKq5VWBkD84CtGhnwzTDo42Eoruy1Mdj3PFy3UZEKH52n.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMmVRD3Xsj2WFpFPsN2ymjjVhqW6LnUHv3k9WK4MizkmcvgppHs1Zgyd72AReZYxfvF.png)</center>

* We add the honey, the amount will depend on the sweetness you wish to enjoy, in my case 5 heaped tablespoons were enough.

>* Incorporamos la miel, la cantidad dependerá del dulzor que deseen disfrutar, en mi caso 5 cucharadas colmadas fueron suficientes.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242DVMVvqrzdQmkh7J5JJnQVhGXEe5kv3DpqYkkJCxJxV9cFSAMjNc8oznXJzmSgSRyMA.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zbaRygkyQuBdBnhZrGTQmNReuN5X5eE6Y4fyLoYUcoCwqzzowpsaTLyt1gzskHJrL1E.png)</center>

* We add 1 cup of oat flour, this time I decided to mix it with a small portion of rolled oats... We add our aromatic cinnamon.

>* Añadimos 1 taza de harina de avena, en esta ocasión decidí mezclar con una pequeña porción de avena en hojuelas... Colocamos nuestra aromática canela.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xyff9s51HFZ94hVt2vTWwwYqqCHQVForym8KGVB7dW1UCvbJoXeLHPmu3bmHoQQ7jAp.png)</center>

* To soften the texture, we'll add 1/2 cup of milk... Add the baking powder and mix until well combined.

>* Para suavizar la textura vamos a colocar 1/2 taza de leche... Añadimos el polvo de hornear, mezclamos hasta integrar bien.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23w31oa8gCp58TX97h2pzc93WK5Yb3SMdTPqhPFTBsxCp3LD82M6fvuJRTr1Krs9p9pG8.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wquAXDaArxoSDVMbyBxuN7S5RG2xStweu9UNmR5ipWT6bMNiWDqbCBqCQ4njAAYvN1k.png)</center>

* We pour our delicious mixture into a greased and floured baking dish... We decorate with apple slices. 
We bake at 180°C for 45 minutes or until cooked through.

body.title: Some new events story
body.body:
Hi, guys!

So, the first few events are over, and now it's time to prepare for the next ones. I still have a lot to shoot, and I'm not sure yet whether I'll start filming today or get ready and get back to work with the camera tomorrow. It's most likely the latter, because I need to devote some time to myself, otherwise I'll quickly burn out. So I need to slow down a bit and pay attention to my state.

So, I'll probably tidy up my home and myself today, and then start filming. It'll be easier and more effective that way. I've been focusing solely on work for quite some time now, and it's starting to affect my state again. Especially since I was quite nervous during the first two events. So now I definitely need to take a breather and rest.

I have a lot planned for this week, so I need to focus and take everything step by step. So I'll start with myself, and then continue with work projects.

I also need to groom the dogs and deworm them because the season has already started, and I'm really worried about my girls being okay. So, as you can see, I have a lot of plans.

So, today I start the day by tidying up myself and everything around me, and then I'll figure out what I need to film for work and so on.
But let's start by coming to my senses. Otherwise, I definitely won't be able to work properly.

Have a great day, everyone!
