body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Anemic: Questions and Answers
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdws3M2Wd32GvgA2m793SChaPscjAt7QSHT7bjaPYSjpi/Portada%20-%20Anemic.png</center>

<center>Despite a few days having passed since this topic emerged, the recent Splinterlands update has thrown us a new challenge called **Anemic**. With the premise:</center>
><center>A pesar de ya haber pasado algunos días para este tema la reciente actualización de Splinterlands nos ha lanzado un nuevo reto llamado **Anemic** Con la premisa:</center>

### <center> Anemic </center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQme7MjWFvTUB6xPEjSdWv4AVErF2JkKCb9XqmXwyx4A4bL/img_combat-rule_anemic_150.png </center>
- **Anemic:** Max health, at the start of the battle, is 4.
- **Anemic:** La salud máxima, al inicio de la batalla, es 4.

<center>The Ruleset forces us to rethink every tank, every healer and every support unit. However, as with every new **Ruleset**, the description leaves gray areas that only experimentation in the arena can resolve.</center>
><center>La Ruleset nos obliga a replantearnos cada tanque, cada curandero y cada unidad de apoyo. Sin embargo, como toda nueva **Ruleset**, la descripción deja espacios grises que solo la experimentación en la arena puede resolver.</center>

<center>Following the dynamic of my previous analyses, today I am going to break down the most critical doubts that have arisen. These are the questions that will define if this Ruleset is an important challenge or a small alteration in the battle.</center>
><center>Siguiendo la dinámica de mis análisis anteriores, hoy voy a desglosar las dudas más críticas que han surgido. Estas son las preguntas que definirán si esta Ruleset es un desafio importante o una pequeña alteración en la batalla.</center>

### <center>Is it an absolute limit or just an initial condition? | ¿Es un límite absoluto o solo una condición inicial?</center>
<center>This is the mother of all questions. The rule says **at the start of the battle**. If we interpret this literally, health is reduced to 4 before the bell rings. But what happens during combat?</center>
><center>Esta es la madre de todas las preguntas. La regla dice **at the start of the battle**. Si interpretamos esto de forma literal, la salud se reduce a 4 antes de que suene la campana. Pero, ¿qué pasa durante el combate?</center>

### <center>Minimum health units: Increase or limit? | Las unidades de salud mínima: ¿Aumento o límite?</center>

<center>This is the doubt that can generate the most confusion. If I have a unit that naturally has 1 or 2 health (like many Fiends or 0-1 mana units). Does health increase to 4 to match everyone as happens with Equalizer, or are they simply not affected because they are already below the limit? If life increases, low-mana cards receive a massive indirect **buff**, making them much more resistant than normal.</center>
><center>Esta es la duda que más confusión puede generar. Si tengo una unidad que naturalmente tiene 1 o 2 de salud (como muchos Fiends o unidades de 0-1 maná). les sube la salud a 4 para igualar a todos como pasa con Equalizer, o simplemente no les afecta porque ya están por debajo del límite? Si les sube la vida, las cartas de bajo maná reciben un **buff** indirecto masivo, haciéndolas mucho más resistentes de lo normal.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXA4hFxExCndX8XWnSdNcAaS6aAdaEe6R2Y2eDi4gucZS/Salud%20Minima%20V2.png</center>

<center>This battle confirms that health does not increase, which must be taken into account to avoid confusion and losing units, but knowing this gives an advantage if the enemy does not know it.</center>
><center>Esta batalla confirma que no aumenta la salud lo que hay que tener en cuenta para evitar confusiones y perder unidades pero que el saberlo da una ventaja si el enemigo no lo sabe.</center>

### <center>Archons and summoner buffs | Anchons y los bufos de invocador</center>

<center>One of the first doubts is what happens when using a Summoner or Archons that modifies health and in what order the modifications are applied. Can health go above or below 4? Or does the Ruleset block the counter so it never exceeds that digit?</center>
><center>Una de las primeras dudas es que pasa al usar un Summoner o Archons que modifica la salud y en que orden se aplican las modificaciones ¿puede la salud subir o bajar de 4? ¿O la Ruleset bloquea el contador para que nunca supere ese dígito?</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmamjhjQojQHhpc2Srqwuz3fzZpiDTrKGarCXS1Vdh5Z7b/Archons%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle, this doubt is resolved as health can be modified. This opens up many strategies, from reducing health to eliminate enemies very easily with very fast units but with little damage to prevent the enemy unit from attacking, using units with Blast that can eliminate several enemies at once, or conversely increasing the team's health to resist more attacks or escape the point where they can be eliminated by a single enemy blow.</center>
><center>En esta batalla se resuelve esta duda al poder modificar la salud esto abre mucho las estrategias desde reducir la salud para poder eliminar a los enemigos con mucha facilidad desde una unidades muy rápidas pero con poco daño para evitar que la unidad enemiga ataque, usar unidades con Blast que pueda eliminar a varios enemigos a la vez o alrevez aumentar la salud del equipo para poder resistir mas ataque o salir del punto donde puede ser eliminado de un solo golpe del enemigo.</center>

### <center>The dilemma of **Strengthen** and **Weaken** | El dilema de **Strengthen** y **Weaken**</center>

<center>We already know that Archons can modify the health of units but what happens with abilities, as they might not work and act as happens with Rulesets like Back to Basics where unit abilities do not work but Archons' do. This is something important as abilities can be stacked to increase team health with Strengthen or reduce enemy team health with Weaken.</center>
><center>Ya Sabemos que los Archons puede modificar la salud de las unidades pero que pasa con las habilidades ya que puede no funcionar y actuar como pasa con Ruleset como Back to Basics donde las habilidades de las unidades no funcionan pero las de los Archons, esto es algo importante ya que las habilidades se puede acumular para aumenta la salud del equipo con Strengthen o reducir la salud del equipo enemigo con Weaken.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUQbXbF9c1eJ6R1KZbScQQn5UigEDTLrzF29ynt6k4VkP/Strengthen%20V2.png</center>

<center>In this battle it is confirmed that these abilities also affect the health of the units (it also confirms other doubts but I will ignore them for the next doubt), which enables many strategies and giving more efficiency when combined with Archons such as using a team that reduces enemy health with Weaken and armor reducer with a card with Rust to eliminate as many enemies as possible or increase the health of your team to avoid enemies seeking to deal exactly 4 damage seeking to avoid activating Forcefield.</center>
><center>En esta batalla se confirma que estas habilidades tambien afectan a la salud de las unidades (tambien confirma otra dudas pero la ignorare para la siguiente duda)lo que habilita muchas estrategias y dándole mas eficiente al combinarse con los Archons como usar un equipo que reduzca la salud enemiga con Weaken y reductor de armadura con una tarjeta con Rust para eliminar a todos los enemigos posibles o aumentar la salud de tu equipo para evitar a los enemigos que buscar hacer 4 de daño exactos que buscan evitar activar Forcefield</center>

### <center>What happens with **Scavenger** and **Life Leech**? | ¿Qué sucede con **Scavenger** y **Life Leech**?</center>
<center>There are abilities that allow **growth** during battle. Like **Scavenger** grants life every time a unit dies, and **Life Leech** allows increasing maximum health by inflicting damage, among others. Being abilities that are activated after the start of the battle, could these cards break the 4-point health ceiling? If so, these units would become the new **Super Tanks** of this Ruleset, being the only ones capable of resisting more than hits.</center>
><center>Existen habilidades que permiten **crecer** durante la batalla. Como **Scavenger** otorga vida cada vez que una unidad muere, y **Life Leech** permite aumentar la salud máxima al infligir daño entre otras. Al ser habilidades que se activan después del inicio de la batalla, ¿podrían estas tarjetas romper el techo de los 4 puntos de salud? <center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWxJv79Z41ZeErnQwpb5YhLWHb4e4K1TaSMxXAhzc5o5p/Scavenger%20V2.png</center>

Sin embargo, entender si este límite de 4 es inamovible o superable con habilidades es lo que separará a los jugadores inteligente del resto.</center>

body.title: Covers songs: the beauty I've found in rock songs performed on the piano
body.body:
>I can’t write without music. That’s non negotiable. And yeah, like I’ve said a thousand times before, rock and roll is home for me. But even the things you love the most can start to feel like too much at times. Maybe that’s why, and also thanks to the era we’re living in, algorithms across pretty much every platform you can think of have been feeding me something different lately: piano covers. And not just any covers, but deeply emotional reinterpretations. From Alice in Chains to Depeche Mode, everything filtered through the softness and depth that only a piano can deliver.

*\n\n*

>There’s something almost unfair about how much that instrument can transform a song. Take Heart-Shaped Box by Nirvana. Originally, it’s raw, uncomfortable, almost suffocating in its intensity. But put that same structure on a piano, and suddenly it becomes… fragile. Haunting in a different way. My girlfriend once described it as “strangely beautiful,” and honestly, I couldn’t say it better. It’s like the same emotion, but translated into another language.

* https://youtu.be/tz9i3F4NZW0?si=KbPp7GooUgkVozgJ https://youtu.be/sCxmDu5cRM0?si=YD4tpVTJGjecjVbx *

>The same thing happens with tracks like No Excuses, Brother, or Your Decision. Songs that already carry weight somehow become lighter, more reflective, almost comforting when stripped down to piano. And it’s funny, because when I was younger, I didn’t like piano much at all. I thought it was too sad, too slow. I was all about distortion, power, volume. Guitar, bass, drums. The louder, the better. Turns out, I just didn’t know how to listen yet.

*\n\n*

>That’s the thing. Time sharpens your ears. You start noticing textures, spaces, silences. You realize that music isn’t just about impact, it’s about interpretation. The notes don’t change, but the way they hit you absolutely does. And piano, for whatever reason, has this ability to break through whatever emotional walls you have up. It doesn’t ask for permission, it just gets in.

* https://youtu.be/gwF6_xTvSNI?si=EmEm-eurxuAo61EF https://youtu.be/ilLTcTXTI0E?si=W_x8wLnMj_UEQXZG *

>You hear it across genres too. Jazz, blues, soul, rock, pop. The piano is everywhere, quietly holding everything together. And in my case, it’s not even about discovering new songs. It’s about rediscovering the ones I already know. Watching them evolve into something else entirely just because the instrument changed. Same skeleton, completely different soul.

*\n\n*

>At some point, I just typed “rock and roll piano covers” into a search bar, and that was it. Down the rabbit hole. And yeah, I’m not exaggerating when I say it felt like a small revelation. Even songs like Call Me When You're Sober, which already lean into piano in their original form, take on a whole new dimension when reinterpreted. There’s something about hearing every detail laid bare, nothing hiding behind production.

* https://youtu.be/mTcgpm2E5es?si=zDbnje1Wt27ieg0W https://youtu.be/5VeflGoMOv0?si=4ziIS-yz6BhWoy9l *

>And then you get voices that just belong there. Like Amy Lee with Evanescence. That combination feels inevitable, like it was always meant to exist. But honestly, it goes way beyond that. You can find anything reimagined this way. Death metal, glam, whatever. Genres that shouldn’t “fit” suddenly make perfect sense.

*\n\n*

>It’s kind of addictive, not gonna lie. Perfect for writing, for thinking, for feeling things a little deeper than usual. So yeah, this is me, giving a bit of credit where it’s due. Because somehow, this instrument I used to ignore ended up becoming one of the most honest ways I’ve found to reconnect with music. Thank you, piano. Didn’t see that one coming.

* https://youtu.be/GVkiHjfb2Do?si=zPDnedbMbfQ726WN https://youtu.be/VITpVetwJfM?si=bPOzvGLNKX4zfNhs

body.title: Eggs with apples (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today I wanted to try something different for breakfast, so I made some delicious cornmeal arepas, but this time I served them with a soft-boiled egg and apple—a sort of salad that served as both a filling and a side dish for the arepas. The apple added a sweet, refreshing, and natural touch; I think it was a great idea.
![1000110286.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EprTA3eZi6Q9vKinDFXSBGW9KTiGthcrf8GUPuM4FjKvA9XNP5iWg8vbmxBVt98arKK.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 3 eggs - 1 apple - 100 grams of cornmeal - 6 cups of water - 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise - Oil - Butter - Salt to taste
![1000110288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EpnBR3MRiVgvGvUYc5rGxK53CjRaJfpBbA78PWT45Z3hVNym8we13SA1Zme1dhmgTCu.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed the eggs in a pot with four cups of water; after fifteen minutes, the water came to a boil and the eggs were parboiled. When they were ready, I removed them from the pot and ran them under cold water, which helps the shells peel off easily.
![1000110284.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EpLdBJ9qAwiP6jap62VGiseSFuRivvCcqM1J3o9vpaeRwbXpHy2rmBMCQRjf5mbeZFY.jpg)
Next, I moved on to the apple; I peeled it, cut it into pieces, and placed it on a plate. Next, I put two cups of water and half a tablespoon of salt in a bowl and gradually added the cornmeal, mixing thoroughly until I achieved the perfect consistency. This step is crucial because it determines how soft the arepas will be. Then I set up a griddle, oiled the surface, and placed three arepas on it.
![1000110282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsNEUZoZ5DJ829Ha9m2zK7sHGJm21GHZa1EwV4ZoW39aCWffdhydJnNPSDXxMwjzVHC.jpg)
Once the eggs were cool enough to handle, I peeled them and cut them into pieces, placed them on a plate, and added the apple slices. Then I added a dollop of mayonnaise and a pinch of salt, and mixed everything together thoroughly.
![1000110280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uFa9FLmaYBT8dyVPZ2vHnPB9fAafWj7beLKPwPJ1RAdtGnHMc8Z6eRNkvd4sdwZJThK.jpg)
The last step was to remove the arepas from the budare, open them up, and spread a little butter on them. In this case, I decided to place the side dish on the side of the plate. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy busqué una opción diferente para desayunar, preparé unas deliciosas arepas de harina de maíz, pero esta vez las acompañé con huevo sancochado y manzana, una especie de ensalada que sería el relleno o el acompañante de las arepas. La manzana le concedió un toque dulce, refrescante y natural, considero que fue una idea acertada.
![1000110286.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EprTA3eZi6Q9vKinDFXSBGW9KTiGthcrf8GUPuM4FjKvA9XNP5iWg8vbmxBVt98arKK.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 3 huevos - 1 manzana - 100 gramos de harina de maíz - 6 tazas de agua - 1 cucharada de mayonesa - Aceite - Mantequilla - Sal al gusto
![1000110288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EpnBR3MRiVgvGvUYc5rGxK53CjRaJfpBbA78PWT45Z3hVNym8we13SA1Zme1dhmgTCu.jpg)
## Preparación: Coloqué en un olla los huevos junto a cuatro tazas de agua, en quince minutos el agua hirvió y los huevos se sancocharon. Cuando estuvieron listos, los saqué de la olla y los pasé por agua fría, esto ayuda a que la cáscara se desprenda con facilidad.
![1000110284.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/EpLdBJ9qAwiP6jap62VGiseSFuRivvCcqM1J3o9vpaeRwbXpHy2rmBMCQRjf5mbeZFY.jpg)
De allí pasé a la manzana, la desconché y corté en pedazos, la puse en un plato. Luego, en un envase puse dos tazas de agua, media cucharada de sal y paulatinamente vertí la harina de maíz, amasé muy bien hasta obtener una consistencia perfecta. Este paso es decisivo porque determina la suavidad de las arepas. Luego monté un budare, aceité la superficie y procedí a colocar tres arepas.
![1000110282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsNEUZoZ5DJ829Ha9m2zK7sHGJm21GHZa1EwV4ZoW39aCWffdhydJnNPSDXxMwjzVHC.jpg)
Cuando los huevos estuvieron bastante fríos retiré la cáscara y dividí en pedazos, los coloqué en un plato y agregué los pedazos de manzana. Luego adicioné un toque de mayonesa y una pizca de sal, mezclé muy bien.
![1000110280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uFa9FLmaYBT8dyVPZ2vHnPB9fAafWj7beLKPwPJ1RAdtGnHMc8Z6eRNkvd4sdwZJThK.jpg)
El último paso fue retirar las arepas del budare, abrirlas, untarle un poco de mantequilla. En este caso, decidí que en el plato el contorno se colocara en un costado.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: 自己动手☞凉面
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![RoCixT47CttasxR1_mmexport1776657079301.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/jingjing1616/images/RoCixT47CttasxR1_mmexport1776657079301/RoCixT47CttasxR1_mmexport1776657079301.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近群里天天看他们说吃凉面，说得我馋虫都出来了，说有个地方的很好吃，但是我又没有碰到，所以我计划自己在家里做的，当然这凉面我不是说买半成品，我之前买过，我觉得那个面不好吃，硬邦邦的，还是喜欢自己动手。

两个人吃一顿的话买一块钱的面就可以了，是不是和外面的相比这个性价比很高，外面的一小份都七八块了呢可能我还报价低了，我没买过具体价格还不晓得，然后你去买人家担好的面回家自己拌调料也要五六块一斤吧（我没问过价格），我这个应该是最划算的了。

结果昨天人家心大，觉得一块钱的不够，然后就买了两块钱的，果然要吃两顿，中午一顿晚上一顿，凉面这个东西有点小气，吃多少拌多少，不然拌了调料的吃不完留着第二顿吃那个面就会糊哒哒的。

担面是很简单的，不能担得太软，因为面出锅摊一起还有温度，可以利用那个余温让面完全熟透，昨天我失算了，我竟然忘了准备冷白开水，然后我也没有反应过来用矿泉水，所以导致面有点糊哒哒的，但是最后的效果也还是可以的，然后丑丑全程参与担面，然后一个劲儿的彩虹屁说我好厉害，这都会，之前他又不是没吃过，简直假打。

凉面里面配点黄瓜丝，真的不要太巴适，这个天气燥热，我都只想吃吃凉拌菜，一点都不想吃热菜炒菜，

---

body.title: Fried arepas 🫓 with ground beef and egg 🥚
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz noche para todos, deseo hayan tenido un excelente fin de semana y que la que está por iniciar venga cargada de bendiciones, dicha y prosperidad en compañía de sus seres queridos, siempre de la mano de Dios Todopoderoso; bienvenidos a mi blog! Quiero compartirles la receta de un almuerzo poco tradicional que prepare en casa el día de hoy; se trata de unas arepas frita acompañadas con un huevo y un poco de carne molida guisada que tenía guardada en mi refrigerador jejeje; les muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** Good evening, everyone! I hope you had a wonderful weekend and that the week ahead is filled with blessings, joy, and prosperity as you spend time with your loved ones, always guided by Almighty God. Welcome to my blog! I want to share with you the recipe for a somewhat unconventional lunch I made at home today; it’s fried arepas served with an egg and a little stewed ground beef that I had stashed in my fridge, hehehe; here’s how I made it ![IMG_20260417_212822_274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uFTdgwnwZCDPsuf1DpVLtczdUAwRznCmCvWHNjXFHYZtMtygmie9JTLMeRCYua6zi1V.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** harina de maíz, mantequilla, aceite, huevo, guiso de carne molida

> **
INGREDIENTS
** cornmeal, butter, oil, egg, ground beef stew ![IMG_20260417_211217_901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tbu3ZuLUSSXfhL7ptZZkBpM599oYcaCGbw6pWHqjVzBTHssYkoEGATcK9v7qZHkLqfr.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Coloqué la harina de maíz en una taza, agregue sal, agua y mezcla hasta que quedó compacta; tomé porciones, di forma redondeada y llevé a freír en aceite caliente volteando por ambos lados. Por otra parte freír el huevo, una vez que las arepas estuvieron lista las serví acompañada con un poco de mantequilla y agregué a la preparación un guiso de carne molida

> **
PROCEDURE
** I put the cornmeal in a bowl, added salt and water, and mixed it until it formed a firm dough; I took portions of the dough, shaped them into rounds, and fried them in hot oil, flipping them over on both sides. Meanwhile, I fried the egg. Once the arepas were ready, I served them with a little butter and added a ground beef stew to the dish. ![IMG_20260417_211629_319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMW93TtVXVw6K1R7UvAweeZs58Jy2MioiVXTeYyywWbWjfzyMCSE4jwFUKAEeuqdeQU.jpg) ![IMG_20260417_211826_369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vsJJ2dnksLVwUHhnnMLJMJzGPmhkHjtrfaChEDjaxi1kz652ynbVqUXnmNuM5Na3zXJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260417_212324_321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vhsCuvrFDqzC98fRYBRVnqCJNYrDyxU7FfUdU4YET85ob6sFcRACZ2rze1HZr5Sbvrx.jpg) ![IMG_20260417_212412_567.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vhViH6GijeSMZUnPJRi8uKhXdUmRx4qMAzpKqY9xbDe17UKJewR4CrFQpiEeoDRHiz3.jpg)

body.body:
![1000522992.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23ywuicViUAfrmsASoZP578zANSie3UvvnJEsBKMBFDxTx3jZ9p83b1wcbQ6uev7vg8eX.jpg)


<div class=text-justify> 

Este fin de semana me animé a preparar unas tortillas de remolacha con el propósito de buscar una opción de carbohidrato más saludable. Tenía en mente prepararlas solo con harina de coco, pero cuando la agregué, no compactó del todo, por lo cual decidí añadir harina de maíz para darle una mejor textura, la cual me permitiera formar las bolitas y aplastarlas sin que se rompieran.

Entre las opciones que tienes para degustar estas tortillas están el comerlas bien tostadas o en deliciosas fajitas; son muy versátiles.


***¡Vamos a prepararlas!***

> This weekend, I decided to make some beet tortillas as a healthier carbohydrate option. I had planned to make them using only coconut flour, but when I added it, the mixture didn’t hold together well, so I decided to add corn flour to improve the texture, which would allow me to shape the patties and flatten them without them falling apart.

>Some ways to enjoy these tortillas include eating them well-toasted or in delicious fajitas; they’re very versatile.


>***Let’s make them!***


------------------
#### <center>Ingredientes <sup>(Ingredients)</sup> </center>
------------------------------


<div class=\
> * 1 remolacha rallada. * 2 cucharadas de linaza molida más 6 cucharadas de agua. * 1/2 taza de agua. * 1/2 taza de harina de coco. * 1 taza de harina de maíz. * Jengibre. * Sal.

> * 1 grated beet. * 2 tablespoons ground flaxseed plus 6 tablespoons water. * 1/2 cup of water * 1/2 cup coconut flour. * 1 cup cornmeal. * Ginger. * Salt. ------------------ ####
Preparación (How to make it)
------------------------------ * Empecé pelando y rallando la remolacha. Por otra parte, pulvericé en la licuadora dos cucharadas de semillas de linaza y le agrego seis cucharadas de agua; dejé reposar hasta que espese. > I started by peeling and grating the beets. Meanwhile, I blended two tablespoons of flaxseeds in the blender with six tablespoons of water and let the mixture sit until it thickened. ![1000522910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgPuxjMmewwCLJPP1ndvVkN2wZzMPu5zW4RYZfqGxG5LCkunyCaoCh6VPp4pmvJHSMj.jpg) * Colocar en un bol la remolacha, la linaza y mezclar. Añadir el agua y las harinas, el jengibre y la sal. Amasar hasta unificar. Dejar reposar en la nevera durante 10 minutos para que tome una mejor consistencia. >Place the beets and flaxseeds in a bowl and mix. Add the water, flours, ginger, and salt. Knead until well combined. Let the dough rest in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to develop a better consistency. ![1000522918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xATXmJrv8yTo5RAthD6XeyPmKike7RoJAz2MrbQePAV5m73Ssfczov4RcXFX8Y2XNFv.jpg) ![1000522954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xVM5B2LREMdjAPymxLc2ZwKLuY3oT2tCFi3VyBjbGJ4JNecdtDTSw4Yi5jsTNjpYcXr.jpg) * Formar bolitas de 40 gramos, aplastar con rodillo entre dos láminas de plástico o papel encerado, dar forma redonda con un plato y llevar a un sartén caliente hasta cocinar por ambos lados. >Form 40-gram balls, flatten them with a rolling pin between two sheets of plastic wrap or wax paper, shape them into rounds using a plate, and cook them in a hot skillet until browned on both sides. ![1000522956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xL9JCkUWYpmHKaG4WknP5g6szxSuNigMhRKVZ5Yyoi6hLjK3bCodcxNmScQnLc2qQ6i.jpg) De esta masa salieron 22 tortillas; es bastante rendidora y quedan muy ricas. Les comento que el toque de jengibre fresco rallado le aporta gran sabor y frescura, resalta la riqueza de la remolacha. ***¡Deliciosas!*** > This batter made 22 tortillas; it goes a long way and they turn out delicious. I’ll tell you, the touch of fresh grated ginger adds great flavor and freshness, really bringing out the richness of the beets. > *** So delicious!*** ![1000522981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23y94m1VWgKBhYA7ViwAXjkcGiq6vxomFrwcpvzVJrZkNQ8huBSAQbJDWcpBSJufZ75Bs.jpg)
**¡Espero que te guste esta receta, cocina fácil y con sabor**!

<center><a href=\

>

The [perspective](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNmAwmNdNYESYy2GLZASQs4evBaSQ7MuvFoGJsGyKLfm9/SocialQuotes.jpg) that defines decadence as the only real and natural thing resonates with currents of nihilism and philosophical pessimism, where deterioration is seen as a natural and inevitable process of life and history. This view suggests that ruin is the logical conclusion of **time.**

- **Nietzsche and the Descending Life:** Nietzsche often reinterpreted decadence not only as a moral fall, but as a \

a decline in the will to power, which he considered a real manifestation in culture and biology.

- **Decadence as a Natural Process:** Decadence can be understood as the deterioration or material/symbolic wear and tear that occurs with the simple passage of **time,** applied to both human memory and social structures.

- **Cioran's Perspective:** [E.M. Cioran,](https://medium.com/@schopenhauer_/a-short-history-of-decay-c44ac5a5c6a9) in his reflections, often delves into personal defeat and eternal transformation, suggesting an acceptance of decadence as part of the universe's natural course.

- **Inevitable Nature:** This view posits that decline is the process of \

the decay or deterioration of the original strength and conditions of anything or anyone in the natural course of **time.**

This perspective often challenges [narratives](https://youtu.be/Zci4n2y21Xg) of progress, positioning decline as the true constant. And this will continue to be the case if you continue to refuse to «click» on everything you **should** click on. So don't resist and «click» on everything clickable you find in this post.

body.body: > Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. ***

> Hello my dear friends. I am @rasel72. From #Bangladesh. *** ![6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzyjTmyvZK86LYycQVxxNE6EA4m5Nf2s5bcwZkCJBMoNfUCkRQTqNfHb1wJLb3xk1ewryTjFVENCNYZRWe.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUcAfYJk2qALb4ReERMDBnKb2KRWabew4pTvQaYMXx2Wp/6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzyjTmyvZK86LYycQVxxNE6EA4m5Nf2s5bcwZkCJBMoNfUCkRQTqNfHb1wJLb3xk1ewryTjFVENCNYZRWe.jpeg)
Thumbnail

> ##
***Moment of turmeric in the body***
There are many rules observed in marriage. However, according to our Islam, it is Sunnah to complete the marriage by following very simple rules. However, in the current social system, all Islamic rules are not followed. I have also tried to follow some. However, I could not follow all the rules. After Eid, on March 23, my body was covered with turmeric or khid ceremony. It is basically observed the day before the wedding of a boy or girl. The rule of this day is that the boy or girl is given turmeric and neem leaves on the face and body together, which is called turmeric touch. On this day, girls come from their homes to give various things including wedding clothes for the boy. Even though it was my wedding, I had to take more responsibility than anyone else and get through the busy time. I had bought various types of turmeric from the body since morning and sat down to buy turmeric in the afternoon. Since it was my wedding, I gave the responsibility of taking pictures to my nephew. ![1000049101.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma6vvZs2eBJWUXkW9nDBaoAqzLzE8DagTiNnqKs596oom/1000049101.jpg) ![1000049075.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbBmNcsPqaJc65a8RoMJ5uAFCNJKQiGWHAmPvyLLG1jS3/1000049075.jpg) ![1000049067.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeVZHrkYi7THY99CWhvtNBxMuctz5y7oHN562caGh8dSQ/1000049067.jpg) My friends, they all started giving me turmeric on the face with joy. Every boy or girl always dreams about this moment in life. To fulfill this dream, you have to work hard and take yourself to the brink of success, then you get the person of your choice. After applying turmeric, everyone took me to take a bath. Basically, after they followed the rules and poured water on me, I took a bath myself. In fact, I feel ashamed to take a bath in front of other people or older sisters. Anyway, after finishing the bath, I put on the clothes brought from my future in-laws' house. This moment was a very happy moment in my life, and again, a kind of fear was working in my mind, I am taking such a big decision in life, new responsibilities will come in my life, will I really be able to fulfill all the responsibilities properly. Various such thoughts were going through my mind. ![1000049061.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmXYecBg8mERe5Ft6zTMFU465rq8gd8YPAjFKiZfFcyDHy/1000049061.jpg) |![1000049056.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYNravHMHhsAKXvS9CZ7zF8ahazvXzczmvWeQbKL61Z2S/1000049056.jpg)|![1000049021.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbqD9TEzzFV8o4q47GT4CWNkQRQATzmtHKyKNFCDtjZXF/1000049021.jpg)| |-|-| ![1000048874.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmPPDcjz1MoQvh24t9YtP5fg9qub7tsw3opfFiwaSdfXyK/1000048874.jpg) |![1000048847.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmP4iqVHFwURwccYwETAARjtkHV7BALd9Gcs7owJxE8N98/1000048847.jpg)|![1000048706.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmR5VWhLaZLH3qd5PP8eeMTbzvh66FCzF6Cgupk9shyERC/1000048706.jpg)| |-|-| ![1000048961.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUPoryYGBUhmGfcdsi8JwArJCEDswRfkMCHjY875695Wc/1000048961.jpg) A festive atmosphere was created at home around my marriage. After wearing the clothes, my elder brother-in-law picked me up in his lap and took me to the seat of the khidr. This moment was very funny. It seemed like going a long way with such a heavy person like me on his lap. In the afternoon, I sat down to eat khidr. First, my parents fed me khidr, then one by one my relatives and neighbors fed me khidr. Meanwhile, on the same day, people came from my in-laws' house, they also fed me khidr. I spent this day very beautifully by enjoying food and taking pictures. This day will be memorable for me for the rest of my life. That is why I tried to share this memorable moment of my life with you. ![1000048784.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmc4kaofNopn9poXsmf22bLBmmdKkc5PfZRydbU9XUyiK8/1000048784.jpg) All the sweets that were served at my khidr ceremony were arranged by my elder sisters. They tried to arrange it in various designs. There were payesh, semai, khidr, noodles, sweets, and various other fruits. I have a problem with eating too much sweets, so my elder sister cooked noodles and served them. People kept coming and feeding me khidr till evening. Apart from that, my daughters and friends came one by one and started taking pictures with me. I tried to decorate the place of the Khid ceremony quite beautifully. So that the moment is more beautiful and memorable. Anyway, I spent the day very beautifully, I also shared it with you. Everyone please pray for my new life. So that I can be happy with my life partner in this world and the hereafter. Everyone stay well and healthy. I will see you again with a new post of mine. #
>Thank you very much everyone for reading today's post.

Hi @nova94. Your story has some very nice touches. Kofi is a person who is seeking peace and perhaps forgiveness about things in the past and his role in his family. These are interesting and complex emotions that make the story compelling.

We have a tip for you, which is to take a little more time with your stories before submitting them to make sure they are well edited. In this story, you have provided the main character's name as Kofi, Koffi, and koffi. This is your main character's name. It should not be written with different spellings throughout the story. 

When you take the time to read your story before publishing it, you will most likely discover and fix awkward or confusing sentences like :

> There was no vehicle or bag I site.

> The winds ad chirpring insects added a calm background noise. 

> They all in the bid to remember themselves.

In a short story, every word counts. A sentence that has typos, or does not make sense, creates a stumbling block for the reader. This is why it is so important to read your story carefully before publishing it for all to see.

We hope you accept this as helpful guidance, not criticism.

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《欢迎来到暗黑童话世界》（张晋宜x常斌）PART 1
body.body:
![IMG_5186](https://s1.img-e.com/20260323/69c0e371aaf2e.jpeg)

这部剧大半个月前在抖音上有刷到过预告，当时就被无限流+暗黑童话+大女主的设定吸引预约了。今天一上架就打开来看，不负我的期待这部剧太惊艳了，爆款锁定！

从剧情的角度来说，在未来世界有人研发出了神经端口接入的仿真游戏。结合AI技术以满足氪金玩家的（变态）游戏体验，而里面的女性NPC却是现实中无故失踪的女性。

这个组织绑架女性强迫他们接入端口成为游戏一员，女主的朋友许多意就是其中一个。为了找回好友她潜入组织进入副本，不仅向氪金玩家复仇还打爆副本唤醒女性NPC。


比较讽刺的是，在女主视角回忆中体现这款游戏本来打着「关爱弱势群体，抚慰在情感中受伤人士」的幌子。我不自觉联想到现在的AI乙女游戏，会不会也有类似隐患呢？

从演员的角度来说，张晋宜是这部剧妥妥的大女主。我没记错的话之前应该是看过她的剧的，颜值和演技均在线。里面的其他演员颜值也都不错，对颜控观众非常友好。

从拍摄和服化道的角度来说，我觉得这部剧应该算是在此方面最花心思的剧组。看得出服化道发现花了不少钱和心思，既符合原本童话有融入本土元素，尊嘟太美太好看。

总的来说，这部剧是近期刷到最惊艳的啦，五星推荐！


（本篇完）

body.title: Armor Mayhem: guerra futurista por el control de la energía infinita
body.body: > En la época dorada de los juegos Flash, surgieron títulos que marcaron a toda una generación de jugadores, y uno de ellos fue Armor Mayhem. Este juego nos transporta a un futuro donde la humanidad ha descubierto una fuente de energía prácticamente infinita en un planeta lejano. Sin embargo, lejos de traer paz o progreso, este hallazgo desencadena un conflicto armado entre distintas facciones que buscan controlar este recurso a cualquier costo. --- La historia del juego se centra en esta lucha por el poder. Los cristales de energía no solo representan una ventaja tecnológica, sino también el dominio total sobre el campo de batalla. Como jugador, tomas el papel de un soldado altamente equipado que participa en esta guerra, enfrentando enemigos en diferentes misiones mientras avanzas en la campaña. A medida que progresas, se revelan más detalles sobre el conflicto, mostrando que no se trata solo de sobrevivir, sino de imponerse en un entorno hostil y competitivo. --- Uno de los aspectos más llamativos de Armor Mayhem es su sistema de progresión. A diferencia de otros juegos Flash de su época, aquí puedes mejorar tu equipo, comprar nuevas armas y personalizar tu armadura, lo que añade una capa estratégica al gameplay. Además, el juego incluye una habilidad especial que permite ralentizar el tiempo, lo que resulta clave en enfrentamientos intensos y le da un toque distintivo a la experiencia. --- Como dato curioso, Armor Mayhem fue desarrollado durante una etapa en la que los juegos Flash estaban en su punto máximo de popularidad, y logró destacar gracias a su jugabilidad fluida y su estilo visual atractivo. Muchos jugadores lo comparan con otros títulos icónicos del mismo género, lo que demuestra su impacto dentro de la comunidad. En definitiva, Armor Mayhem no solo fue un juego entretenido, sino también una muestra del potencial creativo de la era Flash, dejando una huella que aún hoy muchos recuerdan con nostalgia.

> During the golden age of Flash games, titles emerged that left a lasting mark on an entire generation of players—and one of them was *Armor Mayhem*. This game transports us to a future where humanity has discovered a virtually infinite energy source on a distant planet. However, far from bringing peace or progress, this discovery triggers an armed conflict between various factions vying to control this resource at any cost. --- The game's story centers on this struggle for power. The energy crystals represent not only a technological advantage but also total dominance over the battlefield. As a player, you assume the role of a highly equipped soldier participating in this war, facing off against enemies across various missions as you advance through the campaign. As you progress, further details regarding the conflict are revealed, demonstrating that the objective is not merely survival, but asserting your dominance within a hostile and competitive environment. --- One of the most striking aspects of *Armor Mayhem* is its progression system. Unlike other Flash games of its era, here you can upgrade your gear, purchase new weapons, and customize your armor—adding a strategic layer to the gameplay. Furthermore, the game features a special ability that allows you to slow down time; this proves crucial during intense firefights and lends a distinctive flair to the overall experience. --- As a fun fact, *Armor Mayhem* was developed during the period when Flash games were at the absolute peak of their popularity. It managed to stand out thanks to its fluid gameplay and appealing visual style. Many players draw comparisons between it and other iconic titles within the same genre—a testament to its significant impact on the gaming community. Ultimately, *Armor Mayhem* was not merely an entertaining game, but also a prime example of the creative potential inherent in the Flash era—leaving behind a legacy that many still look back on with nostalgia today. --- |

Just look at all the clouds piling up against the mountains!”😮 As I was telling everyone a few post ago, morning weather in the Pacific Northwest can be very deceptive in the spring time!😇 Just look at how the weather changed in the next photo, as we left Church and were heading back home!😎 Silvertop just needed to be a little patient Lol!☺️ Living with Solar electricity, you also learn to monitor your electrical “Loads”. With only minutes before Church was starting today, Silvertop was on his iPhone checking our Solar battery percentage of charge !🙄 “ I think the batteries are good honey, and most likely by the time we get home the Sun will be charging the batteries back up!”😇 Yep…, that’s exactly how today played out!😎 On hot days like today……(remember Silvertop is a true “Northwestern”), anything above 70 degrees is too hot Lol!😅 The solution to this “Heatwave” is a cool shady hike deep in the darkest part of the forest!☺️ Silvertop loves the Sun, but after an hour or so I began to turn red and I burn, especially with the UV index of 5 today!😎 “Shade is nice honey, after all, I think I got plenty of vitamin D out in the Sun splitting firewood, this afternoon before our hike!”😎 “You are a little pink Silvertop!”🥰 Everything in moderation my friends!😇 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

body.title: Sky Point Observation Deck : Surfers Paradise, Gold Coast.
body.body:
The first day of the family trip started with a visit to the SkyPoint view tower in Surfers Paradise, Gold Coast. Its location in the centre of the Surfer Paradise makes it within walking distance, and provides a 360-degree view of the city. ![IMG_3550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/23wMYf8rG3yw29UekmbNNoCTK6rBwHNTzbiwdJuNGG34H1rWHTHTL3QXr9RjY2HLBFQpY.jpg) ![vt2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EptTMPX3uLPiHPuYhpfc4wcYZzpSeJm5KhUo8CQ8xTMv8V8WFUXLR8URNncrnPa7dH7.JPG) ![vt1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/Ep3cJ6Y9JjqAz8MV2LEr4njnJPcCMhdtm29SVhmsy37trZ26KAhU3qE7zy5dPxPFCKd.JPG) ![vt4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EoniB57dLKjckbLUPXsT2kjR3bD1w3qSQzxLt9HprnggqXgyiTqJVbBRJsU9QnQ1tfZ.JPG) The view tower's total height is 322 meters, of which the observation deck at 230 meters provides a scenic view above Surfer Paradise. The rest of the height is made for the climbers to do outdoor adventure. It only takes around 40 seconds to reach the observation deck. Moreover, the observation deck has a restaurant that opens from 7:30 am to 9 pm. Due to the time constraints, we decided to go as early as possible. I had booked the spot in Viator ( a third-party booking platform) with an offer for a day pass. It's recommended to go before sunset to get the day-view and sunset-view as well. ![vt8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EqhGy5RquYdo1orLMw7Nafh9SMNEiJaktQP8iJ4cUt2jqz1uSgvEA1yow4LtPt6WPRd.JPG) ![vt5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EqYmPq5E4ft6w8tLAXnpNygS5FhDVwKfimc9KouD15GwtRf7f2WHZmnW2ZtH7NWLVbi.JPG) ![vt6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EpXBLQ5Lvim7seUJZawVE5iowTmrp9UY78LvXBu6qzcW7Gnufr8BEq9Wb4avyWcAeu3.JPG) ![vt7.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EqWdUNL926oUgJaJb8HpWMCWHrRSh2Bqm5b8xqCv2xDQg9ZgPmnN7kFMgM1ShbXtzGu.JPG) ![vt9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suzn.poudel/EoAZFMTdBqFfaao7Q6XG8i12qRLpFZ7rsMgNEezXe75jVm8rnLcTPGCudEevyiaFeRr.JPG) It was jam-packed, and the restaurant was busy. The place was a cozy spot to get a view of the city. The beach with the green sea water and the waves seemed all stuck, making it look like a painting. Oh, I saw the view from the plane as well, with the straight-lined beach. Oh, that was quite a unique view. The restaurant seating space was great, and we decided to skip the food on the spot. But we didn't skip the photographs as the view was worth the ticket.
**Key Information:** - The tower was a hospitality centre in itself. The front car park by the side of the road is free, and you could use it if you find a space. Mostly, cars/vehicles parked in the city require tickets. - It's hot during April, it's hotter than most people feel, also at night. So, comfortable summer clothes should fit in your luggage. - The day ticket was meant for one entry in a single day, not multiple entries in a single day. - Viator is my easy third-party booking app, as it offers discounted offers and also some dollar rewards. - The place is located in 77 storeys, so yes, a bit of motion sickness is possible with the ears clogged. Thank you for going through my travel stories. See you with the next blog. [//]:# (!worldmappin -28.00630 lat 153.42984 long d3scr) [//]:# ([//]:# (!worldmappin -28.00630 lat 153.42984 long d3scr))

body.title: Bracelet display stand | Tutorial [Eng-Esp]
body.body:
> Greetings, fellow craft lovers! Welcome back to my workshop @bricolajedc. Today, I’d love to show you how to make a ***4-tier bracelet display***. Join me, and I’ll walk you through the creative process. >>Saludos amigos amantes de las artes manuales! Les doy la bienvenida una vez más a mi taller @bricolajedc, en esta oportunidad me encantaría compartir con ustedes la elaboración de un ***exhibidor de pulseras de 4 niveles. Acompáñenme y les muestro el proceso creativo. ![1000435508.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/48XfMQBzmcYy5FrxpKXbJd9brzJ5WeMKxECA3jBiGvCB6Uo5cKNn3NrssoSCLYAUud.jpg) Materials Cardboard rolls 2-millimeter-thick cardboard 1 meter of upholstery fabric Scissors Measuring tape Utility knife Hot glue Pencil Paper tape Recycled paper A piece of cardstock >***Materiales*** > >>Rollos de cartón >>Cartón de 2 milímetros de grueso >>1 metro de Tela de tapicería >>Tijera >>Regla métrica >>Cutter >>Silicón caliente Lápiz Cinta adhesiva de papel Papel de reciclaje >>Un trozo de cartón fino ![1000432658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23u6De8Pk8hvpmJd9C939tL6mhYecuhVESpEnTGLFJ4pp3VoH41BFNxbLcR2UVdLHZn9v.jpg) Let's start by taking the paper rolls and taping them together to make a 30-centimeter strip. >>Comencemos tomando los rollos de papel y uniéndolos con cinta para tener una medida de 30 centímetros. ![1000432659.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tvq43ASgLtEn3diEQKvn4VftDWeiq2gvmqD1wCGhZxJDjNeLRUsoVMjS7JykW3a2WgP.jpg) I had a thin cardboard tube, so I added that too to hold the necklaces. You can wrap the tape around the joints a few times to reinforce the cardboard. >>Tenía un rollo de cartón fino y también lo agregué para colocar los collares. Podemos dar varias vueltas de cinta en las uniones para reforzar el cartón. ![1000432660.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tHGQYrdxYHmkzSvyU5qmFiLdQg7RbCSVUpyQ4Wv9S5DhMWS2s8EtuM7yyTEME2WycXE.jpg) Once all the rolls are ready, we’ll take some recycled paper and stuff each one; this will make each roll sturdier and give it enough weight so it won’t tip over. >>Una vez que tenemos todos los rollos listos, vamos a tomar papel de reciclaje y rellenaremos cada uno, esto le dara una mayor fortaleza a cada rollo y le dará peso para que no se voltee. |![1000432662.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23wMcWmAWkujCj7a7RaMLzttKBPRkeruder5bMf2yaadgNXcjwTnuRARVdFXtM6bfUKxb.jpg)|![1000432661.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uQvQfsZiZdACcYjYwsEfotMREEJhjMuCQ7XUkyxsi5r4cMcQHLpiYw19puqQAaeVywA.jpg)| |-|-| We'll use the cardboard to make a flap on each end of the cardboard tube so the stuffing doesn't fall out. To do this, simply glue the tube to the cardboard using silicone glue. Trim off the excess so it doesn't stick out from the tube. >>Con el cartón vamos a hacer una tapa de cada lado del tubo de cartón para que no se salga el papel de relleno. Esto lo hacemos simplemente pegando con silicona el tubo al cartón. Recortamos el excedente para que no resalte del tubo. ![1000432666.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tc3KkEWYEHX86AA6j9XTSuap7aZR4LybdHJzujaYPbDWF7yY3YL9pSTMCiy21M3Dr6s.jpg) Now we’re going to cover each tube with upholstery fabric. I chose a beige fabric to really make the dark bracelets stand out. We seal the edges of the tubes by applying silicone, then cover them with the fabric. Next, we cover the entire tube. >>Ahora vamos a forrar cada tubo con la tela de tapicería. Yo escogí una tela en color beige para resaltar las pulseras oscuras sobre todo. >> >>Tapamos los bordes de los tubos, aplicando silicon y liego cubrimos con la tela. Luego todo el tubo. |![1000432749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23vsUySKAMVNy2BrhtdAaFDDqxbMqN94z5M8uCmNaRrhuEtaVZL4MTK7omyxdgUMbHDwT.jpg)|![1000432750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tvqBp1bjJk71cJSr36k5iaKeX7E18S9oj5kMErJR7znDCS7UveoEJfjeoxmuF8gZ6vn.jpg)| |-|-| The idea is to place the bracelets on the display and arrange them side by side. This type of display is ideal for carrying a large number of bracelets. >>La idea es colocar las pulseras y poder organizarlas una al lado de la otra. Este tipo de exhibidor es ideal para transportar una gran cantidad de pulseras. ![1000432777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uQvsGnFunHRPZ9HBunoBFCmrX55YZzcsKRrd5wrZ32gVq3XzV2X4hihBKQ1a6Lv9TQc.jpg) For the base, we’ll make a 30-centimeter pyramid, and using tubes of the same length, we’ll create a staircase with four semicircles. At each corner of the pyramid, we’ll place a step and measure 2 centimeters inward to position the other steps. We’ll cut along these lines to form the steps. >>Para la base, haremos una pirámide 30 centímetros y con la misma medida de los tubos hacemos en escalera 4 semicírculos. En cada una de las esquinas de las pirámides ubicaremos un escalón y medimos 2 centímetros havia adentro para ubicar los otros escalones. Recortamos para que queden los escalones. |![1000432892.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tc3jJ1e53GGGrreHwwvMjmMEhF3owbQh5EBLRPEVsUTZMqcbdwaBqPG7yy3y3hZim5u.jpg)|![1000432893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tc5WZJZgTvPUpH24T3oU6YurLxCygpnVkwZsVXzpQMF8tGdTnvj7xEoLERpK9kpv8me.jpg)|![1000432904.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uR139uETRGdAz8TTJbMQNSYniKARtQDkHGBYCmdkioK1VQ3cS7GtPR8pYoWK4h1MR1e.jpg)| |-|-|-| Use the tape to cover all the edges of the pyramids. This will prevent the cardboard from tearing and make the structure more sturdy. >>Con la cinta adhesiva, vamos a cubrir todos los bordes de las piramides. Así evitamos que el cartos se desgarre y le damos fuerza a la estructura. ![1000432909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tmUK49yK3V6APFzMNvbTBg2MoUt9eEs1orD6fEQgwvyTRUYPqDRwNCUv7Kh18tUHyjp.jpg) Once we have two pieces like this arranged in a pyramid shape, we’ll cover them with fabric. Apply glue to both sides of the cardboard and cover them with the fabric, making sure there are no wrinkles. >>Luego de tener 2 piezas como esta en pirámide, vamos a forrar con la tela. Por ambos lados del cartón colocamos la silicona y forramos con la tela sin dejar arrugas. |![1000432910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23t7qNMYM5vkcQ6zC7pJsrp7MW1hk4Ziwc7icB8t4k37SMGBGme9enVEPGMriaKtVPPEY.jpg)|![1000432911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23t7quJ5GwAga6VUiJksUscNuFBN4F7ACELVs25oQEwUkbb3igg84iymKPvFCstjEyMSn.jpg)|![1000432953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23tHJKwRQbE3PSZXnvXXzaaKPbr79yqDJi4swt8tffH6EzgvKFLrWXcYsdRYPL58M75xY.jpg)| |-|-|-| Once both pyramids are covered with fabric, we’ll make a piece of cardboard and cut two slits 5 centimeters from the edge; these will serve as the tabs into which we’ll insert the pyramids. And that’s how our display will be ready. >>Una vez que tenemos ambas pirámides con su forro de tela, vamos a hacer una pieza de cartón a la que le abriremos 2 ranumas a 5 centímetros del borde, estas serán las pestañas donde vamos a introducir las pirámides. >> >>Y así nos quedaría listo nuestro exhibidor. ![1000433081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23u6DrBfcY6QjKCvkVG4NRKJGKtUjk8bgjaq7AoFgQ5gtWAPTpW6WWRMpzo6QsSS94Cyc.jpg) And there you have it—our display made from recycled materials: quick, inexpensive, and very easy to make. >>Y listo tenemos nuestro exhibidor hecho con material de de reciclaje, rápido, económico y muy fácil de hacer. ![1000434160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23z7Qko5q6rGu7wA2PtezdvdVRTTwV15VVtZFaSfiS5qtUaUG9KwS7owp8tJQqqVRa5RB.jpg) This type of display stand is ideal for trade shows and events, where transporting the products we sell can be a challenge. >>Este tipo de exhibidor es ideal para las ferias y eventos fonde trasladar los productos que vendemos puede llegar a ser un desafío. |![1000434555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/EoptTfKPPumsM2iGLyCVVhthzWJoeR59juwK4wjQR717ftYkPvWtmLTvFe7SmDvyV2h.jpg)|![1000434557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/EogNquoMC9BJgThKe2sAHE5ZiU2zv8QtTgX7RUvp7WD7BikmUuaR6ZSXvU4th9GJDG3.jpg)| |-|-| These days, a display stand like this can cost as much as $49 or $50. With this tutorial, you can make a 4-tier display stand for just $8. I think it’s a great option for new entrepreneurs. It’s available in my online store. I hope you like my work. See you next time. Bye! >>En la actualidad un exhibidor de este tipo puede llegar a costar 49 o 50$. Con este tutorial un exhibidor de 4 niveles podemos tenerlo por un costo de 8$. Me parece una opción muy completa para los nuevos emprendedores. Está disponible en mi tienda online. >> >>Espero les guste mi trabajo. Nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad. Chao!
![Imagen1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chacald.dcymt/23uFHApKMJ2KLfcNj7uB8npK7eh8YSr1SfRRe3uFGHhKaYrZyvVAJv2gmYqpfMVDXpQo3.png)

body.title: Państwo-miasto raz
body.body:
>



Demokracja, jak pokazuje przykład Wietnamu czy Singapuru, nie zawsze jest najlepszym rozwiązaniem i może nie być pożądanym jeśli mieszkańcom zapewni się w miarę uczciwe warunki egzystencji i możliwość bogacenia się. Bo wiecie, że Singapur to demokracja tylko z nazwy? A wiecie, że Singapur jest chyba jedynym przykładem państwa wyrzuconego z innego kraju. A mimo to osiągnął znaczny sukces. Może z powodu tego, co Polacy chcą żeby wprowadzić, ale jakoś się nie udaje - silne, stabilne państwo o restrykcyjnym prawie, ale przyjazne biznesowi. Wszystkie artykuły o Singapurze, które czytałem podkreślały, że ludzie są w stanie zaakceptować bardziej restrykcyjne prawo i brak wolności politycznych, jeśli te prawo jest stosowane jednakowo przez administrację wysokiego poziomu (merytokracja) i bezwzględną walkę z korupcja. Dura lex sed lex i warunki do rozwoju gwarantowane przez państwo. Wiedziałem, że lecę do nowoczesnego kraju, ale mimo wszystko byłem pod wielkim wrażeniem - 'efekt wow'. 

Słynne Superdrzewa - które widzicie na zdjęciach - to nie tylko futurystyczne instalacje do robienia ładnych zdjęć. To w rzeczywistości zaawansowane systemy ekologiczne. Działają jak gigantyczne kominy wentylacyjne dla podziemnej elektrowni na biomasę, zbierają deszczówkę do nawadniania parku, a ich pnie to pionowe ogrody porośnięte przez ponad 160 tysięcy roślin.







![1000015963.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23vhsd1q5wSeLiAgqbT1yEawmuCH1SWrJB1vvnJcZ5wBgymCjTT1YN5Rhh9Q1QovYy2Yw.jpg)


Po urokliwym, ale jednak azjatyckim chaosie Tajlandii i Wietnamu, tutejsze lotnisko to inna galaktyka. Odprawa paszportowa, odbiór bagażu i znalezienie taksówki (dzięki intuicyjnym oznaczeniom) odbyły się z prędkością światła. Od momentu dotknięcia pasa startowego minęła zaledwie godzina, a my już zameldowaliśmy się w hotelu. U nas czasami w godzinę nie jesteśmy w stanie odebrać w wszystkich bagaży. 


![1000015961.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23xebjM8wUURPEMDPD7RHLHdM9kNELmm53f8xi41ar7AE7coAy2X8S3oUeZXaqaseJDJs.jpg)


Niestety, ​zaraz po zameldowaniu moja druga połówka zaczyna narzekać na dreszcze, ból brzucha i wysoką gorączkę. Nie było czasu na myślenie. Szybki czat z ubezpieczycielem, załatwienie listu gwarancyjnego z deklaracją opłacenia wizyty (co jest ruchem absolutnie kluczowym, bo koszty tutejszej służby zdrowia potrafią wywołać zawał) i ruszamy do jednej z wiodących, prywatnych placówek w Singapurze. ​Szybka diagnostyka, kroplówki, antybiotyk i pakiet leków. Medyczna precyzja i standard na najwyższym poziomie. Sytuacja zdrowotna została opanowana. 

![1000015960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23xySzYeCyLoXMNjDL78w5uxR9RVq1N5rR4kPLrjvEr6x7VVMkCqZ2LQGua1sDTDNCscy.jpg)

![1000015965.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/Eo1wwKMniunhsG3ZmUgBJaNgbrvCrL7t4ooxqBbtaGahJSLsvAqYcTKEDcbLyytGynS.jpg)

![1000015966.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23swi94vCiXiKVAyyDHbm4zCkk7QGUzpahPacd8afMSafWnJS6ib2dxjM5Hyh7ejmgR3x.jpg)

![1000015964.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23tv8HETRzW9ybNsQtwtVdM33AasZaDRR1UzGyK53x2Ereut7zn5SGdGNk5YFhuzf7VBF.jpg)

![1000015957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23wWrwUtrS8AJqSszw4TVABurxZE7DYJ7GPBUs4vbJ7HgZjRBAJViQPLPrnBmHyBh3NLK.jpg)

![1000015951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/244e8DpaEYNnNpEJgPS7KQcqt1riy5bDizACWXUM3jUdmMfi14MjQ4KSZ6ikN5Y5SuPnm.jpg)

![1000015953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/244y1VCDeYbwWRdcWbrvcyFqAaZM87XNzcapygcn3ywRcZUe4izxyg4iu4N8zZzswwUKw.jpg)

![1000015956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/245wFeUsxrAyp8N5i8FpH19df3vbMkXj3fY1cVQRe23AtCqhUmsowb8VoE6sC54VAGU26.jpg)

![1000015955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/246avK4QxCABBPBvRp4zCpzZhcUzdpPimMBAdRrkyRTGSCFS7sxnfD4j3nEopCVergvqT.jpg)

Mimo wszystko, nie mogłem pozbyć się wrażenia, że to miejsce sztuczne i pozbawione duszy. Komunikacja wcale nie jest tak prosta, jak mogłoby się wydawać, bo lokalsi mówią w specyficznym Singlish (z wszechobecnym \

na końcu zdań), co wymaga sporego skupienia. Do tego dochodzi pogoda. Upał i wilgotność wykańczają tu znacznie szybciej i mocniej niż w innych miejscach Azji. Nawet fakt, że chyba 90% miasta to zadaszone aleje z podwieszonymi, wielkimi wiatrakami, niewiele pomaga, gdy powietrze po prostu stoi.


![1000015993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23tv6LRZQKqvxdLJPANY1rgAEY9hUhGmVUfxnDVKk9kEi6enr4Jr3it1q3zuC3xF5aQA8.jpg)

![1000015994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lukaszolejnik/23vhH3LYerRMoG9a7t5tXTuu1xRkGjxBr4kVhLg17vshEwinGA2eX6PixXfs9SPmznsnJ.jpg)


​Singapur to świetne doświadczenie i architektoniczny cud, ale siedząc już na lotnisku po prostu ucieszyłem się, że wracam do głośnej, często brudnej, ze zmieszanymi zapachami kanalizacji, jedzenia, wilgoci ale niesamowicie prawdziwej Tajlandii.

Singapur to według mnie super miejsce na jeden raz.

body.title: 潮汕遊5 - 潮州古城牌坊街
body.body: 其實潮汕兩地的景點實在是不多，潮州就是一個潮州古城，周邊的如鳳凰山就已經遠離潮州市範圍了。我相信去潮州玩的朋友絕大部份都會住在潮州古城裡面，這大部份的大部份又會住在牌坊街周邊的客棧，我也是，因為牌坊街是古城的核心了。 牌坊街有22座牌坊，都是潮州的古人以豐功偉績換回來的，但大家不要以為現在看到的牌坊就是以前的牌坊，我在這裡聽老一輩人說，其實整條牌坊街都是近年修復回來的，有些牌坊更是沒有照片紀錄，都是依靠古文獻描述重新打造出來，一位司機跟我說，牌坊街應該就只有部份騎樓是真的從古時保留下來，其他的都是修復時仿造的。

/> 其實整條牌坊街很熱鬧，不過我第一次參觀的時候是早上8點多，所以街上沒什麼人...哈哈... 牌坊街可說是潮州古城的核心了，基本上吃的、茶館、客棧、手信店都集中在這條街，是去潮州不能錯過的地方，我之前在潮州吃的，有一半都是在牌坊街吃。而潮州古城的景點，例如開元寺、廣濟橋、許駙馬府、潮州府等等，都是在牌坊街附近，至於古城外的範圍，基本上沒有什麼好逛的地方，我就只去了一個潮州博物館，感覺好像一個比較大的商場都看不到，所以如果要住，肯定是住古城裡。 至於牌坊街周邊，也有很多很潮式的建築，保留下很多廣東式的騎樓，這些騎樓在香港已經少之又少了。

오늘 산책을 하면서 정말 즐거운 시간을 보냈습니다. 도심의 공원에서 친구와 우연히 만나 함께 걸었습니다. 그 친구는 최근에 시작한 새로운 취미에 대해 이야기해 주었고, 우리는 서로의 취미에 대해 이야기를 나누며 즐거운 시간을 보냈습니다. 또한, 산책 중에 꽤 큰 나무 아래서 예쁘게 피어난 꽃들을 발견했습니다. 그 꽃들은 초봄에 피는 벚꽃과는 다른, 작고 아기자기한 모습이었고, 지나가는 사람들도 사진을 찍느라 바쁘더군요. 자연의 아름다움과 사람들의 다양한 이야기를 나누는 시간이 정말 소중했습니다. 이런 작은 순간들이 일상을 더욱 특별하게 만들어 주는 것 같아요! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: A couple of busy days
title.body: > I've had a pretty hectic week and I'm really a bit tired. I've also noticed that I've neglected my blog a bit due to a lack of organization; I usually get home exhausted and go straight to sleep. In short, I had several birthdays this week, and for one of them we went to the movies to see Super Mario Galaxy. I liked it and it was entertaining.

> He tenido una semana bastante movida y realmente estoy un poco cansada. También he notado que he descuidado un poco mi blog por falta de organización, suelo estar llegando a casa cansada y directo a dormir. En un resumen esta semana tuve varios cumpleaños, en uno de ellos fuimos al cine a ver la película de Super Mario Galaxy, me gustó y estuvo entretenida.
![IMG_0330.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josehany/EoeCvieTeDkP4sdhbiEfiJZ3dbW8C124iPKYakUfn8YiFHoaPAFFhQNQvdf7QonWNZe.jpeg) ![IMG_0297.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josehany/AKCBWYKN4BkBqGbzRQFSbEBupYuTLg6j5ZAEz4ELk1cf6kz7wdhyS35dkqdiYf4.jpeg) ![IMG_0347.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josehany/Eos2DWA5ZxQqAzP3BYiSvRZXceypEN9AszgxRZWAu1sugp3EQehWTAMByBYZtS9DWQf.jpeg)

> I also worked at another branch of the same store, and it was a horrible experience because everything was disorganized and out of place. That experience made me appreciate my own store even more. Besides going for runs with a group of new people, I've also been meeting people from the gym and boxing. Today I was invited to a Mormon church. It was my first time attending one, and the experience was similar to when I used to go to a Christian church. I respect other people's religions, and if I'm invited to attend, I'm open-minded enough to accept.

> Estuve trabajando también en otra sede de la misma tienda y fue una experiencia horrible porque todo estaba desordenado y fuera de lugar. Esa experiencia me hizo apreciar mas mi tienda. Además de salir a correr con un grupo de personas nuevas, estar conociendo gente también del gym y boxear. Hoy me invitaron a una iglesia mormona. Primera vez que asistí a una y la experiencia fue similar a cuando iba a la iglesia cristiana. Yo respeto las religiones de las otras personas y si me invitan a asistir, mi mente es bastante abierta para aceptar.
![IMG_0507.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josehany/23x17QRCqKGX9G2CbaBFxBD4JKYJJKAWAVA5QHj9x7xyaRD3WoDc6wNFyu5zrobDUmXQy.jpeg) ![IMG_0505.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josehany/23zbPY51JhvQgNdXNEy3TT6mxHL8UoFyqie4bb6TtPKk57FWXHbxgfGLkxoSGmHmTfdB1.jpeg)

> I did more activities but I don't consider them that relevant. I will try to put my life in order for the thousandth time, only this time it really is different because I am in several clubs, doing several activities, feeling like I am in the best moment of my life, but at home I realize that I am starting to neglect household chores because I want to rush from activity to activity so that I have enough time in the day.

> Hice más actividades pero no las considero tan relevantes, trataré de poner mi vida en orden por milésima vez, solo que esta vez sí es realmente diferente porque estoy en varios clubes, haciendo varias actividades, sintiendo que estoy en el mejor momento de mi vida pero en casa me doy cuenta que empiezo a descuidar las tareas del hogar por querer salir corriendo de actividad en actividad para que me alcance el día.

title.title: Un nuevo lugar por explorar. / A new place to explore. The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Part 39. [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUnPeq9Z2evbH1csax6MWfxzNaYVS7WwS57whu64WaQca/1776646482407.jpg)

Hola mi querida comunidad de Hive Gaming. Gracias a todo por el apoyo a mi publicación anterior, no solo a mí sino también a los nuevos que se van integrando cada día a esta comunidad. Cuando alguien te celebra o te felicita por algo que te gusta realizar o hacer la satisfacción llega a otro nivel. 

>Hello, my dear Hive Gaming community. Thank you all for your support for my previous post – not just for me, but also for the newcomers who are joining this community every day. When someone celebrates or congratulates you on something you enjoy doing, the sense of satisfaction reaches a whole new level. 

En el episodio anterior habíamos logrado reunir todas las pequeñas deidades que se encontraban en la Torre de los Dioses. Todas en su conjunto despertaron sincrónicamente expulsando una gran energía hacia el centro de un altar, para crear una especie de túnel ascendente que me llevaría hacia lo más alto de lo misma. Ahora me encontraba en un lugar nuevo por explorar..................

>In the previous episode, we had managed to gather all the minor deities who were in the Tower of the Gods. They all awoke simultaneously, channelling a great surge of energy towards the centre of an altar to create a sort of ascending tunnel that would carry me to the very top of the tower. Now I found myself in a new place to explore..................

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmamKyFPVNpeYaUnN5MLvCtHwQeS7hfmCasK7geuPpimsQ/1776646482603.jpg)

Lo primero que hice luego de ascender fué recorrer toda el área en la que me encontraba. Había una puerta bien cerrada con unos barrotes custodiada por dos estatuas de hierro similares a las que se encontraban en varias zonas de la Torre.

>The first thing I did after climbing up was to explore the whole area I was in. There was a firmly shut door with bars on it, guarded by two iron statues similar to those found in various parts of the Tower. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZc416ccqxD13BcstUUg7Tp2sQpkwMcfEZnkcFWBHMAD5/1776646482556.jpg)

Encontré también un gran baúl encerrado por una barrera de láseres, enfrente del mismo se encontraban en el suelo tres interruptores los cuáles supuestamente deberían ser activados para quitar dicha barrera. Ya tenía algo en mente con las dos estatuillas de hierro que habías visto anteriormente. Por lo que no sería un desafío tan difícil de lograr. 

>I also found a large chest surrounded by a laser barrier; in front of it, on the floor, were three switches which presumably needed to be activated to remove the barrier. I already had something in mind involving the two iron figurines you’d seen earlier. So it wouldn’t be too difficult a challenge to overcome. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8Ypm8AHr5mUWtUS272Yja7BtA6zqPYcrD4uvJ82MtSv/1776646482473.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSB1AmbYfFf1XV7CjznoNJTR1BUcttAa6rmvC7zB1qFYX/1776646482517.jpg)

Me crucé por sorpresa en mi camino con una estructura letal. Se trataba de una especie de vigía  piramidal que tenía un ojo que no dejaba escapar el mínimo objeto en movimiento, para liquidarlo con su potente láser y hacerlo polvo. Menos mal que mis sentidos estaban activos y reaccioné al momento porque no hubiera contado la historia de igual forma. Aprendí que no debería acercarme jamás a esa figura si quería conservar mi vida.

>I unexpectedly came across a deadly structure. It was a sort of pyramid-shaped watchtower with an eye that didn’t miss the slightest movement, ready to obliterate anything in its path with its powerful laser. Thank goodness my senses were on the alert and I reacted instantly, otherwise I wouldn’t be here to tell the tale. I learnt that I should never go near that structure if I wanted to stay alive.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWd5iN4fWcejgYR5ziVEv8EhfSACbFjbkP2hH3JzTHV7X/1776648829832.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKQLr96NZnErjYCwcN7xTBBck9ZrZsx6CVq2pgFoGu8c/1776648829895.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdG5o3f7KNHKz5XSS5sz8cFqSTWBVvBU3iXAhjmTHk8wD/1776648829935.jpg)

No existía más nada importante que el gran baúl que se encontraba atrapado tras aquellos láseres. Así que me puse mano a la obra y fuí trayendo poco a poco a cada una de las estatuillas de hierro las cuáles coloqué sobre cada interruptor para desconectar la trampilla. Efectivamente la trampa se desactivó siendo yo la tercera estatua que la desactivaría. Ahora me quedaba el paso libre para acceder a ese gran baúl.

>There was nothing more important than the large chest trapped behind those lasers. So I set to work and, bit by bit, brought each of the iron figurines over and placed them on the switches to deactivate the trapdoor. Sure enough, the trap was deactivated, with me being the third figurine to do so. Now I had a clear path to access that large chest.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf9tEB8s9RCvAkmqGKxfP8qFMh2QBCpatsTV8wa2YjpGb/1776649146682.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZubVcW2UeMyve5qa2AQG9R5NzzZBNYSvqQ7oxYevJcAM/1776649146614.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc9Zmb79ESyy2eTPhJpMk1Npft7a126Xce2DeUaibq3i2/1776649146723.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmckdH4xVRncYwd4EG9WYqSKVHoM6XKpCR4rSADzv6wCKr/1776649146761.jpg)

Lo que contenía el gran baúl era la llave para acceder a la mazmorra donde se ocultaba el gran jefe de esta Torre. Pero en todo mi camino no había visto dicha puerta que abrir con esta llave, tal vez estaría más adelante.................

>What the large trunk contained was the key to the dungeon where the great lord of this Tower was hiding. But throughout my journey, I hadn’t seen any door that this key could open; perhaps it lay further ahead.................
***********************************************
Soy @loren89 un fanático de los videojuegos y espero que les haya gustado la historia de hoy.

title.title: Cheese Omelette Roll Skewers
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXccDRY9oUW7TpNeC2adZ7zBGzxnYEaRTpms2khyfyJmv/1776648799261.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers! To kick off this Sunday, I’m starting by making a street food dish that’s quite famous in my area—it’s called *telur gulung* or egg rolls skewers. Telur gulung is a street food snack that’s very easy to make; the basic ingredients are just eggs and water, cooked in hot oil. It’s really fun to make because you need a skewer to roll it up in the oil. This time I made them with mozzarella filling, which makes this snack even more appealing to eat. Alright, let’s get started

**Ingredients:**

- 3 eggs
- 6 tbsp water
- a pinch of salt
- a pinch of bouillon powder
- mozzarella slices
- skewers

**Steps:**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNa9iGrZjzMBxtGcsH24jvHREh7NCSCVm1kvagEB3ieK4/1776648835837.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVaERVhfuBZgcLZBKok2V2FdL3z2REmWsaJsNJ2gWdtV/1776648852003.jpg)

- Cut the mozzarella into long strips and skewer them with the prepared skewers

- Set aside

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeda1f3jFBsfRLxnav4kX2c5cVLvt8ZgfShkjFoummWcH/1776648870305.jpg)

- Crack the eggs into a bowl, I use a small glass so it’s easier to pour when cooking

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVz57mSiEDfHdxhzkoBYabb47eVXE21fM6eFA8v9Wk9k9/1776648902583.jpg)

- Add the salt and bouillon powder

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJZH4YaDXWmSEgWsxJZnZ4M5WTmGGkAyceGhWjp7r24n/1776650774194.jpg)

- Whisk the eggs until the whites and yolks are well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPWdD46LVYo3FGH7XR6YRcKpQDcDWSPjhJY62Vu4fVMH2/1776650800476.jpg)

- Add water to the beaten eggs

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkUd5ohVcQjDv21WrhzUR8K6B3mXdJXSGWRRdD2LtjXa/1776650841920.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFeBt2NsWutzKzLA4EdauBLQkYzWEsBqQe8Rd4gYWmEf/1776651818393.jpg)

- Heat oil in a pan, once hot, reduce the heat and pour a small amount of the egg mixture into the oil

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZUvpKV8wiUNxtQzpXMHUJWupv38DftAr7Pu5qPtCr8n8/1776651818532.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSC5pxBZv8FeXEFD7CRFCmBpqS43Ta29Hx9DpYD4ecXis/1776651818623.jpg)

- Quickly take a skewer with mozzarella and roll it in the egg mixture in the oil

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6JicJr6TYrw9hMeWaqKokw1gzaUnhPSmmAxQEibJG1B/1776651818755.jpg)

- Roll the egg around the skewer and press it against the edge of the pan so the egg sticks and doesn’t unravel

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6JicJr6TYrw9hMeWaqKokw1gzaUnhPSmmAxQEibJG1B/1776652086872.jpg)

- Drain

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2dYtaNkBJCNAy89VsNh5My6mSKVgCGehz2A3XMRhm4b/1776652127558.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSZUnyJDy6VybMfiyULcFh2C1FgFU5zznCD2t9cXcrGpF/1776652127727.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNWEMaSJxoRGhVhuMnrwPAn3QgJusjPbFozfKzPMSHwJ6/1776652127901.jpg)

- Repeat the process until all the beaten eggs are used up

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY9ko8bzeNXyXiEx9MJ3voxGQqUWnSuH5v84YBp583mKc/1776652146730.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCAquoAbGYo9R6B43Rfnv6nFW8tnYVUSHXzkCGSzmqeV/1776652146917.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbetSwn9tjnDerw9qg1PkJmtAHJbCRdGViBcdS9PCiEPx/1776652180166.jpg)

- Serve on a plate with tomato sauce or your favorite sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdRwHWyW8QuTMEpRGfJkwnuAnyAMY9CksZWeFp6WH9aXp/1776652180550.jpg)

- The Cheese omelette roll skewers  are ready to eat

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUfydzye8jsK9VbVHaxGeK88WfXbWAFjv9f1HoUgVrCd/1776652218941.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekZaNAMCUq4bydjqeeeJSXTa7MG7TVnzczsZ992zWyr9/1776652240129.jpg)

- Serve while warm so the cheese is still stretchy when eaten

title.title: 放纵的周末
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![LlH4vSzjUBT7KoKK_IMG_9129.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/LlH4vSzjUBT7KoKK_IMG_9129/LlH4vSzjUBT7KoKK_IMG_9129.webp)
![M9GgsAwgMwmeYl6D_IMG_9132.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/M9GgsAwgMwmeYl6D_IMG_9132/M9GgsAwgMwmeYl6D_IMG_9132.webp)
![WjE2tRA0DDRTBk0C_IMG_9133.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/WjE2tRA0DDRTBk0C_IMG_9133/WjE2tRA0DDRTBk0C_IMG_9133.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>



这个周末，过得无比放纵，天气也格外晴好，，仿佛一夜之间就迈入了夏天，周日这天我直接穿上了夏天的连衣裙，这个周末的生活就跟夏天一样火辣起来。

周六中午，我们照常去婆婆家吃午饭，我提前猜到她一定又买了小龙虾加工，上次五斤不够吃，这次她又买了七斤新鲜的小龙虾，虾肉也比上次更饱满，一家人围坐在一起大快朵颐，我感觉自己一周锻炼的功德又吃没了。

晚上结束晚自习回家，老公又早已把烧烤食材全部备好，就等我回来一起吃烧烤，还给我倒好了我上次没喝完的大瓶梅见，我天，这是什么节奏，又要high一晚。

我们让两个娃在一旁自己玩耍，自己围着烤炉，一边慢悠悠烤着食材，一边浅酌聊天。这次的烧烤食材调味恰到好处，口感比上次好了太多，不知不觉间，我们越聊越投机，直到夜深，才让老二跟着哥哥先上床睡觉，等我们终于准备休息时，居然已到了凌晨两点！去看两个娃紧紧抱在一起睡得香甜，哈哈，太幸福啦！

即使熬了夜，周日一早我还是坚持去了瑜伽馆，参加核心床臀腿力量训练。因为熬夜的缘故，这场训练成了我有史以来最吃力的一次，每一个动作都做得艰难，全程累到极致，好不容易咬牙坚持完一小时的课程，回到家忙活片刻后，我终于踏踏实实睡了一个懒觉。

睡醒之后，又跟着老公前往他朋友的露营地，和朋友们一起打掼蛋，吃晚餐，又免不了喝了一顿酒，就这样在周末连续两天都喝了酒，幸好有娃在身边，想着第二天还要上学，大家都有所收敛，十点半便尽兴散场，没有肆意畅饮。

这真是一个彻底放纵的周末，随心所欲的吃吃喝喝，和朋友玩耍。这些简单的快乐汇聚在一起，太治愈了！

---

title.title: [카일의 수다#860]넷플릭스 영화 20세기 소녀
title.body:
![IMG_8342.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaHpAP8e84VD3oNrLDvTmXHRXKRako82nAPNWUhMgRed5/IMG_8342.webp)


딱 우리의 시절을 떠올리게 만든 영화였다.  
레트로 감성을 담은 작품들은 많지만, 이 영화는 유독 더 가까이 와닿았다. 비디오 가게, 삐삐, 수학여행 같은 디테일들이 단순한 장치가 아니라 그 시절의 공기와 감정을 그대로 불러오는 느낌이였다.

영화는 1999년을 배경으로, 친구를 대신해 시작된 작은 관심이 예상치 못한 감정으로 번져가는 과정을 그린다. 단순한 첫사랑 이야기에 머무르지 않고, 그 시절 가장 소중했던 ‘우정’과 ‘순수함’을 함께 담아낸다. 그래서 더 현실적이고, 그래서 더 아련하다.

요즘 작품들처럼 자극적으로 몰아가지 않고, 그 시절 우리가 느꼈던 서툴고 조심스러운 감정을 천천히 쌓아간다. 덕분에 어느 순간, 화면 속 이야기가 아니라 내 기억처럼 느껴지기도 한다.

변우석 배우 때문에 보기 시작했지만, 결과적으로는 청춘 배우들의 풋풋한 에너지 자체가 이 영화를 완성시켰다고 느꼈다. 어색하지만 진심 어린 눈빛, 서툴지만 솔직한 표현들이 오히려 더 설레게 만든다.

첫 사랑은 이루어지지 않는다는 법칙을 따른 것일까…
후반부에 갑자기 연락이 끊긴 남주, 다소 갑작스럽게 느껴질 수도 있지만, 그 또한 ‘첫사랑의 기억’이라는 점에서 보면 납득 가능한 선택처럼 보이기도 한다.

결국 이 영화는 거창한 이야기가 아니라, 누구나 한 번쯤 지나온 순간을 꺼내 보여준다.  
그래서 보고 나면 누군가는 울고, 누군가는 웃고, 또 누군가는 한동안 아무 말도 못 하게 되는 그런 영화다.

생각보다는 시시했지만, 아쉽지 않은, 과하지 않은 즐거운 영화였다.

title.title: 儲值在店家的風險
title.body: >Unsplash 昨天跟別人聊天聊到，有人在店裡儲值，結果老闆惡性倒閉，並沒有退還儲值的事，想到生活中也看過許多案例，像是健身房、理髮，以前還有影片、漫畫租借店，我家以前在影片租借店也放了一筆錢就不見了。 通常這些店預先儲值，都會有一定優惠，不然客人也不會心甘情願先把錢掏出來，如果不是較具規模的店家，大多也都是求助無門，或著是時間成本太高，也就會懶得計較。 不過我在網路上曾經看過別人分享，這些店家的經營者，會這樣惡性倒閉，部分是源自理財觀念的錯誤，更多會出現在健身房經營者上，當然這只是網路上別人的看法，是不是實情就沒得求證。 一些經營者會把這些預收款項，認為是自己的當下收入，而沒有平均分攤到之後的服務成本，像是房租、水電等，自己反而去進行一些分期付款的消費，又或著直接進行大額消費。 所以當潛在客戶都已經預付款向後，現金流就斷源了，也沒有將之前預收的款項做服務期間的分配，所以到了後期就沒有資金來支付服務成本，又或著是被之前的分期付款消費追上來，導致資金周轉不靈，只能選擇跑路。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/pjfn6)
