![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRPukPLKLnUg6FStmuNUbdS7bKHd5pSi9QCakaT5fX98a/1776602571282.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSuJq4VJ8pyTkwUKnoh46L8kezWT4CVMgUDBtWz9y5Sj9/1776602255926.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQsdbKnRZM4AswbjfSi5JvNTDPTw9XSGRErk3Rbt1CeR4/1776605671120.jpg)




**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**GLADUIS CASE: GROWING MY GLADIATORS**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVj4BWZKBABrh7RGuVymRJrStW8asnMRXgNV4R3Kcz5T/1776609696534.jpg)

With my recent encounter in the just concluded brawl fights.My interest in upcoming brawl has taken a new turn. So I decided to use my merit to purchase 2 sets of gladuis case.And after going through the guild store to do the purchasing,I finally opened them,this is what I got:


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJoTFtWfDegLgA7YKLr1CXxcP9QZpnVrzNqaY94V5apr/1776609649534.jpg)

**FIRST PACK** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzEyyNTn2ypqKcyDyhjxfRV61LfUVG9RzdJUtM3BxyEv/1776609649587.jpg)
**SECOND PACK**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbz6QwwUPGEDbicHaCbHeru2sTrnRZJu3gqAnciQpkojJ/1776609649628.jpg)

I got one epic gladiator in the first pack,the rest common, while there was two rare and an epic in the second pack. Coincidentally,the two epic card from each pack are the same card, I just merged them to boost it abilities and that is  **MIRASOL CONTUMA** with great stats.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTrq7tALhQ1PMo7f4zxzbx3XmJ5t4e6NY8qa4mJjnvi4R/1776631691082.jpg)



What this simply means,I have to treasure my GLINTS collection as well. Because I can also use my GLINTS to buy merits and in turn purchase gladius case(s).So this is the  total number of gladiators I owned at the moment,17  in total out of the 32 gladuis edition cards.I still need 15 other gladiators to complete the full set.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaji4dkN5HSYiGmNBFipUPM37gPSTCzWXKrEZup5rPATS/1776631847055.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNndnzx4RLnV2Mg9PHrHLEtyxGijemc32CUpH2eykjDNM/1776631847120.jpg)


Like I said earlier,there are 32 Gladius Edition cards (from Gladius Cases) and  are Soulbound (can't be sold/rented) and designed as powerful \

for Brawls. They can also be used in normal Ranked battles in limited numbers, you are allowed to use one in ruleset like **are you not entertained**!
Their standout feature(ability) is Bloodlust:

* Every time a Gladiator defeats an opponent (including via passive effects like Thorns, Blast, Poison, Return Fire, etc.), it gains +1 to all initially non-zero stats (Attack, Health, Armor, Speed, etc.).
* This stacks during the battle, making them snowball insanely strong if they survive and keep getting kills.
* It can be dispelled, so watch for enemy magic or specific counters.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

Here’s the rarity breakdown for the 32 Gladius Gladiator cards in Splinterlands (all Soulbound with Bloodlust):
**Summary of Rarities**
* Common: 10 cards
* Rare: 10 cards
* Epic: 5 cards
* Legendary: 7 cards
* Total: 32 cards


In the Epic cards:This is where you would find QUORA TOWERSHEAD,there are just Five in numbers I have one already **Marisol Contuma**. **Quora** is one of the most popular among the epic cards praised for her tanky/healing and snowball potential,in short she is one of the strongest.


**Quora Towershead**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUwxcnZHWFUhe2UoTk1PmdBDf8rumAhaDRKECqd3Vy3Z/1776632133175.jpg)

Earth Epic monster. She's one of the most popular and highly regarded Gladiators in the set.
She has a strong combo of melee + magic damage, Heal ability, and of course Bloodlust. Many players call her one of the best or most useful Gladius cards, especially in higher-mana Brawls where she can tank, heal, and snowball hard with Bloodlust kills.I know i would get her in one of collections someday.








For the Rare cards,they are 10 in numbers; my **Captain Katie** fall in this category and I have in my collection 7.

**Captain Katie**(**Captain Katy**): Life Rare monster.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUg1Rvwm5brjBMqrHqVS2QSqZJ18hVrfieFs9ynjVnKDu/1776629242345.jpg)




She's frequently mentioned as a top-tier or must-have Gladiator, particularly strong in lower leagues (Bronze/Silver) and versatile in many rulesets. She has Magic attack with Snipe and Bloodlust, making her excellent for picking off backline targets while ramping up.

Going forward, I will continue to buy Gladius cases, and see if I can get a legendary or even an epic card. Also, know that these cards can be found not just in regular foils but in gold foils as well.


For the common gladiators,out of 10,I have 9 already and I don't have any Legendary gladiator at the moment.There are 7 in total.Let me show you 2 among the 7.Both are legendary gladiators, hoping to get them someday.

**Xulax Nightwind**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXBFfXEw4e7yHiQSRVPVZGYCQVjQyWGmQ4kQLKZMAR5T/1776632929651.jpg)



**Tatiana Blayde**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqcyxEvARndNB9G4Zw1emjVR7ZM7uvXgc9DnhZ92Y7ei/1776632475307.jpg)

**As time goes on, I would be breaking down each of my  gladiator's upgrade path**.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**GLINTS**
This is four days into the new season and this is the end of season glint I have accumulated so far.I hope to hit a target 🎯 of **75,000 GLINT** by the end of the season.![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdKJJjDDqFtme8Z3vBHEuTbMvEcnnApwT1en7f2RrGRE/1776633162977.jpg)

At this point, I want to thank everyone, especially this community, for their constant support. I’m also deeply grateful to my Guild for all the mentorship and inspiration. As a newcomer, I truly appreciate it.


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s a link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)


Thank you for reading my post. Yours truly, @zusi78 signing off.

title.title: Teenaged Adult Men Should Fear American Statutory-Rape Laws
title.body: ![U_fg0tkeqgiy is the creator of this image/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/01/23/14/25/ride-8527715_1280.png) As I was browsing on YouTube while I was eating dinner, I stumbled across a video that showed police arresting an 18-year-old young man after they caught him having sexual intercourse with a 14-year-old girl. I know. Right? Ten years ago they were both watching Bugs Bunny cartoons, and the cops treated the young man as though he were a serial child rapist. Below is the video of this same incident. Police Waste Their Time Closing In On A Young Man For Teenage Sex While Other More Serious Crimes Are Going On https://youtu.be/VO7Gsq-thCk?si=IfxDDpA5uU6b_Ud8 Part of me questions whether this police interview was scripted, because in the thumbnail to the video, they show both the 18-year-old male suspect and a girl who is supposed to be 14 years old. Normally the underage girl's face is either blacked out or blurred out in videos like these. Then again, let's assume that it is all real. I could argue that I don't understand why all these self-righteous do-gooders and self-proclaimed child advocates will put Corey Feldman high up on a pedestal for his so-called crusade against \

when fact has it that he was intimately involved with Drew Barrymore back when she was 14 years old and he was 18 years old. Somehow every other 18-year-old man gets treated like a lascivious sex criminal for a small age-gap relationship like that, but Mr. Feldman gets a free pass. I could point out that if this young man had been caught with a 14-year-old girl over in Canada, the police wouldn't have been able to do anything because of the Romeo-and-Juliet provisions there. In Canada, the boy has to be at least five years older than the 14-year-old girl before the authorities can intervene in a case of consensual sex. I could take my response to this story in a thousand different directions, and I could even direct you to online publications that explain how ludicrous American statutory-rape laws are. Please don't read the comments section to the above video if you can't stomach it. All the self-proclaimed child advocates, self-appointed psychiatrists, wood-chipper enthusiasts, and the likes are having a love fest in it. You see? The men-hating femi-Nazis in the comments section to the above video all agree that a 14-year-old girl cannot consent to sexual intercourse, not even to an 18-year-old man. They proudly call this young man a creep and all sorts of other hateful names. Of course, if their own 15-year-old son were to get a 13-year-old girl pregnant, all that rhetoric about post-pubertal childhood innocence would go flying straight out the window, and they'd be slut-shaming the girl left and right. Instead of diving into all the specifics as for why this same 18-year-old man should not be treated like a criminal and that he, if anyone, would deserve to be acquitted on jury nullification if this matter were to proceed to trial, I'm going to direct all of you to some good, sound advice. Norman Michael Achin gives that advice in his video below, and I'm sure he knows that a number of 18-year-old men watch his videos for such advice. Norman Michael Achin Warns His Viewers Not To Trust The Police https://youtube.com/shorts/8cPvJPpR4GE?si=hw9m7F4FahhzWakA The 18-year-old suspect in the preceding video above could have saved himself a lifetime of regret if he had simply lawyered up once the police began asking him questions. Perhaps he would have had to spend the night in jail, but he probably would have been released on bail the next day; and his criminal defense lawyer would have found a way to get his criminal case thrown out on a technicality. The sad reality is that this young man's life is over as he knows it, and he doesn't look like a bad person. I wouldn't even doubt that this 14-year-old girl he made love to was his first time ever having sexual intercourse with anyone. Of course, the cops aren't going to care, and the court system is not going to look out for his best interests or his rights. When a young man is only 18 years old, he doesn't always know what the best thing is to do in a situation of this nature. In fact, usually he doesn't know how to handle the police at all. Therefore, I'm not going to bash him for making the wrong decisions after the police moved in on him. I did find a few reasonable posts in the comments section to the preceding video above. A YouTuber who goes by the user name of @Emjay2683 posted: > if it was the day before his 18th birthday it would have been legal, so what makes the 18th birthday some special event that makes a person a predator all of a sudden? There are adults who have 20+ year age gaps between them. It’s crazy to suggest that the brain of an 18 year old is vastly different than a 14 year old when science says otherwise. Plus, many states have Romeo and Juliet laws which wouldn’t even make this illegal. He’s not being a predator. He’s being a horny teenager. My exact thoughts, YouTuber @Emjay2683. These cops were looking for every way to demonize this young man in court, and they were using their usual dirty cop tactics to pump him for as much incriminating information as they could get out of him. Ladies and gentlemen? Our tax money pays these police officers' salary. We have the right to object to their activities if we feel that they are not serving the public interest. We can do so by either writing to our elected officials to get the laws changed pertaining to teenage sex. We can be sure to vote not guilty on a jury if we feel that a defendant is not getting a fair shake in a frivolous and malicious statutory-rape trial. There is a whole host of actions that we can take to put a stop to these witch hunts that police officers are pursuing by virtue of ludicrous sex laws that are really only meant to feed the prison-industrial complex rather than make our streets safer than they are. Doing nothing about it will achieve nothing. If the 18-year-old man in the preceding video above were to go to criminal court for his involvement with the 14-year-old girl and he chose a jury trial, there would likely be a load of screaming in the jury room over what his fate should be from that point on. Let's hope that he doesn't choose a bench trial, because judges get brownie points for handing down convictions for these kinds of offenses as though they've gone out of style. Those same brownie points lead to pay raises. Nevertheless, if you're a man 18 years of age and you find yourself in a similar situation with a teenage girl who is below the statutory age of consent, don't volunteer any information to the police. Even before they read you your Miranda rights, you have the right to remain silent. The Fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution guarantees you that right. **This article is copyright-protected.**

title.body: >Hola bonita comunidad me alegra volver a encontrarnos nuevamente en un blog más de costura creativa,hoy seguiremos si aún recuerdan con el TOP #6 De 10 costuras hechas con retazos,estaremos haciendo en tres y simples pasos un moño o lazo coqueto tanto como para adultos y para niñas,espero les guste mucho y como pueden reciclar de una buena manera los retazos de tela que tu tengas guardados en casa♻️. # > _Hello beautiful community! I'm happy to be back with you again in another creative sewing blog post. Today, if you remember, we'll continue with TOP 6 of 10 sewing projects made with scraps. We'll be making a cute bow in three simple steps, perfect for both adults and children. I hope you enjoy it and see how you can recycle those fabric scraps you have stored at home in a great way ♻️._ #

>Así que si amas estos tutoriales te gustará mucho apreciar el resultado de este bello accesorio que no puede faltar en nuestra cabellera hermosa para ocasiones especiales , reuniones , eventos y más,vamos a proceder con los materiales a usar💆🏻‍♀️. # > _So if you love these tutorials, you'll really enjoy seeing the result of this beautiful accessory that's a must-have for our gorgeous hair for special occasions, meetings, events, and more. Let's get started with the materials we'll need 💆🏻‍♀️._ ---
![IMG_20260414_151839_279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/Eos3EpLSMNaSM4iEi5EMh5wLpKYp3KNoM6mLVZTHLmFN68miF73VdERKawfNr7LhuEu.jpg)
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Materiales: | Materials:
_ # * **_Retazos de tela unicolores/estampados_** * **_Tijera_** * **_Pinza o ranita de cabello de metal_** * **_Hilo y aguja_** * **_Silicón_** * **_Cinta métrica_** # > * **_Scraps of solid-color/printed fabric_** > * **_Scissors_** > * **_Metal hair clip or barrette_** > * **_Needle and thread_** > * **_Silicone glue_** > * **_Measuring tape_**
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Pasos a seguir: | Steps to follow:
_ #
![IMG_20260414_152039_559.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKgA4FotrjP2RNQSUfkGPVK9cG3vZE34F2t834D3Zj68/IMG_20260414_152039_559.jpg)
![IMG_20260414_152228_100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EokfTas5htQuc41wSXkREmTeguc9o82c8PYwmHWTtb7N3BPZb66A25uJ6vgZ9QrP6xo.jpg)
![IMG_20260414_152246_505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbU4aBRKp6UwGnwTPfLDkP3HamPy4rZNf83AAw6fKczkA/IMG_20260414_152246_505.jpg)
### _Paso 01_

>Empecé cortando las piezas en este caso un cuadrado de 11.5 cm de largo x 12 cm de ancho, corté la base del lazo abajo de 14 cm de ancho x 7.3 cm de largo,para la unión del lazo corté un rectángulo de 7 cm de ancho x 9 cm de largo, éstas son las piezas base del lazo que usaremos. # > ### _Step 01_ > _I started by cutting the pieces, in this case a square 11.5 cm long x 12 cm wide, I cut the base of the bow below 14 cm wide x 7.3 cm long, for the joining of the bow I cut a rectangle 7 cm wide x 9 cm long, these are the base pieces of the bow that we will use._ ---
![IMG_20260414_152800_627.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQoXYMTk9uap1xfsF5dNdSXXEt59PMCDppBsu8bu5hVM5/IMG_20260414_152800_627.jpg)
![IMG_20260414_153829_872.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2vHKo7SGPd9WtMXhyW3oTyAuSmeZCPYauu4hhWDXd8d/IMG_20260414_153829_872.jpg)
### _Paso 02_

>Como segundo paso vamos entonces a coser los contornos de cada pieza volteando la tela y cosemos dejamos 1 cm de costura de los excedentes y cosemos el rectángulo base y el de la unión,recuerden que vamos a ir dejando por cada pieza una abertura de 2.5 cm de ancho para poder voltear nuestros lazos,coserlo a mano requiera mucha paciencia así que este paso fué algo retardado. # > ### _Step 02_ > _As a second step, we will then sew the outlines of each piece by turning the fabric over and sewing, leaving 1 cm of seam allowance for the excess fabric, and sew the base rectangle and the joining rectangle. Remember that we will be leaving a 2.5 cm wide opening for each piece to be able to turn our bows over. Sewing it by hand requires a lot of patience, so this step was somewhat delayed._ ---
![IMG_20260414_154616_230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/Eokg1o5an6mn2wTCcXBEmAUxZB8exWLkHn1EyVyK5muLjoy3Bh2YeR9Yfbe1aKEYZtp.jpg)
![IMG_20260414_155703_211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/EonnQUdFda7hFW47fhTCxXFbKe7fQXBRm56Q4iuHSew8pE3UzymgMmGVQs2st2FeKuA.jpg)
### _Paso 03_

>Después de coser las piezas procedo entonces a volverlas y por la abertura por dónde hemos volteado las piezas vamos a estar cosiendo con costura invisible el agujero y planchamos cada pieza,tomaremos el cuadro del lazo y vamos a marcar la mitad de este y frunciremos en el medio,hacemos lo mismo con la pieza base y empezamos a colocar o unirlas,daremos tres vueltas con el hilo para reforzar costura,vamos a pegar el gancho por la parte de atrás y como último paso hago la unión del lazo con la pieza del rectangulo ya volteada y coseremos con puntada invisible una vez colocamos nuestro gancho así nos queda el lazo armado con au pinza que la ubicamos en la parte de atrás . # > ### _Step 03_ > _After sewing the pieces together, I turn them right side out. Through the opening where we turned them right side out, we close the hole with an invisible stitch. Then we iron each piece. We take the square of the bow and mark its midpoint, gathering it in the center. We do the same with the base piece and begin to join them. We wrap the thread three times to reinforce the seam. We glue the hook to the back and, as a final step, we attach the bow to the folded rectangular piece with an invisible stitch. Once we have attached the hook, we have the finished bow with its clip, which we have attached to the back._ ---
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)

The fabric I used is called velvet, and it gives a much more elegant touch to the accessory and our bow, as it adds elegance and originality. title.title: ACEH TAMIANG NIGHT RECREATION // The excitement under the colorful lights at the Aceh Tamiang night market
title.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGdMpbWcD2knhhH4SSBzFHK3NG7MFFR7ytpbc3yhcEJy/1776617064506.jpg) In this post, I will share my experience when visiting a night recreation area in Aceh Tamiang, namely the night market located in Terban village, Karang Baru Subdistrict,Aceh Tamiang Regency.If we remember the history of 4 months ago, Aceh Tamiang was the area that experienced the worst flood impact in Aceh, but now this Regency is starting to recover and start to rise again.Of course with the presence of this night market ride can add color to life and a place for local people to seek pleasure, especially since the night market offers a wide variety of attractions for everyone,from adults to young children. As the name suggests, this place will always be crowded with visitors at night, and we can find the lively atmosphere starting from the parking area. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQs2iuo7w9VRN3wDjpzbc2mhRSXb2se3VLBunm3nv32DU/1776617064567.jpg) The good news is that this night market ride also has a very large parking area so that it can accommodate many vehicles, and if I'm not mistaken the parking fee is only IDR 3,000 in Indonesian currency or the equivalent of 2.8 Hive prices now, of course this is a very cheap price. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTiMZHLC6mzPXY54DtmZhJtG1LLNa7DSdJwUSwMTGubmY/1776617064615.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUTPYQnsoCc5bWmYXLMPTzLRQoCoxaa93BnyfH5qxTNnV/1776618789684.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiTbVfKVVbexH7b3RBoKX7w5yjVHvSwwwvirGARKZv5q/1776618789727.jpg) There are lots of visitors who come to this night market ride, and in the main area there are lots of exciting rides for small children, some of which are rides for fishing for toy fish and painting.Of course, this place is like heaven for small children, they can play as much as they want here and try various exciting rides. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8PAqrmMKYmA3rS1X8kYHLdw9EASgYZP2aD6HNdbx9EW/1776617064644.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPiBybjXVoXA6m3EHWKoq1rXuTfpZGhF4aA19RQ36mMuo/1776618789771.jpg) The balloon palace is one of the most popular rides for small children because in this ride they can play on the slide to their heart's content, this is a balloon that has been filled with air, so this ride is very safe for small children. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSKGt1maCN5YHDUuDwRqKKxLqxVcuo5DzfLtfXQgfezUs/1776619520743.jpg) At the night market we can also find many traders selling various culinary delights and also shopping stalls at affordable prices,so the night market is perfect for visitors of all ages. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAVwUwyfKiD2JKWho48978v48GPwGV6EhzJmjN5WQGzF/1776619846193.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRf49LDVWydK4rviVKycmKu4otxzZ1dbGtP38LSDCV4nH/1776619846225.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaaa2bLekT4bTbMxHU88VKVExQb8i9RmQ26f659f1Ds5h/1776619846264.jpg) The night market held in Aceh Tamiang isn’t very large, but it offers a fairly comprehensive range of amenities,here we can find several large rides such as the Ferris wheel, swing boat, merry-go-round or more often called odong-odong,from the many rides at this night market, we can conclude that everything offered by this place is indeed dominant for children and families. What's even more interesting is that almost all of the rides here are decorated with colorful LED lights, and in my opinion, these lights are the main attraction, because they can attract the attention of visitors from a distance, and give a lively and festive impression at night, and this looks very dramatic. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSrnJjBMG3EDQUbbB1WdQcbbgkDWwkf8jZTQG6ScQGHbe/1776620385076.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme5DjHouxpWnDRY1Krha71M7mRcz3HieArQvPLLJ5khq2/1776620385104.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXCJevffcEVKJ9M69M3K2UG7JKJcc7M6eLPH1rTaKPvS1/1776620385141.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXz1FytHj1v262rbgh5GK7BRxqFXYVK3aW1Mj5GaH5wCM/1776620385178.jpg) There’s no harm in trying out all the rides here since the prices are very affordable,so it can be concluded that this place is very suitable to visit with family. Actually, there are a lot of exciting rides that I really want to try, such as the swing boat ride, but it's a shame that I visited this place alone so it felt like something was missing. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

title.title: MONARCH: String Theory - S02E07 - RECAP
title.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/kMsz3RGx/MOARCH-S02E07-RECAP-000.gif

[Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

https://i.imgur.com/PGNq5Ek.png

Men its almost unfair about casting a real life father and son as two versions of the same character and then writing an episode where they have to talk to each other across four decades without ever being in the same room, because that is exactly what String Theory pulls off and it works awesome while at the same time the name of the episode is phenomenal to everything that goes one, even when the episode surrounding that central idea is doing everything it possibly can to bury its own best moment under a pile of scattered subplots and geography changes specially consider how this people move around the world like its nothing, when did they took an airplane? was the ship that fast? didnt they burn the engines on episode 1, Im like how does this people move from Tokyo to Australia in a blink of an eye. Episode 7 of Monarch Season 2 really shows that the writers know Kurt and Wyatt Russell are the strongest part of the series, but weirdly, they keep splitting the episode between them and other story lines that are just not strong enough to hold your attention. The Operation Hourglass signal bounces off a Titan and accidentally locks onto a frequency from 1962, which means older Lee Shaw is suddenly posing as Mission Control for his own younger self, walking him through a component retrieval from the entry vehicle so they can build a tracker for Titan X, and all of this happens over a radio connection with no face to face contact ever. That should not work as well as it does, its just how they move around from one continent to another that fast without much explanation or reason of time but what ever I guess, but the truth is that the chemistry between those two men does not require eye contact to make your brain think its possible.

- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt17220216/
- Platform: [APPLETV](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

https://bo.skiptvads.blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-10-1776290724-overlay.png
<div style=\

> https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSdPW7.png [Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew) The Shaw radio exchange is hands down some of the best human material this show has produced across both seasons as a continuation of Hiroshi funeral, and I do not say that to be dramatic, I say it because the specific emotional weight of those scenes is built on something the show cannot manufacture through good writing alone, it requires the actors to carry a believable shared history inside a character who is separated from himself by sixty years of living, its Lee younger version feeling desperate because he feels at some point he is been play out by been tired and hungry, that was a very very dangerous moment because I though he was just going to hang up thinking it was just the voices on his head, specially when he finds Keiko. There is a moment where older Lee has to quietly push his younger self away from interfering with Keiko, and the restraint in how Kurt Russell plays that is the peak of any monologue they could have written, because he is playing a man who knows exactly what happens if young Lee makes the wrong move and cannot say a word about it. It reminded me of that moment in Day of the Doctor where Matt Smith has to look at his past self and recognize himself inside a situation he has already survived, the kind of scene where memory and present time fold into each other and you feel the weight of both at once, and the moment where older Lee reassures younger Lee that he is going to make it home carries so much confidence that probably your mind will think \

. On the other side of the episode, Cate and Keiko trace a local island legend about a woman supposedly possessed and it leads them down an old well chasing the signal from Titan X, the more interesting thing happening there is Keiko starting to believe that Cate might actually be the bridge to sending Titan X back to Axis Mundi rather than letting Shaw destroy it, and that puts the two women and Shaw on the same course to clash but we know all Lee will do is try to front run them, never to hurt them to take them out of his way.

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSdRx6.png
[Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSdTkT.png
[Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

Not everything is pretty rainbows with this series, something I have been saying episode after episode, my frustration starts stacking up with Episode 7, because everything outside the Shaw exchange and the island thread feels like the show servicing its own obligations instead of earning its screen time. Kentaro is in Thailand with Isabel Simmons and while Amber Midthunder brings a real charged energy to that character, Isabel shows up with a lavish house her father Walter Simmons built, a speech about living in a world where G Day never happened, and absolutely zero foundation underneath any of it to make you care whether Kentaro buys in or walks away, its like they giving her too much power and presence too fast without been earn. There was not much context about who Walter Simmons is and what Apex represents from Godzilla vs. Kong, and Kentaro is suppose to know that? it felt like Isabel came out of nowhere and was suppose to be very important, so watching him get swept up by someone who claims to hate everything her father stood for while using every single thing he built to make her pitch is a scene that plays cheap because the gap between what we know and what he knows is too wide to bridge in a single Thailand trip, come on. Then there is May, who gets picked up under her government name Corah Mateo by Monarch agents after a tense goodbye and ends up back at Outpost 18 in the South Pacific working with Tim on a neural implant fragment pulled from Titan X, and the reveal that the implant is the thing that knocked Titan X off its natural migration path is actually a solid piece of information that deserved thirty more seconds of screen time to breathe, if they only give this idea a bit more room to expand what it really is, this is why everything about it felt rushed, and that is becoming almost an intentional slip to give their back to interesting plots and ideas , turning more into a bad habit.

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSd9rM.png
[Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

https://t6.picb.cc/2026/04/20/uSdLSt.png
[Source](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/monarch-legacy-of-monsters/umc.cmc.62l8x0ixrhyq3yaqa5y8yo7ew)

The tech side of this series just keeps hinting at bigger MonsterVerse stuff without really going all in. The idea of a neural interface built from something connected to Titan X could have huge implications for Apex and the future of the franchise, and that is actually really interesting, but instead of fully exploring it, the show just keeps teasing it and never fully commits, this is not something around the monsters but with everything else like they have this massive ship that looks like a fortress but they just use it like a high tech cruise to chase titans and the ship itself cant even be fast enough to keep up. Episode 7 does not reveal much, but it gives just enough to keep those bigger timeline questions interesting until we all get tired of them teasing, even if the rest of the episode is a little weak. Shaw wanting to face Titan X alone and refusing to let Suzuki come with him because he thinks Suzuki would die can be read in two ways. It could be a real self sacrificing moment or it could be something more manipulative, depending on how you feel about Shaw by this point because the guy has that two side of the coin character, he can be an antagonist and sometimes the hero. Season 1 made Shaw seem like an underdog fighting against a broken system while Season 2 has been slowly making us question whether he is really that different from the kinds of institutions he is against. That is an interesting idea but the show keeps bringing it up without fully doing enough with it.
https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png
<div align=\

> https://i.imgur.com/r0yj9oi.png Im going to be straight up and I do feel disappointed not mayorly disappointed but at this point in time I feel they should already give us way more, starting with some real Titan fights episodes, some real chaos. The episode wasnt bad bad but String Theory kept almost being great and then sidestepping its own best moments every single time something else needed a check in. The two Shaw performances are the real thing and is what kept this episode up float, but they the episode puts a shadow over this moments with Kentaro packing a bag to go to Thailand for who knows what or May getting escorted back to outpust 18, they just not only interrupt the meat of the episode but totally takes you away from the immersive moment, almost disrespectful to what Kurt and Wyatt Russell are doing with the most interesting science fiction concept this season has tried. Three episodes left and Titan X has still not done anything properly terrifying on screen, and that is starting to feel like a debt this season is going to have trouble paying back no matter how good the ending is. I am giving String Theory a 7 out of 10, the radio scenes alone justify that number but the rest of the episode is the show coasting on goodwill and betting the next episodes can deliver what the setup keeps promising because at this point I need something to actually get destroyed, not hinted at from inside a conference room or through a hole in the ground. https://i.imgur.com/uwwnjtd.png https://i.imgur.com/AbuDA6i.png

title.title: Catharsis: “a necessary space within the soul” (eng-esp)
title.body:
<center>![1000024038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uQiGZHuDdeN8QwxGron6enQjiB6kiuUNjVKdz9htK1F1VUnd2ouybEQpfksm5o5FCRD.jpg)</center>


We often find ourselves lost in our thoughts; indeed, these are the moments when my creativity is most true to myself, as I let go of everything I am thinking and feeling. 

Certainly, I felt that way today, on this autumn afternoon, where the sun allowed itself to be felt—albeit, of course, softer and gentler—as if this powerful sun were a cuddly cat rubbing its head against my leg, just as Roberto, our little house cat, does. 

But these thoughts come and go, as if I were holding them with a firm string, just like the one we used in September when we flew colorful kites in the sky, with that tension created by the wind pulling our hand further, as if wanting to make us let go, but we refuse to do so, because in that work of paper, cane, and glue, there is also love and effort. 

<center>![1000024036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23vsLAZWTUADgiNVZ8zMCDS7szoTkANtsS41qMLNRYBWSKPgovmM8zDTSyS3e5YuQimhA.jpg)</center> 

So, those past moments could be like that paper, and we find catharsis, as if this were the invisible, indelible glue that adheres, that holds fast yet gently, because that memory, just like tissue paper, is delicate, since sometimes it makes us cry and on other rare, very rare occasions, smile. 

And there, sitting in the chair in the sun, while my cat rubs its back against my foot, I feel the memories grow light; I watch them in that infinite sky, where everything looks so small, and what hurt—or still hurts—when remembered slowly releases that weight to become an opportunity, a feather dancing in the wind. 

<center>![1000024033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wMefCfFzpdJAt9uH2yShruuey9LC941EriDrv69udbDBG6PV5iGkfUKYHbpGLaLAKhe.jpg)</center> 

“My catharsis is to wander between the past and the present, with those demons and angels we all carry, but in the midst of it all, where the old weight no longer exists, I can tell myself, holding my own hand, that at this stage of my life I walk calmly through a meadow full of reeds and daisies”.
***
### <center>Español</center>
***
<center>![1000024038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uQiGZHuDdeN8QwxGron6enQjiB6kiuUNjVKdz9htK1F1VUnd2ouybEQpfksm5o5FCRD.jpg)</center> 

Muchas veces nos hallamos en medio de divagaciones, que por cierto, son mis espacios de creación más fiel a mi misma, ya que suelto todo aquello que estoy pensando y sintiendo. 

Ciertamente, hoy me sentí así, en esta tarde de otoño, donde el sol se dejó apreciar en sentir, claro está, más suave y dócil, como si este sol poderoso, fuera un gato mimoso frotando su cabeza en mi pierna, al igual que lo hace Roberto, el gatito de casa. 

Pero estos pensamientos qué van y vienen, como si los sujetara con una cuerda firme, igual a la que usamos en septiembre cuando remontamos barriletes coloridos en el cielo, con esa tensión que aplica el viento, llevando la mano más allá, como queriendo hacer que lo solemos, pero nos rehusamos a aquello, porque en ese trabajo de papel, caña y pegamento, también hay amor y esfuerzo. 

<center>![1000024036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23vsLAZWTUADgiNVZ8zMCDS7szoTkANtsS41qMLNRYBWSKPgovmM8zDTSyS3e5YuQimhA.jpg)</center> 


Entonces, esas instancias pasadas, podrían ser como ese papel, y hacemos catarsis, como si esta fuese el pegamento invisible e indeleble que se adhiere, que sujeta con firmeza y al mismo tiempo con delicadeza, porque ese recuerdo al igual que el papel de seda, es delicado, ya que a veces nos hacen llorar y otras pocas, muy pocas, sonreir. 

Y ahí, en la silla sentada al sol, mientras me gato frota su lomo en mi pie, siento los recuerdos livianos, los observo en ese cielo infinitos, donde todo se ve tan pequeño y lo que dolía o aún duele al ser recordado, lentamente suelta ese peso para convertirse en una oportunidad que pluma que danza en el viento.

title.title: Cheese and smoked chorizo torticas (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Today I was in the mood for pizza for breakfast—a unique and delicious craving—but when I looked in my fridge for the necessary ingredients, I realized I didn’t have any tomato sauce or fresh tomatoes, just flour, yeast, cheese, and smoked chorizo. So I had to give up on my craving and improvise a new recipe on the spot using what I had on hand.
![1000110321.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wC7JZBtY9p6b4WdHosVZx24R3CJQriRhwNDhHxooRt92239Qx9YNiKQfqBDiwJiiMWy.png)
## Ingredients: - 1 smoked chorizo - 100 grams of wheat flour - 1 cup of water - Hard white cheese for grating - Butter - Oil - Salt to taste
![1000110297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX7i1ZUx1Vx2UbqtTGegLdHdpyMfHbpxfseGfjN7Kj8wGJAgwwwqopWSs5oJcLoXc87.jpg)
## Preparation: I poured the cup of water into a bowl and added the wheat flour, kneading it thoroughly until the mixture no longer stuck to my hands.
![1000110301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgW5cz6GubPikiqgdQYWu3u7mDXn7Jzw4k6mkmjBdQWUbKYJmpprKmnLpaJmGR8tVEo.jpg)
![1000110304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvkkLcoDmnwSRrgGX6AKoss5V9ShMGWpgCbZFRQz17JHbPTP2zU5AH3LFp6mrcENN9u.jpg)
Then I washed the smoked chorizo and sliced it into rounds. Next, I heated a skillet on the stove and greased the surface with oil, then placed the slices in the skillet to sauté over low heat until cooked. Five minutes on each side was enough to make the rounds crispy.
![1000110308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/242NqQ8HeQRLADeRM4rHmTqzjB5LVP9dWsheMZk6XogYUgpos5kgLZ78s791AEmA683nv.jpg)
![1000110311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wCNEr2KTt6JHAbj9mpjxkTjT9aGrh8dvvVcyiipckaKKTfHuo8foEDLreW8WzsSAEaX.jpg)
I removed the skillet and set up a griddle, lightly oiled the surface, and placed two small tortillas on it. I shaped them with my hands, which is why they look a bit rustic—I didn’t have a rolling pin handy. I cooked them for 10 minutes, then, without removing them from the griddle, I spread butter on top and grated cheese over them. I also placed the slices of smoked chorizo on top.
![1000110315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wCGSttCd8tpJYog6MHWgKUnb1Uk5XcewWCa5pXhvxNtA2p7CPtQZYrjv7swDrJepVSL.jpg)
I put a lid on it so the cheese and butter would melt. My creative breakfast was ready—so delicious that I hope to make it again soon, but this time with tomato sauce and mozzarella cheese. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy tenía ganas de comer pizza para desayunar, ese es un antojo exótico y delicioso, pero resulta que buscando en mi nevera los ingredientes necesarios, me encuentro con que no tengo la salsa de tomates, ni tomates frescos, solamente harina, levadura, queso y chorizo ahumado, así que tuve que desistir de mi antojo y sobre la marcha improvisé una nueva receta con los elementos que tenía a mano.
![1000110321.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wC7JZBtY9p6b4WdHosVZx24R3CJQriRhwNDhHxooRt92239Qx9YNiKQfqBDiwJiiMWy.png)
## Ingredientes: - 1 chorizo ahumado - 100 gramos de harina de trigo - 1 taza de agua - Queso blanco duro para rallar - Mantequilla - Aceite - Sal al gusto
![1000110297.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX7i1ZUx1Vx2UbqtTGegLdHdpyMfHbpxfseGfjN7Kj8wGJAgwwwqopWSs5oJcLoXc87.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase coloqué la taza de agua y agregué la harina de trigo, amasé muy bien hasta sentir que la mezcla no se pegaba en mis manos.
![1000110301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgW5cz6GubPikiqgdQYWu3u7mDXn7Jzw4k6mkmjBdQWUbKYJmpprKmnLpaJmGR8tVEo.jpg)
![1000110304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvkkLcoDmnwSRrgGX6AKoss5V9ShMGWpgCbZFRQz17JHbPTP2zU5AH3LFp6mrcENN9u.jpg)
Luego lavé el chorizo ahumado y lo corté en ruedas. Después monté un sartén en la cocina y le aceité la superficie, allí los coloqué a sofreír a fuego bajo para que se cocinaran. Cinco minutos de cada lado fueron suficientes para que las ruedas quedaran crujientes.
![1000110308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/242NqQ8HeQRLADeRM4rHmTqzjB5LVP9dWsheMZk6XogYUgpos5kgLZ78s791AEmA683nv.jpg)
![1000110311.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wCNEr2KTt6JHAbj9mpjxkTjT9aGrh8dvvVcyiipckaKKTfHuo8foEDLreW8WzsSAEaX.jpg)
Quité el sartén y monté un budare, aceité un poco la superficie y allí coloqué dos torticas, las formé con mis manos, por eso lucen un poco rústicas, no tenía a la mano el rodillo. Cociné durante 10 minutos, luego, sin bajar del budare, unté mantequilla y rallé queso por encima. Les coloqué también las rodajas de chorizo ahumado.
![1000110315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wCGSttCd8tpJYog6MHWgKUnb1Uk5XcewWCa5pXhvxNtA2p7CPtQZYrjv7swDrJepVSL.jpg)
Le coloqué una tapa para que el queso y la mantequilla se fundieran. Mi desayuno creativo estaba listo, tan delicioso que espero repetirlo pronto, pero agregando salsa de tomate y queso mozzarella.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

Harry is one of the common nft card of Rising Star Game and has 10 fans and 5 skill of in game items. According to Harry's NFT description, Harry and Gary form a band. In fact, I don't have Gary. So I bought Gary from the in-game market for over 600,000 Starbits. This is a very expensive price for an Epic card. Because even Seasonal animated cards can be purchased for that price. I will have to find Harry, Gary, and other members to form a band.


**Drawing Anime For 80 Harry**
First I drew the body outlines of Harry. After that, I drew the hat, dress and shoe on that body outlines. I erased the unnessary body outlines and got the entire of Harry outlines.

# Spanish

Estoy empezando una nueva serie de un juego que acabo de comprar, se llama The Knight Witch que es un Metroidvania combinado con Bullethell. La estetica del juego se ve muy bien, segun todos los graficos son dibujados a mano. La historia se trata de un grupo de brujas que tienen poderes que nadie mas tiene y que liberan a el mundo de las garras de una compañia que solo hace daño al planeta. Bueno, esa es una manera muy simplista de resumir la intro del juego...

Algo que me llamo la atención que no habia visto en ningun otro Metroidvania, es que tienen unas cartas que son como de habilidad que consumen Maná y te permiten disparar misiles autodirigidos, dejar bombas y modificar tu disparo por unos segundos a una metralleta para aumentar tu DPS. Hay más por lo que puedo ver en los menus, pero todavia no desbloqueo ninguna.

Espero les guste esta serie, ya que voy a estar subiendola a mi canal secundario de gaming @t0xicgh0st en 3Speak. 
En YouTube ya no se llama asi ahora es IngeTactico, le cambie el nombre ya que el anterior no atraia mucho que digamos y en YT no pienso subir esta serie, quiero hacerla exclusiva de Hive.

# English

I’m starting a new series on a game I just picked up called The Knight Witch, which is a Metroidvania blended with a Bullet Hell. The game’s aesthetic looks incredible—apparently, all the graphics are hand-drawn. The story follows a group of witches with unique powers who are fighting to liberate the world from the clutches of a corporation that’s destroying the planet. Well, that’s a very simplistic way of summarizing the intro, anyway...

One thing that caught my eye—which I haven’t seen in any other Metroidvania—is a skill card system. These cards consume Mana and allow you to do things like fire homing missiles, drop bombs, or swap your standard shot for a machine gun to boost your DPS for a few seconds. Based on the menus, there’s a lot more to discover, but I haven't unlocked them just yet.

I hope you guys enjoy this series! I’ll be uploading it to my secondary gaming channel, @t0xicgh0st, on 3Speak.

Note on YouTube: My YT channel is no longer under that name; it’s now IngeTactico. I changed it because the old handle wasn't exactly a crowd-manger. I don't plan on uploading this series to YouTube, as I want to keep it exclusive to Hive.

title.body:
>


Buscar que cocinar algunas veces nos invita a tener creatividad en la cocina ina, no soy experta y de hecho no es que me sea tan fácil cocinar, de hecho algunas veces me cuesta, a mi me gusta hacer más postres que salado, sin embargo en casa siempre tengo que cocinar pues me toca alimentar a mi familia, sobre todo las horas de almuerzo cuando todos vienen del trabajo, asi que aqui aplico la creatividad de la cocina.



Para poder hacer algo sencillo quise realizar ***\

*** el arroz es muy veratil y se puede combinar con muchas cosas para comer algo rico y delicioso, en casa no le colocó muchos vegetales ya que aqui no todos se lo comen así sobre todo los chicos, por lo que prefiero no agrehar tantas cosas, así se que todos comerán y no sobrará nada.

Así que les invito a ponerse manos a la obra y ver esta pequeña receta que de seguro muchos ya han realizado a su gusto, manos a la obra mis queridos creativos.


>! [ENGLISH]
>
>Figuring out what to cook sometimes encourages us to get creative in the kitchen. I’m no expert, and honestly, cooking isn’t always easy for me in fact, I sometimes struggle with it. I prefer making desserts over savory dishes, but at home I always have to cook because I’m the one feeding my family, especially at lunchtime when everyone comes home from work. So that’s when I put my culinary creativity to work.
>
>To make something simple, I decided to make ***\

***. Rice is very versatile and can be combined with many ingredients to create a tasty and delicious meal. At home, I don’t add a lot of vegetables because not everyone here eats them that way—especially the kids—so I prefer not to add too many things. That way, I know everyone will eat it and nothing will be left over.
>

title.title: Digital technology poses a major problem for students' education
title.body:
Greetings Education Community. I hope you are all doing well by the grace of Almighty God. Today I would like to talk to you about digital technology and the quality of education for students.


![pexels-katerina-holmes-5905506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23uFPYWK5RupBQ7zH6jdzBeMQxc3mpxhSZB6P4Kmn9LVt9bCbszm89XTN33jQD8xjNsQY.jpg)




[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/cute-diverse-schoolchildren-sharing-smartphone-during-break-in-classroom-5905506/)

Basically, digital technology is being used everywhere in the present world. From the moment we wake up in the morning to the moment we go to bed at night, we are using digital technology everywhere. The present world has become such that we will never be able to survive without digital technology. But can we imagine what kind of impact these modern and digital technologies or digital devices are having on our students? 

It is very sad to say that the more modern the world is, the more digital devices are coming to us. We are constantly using these digital devices and we are becoming addicted to digital devices. As a result, our normal quality of life is being disrupted. 

After the advent of digital technology, one of the most affected people is the students. Because nowadays, students have become modern and are cheating their families by talking about education. Not only are they cheating their families, they are also destroying their bright futures. Now you can ask me, how is digital technology harming the education of our children??


![pexels-rdne-8499502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23yTmaWRoRfoQDDZP3QuuebLaVEFj1jf9A1yFLLmV9uQigVNRgnfaC4q6CkK6LP3JufWB.jpg)


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/girl-taking-a-selfie-in-a-class-against-a-blue-door-8499502/)


You will understand if you notice one thing. Before the advent of digital devices, students used to sit at the study table with books in the evening. Students used to continue their study activities for five to six hours continuously. But now, students no longer express any interest in sitting at the study table with books. Although their families ask them to sit at the study table, somehow they sit at the study table and watch various videos. 

Especially when a student sits and reads with his mobile next to him, he loses his focus on his studies. That is, he does not want to study and it seems that if he presses his mobile a little, his boring feeling will get better. 

I have seen many students who sit at the study table and watch various reels of videos. Along with this, they talk to friends on video calls. When these two activities are over, then students start playing games on their smartphones. If the phone is not gaming, then students use their mobile or digital devices to watch various pictures, cartoons or movies. Sitting at the study table, they put books on one side and use smart devices on the other side. And in this way, students are ruining their bright and beautiful future.

![pexels-kaku-nguyen-1144098-2181420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23wgW59ezRnNN24LiEoLuLmmgYA6j2eFi2EH1TX5TSFpi2RghThp4yCbSYKiPpKvicJWU.jpg)

[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/selective-focus-photography-of-toddler-holding-smartphone-2181420/)

In the modern world, we all want to use digital devices and digital technology. But of course, we need to know the correct rules for using digital technology. If we break the rules of anything, there is a possibility of harm instead of benefit. 

Digital technology surrounds our entire world. And that is why we are constantly using digital technology. However, this digital technology can have a very bad effect on students. If students cannot use these devices sufficiently and in good quality. 

Students should be aware of this issue by not using devices at the study table. I think that students must do well in their studies. We all expect them to do well in their studies and build a bright future. At the end of the day, we have given digital devices to them. As a result, students are quite inattentive in their studies. 

Moreover, in the afternoon, when students go to the field to play, they take smart devices with them. They give up physical games and they continue online gaming projects. This is very harmful for the brain development of students. 

So let's think about digital technology and students' education.  Because this digital technology can cause great harm to students' education. We should immediately investigate the cause and keep this issue in our mind so that students are not harmed. 

I think it is wise to keep students away from all digital devices. What is your opinion??

title.title: Little Moments at the Mall: A Sweet and Simple Gift Hunt!🎁
title.body:
A Beautiful and Pleasant day to each and everyone!👋😊

Hello to all of my friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @hiveph community!😍

How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. Here I am again, @lj1728 to share another simple life story with you all.💕

![April 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wX5UxdgBT3RiaWLuKKadwiY3vComqA5dcht82tFSLCRxtdFNzo8S1bRCbg8TwxiLRe9.png)

Yesterday, my son and I spent a simple yet meaningful day at SM Mall as we looked for a birthday gift for my cousin, whose special day is coming this Sunday. He will be celebrating his 18th birthday. It was just a casual trip to the mall but those are often the days that turn into quiet little memories!

![IMG_6091.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMckitCGVQzGXxCypCg4kXXM6G8u3rVXx149QZyqy1nSoJUGHHkpWA32UxE1XTBeQgm.jpeg)

![IMG_6087.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wCEJZc27EvJVyPB1utKtqVnn3LCVE6C5sKZ4cLLR7n1mJ2sb8ZAoJsTY9vWA3GSAqnQ.jpeg)

We started by strolling around different stores, checking out anything that might be a good gift. I wanted something useful yet thoughtful–something my cousin would actually enjoy. After browsing for a while, we ended up at “Penshoppe”. That’s where I finally found the perfect present. I came across a perfume that instantly caught my attention. The scent was light, fresh, and perfect for the warm summer weather. It wasn’t too strong, just the right balance that made it feel clean and refreshing. I knew right away it was the one, so I did not hesitate to get it.

![IMG_6086.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23w2sp1M93CtSuAbrWb54UF937Gvf46nv1MF533RrXiyF57kqeYv7dYjnJtDFakgDCi7n.jpeg)

![IMG_6089.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xekBUx8Cqr5UQ664wg93a7Ztd3PinNiTQAbKFQeRPwZet3mBh7Cn5rvcgDsbeQcUNVG.jpeg)

After purchasing the gift, we continued walking around and stopped by the “Anta Store”. I’ve been thinking about getting new walking shoes, so I took the time to check out some styles that I might want to buy later online. The designs were really nice, and I liked how comfortable they looked. I made a mental note of the pairs I liked since I know I can find better deals in their online shop.

![IMG_6097.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23uFWDF5DAxZAumEMVwYLMUP172oiYJK2XLLoFUdSc4eXPy4ZmvXtE1HaUUaXNALKHUds.jpeg)

![IMG_6098.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23w2kyAtV6LYCcSfckuCqAPai54bVTn1w3yADrkEb1sqK3mpcSJZFKaJdtrFrbqPf5QsP.jpeg)

Feeling a bit tired from walking, we decided to take a break at the food court. It was nice to just sit down, relax, and enjoy the moment with my son. While resting, I treated myself and my son to an avocado taho. We’ve already tried their Oreo taho before, and I remember how delicious it was, so I was excited to try different flavor this time. It didn’t disappoint. It was creamy, sweet, and just perfect as a light snack.After resting for a while, we finally headed home

![IMG_6108.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ywqK4cqD7s5ECVHz4DbtcrYZjafdzopTs8yg7WcscFF2ifhqut9mvr1VR83DgURGYnn.jpeg)

![IMG_6104.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23ynbBNjD6wDbodi8yU6PC6DCLPA721ihk6dXd1LhNc4PfRedpudmHHoKAaqCmmgUiGjW.jpeg)

![IMG_6102.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23uFaXMUF7MQfU62Q1DcP7fWiyx8iEXPvZbaZy6qSLu7gK3NVB2g5UAbJx4qVRLNhEQ7v.jpeg)

And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.😍

These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.✍️👩‍💻

Lots of love,
LJ💗

title.title: Rupturas
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQHW7zYpqqgUjsXanSTz4PrwyYv6L517yiErDdPGAp1Ej/1776652742934.jpg)


Un honor estar aquí con ustedes hoy Hivers, con un lienzo algo diferente, cercano, personal.

 Resulta que las rupturas, cualesquiera que sean, nunca son fáciles de llevar. Cada cual lo dibuja a su manera y lo exterioriza de la mejor manera que puede.

Las rupturas no siempre estallan. A veces se diluyen como acuarela bajo la lluvia, dejando solo manchas de lo que fué. Por eso hoy el lienzo del blog cambia de tema.  Vengo a colgar aquí un cuento breve. Una historia pintada con los restos de un lienzo que se fue deteriorando entre dos tazas de café y una ventana empañada.

Es ficción, sí. Pero está hecha con los pigmentos de esa tristeza clara que todos reconocemos al ver un retrato roto. Ojalá alguna de estas pinceladas te roce algo conocido. Ojalá el relato te sirva de espejo o, simplemente, de compañía, reflexión, empatia.

Gracias por detenerte frente a este bastidor. Si al terminar te quedas con ganas de charlar, abajo te dejo un espacio para que me cuentes con qué colores pintas tú los finales.




EL PASO

Un paso, solo se necesita dar un paso, para salir o para llegar.
No recordaba haberse encontrado en una situación semejante en toda su vida. Ahí, en el suelo, en el lodo que recubría todo su cuerpo, los golpes le impedían pensar porque el dolor se estaba volviendo más y más intenso. La golpiza que había recibido no la esperaba. Lo tomaron desprevenido, y supo desde el primer momento que era mejor no defenderse. Nada se puede hacer cuando somos superados por la adversidad. 
Sabía muy dentro de sí que quién lo viera en ese instante y en ese lugar, correría en sentido contrario. Y no le importaba. Hasta él estaba falto de humanidad: ¿por qué necesitar la humanidad de los demás? 
En cierto modo, se avergonzaba. Todo cubierto de golpes, lodo, desnudo, lágrimas, remordimientos y dolor. Mucho dolor, infinito dolor que aun en esa situación era capaz de corromperle el alma. De pronto, todo vino claro a su mente, se sintió morir y comprendió que agonizaba: -Si solo pudiera dar un paso, pensó, y se quedó allí desplomado, mirando a las estrellas, intentando reconstruir su vida desde donde estaba. Le pidió a Dios que le diera fuerzas solo para dar un paso. 
…
Amanecía. La luz de la aurora le interrumpió el sueño al darle de lleno en la cara. Las persianas de aquel apartamento permanecían abiertas a toda hora. No era su casa pero ya la sentía como suya. Llevaba ocho años de relación, y después de haber vivido aquí y allá habían decidido asentarse. 
Sabía que no la quería. Y como hombre de mundo que se consideraba, ya ella había experimentado con él lo mejor y lo peor. Tenía consciente que la había amado: con toda el alma. Pero el tiempo y las circunstancias son capaces de cambiarlo todo en un instante, como por arte de magia. Simplemente decidió quedarse, aun sabiendo que no era feliz y que no era capaz de hacer feliz a nadie. Fue egoísta, y destructivo por una cuestión de comodidad, de cobardía, de miedo a lo que está por venir. Se paralizó y dejó de andar, de soñar, de crecer. Tomó la decisión de dar otro paso a lo que sería una vida llena de silencios, de orgasmos ayudados por fantasías, palabras recubiertas de agresiones y rencores, carente de perdón y comprensión. Solo callaba y esperaba. Lo veía venir, lo sentía dentro de sus huesos, la tempestad se aproximaba, y todo tendría que ver con aquel rostro que dormía apaciblemente a su lado. Después de todo confiaba ciegamente en aquella mujer. La que le había perdonado todo y continuaba allí, pero aun así no se engañaba, y supo mirándola dormida que a ella le costaba despertar. Sintió rabia al verla así tan apacible y un pensamiento maligno inundó todo su cuerpo. Casi podía sentirse un arma de destrucción masiva, pero la conciencia corrió en ayuda de la razón. Solo sintió que su brazo, antes portador de calamidades, se deslizó hasta la cintura de quien estaba a su lado. Se ancló a ese cuerpo, a esa vida, y como un niño se quedó dormido.
Soñaba, el sueño de aquellos que saben que le arrebatan el alma. Escuchó una canción que era portadora de apacible calma. Sintió una mano que le rozaba el pecho y buscaba. Comenzó a sentirse incomodo, no le gustaba aquellas manos, su roce, ni lo que buscaban. Miró a su lado. Allí estaba ella, mirándolo fijamente. Quiso hablarle pero ella, como enviada del infierno, se transformó en otra cosa, algo que él no conocía. Se quedó estupefacto, ¿de dónde había salido aquella mujer? No tenía nada que ver con la persona que momentos antes él había abrazado. Sabía que soñaba, y aun así no pudo evitar sentir  que todo se desmoronaba a su alrededor, de victimario a víctima. Aquellas manos eran portadoras de muerte, lo acorralaban y ofendían, lo violaban y golpeaban, lo abofeteaban y mordían. Luchó, luchó con todas sus fuerzas para separarse, pero aquellas manos tenían garras. Se preguntó si podía ser capaz de despertarse y huir. Quizás se merecía aquella pesadilla, pero ya las fuerzas le faltaban, las manos, las irremediables manos entraron haciendo un crujido de muerte dentro de su pecho. El dolor era indescriptible. No se detuvieron hasta arrancarle el corazón. Creyó que se desvanecía en el universo, que dejaba de existir, que desaparecía y así lo hizo. Lo último que escuchó fue retazos de una canción…ámame como soy, quiéreme sin temor…..
…Que voy a perder la calma…..Las palabras llegaban a su oído como un susurro. Calma, precisamente era eso lo que se podía respirar a su alrededor.
Primero, tuvo la impresión que habitaba otro cuerpo, que estaba en otro mundo, un mundo paralelo, donde a él le habían usurpado, arrancado y vilipendiado su corazón. Allí no existía la vida. Los colores que conocía ya no estaban, tampoco los olores. La ausencia de todo lo horrorizó. Solo era capaz de sentir dolor. Sintió que flotaba entre la duda y la desesperación, necesitaba algo, pero ¿qué? Lo buscaba hasta en la locura que estaba sintiendo. Miró a todos lados y solo pudo percibir oscuridad, silencio, temor, horror. Estaba inerte, gélido, confundido, y sin embargo buscaba. 
Casi al alcance de su mano había un objeto junto a él, pequeño, diminuto, casi insignificante. Si no estuviera buscando no lo habría visto, pero el brillo de aquel objeto le decía a sus entrañas que era la única salvación. Ya casi sin aliento, estiró el brazo para alcanzarlo. Sus dedos hurgaban intentando aferrarse a ese soplo de vida. Moría, y lo sabía. Un último esfuerzo, la esperanza es lo último que se pierde, decían. Nadie era capaz de saber la verdad oculta en aquellas palabras, y logró al fin tomar aquel brillo en sus manos. Para su sorpresa y alivio lo que atraparon sus dedos fue un espejo. En un esfuerzo sobrehumano lo llevo a su cara y contempló, por primera vez en mucho tiempo, lo que del otro lado proyectaba. Se encontró.
Perdido entre las sombras del destino, se aferraba a aquel objeto como si en ello le fuera la vida. Las lágrimas surcaban su rostro y caían a sus pies, como cascada. Se reconoció como un hombre desgraciado, sin alma, sin amor, traicionado, incapaz de dar un paso, un simple paso, tirado allí donde nadie le veía, gritando a viva voz. Era su vida o su muerte. El dolor, agudísimo dolor, le impedía dar un paso, pero a través del murmullo del silencio putrefacto de la angustia, un susurro casi imperceptible de tambor le hizo girar la cabeza, por su lado, iba pasando un corazón.
…
Cuando  volvió en sí, estaba de rodillas, ensangrentado, gritaba, se revolcaba en el lodo, lo intentaba: - Un paso, Dios mío, solo un paso, necesito recuperar mi corazón.




PARA CURIOSOS: El cuadro de portada se llama Separación de Edvard Munch. En la imagen, un hombre vestido de negro (el color del luto y la desesperación) se lleva una mano ensangrentada al pecho, mientras la mujer, de blanco, mira al mar con su largo cabello flotando hacia él, sugiriendo que aún están unidos a pesar de que ella lo está dejando. Este juego de colores refleja un corazón que sangra, un amor que se desgarra.


La foto y referencia al cuadro fué tomada de Google. El cuento o microrelato( como quieran llamarlo)es de mi autoría.

title.title: Dấu hiệu nhận biết mang thai sớm nhất bạn cần lưu ý
title.body:
Dấu hiệu nhận biết mang thai sớm nhất thường xuất hiện khá sớm nhưng dễ bị bỏ qua do nhầm lẫn với thay đổi nội tiết hoặc chu kỳ kinh nguyệt. Việc nhận diện đúng giúp phụ nữ chủ động theo dõi sức khỏe và có kế hoạch chăm sóc phù hợp. Bài viết dưới  đây từ PhenikaaMec cung cấp thông tin giúp bạn hiểu rõ những biểu hiện quan trọng trong giai đoạn đầu.

▶️▶️▶️ Tham khảo thêm:

<https://suckhoedoisong.vn/nhan-biet-som-dau-hieu-mang-thai-thang-dau-chia-khoa-bao-ve-thai-ky-tu-som-169251231163434741.htm>

<https://www.deviantart.com/sonyasaran/journal/Dau-hieu-cua-mang-thai-som-trong-nhung-tuan-dau-1323716841>

\-


## **Dấu hiệu nhận biết mang thai sớm nhất cần lưu ý**

Dấu hiệu nhận biết mang thai sớm nhất thường liên quan đến sự thay đổi hormone trong cơ thể. Các biểu hiện có thể xuất hiện riêng lẻ hoặc đồng thời, mức độ khác nhau tùy từng người:

*   Trễ kinh: Đây là dấu hiệu phổ biến nhất, đặc biệt ở phụ nữ có chu kỳ kinh đều. Nếu chậm kinh vài ngày trở lên, cần nghĩ đến khả năng mang thai.

*   Căng tức ngực: Vùng ngực trở nên nhạy cảm, đau nhẹ hoặc căng hơn do hormone thai kỳ tăng cao.

*   Mệt mỏi, buồn ngủ: Cơ thể dễ rơi vào trạng thái thiếu năng lượng, cần nghỉ ngơi nhiều hơn so với bình thường.

*   Buồn nôn, thay đổi khẩu vị: Có thể xuất hiện cảm giác buồn nôn nhẹ, chán ăn hoặc nhạy cảm với mùi, dù chưa rõ rệt như giai đoạn nghén.

*   Đi tiểu nhiều lần: Tần suất đi tiểu tăng lên do thay đổi nội tiết và tăng lưu lượng máu đến thận.

*   Ra máu báo thai: Một lượng máu rất ít, màu hồng nhạt hoặc nâu, xuất hiện trong thời gian ngắn khi phôi làm tổ.

Những dấu hiệu này mang tính gợi ý và dễ nhầm lẫn với biểu hiện trước kỳ kinh. Vì vậy, cần theo dõi kết hợp thay vì dựa vào một dấu hiệu đơn lẻ.


## **Khi nào cần kiểm tra và thăm khám?**

Phụ nữ nên kiểm tra khi xuất hiện các dấu hiệu nghi ngờ kéo dài, đặc biệt là trễ kinh kèm mệt mỏi, căng tức ngực hoặc buồn nôn. Đây là thời điểm phù hợp để sử dụng que thử thai nhằm xác định bước đầu.

Nếu que thử cho kết quả dương tính, việc thăm khám tại cơ sở y tế nên được thực hiện sớm để xác nhận bằng xét nghiệm và siêu âm. Trường hợp kết quả âm tính nhưng vẫn trễ kinh hoặc có biểu hiện bất thường, việc kiểm tra cũng cần được tiến hành để xác định nguyên nhân.

Tại PhenikaaMec, người bệnh được hướng dẫn kiểm tra đúng thời điểm và theo dõi thai kỳ từ sớm, giúp đảm bảo an toàn và chủ động trong chăm sóc sức khỏe.

## **Kết luận**

Dấu hiệu nhận biết mang thai sớm nhất như trễ kinh, mệt mỏi, căng tức ngực hay buồn nôn giúp bạn có định hướng ban đầu. Tuy nhiên, các biểu hiện này không đủ để khẳng định chắc chắn. Chủ động kiểm tra và thăm khám theo khuyến nghị từ PhenikaaMec giúp xác định chính xác và đảm bảo theo dõi thai kỳ an toàn ngay từ những tuần đầu.

title.title: Bagre frito con empanado de especias/Fried catfish in a spiced batter 🐟🍽
title.body:
> Hello gente! Qué tal todo? Ayer estuvo de visita en casa uno de mis primos y nos trajo de regalo un bagre bastante grande, de hecho el más grande que había visto hasta ahora, y lo mejor de todo es que ya estaba compuesto y cortado en ruedas, es decir, listo para cocinar, así que estuve buscando recetas para prepararlo ya que jamás lo había preparado antes y de hecho la única forma en que lo había comido era guisado hace un montón de tiempo, por lo que estaba bastante perdida sobre cómo prepararlo y entre muchas recetas decidí preparar **bagre frito**.
Hello everyone! How are you all doing? One of my cousins came round yesterday and brought us a rather large catfish as a gift – in fact, the biggest I’ve ever seen – and best of all, it was already cleaned and cut into slices, meaning it was ready to cook, so I was looking for recipes to cook it, as I’d never prepared it before and, in fact, the only way I’d ever eaten it was in a stew ages ago, so I was quite at a loss as to how to cook it. After looking through lots of recipes, I decided to make **fried catfish**.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkQLSsGSKZuR2Bj82j8CV4tTgdmjCJAAVcw5sjs89G1C/1776653207939.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) La primera búsqueda que hice para saber qué haría fue *\

* y el buen Google me dijo que frito, así que frito sería, y entre las muchas recetas que encontré estaba una con un empanado seco a base de harina de maíz y una mezcla de especias que jamás pensé que se usarían en el pescado, pero que resultaron muy acertadas y le dieron al bagre un gran sabor. Y ahora sin más vueltas vamos con la receta.

<blockquote>

The first thing I searched for to find out what to make was *\

* and good old Google told me to fry it, so fry it I would. Among the many recipes I found was one with a dry coating made from cornflour and a mixture of spices that I never thought would be used on fish, but which turned out to be spot on and gave the catfish a great flavour. And now, without further ado, let’s get on with the recipe. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbubQbFhgWKCkwkKbdQGoR9C62HLDBwf9DYsJpjPyVNtu/1776653419374.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes Bagre en ruedas 1 limón 1 taza de harina de maíz amarillo 1/2 taza de harina de trigo 1 cucharada de paprika 1 cucharadita de pimienta 1 cucharadita de jengibre 1/4 de cucharadita de nuez moscada 1 cucharadita de laurel Sal Aceite
## Ingredients Catfish in batter 1 lemon 1 cup yellow cornflour 1/2 cup plain flour 1 tablespoon paprika 1 teaspoon pepper 1 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg 1 teaspoon bay leaf Salt Oil
## Procedimiento/Procedure Lo primero que haremos es lavar las ruedas de pescado y dejarlas en agua con limón por una hora.
The first thing we’ll do is wash the fish fillets and leave them to soak in lemon water for an hour.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaZYXa41L2KSbo2GFovQ16yfy1bHEzqabUTHLZ47GST2/1776653208293.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Transcurrido el tiempo de espera retiramos el pescado del agua, le agregamos sal y pimienta y preparamos el empanado, y para ello solo agregamos los dos tipos de harina en un envase junto con todas las especias y sal, mezclamos todo muy bien y estamos listos para empanar nuestras ruedas de bagre.
Once the soaking time is up, remove the fish from the water, season with salt and pepper, and prepare the breadcrumb coating. To do this, simply combine the two types of flour in a bowl with all the spices and salt, mix everything together thoroughly, and you’re ready to coat your catfish fillets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmFUoPWnsAasW5C8erpgznhFPFvLjQLVzchGD9FQNaCn/1776653208544.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbMamByfC88mx312HMrPdj2DMMLaNQHJdbQfUKkQTrmJq/1776653208822.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcT9Va8QFJow8TrNsFMvGzf57ZXERL5x5kWPxX5s5D4Dn/1776653209054.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Calentamos la sartén y agregamos suficiente aceite para freír y mientras el aceite se calienta pasamos nuestras ruedas de pescado por la mezcla de harina y especias por ambos lados y freímos a fuego medio bajo hasta dorar.
Heat the frying pan and add enough oil for frying. Whilst the oil is heating, coat the fish slices in the flour and spice mixture on both sides, then fry over a medium-low heat until golden brown.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6cW73wrfQuYGYCciwV3Rz5dRxR2XFZGUoiWfCLaJDRw/1776653418654.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYxnwAFfm4rE4bUXF54mAwHTmR7ZkoS4EqPtTwonYcyB1/1776653418929.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQ5LNsyonx5DbizpRNdftmnmjZ5biLVbcKpCPUKMPUkG/1776653419158.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY797rUtmtDn51NL1mTSY65pu8QjFsvYqWU38yXF2kwL4/1776653419649.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El tiempo de cocción va a depender de cuán gruesas sean las ruedas de bagre, en mi caso les dí 8 minutos por ambos lados y les cuento que quedaron realmente deliciosas con muchísimo sabor y con una textura bien crujiente, así que si no han preparado el bagre de esta manera los invito a probarlo porque les aseguro no se arrepentirán.
The cooking time will depend on how thick the catfish fillets are; in my case, I cooked them for 8 minutes on each side, and I can tell you they turned out absolutely delicious – full of flavour and with a lovely crispy texture. So, if you haven’t tried cooking catfish this way before, I urge you to give it a go – I promise you won’t regret it.

title.title: absolute laziness. My Actifit Diary: April 19 2026

9pm and I have nothing to show for. In traditional terms. Okay, we did go to the market in the morning, but since then – nothing. What a beautiful lazy day! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0139e450-48a7-4588-b159-04875381443b.jpg) We stayed at home all day watching Malcolm. Even the new episodes, which aren’t half as bad as the media wants us to believe. If coming right from the old series, diving into the super small new one is a lot of fun. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/256cda8a-fe25-45b0-89dc-8d841c34e281.jpg) I walked Ellie home around 6pm, that’s why I count more than 2k steps. And it poured! I got absolutely soaked and I don’t regret a thing. It was quite awesome. I enjoy water, and since I was soaked, I did some stupid things like standing within the flow of water. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/441d45cb-4a21-44af-a828-187a42f6884b.jpg) I also helped a neighbor who was trying to get her mango cart inside. She wasn’t soaked yet, so I took care of everything within the rain and water. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/300c08cc-9ad3-4ab2-a7d3-50ff1357fa6c.jpg) She said she’d give me some green mango with vinegar next time she sees me, since I refused to take the candy apple. I prefer sour stuff… Not that she had to give me anything, but those gestures are important among neighbors. Give and take. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9e3d4fae-1d72-4286-8c09-e7b74828a41a.jpg) And now it’s 9.30pm and I’m already super tired. Probably going directly to bed. Sleep well! body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 18 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3943fc43-ac39-4181-b5ec-7ebb963e859f.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Yesterday was supposed to be really busy but in the end, it was pretty much the same as usual. But since the sun showed up for a bit, we started a long walk in the afternoon. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a6ff5f95-106c-47f8-915c-7c81369737ce.jpg) Le Chat was in the area, checking if it was safe. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5af14975-0a08-4079-b236-2b03af7f98ad.jpg) It was so she quickly joined Kaia. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/34bcd479-b66d-4610-91b6-c06ce392cff0.jpg) At least until we went to the bigger forest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0d4bf040-f37b-4d02-af5b-929fe1a6d5b4.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c71728ec-04c1-42ff-9f22-5c5118bdd756.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/85f9351b-da0f-4c11-a0c6-ebfb9b90ebfa.jpg) We met a few deer, but for once I didn't want Kaia to bother them too much, so we stayed far from them. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/316bea4d-1d6d-4fa4-8271-70130c851d55.jpg) We.made a quick detour near the teepees, as often when we have extra time. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/78d10748-4269-4513-a909-b79d28f9fae3.jpg) After hiding for a while, the sun was back, albeit behind the trees. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/77c74d52-4c0b-457a-9efa-30056039b94c.jpg) So we tried to catch the sunset again, but the clouds made it difficult. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e7489415-a951-43ab-b369-22aa92abe740.jpg) And of course, we finished with the same usual cut through the forest to get us on our way back home. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ec1a4641-9b15-4450-b5d9-5efe19816e85.jpg) Just a few more reflections in the neighborhood, and our walk was complete. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7fd55509-6d66-4f64-962b-498aff3fea5c.jpg) We were supposed to go see Puscifer (in case you don't know them, it's one of the side projects of Maynard James Keenes, Tool frontman) at the Fox Theater I'm Detroit. But I didn't feel well again, third time in about a week, maybe I need to see a doctor. So eventually it was a mostly quiet night. But good news, my step count was pretty good, well above the bar for #poprzeczka competition. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260420t024307045z)_

body.title: A lovely family lunch, perfect for celebrating a loved one's birthday.
body.body:
>
![GridArt_20260419_215313732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKGakygbPT8wBmgritkvubE1HwwuSboLvt3pQSMuPK2aaNvn6SA78hB1BwRoWBW.jpg)
Maravilloso domingo tengan todos mis queridísimos amigos con lectores y seguidores y les recibo con un cariñoso abrazo de bienvenida a mi blog personal, esperando que hayan tenido un fin de semana muy productivo aprovechando cada momento para disfrutar y compartir con la familia y seres queridos, en esta oportunidad, aprovecho para regalarles un almuerzo familiar para honrar el cumpleaños #16 de un año más de vida de mi sobrino adorado. Como ya he comentado en otras publicaciones, a inicios de este mes específicamente el día 2 estuvo de cumpleaños mi sobrino Eduardo Sebastián y para ese día sumamente mega especial para toda la familia, sus padres decidieron preparar un delicioso almuerzo para degustar en compañía del resto de la familia, por supuesto para ese día lo consintieron con una sus comidas preferida como es un arroz chino a la marinera acompañado pan y gaseosa.
